name: Běh na Kraví horu
location: Kraví hora, Teplice nad Metují, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Kraví hora is a public mass-start hill race held in the picturesque setting of Kraví hora in Teplice nad Metují. The race is part of the hill-running series and challenges athletes with a demanding climb and beautiful views. It has a long-standing tradition and is popular with runners who want to test their strength on mountain terrain. The event is organised by Redpoint Teplice nad Metují, which ensures high-quality organisation and a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: A demanding mass-start hill race
Picturesque setting of Kraví hora in Teplice nad Metují
Part of the hill-running series and hill-running league
additional: The race takes place on urban and hilly terrain. Registration and results are managed using professional chip timing. Parking and travel information are available on the website.

name: Zátopkova pětka
location: Stadion Emila Zátopka, Kopřivnice, Czech Republic
description: Zátopka’s Five is a traditional running race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletic Club in Kopřivnice. The race takes place on the cinder track at Emil Zátopek Stadium and is part of the Lašská Running League. It is open to the general public and offers the opportunity to run on a quality athletics track in a pleasant sporting atmosphere. The race has a long tradition and is popular with runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Race on the cinder track at Emil Zátopek Stadium
Part of the Lašská Running League
Pleasant atmosphere and quality athletics facilities
additional: The race is part of the Lašská Running League and is open to adults and young people. It is organized by Atletický klub Emila Zátopka Kopřivnice, z.s. Registration takes place online via the official entry form. The club also has active sections for children and young people, with their own contacts and coaches. The previous edition documented in the sources took place in October 2025 and started in three waves. Details about registration or the entry fee for the 2026 edition have not been confirmed in the cited sources.

name: Prešovská hodinovka na tartane
organizer: BK ZasRun, Olympijský klub Prešov, AK TJ Slávia Prešovská univerzita
description: The Prešov Tartan Track Hour is a running race held at the Prešov University athletics stadium in Prešov. The competition is open to men and women in various age categories and offers a unique opportunity to test your endurance and speed on a tartan track. It is organized by BK ZasRun Šarišské Bohdanovce, Olympijský klub Prešov and AK TJ Slávia Prešovská univerzita. The race is suited to runners looking to experience a high-quality athletics atmosphere and compete in the pleasant surroundings of a university stadium.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the tartan track at the Prešov University athletics stadium
Categories are divided by age and gender (Men A, Men B, Women F, Women G)
The start and finish are on a high-quality athletics surface in Prešov
additional: The event also offers online registration and takes place on 15 October 2026 at the university athletics stadium in Prešov.

name: Běh Heulosem - memoriál Jiřího Šmrhy
location: Lesopark Heulos, Jihlava, Vysočina, Czech Republic
description: The Heulos Run – Jiří Šmrha Memorial is a traditional running race held in Heulos Forest Park in Jihlava. The race offers various categories and distances for men, women, veterans, juniors, youth and children, with colour-coded circuits along the park’s paths and trails. The event has a long history dating back to 1977 and is part of the Vysočina Runners series. It starts in the afternoon at the Na Stoupách athletics stadium, and its courses are suitable for a wide range of runners, from the youngest participants to veterans.
course_highlights: Colour-coded circuits along the paths and trails of Heulos Forest Park
Various distances, from 300 m for the youngest participants to 9 km for men and veterans
Start and finish at the Na Stoupách athletics stadium in Jihlava
additional: Categories include men, women, veterans, juniors, youth and children, with different race distances. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category, and young participants receive medals and prizes. This is the 49th edition, supported by the statutory city of Jihlava and the Czech Sports Office. The race is open to the general public, offers trail courses in nature, and is part of the Vysočina running cup. The date is 16 October 2026.

name: Gladiator Race Praha
location: Přírodní park Čihadla, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Gladiator Race Prague is a challenging obstacle race set in Čihadla Nature Park on the outskirts of Prague. The race combines relatively flat running sections with water, mud, and challenging obstacles, including a net above a water sluice. This ninth edition brings a unique atmosphere, new challenges, and the camaraderie that participants have come to love. Various race categories are available for adults, children, and dogs, making the event appealing to a wide range of participants.
course_highlights: Čihadla Nature Park, with a combination of relatively flat running sections
Challenging obstacles, including a net above a water sluice
Plenty of water and mud on a varied running course
additional: Mass start in waves of up to 50 participants. The race is timed using wristband chips, with online results. Facilities and services include changing rooms, baggage storage, parking, medical service, toilets, showers, catering, race photos and video, sportswear and footwear sales, and a Gladiator Race photo wall. Race capacity is 2,000 places. Categories: ORIGINAL: 6+ km and 30+ obstacles; NIGHT: 3+ km and 15+ obstacles; RUN: 4+ km and 20+ obstacles; KIDS: 1–2 km and 10–12 obstacles; DOG: 3+ km and 15+ obstacles. Starts are in waves of up to 50 participants; capacity across all categories is 2,000 places.

name: Stovka Považím - Považie ultra trail
description: Stovka Považím is a challenging long-distance hike and ultra trail in the beautiful Považie region, intended for experienced ultrarunners and walkers. Each year, it offers an original and extremely demanding course. Course A is part of the Czech-Slovak Ultratrail Cup and the first stage of the Extreme Ultra Trail Combination. The event takes place in Trenčín and the surrounding area, with several course options and luggage transport between the start and finish. Participants can stay overnight in the gym at ZŠ Predmier, adding to their comfort.
course_highlights: An extremely demanding and original course through the Považie region
Course A is part of the Czech-Slovak Ultratrail Cup (CSUT)
Luggage transport between the start and finish is available for all courses
additional: Participant check-in takes place on Friday evening in Trenčín and on Saturday morning in Ladce and Považská Bystrica. The finish-area facilities close on Sunday at 18:00 in Predmier. Participants on the shorter courses can stay overnight in the gym at ZŠ Predmier from Friday evening. Luggage must be securely closed; the organizer is not responsible for valuables. The 2026 edition is scheduled for 16–18 October, with a start at 23:00. Course A is part of the Czech-Slovak Ultratrail Cup and the first stage of the Extreme Ultra Trail Combination.

name: Půlmaraton Český les
location: Nemanice, Český les, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 500 Kč předem / 600 Kč na místě (21 km), 300 Kč předem / 400 Kč na místě (7 km)
description: The Český les Half Marathon is a traditional trail race held amid the picturesque nature of the Český les in the village of Nemanice. The event offers two routes: 21 km with 520 m of elevation gain and 7 km with 80 m of elevation gain. Both run through beautiful countryside, and GPX routes are available to download. The longer route awards overall winners and age-group winners, while the shorter route recognizes the three fastest men and women. The start and finish are in Nemanice, with parking available at the start.
course_highlights: 21 km route with 520 m of elevation gain through the Český les
7 km route with 80 m of elevation gain, suitable for fast runners
Start and finish in Nemanice, with parking at the event venue
additional: Parking is available at the start and finish. On the 21 km route, overall winners and 10 age categories for men and women are recognized. On the 7 km route, the three fastest men and three fastest women are awarded. GPX routes for the race are available to download. A trail race with downloadable GPX routes, registration, and categories for men and women; the race is part of the Trail Running Cup series.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (11) – říjnový
description: The 5 and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY is a regular running race in Prague’s Braník district, offering a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava. The race is part of the 16th edition of the running league, where runners can compare themselves with others and with their own previous performances. The course is certified, and the 10 km distance gives runners the opportunity to achieve the qualifying time for the Czech Championships. After the race, enjoy a relaxed atmosphere, refreshments and an awards ceremony for the top runners.
course_highlights: A pleasant, fast course along the Vltava in Prague’s Braník district
Course measured by a certified course measurer
Opportunity to achieve the qualifying time for the Czech Championships in the 10 km race
additional: Registration from 18:00; 10 km starts at 19:00 and 5 km at 19:05. Refreshments and an awards ceremony for the top runners after the race. Luggage storage is available in the organisers’ tent. Recommended parking: P+R Nádraží Braník; public transport: trams and buses. Free sports drink after the race. The race is part of a league offering rewards for top-performing and loyal runners, including medals and prizes from partners. Registration is through the website. Winners and regular runners can win prizes; the race is part of a series of races in Prague.

name: Běh kolem Ameriky
location: Lesní park Amerika, Písek, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Běh kolem Ameriky (Run Around Amerika) is the oldest forest running race in the Czech Republic and the third-oldest running race overall. It has been held since 1925 in the Amerika Forest Park in Písek. This off-road race has a history spanning more than 100 editions and offers a challenging 10.4 km course that has evolved over the years. It is popular with runners and local residents and is known for its history and atmosphere in a natural setting. It is organized by Atletika Písek, z.s., and is internationally recognized thanks to partnerships with towns in England and Germany.
course_highlights: Forest terrain in Amerika nature park
A 10.4 km course with historical significance
A traditional race with more than 100 years of history
additional: The race takes place in Amerika Forest Park in Písek and is the oldest off-road running race in the Czech Republic. It is organized by Atletika Písek, z.s. The race has a rich history, with several categories, and is internationally recognized. The 100th anniversary edition will take place in 2026. In the past, the race was interrupted several times (1942, 2020). The oldest forest running race in the Czech Republic, an off-road course, the 100th anniversary edition in 2026.

name: ČEZ RunTour Pardubice
location: Velké pardubické závodiště, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: ČEZ RunTour Pardubice is a family-friendly running event offering seven different races for all ages and ability levels. With distances ranging from 500 metres for the youngest runners to a half marathon, everyone can find their own challenge. The race takes place at the Velká pardubická racecourse and, alongside the sporting experience, offers a varied programme for the whole family. Participants receive a race pack and contribute to charity. The atmosphere is friendly and welcoming to both recreational and elite runners.
course_highlights: Distances include 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km, plus children’s races of 500 and 1,000 m
Start and finish at the Velká pardubická racecourse, with its unique atmosphere
Refreshment stations along the course; at least two on the half-marathon route
additional: The race offers a special emergency medical service phone line during the event. Every runner receives a gymsack with gifts from partners. Children receive a Lidl race pack, and there is a supervised kids’ corner. Pacers are on the course to help runners achieve their target times. Refreshments are available at the finish for children’s races, with refreshment stations on the longer routes. The event includes multiple distances, participant medals, refreshment stations, changing rooms, showers, medical support and post-race photography.

name: Běh podél Halštrova
location: Pramen Halštrova, Aš, Karlovy Vary, Czech Republic
description: The Run Along the Halštrov is a traditional race organised by the Jasan Aš Ski Club. It takes place in October near the source of the Halštrov. The race offers a running experience in the beautiful natural surroundings of Aš and the surrounding area, suitable for active athletes and runners looking for a challenge. Jasan Aš is known for its long-standing tradition and support for running activities in the region.
course_highlights: The course follows the source of the Halštrov through a natural setting
Beautiful views and forest terrain around Aš
The race is part of Jasan Aš’s autumn running calendar
additional: The event marks the end of the running season, offers refreshments at the finish, and is open to the general public, including children.

name: Od radnice k radnici
organizer: Okresní sdružení České unie sportu Náchod
description: From Town Hall to Town Hall is a traditional children’s running race organized by the Náchod District Association of the Czech Union of Sport. In 2026, the event will take place for the 7th time, offering several age categories for children, with distances ranging from 150 to 1,200 meters. The race is intended primarily for young runners and encourages children’s participation in sport in the Náchod region. Starts begin at 9:00 a.m. and proceed by age category. The event is part of the wider ČUS sports program in the region.
course_highlights: Categories range from the youngest children (born in 2021 or later) to older pupils (born in 2011–2012)
Distances from 150 m to 1,200 m, adapted to age
Starts are organized by category, according to a schedule running from 9:00 to 10:25
additional: The race is divided into categories by year of birth, with a precise start schedule. Results from previous editions are available online. The event is part of the wider Czech Union of Sport program in the Náchod region. It takes place as part of the regional sports calendar; registration is via sportchallenge.cz, and it is suitable for all age groups.

name: Silniční běh Hronov-Náchod
description: The Hronov–Náchod Road Run is a traditional race with a long history, connecting the towns of Hronov and Náchod. It starts at Hronov Town Hall and finishes at Náchod Town Hall. The race gives runners of all levels the chance to enjoy a beautiful course through picturesque surroundings. It is popular with locals and visitors alike and creates a friendly sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Road course connecting the towns of Hronov and Náchod
Start and finish at the town halls of both towns
Picturesque surroundings in Eastern Bohemia
additional: Start at 11:00. The course includes asphalt and cobbled roads. The race is open to the general public.

name: Malá křivoklátská
description: Malá křivoklátská is a traditional forest run with a long history dating back to 1973. It takes place in the picturesque valley of the Rakovnický Stream below Křivoklát Castle. The main race is 6,000 metres long and consists of two laps over gently undulating terrain, combining forest trails, paved roads and a ford across the stream. Children can take part in a 600-metre schoolchildren’s race on a flat course at the Kolečko sports ground. Race facilities are at the Kolečko sports ground, which belongs to Sokol Křivoklát, the event organiser.
course_highlights: Forest run in the Rakovnický Stream valley below Křivoklát Castle
The 6,000 m main course consists of two laps, with elevation changes and a ford across the stream
Flat 600 m schoolchildren’s course at the Kolečko sports ground
additional: Race facilities and the start/finish are at the Kolečko sports ground. The main race has a mass start, and the course crosses footbridges and a ford over the Rakovnický Stream. The schoolchildren’s race is a 600 m loop at Kolečko, run over 1–3 laps depending on age. The course is measurable and comparable with previous editions dating back to 1975. The course is set in a natural environment; registration and further information are probably available on the website. The course includes forest and urban sections, and the main race consists of two 3,000 m laps.

name: Běh okolo Lemberka
location: Jablonné v Podještědí, Liberec, Czech Republic
organizer: Sportovní klub ZŠ Jablonné v Podještědí
description: Běh okolo Lemberka is a traditional autumn running race held near the chapel by Markvartický Pond, between Jablonné v Podještědí and Lvová. The race offers various distances, from children’s categories to adult 5 km and 10 km races, including relays. The course starts on the green hiking trail, and the race is part of the Českolipská District Running League. Participants have access to limited changing facilities, and category winners receive diplomas and prizes.
course_highlights: Courses follow the green hiking trail between Jablonné v Podještědí and Lvová
Distances range from 50 m for children to 10,000 m for adults and veterans
The race is part of the Českolipská District Running League – For the Českolipský deník Cup
additional: Registration from 8:30 a.m. at the start and finish area. Limited men’s and women’s changing facilities are available in a tent near the start. The first three finishers in each category receive a diploma and a prize. Veteran categories are offered only over 10,000 m. The race is part of the Českolipská District Running League – For the Českolipský deník Cup. Course distances range from 300 m to 10,000 m; veteran categories, relays and a public run are available. Registration from 8:30 a.m.; start at 9:30 a.m. Limited changing facilities are available in a tent.

name: Malá Kunratická
location: Kunratický les, Praha 4-Kunratice, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Malá Kunratická is a traditional running race in Kunratice Forest in Prague, now in its 23rd edition. The race offers a 3-kilometre course starting in the southern part of the forest near Kunratický Mill. It is open to the general public and is part of a sports and entertainment afternoon in Nové Roztyly Park, where participants and visitors can try various activities such as slacklining and disc golf. The race is scheduled to start in the morning, making for an enjoyable sporting get-together in nature.
course_highlights: A 3-kilometre course in Kunratice Forest
Start in the southern part of the forest near Kunratický Mill
A run in a natural setting, with the option to enjoy additional sports activities in Nové Roztyly Park
additional: The race is part of a sports and entertainment afternoon in Nové Roztyly Park, with activities including slacklining, sack races, a spider climbing frame and disc golf. The race includes various categories and is part of the SABZO series, with a cross-country course in the natural setting of Krč Forest.

name: Heimstaden Havířovská desítka
location: Náměstí Republiky, Havířov, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 290 Kč - 700 Kč (on the day), 4000 Kč - 5000 Kč (team categories)
description: The Heimstaden Havířovská Desítka is a traditional running race held in the centre of Havířov, offering several categories and distances for the general public, including children’s races and relays. The course follows two laps through the city centre, with the start and finish at Republic Square, where fans and spectators add to the atmosphere. The race has a charitable purpose and supports athletes with disabilities from the HSC Moravia club. The 10th-anniversary edition attracted a record number of participants and prominent sporting figures, including Pavel Maslák. Registration is also available on race day, and the event supports corporate well-being and teamwork.
course_highlights: 10 km run through the centre of Havířov (2 laps)
The course runs through the city centre, with the finish at Republic Square
Professional electronic chip timing
additional: Registration is available until 11:00 on race day at the Lučina Cultural Centre. The race is designated as the Czech Republic Veterans’ Road Running Championship. Race packs can be collected at the company’s headquarters. The race supports athletes with disabilities from the HSC Moravia club, with part of the entry fee going towards their activities. Corporate teams are offered a 12-week training plan and online consultations with a coach. Refreshments are provided on the course and after the race. A financial prize is awarded for breaking the course record. Race over 2 laps, prize money, discounts for locals and tenants, relay race, corporate categories, online training support

name: Plesenská 7 Plesná – Skalná

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné: 100 Kč = pomoc tam, kde je potřeba

description: Plesenská sedmička is a charity running race held as part of a series of seven races in different towns. The fifth race will take place in Skalná over a course of approximately 5.2 km, following forest trails and paved roads. The start and finish are at the sports hall in Skalná. The race takes place in the evening in low visibility, so a headlamp or another light source is mandatory. Proceeds from the entry fees go to charity, and the atmosphere is friendly and encourages runners to push their limits.
course_highlights: Course length: approx. 5.2 km
Surface: forest trails and paved roads
Start and finish at the sports hall in Skalná
additional: Registration opens at 19:00 on race day. The race takes place in all weather conditions and may be cancelled only if a risk of danger in the forest is officially declared. The results are expected to be announced at approximately 21:00 after the race. Refreshments, including homemade cakes and drinks, will be available. Each race has a sponsor who prepares a prize package for one runner; the winner is drawn from among the participants. Registration opens at 19:00. Parking is available by the sports hall in Skalná; refreshments, including homemade cakes and drinks, will be available at the venue. The race takes place in all weather conditions, and participation is at your own risk.

name: NN NIGHT RUN České Budějovice
location: Náměstí Přemysla Otakara II., České Budějovice, Czech Republic

price_tiers.distance: BELLIS RUN proti rakovině prsu - 5 Km

description: NN NIGHT RUN České Budějovice is one of the largest running events in České Budějovice, held in Přemysl Otakar II Square. This night run offers the atmosphere of the city illuminated by headlamps and is open to runners of all ages and abilities. More than 2,000 runners take part each year, from beginners to experienced racers. The programme also includes children’s races and charity runs, alongside the main 10 km race.
course_highlights: A night run through České Budějovice, with the city illuminated by headlamps
The main race course is 10 km long, with a 90-minute time limit
Children’s races and a charity run against breast cancer over shorter distances
additional: The programme includes children’s races, a charity run against breast cancer, a 2 × 5 km relay and the main 10 km night run. Race packs are available from 13:00, and the bag drop and changing rooms are open from 14:00. The event also features a programme of performances, warm-ups, sports product testing, a photo booth, tattoos and a raffle. The time limit is 90 minutes for the main race and 75 minutes for the charity run. According to the organisers, online registration is open until 13 October 2026 at 18:00, or on site subject to capacity. The main race has a 90-minute time limit; BELLIS RUN has a 75-minute limit and can also be completed as a brisk walk.

name: Ultramaraton Zapomenuté hory
location: Areál Račího údolí, Uhelná, Czech Republic
description: The Forgotten Mountains Ultramarathon is an autumn trail race that takes you along superb mountain trails to the most remote parts of the Rychlebské Mountains. The routes pass through deep valleys, remote ridges and beautiful viewpoints, including the highest peak of the neighbouring Góry Bialskie in Poland. The race offers three route options of varying distances and difficulty, suitable for experienced runners seeking wild nature and unforgettable experiences. The event also includes an evening programme of talks and entertainment. We look forward to welcoming everyone who wants to discover these forgotten mountains as few have before.
course_highlights: The routes follow superb mountain trails along the main border ridge and side ridges of the Rychlebské Mountains
Beautiful views from deserted rocky outcrops, old quarries and mountain meadows around former Sudeten settlements
Very little running on asphalt; the routes are mostly forest trails and footpaths
additional: Registration is closed. The remaining option is to purchase an entry from another participant. Runners are divided into two age categories (up to 39 and 40+). The fee includes a forest fee, map, race number, chip timing, a GPS tracker for the long route, a finisher’s diploma, generous refreshments along the course and hot soup at the finish (vegan and non-vegan options). This year, the gym has changed; alternative accommodation is available in Javorník for 150 Kč per night. The start and finish are at the Račí údolí grounds. Registration for the race is closed; participation is only possible by buying an entry from another runner.

name: Krumlovský běh
location: Orlovna, Rakšice, Moravský Krumlov, Czech Republic
description: The Krumlov Run is a road race held in Moravský Krumlov, in Rakšice at the Orlovna complex. It offers courses of 10.9 km for men and 4.5 km for women, on asphalt and nearby roads. The race is suitable for recreational runners and families with children, as it also includes children’s races and a run for health. It is organized by AC Moravský Krumlov under the direction of Mgr. Zuzana Marková. Registration is available on a separate page, and the race is part of the Český běh running series.
course_highlights: The courses run on asphalt and nearby roads
Course distances: 10.9 km (men) and 4.5 km (women)
Includes a run for health, a recreational run, and children’s races
additional: Registration is available on the external page http://registrace.atletika-mk.cz. The race is part of the Český běh running series and is suitable for the general public, including children. It is organized by AC Moravský Krumlov; the contact person is Mgr. Zuzana Marková. The race takes place in Rakšice near the Orlovna complex. Registration: http://registrace.atletika-mk.cz.

name: Altmühltrail
price_range: ca. 28-56 € je nach Strecke und Anmeldedatum
description: The Altmühltrail 2026 takes place on October 17 in Dollnstein in the Altmühltal Nature Park and offers a unique trail-running experience combining sport, nature and enjoyment. The route leads over challenging trails, past impressive rock formations, through dense forests and across scenic ridges. Refreshment stations serving regional specialties add to the experience. The children’s race, which includes a trail obstacle course, also gives young runners the chance to gain their first experience.
course_highlights: Challenging trails through the Altmühltal
Impressive rock formations and dense forests
Refreshment stations serving regional specialties along the route
additional: Start times: long-distance hikers and Nordic walkers without timing at 09:30; timed long-distance runners at 11:30; timed short-distance runners at 12:00; short-distance hikers and Nordic walkers without timing at 12:15. Race-pack collection is available the previous day from 17:30 to 18:30 and on race day from 8:30 to 12:00 (children’s race packs available only until 10:00). Registration opens on February 16, 2026, at 16:02. Capacity fills quickly; a waiting list is available. Registration for the children’s race is still open separately. Participation is possible in trail running, Nordic walking or hiking. Refreshments, showers, an awards ceremony and age restrictions.

name: Bad Dürkheimer Berglauf mit RLP-Meisterschaft
location: Sporthalle der Berufsbildenden Schulen, Bad Dürkheim, Bad Dürkheim, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The 29th Bad Dürkheim Mountain Race with the Rhineland-Palatinate Championships takes place on 17 October 2026. The route leads from the sports hall of the vocational schools in Bad Dürkheim up to the Bismarck Tower on the Peterskopf. Over a distance of 8.7 km, runners climb 510 metres, mostly on varied forest paths and trails with stones, roots and steps. The race is a DLV-sanctioned competition with several age categories and a team classification. Alongside the sporting competition, the event offers a friendly atmosphere, refreshments and return transport for participants.
course_highlights: 8.7 km route with 510 metres of elevation gain
Start at 123 m above sea level, finish at the Bismarck Tower at 493 m above sea level
Varied natural terrain with forest paths, narrow trails, stones, roots and steps
additional: The entry fee includes federation and mountain-running cup fees, timing, a rental chip (to be returned at the finish), a clothing bag and transport for clothing, a sports drink, bananas, a rental cup (to be returned at the finish), a photo frame, the bus journey back, a sparkling-wine stand along the return route, and free certificate printing via my.raceresult.com. On-site late registration is possible, but not for the Rhineland-Palatinate Championships. Non-cash and special prizes are awarded at the prize-giving ceremony; prizes are given only to participants who are present. Hilly natural terrain with trails featuring stones, roots and steps; online registration; parking fees apply nearby; bus transfer included.

name: Bottwartal-Marathon Run und Fun Day
location: Steinheim an der Murr, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Bottwartal Marathon is a unique running event set amid the picturesque landscapes of southern Germany. The course takes you through gentle vineyard slopes and idyllic historic town centers, with an exciting atmosphere along the route. Whether you are a beginner or an ambitious runner, there is a highlight for everyone. In addition to the marathon, a range of races from 5 km to an ultra is available for all age groups and fitness levels.
course_highlights: Run through historic town centers such as Großbottwar and Steinheim
The course follows the Bottwar River and passes through vineyards
Flat finish at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim
additional: Free monthly training runs with pace groups and guides to help you prepare. Summer holiday runs every Tuesday evening during the summer holidays. Year-End Run with 10 km, followed by punch and mulled wine. The OPR30 Run is limited to 150 participants. All races have refreshment stations approximately every 5 km. Late entries are possible until shortly before the event; registration via Datasport. Various distances, including children’s and inclusive races; registration via Datasport; GPS-supported course measurement; medals at the finish.

name: ENSINGER Laufcup
location: Vaihingen an der Enz, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Ensinger Laufcup on 17 October 2026 offers runners of all ages and ability levels suitable distances in the beautiful region of Vaihingen an der Enz. The event includes a range of races, from Bambini runs to challenging trail routes of up to 24 kilometres and up to 700 metres of elevation gain. Runners can enjoy the varied landscape of asphalt, gravel paths and trails. The Laufcup is also part of a regional support programme that helps schools and promotes community spirit.
course_highlights: A variety of routes from 550 m to 24 km, with up to 700 metres of elevation gain
A mix of asphalt, gravel forest paths and trails
Start and finish area in front of the Ensinger Kelter, with good public transport connections
additional: Online registration closes on 8 October 2026 at 23:59. Late registration is available online from 9 to 17 October 2026 for an additional fee, subject to places being available. All participants receive a medal at the finish. The event is part of the school support project run by the Alison and Peter Klein Stiftung, which covers registration fees and donates €5 to each participant’s school for every finisher. The start and finish area is at the square in front of the Ensinger Kelter on St. Veith-Straße. Parking is permitted only in designated areas; travel by public transport is recommended. Several race distances, trail and asphalt routes, detailed route information available

name: Falke-Rothaarsteigmarathon
location: Schmallenberger Sauerland, Hochsauerlandkreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 23rd FALKE Rothaarsteig Marathon takes place on 17 October 2026 in the Schmallenberger Sauerland. The event offers marathon, half-marathon, walking, Nordic walking and a 12.5 km AOK run. The course passes through the scenic Rothaar Mountains and is recognised by the DLV as an officially authorised popular race. More than 1,000 runners take part each year, enjoying the varied trails and forest scenery.
course_highlights: Scenic course in the Rothaar Mountains
DLV-recognised, officially authorised popular race
A range of events: marathon, half-marathon, walking, Nordic walking and 12.5 km AOK run
additional: Registration opens on 01.05.2026. Late registration is available until half an hour before the start of the respective event. Start times are staggered: marathon at 11:00, half-marathon at 12:00, walking and Nordic walking at 12:15, and the AOK run at 11:45. The event venue is Latroper-Str. 57392 Fleckenberg in the Schmallenberger Sauerland. Registration opens on 01.05.2026; no dog runs. A detailed course description is available, along with start times and organisational information on the website.

name: Hachenburger Löwenlauf
description: The Hachenburg Löwenlauf is a long-standing race with a family-friendly atmosphere, taking place on October 17, 2026, in Hachenburg. The event offers various distances, including a half marathon, a 10.5 km race, a 6.3 km fun run/team race, and children’s races. The courses pass through the varied landscapes of the Westerwald, with challenging climbs and wonderful views. Since 1989, proceeds from the race have been donated to social projects, giving the event special social significance.
course_highlights: The half marathon reaches its highest point at Gräbersberg (513 m) and features varied climbs and descents.
The 10.5 km race runs mostly along forest paths, with its highest point at 439 m above sea level.
The start and finish area is at the Rundsporthalle in Hachenburg, which has changing rooms and showers.
additional: Electronic timing without a chip; certificates for all finishers; prizes for category winners; special prize for the largest team in the team race. Late registration is available on October 16 from 17:00 and on race day from 09:00. Refreshments including electrolyte drinks, water, tea, cola, and fruit are available on the course and at the finish. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Rundsporthalle. Distances include a half marathon, 10.5 km, a 6.3 km team and fun run, and children’s races. The start and finish area is at Lohmühle, Hachenburg. Electronic timing without a chip; certificates for all finishers; prizes for category winners; refreshments on the course and at the finish. Registration is online only.

name: Herbstlauf der DJK Feudenheim

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Bei Anmeldung bis zum 11.10.2026 gelten vergünstige Anmeldegebühren.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Bei Anmeldung bis zum 11.10.2026 gelten vergünstige Anmeldegebühren.

description: The DJK Feudenheim Autumn Run is a traditional running event in Mannheim-Feudenheim, taking place for the 35th time on October 17, 2026. The main race covers a 10 km course completed over three laps, with a time limit of 90 minutes. There is also a recreational run, along with races for schoolchildren, Bambini and inclusion. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, refreshments, changing rooms and showers, and an awards ceremony immediately after the races. Registration opens on June 1, 2026, with reduced fees for registrations by October 11, 2026.
course_highlights: 10 km main race over three laps, with a 90-minute time limit
The event takes place in all weather conditions
Start and finish at the DJK Feudenheim sports grounds
additional: Timing is recorded using a transponder on the back of the bib, which must be worn visibly on the front of the upper body. No drinks are provided along the course; runners must bring their own. Warm tea, changing rooms, showers and first aid are available at the finish. Headphones are not permitted for safety reasons. The awards ceremony takes place in front of the tents after the races. Advance registration from 01.07.2024; race held in all weather conditions; race is part of the Engelhorn Sports Running Cup; on-site late registration available.

name: Herbstlauf des LSV Porz
organizer: LSV Porz / Kölner Lauf- und Nordic-Walkingteam
description: The LSV Porz Autumn Run is Cologne’s oldest road race and takes place in the picturesque Leidenhausen recreation area. The event offers distances from 1 km to 10 km, measured in accordance with the German Athletics Association (DLV) regulations and eligible for rankings. Both competitive runners and recreational joggers can enjoy the autumn scenery as they run. The 5 km loop is considered one of the fastest running routes in Cologne and the surrounding area, and is often used by top runners to assess their form.
course_highlights: Running routes through the Leidenhausen recreation area amid autumn scenery
The 5 km loop is one of the fastest running routes in Cologne
Routes measured in accordance with DLV regulations and eligible for rankings
additional: Race numbers must be worn on the chest. Timing is provided by time-and-voice.com. Late registration is possible on the day of the event for a fee of €2; school students are exempt from the fee. No liability is accepted for theft, accidents or other damage. Payment is by SEPA direct debit a few days before the event. No entry fee will be debited if the event is cancelled. Courses measured, registration until 14.10.2025, start times from 11:00, parking nearby, participation in running and Nordic walking events

name: Krummenseelauf
description: The Krummensee Run is a traditional road race in Mittenwalde, Brandenburg, organized by WSG 1981 Königs Wusterhausen since 1980. The course runs around Lake Krummensee, the event’s central feature. Three distances are offered (3.6 km, 7.2 km and 15 km), as well as Nordic walking; all start in the morning. The event typically takes place in autumn and is part of the Oder-Spree Cup, making it appealing to both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Loop around Lake Krummensee
Start on Krummenseer Straße by the sports field in Schenkendorf
Road race with distances of 3.6 km, 7.2 km and 15 km
additional: All races and Nordic walking start in the morning, within a few minutes of one another. The event is part of the Oder-Spree Cup and typically takes place in autumnal weather, with an average temperature of 14 °C. The event takes place in October, with the start and finish in Schenkendorf, Mittenwalde. It is known for its friendly atmosphere and scenic route around Lake Krummensee.

name: Oberwaldlauf
description: The Oberwaldlauf is a race held every year on the third Saturday in October, with 5 km and 10 km courses through Karlsruhe’s Oberwald forest. The courses are officially measured and approved by the German Athletics Association, making results eligible for ranking lists. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, refreshments, changing rooms and showers, as well as a varied program for all participants. The start and finish are near the TUS Rüppurr clubhouse, which is also used for race-bib collection and late registration.
course_highlights: Race through Karlsruhe’s Oberwald forest on well-maintained forest trails and partly paved sections
Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses, approved by the German Athletics Association (DLV)
Race-bib collection and late registration in the tent behind the clubhouse
additional: Race-bib collection and late registration from 13:00 to 14:00 in the tent by the garages behind the clubhouse. Free water, tea and bananas for all runners in the finish area. Toilets, changing rooms and showers in the basement of the clubhouse and at the nearby Eichelgartenhalle. Waffles, coffee, cake, drinks, fries and bratwurst available during the event. From 13:00, there will be a mobile play area with a bouncy castle and a refreshment stand. Courses on asphalt and forest trails, family and youth races, refreshments in the finish area

name: Panoramalauf Niedenstein
description: The 24th Niedenstein Panoramic Run takes place on October 17, 2026, in Niedenstein. The event is organized by SG 1898 Chattengau e.V. and Lauftreff Niedenstein. The run features an attractive course around the Hessenturm Stadium and the clubhouse, set amid the beautiful landscape of the region. Participants can look forward to a well-organized running event as part of the Schwalm-Eder Running Cup.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Hessenturm Stadium in Niedenstein
Run through the picturesque surroundings of Niedenstein
Event as part of the Schwalm-Eder Running Cup
additional: Undulating terrain, family-friendly, children’s and youth races, finish at Hessenturm Stadium

name: Prignitzer Moormeile
description: The Prignitzer Moormeile in Bad Wilsnack is a traditional race taking place for the 26th time on October 17, 2026. The event offers various distances from 1 km to 12.4 km, running through Wilsnack’s forests, the spa gardens and around the Karthanehalle. The races are suitable for children, young people and adults, and are part of the Prignitz Cup and the Brandenburg Cup. The event is known for its welcoming atmosphere, good course support and professional timing.
course_highlights: 12.4 km and 7.8 km through Wilsnack’s forests on asphalt and forest trails
3 km route through the spa gardens
1 km circuit in front of the Karthanehalle
additional: Late registration is available on race day from 08:00 to 09:30, provided the maximum of 550 participants has not yet been reached. The late registration fee is an additional 5 euros on top of the entry fee. The start and finish are at the Karthanehalle in Bad Wilsnack, where showers and toilets are also available. Overall winners receive trophies. Dogs are not permitted during the race. There are drink stations on the longer routes. The event offers online registration, refreshments, showers and prizes for the top runners. The Moormeile is also known for famous guests such as Dieter Baumann and high participant numbers.

name: Rottachseelauf 2026
description: The Rottachseelauf is a traditional running event in Oy-Mittelberg, taking place for the 35th time on October 17, 2026. Various distances are offered for different age groups, including a 15-kilometer main race for participants aged 16 and over, as well as children’s races over 2.4 km and 1.2 km. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings. Registration opens in mid-August 2026.
course_highlights: 15-kilometer main race
Children’s races over 2.4 km and 1.2 km
Event in the scenic Oy-Mittelberg region
additional: Registration is via the TSV Petersthal website, with the deadline on the day before the race. The event takes place in the scenic surroundings of Oy-Mittelberg, with typical October conditions of around 6–14°C and approximately 40 mm of precipitation.

name: Schloss Cross Laupheim
description: Schloss-Cross Laupheim is a varied cross-country race on a 1,550-metre loop through the picturesque castle park in Laupheim. Several events are offered, including a 9.3-kilometre main race, a 4.65-kilometre fun run, a 6.3-kilometre Nordic walking event, and children’s races over 1.55 kilometres. The course starts at the archway on Klaus-Graf-Stauffenberg-Straße by the Kulturhaus and follows gravel and crushed-stone paths as well as paved sections, with 19 metres of elevation gain. The event offers an appealing programme for competitive runners, recreational runners, and children alike.
course_highlights: 1,550-metre loop through Laupheim Castle Park
Start at the archway on Klaus-Graf-Stauffenberg-Straße by the Kulturhaus
Course with gravel, crushed-stone, and paved paths, and 19 metres of elevation gain
additional: Alongside the main race, there is a fun run, a Nordic walking event, and children’s races. The course has 19 metres of elevation gain per loop. The start is at the Kulturhaus on Klaus-Graf-Stauffenberg-Straße. Training plans are available to help participants prepare. The event is organised by Alpsee Bergwelt and also features children’s races, Nordic walking, and a school class cup. Exact start times and further details are available on the official website and Facebook page.

name: Schwindegger VR-Bank 6h-Lauf (Deutsche Meisterschaft der DUV)
description: The Schwindegger VR-Bank 6h Run is the DUV German Championship in the 6-hour run and takes place on October 17, 2026, in Schwindegg. The event is for ultrarunners who want to test their endurance on a flat, well-marked course. It offers both individual and relay races and is a highlight of the German ultrarunning calendar. Its friendly atmosphere and long-standing tradition make the VR-Bank 6h Run a special experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Flat, well-marked circuit
German 6-hour run championship
Event for individual and relay participants
additional: The race takes place on a flat circuit suitable for individual and relay participants. The event is part of the DUV German Championships in the 6-hour run. It is organized by a friendly running group dedicated to ultrarunning. 6-hour ultramarathon, German championship, paved course, fundraiser for the BALU children's cancer support organization

name: Steigerwald - Fackellauf 2026
location: Burghaslach, Neustadt an der Aisch, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Steigerwald Torchlight Run is being held for the 39th time by the athletics department of TSV Burghaslach and traditionally takes place on the third Saturday in October. The run gives runners of all ability levels the opportunity to run together through the beautiful Steigerwald countryside. The event is a fixture in the regional sporting calendar and promotes community and enjoyment of running.
course_highlights: Traditional run through the Steigerwald region
Event held on the third Saturday in October
Organized by the athletics department of TSV Burghaslach
additional: Registration for the Burghaslach Torchlight Run 2026 is available via the official website. The event is organized by the athletics department of TSV Burghaslach. The website does not provide explicit information about start times, pricing tiers, or different distances. The event also includes children's races, community celebrations in the TSV hall, and a festive running atmosphere with food, drinks, and prizes. The main race is regularly won by local personalities, and the event attracts many participants from the region.

name: TeutoMarsch
location: Grundschule Hohne, Lengerich-Hohne, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Teutomarsch is a unique hiking and running experience through the Teutoburg Forest and surrounding area. Organized by Turnverein Hohne von 1911 e.V. in Lengerich, the Teutomarsch offers two routes designed to delight participants. The event is very popular, and starting places fill up quickly. The exact route is still being finalized, but promises to be a fantastic and unique course. Participants must be at least 16 years old, and dogs are allowed on a leash.
course_highlights: A unique route through the Teutoburg Forest and surrounding area
Two different routes for a special experience
A nature experience in the Lengerich-Hohne region
additional: Registration for the 2026 Teutomarsch sold out within 30 minutes, with 500 starting places. There is a waiting list. Participants consent to being photographed and filmed and to the publication of the resulting images and footage. Entry fees are non-refundable. Minimum age: 16. Dogs are allowed on a leash. The organizer accepts no liability for personal injury, property damage, or loss or theft. Trail running, no timekeeping, refreshment stations along the route, start and finish at Grundschule Hohne, participant limit: 500.

name: Vellberger Volkslauf
description: The Vellberg Volkslauf is a local running event in Vellberg, Baden-Württemberg, organized by TSV Vellberg e.V. It is part of the Stadtwerke Läuft bei dir series, which also includes races in Michelfeld, Gaildorf and Bibersfeld. The event offers a classic 10 km race and a 400 m race for different age groups. Registration is online only; late entries are possible up to 45 minutes before the respective start. Timing is provided by Speed Timing, and certificates can be printed on site.
course_highlights: Classic 10 km race
Additional 400 m race
Event in the picturesque town of Vellberg
additional: Late entries are possible up to 45 minutes before the start. Timing is provided by Speed Timing. Certificates can be printed by participants at a terminal on site. Distances include 400 m and 10 km; registration is online; part of the Stadtwerke Läuft bei dir series.

name: Berchtesgaden
description: Berchtesgaden lies in southern Bavaria and offers an impressive alpine landscape with high peaks, romantic lakes and Germany’s only Alpine National Park. The region is ideal for hikers and mountaineers, who can experience nature up close on a variety of circular trails and tours. Berchtesgaden’s historic centre combines culture and history with a modern shopping experience in an Alpine setting. A special destination is the Kehlsteinhaus, with its breathtaking panorama at an altitude of 1,834 metres.
course_highlights: A variety of circular trails in the Berchtesgaden area, including valley, high-altitude and summit trails
Panoramic views from the Kehlsteinhaus at 1,834 metres
Hikes to alpine pastures, mountain huts and peaks, with up to 859 metres of elevation gain
additional: Kehlstein buses run every 25 minutes daily from 08:30 to 16:00. The Kehlstein season runs from early/mid-May to mid/late October, depending on the weather. It is possible to hike to the Kehlsteinhaus; the lift in the Kehlstein Tunnel takes visitors directly into the building. Sturdy footwear is recommended. No specific information about a race in 2026; the region is known for its wide range of tourist attractions and outdoor activities.

name: XTERRA O-SEE Ultra Trail
description: The XTERRA O-SEE Ultra Trail on October 17, 2026, in Kurort Oybin, Germany, is part of the XTERRA Trail Run World Series and serves as the European Championship. The event offers various distances from 0.5 km to 100 km, taking runners through the varied and challenging landscape around Oybin. Runners experience a combination of nature, trail running, and athletic challenge in a picturesque setting. In addition to the races, there is an extensive supporting program featuring a pasta party, awards ceremony, and Canicross the following day.
course_highlights: 50K course with 2,340 meters of elevation gain
100K Ultra Trail with 3,654 meters of elevation gain
75K course with 2,806 meters of elevation gain
additional: Start times vary by distance, from 04:00 (100K) to 12:00 (16K). There is a pasta party on the evening before the race and an awards ceremony on race day at approximately 15:00. Participants receive a race pack with giveaways and a finisher’s medal. Participant limits are defined for each distance. Participants under 18 require written consent from a parent or guardian. The event includes various distances, including 25 km, 50 km, 75 km, 100 km, and shorter categories. It offers a unique setting in the Germany-Poland-Czech Republic border region and serves as a qualifier for the 2027 World Championship. The event also includes activities such as Canicross and children’s races.

name: Ndb. und KR Passau Cross-Laufmeisterschaft im Rahmen des 5. intern. DJK Crosslauf in Passau
Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail
description: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail is a trail-running series held on the hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia, with the event base at KJ Barłomino. The event offers five distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km and 11 km, providing a range of challenges for trail runners. It showcases the beauty of the Kashubian landscape and regional attractions, and participants can look forward to excellent aid stations along the course. The event is supported by the #AktywnaWieś programme and organised by the Pomerania Sports Association.
course_highlights: Hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia
Beautiful Kashubian landscapes
Excellent aid stations along the course
additional: The event offers five distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km and 11 km, as well as the Junior Trail run of up to 1 km. The races take place at KJ Barłomino. The event promotes regional trails and tourist attractions in Pomerania and is supported by the #AktywnaWieś programme. The event is supported by Coconaut and features courses at various difficulty levels, an attractive base in Barłomino and beautiful views of Kashubia.

name: Łemkowyna Trail
location: Krynica-Zdrój, Powiat nowotarski, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
distance_verbose: Ultramaraton, 100 km, Ultramaraton, 50 km, Maraton, 28 km, 10 km
description: Łemkowyna Trail is a mountain race along a route marked by the Main Beskid Trail in the Low Beskids. The event takes place around Krynica-Zdrój and Komańcza, offering a range of distances from 10 km to a 150 km ultramarathon. The course features substantial elevation gain and challenging natural terrain, making it a test for trail-running and mountain-adventure enthusiasts. The event has a strong tradition and attracts runners from across Poland and abroad.
course_highlights: Route marked by the Main Beskid Trail
Significant elevation changes of up to +5,860 m and -5,970 m on the longest distance
A range of distances from 10 km to 150 km, with time limits
additional: Participants can switch between courses until October 1, 2026. Participant limits for individual distances range from 300 to 550. Starts are scheduled across October 17 and 18, 2026, with different start times for each distance. Each distance has a time limit. The event takes place on natural mountain trails with substantial elevation changes. Courses include elevation gains of up to 740 m for the 30 km and 150 km ultramarathon distances, with time limits of up to 35 hours. Registration is available online, with options for entry-fee refunds and transfer of race packages.

name: Pomerania Ultra-Trail®
description: Pomerania Ultra-Trail® is a series of trail races held on the hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia, with the event base at KJ Barłomino. The event offers five distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km, and 11 km, providing a range of challenges for trail runners. The races showcase the beauty of the Kashubian landscape and regional attractions, and participants can expect well-stocked aid stations along the course. The event is supported by the #AktywnaWieś programme and organised by the Pomerania Sports Association.
course_highlights: Hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia
Beautiful Kashubian landscapes
Well-stocked aid stations along the course
additional: The event takes place at KJ Barłomino. Five distances are available: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km, and 11 km, as well as a Junior race of up to 1 km. The organiser is the Pomerania Sports Association. The event promotes long-distance trail running and Nordic walking. It is supported by the #AktywnaWieś programme. The event features multiple distances, routes through the beautiful Kashubian landscape, support from #AktywnaWieś, and a base at KJ Barłomino.

name: Dębowiec Nocna Pętla
description: Dębowiec Night Loop is a mountain race on the slopes of Dębowiec in Bielsko-Biała. The 8-kilometre course follows forest trails from Dębowiec to the Wapienica Valley and back. Runners face a demanding climb beneath the Dębowiec cable car, and a bonfire and meal await them at the finish. The race offers a chance to spend an October evening actively, and participants receive a race pack and medals. Prizes are awarded to the top finishers and the oldest participants. A Nordic Walking event is held alongside the race, with a distance of approximately 4 km and a finish at the Dębowiec 520 mountain hostel.
course_highlights: 8 km course on forest trails from Dębowiec to the Wapienica Valley and back
Demanding climb beneath the Dębowiec cable car
Finish at the Dębowiec 520 mountain hostel, with a bonfire and meal
additional: Race participants must bring a headlamp. Sports equipment vouchers will be awarded to the top three finishers in the Open categories and the top three women. Special prizes are planned for the oldest male and female participants. A bonfire is held after the race at the Dębowiec 520 mountain hostel. A free Nordic Walking event is held alongside the race, covering approximately 4 km and starting at 18:00 from the lower station of the Dębowiec cable car. The race route starts at the lower station of the Dębowiec cable car, climbs to a clearing, turns back with a hairpin at the checkpoint, and finishes at the Dębowiec 520 mountain hostel. The Nordic Walking route is 6 km long and passes through Dylówki Pass and Cyberniok. Participants need a headlamp.

name: IV Wilczy Półmaraton
price_range: 100 zł - 130 zł za dystans, 80 zł za koszulkę
description: The IV Wilczy Half Marathon is a unique trail race held in the picturesque, wild forests of the Rybnik Forest District, in the “Głębokie Doły” nature reserve. The approximately 22 km half-marathon route follows unique forest paths, offering runners contact with nature and rare plant species. It is the only half marathon of its kind in Silesia, promising plenty of adrenaline and satisfaction for cross-country enthusiasts. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, and the route is full of amusing, muddy traps. Join us in Wilcza for an unforgettable sporting experience!
course_highlights: An approximately 22 km route through the forests of the Rybnik Forest District
Forest paths in the “Głębokie Doły” nature reserve, with its unique microclimate
Natural muddy traps and wild, picturesque terrain
additional: A commemorative medal for every participant. Dogs are welcome. The race office is located at the Community Centre in Wilcza, Karola Miarki 123. A commemorative T-shirt is available as an optional purchase for PLN 80. The route is approximately 22 km and runs through forest terrain. Participation is available in canicross and Nordic walking. Commemorative medals are provided. Online registration is available, with prices depending on the registration period.

name: Rajd Waligóry
description: Rajd Waligóry is an orienteering event held in the scenic Wiśnickie Foothills near Bochnia. Participants compete by finding checkpoints using a map and compass, combining adventure, exercise, and outdoor fun. The routes vary in length and difficulty, catering to both families and more experienced competitors. The event has a recreational and sporting character and promotes an active lifestyle, as well as exploring local nature and history.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the Wiśnickie Foothills, with charming forest paths and rolling hills
Checkpoints are marked with white-and-orange lanterns equipped with punches
Participants can plan their own routes and choose the order in which to visit the checkpoints
additional: The start and finish are at Arka Cafe in Lanckorona (for the Mini Rajd Waligóry). Participants receive a map before the start and can plan their route and individual start time within the designated hours. There is no official closing ceremony or awards presentation, and results are published on the website. GPS navigation is prohibited on the course; compasses are allowed. orienteering, checkpoints, maps, no GPS navigation

Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Górskich
X Bieg o Puchar Rektora ANS w Nowym Targu
XI Półmaraton Piastowski
location: Wilkszyn, Miękinia, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Podvihorlatský kros
location: Futbalové ihrisko (amfiteáter), Poruba pod Vihorlatom, Slovakia
description: Podvihorlatský Cross-Country Run is a running event held at the football field (amphitheatre) in Poruba pod Vihorlatom. The race offers starts for children’s categories and the main category. The course runs mainly along field and forest roads, with 30% asphalt. It is organized by Mgr. Ján Podstavský with the support of the Municipality of Poruba pod Vihorlatom. The event is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Running League 2025 and offers categories for various age groups, as well as Nordic walking.
course_highlights: 70% field and forest roads, 30% asphalt
The course passes through the natural surroundings of the Vihorlat Mountains
Start and finish at the football field (amphitheatre) in Poruba pod Vihorlatom
additional: The children’s categories start at 9:00, and the main category starts at 11:00. Categories are divided by age and gender, including Nordic walking. The event is supported by the Municipality of Poruba pod Vihorlatom and is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Running League 2025. Course: forest and asphalt roads; online registration until 16.10.2025; start times at 9:00 and 11:00; categories for different age groups and ability levels; registration also includes a charitable contribution.

name: Extrém Maratón Oščadnica
organizer: Obec Oščadnica, Klub turistov Oščadnica, extremmaraton.sk
description: Extrém Maratón Oščadnica is a mountain marathon through the picturesque Kysuce countryside, mainly along mountain ridges with beautiful views of Veľká Rača. The 42-kilometre course, with nearly 1,700 metres of elevation gain, tests endurance, strength and a love of the mountains. This is not a race but a recreational running experience that celebrates the joy of movement, friendship and determination. The organisers provide full support, including refreshments, a T-shirt and a get-together after the run.
course_highlights: 42 km course with nearly 1,700 m of elevation gain
Mainly mountain ridges with views of Veľká Rača (1,236 m above sea level)
Refreshment stations approximately every 8 km
additional: Runner check-in is on 17.10.2026 from 06:30 to 08:30 at the Oščadnica Cultural Centre. The marathon time limit is 7 hours, with a 5-hour cut-off for reaching Veľká Rača; after that, the organisers do not guarantee refreshments. Registration is available online only, or on site if the start list is not full. Registration closes once the limit of 200 participants is reached. The entry fee includes a T-shirt, baggage storage, showers, refreshments on the course and at the finish, a medal and an after-party. Registration is available online, and the number of participants is limited to 200. The entry fee includes a T-shirt, refreshments, a medal and an after-party.

name: Rozhanovská dvanástka
organizer: Obec Rozhanovce, Občianske združenie KŠK Rozhanovce
price_range: 15 € online pred 9.10.2025, 20 € po tejto dátume a na mieste
description: Rozhanovská Dvanástka is a running race held in the amphitheatre grounds in Rozhanovce. It offers two main categories—a 6 km short course and a 12 km long course—for both men and women. The race is organised by the Municipality of Rozhanovce and the KŠK Rozhanovce civic association, and is suitable for runners of various abilities. The race is scheduled for 17 October 2026, with the children’s races starting at 10:45 and the main races at 11:00.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Rozhanovce amphitheatre grounds
Two categories: a 6 km short course and a 12 km long course
Races for men and women, with children’s races also available
additional: Children’s races start at 10:45. The entry fee can be paid online or on site. Organisers: Municipality of Rozhanovce and KŠK Rozhanovce civic association. Contact: Ing. Matúš Adamčík, tel.: +421 908 909 779. The event also includes a children’s race, starting at 10:45, and the course is probably outdoors in the area around Rozhanovce.

name: Šurianska desiatka
description: Šurianska desiatka is a running event held in the town of Šurany, with the start and finish in front of the Municipal Office. The course runs along the town’s streets and through part of Nitriansky Hrádok on asphalt roads. The event is open to the general public, including pupils, junior runners, recreational runners and Nordic Walking participants. It is organised by Gymnázium Bernolákova 37, Šurany, and has a limited number of participants in categories A to J. Refreshments and drinks are provided for runners. Winners receive diplomas, prizes and cash awards.
course_highlights: The course runs along the streets of Šurany and through part of Nitriansky Hrádok
The course surface is asphalt
The start and finish are in front of the Municipal Office in Šurany
additional: On-site registration is available from 9:00 in front of the Municipal Office in Šurany. The race is limited to 400 participants in categories A to J. Secondary school pupils at schools established by the Nitra Self-Governing Region (NSK) pay no entry fee when registering online; on-site registration costs €2. Every participant receives a finisher’s medal. Winners in men’s category A and women’s category D receive cash prizes of up to €100. The main races start at 13:00. Online registration closes on 15 October 2026 at 23:59 or when the capacity of 400 participants in categories A to J is reached. Entry is free for youth categories when registering online (€2 on site); adults and recreational runners pay €18 online or €24 when registering on site.

name: Psotkov memorial
description: Psotkov Memorial is a traditional mountain running race in the heart of the High Tatras, held near Štrbské Pleso. Runners can choose between two challenging routes: BASIC, 25.3 km long with 1,540 m of elevation gain, and EXTREME, 37.9 km long with 2,490 m of elevation gain. The route passes through picturesque mountain scenery, including a climb to just below the summit of Kriváň, a descent to Tri studničky, a stretch past Jamské pleso and through Furkotská dolina, and a finish at Chata pod Soliskom. The race is part of the Skyrunner® National Series Slovakia and offers a unique running experience in challenging mountain terrain.
course_highlights: Climb to just below the summit of the prominent Kriváň
Long descent to Tri studničky with a refreshment station
Pass by Jamské pleso and through the demanding Furkotská dolina
additional: Registration is limited to 400 participants (200 for BASIC and 200 for EXTREME). Members of the Slovak Mountaineering Association James are entitled to a discounted entry fee. The EXTREME route is run as a time trial. The start and finish are at the SNOW - Štrba cross-country skiing area, Štrbské Pleso. The time limit is 6 hours for BASIC and 8 hours for EXTREME. The event is limited to 400 participants.

location: Muráň, Revúca District, Banská Bystrica Region, Slovakia

location: Devín, Bratislava IV, Bratislava Region, Slovakia

name: Kros Českým rájem
description: Kros Českým rájem is a trail race in a picturesque, little-known corner of the Bohemian Paradise. It offers a varied, undulating course among sandstone rocks, woodland paths and white-sand tracks. The race is 100% trail and is suitable for nature lovers and fans of technical running. The start and finish are in the village of Skokovy, less than an hour from Prague. Race day also features children’s races and a side programme, including a children’s corner.
course_highlights: 99% of the course follows woodland trails and passes among sandstone rocks
The route runs over white sand, grass and pine needles, with up to 440 m of elevation gain
Picturesque spring forests and technical descents on sandy paths
additional: A children’s corner for ages 3 to 10, with art supplies and a teacher supervising. It opens 30 minutes before the start and closes 5 minutes after the last competitor finishes. There are plenty of toilets, refreshments and restaurants at the start and finish. Family registration is available, with a discount on children’s entry fees. The course is marked, and maps will be available on site. The time limit for completing the shorter course is 2 days and for the longer course 3 days (for orientation). Trail races in nature, children’s races, easy access from Prague, technical courses, varied scenery, registration including gift vouchers.

name: Podzimní Kiosk
description: Podzimní Kiosk is a cross-country race held in Tyršovy sady in Šternberk, offering a 7 km course for men and a 3.5 km course for women. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners Grand Prix and gives runners the chance to test themselves in pleasant autumn surroundings. The course crosses mixed terrain, making for an engaging and dynamic run for all participants.
course_highlights: A cross-country race in the natural surroundings of Tyršovy sady
A 7 km course for men and a 3.5 km course for women
Part of the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners Grand Prix
additional: The race takes place at the Kiosk gazebo in Tyršovy sady in Šternberk. It is part of a series of races with various distances and offers the option of taking part on either a trail or road course.

name: Běh Zlínem "Přes valašské kotáry"
description: The “Across the Wallachian Hills” run in Zlín is a traditional running race that gives participants the chance to experience the beauty of the Wallachian countryside and enjoy a sporting atmosphere. The race starts at the Youth Stadium, and the route passes through picturesque hills and natural scenery. The organizers focus on high-quality organization and a friendly atmosphere for all participants. The race is part of the year-round Běhy Zlín series, which includes various running events in the region.
course_highlights: The route passes through the Wallachian hills, with picturesque views
Start and finish at the Youth athletics stadium in Zlín
Natural and forest terrain with varied surfaces
additional: The race is part of the year-round Běhy Zlín series, which offers various running events in the region. The organizers provide a friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization. The website also lists other races and a running school for anyone interested in running. The race takes place in the center of Zlín; registration is at the Zlín City Hall. Various age categories are offered, with prizes for the top runners and record holders.

name: PREFA Brněnská 25
location: Olympia park, Modřice, Brno, Czech Republic
organizer: BehejBrno.com, MARATON BRNO z.s., Aleš Čtvrtníček
description: PREFA Brněnská 25 is a traditional road race held in Brno and the surrounding area, running continuously since 1967. It offers several race distances—25 km, 16 km and 8 km—as well as relays, and is open to a wide range of participants, from competitive runners to beginners. The race takes place at Olympia Park near the rope centre in Modřice and is part of the Czech Running Club. The first category starts at 11:00, making it convenient for families and recreational runners to take part.
course_highlights: Road race distances of 25 km, 16 km and 8 km
Start and finish at Olympia Park near the rope centre in Modřice
A traditional race dating back to 1967, held every year except 1968
additional: The race is part of the Czech Running Club project and is open to the general public, including newcomers. Brno runner Karel Fuksa has completed every edition to date. The race is part of the traditional running calendar and is supported by the Czech Athletics Federation. It offers several race distances and relay options, with the start and finish at Olympia Park, on-site registration and bib collection, and the option to watch the race live.

name: Horokros
description: Horokros is part of the Chlapácký běh series, which offers a challenging cross-country race in the picturesque Jeseníky Mountains near Šumperk. The race is for runners seeking an off-road challenge with varied terrain and natural obstacles. The course is known for its difficulty and beautiful views, attracting both experienced competitors and mountain-running enthusiasts. The Chlapácký běh series recognizes regular participants who complete at least six races in a season. Come and enjoy the sporting atmosphere and push your limits in the unique setting of the Jeseníky Mountains.
course_highlights: Challenging cross-country terrain in the Jeseníky Mountains
Natural obstacles and varied terrain
Beautiful views and a mountain setting
additional: The race is part of the Chlapácký běh series, where competitors who have completed at least 6 races in a season are officially recognized. The race is part of the Chlapácké běhy series and takes place in the Jeseníky Mountains; the exact terrain conditions are not specified.

name: Běh na Žaltman
location: Malé Svatoňovice, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Žaltman is a public uphill race with a mass start, part of the Krakonoš Czech Mountain Running Cup and the East Bohemia Grand Prix series. The race takes place in Malé Svatoňovice in the Hradec Králové Region and offers a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings. The course crosses challenging terrain with significant elevation gain, attracting runners of all levels. The event is a traditional part of the running season and welcomes all athletes and fans of uphill running.
course_highlights: A challenging uphill race with significant elevation gain
The course passes through the scenic countryside around Malé Svatoňovice
Part of the Krakonoš Czech Mountain Running Cup and the East Bohemia Grand Prix series
additional: The race is part of the Krakonoš Czech Mountain Running Cup and East Bohemia Grand Prix series, and is suitable for runners looking for mountain and trail challenges.

name: Běh okolo Rané
location: Rané u Loun, Louny, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běh okolo Rané is a race around Raná near Louny in the Ústí nad Labem Region. It offers an 8.5 km course for men and a 4.25 km course for women. The race is part of the Louny Running Cup and gives runners the chance to enjoy a run in natural surroundings with scenic views. The event is suitable for a wide range of runners looking for a quality race with a regional tradition.
course_highlights: 8.5 km course for men and 4.25 km course for women
Natural scenery around Raná near Louny
Part of the Louny Running Cup
additional: The race is part of a running cup; exact registration and entry fee information has not yet been published.

name: Trainingslauf Bottwartal-Marathon
location: Riedstadion, Steinheim an der Murr, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Bottwartal Marathon is a running event in one of the most beautiful landscapes in southern Germany, taking runners through gentle vineyard slopes, idyllic old towns and an inspiring atmosphere along the course. The route is a circuit through the southern and northern Bottwartal, with varied sections on paved farm roads and through historic town centres. The flat finish at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim invites runners to make a strong final push. Whether you are a beginner or an ambitious runner, you’ll find your own personal running experience here.
course_highlights: Circuit through the southern and northern Bottwartal
Passage through historic old towns including Steinheim, Murr, Gronau, Beilstein, Oberstenfeld and Großbottwar
Flat finish at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim, ideal for an exciting final push
additional: Free monthly training runs in different pace groups take place in Steinheim on the last Sunday of each month. Summer-break runs are held every Tuesday evening during the summer holidays and include a 10 km long run. The Year-End Run is a 10 km run with punch and mulled wine at the end of the year. Registration is through Datasport. Late entries and changes of registration are possible until shortly before the race. In addition to the marathon, the event includes a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and running events for all age groups; it takes place in June 2026 to give runners the opportunity to prepare optimally.

name: 20. Müggelsee-Halbmarathon
price_range: 15 EUR bis 47 EUR je nach Strecke und Anmeldedatum
description: The Müggelsee Half Marathon is a scenic race in southeastern Berlin that takes runners all the way around the Großer Müggelsee. The event offers three distances: half marathon, 10 kilometers and 5 kilometers, each available as an out-and-back route or a loop. The course passes through the historic Spreetunnel and offers idyllic views of Berlin’s largest lake and the surrounding Müggelberge. The race is suitable for runners aiming for a personal best as well as those who simply want to enjoy the community and nature. The start and finish are at Müggelseeperle, and the race takes place on October 18, 2026.
course_highlights: Loop route all the way around the Großer Müggelsee
Passage through the historic Spreetunnel Friedrichshagen
Idyllic scenery with views of the Müggelberge and Berlin’s skyline
additional: Race bib collection on October 17, 2026, from 12:30 to 16:00 and on October 18, 2026, from 07:30 at Müggelseeperle. Late registration is available only on October 17, 2026, with a late fee of 3 EUR; no race-day registration. Free boat shuttle to the start on October 18, 2026, at 8:30 from Friedrichshagen/Spreetunnel. Bag drop available; changing tent provided. Optional T-shirt, personalized bib number and boat escort tickets for spectators can be booked. Terrain: lakeside and waterfront paths; online registration; shuttle service; start/finish in the Müggelsee area; various race distances.
