description: The Krospůlmaraton in Sosnová near Česká Lípa is a traditional running race held as part of the Českolipsko District Running League. The race takes place on October 31, 2026, and gives runners the chance to test themselves in the pleasant autumn surroundings of the Liberec Region. The event is part of a series of regional races that promote physical activity and bring together runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Natural terrain suitable for cross-country running
Part of a regional running league
Held in the picturesque surroundings of Sosnová near Česká Lípa
additional: The race is part of a regional running series. The exact course profile is not provided, but the terrain is expected to be suitable for running in nature.

name: Lesní kros mezi přeštickými prasaty
price_range: 150 Kč při online registraci, 250 Kč na místě
description: Lesní kros mezi přeštickými prasaty is a traditional 8-kilometre race in Přeštice. Runners follow forest trails over dirt, leaves and roots, with the possibility of mud. The start and finish are at Střelnice in Přeštice, which provides convenient facilities including changing rooms, refreshments and home-style food. The race is part of the Běžecký pohár Plzeňska 2026 and is open to runners over 15. Registration opens at 9:00, and the race starts at 10:30. The results are announced after the last runner finishes, usually around noon.
course_highlights: Eight kilometres of forest trails over dirt, leaves and roots
Start and finish at Střelnice in Přeštice, with full facilities
Part of the Běžecký pohár Plzeňska 2026
additional: Registration opens at 9:00. Results are usually announced around noon, after the last runner finishes. The race takes place in all weather. Runners keep their race numbers. The organiser provides changing rooms, refreshments and home-style food. The race is open to runners over 15; minors must have the responsibility of their legal guardians. The race takes place on 31 October 2026. Registration opens at 9:00 and the start is at 10:30. Changing rooms and refreshments are available at Střelnice; the race is part of the Běžecký pohár Plzeňska 2026.

name: 34. Mündener Altstadtlauf
description: The 34th Mündener Altstadtlauf takes place on October 31, 2026, in Hann. Münden and offers suitable distances for runners of different age groups and ability levels. The event includes Bambini and schoolchildren’s races, as well as 5 km and 10 km races for recreational and competitive runners. The course is measured by the Lower Saxony Athletics Association and is therefore eligible for record times. In addition to individual rankings, there are group and team rankings, making the race particularly appealing to teams. The organizing team places great importance on professional delivery and continually improving the event.
course_highlights: Course measured by the athletics association and eligible for record times
500 m Bambini course and 1,000 m schoolchildren’s race for young runners
5 km course with a group ranking and 10 km course with a team ranking (at least one woman per team)
additional: The 5 km course offers a so-called combined ranking for groups. The 10 km course has a team ranking for teams of three, including at least one woman. Around 40 volunteers help with setup and dismantling and secure the race routes. Various local institutions, including the fire department, police, and city administration, are involved. Commentator Frank Neumann hosts the event. Courses for Bambini, schoolchildren, 5 km, and 10 km; team and group rankings; courses measured to be eligible for record times

name: 6. Halloween Run
description: The Halloween Run Bremen 2026 takes place on October 31 at Werdersee in Bremen and offers runners a spooky running experience with various distances from 1 km to the marathon. The courses are measured in accordance with German Athletics Association rules and are eligible for record lists, underscoring the competitive nature of the event. Alongside the sporting event, participants can look forward to a spooky atmosphere with costumes, lights and fog, as well as a spectacular fireworks display to close the event. The event is open to all age groups and ability levels, and includes relay races and a children’s run.
course_highlights: 8.333 km loop, measured by the German Athletics Association and eligible for record lists
Distances from 1 km to the marathon (42.195 km) in a spooky atmosphere
Start and finish area at Werdersee, with fireworks from 18:00
additional: Relay races for men’s, women’s and mixed teams with RFID bibs. Costumes are expressly encouraged, but regular sportswear is also allowed. The award ceremony takes place immediately after the Spooky Run and later for the other distances. Fireworks from 18:00 bring the event to a close. The start and finish area is between the Finnbahn at Werdersee and the Grillwiese/DLRG lifeguard station. Several running distances, including the marathon, take place on measured loops; costumes are encouraged; the event concludes with fireworks.

name: Halloween - Lauf
description: The Halloween Run in Oppen (Beckingen) is a virtual race taking place from October 31 to November 2. The event invites runners to take part in this special event with a headlamp and a pumpkin grin. The race is flexible, allowing each participant to choose their own start location and time. After the run, results can be uploaded online and a certificate can be downloaded for printing. Participants can also order a medal and a race shirt to commemorate the experience.
course_highlights: Virtual race with a flexible start location and time
Run with a headlamp and a Halloween theme
Upload results online and download a certificate to print
additional: The race is virtual and can be started from any location. Participants receive a digital race number to print. Results are tracked using an app or running watch and uploaded online. A digital starting signal is given on social media. Medals and shirts can be ordered separately. The event is in the past, but is known for its Halloween atmosphere and the use of headlamps during the run.

name: Halloween-Run-Bremen
description: The Halloween Run Bremen 2026 takes place on October 31 and offers runners a spooky race experience around Werdersee. With five different distances, from 1 km to the 42.195 km marathon, there is something for every ability level. The courses are measured in accordance with German Athletics Association rules and are eligible for record lists, underscoring the competitive nature of the event. Alongside the sporting event, participants can look forward to a spooky atmosphere with costumes, lights and fog, as well as an awards ceremony and a closing fireworks display.
course_highlights: 8.333 km loop course, measured by the German Athletics Association and eligible for record lists
Distances from 1 km (Spuklauf) to the marathon (Splatterthon), with a spooky atmosphere
Start and finish area at Werdersee, between the Finnbahn and the barbecue area
additional: The awards ceremony for the Spuklauf takes place immediately after the finish; awards for the other distances are presented later. A spectacular fireworks display at 18:00 rounds off the event. There are also relay competitions for the marathon (5-person relay). The race bib with RFID chip serves as the relay baton and must be brought by the team. Costumes are expressly encouraged but are not compulsory. Participants can register online. There are various distances and relay options; the event takes place at night and offers a spooky atmosphere.

name: Kreismeisterschaft und 3. Halloween-Crosslauf im Örtzetal zu Munster
location: Sportpark Osterberg, Munster, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The District Championships and 3rd Halloween Cross-Country Run in the Örtzetal in Munster is a cross-country event taking place on October 31, 2026, at Sportpark Osterberg in Munster. The event combines the District Cross-Country Championships with the third Halloween Cross-Country Run and is open to children, young people, open categories and masters. Distances range from 500 metres to 10 kilometres, offering a local, club-oriented atmosphere rather than the feel of a major city race. The race takes place in the autumnal Örtzetal region and is a popular seasonal event organised by Eintracht Munster.
course_highlights: Cross-country running in the Örtzetal on varied terrain
Distances from 500 m to 10 km for different age and ability categories
Event at Sportpark Osterberg in Munster
additional: The event was postponed due to bad weather and incorporates the District Championships into the Halloween Cross-Country Run. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with mostly cloudy skies and an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The event uses a cross-country race format, has a local character, is open to children, young people, adults and masters, and takes place on Halloween with weather-dependent adjustments.

name: Köstritzer Parklauf
location: Köstritzer Park, Bad Köstritz, Thuringia, Germany
description: The Köstritzer Parklauf is a cross-country race held in late October in Bad Köstritz, Germany. The course runs through and around Köstritzer Park, away from the usual running tracks. The event offers short races for children and young people, as well as longer distances for adults and masters, from 500 m to the 12 km main race. It attracts numerous local and regional clubs, mainly from Thuringia, but also from Saxony and Bavaria. The 27th edition of the race is known for its strong regional turnout.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through and around Köstritzer Park
Start in the park with views of dahlias in bloom in autumn
A range of distances from 500 m to 12 km
additional: Typical October weather: around 14 °C maximum and 6 °C minimum, mostly cloudy, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The event includes races for children and young people, as well as main races for adults and masters. It takes place in late October, with various race distances and categories for children, young people, active runners, and masters. Registration is possible until shortly before the event.

name: Nordhessische Crosslaufmeisterschaften
description: The North Hesse Cross-Country Championships are a regional club and regional cross-country championship held in various locations across North Hesse. The event is aimed primarily at club runners from the region competing for regional and district titles. Course distances range from short youth races of 1.2 km to longer senior races of 8 km. The races take place on cross-country terrain, not on closed roads, and are organized by various athletics districts and clubs.
course_highlights: Cross-country terrain rather than a road race
Distances from 1.2 km to 8 km
Held at sports facilities in various locations across North Hesse
additional: The event is geared strongly toward club runners. Depending on the course, runners are advised to choose suitable shoes carefully, such as spikes. Results are published as web and PDF listings. Typical October weather is cool and mostly cloudy, with a daytime high of about 14°C and a low of 6°C. October weather: about 14°C, low of 6°C, 40 mm of precipitation, cloudy; races take place at sports facilities in the region, online registration is possible, and results are published as web and PDF listings.

description: The TEAG - LEGEND OF CROSS is Thuringia’s toughest and warmest-hearted cross-country race, taking place on 31 October and 1 November 2026 in Mühlberg at the Drei Gleichen. The event features challenging trails, more than 30 natural and man-made obstacles, and a unique setting with three castles. Whether running solo or as part of a team, recreational runners can become legends in a strong community. The event offers various distances and levels of difficulty suitable for all age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: Three courses of different lengths, each with its own obstacles and difficulty level
More than 30 natural and man-made obstacles, including water obstacles at the Wechmar Reservoir
Start and finish at the Mühlberg sports ground, set against the historic backdrop of the Drei Gleichen
additional: The Fun and junior races start on Saturday, and the main races take place on Sunday. There are individual and team rankings. The 4 km SPECIAL CROSS is available for Special Olympics athletes with intellectual disabilities. Changes and late registrations are free until mid-October; after that, a €5 fee applies. Double-start offer for both LEGEND OF CROSS events in 2026 for €99. Several course distances, obstacles, junior races, team rankings, start and finish at the Mühlberg sports ground, water obstacle on the 30 km course.

name: Frankenwaldlauf um den Preis der Kulmbacher Brauerei
description: The Frankenwald Run for the Kulmbacher Brewery Prize is a relaxed running event in the beautiful Franconian Forest village of Ludwigschorgast, organised by runners for runners. Featuring a 1.5-kilometre singletrack trail as an exciting alternative to the paved section, the event welcomes both ambitious runners and recreational athletes, with a fun run and Nordic walking. Alongside sporting ambition, the focus is on having fun amid the Franconian Forest’s romantically rugged natural scenery. The overall male and female winners of the main race receive prize money, and the club with the most participants receives a financial award.
course_highlights: A 1.5 km singletrack trail replaces the paved section from Wirsberg to the Goldener Adler Hut
Run through the Franconian Forest’s romantically rugged natural scenery
A variety of events: main race, fun run (5 km) and Nordic walking (8.4 km)
additional: Late registration is available on the event day at the FC Ludwigschorgast sports hall from 12:30 to 13:30, for an additional fee of 5 euros. All participants receive a small gift from Kulmbacher when they hand in their race number at the finish. Tea, non-alcoholic drinks, biscuits, pretzel sticks and gummy bears are available at the finish. The race number must be worn clearly visible on the front of the body; otherwise, participants will be disqualified. There is a team competition in the main race, with non-cash prizes and a challenge trophy for the fastest men’s team. Courses in the Franconian Forest region; registration opens on 18 September; late registration at the start for a fee; refreshments at the finish; start at 9:00; awards ceremony at 11:30.

Start in the clearing behind Piast Stadium (entrance from Leśna Street)
The course suits both experienced runners and amateurs

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - listopad
description: The Olomouc 2 Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. On-site registration is from 9:30 to 10:00, and the race starts in the morning. course_highlights: 2-mile (3.2 km) course in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc
Suitable for all ages and running abilities
Picturesque setting by the park fountain
additional: On-site registration is from 9:30 to 10:00. The start is by the fountain in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc. The top three finishers in each category receive awards. The race is part of a year-long cup competition, with points calculated using an age-grading coefficient. It is part of the Olomouc 2-mile race series, takes place on a paved course, registration is from 9:30 to 10:00, and it is suitable for all age groups and running abilities.

name: HRUŠTICE 10 km - Memoriál Zdeňka Drobníka
location: Turnov, Liberec District, Liberec Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné 200 Kè - přihláška předem - kategorie Z, Z35, Z45, M39, V40, V50, V60

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Startovné 150 Kè - přihláška předem - kategorie V70, Z55

description: The HRUŠTICE Road Race – Zdeněk Drobník Memorial is a traditional race with a history dating back to 1974. Since 2024, it has been run on a new 10 km course through the Jizera Valley. This popular autumn event attracts runners from across the surrounding area each year and offers beautiful views and an atmosphere shaped by local history and traditions. The start and race facilities are in Turnov, with chip timing and professional organization. After the race, prizes are raffled, traditionally including regional semi-precious stones.
course_highlights: New 10 km course through the Jizera Valley
Beautiful views from the plateau above Turnov
Traditional prizes featuring regional semi-precious stones
additional: All categories start together. Registration and race-number pickup take place from 08:30 to 10:00. On-site registration is available until 10:00 for a higher entry fee. After the race, race numbers are entered into a prize draw. Race facilities are located in the AC Turnov athletics clubroom at Ludvík Daněk Stadium. The race is part of a long-running series and offers various age categories. Registration and results are managed by STOPNI TO s.r.o. The race takes place on a road course and is open to runners of all levels.

name: 19. Bothfelder Waldlauf
location: Bezirkssportplatz Bothfeld, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Bothfelder Waldlauf is a DLV-approved public race organized by TuS Bothfeld 04 in Hanover. The races start and finish at the Bothfeld district sports ground and follow a loop through the beautiful Bothfelder Wald on forest trails and well-maintained forest roads. The race is part of the Hannover Region Running Pass and offers changing and shower facilities in the finish area. Affordable food, drinks, and free hot tea are available. The event is open to runners of all age groups, including Bambinis, with short-distance races.
course_highlights: Loop through the Bothfelder Wald
Forest trails and well-maintained forest roads
Start and finish at the Bothfeld district sports ground
additional: Late entries on race day can be made online up to 60 minutes before the respective race, subject to availability. The late-entry fee is €2 in addition to the entry fee. The children’s race award ceremonies take place approximately 60 minutes after the races; ceremonies for the longer races follow immediately after the finish. On-site certificate printing is available. The 5 km walk starts at the same time as the 10 km main race. Changing and shower facilities are available. Public transport is available via tram line 13, and parking is available nearby. The registration deadline is October 30, 2026; the event takes place in typical November weather in Hanover; the event is outside the official stadium calendar.

name: 28. Tangerpokallauf
description: The 28th Tanger Cup Run in Demker is the oldest running event organized by SC Demker '95 and is part of the Elbe-Ohre Cup. The course runs through the autumnal Tanger lowlands between Demker and Weißewarte, past Deutsches Eck, under the Stendal–Magdeburg railway line, and through the Süppling woodland. Distances offered are 1.2 km for children and young people, and 5.4 km and 12.0 km for older young people and adults. The terrain is mostly flat, with gentle rises formed by the dikes surrounding Demker.
course_highlights: Flat course through the Tanger lowlands between Demker and Weißewarte
Runs along the Tanger and past Deutsches Eck
Passes through the Süppling woodland
additional: Distances: 1.2 km (children/young people), 5.4 km and 12.0 km (older young people/adults). The terrain is flat throughout, with the dikes as the only rises. The course passes under the Stendal–Magdeburg railway line. The event takes place on November 1, 2026. Information is also provided about registration, results, photos, and accommodation in Demker.

name: Käppelelauf 2026
description: The Käppelelauf is a long-standing running event held every year on November 1 in Reudern near Nürtingen. The course covers 8.7 kilometers with around 245 meters of elevation gain on gravel forest paths, climbing to the Käppele parking area. The race is part of the TSV Beuren Tälescup race series and also offers a separate Nordic walking category. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a traditional buffet, making the event a social occasion.
course_highlights: 8.7-kilometer course with approx. 245 meters of elevation gain
Route on gravel forest paths
Finish at the Käppele parking area
additional: Start at the edge of the forest in Reudern; a lead bicycle rides ahead of the first woman and first man. Awards ceremony and traditional buffet after the race; separate category for Nordic walkers; part of the TSV Beuren Tälescup race series. Start at 10 a.m. at the Reudern sports ground. Registration in advance only. November weather is usually rainy, with temperatures around 2–7°C.

name: LG Alsternord Herbstwaldlauf 2026
description: The LG Alsternord Autumn Forest Run is a local autumn race through the forest in Norderstedt, north of Hamburg. Organized by LG Alsternord Hamburg e.V., the race starts at 11:00 a.m. at the Rantzauer Forst-Thingplatz. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km routes, including a cross-country option. The race takes place away from city streets in the Rantzauer Forst area and also offers walking and hiking events. With a modest field of usually 101 to 300 runners, the event has more of a club-run feel than that of a major race.
course_highlights: Run through the autumnal Rantzauer Forst, away from city streets
5 km, 10 km and cross-country options
Modest field with a club-run atmosphere
additional: Results are published via race result; public start lists, photos, reports and historical rankings are available. In addition to the races, there are walking and hiking events, including a 5 km walk. Typical November weather is around 7 °C, with rainy days. The event takes place in typical November weather, around 7°C and with rainy conditions. It is open to runners and walkers of all ages, with a modest participant count of between 101 and 300.

name: Neustädter Sparkassen Nachtlauf
location: Neustadt an der Aisch, Neustadt an der Aisch, Bavaria, Germany
organizer: Turn- und Sportverein 1861/08 Neustadt an der Aisch e.V.
description: The Sparkassen Night Run in Neustadt an der Aisch is a popular running event with several competitions, including a children’s run, fun run, Nordic walking and the main race. The event takes place in the town centre, with the start and finish at the town hall on the market square. It offers an attractive course that has been adapted to participants’ needs. Race numbers are available at the town hall, and showers and changing rooms are available at the TSV sports ground. The award ceremonies take place in the evening in front of the Sparkasse or at the town hall. Every participant receives a small thank-you bag at the finish.
course_highlights: The course runs through the town centre, with adjustments to avoid narrow sections
Start and finish at the town hall on the market square
Showers and changing rooms available at the TSV sports ground
additional: Late entries are accepted at the town hall until 30 minutes before the respective start, for a late-entry fee of 2€. Race-number distribution starts at 15:45 at the town hall. Jackets may be left at the town hall or in the Stadtwerke tent during the race, at the owner's own risk. For safety reasons, children start in staggered groups: boys 3 minutes before girls. Main-race prize money: 1st place 150€, 2nd place 100€, 3rd place 75€. Course changes are possible. Children’s-run course length: 1.7 km; main race: 4 laps; fun run: 2 laps. The event takes place in the town of Neustadt an der Aisch, with the start and finish near the Neustadthalle and at the town hall on the market square.

name: Winterlaufserie 2026/2027, 1. Wertungslauf
description: The Winter Run Series in Hamm is a long-standing winter road-running series, now taking place for the 51st time. The first scoring race covers a distance of 15 km on roads outside the stadium. The event attracts many club runners from Westphalia and beyond, including teams from Dortmund, Münster and Bielefeld. The race offers a challenging course in the cool November weather and is a popular start to the winter season for runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: 15 km road race outside the stadium
A field with a strong club-running presence from Westphalia and the surrounding area
Typically cool and rainy November weather
additional: The starting location is Ahnatal. The average November temperature is around 7°C, with frequent rain (approximately 45 mm of precipitation). The event is part of the Winter Run Series, which may take place in typical weather of around 7°C with rain. It is the series’ first scoring race and appeals to runners from various regions.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Beroun
location: Hospoda na Černém vršku, Praha, Czech Republic
price_range: 240 Kč (voucher za celou sérii), 316 Kč (voucher za 6 závodů)

description: The Berounka Running Series is a series of 12 races in the beautiful natural surroundings along the Berounka, motivating runners of all levels to exercise regularly. The race in Beroun, held on November 2, 2026, is a night stage through the Křivoklát forests, with views of the surrounding area and a final descent from the Děd lookout tower to the finish. The route is well marked and offers beautiful natural scenery, refreshments, and baggage storage. The series is suitable for experienced runners as well as beginners who want to improve their fitness and enjoy running in nature.
course_highlights: Night stage requiring a headlamp
The route runs through the Křivoklát forests, with views by the walnut-tree avenue
A challenging climb to the Děd lookout tower, followed by a descent back to the finish with views of Beroun
additional: Every participant receives a race number. Refreshments and baggage storage are available on site. Bringing a headlamp for the night run is recommended. The top three finishers in each category receive diplomas. Night stage, trail run, marked routes, views of the surrounding area, on-site registration, start no later than 17:45, refreshments and baggage storage, winners’ awards by category, headlamp required.

name: BEH 17. NOVEMBRA

name: TRAIL LÁZNĚ VELICHOVKY
location: Lázně Velichovky, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Trail Lázně Velichovky is the third edition of an autumn trail race in the historic spa town of Velichovky. It offers varied and beautiful running terrain, with the start and finish on the spa colonnade, where covered facilities with changing rooms and a restaurant are available. The race is complemented by spa amenities, including a café, and offers original medals, gifts and a race pack. The atmosphere is friendly, and the race is suitable for all lovers of trail running and spa surroundings.
course_highlights: The most colourful autumn running terrain
Start and finish on the spa colonnade
Covered facilities with changing rooms and a restaurant
additional: The race includes an original medal, race pack, electronic timing chip, refreshments during the race and at the finish, changing rooms, baggage storage, toilets, medical services and an accompanying programme. Gladiator Race clothing is also available for purchase, and parking is available near the event centre. Online registration via reg-sportvisio.cz, medals, chip timing, course photos, certificates, refreshments and spa services.

name: Jizerun
location: stadion Čelákovice, Čelákovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: přátelé a sportovní nadšenci z Hitgymu

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.label: tier_2

description: Jizerun is a relay race connecting Prague and the Jizera Mountains. Teams of 4–5 runners cover a total of 164 km along cycle paths and Jizera Mountain trails in a single day. The race offers a unique team experience, with a choice of two entry packages featuring different benefits such as a sports T-shirt, headband, evening buffet and finisher medals. The event is open to men’s, women’s, mixed and corporate relay teams and is supported by general partner Metrostav a.s.
course_highlights: 164 km route from Prague to the Jizera Mountains
A combination of cycle paths and Jizera Mountain trails
Relays for teams of 4–5, with each runner completing at least 3 legs
additional: Entry packages are for teams of 5. The RUN&FUN package includes T-shirts, headbands, a buffet dinner, finisher medals, refreshments, race bibs, GPS tracking and a finisher party with live music. The NO FUN, JUST RUN package includes finisher medals, refreshments, race bibs, GPS tracking and a finisher party. Facilities and services include mobile toilets, showers at the finish, medical services, an announcer and full event support. When registering, the captain’s details must be provided; team members and T-shirt sizes can be added later. Each team member must run at least 3 legs, and only one car per team is allowed. The race supports a fundraiser for hospice and hospice care in the Czech Republic. Registration opens in April 2026.

name: Běh kolem Práchně
description: Běh kolem Práchně is a traditional running race in Horažďovice, offering a 9.5 km course. Since 2024, the updated route has followed the Horažďovice Green Walking Circuit. The start and finish are located in front of Envicentrum PROUD, which provides runners with facilities including changing rooms, toilets and refreshments. The results are announced at approximately 12:00 after the race. The event is organized by DDM Horažďovice and KČT Horažďovice, who ensure a pleasant atmosphere and a smooth event.
course_highlights: The 9.5 km course follows the Horažďovice Green Walking Circuit
Start and finish in front of Envicentrum PROUD, with full facilities
A mixed-type race in the picturesque surroundings of Horažďovice
additional: The results are announced at approximately 12:00 at Envicentrum PROUD, where refreshments, changing rooms and toilets are available. The course follows the Horažďovice Green Walking Circuit, with the start and finish in front of Envicentrum PROUD and refreshments and facilities available after the race.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - listopad
description: The 2 Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone and consists of just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt circuit. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and the start at 9:00. Every participant is welcomed at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake as a reward for their effort.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt circuit, just under two laps long (3.2 km)
The children's course is 800 m long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and over, and children up to 12 years old (boys and girls). Every runner is timed, and the top three finishers in both adult and children's categories receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get to the start include by bike, on foot, by car, on roller skates, or by trolleybus no. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). Races take place on the first Saturday of every month, start at 9:00, and registration is from 8:15 to 8:55; you can arrive by bike, on foot, by car, or by trolleybus. The course is a precisely measured asphalt circuit; the main course is 3.2 km long and the children's course is 800 m long.

name: Memoriál MUDr. Josefa Podmolíka - Běžecký festival Otrokovice 2026
description: The Otrokovice Running Festival is a traditional sporting event offering a wide range of races, including a marathon, half marathon, half-marathon relay, decamarathon and youth races. The MUDr. Josef Podmolík Memorial is the flagship half-marathon race, held in the beautiful surroundings of Otrokovice. Runners can enjoy a well-maintained course with electronic timing and the atmosphere of a running festival with a varied program for all age groups. Race check-in and the awards ceremony take place at the Otrokovice Municipal Sports Hall.
course_highlights: Half-marathon and marathon courses in Otrokovice with chip timing
A 4.2195 km decamarathon loop
Youth races over various distances from 200 m to 1,700 m
additional: Race check-in takes place at the Otrokovice Municipal Sports Hall. Runners must collect their race number and chip for electronic timing. Winners are presented with their awards after each race in turn, and winners are required to attend the ceremony. Registration is by email. The event includes various age groups and races on city streets and at the sports hall.

name: Svatojánská 20
location: TJ Lokomotiva Beroun, Beroun, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Svatojánská 20 is a traditional running race held in Beroun, offering two main routes of 11 and 18 kilometres. The start and finish are at the TJ Lokomotiva Beroun athletics stadium. The routes run mainly on paved roads and cycle paths along the Berounka River and the Loděnice Stream, with turnarounds at the settlement of V Kozle (11 km) and in Svatý Jan pod Skálou (18 km). The race is open to a wide range of age groups and offers refreshments at the finish, as well as cash and non-cash prizes for the top runners.
course_highlights: The routes run mainly on paved roads and cycle paths along the Berounka River and the Loděnice Stream
The 11 km route turns around at the settlement of V Kozle; the 18 km route turns around in Svatý Jan pod Skálou
The start and finish are at the TJ Lokomotiva Beroun athletics stadium
additional: On-site check-in and registration on race day from 11:00 to 12:40. Runners who register in advance and pay by 5 November will receive a race number bearing their name. Finish-line refreshments include tea and biscuits. The race takes place in open traffic; participants must obey traffic regulations and take part at their own risk. Parking is available around the stadium; nearby car parks are recommended because of the blue parking zones. Online and on-site registration are available. Medals and certificates are awarded, and cash prizes are paid.

name: Kovářská pětka
location: Baťovský areál, Zlín, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Kovárna VIVA a spolkem Běhy Zlín
description: Kovářská pětka is a traditional 5-kilometre city road race held in the Baťa complex in Zlín. The race is open to both adults and children and is organised by Kovárna VIVA in cooperation with the Běhy Zlín association. The event offers a high-quality sporting experience in the centre of the regional capital, with international participation. It attracts a wide running community every year and is known for its friendly atmosphere and well-organised proceedings.
course_highlights: The course runs through the former Baťa complex in Zlín
A 5-kilometre road race in an urban setting
The race is suitable for adults and children
additional: The race is part of a year-round competition for runners from the Zlín region. The organisers provide online results and event photos. Children’s categories are also included. The event provides professional timing and support for the regional running community. It is part of a series of races in Zlín, offers various age categories and is suitable for the general public.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - listopad
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running levels, including children up to 12 years old, who run 1.6 km. The race is suitable for slow and fast runners, experienced runners and beginners who want to improve their personal best, train, or simply enjoy a pleasant run in the beautiful park setting. After the finish, everyone receives a warm cinnamon pancake. Times are recorded for every participant and results are published online; they count toward the year-round Lívancový Cup.
course_highlights: The course runs along Stromovka’s paved paths
Adults run 2 laps (2 miles, 3.2 km); children run 1 lap (1.6 km)
The race takes place in the beautiful setting of Královská obora–Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Bruselská Gate area (beneath the Marold Panorama building) from 8:15 to 8:45. Online pre-registration is available for faster check-in. Arriving by bicycle, on foot, on roller skates, or by tram (Výstaviště stop) is recommended. Parking is available by the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou Street. Tents are available for changing and leaving belongings (unattended), along with a mobile valuables storage service. Toilet cabins are available on site. Start at 9:07; registration from 8:15 to 8:45; online registration available. The race takes place in Královská obora–Stromovka Park. Parking is by the bridge to Císařský Island; changing facilities and toilets are available.

name: Labský půlmaraton
location: Lysá nad Labem, Lysá nad Labem, Středočeský, Czech Republic
description: The Labský Half Marathon is a running race held in Lysá nad Labem, offering two courses of approximately 12.5 km and 21.3 km. The routes pass through the flat Polabí forest, on a mix of paved and unpaved roads, trails, and short sections of asphalt or concrete. The start and finish are at the racecourse, where refreshments, baggage storage, and other facilities are available. The race is suitable for the general public and is limited to 700 participants. The program also includes children’s races with distances varying by age.
course_highlights: The courses are flat and run through the beautiful Polabí forest
Start after approximately 1 km on the racecourse
Refreshment stations at km 8 and 17 on the 21 km course, and one station at km 8 on the 12 km course
additional: The race is limited to 700 participants. Baggage storage, changing tents, toilets, refreshments, and a raffle are available for runners. Parking in the venue costs 50 CZK per car. Children’s races range from 200 to 1,000 metres depending on age. The route is marked with ribbons, signs, and flour arrows, and each kilometre is marked approximately. The race includes children’s races, registration is available online, and the route may be modified due to reconstruction work in the area.

name: Závod dvojic
description: Hostivařské dvojice is a relay running race for pairs, offering a unique team-running experience in the beautiful surroundings of Hostivař. The race is for pairs who want to enjoy a sporting challenge as well as the friendly atmosphere. The route passes through scenic terrain and is suitable for runners of all levels. Come for a run and enjoy a great sporting event in a welcoming community.
course_highlights: Relay race in pairs
Scenic surroundings of Hostivař
Friendly race atmosphere
additional: The race takes place on November 7, 2026, in Kladno. It is a team relay event, and registration is available online.

name: Hornická desítka
location: Národní dům, Frýdek-Místek, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Hornická desítka is a traditional running race held in Frýdek-Místek. It has been held since 1980, with interruptions, and the tradition was revived in 1996. The event offers various running disciplines, including youth races, a Run for Health and the main 10 km race. It celebrates exercise and sporting spirit, attracting hundreds to thousands of participants of all ages. It is known for its excellent organization and friendly atmosphere. The race starts at the National House in Frýdek-Místek and is suitable for the general public, including families with children.
course_highlights: The course runs in the Frýdek-Místek area; the event dates back to 1980
A main 10 km race, accompanied by youth races and a Run for Health
Start and finish at the National House in Frýdek-Místek
additional: The event includes a non-competitive parents-and-children run, youth races, a Run for Health and the main 10 km race. It is known for its excellent organization and relaxed atmosphere. The organizer is Tělovýchovná jednota Slezan Frýdek-Místek, z.s. The race takes place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at the National House in Frýdek-Místek. The event involves road closures and traffic measures.

name: Malá Pardubická cross country
location: Labe and vicinity, near TJ Dynamo canoe club, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: Malá Pardubická - cross country is a traditional cross-country race organized by the AC Pardubice athletics club. The race takes place near the Elbe River and close to the TJ Dynamo Pardubice canoe club. The organizers warmly invite all runners and running fans to this popular event, which offers a sporting experience in a natural setting. The race regulations and further information are available on the club’s website.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on natural terrain near the Elbe River
Start and finish close to the TJ Dynamo Pardubice canoe club
A traditional running event organized by AC Pardubice
additional: The race takes place on November 7, 2026, is open to the general public, including children and young people, and is part of the local sports calendar.

name: Jizerun

description: Jizerun is a relay running race from Prague to the Jizera Mountains, following the Jizera River. Teams of 4–5 runners cover a total of 165 km along cycle paths and trails in the Jizera Mountains in a single day. The race offers a unique sporting experience and the chance to work as a team in men’s, women’s, mixed, and corporate categories. The route is divided into several stages of varying difficulty, allowing each runner to choose a suitable segment.
course_highlights: A 165 km route from Prague to the Jizera Mountains along cycle paths and trails
A relay race for teams of 4–5 in several categories
Stages with difficulty ratings from 1 to 8 on a 10-point scale, across varied terrain
additional: The entry fee includes timing, GPX tracking and the JIZERUN app, portable toilets, finish-area facilities including showers, a speaker and sound system, medical services throughout the race, gifts from partners, photos and video, and full event staffing and all relevant permits. The route is divided into 14 stages of varying lengths and difficulty; for example, the Bradlec–Klášter stage is 14.7 km and rated 7/10. The 2026 edition is sold out; the organizer mentions a waiting list. Teams consist of four or five runners.

name: Během proti závislostem

description: The Run Against Addiction is a running race in Homolka Forest Park in Plzeň, with courses for different age groups, from children to adults. The route follows paved paths and includes both flat children’s courses and the varied terrain of the 6 km main race. There is also a relay race for teams of three, with each runner completing one lap. The event is suitable for runners of all abilities who want to support the fight against addiction and enjoy a sporting atmosphere in nature.
course_highlights: The route follows paved paths in Homolka Forest Park
The 6 km main race features varied terrain and three laps
The children’s courses are flat and adapted to different age groups
additional: Race numbers are distributed from 9:00 to 10:30. Children’s races begin at 10:00, with staggered starts by age group. The men’s and women’s main races and the relay start at 11:30. The relay has three runners, each completing one lap of approximately 2,000 m. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 12:15. A recommended route is available on Garmin Connect as a single lap, which will be run three times during the race. The organizer lists children’s races and a 6 km race; Kudy z nudy also lists a 3 × 2 km relay for 2026. The race regulations available on the organizer’s website are for the 2024 and 2025 editions, so prices from those editions have not been assigned to the 2026 race.

name: 14. Sollingquerung
description: The Solling Crossing is a unique run from Dassel to Bad Karlshafen, taking place on November 7, 2026. The course is run exclusively by GPS, as it is not marked, making the event particularly challenging and exciting. The field is limited to 100 participants, creating a friendly atmosphere. The start is at 9:00 a.m., after runners are taken by bus from Dassel to Bad Karlshafen at 7:45 a.m. A tip for runners: anyone who completes the marathon distance at the Solling Run on June 6, 2026, is guaranteed a starting place in the Solling Crossing.
course_highlights: Course from Bad Karlshafen to Dassel
No course markings; GPS navigation only
Aid stations along the course
additional: Start at 9:00 a.m. after the 7:45 a.m. bus ride from Dassel to Bad Karlshafen. Field limited to 100 participants. No course markings; GPS navigation only. Tip: A starting place is guaranteed to participants in the Solling Run marathon on June 6, 2026. The course is unmarked, GPS navigation is required, November weather may bring rain and temperatures of around 2–7°C, no on-site entries are possible, and the event sells out quickly.

name: 6. Weserbergland Backyard Ultra
description: The Weserbergland Backyard Ultra Run is a unique ultrarunning event in Höxter, North Rhine-Westphalia, held every year in November. Participants run a lap of about 6.7 kilometers every hour until only one runner remains. The race stands out for its distinctive challenge and the camaraderie among runners. The event is known for its demanding course and the impressive performances of participants, who often run for many hours and cover many kilometers.
course_highlights: A course of approximately 6.7 km per lap
A loop course with challenging climbs on the Heiligenberg
A run through varied terrain in the Weserbergland
additional: The race traditionally starts at 10 a.m. Registration usually fills up quickly, and the field often reaches capacity early. There is currently no waiting list. The event is organized by TuS Lütmarsen e. V. Participant numbers are limited to ensure the quality and safety of the event. It is one of Germany's last major Backyard events of the year, with typical November weather and long nights. Registration opens on 1 May 2026.

name: Augsburger AOK-Winterlaufserie Südring
description: The Augsburg AOK Winter Running Series, organized by TG Viktoria Augsburg, consists of four races through the beautiful Western Woods Nature Park. The routes cross hilly terrain and require good fitness and health. The event offers age-group rankings and an overall ranking with attractive prizes and trophies. The races take place on Saturdays and one Sunday in November and December, and are ideal for runners of all ages looking for a varied winter running series.
course_highlights: Running routes through the Western Woods Nature Park over hilly terrain
Route distances of approx. 2.8 to 3.2 km per race
Start and finish area with refreshments and changing facilities
additional: Race-number collection is in the start/finish area each time. A mobile toilet is available at the Kathreinerstraße car park (Races 1–3). Changing clothes and luggage can be left in the tent or pavilion, but at your own risk. Tea, water and a cake buffet are provided at Races 1–3; mulled wine and children's punch are also available at Race 4. The awards ceremony takes place after Race 4, with wooden trophies and cash prizes. Parking is available in Bergheim, on Kathreinerstraße or on nearby streets; do not park at the Bergheim sports clubhouse. Races take place in November and December. The meeting point is usually near Kathreinerstrasse and Brennhölzerweg in Augsburg-Bergheim. Typical weather is rainy, at around 7°C.

name: Freundschaftslauf der LLG Wustweiler
description: The 22nd Friendship Run of LLG Wustweiler takes place on November 7, 2026, at the Dorfwaldhalle Wustweiler. The event begins at 1:00 p.m. with the Wustweiler Beaver Trail (WuBiT), a challenging trail route, followed at 3:00 p.m. by running and walking groups. This is not a race and there is no timing; the focus is instead on enjoying exercise in nature and in good company. The route follows official forest paths and trails, with a small refreshment station at kilometer 12. Afterwards, participants can gather for food and drinks in the hall.
course_highlights: Challenging route along official forest paths and trails
Small refreshment station at kilometer 12 (no cups)
Three groups at different running paces, accompanied by LLG runners
additional: This is not a race and there is no timing. There are three groups at different paces (6–6:30, 7–7:30, and 8–8:30 min/km), accompanied by experienced LLG runners. The running and walking groups each run or walk for one hour. The route is approximately 7 to 11 km for runners and 5 to 6 km for walkers/hikers. The GPX file for the route is available to download. The event is part of the LLG Illtal Cup, together with the Illinger City Run and the Benin Benefit Run. A hot-air balloon ride will be raffled among participants who complete all three events (participants must be 18 or older; LLG members are not eligible). No race or timing; challenging forest paths and trails; trail shoes are recommended; participation is at your own risk; social gathering after the run.

name: Geilenkirchener Crosslauf
location: Teverener Heide, Geilenkirchen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Geilenkirchen Cross Country Run takes place on 7 November 2026 in the Teverener Heide near Geilenkirchen. Organized by ATV Geilenkirchen, the event has offered a compact, local program since 2006, with distances from 1.1 km to 9.2 km for adults, young people, and children. The course is a true cross-country route with some substantial undulations, running through the heathland and starting and finishing at the Grotenrath parking lot. With usually 101 to 300 participants, the race has a friendly club atmosphere in a natural setting.
course_highlights: A true cross-country course with substantial undulations
Run through the heathland of the Teverener Heide
Start and finish at the Grotenrath parking lot
additional: The race takes place in November, with typical November weather of around 7 °C and rainy days. Participant numbers are usually between 101 and 300 runners. Separate races are held for adults, young people, and children. Run in the Teverener Heide, cross-country race with various distances, more of a club atmosphere, November weather with rain and temperatures around 2–7°C

name: Heiner-Mayr-Staffelberglauf
description: The Heiner Mayr Staffelberg Relay is a challenging mountain relay taking place on November 7, 2026, in Bad Staffelstein. Organized by TSV 1860 Staffelstein e.V. with support from Sparkasse Coburg-Lichtenfels, the route covers 3,960 meters and 260 meters of elevation gain, from the start on Hirtengasse-Horsdorfer Straße up to the Staffelberg plateau at the Adelgundis Chapel. Runners can expect a challenging race with impressive views across the Franconian countryside. The race pays tribute to decades of dedication to running in the region.
course_highlights: 3,960-meter course with 260 meters of elevation gain
Start on Hirtengasse-Horsdorfer Straße in Bad Staffelstein
Finish on the Staffelberg plateau at the Adelgundis Chapel, with panoramic views
additional: Mountain relay, starts at 2 p.m., finish on the Staffelberg plateau, registration until November 6, 2026, open to all age groups

name: Internationaler Fackellauf
description: The 45th International Torch Run in Rodenbach takes place on November 7, 2026, and offers a challenging 7 km course for adults. The course is a hilly loop with a total of 92 metres of ascent and descent, appealing to runners, walkers and Nordic walkers alike. In addition to the main event, there are also races for children and young people; details can be found in the organizer’s official race announcement. The start is at 18:00, and all events share the same finish.
course_highlights: 7 km hilly loop
92 metres of ascent and descent
Very challenging, hilly course
additional: Races for children and young people are offered; see the organizer’s official race announcement for details. All events share the same finish location. The exact finish location display requires RUNME Premium. The event takes place on November 7, 2026, starting at 18:00, with accommodation options near the start and finish area. The event is part of the Red Cross’s international humanitarian commitment, conveying a message of hope and peace.

name: Lauf der 17. OIE-Nahe-Crosslaufserie
description: The OIE-Nahe Cross-Country Series is a long-running running series held in the region around Idar-Oberstein. It includes several races on varied cross-country courses, catering to both middle- and long-distance runners. Participants who take part in at least four races in the series receive a series gift—in 2026, sports socks. The series is organized by TuS Oberbrombach and places great emphasis on community and the enjoyment of sport.
course_highlights: Varied cross-country courses in the Idar-Oberstein region
Middle- and long-distance races with challenging sections
Series standings with attractive gifts for frequent participants
additional: Participants who take part in at least four races in the series receive a series gift (sports socks for the middle- and long-distance races). Sock size must be specified when registering. Children’s races have a different gift. After a weather-related cancellation, a replacement date of 08.02.2026 was set. Registrations remain valid; if participants cannot attend, the entry fee may be refunded. Dates in various locations, registration with sock size, weather-related date change, series standings, WhatsApp channel

name: Limes- Winterlaufserie - 1. Lauf über 10 km
description: The Limes Winter Running Series is a three-part winter running series in Pohlheim. The first race, a 10 km run, forms the basis for the overall standings. The series attracts runners from the region, particularly from the Lahn-Dill district, and has a long tradition, with its 49th edition taking place in 2026. The race offers a great opportunity to compete with other runners during the colder months and kick off the winter running series.
course_highlights: 10 km run through Pohlheim, Watzenborn-Steinberg
Part of a three-race winter running series
Popular race with regional participation, particularly from the Lahn-Dill district
additional: Typical November weather: around 7 °C, usually rainy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. Please check the details with the organizer before registering. Participants can look forward to a sporting challenge in a wintry atmosphere. The event is open to runners of all ability levels and also provides results and participant lists.

name: Pokallauf
description: The “Rund um Marienberg” Cup Race is a traditional running event held in the Marienberg region. Competitions are held in classic and freestyle technique, with distances of 5 km and 10 km, each run on a 2.5 km loop. The event offers runners of various age groups and ability levels a sporting challenge in a scenic setting. Due to the current snow conditions, technical and course adjustments may affect how the competition is run.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances on a 2.5 km loop
Classic technique for U6–U9; freestyle technique from U10
New 10 km distance from H21
additional: The event is organized by ATSV Gebirge/Gelobtland e.V. The event announcement will not be updated. Competition technique depends on age group: U6–U9 use classic technique with a mass start; U10 and older use freestyle technique with a mass start. Depending on snow conditions, the route may vary, with adjustments to technique and distance. It is a popular event for runners seeking nature and a challenge.

name: Rülzheimer Crosslauf
description: The Rülzheim Cross Country Run, organized by LG Rülzheim, takes place on November 7, 2026, at Peter-Becht-Stadion in Rülzheim. The event offers two distances, 1.1 km and 8.4 km, on a compact cross-country course within the stadium grounds and neighboring areas. Unlike road races, the course crosses varied terrain and features new obstacles introduced by organizer Otto Pfadt. The run is part of a series of events organized by LG Rülzheim, including the Südpfalz Runs near the Moby Dick leisure center.
course_highlights: Compact cross-country course in the stadium and neighboring areas
New obstacles on the course
November event, with typically cool and rainy weather
additional: The start is at Peter-Becht-Stadion in Rülzheim. Typical November weather is around 7 °C, with frequent rain. This is not a road race but a cross-country run with obstacles. The race takes place within the stadium grounds; obstacles are present, and weather-dependent conditions may be possible in November. Ask on site for details.

name: SCC Cross Country
description: The SCC Cross Country is a forest race in Berlin at the Julius-Hirsch-Sportanlage in Westend. Two clearly defined cross-country routes are offered: 4 km for U16 through adults and 9 km for U18 through adults; both races start in the morning. The event is deliberately straightforward and is aimed at club runners, young athletes and adults who want to run short off-road loops, setting it apart from the city’s major road races. The course follows paved and unpaved forest paths, where rhythm, sure footing and a fast finish matter more than scenic views. Awards go to the top three in each age and gender category, and there is a prize for the fastest final lap for men and women.
course_highlights: Forest race on paved and unpaved forest paths
Two routes: 4 km for U16 through adults, 9 km for U18 through adults
Focus on rhythm, sure footing and a fast finish
additional: Entry is free for SCC members. Late registration is available shortly before the start for an additional fee. An archive of results is available to document the race. The event takes place at the Julius-Hirsch-Sportanlage on Harbigstraße in Westend, Berlin-Charlottenburg. Typical November weather is around 7 °C, with rainy days. Forest race on paved and unpaved forest paths, entry fee for non-members, late registration for an additional fee, November weather around 7 °C, rainy.

name: Schkölener Stadtparklauf
description: The Schkölen Stadtparklauf is a long-standing running event in Schkölen, Thuringia, taking place on November 7, 2026. Organized by TSV 1885 Schkölen and SSV Friedrich-Schiller-Gymnasium Eisenberg, the event offers various distances for children, teenagers, and young adults. The routes run through the town park and include short and long loops, combined according to age group. The event emphasizes clear age-group divisions and is aimed particularly at young runners.
course_highlights: Distances from 0.6 km to 5 km, tailored to age groups
Loops through the town park, combining short and long loops
Age groups determined by calendar year for fair competitions
additional: Age groups are determined by calendar year; for example, a 6-year-old runner in 2025 belongs to age group 6. Participants are asked to enter the correct age group when registering late. Various running distances, age-group divisions, registration with the correct age, looped running on the sports field

name: Sparkassen-LüneCross
description: The Sparkassen-LüneCross is an exciting and challenging cross-country running event set amid nature and the city of Lüneburg. The varied course follows sandy, root-covered trails, meadows, forest paths and gravel tracks, testing endurance, strength and running technique. Main races are offered over 4 km and 8 km, along with shorter distances for children and young people and 8 km relay races. Alongside the sporting challenge, the focus is on the enjoyment of running and community, with a school competition and a convivial awards ceremony afterwards.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with sandy, root-covered trails
Routes through meadows, forest paths and gravel tracks
8 km relay races can be run by teams of 3 to 6 runners
additional: There is a school competition with prizes for schools with the highest participation rate. Food and refreshments are available, followed by an awards ceremony and a convivial get-together. Relay teams of 3 to 6 runners can be formed from family, colleagues, teammates or friends. The route passes through natural surroundings, including forest paths, meadows, sand and gravel. Registration is required; family and group participation is possible.

name: TSV Bayer 04 Talent- und Speed-Cross
description: The TSV Bayer 04 Talent and Speed Cross in Leverkusen is an established cross-country race, serving in particular as a talent scout event for school-age categories up to U16, as well as for the U18 and older age groups. The event is a regular fixture on the Nordrhein Cross Cup calendar and features a varied course on the grass auxiliary field at the Fritz-Jacobi-Anlage. With a tight schedule and exciting races, including cross sprints, it offers an engaging experience for both participants and spectators. The event is attracting growing numbers of participants and is accompanied by good catering and professional commentary.
course_highlights: Varied course on the grass auxiliary field at the Fritz-Jacobi-Anlage
Part of the Nordrhein Cross Cup for age groups M/W 11 to 15
Exciting cross sprints, particularly in the U18 category
additional: The event saw an increase of almost 200 participants. Good catering and professional commentary are provided. The races follow one another in a tight schedule. Dates in November 2026; cross-country race as part of the Nordrhein Cross Cup; various age groups; competition on unpaved terrain.

name: Westerwinkellauf
location: Wasserschloss Westerwinkel, Ascheberg-Herbern, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Westerwinkellauf is a traditional fun run around Westerwinkel moated castle in Ascheberg-Herbern. The course runs mainly along park paths and offers scenic surroundings. The event is open to runners and walkers of all ages and uses modern Race Result timing. The start and finish areas are at the sports and swimming hall in Herbern. Local partners provide refreshments, and professional commentary helps create a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course runs mainly along park paths around Westerwinkel moated castle
Start and finish at the sports and swimming hall in Herbern
Scenic running surroundings with good facilities
additional: Timing is provided by Race Result using a disposable chip attached to the race bib, which is collected at the finish. No refunds for non-participation. Parking is available in the schoolyard of Mariengrundschule. Commentary by Janik Broszeit from Dortmund. Refreshments for participants and spectators provided by Getränke Zimmermann. Courses, start times, site map, registration, results, certificates, running and walking categories, participation for school groups, free participation for registered pupils.

name: Winterlaufserie Rodgau Jügesheim
description: The Rodgau Winter Running Series is a traditional running event that has been held in Rodgau since 1980, attracting recreational runners as well as top athletes from Germany and abroad. The series features four race dates, each with 5 km and 10 km routes through the Jügesheim Forest, described as fast and flat. The event takes place at the Maingau-Energie Stadium in Rodgau Jügesheim and offers team rankings for men’s, women’s and mixed teams. The organization receives high praise, and there is a COVID-safe outdoor changing area. Timing is handled with a bib chip.
course_highlights: A flat, fast route through the Jügesheim Forest
Event held at the Maingau-Energie Stadium in Rodgau Jügesheim
Team rankings for men’s, women’s and mixed teams
additional: Start times: 5 km at 14:00, 10 km at 15:00. Chip timing using a bib chip (gun-time recording). The first 250 series registrations receive a gift. Club members receive a 50% discount on the entry fee when registering by email. Payment is in cash on site. There is a COVID-safe outdoor changing area (covered). The route is very popular for personal bests. The event takes place on four Saturdays: 1.11.2025, 6.12.2025, 3.1.2026, 7.2.2026. The series comprises several races, with chip timing and refreshments at the stadium. Teams of three are possible. The event is also geared toward winter training, with training plans provided.

name: Augsburger AOK-Winterlaufserie Südring
description: The Augsburg AOK Winter Running Series organized by TG Viktoria Augsburg consists of four races through the beautiful Western Forests Nature Park. The courses run through hilly terrain in the western forests of Augsburg and require good fitness and health. The event offers age-group rankings and an overall ranking with attractive prizes and trophies. The races take place on Saturdays and one Sunday in November and December and are a popular series for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Running routes through the Western Forests Nature Park
Hilly terrain with challenging sections
Course distances of approximately 2.8 to 3.2 km per race
additional: Race numbers are distributed in the start/finish area each time. Portable toilets are available at the Kathreinerstraße car park (races 1–3), and there is space to leave a change of clothes or luggage in a tent or pavilion (at your own risk). Finish refreshments include tea, water and a cake buffet at races 1–3; the fourth race also offers mulled wine and children’s punch. The overall awards ceremony takes place at the forest hut after the fourth race. Parking is available in Bergheim, on Kathreinerstraße and on surrounding streets, but not at the Bergheim sports clubhouse. Races take place in November, with distances ranging from approximately 2.8 km to 9.9 km. The meeting point is usually by the forest car park near Kathreinerstrasse and Brennhölzerweg in Augsburg-Bergheim. November weather can be cool and rainy.

name: Gorlicki Bieg Górski
location: Wysowa-Zdroju, Powiat Gorlicki, Województwo Małopolskie, Poland

tiers.description: 60 zł brutto płatne przelewem w terminie do 30.06.2026 r.

description: Gorlicki Mountain Run is an annual running event held in the scenic surroundings of Radocyna and Magura Małastowska in the Low Beskids. The event offers three distances: 7.6 km, 23.9 km, and a 2.3 km Vertical race with significant elevation gain. It attracts both amateurs and elite runners, offering a unique atmosphere and cash prizes. The participant limit is 400, and the start and finish are located at the State Forests Holiday Resort “Radocyna” and Magura Ski Park. This is the event’s eleventh edition, combining sporting competition with the beauty of mountain nature.
course_highlights: 24 km course with 610 m of elevation gain
7 km course with 160 m of elevation gain
2.3 km Vertical with 340 m of elevation gain to Magura Małastowska
additional: Participant limit: 400 (150 for 7 km, 250 for 24 km). Start and finish at the State Forests Holiday Resort “Radocyna.” Race office open from 7:45 to 10:00. The time limit for the 24 km race is 5 hours. Runners must attach their bibs to the front of their shirt or shorts. Participants with a Rate My Trail ranking of 730 points or higher may enter free of charge. The courses include mountain trails and muddy sections, and the start is scheduled for 10:30. The event attracts both amateurs and experienced trail runners.

name: 20 Gminne Biegi z okazji Święta Niepodległości
Kováčovská desiatka
location: Kováčová, Zvolen District, Banská Bystrica Region, Slovakia

name: Žandovská desítka
description: Žandovská desítka is a traditional 10-kilometer race held in Žandov in the Liberec Region. The event is part of the Českolipsko District Running League and welcomes runners of all ages. The course runs on both roads and trails, offering varied surroundings for competitors. The race is popular with the regional running community and provides an opportunity to challenge yourself and meet fellow running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The course runs on both roads and trails
Part of the regional Českolipsko running league
Suitable for all age groups
additional: The race takes place in November 2026. Registration and further details are not specified. The event is part of a broader series of regional races.

name: Dobřichovický běh
location: Škvárový stadion TJ Sokol Dobřichovice, Dobřichovice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Dobřichovice Run is part of the Brdy Running Cup and offers runners a course approximately 6 km long. The race starts at the cinder track at TJ Sokol Dobřichovice and follows farm roads, providing pleasant running terrain. The event is suitable for both adults and children, who have their own races. The main race starts at 13:00 and is organized by ASK Dipoli.
course_highlights: Course approximately 6 km long
Starts at the cinder track at TJ Sokol Dobřichovice
The course follows farm roads
additional: Start location: TJ Sokol Dobřichovice, Pražská 375. The course was measured by GPS at 5.72 km, though the race information lists it as 6 km. The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup, which also includes children's races. The course combines a cinder track and farm roads. The course includes a cinder track and farm roads; online registration is available; races are suitable for all age groups.

name: Velká kunratická
location: Kunratický les, Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Velká kunratická is one of the oldest running races in the Czech lands. It is held every year on the second Sunday in November in Kunratice Forest in Prague. The race has been run continuously since 1934 and is known for its challenging course and changeable weather, which contribute to its unique atmosphere. A wide range of runners take part, from young children to veterans, competing on six courses ranging from 370 to 3,100 metres. The event is organised by the Spartak Praha 4 athletics club.
course_highlights: Challenging courses through Kunratice Forest
Six courses ranging from 370 m to 3,100 m
Wave starts in pairs, with a 10-second interval
additional: All categories start in pairs at 10-second intervals. Official BUSHMAN-brand T-shirts are available exclusively during registration. Ordered T-shirts can be collected at the tent on the dam. The total number of participants is limited to 3,600, with a limit of 2,700 runners on the route over Hrádek. Registration changes can be made by email until 14 October 2026; after that, they can only be made at check-in. The race takes place in November, with the number of participants limited to 3,400. Online registration opens on 5 October 2026, and on-site registration is available. There are various age and performance categories.

name: Krumlovská 11
location: Hornobránský rybník, Český Krumlov, Czech Republic
