Registration opens in June 2026 and is in high demand due to the limit of 1,000 pre-registrations.
course_highlights: Festively decorated city center of Freiberg
Musical accompaniment from the barrel drummers “Blechlawine” at Schlossplatz
Various race distances from 1 km to 12 km, including a relay
additional: Race number pickup from 12:00 at Rüleinsporthalle; late entries and changes are possible until 1 hour before the start. All races start at Café Hartmann. Start times: Bambini Run 15:00, 1 km Children's Run 15:15, 3 km Teen Run 15:30, 6 km Fun Run 15:45, 12 km Main Run and relay 16:30. Limit of 1,000 pre-registrations. Registration opens in June 2026; late entries are possible on race day. Start times: Bambini Run at 15:00, Children's Run at 15:15, Teen Run at 15:30, Fun Run at 15:45, Main Run at 16:30.

name: Mesumer Adventslauf
description: The Mesum Advent Run is a long-established running event in Rheine, offering various distances from 1 to 10 kilometres. More than 660 runners took part in the 37th edition in pleasant temperatures and sunshine. The event attracts a broad range of participants, including many athletes from Laufgemeinschaft Emsdetten, who achieved excellent results in various age groups. The race offers an appealing competition during Advent for both ambitious and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Races over 1 km, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km
More than 660 finishers
Top placings in various age groups
additional: The race takes place in cool temperatures and usually sunny weather. The event includes several distances suitable for young people and children. Laufgemeinschaft Emsdetten is strongly represented and supports the event. Races in Rheine-Mesum, family-friendly, flat courses, races for children and young people

name: Nikolauslauf
description: The Nikolauslauf in Reichenbach near Lahr/Black Forest is a DLV-sanctioned race eligible for rankings, with distances of 5 km and 10 km. The course follows a 2 x 5 km loop over paved and forest paths, mostly flat with gentle climbs. The start and finish are beside the Schutter, near the Geroldseckerhalle. There is also a 5.5 km walking route through the forest and local districts, offering beautiful views of Hohengeroldseck Castle.
course_highlights: 2 x 5 km loop over paved and forest paths
Flat course profile with gentle, short climbs
Walking route with views of Hohengeroldseck Castle
additional: The 5.5 km walking event starts at 14:10 near the finish area. Based on experience, the start area for the 5 km and 10 km races is very cramped, so arriving early is recommended. The walking route passes historic and scenic points. Courses over paved and forest paths; start and finish beside the Geroldseckerhalle; limited parking; arriving early is recommended.

name: Villmarer Dorflauf
description: The Villmar Village Run is a long-standing race held in Villmar at the end of November. Races are offered over 5 km and 10 km, and young people may also take part in the adult races. The course is flat, and all events finish in the same area. Children’s and youth races are also held; further details are provided in the official race announcement. Now in its 33rd edition, the race is a fixture on the local running calendar.
course_highlights: Flat course
All adult races finish in the same area
Children’s and youth races in addition to the main programme
additional: The 5 km run and 5 km walk start first, followed by the 10 km run. Typical November weather in Villmar is around 7 °C, with frequent rain. The race takes place in November; exact details about registration and participation are available in the official race announcement.

name: Volksbank WeinstadtCross mit DM Cross und Deutschem Cross Cup
description: The Volksbank WeinstadtCross is a traditional cross-country race taking place in Weinstadt on 29 November 2026. The event includes school championships, children’s and youth races, and the JedermannCross on Saturday, while the German Cross Country Championships are held on Sunday. The challenging course runs cross-country over uneven terrain, through mud and up steep climbs, offering runners of all ages and abilities a genuine running experience. The WeinstadtCross is part of the German Cross Cup and attracts participants from across Germany.
course_highlights: Cross-country over uneven terrain
A course with mud and steep climbs
Competition on a course worthy of a German championship
additional: School championships, children’s and youth races, and the JedermannCross take place on Saturday (28.11.26). The German Cross Country Championships are held on Sunday (29.11.26). The event is open to all ages and abilities. It includes school, youth, and open races, takes place in typical November weather with rain and temperatures around 2–7°C, and offers a challenging cross-country course of national significance.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: The 146th Gliwice Park Run Provocation is an annual running event held in Gliwice, combining sport, a friendly atmosphere and time among the city’s green spaces. The run is open to both experienced runners and people who want to spend time actively without the pressure of competition. The start traditionally takes place in the clearing behind the Piast Stadium, and participants can look forward to a welcoming atmosphere and an active way to wrap up February. The event is a great opportunity to start a new month with energy and in a good mood.
course_highlights: Start in the clearing behind Piast Stadium (entrance from Leśna Street)
The route passes through the city’s green spaces
The event combines sport, a friendly atmosphere and recreation
additional: The event office is open from 9:00. To be included in the results, advance registration and an entry fee are required. The event takes place on the last day of February, making it a great way to end the month actively. trail run, online registration, start and finish in the clearing behind Piast Stadium

name: Jesienny Ultra Świr
description: Jesienny Ultra Świr is a mountain ultramarathon held in Grybów, offering a challenge for fans of long-distance running in natural terrain. The course runs mainly along forest and gravel paths, with minimal asphalt, providing an authentic trail-running experience. The event offers different competition formats, including timed races and Nordic Walking, catering to various levels of experience. It is organised by experienced enthusiasts who ensure a welcoming atmosphere and participants’ safety.
course_highlights: 98% of the course runs along forest and gravel paths
Minimal asphalt: just 2%
Start and finish at the Winter Sports Centre in Ptaszkowa
additional: The start, finish and race office are at the Winter Sports Centre in Ptaszkowa. On race day, the race office is open from 06:45 to 07:30 for the 6/12/24-hour distances and until 09:30 for Nordic Walking and the one-lap race. In the 6-hour and 12-hour races, the winner is the participant who completes the greatest number of full 17 km laps. Running is prohibited during the Nordic Walking event, and judges on the course monitor proper technique. Participants must check in at the race office with an identity document and have the mandatory equipment. The event is part of the Jesienny Ultra Świr series, which includes various distances and activity formats, with online registration. The course may be changed due to weather conditions.

name: XXIII Maraton Komandosa
description: The XXIII Commandos Marathon is a demanding 42.195 km marathon held in Lubliniec. The race takes place on 28 November 2026 and is organised by the Wojskowy Klub Biegacza „Meta” Lubliniec. The course has recently been changed and is available online. Participants can expect professional timekeeping and full technical support for the event.
course_highlights: The new course is available online
Marathon distance: 42.195 km
Organiser: Wojskowy Klub Biegacza „Meta” Lubliniec
additional: The race office is open on 28 November from 15:00 to 20:30 and on 29 November from 07:00 to 08:40. The entry fee can only be paid via an individual link to quick online payments through tpay.com, sent by email. After 31 October 2026, entry is possible only with the organiser’s consent and without the full race package. The participant limit has been reached and registration is suspended. New course; participant limit reached; urban and forest terrain; electronic timekeeping.

name: Christmas Run To Tree
description: The Christmas Run To Tree is an atmospheric forest run in Klövensteen Forest near Hamburg, taking place on November 29, 2026. Participants can choose between two distances: 6 km or 12 km. The run combines sporting activity with the special experience of buying a Christmas tree. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and is ideal for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Forest run through scenic Klövensteen Forest
Choice of 6 km or 12 km distance
Race bib in the shape of a Christmas tree
additional: Race packet pickup on event day from 09:00 to 11:15. The race bib is in the shape of a Christmas tree and must be worn visibly on the chest. Bag drop-off is available with the coupon on the race bib. Late entries are not possible. Participant transfers are possible for a fee until November 25. Awards ceremony for the 6 km at 11:15 and for the 12 km at 13:00. The event includes race bib pickup, certificates, Christmas activities, and a festive atmosphere.

name: Adventslauf
description: The Advent Run in Schiffenberger Wald, Giessen, is a flat running event held annually in November. It offers 5 km and 10 km races for adults, as well as races for children and young people. The event is ideal for runners looking for a fast, flat course in a natural setting. The start and finish are at the same location; exact details are available through RUNME Premium. The run takes place on Sunday, November 29, 2026, and starts at 10:15 a.m.
course_highlights: Flat course in Schiffenberger Wald
5 km and 10 km distances for adults
Races for children and young people
additional: The start and finish are the same for all races. The exact start and finish locations are visible only with RUNME Premium. There are also 5 km walking and Nordic walking events. Results are usually published on the RUNME results page shortly after runners finish. The event is for adults, children, and young people, with start times in the morning. The exact start and finish locations are visible only with RUNME Premium.

name: Adventslauf SV Weiden e.V.
description: The SV Weiden e.V. Advent Run is a traditional, family-friendly fun run that has been held for more than three decades on the first Sunday of Advent in the Fuchswald forest near the sports grounds in the Rottweil region. The varied course runs mostly along forest and farm tracks and offers runners of all abilities an enjoyable running experience. Alongside the main race and middle-distance race, there are also children’s races and a little ones’ race, making the event suitable for the whole family.
course_highlights: Course runs mostly along forest and farm tracks
Main race: 10.7 km; middle-distance race: 5.9 km
Children’s races and a little ones’ race on the sports field and field paths
additional: The Advent Run is open to Nordic walkers, recreational runners and competitive runners. Numerous training plans are available to help participants prepare. More than 200 runners take part, and the children’s races attract 28 children and young people. The 350 m little ones’ race takes place on the sports field. The courses are close to nature and family-friendly, with Nordic walking options.

name: FORD Advent-Lauf
location: Leinpfad, Daarler Brücke, Saarbrücken, Saarland, Germany
description: The FORD Advent Run is a traditional road race held in late November in Saarbrücken, on the Leinpfad at Daarler Brücke. It is part of the Sparkassen City Run Series and offers a range of distances—10 km, 5 km and 2 km—for experienced runners, beginners and children. The event is organised by SV GO! Saar 05 Leichtathletik e.V., with support from SparkasseSB, Ford and LottoSaartoto. Registration is through meisterchip.de, and the courses are officially measured, allowing results to qualify for rankings.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the Leinpfad at Daarler Brücke in Saarbrücken
Part of the Sparkassen City Run Series
2 km, 5 km and 10 km distances for different groups of runners
additional: Typical November weather, with an average temperature of 7 °C, lows of around 2 °C and rainy days. The race is listed in the German running calendar system, and the courses are officially measured. The race takes place in Saarbrücken, with the start and finish on the Leinpfad at Daarler Brücke. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and is a great opportunity to kick off the Advent season with some exercise.

name: Friedeholz Cross
description: The Friedeholz Cross is a traditional forest cross-country race in Syke, Lower Saxony, and part of the Syke-Weyher Cross Series. On November 29, 2026, races will be held over various distances, from a 1.3 km schoolchildren’s race to the 10.3 km main race, for children, young people, and adults. The course runs mostly on forest trails, with a short asphalt section before the finish at Waldstadion Syke. The event offers a varied cross-country running experience in an autumn setting and is ideal for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Mostly forest trails with only approx. 100 m of asphalt
Start and finish at Waldstadion Syke
Part of the Syke-Weyher Cross Series, with several distances
additional: Four distances on race day: 1.3 km schoolchildren’s race, 3.6 km middle distance for U16 and older, and 10.3 km main race for U20 and older. The event is part of a series of three races, with series scoring for those who register before the first race. Switching between the middle and long distances is possible, but does not count as a series switch. Forest trails, cross-country running, series scoring, registration required for series scoring, limited shower and changing facilities at Waldstadion Syke

name: Lorsbacher Winterlauf- und Walkingserie
location: Langenhainer Wald, Hofheim-Lorsbach, Hochtaunuskreis, Hessen, Germany
description: The Lorsbach Winter Running and Walking Series is a long-standing series in the Langenhain Forest near Hofheim-Lorsbach, held on five Sundays during the winter months. Participants can choose between 10 km and 20 km routes, which are permanently signposted and can also be used for walking or hiking. The start is free, there is no timing, and the event is all about running together without a competitive element. On running Sundays, participants are served tea at a refreshment station, and coffee and biscuits are available in the sports hall after the run. At the final event, soup, wheat beer, coffee and cake are also served.
course_highlights: Permanently signposted 10 km route in the Langenhain Forest
An additional loop for the 20 km route is signposted from late November to mid-February
Hot tea available at the refreshment station near the Bahai’i forest car park (approx. km 6.4)
additional: Starts are individual, with no timing. No registration is required. Participation is free, with voluntary donations welcome. Changing rooms in the sports hall at Schinderwald are open on Sundays from 8:00 to 13:00. Coffee and biscuits are available after the run; at the final event, soup and wheat beer are also served. Bring your own collapsible cup for tea. Route profiles are available on Komoot. Routes: 10 km and 20 km; challenging and varied routes; no timing; individual starts; GPS track via Komoot; tea station with tea, coffee, biscuits, soup, wheat beer, coffee and cake; changing rooms in the sports hall; parking at the sports field and Park & Ride; no registration required.

name: Pfungstädter Advents-Crosslauf
description: The Pfungstädter Advent Cross-Country Run is a traditional cross-country event reaching its 57th edition in 2026. The races take place on an established course with cross-country conditions and offer appealing competitions for all age groups, from children to seniors. The event is part of the Langlaufcup and the HLV Darmstadt-Dieburg District Cross-Country Series. Staggered start times make for exciting races across various distances and age groups.
course_highlights: Cross-country course of approx. 3,700 m for the middle-distance race
Long-distance race of approx. 7,300 m over 6 cross-country laps
Sprint course of approx. 850 m for children and youth
additional: Race packets for schools will be distributed on the hard-surface court; all other participants can collect theirs in the youth room. No late entries or changes are possible on site. Start times are approximate and may be changed slightly. Online registration only, until 28.11.2025; no late entries on site; refreshments available; toilets in the Ludwig-Crössmann-Heim; no changing or shower facilities.

name: Ratzeburger Adventslauf
description: The Ratzeburg Advent Run is a traditional race around Lake Ratzeburg, taking place on November 29, 2026. The main course covers 26 kilometres, mostly on hiking trails with scenic sections and historical landmarks. There is also a 7.5 km run around Küchensee and a 1.5 km children’s run, offering an accessible introduction to running. The event combines a sporting challenge with nature and a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 26 km around Lake Ratzeburg, with approx. 80% hiking trails and 20% asphalt
5 refreshment stations along the course at km 5, 10, 15, 20 and 22.5
A scenic, undulating 7.5 km route around Küchensee, plus a 1.5 km children’s run with spectator support
additional: New since 2022: split-time tracking on the 26 km course, allowing spectators and athletes to follow intermediate times. The races start at the same time, with runners lining up on the right-hand side at the start on Königsdamm. The children’s run is supported by Dein-Holzpferd.de. Routes around Lake Ratzeburg and Küchensee; online registration opens on 01.09.2026; participant limits apply to each distance; timing by Race Result.

name: Schlößlelauf - 4. Lauf der Jedermannlaufserie
description: The Schlößlelauf in Donauwörth is the fourth race in the Jedermannlauf series and offers runners of all ages and ability levels an attractive opportunity to compete. The event is organised by LG Donau-Ries and traditionally takes place in late autumn. The course passes through the scenic surroundings of Donauwörth and is part of a popular running series in the region. The event promotes recreational sport and is aimed at children, young people and active runners.
course_highlights: Part of the Jedermannlauf series
Various categories for all age groups
Race in the historic town of Donauwörth
additional: Registration is by email. The event includes running and cycling events, as well as filters for terrain and sport type.

name: Schmachtendorfer Nikolauslauf
description: The Schmachtendorf St. Nicholas Run is a traditional running event held in late November in Oberhausen-Schmachtendorf, organized by Spvgg. Sterkrade-Nord 1920/25 e.V. The event offers races for all age groups, from a 300-meter Bambini run to a 10 km run for adults. The course runs mostly along forest trails in Dunkelschlag and around the Buchenweg sports ground. Every participant receives a Stutenkerl, and awards are presented promptly after each race, with prizes for the top runners in each category.
course_highlights: 300-meter loop around the artificial-turf pitch on Buchenweg (Bambini run)
10 km run mostly along forest trails in Dunkelschlag
Start and finish at the Buchenweg sports ground; no traditional city-center course
additional: Electronic chip timing using the chip in the race bib, provided by TAF-TIMING. Certificates are available on the event day or online later. Parking is signposted at Heinrich Böll Comprehensive School and at the Schmachtendorfer Straße market square. Distances: 300 m Bambini run and 10 km for adults; course on forest trails and sports grounds; children’s and adult categories; November weather may be rainy.

name: Uplengener Adventslauf
description: The Uplengen Advent Run is a traditional cross-country race taking place for the 54th time. The races run through the Hollsand Nature Reserve and offer challenging courses depending on the weather. The event is one of the oldest running events in the region and is often used to prepare for cross-country championships. Various course distances give young people and adults the opportunity to achieve personal bests or improve their endurance. The Remels Primary School Friends’ Association will provide coffee and cake.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through the Hollsand Nature Reserve
Challenging courses depending on the weather
Various course distances for different age groups
additional: U14 runners can choose between 1450 m and 3100 m; U16 runners can take part in the 4450 m middle-distance race. The red loop is approximately 3000 m plus a 100 m start chute. The course uses a checkpoint system for route guidance. Cross-country race in the Hollsand Nature Reserve; course distances vary; registration and results online; coffee and cake from the Remels Primary School Friends’ Association.

name: Weihnachtsmarktlauf
description: The Christmas Market Run in Landstuhl is a traditional race held annually on November 30. With a 7.6 km main race and a 1.3 km students’ race, it offers a sporting challenge for various age groups. The event is organized by LLG Landstuhl e.V. and is known for its friendly atmosphere and scoring for clubs and groups. Registration is open from October 15 to November 28, and on-site registration is available.
course_highlights: 7.6 km main race
1.3 km students’ race
Age-group scoring and group competition
additional: Registration is open from October 15 to November 28. On-site registration is available. There are performance and group competitions, with prize money for the top participants and groups. The race takes place on November 30. Online registration is available, with prizes for individual and group competitions. The course runs through the festively decorated town.

name: Überruhrer Adventscrosslauf
description: The Überruhrer Advent Cross-Country Run takes place on November 29, 2026, in Essen-Überruhr. Its cross-country course takes runners through wintry nature in keeping with the Advent season. The event is open to all age groups, from children to seniors, and is held in accordance with the German Athletics Regulations (DLO). The awards ceremony and certificate distribution take place right next to the course, creating a friendly, sporting atmosphere. A catering stand in the finish area serves hot and cold drinks and snacks.
course_highlights: Cross-country course through the natural surroundings of Essen-Überruhr
Age-group categories from U8 through seniors M/W 80
Awards ceremony and certificate distribution right next to the course
additional: Parking is available in the adjacent residential area; the recommended parking location is Marktplatz Überruhr (approx. 500 m on foot). Public transport is available via bus routes SB15, 144, 166, and 177. Catering in the finish area includes hot and cold drinks, cake, and bratwurst. The race office is located in the park. Certificates can be printed via Race Result. The race takes place on the first Sunday of Advent, in typical November weather, with temperatures around 2–7°C and frequent rain. The event is open to everyone who enjoys cross-country running and offers a friendly atmosphere, with the awards ceremony held on site.

name: 45 Strzeliński Rogaining
location: Kamiennik, Strzelin County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Polskie Towarzystwo Turystyczno-Krajoznawcze Oddział Ziemi Strzelińskiej
description: Strzeliński Rogaining is a walking orienteering event in which teams of 2–5 plan their own route to visit as many checkpoints as possible within a set time. The checkpoints are spread across the terrain and marked on a map. The event is open to participants of different ages and experience levels, from enthusiasts and recreational participants to families. Rogaining combines tourism and sport, and participants can modify their route at any time during the competition, making it an appealing way to enjoy the outdoors. The event is organised by the Polish Tourist and Sightseeing Society, Strzelin District Branch, which has been holding orienteering competitions in the region for many years.
course_highlights: Teams travel on foot only, using a map and compass to navigate the terrain
Checkpoints have different point values depending on how difficult they are to find
Participants can choose and change their own route, at any length from 5 to 70 km
additional: The competition is open to all age groups and genders. Teams consist of 2–5 people. Rogaining combines tourism and sport and is suitable for both experienced competitors and families. Routes can be changed during the competition. In 2026, four rogaining events are planned around Strzelin, including the 45th edition in November. The events offer distances from 5 km to 70 km and use maps and compasses. They cater to different experience levels and offer both recreational and competitive participation.

name: Szybka Piątka
description: Szybka Piątka is a 5 km race held in Lublin on 29 November 2026. The event is part of a series of races organized by the Sports Development Foundation in Lublin, which promotes physical activity and the integration of the local community. The race is an excellent opportunity for runners of all levels to test their fitness and enjoy the city’s sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the city
Training support for 8 to 20 weeks
Organized by a local sports foundation
additional: The race is part of local sporting events and includes various distances and age categories, as well as the Lublin Grand Prix classifications.

name: Wiedenbrücker Christkindllauf
description: The Wiedenbrücker Christkindllauf is a popular race around the Christmas market in Wiedenbrück’s old town, illuminated for the festive season. The course is a five-lap circuit of approximately 10.2 km and has not been officially measured. The race traditionally takes place in December and offers a festive atmosphere in the town centre. The event is organised by LG Burg Wiedenbrück and attracts numerous runners from the region.
course_highlights: Five-lap circuit around the Christmas market
Wiedenbrück’s old town illuminated for the festive season
Approximately 10.2 km; run clockwise
additional: Start and finish on Lange Straße in Wiedenbrück. Race-pack collection on 5.12.2025 from 15:00 at the Luise-Hensel-Saal in the Stadthaus. Online registration only, opening on 8.10.2025 at 21:00. No race-day registration. Time limit: 75 minutes. Wearing headphones or earbuds is prohibited and will result in disqualification. Participants are asked to keep as far to the right as possible and not to run in groups, to allow others to lap them. Participant limit: 1,100. Online registration only. Medals can be reordered. Start on 04.12.2026.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Gdansk
description: Garmin Ultra Race Gdańsk is an exceptional trail race taking place on 5 December 2026 in the picturesque Tricity Landscape Park. The course combines a seaside atmosphere with varied, mountainous terrain, offering runners challenging climbs, valleys, ravines and gorges. It is a great opportunity to end the season amid sporting competition and close contact with nature. The event is part of a nationwide mountain-running series that promotes physical activity and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Tricity Landscape Park, close to the sea
Varied terrain with dense forests, valleys, ravines and gorges
Challenging elevation gains and natural climbs characteristic of trail running
additional: Race packs can be collected on 4–5 December 2026 at the race office. Starts are held in waves: the 6 km night race starts at 19:00 on 4 December; on 5 December, the 101 km (05:00), 53 km (07:45), 27 km (10:30) and 12 km (13:30) races start, along with Garmin Junior races for children. Time limits for completing the distances range from 2 to 15 hours, depending on course length. Discounts are available when registering for more than one event in the series. The participant card is available 5 days before the race after logging in to startlist.pl. Distances from 12 km to 86 km, time limits, qualifying points for Ultra Trail du Mont Blanc, and accompanying races for children and young people.

name: Maraton Praha – Dobříš
location: A Park, Braník, Praha 4, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Prague–Dobříš Marathon is a traditional trail race held on 5 December 2026. The event offers three distances: 42 km with an individual start, and 21 km and 10 km with mass starts. The route runs from Prague 4, Braník, through Dobříš to Kytín, with elevation ranging from 125 to 593 metres. Runners can use baggage transport from the start to the finish. Overall winners and age- and gender-based category winners are announced. The event is suited to trail-running enthusiasts looking for a challenge in a natural setting, with a choice of distances.
course_highlights: 42 km course with 593 m of elevation gain
Start in Prague 4, Braník; finish in Kytín
Baggage transport for runners from the start to the finish
additional: The 42 km race has an individual start; the 21 km and 10 km races have mass starts. The 42 km course has aid stations at kilometres 10, 16, 27 and 33, and at the finish. Parking is available near the start and finish area. Runners take part at their own risk and must take extra care when crossing roads. The course is suitable for runners of all levels. Online registration is available, along with course maps and information about race categories.

name: Mikulášský běh Čimelice
description: The Mikulášský běh Čimelice is a traditional annual race held in Čimelice, a popular event with a long history that usually takes place in early December. It attracts local runners and visitors, who can look forward to a sporting experience in a friendly atmosphere. Exact details about the course and race distance are not currently available, but the race is part of the local sporting calendar and has a long tradition.
course_highlights: A traditional race with a long history in Čimelice
Held annually in December
Friendly atmosphere and local community
additional: The race is part of the local sporting calendar. Results from 2025 are available online.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - prosinec
description: The 2-Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt loop. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and the start at 9:00. Every participant is rewarded at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt loop covering just under two laps (3.2 km)
The children's course is 800 m long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and over, and children aged 12 and under (boys and girls). Every runner is timed, and the top three finishers in the adult and children's categories receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get there are by bicycle, on foot, by car, on inline skates, or by trolleybus No. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). The course is a precisely measured asphalt loop; the children's course is 800 m long. The race is open to all age groups, with categories for men, women, boys, and girls. You can start by bicycle, on foot, by car, on inline skates, or by trolleybus No. 11.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - prosinec
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka Park is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, including children up to 12 years old, who run 1.6 km. The race has a friendly atmosphere and encourages everyone to enjoy running, whether you want to improve your personal best or simply enjoy a pleasant run in a beautiful park. After the finish, everyone gets a warm cinnamon pancake. The course follows the park’s paved paths; adults run two laps and children one.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths in Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km); children up to 12 years old run 1 lap (1.6 km)
Beautiful setting in the Royal Game Reserve – Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Brussels Gate (below the Marold Panorama building) from 8:15 to 8:45. Pre-registration online is available for faster check-in. Categories are divided by age, with an age-adjustment coefficient used for the year-round Lívancový Cup. Recommended ways to get there are by bicycle, on foot, on roller skates, or by tram (Výstaviště stop). Changing and bag-drop tents, a mobile valuables storage facility, and toilet cabins are available. Parking is recommended near the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou Street. 3.2 km course, road surface, registration is voluntary, and running without a bib is permitted.

name: LEKI WINTER SkyRace®
description: LEKI WINTER SkyRace® is a winter skyrunning race held at Ještěd, in the ski jump area. The race offers a challenging 22 km royal course with 1,180 metres of elevation gain, bringing the 2025 skyrunning season to a close. Shorter courses and children’s races are also available, welcoming a wide range of runners. The event atmosphere is rounded out by the winners’ ceremony and an accompanying programme.
course_highlights: Winter SkyRace® royal course: 22 km with 1,180 m of elevation gain
Other courses: Winter Trail 12 km / 520 m+, Winter Easy 6 km / 220 m+
Children’s races: 200 m, 500 m and 1,200 m
additional: The winners’ ceremony starts at 15:30. The race takes place in the ski jump area at Ještěd. Canicross races are also available over the same distances as the main courses. The race is part of the LEKI JEŠTĚD SERIES. winter mountain race, multiple courses, children’s races, canicross, registration, race equipment and refreshments

name: LEKI JEŠTĚD SkyRace®
description: LEKI JEŠTĚD SkyRace® is a trail-running race held on the Ještěd Ridge in the Liberec Region. It offers challenging courses with beautiful views and natural scenery, appealing to both experienced runners and fans of mountain running. The race is part of the JEŠTĚD SKYRACE series and is known for its friendly atmosphere, high-quality organization, and extensive accompanying program, including healthy refreshments and a partner zone. Participants can also purchase original merchandise for the race’s 10th anniversary.
course_highlights: Trails on the Ještěd Ridge with beautiful views
Challenging mountain terrain with courses of varying distances (22 km, 13 km, 6 km)
Extensive accompanying program, including healthy and varied refreshments
additional: Participants receive a specially stocked race bag. Healthy and varied refreshments are available, including meat, vegetarian, and vegan options, as well as quality coffee. The event also features a TV studio with interviews and competitions, and an expanded partner zone with equipment and accessories for runners. Original merchandise for the race’s 10th anniversary is available. Races on different courses, a series of summer and winter races, registration, results, and rules are available on the official website.

name: Čertovská 5
description: Čertovská 5 is a traditional winter run in Unhošť over a distance of 5.7 km. It offers not only a sporting experience, but also a social gathering and the announcement of the Sokol Cup results. Runners are welcome to wear devil costumes, adding a unique atmosphere to the race. The race is divided into categories by age and gender, allowing for fair competition. The event takes place at the Sokol hall and is popular with locals and visitors alike.
course_highlights: Traditional 5.7 km winter run
Runners in devil costumes are welcome
Sokol Cup results announced after the race
additional: The race takes place on 6 December 2025 from 08:00 to 11:00 in Unhošť, at the Sokol hall, Melicharova Street. Categories are divided by age and gender (men and women in different age groups). After the race, there is a social gathering and the announcement of the Sokol Cup results. Terrain: winter course. Registration via naZávody.cz. The event is suitable for all age groups and fans of dressing up.

name: Běh do vrchu Ráztoka-Pustevny
description: The Ráztoka–Pustevny Uphill Run is a traditional mountain race held in Ráztoky and around Pustevny. It offers a challenging course with elevation gain that tests runners’ endurance and strength in the beautiful setting of the Moravian-Silesian Beskids. The event is popular with athletes of all levels and has a rich history dating back to 1969. It welcomes everyone who enjoys mountain running and wants to experience the race’s unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: Climb to Pustevny with 400 m of elevation gain
Course length of approximately 5.7 km
Mountain setting in the Moravian-Silesian Beskids
additional: The race is also suitable for children. Weather may affect conditions. Registration details are not provided. The event has a long tradition and is very popular.

name: Jested Series
description: Ještěd Skyrace is a technical trail-running race on the Ještěd Ridge, featuring challenging climbs and descents with up to 1,390 metres of elevation gain. The race is suitable for both recreational runners and professionals and includes several route options, including races for children. The event is part of a race series with a friendly atmosphere and a generous participant race pack.
course_highlights: Technical trail sections on the Ještěd Ridge
Challenging climbs and descents with up to 1,390 m of elevation gain
Route options from 6 km to 22 km, including children’s races
additional: Mandatory equipment is required. Race bibs and timing chips are provided. On-site registration is available, along with bag storage, changing rooms and toilets. Refreshments and an awards ceremony are provided after the finish. The race is livestreamed, and results are available online. The race also offers canicross options and children’s races on shorter routes. The series also includes children’s races. The listed Winter SkyRace distances are 22, 12 and 6 km; the date 5 December 2026 is not confirmed in the available information.

name: Last Man Standing Run VYSOČINA
description: Last Man Standing Run Vysočina is a unique endurance race held on December 5, 2026, at Želiv Monastery. Competitors repeatedly complete a 6.7 km loop, starting every hour, with the aim of lasting as long as possible and lining up for another start on the hour. The inaugural edition is limited to a maximum of 24 hours and 24 loops, with the winner being the person who completes all 24 loops. The race is not about speed, but about endurance and the ability to overcome physical and mental challenges in the winter conditions of Vysočina.
course_highlights: A 6.7 km loop through the hilly terrain of Vysočina
A new start every hour, up to a maximum of 24 loops / 24 hours
The official time is set by the tolling of the church bell at Želiv Monastery
additional: The race is limited to a maximum of 24 hours and 24 loops. Every competitor must wear their race bib throughout the event and keep a timing chip on their ankle. Headphones are prohibited on the course for safety reasons. Registration is processed manually; payment details are sent by email after the application has been processed. A T-shirt can be ordered as an add-on for 490 Kč. The official race time is set by the tolling of the church bell, which also symbolically closes the finish gate on the hour. The entry fee includes participation, light refreshments and facilities. Mandatory equipment includes a red rear light, a reflective item, neck protection and a personal drinking container. Part of the route may run along roads open to regular traffic.

name: /10k Rainbow Run 2026
location: Frankfurt am Main, Frankfurt City Forest, Hesse, Germany
description: The 5/10k Rainbow Run is a trail race in Frankfurt’s Goldstein City Forest, taking place on December 5, 2026. Participants can choose between one 5 km lap or two laps for 10 km. The course runs mostly on firm forest paths, with some sections on asphalt, making it suitable for both beginners and runners looking for a faster pace. The race is part of the FVV XMAS Tournament weekend and stands against homophobia in sport by promoting an open and tolerant society. The event welcomes a diverse field of runners, including queer athletes, allies, and people of all ages and backgrounds.
course_highlights: Forest course in Frankfurt’s Goldstein City Forest
Firm forest paths with some sections on asphalt
Part of the long-running FVV XMAS Tournament, with more than 30 years of LGBTIQ* sports history
additional: In addition to the run, the FVV XMAS Tournament includes a Saturday evening party, a Sunday brunch, and a city tour. Typical December weather is around 3 °C, with frequent snowfall and an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The FVV XMAS Tournament weekend also features social events such as a party, brunch, and city tour, and supports LGBTQ+ causes.

name: Berliner Nikolauslauf 2026
price_range: 5,00 Euro bis 30,00 Euro (je nach Kategorie und Anmeldungstermin)
description: The 2026 Berlin St. Nicholas Run is a traditional race around the picturesque Schlachtensee and Krumme Lanke lakes in Berlin’s Grunewald forest. The course follows a measured 5.3-kilometre lakeside path that is popular with both recreational visitors and competitive athletes. The event offers a range of distances for the whole family, from the Bambini Marathon to the Big 5 Marathon, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and scenic surroundings. It takes place on December 6, 2026, and is organised by DIE LAUFPARTNER e.V.
course_highlights: A loop around Schlachtensee, 5.3 km per lap
A nature-rich route through Berlin’s Grunewald forest
A popular training route with top athletes and recreational visitors
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day from 8:00 a.m. at Fischerhüttenstraße 137, 14163 Berlin, near the turning circle between Schlachtensee and Krumme Lanke. Race-day late entries are available online, subject to an additional fee. The event offers a range of distances for runners and Nordic walkers, as well as relay races. Distances range from 330 m to 26.8 km. Registration is available online or in writing; race-day late entries are online only and subject to a fee. Race bibs can be collected in Berlin.

name: Forchheimer Nikolauslauf
description: The Forchheim Nikolauslauf is a long-standing running event hosted by LG Forchheim on the Sportinsel in Forchheim. The 46th edition takes place on December 5, 2026, and features races for children and young people, a 5.3 km fun run, and a 10 km main race. The course follows a new route heading south, with the 10 km race making four circuits around the Sportinsel. The event regularly attracts more than 600 participants and offers a friendly, sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Children’s and youth races in the morning, starting at 11:20 a.m.
5.3 km fun run on a new route heading south (4 laps)
10 km main race with four laps around the Sportinsel
additional: Start times: children’s and youth races from 11:20 a.m., 5.3 km fun run at 1:00 p.m., 10 km main race at 2:00 p.m. The 5.3 km course is run four times heading south; the 10 km course is run four times around the Sportinsel. Various race categories, festive atmosphere, traditional December event, children’s and youth races, 5.3 km fun run, 10 km main race.

name: Nikolauslauf
description: The Nikolauslauf in Schnaitheim is a traditional running event held annually at Moldenberg. The event offers various distances for students, fitness runners, and trail runners, including 5 km, 10 km, and a 12 km trail run. Runners can look forward to a varied course in a sporty, family-friendly atmosphere. TSG Schnaitheim Athletics looks forward to welcoming all participants on December 5.
course_highlights: Children’s races with age-appropriate courses
5 km fitness run and walking on varied terrain
12 km trail run with sections close to nature
additional: The Nikolauslauf takes place at Moldenberg. The event is organized by TSG Schnaitheim 1874 e.V. Various race distances are available for different age and ability groups. Results and rankings from previous races are available to download. The event takes place on December 5, 2026, with course analyses, elevation details, and downloadable results. It is a popular event for runners and walkers in the region.

name: Steinfurter Nikolauslauf 10 km
description: The Steinfurter Nikolauslauf 10 km is an annual pre-Christmas road race in Steinfurt, Germany, held as part of the Nikolausmarkt. The race starts at the historic market square in Burgsteinfurt and finishes at the Nikolausmarkt. The course first passes through the historic old town, then follows natural forest trails around the Bagno recreation area before returning to the market. Since its founding in 1975, the race has become a fixture in the local running calendar, attracting both club and recreational runners from the region.
course_highlights: Start at the historic market square in Burgsteinfurt
Route through the historic old town
Loop on natural forest trails around the Bagno recreation area
additional: Typical December weather: approx. 3 °C, usually snow-covered, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. 10 km race, typical December weather with possible snowfall; participants are usually local club members and recreational runners.

name: Winterlaufserie Rodgau Jügesheim (2)
description: The Rodgau Winter Running Series is a long-standing running event that has taken place in Rodgau-Jügesheim since 1980, attracting both recreational runners and top athletes from Germany and abroad. The series comprises four events, each offering 5 km and 10 km distances, starting at the Maingau-Energie-Stadion. Alongside the sporting competition, community spirit is also a key focus, supported by team scoring for men’s, women’s and mixed teams. The event is easy to reach by public transport and offers professional timing with a chip attached to each race number.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Maingau-Energie-Stadion in Rodgau-Jügesheim
5 km and 10 km distances
Easy to reach by S-Bahn (S1), with only a 1 km walk from the station
additional: Team scoring is available for teams of three (men, women, mixed). Chip timing with gun-time recording by MA:XX-. The first 250 series registrations receive a gift. Series dates: 1.11.2025, 6.12.2025, 3.1.2026, 7.2.2026. The series comprises several races, with team scoring also available. The routes are on paved and asphalted forest paths, which often have snow or frost in winter conditions. Training plans for various target times are offered to help runners prepare for the races.

name: MOUNTAINMAN Nikolaus-Trail Pommelsbrunn
description: The MOUNTAINMAN Nikolaus Trail in Pommelsbrunn offers trail running and hiking in the picturesque Hersbrucker Schweiz in the Nürnberger Land. On December 5, 2026, runners can choose from four challenging routes ranging from 10 km to a marathon, and families can take part in the Wichtel Trail. The trails are well marked and cross varied terrain with some challenging climbs, making them ideal for both ambitious runners and beginners. A free shuttle service makes getting there easier, and there are special options for trail runners with dogs.
course_highlights: Four routes from 10 km to a marathon, with challenging climbs
Well-marked trails in the Hersbrucker Schweiz
Wichtel Trail for families and special trails for runners with dogs
additional: On Saturday, December 5, 2026, the XL and L trails and the Wichtel Trail take place; on Sunday, December 6, 2026, the S and M trails take place, including options for runners with dogs. A free shuttle service runs from parking areas in Happurg to the start and finish area. The routes are fully marked, and participants receive a voucher code 14 days before the event for a free Komoot route download. Parking in Pommelsbrunn is limited, so travel by public transport is recommended. Trails with up to 1,582 meters of elevation gain, aid stations, well-marked routes, GPS downloads available.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The 17th Mysłowice Grand Prix is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, promoting a healthy, active lifestyle and bringing together runners of all abilities. The event takes place in Mysłowice and is open to all age groups and running levels. Participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to compete throughout the Grand Prix series. Registration is available only at the Race Office on race day, and participation is free.
course_highlights: 10 km race in the scenic surroundings of Mysłowice
A series of seasonal events promoting a healthy lifestyle
A running community and opportunities to connect with the local community
additional: Registration for the Grand Prix series is available only at the Race Office on race day. Participation in the Grand Prix races is free. The event is open to everyone, regardless of age or ability. It focuses on promoting physical activity, health, and the running community, with varied courses and seasonal editions.

name: Malá cena Velké Verandy
description: The Malá cena Velké Verandy is a traditional forest cross-country race held in Choceň. The race is 4,300 metres long and follows forest roads and trails, with approximately 200 metres of elevation gain. The course is marked with ribbons and includes a short stretch of asphalt. The race is also the Jirka Švadlena Memorial and is popular with runners looking for challenging terrain with a hilly profile.
course_highlights: 4,300 m along forest roads and trails
Hilly profile with approximately 200 m of elevation gain
Course marked with ribbons, approximately 400 m of asphalt
additional: The race includes approximately 400 m of asphalt and is suitable for runners looking for a challenge in a natural setting. It is part of the local sporting calendar.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - prosinec
description: The Olomouc 2-Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The race takes place in the picturesque setting of Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, where everyone can enjoy running for fun and compete primarily against themselves. It also includes a cup competition, with results adjusted using an age coefficient and runners collecting points throughout the year. Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:00. The start is by the fountain in the park.
course_highlights: A 2-mile (3.2 km) course in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc
A race suitable for all ages and running abilities
A picturesque park setting, with the fountain as the starting point
additional: Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:00. The race venue is by the fountain in Smetana Gardens, except for two races in June and August, which take place by the river on U Dětského domova Street. The top three finishers in each category receive awards. The race is held on an asphalt course. It is part of a series of runs in Olomouc, with multiple dates throughout the year.

name: Adventslauf
description: The Advent Run in Lage is a traditional running event organized by the running division of TG Lage. The course runs through the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park and features well-maintained forest trails, partly along the famous Hermann Trail. The run is suitable for runners of all ability levels and takes place annually in December. The event is part of TG Lage’s varied running and walking program, which also offers beginner courses and training opportunities.
course_highlights: Course through the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park
Well-maintained, easy-to-run forest trails
Sections along the famous Hermann Trail
additional: TG Lage’s running division also offers a Nordic walking beginner course that covers the basics in 4 sessions of 60 minutes each. Walking poles are available to borrow. There is also a 10-session pass for time-limited training participation, valid for 6 months and 10 training sessions. The office is open on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Run on forest and field paths in the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park, on the 2nd Sunday of Advent; easy to reach, with a festive atmosphere in the gym.

name: FT Jahn Nikolauslauf
location: Jahn Vereinsheim, Landsberg am Lech, Bavaria, Germany
description: The FT Jahn Nikolauslauf in Landsberg am Lech is a traditional running event held annually in December. It offers various distances for all age groups and fitness levels, from 1 km for children to 10 km for endurance runners. Nordic walking is also included. The event combines sporting ambition with a friendly community atmosphere in one of Germany’s most beautiful towns, inviting everyone to kick off the Advent season in an active way.
course_highlights: Distances from 1 km to 10 km for different age groups
Winter atmosphere in the historic town of Landsberg am Lech
Combination of running and Nordic walking events
additional: Start times are staggered by distance: the 1 km and 2 km races start at 11:00, the 5 km run and Nordic walking event at 11:30, and the 10 km run at 11:45. Minimum ages vary by distance (6 years for 1 km, 12 years for 2 km, and 16 years for 5 km and 10 km). The event takes place at the Jahn clubhouse in Landsberg am Lech. Running and Nordic walking distances from 1 km to 10 km; various age groups; winter atmosphere; registration required.

name: Heeslinger Nikolauscross
description: The Heeslingen Nikolaus Cross-Country Run is a popular cross-country race held annually in Heeslingen, Lower Saxony. The event attracts athletes and families from the region and is known for its high-level sporting challenges. The races also determine the district champions of Rotenburg/W. The organizer, Heeslinger SC, is an established point of contact for sports enthusiasts and volunteers from the surrounding communities.
course_highlights: Cross-country run through varied terrain
Determination of the district champions of Rotenburg/W.
Event in the Heeslingen region with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: Courses and participation conditions are available in the relevant event announcement; no entry fee is required. The event is open to runners of all ages, including children, young people, adults and masters.

name: Ilsfelder Nikolauslauf
price_range: 6,00 € bis 12,00 € je nach Lauf und Anmeldung
description: The Ilsfeld St. Nicholas Run is a traditional running event taking place on 6 December 2026 in Ilsfeld. The races follow scenic circular routes along the Schozach through the municipality. Whether you are a beginner or a pro, the focus here is on the enjoyment of running. In addition to individual and group entries, there is also a St. Nicholas category for runners wearing a St. Nicholas costume. The event is approved by the German Athletics Association and takes place in all weather conditions.
course_highlights: Run along the Schozach on a scenic circular route
Distances: 1.6 km schoolchildren’s run, 5 km Volksbank Run, 10 km TRZ Siegele Run
St. Nicholas category for runners wearing a St. Nicholas costume (excluding the school run)
additional: Timing is recorded as net time using a single-use transponder system attached to the race number. The awards ceremony takes place in the community hall. Prizes are awarded to the St. Nicholas costume winners, the largest group, the fastest group and solo runners. The courses are not officially measured and are not eligible for rankings. Registration by 25 November 2026 allows participants to receive a personalized race number; after that date, only standard race numbers are available. The event takes place in all weather conditions. St. Nicholas costumes must include trousers (a skirt is also acceptable), a top and a hat. Individual and group starts are available. The St. Nicholas category includes gifts. Online registration. Transponder timing. Awards ceremony in the community hall.

name: itdesign-Nikolauslauf Tübingen
description: The itdesign Nikolauslauf Tübingen is a traditional half marathon organized by Post-SV Tübingen since 1976. The course is officially measured and recognized as a road race, making it eligible for rankings. It runs along finely gravelled forest paths and paved sections with moderate climbs, providing a varied challenge. Refreshment stations along the course and at the finish ensure runners are well supplied. In addition to the main race, the event offers a 10 km school competition and a virtual 10 km run.
course_highlights: Officially measured half marathon (21.1 km), eligible for rankings
Finely gravelled forest paths and approx. 8.5 km of paved paths
Maximum elevation difference of approx. 82 metres, total ascent of approx. 300 metres
additional: Start and finish are at Waldhäuser Straße 120, 72076 Tübingen, approx. 200 metres from the runners’ expo. The runners’ expo, race-pack collection and race office are located in the sports hall of Geschwister-Scholl-Schule, Berliner Ring 33, 72076 Tübingen. Refreshments including water, tea and UltraSports products are available at kilometres 5, 11 and 17, as well as at the finish. Raisin rolls from Bäckerei Gehr are served at the finish. A Nikolauslauf app provides current information, race numbers and results. Held annually in December, with practice runs in November; environmentally friendly travel options with the naldo transport association; anniversary and special shirts; courses in Schönbuch Nature Park.

name: Klausdorfer Nikolauslauf
description: The Klausdorf St. Nicholas Run is a longstanding running event on the eastern shore of Kiel Fjord, taking place on December 6, 2026, in Schwentinental, Klausdorf district. This will be the 41st edition of the event, attracting runners from the region. The event offers a festive pre-Christmas atmosphere and is a sporting highlight for all age groups. Official registration is expected to open after the 2026 summer holidays.
course_highlights: Run along the eastern shore of Kiel Fjord
Traditional running event with a festive atmosphere
Event in Schwentinental, Klausdorf district
additional: The official registration page is expected to open after the 2026 summer holidays. Course maps are available as images on the website. Registration is expected to be available on the official website after the 2026 summer holidays; the event is known for its good value for money and family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Kölner Nikolauslauf
organizer: Leichtathletik Team der Deutschen Sporthochschule Köln

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgebühr für den KIDS RUN: 11,00 EUR

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgebühr für den Top und FunRun: 19,00 EUR bis 01.10.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Startgebühr für den Top und FunRun: 21,00 EUR ab dem 02.10.

description: The Cologne St. Nicholas Run is a traditional fun run, taking place for the 29th time on December 6, 2026. The event offers three different races: the competitive 10 km TopRun, the FunRun with a variable distance of 3.4 km to 10 km for all running enthusiasts, and the KidsRun, a 3.4 km race for children. The races follow a course through the beautiful Cologne City Forest on a DLV-measured loop, creating a festive, athletic atmosphere for the whole family. The event is organized by the athletics team of the German Sport University Cologne and emphasizes community and the joy of running.
course_highlights: Loop course through the Cologne City Forest
DLV-measured course with a course certificate
Three laps for the 10 km TopRun; variable distance for the FunRun
additional: Start times: TopRun 10:00, KidsRun 11:30, FunRun 11:35. FunRun participants can choose between 3.4 km, 6.7 km, or 10 km. A preferred bib number is available for an additional €3. On-site late registration is possible for an additional fee of €5. €1 from every St. Nicholas hat sold will be donated to Lindenthaler Tierpark. Race bibs include B-tags for timing; registration is closed, late registration is possible, and race packet pickup is in Cologne.

name: landesoffener Nikolaus-Waldlauf
description: The 46th open Nikolaus Forest Run will take place on December 6, 2026, at the Arnstorf School Centre. The event offers various races for adults, young people and children on hilly forest trails, with distances ranging from 2.7 km to 7.2 km. The start and finish are at the Arnstorf School Centre, which can be reached by a free shuttle bus. The award ceremonies and shower facilities are also at the school centre. The event is part of the Grenzland Running Cup and includes age-group rankings for schoolchildren.
course_highlights: Hilly route through woodland
Start and finish at the Arnstorf School Centre, with shower facilities
Free shuttle bus to the start/finish
additional: Distances range from 300 m to 8.7 km, with age-group rankings for schoolchildren. Races are offered for children, young people and adults, as well as Nordic walking. The route to the school centre is signposted. Various distances; start at the Arnstorf School Centre; free shuttle buses; shower facilities; winter running event in woodland.

name: Lauf 38. Winterlaufserie
description: The LSV Porz Winter Running Series kicks off with the race in Ochtendung on December 6, 2026. The event offers various distances, including 0.4 km and 8.1 km, and is open to runners of all ability levels, including students and Nordic walkers. Participants who successfully complete the series receive an award, such as a trophy or a towel. Dogs are not allowed, and the event is not accessible for people with disabilities.
course_highlights: Distances: 0.4 km and 8.1 km
Start location: Ochtendung
Typical December weather, with snow cover on most days
additional: The Winter Running Series offers several distances and is aimed at students, walkers, and road runners. Participants who successfully complete the series exchange their race bib for a trophy or a towel. Students receive a commemorative medal at the opening race. Dogs are not allowed, and the event is not accessible for people with disabilities. Several distances, start in Ochtendung, typical winter weather in December

name: Melsunger Adventslauf Rund um die Koppe
description: The Melsungen Advent Run is a traditional running event held every year on the second Sunday of Advent in Melsungen. Various distances are offered: 1.2 km, 1.6 km, 5 km and 10 km. The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course. The event attracts runners of all ages and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with special appreciation for children and recreational runners. It is organised by the running group of Melsunger Turngemeinde 1861 e.V. and is a fixture in the North Hesse popular running calendar.
course_highlights: Various distances: 1.2 km, 1.6 km, 5 km and 10 km
The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course
Family-friendly event with special care for children
additional: Results and certificates are provided via My Race Result. The event takes place every year on the second Sunday of Advent. Children receive a small treat (e.g. chocolate wafers) and a medal at the finish, as well as a certificate at the awards ceremony. The event is organised by the MT Melsungen organising team / recreational sports department / running group. Course distances: 1.2 km, 1.6 km, 5 km and 10 km; registration and results via My Race Result; winter weather is possible.

name: Nat. Nikolaus Volkslauf
description: The 46th Nat. Nikolaus Volkslauf in Mingolsheim (Bad Schönborn) is a traditional running event held on field and forest paths, with the start and finish at Schönbornhalle. The race welcomes children, youth, adults and masters, offering a sporting challenge in a natural setting. The event is organized by SG Bad Schönborn and warmly invites runners of all ages to take part in this popular fun run.
course_highlights: Course on field and forest paths
Start and finish at Schönbornhalle
Natural running environment in Mingolsheim
additional: The entry deadline is December 2, 2023. The event is open to children, youth, adults and masters. Registration is online via the SG Bad Schönborn website. The event category is 6.5.1 Non-stadium events. The race takes place on December 6, 2026, with categories for children, youth, adults and masters. December weather is typically cold, with temperatures around 3°C; snowfall is possible. The event is a lovely opportunity to celebrate the run-up to Christmas actively.

name: Nikolaus-Lauf in Ochsenfurt
description: The Nikolauslauf in Ochsenfurt is a traditional running event organized annually by Turnverein Ochsenfurt 1862 e. V. The event offers various races for Bambinis, schoolchildren, young people, recreational runners, and a main race. The courses are suitable for all age groups and foster a sense of sporting community in the region. The run traditionally takes place in early December and attracts numerous participants from the surrounding area.
course_highlights: Various race categories for all age groups
Festive December atmosphere in Ochsenfurt
Annual event with a tradition and community spirit
additional: Alongside the races, the Nikolauslauf also offers a sociable atmosphere, ideal for families and running enthusiasts. Results from previous years are available on the website.

name: Oelder Nikolauslauf
location: Oelder Jahnstadion, Oelde, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 52nd Oelde St. Nicholas Run takes place on December 6, 2026, at Oelde’s Jahnstadion and invites children, young people, and adults to enjoy a varied running experience. With four different running distances and a Nordic walking and walking distance recognized as a performance course for the German Sports Badge, the event offers a suitable challenge for every age and ability level. The routes pass through the stadium and the surrounding countryside, including challenging climbs in Limberger Forst. The event is a popular St. Nicholas Day tradition and promotes recreational sport in the region.
course_highlights: 0.6 km loop in the stadium for children up to age 7
3 km fitness run on paved farm roads through the Bergeler farming community
11.5 km cross-country run with climbs in Limberger Forst
additional: The 7.5 km walking and Nordic walking route is accessible and also easy to navigate by wheelchair. Age-group rankings are offered for walking. The event is recognized as a performance course for the German Sports Badge. Various running and walking routes, including Nordic walking; accessible routes; performance courses for the German Sports Badge; children’s and youth races

name: Saalfelder Winterlauf
description: The Winter Run Around the Katze in Saalfeld an der Saale is a traditional 15 km road race held in winter since 1982. The course starts at the Langenschader Straße sports field, loops around the local landmark “Katze,” passes through Langenschade and Schloßkulm, and returns to the start. The race is officially measured and scored in DLV age groups, making it especially appealing to club runners of all ages. The event is small, usually attracting fewer than 100 participants, and offers straightforward organization with online registration, changing rooms, and showers on site.
course_highlights: Officially measured 15 km road-race course
Loop around the “Katze” landmark in Saalfeld
Course passes through Langenschade and Schloßkulm
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available at the Langenschader Straße sports field. The event usually has fewer than 100 runners. Results are scored in DLV age groups. December weather is typically cold, averaging 3 °C, with frequent snowfall. The race offers online registration, changing rooms, and showers at the venue, and results are scored by age group.

name: Werdener Crosslauf
description: The 12th Werden Cross-Country Run is a local cross-country event organized by the athletics department of the Werden Gymnastics Club, a multi-sport club with numerous sections. The event takes place in Essen and offers two distances: 570 m and 5.1 km. The course is officially measured and is especially popular with club runners and running enthusiasts from the region. The event relies on the commitment of volunteer helpers and is part of Germany’s popular running calendar.
course_highlights: Cross-country run on an officially measured course
Distances: 570 m and 5.1 km
Event in the countryside around Essen
additional: Typical December weather conditions: around 3 °C, mostly snow-covered, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The start is in Essen. The event relies on volunteer support. A December cross-country run, weather-dependent, and more suited to club and recreational runners.

name: Zülpicher Seepark Nikolauslauf mit Fun/Firmenstaffel
description: The Zülpich St. Nicholas Run is organized by the athletics department of TuS Chlodwig Zülpich and Seepark Zülpich. The races take runners through the wintery park, including along the shore of the watersports lake, and offer various events for youth, recreational runners, corporate and club relay teams, as well as the main race. The event takes place at the Seehaus in Zülpich and invites both runners and spectators to a festive St. Nicholas celebration with mulled wine and non-alcoholic punch. Changing rooms and showers are available on site, and race bibs can be collected at the pavilion behind the main entrance.
course_highlights: Run through the wintery Seepark Zülpich
Route along the shore of the watersports lake
Start and finish at the Seehaus, with changing rooms and showers
additional: Late entries are possible up to 60 minutes before the respective race for a late-entry fee of €2.00. Admission to the Seepark is free. Race bibs can be collected at the pavilion behind the main entrance. Mulled wine and non-alcoholic punch will be available. Various race categories, online registration, start and finish at the Seehaus, changing rooms and showers available, fixed date: December 8, 2024.

name: ELM-Advents-HALBMARATHON
location: Königslutter am Elm, Lower Saxony, Germany

name: Festiwal Biegów Świętych Mikołajów – XXIV Półmaraton Świętych Mikołajów
XV Grand Prix Krakowa w biegach górskich – Bieg Mikołajkowy
Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 12. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava is a regular 2-mile (3.218 km) running race organized by Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming pool grounds in Bratislava. The race is open to a wide range of categories, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place on site from 9:30, and the race starts at 10:00. The event is part of a series in which runners earn points toward the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Challenge Cup, with finishing times adjusted using age coefficients based on year of birth.
course_highlights: Course length: 2 miles (3.218 km); children: approx. 200 m
Venue: Kuchajda swimming pool grounds, Bratislava
Check-in beside the volleyball court
additional: Registration takes place on site beside the volleyball court from 9:30. Categories are children (13 and under), juniors, women, men, female veterans, and male veterans. Competitors are awarded points based on the number of participants in their categories; junior men and junior women are scored separately. In the event of a tie, year of birth and the best time that year determine the result. An amnesty is granted for two participations, in which the two months with the lowest point totals are discarded. Races take place in several rounds throughout the year, including the 12th round in December. On-site registration is available; pricing details are not specified, and the course is mostly asphalt in an urban setting.

name: Mikulášsky nočný výbeh na rozhľadňu na Balážke
location: Základná škola Hviezdoslavova, Lipany, Prešov, Slovakia

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Mikuláš Night Run to the Balážka Lookout Tower is an adrenaline-filled night race for participants over 15 years old. The event takes place on 6 December 2025, starting at 19:00 from Hviezdoslavova Elementary School in Lipany. Runners can look forward to a unique nighttime experience with views from the lookout tower. The entry fee is a minimum of €7, and participants must register by 5 December 2025.
course_highlights: A night run with an adrenaline-filled atmosphere
The route leads to the Balážka Lookout Tower
The event is for participants over 15 years old
additional: This is a unique nighttime event with a minimum entry fee of €7. Participants must be over 15 years old. Registration is open until 5 December 2025. The start is at Hviezdoslavova Elementary School in Lipany. Night run, start at Hviezdoslavova Elementary School, registration by 5 December 2025, discounted entry for groups and costumes, refreshments and showers provided.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Nižbor
price_range: 390 Kč za závod, 1 900 Kč za 6 závodů, 2 900 Kč za celou sérii

tiers.label: tier_1
