description: The Berounka Running Series is a series of 12 races in the beautiful surroundings of the Berounka River, from Radotín to Nižbor, running from January to December 2026. The routes follow trails with stunning views and varied terrain, often near nature reserves and historical sites. The series is suitable for experienced runners and beginners alike, and aims to encourage regular running. Most starts are at accessible locations with train connections and facilities at local pubs. At the end of the series, winners are announced and prizes are awarded in 12 categories.
course_highlights: Trails with views of the Berounka River and the Český kras Protected Landscape Area
Challenging climbs and nature reserves, such as Klapice and Radotínské skály
Starts at accessible locations with train connections and facilities at local pubs
additional: Refreshments, baggage storage, changing rooms with showers, and race bibs are available at the race venues. Bringing a headlamp is recommended. Rankings are based on the 10 highest-scoring races in the series. Most starts are near train stations and at local pubs that provide facilities. Trail races in the Berounka area; starts mostly accessible by train; winners announced in December; 12 categories; scoring based on the 10 best races

name: Winter Milada Run
location: Chabařovice, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: WINTER Milada Run is a winter running race held in the unique landscape of a former brown-coal mine, transformed into the beautiful natural setting of Lake Milada, between the Ore Mountains and the Central Bohemian Uplands. The race takes place on 12 December 2026 in Chabařovice and offers 12.5 km and 5.3 km routes, as well as Olympia children’s races. The event marks the end of the running season in northern Bohemia and attracts hundreds of runners each year to the lake’s magical snowy and icy landscape. All races have a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere and are suitable for children, families and adult competitors.
course_highlights: Routes run through the natural surroundings of a former brown-coal mine transformed into Lake Milada
A winter run through the snowy and icy landscape of Lake Milada
Two main routes: a 12.5 km long route and a 5.3 km short route, plus children’s races
additional: A race pack and medal for every competitor. The official Milada Tour 2026 T-shirt can be ordered during registration and collected on race day. The first 100 children to register receive a children’s T-shirt free of charge. The race is limited to 500 competitors. The accompanying programme includes St. Nicholas, a devil and an angel, and the Olympia children’s corner. Terrain in the former mine area, winter/icy conditions, family and children’s categories, on-site registration, medals for all participants, official T-shirts available for purchase.

name: Mikulášský běh Úpice
location: Náměstí v Úpici, Úpice, Czech Republic
description: The St. Nicholas Run in Úpice is a traditional running race organized by the Maratonstav Úpice sports club. The race takes place in the square in Úpice and offers categories for children and adults. The race bib is valid for the entire series of races organized by the event organizer. The event is suitable for all age groups and runners of different levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the square in Úpice, by the A. Jirásek Theatre
Categories for children and adults, with separate starts
Friendly atmosphere and the option to take part in the race series
additional: The race office opens one hour before the first category starts. Registration closes at 13:30 for the children’s categories and at 14:00 for adults. The race bib is valid for the entire race series and must be brought to each subsequent race. Results are not announced after each individual race but are published on the organizer’s website. The race takes place on 12 December 2026 in the square in Úpice. The scheduled start times are 14:00 for children and 14:30 for adults. Registration takes place one hour before the start, and results are published online.

name: Zručský adventní běh
location: Zruč nad Sázavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Zruč Advent Run will take place for the seventh time on December 12, 2026. It is both a charity event and a race. The aim is to encourage more people to take up sport, help those in need, and give participants a chance to unwind from pre-Christmas stress by running through Zruč, illuminated for Christmas. The route passes through the beautiful chateau park and surrounding area, filled with a festive atmosphere. You can preview it in a video or download the GPX file for your smartwatch. After the race, warm soup and mulled wine will be served to round off the event.
course_highlights: Run through Zruč, illuminated for Christmas
The route passes through the chateau park and surrounding area, filled with a festive atmosphere
Downloadable GPX route file for smartwatches
additional: The race is a charity event, and warm soup and mulled wine will be served to participants after the run. The overall male and female winners hold the course record with a time of 19:10. The route is illuminated for Christmas, and festive decorations add to the atmosphere. The event offers two distances, 900 m and 5,500 m, and is open to children and adults. It features a Christmas atmosphere and a downloadable GPX route file.

name: Předvánoční běh
description: The Pre-Christmas Run is a traditional running race with a history dating back to 1984, held in Frýdek-Místek. The race offers courses for both young people and adults. Young runners take on asphalt loops in the stadium grounds ranging from 180 m to 1.7 km. Adults run kilometre loops: men run 8 km and women 3 km, with various distances available in the stadium grounds. The race is suitable for the general public and is part of the TJ Slezan Frýdek-Místek athletics calendar.
course_highlights: Asphalt loops in the stadium grounds for young runners, from 180 m to 1.7 km
Kilometre loops in Staré Město for adults — 8 km for men and 3 km for women
Race with a long-standing tradition dating back to 1984
additional: A run in the stadium grounds, with on-site registration, refreshments in the stadium clubhouse, and various distances from 200 m to 8 km

name: Vranovský noční Trail
location: Samovýčep, Vranov u Brna, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Vranov Night Trail is a winter race run in the dark around Vranov u Brna, offering a challenging yet beautiful course. The race symbolizes the balance between day and night and is the first real running test of the new season. The start and finish are at the Samovýčep venue, which has facilities including a heated tent, hot coffee and tea. After the race, warm Italian food, mulled wine and a relaxed after-party await. The organizers emphasize quality refreshments and a friendly atmosphere that runners can enjoy after finishing.
course_highlights: A 21.3 km course in the Podkomorské forests and around the reservoir
The course is marked with red-and-white and yellow tape and reflective spray
A winter race run in the dark over challenging terrain
additional: Race facilities at the Samovýčep venue include a heated tent, hot coffee and tea. There is plenty of water and sports drinks on the course. After the race, there is warm Italian food, mulled wine and an after-party with the opportunity to share feedback and socialize. A headlamp is essential. Facilities include a heated tent, hot coffee and tea, a warm post-race meal and an after-party.

name: Adventscrosslauf
description: The Wilscher Advent Cross-Country Run Gifhorn is a traditional cross-country race held during Advent in Gifhorn, Lower Saxony. The main distance is 7.5 km and runs through the winter landscape of the Wilsche district. The race starts at 14:00 at the meeting point at An der Masch 4. The event is organised by VfR Wilsche/Neubokel, and the entry fee is 7 euros.
course_highlights: Cross-country run through the winter landscape of Gifhorn-Wilsche
Main distance: 7.5 km
Start and meeting point at An der Masch 4
additional: The meeting point and start are at An der Masch 4 in the Wilsche district of Gifhorn. Typical December weather includes temperatures around 3 °C and snow cover on most days. The race starts at 14:00, with the meeting point at An der Masch 4 in Gifhorn. Registration is via the club website. The event is a lovely opportunity to enjoy the Advent season in an active and sociable way.

name: Alten-Busecker Winterlaufserie - 2. Event
description: The Alten-Buseck Winter Running Series is a traditional running event organised by TSG Alten-Buseck. It includes several races over different distances, including 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and the half marathon (21.1 km). The races take place during the colder months and offer a great opportunity to enjoy the winter landscape around Alten-Buseck together with other runners. The event is open to all ages and ability levels, with special races for children and young people. After crossing the finish line, participants can enjoy refreshments, followed by an awards ceremony for the fastest runners.
course_highlights: Courses over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and 21.1 km
Start and finish at Harbig Halle in Alten-Buseck
Winter running routes; the course may be changed because of construction work
additional: Timing is provided using passive transponders from Raceresult. The awards ceremony takes place after the races, with awards for the three fastest participants of the day (men/women) and age-group winners. Certificates, results and photos are available online. After crossing the finish line, participants receive a free refreshing drink; coffee and cake are available for purchase. Toilets, showers and changing facilities are available at Harbig Halle. Parking at Harbig Halle is limited. The Bambini run starts at approximately 14:15 (December only). Distance options: 700 m and 15 km; the event is expected to take place in winter conditions; start location: Alten-Buseck, Buseck.

name: Bühlerzeller Winterlauf
distance_verbose: 10 km, 6.5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 3000 Meter, 0.9 km
description: The Bühlerzell Winter Run is an established winter running event in Bühlerzell, Germany, organized by Sportfreunde Bühlerzell. With at least 21 editions, the event offers various distances from 900 m to 10 km, including 3 km, 5 km, and 6.5 km. The program is aimed at younger runners, beginners, and experienced road runners, and takes place in typical December weather, with courses usually covered in snow.
course_highlights: Various distances from 900 m to 10 km
Winter running conditions with snow
Start and finish in Bühlerzell
additional: The event offers very short races alongside the 10 km race to include a range of runner groups. Typical December weather, with temperatures around 3 °C and frequent snowfall, shapes the event. Races over various distances, including walking, take place in winter in Bühlerzell; typical temperatures are around 3°C. Check details with the organizer before registering.

name: Ellewicker Adventslauf
price_range: 4 Euro für Kinder- und Schülerlauf, Nachmeldegebühr 2 Euro
description: The Ellewick Advent Run is a traditional running event in Vreden-Ellewick, held every December. It offers a 1.5 km children’s and schoolchildren’s run and a 5 km run, each over two laps. The event is family-friendly and supported by a dedicated organizing team. It gives runners of all ages the opportunity to get active and enjoy the Advent season together.
course_highlights: 1.5 km children’s/schoolchildren’s run over 2 laps
5 km run over 2 laps
Route through the village of Ellewick
additional: Photos and videos are taken during the event for use in the press and on social media. Participant data is used to compile the race results and can be deleted on request. Terrain: loop course of 0.5 km or 2.5 km; online registration until 12.12.2025; trophies, certificates and a raffle; weather-dependent conditions, with possible snow cover and temperatures around 3°C.

description: The year-end run in Bad Berka is a traditional running event held every December. The routes pass through the scenic Dreiteichs, Dammbachs and Kohlgrund areas on paved, gravel and forest roads. The event offers various distances, including a free 400 m mini-run for children and longer distances for young people and adults. It is open to all running enthusiasts and is organized by the sports club Spielvereinigung Bad Berka e.V.
course_highlights: Routes through the Dreiteichs, Dammbachs and Kohlgrund areas
Paved, gravel and forest roads
Start and finish at Ilmtalstadion Bad Berka
additional: The 400 m mini-run is free. On-site registration is available on race day, with an additional service fee (€1.00 up to age 16, €2.00 from age 17) and cash payment only. Changing rooms and showers are available. Parking is available at the sports ground and on Tannrodaer Straße (approx. 500 m walk). The race office opens at 9:00 a.m. The routes have a rolling profile. Online registration is available. Showers and changing rooms are available. Parking is available at the sports ground and on Tannrodaer Straße.

name: MB Brandschutz-Nachtwächterlauf
description: The MB Brandschutz Night Watchman Run is a winter race in Ottweiler, usually held before the New Year’s Eve runs. It offers short road-race distances of 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km, suitable for both beginners and club runners. The event is organised by the athletics section of TV Ottweiler. Registration is available for individuals and groups, making it easier for teams to sign up.
course_highlights: Short road-race distances: 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km
Winter race with typical December temperatures around 3 °C; roads are often snow-covered
Starting point in Ottweiler
additional: The race is usually held before the New Year’s Eve runs. Younger runners are eligible for the 2.5 km race; higher minimum age limits apply to the 5 km and 10 km races. Group registration is also available, making it straightforward for teams to sign up. Typical December weather is around 3 °C, with roads often snow-covered. Winter race, road race, individual or group registration available, age limits vary by distance.

name: 9 Bieg Śladami Żubra
description: The Bieg Śladami Żubra is an annual running event organized by the Aktywna Pszczyna Sports Association in Studzienice, held in December. The route follows one or two loops through Studzienice Forest, part of the Pszczyna Forest, offering scenic woodland views. The event features several distances, including the Fancy Dress Run, children’s races, 6 km and 12 km runs and Nordic Walking, as well as a half marathon and marathon. Participants can expect medals, awards for costumes, and traditional pea soup at the finish.
course_highlights: The route runs through Studzienice Forest, part of the Pszczyna Forest
Races cover one or two forest loops
Scenic woodland views and natural mud
additional: Start times are staggered: 08:00 marathon, 08:30 Fancy Dress Run (1.8 km), and 10:10 half marathon. Children’s races are offered over distances of 200 m, 400 m, 800 m and 250 m, 400 m, 850 m, depending on age. Medals and awards for the most creative costumes await at the finish. A team classification is held (the four fastest times after one loop). The route is also used for Nordic Walking. Traditional pea soup is served at the finish. GPX files are available for the half-marathon, marathon, and 6 km and 12 km routes. New marathon distance, changed start and finish location, food and recovery attractions, honorary patronages, additional cross-country races, and team classification.

name: Adventslauf
price_range: 10,00 € bis 16,00 € je nach Strecke und Anmeldedatum
description: The Advent Run in Hamm is a traditional winter race on officially measured out-and-back courses through the Lippeaue nature conservation area and the Kurpark in Bad Hamm. The start and finish are on the tartan track at Jahnstadion, creating a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages. The event offers two distances, 5 km and 10 km, with chip-based net and gun timekeeping. Alongside the sporting challenge, charity is also a key focus, with a donation collected for the support association of the hospice in Hamm.
course_highlights: Officially measured out-and-back courses
Lippeaue nature conservation area
Kurpark in Bad Hamm
additional: Young people and young adults up to age group U20 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee (excluding the donation and deposit). An additional €3.00 deposit is charged for the race bib (refunded when returned), along with a €1.00 donation for the support association of the hospice in Hamm. Timing is provided using Race Result systems via a chip in the race bib. The timing is eligible for best-list results and is forwarded to the DLV federation. Headphones, dogs and jogging strollers are prohibited during the race. The awards ceremony takes place approximately 45 minutes after the first runner finishes. Discounted admission is available at the neighboring Maximare adventure swimming pool. Courses are timed using Race Result; race bibs contain a chip; the awards ceremony is approximately 45 minutes after the finish; admission to Maximare is available.

name: Ismaninger Winterlaufserie
description: The Ismaning Winter Running Series is a traditional running event held in several stages from December to February. It offers races for different age groups and distances, including 13 km, 17 km and a half marathon, as well as races for schoolchildren and speed races. The races take place in the beautiful surroundings of Ismaning and are ideal for runners who want to stay active in winter. A free shuttle bus from Ismaning S-Bahn station makes getting there easier, and refreshments at the finish invite participants to linger.
course_highlights: 13 km, 17 km and half marathon courses
Separate races for schoolchildren and speed races for different age groups
Free shuttle bus from Ismaning S-Bahn station
additional: Finish refreshments; participants may bring their own cup. Free shuttle buses from Ismaning S-Bahn station. Races for schoolchildren and speed races for U16 and older. GPX course files are available. The event also includes youth and speed races, with shuttle bus transport from Ismaning S-Bahn station. Results and historical data are available on the website.

name: Lauf Winterlaufserie 2026/2027
description: The 1st Lauf Winterlaufserie 2026/2027 in Beverstedt-Wellen is a winter running series associated with the traditional Rund um Wellen. The event is organized by the local running community, which also organizes the Wellen Marathon, and offers a family-friendly, club-like atmosphere away from large city events. The course includes several distances and runs through the rural surroundings, supported by local volunteers, sponsors, and the fire brigade. The series preserves its traditional character and offers runners a challenging, authentic winter running experience.
course_highlights: Rural course with a traditional character
Event with a family-friendly, club-like atmosphere
Support from local volunteers and the fire brigade
additional: Typical November weather conditions: around 7 °C, mostly rainy; start location: Beverstedt-Wellen; the event is part of a series with several distances (3 km and 11 km). Distances: 3 km, 11 km; traditional, community-oriented; December weather is usually cool and rainy.

name: Sparkassen Advents-Cross der LG Nordheide
location: Jahnplatz, Schützengehölz, Winsen (Luhe), Lower Saxony, Germany
price_range: U10-U16 2,50 Euro, U18-U20 3,00 Euro, Erwachsene 5,00 Euro
description: The Sparkassen Advent Cross-Country Run hosted by LG Nordheide takes place on December 13, 2026, in Winsen (Luhe), at Schützengehölz by Jahnplatz. The event is open to participants from across the state and offers races for all age groups from U10 to seniors, including age groups up to M/W 95. The races cover various distances of approximately 1,400 meters to 9 kilometers. Team rankings are held separately for male and female participants. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available, as well as signposted parking nearby.
course_highlights: Various distances from approx. 1,400 m to 9 km
Races from U10 through senior age groups, including M/W 95
Venue in Schützengehölz, with a signposted walking route
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, subject to a 50% surcharge. Entries submitted by email incur a surcharge of EUR 1.00 per start. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available. Parking is available behind the Stadthalle and at the Stadthalle car park; the venue is about a 300-meter walk through Schützengehölz along a signposted route. Registration constitutes consent to the publication of the participant’s name, year of birth, club, and photo and video material in results lists and the media. Distances range from approximately 1,400 m to longer distances; registration is open until December 6, 2026. Late entries are possible for an additional fee. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available; parking is behind the Stadthalle.

name: Winterlauf
description: The Aachen Winter Run is a traditional 16.1-kilometre race from Bürgerhaus Venwegen to the ATG sports field at Am Chorusberg. Held annually in December, it attracts many runners of all ages. The route passes through the Voreifel and the city of Aachen, offering varied and scenic running. The event is well organised, with race bib collection available on several days, a bus transfer to the start and refreshments at the finish.
course_highlights: 16.1 km route from Bürgerhaus Venwegen to the ATG sports field at Am Chorusberg
Run through the Voreifel and the city of Aachen
Start at Bürgerhaus Venwegen, with a heated indoor area and refreshments
additional: Race bibs can be collected at various locations on several days before the race. Free bus transport from Chorusberg to the start is available from 8:15 a.m.; taking an early bus is recommended. Bürgerhaus Venwegen is heated and serves as a place to wait and get refreshments. Clothing is transported from the start to the finish. Late entries are not possible. Starting places can be transferred up to one hour before the race via the individual change link or by email. The Winter Run takes place on 13 December 2026; further information about start times, registration and logistics is available on the website.

name: X-MAS Trail
description: The X-MAS Trail in Weiskirchen is a challenging winter trail run through the picturesque landscape of the Hunsrück-Hochwald Nature Park. Three demanding courses with singletrack trails and technical sections lead through moss-covered forests, over small bridges and past rock formations. Participants need suitable equipment and experience handling winter conditions, as runners are self-sufficient. The course is marked with flagging tape and spray chalk, and there is a course briefing before the run. This is not a road race, but a genuine trail run with strict cutoff times.
course_highlights: A high proportion of singletrack, with many technical sections
Winter scenery in the Hunsrück-Hochwald Nature Park, with moss-covered forests and waterways
Sections crossing small bridges and passing rock formations and the spectacular Felsenpfad
additional: Mandatory equipment is required, especially for the longer distances. The course will be confirmed shortly before the race and made available to download. The longer distances are part of the ITRA National League Challenge. Cutoff times are strictly enforced, and sweepers may remove very slow participants from the race. The event is not suitable for walkers. Aid stations are available on the longer distances. A headlamp is recommended and mandatory for the long distance. Winter trails, technical sections, no walkers permitted, mandatory equipment required, course changes possible, no dogs allowed.

name: Zeller MEHR Raiffeisenbank-Adventslauf
location: Zell an der Mosel, Cochem-Zell, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Zeller MEHR Raiffeisenbank Advent Run is an atmospheric race in Zell an der Mosel, traditionally held during Advent. The event offers runners a festive atmosphere and an attractive course through the picturesque Moselle landscape. The race is open to all ages and ability levels, combining sporting ambition with Christmas spirit.

Festive Advent atmosphere
Suitable for all ages and ability levels

description: Panewnicki Bieg Dzika is a recreational running and Nordic walking event held in the picturesque Panewniki forests in Katowice. The event takes place on a loop approximately 4,882 metres long, which participants can complete up to four times. It promotes an active lifestyle and education about responsible behaviour in forest areas. Participants can compete individually or in pairs, and the event is open to both recreational runners and athletes affiliated with sports clubs.
course_highlights: A route through the Panewniki forests, approximately 4,882 m long
The loop is marked every 1 km
The route can be completed up to 4 times
additional: The time limit for running and Nordic walking is 3 hours. Participants over 18 must sign a declaration accepting responsibility for their participation or provide a medical certificate. Minors must be accompanied by a parent or guardian during verification. Annual race-entry packages are available for purchase. Entry fees are non-refundable but may be transferred to a subsequent race if requested by 3:00 p.m. on the Thursday before the race. The event is recreational, with a 3-hour time limit and online registration; entry fees are non-refundable. It also has an educational aspect, promoting responsible behaviour in forest areas.

name: Bieg po moczkę i makówki
location: Szkoła Podstawowa w Stanowicach, Stanowice, Opole, Poland
description: Bieg po Moczkę i Makówki is an annual, friendly running event held in Stanowice. Since 2012, it has become a fixture on the holiday running calendar. The course is 10 km long, divided into four 2.5 km loops, and runners may finish after any number of loops. After the run, participants receive handmade gingerbread medals and traditional moczka and makówki, and can also enjoy hot coffee and tea. The event has a relaxed, friendly atmosphere, with a prize-winning contest for the most interesting costume and a spectator competition.
course_highlights: A 10 km course divided into four 2.5 km loops
Start and finish at Stanowice Primary School, ul. Szkolna 17A
Runners may finish after any number of loops
additional: After the run, participants receive handmade gingerbread medals and servings of traditional holiday dishes: moczka and makówki. A prize-winning spectator competition is held along the course, as well as a contest for the most interesting individual or group holiday-carnival costume. The event has a relaxed, friendly atmosphere and encourages active spectating. It features costume contests and recreational activities, is based at Stanowice Primary School, and offers the option to take part in the 10 km run. The event is usually held in December during the holiday season.

406. Malá cena Monaka – Vánoční
description: Malá cena Monaka - Christmas is a traditional running race held in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. This Christmas race is part of the Malá cena Monaka series and gives runners the opportunity to compete in a pleasant pre-Christmas atmosphere. The race is suitable for the general public and is known for its friendly organization and sporting spirit. It is organized by KRB Chrudim, which has been organizing running events in the region for many years.
course_highlights: A traditional Christmas run in the picturesque surroundings of Slatiňany
A friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization
Part of the long-running Malá cena Monaka series
additional: The race takes place on 20 December 2026 in Slatiňany, Pardubice Region, and is part of the Malá cena Monaka series. The event is suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels.

name: Vánoční běh Opava
description: The Opava Christmas Run is a traditional running race organized by the BěhOpava association team. The race covers a 4.7 km course starting on Englišova Street and heading toward Gappay (Latarna) along a farm track with an asphalt surface, with several turns before returning to the finish. Kilometer markers are placed along the course to help runners track their performance. The race is open to various age categories, from pupils to men across several age groups. The organizers provide small prizes for the top runners and hold a prize draw for additional prizes.
course_highlights: A 4.7 km course along a farm track with an asphalt surface
Kilometer markers along the course for orientation
Start and finish by Englišova Street – the gate of the School Farm
additional: The course record is held by Petr Gebel, set in 1994 with a time of 13:39. Participants race at their own risk and are advised to take care when crossing roads and follow the organizers’ instructions. The finish judges are members and supporters of the BěhOpava association. The race takes place on an asphalt course with a slight uphill section, starts at the School Farm, and includes small prizes and a commemorative run.

name: Augsburger AOK Winterlaufserie Weihnachtslauf
description: The Augsburg AOK Winter Running Series organized by TG Viktoria Augsburg consists of four races through the beautiful Western Forests Nature Park. The routes cross hilly terrain in the forests west of Augsburg and require good fitness. The series offers age-group rankings and an overall ranking with attractive prizes. The races take place in November and December, with the Christmas Run bringing the series to a close.
course_highlights: Routes through the Western Forests Nature Park
Hilly terrain with challenging sections
Routes approximately 2.8 to 3.2 km long per race
additional: Bib pickup is in the start/finish area for each race. Portable toilets are available at the Kathreinerstraße parking lot (races 1–3). Change of clothes and bags can be left in the tent or pavilion, but are not covered by liability. Finish refreshments include tea, water and a cake buffet at races 1–3; the Christmas Run also offers mulled wine and children's punch. The awards ceremony takes place after the 4th race from 11:45 a.m. at the forest hut, with wooden trophies and cash prizes. Online registration closes at 10 p.m. on the Thursday before each race. Part of the AOK Winter Running Series; typical December winter weather; online registration available; routes on hilly terrain; start and finish locations in Augsburg.

name: Int. Weihnachts-Crosslauf
location: Ravensberger Stadion, Borgholzhausen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Int. Christmas Cross-Country Run is a cross-country race held shortly before Christmas at Ravensberger Stadium in Borgholzhausen. The event is organized by LCS Olbä and offers several distances, including 16 km, 10 km, 5 km, and a 7.5 km walking/Nordic walking course. The 16 km course consists of two laps over partly hilly terrain around Borgholzhausen, including a loop around Barenberg that is completed twice. It is a genuine cross-country challenge with climbs and descents. The start and finish sections are on paved paths, where spikes are not allowed. The race attracts a diverse field, from elite runners to recreational and older runners, as well as walkers.
course_highlights: 16 km course with two laps over hilly terrain
Loop around Borgholzhausen, including the Barenberg loop
Start and finish at Ravensberger Stadium, with paved sections
additional: The event takes place in typical December weather, with temperatures around 3 °C and frequent snowfall. Various distances are offered, including Nordic walking. Spikes are not allowed on the paved start and finish sections. The event includes several running distances as well as walking options. The course is partly hilly and runs along natural trails; the first and last metres are on paved paths. No spikes are allowed.

name: Lorsbacher Winterlauf- und Walkingserie
location: Langenhainer Wald, Hofheim-Lorsbach, Hochtaunuskreis, Hessen, Germany
description: The Lorsbach Winter Running and Walking Series is a long-standing event in the Langenhain Forest near Hofheim-Lorsbach, held during the winter season from November to February. The series consists of five dates, when runners and walkers can complete the challenging, varied 10 km or 20 km course. The 10 km route is permanently signposted, while the 20 km loop is marked seasonally. The event is open to everyone; no registration is required and there is no entry fee. Participants start individually and run together without timing, emphasizing the community aspect.
course_highlights: Permanently signposted 10 km route in the Langenhain Forest
20 km route with a seasonally marked second loop
Refreshments include warm tea along the route and coffee and biscuits in the sports hall
additional: Starts are individual from 8:00 at the sports hall at Schinderwald; there is no timing. Changing rooms are open on running days from 8:00 to 13:00. A tea station with warm tea is available along the route (please bring your own collapsible cup). Soup, wheat beer, coffee and cake are served on the final date. Participation is free, and voluntary donations are welcome. The event is covered by sports insurance through LSB Hessen. GPS tracks for the routes are available via Komoot. Route distances: 10 km and 20 km; challenging, varied courses; no timing; individual starts; GPS tracks via Komoot; tea stations with tea, coffee, biscuits, soup and wheat beer; parking at the sports ground or Park & Ride; access by train is possible.

name: Weihnachtslauf Lipperreihe
description: The Weihnachtslauf Lipperreihe is a traditional running event held annually on the fourth Sunday of Advent in Lipperreihe, a district of Oerlinghausen. The loop course starts and finishes at Lipperreihe Primary School and is precisely measured, with a hilly, moderately challenging profile. The scenic route is timed using the professional race|result timing system. The event is for adults and young people and offers a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ability levels.
course_highlights: Precisely measured course with a hilly profile
Moderately challenging route through scenic surroundings
Start and finish at Lipperreihe Primary School
additional: Online registration is available until 7 a.m. on the day of the event. Late entries are possible until 30 minutes before the start, with a late-entry fee of 5 EUR payable in cash only. Animals are not permitted. An event shirt in French navy can be ordered as an option. Timing uses the race|result system, with a dual transponder in the race number since 2019. Residents are provided with information about traffic restrictions and road closures. Precisely measured; race|result timing; online registration until 7 a.m. on the day of the event; cash payment only; no animals permitted.

name: Vánoční běh v Ďáblickém háji
location: Ďáblický háj, Praha 8, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic

It is mostly flat, with one gentle hill, making it suitable for runners of all levels. The event traditionally takes place on 24 December, with the first category starting at 10:00. It is organised by AVC Praha and is free of charge, fostering a friendly, community atmosphere.
course_highlights: Two loops through Ďáblický Forest
Flat terrain with one gentle hill
Woodland setting in the health area

The course is suitable for all age groups. The event takes place on Christmas Eve, 24 December 2026, at the health area in Ďáblický háj.

The morning program begins with children’s and youth categories. The 10 km main race and 5 km hobby race start at 11:00. The route follows paved roads, with an elevation gain of 176 metres on the main course and 68 metres on the hobby course. The race takes place in front of the Municipal Stadium in Prachatice and is part of the 2025 South Bohemian Running Cup.
course_highlights: 10 km main course with an elevation gain of 176 metres
5 km hobby race with an elevation gain of 68 metres
Start and finish in front of the Municipal Stadium in Prachatice
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available to runners in the stadium stand, and refreshments (tea and pastries) are provided at the finish. Race numbers and timing chips are issued during check-in and must be returned to the organizers after the race. Trophies, prizes in kind, and cash bonuses for breaking the course record are awarded to the top finishers. The first 100 participants in the main races to register and pay will receive gifts from sponsors. The event includes 5 km and 10 km courses. Registration is available via maraton.cz, and showers, refreshments, and facilities for runners are provided.

name: Štěpánský kros pro děti všech kategorií a Lidový běh
location: Svitavy, Svitavy District, Pardubice Region, Czech Republic

The race is suitable for all age groups, from the youngest children running 100 metres to adults taking part in the 4,200-metre People’s Run. The event takes place in all weather and offers a sporting atmosphere and support for all participants. Registration is available online, by email or on site on race day.

description: The Třtice Christmas Run is a traditional running race held annually on December 26 in the village of Třtice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is 4.8 km long, with categories based on age and gender. This popular sporting event continues a long-standing tradition and attracts runners from the surrounding area. It is part of the village’s sporting activities and offers a pleasant atmosphere for athletes and spectators alike.

Traditional Christmas run held since 1976

Třtice offers sports facilities, including a children’s playground and a multi-purpose sports court. The race takes place on December 26, 2026, and is attended by approximately 200 runners. name: 21. Wolfshäger Gänsebraten Fettverbrennungslauf

It is organized by Laufteam Wolfshagen im Harz e.V., a nonprofit club that promotes running in the region. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the strong sense of community among its runners.

A traditional end-of-year race on December 26

name: Schokocross

The event features short off-road races for adults over distances of approximately 2.2 km, 4.2 km and 8.2 km, as well as 400 m races for children under 10 and 800 m races for children under 14. This local club race offers competitions for children, young people, women and men, and is particularly family-friendly, with appealing race options for both young and adult runners. It traditionally takes place on December 26 and is known for its winter conditions.

Distances ranging from 400 m to 8.2 km
Competitions for children, young people and adults

After a two-year hiatus, the race is once again looking forward to welcoming participants, who can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere and a sporting challenge in Lysá nad Labem. name: Internationaler Sparverein Silvesterlauf Saarbrücken
description: The International Sparverein Saarbrücken New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional year-end race taking place on December 27, 2026, at the Sportcampus Saar. The main event is an officially measured 10 km circuit, running mostly through Saarbrücken City Forest, with the start and finish in the Sportcampus stadium. There are also other events for schoolchildren and children on flat circuits. The race attracts numerous participants and spectators every year and offers a special atmosphere with sporting highlights and attractive prizes.

Flat circuits for the schoolchildren’s and children’s races
additional: Late entries are possible online until December 27 at 10:00 and in person on December 27 from 15:00 to 17:00 and on December 28 from 10:30 until one hour before the respective start. Only cash payments are accepted in person. Free parking is available in the parking garage at Saarland University, about a 5-minute walk from the start area. Certificates can be printed online at www.meisterchip.de. Trophies and vouchers are awarded to the top finishers in various categories, and medals are awarded in the children’s races. Winter race; free parking in the parking garage at Saarland University; in-person late entry is cash only.

name: Aschauer Vorsilvesterlauf

With a flat, fast 5 km course through the town centre and a 1.7 km children’s run, the event offers an attractive race for both recreational and competitive runners. Known as Southern Bavaria’s biggest running party between Christmas and New Year, it attracts numerous participants and spectators every year. Alongside sporting ambition, community and fun are also at the heart of the event, supported by a varied programme and an after-run party.
course_highlights: Flat, fast 5 km course through Aschau town centre
Children’s run over one 1.7 km lap
Three laps in the recreational and night runs, 5 km in total

Mulled wine (including a non-alcoholic option), gingerbread and stollen are available in the finish area. Every finisher receives an edible medal. An awards ceremony and after-run party take place at Chalet after the night run. Parking is available at the Festhalle, Tourist Information, sports hall and railway station. Changing facilities and toilets are available at the Red Cross centre and railway station. 5 km run, children’s run, community event, held annually on 28 December, festive atmosphere, medals and refreshments included

name: Silvestrovský běh Hrabovou

The routes pass through the picturesque surroundings of Hrabová and are suitable for a range of ability levels. The race is part of the Hrabová Runs series and is known for its long-standing tradition and community spirit.

The event also includes free children’s races in the local forest park, over distances from 200 m to 1.8 km. The start and registration take place at the city stadium, which also serves as the event’s base. After the race, participants can enjoy refreshments and the medal ceremony for various categories.

The event offers a 6.6 km main race on a new four-lap course, as well as children’s categories with shorter distances. The race starts at the HAPO grounds in Havlovice, where runner registration also takes place. The event is part of a long-standing tradition of running races in the region.

New Year’s Eve refreshments at the finish

name: Silvestrovský běh Zlín

The race is suitable for the general public, including young people and juniors, and is part of the Běhy Zlín series. Winners are announced shortly after the race, with prizes awarded to the top finishers in each category.
course_highlights: The route follows the cycle path from Vršava to Kostelec and back

A shorter 5-kilometer course is also available for young people and juniors
additional: Online registration is open until December 30 at 12:00; on-site registration on race day is open until 10:40. Winners are announced at 12:45 at the race registration venue. Age categories are according to the rules of the Běhy Zlín series. Category winners receive prizes, subject to the organizer’s options. 5 km and 10 km races, online registration, category winner announcements, photos and results available

name: Silvestrovský běh Stříbro
organizer: Sdružení vytrvalců Stříbro, z.s. a TJ Baník Stříbro
description: The Silvestr Stříbro Run is a traditional year-end running race held in the picturesque town of Stříbro in the Plzeň Region. The race offers a 10.5 km course, mostly off-road, starting and finishing at the KERMI complex. It is suitable for all runners who want to end the year on an active and enjoyable note, with the option to start in different waves according to pace. After the race, there will be an awards ceremony, a get-together and refreshments for participants. The organizer, KERMI Stříbro, provides a friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: 10.5 km course, mostly off-road
Start and finish at the KERMI Stříbro complex
Option to start at 10:00 or 10:30, depending on the runner’s pace
additional: After the race, there will be an awards ceremony, a get-together and refreshments. The entry fee can be paid in advance by email or on site at the KERMI complex, training center. The race includes a trail at KERMI and a historic city run. Registration is available on site or by email. The start is at 10:00. The race is suitable for the general public.

name: Silvestrovský běh - memoriál Richarda Plcha
location: Park Pod Plachtami, Brno-Nový Lískovec, Brno, Jihomoravský, Czech Republic
price_range: 120 Kč – při přihlášení předem do 29. 12. 2025, 18:00 hodin; 200 Kč – na místě

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné 120 Kč – při přihlášení předem do 29. 12. 2025, 18:00 hodin.

description: The Silvester Run – Richard Plch Memorial is a traditional running race organized by the AC Moravská Slavia Brno athletics club. It takes place on 31 December in Brno-Nový Lískovec, in Pod Plachtami Park, and offers races for all age groups, from children to veterans. Runners can choose between the main races of 9.84 km and 4.92 km, a 1.64 km fun run, and children’s races starting at 100 m. The course is asphalt with a mix of paved paths, and runners can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere as they end the year on the move.
course_highlights: Asphalt surface combined with paved paths
Routes for all age groups, from 100 m to 9.84 km
Held in Pod Plachtami Park in Brno-Nový Lískovec
additional: Check-in is required no later than 30 minutes before the start of each category at ZŠ Svážná 438/9; it opens at 8:00. Changing rooms are available at ZŠ Svážná and are for changing only; the organizers are not responsible for belongings left there. Results will be posted throughout the event in the start/finish area and later published on mslavia.cz and atletika.cz. The first three finishers in each category will receive prizes, and children will receive a small prize at the finish. In the fun run, prizes will be drawn among three runners. Entering two races is permitted only for categories up to and including older pupils. The course consists of asphalt and paved paths; online registration runs from 20. 11. 2025 to 29. 12. 2025; the event includes various age categories and a fun run open to all birth years.

name: Silvestrovský běh Kolín
location: Lesopark Borky, Kolín, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Kolín New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional three-kilometre race held in Borky Forest Park. In 2026, the race will take place in an unusual format: the course will be marked from December 30 to January 1, and each participant can complete it individually. Results can be sent to the organisers by email or SMS, after which the results list will be published. The start is by the FK Kolín football pitch, and the course follows a road, a cycle path and a chestnut avenue, finishing at the athletics stadium.
course_highlights: Traditional three-kilometre course in Borky Forest Park
Start by the FK Kolín artificial-turf football pitch
The route follows a road, a cycle path and a chestnut avenue past STAP
additional: The race can be completed individually between December 30 and January 1, with results submitted by email or SMS. The start is by the FK Kolín football pitch, and the finish is on the cycle path by the athletics stadium. The results list will be published on January 2. The race will not be held as a conventional mass start due to pandemic-related restrictions. Modified format due to the pandemic; individual participation; the course is marked from December 30 to January 1; results submitted by email or SMS; results published on January 2.

name: Půlnoční silvestrovsko - novoroční běh metropolí
description: The Midnight New Year’s Eve–New Year’s Day Metropolis Run is a unique sporting event held in Prague at night, just before midnight on New Year’s Eve. The race starts at Galerie Butovice and offers the last run in Europe in 2025. It is for recreational runners as well as more experienced competitors who want to celebrate the arrival of the new year together in an active, sporting way. The start is scheduled for December 31, 2025, at 23:50. Registration is available in advance and on race day.
course_highlights: A night run in Prague’s unique atmosphere
Start at Galerie Butovice
The last race in Europe in 2025
additional: Registration is also available at the race-day check-in desk. Detailed information about the course, rules, safety measures, and videos from previous editions are available at www.behmetropole.cz. Start at Galerie Butovice, registration at www.behmetropole.cz, course and safety information on the website

name: Silvestrovský běh Přerov
description: We invite you to the traditional Přerov New Year’s Eve Run, held on December 31, starting at 10:00 from the boathouse. Men run 7.5 km, while women, junior women and junior men run 5 km, consisting of two 2.5 km laps. The race offers a pleasant end-of-year atmosphere and the chance to compete in the beautiful surroundings of Přerov. You can register online in advance or at the race office on the day of the event. We look forward to seeing you!
course_highlights: The course runs around the boathouse and skatepark in Přerov
Men run 7.5 km; women and juniors run 5 km (two 2.5 km laps)
Start at 10:00 from the boathouse
additional: Registration is available in advance via an online form or at the race office on the day of the event. The course is a 2.5 km loop: boathouse – skatepark – boathouse. Men run three laps (7.5 km), while women and juniors run two laps (5 km). The race takes place on December 31, 2026. Registration is available online or on-site on race day. Start at 10:00.

name: Běh od Hasy k Hase
location: Roudnice nad Labem, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: The Run from Hasa to Hasa is a traditional New Year's Eve run in Roudnice nad Labem, now being held for the 42nd time. The race offers a simple, easy-to-follow format, with times recorded using chip timing. The atmosphere is friendly, and participants enjoy a beautiful race at the end of the year. Check-in takes place from 8:30 in the Elbe River Board building in Roudnice nad Labem.
course_highlights: A traditional New Year's Eve run with high participation
Chip timing
Start and check-in at the Elbe River Board building, Pod Katovnou 228
additional: Check-in from 8:30 at the Elbe River Board building, Pod Katovnou 228, Roudnice n.L. The start is between 10:00 and 11:00. The race is simple and easy to follow, and suitable for the general public. It is part of a regional celebration attended by runners and organizers from Sokol and local partners. The course is approximately 5.2 km long, and registration is available online at naZávody.cz. The event is traditionally associated with celebrating the arrival of the new year.

name: Silvesterlauf Bremen
description: The Silvesterlauf Bremen is a popular running event on December 31 that welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels. The event offers various distances, from 400 m for Bambinis to 10 km for experienced runners, through the beautiful surroundings of Werdersee. Alongside a sporting end to the year, festive music and a New Year’s Eve atmosphere make for a special experience. Participants in costumes are warmly invited to add their own creative touch to the event and run together into the New Year.
course_highlights: The routes pass through the picturesque surroundings of Werdersee
More accessible 2.5 km route for beginners and people with special needs
Festive New Year’s Eve atmosphere with music and medals for all finishers
additional: Start times vary by distance: 5 km run at 12:00, 2.5 km walk at 12:30, 5 km and 10 km walks at 12:50, 400 m Bambini run at 12:55, 1,000 m kids’ run at 13:00, 10 km run at 13:15. Race materials can be shipped for a fee. More accessible 2.5 km route suitable for everyone. Costumes are expressly encouraged for a special New Year’s Eve feeling. Various distances, including children’s and walking options, festive atmosphere, medals for everyone, creative costumes welcome.

name: Silvesterlauf Hannover
description: The Silvesterlauf an der Leine in Hanover is a traditional year-end race held on December 31. The event features a 7.7 km loop, mostly on paved paths through the Steintormasch, to the Wasserkunst and along the Stichkanal to the Ihme. The race starts at 13:00 at the clubhouse of the Hannoverscher Radsportclub on Weddigenufer. After the race, participants can refuel with mulled wine and bratwurst and receive a finisher wheat beer glass as a keepsake. The event is known for its relaxed atmosphere and mass start.
course_highlights: 7.7 km loop on mostly paved paths
The course goes through the Steintormasch to the Wasserkunst and the Stichkanal
Start and finish at the clubhouse of the Hannoverscher Radsportclub on Weddigenufer
additional: Mass start; mulled wine and bratwurst at low prices after the race; every finisher receives a 0.5 l wheat beer glass in the event design. On-the-day registration is possible on site from 12:00 (cash or PayPal). The race takes place on December 31, with online registration open until 31.12.25 at 10:00. There is a mass start and festivities that make the race a sociable way to end the year.

name: Silvesterlauf Wernigerode
description: The 49th Wernigerode New Year's Eve Run is the perfect end to the year in the Harz district for running enthusiasts. The race takes place on December 31, 2026, at Marstall/Schlosschaussee in Wernigerode and offers a festive atmosphere to close out the year. Organized by Harz-Gebirgslauf 1978 e.V., this popular event welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic Marstall/Schlosschaussee in Wernigerode
Run through Wernigerode's picturesque old town
Festive end-of-year atmosphere in the Harz district
additional: The course goes around Wernigerode Castle; start and finish at Marstall; no shower facilities; several events, including youth races and training sessions.

name: Silvesterlauf Burgwedel
description: The Burgwedel New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing running event held annually on December 31 in Burgwedel. The races cover several distances, including 10.6 km, 5.3 km and 2 km for children, and follow a scenic course with the start and finish at the modernised stadium on Ramhorst. The event attracts numerous runners and spectators and is organised by Schwimmverein Burgwedel. It is a popular sporting way to round off the year, with a family-friendly atmosphere and a diverse range of participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the recently modernised stadium on Ramhorst
Distances: 10.6 km, 5.3 km and a 2 km children’s race
Beautiful blue running track in the stadium
additional: The starting signal is given promptly at 12:00 by the local mayor. The event traditionally takes place on Ramhorst, where the series began in 1984. There is an award for the largest group, and the event is supported by numerous volunteers, sponsors and spectators. Distances: 2 km, 5.3 km, 10 km; December weather is usually cold and snowy; the event involves local clubs, fire brigades and families; course records have been set.

name: Silvesterlauf Salzgitter
organizer: Move SZ - Wir fördern Sport e.V.
description: The Silvesterlauf at Salzgittersee is a traditional running event held on the last day of the year. The event offers various running and walking distances for different age groups and ability levels. The race is a sporting highlight and a meeting place for runners and spectators who want to end the year on an active note together. Alongside the sporting competition, there is a team classification and an awards ceremony that gives special recognition to the children’s races.
course_highlights: Running routes at Salzgittersee of 5.7 km and 11.4 km
Children’s race over 1.2 km for age groups 2013 to 2019
Team classification based on the combined times of each team’s three fastest runners
additional: Race number collection and late registration (plus €3) from 16.12. to 28.12.2025 at the Stadtbad Salzgitter pool cashier. Changes of registration and late registration are possible on 30.12. (15:00–17:00) and 31.12. (11:00–13:00) in the Stadtbad foyer. Online registration is available until 31.12.25 at 10:00 without an extra fee, unless the event is full. Team classification based on the combined times of each team’s three fastest runners. Race packs do not need to be collected in person. Online registration until 31.12.25, race number collection at Stadtbad Salzgitter, refreshments in the finish area, parking available at Salzgittersee, dogs and jogging strollers allowed

name: Silvesterlauf Magdeburg
description: The Magdeburg New Year's Eve Run is a traditional popular sporting event that has been held on the last day of the year for over 50 years. It brings together runners of all ages and ability levels in the city of Magdeburg. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and its sporting end to the year, with over 900 participants crossing the finish line. The run is part of the Magdeburg City Rankings and is very popular in the region.
course_highlights: 5 km loop, run twice
10 km main race
1.5 km children's run for the youngest participants
additional: The New Year's Eve Run is the eighth and final event in the Magdeburg City Rankings. More than 950 runners of all ages take part. The event is organized by the Magdeburger LaufKultur 08 e.V. club. Courses, registration, results, photos, press reports; the weather in December is usually cold and snowy.

name: Silvesterlauf Berlin
description: The Berlin New Year’s Eve Run on December 31 gives runners the chance to end the year on an active note. The event offers three different distances (4 km, 6 km and 10 km) through the scenic Grunewald, with challenging sections such as Drachenberg and Teufelsberg rewarded with great views over Berlin. Alongside the sporting experience, fun takes centre stage, particularly with the option to run in costume and prizes for the best costumes. At the finish, all finishers receive a delicious Pfannkuchen as a sweet keepsake to hang around their neck.
course_highlights: Route through the Grunewald, including Drachenberg and Teufelsberg
Fantastic views across Berlin before the turn of the year
A choice of distances: 4 km, 6 km and 10 km
additional: The start and finish are near Mommsenstadion (Waldschulallee 34, 14055 Berlin). The race pass and race number will be sent by email in advance. Race materials can be collected on site from 10:00 a.m. on the event day. Timing is provided by a disposable transponder attached to the race number. The time limit is 1 hour 30 minutes. Water, tea and Pfannkuchen are available at the finish. Only reusable cups are used. Changing facilities are available at Mommsenstadion, but there is no bag drop. Results and certificates are available online that evening. Distances vary between 2, 4, 6 and 10 km; a run for all age groups; start and finish at Mommsenstadion; refreshments include Pfannkuchen, with awards for the top finishers and the most original costumes.

name: Silvesterlauf München
description: The MRRC Munich New Year’s Eve Run is a long-established running event in Munich’s Olympic Park, held annually on December 31. With more than 4,300 participants from 54 nations, it is one of Germany’s largest New Year’s Eve runs. The races follow loop courses through the Olympic Park, starting and finishing by the lakeshore near the Olympic Tower. The event offers distances for all age groups and ability levels, making for an active and festive end to the year.
course_highlights: Loop courses through Munich’s Olympic Park
Start and finish by the lakeshore near the Olympic Tower
The 10 km race is officially measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and eligible for rankings
additional: Race bib collection is available on December 30 from 17:00 to 19:00 and on race day from 9:30. The race bib with its QR code must be clearly visible on the chest. Safety pins are provided. Pacemakers will be available for the 5 km and 10 km races. The start and finish are by the lakeshore near the Olympic Tower. Late entries are not possible. Race entries can be transferred to another participant for a fee until December 23, 2025. Public transport and cycling are recommended for getting to the event. Annual participant numbers range from 1,600 to more than 2,900. Results, photos and videos are available, and online registration is possible.

name: Silvesterlauf Neuss
description: The Silvesterlauf Neuss is an established 10 km race that starts at 12:00 on December 31, 2026, at the Uedesheimer Deichtor. The course offers beautiful views of the Rhine as it passes through the Rhine meadows and Uedesheim fields, making it a perfect sporting end to the year. The event is suitable for all runners, from beginners to professionals, and combines a sporting challenge with a festive year-end atmosphere. The race also supports Aktion Luftballon, the support association for the children’s clinic at Lukaskrankenhaus Neuss, through fundraising.
course_highlights: 10 km course approved by the DLV
Start at the Uedesheimer Deichtor with views of the Rhine
Run through the Rhine meadows and Uedesheim fields
additional: A supporting program in the start/finish area at the Deichtor creates a pleasant year-end atmosphere. The race raises funds for Aktion Luftballon, the support association for the children’s clinic at Lukaskrankenhaus Neuss. Record participation in 2025, with 1,040 registrations and 859 finishers. The event begins at 12:00 on December 31, 2026, at the Uedesheimer Rhine embankment and features a 10 km course. Training plans are also available, and the event is known for its friendly atmosphere and scenic running route.

name: Silvesterlauf Nürnberg
description: The Silvesterlauf Nürnberg is a traditional running event held annually on December 31 around Lake Wöhrder See. Various races are offered for all age groups, from the Bambini run through the children’s and fun runs to the 10 km main race. The course is mostly flat and entirely paved, making fast times possible. The event is open to runners of all abilities and offers a festive atmosphere to round off the year.
course_highlights: Loop around Lake Wöhrder See, entirely paved
Flat course, ideal for fast times
Out-and-back courses for the Bambini and children’s races along the northern shore
additional: The start and finish are in front of Café Tante Noris im Wastl on Johann-Soergel-Weg. Race packs are distributed at Sebastianspital. Nordic walking poles and jogging strollers are allowed in the fun run, but not in the main race for safety reasons. Participant limits apply: 150 for the Bambini and children’s races, and 1,300 for the fun and main races. A Silvesterlauf long-sleeved shirt can be ordered for an additional charge; children’s sizes can only be ordered until 16.11.2025. Races take place on 31.12.; registration is open until 18.12.2025. Participant numbers are limited, and race-day entries may be possible for certain races. Race number distribution is at Sebastianspital. Participation is open from certain birth years.

name: Silvesterlauf Schifferstadt
description: The Silvesterlauf Schifferstadt is a long-established running event held annually on December 31 at the School and Sports Center on Neustückweg. The flat, fast courses follow paved and compacted paths and finish in the stadium, where spectators can watch the runners cross the line. Alongside the main race, there is also a mini run for children, catering to the growing number of participants. The event is approved by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and attracts runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Flat, fast courses on paved and compacted paths
Finish in the stadium, with the course adjusted to ease congestion at the bottleneck
Mini run for children with its own course
additional: The finish was adjusted in 2012 to ease congestion at bottlenecks in the stadium. The event is approved by the DLV. Children aged 2–5 can take part. Race numbers are issued to all participants. The event takes place at the School and Sports Center on Neustückweg. Registration opens in October 2025 and includes course maps and children’s races.

name: Silvesterlauf Zossen-Ludwigsfelde
description: The 46th Zossen-Ludwigsfelde New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional race covering approximately 18 km from Zossen to Ludwigsfelde. The event begins at Zossen Town Hall Square with a ceremonial start at 9:00 a.m. and the official start at 9:15 a.m. on the outskirts of Zossen. The route follows firmly frozen paths that are easy to run on in good weather. At the finish in Ludwigsfelde Forest Stadium, participants receive a commemorative medal and a prosecco as a reward.
course_highlights: Approximately 18 km from Zossen to Ludwigsfelde
Start on the outskirts of Zossen, beyond the railway crossing on the old B246
Finish at Ludwigsfelde Forest Stadium, with a medal and prosecco
additional: Ceremonial start at 9:00 a.m. at Zossen Town Hall Square. In frosty conditions, the route is firmly frozen and easy to run on. At the finish, runners receive a commemorative medal and prosecco. Registration deadline: December 28, 2025; route may be frozen depending on the weather; commemorative medal and prosecco for finishers; event away from the stadium.

name: Silvesterlauf Gießen
description: The traditional Sparkasse Gießen New Year’s Eve Run takes place on 31 December 2026 in Gießen-Ost and offers runners a varied event with four distances: a schoolchildren’s race, 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The event is sold out, with 1,800 starting places, and is known for its family atmosphere and high-quality organisation. The start and finish are at Karl-Reuter-Weg, and all finishers receive a medal sponsored by Autohaus Erben. In addition to the races, there are awards and ceremonies for walkers and Nordic walkers, as well as a team competition with attractive prizes.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Karl-Reuter-Weg in Gießen-Ost
Four distances: schoolchildren’s race, 5 km, 10 km and half marathon
Separate results and awards ceremony for walkers and Nordic walkers
additional: Race-number pickup is available before Christmas at Sparkasse Gießen premises and on the day before the race at Sporthalle Ost. Changing and shower facilities are available at Sporthalle Ost. Every finisher receives a medal; for the first time, fruit will be provided in the finish area. Start times are staggered to ease congestion on the course. The field is limited to 2,200 participants, and medals go to the first 2,000 finishers. Finisher shirts can be ordered at an additional cost. Parking is available at Philosophikum I and the Studierendenwerk on Otto-Behaghel-Straße. GPX files of the courses are available and can be used with navigation apps. Participant limit: 2,200. Online registration is open until 27 December 2025. Race-number pickup is on 27.12.2025. Medals for the first 2,000 finishers. Entry fee includes a deposit. Shower and changing facilities are available at Sporthalle Ost.

name: Silvesterlauf Frankfurt
location: Deutsche Bank Park, Frankfurt, Hesse, Germany
description: The Spiridon Mainova New Year's Eve Run in Frankfurt is a traditional 10 km race taking place on December 31, 2026, at Deutsche Bank Park. The course is mostly flat and runs through wooded areas on asphalt and well-maintained forest paths. It is accurately measured according to AIMS rules and is open to both club and recreational runners. In addition to the main race, there are also schoolchildren’s and Bambini races, which are particularly popular and regularly see record participation. The event is organized by Spiridon Frankfurt e.V. and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with a broad field of participants.
course_highlights: 10 km course, mostly through woodland, on asphalt and well-maintained forest paths
Mostly flat and accurately measured according to AIMS rules
Every kilometer is marked
additional: Start and finish at the Wintersporthalle at Deutsche Bank Park. Participation is limited to a maximum of 3,000 athletes. Race materials are mailed to participants who register in advance; late registrants receive them at the venue. There are schoolchildren’s races over 2 km and 4 km, as well as Bambini races. The race is eligible for best-list rankings and is a scoring event in the Rosbacher Main-Lauf-Cup 2025. The HLV Frankfurt district championships are held as part of the race. The New Year's Eve Run is open to club and recreational runners, with the start and finish at the Wintersporthalle at Deutsche Bank Park. Registration is online only. Race numbers include a chip, and there is refreshments at the finish, as well as showers and toilets in the hall.

name: Silvesterlauf Bad Staffelstein
description: The Silvesterlauf Bad Staffelstein is a traditional running competition held annually on December 31. The event attracts both recreational and competitive runners and offers an appealing course in the Bad Staffelstein region. The race is known for its team rankings and the personal bests achieved by participants. The event is organized by Böhnlein Sports Bamberg e.V., which also provides professional training programs.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer race course
Team rankings with strong participation
Appealing course in Bad Staffelstein
additional: Böhnlein Sports Bamberg e.V. offers professional training with experienced coaches. The event is part of the club calendar and is organized by a dedicated team. It features strong team rankings, and participants often achieve personal bests. The event takes place at the Adam-Riese-Halle in Bad Staffelstein and offers both individual and team competitions. It is a popular opportunity to end the year on an athletic note.

name: Silvesterlauf Tuttlingen
description: The Silvesterlauf Tuttlingen is a popular running event with a flat, officially measured course along the Danube that is eligible for rankings. Events include 5 km and 10 km races and walking, complemented by Bambini and schoolchildren’s races over shorter distances. The event attracts many participants each year and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, supported by numerous volunteers and sponsors. The 13th edition takes place on December 31, 2026, and promises another sporting highlight to close out the year.
course_highlights: Flat, 5,000-meter loop course along the Danube
Course officially measured by the DLV and eligible for rankings
Bambini and schoolchildren’s races over short distances of 250 to 1,000 meters
additional: The event set a new record in 2025 with 2,512 participants. The 10 km course record is 29:30 minutes. The start and finish for the Bambini and schoolchildren’s races are at the Ferdinand-von-Steinbeis School. The schoolchildren’s races go around the Fritz-Erler School. The course is flat and measured by the DLV. Children’s and schoolchildren’s races are included, and registration and results are available online.

name: Silvesterlauf Schwalmstadt
description: The New Year's Eve Run in Schwalmstadt-Ziegenhain is a traditional race that has taken place every year on December 31 since 1970. The event offers a short 2.7 km race for children and young people, as well as a long 8.1 km race for adults. The race marks the end of the Schwalm-Eder Cup series and is known for its musical program, with samba rhythms by Sola Quente accompanying runners along the course. The event is organized by a dedicated team from TuSpo Ziegenhain and is a popular way for many track and field athletes to end the year.
course_highlights: Short race: 1 lap = 2,740 m; long race: 3 laps = 8,100 m
Samba rhythms by Sola Quente provide musical accompaniment
The course runs through Schützenwald, with parking nearby
additional: Parking is available in the woods between the hospital and the start. Access to the parking lot at the start is possible until 12:45 p.m. After 12:45 p.m., free parking is available at the Asklepios Hospital parking lot. The awards ceremony takes place at the venue in Schützenwald after the races. The race takes place in Schützenwald; online registration is available. The start and finish area is by the pond at Ziegelhütte. Parking is available nearby. There are no shower facilities. Food and drinks are available, along with a program of music and community activities.

name: Silvesterlauf Winsen (Aller)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Das Startgeld beträgt für Erwachsene und Jugendliche 5,00 € und ist im Vorfeld per Überweisung zu entrichten.

description: The MTV "Fichte" Winsen (Aller) New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional year-end running event that welcomes runners of all ages. Various distances are offered, from 1,600 m for children to 10,300 m for adults, as well as a 6,400 m walking route with no competitive pressure. The run starts and finishes at the Allertalsporthalle, where changing rooms and showers are also available. The event is officially sanctioned by the German Athletics Association and features a celebratory awards ceremony for the fastest participants in each distance.
course_highlights: Distances from 1,600 m to 10,300 m for all age groups
6,400 m walking route with no competitive pressure
Start and finish at the Allertalsporthalle, with changing rooms and showers
additional: Race bib distribution from 2 December 2024 at the business office (Mon–Fri, 8:00–12:30). Late registration is possible on the event day from 12:00 to 13:45 for an additional fee. Plenty of parking is available at the Allertalsporthalle. Awards ceremony at approximately 15:30. Distances: 3 km, 5 km, 10.3 km, children’s race 1.6 km; walkers welcome. Start at 14:30. Register online or on site.

name: 12. Silvesterlauf an der Leine
description: The Silvesterlauf an der Leine in Hanover is a popular end-of-year race that traditionally starts at 1:00 p.m. on December 31. The event offers a 7.7 km loop on mostly paved paths along the Leine, through the Steintormasch, to the Wasserkunst and back along the Ihme. The race is organized by Hannoverscher Radsportclub (HRC), Bladerunner and Trimindous UG, and is known for its friendly atmosphere, with mulled wine and bratwurst after the race. Every finisher receives a wheat beer glass featuring the event design as a keepsake. There is also a walking category, making the event appealing to a range of participants.
course_highlights: 7.7 km loop on mostly paved paths

Return route along the Ihme

The start and finish are on Kreisstraße 106, near the Bernshausen multipurpose hall. No bib pickup at Laufline Göttingen. No refund of the entry fee is available if a participant does not start or if the event is cancelled. name: 38. Silvesterlauf

Organized by SV Molbergen since 1975, the race is the final competition of the year for many runners and officially counts toward rankings. The 37th edition of the race in 2026 offers various events for children, young people and adults, including an elite race and a people’s race.
