The event offers various race distances, including Bambini, children’s and youth races, as well as 5K and 10K runs through the Montabaur city forest, featuring challenging elevation gains. Its welcoming atmosphere and professional organisation make the New Year’s Eve Run a popular event, with music, refreshments and a special year-end atmosphere.
course_highlights: 5K route with 70 metres of elevation gain
10K route with 150 metres of elevation gain
Run through the Montabaur city forest
additional: Late registration is possible until 30 minutes before the start of the respective race. Race packs can be collected from 16.12.2025; they will not be mailed. Strollers, walking poles, bicycles and dogs are not permitted on the course. Free drinks and a large, freshly baked pretzel are included at the finish. Prizes are awarded to the largest groups, and the fastest runners are honoured. Race routes, on-site registration, race packs available from 16.12.2025, participation for children and adults, donations to clubs/schools/running groups, extras included at the anniversary event

name: Nellschützer Silvesterlauf
description: The Nellschütz New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional 10 km road race in Lützen, Saxony-Anhalt, held on the morning of December 31. Since 2000, it has been a regular fixture in the local running calendar and offers runners in the Burgenlandkreis a chance to end the year together. The race starts near the church in Nellschütz and is officially organized within the German athletics framework, including insurance and coordination of the event date. Its characteristic relaxed style means runners usually run and chat in small groups rather than aiming for a personal best. After the race, participants are traditionally treated to hot food, tea, and mulled wine in the courtyard of the Kitze family.
course_highlights: 10 km road race through Lützen and the surrounding area
Dedicated aid station on the course
Finish area with hot food, tea, and mulled wine in the courtyard of the Kitze family
additional: Typical December weather: around 3 °C, a low of -2 °C, usually snow-covered, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The race is designed as a communal year-end event, with runners taking part in small groups. The start is near the church in Nellschütz. The race starts in Nellschütz near the church, with a dedicated aid station on the course. The event is known as a year-end race with a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Oberlichtenauer Silvesterlauf
description: The Oberlichtenau New Year's Eve Run is a traditional end-of-year race in Pulsnitz, Saxony. With a 1.2 km children’s race, a 4.8 km fun run and a 9.2 km long-distance race, it offers a sporting option for all ages and ability levels. The race is popular with runners and spectators and always takes place on New Year’s Eve, giving participants a chance to end the year on an athletic note. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and dedicated organizers.
course_highlights: 1.2 km children’s race
4.8 km fun run
9.2 km long-distance race
additional: The race traditionally takes place on December 31 and includes three distances for different age groups. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and provides a sporting end to the year. The website has no information on start times or pricing tiers. The organizers provide a welcoming race environment, with mulled wine and a gymnasium as a meeting point. Start times on December 31, 2025: 13:10, 13:50 and 14:00; on-site registration available; race distances: 1.2 km children’s race, 4.8 km fun run, 9.2 km long-distance race; refreshments provided by club members.

name: OTB Silvesterlauf
description: The OTB New Year’s Eve Run in Osnabrück is a traditional year-end race that welcomes recreational runners, walkers and competitive athletes alike. On the last day of the year, participants can choose from several distances, including a 10 km main race, walking routes, a 5.6 km short race, an accessible fun run and a Bambini run. The event offers a lively atmosphere and modern timing with a disposable chip. The route passes through scenic areas such as Rubbenbruchsee and Natruper Holz, and the race has been a fixture on Osnabrück’s running calendar since 1980.
course_highlights: The 10 km main race goes to Rubbenbruchsee, through Natruper Holz and over Finkenhügel before returning to Illoshöhe
Walking route along Rubbenbruchsee (approx. 8 km), not timed
Accessible fun run on the Illoshöhe track, with up to 5 laps of 400 m each
additional: Timing uses a disposable chip attached to the race number (walking is not timed). From 2025, the Bambini route goes through the “big finish.” The accessible fun run is new from 2025. Start times vary by distance: walkers at 11:20, Bambini at 11:30, fun run at 11:50, 5.6 km short race at 12:10, and 10 km main race at 12:20. Spikes are not allowed on the 10 km and 5.6 km routes. Several race options are available, including an accessible run, a children’s race and walking; spikes are not allowed; online registration is available; field limited to 3,000 runners.

name: Ottenbacher Silvesterlauf
description: The Ottenbach New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional running event in Ottenbach, held annually at the end of the year. It gives runners of different age groups and ability levels the opportunity to enjoy being active together and round off the year with a sporting highlight. The courses pass through the scenic surroundings of Ottenbach and offer varied running conditions. The event is organized by TSV Ottenbach and is a popular meeting point for the regional running community.
course_highlights: Running routes through the beautiful surroundings of Ottenbach
A range of distances for different age and ability groups
Traditional New Year’s Eve running atmosphere to round off the year
additional: The event is organized by TSV 1904 Ottenbach e.V. Information about travel and parking is available on the website. Registration is online via the official registration page. The event includes various age groups and race distances; details about the routes are available on the website. The race takes place on December 31, with online registration available. The course is approximately 10.4 km; details are available on the official website.

name: Pönitzer Silvesterlauf
description: The Pönitz New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional road race held in Pönitz, a district of Scharbeutz in Schleswig-Holstein. On December 31, 2026, runners set off at 9:00 a.m. to choose between 7.5 km and 15 km on a flat course that finishes at Lindenstraße 34. The event is organized by SVG Pönitz and features electronic timing. After the race, participants receive a hot drink, a Berliner doughnut and a commemorative medal, as well as a personalized certificate on request.
course_highlights: Flat course in Pönitz, finishing at Lindenstraße 34
Electronic timing
Traditional New Year’s Eve event with refreshments and a medal
additional: Registration is easy and available on race day. The event has a long tradition, with more than 40 editions, and attracts numerous runners and walkers even in adverse weather conditions. Typical December weather is around 3 °C, with occasional snowfall. A traditional New Year’s Eve run with a sense of community, electronic timing and small celebrations to round off the year.

name: Zimní běh na Blaník
description: Zimní běh na Blaník is a legendary January race in the picturesque town of Načeradec, taking place on 16 January 2027. The event offers two main races: a challenging 19.9 km main race over Velký and Malý Blaník, and an accompanying 11.2 km race. The routes pass through the beautiful Podblanicko countryside, with significant climbs, forest sections, and views from the lookout tower on Velký Blaník. The start and finish are right in the centre of Načeradec, with cosy facilities. The race is limited to 700 runners, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere and high-quality organisation.
course_highlights: The 19.9 km main race with 542 m of elevation gain over Velký and Malý Blaník
The 11.2 km accompanying race with 238 m of elevation gain and views from Malý Blaník
Refreshment stations along the route in Býkovice and by the lookout tower on Velký Blaník
additional: The start and finish are behind the Načeradec Municipal Office building, approximately 270 m from the race facilities. Parking is available in several designated areas, marked with traffic signs and assisted by volunteer firefighters. The race is limited to 700 runners. The organisers offer free secure storage for valuables in the changing rooms at the primary school. The accompanying race starts at 10:45. The entry fee includes the option to order functional accessories from the J&O 2025/2026 collection. In adverse circumstances, the race may be modified to individual starts or postponed. Online registration is available, with entry-fee refunds possible until 31.12.2026. The race takes place in January and has a capacity of approximately 700 runners. The route runs mostly along forest and field tracks. The main race starts at 10:10.

name: Zimowy Maraton Świętokrzyski 2027
description: The Świętokrzyski Winter Marathon is a unique outdoor event held in the scenic Świętokrzyskie Mountains, around Chęciny and Ciekoty. Participants can choose between two routes: Royal Battle and Knights’ Charge, which cross natural terrain in challenging winter conditions. The event attracts hundreds of runners and hiking enthusiasts from across Poland every year, offering a distinctive atmosphere and beautiful views. The organizers look after participants’ safety and comfort, providing refreshment and checkpoint stations along the routes.
course_highlights: Two routes to choose from: Royal Battle and Knights’ Charge
The routes cross the natural terrain of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains in winter conditions
Refreshment and checkpoint stations along the routes, and a GPX file available to download
additional: Race packets can be collected in person at designated times and locations, including the Regional Tourist Information Centre in Kielce and the European Centre for Geological Education in Korzecko. The Royal Battle starts at 7:00, and the Knights’ Charge at 9:00. Participants must bring the mandatory equipment and prepare for winter conditions. Race packets are issued only to participants with a signed Participant Card and proof of identity. The event does not provide official timing; it focuses on outdoor activity and tourism, with tourist attractions and a sense of community. Registration is available through the B4SPORTONLINE platform.

name: Zimowy Maraton Świętokrzyski

The event brings together runs, hikes and run-walks, giving participants the opportunity to discover the region’s beautiful, scenic landscapes. For years, the organizers have promoted outdoor activity and mountain tourism by creating and restoring hiking trails. This event is for those who enjoy long-distance challenges and being close to nature.
course_highlights: Mountain routes in the heart of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains
Scenic landscapes and natural hiking trails
Routes suitable for running, hiking and run-walks
additional: The organizers also restore and promote hiking trails in the region. The event is part of a broader range of outdoor activities in the Świętokrzyskie Mountains. Aid and checkpoint stations are available to participants, as is the option to download a GPX file with the routes. The event is aimed at runners and hikers taking on challenging winter conditions.

name: Ľudova 50
description: Ľudova 50 is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance hiking event through the beautiful Strážov Mountains. The 51 km route with 2,600 metres of elevation gain starts and finishes in the village of Uhrovec, birthplace of Ľudovít Štúr, after whom the race is named. The race is demanding, and experience with similar long-distance routes is recommended. There are three aid stations along the course, which follows marked hiking trails throughout, offering beautiful views and historical sites.
course_highlights: 51 km route with 2,600 m of elevation gain
Follows marked hiking trails in the Strážov Mountains
Checkpoints at Uhrovec Castle, Chata pod Čiernym vrchom and Kajtárov
additional: The participant limit is 200 runners/hikers. Participant check-in takes place the day before the race and on race morning. There are three aid stations along the route. The organiser recommends having completed at least one event with a 50 km route before the start. The course passes through areas inhabited by brown bears and other wildlife. The organiser monitors the weather and may adjust the route or programme in case of danger. The start and finish are at Ľudovít Štúr Square in Uhrovec. Information about mandatory equipment, rules and registration is available on the official website.

The series includes several races over different distances, including 10 km, 15 km and a half marathon, with individual-race and series rankings. Awards ceremonies take place approximately 45 minutes after the finish in the marquee at Jahnstadion. The event comprises a series of three 10 km races held in Hamm’s natural landscape and spa gardens. Registration is online, timing is provided by Race Result, and awards are given to the top participants and series winners.

The start is at the New Primary School in Halenkovice, and race bibs can be collected from 8:00 to 9:30. The race is suitable for the general public and focuses on safety and fun outdoors.

description: Letecká stovka is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance hike covering 106 km with +3,590 m of elevation gain in the Považský Inovec and Strážovské vrchy mountain ranges. The start and finish are in Trenčín. The route runs mostly along marked hiking trails and is ITRA-certified. The event is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League and is also a qualifying race for the 2028 Western States Endurance Run. It is organized by o.z. SLOVAK ULTRA TRAIL, an ITRA member since 2015. The race is open to individuals aged 18 and over, with participation also permitted from age 17 when accompanied by a legal guardian.
course_highlights: A 106 km route with +3,590 m of elevation gain in the Považský Inovec and Strážovské vrchy mountain ranges
Start and finish in Trenčín; the route runs mostly along marked hiking trails
ITRA-certified, part of the Slovak Ultratrail League, and a qualifying race for the Western States Endurance Run
additional: Participant check-in takes place on Friday, March 5, from 18:00 to 22:00 and on Saturday, March 6, from 05:00 to 05:40 in the Arena Ostrov building in Trenčín. The winners’ announcement and prize-giving will take place at the finish in the Arena Ostrov building, according to the finish times of the first three participants in each category. Both the start and finish are in Trenčín. According to information for the 2027 edition, the main race takes place on March 6–7; the available date information therefore does not match the stated date of March 13.

description: The Úpice Ten is a traditional 10 km road race held in Úpice. The course is accurately measured, flat, and follows an asphalt road from the town centre towards Havlovice and into the Ratibořické Valley before returning. The race is suitable for the general public, including juniors, who may take part with the race director’s approval. After the race, results are announced at the Municipal Hall in Úpice, with cash prizes for the top finishers in the adult categories.
course_highlights: Accurately measured 10 km course
Flat asphalt road
Start and finish in front of the Municipal Hall in Úpice
additional: Children’s categories have no entry fee and can register only on site. Juniors (born in 2009–2010) may take part in the main race with the race director’s approval. Registration takes place until 12:00 for children and until 12:30 for juniors and adults. Results are announced at 15:00 at the Municipal Hall in Úpice. The race follows athletics and road traffic regulations, and participants take part at their own risk. Registration is available online and on site. The race takes place on an asphalt road, weather permitting. Categories are available for children and adults, and category winners receive prizes.

description: The ALS Charity Run – Ján Svočák Memorial is a mountain trail run in Svit, offering a challenging 21 km course with 950 metres of elevation gain. The course runs mainly through forest (80%) and meadows (20%), with two refreshment stations at kilometres 8 and 16. Alongside the main race, the event also includes children’s races, relays, Nordic walking and a special trail run with a dog. The event is suitable for runners looking for a challenge in a natural setting, with high-quality organisation and a certified course.
course_highlights: 21 km trail with 950 m of elevation gain
80% of the route is through forest and 20% through meadows
Two refreshment stations at kilometres 8 and 16
additional: Individual start times for the trail run with a dog are between 09:30 and 09:40, at 10-second intervals, with each runner’s exact start time printed on their race number. Relays are 3 × 1.7 km with 140 m of elevation gain; the course surface includes forest trail, meadow, asphalt and gravel. Nordic walking takes place on a route that is 90% forest and 10% asphalt. All children’s categories are awarded and results are announced immediately at the finish. ITRA-certified course, 1 qualifying point for ALS 21 km. The event supports people with neuromuscular diseases. Sources differ on the 2027 event date: the listed date is 27 March, while the event website gives 20 March.

The race offers a beautiful course running between sand quarries, creating a unique setting for runners and spectators alike. The event is for all sports enthusiasts who want to enjoy a friendly atmosphere and a day of sport in nature. Following the success of the first edition, minor changes have been made to enhance the experience for all participants.

A unique setting for runners and spectators alike
A friendly atmosphere for all sports enthusiasts

description: Běh Terezským údolím is a race organized by SK RELAX Olomouc, held at the KVS Olomouc complex in Náměšť na Hané. The 7.1 km course is an out-and-back route and almost flat, with climbs after the start and before the finish. The surface consists of field paths, asphalt, and gravel, offering a varied running experience. The race starts at 11:00 and is suitable for runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: Out-and-back course with climbs after the start and before the finish
Surface: field paths, asphalt, and gravel
7.1 km course at the KVS Olomouc complex in Náměšť na Hané
additional: The race is organized by SK RELAX Olomouc. The contact person is Karel Pikal. The race is part of Český běh, a service of the Czech Athletics Federation for runners. The course is certified, and the race is listed in the official Český běh race calendar. In 2026, the race was part of the Hanácký běžecký pohár and the Velká cena vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje. The race information also lists a fitness run open to all ages.

name: Širokodolský kros
location: Obecní sál, Široký Důl, Pardubice District, Czech Republic
description: Širokodolský Cross-Country Run is a traditional off-road race held in the village of Široký Důl near Polička in the Pardubice Region. The event offers races for children and young people ranging from 60 metres to 4 km, as well as a 7 km main race with a mass start for men and women. The course runs along paved roads, forest trails and dirt tracks, with a climbing bonus on the first hill. Children can win prizes, while adults can receive cash prizes in their categories. The start and finish are by the municipal hall, creating a welcoming race atmosphere.
course_highlights: The course runs along paved roads, forest trails and dirt tracks
Climbing bonus on the first hill
Start and finish by the municipal hall in Široký Důl
additional: Children and young people start in successive age categories, with distances ranging from 60 m to 4 km. The 7 km main race has a mass start for men and women. Children receive prizes for the first three finishers in each category, while adults receive cash prizes for the first three in each category. The race starts by the municipal hall. The programme includes races for children and young people; the results for the 2026 edition list distances from 80 m to 7.8 km.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - duben
location: Madal Bal, Příluky, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: The 2-mile run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt circuit. The event also includes an 800-metre children’s course. After the finish, every participant receives a warm cinnamon pancake as a reward for their effort. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and the start at 9:00 a.m.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt circuit of just under two laps (3.2 km)
The children’s course is 800 metres long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 to 127, and children up to 12 years old. Every runner’s time is recorded, and the top three finishers in both adult and children’s categories receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get there are by bicycle, on foot, by car, on roller skates, or by trolleybus No. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). The men’s course record is 9:31.8. Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55; the start is at 9:00. Every participant is timed, and the best finishers in the categories receive small prizes.

description: Čendův Run is the oldest tramp-style running race in Bohemia and one of the oldest cross-country races of all. It is traditionally held on Easter Sunday in Petrov near Prague and offers technically challenging courses along soft forest roads and trails in the valley of the Záhořanský Stream and around Ďábel Hill. The race is known for its family atmosphere and demanding terrain, with professional chip timing provided by irontime. Courses range from 100 metres for children’s categories to 12 km for experienced cross-country runners.
course_highlights: Technically challenging courses along soft forest roads and trails
The valley of the Záhořanský Stream and the area around Ďábel Hill
A traditional Easter-time date and a family atmosphere
additional: Professional chip timing is provided by irontime. The race offers a wide range of categories, from 100 metres for children to 12 km for experienced runners. The event takes place at the municipal sports ground in Petrov near Prague. It is traditionally held on Easter Sunday; the listed courses in the previous edition included 6 km and 12 km. The date 11 April 2027 has not been confirmed by sources.

name: Velikonoční běh Tovačov
description: The Tovačov Easter Run is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the picturesque grounds of Tovačov Castle. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for endurance runners and gives athletes the chance to test themselves in recreational and competitive races. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support for the running community in Central Moravia. The race is suitable for a wide audience who enjoy running in a pleasant setting steeped in history.
course_highlights: Picturesque grounds of Tovačov Castle
Part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for endurance runners
Traditional endurance race with a long history
additional: The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for endurance runners. Details for the 2027 edition have not yet been confirmed by the listed sources.

description: The Rožmitál–Březnice Road Run is a traditional 10 km race held every year on Easter Sunday. The race starts in front of the TJ Spartak Rožmitál pod Třemšínem stadium and finishes in Březnice. It is part of the regional championships and the Podbrdy Cup, attracting hundreds of runners of all ages. The route follows roads with gentle elevation changes and is suitable for a broad range of runners.
course_highlights: The route follows roads at elevations between 460 and 529 m above sea level.
The start and finish are at the stadiums in Rožmitál and Březnice.
The race is part of the regional championships and the Podbrdy Cup.
additional: Pre-registration is available at www.sportt.cz from 15 December 2026, with payment by bank transfer due by 15 March 2027. After that date, registration and payment are possible only online by card. On-site registration is available until 9:45 a.m. for the increased entry fee of CZK 500. Runners under 18 and over 65 can enter for free. Parking, changing rooms, toilets, and refreshments are provided. Runners’ belongings will be transported from the start to the finish in a white van. The organizer accepts no liability for lost valuables. The 2026 race information lists a predominantly asphalt surface, with the final approximately 400 m on cinder. The organizer’s page lists the 2027 race as taking place on 28 March, which differs from the supplied date of 11 April.

description: The Easter Harrachovka Run in Tábor is a traditional 7.5 km running race held in the beautiful surroundings of the town of Tábor. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and offers a sporting experience for runners of all levels. The course surface is suitable for fast running, and the race has a friendly, motivating atmosphere. The event is organised by the South Bohemian Marathon Club, which provides high-quality organisation and support for participants.
course_highlights: Course distance: 7.5 km
Surface suitable for fast running
The route runs around the town of Tábor
additional: Registration is available online and requires payment of a membership fee of CZK 250. The registration fee must be paid within 14 days, otherwise the registration will be cancelled. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup, with a points system and the option of a team competition. In 2026, the start was scheduled for 14:00; the information provided does not confirm details for the 2027 edition.

description: The Night Run for Světluška in Prague is a charity run held in the evening in the beautiful setting of Stromovka and Výstaviště. Participants can choose between two routes—a short 2.8 km loop and a long 4.5 km loop—which can also be walked. The start is at 21:00, and registration opens at 18:30. The event offers an accompanying programme, including a concert, and is open to all age groups. Proceeds support people with severe visual impairments. Capacity is limited to ensure runners’ safety and comfort.
course_highlights: 2.8 km route – short loop in Stromovka
4.5 km route – long loop in Stromovka
Night run with a choice of entry option including a headlamp or sports headband
additional: Registration is through the GoOut.cz portal, where participants can choose an entry option with a headlamp or sports headband. Holders of TP, ZTP and ZTP/P disability cards are admitted free of charge, without a headlamp or headband. Children under 15 accompanied by an adult are admitted free of charge, but do not receive a headlamp. A cloakroom and baggage storage, medical services and an accompanying programme including a concert are available on site. Dogs on a leash and wearing a muzzle are welcome, except in Jihlava. Information about the venue, route and price is based on the 2026 edition; the date 15. 4. 2027 has not been confirmed. Participants can run a 3 km route at their own pace and support their health. The start is at Lodičky, and proceeds from the entry fee are donated to help those in need. Everyone is warmly invited to take part in this community sporting event.

Start at Lodičky in Karviná
Run at any pace in pleasant natural surroundings

name: Jarní běh v Pávově
description: The Spring Run in Pávov is an 8.8 km race that follows both roads and trails around Jihlava, specifically in Pávov. The race is part of the Běžec Vysočiny Cup and gives runners the opportunity to enjoy a combination of paved and off-road sections in the picturesque Vysočina countryside. It is suitable for the general public and offers a sporting experience in spring.
course_highlights: 8.8 km course
Combination of road and off-road sections
Around Jihlava, in Pávov
additional: The race is part of the Běžec Vysočiny Cup.

name: Horský půlmaraton Sušice
location: Ostrov Santos, Sušice, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The Sušice Mountain Half Marathon is a challenging and beautiful running race in the heart of Šumava, offering a unique experience with stunning views from three peaks and of iconic places such as Žižkův vrch, Kalich, Sedlo, Kalovy and Pustý Hrádek. The race base is traditionally on Santos Island by the Otava River, where runners can enjoy quality services, marked courses and a family-friendly atmosphere. The organizers focus on providing excellent conditions and an unforgettable day filled with sport and nature. The race also has a strong tradition and is organized in memory of Matěj Molcar, an enthusiastic athlete.
course_highlights: The main course is 21.1 km long with 800 m of elevation gain
The surface consists of 90% paved roads, singletrack, forest trails and rocky climbs
The route crosses three peaks and offers stunning views of Šumava
additional: The race base on Santos Island offers a restaurant, parking, a children's playground, a swimming pool, a pump track and a skatepark. Relay teams are provided with transport to the start and a shuttle after the race. The children's race has several age categories, with different loop lengths. Cancellation insurance for the entry fee can be arranged through Kooperativa. The race offers several distances, including a half marathon and 10.5 km, with challenging terrain and a family-friendly atmosphere in the Sušice and Šumava area.

name: 57. ročník Běhu vítězství, 53. ročník Hranické dvacítky a 10. ročník Hranické desítky
location: Stadion SK Hranice, Hranice, Czech Republic
description: The Běh vítězství, Hranická dvacítka and Hranická desítka are traditional running races organized by SK Hranice. The races take place at the SK Hranice stadium and in the surrounding area, with the shorter distances of 100 to 500 metres run on the stadium track. The Hranická dvacítka and Hranická desítka partly follow forest paths, offering runners a pleasant natural setting. These races have a long tradition and are popular with runners of all kinds, as well as children and young people.
course_highlights: Races from 100 to 500 m on the stadium track
The Hranická dvacítka follows forest paths
Natural surroundings near the stadium
additional: The races have children’s categories and a training schedule for children and young people. Photos from previous editions are available online. The races are part of SK Hranice’s activities and promote a healthy lifestyle. The programme also includes children’s and youth races; the 100 to 500 m runs take place on the stadium track. The main 20 km race is part of the Velká cena vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje.

name: Mistrovství ČR v půlmaratonu mužů a žen
location: Společenské centrum IDEON, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: The Czech Men’s and Women’s Half Marathon Championships is a prestigious 21.0975 km athletics race held in Pardubice. The start is on Smetana Square by the East Bohemian Theatre, and the finish is also in Pardubice. The race is for men, women and, where applicable, juniors who are entered by their athletics clubs and approved by the technical delegate. Participants receive a JOMA performance T-shirt free of charge. The Czech Championships results are announced shortly after the race, including the half-marathon results.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Pardubice, on Smetana Square by the East Bohemian Theatre
Course distance: 21.0975 km
Sports drinks and water at every lap
additional: Registration and race-number and timing-chip collection take place on Friday, 9 April, from 16:00 to 19:00 at the IDEON Social Centre, Jiráskova 1963, Pardubice. Runners must compete in club vests registered with the Czech Athletics Federation (ČAS). The race is technically organized by Oldřich Bujnoch in cooperation with the KPA Pardubice Sports Club. The Czech Championships results ceremony is at 15:40, and the half-marathon results ceremony is at 16:25. The race is scheduled for 10 April 2027, with a 14:00 start. The race office and race-number collection will be at the IDEON Social Centre. Runners receive a JOMA performance T-shirt, a medal and water at the finish; entries for the championship race are submitted by runners’ clubs.

name: Jarní běh Bílovice nad Svitavou
location: Palackého údolí, Bílovice nad Svitavou, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Spring Run in Bílovice nad Svitavou is a traditional athletics event organized by Sokol Bílovice nad Svitavou with the support of the municipality. The race takes place in Palackého Valley, approximately 800 metres beyond the Sokol gym, and is open to all age groups, from preschool children to adult men and women. The first race starts at 9:00, with categories divided by age and ability. The event offers a pleasant sporting atmosphere amid beautiful natural surroundings and promotes an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: The course runs through Palackého Valley in Bílovice nad Svitavou
Start approximately 800 m beyond the Sokol gym
Categories range from preschool children to adults
additional: The race is open to all categories, from preschool children up to 6 years old through to men and women. It starts on Saturday morning at 9:00. The event is organized with the support of the municipality of Bílovice nad Svitavou and Sokol Bílovice nad Svitavou.

name: Pardubický vinařský půlmaratón – Mistrovství ČR v půlmaratonu
description: The Pardubice Wine Half Marathon is a traditional 21.097 km race held in Pardubice. It is also the Czech Republic Men’s and Women’s Half Marathon Championship, with a scenic course through the city centre and the finish at Pernštýnské Square. The start is at Smetana Square, and runners complete two laps. Participants receive a technical T-shirt and a bottle of wine if they pay the entry fee on time. The race is suitable for both recreational runners and elite athletes.
course_highlights: The course runs through the centre of Pardubice, starting at Smetana Square and finishing at Pernštýnské Square
Two laps, with a total distance of 21.097 km
Isotonic drinks and water at every lap
additional: The start and finish are in the centre of Pardubice. Registration takes place at the IDEON Social Centre in Pardubice. The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours. Registrations not paid by 4.4.2027 do not include a T-shirt or wine. Timing chips are non-returnable and assigned by number. Parking is available in front of the IDEON Social Centre and in nearby car parks.

name: Zlínská lesní hodinovka
description: The Zlín Forest Hour Run is a unique running race in the Czech Republic, held in the forest above the Lesní čtvrť district of Zlín. The race has a long tradition: it was originally run on a cinder track, moved to the forest at Vršava in 1995, and since 2006 has taken place on a gently rolling one-kilometre loop. The run lasts 60 minutes, and competitors try to cover as much distance as possible. The race is organized by Jirka Prokop and his team and is known for its friendly, regional character.
course_highlights: A gently rolling one-kilometre loop in the forest above the Lesní čtvrť district of Zlín
A unique forest course, the only hourly race in the Czech Republic run in a forest
The Gustav Bělský Loop at Vršava (historically)
additional: Race registration takes place at the observatory. The race lasts 60 minutes of running time. The best performance is over 17 km in an hour. The race is part of the year-round competition for runners from the Zlín region.

name: Jarní kros Okolo Dračí studánky
location: Malíkovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: ZD Hradečno a Obec Malíkovice ve spolupráci s MK Kladno a Pavlem Žlábkem
description: The Spring Cross-Country Race around Dračí studánka is a 6 km race that runs mainly along field and forest paths in Malíkovice. This cross-country race gives runners the chance to enjoy the natural terrain and woodland setting of the Central Bohemian Region. It is organized by ZD Hradečno and the Malíkovice Municipal Office in cooperation with MK Kladno, ensuring high-quality organization and a friendly atmosphere. The race is suitable for anyone who enjoys running in nature and wants to experience a springtime run.
course_highlights: 6 km course mainly along field and forest paths
Natural and woodland terrain in the Central Bohemian Region
Scenic surroundings of Dračí studánka in Malíkovice

name: Půlmaraton Plzeňského kraje
description: The Plzeň Region Half Marathon is a popular running celebration held at the Škodaland venue in Plzeň. The event offers races for different age groups and ability levels, including a half marathon, the regional 10K, a 5K, a team run and children’s races. The event is not only a sporting challenge but also an opportunity to get together and enjoy a great atmosphere in beautiful surroundings. The start and finish are located in front of the Škodaland venue, where refreshments, medical supervision and an accompanying programme are provided.
course_highlights: Certified half-marathon course measuring 21.0975 km
The route passes through Plzeň-Bory, Litice, Šlovice, Dobřany, Lhota and Valcha
Start and finish at the Škodaland venue in Plzeň
additional: You can order a technical T-shirt and headband when registering. The race pack can be collected at the Škodaland venue on Friday, 23.4.2027, from 14:00 to 19:00, or on race day from 7:30 to 9:00. Registration closes after 9:00. The entry fee includes a medal, chip timing, refreshments on the course and at the finish, photo service, an online diploma, a race bag, baggage storage, free parking and medical supervision. You can transfer your registration to another participant free of charge until 20.4.2027; after that date, a fee of 100 Kč applies. The race involves traffic restrictions along the route due to road closures.

name: Veřovská desítka
description: We invite you to the traditional Veřovská desítka run, held in the picturesque village of Veřovice in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The race offers an opportunity for runners of all ages and abilities, including children’s categories and a race for non-registered participants. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and beautiful surroundings, inspiring active movement and a memorable sporting experience. Race information is available to download on the official website. We look forward to your participation and to sharing a great sporting experience.
additional: Race information and details of the children’s categories are available to download on the website. Orlovna’s contact telephone numbers and opening hours are listed for enquiries and reservations.

name: Běhej lesy Karlštejn
location: Bubovice, Karlštejn, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Běhej lesy Karlštejn is a trail race held in the picturesque countryside near Karlštejn, offering a range of distances, including short, medium, and extra-long routes. The race is part of the international UTMB Index Races, ensuring high quality and prestige. The course features special Conti Speed Section speed segments and the extended Generali Investments Finish straight, adding competitive elements and motivation. Join runners enjoying the beautiful forest setting and sporting atmosphere of this popular race.
course_highlights: UTMB Index Races with international rankings
Conti Speed Section – a 150-metre speed segment on the 12 km, 18 km, and 30 km routes
Generali Investments Finish – an extended 500 m finish straight with a timed segment
additional: The race features special Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish speed segments, with prizes for the fastest runners. You can transfer your registration and change your race entry online through SportID or at the race venue. The race is sold out for all main distances in 2026. The race offers a range of distances, including an extra-long route, has an international UTMB Index, and includes charitable and competitive elements, as well as the option to download GPX routes. The course passes historical and natural landmarks with beautiful views.

name: 7 pohoří Jizerské hory
location: Ski areál Severák, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Jizerské hory 2026 race is part of the 7 pohoří trail run series and offers technical trails with epic views around Smržovka, Josefův Důl and Maxov. The start and race facilities are at Ski areál Severák in the Liberec Region. Runners can choose from three courses: the main 25 km course with 860 m of elevation gain, an alternative 14 km course with 400 m of elevation gain, and the Kari Traa RUN 6 km course with 150 m of elevation gain. The routes have been designed by Michal Zavadil, a rescuer with the Jizerské hory Mountain Rescue Service. The race takes place in all weather conditions and has a time limit of 4 hours.
course_highlights: Technical trails with up to 860 m of elevation gain
Routes follow paths and trails around Smržovka, Josefův Důl and Maxov
Epic views and an atmosphere unique to the 7 pohoří trail run series
additional: The entry fee includes a professionally marked course, race number, chip timing, commemorative medal, refreshments along the course and at the finish, and use of the race facilities. Participants can leave small belongings at the registration tent. Recommended gear includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the záchranka app. The event takes place in all weather conditions, and participation is at your own risk. Course distances: 25 km, 14 km or 6 km; elevation gain: 150 m to 860 m; start and race facilities at Ski areál Severák; registration includes chip timing, a medal and refreshments; event held in all weather conditions.

name: Běh Trojzemím
location: Kristýna recreational area, Hrádek nad Nisou, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
price_range: 200/300 Kč to 300/500 Kč za pár, zdarma pro děti
description: Běh Trojzemím is a family run for all ages and ability levels, held at the Kristýna recreation area in Hrádek nad Nisou. The race offers a fast 5 km and 10 km course, mostly along flat cycle paths, ideal for runners of all levels. The event is traditionally supported by local partners and is suitable for the whole family. The start and finish are located in beautiful natural surroundings, with paid parking available near the start.
course_highlights: Fast 5 km and 10 km course
Mostly flat cycle paths
Start and finish at the Kristýna recreation area
additional: Children’s check-in is from 8:30 to 9:30 in the start and finish area. Adult check-in is from 9:00 to 12:30. Parking is paid and available in the immediate vicinity of the start; the car park is unattended. The race has reached capacity and registration is closed; it is not possible to register online or on site. The course includes flat cycle paths; registration is closed; the race includes road traffic; health and safety information is provided.

name: NN NIGHT RUN Ostrava
location: Masarykovo náměstí, Ostrava, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic

price_tiers.distance: BELLIS RUN proti rakovině prsu - 5 Km

description: NN NIGHT RUN Ostrava is the largest running event in Ostrava, held in Masaryk Square. More than 2,000 runners of all ages take part each year, from beginners to experienced competitors. The event offers an unforgettable atmosphere and a varied programme, including children’s races, relays and runs supporting breast cancer awareness. The races start in the evening, giving the event its distinctive nighttime character. There is also entertainment, performances and the chance to test sports equipment.
course_highlights: Night run in central Ostrava, starting in Masaryk Square
10 km course with a 90-minute limit, a 2 × 5 km relay, and shorter 3 km and 5 km runs
A lively atmosphere with accompanying activities, performances and the chance to test sports products
additional: The programme includes the KIDS CUP children’s races, the FÉNIX RUN 3 km, the BELLIS RUN 5 km supporting breast cancer awareness, the NN NIGHT RUN 10 km main race and a 2 × 5 km relay. Race packs are distributed from the afternoon. The accompanying programme features performances, warm-ups, MIZUNO sports equipment testing, a shoe rental service, NUTREND nutritional supplements, a photo booth, face painting, a bouncy castle and other activities. The time limit for the 10 km is 90 minutes and for the 5 km it is 70–75 minutes; the event is also suitable for brisk walking. The organiser offers entry-fee discounts for NN clients and athletes, the option of free insurance during the race and other benefits. Races include various categories, registration is available online and on site, and participants receive medals, running T-shirts and refreshments.

name: Běh Litní a zámeckým parkem
location: Liteň, Liteň, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 150,- předem do 30.3., později 200,- a na místě 300,-, děti 20,-

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Včasná registrace předem: 20,- Kč pro registrované do 30.3.2025 s řádně uhrazeným startovným do 4.4.2025, závodníci při dodržení včasné registraci obdrží startovní číslo se svým jménem

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Registrace předem: 20,- Kč pro registrované po 1.4.2025 s řádně uhrazeným startovným do 4.4.2025

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Včasná registrace předem: 150,- Kč pro registrované do 30.3.2025 s řádně uhrazeným startovným do 1.4.2025, závodníci při dodržení včasné registraci obdrží startovní číslo se svým jménem

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Registrace předem: 200,- Kč pro registrované po 1.4.2025 s řádně uhrazeným startovným do 4.4.2025

description: The Spring Run through Liteň and the Chateau Park is a public running race held in the picturesque grounds of Liteň Chateau and its park. The race is part of the Regional Youth Cross-Country Running Cup and offers courses for adults and children. The main race is 6,760 metres long, and winners of the main categories receive valuable accommodation vouchers. The children’s races take place within the chateau grounds, adding to the event’s family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Main race, 6,760 m long, through the grounds of the former vocational school and the chateau park
Children’s races within the chateau grounds
Picturesque setting of Liteň Chateau and its park
additional: The entry fee is payable in cash when registering on site. Winners of the main categories receive a voucher worth CZK 5,000 for a stay at a cottage in the Jizera Mountains, Šumava, or Český les. The voucher can be used for stays of 3 or more nights and for a minimum of 12 guests. Approx. 6.92 km route, mixed surface, children’s races, various distances in different editions.

name: Štafetová POHÁDKA
description: Štafetová POHÁDKA is a relay race for teams of three, following a scenic route of over 70 km from the village of Police through the most beautiful places in Podyjí and Lower Austria to the wine-growing village of Nový Šaldorf near Znojmo. The route is divided into six legs of 10 to 14 km, which runners complete in sequence while carrying a relay baton. The race offers a unique experience of running in nature, with views of Bítov, Cornštejn and Hardegg castles, as well as other historical and natural landmarks. It is open to men’s, women’s and mixed teams. Participants must be at least 18 years old (15 with parental consent).
course_highlights: The route passes Bítov Castle and the ruins of Cornštejn Castle
Through Thayatal and Podyjí National Parks, with their beautiful natural scenery
Passes through the Austrian town of Hardegg and the wine-growing village of Nový Šaldorf
additional: The race is a relay for teams of three. Each runner must complete at least one leg, and a runner’s legs may not be consecutive. Runners carry a relay baton and hand it over at designated exchange points. The race takes place on public roads under normal traffic conditions, so runners must wear reflective gear to remain visible. If a runner is injured, another team member may take over at the site of the injury. The minimum participant age is 18. The race is intended for team runners, with an emphasis on safety and reflective gear.

name: Rozeběhni Stráž
location: Stráž pod Ralskem, Liberec District, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Základní škola a Mateřská škola ve Stráži pod Ralskem
description: Rozeběhni Stráž is a traditional running race held in the picturesque town of Stráž pod Ralskem. The race offers runners of all ages and ability levels the chance to enjoy a day of sport in a friendly atmosphere. The event is organised by the Stráž pod Ralskem Primary and Nursery School, which also provides the sporting facilities. The race website features up-to-date information and photos from previous editions, reflecting the event’s community spirit.
course_highlights: Running track and multi-purpose sports facilities at the Stráž pod Ralskem Primary and Nursery School
A course suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels
Pleasant school sports facilities with full amenities
additional: The sports complex includes two multi-purpose courts, a small-sided football pitch, a running track, high-jump and long-jump facilities, a shot put area and a climbing rope. On weekdays, the complex is reserved for school lessons until 15:30; the public can use it after 15:00 and on weekends from 9:00. The complex is fenced and offers full sports facilities. The route includes a loop around the prison, the sports complex and walking trails. Refreshments and a commemorative medal are provided to all participants.

name: Městský běh Brandýsem a Boleslaví
location: Zámecká zahrada, Brandýsy nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: The City Run through Brandýs and Boleslav is a traditional running event held in the chateau garden in Brandýs nad Labem, offering races for all ages and levels of runners. The programme includes 5 km, 10 km (two laps of the 5 km course) and 3 km races, which start in the afternoon. There is also a children’s run with several age categories and a team race, in which the best times of three team members are added together. The event also features an accompanying programme, refreshments and valuable prizes for the winners.
course_highlights: Mostly asphalt surface, with sections on cobblestones, concrete paving and a compacted path
The 5 km and 10 km races follow the same course; the 10 km race is run twice
Children’s courses in the chateau garden on a compacted path
additional: You can collect your race pack on 9–10 April at the museum information centre on the square, or on race day at Kočárovna from 9:00 to 13:00. A baggage storage area and changing room are available near the start. There is a water station on the course, and water and fruit at the finish. Traffic restrictions in the town centre from 13:45 to approximately 16:00 due to the closure of the bridge and streets. The team race requires at least 3 runners; the sum of the three best times determines the team’s result. Chateau garden, family programme, children’s races, team races, registration online or at the information centre.

name: Radonický běh
location: Radonické parky Amerika, Radonice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Radonický běh is the 11th edition of a traditional running race for children and adults, held at the Amerika Radonice Park. The main races are 3.5 km and 6.5 km long and run along field and forest paths, with part of the route on a paved road. The children’s courses are marked out within the park, and the race is suitable for a wide range of participants, including families with children. After the race, participants can enjoy refreshments and a Zumba workout. Runners take part at their own risk; minors must be supervised by a parent or guardian.
course_highlights: The main race routes follow field and forest paths, with part of the course on a paved road
The children’s courses are marked out within the park
The race takes place in the picturesque setting of Amerika Radonice Park
additional: Registration opens at 9:00 and closes at 9:40 for children and 11:15 for adults. Children’s categories start from 10:00, according to age. The main races start at 11:30 (canicross), 11:37 (3.5 km), and 11:44 (6.5 km). The entry fee is voluntary. Prizes and medals are awarded to the first three finishers in each category, and all children receive sweets. Tea, fruit, Tatranky bars, and soup are available at the finish. Runners take part at their own risk; minors must be supervised by a parent or guardian. The event includes main courses of 3.5 km and 6.5 km, children’s courses, routes along field and forest paths, registration from 9:00 to 11:15, refreshments at the finish, and activities such as Zumba.

name: Smrt krásných běžců (backyard ultra)
location: Ježkovka, Heřmanův Městec, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: Smrt krásných běžců is a backyard ultra run held at Ježkovka in Heřmanův Městec. The event is accessible to wheelchair users and is organized by Běžecký klub Heřmanův Městec z.s. The race starts on Saturday, April 11, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. This race offers a unique running experience in the beautiful surroundings of Eastern Bohemia.
course_highlights: Backyard ultra format
Venue at Ježkovka in Heřmanův Městec
Accessible to wheelchair users
additional: Nearby accommodation is available at Dům dětí a mládeže Ježkovka and Autokempink Konopáč in Heřmanův Městec. The terrain is not specified; the event is suitable for the general public, including wheelchair users. Accommodation is also available nearby at Hotel Eden and Hotel Marina Heřmanův Městec.

name: Benefiční rodinný běh
location: Pastva Malý Újezd, Malý Újezd, Czech Republic
description: The II Charity Family Run is a charity running event held in Malý Újezd on April 11, 2026. The event is aimed at families and offers an opportunity to spend an active afternoon in the pleasant surroundings of Pastva Malý Újezd. The start is at 13:00, and the event lasts approximately 5 hours. This is the second edition of a successful event that supports a good cause and brings the community together.
course_highlights: Takes place at Pastva Malý Újezd
Family atmosphere and charitable purpose
Approximately 5-hour event with a fun run
additional: The event lasts 5 hours and is intended for families. It takes place at Pastva Malý Újezd. This is the second edition of the charity run. The event is charitable and outdoors, suitable for families and children, supports athletes with disabilities, and includes an accompanying program.

name: ČEZ RunTour Hradec Králové
location: Malšovická aréna, Hradec Králové, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
distance_verbose: Maraton, Půlmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: ČEZ RunTour Hradec Králové is a family-friendly running event offering races for all ages, from children to adults. The event takes place at Malšovická Arena and features 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km races, as well as children’s races of 500 and 1,000 metres. It is known for its friendly atmosphere, high-quality facilities and activities for the whole family. Every participant receives a race pack, and the event supports charity. The race is suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike.
course_highlights: 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km routes at Malšovická Arena
Children’s races of 500 and 1,000 metres, with age-based categories
Refreshment stations on the course and a race pack for every runner
additional: Medical and pacer teams are provided at the event, along with a dedicated emergency-services phone line during the race, refreshments at the finish and on the course, a supervised children’s corner, a race pack with gifts from partners, and an entertaining programme for the whole family. 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km routes; children’s races of 500 and 1,000 m; entertainment programme, charitable contributions, refreshments, medals, photos, showers, massages

name: Běh cyklostezkou
location: Světlá nad Sázavou, Vysočina Region, Czech Republic
organizer: AZ tým ve spolupráci se Sportovním zařízením města s.r.o. ve Světlé nad Sázavou

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 150 Kč při online registraci a uhrazení startovného

description: Běh cyklostezkou is a traditional race held in Světlá nad Sázavou. The main race covers 5.2 km along the Sázava River on the cycle path to the corn mill in Mrzkovice and back. Runners compete in categories by age and gender, including a special category for married couples. Separate children’s races are held over different distances for various age groups. Participants can look forward to chip timing, commemorative medals, prizes for the top finishers, and refreshments at the finish and in the venue’s snack bar. In bad weather, sheltered facilities are available in the indoor tennis hall.
course_highlights: 5.2 km route along the Sázava River on the cycle path
Route to the corn mill in Mrzkovice and back
Chip timing
additional: Registration for the main race: 12:00–14:30; registration for the children’s races: 12:00–12:30; children’s races start at 13:00. Light refreshments are available at the finish, with further refreshments available at the venue’s snack bar. In bad weather, facilities are available in the indoor tennis hall. New: a prize for breaking the course record, by gender. Raffle for participants in the main race. The race takes place on the cycle path along the Sázava River and includes children’s categories, medals, prizes, and refreshments. The event is suitable for all age groups and has indoor facilities in case of bad weather.

name: Běh vítězství, Hranická dvacítka a Hranická desítka
description: Běh vítězství, Hranická dvacítka and Hranická desítka are traditional running races organized by SK Hranice in Hranice near Olomouc. In 2026, the 57th edition of Běh vítězství, the 53rd edition of Hranická dvacítka and the 10th edition of Hranická desítka will take place. The races offer distances from 100 to 500 metres on the stadium track, as well as longer off-road routes, including forest paths. The event is suitable for the general public, including children and young people, and is part of the region’s athletics tradition.
course_highlights: Races from 100 to 500 m take place on the stadium track
Hranická dvacítka follows forest paths with elevation changes
A combination of stadium and off-road routes around Hranice
additional: The races are part of the SK Hranice and Czech Athletics Federation athletics calendars. Photos from previous editions are available online. The races take place on Saturday, 11 April 2026. Children’s categories have their own training and race schedules. The races include various categories, from children to adults; registration is available on the website. The event is part of a regional running series and also offers trail routes.

name: Velká Morava
description: Great Moravia is a multimedia exhibition dedicated to the history of the Great Moravian Empire. It tells visitors the story of Mojslav, an archaeologically identified warrior from the 9th century. The exhibition features life-size historical dioramas depicting key historical moments and the everyday lives of the people of Great Moravia. It also includes an introductory film, an electronic guide, computer animations, and 3D models of reconstructed buildings. Texts and audio guides are available in several languages, and the exhibition is adapted for visitors who are blind or partially sighted.
course_highlights: Historical dioramas with life-size figures
3D models of reconstructed churches and the fortifications of Veligrad
Audio guides and texts in Czech, English, German, and Russian
additional: The recommended time to visit the exhibition is 60 minutes. The exhibition is adapted for visitors who are blind or partially sighted. The virtual guide is also available in Russian. The event focuses on education and promoting the history of Great Moravia, and is suitable for the general public and schools.

name: Jarní bahno - Goethovka
location: Goethova vyhlídka, Karlovy Vary, Karlovarský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Jarní Bahno is a traditional and iconic series of XC races in Karlovy Vary, celebrating its 25th edition in 2026. The series comprises four races in mountain biking, running and canicross, with the final Goethovka race offering a fast, dynamic course around Goethova vyhlídka. The races are suitable for all ages and ability levels, with an emphasis on a friendly atmosphere and bringing sports enthusiasts together after the winter break. The organizer is A.M.bike, which also organizes the region’s largest cycling event, the Karlovy Vary AM Bikemarathon.
course_highlights: A fast, dynamic 5.8 km course near Goethova vyhlídka, with 240 m of elevation gain
Four races in the series, on varied terrain ranging from hilly to rugged
Races in mountain biking, running and canicross
additional: MTB starts take place in three waves between 12:00 and 12:15; the fourth race is an individual time trial with interval starts from 12:00. Free bottled water and hot tea are available at every race, with refreshments at selected locations. A timing chip is lent to participants at check-in; a 500 Kč fine applies if it is not returned. The organizer reserves the right to change the program and conditions. Participants consent to photographs and videos being taken during the race. The race is part of a series featuring four disciplines—mountain biking, running and canicross. Registration and details are available on the website. Medals and certificates are awarded to the best finishers.

name: Jarní rozBěh
location: Husinec - Řež, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Jarní rozBěh is a cross-country and trail race taking place on April 11, 2026, in the picturesque surroundings of the municipalities of Husinec and Řež in the Central Bohemian Region. The race offers three distances of 11.4 km, 7.4 km and 5.7 km, running through natural surroundings and suitable for runners of all ability levels. The organizer is the Municipality of Husinec - Řež, which invites all runners to enjoy the race regardless of fitness level. The event is part of the Czech Running Club and the Czech Athletics Federation, ensuring high-quality organization and atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail routes
Distances of 11.4 km, 7.4 km and 5.7 km
Picturesque surroundings of the municipalities of Husinec and Řež
additional: The race is open to everyone, regardless of fitness level. It is organized by the Municipality of Husinec - Řež. The event is part of the Czech Running Club and the Czech Athletics Federation. It focuses on fun, promoting an active lifestyle and community cohesion. Participants will receive medals, and local volunteers and the fire brigade will take part.

name: Štěpánovský trhák
location: U Dub, Trhový Štěpánov, Czech Republic
description: Štěpánovský trhák is a traditional running race taking place for the eleventh time in 2026. After a one-year break, the race is moving to a new venue at U Dubu in Trhový Štěpánov, where runners can enjoy a new course through the forest, along forest paths and partly on a cycle path. The event offers the atmosphere of a friendly sporting get-together, with children’s and main races. The start and event facilities are situated to support participants’ comfort and safety.
course_highlights: New course at U Dubu
The route runs through the forest, along forest paths and partly on a cycle path
Mostly natural terrain with gentle elevation changes
additional: Registration for the main race is available online and on site on race day from 12:30. The children’s races start at 13:40, and the main race at 15:00. Parking is available on Lesní and Lipová streets and nearby streets; the event facilities are in an area where cars are not permitted. The main race awards ceremony is planned for approximately 16:00. The event includes a 7 km main course, children’s categories and a charity walk. Registration is available online and on site, and the event is part of the Běžec Podblanicka series.

name: Peršlácký kros
location: Fabián - Homolka, Nový Vojířov, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Peršlácký kros is a running race open to the general public and suitable for all ability and age groups. The race takes place in the Fabián - Homolka Nature Reserve, by Novomlýnský Pond below Lesní hotel Peršlák in Nový Vojířov. The 10 km route is gently undulating and follows asphalt and forest paths; it is well marked. After the race, refreshments are available for participants, along with a tent near the start and finish where they can change. The race offers medals and prizes for the top runners and is supported by local sponsors.
course_highlights: The route passes around the Fabián - Homolka Nature Reserve
Route length: 10 km; gently undulating
Course surface: 60% asphalt, 40% forest paths
additional: Registration is also available on race day, no later than one hour before the start. Race-number pickup from 9:00. Children’s races start at 10:00, with the children’s awards ceremony at 11:30 and the main race awards ceremony at 13:30. Parking is about 1 km from the start, in a meadow; arriving early is recommended. A tent is available for changing and for supervised storage of belongings. Refreshments are available after the finish, and lunch is available at the restaurant at Lesní hotel Peršlák. A trail race with refreshments and facilities for runners; online and on-site registration; limited parking about 1 km from the start.

name: Jarní běh Plzeň
description: Jarní běh Plzeň is a friendly cross-country and trail race held in the beautiful surroundings of Homolka Park in Plzeň. It offers 6 km and 2 km courses, as well as a relay race, making it suitable for a wide range of participants, including children and adults. The event is known for its joyful atmosphere and support for sporting achievement. Registration is available online and on site, making it easy for everyone to take part.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail-style courses
Course distances of 6 km and 2 km, plus a relay
Homolka Park in Plzeň
additional: Registration is available online and on site. The race is part of the Czech Running Club. Categories include children, adults, and relays. The event includes children's races starting at 300 m and a 6 km main race, and features family activities and a sporting atmosphere in the outdoors.

name: Jarní stodůlecký kros
description: The Spring Stodůlky Cross is a challenging, single-loop cross-country race that takes runners to various parts of Prague 13. The course passes through the Stodůlky housing estate, Central Park and the rocky areas above Prokop Valley. The race offers medals and certificates to the top three finishers in each category, and prizes to the fastest runners. After the race, all participants can enjoy tea, a sweet treat and the friendly atmosphere of a small race.
course_highlights: Single-loop cross-country race in Prague 13-Stodůlky
The course passes through the housing estate, Central Park and the rocky areas above Prokop Valley
Challenging terrain with varied surfaces
additional: The top three finishers in each category receive a medal and certificate; the fastest runners receive prizes. Tea and a small sweet treat are provided for all participants. The organizer is TJ Stodůlky Praha; contact: Martin Žežulka. The varied course includes urban and trail sections. Registration takes place online. The race is suitable for the general public.

name: 57. Běh vítězství, 53. Hranická dvacítka a 10. Hranická desítka
location: Areál DDM Ježkovka, Heřmanův Městec, Czech Republic
description: Běh vítězství, Hranická dvacítka, and Hranická desítka are traditional running races organized by SK Hranice, held at the DDM Ježkovka complex in Heřmanův Městec. The races offer a range of distances, from short children’s runs on the stadium track to longer off-road courses. The event is open to the general public and offers a sporting experience in a pleasant setting, with a history spanning several decades. The races take place on Saturday, April 11, 2026, and are popular with runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Races from 100 to 500 m take place on the stadium track
The Hranická dvacítka and Hranická desítka routes run partly along forest trails
The courses feature varying elevation (see the attached profiles)
additional: The races have a long tradition (the 57th edition of Běh vítězství, the 53rd edition of Hranická dvacítka, and the 10th edition of Hranická desítka). Photos from previous editions are available online. The routes are shown in detail in the attached maps and profiles. The races are part of SK Hranice’s broader athletics program. They are organized as part of a sports day, with advance registration available, and are suitable for the general public as well as experienced runners.
