name: Jarný beh Bojničky
price_range: 10 € online, 12 € na mieste, deti a dorast zdarma

price_tiers.distance: všetky kategórie okrem detí a dorastu

description: The Bojničky Village Spring Run is a traditional running race organized by Atletický klub Bojničky and the municipality of Bojničky. The race takes place in Bojničky in front of the Cultural Centre and is part of the Nitra Running League 2026. Children, juniors, adults and Nordic Walking participants can compete, with categories based on age and gender. A new feature is a competition for three-person men’s and women’s teams in the 5000 m Nordic Walking event. Starts are scheduled by category from 9:45 to 12:15.
course_highlights: The race takes place in front of the Cultural Centre in Bojničky
Competition for three-person teams in the 5000 m Nordic Walking event (5.2 km)
Categories for children, juniors, adults and Nordic Walking
additional: Race starts are divided among several categories: 9:45 — Bojničky residents’ run; 10:10 — children’s categories; 11:20 — Nordic Walking; from 12:15 — adults. The races are part of the Nitra Running League 2026. The course is on asphalt. Online registration is available until 9 April 2026. Maps and details about the categories are available on the official website.

name: Timravine Ostrôžky Trail
description: Timrava’s Ostrôžky Trail is a mountain running race in Divín, offering two challenging courses with beautiful views and significant elevation gain. The race is organized by OZ Ostrôžky and is suitable for runners looking for a challenge in nature. The Ostrôšky Ultra course is 47 km long with 2,000 m of elevation gain, while the shorter Langoš Trail is 27 km long with 950 m of elevation gain. The race starts in two waves: the longer course starts at 7:30 and the shorter one at 9:00.
course_highlights: Ostrôšky Ultra: 47 km with 2,000 m of elevation gain
Langoš Trail: 27 km with 950 m of elevation gain
Mountain trails with beautiful views around Divín
additional: The race starts in two waves: the 47 km course starts at 7:30, and the 27 km course at 9:00. The organizers are Lukáš Krnáč and OZ Ostrôžky. Entry fees depend on the registration period, with the highest price charged on site. Trail races with various categories, online registration, and start times at 07:30 and 09:00. The 2026 event will be held for the second time, following its first edition in 2025.

name: Beh oslobodenia Kálnice
description: The Kálnica Liberation Run is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Kálnica in honor of the Romanian soldiers who fell during the liberation of the village. The race follows a route from Kálnica to Rakoľuby and back, with different distances for different age categories. The course is paved, flat, with a slight elevation gain and some turns. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, who may run accompanied by an adult. The race starts by the Cultural Center in Kálnica.
course_highlights: Route: Kálnica – Rakoľuby – Kálnica
Race distances: 1,500 m, 5,500 m, and 11,000 m
Paved course with a slight elevation gain of 36 m
additional: Online registration closes on 10.4.2025 at 23:55 or when the participant limit is reached. After this deadline, on-site registration is possible on race day if the limit has not been reached. Entry fees are non-refundable, but can be transferred to another person through an account on vysledkovyservis.sk or, for a handling fee of €4, without an account. The course is paved and flat, with a slight elevation gain; online registration is available until 10.4.2025; the entry fee includes refreshments and a raffle; the race takes place on 11 April 2026.

name: Zvolenská Corrida
location: Námestie SNP, Zvolen, Banskobystrický kraj, Slovakia
organizer: Mesto Zvolen, Mišo s. r. o.
description: Zvolenská Corrida is a running event held in the pedestrian zone of SNP Square in Zvolen. Runners complete five flat 1 km laps, for a total distance of 5 km. The event also includes children’s races and a fun run for parents and children, both free of charge. It is part of the Zvolen Running League and offers professional event organization and timing.
course_highlights: A 1,000 m lap in the pedestrian zone of SNP Square
Flat course, suitable for all age groups
Five laps in total, or 5 km for the main race
additional: Children’s races are free of charge, with age-group categories over distances of 50 m, 250 m and 500 m. Mama/Oco Corrida is a free 1 km run for parents and children. Registration for the main race is online and limited to 200 participants. Registration for the children’s races and Mama/Oco Corrida is available on site from 9:00. The schedule includes check-in, children’s races at 10:00, Mama/Oco Corrida at 10:30, the main race at 11:00 and the awards ceremony with a raffle at 12:00. The event features the 5 km main race, children’s races and family races. Registration is online or on site. Medals are awarded to the first 170 participants. The main race starts at around 11:00.

name: Furčiansky maratón – Memoriál Štefana Semana
description: The Furčiansky Marathon - Štefan Seman Memorial is a traditional running marathon organized by O5 Bežecký klub Furča Košice. This 23rd edition will take place on April 11, 2026, in Košice, offering runners the opportunity to test themselves on a certified course. The marathon is known for its community atmosphere and support for running activities in the region. The organizers welcome all runners who want to experience a high-quality, well-organized marathon.
course_highlights: marathon and relay categories
a traditional event with a long history
location in Košice with a great atmosphere
additional: Online results will be available from 10:00 on race day. Registration for the Furčiansky Marathon 2026 is closed. The organizer is O5 Bežecký klub Furča Košice. The event includes a marathon, an extreme marathon, and relay races, with various age categories and registration fees. It also commemorates Štefan Seman and supports the running community.

name: Jarný beh Michalovčanov
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, Atletický klub Michalovce, Stredná odborná škola technická
price_range: 2 € dospelí, 1 € mládež do 18 rokov, 0 € muži nad 70 rokov a ženy nad 60 rokov
description: The Jarný beh Michalovčanov is a traditional running race taking place on Saturday, April 11, 2026, in Michalovce, at the V. ZŠ on Školská Street. Competitors can look forward to races in various age categories, including a 400-metre race for children under 9. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant spring sports-day atmosphere, with results announced and medalists awarded.
course_highlights: Start and finish at V. ZŠ, Školská 2, Michalovce
Running courses for various age categories
Short 400 m race for children under 9
additional: The event programme includes the 400 m race start at 9:30 for boys’ and girls’ categories under 9, followed by the announcement of results and awards for medalists at 10:30. The children’s race starts at 10:00 and the main race at 10:15; the entry fee covers various age categories. Venue: Michalovce, V. ZŠ, ŠKOLSKÁ 2.

name: Běh lipovou alejí – Nymburská desítka
location: Nymburk, Nymburk District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run Along the Lime Tree Avenue is a traditional road race in Nymburk, now being held for the 31st year. The race features a 10 km loop course, run mainly on asphalt paths on Tyrš Island and on the synthetic-surface athletics track. It is suitable for the general public, including children and young people, for whom shorter distances are available. The atmosphere is friendly and sporty, with an emphasis on a quality course and good organization.
course_highlights: A 10 km loop course with a predominantly asphalt surface
The opening and closing 1,800 m sections are on the synthetic-surface athletics track
The route runs past the Elbe, the Sports Centre and Tyrš Island
additional: Children’s and youth categories can register only on race day, no later than 30 minutes before the start of their respective category. The men’s and women’s 10 km main race starts at 11:15. The course is measured according to IAAF/AIMS rules and meets their standards. Running segments are also available on Garmin and Strava for individual training. The event includes the 10 km main race, children’s categories and awards for the top runners. The start is on the tartan track; the course includes three asphalt loops and finishes with the final 800 metres on the tartan track.

name: Horské běhy v Novohradských horách
location: Hojná Voda, Novohradské hory, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic

price_tiers.distance: Easy – Běh Pro Paměť národa 2,2 km

description: Mountain Runs in the Novohradské Mountains are traditional spring races held amid the beautiful scenery of the Novohradské Mountains, with their hub at Hojná Voda. They offer a range of courses, from children’s categories and shorter runs to a challenging 63 km ultra trail with 2,050 m of elevation gain. The races are open to men, women and canicross participants, offering a sporting experience in nature and a chance to discover the beauty of the Novohradské Mountains. They are organized by Martin Brožka and the Sportcentrum Novohradské hory team, who prepare detailed maps and facilities for runners.
course_highlights: Ultra trail: 63 km with 2,050 m of elevation gain
Classic course: 19 km with 660 m of elevation gain
Zážitek: 12.4 km with 430 m of elevation gain
additional: Race-day registration is also available at Hojná Voda – U Lípy from 9:30 to 10:30 for children and from 12:00 to 13:45 for the other categories. Detailed course maps are available in the Mountain Runs Course section and in printed form at the start. A closing prize draw with valuable prizes is planned for participants, including accommodation in the Alps and a subscription to the Svět běhu magazine. Course maps, online registration, prize draw, accommodation options nearby, weather usually around 19°C

name: Kyfův Jarní běh
location: Hrušov, Senohraby, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Kyfův Spring Run is a traditional running race organised by TJ Sokol Senohraby, held in a meadow below the former ski jump in Hrušov. The race is part of the Ladův kraj Cup and offers a springtime sporting experience on courses that include crossing a stream. Participants can also enjoy a mobile café serving hot drinks. The courses are known for their natural challenges and an atmosphere that attracts runners of all ages.
course_highlights: A 1.8 km course with stream crossings for younger pupils
Meadow below the former ski jump in Hrušov
Natural surface with some uneven patches caused by wildlife
additional: The race is part of the Ladův kraj Cup. The 1.8 km course includes a stream crossing, so bringing a change of shoes is recommended. A mobile café serving coffee and hot chocolate will be available. The courses are marked and maintained by hand, but the meadow below the ski jump is bumpy due to wild boar activity. The race takes place on 12 April 2026. The course includes forest and cross-country sections. Advance registration is recommended. The entry fee is often donated to charity, and the event is part of local community activities.

name: Kros Sázava
location: Pikovice u fotbalového hřiště, Příbramsko, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Kros Sázava is a cross-country running race in Pikovice, near the football field in the Příbram District, offering three routes of varying lengths and elevation gains. The long route is 15.5 km with approximately 500 m of elevation gain, the medium route is 10 km with approximately 230 m, and the hobby route is 5 km with 120 m. All courses run entirely over natural terrain, offering beautiful and challenging running experiences. The race is suitable for runners of different levels who want to enjoy cross-country running in the picturesque landscape of the Central Bohemian Region.
course_highlights: Long route: 15.5 km with approximately 500 m of elevation gain
Medium route: 10 km with approximately 230 m of elevation gain
Hobby route: 5 km with 120 m of elevation gain
additional: The course is technically challenging, with forest trails and natural obstacles; the race takes place on 12 April 2026.

name: Žďárská 10
location: Žďár nad Sázavou, Žďárské vrchy, Czech Republic
description: Žďárská 10 is a fast 10 km road race that opens the spring season in the heart of the Žďár Hills. The route starts in the centre of Žďár nad Sázavou and follows cycle paths to the far end of Pilská Reservoir and back, offering beautiful scenery and minimal elevation gain. The course is accurately measured and the race has a mass start, ensuring a fair and competitive atmosphere. It is organised by Sportovní klub Žďárák z.s. and counts towards the 2025 Ranking.
course_highlights: Road course with minimal elevation gain
Follows an asphalt cycle path around Pilská Reservoir
A short 200 m section along Dvorská Street, with light traffic
additional: Registration is also available on race day from 9:45 to 10:45 at the start area behind the House of Culture. Parking is available at the Municipal Office and in the surrounding areas. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:30. Children's races are organised separately; advance registration is required via a form. The race takes place on a measured course; registration is available online and on site; start at 11:00; results at 12:30; children can take part in accompanying races.

name: Jarní běh zámeckým parkem v Krásném dvoře
location: Krásný Dvůr, Karlovy Vary, Czech Republic
description: The Spring Run through the Chateau Park “Memorial Jaroslav Štůla” is a traditional running race held in the beautiful setting of the chateau park by Krásný Dvůr State Chateau. The race is open to all age groups, from the youngest beginner runners to adults, and offers 19 different categories. The course follows natural paths through the park’s rolling terrain, making for an enjoyable and interesting running experience. Refreshments are available, and the top finishers in each category receive prizes.
course_highlights: The course follows natural paths through the rolling terrain of the chateau park
Start and finish in the courtyard of Krásný Dvůr State Chateau
The race offers 19 different categories for all age groups
additional: The race starts and finishes in the courtyard of the state chateau. Entries can be submitted using the registration form until 10.04.2026 at 12:00. Refreshments are available for runners. Full admission is 20 Kč. The course follows natural paths through the park’s rolling terrain; the race is suitable for all age groups, refreshments are provided, registration is open until 10.04.2026, and the start is at 9:15.

name: Lahofer run
location: Suchohrdly u Znojma, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 150 Kč pro hlavní závod, 50 Kč pro děti
description: Lahofer Run is the first edition of a running race in the Znojmo Running Cup, starting from the grounds of the new LAHOFER Winery building in Dobšice. The approximately 8 km course runs around local vineyards and combines 80% forest and paved paths with 20% asphalt. Spectators can watch runners finish from the winery’s distinctive roof, with views of the surrounding area. A children’s race will also take place before the main race.
course_highlights: Approximately 8 km course around the vineyards
80% forest and paved paths, 20% asphalt
Start and finish at the same location, with views from the winery roof
additional: Parking is available at the LAHOFER Winery grounds. The children’s race will take place before the main race starts. The race is held on April 12, 2026. Routes include 3, 6, and 9 km, and children can also take part in races. The race course includes both asphalt and forest paths.

name: Korunou za korunu
location: Nové Město na Moravě, Vysočina, Czech Republic
organizer: TJ Nové Město na Moravě z.s.
description: Korunou za korunu is a short cross-country race around the dam of Cihelský Pond in Nové Město na Moravě. The race is suitable for runners who prefer off-road running and may also use spikes. It is organised by TJ Nové Město na Moravě z.s. and is part of the Czech Athletic Federation’s running activities. The main category starts at 11:20, and the race offers a pleasant atmosphere in the beautiful Vysočina region.
course_highlights: A short cross-country race around Cihelský Pond
Spikes may be used
Off-road course in the Vysočina region
additional: The first category starts at 9:30 and the main category at 11:20. Organiser: TJ Nové Město na Moravě z.s.; contact: Petr Hubáček, tel. 776 046 260. The race is a cross-country/trail event held on the dam of Cihelský Pond. It takes place on 12 April 2026. The course is 3.2 km for men and 1.6 km for women and runs around Cihelský Pond. Registration is available online or on site.

name: Jarní běh zámeckým parkem
location: Krásný Dvůr, zámecký park, Czech Republic
description: The Spring Run through the Chateau Park “Memorial Jaroslav Štůla” is a traditional running race held in the beautiful setting of the chateau park in Krásný Dvůr. The race is open to all age groups, from the youngest beginners to adults, and offers 19 different categories. The course follows natural paths through the park’s undulating terrain, making for an enjoyable and interesting running experience. The start and finish are in the courtyard of the state chateau, where refreshments are available and prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each category.
course_highlights: The course follows natural paths through the chateau park
The park’s undulating terrain makes for an interesting run
Start and finish in the courtyard of the state chateau
additional: The race offers 19 different categories for all age groups. The start and finish are in the courtyard of Krásný Dvůr State Chateau. Entries can be submitted via the registration form until 10.04.2026 at 12:00. Refreshments are available for participants. Admission to the event is 20 Kč. Course distances: 6,541 m, 4,082 m, 3,136 m; park routes on flat terrain; various age categories; online and on-site registration; refreshments and prizes for winners

name: Jaroměřský kros
description: Jaroměř Cross-Country is a cross-country race held in the unique setting of the fortress and its underground passages in Jaroměř-Josefov. The race takes place on April 12, 2026, and features a varied course profile with rolling terrain, hills, and unobstructed grassy sections. The start is beneath the fortress walls, lending the race the magical atmosphere of a Theresian fortress. Runners of all ages, from children to seniors, take part. The race is organized under athletics rules and uses chip timing.
course_highlights: Unique setting among the fortress and underground passages
Varied course profile with rolling terrain and hills
Start beneath the fortress walls, with a magical atmosphere
additional: Registration and chip pickup begin at 9:00; registration closes 30 minutes before each category’s start. The timing chip is attached to the shoe, and the race number is worn on the chest. Changing facilities are available in tents by the race office. Refreshments and medical services provided by the Czech Red Cross in Jaroměř are available. Parking is available in the car park or along the road. Accommodation can be arranged through TJ Sokol Jaroměř or found among the options in Jaroměř and the surrounding area. Terrain, online registration until April 8, 2026

name: Přespolní běh Cvikováčku
location: Cvikov, Liberec District, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: The Cvikováček Cross-Country Run is a traditional running event organized by the Cvikováček Children and Youth Center in Cvikov. The run takes place on Sunday, April 12, 2026, and is open to the general public, including children and young people. The event offers an opportunity to enjoy sport in the pleasant surroundings of the Cvikov region and encourages active leisure time. The start list and results are available online, and registration is handled through a dedicated registration system.
course_highlights: The course runs mainly along forest paths
Part of a regional running league
Available distances: 9.1 km and 2.7 km
additional: The start list and results are available online at irontime.cz. Registration is possible via the online form at irontime.cz. The event is part of the activities of the Cvikováček Children and Youth Center, which also offers other leisure clubs and events in the region. The race is part of the Okresní běžecká liga Českolipsko running series, and registration is possible through the organizer’s website.

name: Běh u Chlumce

description: We invite you to the 2nd edition of NaPOLEon run, a race for the whole family, held in a meadow by the pear orchard in Chlumec. Routes of varying lengths and difficulty will take you through the beautiful Chlumecko countryside. You can register in advance by email or on site on race day. The entry fee is a symbolic 50 CZK for adults, making the event accessible to all runners and families with children.
course_highlights: Routes of varying lengths: 500 m, 1 km, 5 km and 10 km (2 x 5 km loop)
Beautiful Chlumecko countryside
Start and finish under a shelter in the meadow by the pear orchard
additional: You can also register on site on race day from 9:00 to 10:00. The start and finish are under a shelter in the meadow by the pear orchard in Chlumec. Routes range from 500 m to 10 km. Registration is by email or on site. The event takes place in the meadow by the pear orchard in Chlumec.

name: Kysucká desiatka
organizer: Mestské kulturno-športové stredisko Kysucké Nové Mesto
description: Kysucká desiatka is a running race in Kysucké Nové Mesto, offering courses for various age groups, including children and adults. The race starts in the western part of Murgašova Street. Participants can compete in a 1 km race for children or a 10 km race for adults and juniors. The event is organized by the Municipal Cultural and Sports Centre of Kysucké Nové Mesto and offers categories by age and gender. The children’s race starts at 10:05 and the other categories at 10:30. The race is suitable for a broad running community and supports sport in the region.
course_highlights: The course runs through the western part of Murgašova Street in Kysucké Nové Mesto
Categories include a 1 km race for children and a 10 km race for adults
Categories are divided by age and gender, including junior men and junior women
additional: The children’s race starts at 10:05, and the men’s, women’s, junior men’s and junior women’s races start at 10:30. The event is organized by the Municipal Cultural and Sports Centre of Kysucké Nové Mesto. Contact: Renáta Kováčiková, tel.: 0902 405 190. The 10 km race starts in the western part of Murgašova Street. The event includes categories for children, juniors, men and women, with starts from 10:05 to 10:30. The course runs along the streets of Kysucké Nové Mesto; registration is available online or on site.

name: Majstrovstvá SR v maratóne mužov a žien, veteránov a veteránok (ČSOB Bratislava maratón 2026) (4.kolo BP SAZ)
description: The Slovak Republic Championships in the men’s and women’s marathon, including masters, are a major athletics event taking place in Bratislava. Competitors can look forward to a well-prepared course and professional organization under the auspices of the Slovak Athletic Federation. The event is part of a race series and offers the opportunity to compete in various categories, including masters. Registration is online and open to the wider running community.
course_highlights: A city-style marathon course in Bratislava
Races for men, women and masters in various categories
Organized under the auspices of the Slovak Athletic Federation
additional: Registration is online and must be completed by 12:00 on 7 April 2026. Team leaders will collect race bibs at check-in at the race office. Warm-ups are permitted outside the competition course. Changing facilities are available for boys and girls. Official results will be published on the Slovak Athletic Federation website. The event is part of the ČSOB Bratislava Marathon 2026 and is open to all age groups, including masters.
sources: http://statistika.atletika.sk/admin/media/propozice/MAJSTROVSTVA SR v maratone - propozicie_12.4.2026, Bratislava akt..pdf

name: Trenčianská bežecká liga – 2. kolo
description: The Trenčín Running League is a series of nine running events organized around Trenčín since 2015, open to the general public, including competitive runners and enthusiasts. One race takes place each month from March to November on a different, varied and interesting course. The races offer a friendly atmosphere, motivation, and the chance to meet people who support a healthy lifestyle. The results and points awarded after each race provide motivation for further training and improving performance.
course_highlights: An 8.95 km course with 130 m of elevation gain in Trenčianske Stankovce, mostly off-road, with 20% asphalt
The routes follow dirt roads, the embankment around a pond, village roads, and hills
Start and finish at the football field in Trenčianske Stankovce
additional: Check-in and registration take place on site from 9:00. The entry fee is paid on site. Runners can make a voluntary contribution to the Joint Boarding School in Trenčín. Running with a dog is allowed, but a runner with a dog receives 1 participation point, with no points awarded according to finishing place. The league race takes place at the football field in Trenčianske Stankovce. The event supports the community and a healthy lifestyle and is suitable for all ages and running levels.

name: Šrégom nočným Zvolenom
organizer: Technická univerzita vo Zvolene, WoodenWorld, Cyklo Zvolen o.z., Mesto Zvolen
description: Šrégom Night Run in Zvolen is a night race organized by the Woodenworld student organization at the Technical University in Zvolen and the City of Zvolen. Runners complete a 7 km course with 40 meters of elevation gain through the city of Zvolen, passing notable places such as Zvolen Castle, SNP Square, and the Hron River. The event offers electronic timekeeping, refreshments, prizes for place winners, and a commemorative item. The race starts at 20:30 in front of the Technical University and is suitable for the general public, including university students and staff.
course_highlights: A 7 km course with 40 m of elevation gain through the city of Zvolen
Passes Zvolen Castle and SNP Square
The route runs along the Hron River and finishes at the Technical University
additional: Online registration until 13.4.2026 costs €12; registration on race day from 18:30 to 20:00 costs €15. The entry fee includes a race bib, electronic timekeeping, refreshments, prizes, and a commemorative item. Competitors under 18 may take part with the consent of a legal guardian. Staff and students of TU Zvolen can enter the club name "Technical University" to be included in the ranking of the best TU runners. The race takes place at night, with a route passing notable landmarks in Zvolen. Registration is available online or on site. Men’s and women’s categories compete across different age groups.

name: Malá cena Kunětické devítky Duben 2
location: Kunětická hora, Ráby, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.label: tier_2

description: Kunětická Devítka is a traditional Wednesday cross-country race around Kunětická Mountain, offering two routes: a short 4.5 km loop suitable for everyone and a 9 km loop for more experienced runners. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere, bringing together runners of all levels, and emphasizes enjoying the race rather than focusing on time. The course features varied surfaces, long straight sections, narrow trails, and a challenging climb up the steps to Kunětická Mountain. It is the largest weekday running event in the Pardubice Region and is part of a series of Wednesday races.
course_highlights: Short 4.5 km loop suitable for all runners
Long 9 km loop with varied terrain, narrow trails, and a climb up the steps to Kunětická Mountain
Start and finish by the parking lot at the Staročeská hospoda below Kunětická Mountain
additional: Registration takes place at the finish area from 17:00 to 17:50 from April to August. The race is held in all weather unless safety is at risk. An electrolyte drink is available after the race. Results are not announced at the venue but are published on the website within 24 hours. A race number for the entire series can be purchased for 50 Kč as a one-time fee at the first race of the year. Cross-country running courses, with on-site registration available; a race series with scoring and categories for different age groups.

name: Bratrušovské vrchy
description: Bratrušov Hills is a cross-country race organized by volunteer firefighters in Bratrušov and is part of the Chlapácký běh series. The race offers a challenging course of approximately 10.7 km with 418 m of elevation gain, starting at the football pitch in Bratrušov. Children can take part in a shorter 2 km course with 80 m of elevation gain. The race is suitable for runners looking for a hilly off-road challenge.
course_highlights: 10.7 km course with 418 m of elevation gain
Children’s 2 km course with 80 m of elevation gain
Start at the football pitch in Bratrušov
additional: The race is part of the Chlapácký běh series. It is organized by the Bratrušov Volunteer Fire Brigade. In 2025, the race took place on April 16 at 17:00. The race takes place on April 15, 2026, as part of the Chlapácký běh series; results are available on the organizer’s website.

name: Zbraslavská pila VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
description: Zbraslavská pila VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 is a mountain cross-country race in Prague-Zbraslav, offering a tough challenge with 500 metres of elevation gain over a 7 km course. During the race, participants face three demanding climbs and descents that test their strength and endurance. The race starts at 18:00 by Praha-Zbraslav railway station and is suitable for runners looking for an intense trail experience in an urban setting with natural features. It is organised by VAŠE LIGA, led by Petr Lundák.
course_highlights: 7 km mountain cross-country/trail race
500 metres of elevation gain
Three demanding climbs and descents
additional: The race is a mountain cross-country/trail event with significant elevation gain and demanding sections. It is organised by VAŠE LIGA; the contact person is Petr Lundák. The race starts by Praha-Zbraslav railway station. It is part of the VAŠÍ LIGY series. The course is intended for trail runners, and online registration is available. The start and finish are by Praha-Zbraslav railway station. The race is part of a mountain running series and offers a challenge as well as beautiful natural scenery.

name: Jarní běh Olympu
description: The Spring Olymp Run is a traditional cross-country and trail race held in the beautiful surroundings of Stromovka Park in Prague 7, on the grounds of OLYMP CSMV. It offers three different course distances (5.5 km, 4.4 km and 3.3 km), which run through natural surroundings and suit runners of different abilities. The race is organised by PSK Olymp Praha and is part of the Czech Athletics Federation’s running community. The main category starts at 18:55, allowing runners to enjoy the race’s evening atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail courses in Stromovka Park
Three course distances: 5.5 km, 4.4 km and 3.3 km
Start and finish on the grounds of OLYMP CSMV in Prague 7
additional: Registration is online only, until midnight on 8 October 2026. The organiser does not accept race-day entries. The first category starts at 16:00; the main category starts at 18:55. The organiser is PSK Olymp Praha, z.s.; contact person: Jindřich Linhart. A run on the grounds of Olymp, with various age categories, online registration until 8 October 2026, course distances of 3.3 km, 4.4 km and 5.5 km. The race is open to the general public.

name: Olomoucká desítka
description: Olomouc Ten is the third edition of a 10 km running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Smetana Gardens in Olomouc. The course follows paved paths, and runners complete three laps of 3.343 km, with the first lap slightly shorter. The race is part of the 2026 Haná Running Cup and offers age categories as well as a recreational run open to all ages. The winners’ ceremony takes place at the Music Pavilion, and runners who place on the podium receive small sweet gifts.
course_highlights: A 3.343 km lap on paved paths through Smetana Gardens
The race is run over 3 laps; the first lap is 28 m shorter
Start and finish by the Music Pavilion in Smetana Gardens
additional: Race-day registration takes place at the venue. Runners must have a chip card with a balance of at least 70 CZK, which will be deducted at registration. Belongings can be left in the start and finish area. The race is run according to road-running rules, and all participants take part at their own risk. The race takes place in April 2026, with information available about registration, prices and rules, and is part of a local running series organized by TJ Liga stovkařů.

name: Herbatka u Tadka, czyli Bieg do Herbacia...
Noční běh pro světlušku Olomouc

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: The Night Run for Světluška in Olomouc is a charity run taking place on 16 April 2026 in Flora Park. The run starts at 21:00, and participants can choose between a 2.5 km course (1 lap) and a 5 km course (2 laps). The entry fee is 500 CZK, half of which covers the event’s costs and half goes towards helping people with severe visual impairments. The event offers an accompanying programme, including a concert, and starter packs with a headlamp or sports headband. Capacity is limited for runners’ safety and comfort.
course_highlights: Course in Flora Park in Olomouc
Choice of 2.5 km or 5 km course
Night run with a headlamp or sports headband
additional: Registration desks open at 19:00. Starter packs are available with either a headlamp or a sports headband. Holders of TP, ZTP and ZTP/P disability cards may attend free of charge with an accompanying person; they can purchase a starter pack on site for 250 CZK. Capacity is limited for participants’ safety and comfort. The accompanying programme includes a concert by Rodan at 20:00. The course is also suitable for a walk. The entry fee supports people with visual impairments. The start is from 19:00 to 20:45, and the accompanying programme runs from 19:30 to 21:00. Starter packs include a headlamp or a sports headband.

name: Kateřinský běh Hrabovou
location: Kostel svaté Kateřiny, Ostrava-Hrabová, Ostrava, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: Cena je při registraci a zaplacení do 15.4.2025
description: All runners are invited to the traditional 18th Kateřinský běh Hrabovou, taking place on 16 April 2026 in Ostrava-Hrabová. The main route passes the historic Church of St. Catherine, giving the race a unique atmosphere. The event offers 5 km and 2.5 km races, children’s races, and a 5 km Nordic Walking event. Participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere, refreshments, and an accompanying program.
course_highlights: The route passes the Church of St. Catherine in Ostrava-Hrabová
Available distances: 5 km and 2.5 km, as well as children’s races and 5 km Nordic Walking
Start and registration at the Ostrava-Hrabová Cultural Centre, Bažanova Street
additional: The maximum number of participants is 400. The race bib includes a chip and must be returned. The entry fee includes a medal for those registered by 13.4.2026, post-race refreshments, changing rooms and toilets, SMS results service, and participation in the Hrabová and Moravian-Silesian Running Cups (for the 5 km race). Recommended transport: DPO buses 27, 41, 39, and 77, stopping at Hrabová, kostelík. Results will be announced at the registration venue within 20 minutes of the race. For safety reasons, headphones are not permitted during the race. Distances: 5 km and 2.5 km running, Nordic Walking, and children’s races (150 m, 300 m, 600 m, and 1,000 m). The course is on asphalt, suitable for all age groups, and promotes a healthy lifestyle.

name: Priateľský nočný beh mestom Vranov
location: Základná škola Sídlisko II., Vranov nad Topľou, Prešov, Slovakia
description: Priateľský nočný beh mestom Vranov is a traditional running event in Vranov nad Topľou, offering a nighttime running experience through the city. The race takes place on the grounds of Sídlisko II Primary School and is open to men, women, and children. The main race starts at 19:30, and the children’s race begins at 17:00. The organizers are OZ S rukou v ruke, Sídlisko II Primary School, the City of Vranov nad Topľou, and OZ Vranovské Vydry, who warmly invite all runners to enjoy a friendly atmosphere and a sporting experience.
course_highlights: Night run through the city of Vranov
Start and finish at Sídlisko II Primary School
Categories for men, women, and children
additional: The children’s race starts at 17:00. On-site entry fee: €20. Night course, online and on-site registration, children’s race, relay races

name: Mistrovství Moravy a Slezska v půlmaratonu + 24. Hanácký půlmaraton
description: The Moravia and Silesia Half Marathon Championships, held alongside the 24th Haná Half Marathon, is a traditional athletics event organized by Atletický klub Olomouc. The race takes place on the athletics track in Olomouc and attracts runners from across Moravia and Silesia, who compete for championship titles. The event is known for its excellent organization and an atmosphere that supports both elite athletes and amateurs. The race starts at 9:00 in the morning and is part of the club’s wider athletics program.
course_highlights: The course follows the athletics track in Olomouc
Part of the Moravia and Silesia Half Marathon Championships
An atmosphere that supports both elite runners and amateurs
additional: The race is part of the club’s wider athletics program, which includes youth categories and para athletics. The organizer is Atletický klub Olomouc, which has a rich tradition and experience organizing athletics events at the home stadium of TJ Lokomotiva Olomouc. The Moravia and Silesia Half Marathon Championships are also held as part of the event.

name: Běh Javorkou
location: Javorka, Česká Třebová, Pardubice, Czech Republic
price_range: 150 Kč (předem), 200 Kč (na místě) pro dospělé; 30 Kč (předem), 50 Kč (na místě) pro děti; 50 Kč za štafetu
description: Běh Javorkou is a traditional spring running race with a long history, held regularly in April in the beautiful surroundings of Javorka Park in Česká Třebová. The 6 km main race is among the faster events, as the route follows firm park paths and is only gently undulating. The race is part of the regional ISCAREX Cup running series and offers high-quality competitive experiences for runners in all categories. In addition to the main race, children’s categories and team relays are also held.
course_highlights: The 6 km route follows firm park paths (gravel and paved surfaces)
Loop courses from 200 m to 1,200 m, marked with ribbons according to category
Gently undulating course in the beautiful surroundings of Javorka Park
additional: Registration is available online in advance or on race day, no later than 20 minutes before the start of the relevant category. Race facilities are located by the outdoor stage (Music Pavilion), next to the Javorka restaurant. Start times: children’s categories at 9:30, main race at 11:30, team relays at 12:10. The race takes place in Javorka Park. Registration is available online or on site, and the course has a firm surface with gentle climbs and turns. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup and offers various categories, including for athletes with disabilities.

name: Žehrovický Kalspotkros
location: Kamenné Žehrovic, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Žehrovický Kalspotkros is a 6.2 km trail race with a rolling course, held in Kamenné Žehrovice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup and offers runners an interesting and challenging course in a natural setting. It is suited to trail-running enthusiasts looking for the challenge of hilly terrain. The organizers welcome all runners seeking a quality race atmosphere and a sporting experience.
course_highlights: 6.2 km trail course
Rolling profile with hilly terrain
Part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup
additional: The race takes place on April 18, 2026. The start is scheduled for 10:30, with registration from 9:00 to 10:00. More information is available in the race details on the official website.

name: Listonošův krpál
location: Praha - Jarov (u Zbraslavi), Praha, Czech Republic
description: Listonošův Krpál is an uphill race in Prague–Jarov near Zbraslav, covering 2.88 km with 150 metres of elevation gain. The race is part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series and offers runners the challenge of a demanding climb. It is suitable for fans of mountain running and uphill races who want to test their endurance and strength on hilly terrain. The course is short but intense, making for a dynamic and appealing race experience.
course_highlights: Course length: 2.88 km
Elevation gain: 150 m
Part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series
additional: The race takes place on 18 April 2026. Registration details are not specified. It is part of a mountain-running series in Prague.

name: Cena Tolštejnského panství Jiřetín pod Jedlovou – Jedlová
location: Jiřetín pod Jedlovou, Lužické hory, Czech Republic
description: The Price of the Tolštejn Estate Jiřetín pod Jedlovou–Jedlová is a 6 km mountain uphill race with 340 metres of elevation gain, finishing at the summit of Jedlová in the Lusatian Mountains. The race is part of the Czech Cup in Uphill Running and offers a challenging course with beautiful views. It is suitable for mountain-running enthusiasts looking for a challenge in a natural setting. Come and enjoy the sporting atmosphere and the beauty of the Lusatian Mountains.
course_highlights: 6 km course with 340 m of elevation gain
Finish at the summit of Jedlová
Part of the Czech Cup in Uphill Running
additional: The race is open to the general public, online registration is available, and children can take part for free. The event also offers opportunities for trips in the surrounding area, including a visit to the Jedlová lookout tower and the ruins of Tolštejn.

name: SAFARIBĚH
location: Safari Park Dvůr Králové, Dvůr Králové nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: Safariběh ČSOB: I Don’t Want to Be Last is a running race held at Safari Park Dvůr Králové, offering a unique experience of running through the African and walking safaris. The race is open to the general public and offers three distances: a 2 km family run, and 5 km and 10 km races. The 10 km course consists of two laps of the 5 km route. The courses are mostly on paved asphalt, with the start and finish at the safari park’s main entrance. The entry fee also includes free admission to the safari park on race day and supports the conservation of African wild asses.
course_highlights: The route passes through the African and walking safaris
The surface is mostly paved asphalt paths
The start and finish are at the main entrance to Safari Park Dvůr Králové
additional: A race bib with a built-in chip that runners can keep. The entry fee includes free admission to the safari park on race day, a registration bag with gifts from partners, a voucher for refreshments after the race (one drink and one meal), a commemorative medal, light refreshments at the finish (water and fruit), and children’s activities at the stand of main partner ČSOB. The race is suitable for families and more demanding runners. Registration is available online, with different deadlines. The event is linked to activities at the safari park and supports nature conservation.

name: Jarní běh Dražovkou
description: The Spring Run in Dražovka, Hořovice, is a traditional cup race that invites runners of all ages to enjoy an active sporting experience. The race takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Dražovka and offers an opportunity to get active and meet other runners. You can register online at brdskypohar.cz or in person on race day. We look forward to seeing you and wish everyone success and joy in running.
course_highlights: A cup race in the picturesque surroundings of Dražovka
Suitable for runners of all ages
Registration available online and in person
additional: Online registration at www.brdskypohar.cz is preferred, but you can also register in person on race day. A trail run suitable for all ages; registration is available on the website, and you can also sign up in person on race day.

name: Husínský kros
location: Tajanov u Klatov, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Husínský Cross-Country is a traditional spring running race in Tajanov near Klatovy, established as a replacement for the cancelled Klatovská patnáctka. The race has been held since 2012 and is part of the prestigious Ešus League series. Men run three laps, while women and girls run two. Each lap is approximately 3.6 km and follows mostly forest trails, with a section of smooth asphalt. In recent years, the course has returned to its original, longer route around the perimeter of Husín Forest. The chief referee is running legend Vlastík Zwiefelhofer.
course_highlights: A lap of approximately 3.6 km, with two-thirds on forest trails
One-third of the course is on smooth asphalt
The course runs around the perimeter of Husín Forest
additional: The race is part of the Ešus League series, which reaches its 42nd edition in 2026 and comprises 22 races. Men run 10.5 km (3 laps); women and men over 70 run 7 km (2 laps). The start is by the volleyball courts in Tajanov. The organiser is Jiří Přibík (tel. 608279305). The race is part of the prestigious Ešus League series and was also held virtually in the past because of the pandemic. The event attracts a wide range of participants and has a long tradition in the region.

name: Bakovský půlmaraton
location: Bakov nad Jizerou, Central Bohemia, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 300 Kč pro předem přihlášené s platbou předem do 16.4.2026

description: The Bakov Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in Bakov nad Jizerou, now in its 43rd year. The race is run on a certified 21.097 km course along a hilly asphalt road with varying surface quality, including both climbs and descents. The start is at 10:00 on the town square in Bakov nad Jizerou. Cash and non-cash prizes are offered to the top men and women. You can register in advance for a lower entry fee or on race day for a higher fee.
course_highlights: Certified 21.097 km course
Hilly asphalt road with variable surface quality
Refreshment stations at 9.7 km, 14.5 km, and the finish
additional: Race-day registration and bib collection take place from 8:00 to 9:45 in a building approximately 150 m from the start. Categories are divided by age for men and women. A 2,000 CZK bonus is offered for breaking the course records in the overall men’s and women’s categories. The entry fee can be paid by bank transfer or in person on race day. The route follows a hilly asphalt road with varying surface quality; refreshments are available on the course, and age-group categories are recognized, with bonuses available for course records.

name: Ještěd SkyRace®
location: Ještěd, Liberec, Liberec District, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: Ještěd SkyRace® is a traditional trail-running race held in the beautiful surroundings of the Ještěd Ridge near Liberec. The race offers several route options, including the flagship 22 km SkyRace with 1,390 m of elevation gain, as well as shorter Trail (13 km) and Easy (6 km) courses. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and also includes children’s races and canicross. The start and finish are at the ski-jump complex on Ještěd, offering beautiful views and challenging terrain. The winners’ ceremony takes place after the race, from 16:00.
course_highlights: Flagship SkyRace: 22 km with 1,390 m of elevation gain
Other courses: Trail 13 km / 945 m+, Easy 6 km / 300 m+
Start and finish at the ski-jump complex on Ještěd
additional: The winners’ ceremony takes place from 16:00. The races also include children’s categories and canicross. The start and finish are at the ski-jump complex on Ještěd. The routes are challenging, with significant elevation gain, and are suitable for mountain-running enthusiasts. Course distances: 6 km, 13 km and 22 km; side events, trail camps, merchandise, registration, entertainment and race-weekend nutrition.

name: Pyšelský kopeček
organizer: parta běžců z Pyšel a Kopeček 2016, z.s.
description: Pyšelský kopeček is a traditional trail run in the picturesque surroundings of Pyšely, offering courses for all levels of runners, from recreational runners to ultramarathoners. The course is 90% forest trails and includes distances of 6.5 km, 11.5 km, 21 km, 52 km, and 105 km. The 21 km, 52 km, and 105 km races are UTMB Index Races, attracting experienced runners. The start and finish are at the football field in Pyšely, with facilities including changing rooms, showers, and refreshments. The event is suitable for the general public and also features children’s races and canicross.
course_highlights: The course is 90% forest trails
Distances of 6.5 km, 11.5 km, 21 km, 52 km, and 105 km
The 21 km, 52 km, and 105 km races are UTMB Index Races
additional: The race is limited to 250 participants. Changing rooms, toilets, and showers are available at the start and finish area. Parking is available in designated spaces outside the start area, with consideration for local residents. Canicross participants will find places along the course to give their dogs refreshments. Children’s races use manual timekeeping, while adult categories use electronic timing. Starts are divided into waves from 10:00 to 14:15, with the winners’ awards at 17:00. The ultraPUNKtrail 52 km and 105 km routes branch off from and rejoin the standard 21 km route. The race includes registration, timing, and facilities at the start and finish; the event is also suitable for children and beginners.

name: Run for ProCit
price_range: 550 Kč online, 600 Kč na místě, děti do 10 let zdarma
description: RUN for ProCit is a charity family run organised by the ProCit civic association in Plzeň, supporting families with children on the autism spectrum. The event takes place every April to mark World Autism Awareness Day and offers races for children and adults, including the option of Nordic walking. The run features a rich programme of activities for children and parents and is dog-friendly, so runners can take part with their dogs. Proceeds from entry fees and accompanying activities go towards supporting families with children with autism.
course_highlights: 2 children's courses with no registration or timekeeping
2 km and 5 km courses with timekeeping and winner announcements
A colour zone on the course that can be bypassed
additional: On-site registration from 8:30. Children's races start at 10:00 and 10:10, the 2 km run at 10:15, and the 5 km run at 10:45. The 2 km course can also be completed as a Nordic walk with an instructor. Every participant who crosses the finish line receives a commemorative medal. The run is dog-friendly. A charity raffle and refreshments are available on site. Registration from 8:30, starts from 10:00, charity event, with the option to buy small gifts and raffle tickets.

name: Dačická 14
location: Dačice, Rybník Peráček, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Sdružení běžců Dačic, Běh Vysočiny z. s.
price_range: 100 Kč - 150 Kč, mládež do 17 let zdarma
description: Dačická 14 is a traditional running race held in Dačice, South Bohemia Region, on April 18, 2026. It offers various courses and categories, including adults, youth, and children, on predominantly mixed terrain with fields, forest trails, and paved sections. The event is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and is intended for both recreational runners and competitive enthusiasts, with the opportunity to win valuable prizes and set record times.
course_highlights: Various course distances, including 13.5 km, 9.7 km, 4.3 km, and 1.475 km
Mixed terrain featuring fields, forest trails, and paved sections
Categories for different age groups, including youth and children
additional: The race offers multiple distances and categories, with registration available online and on site, including for children’s and youth categories. The course passes through fields, forest trails, and park paths. Prizes are available for record times, and refreshments and water are provided during the race.

name: ŘepoRun
description: ŘepoRun is a running race held in Řeporyje, Prague, offering courses for children and adults. The race is organized by the enthusiastic group of runners Run Labe Run and is open to all running enthusiasts. The route runs through the area around Řeporyje, and participants receive a race pack and a finisher’s medal. Online registration is available at a lower entry fee until 10 April 2026; after that, on-site registration is possible while capacity remains.
course_highlights: The route runs through the area around Řeporyje
Children’s courses: 200 m, 600 m and 1,300 m
Chip timing using a chip attached to the bib
additional: Race packs can be collected from 9:00 to 11:30 for children and from 10:00 to 11:45 for adults. Times are measured using a chip attached to the bib, which does not need to be returned. A bag drop is available after the race. Parking is limited, so using public transport is recommended. On-site registration is possible while capacity remains. Registration is open until 10 April 2026. Race categories include various course distances, starts are divided by age group, and the race uses chip timing.

name: Děčín RunFest
description: Děčín RunFest 2026 is a friendly sporting event in Děčín, offering a variety of running events, including a half marathon, a 5 km run, a family run and children’s races. The event takes place in the beautiful setting of the Elbe Valley at Mariánská louka and is intended for all ages and levels of athletic ability. The programme also includes Nordic walking and accompanying activities, providing fun and sporting experiences for the whole family.
course_highlights: A variety of race distances, including a half marathon and a 5 km run
A friendly outdoor setting in the Elbe Valley
Accompanying activities for children and adults
additional: The event is family-friendly and offers a variety of sporting activities. Online registration is available. The races are suitable for all age groups. It takes place in April 2026.

name: Kotva race
location: T.J. Sokol Maxičky, Děčín, Czech Republic
price_range: 250,- to 800,- CZK podle kategorie a data registrace
description: Kotva Race is an obstacle race held in Děčín that combines a sporting challenge with the values of the Sokol movement. The race takes place on April 18, 2026, and offers a main race for participants born in 2011 or earlier, as well as children’s and canicross categories. Participants can look forward to a challenging obstacle course that will test their strength, endurance, and determination. Registration is available online and on-site for a higher entry fee. Participants under 18 must have the consent of a legal guardian.
course_highlights: Off-road obstacle race featuring a variety of challenging obstacles
Course suitable for participants born in 2011 or earlier
Children’s and canicross categories
additional: On-site registration is available on race day from 8:00 to 9:15 for the main race and from 11:30 to 12:15 for the children’s race, for a higher entry fee. Participants under 18 must provide written consent from a legal guardian and submit a signed declaration of legal responsibility (REVERZ). Arriving early is recommended to avoid waiting in line. The event includes a main race, canicross, and children’s races. Advance registration is required. The race is open to the general public, including people with disabilities and children aged 2 and up.

name: Žákovský běh Bakovem
location: Atletická dráha u základní školy, Bakov nad Jizerou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
distance_verbose: 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.8 km, 0.6 km, 0.4 km, 0.2 km
organizer: Školní sportovní klub při ZŠ Bakov nad Jizerou
description: The Bakov Student Run is a traditional children’s running race held in Bakov nad Jizerou since 2002. Races take place on the athletics track by the elementary school, where children can run in spiked shoes. There are twelve categories, from preschoolers to juniors, including relays. The event is part of the accompanying program of the Bakov Half Marathon and is known for its friendly atmosphere and for awarding the top runners diplomas, medals, and gifts from sponsors.
course_highlights: Laps around the athletics track by the elementary school
Lap length: 313 metres
Run on a paved path; spiked shoes may be worn
additional: Race-day registration takes place in the elementary school’s theatre hall and closes 30 minutes before the start of the relevant category. There is no entry fee. Prizes include diplomas, medals, and small sports items; relay teams receive sweets and gifts from sponsors. The race has moved from the square to the athletics track because the square is being renovated. The race takes place in April 2026, features various distances from 200 m to 1,500 m, and is open to the general public. Entries can be submitted through the website or the race’s Facebook page.

name: VALAŠSKÝ TRHÁK
location: Městský park Rožnov, Rožnov pod Radhoštěm, Czech Republic
description: Valašský trhák 2026 is a half marathon taking place on Saturday, April 18, 2026, in the Municipal Park in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm. The race offers a sporting atmosphere in the heart of the town and is ideal for runners looking to enjoy a run in beautiful surroundings with a friendly community. The start and finish are located in the park, providing easy access and pleasant facilities for participants. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Half marathon in the Municipal Park in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm
Start and finish in the park, with a pleasant sporting atmosphere
A run in the heart of the town with a friendly community
additional: The event also includes cultural activities such as an Easter creative workshop, concerts, and workshops in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm.

name: TIŠNOVSKÉ KOZY 2026
location: Tišnov, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: 200 Kč for main race, free for children

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dětské běhy zdarma, nutná online registrace

description: Tišnovské Kozy 2026 is a charity trail run taking place on 18 April in Tišnov. The event offers two options: a two-person relay covering 2 × 5 km and a 10 km individual race, both through the scenic countryside around Tišnov, with gentle climbs and flat sections. It celebrates movement, fun and community, with activities for children and adults. All proceeds from entry fees and jersey sales go to support the Lokomoce association and the Člověče, hýbej se! initiative.
course_highlights: The route passes through the scenic countryside around Tišnov, with gentle climbs and flat sections
The 3-hour time limit allows participants to complete the course on foot
Start and finish at the athletics track at ZŠ Tišnov, with a climb to Květnice and Klucanina hills
additional: Children’s races are free, but online registration is required because of the timing chips. The start and finish are at the athletics track at ZŠ Tišnov. The main race has a 3-hour time limit. An original running jersey with a name of your choice is available; orders must be placed by 8 March 2026. After the race, a raffle with valuable prizes will be held. The accompanying program includes archery, an airsoft shooting range, face painting, music and a drumming show, and other activities for children and adults. This trail race offers online registration, supports children’s initiatives, welcomes walkers, and includes refreshments and activities for all age groups.

name: Děčín Run Fest 2026
price_range: 399,- Kč to 850,- Kč podle druhu závodu a data registrace
description: Děčín RunFest 2026 is a traditional running event held on 18 April in Děčín, at Mariánská louka along the Elbe Cycle Path. It offers a half marathon, a 5 km run, a family run, children’s races and a two-person relay, including a Nordic Walking half marathon. The event also features sports activity demonstrations and an accompanying programme, inviting people of all ages to enjoy active sport and family fun. Starts are scheduled from morning to afternoon, followed by the awards ceremony. The family and children’s races have a charitable focus.
course_highlights: Half marathon and 5 km run along the Elbe Cycle Path
Family run and children’s races over various distances
Nordic Walking half marathon and two-person relay
additional: Race registration is open from 08:30 to 12:55, with the latest registration 20 minutes before the start. Events include the Nordic Walking half marathon, half marathon, 5 km run, family run and children’s races. Entry fees for the family and children’s races go to charitable causes. The two-person relay includes a handover at the turnaround point. Categories are based on age and gender. The event features an accompanying programme and sports equipment sales. It includes various races, demonstrations and activities, and takes place at Mariánská louka and around the Elbe Cycle Path in Děčín.

name: Běh do vrchu Jiřetín - Jedlová
description: The Jiřetín–Jedlová Uphill Run is a traditional sporting event organised by the Varnsdorf Running Club. It takes place on Saturday, April 18, 2026, in Jiřetín pod Jedlovou. The race is part of the Czech Uphill Running Cup and features a challenging 5.7 km course with 340 metres of elevation gain, climbing from 434 m above sea level to the summit of Jedlová Mountain at 774 m above sea level. The route combines asphalt, gravel and forest trails. Runners start at 8:00 a.m. at the sports complex and can look forward to cash prizes and a running raffle.
course_highlights: 5.7 km course with 340 m of elevation gain
Surface: 10% asphalt, 60% gravel, 30% forest trails
Start at the sports complex in Jiřetín pod Jedlovou; finish at the summit of Jedlová Mountain
additional: Age categories from youth to seniors; cash prizes for category winners and for breaking the course record; a running raffle drawn from race numbers; participants take part at their own risk; basic medical care provided. Terrain: hilly, trail; registration: online or on site; Milan Krupka Memorial

name: Dehtářská 10°
location: RS Kletečná, Kletečná u Humpolce, Vysočina, Czech Republic
description: Dehtářská 10° is a running race in the Vysočina Region, open to the general public and all age groups. It offers 5, 10 and 20 km courses, with the main race covering approximately 10 km and an elevation gain of 85 metres. The race takes place at RS Kletečná near Humpolec and is known for its friendly atmosphere, where everyone who pushes past their own limits is a winner. Registration takes place on race day from 11:00 to 13:30, and the start is at 14:00. Participants can enjoy the beauty of the Vysočina Region and a sporting experience in a welcoming running community.
course_highlights: Main course: approximately 10 km with an elevation gain of 85 m
Choose from 5, 10 and 20 km courses
Race through the picturesque countryside of the Vysočina Region at RS Kletečná
additional: Race-day registration is open from 11:00 to 13:30. The race is open to all age and ability groups. Maps of all routes are available to download in SVG format. Contact persons and phone numbers are listed for technical support, marketing, and the course/registration. Registration is open from 11:00 to 13:30, and the race starts at 14:00 at RS Kletečná. The race is suitable for all age groups and offers a friendly atmosphere for runners and families alike.

name: Safari běh ČSOB
location: Safari Park Dvůr Králové, Dvůr Králové nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: The ČSOB Safari Run is a running race held at Safari Park Dvůr Králové, offering three courses: a 2 km family run, a 5 km race and a 10 km race. The routes run mainly along paved asphalt paths and pass through the African and pedestrian safaris, offering a unique experience surrounded by nature and animals. The start and finish are by the safari park’s main entrance. The race is suitable for the general public, including families, and supports the protection of maneless zebras and other animals in the park.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the African and pedestrian safaris
The surface is mainly paved asphalt paths
Start and finish by the main entrance to Safari Park Dvůr Králové
additional: A race bib with a built-in chip, which runners keep. Free admission to the safari park on race day. The entry fee includes a registration bag with gifts, a voucher for post-race refreshments (one drink and one meal), a commemorative medal and light refreshments during the race (water and fruit). The entry fee also offers the option to contribute to elephant conservation. Activities for children will be available at the booth of main partner ČSOB. The event was rescheduled to 18 October 2026 to protect the animals from foot-and-mouth disease. The park is operating with safety measures in place; registration is available, with the option to transfer or receive a refund of the entry fee. The event is suitable for families and athletes, with charity activities supporting wildlife conservation in Africa.

name: Běh O pohár století
location: Zámecký park Pacov, Pacov, Vysočina, Czech Republic
description: The O pohár století Run is a cross-country race held in the castle park in Pacov, with laps of 1,100 and 500 metres. The race takes place over undulating terrain on park paths, and spikes can be used. Men run 5.5 km and women 3.3 km. The event is organised by TJ Slavoj BANES Pacov, offering a quality sporting experience in the beautiful Vysočina region.
course_highlights: Laps of 1,100 and 500 metres in the castle park
Undulating terrain on park paths
Spikes can be used
additional: The first category starts at 9:30; the main category starts at 11:40. The event is organised by TJ Slavoj BANES Pacov. Contact: Pavel Zajíc, phone 731 189 985. This cross-country/trail race takes place in the castle park in Pacov, Vysočina. The race is part of the local athletics calendar. Exact registration details are not provided, but the event is suitable for runners of all levels who enjoy trail and cross-country races.

name: 19 Mini Cracovia Maraton im. Piotra Gład...
Beh Galantou – Beh oslobodenia
price_range: 15 € online, 12 € s GALAkartou; štafeta 40 € online, 32 € s GALAkartou; Samsung Run 10 €, 8 € s GALAkartou
description: Beh Galantou - Beh oslobodenia is the 40th anniversary edition of a traditional running event in Galanta, offering a range of disciplines for all age groups. The event is intended not only for athletes, but also for everyone who wants to experience an atmosphere full of emotion, the joy of movement and the challenge of surpassing themselves. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, refreshments and drinks; children also receive a ticket to the Galandia Water World and a package from COOP Jednota Galanta. The best runners receive cash prizes and valuable prizes, including televisions in special categories. After the race, a cultural programme is planned at the Municipal Cultural Centre in Galanta.
course_highlights: Courses for beginner and advanced runners
A commemorative medal for every participant, including children
More than 40 valuable prizes in the final raffle
additional: Registration opens at 8:00 on the day of the event and closes 20 minutes before the start of each category. Children receive a ticket to the Galandia Water World and a package from COOP Jednota Galanta. The best runners do not receive cups, but valuable cut glass. Winners in the special categories must hold a GalaKARTA. After the race, a cultural programme is planned at the Municipal Cultural Centre. The event includes various disciplines, prizes, refreshments and a cultural programme. Registration is online, and road closures are expected during the races.

name: Ultramaratón Miškolc - Košice
organizer: Marathon Club Miskolc, Košice Marathon Club
description: The Košice–Miskolc Ultramarathon is a prestigious running event taking place on April 18, 2026. Runners travel from Košice to Miskolc on a challenging ultramarathon route. The event is part of the region’s rich running calendar and offers a unique experience for endurance runners. It is organized by Maratónsky klub Košice, which provides professional preparation and organization.
course_highlights: An ultramarathon route from Košice to Miskolc
Challenging terrain requiring endurance and fitness
Crosses two countries—Slovakia and Hungary
additional: The event is part of a series of running events in Košice, including the International Peace Marathon and other accompanying events. Organizers offer opportunities to participate as a volunteer, driver, or pacer. Runners receive comprehensive organizational support and benefits associated with the entry fee. The course follows cycle paths and has low traffic, with categories for individuals and two-, five-, and ten-person relay teams; start times are 6:00 and 7:00.

name: BoleRuN
location: areál TJ Slavoj Boleráz, Boleráz, Slovakia
description: BoleRuN is a running event held at the TJ Slavoj Boleráz grounds, offering courses for different age groups, including children, teenagers, and adults. Runners can compete over distances from 50 metres to 10 km, with the children’s start at 13:00 and the adults’ start at 14:00. The event is organised by the Municipality of Boleráz in cooperation with the Boleráz – Hýb sa initiative. It is suitable for runners aged 9 and over who want to enjoy a day of sport in a pleasant setting.
course_highlights: Adult courses: 10 km and 5 km
Course for teenagers aged 10 to 14: 2 km
Course for children under 9: from 50 metres to 1 km
additional: Children’s start at 13:00; adults’ start at 14:00. Categories are divided by age and course distance. The event is organised by the Municipality of Boleráz and the Boleráz – Hýb sa initiative. Registration is likely closed as of April 2024; the event includes categories for children and adults, electronic timekeeping, and a participant medal.

name: Šarišská míľa
description: Šarišská míľa is a running event organized by BK ZasRun in Šarišské Bohdanovce at the football pitch. The race is open to various age groups, including children, youth, adults, and Nordic Walking participants. The starts are divided into the children’s mile, running and Nordic Walking for women, and running and Nordic Walking for men. Entry is free, with the option to make a voluntary contribution at registration. The event offers a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all levels and ages.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the football pitch in Šarišské Bohdanovce
Categories for children, youth, adults, and Nordic Walking participants
Starts are divided into the children’s mile, running and Nordic Walking for women, and running and Nordic Walking for men
additional: Entry is free, with the option to make a voluntary contribution at registration. The children’s mile starts at 16:00, the women’s running and Nordic Walking events at 16:20, and the men’s running and Nordic Walking events at 16:45. Categories are divided by age and gender, including overall rankings for Nordic Walking. The race starts at 16:00, is open to the general public, and is suitable for all age groups.

name: Chlieb náš….
description: Chlieb Náš is an artisan bakery in Hronský Beňadik that makes sourdough bread using traditional methods and quality ingredients. It takes pride in honest baking, reflected in the bread’s crisp crust, lively sourdough starter and soft interior. The bakery offers an authentic experience where you can choose fresh bread straight from the oven. In addition to the quality of its bread, the bakery is also known for its unique Baroque ceiling, one of the most original in Trnava.
course_highlights: Traditional sourdough bread baking using quality ingredients
Crisp crust and soft bread interior
Unique Baroque ceiling in the bakery
additional: The bakery is open Tuesday to Friday from 7:00 to 16:00 and Saturday from 7:00 to 11:30, or until sold out. The business emphasizes honest artisan production and the family character of Trnka Gastronomy. The event is associated with traditional bread baking and is held at Dumas bakery in Hronský Beňadik. It is suitable for anyone interested in the baking craft.

name: Beh oslobodenia Turčianska Štiavnička
description: The Turčianska Štiavnička Liberation Run is a traditional race with a rich history, held to mark the anniversary of the village’s liberation by the Soviet Army. The 32nd edition will take place on April 18, 2026, at the football field in Turčianska Štiavnička. The approximately 10 km course runs mainly through mountainous terrain and offers runners a challenging but beautiful experience. Competitors are divided into age categories, with awards also given in the children’s categories and to the top runners from Štiavnička. The organizers welcome all runners and look forward to their participation.
course_highlights: The course runs mainly through mountainous terrain, along forest roads and through the local park
Approximately 10 km long, known as the “Štiavnická desiatka”
Start and finish by the cultural center and football field in the village
additional: Online registration is open from 1.4.2026 to 16.4.2026. The race is divided into men’s age categories, women’s categories and children’s categories. The race bibs are traditionally sewn and printed according to the original design from Ružomberok and are still used today. A ceremonial wreath-laying at the memorial to fallen heroes takes place before the race. Races start at 10:00 and 13:15; registration is available from April 1 to 16, 2026. The event has historical significance and is part of the local calendar of sporting events.

name: Banská Bystrica - Bežíme spolu v Banskej Bystrici
location: Park pod pamätníkom SNP, Banská Bystrica, Slovakia
description: Bežíme spolu in Banská Bystrica is a running event held in the park below the SNP Memorial in Banská Bystrica. It offers four distances, including a children’s run, and is suitable for the general public, including children under 6. The course is flat, with no elevation gain, making for an enjoyable run for all age groups. The event supports people with disabilities: €2 from each entry fee goes towards motivating them to be physically active.
course_highlights: Flat courses with no elevation gain
Four distances: 10 km, 5 km, 3 km and a 500 m children’s run
Start and finish in the park below the SNP Memorial in Banská Bystrica
additional: Support: €2 from each paid entry fee goes towards supporting people with disabilities. The children’s run is for children under 6 (born 2020–2026) and requires the presence of a legal guardian. Entry fees are valid from 7 April 2026. The course has no elevation gain, making the race easy to run. The course is flat; registration is online; the event supports people with disabilities; information about consent to the use of data is included.

name: Polus Tower Run
location: Polus Tower 2, Bratislava-Nové Mesto, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Polus Tower Run is a unique stair-climbing event taking place on April 18, 2026, at the Polus Tower 2 office building in Bratislava. Competitors climb the elevation under their own power on two courses: a children’s course with 4 floors and 116 steps, and the main adult course with 19 floors and 416 steps. Participants start individually at 30-second intervals, and times are recorded electronically. The event is organized by the KOTRMELEC Sports Foundation and is conducted under the applicable TWA rules.
course_highlights: Adults: 19 floors / 416 steps, distance 400 m, elevation gain +80 m
PHZ (police officers, firefighters, paramedics): 416 steps / 19 floors, distance 400 m, elevation gain +80 m
Children: 4 floors / 116 steps, distance 200 m, elevation gain +21 m
additional: The children’s start is at 11:00, and the adults’ start is at 11:30. The awards ceremony is at 13:00. The course surface is 100% tile. Participants start individually at 30-second intervals, with electronic timekeeping. Awards are given by age category for men and women. Stair race, multiple categories, online registration, limited to 300 participants, race for children and adults, various age groups and medals

name: 5. Prunéřovský půlmaratón
location: Prunéřov–Černovice cycle path, Prunéřov, Kadaň, Czech Republic
organizer: Běžecký klub F - C Kadaň, z.s.
description: The Prunéřov Half Marathon is a certified half marathon on an accurately measured out-and-back course, run over two laps with minimal elevation gain. The start and finish are at the beginning of the Prunéřov–Černovice cycle path. The race is suitable for a wide range of runners, including children, who have their own courses of varying lengths and start times. It is organized by Běžecký klub F - C Kadaň, z.s., and takes place on Sunday, April 19, 2026, starting at 10:00. Aid stations are located every five kilometres and at the finish.
course_highlights: Certified, accurately measured course
Two laps with minimal elevation gain
Aid stations every 5 km and at the finish
additional: Race check-in is from 9:00 at the start area. Children’s races start earlier: Older Pupils at 9:15, Preparatory Class at 9:20, and Younger Pupils at 9:45. Parking is limited at the start and finish area and requires CEZ authorization; otherwise, parking is available by Prunéřov railway station, about a 1 km walk from the start. The organizer offers a special 2,000 Kč prize for beating the times of 1:08:20 for men and 1:22:22 for women. For the 2026 edition, check-in is listed from 9:00 and the main race starts at 10:00. Aid stations are located every five kilometres and at the finish; parking at the start and finish is limited.

name: Běh kolem Hluboké 25 km - Krajský přebor v silničním běhu
description: The Run Around Hluboká is a traditional regional road-running championship over 25 km, held in the picturesque setting of Hluboká nad Vltavou. The race offers a high-quality course suitable for experienced runners and competitors vying for regional titles. The event is part of the South Bohemian Region athletics calendar and attracts a broad running community.
course_highlights: 25 km road course
Picturesque surroundings of Hluboká nad Vltavou
Part of the regional road-running championship

name: Bolatická 20
price_range: 150 Kč pro běžce, zdarma pro děti do 15 let; 30 Kč za pěší pochod
