description: Bolatická dvacítka is a traditional event for hikers and runners, held annually in Bolatice. The race offers 20 km and 10 km runs on routes that are mostly through forest, alternating cross-country sections with asphalt. There is also a 20 km walk or a shortened 10 km route in pleasant woodland surroundings. The event has a long-standing tradition dating back to 1977 and attracts hundreds of participants, including friends from Slovakia. The start and finish are by the local swimming pool, where there is also free entertainment after the race.
course_highlights: The routes run mainly through the forest around the Strahovské ponds and Chuchelnický Forest
A mix of cross-country sections and asphalt stretches
Both the walk and the run are marked in yellow
additional: On-site registration for runners is open from 8:00 to 8:55; those who registered in advance need only give their name and collect their race number. The 3 km run starts at 9:20 and the 500 m run at 9:22. The walk starts between 7:30 and 9:00. The race takes place with normal road traffic, and participants must obey traffic regulations. From 12:00 after the race, there will be free entertainment with the country band CARAVANA. Registration is available on site; the event takes place on 19 April 2026; the routes run mainly through woodland.

name: CRAFT Brněnský půlmaraton a Brněnská desítka
location: Velodrom, Brno, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The CRAFT Brno Half Marathon, 10K and 5K is a traditional road race of international significance, held in Brno with the velodrome as its hub. The event is open to a wide range of participants, from world-class athletes to recreational runners, and also includes children’s races. The race offers distances of 21.1 km, 10.5 km and 5 km, as well as a relay option. It is organised by BehejBrno.com and MARATON BRNO z.s., who prepare this popular sporting event every year.
course_highlights: Race hub at the Brno Velodrome
Traditional road distances of 21.1 km, 10.5 km and 5 km
Races for all age groups, including children
additional: The first category starts at 10:00, with the main category at 11:00. The race is open to the general public and includes a relay and children’s categories. It is organised by BehejBrno.com and MARATON BRNO z.s. The race is part of the traditional running calendar and offers races for children and adults, with an emphasis on a friendly atmosphere and promoting a healthy lifestyle.

name: Chřibská – Studenec
description: We invite all runners to the 15th edition of the Chřibská Town Prize Studenec Uphill Race, held in the picturesque Lusatian Mountains. The race is suitable for elite competitors and recreational runners alike, and serves as a qualifying event for the World Mountain Running Championships for boys and girls. The course is 6.1 km long with 397 metres of elevation gain, and finishes at the Studenec lookout tower. The race starts at 10:00 in Chřibská town square; registration opens at 8:30 at the Chřibská Municipal Office.
course_highlights: 6.1 km course over the varied terrain of the Lusatian Mountains
397 metres of elevation gain
Finish at the Studenec lookout tower
additional: Registration from 8:30 at the Chřibská Municipal Office. Prizes for the top three in each category and a running-themed raffle. The race is a qualifier for the World Mountain Running Championships for boys and girls. The race takes place in the Lusatian Mountains, registration opens at 8:30, and the start is at 10:00. The course passes through beautiful natural scenery and is suitable for runners of all levels.

name: Žatecký půlmaratón a desítka
description: The Žatec Half Marathon and 10K is a popular running event held in Žatec on April 19, 2026. Runners can choose between the half marathon (21 km) and the 10K (10 km); both courses follow paved paths along the Ohře River towards Vičice and Stroupeč. The event also includes children’s races of 400 m, 750 m, and 1,500 m. Check-in takes place at the football field across the river, the main races start in the morning, and all finishers receive a participant medal.
course_highlights: The routes follow paved paths along the Ohře River
Half marathon: 21 km; 10K: 10 km
Children’s races of 400 m, 750 m, and 1,500 m
additional: Race check-in takes place from 8:00 to 10:00 at the football field across the river. The children’s races start from 10:00, the half marathon at 11:00, and the 10K at 11:15. All finishers receive a participant medal. Registration is now open; the races include a half marathon, 10K, triathlon, and Advent run. The races are suitable for all ages and running levels.

name: Petřín třikrát jinak
location: Praha, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
price_range: Dětské závody: 80-100 Kč, hlavní závod: 200-250 Kč, štafety: 200 Kč
description: Petřín Three Ways is a unique race in Prague where participants tackle Petřín Hill in three different ways: an interval-start climb up the 299 steps of the Petřín Lookout Tower, a mass-start uphill race, and an interval-start climb up the slope on an unpaved path and stairs. The overall ranking is based on the combined times of all three races, with bonuses for the top participants. Children can enter ten age categories, with courses around the Hunger Wall. The race also offers a relay, with three runners each completing one leg.
course_highlights: Interval-start climb up the 299 steps of the Petřín Lookout Tower
1 km uphill race with 118 m of elevation gain and a mass start
Interval-start 1 km climb up the slope on an unpaved path and stairs
additional: The race office and facilities are in tents near the Petřín Lookout Tower. Interval starts are every 30 seconds, with a break after every 30 participants to allow them to descend from the tower. Children’s races feature 200 m, 365 m, and 730 m courses, with awards immediately after each race. Relays consist of 3 runners, each running one leg; they start together with the individual competitors. Relay participants cannot also enter the main race. The schedule runs from 7:45 to 12:35, with the main race awards at 11:30. The terrain includes stairs and unpaved paths. Registration is through the Apachi platform. The race is part of the Rozhledny v pohybu series and offers multiple categories and a relay option.

name: Charitativní běh NF Křídla dětem
location: Ostrava-Poruba, Ostrava, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: dobrovolné startovné, 150-400 Kč podle věkové skupiny a registrace
description: The Křídla dětem Foundation charity run is an annual event held in Ostrava-Poruba to support sick children in the pediatric hemato-oncology department of the University Hospital. The run is open to all age groups, with children’s races and walking routes also available. The event combines sport with a charitable purpose: proceeds help make children’s hospital stays more pleasant by providing needed gifts. The run takes place on Sunday, April 19, 2026, and you can also make a donation without taking part in the run.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Ostrava-Poruba by the University Hospital’s pediatric hemato-oncology department
Children’s races of 550 m and 1,000 m; adult routes of 5 km and 10 km (2 laps)
Free parking next to the VŠB Sports Hall, with access from Studentská Street
additional: Children’s races start at 9:30 (up to age 6) and 9:45 (ages 7–12). Adult routes are 5 km and 10 km (2 laps). Free parking at the VŠB Ostrava Sports Hall. If there is an error in your registration, contact guras@kridladetem.cz. Entry fees are non-refundable if you do not attend. You can give an entry fee as a gift certificate. The event offers various distances, online and on-site registration, free parking, the option to contribute financially or in kind, a charity collection, and accompanying activities.

name: Šaratický běh
description: The Šaratice Run is a traditional 10 km road race held in the village of Šaratice in the South Moravian Region. The race offers runners of all levels the chance to test themselves on a fast, well-marked course. It starts at the municipal office, and the atmosphere is friendly and sporty. The organiser is the Municipality of Šaratice, which ensures the event runs smoothly and supports the local running community.
course_highlights: 10 km road course
Start and finish at the municipal office in Šaratice
Course suitable for recreational and competitive runners
additional: The race is part of the local running calendar. Registration details are not explicitly provided, and the race is suitable for the general public.

name: Charitativní běh Karlštejn
location: Nádvoří hradu Karlštejn, Karlštejn, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Karlštejn Charity Run is a running event organized by Charita Beroun, offering the chance to combine a sporting experience with supporting a good cause. The run takes place in the beautiful surroundings of the Gothic Karlštejn Castle and the Velká Amerika quarry, providing a unique trail-running experience. The start is right in the castle courtyard, allowing participants to experience the atmosphere of this historic place. The event is for all runners who want to run with their hearts while supporting charitable activities.
course_highlights: Start right in the courtyard of Karlštejn Castle
Trail run around the Gothic Karlštejn Castle
The route also passes by the Velká Amerika quarry
additional: The event takes place on 19 April 2026 from 10:00 to 14:00 in the beautiful Karlštejnsko area. The entry fee also serves as a contribution to the charitable work of Charita Beroun. Routes of 12 km, 18 km, and 30 km; included in the UTMB Index Race; charitable and sporting in nature; finisher shirts; GPX route available to download.

name: Craft Brněnský půlmaraton | desítka | pětka
description: The Craft Brno Half Marathon is a running event starting and finishing at the Velodrome in Brno. The route passes through the BVV exhibition grounds and along the new pedestrian path behind the Riviéra swimming pool. Runners can choose from three distances: 21 km, 10 km or 5 km, and children’s races take place at the Velodrome. The event is suitable for the general public and offers an enjoyable sporting experience in an attractive setting.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Velodrome in Brno
The route passes through the BVV exhibition grounds and around the Riviéra swimming pool
Choose from 21 km, 10 km and 5 km distances
additional: Children’s races take place at the Velodrome. The course includes the new pedestrian path behind the Riviéra swimming pool. The races take place in April 2026, with registration available through the official website. The event is part of Brno’s sports calendar and promotes an active lifestyle.

name: 15 brodů Bílého potoka
description: 15 Fords of the White Brook is an off-road running adventure through the beautiful valley of the White Brook, near the settlement of Šmelcovna. The longest route is approximately 22 km and includes 16 fords, which are runnable, with most avoidable via a footbridge. The race is suitable for recreational runners and moderately trained athletes, with a time limit of 3 hours. There are three routes: a non-competitive 7 km route, a 15 km route with 7 fords, and a 22 km route with an additional loop and climb. The route runs mostly through forests and meadows along hiking trails and cycle paths. It is clearly marked and offers beautiful natural scenery.
course_highlights: 16 fords on the longest, 22 km route; most are runnable or can be bypassed via a footbridge
The route runs mostly through forests and meadows, away from paved roads, with 400 metres of elevation gain on the longest route
A steep climb of approximately 1.7 km comes at the end of the race
additional: The time limit for the longest route is 3 hours, with a 50-minute time window at the 6.6 km point for splitting runners onto different routes. Slower runners are directed to the finish and classified on the shorter route. The course is marked with arrows and ribbons. Water in the fords reaches above ankle height; the fords are runnable, and most of the more difficult ones can be bypassed. You can change your route distance during the race. Off-road race with fords; 7, 15 and 22 km routes; easy terrain; natural surroundings; marked routes; 3-hour time limit.

name: Silniční běh kolem Hluboké nad Vltavou
location: TJ Hluboká, Hluboká nad Vltavou, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The road race around Hluboká nad Vltavou is a traditional 25 km road event starting and finishing at the TJ Hluboká stadium. The route follows paved cycle paths and third-class roads through the picturesque villages of Bavorovice, Vondrov, Munice, Zahájí and Zliv. The race is suitable for runners looking to test their endurance on a road course in the beautiful South Bohemian countryside. It is organized by TJ KOH-I-NOOR České Budějovice. The contact person is Růžena Smolíková.
course_highlights: 25 km route along paved cycle paths and third-class roads
Passes through Bavorovice, Vondrov, Munice, Zahájí and Zliv
Starts and finishes at the TJ Hluboká stadium
additional: The race starts and finishes at the TJ Hluboká stadium. The route follows paved cycle paths and third-class roads. The organizer is TJ KOH-I-NOOR České Budějovice; the contact person is Růžena Smolíková, tel. 607 525 403. The race takes place on April 19, 2026. Registration costs 200 Kč. The route runs mostly along paved cycle paths and roads, and the start and finish are at the TJ Hluboká stadium.

The race is open to the general public, from young children to adults, and offers several categories, including the 9 km main race, youth races, and a non-competitive run for Paskov Castle. This year, the registration and start location for the main race have changed; the race starts at 9:15. The event offers a sporting opportunity with an emphasis on safety and support for the local community.

Youth races of 940 m, 480 m, and 160 m for the youngest participants
Non-competitive 3,000 m run for Paskov Castle

The registration and start location for the main race have changed; traffic along the course will be restricted from 9:00 to approximately 12:00.

name: Běh Chýní
description: Běh Chýní 2026 is an athletics race organized by ASK Dipoli in the municipality of Chýně, in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is part of the club’s RUN THE TRIO quadrathlon and is intended for youth, juniors, men, and women. ASK Dipoli also offers other races and athletics activities for different age groups and ability levels. Registration and the training schedule are available online, and the race supports an active sporting life and an athletics community in the region.

Part of ASK Dipoli’s series of running events in 2026
Online registration and attractive prizes for the winners

The race takes place on 19 April 2026 in Chýně, with different distances, including children’s and adult races. Registration is online, and participants receive prizes and certificates.

The course runs through the natural surroundings of the Hradec Králové forests
Categories for children and adults, with medals and gifts for the winners

This is the first event in the Summer Running Cup and offers a pleasant, fast running environment suitable for the general public. The event is organized by Běžecký klub F - C Kadaň, z.s., which provides convenient registration and quality race services.

Two laps with minimal elevation gain
Run on the cycle path between Prunéřov and Černovice

ČSOB Bratislava marathon – desiatka, Minimaratón, deti, lezúni
description: The ČSOB Bratislava Marathon is a family-friendly running event with a long-standing tradition, held in Bratislava and attracting runners from Slovakia and abroad. It offers a range of disciplines, from the marathon, half marathon and relay races to the 10K, minimarathon, children’s races and crawling races. The atmosphere is full of emotion, fair play and camaraderie, where everyone who takes the start and pushes their own limits is a winner. The event also supports charitable activities and highlights the importance of helping one another and solidarity.
course_highlights: A 42.195 km marathon course through central Bratislava
The Mattoni 10K and Garmin Run Series Minimarathon as shorter events
Children’s races and crawling races for the youngest participants
additional: The Mattoni 10K starts on Saturday, 11.04.2026 at 16:00; the Garmin Run Series Minimarathon starts on Saturday, 11.04.2026 at 14:00; children’s races begin on Saturday, 11.04.2026 from 10:00, according to age categories. Relay races have special bib numbers with timing chips. Participant limits are set for individual events (for example, 2,000 for the 10K, 1,500 for the minimarathon and children’s races). The races take place in Bratislava. Registration is open, with various prices. The course includes city streets and the attractive surroundings of Eurovea Galleria.

name: Národný beh Devín - Bratislava (5.kolo BP SAZ)
description: TIPOS National Run Devín–Bratislava is Slovakia’s oldest sporting event, with a tradition spanning more than 100 years, and will be held for the 78th time. Runners will follow the iconic route from historic Devín Castle to the centre of Bratislava, creating a unique atmosphere that brings history and sport together. The event is suitable for recreational athletes as well as more demanding runners, and attracts thousands of participants of different ages every year. It is organised by STaRZ of the City of Bratislava, which provides all organisational information and registration.
course_highlights: The route runs from Devín Castle to the centre of Bratislava
Road race with more than 5,000 participants
Historic, iconic running tradition dating back to 1921
additional: Online registration is open until 15 April 2026 at 20:00. Group registration is available by emailing hromadne_prihlasky@starz.sk with billing details. A limited-edition T-shirt is available for EUR 13. The start list is available online. The event is organised by STaRZ of the City of Bratislava. The event includes various courses in Devín, registration is available online, and it is part of the Slovak Athletics Association running series. Results and statistics can also be followed on the official websites.

name: Sačurovská pätnástka – 20. Memoriál Heleny Slukovej
organizer: Obec Sačurov, OZ Sačurov, ZŠ Sačurov, MŠ Sačurov
description: Sačurovská pätnástka – 20th Helena Sluková Memorial is a traditional running race held in the village of Sačurov in Vranov nad Topľou District. The race starts in front of the primary school in Sačurov and offers categories for different age groups, including children, juniors and adults. The main category starts at 13:00, and the children’s race at 12:00. The organizers are the Municipality of Sačurov, OZ Sačurov, and Sačurov Primary and Nursery School. The race is suitable for local runners and beginners alike.

Categories range from preschool age to seniors over 70
Awards for the top runners from Vranov District

Awards for the top runners from Vranov District are part of the event. The race is part of a community-support event, with online registration and various categories for all age groups.

The competition is divided into several age categories for men and women, welcoming participants of different ages and abilities. The organizer is MATORE s.r.o., which provides race organization and timing.

The race is suitable for the general public and offers an opportunity to test your strength in the pleasant surroundings of Likavka.

Part of the 2025 Liptov Running League
Categories for children, pupils, juniors, women, and men in various age groups

The race takes place at the football stadium; registration is available online and on-site, the event includes various categories, and it is part of a regional running series.

name: Čadčianska desiatka

The 30th edition will take place on 19 April 2026, starting at 10:00 in the Žarec housing estate in Čadca. Runners can look forward to a well-prepared course and a welcoming atmosphere at an event popular with the region’s running community. Online registration is open until 17 April 2026. You can also register on race day for a higher entry fee.

Start and finish at the Žarec housing estate in Čadca
Race for the Mayor of Čadca Cup

If you do not attend, your name will not appear in the results. The race takes place on 19 April 2026 at 10:00. Registration is open until 17 April 2026. The start and finish are at the Žarec housing estate. The race is part of a traditional sporting event with a rich history.

name: Běh Čedoku
description: The Čedok Run is a 3.7 km race held mostly on asphalt in Prague 4. Part of the SABZO series, it offers runners of all levels the chance to enjoy a fast, pleasant race in an urban setting. It is ideal for those looking for a short, dynamic course with a city feel.

Mostly asphalt surface
Urban setting in Prague 4

name: UCM Night Run
description: UCM Night Run is a charity evening run taking place on 21 April 2026 at 20:00 at Trojičné námestie in Trnava. Runners will complete a 5-kilometre route through the historic streets of Trnava’s centre, offering the unique atmosphere of the “Little Rome.” The event is open to everyone, regardless of ability, and brings the community together through movement and support for those in need. Proceeds from the run will go towards rehabilitation and treatment for a child with a disability. The organisers are the City of Trnava, FMK UCM students and main partner CUKROVAR.
course_highlights: 5 km route through the historic streets of Trnava’s centre
Evening atmosphere at Trojičné námestie
Charity event supporting people with disabilities

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (5) – dubnový
description: Come and run on a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava in Prague’s Braník district, where personal records are often set. The race is part of the 16th year of VAŠE LIGA’s regular 5 km and 10 km runs, held every month. You can compare yourself with other runners and track your progress throughout the year. The course is certified, and the 10 km distance offers the chance to run a qualifying time for the Czech Championships. A relaxed running atmosphere and chip timing guarantee a great experience.
course_highlights: Pleasant, fast course along the Vltava in Prague’s Braník district
Course measured by a certified measurer
Chance to run a qualifying time for the Czech Championships in the 10 km
additional: The 10 km race starts at 14:00 and the 5 km race at 14:05. Check-in is from 13:00 to 13:50 at the blue tent by the cycle path, near U Kempinku 2, Prague. Recommended parking is at the P+R lot by Braník railway station or on nearby streets. additional: Race-day registration is available at the start area from 8:00. The participant limit is 200 runners. The time limit for the long course is 8 hours, with a checkpoint halfway through the course. Mandatory equipment includes a personal cup, mobile phone, emergency blanket and suitable clothing. Parking is available right by the start in Třísov, but spaces are limited, so carpooling is recommended. Registration, parking and safety rules are described in detail on the website. Various course distances are available, including 45 km and 44 km, with support and timing.

name: VOKOLO trail
organizer: Brněnský klub běžeckých a sportovních aktivit z.s.
description: Vokolo TRAIL is a spring running race taking place on April 25, 2026, around the Brno Reservoir. It offers a beautiful, varied course through natural terrain, with stunning views of the reservoir and historic Veveří Castle. The race is for runners looking for a personal challenge and wanting to push their limits on a moderately difficult course. It also features a unique steamboat relay, combining running with a steamboat ride across the reservoir. The event is organized by Brněnský klub běžeckých a sportovních aktivit z.s., which emphasizes quality facilities and runner safety.
course_highlights: An 18 km varied course through natural terrain along both shores of the Brno Reservoir
Stunning views of the reservoir and Veveří Castle
A unique 2 × 9 km steamboat relay, including a crossing of the reservoir
additional: The race is limited to 700 runners. The race packet contains a race bib with a timing chip, safety pins, a bag-storage tag, partner vouchers, a ticket for hot soup after the race, and a raffle ticket. Separate changing rooms, guarded baggage storage, and storage for bicycles and scooters are available. Timing uses chip technology, with real-time results. Medical support is available on the course, at the finish, and at the event facilities. The first relay leg and the main race start between 9:45 and 9:55; the second relay leg starts at 9:20, with participants departing for the steamboat. The race is limited to 700 participants and includes timing, technical facilities, medical support, and refreshments on the course and at the finish.

name: Hlučínská 24ka
description: Hlučínská 24ka is a unique 24-hour ultramarathon held in the beautiful surroundings of the Hlučín gravel pit, around Hlučín Lake. The race offers the chance to test your endurance by completing as many laps as possible on a 6,180-metre course. In addition to the main individual race, a new pairs race gives participants the opportunity to share the experience with a partner. The event also includes children’s races and shorter runs for the general public, all in a friendly and supportive atmosphere. It is organised by the Benešováci z.s. association, which emphasises sporting spirit, fair play and promoting an active lifestyle in the region.
course_highlights: A 6,180-metre loop around Hlučín Lake
Flat asphalt course with no significant elevation changes
Beautiful natural surroundings at the Hlučín gravel pit
additional: The race takes place on 25.4.2026 and the 24-hour ultramarathon finishes on 26.4.2026 at 9:00. Children’s and shorter runs start between 14:00 and 15:00. The course is flat asphalt with a low difficulty level. Each participant receives a race number and an ID chip; the race number must be worn visibly. The organiser recommends a medical check-up before the race, and participation is at your own risk. An ultramarathon T-shirt is also included. Facilities are at the campsite directly by the Hlučín gravel pit. 24-hour ultramarathon, 6,180 m course, held at the Hlučín gravel pit, pairs race option, accompanying activities

name: Nížkovský běh u koupaliště
location: Nížkov u koupaliště, Nížkov, Czech Republic
description: The Nížkov Run by the Swimming Pool is a traditional cross-country race organised by TJ Sokol Nížkov and held annually by the swimming pool in Nížkov. The race has a long-standing tradition and is popular with local runners and sports enthusiasts from the surrounding area. It offers athletes of all ages and abilities the chance to enjoy a run in the pleasant surroundings of the Vysočina region. The organisers focus on a friendly atmosphere and high-quality event organisation.
course_highlights: A traditional cross-country race in the natural surroundings by the swimming pool in Nížkov
Organised by TJ Sokol Nížkov, with a long-standing tradition
Suitable for runners of different ages and abilities
additional: The race is part of TJ Sokol Nížkov’s activities and traditionally takes place in spring, usually one week after the Easter holidays. The organisers also hold athletics races for children and young people at the field behind the Sokol hall. The Nížkov Run by the Swimming Pool is part of the wider sports programme in the municipality of Nížkov. A traditional spring race; attended by local and visiting runners; results available online; held by the swimming pool in Nížkov.

name: ALIS RUN - Bystřický běh s úsměvem
description: ALIS RUN – Bystřice Run with a Smile is a traditional running race held in the village of Bystřice. This friendly race offers a pleasant atmosphere and is suitable for the general public, including younger participants with written consent from a legal guardian. The race takes place on April 25, 2026, and participants start at their own risk, with an emphasis on following safety instructions. The event also offers the opportunity to buy an Alis Run 2026 T-shirt in advance.
course_highlights: Scenic route around Bystřice
Support for the local charity “Nikdy nejsi sám”
Friendly atmosphere and various race categories
additional: Participants under 18 may take part in the race only with written consent from a responsible representative. Each participant starts at their own risk and agrees to follow safety instructions. Participants consent to audiovisual recording of their participation and performance for the purpose of promoting the race. Orders for Alis Run 2026 T-shirts are closed for this year. Entry fees will support the association “Nikdy nejsi sám”; the event is suitable for all age groups.

name: Rychlebský maraton
description: The Rychlebský Marathon is a spring supplementary race in the beautiful Rychlebské Mountains, known for their wild and remote nature. The routes follow excellent mountain trails through deep valleys, deserted rocky outcrops, old mountain meadows and abandoned settlements, offering runners an unforgettable wilderness experience and beautiful views. The race is ideal for anyone who wants to discover the Rychlebské Mountains through the eyes of experienced locals and enjoy a run in nature with minimal asphalt. Routes of 26, 46 and 76 km are available, with the longer options also entering neighbouring Poland.
course_highlights: Routes follow excellent mountain trails and a border path
Through deep valleys, deserted rocky outcrops and mountain meadows around former settlements
Minimal asphalt, mostly forest trails and paths
additional: Registration is also possible on site, but signing up in advance helps with race preparations. Runners are divided into two age categories (under 39 and 40 and over). The entry fee includes a forest-owner fee, a map, a race bib, chip timing, a GPS tracker for the long route, a finisher’s certificate, generous on-course refreshments and hot soup at the finish (vegan and non-vegan). Accommodation in a makeshift gym in Javorník is available for 150 CZK per night. Trail ultramarathon on mountain trails, registration information, special programmes including evening talks, and changes to the event venue on race day.

name: Běh na Mědník
location: Klášterec nad Ohří, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Mědník is a sporting event held in the scenic Ore Mountains, with the event hub and registration at the Fénix restaurant in the village of Měděnec. Runners are taken by bus to the start in Klášterec nad Ohří, where they set off on the course. The event offers beautiful natural scenery and is suitable for runners who want to combine sport with discovering the region.
course_highlights: Start in Klášterec nad Ohří
Event hub at the Fénix restaurant in Měděnec
Runners transported by bus to the start
additional: The event hub and registration are at the Fénix restaurant in the village of Měděnec. At 10:15, runners are taken by bus to the start in Klášterec nad Ohří. The course runs mainly over off-road terrain in the Ore Mountains. The race includes bus transport from Měděnec to the start, refreshments along the course and at the finish, and the option to change at the Fénix restaurant at the finish.

name: VC Krkonoš Horní Maršov - Pomezní Boudy
location: Horní Maršov, Trutnov District, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: VC Krkonoš Horní Maršov - Pomezní Boudy is a mountain trail race with 540 metres of elevation gain. It starts in Horní Maršov and finishes at the former customs house on Pomezní sedlo at an altitude of 1,050 m above sea level. The challenging 13.6 km course is suited to runners who enjoy mountain challenges. A cross-country race is also organised for children and young people, making the event accessible to a wider public. The organiser, Jiří Kostadinov, ensures the event runs smoothly.
course_highlights: Mountain trail race with 540 metres of elevation gain
Finish at the former customs house on Pomezní sedlo at an altitude of 1,050 m above sea level
Course length: 13.6 km
additional: A cross-country race is organised for children and young people. The race is part of the Czech Athletics Federation’s services for runners and running. The start is at Bertholdovo náměstí in Horní Maršov. The event also includes a cross-country race for children and young people and is part of the national mountain-running series, with the possibility of qualifying for European competitions.

20% asphalt
Two races: 10 km run and 6.5 km accompanying run

It is open to various age categories and offers an opportunity to enjoy sport and meet runners from the region. Results from previous editions are regularly published on the school’s official website.

A tradition and a friendly atmosphere at a local sporting gathering

The start is on Hlavná Street in Košice, giving the race a historic atmosphere and support from local spectators.

Race-pack collection takes place the day before the start and on race day, with a mass start at 7:00 a.m.

Live checkpoints at refreshment stations

The start and finish are at the parking lot next to Hviezda cinema in Turňa nad Bodvou. Electronic timing records arrivals at checkpoints and the finish. 57 km course, 12-hour time limit, registration on 24–25 April, refreshment stations, mandatory equipment, men’s and women’s categories, part of the Slovak Ultratrail League.

name: Demänovský Štvanec

The event is part of a weekend full of movement, games and fun, organized by WinTeam o.z. and Agentúra 8P in cooperation with Demänová Resort.

Choose between the half-marathon and 10K courses
The route passes through the Rača borough in a pleasant urban setting

The course includes city streets. Online registration is available, and the event features an accompanying programme of music and performances.

name: Beh oslobodenia Chtelnice
description: The Chtelnica Liberation Run is a traditional race with an unchanged route. It starts at 1. mája Square and passes through the picturesque surroundings of the Little Carpathians. The course combines asphalt sections with a forest path running past the Chtelnica Reservoir, a memorial to those who fell in World War II, and the Chapel of St. Roch. Runners can enjoy natural scenery and challenges such as the legendary steep climb on the forest section. The event is suited to runners looking for a mix of asphalt and natural terrain in peaceful mountain surroundings.

description: The Bodice Liberation Run is a traditional running race held in Bodice, a district of the city of Liptovský Mikuláš, with its hub at the Bodice Cultural Centre. The race also serves as the Slovak Forest Running Championships and offers categories for children, youth, juniors, women and men across various age groups. The children’s race starts at 9:00, the youth and adult races at 10:25, and the main men’s category at 11:30. The event is organised by Bežecký klub Bodice and Olympijský klub Liptova, offering a quality sporting experience in pleasant surroundings.
course_highlights: Slovak Forest Running Championships
Race held in Bodice, a district of Liptovský Mikuláš
Bodice Cultural Centre serves as the start and finish
additional: The children’s race starts at 9:00, the youth and adult races at 10:25, and the men’s A, B and C categories start at 11:30. Štefan Ganoczy, PhD, tel.: 0905 522 651, 044/5549058. City run, categories for children, youth and adults, various age groups, start from 9:00.

name: JAK
description: The Jan Amos Komenský Operational Programme (OP JAK) supports the development of research, development and education in the Czech Republic, aiming to strengthen strategic intelligence, innovation and the modernisation of teaching methods. The programme focuses on supporting leading research teams, internationalisation and the development of the institutional environment of research organisations. OP JAK also emphasises equal opportunities and developing individuals’ potential, contributing to greater competitiveness for the Czech Republic and improved living conditions for its residents. The programme’s calls are open to projects with a nationwide impact in research, development and innovation (RDI) and education.
course_highlights: Held in Prague 4, Prague
Promotes a healthy lifestyle and community spirit
Open to the general public
additional: Applications for support are submitted through the IS KP21+ application from 3 April 2025 to 1 June 2026 at 14:00. The Managing Authority of OP JAK is the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sports, with contact addresses in Prague 1 and Prague 9. A consultation helpline for OP JAK templates offers telephone support every working day from 9:00 to 15:00. Harfa Office Park is wheelchair accessible and has a lift. A contact form is also available for enquiries. The race is part of a wider programme focused on supporting research, development and education in the Czech Republic, with an emphasis on community involvement and a healthy lifestyle.

description: Přeštická desítka is a traditional running race in Přeštice, taking place for the tenth time in 2026. The race offers a fast, flat 10-kilometre course on soft terrain along the Úhlava River, ideal for everyone from competitive runners to recreational athletes. The event also includes shorter 5-kilometre races and children’s categories, so there is something for the whole running community. The facilities at the Loděnice complex provide comfortable amenities, including a buffet, changing rooms and showers. Přeštická desítka is part of the Plzeň Region Running Cup and promises a friendly atmosphere and a great sporting experience.
course_highlights: Fast, flat 10 km course along the Úhlava River
Soft terrain ideal for running
Categories for adults, children and a 5 km Fit Run
additional: Facilities at the Loděnice complex include an open buffet, heated changing rooms, hot showers and toilets. Runners do not have to return their race bibs. The race takes place in all weather conditions. The organiser may use photographs and video footage for promotional purposes without compensation. The event includes 10 km and 5 km races. Registration is available online or on site; the start is at 10:30, with registration from 9:00. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Running Cup.

The route passes through the picturesque České středohoří region and challenges runners with off-road terrain and natural obstacles. The event is suitable for all runners who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and the beauty of the surrounding landscape.

A 6666-metre route
Picturesque views and natural obstacles

Results from previous editions are available on the website. The race offers a cross-country course, registration information, the date and time of the event, and is part of a race series with the option to take part in other disciplines and an after-party.

The event starts in the grounds in front of the elementary school, while the main categories set off from Martinák. After the race, runners can shower and use the valuables storage. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and tradition, attracting runners of all ages.

It is part of the SABZO series and attracts runners looking to enjoy a run in a natural setting with a historic atmosphere. The race is suitable for the general public and offers an opportunity to test your strength in a beautiful park with a rich history.

Two distances: 6.6 km for men and 3.3 km for women
Part of the SABZO running series

description: The Luboš Svoboda Memorial – Vysočina Runner’s Prize is a traditional running race held in Heulos Forest Park in Jihlava. The race offers various distances for all age groups, from the youngest children to veterans, with the main 8.8 km course for men, juniors, and veterans. The course follows paved and unpaved paths through the forest park, with scenic sections along the Jihlávka River and around the athletics stadium. The race also honors the memory of Luboš Svoboda, a prominent runner from the Vysočina region.

The main course runs along the left bank of the Jihlávka River and crosses footbridges near the ZOO and athletics stadium
Paved surfaces make up approximately 25% of the course
additional: The start takes place at the summer cinema venue in Heulos, Jihlava. Changing rooms and toilets are available beneath the cinema screen. Runners aged 3 and older may take part. Categories are divided by age, with distances ranging from 350 m for the youngest participants to 8.8 km for adults and veterans. A season entry pass can be used. The race is part of the Vysočina Runner series, which promotes an active lifestyle and sporting opportunities in the region. The start is scheduled between 17:15 and 17:30 at the summer cinema venue in Jihlava.

name: Běh na Doubravku
description: The Run to Doubravka is a traditional running race held at Doubravka Castle in Teplice as part of Sports Day at Doubravka. The course is 5,100 metres long with 170 metres of elevation gain and follows a forest trail. The race is open to the general public and offers an opportunity to celebrate spring through sport and fun. Diplomas are awarded to the top three in each category, winners receive a trophy, and the fastest team receives a perpetual trophy. The event also features a cultural programme and other sporting activities.
course_highlights: A 5,100 m course with 170 m of elevation gain
The course surface is a forest trail
Part of Sports Day at Doubravka Castle

The event is part of the wider Sports Day at Doubravka, which also includes a cultural programme and other sporting disciplines. The race includes category awards and prizes for the top runners, and in the past it has also had virtual editions during the COVID-19 pandemic.

Hilly terrain on the slope of Karlov

After the race, there will be a results ceremony, a get-together and refreshments for participants. The event is organized by KERMI in cooperation with the Stříbro Endurance Runners Association, which supports amateur athletes and runners in the region.

The event is part of the Ešus League, a series of off-track races in the Klatovy District, and is suitable for the general public looking to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and nature.

The race is part of the Ešus League, a series of off-track races in the Klatovy District

The event includes various races, including the main race and a children’s race, and is part of the local sports calendar. The run is known for its tradition and friendly atmosphere.

The organizers welcome both new runners and experienced athletes looking for a quality running experience.

A traditional running event with a friendly atmosphere

description: Boskovice Runs is a major sporting event in the region, offering routes of varying lengths for all age groups, including children. The main race, the Run for the Seven-Toothed Ridge, is 12.5 km long and features two long forest sections. The event is not only a sporting competition but also a social occasion that promotes a healthy lifestyle and a family-friendly atmosphere. It also includes a varied accompanying program and, new this year, a team race for teams of three. Walkers can join in and enjoy a shared day of activity and fun.

Two long forest sections on the main course
Children’s races for all age groups

The event includes various races, including children’s races, team races and the main race, and takes place in the South Moravian Region on May 1, 2026.

name: Vrcholy
description: The Peaks of the Czech Mountains are a unique collectible challenge for all nature lovers and outdoor adventurers. This sticker set features the 25 highest peaks of the Czech mountains and ranges, which you can stick on your bottle as a reminder of your trips and achievements. Each sticker is hand-drawn and inspired by real peaks, and made from durable material with UV protection and water resistance to withstand even demanding conditions. This collection is ideal for anyone who wants to carry an original, personal touch of adventure with them wherever they go.
course_highlights: The 25 highest peaks of the Czech mountains and ranges
Hand-drawn and exclusively designed stickers
High-quality materials with UV protection and water resistance
additional: The stickers are water-resistant and have strong adhesive that holds on a variety of surfaces, even in adverse conditions. They are protected against fading by UV lamination. Some stickers are also dishwasher-safe.

The race is part of the Pohár Ladova kraje running series and welcomes a wide range of runners, including children, juniors, adults, and veterans. The start and race facilities are at Hliněný rybník, where accompanying races for the youngest age groups are also held. The main race is 7.4 km long and follows one loop along the nature trail. The race is made possible by the support of volunteers, local associations, and partners.

Accompanying races for children and juniors around the pond

Race distances include the 7.4 km main race and children’s races of 200 m, 620 m, and 1860 m.

description: The PM Consulting Choceň Half Marathon is a 21.1 km running race along forest roads between Choceň and Horní Jelení. The course follows good-quality forest roads with gravel and some asphalt, making it suitable for running on light terrain. In addition to the half marathon, shorter 10 km and 5 km routes are available, suitable for juniors, veterans and anyone who wants to experience the race atmosphere. Race facilities are located at the swimming pool complex in Choceň, where medical services are also provided. The event is open to the general sporting public and takes place in all weather conditions.

description: The Run for the Memory of Nations in Chomutov is a sporting and community event held to support the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the lives of people who witnessed historical events and helps preserve their stories. The race takes place on May 1, 2026, at Wakepark Chomutov and offers a timed 5 km run and an untimed 1 km family run. The course follows a flat cycle path around the Banda reservoir and through Otvice, finishing in the car park by Banda. The event is suitable for all ages and promotes endurance and remembrance of freedom fighters.

Turnaround in the village of Otvice, followed by a return along the same route
Start and finish by Aquasvět and the car park by Banda
additional: Registration and race-bib collection are open from 8:30 to 9:45 for the 1 km run and until 10:30 for the 5 km run. Storage, restroom facilities, water at the finish, and refreshments are available. DJ Lukáš Budai will provide the music. Pupils, students under 18, members of the Memory of Nations Club, and runners over 65 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. The start is scheduled for 08:30. Registration is available online and on site; the event includes refreshments, bag storage, and music.
