name: Nieder Erlenbacher Volkslauf
location: Nieder-Erlenbach, Frankfurt am Main, Hesse, Germany

name: Behaj lesmi – Smolenice
description: Behaj lesmi Smolenice is part of a series of seven races set in beautiful Slovak nature, offering routes that run mostly on soft terrain and in fresh air. The race is included in the UTMB Index Races, which means it receives an international trail-running score. The routes pass below Smolenice Castle, where themed characters cheer on the runners and create a unique atmosphere. You can compete on two main routes—12 km and 19 km—with a Conti Speed Section on the course offering a valuable prize.
course_highlights: Routes run 80% on soft terrain in nature
A 150-metre Conti Speed Section
A race below Smolenice Castle with a themed atmosphere
additional: The race includes a Conti Speed Section marked with Continental flags, where you can win a €200 voucher and a running shirt. The routes are marked and run mostly through nature, with elevation gain. The event also includes Dr. Max children’s races. Distances include 6 km, 12 km and 19 km. Registration discounts are available for multiple race starts. The event takes place in the attractive surroundings of Smolenice Castle and is part of a trail-race series held throughout Slovakia.

name: Tlmačský polmaratón

price_tiers.distance: Hobby beh a nordic walking 3,5 km

description: The Tlmače Half Marathon and 10K is a traditional running race held in the town of Tlmače. This 43rd edition offers a 21 km half-marathon course and a 10K, as well as a 3.5 km hobby run and Nordic walking. The event is part of the Patriots Running League and is organized by the town of Tlmače together with local sports clubs. Runners can enjoy high-quality organization, electronic timing, and race packs with promotional items and a meal voucher.
course_highlights: A 21 km half-marathon course and a 10K in the town of Tlmače
Part of the Patriots Running League
A 3.5 km hobby run and Nordic walking
additional: Race packs include a race number, sports and promotional items, and a meal voucher. Electronic timing is provided by SunBell s.r.o. using chips attached to race numbers. Online registration is open until 30.4.2026, or participants can register on site on race day. Registrations are valid once the entry fee has been paid. On-site registration fees can be paid in cash only. The event also includes children’s races, Nordic walking, and an accompanying program. It also features an awards ceremony and results on VysledkovyServis.sk.

name: Tlmačský polmaraton (10 km)
organizer: Mesto Tlmače, MsKS Tlmače, ZŠ a MŠ Tlmače, Atletický klub mesta Tlmače
price_range: 15,- € to 20,- € online, 20,- € na mieste; detské behy zdarma

price_tiers.distance: Hobby beh a nordic walking 3,5 km

description: The Tlmače Half Marathon is a traditional running race in the town of Tlmače, offering a 21.1 km half-marathon course and a 10 km run for recreational runners. The race takes place on 2 May 2026, with the adults’ start at 10:00 and the children’s start at 9:00. It is organised by the Town of Tlmače, MsKS Tlmače, ZŠ a MŠ Tlmače, and the Tlmače Town Athletics Club. Runners receive a race bib, sports and promotional items, and a lunch voucher. The event also includes a 3.5 km hobby run and Nordic walking, as well as free children’s races.
course_highlights: 21.1 km half-marathon course
10 km run for recreational runners
3.5 km hobby run and Nordic walking
additional: Participants in the half marathon and 10 km run receive a pack containing a race bib, sports and promotional items, and a lunch voucher. Children’s races are free. The children’s start is at 9:00 and the adults’ start is at 10:00. The course includes road running. Registration is available online and on site. The races start at 10:00 for adults, 9:58 for handbikes, and 9:00 for children. The event also includes an accompanying programme.

name: Jarný charitatívny beh Nitra
organizer: Mgr. Lukáš Čelinák, Rotary klub Nitra Harmony
description: The Nitra Spring Charity Run is a community sporting event that brings together exercise, solidarity, and support for healthcare in the city of Nitra. It raises funds for the emergency department of Nitra University Hospital and is organized by Rotary Club Nitra Harmony together with the Oktoberfest Run Nitra team. The event offers several race distances, including 10 km, 5 km, and 1.2 km, and participants can also enter as a team. Runners can contribute to the charitable cause while enjoying the sporting atmosphere in Nitra.
course_highlights: The course runs around Nitra University Hospital
Race distances: 10 km, 5 km, and 1.2 km
Team competition for companies, clubs, and communities
additional: Companies, clubs, and communities can enter the team competition. The best team is determined by the combined times of its three fastest runners. A charity run focused on community, health, and solidarity; the event supports healthcare workers and the public.

name: Ivachnovský beh pre všetkých
location: Futbalové ihrisko obce Ivachnová, Ivachnová, Slovakia
organizer: Cyklo - turistický oddiel obce Ivachnová a Kúria Ivachnová
description: Ivachnová Run for Everyone is a sporting event for all age groups, taking place on May 2, 2026, at the sports grounds of the football pitch in Ivachnová. It is organized by the Cyklo-turistický oddiel obce Ivachnová in cooperation with KÚRIA Ivachnová. Runners can choose from several categories, including 5,000 m for men, women and juniors, 10,000 m for men and women, as well as shorter runs for preschoolers, primary school pupils and seniors. The course follows a farm track and paved road, with a flat profile in the village of Ivachnová. Online registration is open until May 1, 2026, at 12:00, or in person on race day.
course_highlights: The course follows a farm track and paved road
Flat course profile in the village of Ivachnová
Several categories for all age groups
additional: The 5,000 m race for men, women and juniors starts at 13:00; the 10,000 m race for men and women starts at 14:00; and the races for preschoolers, primary school pupils and seniors start from 15:30. The organizer reserves the right to change category start times depending on organizational requirements. Payment can be made on site on the day of registration. The event will not take place in adverse weather. The event is held at the football pitch in Ivachnová. Participants can enter different categories, including children, juniors, men and women; registration is available online and on site.

name: Sklené sa hýbe
location: Futbalové ihrisko, Sklené, Turčianske Teplice, Slovakia
description: Sklené is on the Move is a running event held at the football field in Sklené, Turčianske Teplice District. Runners can choose from three courses of varying lengths and elevation gains: a half marathon (21.5 km, 740 m+), 14 km (420 m+) and 8 km (320 m+). Children’s activities are also available alongside the main race categories. The main races start at 10:30, and the children’s races begin at 10:45. The event is part of the Run Through Three Regions and Run Through Two Regions series.
course_highlights: Half marathon with 740 m elevation gain
14 km course with 420 m elevation gain
8 km course with 320 m elevation gain
additional: Children’s activities start at 10:45. Entry fees differ for online registration and payment on site. The event takes place at the football field in Sklené, Turčianske Teplice District. The event also includes Martin’s off-road activity; registration is available online and on site, and the course covers varied terrain, including the football field.

name: Plesnivec VerticalRun

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: po vyplnení registračného formulára a prevode 17 eur

description: Plesnivec VerticalRun is a 5 km mountain race with 530 metres of elevation gain, taking place on 2 May 2026 in Tatranská Kotlina, near the Plesnivec chalet. Runners will take on a challenging vertical course that tests their fitness and endurance. Registration is online, and runners are added to the start list once the entry fee has been paid. The event is suitable for all mountain-running enthusiasts looking for a challenge in beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: 5 km course with 530 metres of elevation gain
Challenging vertical course profile
Start near the Plesnivec chalet in Tatranská Kotlina
additional: Online registration opens on 1 April 2026. After completing the registration form and paying the entry fee, runners are added to the start list. Organiser contact: Ján Matava, tel.: +421944132176. Online registration from 1 April 2026; the course includes a vertical climb; location: Tatranská Kotlina

name: Beh oslobodenia obce Budča
description: The Budča Liberation Run is a traditional running race held in the village of Budča to commemorate its liberation. The main race is 8.4 km long with 232 metres of elevation gain and follows a route around the village on forest roads and asphalt, starting and finishing by the municipal office. The event also includes children’s categories with shorter courses adapted to the runners’ ages, as well as the “Ride for Health” category, open to everyone regardless of age or ability. The race is part of the Zvolen Running League and offers electronic timing, refreshments and medals for participants.
course_highlights: A loop around the village of Budča through the forest areas of Kremenný Jarok and Sietno
The main race is 8.4 km long with 232 m of elevation gain
A refreshment station at approximately the 4 km mark
additional: The children’s categories start at 10:15, and the “Ride for Health” category starts at 12:05. Runners permanently resident in Budča do not pay an entry fee. The entry fee includes a race bib, electronic chip timing, refreshments at the finish, a participant puzzle medal and prizes for the top three in each category. Registration is available online until 26.4.2024 or in person on race day from 9:00 until half an hour before the start. The race takes place in May. Registration is available online or on site, and the “Ride for Health” category is free of charge.

name: Mistrovství ČR v maratonu mužů a žen
description: The Czech Republic Men’s and Women’s Marathon Championships is a prestigious race over the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km, held in Prague’s historic city centre, starting in Old Town Square. The race is for men and women over 18 who met the qualifying standards in previous years. It is organised by Juniorský maratonský klub, z.s. in cooperation with RunCzech. Runners can use modern timing services, and a professional photography service is available after the race. The start is traditionally at 08:00 in the morning.
course_highlights: Start and finish in historic Old Town Square in Prague
A 42.195 km route through central Prague
Professional timing and the option to download the GPX route
additional: The race office is open on 1 and 2 May 2026 at the Výstaviště exhibition grounds in Holešovice, in the Křižík Pavilions. Photography is provided by witisi.photo, with the option to pre-order during registration or order after the race. Applications are accepted only from runners who met the qualifying standards between 1 January 2025 and the registration deadline. Participation is subject to the qualifying standards and approval by the technical delegate. The available information relates to the 2025 and 2026 editions, not to the date 9 May 2027.

name: Barvám Neutečeš České Budějovice
location: Sokolský ostrov, České Budějovice, Czech Republic
description: Barvám Neutečeš is a colourful run and a full day of fun for all ages, families and friends, held on Sokolský Island in České Budějovice. Choose between two routes: 5 km with five colour zones, or 1.5 km with three colour zones and an interactive sports zone. It’s not about speed, but about joy, friendship and unforgettable experiences filled with colour, music and fun. Come and enjoy a day of laughter, dancing and shared energy, where nobody can escape the colours.
course_highlights: 5 km route with 5 colour zones
1.5 km route with 3 colour zones and an interactive sports zone
The colour zones cover runners from head to toe in colour
additional: The event runs from 9:00 to 16:00 on Sokolský Island. It includes musical performances, themed zones, photo booths, 360° video and an accompanying programme. The event is suitable for everyone, regardless of ability; children can take part on shoulders, scooters or in strollers. It takes place on 3 May 2026 on Sokolský Island in České Budějovice. Registration is available both on site and online, with different packages for individuals, teams and corporate participants. The event also has a charitable aspect and various accompanying city activities.

name: Běh na 2 míle, Zlín – Příluky
location: Průmyslová zóna Příluky, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: The 2 Miles Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt loop. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and a 9:00 start. At the finish, each participant is rewarded for their effort with a warm cinnamon pancake.
course_highlights: A precisely measured asphalt loop of just under two laps
The course runs mostly among gardens in the industrial zone
The children’s course is 800 metres long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 to 127, and children up to 12; age categories apply for the entire calendar year. Every runner is timed, and the top three finishers in the men’s, women’s and children’s categories receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get to the start are by bicycle, on foot, by car, on roller skates or by trolleybus No. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). The race takes place every month, registration is voluntary, a warm cinnamon pancake is served at the finish, the course is precisely measured and suitable for runners of all abilities.

name: Prague International Marathon 2026
description: The Prague International Marathon 2026 is a prestigious running event held in Prague’s historic city centre. The race offers a traditional 42.195 km marathon course that passes iconic city landmarks. The running weekend also includes accompanying races for families and children, creating a welcoming atmosphere for all age groups. The start is scheduled for May 3, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. in Old Town Square.
course_highlights: The course runs through Prague’s historic city centre, with views of its landmarks
Start and finish in Old Town Square
A measured 42.195 km marathon distance
additional: The running weekend also includes the Active Breakfast Run (4.2 km), the dm Family Mile (1.609 km) and the dm bambini run (children’s races of 100–200 m). Runners can use the RunCzech mobile app for race information and a virtual race pack. The race is part of the RunCzech running league and offers special categories, including the Czech Marathon Championships for men and women. The 42.195 km race starts on Sunday, May 3, 2026, at 8:00 a.m.; registration also includes other events such as the Active Breakfast Run, the dm Family Mile and the dm bambini run.

name: Běh 2 míle Olomouc
description: The Olomouc 2 Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The race takes place in the picturesque Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, where everyone can enjoy running for fun and competing primarily against themselves. It also includes a cup competition, with results adjusted using an age coefficient and runners collecting points throughout the year. Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:00. The top three finishers in each category receive awards.
course_highlights: Race in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, by the fountain
Course length: 2 miles (3.2 km); children’s course: 600 m
Friendly atmosphere for runners of all abilities and ages
additional: Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:00. The race venue is by the fountain in Smetana Gardens, except for two races in June and August, which take place by the river on U Dětského domova Street. Results are adjusted using an age coefficient, and runners collect points for the cup competition covering September 2025–August 2026. The race includes categories for all age groups, with awards for the best finishers in each category; the course runs through Smetana Gardens and by the river, and registration is from 9:30 to 10:00.

name: ORLEN Maraton Praha, MČR v maratonu mužů a žen
description: The ORLEN Prague Marathon is a prestigious race held in Prague’s historic center and also serves as the Czech Republic Marathon Championships for men and women. It traditionally covers the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km, starting in Old Town Square. The race attracts thousands of runners and offers a unique atmosphere with beautiful views of Prague’s landmarks. It is part of the RunCzech Running League and is known for its professional organization and support for the running community.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Old Town Square, Prague
The route passes through Prague’s historic center, with views of its landmarks
Classic marathon distance of 42.195 km
additional: The marathon weekend also includes accompanying races such as the ORLEN active breakfast (4.2 km), dm family mile (1.609 km), and dm bambini run (children’s races of 100–200 m). The race pack and further information are available in the RunCzech mobile app. The race is part of the RunCzech Running League and offers support for runners, including insurance and race transfers. It includes various categories, including relays and accompanying races, and is a major sporting event with international participation. The route is challenging but offers a unique running experience in Prague’s historic setting.

name: Sparkassenlauf und Wandertag TuS Bergen von 1867 e.V.
Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 4. kolo
description: The 2 Mile Run Bratislava is a regular 2-mile (3.218 km) race held at the Kuchajda swimming complex in Bratislava. It is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team and is open to the general public, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place at the venue on race day from 9:30, with the start at 10:00. The race is part of a series in which runners earn points toward a traveling cup based on their categories and performances.
course_highlights: A 2-mile (3.218 km) course at the Kuchajda swimming complex
Race check-in and registration by the volleyball court
Categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans
additional: Registration takes place at the venue on race day from 9:30. In the event of a tie in the competition, the best time after applying a coefficient decides the result, followed by shoe size. Competitors can earn an extra point by improving their best time of the year. At the end of the year, the two worst months are removed from the overall results (amnesty). The race takes place on a public road in the Kuchajda area of Bratislava; categories include children, juniors, women, men, and veterans; on-site registration is also available.

name: Beh 2 míle
description: The 2-Mile Run in Bratislava at Kuchajda is a regular 2-mile (3.218 km) race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team. Check-in and registration take place on site by the volleyball court from 9:30, with the start at 10:00. The race is open to various age categories, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. It is part of the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Traveling Trophy, with finishing times adjusted using age coefficients and runners awarded points based on participation and performance.
course_highlights: A 2-mile (3.218 km) course in the Kuchajda swimming pool grounds
Check-in and start by the volleyball court
Categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans
additional: Registration takes place on site by the volleyball court from 9:30. The Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Traveling Trophy awards points based on participation and performance, with the option to disregard the two worst participations of the year. In the event of a tie, age and the best time that year determine the result. The race takes place at the Kuchajda swimming pool grounds in Bratislava, with registration from 9:30 and the start at 10:00. The Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Traveling Trophy competition is scored based on points and times, with categories for various age groups.

name: Stropkovská dvadsiatka
description: Stropkovská Dvadsiatka is a traditional road race with a rich history dating back to 1977, held in the town of Stropkov. The course passes through several villages and gives runners the opportunity to compete over a distance of 20 km, with refreshments along the route and at the finish. The event is organised by Klub Bežcov Stropkov, which supports the development of running in the region. Runners can expect good organisation, race packs, and the opportunity to recover after the race at the indoor swimming pool. The race is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Regional Running League.
course_highlights: The route passes through the villages of Stropkov; refreshments are available at 5 km, 11 km, 16 km, and 19 km.
Finish at Námestie SNP in Stropkov, with refreshments and the option to recover at the indoor swimming pool.
A 20 km road race with a rich history dating back to 1977.
additional: Online registration is open from 01.03.2026 to 30.04.2026. On-site registration is available until 10:30 on race day. The first 150 participants who register and pay the entry fee in full will receive a complete race pack, including a medal. The event is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Regional Running League. After the race, showers and recovery facilities are available at the indoor swimming pool by ZŠ Konštantínova ul. from 12:30. Event date: 3 May 2026; Location: Námestie SNP, Stropkov. The event includes categories for different age groups and activities such as Nordic walking and barefoot running.

name: Stropkovská desiatka a  I. ročník Barefoot
location: Námestie SNP v Stropkove, Stropkov, Slovakia
description: The Stropkov 10K and the 1st Barefoot edition are part of the traditional road races in Stropkov, which have a rich history dating back to 1977. The event is organised by the Stropkov Runners Club to support running in the region and across Slovakia. Runners can expect well-prepared courses and an atmosphere created each year by hundreds of fans and runners. In addition to the main race, the programme includes a barefoot run, offering participants a new experience.
course_highlights: Road race courses with a rich history dating back to 1977
Courses lined with fans in Stropkov and the surrounding area
The programme also includes a new barefoot run (Barefoot)
additional: The event includes several running disciplines on the same day: the Stropkov 20, Stropkov 10 and 10 Barefoot, Stropkov 5 and 5 Nordic Walking, and the Children's Run for Mum. All main races start at 11:00 at SNP Square in Stropkov. The event offers races over 5 km, 10 km and 20 km, with an emphasis on sporting experiences and a community atmosphere.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Řevnice
location: Pivovar Řevnice, Řevnice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 240 Kč (voucher na 12 závodů), 316 Kč (voucher na 6 závodů)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 240 Kč (v rámci voucheru na celou sérii 12 závodů)

description: The Berounka running series in Řevnice is part of a traditional race series held in the picturesque surroundings of the Central Bohemian Region. The route runs mainly along a green educational trail, with beautiful views of the surrounding fields, meadows, and forests. It includes two long climbs, passing through the Forest Theatre and by Píšťák Pond. The start and finish are at the Řevnice Brewery, where refreshments and bag storage are available. The race is suitable for runners who want to enjoy nature and the community atmosphere of the running series.
course_highlights: The route runs mainly along a green educational trail marked in red and white
Two long climbs, including a section through the Forest Theatre and up to Píšťák Pond
Views of the surrounding fields, meadows, and forests, with the return route passing the cemetery and Havlíčkovy sady Park
additional: Registration is available online and on site from 17:00; arrival by 17:30 is recommended. Refreshments and bag storage are available on site. Diplomas are awarded to the top three finishers in each category. The race follows a natural-surface course. On-site registration is available, and the event includes race numbers, refreshments, and awards for the best in each category.

name: Charity-Lauf des PSV Grün-Weiß Kassel e. V.
Jarní kros Písařova
location: Tatran Písařov, Písařov, Olomoucký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Spring Cross-Country Race in Písařov is a traditional running event organized by SK Pašerák in the village of Písařov. It is part of the CHLAPÁK district running competition and is open to the general public, including children. The event takes place at the Tatran Písařov sports field and offers a sporting experience in a friendly atmosphere. SK Pašerák has a long-standing commitment to organizing sports activities for children and young people in the region.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the Tatran Písařov sports field
Part of the CHLAPÁK district running competition
A traditional spring cross-country race in the village of Písařov
additional: The race takes place on Wednesday, May 6, 2026, from 5 p.m. at the Tatran Písařov sports field. It is organized by SK Pašerák, which also organizes the Children’s Cup, a series of races for children in various sports. The race is scheduled for May 6, 2026. The event is in Czech and supports an active lifestyle among young people in the region.

name: Běh lesoparkem Praha Hostivař
description: The Prague Hostivař Forest Park Run is a trail race offering two course options: 3.5 km for women and 7 km for men. The race takes place in the scenic Hostivař Forest Park in Prague 10 and is part of the SABZO series. It is suitable for anyone who wants to enjoy running in nature, with gentle elevation and a pleasant atmosphere. The race is ideal for trail-running enthusiasts and offers the chance to compete against other runners in the beautiful Hostivař forest.
course_highlights: Trail course in Hostivař Forest Park
Two distances: 3.5 km for women and 7 km for men
Part of the SABZO series
additional: Registration costs 50 Kč; members of TJ Zentiva and SABZO can enter for free. The race takes place in Prague 10-Hostivař, near the gazebo by the children's playground in Hostivař Forest Park.

name: Žďárák – Čerňák
location: Čerňák, Žďár nad Sázavou, Vysočina, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné: 50 Kč (startovné bude opět věnováno na dobročinnou sbírku, tentokrát pro Charitu, která podpoří Alexe Vondru, studenta ze Žďáru, který přišel o ruku a potřebuje peníze na sportovní protézu.)

description: Čerňák is a trail race along the paths of the Black Forest around Zelená hora and across meadows towards Vysoké. The 7 km route with 180 m of elevation gain features varied terrain, with 90% off-road and 10% asphalt, reminiscent of Scottish fellrunning races. The race is popular with local runners and offers beautiful views of the town of Žďár nad Sázavou and the UNESCO-listed Pilgrimage Church of St John of Nepomuk on Zelená hora. The start and finish are by the car park at the church on Zelená hora. The entry fee goes to a charity fundraiser for a sports prosthesis for student Alex Vondra.
course_highlights: 7 km trail race with 180 m of elevation gain
The route follows paths through the Black Forest and meadows towards Vysoké
A final climb up the steps to the UNESCO-listed church on Zelená hora
additional: Start and finish by the car park at the church on Zelená hora. Trail shoes are recommended. The entry fee goes to a charity fundraiser for a sports prosthesis. The route is marked. Race photos are available online. Events include trail, cross-country, road, gravel and MTB disciplines; registration and exact routes are listed on the website.

name: Noční běh pro Světlušku České Budějovice
location: České Budějovice, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Noční běh pro Světlušku České Budějovice

price_tiers.distance: Noční běh pro Světlušku České Budějovice

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: The Night Run for Světluška in České Budějovice is a charity running event taking place on 6 May 2026, starting at 21:00 by the sports hall near Stromovka. Participants can choose between two distances—2.3 km (1 lap) and 4.6 km (2 laps)—and the event is suitable both for runners and for those who would like to walk the course. The entry fee is 500 Kč, half of which goes directly to support people with severe visual impairments. The event offers race packs with a headlamp or a sports headband, as well as an accompanying programme including a concert by the band Byt číslo 4.
course_highlights: Night run with a choice of 2.3 km or 4.6 km courses
Start and finish by the sports hall near Stromovka in České Budějovice
Charity run supporting people with severe visual impairments
additional: Registration desks open at 19:00. Capacity is limited for participants’ safety and comfort. Race packs are available in two versions—with a headlamp or a sports headband. Holders of TP, ZTP and ZTP/P cards who are accompanied by someone can enter for free; they can purchase a race pack on site for 250 Kč. An admission ticket with a unique code, either printed or on a mobile device, is required to enter the venue. The programme includes a concert by the band Byt číslo 4 from 20:00. Distances of 2.3 km or 4.6 km, accompanying programme, benefits for the Světluška project, registration via GoOut.cz, tickets with a code, holders of ZTP and ZTP/P cards enter for free

name: RHEIN-VOLKSLAUF Maximiliansau
location: Maximiliansau, Wörth am Rhein, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany

name: Lauf um den Allendorfer Bahnhof – Volksbank Sauerland Lauf Cup
VSE City run Košice
price_range: 3 EUR (pre deti, študentov, seniorov, PWD), ďalšie dary prijímané

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deti, študenti, dôchodcovia a ZŤP osoby: 3 EUR

description: VSE City Run in Košice is a 4 km charity run taking place on 7 May 2026. The event is open to the general public, including children, students, seniors and people with disabilities. Entry fees are donated to support the Platform of Families of Children with Disabilities. The run takes place in the centre of Košice and is known for its inclusive atmosphere and community spirit. The organisers work with the Košice Marathon Club and other partners. The event aims not only to promote sport but also to help families with children with disabilities.
course_highlights: 4 km course in the centre of Košice
Charity run with an inclusive character
Support for families of children with disabilities
additional: Entry fees are paid in cash on the day of the run when race numbers are handed out, from 14:00. Participants under 12 must run accompanied by an adult. Groups can use the online Google form to register together. The programme also includes the VSE City Run Walk at 16:30. The event offers a charity run and the option to register in person or online; the programme includes both a walk and the main run, and proceeds support children with disabilities.

name: Mistrovství ČR v silničním běhu na 1 míli a 5 km mužů a žen
description: The Czech Road Running Championships for men and women over 1 mile and 5 km take place in the beautiful surroundings of the spa park in Poděbrady. The course is very fast, with no elevation gain and precisely measured 1 km laps along the spa colonnade, offering ideal conditions for personal records. The race is officially recognized by the Czech Athletics Federation and is part of the prestigious Poděbrady Walking program. The event also features an accompanying program and the chance to receive an original finisher’s medal featuring the spa fountain.
course_highlights: 5 km race over five 1 km laps along the spa colonnade
1 mile race featuring an opening 609 m section and a 1 km lap along the spa colonnade
Very fast, flat course certified for the European Race Walking Championships
additional: Registration is available online only, with payment due within 7 days of registering. Late registrations will have no name printed on the race bib. On-site registration is available until 30 minutes before the race starts. Registration can be transferred free of charge until 21.4.2026; a fee applies after that date. Finisher’s medal featuring the spa fountain. Accompanying program throughout the day along the spa colonnade. Available information about the program, registration, and prices applies to the 2026 edition; details for the date 14. 5. 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Běh vítězství Jihlava – Třešť
price_range: 150 Kč online, 200 Kč na místě pro dospělé; zdarma pro mládež do 17 let online, 50 Kč na místě
description: The Jihlava–Třešť Victory Run is an annual running event held on May 8, 2026, offering various race categories for adults, juniors, and children. The route runs from Jihlava to Třešť and includes both road sections and forest trails, with the main race covering 14.6 km. The event is part of the Vysočina Running Cup and offers not only sporting experiences but also prizes and in-kind awards for the winners. Registration is available online, and the race is suitable for a broad range of participants, including young people and children.
course_highlights: Main 14.6 km route from Jihlava to Třešť on roads and forest trails
Categories for different age groups, including children and young people
Part of the Vysočina Running Cup, with online registration available
additional: The route includes paved roads and forest trails; the race starts at approximately 8:45–9:45; race categories are available for children and young people; winners receive prizes and in-kind awards; refreshments and showers are provided.

name: Běh vítězství zámeckým parkem Lány
location: Lány, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: TJ Sokol Lány, Základní škola Charlotty Garrigue Masarykové Lány
price_range: 50 Kč pro děti a mládež, 100 Kč pro dospělé, zdarma pro účastníky akce 'Běh pro zdraví'

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Děti a mládež do 18 let 50 Kč

description: The Victory Run through the Lány Castle Park is a traditional running race with a history dating back to 1972. It takes place every year on May 8 in the castle park in Lány. The race offers a wide range of categories for children and adults, with distances from 60 metres to 7,800 metres. The courses are mostly on sand, gravel and grass, creating a pleasant and varied running environment. Races start at 8:20 and continue throughout the morning, and spectators are welcome to enjoy the atmosphere. The event is organised by TJ Sokol Lány and Charlotta Garrigue Masaryk Elementary School under the auspices of the Municipality of Lány.
course_highlights: The courses run mainly along sandy and gravel paths and over grass in the castle park
The women’s main race is 3,900 m (one lap), and the men’s is 7,800 m (two laps)
Children’s courses range from 60 m to 1,500 m, with colour-coded laps
additional: Race-day check-in is from 7:30 at the main entrance to the castle park, below the castle greenhouse. Runners must collect their race numbers no later than half an hour before their category’s start. Runners line up at the start 5 minutes before the start. Participants in the Run for Health start together on the 1,200 m course; the winner is determined by a draw. There is no entry fee for participants in the Run for Health. The race starts at 8:20; registration is available online or on site. The event has been part of the local sports calendar since 1972.

name: Čavisovská stovka
description: Čavisovská Stovka is a long-distance walk in the area around Čavisov, with 30, 50 and 100 km routes. It is being held for the thirteenth time. The start and finish are at the TJ Sokol sports field in Čavisov. Routes follow hiking trails, cycle routes and the event’s own markings; using a digital track for navigation at night is recommended. The organisers provide refreshments and basic facilities, including toilets and a shower at the start. The event is open to everyone, regardless of gender or a dog’s breed, and dogs may take part without a time limit.
course_highlights: Routes follow hiking trails, cycle routes and the event’s own markings
A flagship 100 km route for experienced participants, a challenging 50 km route and an easier 30 km route
Four refreshment stations on the 100 km course (at 16, 26, 53 and 79 km)
additional: The start and finish are at the TJ Sokol Čavisov sports field. Routes are not marked on hiking trails or cycle routes, so a digital track on a watch or phone is recommended. The event ends on 10 May 2025 at 23:59 for all routes; anyone finishing after the time limit will be recorded as DNF. Dogs may take part without a time limit. Toilets and a shower are available at the start; hot water is limited by the capacity of the boiler. The event offers several distances, online registration, maps and elevation profiles for the routes. The walk is open to the general public, including families and endurance runners.

name: Memoriál obětí fašizmu Čechtice
description: The Memoriál obětí fašizmu Čechtice is a 6 km running race that takes place on trails in the countryside around the village of Čechtice. The race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka Cup and gives runners the chance to test themselves amid the picturesque scenery of the Central Bohemian Region. It is suitable for anyone who enjoys trail running and wants to experience a sporting atmosphere in pleasant surroundings.
course_highlights: Trail course around the village of Čechtice
Race distance: 6 km
Part of the Běžec Podblanicka Cup
additional: The race is part of a solemn day of remembrance for the victims of fascism, highlighting the event’s historical and social significance.

name: Strážnická stovka
description: Strážnická stovka is an extreme sporting event in the heart of the White Carpathians, open only to participants over 18. This ultratrail marathon features a challenging 100 km route, with a slightly modified hundred-kilometre course that tests runners’ determination and fitness. The start and finish are in Strážnice. The race includes aid stations and the option to transport drop bags. Each participant receives an original race bib bearing their name and, after completing the course, a beautiful metal finisher’s medal as a reward for pushing their limits.
course_highlights: 100 km route through the White Carpathians
Aid stations and drop-bag transport to OS Května
Race bib bearing your name and a metal finisher’s medal
additional: The race has two start groups: Limit 24h starts on Friday, 8 May 2026 at 19:30 for participants not aiming for a trophy; Limit 15h starts on Saturday, 9 May 2026 at 5:00 for runners aiming for a trophy. Accreditation takes place on Friday, 8 May from 17:00 to 19:00 and on Saturday, 9 May from 4:15 to 4:45 (drop bags are not available). The entry fee includes refreshments on the course and at the event base. Timing is provided by ORGSU chips, and entry can be transferred to a substitute. A T-shirt with the logo is an optional item available to order through the e-shop. Registration opens on 3 November 2025. The race is open to adults only, and the course includes challenging terrain and technical sections.

name: Poděbrady Running - MČR v silničním běhu na 1 míli a 5 km a veřejný běh na 5 km
description: Poděbrady Running is the inaugural open Czech Republic Road Running Championships over 1 mile and 5 km, complemented by a public 5 km race. The event takes place in the beautiful surroundings of the spa colonnade in Poděbrady and features certified, very fast and flat circuits where world records are set. This race is an ideal opportunity for runners looking to set a personal best and experience the atmosphere of competing alongside the best Czech athletes.
course_highlights: Certified circuits along the spa colonnade
A very fast, flat course suitable for personal bests
The beautiful surroundings of Poděbrady
additional: The event is organised by the Czech Athletics Federation. The first and main category starts at 12:00. The course is certified and suitable for fast times. The entry fee can be paid in advance or on site for an additional charge. The 5 km course consists of 5 laps of 1 km each. The race is certified for the European Race Walking Championships. Registration is available in advance and on site. The time limit for the 5 km is 38 minutes. The race is suitable for participants aged 15 and over.

name: Běh osvobození
location: Lišany, Díly, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: SK Lišany, z.s. / TJ Sokol Díly
description: The Liberation Run is a traditional road race between the municipalities of Lišany and Lužná in the Plzeň Region. The race is 7 km long and takes place on a lightly trafficked third-class road. The start is at 11:15 after registration at the U Hřiště restaurant in Lišany. The race is divided into six age categories and is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup. Cash prizes are offered to the top finishers in each category and for breaking course records.
course_highlights: A 7,000 m route on the lightly trafficked third-class road Lišany–Lužná–Lišany
Start and finish by the U Hřiště restaurant in Lišany
Cash bonuses for breaking course records
additional: Registration opens at 9:30 at the U Hřiště restaurant (community hall) in Lišany. Entries are accepted on site until 30 minutes before the start at the latest. Results and the awards ceremony are planned for approximately 12:30. The race has four men’s and two women’s categories. Cash prizes and certificates are awarded to the first six finishers in each category. Bonuses are also offered for the speed section and for breaking course records. Participants or their sponsoring organizations are responsible for meeting health requirements and covering the entry costs. The races are open to various age groups, with non-members of ČUS also eligible to compete, and include cash prizes and bonuses. The course follows a lightly trafficked road, and the races are part of regional cups.

name: Czechia Backyard Ultra Run
location: Zámecký park, Holešov, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: Czechia Backyard Ultra Run 2026 is the fourth edition of a unique ultra-running race with the motto “Run as long as you can.” The race takes place in the beautiful grounds of the chateau park in Holešov and is part of the Silver Ticket races, offering the opportunity to compete in an international endurance event. Runners complete a 6.706-kilometre loop within 60 minutes and must line up at the start on the hour every hour until only one runner remains. The race is streamed live and offers full facilities, including showers, toilets and refreshments.
course_highlights: An exactly 6.706 km loop in the chateau park in Holešov
The route passes the chateau, a watercourse and a paved cycle path
Start and finish at the swimming pool complex, with full facilities
additional: The maximum number of participants is limited to 100 runners. Registration may be transferred to another runner until 24.4.2026. The entry fee includes a personalized race number showing the number of laps completed, a commemorative medal and refreshments. Showers, toilets, a medical professional and continuous supervision in the start/finish area are available. The race will be streamed live. Terrain: chateau park; registration: online; rules: run a 6.7056 km loop every hour, no assistance except from other runners, live streaming, maximum 100 participants, no poles; showers, toilets and heated changing rooms available.

name: Memoriál otce Jožky
organizer: Orel jednota Stěbořice, Farnost Stěbořice, Obec Stěbořice
description: The Father Jožka Memorial is a traditional running race held in Stěbořice, in the Moravian-Silesian Region, in honour of the priest Josef Motyka. The event offers various distances, including 10 km and 4 km, for men, women and young people, as well as short races for preschoolers. It is organised by local associations and the municipality and is open to the general public, who can enjoy a sporting atmosphere in the picturesque surroundings of Stěbořice. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere and for supporting sport in the region.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the picturesque surroundings of Stěbořice
Distances range from 100 m for preschoolers to 10 km for adults
The race is suitable for all age groups, including masters
additional: Participants and spectators are advised not to take dogs onto the course during the race. Registration is open. The race is held in honour of the priest Josef Motyka and is part of the local cultural calendar.

name: Běh Černou Horou
location: Černá Hora, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běh Černou Horou is a traditional cross-country race with a rich history dating back to 1928, making it the fourth-oldest race in the Czech Republic. The race takes place in the picturesque setting of Černá Hora and offers courses for all age groups, including children’s races with up to 200 participants. The main course is 9.2 km long and runs around Černá Hora Castle. The race is part of the Blansko District Running League. The event is suitable for runners of all abilities and offers a challenging yet beautiful running experience.
course_highlights: 4 laps around Černá Hora Castle, each 2.3 km long
A 9.2 km main course with picturesque views of the castle
A course suitable for all age groups, including children
additional: Race registration takes place in the old changing-room building at the sports complex in Černá Hora. Parking is available in the adjacent car park right by the sports complex. The race is part of the Blansko District Running League. The race is suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike, offers relays and children’s courses, and is part of the local sports calendar.

name: VR-Bank Abendlauf
location: Neuenkirchen bei Bramsche, Lower Saxony, Germany

name: Varínsky lesný beh
location: Športový areál Juraja Sobolu, Varín, Žilina, Slovakia
organizer: Žilinský pedál, XIRIS, AUTOSKLO Stehlík, Obec Varín
description: Varín Forest Run is a running event in the foothills of the Malá Fatra, offering scenic routes with views of the Malá Fatra ridge. Runners can choose between a longer 13.7 km route with 600 m of elevation gain and a shorter 6.5 km route with 120 m of elevation gain. The event is ideal for runners and nature lovers who want to enjoy a run in picturesque surroundings. The programme also includes children’s races, and a prize raffle is held after the results are announced. The organisers are Žilinský pedál, XIRIS, AUTOSKLO Stehlík and the municipality of Varín.
course_highlights: The route runs through the foothills of the Malá Fatra, with views of the Malá Fatra ridge
The long route is 13.7 km with 600 m of elevation gain
The short route is 6.5 km with 120 m of elevation gain
additional: Race registration is open from 7:30 to 9:45 at the J. Sobola Sports Complex in Varín. The briefing is at 9:55 for the long course and at 10:15 for the short course. The short course starts at 10:20, and the children’s races begin at 10:30. The results announcement and prize raffle are scheduled for 13:30. Race registration is on Saturday from 7:30 to 9:45; the long course starts at 10:00, the short course at 10:20, the children’s races at 10:30, and the results are announced at 13:30. The routes run through the foothills of the Malá Fatra, with views of the Malá Fatra ridge.

name: Memoriál brig. gen. Ľ. Kukorelliho
organizer: Mesto Hanušovce nad Topľou, Mestské kultúrne stredisko mesta Hanušovce nad Topľou, ZO SZPB Hanušovce nad Topľou, Hermanovský bežecký oddiel
description: The Brigadier General Ľ. Kukorelli Memorial is a running event in Hanušovce nad Topľou, offering categories for men, women, relays with varying numbers of team members, and a fun run. It is organized by the Town of Hanušovce nad Topľou, the Municipal Cultural Centre, ZO SZPB, and the Hermanovský Running Club. There is no entry fee, allowing the wider public to take part without financial burden. The race starts at the Municipal Office in Hanušovce nad Topľou.
course_highlights: Start location: Municipal Office in Hanušovce nad Topľou
Categories: men, women, relays (2 to 5 members), fun run
Organized by the town and local running clubs
additional: There is no entry fee. The organizers are the Town of Hanušovce nad Topľou, the Municipal Cultural Centre, ZO SZPB, and the Hermanovský Running Club. Categories include relays with 2 to 5 members and a fun run. The event takes place in Hanušovce nad Topľou; the exact course profile is not specified. Registration is available via the contact details listed on the official website.

name: Charitatívny beh obcou Bukovec
organizer: Obec Bukovec a občianske združenie Oáza-nádej pre nový život
description: The Charity Run through the village of Bukovec is a traditional sporting event organized by the Municipality of Bukovec, its mayor, and members of the municipal council. The run takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Bukovec, known for its recreational area with reservoirs and natural beauty. Runners can enjoy a pleasant sporting experience near the local church while supporting charitable causes. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a community experience in peaceful surroundings.
course_highlights: The route runs through Bukovec near the local church
Picturesque surroundings with views of the reservoirs and the Ida River
A recreational area with natural scenery and tranquil surroundings
additional: The event is organized by the Municipality of Bukovec, the mayor, and members of the municipal council. The race regulations are available to download in PDF format. Bukovec is known for its recreational area with reservoirs, which are part of the route’s surroundings. Information about the event is published on the municipality’s official website. Date: May 8, 2026; start: 10:00; location: Bukovec, by the church; on-site registration is available; proceeds support charitable causes.

name: Běh Mánesovou stezkou
organizer: TJ Sigma Lutín a TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc
description: The Mánes Trail Run is an endurance cross-country and trail race held in Lutín, in the Olomouc Region. The moderately undulating course runs mainly along local roads and forest and field paths. The race offers two distances: 23 km for men and 16.5 km for women and men over 60. It is organized by TJ Sigma Lutín and TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, with the aim of offering runners interesting and challenging terrain.
course_highlights: The course runs mainly along local roads and forest and field paths
Moderately undulating terrain suited to cross-country and trail running
Two distances: 23 km and 16.5 km
additional: The race is organized by TJ Sigma Lutín and TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc. The start is at the Sigma Lutín stadium. The race is open to men, women, and men over 60, with different course distances. It is part of the Czech Running Club. The race is suitable for runners looking for a moderately challenging course with varied terrain; registration and further information are available on the official website.

name: Vltava Run 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Základní startovné 29.700 Kč / 1.215 € včetně DPH pro jeden tým. Předregistrace do 30. 9. 2025.

description: Vltava Run is a relay race more than 375 km long, running from Šumava to Prague. The route passes through Šumava National Park, along the Vltava River, through forests, past reservoirs, and through beautiful valleys, hills, and historic towns and villages in the South Bohemian and Central Bohemian Regions. The race is for teams of 6 to 12 runners, regardless of gender, and offers a unique experience of running the most beautiful route to the finish. It starts at the Zadov–Churáňov cross-country skiing stadium at dawn and finishes in Prague in the afternoon.
course_highlights: A 375 km route from Šumava to Prague
Route along hiking trails and second- and third-class roads
Passes through Šumava National Park, by Vltava reservoirs, and through historic towns
additional: The race is a relay with designated changeover points. Teams may have 6 to 12 runners, regardless of gender. A runner’s estimated 10 km time in the past year must not exceed 60 minutes. Runners must be at least 18 years old, or 15 with written parental consent and a parent on the same team. Registration includes required information and questions about the race rules, which must be answered correctly for registration to be successful. The race is divided into several checkpoints and is run by teams of 6–12 runners. It offers a unique experience of running in nature, with the opportunity to discover the beauty of the South Bohemian and Central Bohemian regions.

name: Kros Merklín-Plešivec
location: Sjezdovka v Merklíně, Merklín, Karlovy Vary, Czech Republic
description: Kros Merklín-Plešivec is a 6.5 km uphill race that follows forest trails and, at the start, a ski slope in the Ore Mountains. The race is part of the Karlovy Vary Region Runners’ League and offers runners challenging terrain and beautiful natural scenery. It is suitable for mountain running enthusiasts who want to test their endurance and strength on hilly terrain.
course_highlights: 6.5 km course with elevation gain in the Ore Mountains
Forest trails and an opening section on a ski slope
Part of the Karlovy Vary Region Runners’ League
additional: The course features mountain terrain; registration details are not specified. The race is suitable for runners seeking an outdoor challenge.

name: Memoriál Jana Janovského
description: The Jan Janovský Memorial is a traditional sporting event organized by TJ Sokol Blatná. It takes place in Blatná, in the area below the Sokolovna and in the castle park. The races are primarily intended for children and young people, with categories ranging from the youngest children to adults, and take place on asphalt and forest paths. The first race starts at 9:00. In-person registration is available no later than 15 minutes before the start of the relevant category. The event is supported by the South Bohemian Region and offers facilities including toilets, changing rooms, and baggage storage.
course_highlights: Course surface: asphalt and forest path
Start and finish in the area below the Sokolovna and in the castle park
Categories for children aged 3 and up, as well as adults
additional: In-person registration is available no later than 15 minutes before the start of the relevant category. Toilets, changing rooms, baggage storage, and washrooms are available. The event is supported by South Bohemian Region grant programs focused on sports activities for children and young people. The event is part of a local sporting tradition; in-person registration is available before the race, and the event is supported by regional grants.

name: Novojičínský půlmaratón
location: Náměstí v Novém Jičíně, Nový Jičín, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 400,- Kč v rámci on-line registrace do 31.3.2026 i jeden člen štafety

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 500,- Kč v rámci on-line registrace od 1.4.2026 do 30.4. 2026 i jeden člen štafety

description: The Novojičín Half Marathon is an open race with a maximum capacity of 400 runners aged 18 and over. It takes place on 9 May 2026 in Nový Jičín. The route follows a scenic landscape along the award-winning KOLEJE cycle path from Nový Jičín through Hodslavice, Mořkov and Hostašovice and back, predominantly on asphalt. The race also offers a 2 × 10.5 km relay and is suitable for runners looking for a quality half-marathon experience, with refreshments along the course and at the finish. The start and finish are on Masaryk Square in Nový Jičín; the race starts at 9:00.
course_highlights: The route follows the award-winning KOLEJE cycle path
95% asphalt, 5% paving
Refreshment stations at kilometres 6.5, 11 and 17, and at the finish
additional: Race packs are distributed on race day from 07:00 to 08:30. A changing room is available at the start venue for storing belongings. Two pacers are available on the course, targeting times of 2:00 and 1:45. Medical services are provided at the start, at the refreshment stations and at the finish. The race takes place in all weather conditions and has a maximum time limit of 2:45. The course passes through Nový Jičín, Hodslavice, Mořkov and Hostašovice; the race takes place in all weather conditions, with refreshments along the course and after the race, and a medal for participants. Registration is open until 30 April 2026.

name: Přísnotický kros
description: Přísnotický kros is a traditional running race held in Přísnotice in the South Moravian Region. It is part of the Zajíc League as the series’ second race. The event offers a wide range of categories for men, women, youth and children of all ages, with distances ranging from 110 metres for the youngest runners to 7,500 metres for adult men. Race numbers are issued from 8:30 a.m. The race is also open to the youngest children, who do not score points in the league and can register on site. Přísnotický kros is suitable for all runners who want to test themselves in pleasant surroundings with well-organised event support.
course_highlights: Distances range from 110 m for the youngest runners to 7,500 m for adult men
Categories for all age groups, including veterans
Part of the Zajíc League; the second race in the series
additional: Registration and race-number collection are available from 8:30 a.m., no later than 30 minutes before each category’s start. The youngest children, as well as adult and youth categories, can also register on site up to 30 minutes after their category’s start. The race takes place in Přísnotice. Registration costs 50 CZK. The course is mostly through woodland, with pleasant natural surroundings and minimal elevation gain.

name: Závadská desítka
location: Přírodní rezervace Dařanec u Závady, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: od 01.04.2026 do 12.04.2026 - 1. vlna registrace: 250,- Kč, (startovní číslo se jménem v ceně)

description: Závadská Desítka is a 10 km cross-country race along forest trails around the Dařanec Nature Reserve. This highly appealing race has become a traditional part of the Prajzsko-opavská Running League (POBL), where it is considered the most appealing short-distance race. Safety along the course is provided by race staff, and a refreshment station is located at the 6 km mark. The race is divided into several men’s, women’s and youth categories, including categories for local residents and people born in Závada, who compete for a perpetual trophy.
course_highlights: Cross-country race along forest trails in the Dařanec Nature Reserve
Refreshment station at the 6 km mark
Safety provided by race staff
additional: The race is part of the Prajzsko-opavská Running League (POBL). In addition to the main 10 km race, there are children’s races of 100 m, 500 m and 1,000 m, as well as 4 km and 10 km walks. A race bib bearing the runner’s name is included in the first registration wave price. Course: 90% forest trails, 10% asphalt; registration waves, refreshments, race pack; race categories by age and gender.

name: 50 mil železnohorských
location: Náměstí míru, Heřmanův Městec, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: The 50 Miles of the Iron Mountains is an ultramarathon held in the beautiful Iron Mountains near Heřmanův Městec. The course passes historic fortresses, castles, hillforts, and oppida, offering a unique opportunity to explore the region up close. The race is open to both individuals and relay teams and is part of the Vládce Mrdic series. The event takes place on May 9, 2026, and welcomes all running enthusiasts looking for a challenge and the beauty of nature.
course_highlights: The course passes historic fortresses, castles, and oppida in the Iron Mountains
The race can be run individually or as a relay
Part of the Vládce Mrdic series, with beautiful trail sections
additional: The race offers a course approximately 81 km long, with cycling and scootering available as secondary categories. Advance registration is recommended.

name: Barvám neutečeš – Olomouc
description: Barvám Neutečeš in Olomouc is a colorful run full of joy, friendship and fun, taking place on May 9, 2026, at Výstaviště Flora. It offers two routes: 5 km with five color zones and 1.5 km with three color zones and an interactive sports zone. The event is not about speed, but about sharing an experience, music and fun for all ages, families and individuals. The race pack includes a T-shirt, colors, a medal and other items to enhance the colorful experience.
course_highlights: 5 km route with 5 color zones
1.5 km route with 3 color zones and an interactive sports zone
Color zones shower runners with color from head to toe
additional: Online registration closes on May 7, 2026, at 20:00. After that, registration is available only on site, subject to capacity. The race pack includes a T-shirt, a sackpack, Holi color powder, a sheet of limited-edition temporary tattoos, a bubble blower, a race number and a medal. The event is suitable for individuals and teams (a team consists of 4 or more people). Various registration packages are available, including options for teams, and the event is also suitable for children. The event also has a charitable component and an interactive sports zone.

name: Vrchlabí - Strážné
description: Vrchlabí - Strážné is a traditional off-road hill running race that leads from Vrchlabí to Strážné over three hills and two descents. The varied course offers challenging climbs, technical descents and fast flat sections, making it ideal for hill-running enthusiasts. The race is part of the Czech Cup in Hill Running and the Hradec Králové Region Championships. The start is by the Střelnice Cultural Centre in Vrchlabí, and the finish is in the car park in Strážné. The race is held in memory of Jan “Pída” Herbes, the race’s spiritual founder.
course_highlights: The course runs mainly off-road along forest and meadow paths
A challenging climb up Jankův kopec and a technical descent past Jankův háj
The final section features an almost 1.5 km fast straight and a finishing sprint on asphalt
additional: Transport for runners from the finish back to the start is not provided; using the yellow hiking trail is recommended. Refreshments are available at the finish. Cross-country or trail shoes are recommended. The race is part of the Hradec Králové Region Championships, and the finish offers refreshments and a friendly atmosphere.

name: Na dvě rozhledny s Nadačním fondem Bernard
price_range: 300 Kč za jednotlivce, 500 Kč za rodinu

description: The Na dvě rozhledny charity run with the Bernard Endowment Fund is a sporting and social event organized by the Bernard Family Brewery in Humpolec. The race has staggered starts and passes through two checkpoints: the Bernard Lookout Tower and the lookout tower at Orlík Castle. The route follows both paved and unpaved paths, and runners can choose their own strategy and navigation. After the race, refreshments, including beer, are available at the finish, and medals are provided for the first 100 registered participants. The event is intended for people over 15; younger participants must have the consent of a legal guardian.
course_highlights: The route passes two lookout towers: Bernard and Orlík Castle.
Runners must pass through two checkpoints and have them marked on their race card.
The route combines paved and unpaved paths, with free navigation.
additional: Starts are staggered at 30-second intervals for runners and 5-minute intervals for groups of 15 walkers. Water is available for runners at Orlík Castle. Each participant is entitled to refreshments at the finish, including alcoholic or non-alcoholic beer. Medals are provided for the first 100 registered participants. Runners must have both checkpoints marked on their race card. The time limit is 2 hours from the start. Participants under 15 may take part only when accompanied by a legal guardian or with the guardian’s written consent. The route is approximately 5 km long. The start is scheduled for 12:30, and the race lasts up to 2 hours. Start intervals are 30 seconds and 5 minutes. The event supports the Bernard Endowment Fund.

name: FREEDOM RUN
description: FREEDOM RUN is a cross-border mountain race in the Krkonoše Mountains, offering two route options. The shorter 9 km Classic route runs from Harrachov through Nový Svět and the Mýtiny area to Orle in Poland, finishing in Jakuszyce, a well-known sports centre. The longer 16 km Mega route is more technically and physically demanding, with greater elevation gain and beautiful mountain scenery, making it ideal for more experienced runners. Both routes start in Harrachov and pass through picturesque mountain landscapes and forest trails, with open mountain plains in the Krkonoše.
course_highlights: Cross-border route from the Czech Republic to Poland
Beautiful mountain scenery and forest trails in the Krkonoše Mountains
Finish straight at the Jakuszyce sports centre
additional: The entry fee includes a race number and timing chip. The race includes mountain terrain, forest trails and cross-border sections; registration is required, and safety rules and race regulations apply.

name: Charitativní běh pro Emmičku
location: Kramolna u hasičské zbrojnice, Kramolna, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: The Charity Run for Emmička takes place on Saturday, May 9, 2026, in Kramolna by the fire station. The event offers two routes—3 km and 7 km—as well as a 200 m children’s route. The routes follow surfaced forest paths, suitable for sports strollers and wheelchairs. Dogs are welcome but must be kept on a leash or in a harness throughout the event. Participants can run or walk the course at their own pace.
course_highlights: The routes follow surfaced forest paths
Suitable for sports strollers and wheelchairs
Dogs are welcome but must be kept on a leash or in a harness
additional: The routes are also suitable for sports strollers and wheelchairs. Dogs are welcome but must be kept on a leash or in a harness. The course can be completed by running or walking. The event traditionally takes place by the fire station in Kramolna. Dogs are welcome, and participants can run or walk. Registration: sport-reg.cz. Date: May 9, 2026.

name: Hörster Waldlauf im Naturpark Teutoburger Wald
Garmin Ultra Race Myślenice 2026
description: Garmin Ultra Race Myślenice is a mountain trail race taking place on 9 May 2026 in the picturesque Beskid Wyspowy mountains, near Kraków. The routes run along forest trails with numerous steep climbs and breathtaking views, offering challenges for runners of varying experience levels. Myślenice combines natural beauty, history and modern infrastructure, making the race an attractive event for fans of active recreation. The Garmin Ultra Race series promotes running in harmony with nature, fair play and support for the running community.
course_highlights: Forest trails in the Beskid Wyspowy mountains, with natural climbs
Views of the Tatras from selected points along the route
A range of distances from 13 km to 78 km, with up to 2,300 m of elevation gain
additional: Race packs can be collected at the race office on 8–9 May. Starts are in waves according to distance, with the longest distance, 78 km, starting at 05:00. The time limit for completing the 78 km distance is 15 hours. Discounts are available when registering for more than one event in the series. Runner cards can be downloaded 5 days before the race after logging in to startlist.pl. Award ceremonies take place after each distance has finished. Distances from 6 km to 101 km; time limits from 1 hour to 17.5 hours; different race-pack options; the option to take part in several distances as part of the Challenge; mountain terrain; medical support; marked routes; refreshment stations; GPS tracker (78 km only).

name: Bieg Herosa
description: Bieg Herosa is a unique running event held in Klucze near Olkusz, offering a range of distances and race formats on challenging sandy terrain. The most extreme event is Nomada 9h, where runners take on desert sand and their own limits for 9 hours, relying on strategy and endurance. Shorter options are also available, including Nomada 3h, dynamic 5- and 7-kilometre loops, children’s races, and special races with dogs that highlight cooperation and trust between the handler and their four-legged companion. It’s an event for those seeking a sporting challenge and a connection with nature in a unique desert setting.
course_highlights: Sandy, desert terrain that demands good technique and endurance
Long-distance competition lasting up to 9 hours in extreme conditions
Special courses for dog-running races and children’s races over distances from 200 to 1,000 metres
additional: The event includes various race formats: an extreme 9-hour race, a 3-hour race, short 5- and 7-kilometre loops, children’s races, and races with dogs, which require cooperation and trust between the runner and their pet. The event focuses on pushing personal limits, endurance, and strategy in challenging terrain.

name: Blue Power Run
organizer: Fundacja Pełnoprawni MY i Stowarzyszenie Pomocy Dzieciom z Autyzmem SENSE
description: Blue Power Run is an inclusive race organised for people on the autism spectrum, their families and friends. The event aims to support social inclusion through a shared sporting event that brings participants together and raises awareness of autism. The race takes place on a paved path by Arkonka Swimming Area in Szczecin. Above all, taking part is about the satisfaction of completing the challenge and overcoming yourself, regardless of finishing place. The event also includes group activities led by therapists and volunteers, further encouraging inclusion.
course_highlights: The route follows a paved path by Arkonka Swimming Area
An inclusive race for people on the autism spectrum and their families
Group activities led by therapists and volunteers
additional: The entry limit is 300 participants. Race packs can be collected at the Race Office on Friday, 16 May, from 10:00 to 12:00 and from 14:00 to 16:00, as well as on event day from 12:00 to 13:00. Starts are divided into age categories, with distances ranging from 200 to 600 metres. The Race Office and start are located by the Szyszka restaurant. The event is inclusive, with routes for children and adults, and takes place on a paved course in Arkonka. Online registration is available until 10 May 2025. The start is scheduled for 13:00.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź
description: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the beauty of the chosen locations. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and enjoy the beauty of nature in Łódź.

The beauty of the chosen locations
Passionate organization since 2014

The event will take place on 9 May 2026 and offers an excellent opportunity for sporting competition and to discover local attractions such as the largest wooden clog and a communal feast table. Participants can prepare by using the certified Nordic Walking routes available in the Nowa Wieś Lęborska municipality.
course_highlights: Red route, 8.2 km long
Scenic but challenging terrain
Local attractions: a communal feast table, the largest wooden clog and a snuffbox
additional: The event starts at 11:00. Registration is open from 18 March 2026 to 7 May 2026. The route passes through the Nowa Wieś Lęborska municipality, encouraging participants to use the certified Nordic Walking routes available in the region. The event offers sporting challenges, beautiful views and local attractions to enrich participants’ Nordic Walking experience.

name: III M Park4RUN
description: The III M Park4RUN Half Marathon is a race of approximately 21.2 km, taking place on May 9, 2026, in Tarnów, on the grounds of the M Park Shopping Centre. The course is 100% paved, flat, and marked every 1 km, with road traffic restricted for the duration of the race. The event promotes running and recreation and brings the local community together. In addition to the main race, children’s and youth races are held over distances suited to different age groups. Participants in the main race receive a race pack containing items from sponsors as well as informational and promotional materials.

Flat course, marked every 1 km
Refreshment stations at 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and the finish

Runners must keep to the right on the course. Classifications include overall categories for women and men and age categories for adults and children. Approximate children’s race distances: 100 m (preschoolers), 250 m (grades I–III of primary school), 500 m (grades IV–VI of primary school), and 800 m (grades VII–VIII of primary school). Online registration was available for the event, which also includes children’s races and community activities.

name: IV Płużnicka Piątka
description: The 4th Płużnica Five is a 5-kilometer race held in the scenic village of Płużnica. The course has a varied surface, making it appealing to both recreational and more experienced runners. Participants start in the village center, and the event also includes children’s races and an awards ceremony. The race has a friendly, family atmosphere, as confirmed by positive reviews from participants in previous editions.

Scenic views and varied terrain

The race is part of the Grand Prix of the Chełmno Land. Online registration, timekeeping, and live results are available.

name: ProviRun for Invisibles IX Mistrzostwa Biegowe Provi Run
description: ProviRun for Invisibles / 9th Provi Run Running Championships is a 5.5 km road race taking place on May 9, 2026, in Łódź. The event is for runners of different ability levels, and participants can use training plans tailored to their individual level and needs. The race is moderately challenging and takes place on an urban asphalt course. The organizers provide expert support and detailed training instructions so everyone can prepare optimally for the start.

description: Rajd Beskidy Short is a European adventure race held in the scenic Beskids, on the border between Poland and Slovakia. The event includes a variety of disciplines, such as mountain biking, trekking, kayaking, climbing and orienteering, with routes through mountainous terrain featuring beautiful views and challenging sections. The race is open to two-person teams or solo participants, offering an intense challenge for lovers of adventure and outdoor sports. The start and finish are in the Kosice area, and the organizers provide professional service and support.

Varied mountain terrain with orienteering and climbing

Race office and start/finish: Dworek nad Wisłą, Wyzwolenia 65, 43-460 Wisła, Poland. The race includes various disciplines, such as climbing, kayaking, navigation and field tasks, and the route passes through scenic areas of the Polish mountains, including caves and rock formations.

name: VIII Ultramaraton Warmiński Warneland
description: The VIII Warmian Ultramarathon Warneland is a unique running event held in picturesque Olsztyn. The route follows charming trails in Warmia, along the Łyna River and Lake Ukiel, offering runners a chance to connect with nature and enjoy beautiful views. The event is a great opportunity to spend time actively, both for experienced ultramarathon runners and younger running enthusiasts, who can take part in the Ultra Warmiaczek children’s races. The atmosphere encourages participants to connect and share a sporting adventure.
course_highlights: Picturesque trails in Warmia around Olsztyn
Route along the Łyna River and Lake Ukiel
A chance to connect with nature and enjoy charming views
additional: Race packs can be collected on 9 May 2026 from 17:00 to 21:00 at the Best Western Plus Olsztyn Old Town Hotel, and from 07:30 to 10:00 at CRS Ukiel for the children’s races. The W50+ and W25+ distances start at 08:00. The time limit for completing the W50+ race is 10 hours, and for W25+ it is 5 hours. After this time, runners must leave the course and remove their race bibs. The Ultra Warmiaczek children’s races start at 11:10. The race village is located at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Centre, close to numerous hotels and apartments. The event features distances of 53 km, 32 km and 19 km, as well as children’s races, with time limits of 10 and 5 hours. The start and finish are at CRS Ukiel in Olsztyn. Participants can expect medical and logistical support, and registration closes on 26 April 2025.

name: Košice Peace Half marathon

description: The Košice Peace Half Marathon is a traditional half-marathon held in the historic centre of Košice. The course follows the city's picturesque streets, including Dolná brána and Hlavná ulica, offering runners a unique experience in an atmosphere of peace and sportsmanship. The event is part of a series of running events in Košice and is organized with an emphasis on quality and safety for all participants.

A running experience in an atmosphere of peace and sportsmanship
Organized as part of a series of major running events in Košice
additional: The event includes various race distances, accompanying activities, finisher medals, and discounts for registered participants on other events in the Košice Peace Marathon series.

name: Strážovská 50
description: Strážovská 50 is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance hiking event covering 50 km, held in the beautiful surroundings of the Strážov Mountains. Both the start and finish are in the spa town of Trenčianske Teplice. The route follows marked hiking trails and is ITRA-certified at Mountain level 5. The event is part of the Slovak Ultra Trail League 2026 and offers a challenging experience for both runners and hikers.
course_highlights: A 50 km mountain ultramarathon in the Strážov Mountains
The route follows marked hiking trails with a challenging mountain profile
ITRA-certified route with 2 points and Mountain level 5

On-site registration is not available. Participants must be at least 18 years old. The entry fee must be paid by bank transfer within 7 days of registration. The route includes challenging navigation sections where participants must pay close attention to the markings. Participants must carry all required equipment and submit a signed informed consent form at check-in. Ultramarathon, 50 km, mountain terrain, registration required, part of the Slovak Ultra Trail League, categories with and without a dog, registration includes mandatory equipment

Categories are divided by age and gender, allowing runners of various age groups to take part.
