Online and on-site registration available.

name: Vertical Chopok
description: Vertical Chopok is a vertical running event taking place on 9 May 2026 in the Low Tatras, on a route from Srdiečko to Chopok Juh. Runners face a challenging climb with almost 950 metres of elevation gain over 6.4 km. The event is part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association calendar and is also a qualifying race in the vertical category. The course runs mainly along the road to Kosodrevina and through Zadné Dereše, allowing runners to perform at their best. The Vlado Plulík Memorial, after which the event is named, has a long tradition and commemorates a significant figure in Slovak sport.
course_highlights: Almost 950 metres of elevation gain over a 6.4 km course
The route runs from Srdiečko via Krupová to Chopok Juh
The course follows the road to Kosodrevina and passes through Zadné Dereše
additional: The event is included in the Slovak Skyrunning Association calendar for 2026 and serves as a qualifying event in the vertical category. Since 2025, the course has been extended and adjusted to allow for better performances and avoid congestion on the opening section. GPX coordinates for the route are available in the attachment. Registration opens on 20 December 2025. The race is part of the Slovak Mountain Running Cup 2019 and takes place in mountainous terrain, with the possibility of qualifying for the European Championships, the U23 World Championships and the Masters World Championships.

name: Podhájska Trail
description: Podhájska Trail is a community running event held at the Podhájska Thermal Swimming Pool, bringing together outdoor exercise, a healthy lifestyle and the local community. The event offers two main courses: a long 18 km route with 353 m of elevation gain and a short 7 km route with 143 m of elevation gain, as well as children’s races of various distances based on age. The route runs mainly along forest roads and paved cycle paths, with the start and finish at the thermal swimming pool. The event also has a charitable dimension, supporting local young people by purchasing sports equipment.
course_highlights: The route follows a dike, forest cycle paths and the area between the villages of Podhájska and Veľké Lovce
The course surface is 20% paved cycle paths and 80% forest roads
Elevation gain is +353 m on the long course and +143 m on the short course

Competitors receive free access to the car park in front of the thermal swimming pool. The route is marked with white-and-red ribbons and marshalled by organisers. Age categories are based on the age attained in the year of the race. The 100 m children’s category is not chip-timed, and all children receive an award. The route follows a dike, forest cycle paths and the area between villages, with a surface of 20% paved cycle paths and 80% forest roads. The event has a charitable dimension, and the participant limit for the main races is 400. Children’s categories are also included.

Entry fees vary by discipline and registration date, increasing gradually until the beginning of May 2026.

Slovak Championships in the 50 km run, with categories by age and gender

This unique race brings together runners, wheelchair users, and beginners around the world, all starting at the same time and running against the so-called “Catcher Car”—a moving finish line that gradually catches up with them. name: Wings for Life World APP RUN Nižná Myšľa
description: Wings for Life World Run in Nižná Myšľa is a unique event where runners and wheelchair participants race against a virtual Catcher Car that gradually catches up with them. The route starts at the Nižná Myšľa archaeological open-air museum, a well-known archaeological site, and passes along forest trails and unpaved roads, through meadows and the village, combining paved and natural surfaces. The race starts on May 10, 2026, at 13:00, and all registration fees go towards spinal cord injury research. Join runners around the world and challenge yourself in this global race with no finish line.
course_highlights: The route is 20% paved and 80% forest trails and unpaved roads
Start and finish at the Nižná Myšľa archaeological open-air museum, with full facilities and refreshments
The route passes archaeological sites and the scenic natural landscapes of the Košice Basin and Slanské Mountains
additional: The virtual Catcher Car sets off 30 minutes after the start at 14 km/h and gradually speeds up until it catches all the runners. Nordic walking is welcome. Parking, changing rooms and bag storage are available at the archaeological open-air museum. 100% of registration fees go towards spinal cord injury research. The route includes paved roads, forest trails and unpaved roads; the start is at the archaeological open-air museum, parking is on site, and registration is via the app.

name: Benefičný beh PRO AUTIS
description: The PRO AUTIS Charity Run is a charitable running event whose proceeds go to the PRO AUTIS autism centre in Trenčín. The race takes place in Soblahov near Trenčín and offers various courses, including children’s races and distances of 5 km, 10 km and 13.3 km. The event is open to all runners with no age limit, and the organisers emphasise personal performance and pushing your own limits. Online registration is available until 8 May 2026, with on-site registration also available on race day.
course_highlights: 5 km, 10 km and 13.3 km courses with elevation gain of up to 482 m
Electronic timing at the start and finish
Children’s races of 300 m and 800 m for different age groups
additional: Registration closes 20 minutes before the race starts. Participants are considered confirmed only after paying the entry fee. On-site registration is available from 8:00 at the former forester’s lodge. The organiser provides refreshments at the start and finish. Parking is available along the road towards the village if the car park is full. Live results are available online at VysledkovyServis.sk. The first three places will be announced during the race. Course distances: 5 km, 10 km, 13.3 km; children’s races: 300 m and 800 m; online registration; race number with a chip; medical information on the race number; parking along the road towards the village.

name: Krčský kros
description: Krčský kros is an annual cross-country and obstacle race in Krč Forest in Prague, offering several course distances, including 4 km, 6 km, and 12 km. The event is suitable for the general public and families and takes place in the natural surroundings of a park with varied terrain, including flat sections, descents, and climbs. It is organized by the Sabzo running club, which supports sporting activities in Prague 4. The race is part of the SABZO series and is ideal for runners of all levels who want to enjoy a day of sport outdoors.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with flat sections, descents, and climbs
Courses available in 4 km, 6 km, and 12 km distances
Natural surroundings of Krč Forest in Prague 4
additional: The race is part of the SABZO series, offers courses of various distances, and is suitable for the general public and families. Registration details are not specified.

name: Běh Violky
location: Kouty nad Desnou, Jeseníky, Czech Republic
description: The Violka Run is a traditional running race held in the picturesque setting of Kouty nad Desnou in Olomouc. It attracts runners of all levels who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere amid the beautiful scenery of the Jeseníky Mountains. Exact details about the course length and organizer are not publicly available, but the race is part of a wider series of running events in the Czech Republic. Registration and further information are usually published on regional websites and the organizers’ social media.
course_highlights: Picturesque scenery of the Jeseníky Mountains
Friendly atmosphere for all age groups
Traditional spring running event in Kouty nad Desnou
additional: Specific information about the course length, entry fee, or registration requirements is not publicly available, but the race is part of a regional running series.

name: Běh na Červenou horu
location: Štěchovice, Praha-východ, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Červená hora is a 3.71 km hill race with 270 m of elevation gain, held in Štěchovice, Prague-East. The race is part of the Runs in the Hills of Prague and Surroundings series and offers runners a challenging but appealing course with a significant climb. It is suited to fans of mountain running and hill running who want to test their endurance and strength in a natural setting. The organizers welcome all runners who want to enjoy a sporting challenge in the beautiful countryside of the Central Bohemian Region.
course_highlights: 3.71 km course with 270 m of elevation gain
Challenging hill run on natural terrain
Part of the Runs in the Hills of Prague and Surroundings series
additional: The race is part of the Runs in the Hills series; registration and further information will be published on the official website.

name: Noční běh pro Světlušku Jihlava

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: The Night Run for Světluška in Jihlava is a traditional charity run taking place on 14 May 2026 at the Amphitheatre. Participants can choose between two distances, 3 km and 4.8 km, and the run starts at 21:00. The entry fee is CZK 500, half of which goes to support the Světluška project, which helps people with severe visual impairments. The event offers an accompanying programme and race packs with a headlamp or sports headband for those who register early.
course_highlights: Two routes: a 3 km short loop and a 4.8 km long loop
Night run starting at 21:00 at the Amphitheatre
Choice of a race pack with a headlamp or sports headband
additional: Registration desks open at 19:00. Admission to the venue requires a ticket with a unique code, either printed or on a mobile device. Holders of TP, ZTP and ZTP/P disability cards may enter free of charge with a companion, but are not entitled to a race pack; one can be purchased on-site for CZK 250. The run’s capacity is limited for participants’ safety and comfort. The accompanying programme includes a concert by Michal Horák at 20:00. Start at 21:00, registration from 19:00, option to receive a donation receipt, free admission for holders of ZTP and ZTP/P cards.

name: KPMG Noc rekordů
location: Praha, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: KPMG Night of Records is a running show held in Prague under the patronage of KPMG partner Eva Bláhová, British Ambassador Matt Field, and Czech 5,000-metre record holder Jiří Sýkora. The event offers a unique opportunity to watch elite runners in an attractive setting and experience a sporting atmosphere full of record-breaking performances. It is open to the general public and supports the running community in the Czech Republic. Everyone who enjoys running and sporting competitions is welcome to register and take part.
course_highlights: A running show featuring Czech 5,000-metre record holder Jiří Sýkora
An event under the patronage of prominent figures, including KPMG partner Eva Bláhová and British Ambassador Matt Field
An attractive sporting setting in Prague
additional: The event offers registration, prize money, and an entry fee, and takes place in Prague on 14 May 2026.

name: FyzioRUN
location: Obora Hvězda, Praha 6, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: The FYZIORUN charity sporting event invites all runners to a certified 5 km course in the beautiful setting of Prague’s Hvězda Game Reserve. The event is organized by the Cystic Fibrosis Club and supports people living with the disease. The route is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant experience in the natural surroundings of Prague 6. Come support a good cause and enjoy a sporting day in a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course
Beautiful setting of Prague’s Hvězda Game Reserve
Charity run supporting people with cystic fibrosis
additional: The event is a charity run organized by the Cystic Fibrosis Club, which supports people living with CF. Due to health measures, visits to the CF Club must be reported in advance. The website offers the option to subscribe to a newsletter with updates about Club events. The event is open to the general public, registration takes place before the race, and the race uses GPS tracking and chip timing.

name: Planderský běh
location: Plandry u Jihlavy, Jihlava, Vysočina, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 Kč - muži, junioři, ženy, juniorky přihlášené on-line

description: The Plandry Run is a traditional cross-country race held in the village of Plandry near Jihlava, organized since 1998. The event offers various categories for men, women, juniors, youth and children, with distances ranging from 220 metres to 9 km. The course follows a 3 km loop featuring forest and field paths, with a turnaround point at Brandl’s Mill, and is suitable for recreational runners of all ages. Refreshments are provided after the race, along with prizes for the top finishers in each category. The mass start is at 18:00 by the municipal office in Plandry.
course_highlights: A 3 km loop along forest and field paths, with 16% paved surface
Turnaround point at Brandl’s Mill on the Bělokamenský stream
Distances for all age groups, from 220 m to 9 km
additional: Runners aged 3 and over may take part. Participants aged 17 and under race for free. After the race, refreshments are available in the local volunteer fire brigade clubhouse, with roast pork available for purchase. During the event, Běžci Vysočiny sports T-shirts are on sale at a reduced price. The bus from Jihlava departs at 16:20; there is no return service. Course: 3 km loop, start at 18:00, various categories by age and gender; more than 100 runners take part in the main 9.4 km race.

name: 250 ČESKÝ RÁJ
location: Turnov, Český ráj, Liberec District, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: 250 ČESKÝ RÁJ is a unique running relay race in the picturesque Český ráj region, taking place from 15 to 17 May 2026. A team of eight runners covers a total of 250 kilometres, with each runner completing three legs of approximately 10 kilometres. The varied course includes forest and field paths, and sometimes roads, with a mix of flat and rolling terrain that showcases the beauty of Český ráj. Known as the most beautiful race, it is for runners looking for a team challenge in stunning natural surroundings.
course_highlights: The course is divided into legs of approximately 10 km; each runner completes 3 legs
A mix of forest and field paths, and occasionally roads, with flat and rolling terrain
250 km in total for a team of 8
additional: TRAILS CUP is a one-off race for teams of three on the final 13 km leg of the 250-kilometre race, with 356 m of elevation gain. A headlamp and mobile phone are recommended. After the race, there will be an awards ceremony and party at the Skalák restaurant in Sedmihorky campsite. Participants can drive directly into the campsite and park near the start. Refreshments are provided. Official T-shirts and hoodies can be ordered from the online shop until 13 June 2025. The race also offers the option to order official merchandise and take part in an accompanying trail event.

name: V Nocny Bieg Parami ze Świetlikami
description: The V Night Run in Pairs with Fireflies is a unique night running event held in Reda, by a retention reservoir. The runners’ headlamps and the illuminated course create a spectacular visual effect. Participants start in pairs, highlighting the event’s inclusive character and setting it apart from other sporting events in the Pomeranian Voivodeship. The run takes place after dark, adding a distinctive atmosphere and excitement.
course_highlights: The run takes place after dark, with runners using headlamps
The course is located by the forest and retention reservoir in Reda
Pairs start together, with spectacular lighting along the course
additional: The start line closes 5 minutes after the starter’s signal. The event headquarters are in Reda, at the end of Karłowicza Street, by the forest and retention reservoir. Race numbers can be collected on site. The organizer is not responsible for valuables. The first pair is expected to finish between 22:00 and 22:15. night run, limited number of participants, distance over 15 km, area around Reda, start in the town center by the retention reservoir

name: Beh do Strečnianských hradných schodov
description: The Run up the Strečno Castle Stairs is a challenging race in Strečno near Žilina, testing your fitness on a course with 151 steps and an elevation gain of 144 metres. The race is open to all youth categories, university students, women and men. The start is at the car park below Strečno Castle, with youth starting at 10:15 and students and adults at 11:45. The event is organised by the Institute of Physical Education of the University of Žilina and OK Žilina, who ensure the event runs smoothly. The entry deadline is 10 May 2026; late entries are possible only in exceptional cases.
course_highlights: The course follows 151 steps with an elevation gain of 144 metres
Start at the car park below Strečno Castle
Categories for youth, university students, women and men
additional: Youth start at 10:15; university students and adults start at 11:45. Late entries are possible only in exceptional cases. The race takes place in May, with registration open until 10 May 2023. It includes several categories and different start times for youth and adults.

name: Běh města Nýřany

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Děti s bydlištěm mimo okolí Nýřan mají start zpoplatněný částkou 30,00 Kč

description: The Nýřany City Run is a traditional sporting event organized by Atletclub Nýřany, z.s. and the Education, Sport and Culture Committee. The main 10 km race, including a 2 x 5 km team run, offers an opportunity for the general public to take part in an active event. The program also includes children’s races for kids from Nýřany and the surrounding area, which are free or subject to a nominal fee. The event takes place at the athletics stadium of ZŠ Nýřany and concludes with a disco with free admission.
course_highlights: Main 10 km race, with the option of a 2 x 5 km team run
Children’s races for local kids, free of charge
The event concludes with a disco on the asphalt court
additional: Registration is available online and on-site, with a higher fee for on-site registration. The disco starts at 18:00, with free admission. Children’s race numbers are distributed at educational institutions or in the white booth next to the gym. 10 km race, 2 x 5 km team runs, children’s races, online registration since 2018, results and photos available

name: Mácháč Run Fest
location: Máchovo jezero, Liberec region, Czech Republic
organizer: Mácháč brothers crew, Jan Venca Francke
description: Mácháč Run Fest is a rolling cross-country race through the beautiful countryside around Lake Mácha in the Liberec Region. It offers distances of 160 km, 60 km, 25 km, 10 km, and 5 km, with 90% of the route on trails. The race is ideal for nature lovers and runners who enjoy a challenging off-road course. Come and enjoy running in a picturesque setting, with a challenge for every runner.
course_highlights: Rolling cross-country terrain with 90% on natural trails
Distances from 5 km to a 160 km ultramarathon
Scenic countryside around Lake Mácha in the Liberec Region
additional: A multi-distance trail race, held in May 2026. The race is unsupported and follows a single loop.

name: Lesempolem
description: Lesempolem is a traditional running race held in the picturesque village of Veselice in the South Moravian Region. It offers three distances—14 km, a marathon (42 km), and an ultramarathon (84 km)—run mainly on forest and field paths around the Podvrší lookout tower, offering beautiful views and a chance to run in nature. The race is suitable for all runners, from amateurs to experienced athletes, and the marathon is part of the Blansko District Running League. The start and finish are at the sports complex in Veselice, where a varied programme, refreshments, and a friendly atmosphere await runners and spectators.
course_highlights: The course runs mainly on forest and field paths (90%), with only 10% on paved roads
The area around the Podvrší lookout tower offers beautiful views
Three distances: 14 km, a marathon (42 km), and an ultramarathon (84 km)
additional: The start and registration are at the cultural centre in Veselice, with parking about 200 m from registration. Refreshments are available on site (water, tea, sports drinks, fruit, and traditional Loštice spread), and participants can store their own refreshments. Spectators can enjoy a cultural programme, a bar, and children’s races. Overnight accommodation is available in the cultural centre for a nominal fee; bring your own sleeping bag. The marathon is part of the Blansko District Running League. The races take place around Veselice in the Moravian Karst, with an emphasis on a family atmosphere and socialising.

name: Mattoni 1/2Maraton Karlovy Vary 2026
location: Karlovy Vary, Karlovy Vary District, Czech Republic
description: Mattoni Running Festival Karlovy Vary 2026 is a unique race in the heart of the spa town of Karlovy Vary, offering runners the chance to enjoy running while discovering the beauty of this UNESCO-listed city. The World Athletics-certified course passes the iconic Thermal and Pupp hotels and the unique colonnade. This festival is a traditional gathering of runners, with a vibrant atmosphere and beautiful views of world-famous landmarks.
course_highlights: The course passes the Thermal and Pupp hotels
It runs through Karlovy Vary’s unique colonnade
Surroundings featuring UNESCO landmarks
additional: Registration is possible only with a registration code. The race takes place on May 16, 2026, with the first start wave from 14:00. The festival includes various running events, including a half marathon and a half-marathon relay. Registration is by registration code only; multiple race categories are available, including 3 × 5 km and 6.0975 km. The races take place in the beautiful surroundings of UNESCO landmarks and hotels.

name: Zručský májový běh
location: Zruč nad Sázavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic

price_tiers.distance: Dětské závody (150 m, 300 m, 600 m, 1100 m)

description: Zruč May Run is a traditional race held every May in the picturesque setting of the château park and the Sázava River in Zruč nad Sázavou. The event offers races for all age groups, from the youngest children to adults, including the 10 km main race on a fast, ČAS-certified course. The program also includes children’s races, relays, and a 3 km fun run. The event supports the TJ Jiskra Zruč nad Sázavou athletics club and encourages sporting activity in the region, with proceeds donated to a good cause in the local community.
course_highlights: The 10 km main race is a fast, ČAS-certified course that runs around the château park and the Sázava River
Four color-coded loops for children and young people, ranging from 150 m to 1,100 m, in the château park
The 3 km fun run goes through the château park, along the cycle path, and across the town square, finishing by Barončina stezka
additional: Race bibs can be collected on Friday from 17:00 for Friday’s 3 km fun run and on Saturday from 8:30 for all categories. On-site registration is available only on Saturday from 8:30 and closes 30 minutes before each race starts. Everyone over 35 registered for the main race is automatically entered in the 2026 Czech Masters Championships. The course is marked with colored wooden direction signs at turns. The main race’s results and records receive cash prizes. Races take place in and around the château park; registration is available on-site and online, with various race distances, including children’s races and relays, and a certified 10 km course.

name: NN Night Run Brno
location: Hněvkovského sportovně-rekreační areál, Brno, Czech Republic

price_tiers.distance: BELLIS RUN proti rakovině prsu - 5 km

description: NN Night Run Brno is the largest running event in Brno, held at the Hněvkovského sports and recreation complex. More than 2,000 runners of all ages take part each year, from beginners to experienced competitors. The event offers a 10 km main race, as well as children’s races and shorter-distance runs, all in a friendly, lively atmosphere. The program also includes accompanying activities, performances, and plenty of entertainment for participants and spectators alike.
course_highlights: Hněvkovského sports and recreation complex in Brno
10 km main race with a 90-minute time limit
Children’s races and 3 km and 5 km runs with a charitable purpose
additional: The program includes KIDS CUP children’s races, the FÉNIX RUN 3 km and BELLIS RUN 5 km with a charitable purpose, a 2 x 5 km relay, performances, and warm-ups with Honza Kaňůrek (NUTREND). A bag drop and changing rooms are available, along with MIZUNO running shoe testing, airbrush tattoos, a photo booth, a raffle, and other activities. NN clients can get a 50% discount on the entry fee, and athletes receive a discount on life insurance through the Fit Sport program. The route includes a city park and recreation area; registration is available online and on site; the event features various race categories and accompanying activities.

name: Dobřichovický kros půlmaraton a 10 km
location: Nádvoří zámku Dobřichovice, Dobřichovice, Czech Republic
description: The Dobřichovice Cross-Country Half Marathon and 10 km is a traditional running race organized by Radost v pohybu in the picturesque courtyard of Dobřichovice Castle. The event offers three options: a free 1 km children’s race, a 10 km race suitable for beginners and experienced runners on a mostly flat course, and a half marathon for more experienced runners, with a more challenging second half full of hills. There are refreshment stations along the route, and participants receive a commemorative medal after the race. The atmosphere is friendly and welcoming to all age groups.
course_highlights: The half marathon has a flat first section and a hilly second half
The 10 km race is mostly flat, with one refreshment station
Three half-marathon refreshment stations (at 5, 10 and 15 km) offering water, an isotonic drink and fruit
additional: Athletes registered by 1 May 2026 are eligible for a commemorative medal, which is handed out after the results ceremony. All participants meet in the courtyard of Dobřichovice Castle. By registering, you confirm that you are participating at your own risk and consent to the use of images for promotional purposes. The event includes a half marathon and a 10 km race, starting in the courtyard of Dobřichovice Castle, as well as a children’s race.

name: Rakovnická 100
description: Rakovnická 100 is a traditional ultralong-distance hike and run through the beautiful Křivoklátsko countryside, offering a challenging but manageable route of approximately 107 kilometres with 2,400 metres of elevation gain. The event is known for its excellent organisation and friendly atmosphere, making it ideal for testing your physical limits. The start is at Husovo Square in Rakovník, and participants can expect a combination of running and hiking with various natural obstacles, including river crossings and wet sections. Rakovnická 100 is suitable for experienced athletes looking for a challenge on less extreme, but still demanding, terrain.
course_highlights: A route of approximately 107 km with 2,400 m of elevation gain
Beautiful Křivoklátsko countryside with rivers, streams and river crossings
Well-organised refreshment stations and support along the route
additional: The start is at 4 a.m. from Husovo Square in Rakovník. The route combines running and hiking and is also suitable for testing your fitness after the winter. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organisation. The route has been adjusted slightly in the past, but still offers a challenge, with possible river crossings and wet sections. The race takes place in May, finishing at Penzion Šéba, and is part of the regional ultramarathon series. The route is suitable for experienced runners looking for a challenge in a natural setting.

name: Charitativní Běh Na Špince
location: Tábořiště Špinka, Červený Kostelec, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Špinka Charity Run is a sporting event with the motto #WhenICanIHelp, bringing together the joy of exercise and support for those in need. Proceeds from the event support NONA 92 Day Centre in Nové Město nad Metují, which helps people with intellectual disabilities become part of society. The race is open to everyone—professional runners, beginners, parents with strollers, and children. The race has a unique atmosphere, and 100% of entry fees go to charity; operating costs are covered by sponsors.
course_highlights: Routes for all age groups, from 100 m for the youngest participants to 10 km for adults
Children’s races start at 10:00 and 10:15; the main 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km routes start at 10:30 and 11:00
A charity run supporting NONA 92 Day Centre, which offers meaningful daytime activities and preparation for independent living
additional: Registration is available online via SportChallenge.cz or on-site from 9:00 until 30 minutes before the start. The race is part of the Primátor CUP series. Teams can register with at least 3 members; their final time is calculated as an average. The programme includes children’s races, main races of 2, 5, and 10 km, a quiz, and a prize draw for a scooter. All entry fees go to charity; operating costs are covered by sponsors. Charity run supporting NONA 92 Day Centre, open to all age groups, with 100% of entry fees going to charity.

name: Májový běh Slapy
location: Sigma Slapy, Slapy, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné je dobrovolné formou příspěvku v libovolné výši na jednu ze sbírek Blíž domovu

description: The May Slapy Run is a traditional running race organised by the Slapy Cultural Association, held amid the scenic forests and hills of Slapy. The race offers courses for children and adults, with a focus on beautiful nature, forest trails and an interesting elevation profile. The start and facilities are at the Sigma Slapy grounds, where changing facilities and luggage storage are available. The race is suitable for all age groups and offers a friendly atmosphere, with prizes for the top finishers and all children.
course_highlights: Forest trails and terrain with minimal elevation gain for children
A manageable but undulating course with 225 m of elevation gain for adults
A beautiful view of the reservoir from halfway along the adult course
additional: Children start separately at 9:30, and adults start at 10:00 after the children have finished. Registration is open from 9:00 to 9:20 for children and until 9:45 for adults. Changing facilities and storage for belongings, excluding valuables, are available at the start. The route is clearly marked with white arrows on the ground. Children may be accompanied by their parents. Children up to 9 years old run 1.4 km, older children run 2.8 km, and adults run 7.5 km. Children under 18 may also run the adult course with parental consent. Start times: children at 9:30, adults at 10:00; course distances: 1.4 km for children up to 9 years old, 2.8 km for children aged 10–18, and 7.5 km for adults; the race takes place on forest trails with elevation gain

name: Městecká desítka
location: Náměstí Republiky, Městec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Městecká Desítka is a traditional running race in Městec Králové, offering 10 km and 5 km courses, as well as a 1 km children’s race, including a run for the youngest participants. The course runs mostly on asphalt roads with gentle elevation changes, and both the start and finish are on Náměstí Republiky. The race is known for its records and great atmosphere, and participants can use refreshment stations along the course and at the finish. After the race, runners receive an SMS with their finishing time, and winners receive trophies and prizes. The organizers emphasize fair play and the safety of all participants.
course_highlights: Course with no significant elevation gain
Surface: 80% asphalt, 20% paving and paths
Start and finish on Náměstí Republiky, Městec Králové
additional: Refreshment stations along the course and at the finish. An SMS with your finishing time is sent after the race. On-site registration will not be available. NO.6 technical T-shirt available to purchase for 490 Kč. The children’s race is untimed and free; registration takes place on race day from 8:30 to 9:20. Children may run with an accompanying adult; balance bikes and scooters are prohibited. The race includes refreshments along the course and at the finish. Registration is available online only; results are available by SMS and online. The course runs over asphalt, paving and sandy paths; the start and finish are on Náměstí Republiky.

name: 7 pohoří Orlické hory
location: Deštné v Orlických horách, Orlické hory, Czech Republic
description: 7 Peaks Orlické Mountains is part of the largest trail running series in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The race in the Orlické Mountains offers technical trails with epic views and an atmosphere you won’t find anywhere else. The route passes viewpoints, Šerlich, the border with Poland and Velká Deštná, the highest peak in the Orlické Mountains. Get ready for a challenge with 920 metres of elevation gain over 24 km that will test your strength and determination.
course_highlights: The route passes viewpoints and Šerlich
Across the border with Poland to Masaryk’s Chalet
Climb to Velká Deštná, the highest peak in the Orlické Mountains (1,115 m)
additional: The race time limit is 4 hours, after which a participant is marked as DNF. Participants can leave smaller items at the registration tent. Recommended kit includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Záchranka app. The entry fee includes a professionally marked course, race number, chip timing, commemorative medal, refreshments along the route and at the finish, and use of the facilities at the start and finish area. The races feature various distances, from 5 km to 24 km, with technical sections, climbs and natural obstacles. Registration includes a race pack, timing, medals and refreshments. The race takes place in May 2026.

name: LHUT – Lysohorský Skyrace a Ultratrail, MČR Skyrace a Ultra Sky 2026
location: SKI Malenovice, Lysá hora, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné pro Ultra Trail je 1 690 Kč od 6. 2. 2026 do 6. 3. 2026

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Startovné pro Ultra Trail je 1 790 Kč od 7. 3. 2026 do 8. 5. 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné pro Skyrace je 990 Kč od 6. 2. 2026 do 6. 3. 2026

tiers.label: tier_2

description: Lysohorský Ultra Trail is a mountain running race in the Lysá hora massif, offering three race distances: Ultra Trail (67 km, +4100 m), Skyrace (31 km, +2100 m) and Supersky (16 km, +875 m). The routes follow marked hiking trails and offer stunning views of Lysá hora from every direction. The race is held with the support of local foresters, LČR and CHKO, and emphasises a runner’s code of ethics and nature conservation. The start and finish are at the KAM hotel complex in Malenovice, where refreshments, recovery zones and other services are available to runners. An awards ceremony and afterparty take place after the race.
course_highlights: Routes follow marked hiking trails in the Lysá hora massif
A challenging elevation gain of up to 4100 m on the Ultra Trail course
Aid stations at the summit of Lysá hora and in the start/finish area
additional: Race registration takes place on Friday 15. 5. 2026 from 16:00 to 20:00 at the KAM hotel complex in Malenovice. Runners will receive a race pack with a chip, race number and gifts from partners. The aid station offers a wide selection of refreshments; showers and a recovery zone are available after the race. Accommodation in Hannah tents is available by reservation via roman.tulinsky@rockpoint.cz. Runner transfers are permitted for a fee of 200 Kč; changing the race distance is not permitted. The race number must be clearly visible on clothing. Support is permitted only on Lysá hora, within 100 metres of the aid station. The race takes place on 16 May 2026 at SKI Malenovice, with different start times depending on race distance, and is supported by local foresters, LČR and CHKO.

name: Energon běh – Penzion Nový rybník
location: Penzion Nový Rybník, Obořiště, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Energon Run at the Nový rybník guesthouse in Obořiště is part of the Brdy Running Cup and offers races for adults, juniors, and children. The main adult race and relay are run over four laps on a combination of paved and off-road surfaces. The children’s routes follow a dirt road to Rosovice and back, with distances tailored to age. The event is family-friendly and welcomes runners of all ages. It traditionally starts at 12:00 at the Nový rybník guesthouse.
course_highlights: The course combines paved, dirt, and forest paths
The main race consists of 4 laps on paved and off-road surfaces
Children’s routes follow a dirt road to Rosovice and back, with distances based on age
additional: Children’s races are free. Registration is open until 15.5.2026 at 22:00, and is also available on race day. The main race can also be run as a four-person relay. The course combines paved and off-road surfaces. The organizers offer neoprene chip straps for purchase for 100 Kč. The event includes various age categories, registration in advance or on-site, and accompanying sports activities, including children’s races.

name: Hostivice RUN

price_tiers.distance: dospělé závody (5 km, 10 km, 21 km, CROSS)

description: Hostivice RUN is a traditional running race held in the picturesque setting of the Hostivice ponds. In 2026, it will take place for the thirteenth time, offering four main distances: 5 km, 10 km, 21 km, and a 4 km CROSS trail run, along with children’s races. The event is suitable for all runners who want to enjoy the sport and challenge themselves in a welcoming atmosphere. Runners will also receive an original metal medal as a symbol of achievement and determination.
course_highlights: The routes run around the Hostivice pond system amid natural scenery
The half marathon consists of two laps of the green route
The CROSS trail run features more challenging terrain and natural obstacles
additional: The children’s races start at 9:00; the main adult races start from 11:00 (10 km and half marathon), the CROSS at 11:10, and the 5 km at 11:20. Hostivice RUN T-shirts can be ordered as part of online registration until April 1, 2026; a limited number will be available at the venue after that. Registration is available online, in person at the Hostivice Municipal Library, and at the start venue on race day. The parent ultrarun and some children’s categories are already full. Multiple race distances, children’s races, registration opens December 1, 2025, event held in Hostivice, Czech Republic

name: Hradubický běh (start Pardubice)
description: Hradubický běh (Pardubice start) is a friendly running race between the cities of Hradec Králové and Pardubice, finishing in Čeperka, which is 10 km from each city. The course combines asphalt sections with natural terrain; the route from Pardubice offers more natural terrain, while the route from Hradec offers more asphalt. The race takes place in all weather and is popular with runners from both cities. More information and registration are available on the race website, www.ph7.cz.
course_highlights: 10 km course from Pardubice to Čeperka
A combination of asphalt and natural terrain
More natural terrain on the Pardubice side, more asphalt on the Hradec side
additional: The race takes place in all weather. More information and registration are available at www.ph7.cz. Reports and photo galleries from previous editions are available. 10 km course, asphalt and natural terrain, all-weather race

name: Pivoňův běh
location: Louka Na Křižatkách, Písecké hory, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Pivoňův běh is a traditional running race in the Písek Mountains, held in the meadow at Na Křižatkách near the White House. It offers routes for beginners and experienced runners over 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon distances, as well as children’s races and a charity walk. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere, beautiful countryside and the opportunity to support charitable projects. The course takes runners past picturesque ponds, through a game reserve with mouflons and fallow deer, and along forest trails with varied surfaces. After the race, participants can enjoy a welcoming event base and original Pivoň merchandise.
course_highlights: Routes pass ponds with wooden footbridges and dams
Run through a game reserve with mouflons and fallow deer in the Písek Mountains Natural Park
Forest trails with varied surfaces and elevation gain of up to 465 metres
additional: Children’s races have different distances according to age, with separate starts. The charity walk with Toyota Dolák donates half of the entry fee to charitable projects. Race numbers and clothing can be collected on race day. Course time limits: 5 km – 1 hour, 10 km – 2 hours, half marathon – 3.5 hours. The routes combine forest trails, paved paths and asphalt roads, with elevation gain of up to 465 metres. Registration is available by bank transfer. The event offers refreshments, an accompanying programme and T-shirts for purchase. The routes are suitable for runners of all levels.

name: ČEZ RunTour Kopřivnice
location: Tatra Kopřivnice, Tatra Trucks, Kopřivnice, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: ČEZ RunTour Kopřivnice is part of a popular running series offering races for all ages and ability levels. The programme includes distances ranging from children’s races and family and hobby runs to the more demanding half marathon. The event takes place at the Tatra Trucks complex and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, quality facilities, and activities for the whole family. Every participant receives a race pack and contributes to charity. Pacers and medical services help ensure the race runs safely and smoothly.
course_highlights: 3, 5, 10, and 21.1 km routes at the Tatra Trucks complex
Children’s races of 500 and 1,000 metres, with a children’s corner
Refreshment stations on routes of 5 km and longer; at least two on the half marathon
additional: Every runner receives an official gymsack with gifts from partners. Children receive a race pack from Lidl. Pacers carrying flags are available on the course to help runners maintain their pace. Emergency medical services can be reached via a dedicated phone line during the race. Refreshments are available at the finish for shorter races, while longer routes have refreshment stations. Multiple race distances, family activities, charity support, participant medals, photos, and comprehensive race services.

name: SKYRUN – DLOUHÉ STRÁNĚ
location: Kouty nad Desnou, Olomoucký kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné je stanoveno na 900,- Kč / závod

description: SKYRUN - DLOUHÉ STRÁNĚ is a challenging 22 km individual race with 820 m of elevation gain, running from Kouty nad Desnou to the crest of the upper reservoir of the Dlouhé Stráně pumped-storage power plant and back. The route combines unpaved roads, paved roads and trails, and runners can enjoy unique views of the Jeseníky Mountains and the power plant’s engineering works. The race takes place at the transition between the winter and summer seasons, creating a distinctive atmosphere and challenges, including the possibility of snow on the course. The Kouty nad Desnou resort offers full facilities, including restaurants, accommodation and parking right by the start and finish.
course_highlights: 22 km course with 820 m of elevation gain
Crosses the crest of the upper reservoir of the Dlouhé Stráně pumped-storage power plant at an elevation of 1,354 m above sea level
A mix of unpaved roads, paved roads and trails, with views of the Jeseníky Mountains
additional: Each runner receives a GPS locator, which must remain active throughout the race. Check-in consists of collecting the race packet, which includes a cable car voucher. Trekking poles are permitted on the course; other assistance is prohibited. Support is permitted only in the designated Support zone, using your own bottle. The organizer provides the route in map and GPX formats. The race bib must be clearly attached to the front of the runner. The race includes trail and road sections; registration is available. The race takes place on 16 May 2026, and the course includes a climb to a technically challenging location with support at the summit.

name: Rozběháme Jaroměřice
location: Fotbalové hřiště v Jaroměřicích nad Rokytnou, Vysočina, Czech Republic
organizer: město Jaroměřice nad Rokytnou a FK Jaroměřice nad Rokytnou
description: Rozběháme Jaroměřice is a running event scheduled for May 16, 2026, taking place at the football field in Jaroměřice nad Rokytnou. The event is open to the general public and offers various distances, including 11 km, 5 km, children’s routes of 3 km, and a short run for the youngest participants. It is organized by the town of Jaroměřice nad Rokytnou in cooperation with FK Jaroměřice nad Rokytnou and promises a fun-filled day of sport and activity for the whole family. Registration for the main distances opens in March 2026.
course_highlights: Various distances, including 11 km, 5 km, and routes for children
Event held at a football field in the peaceful Vysočina region
A family sports day with activities for all age groups
additional: Race day is May 16, 2026. Registration will be available from March 2026. The routes are suitable for runners and families with children.

name: Standův českorybenský půlmaraton
location: Hřiště Česká Rybná, Česká Rybná, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: We invite you to the 2nd annual Standa’s Česká Rybná Half Marathon and Quarter Marathon, run through the beautiful foothills of the Orlické Mountains. The start and finish are at the municipal sports field in Česká Rybná, where there will also be plenty of refreshments and a sports day. The race offers a welcoming atmosphere and a chance to challenge yourself, with awards for the fastest runners. The event is part of the ČUS Sportuj s námi project and is suitable for the general public, including young people.
course_highlights: Beautiful scenery in the foothills of the Orlické Mountains
Start and finish at the municipal sports field in Česká Rybná
On-course refreshments: water, fruit, sugar and salt, with an emphasis on sustainability
additional: On-site registration is also available from 8:00. Parking is available at the turning circle and in the meadow above Dvončovi; it will be signposted. A place to store valuables is available. The awards ceremony will take place at 13:30. The event is part of a sports day with plenty of refreshments throughout the day. Bringing your own water container is recommended to help minimize plastic waste. The race takes place at the Česká Rybná Sports Field, Pardubice Region, and is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners. Exact registration information is not provided.

name: Hradubický běh (start Hradec Králové)
location: Hradec Králové-Lipky, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Hradubický běh is a friendly running race connecting the cities of Hradec Králové and Pardubice. The race is unusual in that it has two starts, one in each city, and a shared finish halfway along the route. The course is exactly 10 kilometres from each side and combines paved sections with natural terrain. The race takes place in all weather and is suitable for a wide range of runners. The start is scheduled for Saturday at 10:00.
course_highlights: Two starts in the cities of Hradec Králové and Pardubice, with the finish halfway along the route
The course is exactly 10 km from each side, measured with a Jones Counter
A mix of paved and natural sections, with more natural terrain on the Pardubice side
additional: Registration for the children’s races takes place from 10:30 to 11:15 at the Čeperka sports field. The cutoff time for the main race is 11:30; the results ceremony and prize presentation are at 11:35. Refreshments are available at the finish, including water, sports drinks, fruit, sweet pastries and salt. A baggage drop is available at the finish, where bags are transported by car from both starting cities. The start locations are easily accessible by public transport from the main railway stations. The race takes place in all weather. It is suitable for all age groups, offers various course distances and is held in all weather, with step-free access.

name: Lomecký běh
description: The Lomec Run is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Lomec in the South Bohemian Region. The event offers two courses, 12 km and 6 km long, combining different surfaces and terrain for an enjoyable experience for runners of all levels. The main category starts at 11:00. The organizer is Josef Prokeš. The event brings together running, nature, and the running community in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Two courses: 12 km and 6 km
Mixed terrain with natural and paved sections
Picturesque surroundings of Lomec in the South Bohemian Region
additional: The organizer is Josef Prokeš; phone contact: 608 854 937. The race is part of the Czech Athletics Federation’s services for runners and running. A meeting of running, people, nature, and faith. The race is part of a social and spiritual gathering with accompanying activities, including a family-friendly atmosphere and an open-air Holy Mass.

name: Dobřichovický půlmaraton
location: Nádvoří zámku Dobřichovice, Dobřichovice, Czech Republic
description: The Dobřichovice Half Marathon is the sixth edition of a successful cross-country half marathon, held in the picturesque courtyard of Dobřichovice Castle. The event offers three options: a free 1 km children’s race, a 10 km race suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike, and a more challenging half marathon with a hilly second half of the course. There are refreshment stations along the route, and participants receive a commemorative medal after the race. The event is suitable for all age groups and runners of varying experience levels.
course_highlights: Half marathon with a flat first half and a hilly second half
10 km race, mostly flat, with one refreshment station
Free 1 km children’s race for young runners up to 10 years old
additional: Athletes who register by 1.5.2026 are eligible for a commemorative medal, which is handed out after the results ceremony. Participants meet in the courtyard of Dobřichovice Castle. There are three refreshment stations along the half-marathon route, offering water, an isotonic drink, and fruit. The 10 km race results ceremony is scheduled for 12:30. The children’s race is free and intended for children up to 10 years old. The races are suitable for all age groups, including the 1 km children’s race. Registration is open until 14 May 2026. The event takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Dobřichovice, with the opportunity to enjoy nature and a sporting atmosphere.

name: Zkus půlmaraton Kuks
description: Try the Kuks Half Marathon, a running race that starts in the courtyard of the Baroque Hospital Kuks complex and follows a scenic educational trail past the unique gallery of sculptures from Braun’s Nativity Scene, carved into the rocks. The route offers a unique experience of Czech Baroque and the atmosphere of a mystical complex hidden in the woods. Runners pass pilgrimage sites around Kuks, and the race finishes with a return along the modern 21st Century Way of the Cross, which connects history with contemporary art. In addition to the half marathon, shorter 10 km and 5 km distances are also available, both of which pass through interesting places in the area.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the courtyard of the Baroque Hospital Kuks complex
Educational trail past Braun’s Nativity Scene, a gallery of sculptures carved into the rocks
Route passes along the modern 21st Century Way of the Cross, connecting history with contemporary art
additional: The entry fee includes a race bib and chip. Entry can also be purchased as a gift voucher with a unique code. Participants under 18 may take part only with the written consent of a legal guardian. The race is organized by TURN ON EVENTS s.r.o. from Hradec Králové. The course runs through the historic and natural surroundings of Kuks. Registration is through myresult.cz. The race takes place in all weather conditions, and prizes are awarded on race day.

name: Šanovská desítka
description: Šanovská desítka is a running event organized by Sokol Šanov, inviting athletes of all ages to take part in races ranging from 100 metres to 10 kilometres. The race takes place on May 16, 2026, at the municipal sports field in Šanov and offers an atmosphere full of excitement and determination. Starts are staggered by category from 9:30, allowing the event to run smoothly for all participants. It is ideal for runners looking to experience a community sporting event in the beautiful South Moravian Region.
course_highlights: Distances from 100 metres to 10 kilometres
Start at the municipal sports field in Šanov
Category starts staggered from 9:30
additional: Starts are staggered by category from 9:30; the course ranges from 100 metres to 10 kilometres, and the race takes place at the municipal sports field in Šanov. Distances from 100 m to 10 km, family activities, medals for early registrations, a race on an asphalt cycle path, outdoor event.

name: Kryry třikrát jinak
price_range: 80-150 Kč, zdarma pro místní děti a školní mládež
description: The Kryry Three Ways race is a unique running event where competitors climb the hill with Schiller Lookout Tower in three different ways: a mass-start uphill race, an interval hill run, and an interval climb up the tower’s 127 steps. The overall standings are based on the combined times for all three stages, with time bonuses awarded to the top three finishers. Children’s races are held on circuits below the lookout tower. The event is part of the Lookout Towers in Motion series and also offers a relay race for teams of three runners.
course_highlights: 1.25 km mass-start uphill race
750 m interval hill run
Climb up 127 steps to Schiller Lookout Tower
additional: Race registration and changing rooms are in tents at Československé armády Square in Kryry. Children’s races are divided into several age categories, with different circuit lengths. The relay race is for teams of three runners, each of whom runs one stage. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each age category and to the top three relay teams. In cooperation with Kryry Elementary School, a competition for parents and children is planned. Registration takes place at Československé armády Square. The race is part of the Lookout Towers in Motion series, which promotes outdoor physical activity and community gatherings.

name: Běh Opárenským údolím

description: Běh Opárenským údolím is a running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Opárno near Lovosice. The 5.5 km route follows paved roads and forest paths, combining pleasant terrain with natural scenery. The race starts at 15:00 in Lovosice and finishes at the former Oráč pub on the village square in Opárno, where refreshments and access to the building are provided. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a relaxed atmosphere, with the option of having backpacks transported to the finish.
course_highlights: 5.5 km route along paved roads and forest paths
Start in Lovosice, finish in Opárno at the former Oráč pub
Picturesque Opárno Valley with natural scenery
additional: Backpacks will be transported to the finish after the start. Refreshments for runners are provided. The start is in Lovosice (Lovosice město stop, at the junction of Lovošská and Ústecká streets). Transport to the start in Lhotka leaves from Lovosice město at 14:00. The start is scheduled for 15:00, with the finish in Opárno. The event is part of a series of sporting events in the Středohoří region.

name: Desítka z Jasének
description: Desítka z Jasének is a traditional running race held in Hlučín, Moravian-Silesian Region. The route runs through the valley of the Jasénka stream and the Opava River and is 8.6 km long. The start and finish are at Gras Servis. The race is suitable for runners who want to enjoy a pleasant run in a natural setting, with the option to make repeated attempts as part of an individual time trial. The organizers welcome fair play, and run records are submitted electronically. Results are published online after the race.
course_highlights: Route through the valley of the Jasénka stream and the Opava River
Route length: 8.6 km
Start and finish at Gras Servis, Jasénky 29, Hlučín
additional: The race is an individual time trial in which participants run with a mobile phone and an app that records their running activity. They may complete the route repeatedly, but submit only their best recording. Recommended apps include mapy.cz, Endomondo, Nike, and others. Parking at the start is limited (about 12 spaces). Results will be published by 10 April 2026. The event includes a family day with activities, registration is open, race categories include the 8.6 km course, and the race takes place in a natural setting with parking available at Gras Servis.

name: Lysohorský Ultra Trail
location: Hotel KAM, Malenovice, Lysá hora, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Lysohorský Ultra Trail is a challenging mountain race held in the scenic surroundings of Lysá hora and the surrounding area in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The start and finish are at the Hotel KAM complex in Malenovice. The race offers plentiful refreshments, a recovery zone, a hot meal, and gifts from sponsors included in the race pack. A celebratory awards ceremony and an unforgettable afterparty are planned after the race. The race is ITRA-rated, and electronic chip timing is provided.
course_highlights: Plentiful refreshments at the summit of Lysá hora and in the start/finish area
Electronic chip timing
Recovery zone and hot meal after the race
additional: Changing your registration to another runner is possible for a fee of 200 CZK. Changing to a different course is not possible. Free showers and baggage storage are available after the race. Free first aid and medical services at the finish are provided to participants with valid health insurance in the Czech Republic. Results are published on the website within 48 hours. The race includes the Ultra Trail, Skyrace, and Supersky categories, with refreshments, medical support, and an afterparty. The start and finish are at Hotel KAM in Malenovice, near Lysá hora.

name: Běh na Velký Javorník
location: Frenštát pod Radhoštěm, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: We invite all runners to the traditional race up Velký Javorník, held in the picturesque surroundings of the Moravian-Silesian Beskids. The race offers a beautiful route climbing to the summit of Velký Javorník, ideal for lovers of mountain running and nature. The start is on Saturday, May 16, 2026, at 10:00 in Frenštát pod Radhoštěm. Come enjoy a sporting challenge and beautiful views in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Mountain run climbing to the summit of Velký Javorník
Picturesque surroundings of the Moravian-Silesian Beskids
Start in Frenštát pod Radhoštěm
additional: The course runs through forest and mountain terrain. The race is suitable for experienced runners seeking a mountain challenge. Registration details and exact participation fees are not specified.

name: Dubenský běh pro dobrou věc
description: The Dubné Run for a Good Cause is a charity running event held in Dubné in the South Bohemian Region. The race offers 3 km and 5 km courses and combines a sporting experience with support for the family of a child with a disability. Proceeds from the event go to help the family of Martin Kříha from České Budějovice, specifically to purchase a van with a wheelchair lift and fund rehabilitation. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere with refreshments and entertainment.
course_highlights: Two courses: 3 km and 5 km
Start at the football pitch by the Velký hajský pond
Charity run supporting the family of a child with a disability
additional: The event is a fundraiser, with proceeds from the 9th edition going to help the family of Martin Kříha from České Budějovice. The start is at the football pitch by the Velký hajský pond in Dubné. The organizers emphasize combining sport, good refreshments and entertainment with charity. The event is connected with the local community; the run is likely charitable, but precise information about the course or registration is not provided.

name: 12. Dynowska ZaDyszka
location: Ośrodek Turystyczny „Błękitny San”, Dynów, Podkarpackie, Poland
description: The 12th Dynowska ZaDyszka is a 10 km race organized by the Jarosławska Grupa Biegowa “Sokół” Association. The event will take place on May 16, 2026, at the “Błękitny San” Tourist Resort in Dynów. The race takes place in the evening, and its course runs through scenic areas, promoting physical activity and the region’s tourist attractions. The event is part of the Piona Cup 2026 series, which brings together the local running community.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Evening race at the scenic “Błękitny San” Tourist Resort
Showcases the scenic areas of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship
additional: The race takes place from 19:00 to 21:00 at the “Błękitny San” Tourist Resort in Dynów. It is organized by the Jarosławska Grupa Biegowa “Sokół” Association and is part of the Piona Cup 2026 series. The event also includes activities for the community, and online registration is available. Participant numbers are limited. The race aims to promote physical activity and strengthen local community ties.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Stradomia – edycja wiosenna 2026
location: Arboretum Leśne im. prof. Stefana Białoboka, Nadleśnictwo Syców, Stradomia Dolna, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Stradomia – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts. It takes place in the picturesque Prof. Stefan Białobok Forest Arboretum in the Syców Forest District. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka race series, which emphasizes scenic courses and natural surroundings. It attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a unique atmosphere and beautiful views. The organizers promote running and provide a friendly, sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the Prof. Stefan Białobok Forest Arboretum
Picturesque forest surroundings and natural beauty
A race in the Botaniczna Piątka series, featuring a unique medal
additional: The race is part of the Botaniczna Piątka series, which organizes cross-country races at various locations in Greater Poland and beyond. Since 2014, the organizers have emphasized scenic courses and natural surroundings. The 2024 spring edition introduced a medal collection featuring a hyacinth motif, highlighting the event’s unique character. The event includes cross-country races at various distances, with an emphasis on the scenic appeal of the locations, including the Prof. Stefan Białobok Forest Arboretum. The race is part of a series of spring sporting events in Greater Poland.

name: XVII Bieg Piastowski - półmaraton Piastowski Festiwal Biegowy
description: The 17th Piast Run is a traditional half marathon held in Inowrocław as part of the Piast Running Festival. The race attracts runners from various regions, offering an appealing course and a sporting atmosphere. It is an excellent opportunity to spend time actively and compete over the 21 km distance. The organizers ensure professional race management and a welcoming atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course passes through scenic areas of Inowrocław
A well-marked and secured course
A festive sporting atmosphere with numerous spectators
additional: The Piast Running Festival also includes 5 km and 10 km races. Registration is available on separate subpages. The website provides information about the race office and regulations for participants. The event includes a half marathon; details about registration, the course, and partners are available on the official website. The event promotes physical activity and integration within the local community.

name: Rudawy Wiosenny Festiwal Biegowy
distance_verbose: Ultramaraton, Ultramaraton, Maraton, 27 km, 16 km, 10 km
description: The Rudawy Spring Running Festival is a mountain running event held in the picturesque Rudawy Janowickie Mountains in Miedzianka. Participants can choose from several distances: 15, 25, 45 and 65 kilometres, as well as a 9 km family run. The event brings the mountain running community together, highlighting the team spirit of the sport and offering unique routes along forest paths and rocky trails. The festival has been held since 2013 and is known for its beautiful views and challenging courses.
course_highlights: Mountain routes along rocky trails and forest paths
Distances from 9 km (family run) to 65 km
Picturesque Rudawy Janowickie Mountains near Miedzianka
additional: The race office is located at Browar Miedzianka and is open on 15 May from 16:00 to 22:00 and on 16 May from 4:00 to 5:00 and 7:00 to 11:00. To collect a race pack, participants must show proof of identity or written authorisation.
