The race features a challenging 25 km course with more than 400 metres of elevation gain. The start and finish are by the SK Litavan Bohutín football pitch, which provides facilities including changing rooms and refreshments. The programme also includes accompanying events such as Nordic Walking Brdy, Cruiser Race Brdy and children’s races. The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup and offers beautiful running weather and a fantastic course safely routed away from roads.
course_highlights: 25 km course with more than 400 metres of elevation gain
Start and finish by the SK Litavan Bohutín football pitch, with full facilities
The course goes to Tok and is more trail-oriented, safely routed away from roads
additional: The start and finish are by the SK Litavan Bohutín football pitch, which provides changing rooms and refreshments. Registration opens at 8:00 for the children’s races. The main race starts at 11:00; the 12 km race, Nordic Walking and Cruiser Race start at 11:05. The entry fee includes refreshments on the course and after the race (water, isotonic drink, cola, banana and salt). School-age categories and children race for free. The race takes place on 17 May 2026 in Láz near Příbram and offers various distances, including 25 km and 12 km. On-site registration is available, and the event also features medals, refreshments and a social programme.

name: Běh na Kašperk
location: Kašperské Hory, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Kašperk is a traditional and prestigious race in the Ešus League series, held in Kašperské Hory. The 3.2 km race starts from the town square at an elevation of 750 m above sea level and follows both flat terrain and a challenging climb to Kašperk Castle, where the finish is located. The route offers beautiful views of the surrounding mountains and the castle atmosphere, making the race a unique experience for runners of all levels. After the race, participants can enjoy the castle atmosphere and jog back to town.
course_highlights: Start in the town square at an elevation of 750 m above sea level
Flat section along the green trail, with views of Mount Křemelná and the surrounding peaks
Final 1.7 km climb with 200 m of elevation gain to Kašperk Castle
additional: Registration takes place from 9:15 to 9:45 in front of the cinema building in Kašperské Hory. The start and finish locations may shift slightly, so no course record is recorded. The organiser is the town of Kašperské Hory; the contact person is Ms. Renata Hartmanová (tel. 777 848 756). The races include the Run Around Ždánov (13th edition) and the Run to Kašperk (12th edition), a challenging 2.9 km climb to Kašperk. Results and complete information are available online.

name: Běh pro kočku
location: Lázně Toušeň, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běh pro kočku is a charity running event held in Lázně Toušeň. It raises awareness of the issue of homeless cats and supports a selected cat shelter. The event offers an 8 km main race along the Elbe between the Toušeň and Čelákovice bridges, as well as a 4 km route suitable for running or walking. It is open to all age groups and also features activities for children and the opportunity to buy cat-themed items, with proceeds going to support the shelter. The start and registration take place at the football ground in Lázně Toušeň.
course_highlights: 8 km main race along the cycle path by the Elbe, between the Toušeň and Čelákovice bridges
4 km accompanying route around Lake Malvíny, suitable for running or walking
Start and finish at the football ground in Lázně Toušeň
additional: Registration is also available at the venue on race day. Entry fees and proceeds from the sale of cat-themed items are donated to a cat shelter. The accompanying programme includes activities for children and adults, and the option to relax at a restaurant with a summer terrace and children’s playground. There is also a shorter 4 km run or walk around Lake Malvíny. Participants agree to the race rules and take part at their own risk. This charity run supports cat shelters and veterinary care and is suitable for all age groups, including families with children.

name: X RUN během pro dobrou věc
location: Park Na Solidaritě, Praha 10, Praha, Czech Republic
description: X RUN is a charity running event organized by Prague 10 District, taking place on Sunday, May 17, 2026, in Na Solidarite Park and its surroundings. The event is for all runners who want to support a good cause while enjoying a day of sport in pleasant surroundings. The run takes place in a beautiful urban park, and the whole family and friends can join in. The start and finish are located right in the park, ensuring easy access and a pleasant atmosphere.
course_highlights: Run in Na Solidarite Park and the surrounding area
Urban setting with natural features
Charity event supporting a good cause
additional: The event runs from 10:00 to 17:00 in Na Solidarite Park and the surrounding area. Registration is available via an online form on the district’s website. At present, registration is open only to administrators, which may mean public registration will become available later. Registration is online. The event is sporting and charitable in nature, takes place in Na Solidarite Park, and is suitable for children and dogs.

name: Hanácká kojetínská desítka
location: Kojetín, u fotbalového stadionu Morava, Kojetín, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Hanácká Kojetín Ten is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc. It takes place in Kojetín, by the Morava football stadium. The race is part of a series of running events in Central Moravia and offers an opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners. The Liga stovkařů club specializes in promoting distance running and supports runners of all levels. The race is suitable for the general public and is part of the Grand Prix of Endurance Runners of the Olomouc Region.
course_highlights: The course passes through the countryside, floodplain forests and along the Morava River
The surface includes asphalt, gravel and natural trails
The race takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Kojetín, near Olomouc
additional: The race will take place on May 17, 2026. The start is scheduled for 11:00 by the Morava football stadium in Kojetín.

name: Brdská 12
location: Bohutín, Příbram District, South Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Brdská 12 is a traditional running race held in Bohutín, offering a course approximately 12 km long. The race follows a loop run counterclockwise, along forest trails and asphalt. The start is at the SK Litavan Bohutín football pitch, and the main race begins at 11:05. The event also includes free children’s races, making it appealing to the general public and families with children.
course_highlights: The loop runs counterclockwise
The course surface includes forest trails and asphalt
Start and finish at the SK Litavan Bohutín football pitch
additional: Children’s races are free. The course is GPS-measured at 12.09 km. Results have been available in the system since 2014. The loop is on forest trails with asphalt sections. A trail race on forest trails and asphalt paths; registration is available in advance or on site; start at 11:05; children’s races are part of the event.

name: Běh alejí
description: Běh alejí is a traditional running race in Králíky, held in the picturesque setting of the avenue leading to the monastery on the Mother of God Mountain. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup and features an uphill course approximately 1.25 km long. It is open to the general public, including young people, and is organized in a friendly atmosphere. The start and registration are in the center of Králíky, with on-site registration available. The race is known for its pleasant surroundings and the views in the area.
course_highlights: An uphill run along the avenue from Králíky to the monastery on the Mother of God Mountain
Course length of approximately 1.25 km, with around 168 m of elevation gain
Picturesque surroundings and natural scenery in the Pardubice Region
additional: Registration takes place in the car park behind building no. 316 (Sadová Street, Králíky) from 8:30 to 9:30. The start is by the entrance gate at the avenue leading to the monastery. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup and offers categories for different age groups, including children. In the past, entry was free; current entry-fee information has not been published. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup 2026, offers various categories, and features a technical course in a mountainous setting.

name: FUN&RUN 2026
description: Fun&Run 2026 is a charity run organized by the Prague Pride association, taking place on 17 May 2026 in Prague’s Stromovka Park. The 15th edition of the run focuses on fighting homophobia, biphobia, intersexphobia, transphobia and the stigmatization of people with HIV. The event offers 5 km and 10 km race routes, along with a program full of entertainment and activities for all participants. Proceeds support activities benefiting the LGBTQ+ community and people living with HIV in the Czech Republic.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km runs in Stromovka Park
Charity run against homophobia and the stigmatization of people with HIV
Program featuring a warm-up, yoga and musical performances
additional: The event starts at 12:00 with the opening of the venue and registration; at 13:00 there is a warm-up with John Reed Fitness. After the race, participants can take part in free Queer Sensitive Yoga and other activities. Toilets, showers, changing rooms, and food and drink stalls are available at the venue. The high-heels race must be registered for in advance. Terrain: Stromovka Park; registration: online and on site; the event includes 5 km and 10 km runs, a high-heels race, family activities, a fitness warm-up and themed runs.

name: Jarov - Károv
location: Jarov u Prahy, Praha, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Jarov-Károv is a 2.99 km uphill race with 150 m of elevation gain, part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series. This race challenges runners with a demanding climb and is ideal for fans of mountain running and fast, short-distance races. It takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Jarov near Prague and attracts runners who want to test their strength and endurance on hilly terrain. Come and enjoy the atmosphere and competitive spirit of this traditional race.
course_highlights: Course length: 2.99 km
Elevation gain: 150 m
An uphill race in the natural surroundings of Jarov near Prague
additional: The race is regularly part of the series of uphill races, participation is high, and the course is challenging, with elevation gain through natural terrain.

name: Peřimovská desítka
description: Peřimov Ten is a traditional road race held in the village of Peřimov in the Hradec Králové Region, offering 10 km and 6 km courses. The race is suitable for runners of all levels and follows local roads with minimal elevation gain, alongside traffic. The event is organized by SDH Peřimov and is part of the local sporting calendar, attracting runners from the surrounding area and the wider region.
course_highlights: The course follows local roads with minimal elevation gain
Both courses are out-and-back and suitable for runners of all levels
The race takes place alongside traffic, adding to the atmosphere
additional: The course follows local roads, is out-and-back, takes place alongside traffic, and has minimal elevation gain

name: 24h Rawicki Festiwal Sportu
description: The 24-hour Rawicz Sports Festival is a unique sporting event held in Rawicz, bringing amateurs and professionals together in a competition that lasts all day and night. Since 2011, the festival has continued to grow, offering a range of sports, with the 24-hour relay race as its main event. It is the largest sporting event in the Rawicz municipality, organized through the cooperation of numerous institutions and volunteers. Participants can also enjoy many non-sporting attractions during the festival weekend.
course_highlights: 24-hour relay race as the flagship event
Competitions held simultaneously at eight sports venues
Sports include streetball, a swimming marathon, a cycling marathon, football, beach volleyball, tennis and Nordic walking
additional: The event requires complex logistics and cooperation between numerous organizations and volunteers. It attracts a growing number of participants—from 200 at the first edition to 1,700 in 2019. The festival takes place across the Rawicz municipality and includes a range of sports and non-sporting attractions. Registration for the event is open; details about the course and participation are available on the website. The event promotes physical activity and community cohesion.

name: 19. Bieg Wiosny - 5 km
organizer: Biegowe Grand Prix Rybnika, MOSiR Rybnik
description: Bieg Wiosny is an annual running event held in Rybnik and part of the Rybnik Running Grand Prix. The event features races for children and young people over various distances, as well as a 5 km cross-country race for adults and young people aged 16 and over. The 19th edition of Bieg Wiosny will take place on 17 May 2026, giving participants the chance to compete and enjoy an active day outdoors.
course_highlights: 5 km cross-country race
Races for children and young people over distances from around 100 m to 1 km
Part of the Rybnik Running Grand Prix
additional: Races for children and young people take place over distances suited to the participants’ ages. The 5 km race is open to participants aged 16 and over. The event is part of the Rybnik Running Grand Prix series. It also includes Nordic walking, and participants can expect sweet treats and drinks. Registration is available online and on site.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Olsztyn - edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Olsztyn – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by a group of running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque Warmia and Mazury Forest Arboretum, highlighting the scenic qualities of the course. The race is participant-friendly, and the organizers emphasize the beauty of the locations and promoting running among different groups. It is a great opportunity to combine sport with time in nature and earn a unique hyacinth-themed medal.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the Warmia and Mazury Forest Arboretum
Picturesque, scenic woodland surroundings
Spring race featuring a unique hyacinth-themed medal
additional: A hyacinth-themed medal, part of the Botaniczna Piątka medal collection for 2024. The organizers particularly emphasize the scenic qualities of the course and the character of cross-country races. The series partner is Trzymsie.pl. Cross-country race, located in the Warmia and Mazury Forest Arboretum, approximately 4,849 registered participants

name: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – Spring Edition is a recurring race held in the picturesque Przelewice Dendrological Garden, an ideal place for nature lovers and those seeking active recreation. The event aims to promote running and physical activity, and there is no age restriction for taking part. Participants can look forward to a unique atmosphere and commemorative medals, awarded after completing the main race and the children’s races. The event is co-organized by the West Pomeranian Voivodeship and held under the honorary patronage of the Marshal of the Voivodeship.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the Przelewice Dendrological Garden
The course runs through the garden’s unique natural surroundings
There is no age restriction for participants; children’s races are also available
additional: Medals are awarded to all participants who finish the main-distance race and the children’s races. Admission to the Dendrological Garden is paid, and the garden grounds are open during operating hours. The website provides no information about start waves, participant limits, or entry fees. The event promotes running and outdoor activity, with medals for participants and online registration. The race takes place in beautiful dendrological gardens, making it a unique experience for nature and sports enthusiasts.

description: CONQUER LUCIFER – The Half Marathon is a mountain race in Nasielsk, taking place on 17 May 2026. The course consists of a 7 km loop through scenic but challenging woodland, with numerous climbs and technical descents. There are four challenges to choose from: Lucyfer 21 km (3 loops), Boruta 14 km (2 loops), Rokita 7 km (1 loop), and Nordic Walking 7 km. This race is for those who value endurance, strength, and determination, with professional timekeeping and commemorative medals for participants.
course_highlights: A 7 km loop through scenic woodland
Challenging climbs and technical descents
Dynamic sections where survival matters more than speed
additional: Team classification for mixed teams of 3, with each participant completing a different distance. Time limits: Lucyfer 21 km – 210 minutes, Boruta 14 km – 120 minutes, Rokita 7 km and Nordic Walking 7 km – 60 minutes. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and a gift, with awards and trophies for the top competitors. Electronic timekeeping. The event also includes a team classification for teams of 3. Registration is open until 15 May 2026. The mountain and woodland course makes this a challenge for trail-running enthusiasts.

name: VIII Charytatywny Bieg Nadziei
location: Park Cegielnia, Żory, Śląskie Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Żorach
description: The 8th Charity Run of Hope is an annual sporting event held at Cegielnia Park in Żory, taking place on May 17, 2026. The event is charitable and supports the John Paul II Hospice in Żory. Participants can run, walk with poles, skate, or ride a scooter, and all proceeds from entry packages go toward the hospice. The event is open to everyone, regardless of athletic ability, and promotes physical activity combined with helping those in need.
course_highlights: The route is in Cegielnia Park in Żory
Participants can complete the route running, walking with poles, skating, or riding a scooter
A charity event supporting the local hospice
additional: Participants can complete the route in different ways: running, walking with poles, skating, or riding a scooter. All proceeds from entry packages go to the John Paul II Hospice in Żory. The event is open and inclusive, encouraging physical activity and working together to help those in need. Location: Cegielnia Park; online registration; charity event; medals available and places still open

name: XRUN Wyspowy Trail
description: Wyspowy Trail is a mountain trail race held in the Beskid Wyspowy, offering four distances: 50 km, 38 km, 22 km, and short races for children. The longest course crosses wild, forested terrain, including a route beneath Mogielica, the range’s highest peak, with beautiful views of the Tatras and the legendary climb up Modyń, where ropes help runners climb. The race takes place on 17 May 2026, with the finish at Limanowa Municipal Park and starts in Limanowa and nearby locations. Time limits are tailored to the course distances. It is a challenging and scenic adventure for mountain-running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The course crosses wild, forested terrain in the Beskid Wyspowy
Views of the Tatras from the Mogielica area (1,170 m above sea level)
The legendary climb up Modyń, with ropes to help runners tackle the steep slope
additional: The race office and finish are located in Limanowa Municipal Park. The distances start at different locations: 50 km from the Wilczyce car park, 38 km from Rydz-Śmigły Pass in Słopnice, and 22 km from Zalesie. The time limits are 10h, 8h, and 6h, respectively. Age categories for the children’s races are for ages 3 to 15. Course maps and regulations are available on the website. Mountain courses, marked with tape and arrows; starts in Polrzeczki; online registration; regional character of the event.

name: 32 Bieg Fiata
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Bielsku-Białej, Agencja Sportu i Reklamy Andrzej Filipiak

tiers.description: Opłata startowa w kwocie 100 zł /brutto/ wyłącznie za pośrednictwem płatności elektronicznych

description: The 32nd Bieg Fiata is an annual road race held in Bielsko-Biała, and in 2026 it will take place on 17 May. The 10 km course runs through the city streets, including Warszawska, 3 Maja and Zamkowa, and others, with the finish at Plac Ratuszowy. The race is open to competitors over the age of 16, and the participant limit is 1,800. The organizers are the Municipal Office in Bielsko-Biała and Agencja Sportu i Reklamy Andrzej Filipiak. The event is a certified PZLA road race with a rich tradition in the region.
course_highlights: A certified PZLA 10 km course through the streets of Bielsko-Biała
Start by the main gate of DL INVEST PARK
Finish at Plac Ratuszowy in the city centre
additional: The participant limit is 1,800. Personal accident insurance is available when registering. Race bib transfers are possible until 6 May 2026. Buses transporting runners depart from the car park at Plac Ratuszowy at around 10:15 after the race starts. The course is asphalt and certified by the PZLA. Main race, option to buy or list race packages, detailed event schedule, bus timetable, parking information and traffic disruptions.

name: Bieg Po Puszczy
location: Polana Sitowiec, Puszcza Niepołomicka, Niepołomice, Poland
description: Bieg po Puszczy is a unique running event held in the picturesque Niepołomice Forest, taking place for the twelfth time in 2026. Participants can choose from three running distances: a half marathon, the Forest 15K and the Forest 7K, and can also take part in the 40 km Gravel in the Forest cycling race. The course follows forest trails, gravel roads and asphalt, offering beautiful views and a chance to connect with nature. Every participant will receive a commemorative anniversary medal, and aid stations and professional medical support will be available along the course. The event is also an opportunity to spend time together as a family, with recreational cycling events for children.
course_highlights: The course follows the most beautiful parts of Niepołomice Forest
Picturesque forest trails, gravel roads and asphalt
The two-loop half-marathon course is also used for the Gravel in the Forest race
additional: Start and finish at Sitowiec Clearing, ul. Droga Królewska, Niepołomice. Gravel starts at 9:00; running races start at 12:00. Aid stations and professional medical support along the course. A commemorative anniversary medal for every participant. Registration on race day at the race office may be possible if places are available. Children’s cycling events will take place alongside the main event, with no competition, medals and fun. The event includes races over various distances and a gravel cycling race, with aid stations along the course, medical support and medals for participants. Registration opens soon.

name: Ekiden Pragmatiq
location: Jezioro Malta, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Ekiden PragmatIQ is a team marathon relay held in Poznań by Lake Malta. Teams of six cover the marathon distance (42.195 km), with each runner completing a designated leg. The course is paved and follows a 5.4 km loop, except for the first leg. The event combines sporting competition with teamwork and support for local charitable organizations. Ekiden Junior for the youngest runners is also held as part of the event.
course_highlights: Paved course around the Malta regatta course
Distance split into 6 legs: 9.795 km, 10.8 km, 4 × 5.4 km
Start by the HP Park Poznań Hotel; finish by the grandstands and relay zone
additional: The team time limit is 4 hours and 30 minutes. A dedicated relay zone is provided. The event includes a charity program, with PLN 42.91 from each entry fee donated to a local public benefit organization selected by the participant. Ekiden Junior for children covers 120 meters and is open to runners born from 2015 to 2024. The event ambassador is Dominika Stelmach, who also leads a special women’s team with athletic requirements. The event features team competition, the EKIDEN Junior race for children, charitable support, attractions, and an exciting atmosphere of sporting competition.

name: III Półmaraton Brzegiem Bałtyku
organizer: Kołobrzeskie Stowarzyszenie Biegów Ulicznych Nadmorscy Biegacze
description: The 3rd Kołobrzeg Half Marathon by the Baltic Sea is a flat road race held in the picturesque seaside setting of Kołobrzeg. The course follows a granite-paved promenade, a cycle path and asphalt roads, with five refreshment stations along the way. The start and finish are located by the Seaside Park Hotel. The race is part of the Kołobrzeska Odyssey series, promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing the running community together. The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours, and timing is electronic, using disposable chips.
course_highlights: Flat course following a promenade, cycle path and asphalt roads
Course marked every kilometre with vertical signs
Five refreshment stations along the course
additional: The race office is open on 16.05.2026 from 18:00 to 20:00 and on 17.05.2026 from 8:00 to 10:50 near the start and finish. Electronic timing with disposable chips. Runners must wear their race number with the chip clearly visible. Pedestrians and cyclists may be present on the course; runners must obey traffic regulations. Open categories for women and men, as well as a classification for residents of Kołobrzeg County. The course runs along the promenade, where pedestrians and cyclists may be present. Time limit: 3 hours. Children’s races are planned. Other distances may also be available (5 km, 10 km, marathon).

description: Bieszczadzki Bieg Lotników - Summer is a mountain race taking place on 17 May 2026 in Ustrzyki Dolne, on the running trails beneath Żuków in the Żuków range, within the Ustrzyki Dolne Forest District. The course follows forest roads with varied surfaces, featuring climbs and descents, with the start and finish in the same location. The event aims to promote outdoor physical activity, bring runners together, and celebrate the aviation traditions of Ustjanowa Górna. The programme includes two running distances and a Nordic Walking event, and the time limit for completing the half marathon is 4 hours.
course_highlights: The course follows forest roads with varied surfaces in the Żuków range
The course is marked with ribbons, directional signs, and signs every 5 km
The start and finish are in the same location; an Anglo-Saxon-style course with climbs and descents
additional: The time limit for completing the half marathon is 4 hours. Race numbers and race packs can be collected on 16 May from 18:00 to 20:00 at the Primary School in Ustjanowa Górna, and on 17 May from 8:00 to 10:30 on the running trails beneath Żuków. Starts take place in waves: 11:00 half marathon, 11:15 Lotniczek 6 km, 11:20 Nordic Walking 6 km. The awards ceremony is at approximately 15:00. The event takes place on 17 May 2026, with different distances available, including a half marathon, a 6 km race, and Nordic Walking. The course includes forest roads and mountain trails, with marked routes and time limits.

name: Lone Willow Marathon
location: Chwałowice, Jelcz-Laskowice, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Lone Willow Marathon is a marathon held in Jelcz-Laskowice, Poland, organized by Maraton Chwałowice and Arkadiusz Tołłoczko. It is listed in marathon calendars for the areas around Tyniec Mały and Namysłów, as well as in the list of sporting events in the Żórawina region. The marathon course is 42.195 km long and takes place in May, offering participants typical spring weather with temperatures of around 20°C. The event attracts runners from various regions, providing professional organization and an attractive course.
course_highlights: A 42.195 km marathon course in Jelcz-Laskowice
Listed in regional running calendars
Typical May weather, with temperatures around 20°C and moderate rainfall
additional: Organizers: Maraton Chwałowice and Arkadiusz Tołłoczko. Registration via ElektroniczneZapisy.pl. The race is part of local sporting events in the Żórawina region. Online registration is available. The race is in the Żórawina, Tyniec Mały, and Namysłów region; a sporting event of regional significance.

name: Marszobieg Trzech Dzielnic
location: VIII Liceum Ogólnokształcące, ul. Grzegórzecka 24, Kraków, Poland
description: The Three Districts Run-Walk is a sporting event promoting physical activity, a healthy lifestyle, and integration among the residents of Kraków. It will take place on May 17, 2026, on the track at Stanisław Wyspiański 8th Secondary School, at 24 Grzegórzecka Street. The programme includes runs and walks for various age groups, including 4 km runs with timing, a 4 km walk without timing, and shorter runs for children. The Run-Walk is not only a sporting competition, but also an opportunity to spend time together and promote an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: 4 km run and walk on the track at 8th Secondary School in Kraków
Children’s runs over 200 m and 500 m
An event bringing together residents of three Kraków districts
additional: The event is organised by the Instructional Team of the Kraków-Śródmieście Scout District, with support from the Councils and Boards of Districts I Stare Miasto, II Grzegórzki, and III Prądnik Czerwony, the “Dom Harcerza” Youth Cultural Centre, and 8th Secondary School. Registration is online. The Run-Walk offers various activities suited to participants’ ages and abilities. The event includes 4 km and 500 m runs for children, as well as a 10 km run. Participants can register online, and the event is supported by local institutions and the community. The programme includes attractions and a hot meal.

name: Moderska Dwusetka Cross Biegowy
description: Moderska Dwusetka Cross Run is the second edition of an off-road race taking place on 17 May 2026 in Modrze, Poland. Participants can choose from a 5 km run, a 10 km run, or a 5 km Nordic Walking event. The course runs through fields and forests between the villages of Modrze and Drożdżyce, offering a chance to connect with nature and enjoy outdoor activity. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and bring the local community together.
course_highlights: The running and walking route passes through fields and forests between Modrze and Drożdżyce
Distances available: 5 km run, 10 km run, and 5 km Nordic Walking
The route and event format remain the same as in 2025

description: Backyard Ultra Jabłonna is a unique ultra-running event in a format that originated in the USA. Competitors start every hour and must complete a 6.706 km loop. After completing the loop, they can rest until the next full hour, and the competition continues until only one runner remains who completes the final loop within the one-hour limit. This is an endurance race where speed, strategy and perseverance all matter.

The event promotes team spirit and offers a healthy change from the working day. Runners can choose from 1.5 km, 5 km, 10 km and team races; online registration is available. The race is approved by the DLV and is part of the Michelstadt Bee Market.

name: VfL Ahaus Stadtfestlauf

The race is organized by VfL Ahaus 1892 e.V., one of the leading recreational sports clubs in the Münsterland region. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers a friendly atmosphere with a focus on health and community. The route has been carefully explored and approved by the VfL Ahaus running group, so participants can look forward to a great running experience.
course_highlights: Route reviewed and approved by the VfL Ahaus running group
Attractive town route in Ahaus
Event focused on health and community

In cooperation with AOK, VfL Ahaus also offers functional training classes. The routes are not officially measured; registration opens on March 15, 2026; places are still available; the event is part of the town festival, which features a varied accompanying program.

The course runs around Offlumer Lake, with the start and finish at the sports center on Haarweg. A range of races is offered for all age groups, from the Bambini run and student races to the 10 km main race. The event is organized by the SuS 09 Neuenkirchen running group and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with on-the-day registration available.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the sports center on Haarweg
Course around Offlumer Lake, measured by the DLV for the 10 km main race
Distances range from a 300 m Bambini run to a 10 km main race

name: Ultra-Trail® Malopolska
location: Gorce and Beskid mountains, Małopolska, Poland
description: Ultra-Trail® Małopolska is a festival of challenging mountain races held in the Małopolska region, in the Gorce and Beskid Mountains. The event offers a range of distances from 16 to 240 km, following scenic and demanding mountain trails. It is organized by the 4 Alternatywy Foundation and attracts runners who value a challenge and the beauty of mountain nature. Ultra-Trail® Małopolska is an excellent opportunity to test your abilities on courses of varying difficulty and experience the unique atmosphere of ultra running.
course_highlights: Routes through the Gorce and Beskid Mountains
Distances from 16 km to 240 km, including highly demanding ultramarathons
Scenic and technical mountain trails
additional: The organizer is the 4 Alternatywy Foundation, based in Kraków. Other running events are also held as part of the festival, including Szczebel CUP and Winter Trail Małopolska. A Ultra-Trail® Małopolska training camp is available, led by professional instructors and camp coordinator Paweł Derlatka. The organizer and camp coordinator can be contacted at fundacja@utm.run and by phone. Registration information, route details, and event updates are available on the organizer’s website. The event also includes the winter edition, Winter Trail Małopolska, in December 2025.

name: Jistebnický VH maraton
location: TJ Jistebník, Jistebník, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100-200 Kč (za jednotlivé závody, dle registrace a délky)
description: The Jistebník Water Management Half Marathon is a traditional running race, now being held for the sixteenth year in the picturesque landscape on the edge of the Poodří Protected Landscape Area. It offers routes ranging from 3.6 km to a marathon, running through nature with beautiful views of the Beskydy Mountains. The start and finish of all races are at the TJ Jistebník sports complex, which also hosts a varied programme of side events, including a children’s Olympics. The race is suitable for the general public, including children and young people, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organisation.
course_highlights: Routes run through nature on the edge of the Poodří Protected Landscape Area
Landscape between Jistebník, Polanka nad Odrou and Klimkovice
Fantastic views of the Beskydy Mountains
additional: Registration for all races opens at 7:00 and closes 20 minutes before the start of the relevant race. The start and finish are at the TJ Jistebník sports complex. There are refreshments on the course; at the finish, one of the course refreshment stations is available, and additional refreshments are offered by the local pub, known for its Marathon Soup. Parking is available near the complex, though using train or bus connections is recommended. Changing rooms and showers are available after the race. Blood and blood plasma donors receive a 50% discount on the entry fee upon proof of their most recent donation. The races take place in a natural setting and offer various route distances, including children’s categories and a side programme. Online registration is available.

name: Vrané – Zvole
location: Vrané nad Vltavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Vrané - Zvole is part of the KOPEC series, which features uphill races in Prague and the surrounding area. This race offers a challenge in the form of a demanding climb and is intended for runners who want to test their endurance and strength on hilly terrain. The KOPEC series is a long-standing, popular circuit where runners are automatically included in the overall standings without needing to register separately. The races are organised with an emphasis on fair play, safety and sportsmanship.
course_highlights: An uphill race through the terrain of Prague and Central Bohemia
A demanding climb and a hilly course profile
Part of the long-standing KOPEC series, with scoring and league standings
additional: Runners are automatically included in the overall KOPEC series standings by taking part in any race. The series standings are determined by the total points earned for placing in individual races, with a maximum of the 10 best results counted. Runners must follow the rules for starting and conduct on the course, including wearing a race number and not receiving assistance from other people or animals. If health is at risk, the race director may interrupt or end the race.

name: Štramberská desítka
description: Štramberk Ten is a traditional road race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletics Club Kopřivnice. The race takes place in the picturesque town of Štramberk and offers a 10 km mixed-terrain course, mostly on roads. The event is open to the general public and is known for its friendly atmosphere and rich history. Participants can expect refreshments at the finish and prizes for the top runners in various categories. The race takes place in traffic, and each participant runs at their own risk.
course_highlights: 10 km course, mixed terrain with mostly road running
Refreshments at the finish and traditional Štramberk ears
Course records: men 37:26.6, women 47:26.5
additional: Race-day registration is open from 9:15 to 10:40 at the gymnasium of Štramberk Primary School. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Sokol Hall in Štramberk. Prizes are awarded in age and gender categories, including cash bonuses and non-cash prizes. The race is part of the Ing. Petr Bayer Memorial. Registration is from 9:15 to 10:40 at the primary school gymnasium in Štramberk; refreshments are provided at the finish, and changing rooms and showers are available at the Sokol Hall. The race takes place in traffic, and participants run at their own risk.

name: Berounská desítka
price_range: drahší poplatek na místě, přesná cena není uvedena
description: Berounská desítka is a revived running race with a long tradition, taking place on 23 May 2026 in the village of Zdejcina near Beroun. It offers three distances: the 10 km main race for experienced runners, a shorter 4 km route suitable for everyone, and a free 500 m children’s run. The course follows forest trails with 252 metres of elevation gain and reaches its highest point at the Děd lookout tower, 491 m above sea level. Runners can look forward to refreshments during and after the race, as well as a welcoming atmosphere that revives the local running tradition.
course_highlights: Paved and unpaved forest trails
Highest point at the Děd lookout tower (491 m above sea level)
252 metres of total elevation gain
additional: Race-number collection is open from 8:00 to 10:00 on race day. Runners in the 10 km race can get refreshments at approximately 6 km, and fruit and water after finishing. The 500 m children’s race starts at 10:15; the 4 km and 10 km races start together at 11:00. Payment on site is possible, but costs more. The race takes place in all weather; suitable footwear for wet terrain is recommended. Parking is available on Hudlická Road; runners are advised not to try to park directly in the village. Course with 252 m of elevation gain; refreshments before the start, at 6 km and after finishing; parking on Hudlická Road; weather may vary; race takes place in all weather.

name: Orelský běh lesoparkem Skalky, memoriál prof. P. Leopolda Benáčka
location: Olešnice v Jihomoravském kraji, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Orel Run through Skalky Forest Park is a traditional sporting event organized by Orel, a Christian sports organization, in Olešnice in the South Moravian Region. The Prof. P. Leopold Benáček Memorial gives runners the opportunity to compete in the beautiful natural setting of Skalky Forest Park. The event is part of Orel’s broader program, which supports sport for all in the spirit of fair play and a healthy lifestyle. The race is suitable for the general public and contributes to the development of sporting activities in the region.
course_highlights: Skalky Forest Park, with natural running trails
Beautiful natural surroundings near Olešnice
A traditional memorial race dedicated to Prof. P. Leopold Benáček
additional: The race is part of the OBL 2026 race schedule, offers rules and results, and takes place in May 2026

name: Hannah Pilsen Trail Letkov
location: Letkov u Plzně, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Hannah Pilsen Trail Letkov is a traditional outdoor running race near Plzeň, offering scenic courses of varying lengths and difficulty. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Letkov and is part of the celebrations marking the municipality’s 750th anniversary. The route passes Jandova skála and Čilina, and also includes a marathon with climbs to Maršál and Radyně. A multigenerational relay is available for children and families, encouraging active movement across all generations.
course_highlights: 8.5 km course via Jandova skála
21 km course via Čilina
Marathon with climbs to Maršál and Radyně
additional: The race is part of the Plzeň Region Running Cup. Children’s races and the multigenerational children-and-parents relay “Běžíme pro Totem” are also available. The race is one of the events celebrating Letkov’s 750th anniversary. The event offers various course distances, including 8.5 km, 21 km and a marathon, as well as family relays and children’s categories. Registration opens at the end of 2025, and the races take place in a natural setting, with refreshments and medals for participants.

description: Tisá Ultra Trail is a new event that continues the tradition of the Libouchec Ultramarathon. It offers several routes of varying lengths and difficulty in the beautiful surroundings of Tisá and the surrounding area. The races run mostly off asphalt roads, along forest and field roads and trails, with clear course markings. The race facilities are well equipped, with showers, changing rooms and refreshments, as well as the option to stay overnight in your own tent or car. The organizers emphasize safety and environmental responsibility, for example by limiting the use of plastic cups at aid stations.
course_highlights: The routes run mostly off asphalt roads, along forest and field roads and trails
Aid stations are placed every 15–20 km and offer a varied selection of food and drinks
Race facilities include changing rooms, showers, toilets and the option to stay overnight in your own tent or car
additional: The start and finish are behind the football pitch in Tisá. Facilities include changing rooms, toilets, showers, seating and refreshments in a covered tent. You can stay overnight in your own tent or car. Parking is available at the Burg grounds. Mandatory equipment for the 100 km race includes a race timing chip and a fully charged mobile phone. Aid stations offer water, cola, sports drinks, fruit, bread, cheese, biscuits, muesli bars and salt. Soup and a main meal are served at the finish; bringing your own dishes and cutlery is recommended. The 10 km race starts at 12:00, and the 100 km race at 5:00. Registration and drop-bag handover take place the day before the race. Course options range from 25 km to 100 km, with children’s races, facilities at the football pitch and in the Libouchec hall, the option of a tent campsite, ceramic medals and participant T-shirts.

name: Běhej lesy Brdy

description: Běhej lesy Brdy is a trail running event held in the Brdy Protected Landscape Area, near Prague and Příbram. The event offers various routes, including short and long distances that are part of the international UTMB Index Races. Runners can enjoy beautiful nature, technical sections and competitions for valuable prizes. The finish straight has been extended to 500 metres, adding an interesting twist for all participants. The Běhej lesy series is known for its community atmosphere and respect for nature.
course_highlights: UTMB Index Races with international ranking points
Conti Speed Section — a 150-metre speed section marked with Continental flags
Generali Investments Finish — an extended 500 m finish straight with a timed section
additional: In Brdy, runners compete on the Nova 12 km and ČSOB 22 km routes. The prize for the Conti Speed Section is a tyre voucher and a running shirt. The fastest man and woman across all routes will each receive a Craft technical running shirt and the title GENERALI INVESTMENTS FINISHER #1. The event features various distances from 4 to 22 km, children’s races, an accompanying programme and options for families to take part. It takes place in the natural surroundings of the Brdy Protected Landscape Area, with an emphasis on ecology and community spirit.

description: The Run for Litoměřice Hospice is a charity sporting event held to support St. Stephen’s Hospice in Litoměřice. Participants run to help those nearing the end of their life and contribute to funding and supporting hospice care. The event takes place in a beautiful setting and includes professional timekeeping. “Those who run help others” is the race’s main motto.

Beautiful surroundings in Litoměřice
Professional timekeeping

name: Milada Run
location: Hlavní pláž jezera Milada, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Milada Run is part of the popular Milada Tour sports series, held in the unique landscape of a former lignite mine transformed into the natural Milada Lake. The 10th anniversary edition offers a friendly, family atmosphere, with routes for children and adults. The races follow rolling and flat paths, with beautiful views of the lake and surrounding countryside. The race’s high standards and popularity are confirmed by the participants themselves.

Children’s races of 500 m and 1 km take place near the main beach, with parental supervision

The accompanying program includes an Olympia children’s corner and childcare. The event features courses around Milada Lake, children’s races, medals for all participants, and an accompanying program.

name: Brdské rokle
location: Lesní divadlo, Řevnice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Brdské rokle is a trail race held in the picturesque setting of the Forest Theatre in Řevnice, offering three courses of varying lengths and difficulty. All routes run through the forest over varied terrain, including climbs, descents and beautiful views of springtime nature. The race is known for its technical sections and undulating profile, which challenge both runners and experienced trail enthusiasts. You can have your name printed on your race bib, and runners can make use of facilities with refreshments and a kids’ corner for families with children.
course_highlights: Forest routes with 200–360 m of elevation gain, depending on course length
Technical sections featuring rocky and soft forest paths
Beautiful views and spring nature in full bloom

The facilities at the Forest Theatre include toilets, baggage storage and refreshments at the finish (Corny bars, bananas, water and Ionilyte isotonic drink). A kids’ corner with arts and crafts activities and supervision by an experienced teacher is available for children. Travelling by train is recommended due to limited parking in Řevnice. Trail races in nature, technical sections, refreshment stations, 10 km and 15 km routes, starting from the Forest Theatre in Řevnice.

This race is ideal for mountain-running enthusiasts who want to enjoy the beauty of nature while taking on a sporting challenge. A range of distances from 10 km to 50 km

The event supports children in need, with all entry fees and voluntary contributions for the original running shirts going directly to Život dětem, a public benefit organisation. The programme also includes free children’s races and a non-competitive scooter ride. The race is ideal for teams who want to combine sporting achievement with supporting a good cause.
course_highlights: Relay route around the Olšovec pond
Four laps of 5.5 km or two laps of 11 km
Follow the race progress live on a large screen

The children’s races are free and take place from 13:30 to 14:45, followed by the results announcement. The main race starts at 15:00 and consists of four laps, with a 3-hour time limit. Registration is available via an online form. The event also includes children’s races and a ceremonial awards presentation.

description: Běhám pro děti is a sports and entertainment afternoon that has been held since 2015 to support children and young people from children’s homes. The event features running races and fun sporting activities for all age groups, including a family run and a team relay. The program also includes face painting, a bouncy castle, a magic show, and musical performances. In 2026, the event will take place on May 23 in Na Pankráci Park in Prague 4, under the patronage of the mayor of Prague 4. Everyone who helps is a winner, and every participant is entered into a prize draw.
course_highlights: The Prague 4 Mayor’s Cup 5 km race in Na Pankráci Park
A 1 km family run for 2 to 5 members, with everyone starting and finishing together
A 4 × 1 km team relay, with at least one adult on each team

The event includes a rich program of musical performances and fun activities for children. It is held under the patronage of the mayor of Prague 4. name: SeziRun

price_range: 150 Kč pro hlavní závody, 100 Kč za 4 km s kočárkem, 50 Kč pro děti do 16 let, dobrovolný příspěvek pro děti do 12 let
description: SeziRun is a traditional running race held in Sezimovo Ústí on May 23, 2026. The 10th anniversary edition offers a wide range of races for children and adults, including a half marathon and 12 km, 6 km, and 4 km distances. The race is suitable for all ages and ability levels, with winners announced in individual categories. Parking is available near the start and finish, making it easier for participants to get there. The atmosphere is sporty and friendly, with photos shared and a limited-edition headband available for participants.

The photo gallery is shared with all SeziRun participants and fans. The race takes place in a natural setting and offers online registration, refreshments, chip timing, and a raffle with prizes. Temporary changing rooms are available on site in a haystack, with no showers or storage facilities.

name: Zaječický bůr
location: Zaječice u Pyšel, Zaječice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Zaječický bůr is a traditional cross-country race with a family-friendly atmosphere, offering courses for all ages, from children to adults. The race takes place in the picturesque setting of Zaječice near Pyšely and is part of the Ladův kraj Cup. Prizes are awarded to the top three finishers in each category, with prize money for a course record on the longest course. The race is popular for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization, attracting runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Five courses ranging from 55 m to 10,555 m for different age categories
A grand prize for the overall winner of the MAXI zajíci category over 5,555 m
Part of the Ladův kraj Cup, with prize money for a course record over 10,555 m
additional: You can register online until 22 May or in person on race day. Starts are staggered by category from 9:00 to 12:50. Parking is available near the start and is signposted from the entrance to Zaječice. The race counts toward the Ladův kraj Cup and the Central Bohemian Regional Ski Association. The HOLE category is Nordic walking, with technique judged. The race offers medals, prizes, certificates, race packs, refreshments for all participants (a biscuit, juice or tea, and soup), and online registration. The event is suitable for the whole family and also includes activities for children.

name: Krok za Šimonka
location: Skalka, Nový Jičín, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Krok za Šimonka is a sporting event held to support a fundraiser for Šimonka, a boy with the rare metabolic disorder Lesch–Nyhan syndrome. The event offers a fun-filled day of sports for the whole family at Skalka near Nový Jičín. Its aim is not only to support treatment and rehabilitation, but also to raise awareness of the disorder and the strength of the community. Participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere and the chance to support a good cause.
course_highlights: A 13 km run combining paved and trail routes
Supporting children with serious illnesses, especially Šimonka, who has Lesch–Nyhan syndrome
Accompanying activities, a raffle, and a fundraiser to support healthcare
additional: The event is a fun-filled day of sports for the whole family, with refreshments. Support also includes selling T-shirts, with part of the proceeds going toward Šimonka’s treatment. The event takes place at the Skalka amphitheatre; online registration is available, and the proceeds go toward rehabilitation, assistive devices, and medical examinations. The programme includes races for children and adults, activities, and a fundraiser.

name: Běh pro úsměv – Pelhřimovský půlmaraton
location: Pelhřimov náměstí, Pelhřimov, Vysočina, Czech Republic
price_range: startovné při registraci do 30. dubna 2026 (cena není explicitně uvedena)
description: Běh pro úsměv is a sporting event for the whole family, held at Masaryk Square in Pelhřimov. This Pelhřimov half marathon is suitable for both sporty and non-sporty families, active seniors, and children from 1 year old. You don’t have to run the race—you can walk it. Half of the entry fees go to the Julinka Endowment Fund, which works to combat childhood obesity. The children’s and parents’ races take place one after the other, and while waiting for their parents, children can enjoy activities such as face painting, a bouncy castle, riding scooters, or learning first aid.
course_highlights: The 5 km, 10 km, and half-marathon courses are certified
Children’s races have no placing awards; they are all about fun and smiles
Start and finish at Masaryk Square in Pelhřimov
additional: Race bib collection and race-day registration open at 8:30. Bibs must be collected at least 20 minutes before the start. Runners in the 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon are timed using disposable chips attached to their race bibs. Registration by 30 April 2026 includes a medal, a race bib with the runner’s name, and Rajec water. Parents accompanying children run for free. A bag drop is available for runners. The event is hosted by Ondřej Havlík (En.dru) and Petr Cerha (Nasty). The races are suitable for all age groups, including children and seniors, with activities for children and a charitable purpose.

name: Memoriál Ivana Belobrada
description: The Ivan Belobrad Memorial is a traditional running race held in Dlouhoňovice and part of the ISCAREX Cup. The race offers courses of up to 9 km along village roads, forest paths and field tracks, with varied surfaces. It is suitable for the general public, including young people and children, with a flexible start time for the youngest participants. The event takes place in a pleasant sports complex and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: A course of up to 9 km along asphalt roads, forest paths and field tracks
Varied surfaces: asphalt, paved and unpaved terrain
Dlouhoňovice Sports Complex serves as the start and finish venue
additional: Registration is open from 8:00 to 8:30, the first category starts at 9:00, and the main course starts at 11:00. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup. A fun run with a flexible start time is available for the youngest children. Registration is available online and on site, with different entry fees. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup 2026 series and includes various categories; exact course details are not specified.

name: Přibyslavský kros
location: Přibyslav u Nové Paky, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Město Přibyslav ve spolupráci s ACO Industries k.s.
description: Přibyslav Cross Country is a cross-country and trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of Přibyslav near Nová Paka in the Hradec Králové Region. The race offers two routes, 8 km and 4 km long, through natural terrain and forest paths. The main category starts at 11:00, making it convenient for both the general public and competitive runners to take part. The event is organized by the Town of Přibyslav in cooperation with ACO Industries k.s. and David Myslivec, who ensure the event is well organized.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail routes
8 km and 4 km routes through natural surroundings
Forest paths and natural terrain
additional: The first category starts at 10:00 and the main category at 11:00. The event is organized by the Town of Přibyslav in cooperation with ACO Industries k.s. and David Myslivec (telephone 728 334 590). The race features cross-country and trail routes, with starts scheduled for 10:00 and 11:00; registration conditions are not specified.

name: Běh do vrchu Poniklá – Rezek
location: Tuláčkova Návsi, Poniklá, Liberec District, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: The Poniklá–Rezek uphill run is a traditional sporting event held in the village of Poniklá. It starts at Tuláčkova náves and climbs uphill to Rezek. The event is suited to runners who enjoy challenges on natural terrain and want to spend an active day outdoors in beautiful surroundings. The organiser is Petr Holec, who ensures the race runs smoothly.
course_highlights: Start at Tuláčkova náves in Poniklá
Uphill run finishing at Rezek
Natural terrain and scenic views
additional: The race starts at Tuláčkova náves. There are various distances, including 2 km and 9.2 km, and the course features a demanding climb and a final ascent to Rezek. The event is supported by the local community and also offers an evening programme.

name: Gočárův běh
location: Hradec Králové and Pardubice, Hradec Králové Region, Czech Republic
description: Gočár’s Run is a unique race connecting the two regional capitals of Hradec Králové and Pardubice, following in the footsteps of architect Josef Gočár. Runners take on a 33-kilometre course combining road and natural-surface sections, with Gočár’s buildings as a backdrop, from the schools in Hradec to the iconic Automatic Mills in Pardubice. The race is open to individuals, pairs, four-person relay teams and children, offering not only a sporting challenge but also a cultural and social experience, with a supporting programme and live music. Gočár’s Run is quickly becoming a tradition in the East Bohemian region, attracting hundreds of runners and thousands of fans every year.
course_highlights: 33 km course from Hradec Králové to Pardubice
A mix of road and natural-surface sections
Gočár’s buildings along the route, including the Automatic Mills
additional: The race pack includes original Eleven socks, a medal, a pack of Hradecký Klenot beer, a race bib with logo, an electronic timing chip, refreshments on the course and at the finish, a digital certificate and a supporting programme. Facilities and services include changing rooms, baggage storage with transfer to the finish, medical services, catering, race photos and video, Craft shoe testing and taping at a reduced price. The VIP experience includes a personalised T-shirt, a certificate and a rooftop experience at the Automatic Mills. The supporting programme features live music, children’s activities, various race categories and the chance to share the experience with friends.

name: Bóžovo 59ka
description: Bóžovo 59ka is a traditional race organized by the Jasan Ski Club in Aš, Karlovy Vary Region. The race takes place on May 23, 2026, and offers a sporting experience in beautiful surroundings, with club members and the public welcome to take part. Jasan is known for its long tradition and active approach to training and racing in the region.
course_highlights: The course includes hills around Aš
The race takes place on May 23, 2026
The organizer offers sporting experiences in a natural setting
additional: Registration until January 31, 2026; the race course includes hills and natural terrain around Aš; start and registration information is available on the official website.

name: Běh o štěně okolo Poděbrad - memoriál Zdeňka Slepičky
description: The Běh o štěně - Zdeněk Slepička Memorial is a 7.2 km cross-country race held in Hejčín, Olomouc. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for distance runners and offers runners an interesting course through natural terrain. The event is suited to cross-country running enthusiasts who want to test themselves on a more challenging course with varied surfaces. The race has a long tradition and is named in memory of Zdeněk Slepička.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through natural terrain
7.2 km course
Part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for distance runners
additional: The event is open to the wider running community and supports the regional running community.

description: Žlutavská 11 is a running race that takes you through the scenic hills around the village of Žlutava. It offers routes for all ages, from the youngest children to a race of over 11 km. Runners can enjoy ample refreshments and comfortable facilities, including changing rooms and showers. Come and enjoy the sporting atmosphere and beautiful countryside around Žlutava.
course_highlights: Main route: 11.3 km with 227 m of elevation gain
Course surface: asphalt (35%), grass and dirt (30%), gravel (35%)
Scenic hills around the village of Žlutava
additional: Runners have access to chip timing, refreshments (drinks and fruit), a meal and drink voucher for online registrants in the main races A and B, participation medals for children, and prizes for the top three in each age category. Changing rooms and showers are available. IZS categories have special conditions, and part of the entry fee is donated to the Military Solidarity Fund. A route of over 11 km, refreshments, showers, parking by the football pitch, registration online and on site, various age categories, start date: 23.5.2026.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Brno
location: Brno, Pavilon Anthropos, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: registrace on-line od 400 Kč / štafeta od 2 000 Kč

description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Brno is a sporting and social event held in support of the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of eyewitnesses and helps them. The race takes place at the Anthropos Pavilion and offers timed 6 km and 10.5 km runs, a 4 x 2.5 km relay, as well as untimed family and children’s runs. The route follows the Svratka River on paved paths and asphalt. Participants’ entry fees help fund the recording and preservation of eyewitness stories and educational programs.
course_highlights: Route along the Svratka River toward Kamenná Colony and Kamenný Bridge
Paved paths and asphalt
Timed runs: 6 km (1 lap) and 10.5 km (2 laps)
additional: Start and finish at the Anthropos Pavilion. Changing rooms, baggage storage, restroom facilities, water for rinsing off, and refreshments to replenish energy are available. Pupils, students under 18, members of the Memory of the Nation Club, and runners over 65 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. On-site registration is available at a higher entry fee. The event includes not only sporting activities but also an accompanying program with music, refreshments, and facilities including changing rooms and water stations. Registration is available online and on-site.

name: Jistebnický vodohospodářský půlmaraton
location: Sportovní areál TJ Jistebník, Jistebník, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 Kč (pro mladistvé do 19 let registrované do 17.5.2024), 200 Kč na místě
description: The Jistebník Water Management Half Marathon is a traditional running event now being held for the sixteenth year in the picturesque landscape on the edge of the Poodří Protected Landscape Area. Races range from 3.6 km to a marathon, including relays and a children’s Olympics, and both start and finish at the TJ Jistebník sports complex. The routes pass through nature, with beautiful views of the Beskydy Mountains, and run between the villages of Jistebník, Polanka nad Odrou and Klimkovice. The event also features a varied accompanying program and is suitable for a wide range of runners and families with children.
course_highlights: Routes pass through nature on the edge of the Poodří Protected Landscape Area
Landscape between Jistebník, Polanka nad Odrou and Klimkovice
Views of the Beskydy Mountains
additional: The start and finish of all races are at the TJ Jistebník sports complex. Registration opens at 7:00 and closes 20 minutes before the start of each race. Refreshments are available on the course, and one of the refreshments is included in the entry fee at the finish. Trying the Marathon Soup at the local pub is recommended. Parking is available near the complex and along the main road; using train and bus connections is ideal. The event also includes a children’s Olympics and an accompanying program from 10:00 to 15:00. Blood and blood plasma donors receive a 50% discount on the entry fee upon proof of their most recent donation. The course runs through natural areas, the event includes multiple race categories and children’s activities, and it takes place in May 2026.

name: Krušnej seběh
location: Nové Hamry, Karlovarský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Krušnej seběh is a traditional running race organized by Bike Team Nejdek, held in the picturesque setting of Nové Hamry in the Karlovy Vary Region. The race offers two courses: the longer FullHD, approximately 14 km, and the shorter HD, 7 km. They run mainly along forest trails and surfaced paths through hilly terrain with technical sections. Both the start and finish are in Nové Hamry, and the start has been moved earlier so the race takes up only part of the morning. The race is suitable for all runners looking for a challenging but attractive cross-country run in the Ore Mountains.
course_highlights: Loop course of 14 km (FullHD) and 7 km (HD)
Forest trails, surfaced forest paths, and asphalt sections
Hilly terrain with demanding climbs and technical descents
additional: The race starts in Nové Hamry by the Velká sjezdovka. The course is a loop, with a refreshment station along the route for FullHD participants and at the finish. Transport to the start is provided, so there is no need to travel by train. Results are announced before noon, so the race takes up only the morning. Course options: FullHD (18.9 km) and HD (11 km); hilly profile; bus transfer from registration to the start; on-site and online registration; changes to the route and schedule compared with previous editions.

name: Běšinský běh
location: Běšiny u Klatov, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: The Běšinský Run is a traditional running race held in Běšiny near Klatovy, offering a 4.8 km course. The race is mixed and also includes a hill-climb bonus, adding to its appeal and challenge for runners. The start is at the football field, and the race takes place in all weather. It is organized by Sokol Běšiny, which ensures a friendly atmosphere and a safe event.
course_highlights: A 4.8 km course in Běšiny near Klatovy
A mixed race with a hill-climb bonus
Start at the football field
additional: The race takes place in all weather. Each participant takes part at their own risk and is responsible for their own health. Children enter for free. The course goes through the football field; registration is at your own risk; race in all weather; hill-climb bonus.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Olomouc

description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Olomouc is a sporting and community event held in support of the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses. The race takes place on 23 May 2026 in Smetana and Čech Gardens and offers timed 5 km and 10 km races and a 4 × 2.5 km relay, as well as untimed children’s and family runs. The start and finish are by the collection greenhouses in Smetana Gardens. The event is suitable for all ages and celebrates heroism and freedom.
course_highlights: The route follows marked loops through Smetana and Čech Gardens
The 5 km race consists of 2 loops, and the 10 km race of 4 loops
The relay consists of 4 legs of 2.5 km each
additional: Pupils, students under 18, members of the Friends of the Memory of the Nation Club, and runners over 65 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. Changing rooms, a baggage drop, sanitary facilities, and water at the finish are available. The accompanying programme includes stalls with games for children, a relaxation and science zone run by Palacký University, workshops, and prize competitions. Race numbers are distributed during check-in on race day. The event includes refreshments, water, a family- and child-friendly programme, and supports remembrance of the past and the fight for freedom.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Jihlava
location: Český mlýn, Jihlava, Vysočina, Czech Republic
organizer: Post Bellum, z. ú. a Parlament Gymnázia Jihlava
price_range: on-line registrace od 200 Kč, na místě od 300 Kč
description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Jihlava is a sporting and community event held in support of the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps them. The race takes place at the Český mlýn complex, with the start and finish behind the skatepark. Runners can choose timed 4 km and 10 km races, or untimed children’s and family races. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a pleasant setting on paved cycle paths. The entry fee is a donation for a good cause and supports the Memory of the Nation.
course_highlights: The course follows paved cycle paths in the Český mlýn complex
The start and finish are located behind the skatepark in the complex
Offers timed 4 km and 10 km races, as well as untimed children’s and family races
additional: Pupils, students under 18, members of the Memory of the Nation club, and runners over 65 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. Sanitary facilities, water at the finish, and refreshments are available. Registration and race-number pickup take place on race day at the specified times. Results are announced after the competitors finish. Paved paths, registration details, support for different race categories

name: Greifenstein Berglauf
organizer: Fussfit Petry GmbH, webconcept GbR, weitere lokale Sponsoren
description: The Greifenstein Mountain Run is a challenging 5.3 km road race from Ehringshausen-Katzenfurt to Greifenstein Castle, taking place for the 27th time on 30 May 2026. The route follows country roads and farm tracks, climbing a total of 260 metres to the finish at the castle, which offers a wonderful view of the region. The race is open to youth, men, women and seniors, with a combined ranking across all categories. Nordic walking is offered without age-category rankings, and a free children’s race for the youngest participants takes place separately in the afternoon. The event concludes with an awards ceremony and refreshments in the courtyard of Greifenstein Castle.
course_highlights: 5.3 km road race with 260 metres of elevation gain
Start in Katzenfurt, finish at Greifenstein Castle with panoramic views
Challenging section of the course above Edingen
additional: The entry fee includes a bus transfer to the start, transport of clothing to the finish, and drinks at the start and finish. Race numbers and finisher shirts will be distributed in the courtyard of Greifenstein Castle from 14:00 on event day. Late registration is possible on event day until 30 minutes before the start. Parking is available at the outskirts of Greifenstein in the direction of Beilstein. A free children’s race will be held at around 16:50, accompanied by members of LG Dill. The awards ceremony and refreshments—including coffee, cake, cold drinks and bratwurst—will take place in the castle courtyard. In clear weather, the courtyard offers impressive views across the Dill Valley as far as the Feldberg in the Taunus. Register online by 28.05.2026; start in Katzenfurt, finish at Greifenstein Castle; no relay or walking event; results available since 2008.

name: Internationaler Biesfelder Dorflauf
location: Kürten, Rheinisch-Bergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
