description: The International Biesfeld Village Run is a long-standing running event in the municipality of Kürten, taking place on 30 May 2026. The race is known for its hilly course, which challenges runners and carries the slogan “Flat is somewhere else.” Various distances, including races for toddlers and schoolchildren, offer suitable competitions for all age groups. The event is organized by Biesfeld Triathlon e.V. and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with the start and finish at the Biesfeld Community Primary School.
course_highlights: Hilly race in the municipality of Kürten, with challenging climbs
Distances from 0.6 km (toddler race) to 9.2 km (main race)
Start and finish in the schoolyard of Biesfeld Community Primary School
additional: Race packs will be handed out on race day in the schoolyard of Biesfeld Community Primary School. No separate timing chip is required, as the chip is integrated into the race bib (RaceResult). A late registration fee of €3.00 applies from 23.05.2026; late registrations are possible on site on race day. Distances: 0.6 km, 2.1 km, 9.2 km; online registration until 28.05.2026; race bib with chip; event in Kürten-Biesfeld

name: Wälster Lauf
description: The Wälster Lauf is a traditional fun run and road race in Drensteinfurt-Walstedde, organised annually by Fortuna Walstedde. The course is measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and offers runners and walkers of all ages an appealing opportunity to get active. The event traditionally opens the sports week in the village of Lambertusdorf Walstedde and continues to attract growing numbers of participants. Alongside competition, the focus is also on the enjoyment of exercise and community.
course_highlights: DLV-measured course in Drensteinfurt-Walstedde
Fun run and road race with various distances
Traditional opening event of the sports week in the village of Lambertusdorf Walstedde
additional: The Wälster Lauf offers running and walking on a DLV-measured course. The event includes various age groups and distances, including a Bambini run, children’s races, a fun run, 5 km and 10 km road races, and walking. Start times are staggered from 15:30 to 17:15. The event opens the sports week in the village of Lambertusdorf Walstedde and continues to attract growing numbers of participants. It is a well-established regional running tradition, with courses known for their accuracy and fairness. It is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes.

name: Enzenbüschlauf Neroth – Der Naturlauf am Eifelsteig
Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – edycja wiosenna 2026
location: Leśny Ogród Botaniczny Marszewo, Gdynia, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race held in the picturesque Marszewo Forest Botanical Garden in Gdynia. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka race series, which has been promoting running and the beauty of natural routes in Poland since 2014. The race attracts running enthusiasts who value being close to nature and the beauty of their surroundings. It’s a great opportunity to spend time outdoors among greenery and enjoy a unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country route through the Marszewo Forest Botanical Garden
Picturesque natural surroundings and scenic beauty
Spring race as part of the Botaniczna Piątka series
additional: The race takes place between 10:00 and 14:00. The organizers are a group of running enthusiasts who focus on cross-country races and attractive locations. The event is part of a series of races held in different Polish cities during the spring season. It is open to runners of varying abilities, with the option to take part in a 5 km race. The event promotes outdoor activity and encourages local communities to take up running.

name: I Górski Pólmaraton Szczytniański
location: Szczytna, Kłodzko County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 1st Szczytna Mountain Half Marathon is a unique running event held in picturesque Szczytna, on a 21.1 km course with numerous mountain climbs. The race offers beautiful views of this charming town in the Kłodzko Land and a chance to connect with nature, giving every participant an unforgettable experience. The event also includes a 10 km Nordic Walking walk, an excellent option for people who enjoy active recreation without time pressure. The event’s organizer, the Szczytna Biega Association, promotes a healthy lifestyle and brings the local running community together.
course_highlights: A 21.1 km half-marathon course with numerous mountain climbs
Picturesque views and a chance to connect with nature in the charming Kłodzko Land region
Untimed 10 km Nordic Walking, with prizes and a shared finish line with the runners
additional: 10% discount for teams of 5 or more. Nordic Walking is untimed, with prizes at the finish and a shared finish line with the half-marathon participants. The Nordic Walking route passes through the most beautiful corner of the Kłodzko Land, with forest trails and a Sudeten atmosphere. Mountain running, preparation and training plans are available online; the event is aimed at fans of trail running and mountain challenges.

name: Kiełczowska Dycha i Piątka
location: Kiełczów, Wrocław, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Kiełczowska Dycha i Piątka is a unique running event taking place on 23 May 2026 in Kiełczów. It’s a full Day of Sport, designed for professionals, amateurs and families alike. The event combines sporting competition with bringing the local community together, offering positive energy and the chance to improve your running times. It is part of the Biegowe Grand Prix Zagłębia Miedziowego and promotes physical activity at all levels.
course_highlights: A scenic, runner-friendly course in Kiełczów
Two distances to choose from: 10 km and 5 km
A family event with a welcoming atmosphere and sporting competition
additional: Registration is via the external system fitstrefa-kielczow.cms.efitness.com.pl. The event is part of the Biegowe Grand Prix Zagłębia Miedziowego. Timing is provided by Feniks - Timing, which offers professional electronic timekeeping services. Street race; online registration available; the event promotes sport and local community integration.

name: Maraton Zagłębiowski
location: ArcelorMittal Park – ZPS Sosnowiec, Sosnowiec, Śląskie, Poland
organizer: Centrum Sportu i Rekreacji w Dąbrowie Górniczej
description: The Zagłębie Marathon is a prestigious marathon held at ArcelorMittal Park - ZPS Sosnowiec. The course is officially certified by the Polish Athletics Association, guaranteeing an accurately measured distance and reliable results. The event is for runners of varying ability levels and combines sporting competition with the satisfaction of overcoming personal challenges. The organizers provide professional event management and extensive support for participants.
course_highlights: Course officially certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA)
The race takes place at ArcelorMittal Park - ZPS Sosnowiec
Professionally prepared and accurately measured course
additional: Registration is through the Datasport Registration Portal. Participants can run the marathon individually or as part of a two-person relay, with each participant completing a half marathon. The certified course allows results to be compared with those from other races. The event is part of the Zagłębie Triad, a series of three races in the region. The event includes relay options, a 6-hour time limit, and course attractions, including the halfway point at Pogoria 3 and a spectator zone.

name: Pancerna Piątka
organizer: Zarząd Wojewódzki NSZZ Policjantów województwa podkarpackiego
description: Pancerna Piątka is the Podkarpackie Police Championships in the 5 km road race, held in Żurawica. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship Police Commander in Rzeszów. More than 400 participants take part, and the course follows roads through Żurawica. The event is organized by the Regional Board of the Independent Self-Governing Trade Union of Police Officers of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship.
course_highlights: 5 km road race
The course follows roads through Żurawica
The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship Police Commander in Rzeszów
additional: More than 400 participants take part. The event is organized by the Regional Board of the Independent Self-Governing Trade Union of Police Officers of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship. The race takes place on 23 May 2026, with electronic timing, and is part of local events promoting sport and physical activity.

name: Ultramaraton Jaga-Kora
description: The Jaga-Kora Ultramarathon is a mountain ultramarathon held in the picturesque Beskid Niski region, on routes of varying difficulty. The event commemorates the historic “Jaga-Kora” Courier Route from World War II, giving the race a unique character and historical significance. Participants can choose from five distances, ranging from 19 km to 101 km, which pass through the areas around Jaśliska and Rymanów-Zdrój. The race is certified by ITRA and UTMB, underscoring its standing in the mountain-running community.
course_highlights: The route follows the historic “Jaga-Kora” Courier Route from World War II
Five distances of varying difficulty: 101 km, 68 km, 42 km, 33 km and 19 km
The course passes through the picturesque Beskid Niski region, including Jaśliska and Rymanów-Zdrój
additional: Starts take place overnight and in the morning on 23 May 2026, with different start times for each distance. The race office is open on 22 May from 17:00 to 22:00 and on 23 May from 5:00 to 7:30. Coach transport to the starts is provided for the 100 km, 33 km and 19 km distances. The courses have specified cutoff times, and the winners’ awards ceremonies take place on the stage at the amphitheatre beside the gazebos above Czarny Potok. Prizes will not be sent to participants who are absent from the awards ceremony. Registration opens on 1 December 2025. Detailed routes and the schedule are available on the organizer’s website. The event includes aid stations and awards ceremonies, live tracking and online results.

name: Bieg Ulicą Piotrkowską Rossman Run
description: The Bieg Ulicą Piotrkowską Rossmann Run is one of Poland’s most important running events, held in central Łódź on Piotrkowska Street. Launched in 2003, the race attracts both recreational runners and leading competitors from across the country. The route runs along the city’s representative thoroughfare, and the event is accompanied by a wide range of attractions, including a food zone and a free post-race recovery meal. A Mini Run over shorter distances is organized for children and people with disabilities.
course_highlights: The route runs along Piotrkowska Street in Łódź
Start and finish near Scheiblerów Avenue, close to Poznańskich Avenue
Evening start at 19:00, with start zones assigned according to declared finish times
additional: The race office is open from Wednesday to Saturday at Łódź Fabryczna Railway Station. Bag storage and changing rooms are available at the station. Showers are available at the Well Fitness club upon presentation of a race bib. Participants can travel free of charge on Łódzka Kolej Aglomeracyjna on race day. After the race, the organizer provides a free recovery meal—a soup. Each participant can enjoy a one-hour visit to the pool and sauna area at Aquapark Fala from 20 to 25 May 2026. Accompanying persons are prohibited from travelling along the route on bicycles, scooters, or other vehicles. Traffic and public transport disruptions will occur during the race, which starts at 19:00; disruptions are expected from 18:00 to 21:30.

name: 10 Family Run
description: The 10th KSOS Family Run is a special celebration of family running held on Kraków’s Błonia. The event brings generations together, promotes physical activity and family bonding, and offers a variety of races for children and parents, as well as an open race for everyone. The event also features games and activities for children, a simultaneous chess exhibition, and artistic performances, creating a joyful, sporty atmosphere for the whole family. It’s a great opportunity to get active, meet in a relaxed setting, and enjoy moving outdoors together.
course_highlights: All races take place on the grassy area of Kraków’s Błonia
5 km Open Run with a 46-minute time limit
Children’s races from 200 m to 2,100 m, adapted to age
additional: Participants may enter more than one race. Children must provide a declaration from a parent/legal guardian. Participant limits: 90 for the Open Run, 190 combined for the Mum and Dad Runs, and 455 combined for the Children’s Races. A race pack including a T-shirt is guaranteed only with advance registration and payment. The race office is open on 22.05.2026 (16:00–20:00) and 23.05.2026 (8:30–11:30). In the “Wolf Cubs” race (children born in 2020 or later), a parent may accompany the child on the course. All races take place on the lawns of Kraków’s Błonia. The event is aimed at the local community, schools, and families. Detailed course information will be available one week before the event.

name: 23. Półmaraton Hajnowski
price_range: 180.00 PLN (standard), 90.00 PLN (zniżki dla mieszkańców powiatu Hajnowskiego i seniorów)
description: The 23rd Hajnówka Half Marathon is a unique and unforgettable race held in the picturesque area of Białowieża, near Hajnówka. The half-marathon route passes through the charming Municipal Park in Hajnówka, giving participants the chance to enjoy nature and beautiful views. The event is very popular and is organised by the Sports and Recreation Centre in Hajnówka, which takes care of runners’ comfort and safety. The race office is open the day before the race and on race day. Participants can expect race packs and a coffee buffet.
course_highlights: The route passes through the Municipal Park in Hajnówka
Picturesque landscapes of Białowieża and the surrounding area
A chance to enjoy nature and beautiful views
additional: The race office is open on 22 May from 15:00 to 21:00 at the Municipal Park Amphitheatre in Hajnówka, and on 23 May from 8:00 to 9:30. An ID card is required to collect the race pack. Running under another participant’s name is not permitted. Registration is not available on race day. Participants can enjoy a free coffee buffet. The route is on asphalt, with the start in Białowieża and the finish in Hajnówka. The race office is in the amphitheatre. Massages and showers are available after the race.

name: Bieg Lwa
location: Tarnów Podgórny, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Bieg Lwa is an annual half marathon held in Tarnowo Podgórne, attracting both elite runners and amateurs. The event is known for its excellent organization, attractive course, and enthusiastic crowd support. The festival also features children’s races and various accompanying events, such as cheering competitions and concerts. Bieg Lwa is a great opportunity for sporting competition and family fun in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course in Tarnowo Podgórne
Pogoń za Lwem 10 km race course
Numerous refreshment stations along the course
additional: Option to transfer the race pack until 10 May 2026. Cheering Competition with a prize of PLN 1,000. Accompanying events: ØRGANEK concert, FOODSTIVAL, Hobby Horse Cup, and challenges on the stadium track. Major children’s races during the festival. Registration until 10 May, race and recovery packs, cheering competition, previous editions’ race sold out

name: Bieg Poznaniaka
organizer: Stowarzyszenie na Rzecz Edukacji Dzieci i Młodzieży z Autyzmem „Aperio”
price_range: 60-80 zł dla dorosłych, 40-45 zł dla dzieci

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Dorośli: 70 zł opłata od 15 kwietnia do 15 maja

tiers.description: Dorośli: 70 zł opłata od 15 kwietnia do 15 maja

description: Bieg Poznaniaka dla Przedszkolaka is a family running event taking place on May 23, 2026, in the picturesque Wielkopolski National Park and on the grounds of the Museum of Agriculture in Szreniawa. The program includes main races over 11 km and 5.5 km, a Nordic Walking march, and children’s and youth races over various distances. The event is charitable, with all proceeds going to support children with autism. The organizers provide electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals, and a range of activities for participants and their families, including free museum admission and outdoor games for children.
course_highlights: The main races and Nordic Walking route follow a marked loop of approximately 5.5 km in Wielkopolski National Park
Participants in the 11 km race complete the loop twice
Children’s races take place on the grounds of the National Museum of Agriculture and Agri-Food Industry in Szreniawa
additional: Electronic timekeeping is provided for all races except the virtual race. Every participant will receive a commemorative medal. Free admission to the National Museum of Agriculture and Agri-Food Industry in Szreniawa is available, along with outdoor games for children. The start area can be reached by car, by MPK bus lines 703 and 705, or by PKP train to Szreniawa station (a 150 m walk). 11 km and 5.5 km races, Nordic Walking march, children’s races, visit to the Museum of Agriculture in Szreniawa, electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals

name: Maraton Sztafet Ekiden
location: Kampus Główny Akademii Wychowania Fizycznego, Białołęka, Warszawa, Poland
description: The 20th Onet Marathon Relay is Poland’s largest team running event. It will take place on 23 May 2026 at the Main Campus of the Józef Piłsudski University of Physical Education in Warsaw. This unique event brings together runners of all abilities, with six-person teams covering the marathon distance together in the Japanese ekiden relay format. The event promotes teamwork and cooperation, offering different relay-leg distances that make it easier for beginner runners to take part. It’s a great opportunity for friendly competition and bonding with friends, family or colleagues.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Main Campus of the Józef Piłsudski University of Physical Education in Białołęka
The course consists of two loops
A fast, team-friendly course for six-person teams
additional: Starts take place in waves; participants select their start time during registration. The race bib must be worn on the front of the outfit and kept visible. Participants should arrive well before the start to allow time to use the baggage drop, changing rooms and toilets. Time is measured net, from the moment each participant crosses the start line. Volunteers help with the event’s organization and atmosphere, and volunteer registration is open. The event promotes cooperation, community and team spirit, with different distances and categories for various age groups, including races for children and young people.

name: Nowomiejska Dycha
location: Nowe Miasto Lubawskie, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Nowym Mieście Lubawskim
description: Nowomiejska Dycha is a special night street race taking place on May 23, 2026, in Nowe Miasto Lubawskie. The route winds through the town’s atmospheric historic streets, offering participants a unique experience and the chance to compete for attractive prizes. The event features two races: 5 km at 18:00 and 10 km at 20:00. Both start and finish at Nowomiejski Market Square. Participants can look forward to generous race packs, post-race meals, and a great time in charming surroundings.
course_highlights: The route runs through the atmospheric historic streets of Nowe Miasto Lubawskie
Night street races starting and finishing at Nowomiejski Market Square
Two distances: 5 km and 10 km
additional: Race packs include T-shirts, bags, commemorative magnets, and medals. Cash and merchandise prizes will be awarded to the top runners. Post-race meals will be available. Both races start and finish at Nowomiejski Market Square. The event combines a passion for running with joy and community in a charming small town. Night race, registration on Superczas.pl, prizes, race packs, festive atmosphere

name: Phoenix RUN
location: Smolarnia, Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Klub Biegowy Phoenix Contact Wielkopolska i Opalenicki Klub Biegacza
description: Phoenix RUN is a unique sporting event held in a scenic forest near the Smolarnia forester’s lodge, close to Nowy Tomyśl. This is the second edition of the race, organized by the Phoenix Contact Wielkopolska Running Club, bringing together running and Nordic walking enthusiasts. The event offers a range of distances for adults and children, encouraging families and friends to spend time actively together. Participants can look forward to generous race packs, commemorative medals, attractive prizes, socializing, and a chillout zone.
course_highlights: 10 km main race through the forest
5 km Nordic walking for adults
Children’s races from 100 to 800 m
additional: Start and finish at the Smolarnia forester’s lodge, close to Nowy Tomyśl. Children’s races start at 9:00; the main race and adult Nordic walking start at 11:00. The event offers opportunities to socialize, healthy food, a chillout zone, generous race packs, commemorative medals for all participants, attractive prizes for the top finishers, and a lottery. Events include a 10 km race, 5 km Nordic walking, and children’s races from 100 to 800 m. Participants can enjoy activities and prizes, and the forest route offers scenic views and an active day out.

name: Sieprawska Piątka
description: Sieprawska Piątka is an annual race held in Siepraw, attracting runners of different age groups and ability levels. The event takes place in a picturesque area, and the course runs through Słoneczny Park and the Orlik sports complex, offering participants comfortable conditions for competition and recreation. The race brings people together and promotes physical activity among residents and visitors. The organizers provide extensive sports facilities and support during the event.
course_highlights: The course runs through Słoneczny Park in Siepraw
The start and finish are located by the Orlik Sports Complex
Well-prepared sports facilities, including changing rooms and toilets
additional: The event is organized by the Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Sieprawiu. The Orlik Sports Complex provides sanitary facilities and changing rooms for participants. The event brings people together and promotes physical activity among the local community. It also includes a variety of sports and cultural activities involving local communities, including children’s and youth races, walks, and accompanying events.

name: Ultramaraton Jaga-Kora
description: The Jaga-Kora Ultramarathon is a mountain ultra race held in the scenic Low Beskids, near Rymanów-Zdrój. The course follows the historic Beskid Courier Route “Jaga-Kora,” which was used during World War II. The event features five races of varying difficulty and length, from 19 km to 101 km. The races are certified by ITRA and UTMB, highlighting their prestige and high organizational standards. Join us for the 10th edition, taking place on 23 May 2026.
course_highlights: The course follows the historic Beskid Courier Route “Jaga-Kora” from World War II
Five race distances: 101 km, 70 km, 42 km, 33 km and 19 km
Scenic Low Beskid landscapes, with numerous trails and historic sites
additional: Starts take place overnight and in the morning on 23 May 2026. The longest distances (100 km and 33 km) start at midnight from the market square in Jaśliska, after participants are transported by coach. The remaining distances start from Altany nad Czarnym Potokiem or Moszczaniec. The courses have designated cut-off times, and the winners’ awards ceremony takes place on the amphitheatre stage next to Altany nad Czarnym Potokiem. Prizes will not be mailed, and attendance at the awards ceremony is compulsory. Registration opens in December 2025. The event offers various distances, and participants can expect support along the course and beautiful views.

name: VII Skaryszewski Bieg Konia
location: Stadnina Koni Hubertus, Skaryszew, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: opłata elektronicznie 50 zł do dnia 21.05.2026 r

description: The 7th Skaryszew Horse Run is an annual running event held at the Hubertus Horse Stud in Skaryszew. The main event is the 10 km Końska Dycha, which follows field, dirt and forest roads, offering participants a chance to enjoy nature and compete. The event promotes running as a form of active recreation and a healthy lifestyle, and brings the local community together. Children’s races are also held, making the event appealing to families.
course_highlights: The 10 km main race follows field, dirt and forest roads
Start and finish at the Hubertus Horse Stud in Skaryszew
Team classification takes competitors’ genders into account
additional: Main race limit: 150 participants. Age categories start at 16, with age-group divisions and an open classification. The team classification is based on the combined times of the four fastest runners, including at least one person of the opposite gender. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, while winners receive trophies and cash prizes in the open category. The course follows field, dirt and forest roads; registration is online and on Facebook. The outdoor event takes place whatever the weather, with prizes and medals provided.

name: X Leśne Bieganie dla Zdrowia
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Miedźnej, Szkoła Podstawowa we Frydku, Nadleśnictwo Kobiór
description: The 10th Forest Running for Health is an annual running event organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Center in Miedźna, based in Wola. The races take place on forest routes of 5.5 km and 10 km, which can be downloaded in GPX format to a smartwatch or smartphone. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and outdoor activity, encouraging runners of different ages and ability levels to take part. Registration is online, and the rules are available on the organizer’s website.
course_highlights: Forest routes of 5.5 km and 10 km
Routes can be downloaded in GPX format to mobile devices
A race promoting health and outdoor physical activity
additional: The electronic entry form is available on the website. The rules and consent forms for minors are available to download. The race routes are available to download in GPX format. Registration is through an online platform. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and sport among residents of the Miedźna municipality.

name: XV Biegiem po Wichrowskich Lasach
description: XV Biegiem po Wichrowskich Lasach is an annual running event organized by the Wichrowo Forest District, attracting people who enjoy spending time actively in nature. The main event is a 10 km race through scenic forest areas. There are also races for children and young people, people with intellectual disabilities, and a Nordic walking event. The start and finish are located at the Wichrowo Forest District headquarters, and participants can take part in a familiarization run on the course.
course_highlights: The race course runs through the Wichrowo Forest District
Scenic forest trails over a distance of 10 km
Race categories for children, young people, people with disabilities, and Nordic walking
additional: The course familiarization run takes place on 6 June at 10:00. The children’s and youth races start between approximately 10:10 and 11:00. The Nordic walking event starts at 9:00 from Garnizonowa Street in Dobre Miasto and covers approximately 10 km. The start and finish of the main 10 km race are at the Wichrowo Forest District headquarters. Main race distance: 10 km; races for children and young people; Nordic walking; pre-race training; online registration until 21 May 2026; Nordic walking time limit: 2 hours.

name: XVI Bieg Koziołków
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Kędzierzynie-Koźlu
description: The 16th Bieg Koziołków is an annual running event held in Kędzierzyn-Koźle, aimed mainly at children and young people. The event takes place on 23 May 2026 and offers professional RFID timing to ensure accurate results. It is organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Kędzierzyn-Koźle. The event has a family-friendly, sporting character and promotes physical activity among the youngest participants. The race is scheduled to start at 16:00, and registration is open until 18 May 2026.
course_highlights: A race for children and young people
Professional RFID timing
Held in the city of Kędzierzyn-Koźle
additional: Registration closes on 18 May 2026 at 23:59. The event is timed by Time-Sport.pl, a leader in professional timing for sporting events in Poland. Online registration is available until 18 May 2026. The event starts at 16:00 and includes various age categories, including the youngest participants, born in 2022 and later.

name: XX Bieg Lupusa
location: Bartkowo, Dobroszyce, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 20th edition of the Lupus Run will take place on May 23, 2026, in Bartkowo, Dobroszyce. This is a Polish Athletics Association (PZLA)-certified race, offering professional timing, a medal, a meal, and excellent organization and atmosphere. The event attracts athletes from across the country, creating a unique spirit of competition and camaraderie. Registration is now open on the dedicated website.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified race
Professional timing
Medal and meal for participants
additional: The Lupus Run offers professional timing, a medal, and a meal for participants. The organizers ensure a great atmosphere. The start and finish are in Bartkowo. Details about start waves, participant limits, or additional services are not available. The race starts at 10:00 in Bartkowo. The event also offers online registration and various distances, including 10 km.

name: XXI Cross Maraton przez Piekło do Nieba
description: The 21st Cross Marathon “Through Hell to Heaven” is a unique running event organized by the PTTK Branch in Końskie. The event will take place on May 23, 2026, and attracts both runners and recreational runners, offering a challenging route in scenic surroundings. The marathon is known for its interesting and demanding course, which passes through areas named Piekło and Niebo, underscoring its character and challenge. The organizers provide professional service and support for participants.
course_highlights: The route passes through the areas of Piekło and Niebo
Scenic landscapes around Końskie
Challenging cross-country terrain
additional: The organizer’s office is open Mondays from 13:00 to 17:00, and Tuesdays and Thursdays from 8:00 to 11:00. Telephone: +48 514 030 401. No details about start waves, participant limits, or entry fees are provided on the website. Participation is open to people over 18, with various age categories and classifications. The race starts at 9:00, with an earlier start for participants expecting to finish in more than 6 hours. After the race, participants will receive medals and trophies and be served refreshments.

name: XXVIII Bieg Święców
location: Sławno, Sławno County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 28th Święcowie Run in Sławno is an annual running event taking place on May 23, 2026. The 10 km main race follows the city streets, including asphalt roads, basalt paving stones, and asphalt bike paths. The route is secured and marked, with water refreshment points along the way. The event also includes children’s and youth races at the athletics stadium over distances from 50 to 600 metres. The organizers promote community engagement and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The 10 km main race route (3 x 3.33 km) through the streets of Sławno: asphalt, basalt paving stones, and asphalt bike paths
Refreshment points along the route at 1.5 km, 3 km, 4.5 km, 6 km, and 7.5 km, with water served in paper cups
Children’s and youth races at the athletics stadium on a tartan track, over distances from 50 to 600 m
additional: The time limit for completing the main race is 90 minutes. Participants must follow instructions from the personnel securing the route. The children’s and youth races start at 11:00 at the athletics stadium, with distances adapted to participants’ ages. The awards ceremony will take place at the amphitheatre at 17:30. Registration is available online; the event also includes organized activities and support for runners.

name: II Podgórski Bieg i Marsz Leśnymi Ścieżkami
V Ultra Nordic Walking World Records
Memoriál Františka Daniša – cezpoľný beh
description: The František Daniš Memorial Cross-Country Run is a running event held at the football field in the village of Trstín, Trnava District. The course runs mainly along field and grassy paths, with a short section on an asphalt footpath. Men, women, juniors and residents of Trstín compete in different age categories, with some categories running two laps. The event is suitable for runners who enjoy natural surfaces and cross-country running in the pleasant surroundings of Trstín.
course_highlights: Three quarters of the course is on field and grassy paths
One quarter of the course is on an asphalt footpath
The race takes place at the football field in Trstín
additional: Categories are divided by age and gender; some categories run two laps, and residents of Trstín have their own category. Local contacts: Trstín Municipality, tel. 033/558 92 62, email outrstin@slovanet.sk; Mayor Peter Hlávek, tel. 0918 775 109, email starosta@trstin.sk. The event includes several categories and is part of the Spring Health Run. On-site registration is also possible. Registration is available by contacting the organizers.

name: Turčiansky beh
description: Turčiansky Beh is a charity race taking place on May 23, 2026, at the football stadium in Belá-Dulice. Runners can choose between 5 km and 10 km routes through gently undulating terrain on dirt roads and gravel, with 40 to 80 metres of elevation gain. The event supports a good cause: all funds raised will go towards treatment for a 4-year-old boy with autism and the “Children of My Heart” project. Participants will receive gifts, raffle tickets and commemorative medals, and there will be entertainment for children, so parents can run while their children are looked after. Refreshments and parking are available at the start and finish.
course_highlights: The route follows dirt roads and gravel
Gently undulating terrain with 40 to 80 metres of elevation gain
Start and finish at the Belá-Dulice football stadium
additional: Registration takes place on race day from 8:00 to 11:00. Before the start, each participant will receive a drink, a fitness bar and a gift from the partners. The entry fee includes one raffle ticket, with additional tickets available to purchase. Every finisher will receive a commemorative medal. Professional entertainers and attractions will be available for children. Parking is available by the start/finish area. Refreshments and drinks can be purchased on site. Virtual runners will be sent a gift and medal to their address after the event. The terrain consists of dirt roads and asphalt. Changing rooms, showers and refreshments are available on site. Registration is available online, with a virtual participation option.

name: Night Run Trenčín
location: Klub Lúč, Mierové námestie, Trenčín, Slovakia
price_range: 12 € až 35 € v závislosti od registrácie a kategórie
description: Night Run Trenčín is a running event taking place on May 23, 2026, in Trenčín, at the Lúč club and, weather permitting, at Mierové Square. Runners can challenge themselves in the pleasant atmosphere of the city in the evening. Registration is available online until May 21, 2026, or on race day at the venue if the participant limit has not been reached. The organizer provides electronic timing and refreshments along the course. The event is suitable for runners aged 12 and over; younger participants need the consent of a legal guardian.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Lúč club or, weather permitting, at Mierové Square
Electronic timing at the start, finish, and 4 km point
Option to use municipal parking near Trenčianska Gate
additional: Race check-in is from 17:00 to 20:40 at the Lúč club or, weather permitting, at Mierové Square. Men and women over 60 do not pay an entry fee but must register online. The minimum participant age is 12; participants under 15 must have the consent of a legal guardian. The organizer accepts no responsibility for damage to property or health. Electronic timing is provided by SunBell s.r.o. - VysledkovyServis.sk, and results will be published on an ongoing basis at vysledkovyservis.sk. Night run, online and on-site registration, start from 17:00 to 20:40, option to use municipal facilities, medical information on the race bib

name: Dynasport beh na Vtáčnik
description: Dynasport Run on Vtáčnik is a challenging mountain race around Kamenec pod Vtáčnikom, offering three courses of different lengths and elevation gains. Runners can choose a 50 km course with 2,000 m of elevation gain, a 27 km course with 1,000 m of elevation gain, or an 8.4 km course with 380 m of elevation gain. Each course has a time limit and categories for women and men under and over 40. The race starts at a farm below Vtáčnik, with refreshments provided at several points along the route. The organizer emphasizes mandatory equipment and runner safety.
course_highlights: 50 km course with +2,000 m elevation gain and a 10-hour time limit
27 km course with +1,000 m elevation gain and a 5-hour time limit
8.4 km course with +380 m elevation gain and a 2-hour time limit
additional: The 50 km course has three refreshment stations at 9 km, 27 km and 44 km. Mandatory equipment includes identity documents, a charged mobile phone, a map or GPX file, a personal collapsible cup or bottle with a capacity of at least 1.5 dl, a first-aid kit (thermal blanket, elastic bandage), and at least 0.5 l of water. The race bib must be clearly displayed on the front of the body throughout the race. Recommended equipment includes a waterproof jacket in case of rain. Course distances: 50 km, 27 km, 8 km; elevation gains: +2,000 m, +1,000 m, +380 m; mandatory equipment, refreshment stations on the courses, time limits of 10, 5 and 2 hours.

name: Petržalská 10
price_range: 20 € (online pred 1. aprílom 2026), 25 € (po, do uzávierky registrácie); deti 6-8 €
description: Petržalská 10 is a popular running race in Bratislava, held at Námestie Republiky in Petržalka. The event offers various categories, including a children’s run, a 10 km main race, Nordic walking, and a family run with a dog. The children’s races start at 10:00 and the main race at 11:30. The organizer, Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, ensures a welcoming atmosphere and quality organization for all participants.
course_highlights: The course is in Bratislava-Petržalka, with the start and finish at Námestie Republiky
10 km main race with categories for men, women, and Nordic walking
1.8 km family run with a dog and 5 km children’s run
additional: Children under 5 and children from Centres for Children and Families (CDR) can enter for free. Categories include men’s and women’s age groups, 5 km Nordic walking, and a 1.8 km family run with a dog. Several categories are available, including 5 km, the family run, and Nordic walking; starts at 10:00 and 11:30; online registration; venue at Námestie Republiky in Petržalka.

name: Medzinárodný Novohradský Maratón štafety
description: The International Novohrad Marathon Relay is a running relay marathon taking place on May 23, 2026, along a route between Salgótarján, Hungary, and Lučenec, Slovakia. The course is 42.2 km long and is divided into four legs, run by four relay team members. The race is open to men’s, women’s, and mixed teams, with mixed teams required to have at least 50% women and 50% men. Refreshment stations are provided along the course, and goulash, sports trophies, and cash prizes for the top teams await at the finish. The race starts at 10:00. Registration is available online until May 21, 2026, or on site if places remain.
course_highlights: The route passes through Salgótarján, Šiatorská, Rátka, Rapovce, and Lučenec
The relay has four legs: 11 km, 10 km, 10.7 km, and 10.5 km
Refreshments are available at every relay exchange point, with goulash at the finish
additional: Registration is valid once the entry fee has been paid. Capacity is limited to 20 relay teams. Each team consists of four runners, and exchanges are permitted only at designated points. The time limit for the full course is four hours. Accompanying participants on the course by car, bicycle, or scooter is strictly prohibited for safety reasons. Runners aged 15 and over may take part. The race takes place on roads open to traffic, with runners keeping to the left. The event is open to participants aged 15 and over, with an emphasis on safety and following the rules. The event also includes cultural activities and online registration.

name: Hlbocký boyard – extrémny beh s prekážkami
description: Hlbocký Boyard is an extreme individual race taking place on 23 May 2026 in the village of Hlboké nad Váhom. This 6th edition features a single lap with numerous adrenaline-fuelled obstacles and steep hills on a motocross track. There are nine categories by age and gender, including children’s categories. Runners can enjoy the fresh air, challenges along the course and, after the race, awards, refreshments and commemorative items.
course_highlights: A 9–10 km course with many new obstacles compared with previous editions
Steep hills and adrenaline-fuelled obstacles on a motocross track
Drinking water at the start and along the course, plus refreshments and goulash after the race
additional: Race-day check-in is from 07:45 at the venue by the football pitch. Starts are staggered: first the children’s Boyard, followed by groups of 4–5 runners every 5 minutes. The entry fee includes a medal, a commemorative item, a goulash and drink voucher, a sweet, water and refreshments along the course. After the race, showers with hot water are available in the football changing rooms. Spectators have free access to the entire course. Parking is free. The race takes place in all weather conditions. Registration is available by prepayment; medals and refreshments are included. It runs from March to May 2025.

name: Jacovská dvadsiatka
description: Jacovská dvadsiatka is a running race held in Jacovce at the football stadium. It offers two distances—a 22 km main race and an 8 km hobby run—on asphalt and gravel farm roads. The 22 km race starts at 10:00 and the 8 km race at 10:15. The event is open to different age groups and genders and is organized by ATK Javorina Jacovce. Entry fees are affordable, making the event accessible to a wide running community.
course_highlights: 50% asphalt roads and 50% gravel farm roads
Two distances: 22 km and 8 km
Start at the football stadium in Jacovce
additional: The 22 km categories are divided by age: up to 39, 40–49, and 50 and over. The 8 km categories are men and women. Starts are staggered: 10:00 for 22 km and 10:15 for 8 km. The course is 50% asphalt and 50% farm roads. Registration is available by email. Race bibs can be purchased or exchanged. The race takes place on May 23, 2026.

name: Kostolanský májovec
description: Kostolanský májovec is a running event organized by run ForRest run o.z., held at the Michal Podolan Football Stadium in Veľké Kostoľany. Runners can choose between two courses measuring 10.90 km and 5.40 km, both with 64 metres of elevation gain and a surface combining asphalt and meadow. The start is scheduled for 11:00, and competitors are divided into age categories, with awards for the fastest man and woman from Veľké Kostoľany. The event offers a refreshment station and is suitable for runners looking for an enjoyable run with gentle elevation in a pleasant setting.
course_highlights: 10.90 km course with +64 m elevation gain
5.40 km course with +64 m elevation gain
Surface: 50% asphalt and 50% meadow
additional: The race awards ceremony is at 12:45. Year of birth determines category placement. To be eligible for the fastest runners from Veľké Kostoľany awards, participants must enter the municipality of Veľké Kostoľany during registration. Number of refreshment stations on the course: 1. The race is run in accordance with traffic regulations. Participants are responsible for their own health insurance. The course is mostly flat, registration is available online and on site, and the event includes categories for different age groups and is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Sninský trailový polmaratón
description: The Snina Trail Half Marathon is a running event in Snina, Slovakia, offering two courses: the main 21 km course and a shorter 7.5 km course. The race is for all trail-running enthusiasts who want to enjoy the beauty of nature and the challenges of the terrain. The organizers welcome runners of all levels and offer a great sporting-event atmosphere.
course_highlights: Trail running in the natural surroundings of Snina
Two course options: 21 km and 7.5 km
A challenge for runners of all levels
additional: The race is suitable for runners of all levels, with the option to register online or on-site. It includes various categories, including children and youth.

name: Beh Soviou Poľanou
description: The Run Around Soviou Poľanou in Podolínec is a forest running race offering quality training and the chance to test your abilities on mountain terrain. It is suitable for runners looking to enjoy an exhilarating day in nature and prepare for important races during the season. The route winds through picturesque forests around Podolínec and offers a challenge even for experienced runners.
course_highlights: Forest trails around Podolínec
Mountain terrain with natural obstacles
Picturesque views in the Poľana area
additional: Children’s races are available, along with several routes, including 11 km and 18 km options. Maps, posters, and race regulations are available to download. Registration takes place online via the official website. The race is part of a series and offers online registration and various categories, including a children’s race. The event promotes trail running in nature and offers attractive prizes for the top finishers in each category.

name: Mravenčárska míľa
description: Mravenčárska Mile is a running event held at the football stadium in Plavecký Štvrtok. The race offers categories for men and women across various age groups, as well as categories for children, school-age runners, youth, juniors, Nordic walking, and canicross. The school-age race starts at 10:10 and the main category at 12:00. The event is organized by the Plavecký Štvrtok Municipal Office, which ensures a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality organization for all participants.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the football stadium in Plavecký Štvrtok
Multiple age-group and special categories, including Nordic walking and canicross
The main categories start at 12:00, and the school-age race starts at 10:10
additional: Categories include men and women in various age groups, children, school-age runners, youth, juniors, Nordic walking, and canicross. The organizers are Milan Zajíček and Soňa Zajíčková; their contact phone numbers are 0907 467 595 and 0908 423 975. The race offers categories for various age groups, including children, Nordic walking, and canicross; starts are scheduled for 10:10 and 12:00; the venue is the football stadium in Plavecký Štvrtok.

name: Niže Linča
organizer: Dobrovoľníci z obce Zeleneč, Obecný úrad Zeleneč, Vinársky spolok vinárov a vinohradníkov Zeleneč, DHZ Zeleneč, Zdravotnícka služba Zeleneč

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Štartovné: 15 € do 15.05.2026 ( online registrácia bude spustená od 13.4. 2026 )

description: Niže Linča is a running event in Zeleneč, organized by volunteers from the village together with local associations and the medical service. The race is open to men, women and juniors under 18, with awards also for the fastest man and woman from Linča. The entry fee includes admission to a wine tasting during the St. Urban Festivities, giving the event a unique atmosphere and bringing sport and culture together. Online registration opens on 13 April 2026, and the race takes place on 23 May 2026.
course_highlights: Race in Zeleneč, Zeleneč Vineyards
Categories for men, women and juniors under 18
Admission to a wine tasting included in the entry fee
additional: The entry fee includes admission to a wine tasting during the St. Urban Festivities, valued at €5. Online registration from 13 April 2026; location: Zeleneč, Trnava District; start time: 18:30; venue: Jednotka

name: Martinský offroad maratón a polmaratón
description: The Martin Off-Road Marathon and Half Marathon is a running event held in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Fatra region, in Tomčany near Martin. Runners can enjoy running across meadows, hills, and the foothills of the Fatra, with wonderful views of the Lúčanská, Krivánska, and Veľká Fatra ranges. The route is off-road, with natural obstacles such as mud and fallen trees, adding to its appeal and challenge. The event is intended for runners of different abilities, who can choose a trail to suit their skills and preferences.
course_highlights: A race through the natural surroundings of the Fatra, across meadows and hills
Wonderful views of the Lúčanská, Krivánska, and Veľká Fatra ranges
An off-road route with natural obstacles such as mud and fallen trees
additional: Mandatory equipment: a cup or bottle with a capacity of at least 0.2 l, and a phone with the organizer’s number (0949 465 006). Location: Tomčany (a district of Martin). This is the first edition of the event. No specific prices or registration dates are listed on the website. Distances range from 4.5 km to the marathon. Registration via MisoSport.sk. Mandatory equipment includes a cup or bottle and a phone with the organizer’s number. Various routes and activities are available for children. Start at 10:00.

name: AZ-Pneu Vertical – Dúbravský beh na Kobylu
location: Ul. Pod záhradami, Mestská časť Dúbravka, Bratislava, Slovakia

price_tiers.distance: AZ-pneu vertical 10 km a Dôverun 5 km

description: AZ-Pneu Vertical – Dúbravský beh na Kobylu is a running event in Bratislava, offering races for both children and adults. The race takes place in the Dúbravka borough, starting on Pod záhradami Street (by Lidl). You can compete in the 10 km AZ-pneu vertical, the 5 km Dôverun, or the children’s races. The event is organized by Beh si ty, o.z., together with the Dúbravka Borough. It is suitable for the general public and offers age- and gender-based categories.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the Dúbravka borough of Bratislava
The AZ-pneu vertical course is 10 km long
In addition to the main race, there are children’s races and the 5 km Dôverun
additional: Dôvera health insurance policyholders receive a €2 discount when paying the entry fee online. The children’s races start at 10:20, the AZ-pneu vertical 10 km race starts at 11:00, and the Dôverun 5 km race starts at 11:20. The course follows urban roads in Dúbravka. Registration is available online and on site. The event is scheduled for 23 May 2026.

name: Beh s vlkmi pre život
price_range: od 11 € do 40 € v závislosti od spôsobu registrácie
description: Run with the Wolves for Life is a charitable running event organized by the CHADIM’S CHARITY Foundation, held in the scenic setting of Čierne at the tripoint of Slovakia, Czechia and Poland. It offers six different races, including a half marathon, a 10 km race, a 5 km race, Nordic walking and children’s races. The routes run mainly along paved and forest roads, with beautiful mountain views. Runners can expect well-organized races with marked routes, refreshment stations and a support vehicle carrying water. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes a healthy lifestyle and charitable causes.
course_highlights: Half marathon with +500 m elevation gain, running along mountain ridges with beautiful views
Routes run mainly along paved and forest roads
Routes marked with ribbons, with volunteers at key junctions
additional: The half-marathon course has a time limit of 5 hours, and the 10 km race has a limit of 2 hours. Runners must wear their bib numbers on the front and pass through all checkpoints. There is one refreshment station on the course, and drinks are provided at both the start and finish. During the race, a support vehicle will distribute water at accessible points. Required equipment includes personal identification documents. Insurance covering medical expenses is recommended, as the route crosses the territories of several countries. The event includes various categories for adults and children, on-site registration, an accompanying program and refreshments, with an emphasis on supporting charitable activities.

name: Hutňanská šelma
description: Hutňanská šelma is a running event in Novoveská Huta, offering races for children and adults. The event takes place in the pleasant surroundings of Remeselný šenk za Holubnicou and is divided into several age categories, with prizes for the top three finishers. The children’s races start at 10:00, and the races for adults and older children start at 13:00. The event is suitable for runners of different ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Races in Novoveská Huta, at Remeselný šenk za Holubnicou
Several age categories, from children to adults
Children’s races start at 10:00; races for adults and older children start at 13:00
additional: Race categories include children under 6, children aged 7–9, children aged 10–14, youth, and adults divided by age, with prizes for the top three in each category. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Novoveská Huta. The children’s races start at 10:00 and the adults’ race at 13:00. Participants also receive a medal, and various activities are offered during the event.

name: Vysocká pětka - vzpomínka na Jirku S.
location: Vysoká nad Labem, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Vysocká pětka is a 5 km running race held in the village of Vysoká nad Labem. The race is held in memory of Jirka S. and traditionally follows a cycle path. The start is scheduled for 9:00, with check-in from 8:00. The event is open to all runners and offers a pleasant atmosphere, with a chance to win a prize in the raffle.
course_highlights: 5 km course
Race along a cycle path
Friendly atmosphere with a raffle
additional: Participant check-in from 8:00; race starts at 9:00; the race follows a cycle path; chance to win a prize in the raffle. The race is part of the local sports calendar and is open to the general public. Exact course distances and registration information have not yet been published.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Kladno
location: Libčice nad Vltavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Libčice nad Vltavou is a sporting and community event held in support of the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the lives of people who witnessed history and helps them. The event offers timed 5 km and 10 km runs with a mass start, following paved paths and asphalt through a forest park and along a cycling path. It is suitable for all age groups and supports remembrance of history and the courage of freedom fighters. Race bibs are issued at the registration desk on race day. The event also includes a children's run and the option of a symbolic “Anywhere!” run outside the official courses.
course_highlights: Start by the entrance at Sletiště
The course runs through the forest park along a cycling path
Paved paths and asphalt
additional: Pupils, students under 18, members of the Friends of the Memory of the Nation Club, and runners over 65 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. Registration and race-bib pickup take place from 9:00 to 9:30 on race day. Participants are advised to write any medications, allergies, and an emergency contact on the back of their race bib in case of medical complications. The terrain includes paved and asphalt paths; registration is available online and on site; the event is part of a series of runs supporting national remembrance.

name: Půlmaraton údolím Moravské Sázavy
location: Zábřeh na Moravě, Olomouc, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: přihlášení do 15.5.2026 – 500 CZK – po tento termín bude jméno závodníka vytištěno na čísle

description: The Half Marathon through the Moravská Sázava Valley is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Zábřeh na Moravě. The 21.0975 km course is certified according to IAAF rules and runs mostly over flat terrain, with a gentle climb between Nemile and Hněvkov. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Endurance Running Series and offers good facilities, including refreshment stations and a children’s race. The start is at the swimming complex in Zábřeh, which is also the finish venue. Participants receive a commemorative medal and refreshments at the finish.
course_highlights: Certified 21.0975 km course with a mostly flat profile
Surface: asphalt, with sections of gravel, cobblestones and concrete
Four refreshment stations serving sports drinks, water and fruit
additional: Runners expecting to finish in 2:30–3:00 hours may start as early as 9:30. The race time limit is 3 hours. After the race, participants can enjoy a buffet with drinks (Welzl beer and draft lemonade) and pasta salad. A children’s race is held after the adults’ start. Lockers are available for 10 Kč. Parking is available by the swimming pool and in the surrounding area; please follow the instructions of the parking attendants. The course is free of restrictions and construction work. The race takes place on 24 May 2026, registration is open, and the event is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners, with various categories and team competitions.

name: Lesní půlmaraton Říčany
description: The Říčany Forest Half Marathon is a running race held entirely on beautiful forest roads and trails, with no asphalt. The surrounding countryside near Říčany is especially picturesque in late May, adding to the enjoyment of the run. The race is suited to lovers of natural terrain and cross-country running who want to experience the forest atmosphere and the challenge of a half-marathon distance. The organizers welcome runners of all levels and encourage them to share their race experiences.
course_highlights: The course runs entirely on forest roads and trails
No asphalt on the course
Beautiful surroundings with tall, old beech trees
additional: Race distances: 5 km, 10.5 km and 14.5 km; elevation gain approx. 120–350 m; routes run entirely on forest roads and trails.

name: Příbramský půlmaraton
location: Příbram, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Příbram Half Marathon is a traditional running race in Příbram, offering a half-marathon course, a relay race, a fitness run, and children’s races. The race is known for its new route and magical atmosphere, especially on the descent to the square. It attracts a broad running community every year and offers quality facilities, including refreshments and parking.
course_highlights: New half-marathon route
Descent to the square with a magical atmosphere
Relay race with team spirit
additional: The race offers several categories: individual half marathon, half-marathon relay, fitness run, and children’s races. Online registration in advance is recommended. Refreshments and parking are available near the start. The race takes place on 24 May 2026. Registration is available via the website, and the race is suitable for a range of ages and ability levels.

name: Běh cestou necestou 13 km Prahou 13
description: Běh cestou necestou is a running race held in Prague 13, offering 13 km and 5 km courses. The race passes through the picturesque corners of Stodůlky Central Park and Prokopské údolí Nature Park. The start is on Sunday, May 24, 2026, at 13:13:13, and runners can use refreshment stations along the course and at the finish. The race is open to everyone and takes place in the spirit of fair play, with an emphasis on staying on the marked course.
course_highlights: The course passes through Stodůlky Central Park and Prokopské údolí Nature Park
Refreshments at the 8 km mark and at the finish of the 13 km course; refreshments at the finish of the 5 km course
The start and finish are close to the Kuželkárna refreshment venue
additional: It is also possible to register for the race in person on race day, May 21, 2026. Awards are presented to the top three finishers in each age category, provided the category has at least 4 runners. Runners under 18 may participate only with the consent of a legal guardian. The organizer reserves the right to make changes to the program and rules without prior notice. Photographs and video recordings may be used to promote the race without compensation. The race takes place on May 24, 2026; registration is available online and in person, and the event also includes training runs and safety rules.

name: Teplýšovický běh
description: The Teplýšovice Run is a charity race held in the picturesque village of Teplýšovice near Benešov. In 2026, its 6th edition will feature 5 km, 10 km and 15 km trail races, an 11 km Nordic Walking event and children’s races. The main course passes Špulka Lookout Tower and offers beautiful scenery and a challenging route. All courses are timed using chip timing, and every participant receives a medal. Part of the entry fee supports the restoration of fruit-tree avenues in the surrounding area.
course_highlights: The main 15 km trail passes Špulka Lookout Tower
The fast 5 km course crosses a local pasture, where runners may encounter cows
The 11 km Nordic Walking route follows the main course
additional: Registration is also possible on race day, but medals may not be available for everyone. Most courses are timed using IRONTIME chip timing. Children’s races are divided into age categories, and there is also a 650 m children’s obstacle race. Entry fees contribute to purchasing mature fruit trees to restore the avenues in the surrounding area. Course options: 15 km trail, 5 km run, 1,300 m children’s course, 10 km Nordic Walking, 650 m children’s obstacle race; online registration until 25.5.2023 or 22.5.2025; proceeds go toward planting trees and restoring the landscape.

name: Suchdol běží
price_range: Kč 0,- to Kč 300,- podle registrace a způsobu platby

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kč 0,- děti při přihlášení online do 24.5.2026 (60 min před startem)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Kč 200,- dospělí při přihlášení online do 24.5.2026 (60 min před startem)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kč 100,- děti při platbě na místě

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Kč 300,- dospělí při platbě na místě

description: Suchdol Runs is part of the seventh edition of the Běhej s námi 2026 running series, which is open to the general public. The race takes place on Sunday, 24 May 2026, in Prague 6 - Suchdol. The start and finish are at the Community Garden. The course follows paved field and forest paths and has 96 metres of elevation gain. It offers runners a pleasant flat section, a descent into the valley, and a return along forest paths. Categories are divided into children and adults by age group. Runners under 18 may take part only with written consent from a legal guardian.
course_highlights: The course follows paved field and forest paths
A descent to Roztoky and the Únětice Stream
Adult course elevation gain: 96 m
additional: Children start at 11:00 and adults at 13:00. Check-in must be completed at least 30 minutes before the start. Chip timing is used; the bib with the chip must be worn on the upper front of the body throughout the race. The race takes place in all weather, but the organizer reserves the right to cancel it in extremely adverse conditions. Starts are scheduled for 11:00 for children and 13:00 for adults. Online registration is available. Parking is provided on Suchdolská Street. The race course is the same as in previous editions.

name: Brunnenfestlauf 2026
organizer: Turn- und Sportgemeinde 1861 e. V. Oberursel (TSGO)
description: The Brunnenfestlauf Oberursel is a long-standing race that starts and finishes at the historic market square in the heart of Oberursel. The course runs through pleasant residential areas, woodland and meadows, offering runners of all ages a varied running experience. In addition to the main races over 10 km, the half marathon and 5 km, there is also a 3 km schoolchildren’s and Sports Badge race, as well as a Bambini run for the youngest participants. The event is part of the Brunnenfest and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with categories for different age groups and youth divisions.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Oberursel’s historic market square
Course through residential areas, woodland and meadows
Varied race distances from 0.8 km to the half marathon
additional: Late entries are possible on race day until 09:30. The races start in staggered order: 10:00 — 10 km & half marathon; 10:10 — 5 km; 12:35 — 3 km schoolchildren’s and Sports Badge race; 13:05 — Bambini run. There is a €5 late-entry fee for all races except the 3 km race. The event supports the German Sports Badge and offers a 3 km Sports Badge race. Supported by local sports clubs, with a focus on youth races and the Sports Badge, at historic venues.

name: Freigerichter Benzinglauf
description: The Freigerichter Benzinglauf is a scenic fun run that follows varied trails over the first hills of the Spessart. The start and finish for all routes are at the DJK clubhouse in Freigericht-Neuses. The three different routes mainly follow woodland, forest and gravel paths, with a small proportion on asphalt. Plenty of refreshments are available along the course and at the finish. The event offers various distances for runners, walkers and children, with suitable options for all age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: 90% woodland, forest and gravel paths; 10% asphalt
Routes climb the first hills of the Spessart
Start and finish at the DJK clubhouse in Freigericht-Neuses
additional: Bib pickup and late registration at the DJK clubhouse in Neuses. Starts for the half marathon (21.2 km), 10 km and 5 km runs, as well as 10 km and 5 km walking/Nordic walking. Bambini and schoolchildren’s races for different age groups. Food and refreshments are provided. A running event with several distances, including races for children and young people, starting and finishing at the DJK clubhouse in Neuses. The event offers a challenge ranking for participants who take part in several races.

name: Pi Lauf 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Bambini und Schülerlauf sind kostenlos, bitte hier die Teilnahme über pilaufanmeldung@web.de zusenden.

description: The Pi Run 2026 in Neunkirchen-Seelscheid offers a diverse range of races for all age groups and ability levels. The event includes distances ranging from Bambini and children’s races to a 13.4-kilometer main race, as well as walking. The course is scenic, with refreshment stations and good on-site facilities. Every finisher receives a medal, and the top runners are honored. The Lions Club will provide cakes and drinks.
course_highlights: 13.431 km main race with two refreshment stations at km 6.5 and 11.5
Short Bambini and children’s races (approx. 600 m and 1,100 m)
Refreshment station on the recreational race course at approx. 3 km
additional: Race number pickup is available from 08:00 on race day in the start/finish area or in the nearby school building. Late registration is possible until 60 minutes before each start, with a €2 late registration fee. Changing facilities and toilets are available in school buildings and nearby halls. There is ample parking nearby. Every finisher receives a medal, and Bambini runners can get a scoop of ice cream from the sponsor. Registration is through the Race Result platform; participants receive running shirts and a multifunctional scarf. The event takes place in typical temperatures of around 20°C.

name: Ra(h)ser-Run
description: The Ra(h)ser-Run is a flat race through the Rahser district of Viersen, with distances from 1 km to 10 km. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the DLV and eligible for ranking lists, and run mostly along paved paths beside the Niers floodplains. The event offers races for different age groups, including a Bambini run for the youngest participants and a schools’ city championship. Timing is electronic, using transponders in the race bibs. Registration is online only; late registration is available until 60 minutes before the start.
course_highlights: Flat, paved loops through Rahser and along the Niers floodplains
The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the DLV and eligible for ranking lists
Kilometre markers and course marshals along the route
additional: Late registration is available until 60 minutes before each start for an additional fee of €5. Race bibs contain an integrated transponder for electronic timing, with both gun and net times. Sittarder Straße will be closed to through traffic between Kränkelsweg and Oberrahserstraße for the duration of the event. Participants can purchase an event T-shirt as part of online registration until 07.05. School and children’s races, free training sessions at Hoher Busch Stadium, race distances for different grade levels.

name: Spatzenberg-Lauf
description: The Spatzenberg Run is a traditional fun run in Löhne, following a hilly circular course around and over the Spatzenberg in the nature reserve. The route runs mostly on paved paths and roads and offers an attractive running opportunity for all age groups. In addition to the 9 km main race, there are shorter 6 km and 3 km races for schoolchildren. The event is organised by Turn- und Rasensportverein Löhne 1910 e.V., running group, and takes place at the Obernfeld sports field.
course_highlights: Hilly circular course around and over the Spatzenberg (nature reserve)
Route on paved paths and roads
Distances: 9 km, 6 km and 3 km schoolchildren’s race
additional: Timing is provided by a disposable chip attached to the back of the race bib. Race materials can be collected from 9:00 on the event day at the Obernfeld sports field. Late entries are possible on the event day until 10:15, while race bibs are available. Payment by SEPA direct debit for online registration or in cash when collecting race materials. Hilly course around the Spatzenberg, registration online or on the event day, timing with a disposable chip, water at the finish station

name: Sponsorenlauf Brustkrebshilfe Dorsten
location: Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof, Dorsten, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
organizer: Khadijeh Mohri, Andreas Schilasky, Ali Abdali
description: The Breast Cancer Aid Dorsten charity run is a charitable event in Dorsten focused on supporting breast cancer care and raising awareness. It takes place in Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof and offers a range of running and walking routes accessible to all ages and fitness levels. Alongside the sporting aspect, supporting breast cancer aid is the main focus. A minimum participation fee applies, and participants can supplement it with additional donations. Participants can run or walk, or support the cause with a donation without taking part in the route.
course_highlights: Event in Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof, with wide paths and plenty of green space
Distances: 800 m for children, 2.5 km and 5 km for running or walking
Accessible changing rooms and shower facilities on site
additional: Race number distribution on site; parking nearby. You can also take part without running or walking by making a “Run with your heart” donation. The run takes place on May 31, 2026, with a focus on donations for breast cancer centers and community involvement. More than 2,000 participants are expected, with a fundraising target of over 50,000 euros.

name: Steinberger Wald-Volkslauf
description: The 49th Steinberger Wald-Volkslauf will take place on 31 May 2026 in Dietzenbach-Steinberg. The event is organized by SC Steinberg and offers runners a sporting challenge in a natural woodland setting. Participants can look forward to well-marked courses suitable for both competitive and recreational runners. A long-standing tradition, the event warmly welcomes all running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Woodland courses in a natural setting
Well-marked 5 km and 10 km courses
Varied running routes with moderate terrain
additional: There are two main courses, measuring 5 km and 10 km. Designed as woodland runs, they offer a varied running environment. The event is organized by SC Steinberg, which also offers other sporting activities such as cross-country skiing, triathlon and running groups. Courses: 5 km and 10 km, online registration, sporting activities, club race

name: MAXiLauf 2026
organizer: Stadt Hamm, Amt für Konzernsteuerung und Sport
description: The MAXiLAUF in Hamm is an annual running event featuring flat, record-eligible courses that appeal to runners of all ability levels. Events include a half marathon, a 10 km run, a 5 km run, and children’s and toddlers’ races. The courses run through the city of Hamm and offer an attractive, approved circuit route passing many landmarks. All participants receive an exclusive medal, and trophies are awarded to the leading runners. The event is family-friendly and part of the Landesturnfest LTF26.
course_highlights: Flat, DLV-measured circuit courses through the city of Hamm
Courses eligible for inclusion in best lists
Attractive routes passing many landmarks
additional: Bib-number distribution from approx. 8:30 a.m. at the Stadtsportbund tent. Timing uses a race|result® chip attached to the bib. On-site registration is available. Cut-off times: half marathon 150 min, 10 km 90 min, 5 km 50 min. Personalised medal engraving can be booked for an additional fee. Certificates are available on-site and online. Official merchandise is available in the shop. The race features a DLV-measured circuit, medals for all finishers, online and on-site registration, and a festive atmosphere for runners and spectators.

name: Wachtelrun - Volkslauf mit Hauptlauf und Schülerläufen & Nordic Walking
Biegi Śnieżnickie
location: Międzygórze, Kłodzko County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Śnieżnickie Runs are legendary mountain races held in picturesque Międzygórze, in the heart of the Śnieżnik Massif. The courses feature challenging climbs and technical descents, winding along beautiful forest trails and gravel roads and reaching the summit of Śnieżnik itself. This event has a rich tradition dating back to the 1990s and attracts both recreational runners and elite athletes from across Europe. Participants can choose between the classic 9.6 km alpine race and the Śnieżnik Half Marathon, approximately 21 km long, which loops around the Crown of Śnieżnik.

For the other categories, the three best times count, with the awards ceremony held after the last race on 26. 8. 2026. The race is part of the 2026 ISCAREX Cup, and the overall results count toward the cup. The event takes place on Wednesday evening. The course is short and steep and crosses the ski slope and forest paths. Races are open to a wide age range, from children to adults.

name: Malá cena Kunětické devítky  květen 2
location: Kunětická hora, Ráby, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.description: První start v roce – Krátký okruh – 100 Kč

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Každý další start v roce – Krátký okruh – 50 Kč

tiers.label: tier_3
