description: Kunětická Devítka is a traditional Wednesday cross-country running series in the area around Kunětická Mountain, offering two routes: a short 4.5 km loop suitable for everyone and a long 9 km loop for more experienced runners. The race is known for its relaxed atmosphere, bringing together runners with different ambitions, and focuses on enjoying the race and the good spirits after the finish. The event takes place at the car park by Staročeská Hospoda and is the largest weekday running event in the Pardubice Region. The organizer invites all runners to enjoy the race and the beautiful surroundings of Kunětická Mountain.
course_highlights: A short 4.5 km loop suitable for everyone
A long 9 km loop with long flat stretches, off-road terrain, and a climb up the steps to Kunětická Mountain
Start and finish at the car park by Staročeská Hospoda, below Kunětická Mountain
additional: Race-day registration takes place at the finish area from 17:00 to 17:50 from April to August. An isotonic drink is available after the race. A series race number can be purchased for a one-time fee of 50 Kč at the first race of the year. Categories are divided by age and gender. Runners take part at their own risk; younger runners must have written parental consent. Cross-country run, start at the car park by Staročeská Hospoda, race takes place on 27 May 2026

name: BĚKODO – květen III
description: BĚKODO is the 40th edition of a traditional running stage race in Teplice, open to recreational, fitness and competitive runners aged 15 and over. The race consists of the ten highest-scoring starts during the season; in the event of a tie, the faster time decides. The timekeeping limit is 35 minutes, after which runners are recorded as 35+. A separate Mladé BĚKODO series is available for younger runners. The event is organised by TJ Lokomotiva Teplice and BK Běkodo.
course_highlights: A stage race with the ten best starts counting towards the overall standings
A 35-minute timekeeping limit; runners may still finish after the limit
For runners aged 15 and over, with a separate series for younger runners
additional: Only runners aged 15 and over (born in 2011 or earlier) may take part. Younger runners may enter the separate Mladé BĚKODO series. The race is held mostly on Wednesdays, except for the third round, which takes place on Saturday, 18 April (the Čudla Vorlíček Memorial). The race uses a multi-stage format, with the option of counting the 10 best performances. Registration is open to runners aged 15 and over. The race takes place in the natural surroundings below Teplická Doubravka.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (6) – květnový
description: Come and run on a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava in Prague’s Braník district, where personal records are often set! The race is part of the 16th season of VAŠE LIGA’s regular 5 km and 10 km runs, held every month. You can compare yourself with other runners and track your progress throughout the year. The course is certified, and the 10 km race offers the opportunity to run a qualifying time for the Czech Republic Championships. After the race, enjoy a relaxed atmosphere with refreshments and an awards ceremony for the top runners.
course_highlights: Fast course along the Vltava in Prague’s Braník district
Course measured by a certified course measurer
Opportunity to run a qualifying time for the Czech Republic Championships in the 10 km
additional: The race is timed using chip timing, and each runner also receives a chip time. Check-in takes place in the blue tent by the cycle path near U Kempinku 2, Prague. After the race, you can replenish your energy and vitamins at the restaurant in the Hamr Braník complex. Toilets are available at the Hamr Braník complex (300 m from the start). Luggage can be stored in the organizers’ tent. You can withdraw from the race up to 24 hours before the start and receive a refund of the entry fee. The races include various types of terrain, from urban courses to trail sections, and are open to runners of all levels. Registration is available online, and the series offers regular updates to results and schedules.

name: Sternchenlauf
description: The Sternchenlauf in Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock is a traditional fun run held annually on the Wednesday before Corpus Christi. The event offers various races for all age groups, from races for toddlers and children to 5 km and 10 km races, as well as walking. The course follows a varied 2.5 km loop with forest trails, gravel and asphalt, lined with enthusiastic spectators. In addition to individual categories, there are team and relay categories, making the race especially appealing to groups.
course_highlights: A varied 2.5 km loop with forest trails, gravel and asphalt
Flat course with clear signage
Out-and-back courses for the toddler, children’s and schoolchildren’s races on Falkenstraße
additional: Start times: toddler race 17:00, children’s race 17:15, 1.0 km schoolchildren’s race 17:30, 2.5 km schoolchildren’s race 17:45, 5 km race 18:30, 10 km race and 5 km walk 19:30. The walk starts at the same time as the 10 km race, at the back of the field. Participant limit: approximately 2,000; relays are limited to 50. Event shirts can be purchased during registration or on site. Changing rooms and showers are available. Start and finish at the Waldstadion Schwarz-Weiß Sende e.V. Registration is available for individual and group races. The 5 km race is fully booked; remaining places will be available on site from 16:00 on the day of the event. The event is part of the region’s running events and offers a welcoming, family atmosphere.

name: B2Run Hannover
description: The B2Run Hannover on May 27, 2026, is a company run covering a roughly 6.5 km, mostly flat route along the Maschsee, with a spectacular finish in the Heinz von Heiden Arena. The run is aimed at companies, organizations and individual participants from Hanover and the surrounding area, and promotes team spirit, motivation and a sense of community. The event features a professional supporting program with a host and music, and is ideal for beginners, walkers and experienced runners. The focus is on fun, togetherness and team building, not personal bests.
course_highlights: A varied loop of roughly 6.5 km along the Maschsee
Mostly flat route, suitable for beginners, walkers and experienced runners
Spectacular finish in the Heinz von Heiden Arena
additional: The event is part of the nationwide B2Run company running series and features a professional supporting program with a host and music. Teams can cross the finish line together and enjoy the event atmosphere. The event is ideal for team building, workplace health promotion and active breaks from the working day. 6.5 km route, team event, company run, finish in the Heinz-von-Heiden-Arena, custom team running shirts, focus on team building and corporate fitness

name: Seligenstädter Marathonstaffel
description: The 44th Seligenstadt Asklepios Marathon Relay is a unique relay race for teams of six from clubs, recreational groups and companies. It takes place on 27 May 2026 on the banks of the Main in Seligenstadt. The fast out-and-back course along the river offers an attractive route, with the start and finish at the newly redesigned festival grounds. The event is organized by LG Seligenstadt and the Friends of LG Seligenstadt e.V. support association. Alongside the sporting experience, pasta dishes from MAIN'E KÜCHE will be available. Bib number collection and the awards ceremony will also take place at the festival grounds.
course_highlights: Fast out-and-back course along the banks of the Main
Start and finish at the newly redesigned festival grounds on the banks of the Main in Seligenstadt
Pasta dishes from MAIN'E KÜCHE available
additional: Bib number collection and the awards ceremony are at the festival grounds. Access via the Grabenstraße 48 parking garage or the car park at Steinheimer Str. 47. Pasta dishes from MAIN'E KÜCHE will be available. Participants can compete in teams from clubs, recreational groups and companies. The event takes place on 27 May 2026 and is part of the LG Seligenstadt events. The start and awards ceremony are at the Mainufer festival grounds.

name: Steglitzer Volkslauf
price_range: 5,00 € Nachmeldegebühr, sonst keine expliziten Preise genannt
description: The Steglitzer Volkslauf is a traditional running event taking place on 27 May 2026 at Stadion Lichterfelde in Berlin-Lichterfelde. Organised by TuS Lichterfelde von 1887 e.V., the race offers a sporting opportunity for runners of all age groups. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and well-organised proceedings. The races start and finish at Stadion Lichterfelde, providing an attractive setting for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stadion Lichterfelde
Routes through the area around Berlin-Lichterfelde
Traditional event with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: Late registration is possible online from 25.05. (00:01) until 30 minutes before the respective start, for a fee of €5.00. Certificates for places 1–3 are presented during the awards ceremony. All placed participants may request a certificate showing their place and time at the venue after the last runner finishes. Multiple race distances, online registration, start times from 18:00, certificates and age-group rankings, event held as part of the Steglitzer Festwochen.

name: Tolarova pětka
description: Tolar’s Five is a running race held in Stříbro, offering a 5-kilometer course. The race is part of the Sdružení vytrvalců Stříbro calendar and is intended for amateur and recreational runners. The route passes through the town park and is suitable for all age groups. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and refreshments for participants.
course_highlights: The route passes through the town park and crosses the Svatováclavská footbridge
The race takes place in the evening, starting at 18:00
A friendly atmosphere and the option to run in a group
additional: The race is part of the Běžec Tachovska series. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and refreshments. It is organized by Sdružení vytrvalců Stříbro, z.s., which supports amateur and recreational athletes. Registration details and prices are not explicitly listed on the website. The race is part of the local sports calendar; exact distances and categories are not specified.

name: Černovírská osmička
description: Černovírská osmička is a traditional running race organized by the Central Moravian Association of Endurance Sports in Olomouc-Černovír. The race is part of the Haná Running Cup, which offers courses of various distances and is open to all runners regardless of age or ability. The course passes through the picturesque surroundings of the Olomouc Region and is suitable for both beginners and experienced distance runners. The organizers emphasize a relaxed atmosphere and high-quality race organization.
course_highlights: The route passes through the picturesque surroundings of the Olomouc Region
Part of the Haná Running Cup, with courses from 5 to 42 km
The race is open to all ages and abilities
additional: Registration is handled through a credit system using a chip card, which is used for electronic timekeeping. The entry fee is paid from prepaid credit in an account at Fio Bank. Runners can also top up their credit in cash after the results ceremony. The race is part of the year-round Haná Running Cup series, in which points are awarded for placements in individual races. The event features a trail/cross-country run, starts at 18:00, offers web registration, and starts in Olomouc-Černovír by the Bulgarian Club.

name: Int. Oberweiser Straßen- und Volkslauf
description: The International Oberweis Fun Run takes place on June 4, 2026, in Oberweis and offers races for all age groups, from Bambinis to adults. The event includes various distances, including a Bambini run, children’s run, youth run, fitness run, walking, and the main 10 km run. The course passes through the picturesque surroundings of Oberweis and is suitable for both recreational runners and ambitious athletes. The event is family-friendly and promotes grassroots sport in the region.
course_highlights: A range of distances from 400 m to 10 km
Races for all age groups from 1 to 99 years
Picturesque course in Oberweis
additional: Start times are staggered by discipline from 16:00 to 18:30. Registration opens on 10.03.2026. Event address: Neuerburger Str. 16, 54636 Oberweis. Contact via the online contact form. The event also includes children’s races, walking, and fitness runs, with registration opening in March 2026. It is generally held in June, weather permitting.

name: Int. Volkslauf, 38. Int. Halbmarathon, 22. Walkinglauf
description: TV Schwafheim is hosting the 52nd International Fun Run, the 38th International Half Marathon, and the 22nd Walking Event in Moers-Schwafheim. Races for children, adults, and walkers range in distance from 500 m to the half marathon. The course is closed to traffic, with several aid stations and timing by the Race Result system. The event is family-friendly and welcomes local club runners as well as half-marathon runners looking for a community atmosphere.
course_highlights: Roads closed to traffic, with traffic rules to be observed
Several aid stations along the course
Timing with the Race Result system and two chips attached to the shoelaces
additional: Race number pickup in the morning at the clubhouse; late entries accepted until shortly before each start; showers at the clubhouse and in the Waldschule gym; certificates can be printed directly at the finish. Course maps, 2025 results, water stations, showers, registration from 08:00, late entries up to 30 minutes before the start, family-friendly

name: Klingenlauf
price_range: Erwachsene: 16,00 € bis 18,00 €, Jugendliche/Kinder: 8,00 €, Firmenstaffeln: 65,00 €, Staffeln: 10,00 €, Schul- und Gruppenstaffeln: 30,00 € bis 60,00 €
description: The Klingenlauf is a traditional running event in Solingen, taking place on June 4, 2026, in Südpark. With various races from 1 km to 10 km, relay races, and a company run, the Klingenlauf offers suitable running opportunities for all age groups and ability levels. The course runs through Solingen’s Südpark and along the Korkenziehertrasse. More than 1,500 runners take part each year, making the Klingenlauf a sporting highlight in the region.
course_highlights: Course through Solingen’s Südpark
Section along the Korkenziehertrasse
Various distances from 1 km to 10 km, as well as relay races
additional: Late registration is possible on the event day until 30 minutes before the respective start, provided the participant limit has not been reached. The late registration fee is €2.00. Race numbers can be collected on the event day and also on June 2, 2026, from 17:00 to 20:00 at the ice rink. The 5 km race is divided into two runs: Speed Run (max. 30 min.) at 18:15 and Fun Run (over 30 min.) at 18:45. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available on site. Various race categories, online registration, changing rooms, toilets and showers at the ice rink, limited baggage storage, certificates and honorary prizes, award ceremonies at the event venue

name: Leihgesterner Volkslauf
description: The Leihgestern Volkslauf takes place annually on Corpus Christi in the beautiful woodland landscape of Linden. Participants can choose from a 5 km walk, a 5 km run, or a 10 km run. The courses run mostly along comfortable forest paths with moderate elevation changes and are suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. Timing is chip-based, and race bibs require a deposit that is refunded when the bib is returned.
course_highlights: 5 km loop with 95% forest paths and approximately 50 m of elevation gain
10 km loop with 95% forest paths and approximately 110 m of elevation gain
A nature-filled route through the woodland landscape of Linden
additional: Race bib deposit: EUR 2, refunded when the bib is returned. Online registration is available until 03.06.2026 at 18:00 (group registration) or 04.06.2026 at 08:30 (individual registration). On-site late registration is not possible. Gross and net times are recorded using a chip. The start venue is the TSG Leihgestern sports clubhouse, Waldstraße 32, 35440 Linden. Run through nature, starting at the sports clubhouse; online registration available until 04.06.2026

name: Volkslauf „Rund um Köchel“
description: The “Rund um Köchel” fun run is a traditional running competition held as part of the annual sports festival of SG Sportfreunde 69 Marmagen-Nettersheim. It gives runners of all ages and ability levels the opportunity to compete in four events (1,000 m, 2,000 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m). The event is part of a week of sport filled with action and team spirit at the grass sports field in Marmagen. A children’s obstacle race is also being offered for the first time, making the event family-friendly and varied.
course_highlights: Four events: 1,000 m, 2,000 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m
Event at the Marmagen grass sports field
Part of a major sports festival with a varied programme
additional: The fun run takes place on 04 June 2026 from 15:45 to 19:30. There are four running distances for different age and ability levels. A children’s obstacle race over 700 m and 1,400 m is also offered. The event is part of a multi-day sports festival featuring other sporting and family-friendly activities. Participation in four running events, including an obstacle race for children

name: Leśna Piątka Pikuś
location: Parking przy ścieżce edukacyjnej Nadleśnictwa Karnieszewice, Koszalin, Poland
description: Leśna Piątka Pikuś is a cross-country race held in the picturesque forest of the Karnieszewice Forest District in Koszalin. The 10 km course runs through charming woodland, with numerous climbs and descents and a section alongside a deep ravine, making the race challenging and full of memorable moments. Every participant who completes the distance will receive a commemorative medal. The start and finish are in the car park by the educational trail, providing easy access and convenient race logistics.
course_highlights: A 10 km course covering one full lap
Runs through the picturesque woodland of the Karnieszewice Forest District
A section alongside a deep ravine that calls for care and offers a unique experience
additional: The start and finish are in the car park by the Karnieszewice Forest District educational trail on Słupska Street in Koszalin. The course includes a variety of climbs and descents, as well as wet and dry sections, offering a varied running experience. Every participant will receive a commemorative medal after crossing the finish line. Participants receive medals, and registration and results are available online. The race is popular locally and brings the running community in Koszalin together.

name: Kamenická 15
location: Kamenice u Jihlavy, Vysočina, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 Kč (online), 150 Kč (na místě), zdarma pro mládež do 17 let

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 Kè - muži, junioři, ženy, juniorky přihlášené on-line.

description: Kamenická 15 is a traditional running race in Kamenice u Jihlavy. Adult runners take on a 15 km loop along paved roads and paths. Young runners can choose shorter 1.75 km and 0.4 km loops on paved roads in the village. The course passes through scenic spots including the settlement of Brodek, Zátiší Chateau and the Cípy forester’s lodge, finishing at the start. The race is suitable for a wide range of ages, from 3 years old, and offers a friendly atmosphere, refreshments, and prizes for winners and young runners.
course_highlights: A 15 km loop along paved roads and paths
The course passes through the settlement of Brodek, Zátiší Chateau and the Cípy forester’s lodge
Youth loops of 1.75 km and 0.4 km in the village
additional: Every participant receives a voucher for refreshments at the U Raimunda restaurant. Prize money for breaking the course record: men 1000 Kč, women 500 Kč. Bus transport to and from Jihlava is provided. Children’s and youth categories are divided by age, with the option of changing routes. The main race is 15 km on paved roads; shorter loops are available for young runners. Online registration is available before 12:00 on race day. The event includes refreshments and prizes for winners.

name: Kapličkobraní

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné od 170 Kč 100% jde na charitu

description: Kapličkobraní is a charitable, non-competitive run that passes 13 chapels around Ludgeřovice and Markvartovice, with 14 stops in total, including the finish. The 10–12 km route is suitable for running, walking, cycling, Nordic walking, or even pushing a stroller. The event has a deeper purpose: all proceeds go to the family of Jan Rieml to support his sons Šimon and Matěj. Participants receive a commemorative magnet, light refreshments at the finish, and a tasting of sacramental wine at one of the chapels. Kapličkobraní received an award for the best low-budget sports project for small organisations.
course_highlights: The route passes 13 chapels around Ludgeřovice and Markvartovice
The 10–12 km route is suitable for running, walking, cycling, Nordic walking, and strollers
A tasting of sacramental wine at one of the chapels
additional: The first 200 participants to check in receive a commemorative medal-design magnet. Light refreshments are available at the finish. Changing rooms, showers, and convenient parking are available. The event is charitable, and 100% of the proceeds go to the family of Jan Rieml to support his sons. Companies can pay employees’ entry fees by invoice or donation agreement and receive free registration codes. The event offers various activities, refreshments, parking, changing rooms, and showers. The route is suitable for running, walking, cycling, and Nordic walking.

name: Běh mimoňským parkem
location: Zámecký park, Mimoň, Liberec, Czech Republic
description: The Run through Mimoň Park is a race held in the chateau park in Mimoň, offering a flat course on paved paths along the Ploučnice River. The race is run in 7-kilometre laps, with distances of 7 km and 21 km available. The event is suitable for the general public and competitive runners, and is organized by Lenka Zeťová. The main category starts at 17:00, while the first category starts at 9:00. The race is part of the Czech Running Club and is held under the auspices of the Czech Athletics Federation.
course_highlights: Flat course on paved paths
7 km loop along the Ploučnice River
Start in the chateau park in Mimoň
additional: Race registration takes place by the swimming pool, and the start is on Vranovská Alley. The race is mixed, with distances of 7 km and 21 km. It is organized by Lenka Zeťová, who can also be contacted by phone at 777 909 842. Races take place in the picturesque setting of Mimoň Park, with children and adults welcome to take part, and are part of a running league. Registration and further details are available on the official website.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Nové Město na Moravě
location: Vysočina Arena, Nové Město na Moravě, Vysočina, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: rodinný závod 2 km - registrace on-line/na místě od 100 Kč

description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Nové Město na Moravě is a charity event held in support of the non-profit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of eyewitnesses and helps preserve historical memories. The race takes place in and around Vysočina Arena, with 2 km, 5 km and 10 km routes; the 5 km route is one lap and the 10 km route is two laps. The event offers timed and untimed runs, including family and children’s races, and is suitable for the general public, including pupils, students and seniors, with a possible discount on the entry fee. The start and finish are at the Vysočina Arena stadium, which has facilities including changing rooms, a bag drop and refreshments.
course_highlights: Routes run on asphalt, paved paths and forest trails in and around Vysočina Arena
The 5 km route is one lap; the 10 km route is two laps
Start and finish at the Vysočina Arena stadium, with full facilities
additional: Registration and race-number collection take place on race day from 15:00 to 16:30. Pupils, students up to 18 years old, members of the Memory of the Nation Club and runners over 65 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. Changing rooms, a bag drop, sanitary facilities and water at the finish are available. Route distances: 2 km, 5 km, 10 km; terrain: road; registration fee: 100–400 Kč; race in Vysočina Arena.

name: Abendlauf Wilstedt bei Nacht
description: The Wilstedt Night Run takes place on 29 May 2026, transforming the village of Wilstedt into an atmospheric race course. The event is family-friendly and open to everyone, from beginners to experienced runners. The new course offers lovely views of the village at night. Cheering spectators and an evening fireworks display add to the atmosphere.
course_highlights: New course through Wilstedt with lovely views of the village
Atmospheric setting with cheering spectators along the course
Floodlit swimming at Heidebad Wilstedt after the run until 22:30
additional: The start and finish are at the Wilstedt sports grounds. The event begins with the mini run at 20:15, followed by the jogging and walking starts. Late entries are available on the event day from 18:30 to 20:00 and cost 9 euros. T-shirts or functional shirts are only available to participants who register in advance and will be handed out on the event day. After the run, floodlit swimming at Heidebad Wilstedt is free until 22:30. Fireworks bring the event to a close at around 22:45. Nordic walking poles are not allowed on the course. Child and running strollers are permitted only for the hiking/walking event. Shower and changing facilities are available on a limited basis. New course through Wilstedt, family-friendly, evening event, registration until 17 May, including a mini run, fireworks and musical entertainment.

name: Raesfelder Mai-Lauf
description: The Raesfeld May Run takes place annually on the last Friday in May and offers a varied running programme for all age groups. From the 400 m Bambini races for kindergarten children to the 5 km and 10 km races for adults, there is something for everyone. There is also a 5 km team run, encouraging the fun of running together. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and are therefore eligible for inclusion in rankings.
course_highlights: 400 m child-friendly course for Bambinis
1,000 m and 2.3 km courses for children and teenagers
5 km and 10 km courses for adults, measured by the DLV
additional: Start times: 16:00 Bambini races (400 m), 17:00 1,000 m schoolchildren’s race, 17:30 2.3 km schoolchildren’s race, 18:00 10 km Volksbank Run, 18:05 5 km walking race, 19:30 5 km company, family and team run. The 10 km course consists of two laps of the 5 km loop. Part of the Lippe-Issel Cup, registration required, family-friendly, various categories.

name: Rohrener Volkslauf
description: The 48th Rohrener Volkslauf takes place on Friday evening in Monschau, Germany. Various events are offered, including a 4.2 km and a 10 km race for adults, as well as a separate 10 km event for walkers and Nordic walkers. The races follow a rolling course and all finish at Im Johannesfeld in Monschau. Younger runners also take part, and registration is online through the organizer.
course_highlights: Rolling course through Monschau
Finish at Im Johannesfeld
Separate 10 km event for walkers and Nordic walkers
additional: The shorter races start first, followed by the walkers and Nordic walkers, with the 10 km runners starting last. Typical June weather is around 23 °C, with mostly sunny days. Event with a rolling course, online registration, children’s and youth races, and walking events.

name: Lauf Rund um Burg
description: The 37th Lauf Rund um Burg is part of the Cross and Forest Run Series and takes place around Burg bei Dithmarschen. The event offers runners the opportunity to run scenic 4.8 km and 10 km courses. The race is distinguished by its natural surroundings and varied course. Participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere and a well-organized event.
course_highlights: 4.8 km and 10 km running courses
Part of the Cross and Forest Run Series
Natural course around Burg
additional: Typical May weather conditions: approx. 20 °C, mostly cloudy, average precipitation of 55 mm. The race is part of MTV Burg’s varied sports program, with registration via Yolawo. Children’s and youth sports activities are also planned in good weather.

name: Mühlhäuser Röblinglauf
description: The Mühlhäuser Röblinglauf is a charity run with the unique concept “Sport meets Music,” benefiting the Kinderhospiz Mitteldeutschland. The event offers various races for children, young people, companies and individual entrants, as well as races for walkers. Alongside the sporting event, there is musical entertainment and a KinderGartenKonzert, making the run a special experience for participants and spectators. Race packs can be collected the day before, and an AfterRöblinglaufParty takes place after the run.
course_highlights: A variety of races for children, young people, companies and individual entrants
Charity run benefiting the Kinderhospiz Mitteldeutschland
Musical entertainment and a KinderGartenKonzert
additional: Race packs can be collected on 28.05.2026 from 15:30 to 18:00 at Schwanenteich in Mühlhausen. Team scoring is available for children’s and company races. The AfterRöblinglaufParty and KinderGartenKonzert are part of the supporting programme. Several children’s, youth and company races; online registration opens on 11.01.2026; donations benefit the Kinderhospiz Mitteldeutschland. The event includes music events and an after-run party.

name: Nacht von Hasbergen
description: Die Nacht von Hasbergen is a traditional road race taking place on Friday, May 29, 2026, in Hasbergen. The event offers exciting races for all age groups, from the Bambini run and relay to the 10 km main race. The races follow a new route, adjusted due to construction work. The event begins with an opening and a show act for the Bambini runners and ends with award ceremonies for the various races.

description: Beh v raji is a traditional running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Dobšinská Ice Cave and the surrounding area. The prologue is a hilly 1 km run along a forest trail from the car park to the ice cave. The event is suitable for the general public and also offers Nordic walking.

The half-marathon course follows an asphalt road through the village of Stratená and Stratenská Píla
The 10 km and 5 km courses are flat and follow an asphalt road with partial traffic closures
additional: Race-day registration takes place in the OOCR building. The prologue starts on Friday, 29.5.2026, from 16:00 to 17:15; Saturday’s races take place on 30.5.2026, from 8:00 to 10:40. name: Self-Transcendence 6/12h a 100km beh / Sri Chinmoy Self-Transcendence 100km beh
description: The Sri Chinmoy Self-Transcendence 6/12-hour and 100 km race in Šamorín is a traditional ultrarunning event held on May 30, 2026, in Pomlé City Park. This is the 24th edition of the 6-hour race and the 15th edition of the 12-hour and 100 km races, with categories for individuals and relays. Runners can compete in various age categories, including men’s and women’s veteran categories over 50. Relays consist of up to three runners, who may take turns in any order, with each member required to complete at least one lap after taking over. Results are measured by the actual distance covered, to the nearest meter.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Pomlé City Park in Šamorín.
The course is a loop, and relay runners may take turns in a specially marked section.
The time limit for the 100 km race is 12 hours.

After the race ends, runners must place a marker on the left side of the course and remain nearby until their actual distance covered has been recorded. For safety reasons, accompanying runners by bicycle or on skates is not permitted. The course doctor has the right to withdraw a runner from the race at any time. The event includes 6-hour, 12-hour, and 100 km categories, with relay options, and has rules for measuring distance and conduct during the race. Registration is open, with dates and fees provided.

description: Fatranský Vĺčko is a canine endurance sport that combines hiking and running with a dog in the beautiful surroundings of the Great Fatra. You can compete in the dog trekking category (person with a dog) or the trail category (running without a dog). Dogs must be kept on a leash or in a harness throughout the entire route; allowing dogs to roam freely will result in disqualification. The organisers recommend the MID route for experienced participants and the SHORT route for beginners or those with less training.

course_highlights: Mostly paved paths beside the water, with short sections of natural terrain
Crossing the Pňovany Bridge, with views of the Hracholusky Reservoir
A 21.1 km loop with a pleasant course profile
additional: The course is mildly trail-like, combining paved paths and natural terrain. A GPX map of the course is available to download. The race is organized by Sportovní klub Marathon Plzeň. The event includes both a marathon and a half marathon. The course is varied and runs through forests, meadows, and along roads, with 433 m of total elevation gain in the half marathon.

name: Hněvošická desítka
description: Hněvošická desítka is a sporting running event organized by Tělovýchovná jednota Sokol Hněvošice, taking place on 31 May 2026 at the TJ Sokol Hněvošice grounds. The run offers an opportunity to enjoy an active day in the beautiful surroundings of the village of Hněvošice in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The event is suitable for the general public and supports sporting traditions in the region.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the TJ Sokol Hněvošice grounds
A run through the pleasant natural surroundings of Hněvošice
A sporting atmosphere within the local community
additional: The event takes place at TJ Sokol Hněvošice, Lesní 242, 747 35 Hněvošice. It is organized by Tělovýchovná jednota Sokol Hněvošice, z.s. The event duration is not specified. Option to add the event to Google Calendar. The race is intended for runners of all levels; the afternoon also includes a color run or walk.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Lesná
location: Lesná, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beauty of the Ore Mountains. The series includes 6 races in various locations, including Lesná, where the main race covers 6 to 9 km, the adventure route is 20 to 30 km, and children’s races are held. The routes are suitable for runners, canicross participants, children, and walkers, offering a varied sporting challenge for all age groups. The series is organized by Živé Sokolovsko z.s. and Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s., in cooperation with local municipalities.
course_highlights: Main race: 6–9 km through the beautiful Ore Mountains countryside
Adventure route: 20–30 km, navigating with a map
Children’s races from 200 m to 1,600 m
additional: The series includes 6 races in various locations across the Ore Mountains. In addition to running, participants can take part in canicross, walking while finding checkpoints using a map, and children’s races. The varied routes pass through the region’s beautiful countryside. The event offers different routes, children’s categories, the option to choose a route individually, starts from 07:30, and award ceremonies after 13:00. Registration is at sokotime.cz.

name: Mezinárodní běh Měška a Doubravky
description: The Mieszko and Doubravka International Run is a summer running race for adults with a 12.5 km course. It starts in Mirošov and finishes at the AQA Land swimming pool in Meziměstí. The race is part of the East Bohemia Grand Prix and follows the scenic Polish-Czech borderland through meadows and forests. The start is beside the amphitheatre on Parkowa Hill at 11:00; the finish and awards ceremony take place at the swimming pool. Free bus transportation is provided for Czech competitors from Meziměstí to Mieroszów. Registration is free and available online or at the venue on race day.
course_highlights: 12.5 km course between Mirošov and Meziměstí
Scenic Polish-Czech borderland with meadows and forests
Start beside the amphitheatre on Parkowa Hill; finish at the AQA Land swimming pool in Meziměstí
additional: The bus for Czech competitors is free and departs at 9:15 from the Meziměstí swimming pool towards Mieroszów. Race-day registration is available from 9:30 at the race office or online. The awards ceremony takes place at the swimming pool after the race. The race includes various categories and is part of the East Bohemia Grand Prix. Registration is available online or at the venue.

name: Elsterlauf
organizer: SG Medizin Bad Liebenwerda e.V. und Lauf- und Walkingverein 05 Bad Liebenwerda e.V.
description: The Elsterlauf in Bad Liebenwerda is a traditional running and walking event, taking place for the 46th time on May 31, 2026. The event offers a variety of distances, including a marathon, half marathon, several walking and hiking routes, and children’s races. The course runs through the spa town of Bad Liebenwerda, with a family-friendly atmosphere and classifications for individual participants, teams, and companies. All participants receive a finisher’s medal and certificate, and awards are presented by age group. The event is organised by SG Medizin Bad Liebenwerda and Lauf- und Walkingverein 05 Bad Liebenwerda e.V.
course_highlights: A variety of distances: marathon, half marathon, 11 km, 5.7 km, 2 km, walking, and hiking
Start and finish at Roßmarkt in Bad Liebenwerda, near the primary school centre with changing rooms and showers
Guided 11 km hike and family-friendly races such as the Bambini and taster runs
additional: Late registration is available on May 30, 2026, from 12:00 to 15:00, and on May 31, 2026, from 07:00 to 09:30. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Bad Liebenwerda primary school centre; baggage storage is available from 7:00 to 14:00. The finish closes for all distances at 13:15. There is a company and club classification, with teams of three participants. Cyclists and hikers start without timing or classification. All participants receive a finisher’s medal and certificate. Results will be published online. Running event with online registration and various categories for runners, walkers, and families, including award ceremonies and finisher’s medals.

name: Urwaldlauf
description: The Urwaldlauf is a six-hour race in which participants can run as many laps as they like on a 1.85 km course through the forest near Saarbrücken within six hours. The start time is flexible from 10 a.m., and participants can enter individually or as part of a team. The course combines wide forest paths with idyllic singletrack trails and offers a challenging 46 metres of elevation gain per lap. The event places great emphasis on flexibility and fun, with an electronic lap counter and refreshments at the Urwaldscheune Neuhaus.
course_highlights: 1.85 km lap through the forest near Saarbrücken
46 metres of elevation gain per lap; more than 1,000 metres over marathon distance
A mix of wide forest paths and idyllic singletrack trails
additional: Bib pickup is available on site from 9 a.m. Flexible start time from 10 a.m.; the finish closes at 4 p.m. Electronic lap counter and refreshment station at the Urwaldscheune Neuhaus. The field is limited to 350 participants. Late registration is possible online or on site; the late-registration fee is payable on site. Team classification available; make sure the team name is spelled consistently. Six-hour race, 1.85 km lap, approximately 46 metres of elevation gain per lap, forest paths and singletrack trails, flexible start time from 10 a.m., finish at 4 p.m., online registration until the Friday before the event, participant limit of 350.

name: Lamer Woid-Reim
description: The Lamer “Woid-Reim” is a varied race starting in Lambach. With more than 70% of the route on trails, it guarantees plenty of fun and variety for runners of all ages and ability levels. The event is aimed at both competitive and recreational runners and is supported by numerous volunteers. Food and refreshments are available, and spectators are warmly welcome to cheer on participants along the course. Its special atmosphere makes the Lamer “Woid-Reim” a popular race in the Laufcup Cham.
course_highlights: Start in Lambach
More than 70% trail route
Varied course
additional: The event is part of the Laufcup Cham. There are classifications for different age groups and distances. Spectators are warmly welcome. Food and refreshments are available. The course is predominantly on trails. Several race categories, including children’s, youth, recreational and main races; start at 10:00 a.m.; registration open until 5 June 2026; Nordic skiing registration open until 5 June 2026, including refreshments, coffee and cake.

name: Freystädter Volksfestlauf
price_range: Erwachsene: 10,00 Euro, Schüler: 5,00 Euro, Bambini: 4,00 Euro
description: The Freystädter Volksfestlauf is a traditional running event in Freystadt, Bavaria, held annually as part of the Freystädter Volksfest. The races start and finish at the town hall on the market square and offer various distances for adults, schoolchildren, and Bambini. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, with awards for the best runners and teams as well as special categories. Changing rooms and showers are available at the TSV sports clubhouse, and the awards ceremonies take place in the festival tent or outdoors.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the town hall on the market square in Freystadt
Course routes can be viewed online in advance
Race distances for different age and ability groups
additional: Late entries are possible at the town hall until 1 hour before the respective start; a late entry fee of 3.00 euros applies. The awards ceremony for schoolchildren takes place at around 11:00 at the town hall, and the ceremony for adults and youth takes place from around 13:00 in the festival tent or outdoors. Changing rooms and showers are available at the TSV sports clubhouse, Allersberger-Straße 23, Freystadt. There are honorary prizes for the top finishers, certificates for places 1–3, and additional certificates available online. Special and team categories are also included. Courses for different age groups, online registration, awards ceremonies at the town hall and in the festival tent, changing rooms at the TSV sports clubhouse

name: 10K Hamburg - Elbe
description: The 10K Hamburg - Elbe is an exciting 10-kilometer race held at attractive spots in Hamburg, the city on the Elbe. The course follows fully closed and secured out-and-back routes on paved and asphalt paths. The race is open to runners of all ability levels and is officially measured in accordance with international competition regulations. The event is part of a cup competition comprising several 10K Hamburg races, with attractive prizes.
course_highlights: Fully closed and secured out-and-back routes
Paved and asphalt paths
Attractive running spots along the Elbe
additional: A bag drop for personal belongings is available on race day. Due to limited parking, travel by public transport is strongly recommended. Official results and personalized certificates are available to download online immediately after the event. Multiple start locations (Elbe, Volkspark, Rotherbaum), online registration only, start at 9:00 a.m., medals for finishers

name: 16. Campuslauf Technische Universität Braunschweig
location: Campus of Technische Universität Braunschweig, Braunschweig, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 16th Campus Run of Technische Universität Braunschweig takes place on 31 May 2026 on the university campus. The run gives students and staff the opportunity to get active and spend time together on the university grounds. The event is part of the university sports program and promotes a sense of community and participants’ health.
course_highlights: Run across the grounds of the TU Braunschweig campus
Event as part of TU Braunschweig’s university sports program
Opportunity for students and staff to get active
additional: The event is part of TU Braunschweig’s university sports program. Some sports facilities are closed during the Pentecost holidays. A tax change taking effect in the 2026 summer semester introduces VAT on certain services. Run on 31.05.2026; registration online and on site; live results during the run

name: 32. Tangerlauf
description: The 32nd Tanger Run in Tangerhütte is a traditional race through the Tangerniederung, organised by SV Germania Tangerhütte. The course follows the River Tanger through the scenic Altmark countryside, which is especially beautiful in spring. The race has a long history dating back to the GDR era and was revived after German reunification. The organisers wish all participants good weather and an enjoyable race.
course_highlights: Course along the River Tanger
Race through the Altmark countryside
Traditional race with a history dating back to the GDR era
additional: The race takes place in spring, and the course runs through the Altmark countryside. The event has a long history dating back to the GDR era.

name: 4. Eilenriedelauf
location: VfR 06 Döhren, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 4th Eilenriedelauf takes place on May 31, 2026, in Hanover and is organized by Hannover Runners e.V. This community race runs through the southern Eilenriede and welcomes runners of all ability levels. The event is part of the Laufpass series and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with refreshments at the finish area. Volunteers are very welcome and are invited to a sociable post-race get-together.
course_highlights: Community race through the southern Eilenriede
Run in Hanover’s green lung
Family-friendly atmosphere with refreshments at the finish
additional: After the race, all volunteers are invited to a sociable get-together in the rugby club’s beer garden. Cake donations for the finish-area refreshments are requested and should be dropped off by 10 a.m. on race day. Registration by May 28. Start at the entrance to VfR 06 Döhren. Events include a 5 km run, 5 km walk, and 10 km run, with chip timing.

name: 40. Göttinger Frühjahrs-Volkslauf
location: Jahnstadion Göttingen, Göttingen, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 40th Göttingen Sparkassen Volkslauf takes place on May 31, 2026, at Jahnstadion Göttingen and offers a varied programme of races for runners of all abilities. The event combines tradition and community, inviting both experienced runners and recreational joggers to enjoy an active day of fun and exercise. The distances are 2 km, 5.4 km and 10.8 km; unfortunately, the half marathon will not take place this year. The event focuses on health, wellbeing and community in the region.
course_highlights: Distances: 2 km, 5.4 km and 10.8 km
Start and finish at Göttingen’s Jahnstadion
The courses are not officially measured; details are available on the website
additional: No registration is required for the Bambini Run; race numbers can be collected free of charge on the day of the event. Registration on the day is not possible. The entry fee includes the organisation fee and a mineral drink. There are individual rankings and a special award for the most active school, as well as rankings in the S-Running-Cup, SüdNiedersachsen-Cup and Gö-Challenge. Race distances: 2 km, 5.4 km and 10.8 km; event at Jahnstadion; online registration; the half marathon is cancelled due to road closures; medical support and parking are available.

name: 5. Urwaldsteig-Ultratrail
location: Parkplatz Schloss Waldeck, Waldeck, Hessen, Germany
description: The Urwaldsteig Ultratrail is a challenging ultratrail run of approximately 66 km with about 2,000 metres of elevation gain around Lake Edersee. Starting in Waldeck, the route runs counterclockwise through varied natural landscapes, including dense forests, narrow trails, the Kahle Haardt nature reserve and Kellerwald-Edersee National Park. Runners can expect impressive views of the lake, historic sites such as Hünselburg and varied trail sections offering a rich nature experience. The start and finish are at the Schloss Waldeck car park. The race starts at 8 a.m.
course_highlights: Circular route of approximately 66 km with about 2,000 metres of elevation gain
Trail running on narrow paths through Kellerwald-Edersee National Park
Impressive views of Lake Edersee and historic sites such as Hünselburg
additional: Refreshment point at approximately km 32.2, after the bridge near Herzhausen. Day parking fee at the Schloss Waldeck start location: at least €5; please have the exact amount or pay digitally. The run follows the original Urwaldsteig route as marked; the GPX track is for general guidance only. Approximately 66 km, approximately 2,000 metres of elevation gain, trail terrain, refreshments at km 32.2, no showers or toilets, GPS recommended, participant limit of 30, start at 8 a.m. at the Schloss Waldeck car park.

name: 9. Hellmich Parkhauslauf
location: Parkhaus Lehrte, Lehrte, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The HELLMICH Parking Garage Run in Lehrte is a unique running event held in the Lehrte parking garage. Participants run a loop of approximately 1 km through the garage, with the inclines and views of the city making for a special running experience. There are three different races with varying numbers of laps, suitable for both children and adults. To ensure safety, each race is limited to 50 participants, and every finisher receives a medal as a keepsake.
course_highlights: Laps through the parking garage, approximately 1 km per lap
Start on the lowest level of the parking garage; finish opposite the start
Inclines and views from the top parking deck
additional: A maximum of 50 participants per race for safety reasons. Race packets can be collected on race day from 09:15 to 12:00 at the stand near the start. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:30 on the stage in front of the parking garage. The winners receive Lehrte Thalers as prizes. Maximum 50 participants per race; start and finish in the Lehrte parking garage; races begin at 10:15; awards ceremony at 12:30.

name: Frankfurter Runden
description: The Frankfurter Runden is a unique mass-participation running event in the heart of Frankfurt am Main, taking place for the sixth time on 31 May 2026. Participants can choose freely between 10, 20, 30 or 40 km during the run by completing one to four laps on a flat, scenic course along the Main with views of the skyline. The event is open to runners of all ability levels and offers professional timekeeping, medical support and refreshments on the course. A high-quality organic cotton shirt and digital live-tracking features round out the offer.
course_highlights: Flat 10 km loop along the Main with views of the skyline
Choose a distance of 10 to 40 km during the run
Two refreshment stations with water, isotonic drinks, bananas and snacks
additional: The start and finish are located below the Holbeinsteg on the banks of the Main. Bib numbers and start times are assigned according to the chosen distance, with start waves every 10 minutes. Bag drop, medical support and electronic timing by Datasport are available. The course is very flat, although there are steps to negotiate at km 8. The finish closes at 12:00. Participants receive a high-quality organic cotton shirt and can use the Your Run app for live tracking and community features. Run on what is probably Germany’s most beautiful running course, choose your laps flexibly, and enjoy an included shirt, live tracking and medical support.

name: Eilenriedelauf Hannover
description: The Eilenriedelauf is a fun run through the southern Eilenriede in Hanover, organized by Hannover Runners. The event takes place on 31 May 2026 and offers runners of all abilities the opportunity to run amid Hanover’s beautiful natural surroundings. It is part of the Laufpass series and focuses on community and the enjoyment of sport. After the run, participants can enjoy a sociable atmosphere with refreshments and cake in the finish area.
course_highlights: Fun run through the southern Eilenriede
Run in Hanover’s green oasis
Part of the Laufpass series
additional: After the run, volunteers gather in the rugby club’s beer garden for a sociable get-together with food and drinks. Donations of cake for the finish-line refreshments are welcome and should be dropped off by 10 a.m. on the day of the event. Volunteers can sign up using a form or get in touch by email. Participation is part of the Hannover Region Laufpass program, which includes collecting stamps and earning rewards. Online registration is available. Refreshments are provided at km 3, 5, 7, 10 and at the finish.

name: Erfurtshäuser Lauf
price_range: 8,00 € für Hauptlauf, andere Kategorien kostenlos oder vor Ort zu zahlen

price_tiers.distance: alle Läufe außer Bambini und Schüler

description: The Erfurtshausen Run is a traditional running event in Amöneburg-Erfurtshausen that welcomes runners of all ages. It offers various races, including Bambini, children’s, fun run and main races, as well as walking/Nordic walking. The course is marked, every kilometre is indicated, and refreshment stations are set up along the route. At the finish, the organiser provides food and drink for participants. Times are recorded electronically, with stopwatches as a backup, and certificates can be issued on request.
course_highlights: Marked course with kilometre markers
Refreshment stations along the route
Changing rooms and showers available on site and at the sports clubhouse
additional: The Bambini run starts at 11:30 a.m. and the children’s run at 11:45 a.m. Registration is possible up to 30 minutes before the start. Participants are insured through the Sports Federation of Hesse. Photos will be taken during the event and published on the website; participants may object. Changing rooms and showers are available on site and at the sports clubhouse. The course is marked, refreshments are available along the route, changing rooms and showers are available on site, and registration is possible up to 30 minutes before the start.

name: Göttinger Frühjahrs-Volkslauf
location: Göttinger Jahnstadion, Göttingen, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 40th Göttingen Sparkassen Volkslauf takes place on 31 May 2026 at Göttingen’s Jahnstadion and offers a varied program of races for runners of all abilities. Combining tradition and community, the event welcomes both experienced runners and recreational joggers to an active day of fun and exercise. The courses are almost flat, paved and partly asphalted, and follow a circuit through the region. Alongside the main races, there are also children’s and Bambini races, as well as walking routes suitable for all age groups.
course_highlights: Almost flat, paved and partly asphalted circuit courses
Distances: 2 km, 5.4 km and 10.8 km (2 laps)
A variety of race categories for all age groups and ability levels
additional: No registration is required for the Bambini race; race numbers can be collected free of charge on the day of the event. Late entries on the day are not possible. The entry fee includes an organizational contribution and a mineral drink. There are individual rankings in the respective races, with no age-group awards. The event is part of the SüdNiedersachsen-Cup and the Gö-Challenge. Race distances: 2 km, 5.4 km, 10.8 km; event at Göttingen’s Jahnstadion; the half marathon is not being held in 2026; participation is open to runners with or without club membership; entry fee includes a mineral drink; medical support is available; held in all weather conditions.

name: Trainingslauf Bottwartal-Marathon
location: Steinheim an der Murr, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Bottwartal Marathon is a running event in one of the most beautiful landscapes in southern Germany, taking runners through gentle vineyard slopes, picturesque old towns, and an exhilarating atmosphere along the course. The route is a loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal, with varied sections on paved farm roads and through historic town centers. The flat finish in Steinheim invites runners to make a strong final push. The marathon is for adult runners aged 18 and over and is part of a varied running program in the Bottwartal.
course_highlights: Loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal
Passage through historic old towns such as Murr, Gronau, Beilstein, Oberstenfeld, and Großbottwar
Flat finish at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim
additional: Free monthly training runs in different pace groups to help participants prepare, Sommerloch runs during the summer holidays, and a Year-End Run with 10 km followed by punch and mulled wine. Registration for all runs is through the partner Datasport. Late entries and changes of registration are possible until shortly before the run. Training run in Steinheim an der Murr with distances of 14 km, 21 km, and 42.2 km, usually in sunny weather in June.

description: The Wachtel Run, organized by TSG Niederhofheim, takes place on 31 May 2026 in Liederbach and invites runners of all ages to enjoy a day of sport. A range of distances is offered, including 10 km, 5 km, youth races and a Bambini run. There is also a 5 km Wachtel Walk for beginner walkers and speed walkers, with no official results. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with the start and finish at the Liederbach sports ground.
course_highlights: 10 km race with a target time of 1 hour 30 minutes (approx. 8:00 min/km)
5 km race and 5 km Wachtel Walk, with no official results
Youth races over 2.6 km and 3.9 km, plus a 500 m Bambini run
additional: Start and finish at the Liederbach sports ground, Wachenheimer Str. 69. The races start in staggered waves: 9:30 a.m. for the 5 km and 10 km races, 9:40 a.m. for the 5 km Wachtel Walk, 11:15 a.m. for the youth races and 12:00 p.m. for the Bambini run. The Wachtel Walk is not timed and is intended for everyone from beginner walkers to speed walkers; walking poles are not permitted. Online registration opens in January 2026. The event supports donations to the Bärenherz Children's Hospice and offers a varied running event in the Main-Taunus region.

description: The TSV Bollensen Hiking Marathon warmly invites all fans of recreational sport to enjoy a pleasant hike through the beautiful Solling Vogler forest area. The routes are loop courses starting and finishing at the TSV Bollensen sports clubhouse and run exclusively along forest trails. The region was awarded the “Wanderbares Deutschland” Quality Region designation in 2022. Refreshment stations along the routes, plus food and drinks at the finish, will keep you fueled. The event offers a friendly, family atmosphere and a relaxed get-together after the hike.
course_highlights: Forest trails through the Solling Vogler forest area
Loop courses starting and finishing at the TSV Bollensen sports clubhouse
“Wanderbares Deutschland” Quality Region since 2022
additional: Refreshments along the routes (42 km = 3 stations, 21 km = 2 stations), coffee and cold drinks at the start, one complimentary drink and a food voucher at the finish. Participant limit: 400. On-site late entries are possible up to one hour before the start, with a €5 late-entry fee. Terrain: forest trails in the Solling-Vogler area; registration until 29.05.2026; start times: 42 km at 08:00, 21 km between 08:30 and 09:30; refreshments included

name: 1. Zielony Półmaraton
location: Chojnowski Park Krajobrazowy, Konstancin-Jeziorna, Mazowieckie, Poland
price_range: bezpłatne dla dzieci i uczniów szkół podstawowych, dorośli od 60 zł do 100 zł w zależności od terminu zapisów
description: “We Run, We Don’t Click! – Konstancin-Jeziorna 2026” is a charity 5 km run taking place on May 24, 2026, in the scenic Chojnów Landscape Park. The course consists of two 2.5 km loops through pine and mixed forests, with gentle terrain suitable for runners of all ability levels. The start and finish are at the forest car park on Od Lasu Street, providing easy access and convenient viewing for spectators. The event combines sporting competition with community spirit and support for the local community, and all proceeds will go to the Special Education School Complex in Pęchery.
course_highlights: A route through Chojnów Landscape Park, an environmentally valuable area south of Warsaw
Two 2.5 km loops among mature pine and mixed woodlands
A gently undulating course with small climbs, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners
additional: The run is a charity event, and all proceeds will go to the Special Education School Complex in Pęchery. Participation is free for primary and secondary school students. The start and finish are at the forest car park, providing easy access and convenient viewing for spectators. During the break between the main race and the awards ceremony, children’s races will be held over 250 m and 500 m. Scenic route, forest terrain, children’s races, support for a local school, registration at the event office on the day of the event, different distances for children.

name: 13. Bieg 10km Szpot Swarzędz
description: The 13th Szpot Swarzędz 10K is one of the most important 10 km running events in Wielkopolska, held since 2012. It attracts leading Polish athletes as well as runners from abroad, creating a unique atmosphere of sporting excitement and energy. The course is interesting and varied, with forest sections and a route through the streets of Swarzędz. The event also includes a Family Run and a start for athletes using active wheelchairs. In 2026, the Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon returns, adding further excitement to the running festival.
course_highlights: A dynamic course profile with forest sections
An appealing route through the streets of Swarzędz
A new version of the course, highly praised by participants
additional: The event will include the 6th Family Run, open to participants of all ages, and a start for athletes using active wheelchairs. A unique commemorative T-shirt will be available for purchase. In 2026, the Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon returns for its fifth edition at the festival. The event features various age categories, the option to purchase a commemorative T-shirt, and a wide range of activities and support for participants.

name: 2. Uliczna Mila / 3. Parkowa Piątka
location: TAURON Park Śląski, Chorzów, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Uliczna Mila (1,609 m) and Parkowa Piątka (5 km) are road races held entirely on the paths of TAURON Park Śląski in Chorzów. The courses are certified by PZLA and World Athletics, guaranteeing high quality and the possibility of obtaining official results. description: The 45th anniversary Krotos Run is an annual running event held in Krotoszyn, scheduled for May 30 and 31, 2026. The event includes races for children and young people at the Municipal Stadium, as well as the main races along the city streets over distances of 10 km and 5 km. The start and finish are at the stadium, and the course runs through the streets of Krotoszyn, allowing participants to experience the city’s atmosphere. The race is an excellent opportunity for families and runners of all ability levels to spend time actively.
course_highlights: A course along the streets of Krotoszyn
Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Krotoszyn
Children’s and youth races at the stadium, divided into age categories
additional: The children’s and youth races take place on May 30 from 14:00 at the Municipal Stadium, with a warm-up led by a coach. Children’s age categories have different distances, from 100 m to 1,200 m. The race office is open on May 30 and 31, 2026, where registration is possible if places are available (without a T-shirt). Registration is open until April 15, 2026, and is available online with race packages and discounts for residents. The races will take place at the stadium and on the city streets, with different age categories.

name: 5. Półmaraton Szpot Swarzędz
description: The 5th Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon is a special running event taking place on 31 May 2026 in Swarzędz. The course consists of two loops with a total distance of 21.097 km, taking runners on a scenic route around Lake Swarzędzkie. The race combines sporting excitement with professional organisation, a unique atmosphere and enthusiastic support from spectators, creating an unforgettable celebration of running. The Szpot Swarzędz Running Festival also features a 10 km race and a Family Run, making the event appealing to different age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: A scenic, dynamic route around Lake Swarzędzkie
Two loops with a total distance of 21.097 km
Some sections of the course are shaded, providing comfort during the race
additional: The Szpot Swarzędz Running Festival features three races: the Half Marathon, the 10 km race and the Family Run. Participants can purchase a special commemorative T-shirt. The event combines sporting, educational and charitable elements. The organiser provides professional organisation, safety, and special medals and prizes. The race atmosphere is boosted by enthusiastic spectator support and extensive media coverage. A route around Lake Swarzędzkie; educational and charitable elements; the option to purchase a commemorative T-shirt; an event held as part of the Swarzędz Running Festival.

name: Bieg z okazji Dni Ziemi Ropczyckiej 2026
description: The Bieg z Okazji Dni Ziemi Ropczyckiej is a 10 km race taking place on 31 May 2026 in Ropczyce. This running event is held to mark a local celebration and attracts runners looking to spend time actively on a moderately distanced course. The route runs through the scenic area of Ropczyce, and participants can expect typical May weather, with temperatures of around 20°C. All running enthusiasts are invited to take part.
course_highlights: 10 km distance
Route in Ropczyce, Poland
Typical May weather: around 20°C, cloudy
additional: Please verify the event details with the organizer before registering. The event includes training preparations, and the route passes through the scenic areas of Ropczyce. May weather is usually favorable for runners, with temperatures of around 20°C and average rainfall of 55 mm.

name: Marceliński Bieg Wiosenny 2026
description: Marceliński Spring Run 2026 is a cross-country race organized in Poznań by running enthusiasts from the Biegi.Wlkp. group. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the aesthetic appeal of the locations. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on promoting cross-country running in Wielkopolska, offering participants a unique running experience amid beautiful natural surroundings.

The aesthetic appeal of the selected locations
Route available on Garmin Connect

Scenic course around Kupienin
First edition of the event

description: The 16th Kogeneracja Biegaj w Siechnicach is a road race over 5 km and 10 km, taking place on 31 May 2026. The course runs through the streets of Siechnice, on a 5 km loop that 10 km runners complete twice. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity and the recreational attractions of the Siechnice municipality. In addition to the main races, children’s and youth races are also held. The start and finish are on Kościelna Street, at the intersection with Jana Pawła II Street, and the race starts at 9:00.
course_highlights: A road course through Siechnice on a 5 km loop
The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km loop
Start and finish on Kościelna Street at the intersection with Jana Pawła II Street
additional: The race office and baggage drop are on Jana Pawła II Street, next to the Municipal Office. Race packs can be collected on Saturday and Sunday morning. The race pack includes an Oshee isotonic drink, an Eatyx bar and a race bib. Finishers receive a medal and a recovery meal. The participant limit is 700. Youth races and the Young Engineer Race for children up to age 7 are also held. Free parking is available by the LA/Błękitna Laguna stadium from 9:00 to 15:00; parking by the railway station and Toro Park shopping centre is recommended. A new system assigns race numbers using QR codes. Online registration is available, the race office is located in Siechnice, and the event also includes youth and children’s races, promoting health and recreation.

name: 3 Zduńskowolski Festiwal Biegowy
description: The 3rd Zduńska Wola Running Festival is a celebratory road race through the city of Zduńska Wola, organized to mark the 200th anniversary of the granting of city rights. The events are held over distances of 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21 km), with the start and finish located at the Municipal Stadium on Łaska Street. The course runs through the city and the municipality of Zapolice to the village of Brzeski in the municipality of Sędziejowice, where the half-marathon turnaround point is located. Several hundred runners take part, and the competition has a road-race, urban character.
course_highlights: Course through the streets of Zduńska Wola
Turnaround point in Brzeski, in the municipality of Sędziejowice
Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium on Łaska Street
additional: Several hundred runners take part in the event. It is organized by the Zduńska Wola City Hall. The half-marathon course is 21 km long, with a turnaround in Brzeski. The available races are 5 km, 10 km, and the half marathon. There is no information about start waves, participant limits, entry fees, or additional services. The event includes races for different age groups and ability levels, as well as attractions for families and participants of all ages.

The event takes place at the OSIR Stadium in Zawiercie and features two distances: the 10 km main race and a 5 km accompanying race. The course runs through the streets of Zawiercie, is properly secured and closed to traffic, and is marked at every kilometre. The event aims to promote running and bring together runners from across the country.

Every kilometre of the course is marked
Course closed to traffic and secured
additional: The race office is open from 7:00 to 8:30 at the OSIR Stadium. Race packs can also be collected on Saturday from 16:00 to 19:00. The time limit is 1:30 for the 10 km and 1:00 for the 5 km. Electronic timing uses a returnable chip attached to the shoe. Runners must wear their race numbers pinned to the front of their shirts. Cycling, skating, skateboarding, and using other devices on the course are prohibited without the organizer’s consent. Distances: 10 km and 5 km; time limits: 1:30 for the 10 km and 1:00 for the 5 km; race packs can be collected on race day; the course is secured; participant limit: 500; online registration runs from December 6, 2025, to May 15, 2026.

description: The Bieg o Koronę Księżnej Dąbrówki is the event’s anniversary 15th edition, traditionally held on the last Sunday of May. The main 10 km race follows forest tracks surrounded by greenery, offering pleasant conditions for running on soft surfaces. Nordic walking enthusiasts can take on a 7.5 km route, while the youngest participants can compete over shorter distances of 200 to 1,000 metres. The start and finish are located at the edge of the Palędzie–Zakrzewo forest, on Parkowa Street in Dąbrówka. The event is family-friendly and inclusive, promoting physical activity among residents of Dopiewo Municipality.
course_highlights: Main 10 km race on forest tracks surrounded by greenery
7.5 km Nordic walking route
Children’s races over distances of 200 to 1,000 metres
additional: Children’s races start at 10:15, the main race at 12:00, and the Nordic walking event at 12:02. Individual and team classifications include categories for people with disabilities and residents of Dopiewo Municipality and LINEA Developer housing estates. Teams must be mixed (women/men). Distances: 10 km, 7.5 km, children’s races; start location: at the edge of the Palędzie–Zakrzewo forest, on Parkowa Street in Dąbrówka; date: 31 May 2026; registration is now open.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Szpot
description: The Szpot Swarzędz Running Festival is a special running event taking place on May 31, 2026. The festival features three races: the 5th Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon, the 13th Szpot Swarzędz 10K, and the 6th Szpot Swarzędz Family Run. The half-marathon course follows two loops around picturesque Lake Swarzędzkie, while the 10K offers a dynamic profile with forest sections and streets. The event brings together sport, education, and charity. Participants can enjoy a food zone, partner expo, post-race meal, massages, and a charity auction. The festival is open to everyone, including athletes using active wheelchairs and seniors over 70, who can take part free of charge.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course: two loops around Lake Swarzędzkie
10K course: a dynamic profile with forest sections and streets in Swarzędz
The event features three races, as well as a food zone and expo
additional: Participants aged 70 and over receive a free race package for the 10K and half marathon. Limited-edition commemorative shirts for runners and families are available to purchase. Athletes using active wheelchairs will make their debut in the 10K. After the race, there will be a post-race meal, stretching and massages at the finish, and a charity auction. The event area includes the surroundings of Lake Swarzędzkie. Discounts are available for families and veterans, and new accessibility amenities are provided.

name: Krakowski Bieg Swoszowicki
description: Kraków Swoszowice Run is a family running event held in the beautiful Spa Park in Swoszowice, in the south of Kraków. It offers a variety of events: a 10 km main race, a 5 km race, a family mile, and races for children aged 1 to 11. The event brings generations together, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle while fostering a sense of community among residents of Kraków and the surrounding area. In addition to sporting competition, participants can look forward to attractive race packs and a family picnic.
course_highlights: 10 km main race through District X Swoszowice and the surrounding area
Family mile over a distance of 1.6 km, with intergenerational competition
Children’s races from 50 to 300 m, tailored to different age groups
additional: The race pack includes sponsor merchandise, a race bib, and a commemorative medal awarded after finishing the race. Participants must show proof of identity and sign declarations when collecting their race pack. The race takes place on the weekend before Children’s Day, and the program also includes a family picnic. The event supports sick children, takes place in the beautiful setting of Spa Park, and attracts large numbers of participants while working with the City of Kraków.

name: LoveLasTrail
description: Love'Las Trail Przystań is a unique forest race held in the picturesque forests of Mazovia, in the heart of the Ostrołęka Forest District. This sports and recreation event combines competition with a love of nature, promoting a healthy lifestyle and social integration. Courses of varying difficulty are available to runners of different experience levels, as well as to families and Nordic walking enthusiasts. The race has an atmosphere full of positive energy and respect for nature, as confirmed by participants in previous editions.
course_highlights: Cross-country routes of varying difficulty in the heart of the forests of Mazovia
Picturesque forest trails in the Ostrołęka Forest District
Distances ranging from a family-friendly 2 km to a challenging race of around 20 km
additional: The race office is open from 7:30 to 9:30. Start times for each distance: 08:00 Maraton Leśnego Jelenia (42 km), 09:00 Król Lasu (approx. 20 km), 10:00 Bieg Wiatrów (5 km) and Trasa Wilka (10 km), 10:05 Spacer Szakala (Nordic walking, 5 km), 10:15 Zielona Przygoda (family run/walk, 2 km). The entry fee includes a race bib, returnable timing chip, commemorative souvenir, medal, post-race meal and sweet treat. Open classifications for women and men, with trophies for the top finishers, are held for the 5 km, 10 km and 20 km distances, as well as Nordic walking. Training plans and support are available to participants, and the event includes various race categories: marathon, 20 km, 10 km, 5 km and a family run. Registration is open until 25 May 2026.

name: Mokotowski Bieg SGH
description: The SGH Mokotów Run is Poland’s largest charity run organized by students, combining sport with helping those in need. The event takes place in the heart of Mokotów, Warsaw, and attracts hundreds of participants—students, alumni, residents, and running enthusiasts. The route runs along Mokotów’s streets and finishes in the SGH Rector’s Gardens. Every step makes a real difference to the lives of those in need through support for the “Akogo?” Foundation. It is not just a sporting event, but also a community built on solidarity and the energy of student engagement.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes along the streets of Mokotów
Finish in the SGH Rector’s Gardens
Run for children and families
additional: The event includes a meeting and partner activities area, a group warm-up before the start, and a medal ceremony after the run. Charity focus, various distances, activities and a Running Village, student community and Warsaw residents

name: Rio de Janeiro Virtual Challange
description: The Rio de Janeiro Virtual Challenge is a virtual challenge that takes you along a route through the vibrant streets and breathtaking landscapes of Rio de Janeiro, known as the Marvelous City. Participants can track their progress using a mobile app, logging various physical activities that are automatically converted into distance covered. The challenge lets you choose your own pace and completion time, and take part individually or as a team. In addition, for every bit of progress made in the challenge, the organizers plant trees or prevent plastic bottles from reaching the ocean, supporting environmental protection.
course_highlights: A 198 km (123 mi) route through Rio de Janeiro
8 virtual postcards to unlock during the challenge
Integration with popular fitness apps and smartwatches
additional: Participants have access to a private Facebook group where they can share experiences and motivate one another. The challenge lets you log any distance-based activities, including yoga or weightlifting. You can choose your own start date and challenge duration. Access to a mobile app for iOS and Android to track your progress. Participants can choose any amount of time to complete the challenge. Medals and apparel are available, and taking part supports environmental initiatives.

name: Stryszów w Biegu

description: The 10th Municipal Charity Run Between the Windmills is an annual running event held in Łukaszów, aimed at promoting running, sport and a healthy lifestyle. The route follows a scenic loop around the windmills in Łukaszów, and participants can choose from several distances, including a children’s run, 5 km, 10 km and Nordic Walking.
