The event also includes races for children and young people, a 5 km Nordic Walking march, and a recreational run-walk. Participants can expect electronic timing, medals for all participants, and prizes for the top finishers. Those who wish to take part virtually can join the virtual race between 27 May and 4 June 2026.

5 km Nordic Walking march
Shorter-distance races for children and young people

The 80 m preschoolers’ race is free, and every participant receives a medal. The 1,200 m recreational run-walk is free and requires no registration. Competitors are classified in 15 age categories. description: The Run Around the Rajec Square is a traditional running race organized by the Rajec Marathon Club and held at SNP Square in Rajec. The race gives runners the opportunity to enjoy the natural beauty and surroundings of Rajec on a May day. The event is suitable for the general public, including children and minors, who must have the consent of a legal guardian. The organizers emphasize safety and thorough preparation for participants.

Natural surroundings with a gentle elevation gain

The organizers are the Kláštor pod Znievom Municipal Office, Strive sport, TRIMAT and the Slovak Athletics Association. The race is part of the Slovak Mountain Running Cup.

Part of the Slovak Mountain Running Cup
additional: The children’s categories start at 14:30, and the youth categories at 15:00. Categories are divided by age and gender, including several age groups from the youngest pupils to veterans. description: The Berounka running series in Zadní Třebaň is a scenic race set in the beautiful countryside of the Central Bohemian Region. The route follows the Berounka River, crosses meadows with views, passes along the Liteň nature trail, and winds through picturesque countryside reminiscent of Tuscany. The race culminates in a climb to the course’s highest point in Doubce, followed by a final descent to the finish at a pleasant campsite with refreshments. Every participant receives a race number, and the top three in each category receive certificates and medals.

The Liteň nature trail along Stříbrný Creek and the historic waterworks

The event is part of the regular sports and entertainment program at Nové Roztyly Park, which is also suitable for families with children.

Distances: 10 km, 5 km, and 2.5 km
Long-standing event with a welcoming atmosphere
additional: The race takes place at the Waldsportplatz in Gladenbach-Frohnhausen; the weather is expected to be sunny at around 23°C. Participants should contact the organizer for registration and further details.

name: III Ryszewkowy Bieg o Puchar Strażaka
Kolem Trpaslíka v Hybrálci
description: The Kolem Trpaslíka race in Hybrálec is a 10 km running race that runs mainly along unpaved forest paths in the Hybrálec area near Jihlava. It is part of the Běžec Vysočiny Cup and gives runners the opportunity to enjoy the natural terrain of the Vysočina region. The course is ideal for fans of forest running and a pleasant outdoor sporting experience.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Mainly unpaved forest paths
Part of the Běžec Vysočiny Cup
additional: The race offers various courses around Hybrálec, including shorter distances, and is suitable for all age groups. A friendly atmosphere and the chance to meet the Vysočina running community await.

name: Valašské kilo
description: Valašské Kilo is a challenging 100 km ultramarathon through the beautiful, hilly landscape of Valašsko, with at least 3,500 metres of elevation gain. The race is a challenge not only for experienced athletes, but also for those who want to push their limits and experience an off-road adventure. After the mass start at 22:00, runners plan their own route between checkpoints, within a 30-hour time limit. Race facilities are at ZŠ Žerotínova in Valašské Meziříčí, where a gym, showers and a dining hall are available. Valašské Kilo offers the freedom to navigate the terrain and is one of the best ultramarathons in Czechia.
course_highlights: 100 km route with at least 3,500 metres of elevation gain
Choose your own route between checkpoints (Krpály)
Challenging Valašsko terrain with hills and natural beauty
additional: The race has a 30-hour time limit. At the start, runners receive a card listing the checkpoints they must visit. Race facilities are open from approximately 16:00 on Friday until 12:00 on Sunday and include a gym, showers, a dining hall, drinking water and baggage storage. Each runner must provide their own map of the route. The race focuses on endurance walking and running, with an emphasis on resilience and the ability to tackle the challenging terrain of the Valašsko region.

name: Dopesace Backyard Ultra
description: Dopesace Backyard Ultra is an endurance race held in the Aš Forests, where runners complete a loop of just under 7 kilometres every hour. The race continues until only one runner remains who can complete one more lap than the others. This unique format puts the emphasis not only on speed, but above all on endurance and determination. The winner receives a silver coin and the opportunity to represent the Czech Republic at the team world championships in October 2026. The race atmosphere is unforgettable, and the event is also linked to a charitable project.
course_highlights: A 6.71 km loop with approximately 80 m of elevation gain
The race takes place in the Aš Forests, with the start and race facilities at Kemp Pod Rozhlednou
Each lap starts exactly one hour after the previous one, with strict timekeeping
additional: Pre-race check-in is available the evening before the race between 5 and 7 p.m., or on race day from 8 to 9:15 a.m. Runners must be over 18. Each lap must be completed within 60 minutes, otherwise the runner is disqualified. No assistance or aids are permitted on the course, including running poles. The race supports charity, with runners contributing CZK 1–10 for every kilometre completed to a selected project. The race takes place in the Aš Forests, and headlamps are required for night sections. Registration is required. The event has a charitable dimension and emphasises community spirit and endurance.

name: Borkener Citylauf
description: The Borken City Run is a traditional fun run that has been held annually in Borken’s city centre since 1987. The event offers races for all ages on a closed 2.5 km circuit through the city centre, the town park and across the market square. Starting and finishing at the market square, the City Run is a popular event that appeals to recreational runners and competitive athletes alike. It is organised by the Borken City Sports Association and several local clubs, and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with a range of age groups and awards.
course_highlights: Closed 2.5 km circuit through the city centre, town park and market square
Start and finish at Borken market square
A range of distances for children, young people and adults
additional: Late entries are accepted at the Tourist Information Centre in Borken on the day of the event from 14:00 until 30 minutes before the start of the respective race, for a fee of €2.00. Race packs are available from 14:00. Transponders can be returned after crossing the finish line for a €2.00 refund. Races for various age groups, online registration, on-site late registration available, special support for young runners with children acting as guides

name: Wallauer Mittsommerlauf
location: Wallau, Hofheim am Taunus, Hesse, Germany

name: 1. Westerwälder Backyard Ultra
description: The Westerwälder Backyard Ultra 2026 is a unique ultramarathon held in Höchstenbach in the Westerwald (Rhineland-Palatinate). Participants run a marked 6.706 km loop with 71 metres of elevation gain per lap, along forest, woodland and meadow paths. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, electronic lap timing, refreshments in the start/finish area, and a medal for everyone who completes at least one lap. A portion of the entry fee is also donated to local youth work and a tree-planting project.
course_highlights: 6.706 km loop with 71 metres of elevation gain per lap
Route along forest, woodland and meadow paths
Electronic lap timing via RaceResult
additional: Bib pickup begins on 5 June 2026 at 17:00. Mandatory briefing 15 minutes before the start. Runner-friendly drinks and snacks are available in the start/finish area. Camping and setting up a gazebo are possible on a limited basis. A shower trailer is available on site. No refunds of the entry fee for non-participation; substitute runners are allowed. A waiting list will be available if the event sells out. A portion of the entry fee is donated to youth work and a tree-planting project. A medal is awarded to everyone who completes at least one lap. The awards ceremony will take place shortly after the finish. Participants may camp or set up gazebos in the start/finish area. The entry fee includes a donation to a charitable cause; an additional €1.50 is charged per lap (up to a maximum of 10 laps). The event is limited to 200 participants and starts on 5 June 2026 at 19:00.

name: Freundschaftslauf
description: The saarLANDlauf is a friendship run around Saarland, held in 20 stages along the Saarland Circular Hiking Trail, covering a total of about 400 kilometers. The runs are guided friendship runs organized by local hosts and are intended for experienced runners who can comfortably complete a half marathon. The aim is to strengthen the community of Saarland runners and running clubs and to explore the region’s most beautiful spots together on foot. Participation is free, although a small donation is welcome.
course_highlights: 20 stages, each about 20 km long
Routes follow the Saarland Circular Hiking Trail, with plenty of climbs and descents
Guided runs without markings; GPS data is provided
additional: These are not races but friendship runs. There are no running pacers or course markings; instead, GPS data for the routes is provided. The event encourages sociability and community, with a relaxed get-together after the runs. Changing facilities, showers, and parking are available at the meeting points. Participants explore the mystical, marshy Rötelsteinpfad region, with picturesque views of the Nahe. The event is part of a multi-day, regionally focused running event with several stages and route options.

name: Saalfelder Bambini-Schloßparklauf
organizer: Saalfelder Leichtathletik-Verein e.V. und Thüringer Leichtathletik Verband e.V.
description: The Saalfeld Bambini Schlosspark Run is a traditional children’s race taking place on June 5, 2026, from 5:00 p.m. in Saalfeld’s Schlosspark. The event is for children born between 2017 and 2023, who run one or two laps depending on their age. It is organized by Saalfelder Leichtathletik-Verein e.V. and offers a child-friendly atmosphere for the youngest runners. Registration is available online, at the start, or by phone.
course_highlights: Races for children aged 3 to 9
Lap count varies by age group (1 or 2 laps)
Event held in Saalfeld’s picturesque Schlosspark
additional: Registration is available online, at the start, or by phone through Uta Weber (Tel.: 0176/84770473). There are no entry fees. Races are grouped by year of birth, with 1 or 2 laps. A liability disclaimer applies to damage and injuries. The event is organized by Saalfelder Leichtathletik-Verein e.V. Children’s race in Schlosspark, part of the Saalfelder Kulmberglauf; dates and results available

name: Spargellauf
description: The WERNER Spargellauf in Deinste is a 5.5 km relay race held annually, celebrating its 20th anniversary in 2026. Teams of five runners make their way together through the asparagus fields, using an asparagus spear as the relay baton. The race is suitable for all fitness levels, from beginners to professionals, and fun comes first, as the winning team is selected by lottery. Alongside the race, there is a culinary mile featuring regional specialties and a family programme with a bouncy castle and other attractions. A special race shirt will be available for the anniversary, and a big after-show party will take place.
course_highlights: 5.5 km route through Deinste’s asparagus fields
Relay race with an asparagus spear as the baton
Suitable for all fitness levels; participants can walk, power walk or run
additional: The 2026 anniversary celebration includes an after-show party, an anniversary magazine, a prize wheel, and special anniversary dishes and drinks. The winning team is drawn by lottery and receives regional products (asparagus, potatoes, ham and strawberries). Anniversary race shirts featuring a custom team name or logo can be ordered until 16 May. The culinary mile offers a variety of food and drinks. The family programme includes a bouncy castle. The anniversary event also features music and refreshments along the route.

name: Stapelmoorer Run-Fun-Loop
description: The Stapelmoorer Run Fun Loop is a 10 km race measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV), starting and finishing at the Teutonia Stapelmoor sports ground. The course winds through the scenic surroundings of Stapelmoor, along farm tracks, school routes and village streets. Part of the Teutonia Stapelmoor running community, the event offers runners a well-organised and varied course in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km course measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV)
Start and finish at the Teutonia Stapelmoor sports ground
Route follows farm tracks, school routes and village streets
additional: Online registration is available until race day. Start and finish at the sports ground in Stapelmoor. Nordic walking is also offered without timing.

name: Warnemünder Stapellauf
description: The Warnemünder Stapellauf is a small race held in June in Rostock, Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, Germany. The event offers short distances of 555 meters and 9.3 kilometers, ideal for runners looking for a straightforward race experience. The courses have local nautical names that reflect Warnemünde’s coastal identity, including the 5-Seemeilen-Lauf (9 km) and the 3-Seemeilen-Lauf (6 km). Results are managed via my.race|result, and the event is listed in the laufen.de calendar.
course_highlights: Short distances: 555 m and 9.3 km
Locally inspired nautical race names (5 Seemeilen-Lauf, 3 Seemeilen-Lauf, 3 Kabellängen-Lauf)
Venue in Warnemünde with a coastal character
additional: The event takes place on 5 June 2026 in Warnemünde. Typical June weather is around 23 °C high and 13 °C low, with mostly sunny days. Detailed course information is not available; results are provided online. The event also includes running routes in the fields of maritime studies, engineering, and logistics; results are available online.

name: Čertovskej Trail

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné stejné pro obě trasy: 1 222 Kč

description: Čertovskej Ultratrail is a challenging trail run through the mountains, valleys, castles and waters of the mysterious Kokořínsko and Máchův kraj regions. It offers a main 66.6 km route that is also suitable for beginner ultrarunners thanks to well-stocked aid stations and a friendly atmosphere. A shorter 33.3 km course, called Letní půlčert, is also available. The race is part of the prestigious Ultracup series and offers ITRA points to runners. Capacity is limited, so early registration is recommended.
course_highlights: A trail run through the mountains, valleys, castles and waters of Kokořínsko and Máchův kraj
Well-stocked aid stations along the course
Scenic countryside and a family-friendly race atmosphere
additional: A personal drinking cup is mandatory equipment. You can order one during registration, along with a Čertovskej cup, T-shirt or socks. Race capacity is limited. Categories are available for individuals and relay teams, including a family relay with a child under 15. The route is marked with ribbons and arrows. The time limit for the Čertovskej Wintertrail is 7 hours. Post-race refreshments are provided at the finish, including soup, a main course and drinks. The race is part of the UTMB Index Races and ITRA National League. A personal cup is mandatory at the aid stations. A running cup, T-shirt or socks can be ordered during registration.

name: Trutnovská 10
location: Paradráze, Trutnov, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Trutnovská 10 is a traditional running race with a 12-year history, offering unforgettable experiences in the beautiful surroundings of Para Forest Park in Trutnov. The race takes place on June 6, 2026, with several distances to choose from: a 5 km loop, a 10 km loop, and a 3 km canicross race. Children can take part in a kids’ cross-country race with obstacles adapted to different age groups, along with a range of accompanying activities. Trutnovská 10 is suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike, offering the chance to experience the atmosphere of a mass start and connect with nature in the heart of the Krkonoše Mountains.
course_highlights: Para Forest Park, with compacted forest trails
5 km and 10 km routes, plus a 3 km canicross loop
Kids’ cross-country race with age-appropriate obstacles
additional: The start and finish are at the Paradráha Trutnov complex. The routes are not certified. Children’s categories cover different distances from 200 m to 1,500 m, with obstacles such as climbing over, crawling under, and slaloming. The difficulty of the obstacles is adapted to each age group so that everyone can manage them. The race offers a range of distances, including canicross, and focuses on a community-oriented, family-friendly atmosphere, with activities such as yoga, a bouncy castle, and refreshments.

name: Jesenická šedesátka
location: Zámecké náměstí, Jeseník, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Jesenická šedesátka is a hiking march and run along the ridges of the Hrubý Jeseník Mountains, offering beautiful natural surroundings and the chance to test yourself against the clock. The 60 km route is intended for more experienced participants aged 16 and over and includes refreshment stations. This is a traditional and popular event, with chip timing and results announced at the finish. The organizers emphasize safety and a relaxed atmosphere, and the event is suitable for both runners and hikers.
course_highlights: Hiking march along the ridges of the Hrubý Jeseník Mountains
Refreshment stations at 6 locations along the 60 km route
Time limits and chip timing
additional: Refreshments are available at 6 locations along the 60 km route, including 5 organizer checkpoints. The organizers use chip technology to record times and rankings. After the race, results are announced at the finish at 20:30. Children under 12 are advised to do the 25 km route with an adult. If you withdraw from the route, you must notify the organizers to avoid an unnecessary search. The event takes place on 6 June 2026, with the start and finish at Zámecké náměstí in Jeseník. The routes run across the Jeseníky ridges, and registration opens in April.

name: Čertovskej ultratrail
location: Hamr na Jezeře, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_5
tiers.description: 4 etapy z 8 dle vlastního výběru – jednotlivci – 4 666 Kč / osobu

description: Čertovskej Ultratrail is an off-road run through the mountains, valleys, castles and waters of the mysterious Kokořínsko and Máchův kraj. The main route is 66.6 km, with beautiful scenery and well-stocked aid stations, and is also suitable for beginner ultramarathon runners. The race is part of the Ultracup series and is also the final stage of the 8-day, 666 km Čertovská Výzva. Runners can look forward to a friendly, family atmosphere and unforgettable experiences in scenic terrain.
course_highlights: Off-road route through the mountains, valleys, castles and waters of Kokořínsko and Máchův kraj
Well-stocked aid stations along the route
Scenic surroundings and a friendly, family atmosphere
additional: Runners must bring their own cup for drinks at the aid stations. A Čertovský running cup, T-shirt or socks can also be ordered. Race capacity is limited, and registration for the main race on 6.6.2026 is sold out, though places may become available before the event. Čertovská Výzva 666 km is an 8-day stage race with GPS trackers and online timing. The race is part of the UTMB Index Races, with the opportunity to earn ITRA points. Registration is sold out, capacity is limited, and the race offers a family atmosphere and bus transport to the start.

name: Vybarvený běh
description: The Color Run in Kroměříž is an unconventional running event where it’s not about the time, but about having fun and getting covered in color along the course. Every runner can enjoy the pleasure of movement and the colorful atmosphere in the Great Square. The event is suitable for all ages, including children, who must be accompanied by an adult. The Color Run is a great opportunity for families and individuals to enjoy a sports day full of color and music.
course_highlights: A run in the Great Square in Kroměříž
Throwing color on yourself and others along the course
Music and a lively atmosphere
additional: There is no competition and no times are recorded. Children under 10 must run with an adult, who is responsible for them. Parents can also run with children in strollers, but should be careful because of the powdered colors. Registration is individual and takes place via an online form, where participants must confirm that they agree to the rules and conditions. The event is suitable for all age groups, and registration is available online or in person. The race pack includes a T-shirt, a race number, color powder and gifts. The program also includes concerts in the Great Square.

name: Skřipovská lítačka
location: Fotbalové hřiště ve Skřipově u Opavy, Skřipov, Opava, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné pro Vrabčí a Holubí závod je zdarma při online registraci

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 50 Kč při osobní registraci v den a místě závodu

price_tiers.distance: Pštrosí a Orlí závod (5 km a 10 km)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné pro Pštrosí a Orlí závod činí 250 Kč při online registraci

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 350 Kč při osobní registraci v den a místě závodu

description: Skřipovská lítačka is a traditional running race held amid the picturesque fields, meadows, and forests around the village of Skřipov near Opava. The seventh edition will take place on June 6, 2026, with its hub at the TJ Sokol Skřipov football field. The race offers courses for all age groups, from the youngest children to adults, along with a varied program of activities including an inflatable maze, face painting, and refreshments. All courses are clearly marked, and volunteers at intersections point runners in the right direction. The event is organized by Běžecký klub Skřipov, z. s.
course_highlights: The course passes through the fields, meadows, and forests around Skřipov
Volunteers at intersections and course marked with streamers
Time limits for some races (Orlí 60 min, Pštrosí 90 min)
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day from 14:00 at the football field. Registration for each race closes at a different time. Changing rooms, showers, toilets, and baggage storage are available. Parking is provided in a residential area, with volunteers directing traffic. Refreshments are available for participants at the finish. Runners must wear their race bib visibly attached to the front of their chest. The race is open to all age groups; participants under 18 must have the consent of a legal guardian. The event is designed for all ages, offers courses of varying lengths, and features family-oriented activities.

name: Happy run
location: Studenec u Třebíče, Kraji Vysočina, Czech Republic
description: Happy Run is a charity run taking place on June 6, 2026, in Studenec u Třebíče in the Vysočina Region. The event is open to everyone—athletes and non-athletes, families with children and individuals—with several routes to choose from to suit their abilities. It supports Viktorka, a boy with serious health complications, and the proceeds from the run will go toward his rehabilitation stay. Alongside the run itself, there will be a varied program of activities and an evening social party.
course_highlights: Routes of 11 km, 6 km, 1 km children’s race, and 1 km non-competitive family run
The children’s route is timed and includes a race number and chip
The family route follows the same course as the children’s route and is not timed
additional: Registered participants will receive a race pack with a race number and chip. Times are recorded on the children’s course but not on the family route. On-site registration is available only for the family route. There is a competition for the largest team, with a small prize. Activities will run throughout the day, followed by an evening party. Charity event, family and children’s routes, on-site registration, support for children with health problems.

name: Běh napříč republikou
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique relay event, now taking place for the fifth year. Participants run together from different parts of the Czech Republic to its geographical centre in Číhošť. The pace is suited to recreational runners and is conversational. The routes are divided into individual sections, each with pacers who ensure the right pace and guide the way. This is not a race, but a shared experience that offers a chance to discover new places and meet other runners.
course_highlights: Four parallel routes from Liberec, Pohoří na Šumavě, Prostějov and Rokycany to Číhošť
A total distance of 782.9 km divided into 82 sections, with a precise schedule
Routes cross varied terrain—hills, flat stretches, trails, roads, forests and towns
additional: Participants run together at a conversational pace, with pacers on every section. The pace is suited to recreational runners: around 6 min/km on flat stretches and slower in the hills. On selected sections, the pace is reduced to 7 min/km so occasional runners can join in. Refreshments are provided at handover points, along with a support vehicle and participant transport subject to capacity. The route is not marked; participants follow the schedule and run with pacers. Everyone finishes together in Číhošť on Sunday at 17:00. Multiple start locations, approximately 867 km in total, group runs with pacers, no official timing, open participation, varied terrain from city streets to trails, and a relay format with a predetermined schedule.

name: Z Hejnic do Pekla
location: Skatepark Hejnice, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Děti do 15 let* a běžci nad 65 let* 0,- Kč

description: Z Hejnic do Pekla 2026 is the second edition of a running race held in the Liberec Region, starting at Hejnice Skatepark. The race offers a welcoming atmosphere, refreshments, medical support, and a race pack for every participant. It is suitable for the general public, including children and seniors, who receive special entry-fee conditions. The organizers prioritize runners’ comfort, providing changing rooms, showers, and luggage storage.
course_highlights: Refreshment station on the long course
Medical support at the start, finish, and along the course
Start and finish at Hejnice Skatepark
additional: The entry fee includes a race bib, a borrowed electronic timing chip, changing rooms, showers, toilets, luggage storage, refreshments, a finisher’s medal, online results and a certificate, a race pack, email updates, and special offers from partners. Race bibs are issued on race day during check-in at the registration tent. Entry is tied to a specific person, non-refundable, and non-transferable. The race takes place on June 6, 2026. Registration requires proof of identity and proof of payment. Children under 18 need a form signed by a legal guardian.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S01 – Machnín-Výpřež
location: Machnín, Liberec District, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: Běh napříč republikou is a unique event that is not a race, but a group run at a conversational pace. In 2026, it will be held for the fifth time, with four parallel routes starting from different parts of the Czech Republic (including a route from Liberec-Machnín) and heading to the geographical centre of the Czech Republic in Čihošť. The run follows a precise schedule, with pacers on every section to set the pace and guide the route. Participants can choose any number of sections to run, and stop at interesting places along the way to enjoy the beauty of the landscape.
course_highlights: The Northern route starts in Liberec-Machnín and is 185.7 km long, with 2,662 m of elevation gain
The route passes through varied terrain—hills, flat stretches, trails, roads, forests and towns
The pace is suited to recreational runners, averaging 6:00 min/km and slowing to 7:00 min/km on selected sections
additional: This is not a race; participants run together in a group with pacers who set the pace and guide the route. Organizers provide refreshments and race packs at the handover points. Participants can join or leave the running “train” at any section. The run ends with a group finish in Čihošť on Sunday at 17:00.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S02 – Výpřež-Rašovka
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique relay event, now being held for the fifth time, that brings together four starting points from different parts of the Czech Republic and heads to the geographical center of the country in Číhošť. It is not a race, but a group run at a conversational pace, with pacers on each section to set the pace and guide the route. Participants can choose any number of sections they want to run, and stop at interesting places along the way to enjoy the beauty of the landscape. The event is suitable for recreational runners and offers a chance to discover new places and meet like-minded people.
course_highlights: The route runs from Liberec via Výpřež and Rašovka to Číhošť, the geographical center of the Czech Republic
A total of 21 sections covering 185.7 km with 2,662 m of elevation gain on the northern route
The pace is tailored to recreational runners, averaging 6:00 min/km and slowing to 7:00 min/km on selected sections
additional: This is not a race; participants run together according to a schedule, with pacers on each section. Organizers provide refreshments and race packs at the handover points. By arrangement and subject to capacity, participants may be transported to the next handover point or to a location with public transport. The event concludes with everyone meeting in Číhošť on Sunday at 17:00, where all the routes come together.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S03 – Rašovka-Hodkovice nad Mohelkou
location: Hodkovice nad Mohelkou, Liberec, Czech Republic

description: Running Across the Country is a unique relay event that brings runners from all corners of the Czech Republic together at the finish in Čihošť, the geographical center of the Czech Republic. The event is not a race, but a group run at a conversational pace, with pacers on every section to set the pace and guide the route. Participants can choose any number of sections from a total of 82 carefully designed routes, which cross varied terrain, from hills and flatlands to forests and cities. The run offers an opportunity to discover new places, meet like-minded runners, and enjoy an unusual sporting experience.
course_highlights: Routes lead from all corners of the country to the geographical center of the Czech Republic in Čihošť
A total of 82 sections of varying lengths and difficulty, including hills, flatlands, forests, and cities
A pace suited to recreational runners, with pacers on every section and a precise schedule
additional: This is not a race; participants run together at a conversational pace with pacers. Organizers provide refreshments and race packets at the relay handovers. Transport to the next handover may also be available, subject to capacity. The run takes place from 6.6.2026 7:00 to 7.6.2026 17:00, with an overnight break. The pace is suited to recreational runners: approximately 6 min/km on flat terrain and slower on hills.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S04 – Hodkovice nad Mohelkou-Frýdštejn
location: Hodkovice nad Mohelkou, Liberec District, Czech Republic
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique event that brings runners from all corners of the Czech Republic together at the finish in Čihošť, the geographical center of the country. It is not a race, but a group run with pacers who maintain a conversational pace and help with navigation. Participants can choose any number of sections from 82 carefully planned segments, taking in varied terrain from hills and flatlands to forests and towns. The event is suitable for recreational runners who want to discover new places, meet new people, and enjoy an unusual running experience.
course_highlights: 4 parallel routes from different parts of the Czech Republic to Čihošť (Liberec, Prostějov, Pohoří na Šumavě, Rokycany)
A total of 82 sections of varying lengths and difficulty, following hiking trails, roads, and urban terrain
A pace suited to recreational runners, averaging 6:00 min/km and slowing to 7:00 min/km on selected sections
additional: This is not a race; participants run together in groups with pacers who manage the pace and navigation. Organizers provide refreshments and race packs at relay points. Transport to the next relay point may also be available, subject to capacity. The run ends with a group finish in Čihošť on Sunday at 17:00.

Route along the Elbe route; registration online and on site; start at 19:15; awards ceremony at approximately 20:15; accompanying vehicles are not permitted; sustainable organisation with reusable cups and recycled medals.

name: Hahnenkammlauf
description: The Hahnenkamm Run in Edelsfeld is an idyllic forest race, taking place for the 23rd time in 2026. The event is open to runners of all ages, from children to experienced athletes, and offers varied routes around the sports grounds at Hahnenkamm. The course has been adjusted because the sports field is being renovated. The race is part of the Amberg-Sulzbach District Cup and inspires around 250 participants each year to achieve sporting success in a natural setting.
course_highlights: Idyllic forest route around Hahnenkamm
Routes from 1,000 m, signposted year-round
Adjusted course because the sports field is being renovated
additional: Race-number collection from 13:30 at the sports clubhouse. Children's races start from 15:00 (400 m and 600 m Bambini, 1,000 m and 2,000 m schoolchildren), followed by the awards ceremony. Youth, women's and men's races start from 17:15. The routes are divided into DLO age categories and also count toward the District Cup and the municipal rankings. Online payment of the entry fee is available, as is payment on race day. Children's running training starts in May to prepare for the race. Routes at Hahnenkamm; online registration available; late entries accepted on race day until 14:00; race-number collection at the sports clubhouse; course secured by the fire brigade; free refreshments; medical care provided by First Responders.

name: Oranienburger Stundenlauf
description: The Oranienburg Hour Run is a varied running competition on the track behind Oranienburg Palace. The event offers several races with time limits of 15, 30 and 60 minutes, as well as a 400-metre children’s race and Nordic walking. Races are divided by age group and gender, and all laps completed within the time limit count. Every finisher receives a medal, and certificates and award ceremonies are provided for the top runners.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the track behind Oranienburg Palace
Results are based on laps completed within the time limit
Several events ranging from 15 to 60 minutes, plus children’s races and Nordic walking
additional: A maximum of 100 participants per start. Late registration fees: €2.00 for children and €5.00 for adults. Registration is exclusively online via myracepartner.com. Payment methods: direct debit and PayPal (group registrations by direct debit only). Every finisher receives a medal; certificates are available online. Award ceremonies for children’s and youth races, as well as the main races, by age group and overall standings. The event is part of the EMB-Energie-Cup Oberhavel and offers online registration and parking.

name: Stadtwerke Inselseelauf Güstrow LC/NLC
description: The Stadtwerke Inselseelauf Güstrow is a traditional running event taking place on June 6, 2026, in Güstrow, Germany. The event is organised by Tri Fun Güstrow e. V. and offers various distances for different age groups. The main race is a 10 km course for runners aged U20 and older, complemented by shorter races for youths and children. The 48th edition of this local event takes place at Badestrand InselseeHeidberg and promises a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Start at Badestrand InselseeHeidberg in Güstrow
10 km main race for U20 and older
Shorter races for youth and children’s age groups
additional: The event includes a 10 km main race, a 5 km road race for JU14, JU16 and JU18, and a 1.2 km race for KU10 and KU12. Typical June weather in Güstrow is around 23 °C, with mostly sunny days and average precipitation of 65 mm. The event is part of the regional running calendar and offers a family-friendly atmosphere. June weather in Güstrow is typically pleasantly warm, at around 23 °C.

name: Usedom Beach Marathon - 6. Juni 2026
price_range: 42€ für den Marathon, 99€ für die Staffel
description: The Usedom Beach Marathon is Germany’s first beach marathon and takes place on June 6, 2026, on the island of Usedom. The races run exclusively on sand along the Baltic Sea coast, with no asphalt or road traffic, offering a unique nature and running experience right by the sea. Choose from the marathon, half marathon, 10 km short distance, or marathon relay. The event combines a sporting challenge with a special beach atmosphere and a professional program in the finish area in Ahlbeck.
course_highlights: Run exclusively on sand, with no asphalt or road traffic
Start in Zinnowitz, finish in Ahlbeck (marathon)
11 aid stations with water, sports drink, bananas, gels, and cola
additional: The marathon has a time limit of 7 hours (finish cutoff at 16:00). After the time limit, course support and refreshments are no longer provided. The relay consists of 5 legs, with at least 3 runners per team, and categories for women’s, men’s, and mixed teams. Start areas are in Zinnowitz, Koserow, or Ahlbeck, with a shared finish area in Ahlbeck. The finish area hosts a professional program with entertainment and information from 10:00 to 18:00. Run on sand, no asphalt course, start and finish areas in Zinnowitz, Koserow, or Ahlbeck, refreshments, medal, certificate, and shuttle transfers included.

name: Wremer Deichlauf
location: Wremen, Wurster Nordseeküste, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Wremer Deichlauf is the traditional highlight of TuS Wremen 09’s sports season and warmly welcomes runners of all abilities. Two courses are offered: a short 5,300-meter loop and a long 15,900-meter course through the green marshland. The routes run mostly along paved cycle paths and farm roads, and also go outside the dike directly alongside the water and tidal flats. The short loop also features a separate walking event.
course_highlights: The route runs mostly along paved cycle paths and farm roads
Run directly alongside the water and tidal flats on the Treibselräumweg
Two distances: 5.3 km and 15.9 km through the green marshland
additional: Walking event on the 5,300-meter loop. The event is the highlight of TuS Wremen 09’s sports season. The courses are mostly paved and also run outside the dike alongside the water. Routes mostly follow paved cycle paths or farm roads; run along the water and tidal flats; walking event on the short course.

name: 12. Tarczyński Nocny Wrocław Półmaraton
location: Tarczyński Arena Wrocław, Wrocław, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 12th Tarczyński Night Wrocław Half Marathon is one of Wrocław’s most important sporting events and will take place on 6 June 2026. Runners will follow a new, wide and safe course, starting and finishing at Tarczyński Arena Wrocław. The half marathon represents the city’s commitment to activity, health and openness, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad, as well as numerous spectators. The event aims to join the ranks of Europe’s largest half marathons, offering a record 21,975 entry packages—a number that refers to the race distance.
course_highlights: A new, wide and safe course
Start and finish at Tarczyński Arena Wrocław
A night race with symbolic significance for the city
additional: Start and finish by Gate A at Tarczyński Arena Wrocław. The entry package limit is 21,975, a number referring to the half marathon distance (21.0975 km). The event aims to attract more than 20,000 participants and enter the top ten largest half marathons in Europe. The start has been moved from the Olympic Stadium to Tarczyński Arena to accommodate more participants. The new course starts and finishes at Tarczyński Arena, with a focus on safety and cooperation with emergency services, as well as changes to traffic and public transport arrangements.

name: II Półmaraton Miasteczkowskich Lasów
location: Miasteczko Śląskie, Tarnowskie Góry County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Góra Jerzego w Miasteczku Śląskim

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The 2nd Miasteczkowskie Forests Half Marathon is organised by the Góra Jerzego Association in Miasteczko Śląskie and will take place on 6 June 2026. The half-marathon course is approximately 21.5 km long and runs through the town’s streets, the Świerklaniec Forest District and the Tarnowskie Góry municipality. The start and finish are at the stadium next to the Sports and Recreation Centre, allowing spectators to follow the race conveniently. The event will also include a 5 km race and children’s races over various distances, promoting physical activity among the local community.
course_highlights: The course partly runs through the streets of Miasteczko Śląskie
It passes through the Świerklaniec Forest District and the Tarnowskie Góry municipality
The start and finish are at the stadium next to the Sports and Recreation Centre, with spectator stands
additional: The time limit is 4 hours for the half marathon and 1 hour for the 5 km race. Children’s races cover distances from 100 to 500 m on the CSIR sports field. The start and finish are at the Sports and Recreation Centre field, at the intersection of Dworcowa and Sportowa streets. Participants should be at the start at 10:50. The programme includes children’s races; registration is via Raatiming; the course uses the stadium and streets; the promotional period runs until 10 May 2026; parking is available nearby.

name: Poznańska Piwna Mila #19
description: The Poznań Beer Mile is an annual cross-country race held in Poznań, attracting runners who appreciate scenic routes and a sporting atmosphere. The event is part of a series of races organized by enthusiasts from the Greater Poland region, who have been promoting running and the beauty of local areas since 2014. The race features start groups with participant limits, allowing for a comfortable experience and good organization. Particular emphasis is placed on the scenic qualities of the route and bringing runners together.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes in Poznań
Start groups capped at 60 participants
Routes with scenic appeal and a sporting character
additional: Starts take place in waves every 20 minutes from 12:00 to 15:40, including two HARD waves and a “0%” group. Each group is limited to 60 participants. The schedule of group starts with participant limits, and the event on a summer evening promotes activity and having fun.

name: Półmaraton Kurpiowski Pśejåk Bieg Szlakiem Schronów Bojowych SGO "Narew"
description: The Kurpiowski Pśejåk Half Marathon follows the route of the SGO "Narew" combat bunkers in Nowogród. The half-marathon course passes through historic areas dotted with numerous combat bunkers, giving the race a unique character and combining sport with history. The event attracts runners who value both off-road challenges and the atmosphere of the Kurpiowszczyzna region. It is an excellent opportunity to spend time actively and learn about local history.
course_highlights: The course follows the route of the SGO "Narew" combat bunkers
The race takes place in the picturesque Kurpiowszczyzna region
A 21.097 km half marathon combining sport with history
additional: The event includes races over various distances, including a half marathon and shorter distances, with options for different age groups. The race promotes local history and nature, and participants can look forward to attractive routes and an atmosphere conducive to sporting competition.

location: Lipnica Wielka, Babiogórski Park Narodowy, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

description: Ultramaraton Babia Góra is a prestigious mountain race taking place on 6 June 2026 in Lipnica Wielka. The event offers various distances, including ultramarathons involving multiple laps of Babia Góra and shorter races such as SkyRace®. The course runs through the scenic areas of Babia Góra National Park, with challenging climbs and spectacular views. The event promotes an active lifestyle and supports the charitable work of the Rak’n’Roll Foundation. The organiser provides aid stations, medical support, and the option to have drop bags delivered to the course for the longest distances.
course_highlights: The course runs through Babia Góra National Park and includes multiple ascents of Babia Góra
Checkpoint cut-off times on key sections of the course
Scenic views and challenging climbs on mountain trails
additional: Start and finish at Polana Stańcowa in Lipnica Wielka. Race office open on 5 June from 18:00 to 20:00. Participant limits apply to individual races; registration is suspended once a limit is reached. Aid stations are available on the course, and drop bags can be delivered for the 6xBabia Góra Ultramarathon. Mandatory cut-off times apply at checkpoints; missing a cut-off results in disqualification from the remainder of the race. Medical and GOPR mountain rescue support is provided. Runners must report their withdrawal by SMS if they stop racing. Registration is limited for some distances; the course includes Polana Stańcowa and Lipnica Wielka, with a checkpoint at the PTTK Markowe Szczawiny Mountain Hostel. Accommodation is available in Lipnica Wielka.

name: Cross Maraton u Ryśka vol 84
description: Cross Maraton u Ryśka vol 84 is a race held in Wieluń and part of Liga Biegowa, a platform promoting physical activity and running competitions in Poland. The event is open to runners at various distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon and marathon. Liga Biegowa allows participants to earn points and compete in numerous rankings throughout the year, encouraging regular running and athletic development. The race is open and inclusive, welcoming both recreational and more experienced runners.
course_highlights: Marathon distance (42 km)
Scenic route in Wieluń
Annual traditional running event
additional: Liga Biegowa is a year-round running platform that automatically records results for races at 5 km, 10 km, half-marathon and marathon distances, converts them into points and enables competition in numerous rankings. Participants can create private leagues and access materials on training, diet and sports psychology. No details are available about the route, registration or other notes concerning this specific race.

name: Kwietny Bieg
description: The Kwietny Bieg in Lisowice is a unique 24-hour running relay that commemorates the spirit of freedom awakened by Pope John Paul II during his first pilgrimage to Poland. The race takes place on a certified 1,352-metre loop that is clearly marked and illuminated after dark. The event is open to everyone and is growing in popularity, attracting a record number of participants. Everyone who completes 10 Flower Miles (35.3 km) receives a certificate and commemorative medal. It is not only a sporting competition, but also a community event with an atmosphere full of positive energy.
course_highlights: A 1,352-metre loop certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA)
A clearly marked course illuminated after dark with torches and lights
A relay running along Poland’s borders, with the Flower Mile (3,530 m) as its symbolic unit
additional: The race takes place on a 24-hour loop, with participants running in a relay while carrying a red-and-white sash. After completing 10 Flower Miles (35.3 km), participants receive a certificate and medal. The course is illuminated after dark, and the race is open to everyone and free of charge. 24-hour relay race, 1,352 m course certified by the PZLA, free entry, record number of participants

name: Nocna Dycha Kopernika Bieg z Panem Kleksem
description: Nocna Dycha Kopernika is a unique street race held in the magical setting of Toruń, the city of Copernicus. Participants can choose from the 10 km and 5 km distances, Nordic Walking, and a special children’s race, “Odkrywcy Mocy” (“Discoverers of Power”). The event takes place at night, giving it a distinctive atmosphere and appeal. The start and finish are located in the city, and the organizers provide full logistical support and attractive race packs.
course_highlights: A night race through the streets of Toruń, the city of Copernicus
10 km start at Galeria Copernicus; finish at the Municipal Stadium
Available events: 10 km, 5 km, Nordic Walking, and children’s races
additional: The race office is open on June 6, 2026, from 15:00 to 21:00 at Galeria Copernicus, next to the Decathlon store. A baggage drop is available at the start, with bags transported to the finish. The 10 km starts at Galeria Copernicus; the 5 km and Nordic Walking start from Józef Piłsudski Bridge (Camping Tramp). The finish is at the Municipal Stadium. Time limits are 1 hour 20 minutes for the 10 km, 50 minutes for the 5 km, and 60 minutes for Nordic Walking. PZLA-certified courses; fast, flat routes; 22:00 start; various distances; children’s race; medals and prizes; opportunity to take a guided walk.

name: Sudecki Festiwal Biegów Gorskich
description: The Sudecki Mountain Running Festival is a continuation of the Runs Along the Riese Trail in a new format, held in the scenic area around Głuszyca. The festival offers three distances: Sudecki Olbrzym (43 km), Półmaraton Szlakiem Riese (22 km), and Historyczna Dycha (10 km), with routes available in GPX format. The event attracts mountain running enthusiasts with challenging yet beautiful routes in the Sudetes. The organizer provides professional support and rankings in the international ITRA and UTMB Index systems.
course_highlights: Mountain routes of 10 km, 22 km, and 43 km
Scenic Sudetes landscapes and historic trails
Route profiles available in GPX format
additional: The race routes are available to download in GPX format. The event is ranked in the international ITRA and UTMB Index systems. The organizer is Stowarzyszenie Walim Na Żądanie, based in Głuszyca. mountain routes, online registration, access to GPX files

name: XII Festiwal Biegu Rzeźnika
description: The 12th Rzeźnik Running Festival will take place from June 3 to 6, 2026, in Cisna. This exceptional running event in the Bieszczady Mountains offers a wide choice of distances, from 5 km to an extreme 500 km, including ultraruns, marathons, and children’s races. The routes pass through the picturesque mountain terrain of the Beskids, offering unforgettable views and challenges for runners of varying experience levels. The festival also offers the opportunity to take part in hiking and cycling events and other accompanying activities.
course_highlights: Mountain routes in the Bieszczady Mountains, ranging from 5 km to 500 km
Scenic views and challenging climbs on the ultra and marathon routes
Special races for children and Nordic walking events
additional: The festival features numerous races at various distances, including Rzeźnicka Piątka (5 km), Dycha Na Jeleni Skok (12 km), Rzeźnicki Marsz z Walking Lovers (16 km), Rzeźniczek (28 km), Maraton Rzeźnika (52 km), Rzeźnik Ultra (95 km), Bieg Rzeźnika + Hardcore (80 km and 106 km), Rzeźnicki Szlem (175 km), and the stage-based Rzeźnik 500 hiking event. Children’s races cover distances from 100 to 2,000 m. The festival also includes hiking and cycling events and accompanying activities. Registration via voucher, children’s race participation, the detailed schedule, and results are available on the website.

name: Banskobystrický maratón
location: Námestie pred Europa SC, Banská Bystrica, Slovakia
price_range: 33 € to 108 € v závislosti od kategórie a termínu registrácie
description: The Banská Bystrica Marathon is the largest recurring sporting event in central Slovakia, offering a magical evening atmosphere and a fast, certified course that’s a great experience to run. Competitors can choose from several disciplines, including the marathon, half marathon, 10K, STEFE 5K and relay. The course is well supported with aid stations and sound, ensuring a great experience for all participants. The event is suitable for active runners and families looking to enjoy exercise and a sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: A magical evening course with certification
The half marathon consists of 3 fast laps with 12 aid stations
A super-fast 10K with minimal elevation gain
additional: The half marathon has 12 aid stations, and the entire course has sound. The relay consists of 3 legs of 7 km each. The STEFE 5K is intended for families and active runners. The event takes place on 6 June 2026, with the start at the square in front of Europa SC. Several aid stations and different categories are available for all age groups.

name: Poludnica Run
description: Poludnica Run is a mountain race in the Low Tatras, covering 23 km with 1,600 metres of elevation gain. The course runs mostly along marked hiking trails, through beautiful south-facing forest singletracks, a rock city and the summit of Poludnica, with panoramic views of Liptov and the Tatras. The event is part of the Slovak Skyrunning League and Skyrunner® National Series Slovakia, and also serves as a qualifying race for the Skyrunning World Championships. The atmosphere is friendly, and the course is among the toughest in Slovakia in its category. The 2026 event will be its final edition.
course_highlights: 23 km course with 1,600 m of elevation gain
The route follows marked hiking trails, singletracks and a rock city
The summit of Poludnica offers panoramic views of Liptov, the Western Tatras and the High Tatras
additional: Registration opens on 23 March 2026. Race-day check-in and bib collection take place from 07:00 to 08:40 at the start area. The mass start is at 09:00. The maximum number of participants is 200. There is a refreshment station at the 19 km mark. The course is considered one of the toughest in Slovakia in its category. After the results ceremony at 14:00, there will be a raffle with tickets costing €2. The event is part of the season standings and ITRA points collection, with the opportunity to earn points for the World Championships. The event also includes a raffle, a hot lunch and free parking.

name: Beh Vyšnou Myšľou
location: Futbalové ihrisko, Vyšná Myšľa, Košice, Slovakia
description: The Vyšná Myšľa Run is a running event organized by the Vyšná Myšľa village running club and the Municipality of Vyšná Myšľa. The race takes place at the football pitch in Vyšná Myšľa and offers categories for men, women and children in different age groups. It also includes a two-person relay over 2 x 3 km. The children’s races start at 14:00 and the adults’ races at 16:00. The event is suitable for the general public, including club members and local residents, who receive discounts on the entry fee.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the football pitch in Vyšná Myšľa
Age-group categories for men, women and children
Two-person relay over 2 x 3 km
additional: The children’s races start at 14:00 and the adults’ races at 16:00. There is no entry fee for Men E, Women I, members of BKO Vyšná Myšľa, residents of the Municipality of Vyšná Myšľa, or children. The event includes categories for children, adults and relay teams, with registration available online or on site. The course is located at the football pitch and in the surrounding area.

name: Trail Run
description: Trail Run in Družstevná pri Hornáde is a running competition featuring a natural course with varied terrain. The race takes place on 6 June 2026, with a choice of 8 km and 15 km routes that run along asphalt, concrete, forest and field roads, with elevation gains of up to 309 metres. The event also includes children’s categories with different route distances, making it suitable for runners of a wide range of ages. The start and finish are located by the multifunctional sports ground on Okružná Street in Družstevná pri Hornáde.
course_highlights: 8 km route with 162 m of elevation gain
15 km route with 309 m of elevation gain
The course includes asphalt, concrete, forest and field roads
additional: Registration is available online only, with payment by bank transfer or card, or payment on site during registration. The programme also includes children’s categories with different route distances and Nordic walking at 16:00. Registration opens at 13:30 and closes at 15:30; children can register until 14:30. The event is supported by the e.SK Foundation and aims to promote trail running in the Slovak countryside. Details about the route and registration will be announced later.

name: Starostovská desiatka
location: Futbalové ihrisko Kišovce, Hôrka, Poprad, Slovakia
description: The Starostovská Desiatka is a running race held in the village of Hôrka, Poprad District, at the Kišovce football pitch. The event offers a 10 km course with age- and gender-based categories, as well as a 5 km hobby category and races for children and pupils. The main categories start at 16:30, and the children’s categories start at 13:00. The organizers, Hôrka Municipal Office and TJ Baník Hôrka, welcome runners of all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: 10 km course with age- and gender-based categories
5 km hobby category with no age limit
Races for children and pupils, with a separate start
additional: The children’s and pupils’ categories start at 13:00 and have no entry fee. On-site entry costs €15. Registration is available online and on-site. Start times are 13:00 and 16:30. The entry fee includes a hot meal and drinks.

name: Beh pre dobrú vec
description: Run for a Good Cause is a running event in the village of Pača, offering a 4.4 km course. The race is open to a wide age range, from younger to older runners, with categories for men and women. This community run brings together sport and a good cause, with participants able to compete in different age groups. The event is part of the pretekaj.sk platform and offers simple online registration.
course_highlights: A 4.4 km course in the village of Pača
A simple loop course consisting of one lap
Categories for men and women aged 15 and over
additional: Registration takes place via the pretekaj.sk platform, where participants need to create an account to manage their entries. Partner clubs may offer loyalty or membership cards for faster registration. The event includes categories for men, women and children. Start times are scheduled for 9:30 and 10:30. The course is mostly paved, with sections on gravel roads.

name: Beh na vrchol Minčola
organizer: Turisti a priaznivci behu na Minčol v spolupráci s Mestom Lipany
description: The Run to the Summit of Minčol is a traditional running race in Lipany, offering a challenging 7,300-metre course with 649 metres of elevation gain. The race is open to a wide range of categories, from the youngest children to seniors, and is also part of the 2025 Eastern Slovak Hill Running League. It is organised by Tourists and Minčol Running Enthusiasts in cooperation with the City of Lipany. The race is suitable for anyone who enjoys uphill running and wants to test their strength in beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: 7,300 m course with 649 m of elevation gain
Start in Lúčka, above the municipal office in Lipany
Part of the 2025 Eastern Slovak Hill Running League
additional: Categories range from preparatory school (born 2017 and later) to seniors, including Nordic walking categories. The race is organised by the City of Lipany in cooperation with tourists and Minčol running enthusiasts. The entry fee is higher on race day. The race is part of the 2025 Eastern Slovak Hill Running League. Terrain: mountain trail. Registration is available online or on site.

name: Single-Trail run 30
location: Ruská Nová Ves, Hostinec pod zámkom, Slovakia
price_range: 15€ online pred 10.9.2025, 20€ online od 11.9.2025 do 26.9.2025, 20€ na mieste
description: Single-Trail Run 30 is a running race in Ruská Nová Ves, at Hostinec pod zámkom, offering three distances: 25 km, 15 km and 7 km. The race is open to men and women with no age restrictions and is organised by O.z. Single-Trail Run 30. Registration is available online and on site, and the event offers the chance to experience a challenging trail run in nature. The organisers provide contact details for anyone seeking further information.
course_highlights: Distances of 25 km, 15 km and 7 km
Race in the natural surroundings of Ruská Nová Ves
Categories for men and women with no age restrictions
additional: The race is organised by O.z. Single-Trail Run 30. The start is at Hostinec pod zámkom in Ruská Nová Ves, by the municipal office building. Contact persons are Lukáš Ferenc, Peter Kačmár and Filip Kušnír, with the listed telephone numbers. The route crosses challenging terrain. Registration is available online and on site, and the start and finish are at Hostinec pod zámkom.

name: Mnichovohradištská patnáctka, memoriál ing. Josefa Hrona
location: Náměstí T.G. Masaryka, Mnichovo Hradiště, Czech Republic
description: Mnichovohradištská Patnáctka is a road race featuring a gently rolling, out-and-back 15 km course, held in Mnichovo Hradiště at T.G. Masaryk Square. The course has a quality asphalt surface and marked kilometers, helping runners pace themselves. The race is held in memory of Ing. Josef Hron and offers a pleasant atmosphere for all runners. The start is at 10:00, and the organizer is Vladimír Koudelka. The race is suitable for runners looking for a quality road race with tradition.
course_highlights: Gently rolling out-and-back road course
Quality asphalt surface
Kilometer markers along the course
additional: The race is held in memory of Ing. Josef Hron. The organizer is Vladimír Koudelka; contact by phone: 606 432 483. The course is out-and-back, with marked kilometers. The race is dedicated to the memory of Ing. Josef Hron and offers two distances (15 km and 25 km). The start is at 10:00, and registration is available online and on site.

name: Běh 2 míle Olomouc
description: Běh 2 míle Olomouc is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all age groups. Each participant primarily competes against themselves, giving the race a friendly and motivating atmosphere. It takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Smetanovy sady in Olomouc, making for an enjoyable running experience. The race is suitable for beginners as well as experienced runners looking to test their speed over a short distance.
course_highlights: 2-mile (3.2 km) course
Race in the picturesque Smetanovy sady park in Olomouc
Suitable for all age groups
additional: The race is part of a broader sporting calendar and is suitable for runners of all levels. No specific fees or registration requirements have been announced so far.

name: Běh přes Červený vrch
description: The Běh přes Červený vrch is a traditional running race organized by Atletický klub ISCAREX in the picturesque setting of Dolní Čermná in the Pardubice Region. The race offers a technically interesting course with gentle undulations and numerous turns, suitable for a wide range of runners, from recreational athletes to experienced competitors. The event is part of the regional ISCAREX Cup running series and provides quality facilities for both runners and spectators. You can register online or on site on race day, which takes place on June 7, 2026.
course_highlights: A technically interesting course with an undulating profile
Numerous turns on paved paths
Picturesque natural surroundings in Dolní Čermná
additional: The race is part of the Iscarex Cup series and offers races for children and adults. Registration is open until 11:30. The race takes place in June 2026.

name: Chotucká šlapka
location: Zámecký park, Křinec, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Chotucká šlapka is a traditional running race in Křinec. It began in 2012 as a duathlon and has been held as a trail-only run since 2020. The race offers two courses: the main 11 km course and a shorter 5.5 km course, both running mostly along trails with a small amount of asphalt. The start and finish are in the castle park, and the route passes through scenic countryside with several hills and aid stations. The race is open to the general public, with capacity limited to 100 runners. Participants receive personalized bibs, refreshments, and wooden medals.
course_highlights: The course is a 5.5 km loop comprising 80% trail and 20% asphalt
The main race covers two loops (11 km); the shorter race covers one loop (5.5 km)
The route passes through the castle park, Bažantnice, the cemetery, Chotuc, and other natural areas
additional: Race capacity is limited to 100 runners. Bibs are personalized with the runner’s name for registrations received by 30.05.2026. Men’s and women’s changing rooms are available, along with refreshments on the course and at the finish and wooden medals for all participants. Results are announced after the last runner finishes. Children’s races begin at 11:00, with staggered starts from 12:00. The race takes place on 7 June 2026, also offers children’s races, and is part of the Postřižinská Running League.

name: Babický trail 1/4 maraton 2026
price_range: 400,- Kč pro hlavní závod, 50,- Kč pro dětské závody

tiers.description: hlavní závod 1/4 Straighten 10,55 km Altitude 160 m 400,- Kč*

tiers.description: závod 1/8 Straighten 5,95 km Altitude 60 m 400,- Kč*
