description: Babický Trail 1/4 Marathon is a traditional running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Babický Forest. The event offers two main routes, 10.55 km and 5.95 km long, running mostly along forest roads and trails with gentle elevation changes. Children’s categories with shorter distances are also available. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and emphasizes a community atmosphere and the joy of exercising outdoors. The main race is limited to 200 participants, so early registration is recommended.
course_highlights: The route runs mostly along forest roads and trails in Babický Forest
The main race is 10.55 km long with 160 m of elevation gain
Children’s races feature distances from 300 m to 1,500 m
additional: Registration and race bib collection take place from 08:30 to 09:45. The children’s races start between 09:45 and 10:01, and the main race starts at 11:00, with the 1/4 and 1/8 marathons starting together. The main race is limited to 200 participants. Parking is available at the Babice Sports Complex and on surrounding streets; participants are asked not to park in front of driveways to family homes. The main race route is 38% forest roads, 56% forest trails, and 6% road. The event offers participant medals, online registration, limited capacity for the main race, and results services.

name: Skalecký kros
location: Skalka, Mníšek pod Brdy, Středočeský, Czech Republic
description: Skalecký Cross-Country Run is a traditional running race held in the picturesque Baroque grounds of Skalka in Mníšek pod Brdy. It offers 10 km and 5 km courses, as well as children’s races, running along forest paths and paved roads. The main race starts at 11:30 and is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children and teenagers. The event is organized by SK Mníšecko, z.s., which ensures professional organization and a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: The course runs along forest paths and paved roads
Start and finish in the Baroque grounds of Skalka
The main course is approximately 10 km long
additional: Registration is available online and on site. The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup. Children’s races are available. Results are published in the system and as a PDF. The organizers provide timing and statistics. Start and finish in the Baroque grounds of Skalka. The event offers courses of various distances; the main race starts at 11:30, the terrain includes forest paths and paved roads, and children’s races are also included.

name: Červenkovská desítka
description: Červenkovská desítka is a 10 km road race held in Červenka, near Olomouc. The race is part of the 2026 Haná Running Cup and the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for distance runners. The out-and-back course runs from Červenka through Dětřichov to Renoty and back, mostly on roads. Runners are divided into age categories, and category winners receive prizes in kind. The results ceremony will take place at the race venue, Hostinec u Nádraží, and results will be published on hanackybeh.cz.
course_highlights: Out-and-back course from Červenka through Dětřichov to Renoty and back
The course runs on roads
Start and finish at Hostinec U Nádraží in Červenka
additional: Race-day registration takes place at the venue. Runners must have a chip card with a balance of at least CZK 150; otherwise, they must top it up. The race is governed by road-running rules, and everyone runs at their own risk. The race is at the participants’ own risk; registration is conducted using a chip card and is subject to the credit requirements. Participants can look forward to small prizes in kind for category winners.

name: Milada Run
location: Milada Lake, Chabařovice, Ústí nad Labem District, Czech Republic
description: Milada Run is a popular sporting event held in the unique landscape of a former lignite mine, transformed into the beautiful natural setting of Lake Milada. The event offers various routes, including a half marathon, 10 km race and children’s races, along undulating and flat paths with views of the lake. The atmosphere is family-friendly and welcoming, making it suitable for all ages and running levels. All races are part of the Milada Tour series, which runners themselves praise for its high standards and popularity.
course_highlights: The half-marathon route has two loops, one with views directly over the lake
The 10 km route follows paved paths with a flat profile, suitable for all runners
Children’s races of 500 m and 1 km take place near the main beach, with parents supervising
additional: A race bib printed with your name is available if the entry fee is paid by 16 May 2026. Medals for all participants. The official Milada Tour 2026 T-shirt can be ordered during registration and collected on race day. A free children’s T-shirt for the first 100 children to register. The event has a capacity of 500 participants. Family-friendly and welcoming atmosphere. Series points are awarded for the main adult races. Routes: half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and children’s races; the event takes place at Lake Milada; children’s activities; registration and winners’ awards.

name: Konopišťská desítka
location: Konopiště u Benešova, Benešov, Czech Republic
description: The Konopiště Ten is a traditional 10 km running race held in the beautiful setting of the Konopiště open-air theatre and park near Benešov. The race is part of the Benešov Running Festival and offers the chance to compete in the main race, relays and children’s categories. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to enjoy a run in scenic surroundings with high-quality organisation. The 30th anniversary edition will take place on 7 June 2026.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Konopiště open-air theatre and park
A 10 km race with relay and children’s categories
Scenic surroundings, with high-quality technical support and timing by SPORT BASE
additional: The race is part of the Benešov Running Festival. The programme includes children’s races, relays and the Buď Fit run. Timing is provided by SPORT BASE. The organisers provide technical support, and the awards ceremony takes place at the venue. Results are available online and in PDF format. The race takes place on 7 June 2026; online registration is available, and the event includes various age categories and relays.

name: Bolfánek třikrát jinak
description: Bolfánek Three Ways is a running race organised by the Pro Sport Activities agency in Chudenice, in the Plzeň Region. The race is part of the Rozhledny v pohybu series and offers an unusual format in which competitors complete the course in three different ways. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own categories. The organisers emphasise the sporting experience in beautiful natural surroundings and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Three different ways to complete the course in a single race
Beautiful natural surroundings and terrain around Chudenice
Children’s categories with appealing routes for young runners
additional: A relay race is possible: each team consists of 3 runners, each of whom runs one section of the race. Relay entries should be sent by email. Prizes are awarded to the top three finishers in each category and relay. Pupils from the Kryry nursery and primary schools, and residents of the town of Kryry, can enter for free. The event consists of three runs featuring an uphill climb, stairs and a forest trail. Registration is available online or on site. The event is part of the Rozhledny v pohybu series.

name: Mnichovická běhna

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Registrační poplatek : 150 Kč/osoba (při platbě předem). Platba na místě: 200 Kč

description: Mnichovická běhna is an amateur running race through the beautiful Central Bohemian countryside, featuring a challenging course approximately 7–8 km long with around 200 metres of elevation gain. The race offers varied terrain with steep climbs and descents, running on paved paths, through forest, meadows and pastureland, accompanied by domestic and wild animals. The start and finish have been moved to the sports complex at Šibeniční vrch, at the Podhorky sports field. All runners receive a commemorative medal and certificate; category winners receive trophies and a small surprise. Mnichovická běhna is part of the Ladův kraj Cup running series, and everyone who finishes the race safe and sound is a winner.
course_highlights: 7–8 km course with approximately 200 m of elevation gain
Terrain includes paved paths, forest, meadows and pastureland
Challenging sections with steep climbs and descents
additional: All participants receive race numbers and medals; the first three finishers in the women’s and men’s categories receive trophies and a surprise. Check-in and race-number collection take place from 9:00 to 9:45. There are drinking-water stations along the course, and additional refreshments are available at the Šibeniční vrch restaurant. Dogs are not allowed on the course. The race is limited to a maximum of 100 runners. Parking is available on Bezručova Street by the elementary school. The race is open to adults aged 15 and over. Registration takes place from 9:00 to 9:45. Refreshments are included in the entry fee, and all participants receive a medal. Parking is available by ZŠ Bezručova and at the Podhorky sports field. Dogs are not allowed on the course.

name: Babický Trail 1/4 maraton
location: Babice u Říčan, Praha-východ, Czech Republic
price_range: 400,- Kč za hlavní závod, 50,- Kč za dětský závod na 300 m, 150,- Kč za dětský závod na 1000 m

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Účastník hlavního závodu může přihlásit i dítě v balíčku Rodič + 1 dítě

description: The Babice Trail Quarter Marathon is a traditional running race held in the beautiful Babice forest near Říčany. It offers two main routes, 10.55 km and 5.95 km long, with 160 m and 60 m of elevation gain, respectively, running mostly along forest roads and trails. The race is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children, who have their own shorter courses. The event has a community-focused feel, and the organisers emphasise a friendly atmosphere and support for the running community in Babice.
course_highlights: The main race route runs through the Babice forest, with 160 m of elevation gain over 10.55 km
Mostly forest roads and trails, with very little asphalt
Children’s races on courses from 300 m to 1,500 m, suitable for different age groups
additional: Registration and race-number collection take place from 08:30 to 09:45. Children’s races start from 09:45 to 10:01, and the main race starts at 11:00, with the quarter and eighth marathons starting together. The main race is limited to 200 participants. Online registration is available, as is registration on race morning for a 100% surcharge. Parking is available by the sports complex and on nearby streets; please do not park in front of driveways to family homes. Forest course; limited capacity for the main race; unlimited places in the children’s races; start at the Babice Sports Complex.

name: Alemannia Stadtparklauf
location: Aachener Stadtpark, Aachen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Aachener Stadtparklauf by CAROLUS THERMEN takes place in the picturesque Aachen City Park and offers a pleasant running atmosphere away from roads. The course follows winding park paths and showcases the park’s special beauty. Races are offered over 2 km, 4 km and 8 km, as well as a 600 m schoolchildren’s race and a Bambini race for the youngest runners. The start and finish are by the large fountain on Monheimsallee, where refreshments and a supporting program are also available. Since 2024, the Stadtparklauf has been part of the Regio Aachen Laufcup.
course_highlights: Winding paths through Aachen City Park
Start and finish by the large fountain on Monheimsallee
Distances: 2 km, 4 km, 8 km, 600 m schoolchildren’s race and Bambini race
additional: The start and finish are by the large fountain, with the race office, race-number collection, a refreshment station and a supporting program. Easily accessible via several bus routes, with a large public car park nearby. Results and certificates are usually available online shortly after the event. The event takes place in Aachen City Park and features various race distances, children’s races and a supporting program. Registration is online, and results are available shortly after the race.

name: Obermosel Trail
location: Sportplatz Wasserliesch, Wasserliesch, Trier-Saarburg, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Obermosel Trail makes its debut on May 31, 2026, in Wasserliesch. The event offers varied courses through the impressive landscape of the Upper Moselle, suitable for ambitious trail runners, recreational runners, walkers, and young athletes. Distances range from 5 km to 33 km, with the 5 km, 10 km, and 20 km courses also available for walking. The start and finish are at the Wasserliesch sports ground, and the event places emphasis on well-marked courses, refreshment stations, and medical support.
course_highlights: Technically challenging single-track trails with roots and small hills
Vineyards with steep climbs and scenic views
Wide gravel tracks and forest and meadow paths offering varied terrain
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 9:00 a.m. at the Wasserliesch sports ground until 30 minutes before each start. A mandatory briefing takes place 15 minutes before every start. The event ends for all participants at 7:00 p.m. Refreshment stations with drinks and fruit are available along the course and in the finish area. Carrying a mobile phone is expressly recommended. Dogs are not allowed. It is possible to switch to another distance, but there is no refund for switching to a shorter course or for not participating. Race bibs are personal and may not be transferred. Travel by train, bicycle, or car is possible; parking areas are signposted, but the car park directly at the sports ground will be closed on the event day. Several courses are available, including youth races and walking options; start and finish at the Wasserliesch sports ground; registration runs from March to May 2026.

name: 17. Klingenthal Salzkotten Marathon
description: The 17th Klingenthal Salzkotten Marathon offers a unique running weekend with an exhilarating atmosphere in the heart of Salzkotten. The routes pass through the town and the district of Verne, are officially measured, and offer a top-level sporting experience. In the shade of the Salzkotten saltworks, runners can enjoy a first-class refreshment area and a relaxed chill-out area. All event proceeds go directly to youth programs run by local clubs, supporting sport in the region.
course_highlights: Attractive loop course of approximately 10.55 km through Salzkotten and Verne
Marathon and half-marathon courses officially measured and compliant with IWR/DLO rules
Loop course with around 25 metres of elevation gain; flat 10 km course ideal for personal bests
additional: Start times vary by distance: the marathon and half marathon start at 08:30, the 10 km race at 10:30, the 5 km race at 11:30, and the Bambini races from 15:30, with different start times for each age group. The courses are officially measured and comply with international competition rules. On event day, roads through the town and side streets will be closed from approximately 06:30 to 16:00. A supervised bicycle parking area is available at the Sälzerhalle car park in exchange for a voluntary donation. The NUNAV app is recommended for a stress-free journey and parking search. The marathon places particular emphasis on community and team spirit, with company teams able to take part in the team competition. The event also offers parking, pacemaker teams, and a family program.

name: Harzgeröder Klippenlauf
description: The Harzgeröder Klippenlauf on 7 June 2026 is a varied popular and cross-country running event in the Lower Harz, suitable for runners of all abilities. Distances range from 1 km for children to a challenging half marathon of 21.1 km with 450 metres of elevation gain. The routes follow the Selke Valley along the Selketalstieg, passing through the districts of Mägdesprung and Alexisbad, with rocky sections, narrow trails and a rock tunnel. Alongside the sporting challenge, the Klippenlauf offers fun for the whole family, including a raffle and other events. The start and finish are at the dog training club grounds in Harzgerode.
course_highlights: Rocky sections and challenging climbs
Narrow trails along the Selketalstieg
Rock tunnel on the 15 km and half-marathon routes
additional: The start and finish are at the dog training club grounds in Harzgerode, where the race office and race-number collection are located. Safety pins may not be used to attach race numbers; race belts are available for 5 EUR. Separate starts are offered for the Fun Run (1 km), Schoolchildren’s Run (2.5 km), Everyone’s Run (5 km), Main Run (15 km) and Half Marathon (21.1 km). A raffle with great prizes is held for participants. The event is one of the region’s major running and sporting events. Participants can pre-order a running shirt, registration is available online, and running with dogs is prohibited. The event is limited to 600 participants.

name: Benrather Schlosslauf 2026
location: Schlosspark Schloss Benrath, Düsseldorf-Benrath, Düsseldorf, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
price_range: 14 EUR (5 km), 16 EUR (10 km), 3 EUR (Bambinilauf), 7 EUR (Schülerlauf), 0 EUR (Inklusionslauf), 15 EUR (Staffel)
description: The Benrath Palace Run takes place on June 7, 2026, in the park of Benrath Palace in Düsseldorf-Benrath. The event offers 5 km and 10 km runs, both on flat, shaded paths through the park. There are also shorter runs for children, school groups, and people with disabilities, making this a family-friendly and inclusive event. The course starts and finishes on the palace’s north terrace and is easily accessible by public transport.
course_highlights: Flat, shaded paths in Benrath Palace Park
One 5 km lap or two laps for 10 km
Start and finish on the north terrace of Benrath Palace
additional: The program also includes a 1.44 km schoolchildren’s run, a free PAULI inclusion run, a Bambini run, and a primary-school relay. The U72 tram stops right by Benrath Palace, and Benrath station is a 10-minute walk away. In June, average temperatures of 23 °C and mostly sunny weather can be expected. Medals for all participants, trophies for winners, cash prizes for kindergartens, late entries possible for a fee, dogs and jogging strollers not permitted, start and finish at Benrath Palace, easily accessible by public transport.

name: Deichlauf
organizer: TSV Winsen (Luhe) von 1850 e.V. und SV Greven
description: The Deichlauf in Hohnstorf/Elbe offers a varied running programme with races for children and teenagers, an Olympic school relay, and 5 km and 10 km races. The event is sanctioned by the German Athletics Association and welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels. The scenic course follows the dike and offers a sporting challenge in a family-friendly atmosphere. Special and team classifications add to the excitement of the competition.
course_highlights: Running routes along the Elbe dike
A range of distances from 1000 m to 10 km
The Olympic school relay as a special highlight
additional: Showers are not available. Medical services will be stationed at the finish and along the course. Late entries are possible online until 11 June 2026 and on the day of the event until 1 hour before the respective start. Photos and videos will be taken by a commissioned service provider and may be published. The Deichlauf in Greven drew over 800 participants in June 2026, with distances from 2 km to 10 km, including climbs, and suitable for all age groups. The event is a community event with a particular focus on families and nature lovers.

name: Lingener Citylauf
description: The Lingener City Run is a long-standing event held each year on and around Lingener Market Square. For the 35th time, the city centre will become a sporting stage full of energy and community spirit. The event offers various distances, including 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as a 10-kilometre relay with up to 100 teams. The course runs through the city centre and is part of the EL Cup. The event is a highlight for runners and spectators from the region and beyond.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Lingener Market Square
Route through the city centre of Lingen
Part of the EL Cup, with 5 km and 10 km runs
additional: Late registrations are possible on race day up to 45 minutes before the start for a fee of €3.00. Bib number distribution begins at 10:00 on race day. Changing facilities and restrooms are available in the Bäumerstraße gym, about 500 m from the market square. Timing is recorded using transponders attached to the bib numbers, which must be handed in after the race. Parking is available, among other places, in the Marktplatz underground car park and at the Alter Pferdemarkt car park. Due to road closures, access to parking in the city centre will be restricted on the event day. Start and finish on Lingener Market Square, parking in the city centre, changing facilities at the Bäumerstraße gym, no timing for the children's race

name: Mainauenlauf 2026
description: The Mainauenlauf 2026 takes place on June 14 on the grounds of the former State Garden Show in Bayreuth. The scenic, challenging, undulating course runs through green parks with wonderful panoramic views over the city. Various distances are offered, including 5 km, 10 km, a half marathon, Nordic walking, and children’s and youth races. A special highlight is the atmospheric finish in the Finisher Park, with excellent refreshments and a unique finisher medal. City championships will also be held across all distances for the first time.
course_highlights: Challenging, undulating 5 km loop with 85 meters of elevation gain per lap
Highest point on the course: Col Bellota
Finish in the Mainauenlauf Finisher Park, with refreshments and a medal
additional: Showers are open at the Ost school center until 3:00 p.m. There is a photo booth in the start/finish area. Bag drop is available in the Finisher Park, with bags to be collected by 3:00 p.m. Group warm-up run on Saturday at 6:30 p.m. in the Finisher Park. Refreshment stations at km 2, 3, 6, and 7 provide water, isotonic drinks, baked goods, and fruit. Restrooms are available near the finish area and at the Ost sports center. Distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, relays, Nordic walking, and children’s and youth races; start on the State Garden Show grounds; refreshments at several points; finish in the Finisher Park

name: Taunussteiner Waldlauf 30.7
description: The Taunusstein Forest Run is a long-established running event that has attracted around 700 runners to the scenic forests and hills of the Lower Taunus every year for over 30 years. The main 15-kilometre course offers a demanding challenge, with varied terrain and around 250 metres of elevation gain. Shorter distances of 5 and 2 kilometres are available for beginners and children, making them ideal for getting a taste of competition. The event stands out for its varied scenery and lively programme in the finish area.
course_highlights: Scenic, varied routes through forests and fields between Hahn, Wingsbach and Watzhahn
Main 15 km course with around 250 metres of elevation gain and demanding terrain
Refreshment stations at km 3, 6, 7, 10 and 13 on the 15 km course
additional: Start and finish at Gesamtschule Obere Aar (Pestalozzistraße 3, 65232 Taunusstein). Race-number collection from 07:30 in the cafeteria of IGS Obere Aar; runners are advised to collect their numbers at least 40 minutes before the start. The time limit for the 15 km race is 2:30 hours. All finishers receive a medal. The fastest men and women in each distance receive prizes, which are awarded only on race day. Participants in the 2 km race take part in a raffle. Showers and changing facilities are available on site. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Walkers are welcome and are classified separately, but receive no prizes. On-site late registration is available for a €2 fee. Results and certificates are available online. Refreshments, cake, grilled food and drinks are available in the start/finish area. The event is family-friendly, welcomes walkers, and offers refreshments and drinks in the finish area. Registration is available both online and on site.

name: Neustädter Stadtlauf
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany

name: 14. Stadtlauf des TSV Neustadt
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
organizer: TSV Neustadt am Rübenberge von 1862 e.V.
description: The 14th TSV Neustadt City Run on June 7, 2026, is an accessible community race in Neustadt am Rübenberge that promotes community and inclusion. The race stands for togetherness and brings friends together through shared exercise. Every step strengthens social bonds and sends a message in support of an inclusive future. The race is open to all age groups and combines sport with social commitment.
course_highlights: Accessible race promoting inclusive participation
Togetherness and social connection
Community race in Neustadt am Rübenberge
additional: The race is designed to be accessible and promote inclusion. There is a running championship for primary schools. The event is organized by Turn- und Sportverein TSV Neustadt am Rübenberge von 1862 e.V. Accessible, inclusive, community-focused, community race, parking at Schulzentrum Süd and Gymnasium, changing rooms, showers, bag storage in the TSV club building.

name: 21. ProPotsdam Schlösserlauf
description: The ProPotsdam Schlösserlauf in Potsdam is a unique running event that combines tradition, culture and sporting challenge. The course passes through the historic palaces, gardens and sights of the state capital of Brandenburg, offering runners an unforgettable experience in a UNESCO World Heritage Site. With over 4,500 participants, the race is a popular event for running enthusiasts of all abilities. Experience the special atmosphere and the many impressions along the route through the city’s history.
course_highlights: Run past historic palaces, churches, parks and gardens
Route along lakes, rivers and bridges, and through the Russian Colony
Temporary road closures in central Potsdam and the surrounding area
additional: The race takes place on 7 June 2026 from 09:00 to 12:00. The route is temporarily closed to traffic in several sections and reopened after the runners have passed. Start-place transfers are possible through the davengo account until 30 April 2026, and after that only via a re-registration form until 20 May 2026. The day before, 6 June 2026, a sports activity day featuring activities and exercise stations for families and children will take place at Sportpark Luftschiffhafen. Routes, start times, fees, special-edition T-shirt, pasta party, certificate for download, age restrictions, race numbers and timing with EasyChip, online registration, run past historic landmarks

name: 45. Wehlheider Volkslauf
location: Park Schönfeld, Kassel-Wehlheiden, Kassel, Hesse, Germany
description: The Wehlheider Volkslauf is a long-standing recreational running event in Schönfeld Park in Kassel-Wehlheiden and is part of the Nordhessencup. The course runs mainly along paved paths and through wooded areas, with various distances for all age groups. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and is open to everyone, regardless of club membership. Changing and shower facilities are available, and runners are provided with refreshments along the course.
course_highlights: The course runs mainly along paved paths and through wooded areas
5 km out-and-back course
Children’s races in the Angerstation, with distances of 400 m and 1000 m
additional: The wearing of spikes is prohibited. Bib numbers must be worn clearly visible; safety pins are not provided. Changing and shower facilities are available, but have no windows and therefore pose an infection risk. The event is part of the Nordhessencup and the HLV Running Cup. Advance registration is mandatory; on-the-day registration is not possible. The event takes place in Schönfeld Park in Kassel-Wehlheiden and offers a family-friendly atmosphere. The entry fee includes race numbers, timing, refreshments and league scoring. At the final round, the league standings are officially announced and the top runners are awarded.
course_highlights: Pomlé Forest Park in Šamorín is the start and finish venue
Various categories with shorter and longer distances (100 m to 5 km)
Running routes in natural surroundings, with refreshments at the finish
additional: Children’s categories start in sequence from 10:00 (preschoolers: 100 m, younger pupils: 700 m, older pupils: 700 m), and adults start at 10:30. Check-in is from 9:00 until 30 minutes before each category’s start, on the meadow in Pomlé Forest Park. Toilets and a changing room are available at the Amphitheatre. The entry fee includes race numbers, timing, refreshments at the finish and a raffle. Preschoolers receive a medal after finishing but are not included in the results. The event is part of a series running from March to October 2026, with various categories for all age groups, at Pomlé Forest Park.

description: Šebešská pätnástka is a running race organized by the MTC Vyšná Šebastová club in cooperation with the Vyšná Šebastová municipal office and sports associations. The main course is 15.5 km long and includes a climb to Nevická Cottage. There is also a recreational 3 km course and children’s events for various age groups. The race takes place every year on Sunday of the first weekend in June, with a morning start and a rich cultural and social program that attracts hundreds of visitors. The event is part of several running competitions and a league, and the organizers focus on developing sport and building the village’s reputation. Šebešská pätnástka received the Running Diamond award in 2011 and 2012.
course_highlights: 15.5 km main course with a climb to Nevická Cottage
3 km recreational course suitable for the general public
Children’s events for preschoolers through juniors

It is also part of regional running competitions and the East Slovak Grand Prix for Endurance Runners (VVCV). Race director Ján Tomčo is an active runner and founder of the MTC Vyšná Šebastová club, bringing a spirit of fair play and determination to the event. The course includes a climb to Nevická Cottage; the event also features children’s races, a rich cultural program, awards, and recognition.

Categories for children and young people aged 2 to 15

SABZO is known for its long history and for regularly organizing running events in Prague and the surrounding area. The race is part of the club’s wider calendar of running events, which promotes an active lifestyle and a running community.

An opportunity for runners of all levels
Organized by the SABZO club

A large portion of the entry fee supports heroes who face challenges in life, and participants receive a race bib, certificate, gingerbread and other benefits. The event is friendly, charitable and suitable for all age groups.

name: Trail Zlíchovskými vyhlídkami VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
description: The VAŠÍ LIGY Trail through Zlíchov’s Viewpoints is an amateur trail race held in Prague, offering runners the experience of running in nature across varied terrain with interesting views. The races are part of VAŠÍ LIGY, the largest amateur league in the Czech Republic, which promotes the joy of sport and a community atmosphere. Participants can look forward to a friendly environment and the chance to compete with runners of all age groups. The races are regularly held, with medals awarded to the best runners in the under-40 and 40+ categories.

Races with the atmosphere of an amateur league and community running

name: Mittsommernachtslauf
description: The 19th MittSommerNachtsLauf on June 10, 2026, is an event for everyone, with a steady pace of approx. 6 min/km for runners or 6 km/h for walkers. The start is at 7 p.m. in the village center of Marklohe, and the finish is at the heated outdoor pool in Wietzen, where the swimming pool will remain open until 10 p.m. and the support association will provide refreshments. The running route is up to 18 km, with additional entry points at 13, 10 and 5 km; walking routes are up to 10 km or 5 km. The event promises a sporting evening in beautiful surroundings and is open to everyone who enjoys running or walking.

Running routes up to 18 km, with entry points at 13, 10 and 5 km

It offers a chance to experience the picturesque Haná countryside and join a community of sports enthusiasts. STMSVS is known for its long-standing organization of endurance sports and its support for running, cycling, and triathlon disciplines in the region.

Part of the Haná Running Cup, with distances from 5 to 42 km
A traditional running event with an open start for all age groups

The race takes place on 11 June 2026; on-site registration is available, and results are published online.

name: Yellow Ribbon Run
location: Obora Hvězda, Praha 6, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
organizer: Czechia Yellow Ribbon Run (Gabriela Slováková a podporující organizace)
description: Yellow Ribbon Run is a running event taking place on June 11, 2026, in Hvězda Game Reserve in Prague 6. It symbolizes second chances and supports the integration of people with criminal records. The run brings together sport, solidarity, and the courage to help those who want to start a new life and become valued members of society. The event offers various race categories, including the main relay, the easy relay, and a children’s run, while also raising awareness and helping to reduce recidivism. Join the largest community in the Czech Republic working to break down prejudice and support second chances.
course_highlights: Run in the beautiful surroundings of Hvězda Game Reserve in Prague 6
Various race categories: main 5 km relay, 2.5 km easy relay, and children’s run
A symbol of second chances and support for the reintegration of people with criminal records
additional: The event includes the main 5 km relay, the 2.5 km easy relay, the Connecting Hearts Race for Children, and VOL FANWALK. The project raises awareness about people with criminal records and gives institutions and companies the opportunity to take part in the run as a CSR project. The organizers welcome volunteers to help with preparations and the event itself. The event aims to raise awareness about the challenges of reintegrating people after serving a sentence and to support their social inclusion. Registration is available through Stopnito.cz.

The event is designed as a birthday marathon and offers a personal atmosphere with no organizational fee, as this is covered by the birthday celebrant.

Loop course with 10 laps of 4.06 km each around Bugasee
Start and finish in front of the information sign between Restaurant Strandbar and parking lot P1

The course runs mainly along field and forest paths, including crossings over the dams of three local ponds, giving the race its unique character. The event is open to a broad range of age groups and focuses on the sporting experience and supporting the local running community.

Particularly popular are the relay races for Bambini and youth, as well as the Nordic walking event along the scenic Ruhr Valley Cycle Route. The 10 km course is measured according to DLV criteria and follows a loop over paved and surfaced paths through a wooded area, finishing in the stadium.

description: The International Brothers Grimm Run is a long-standing three-day event that covers approximately 82 km from Hanau, the birthplace of the Brothers Grimm, to Steinau, where the collectors of fairy tales spent their childhood. It follows historic trade routes, passing historic buildings, scenic attractions, and spa and recreation resorts in the Spessart and picturesque villages in the Kinzig Valley. The event is open to recreational runners and competitive athletes alike.
