description: The 14th Garbsen City Run on June 12, 2026, is Garbsen’s largest sporting event and offers races for all ages and ability levels. There are six different races, from a 500-meter parent-and-child race to the 10,000-meter Agon Tax Run. The courses pass through Rathausplatz and the IGS grounds, as well as along Meyenfelder Straße and by Lake Berenbostel. The event is family-friendly and emphasizes fun and community, supported by a dedicated organizing team and numerous volunteers.
course_highlights: Course around Rathausplatz and through the IGS grounds
Races along Meyenfelder Straße and by Lake Berenbostel
Distances ranging from 500 m to 10,000 m for all age groups
additional: Race-bib pickup is on 11.06.2026 from 17:00 to 20:00 at Garbsener Sport-Club 67 e.V. and on race day from 14:30 in the town hall. Changing rooms and showers are located at the IGS. There will be an awards ceremony for timed races, with medals for all participants. Certificates can be printed on site for a fee or free of charge afterward. Late registration on race day is possible for an additional fee of €3. Several race categories held throughout the evening offer a wide range of opportunities for recreational runners and families.

name: Lippe-Sommer-Serie 2026 Lauf 1: 36. Donoper Volkslauf
description: The Lippe Summer Series 2026 is a three-part running event taking place from 12 to 26 June 2026 in the Schieder-Schwalenberg region. The first race, the 36th Donoper Volkslauf, is organised by SC Donop 1948 e.V. and features a varied 7,777-metre course around the Donop sports field in Blomberg-Donop. The series combines sporting challenge with nature and community, and is open to runners, walkers and hikers.
course_highlights: A varied 7,777-metre course
Start and finish at the Donop sports field in Blomberg-Donop
Part of a three-race series through the region’s most beautiful landscapes
additional: The Lippe Summer Series comprises three races on three consecutive Fridays. Walking and hiking are also possible alongside the popular race. The event is supported by KOLIBRI Förderverein für offene Kinder- und Jugendarbeit Schwalenberg e.V. It takes place on roads and off-road, with temperatures around 23°C in June. It is a sociable run for the whole family.

name: Aschauer Bankerl-Lauf
location: Aschau im Chiemgau, Rosenheim, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Aschau Bankerl Run is a sociable evening run in the idyllic Chiemgau countryside, open to everyone who enjoys running. For the fifth time, the organizer Lauffeuer Chiemgau e.V. invites participants to an untimed running event where the joy of being active takes center stage. Various distances are offered, from about 1 km (Bambini Run) up to 7 km. A portion of the proceeds will be donated to a good cause, making the event a socially minded one as well.
course_highlights: Idyllic Chiemgau countryside
Distances from approx. 1 km to 7 km
Untimed evening run with pacers
additional: Pacers are available for participants who prefer a more leisurely pace. Water, coffee, cake and other refreshments are available in the finish area. A portion of the proceeds will benefit Benedetto-Menni-Nest, a residential community in Aschau for people with additional support needs. Run for all age groups, charitable donations, online registration, pacers, refreshments in the finish area

name: Deichlauf Neuwied

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Jugend ab 12 Jahre (Jg. 2014) bis 19 Jahre (Jg. 2007) 8,- EUR

description: The Deichlauf Neuwied is a traditional running event in Rhineland-Palatinate that welcomes runners of all ages. Events include children’s and youth races, an Olympic school relay, 5 km and 10 km races, as well as walking and Nordic walking. The course runs along the dike and offers an attractive running backdrop. The event is sanctioned by the German Athletics Association and attracts around 2,000 participants each year.
course_highlights: Course along the dike
A variety of events, from a 600 m relay to a 10 km race
Attractive running backdrop in Neuwied
additional: Showers are not available. Medical services are on hand at the finish and along the course. Photos and videos will be taken by an appointed service provider and may be published. Late registration is possible online until 11 June 2026 and on the day of the event until one hour before the respective start. Participants are covered under the sports insurance contract of the Sports Association of Rhineland. Various categories for children, young people and adults; registration until 31.05.2026; results and certificates available online.

name: Derentaler Löwenlauf
description: The Derentaler Löwenlauf is a traditional race in the Weser Uplands, designed as a sporting family festival for all age groups. The event offers various distances that lead through the beautiful Derentaler countryside and the Steinbach Valley. A particular focus is placed on embracing diversity, tolerance and working together, supported by a donation to the “augen auf!” foundation for each participant. The race is organised with great care by the Weserbergland Runners Derental and promises an unforgettable day for children, young people, adults and seniors.
course_highlights: 3 km students’ race for ages 8 and up
6 km loop through the Derentaler countryside
12.7 km course including the Steinbach Valley
additional: One euro per participant is donated to the “augen auf!” foundation. The race is designed as a family festival, with various distances for all age groups. Multiple distances (300 m, 10 km), no official timing, special route due to construction work, fundraising campaign for the “Augen auf!” foundation.

name: Kleinbahn-Lauf
description: The Kleinbahn Run in Rhauderfehn is a fun run with no timing, welcoming runners and walkers on 5- and 10-kilometre routes. There are also children’s races for kindergarten and primary school children, enthusiastically supported by parents and grandparents. The 10 km loop starts at the market square and follows the Hauptfehn Canal, through the villages of Holtermoor and Rhaude, and along the Ostfriesland Hiking Trail back to the finish. The 5 km route also starts at the market square and follows the Ostfriesland Hiking Trail back to the finish. The run is a great opportunity to experience the region on varied routes.
course_highlights: 10 km loop along the Hauptfehn Canal and Ostfriesland Hiking Trail
5 km loop with a section through Rhaudermoor and along the Ostfriesland Hiking Trail
Children’s races for kindergarten and primary school children
additional: The event is a fun run with no timing. Training plans are available for different performance goals. The event is open to runners and walkers alike. The run takes place in June, with typical temperatures around 23°C. Bus transport is available from Rhauderfehn to Ihrhove, and showers and changing rooms are provided on site. Competitions are also offered for children and young people.

name: Krackenlauf 2026
description: The Krackenlauf Großlangheim takes place on Friday, June 12, 2026, and offers races for different age groups and ability levels. The events include an 800-meter Bambini Run, a 2,000-meter students’ race, a 7,500-meter main race, and a 6,000-meter walking competition. This popular local running event, with unchanged start times and distances, is open to all running enthusiasts. Registration is via the RaceResult platform.
course_highlights: 800-meter Bambini Run
2,000-meter students’ race
7,500-meter main race and 6,000-meter walking competition
additional: The races and distances remain unchanged from previous years. Registration is online via RaceResult. Events are offered for children, students, the main race, and walkers. The event takes place in the evening in Großlangheim. Registration will open later via RaceResult.

name: Sommer-Abend-Lauf
description: The Summer Evening Run in Steinach is a popular running event celebrating its 10th edition on June 12, 2026. It offers 5 km and 10 km main races on a scenic, flat course, as well as various children’s races. The event attracts many running enthusiasts from the region and beyond each year and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with the start and finish at the school. The races take place in the evening, making for a special running experience in a pleasant atmosphere.
course_highlights: Flat, scenic course through Steinach
5 km or 10 km main race (1 or 2 laps of 5 km)
Children’s races on school roads: 375 m, 750 m and 1,100 m
additional: Children’s races start in stages from 18:00 (Bambini, 375 m), 18:30 (students, 750 m) and 19:00 (students, 1,100 m). The main race starts at 20:00, with the start and finish at the school. Changing facilities are available in the gym and festival hall. Flat course, online registration available, family- and company-friendly.

name: Spendenlauf LT Phoenix Dudweiler
description: The charity run organized by LT Phoenix Dudweiler is a fundraising event in which all entry fees and donations benefit the Saar Children’s Hospice and Palliative Care Team. Participants can learn about the organization’s important work at the event. The run promotes runners’ health and well-being while supporting an important social cause in the Saarbrücken region.
course_highlights: Charity run benefiting the Saar Children’s Hospice and Palliative Care Team
Event in Saarbrücken-Dudweiler
Information about the supported organization’s work available at the event
additional: Participation in the run is covered by club insurance, which requires advance notification to sports coordinator Fabiola Marx (telephone: 06897 761487, email: fabi.marx@web.de). No start times or price tiers have been published on the website. The run is part of the activities of Lauftreff “Rennschnecke” Dudweiler e.V. and offers the opportunity to learn about the work of the Saar Children’s Hospice and Palliative Care Team at the event. The event is open to all age groups and ability levels.

name: Angličák night run Pezinok
description: Angličák Night Run Pezinok is a 5-kilometre night race held at the Rozálka Health Park in Pezinok. Runners can enjoy a fast, dynamic run along a route through the Little Carpathians, illuminated by artificial lighting that creates a unique atmosphere. The event is open to everyone aged 15 and over and is divided into starting corrals according to performance. The organisers prioritise safety, so headphones are prohibited, and reflective gear or headlamps are recommended. Registration is available online and is tied to the runner’s name; ticket re-registration is possible until 9 June 2026.
course_highlights: A 5 km night run with artificial lighting
The route passes through Rozálka Health Park, the Little Carpathians and Radničné Square
Starting corrals are assigned according to the time submitted from a previous race
additional: Participants must be at least 15 years old in the calendar year 2025. A ticket can be re-registered to another person until 9 June 2026 for a fee of 10 euros. The use of headphones during the race is strictly prohibited. Reflective gear and headlamps are recommended for the night run. Entry is non-transferable and tied to the runner’s name. The route runs from Rozálka Health Park through Malokarpatkú, Majakovského Bridge, Okružná Street, SNP Bridge, Kupeckého and Holubyho, and finishes at Radničné Square. Registration is available online only; re-registration is required, and entry is tied to the participant’s name.

name: The Run Slovakia
description: THE RUN SLOVAKIA 2026 is a national relay race across Slovakia, taking place over three days. Runners cover more than 530 km together from Košice to Bratislava, passing through beautiful natural scenery, historic landmarks and picturesque towns. The event offers a unique sporting atmosphere, teamwork and many unforgettable experiences. The route passes significant places such as Spiš Castle, the High Tatras, Orava Castle and the Little Carpathians, with a rich programme of accompanying activities for runners to enjoy.
course_highlights: A 530 km route from Košice to Bratislava
Passes significant natural and historic landmarks such as Spiš Castle, the High Tatras and Orava Castle
Total ascent of 7,308 m and descent of 7,376 m
additional: The total number of participating teams is limited to 100. Registration takes place via a web application that enables real-time runner tracking, live results, navigation and notifications from the organizing team. The race is intended for teams of runners and offers real-time results tracking. Registration is open, various promotional items are available, and a mobile app is provided for tracking performances.

name: Mattoni 1/2Maraton Olomouc 2026
description: Mattoni Running Festival Olomouc 2026 is a traditional half marathon that takes you through the historic beauty of Olomouc. The start and finish are at Horní náměstí, where you can admire the Holy Trinity Column and the town hall with its unique astronomical clock. During the race, you’ll enjoy the city’s atmosphere, historic buildings, and beautiful parks. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and also offers an accompanying program.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Horní náměstí, with landmarks including the Holy Trinity Column and the astronomical clock
The route passes through Olomouc’s historic center and beautiful parks
Enjoy the city’s atmosphere and rich history during the race
additional: The race is part of the Mattoni Running Festival, which also features events such as the Šantovka 5 km Run, the dm Family Mile, the dm bambini run, and a half-marathon relay. Starts are divided into several time waves from 15:00 to 19:00. The RunCzech mobile app provides all race information and a virtual package. The course covers historic streets, parks, and city roads; it is certified and fully closed to traffic. The race offers technical support, refreshment stations, and medical services.

name: Horem dolem Chospílem
description: Horem dolem Chospílem is a 9.2 km interval-start running race that follows meadows and dirt roads around Postřekov in the Chospíl area. The race is part of the Běžec Chodska series and offers runners pleasant terrain and a natural atmosphere. Its interval start makes for an interesting race format. It is suited to runners looking for a combination of nature and sporting challenge in the Plzeň Region.
course_highlights: A 9.2 km course through meadows and along dirt roads
Interval start
Natural surroundings near Postřekov in Chospíl
additional: The race takes place on June 13, 2026. Results and participant lists are available on the website. Exact registration details are not provided.

name: Sokolovský  ¼ maraton
organizer: Živý kraj – Destinační agentura pro Karlovarský kraj, z.s.
description: The Sokolov Quarter Marathon is a running event taking place on June 13, 2026, in Sokolov, in the Karlovy Vary Region. The route runs mainly through scenic parts of the town and the surrounding countryside, and the race is approximately 10.5 km long. The event is intended for recreational runners as well as those who want to experience the atmosphere of a race in beautiful surroundings. The organizers emphasize a friendly atmosphere and a sporting experience for all participants.
course_highlights: A scenic route through Sokolov and the surrounding natural landscape
An approximate distance of 10.5 km, suitable for recreational and competitive runners
A relaxed and friendly race atmosphere
additional: The race is part of the Sokolov Colour Run. Registration details and further information are not specified. The race is suitable for the general public.

name: Barevný běh Sokolov
description: Barvám Neutečeš is a colourful run and a full day of fun for all ages, families and friends. Choose between two routes: 5 km with five colour zones, or 1.5 km with three colour zones and an interactive sports zone. It’s not about speed, but about joy, friendship and unforgettable experiences filled with colour, music and laughter. The event takes place in Sokolov on 13 June 2026 and is part of a year-round colour tour visiting several cities.
course_highlights: 5 km route with 5 colour zones
1.5 km route with 3 colour zones and an Urban Challenge zone
The colour zones shower runners in colour from head to toe
additional: Enjoy a full day of fun from 9:00 to 16:00, with music, themed zones, photo booths and a 360° video. The race pack includes a T-shirt, race number, medal and other accessories. The event is also suitable for children, who can take part on shoulders, scooters or in strollers. There is no timing; the focus is on fun and sharing the experience. Registration is open. The event takes place on 13 June 2026 in Sokolov. The routes pass through Sokolov Island and the surrounding area, with a focus on fun and community.

name: Run Labe Run

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné pro ročník 2026 je 17 000 Kč za tým.

description: Run Labe Run is a relay race for teams of up to 12 runners, held on June 13–14, 2026. The route runs from Špindlerův Mlýn to Děčín along the Elbe River and covers a total of 380 km, divided into 36 stages of varying difficulty. The race starts in 8 waves between 5:00 and 11:00. Categories include mixed teams of 10–12 runners, mixed teams of 6–9 runners, women’s teams, and veterans. Teams compete for prizes in several categories, and registration is open until March 31, 2026, or until capacity is reached.
course_highlights: A 380 km route divided into 36 stages, with difficulty levels from 1 to 5
Start in Špindlerův Mlýn, finish in Děčín by the chateau
The race starts in 8 waves between 5:00 and 11:00
additional: The maximum team size is 12 runners. The captains’ meeting will take place online on May 24, 2026, at 19:00. Teams from previous editions have priority registration from June 26, 2025. The race starts in 8 waves between 5:00 and 11:00. A team is not considered registered until its payment has been credited to the account. Registration opens on July 1, 2025; the deadline is March 31, 2026, or until capacity is reached. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of the Krkonoše Mountains and the Elbe River.

name: JEŠTĚD SUMMER RUNNING WEEKEND
location: Skokanský areál u Ski Ještěd, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Ještěd Summer Running Weekend is a trail-running weekend event held in the beautiful setting of the Ski Ještěd ski jumping complex in the Liberec Region. It offers a range of running disciplines, including a 24-hour run, a marathon, a half marathon and shorter races. The event is suitable for a wide range of runners, from experienced ultramarathoners to families with children. The routes follow scenic mountain terrain with significant elevation gain and beautiful views of the Ještěd Ridge. The event is part of the prestigious Ještěd Skyrace series and provides quality facilities and a great atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Scenic mountain routes on the Ještěd Ridge
Significant elevation gain of up to 1,390 m on the longer routes
A range of distances, including a 24-hour run, a marathon and shorter races
additional: The event offers a range of running disciplines, including a 24-hour run, a marathon, a half marathon and shorter races. The routes are challenging, with significant elevation gain, and run through mountain terrain. The event also includes facilities with refreshments and accommodation options. Shorter races are available for children. The races take place on terrain around the ski jumps; registration and route details are available on the website. The event also includes trail camps, merchandise, a partner zone and environmental measures.

name: Dobročinný běh po stopách Silver A
location: Pardubice, Pardubice District, Pardubice Region, Czech Republic
price_range: startovné na charitativní účely, přesná částka není uvedena
description: Join the 3rd annual charity run and walk, In the Footsteps of Silver A, organized by the Zámeček Memorial in Pardubice. The event is suitable for athletes and non-athletes, children and adults, and the entry fee goes to charity. The run offers two routes—a shorter 5 km route and a longer 10 km route—as well as a children’s race of approximately 1 km. There will also be a guided walk through the city to places associated with the Silver A parachute group, starting from the Zámeček Memorial.
course_highlights: Two running routes: 5 km and 10 km
Children’s race of approximately 1 km
Guided city walk in the footsteps of the Silver A parachute group
additional: Registration opens at 14:00, and the event is expected to end at 18:00. The entry fee includes a public transport ticket. Online registration is available until 11 June; after that, registration is available at the venue on the day of the event. Proceeds from the entry fees will go to charity, specifically towards buying a stroller for four-year-old Viktorka, who has autism spectrum disorder. Routes: 5 km, 10 km and a children’s race; guided city walk; start from the Zámeček Memorial; entry fee includes a public transport ticket; supports local charity and historical awareness.

name: Hradecký koloběh
location: Biřička, Nový Hradec Králové, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Hradecký Koloběh is a mixed-pair race held in the beautiful surroundings of the city forests, starting at Biřička. The race combines running and cycling: one team member runs while the other rides a bike, and they can switch at any time during the race, adding strategy and dynamism. The event promotes team spirit and the joy of movement, with OPEN and FAMILY categories. It is held with the support of the City of Hradec Králové and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality event organisation.
course_highlights: Beautiful surroundings of the city forests
A combination of running and cycling, with teams free to switch at any time
Start at Biřička in Nový Hradec Králové
additional: The race pack includes a race number, event organisation, baggage storage, toilets, race marshals, refreshments at the finish, and photographs (a photo for every participant is not guaranteed). Toilets, baggage storage, catering, and parking are available. Parking is recommended at the parking lot on Partyzánská Street. Stopping is prohibited on Mužíkova Street, where the situation is monitored by the municipal police. Prizes are awarded to places 1–3 in each category. Terrain: 90% forest trails, 10% asphalt roads. Elevation gain: 108 m. Categories: OPEN and FAMILY. Start at Biřička, Nový Hradec Králové.

name: Jinecký kros
organizer: Městys Jince a Jinečáček, z. s.
description: Jinecký kros is a traditional running race held in Jince. It offers a challenging course of approximately 5.7 km with around 178 metres of elevation gain. The start and finish are on the football pitch by the Bio Swimming Pool, which provides facilities for runners, including parking, changing rooms, showers and refreshments. The course runs on asphalt, forest paths and meadows, and includes a crossing over a wooden footbridge, asphalt roads and a climb up Vystrkov Hill. The race is suitable for adults and children, who have their own categories. The main race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: The course crosses a wooden footbridge over the Ohrazenický Stream
A challenging climb up Vystrkov Hill with approximately 30 m of elevation gain
A mix of asphalt, forest paths and meadows
additional: Race facilities include parking, changing rooms, showers, toilets and a refreshment stand. Registration is open until 13.6.2026 at 17:00, and is also available on race day. Children’s races are part of the programme. The course has +178 m and -187 m of elevation change. The start and finish are at the SK Jince 1921 sports complex. Course: approx. 5.7 km; terrain: asphalt, forest paths and meadows; children’s races; start on the football pitch by the Bio Swimming Pool.

name: Mattoni Running Festival Olomouc
description: Mattoni Running Festival Olomouc is a popular running event held in the historic center of Olomouc. The race offers an attractive route through the city’s picturesque streets, suitable for both experienced runners and recreational athletes. The event is part of the RunCzech running league and offers a unique atmosphere and professional organization. Runners can enjoy excellent facilities and support throughout the race.
course_highlights: The route passes through the historic center of Olomouc
Pleasant urban surroundings with cultural landmarks
Part of the RunCzech running league, professionally organized
additional: The event includes various race categories, an expo and accompanying activities. Registration is available through the RunCzech website. The races are certified and suitable for all age groups.

name: Jindřichohradecký půlmaraton
location: Jindřichův Hradec, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The Jindřichův Hradec Half Marathon 2026 is the 10th anniversary edition of a running event offering a unique experience that combines the city’s picturesque historic centre, sections along the water and natural trails with significant elevation gain. The race is open to individual runners covering 21.1 km, as well as relay teams, families and schools taking part in shorter races. The atmosphere is enhanced by spectators, music and event services including refreshment stations and showers. A special Rebel Run for schools is also planned, focusing on teamwork rather than time. The race starts on 13 June 2026. Participants will receive an original medal and may win prizes.
course_highlights: A beautiful combination of city and countryside: historic lanes and peaceful landscapes around Jindřichův Hradec
Sections along the water and natural trails with considerable elevation gain
An unforgettable atmosphere, with spectators, music and encouragement along the course
additional: The event schedule includes the Rebel Run starting at 15:00, the Family Run at 16:00, and the half marathon and relay races at 17:00. Refreshment stations, showers, a baggage area, and professional photos and video from the course and finish are available. The Rebel Run is a special team race for primary schools, where teamwork and everyone’s participation matter more than time. The event features a course through the historic centre and natural trails, various races including relays, family and school runs, refreshments, showers, facilities, medals and prizes.

name: LEKI JEŠTĚD SUMMER - Running Weekend
description: LEKI JEŠTĚD SUMMER - Running Weekend is part of the prestigious Ještěd Skyrace series, which offers challenging and beautiful routes in the mountain terrain of the Ještěd Ridge. The races are intended for a wide range of runners, from children to experienced skyrunners, with distances ranging from 200 metres to 42 km. The event takes place in the picturesque setting by the ski jumping hills at Ještěd and offers a unique experience of running in nature with significant elevation gain. The running weekend is complemented by activities, refreshments and accommodation options close to the races.
course_highlights: Challenging mountain routes with up to 1390 m of elevation gain
Distances ranging from children’s races to a 42 km ultramarathon
Picturesque Ještěd Ridge setting with views and technical sections
additional: The winners’ ceremony takes place from 16:00. The races are held at the ski jumping hills at Ještěd. Children’s races, refreshments and an accompanying programme are available. Accommodation and volunteer support are also available. The routes are technically challenging, with significant elevation gain. The race emphasises ecology, for example by not using disposable cups, and offers a wide range of activities throughout the weekend.

name: Neveklovské běhy
organizer: kulturní a sportovní komise města Neveklov
description: Neveklov Runs is a traditional running event held in the picturesque Castle Park in Neveklov. The race gives runners of all abilities the chance to enjoy a run in the park’s pleasant setting and friendly atmosphere. It is part of the wider Běžec Podblanicka race calendar, which promotes an active lifestyle and brings the region’s sporting community together.
course_highlights: Run in Neveklov Castle Park
Peaceful natural park setting
Traditional regional running event
additional: The races are part of the Běžec Podblanicka Cup, with distances ranging from 50 m to 5 km, and offer an outdoor sporting experience for the general public.

name: 7 pohoří Jeseníky
location: Dolní Morava, Jeseníky, Olomoucký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Jeseníky 2026 race is a technical trail run in the beautiful countryside below Králický Sněžník, offering three routes of different lengths and elevation gains. The routes have been prepared by members of the local mountain rescue service and run mainly through natural terrain. Participants can enjoy a professionally marked course, chip timing, refreshments on the course and at the finish, and a commemorative medal. The event takes place in all weather and is suitable for all trail-running enthusiasts who want to experience epic views and an atmosphere they won’t find elsewhere.
course_highlights: Main course: 23.5 km with 830 m of elevation gain
Alternative course: 11.3 km with 410 m of elevation gain
Kari Traa RUN: 7 km with 230 m of elevation gain
additional: The race time limit is 4 hours; after that, a runner is marked as DNF. Participants can leave small items at the registration tent. Recommended gear includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Záchranka app. The entry fee includes a race bib, chip timing, refreshments on the course and at the finish, and use of the facilities at the start and finish area. The event takes place in all weather, and participation is at the runner’s own risk. The race offers registration, timing, medals, and other facilities. The routes run through mountainous terrain with technical trail sections and are suitable for both experienced and beginner trail runners. The race takes place in June 2026.

name: Okrouhelský běh
description: The Okrouhlá Run is a traditional race in the Českolipsko District Running League, held in the picturesque village of Okrouhlá in the Liberec Region. The race offers an opportunity for runners of all levels to enjoy running in a natural setting with a friendly atmosphere. The Okrouhlá Run is part of a series of regional races that promote an active lifestyle and community sport.
course_highlights: Natural terrain around the village of Okrouhlá
Picturesque views and peaceful surroundings
Part of the Českolipsko District Running League
additional: Part of a series of regional races, including cross-country races and half marathons; exact race distances are not specified

name: Extrem Run 5Hills
location: Vojtanov, Karlovy Vary District, Czech Republic
description: Extrem Run 5 Hills is an ultratrail running race in the westernmost part of the Czech Republic, offering a challenging 91-kilometre course with 2,174 metres of elevation gain. The route crosses five Egerland peaks and combines paved roads, cycling and hiking trails, and forest terrain. The race is for experienced runners looking for an extreme sporting challenge and stunning panoramas. The organisers place an emphasis on accurate timekeeping and runner safety. The race takes place in the picturesque area of Vojtanov and also offers relay and two-person duathlon formats.
course_highlights: 91 km course with 2,174 m of elevation gain
Five Egerland peaks: Kapellenberg, Háj Aš, Zelená hora Bismarck, Dyleň, Lesný
A combination of paved roads, cycle paths, and forest terrain
additional: The race starts by the municipal office in Vojtanov. Timing is provided using highly accurate passive or active chips. Runners receive a technical T-shirt with the logo and a finisher medal. Refreshments are provided during the race and at the finish. The relay race is for teams of 3–6 runners, with at least one woman on each team. The two-person duathlon combines a runner and a cyclist, with the order of the legs fixed. The race is authorised by Lesy ČR and the Slavkov Forest Protected Landscape Area. Registration requires a team with at least one woman. The time limit is 18 hours, and the entry fee is 2,400 CZK, payable in cash on site. Accommodation is not provided.

name: Běh na Pajrek
description: Běh na Pajrek is the second edition of a running race organized by TJ Nýrsko, taking place on June 13, 2026, at the grounds below the ski slope in Nýrsko. Men run 8.6 km (2 laps) and women 4.2 km (1 lap), with 152 meters of elevation gain per lap. The finish is at the same location as the start. The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and the Ešus League, with refreshments available at the venue. The organizers note that the course may change due to construction work and provide prizes in kind for the top finishers in each category.
course_highlights: Men’s course: 8.6 km (2 laps); women’s course: 4.2 km (1 lap)
152 m of elevation gain per lap; an uphill and downhill course
The finish is at the same location as the start, at the grounds below the ski slope
additional: On-site registration is open from 12:00 to 13:45. Payment by bank transfer; include your first name, surname, and year of birth in the payment reference. All participants compete at their own risk. Refreshments are available at the venue. Prizes in kind for the top three in each category. The organizer reserves the right to change the course due to construction work. The race takes place at Pajrek; on-site registration is available. The event is part of a series of local running races. Registration is open from 12:00 to 13:45 on race day.

name: 55. Bartenwetzer Volkslauf
description: The Bartenwetzer Volkslauf is the oldest people’s race in North Hesse and takes place on 30 May 2026 at Waldstadion Melsungen. The event includes children’s and schoolchildren’s races over 400 m and 1,000 m, as well as races over 5 km, 10 km and 19 km on firm paths through Melsungen city forest. As the 10th scoring race in the Nordhessencup, it offers a family-friendly atmosphere with refreshments, award ceremonies and a buffet. The start and finish areas are centrally located at Waldstadion, which also has changing facilities.
course_highlights: Races on firm paths through the beautiful Melsungen city forest
Start and finish at Waldstadion Melsungen, on the edge of the city forest
Distances: 5 km, 10 km and 19 km, as well as children’s races on the track
additional: Race-pack collection from 14:30 at the MT clubhouse in Waldstadion. Same-day entries are not possible. Changing rooms are available at the MT clubhouse. Refreshments include water on the longer courses, hot tea at the finish, and a buffet with coffee, cake and bratwurst from 15:30. Medical services provided by the German Red Cross. Certificates and medals for the Bambini and 1,000 m races; certificates can be printed on site or accessed online. The event is subject to the applicable regulations for road races and running events held away from a stadium. Register online via RaceResult. The event at Waldstadion Melsungen includes award ceremonies, refreshments and medical support.

name: SV Greven Deichlauf
description: The SV Greven Deichlauf on May 30, 2026, offers an unforgettable running experience along the idyllic Ems dike and through the town forest. The route, surrounded by nature, is suitable for both recreational runners and ambitious athletes, and is accompanied by numerous spectators. Around 1,000 runners take part, seeking both a sporting challenge and an experience in nature.
course_highlights: Loop course from Emsaue Stadium along the Ems dike
Route passes through the town forest
Nature-filled running route with many spectators
additional: Running event, loop course, experience in nature, approx. 1,000 participants, official timing, medals for children and age groups

name: Hohenlimburger Lennelauf
description: The 3rd Hohenlimburg Lenne Run takes place on June 13, 2026, around Lennepark in Hohenlimburg. The event is open to runners and walkers of all ages and offers a suitable distance for every age group. It is organized by Elseyer Turnverein 1881 e.V., known for its wide range of sports activities for the whole family. The event promises a sporting, community-oriented atmosphere in a beautiful park setting.
course_highlights: Loop course around Lennepark in Hohenlimburg
Suitable for runners and walkers of all ages
Family-friendly event
additional: The event offers various running and walking distances to suit all age groups. Registration is through Elseyer Turnverein. Telephone inquiries are possible at certain times on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Fridays. The course is on asphalt; spikes are not allowed. Limited start places. Refreshments are available on site. Transponders are used for timekeeping.

name: Ketteler-Lauf, Lauf dem Krebs davon
description: The Ketteler Run is a charity run taking place on June 13, 2026, in Offenbach under the motto “Run away from cancer.” Proceeds from the run support care for cancer patients. The starting gun will go off at 3:00 p.m. on Obere Grenzstraße in Offenbach. Participants who register in advance can collect their race numbers and finisher T-shirts at Ketteler Hospital on June 12. The event is an established tradition that combines athletic commitment with a social purpose.
course_highlights: Start on Obere Grenzstraße, approximately at house number 119, Offenbach
Charity run supporting care for cancer patients
Race numbers and finisher T-shirts can be collected in advance at Ketteler Hospital
additional: Race numbers and finisher T-shirts can be collected on June 12, 2026, from 2:00 p.m. to 4:30 p.m. in the reception area of Ketteler Hospital. On the day of the event, collection is also available from 12:00 p.m. to 2:00 p.m. in the hospital courtyard. The run includes distances of 5 km and 7 km, with on-site registration available. The event is part of an annual series of charity runs to combat cancer and offers finisher T-shirts to participants.

name: Kurparklauf Bad Nenndorf
location: Kurpark Bad Nenndorf, Bad Nenndorf, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Kurparklauf Bad Nenndorf is a long-standing, DLV-approved public race and part of the Schaumburg Running Series. It takes place in the beautiful Kurpark in Bad Nenndorf and offers distances for different age and ability groups, including 1,000 m, 2,500 m, 5 km, 10 km, and 5 km walking and Nordic walking. The event is family-friendly and attracts many participants, who run on paved paths through the park. In addition to the sporting competition, there is an attractive supporting program and good facilities, including changing rooms and showers.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths through the Kurpark
Start and finish on Kurpromenade by the Wandelhalle
A range of distances from 1,000 m to 10 km, plus walking options
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports center, which can be reached by bus shuttle. Insurance coverage is provided through an LSB contract. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Medical support is provided. A maximum of 300 participants in the 1,000 m and 2.5 km races. The 5 km Nordic walking and walking events are timed, with no placings. First race for the Samtgemeinde Cup. Scoring race in the Schaumburg Running Series. The race takes place as part of the State Garden Show, with various distances and a family-friendly atmosphere. Early registration is possible, and the event is open to all age groups.

name: Mut-Lauf
description: The MUT-LAUF Kiel is an annual running event that promotes greater openness and courage in addressing mental illness. Its aim is to take a stand against stigma and raise awareness of mental health. The event celebrates moving together without pressure to perform and is open to everyone, regardless of age, fitness level or physical limitations. Alongside the run, there is a varied program featuring music, interviews, food and drink, and a marketplace with information on mental health and prevention.
course_highlights: A run for everyone, with no pressure to perform, including wheelchair users
Event held at Moorteichwiesen in Kiel
Program featuring music, interviews and a marketplace
additional: Registration is available online via the Davengo portal or in person at KIELER FENSTER, Ambulantes Zentrum. The event takes place every year on the Saturday before Kiel Week begins. The program includes activities for the whole family and a marketplace featuring self-help groups and social services. The MUT-LAUF 2026 takes place on June 13, 2026, with registration via the Davengo portal. Entry fees are €10 for adults and €5 for children. Information about self-help groups and a sociable accompanying program will be provided.

name: Oelder Citylauf
description: The Oelde City Run is a traditional running classic in the heart of Oelde that has delighted runners of all ages for over 45 years. The event offers a varied programme featuring Bambini, schoolchildren’s and inclusive races, as well as 5 km and 10 km road races. The races take place before a large crowd in a festival-like atmosphere and are part of the Volksbank Cup race series. The course is measured to international standards and runs through Oelde city centre, with the start and finish at the Market Square.
course_highlights: An internationally measured 2.5 km lap, repeated as required for each distance
The course runs through Oelde city centre, with the start and finish at the Market Square
A variety of races for all ages, including Bambini and inclusive races
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, subject to a late-entry fee of EUR 3.00. Race packets can be collected at the event centre on the Market Square. Certificates for the schoolchildren’s and Bambini races are available on site; certificates for the other races are available online. Showers are available at the Oelde Comprehensive School sports hall, approximately 300 m from the finish. Registration is via Raceresult; the event is known for its diverse categories and friendly atmosphere.

name: Rettichfestlauf
description: The Rettichfest Run in Schifferstadt is a long-standing running event taking place on June 13, 2026. The races follow fast and varied routes around the Waldfesthalle, partly on paved paths and partly on forest trails. Distances of 5 km and 10 km are offered, along with shorter races for schoolchildren, Bambinis, and Minis. The event is family-friendly and offers suitable running options for all age groups.
course_highlights: Route near the Waldfesthalle, with paved paths and forest trails
Main race loop length: 2.5 km
Fast and varied running routes
additional: Start times: schoolchildren’s race (1,200 m) at 17:30, Bambini race (650 m) at 17:45. There is also a 200 m mini race with no timekeeping. Registration is expected to open in March 2026. The event takes place at the Waldfesthalle in Schifferstadt. Start and finish at the Waldfesthalle; online registration; children’s and schoolchildren’s races; transponder timing; refreshments in the finish area.

name: Steinfurter Altstadt - Abendlauf
description: The Steinfurter Altstadt Evening Run is a traditional running event, holding its 38th edition on June 13, 2026. Organised by Turnerbund Burgsteinfurt, the event offers various age groups and race distances through the historic old town of Steinfurt. It is particularly family-friendly and is known for its lively atmosphere and large fields. Young runners receive medals and trophies, making the race a popular event for all ages.
course_highlights: Races through the historic old town of Steinfurt
Age groups from Bambini to masters athletes
A medal and water bottle for every young runner at the finish
additional: Race packs can be collected on the event day from 1 p.m. at the old town hall on the market square. Late entries are possible up to 45 minutes before the respective start. Every young runner receives a medal and a water bottle; the first three in each category are awarded trophies. Races for different age groups, on-site registration, medals, trophies, reusable race numbers, entry fee paid by SEPA direct debit, no refunds possible

name: Straßenlauf Gollhofen mit Mittelfränkischer Meisterschaft über 10 km
location: Gollhofen, Landkreis Neustadt an der Aisch-Bad Windsheim, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Gollhofen Road Race will take place for the 26th time on June 13, 2026, and includes the Central Franconian 10 km Championship. The event is hosted by FC Gollhofen and gives runners the opportunity to take part in a long-established competition. Further details and information are available in the announcement on the website. The event is aimed at ambitious runners and running enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: 10 km road race with the Central Franconian Championship
Established race with more than 25 years of history
Event in the municipality of Gollhofen, Würzburg district
additional: The German Sports Badge event will take place on June 14, 2026, from 1:00 p.m. The girls’ taster training session is on July 4, 2026, from 10:00 a.m.; registration by email is required by June 26. Registration for the road race is via the link provided on the website. Further details are included in the flyer and event announcement. The race takes place on a road course at the Gollhofen sports grounds. Registration is online, and the event also includes youth categories. The event offers a good opportunity to meet the running community in the region.

name: Söltjerlauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 3,- € Kinder und Jugendliche bis einschl. Jg. 2007

description: The Söltjerlauf in Bad Münder is a charity run in the beautiful Süntel, where every lap counts. The event is open to all ages and ability levels, from children to marathon runners, and features a shaded forest loop of approx. 3.8 km with a refreshment point. Participants have four hours to run as many laps as possible, with the proceeds going to a good cause. The event promotes team spirit and health, and invites participants to stay after the run for catering and the awards ceremony.
course_highlights: Shaded forest loop of approx. 3.8 km
Refreshment point on the course
Atmosphere at the Bergschmiede restaurant, with catering
additional: A shuttle service will be available from 09:30 to get participants to the 11:00 start on time. Online late registration is possible until 12.06.2026, with a late-registration fee of 3 euros. Every participant receives a certificate stating the distance they ran. Prizes will be awarded to the top individual runners and the top 10 teams. Parking is limited, so using the alternative parking areas and bus shuttle is recommended. Dogs are allowed only on a short leash and may not participate as members of a team. Competition open to all age groups; sponsors donate for local projects for every lap completed. Venue at Bergschmiede, supported by local sponsors including Sparkasse Hameln-Weserbergland and Ardagh Group.

name: Volksbank Haren Citylauf
description: The 27th Volksbank Haren City Run takes place on June 13, 2026, and offers an attractive, fast course through the center of Haren. The 5 km and 10 km races are measured by the DLV and eligible for official rankings, making them ideal for competitive athletes and recreational runners. Children and young people can take part in dedicated 400 m, 750 m and 1.5 km races. There is also a team competition in the 5 km race, with teams from companies, clubs or other groups eligible to compete.
course_highlights: Attractive, fast course through the center of Haren
The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the DLV and eligible for official rankings
Dedicated races for children and young people over 400 m, 750 m and 1.5 km
additional: All participants in the 5 km and 10 km races receive a finisher shirt. Entry fees are paid by direct debit. The 5 km race has a team competition for teams of at least 3 people. Children attending Haren's daycare centers and schools can take part for free if their institution participates. Large trophies and certificates are awarded in the school competitions. Free entry for children on school and daycare teams, registration until June 7, 2026, prizes for winners and teams, parking nearby

name: Werner Volksbank Stadtlauf 20. Team- / Firmenlauf
description: The 24th Werner Volksbank City Run 20th Team/Company Run takes place on 13 June 2026 in Werne. This running event offers the opportunity to get active with colleagues or friends and strengthen team spirit. The event includes two distances, 1 km and 10 km, and is aimed especially at teams and companies that want to run together.
course_highlights: Distances: 1 km and 10 km
Start location in Werne
Typical June weather, with an average of 23 °C and mostly sunny days
additional: Please check the event details with the organizer before registering. The event promotes physical activity and team spirit, with registration via Raceresult. The weather in June is expected to be warm and sunny, at around 23°C.

name: Enni Donkenlauf
description: The ENNI Donkenlauf on 13 June 2026 in Neukirchen-Vluyn offers a varied range of running events for all age groups and ability levels. The courses are mostly flat and run along paved, low-traffic farm tracks and side roads, making them ideal for fast times. In addition to races, there are also non-competitive runs and walking events open to everyone. The event is family-friendly and includes special rankings for schools and youth groups.
course_highlights: Flat, mostly paved, low-traffic farm tracks and side roads
Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses
Minis-Run and Donki@school on the sports centre’s synthetic track
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event from 11:30 a.m. in Building “G”. The Minis-Run and Donki@school take place on the sports centre’s synthetic track. Dogs, baby joggers and cycling escorts are not permitted for safety reasons. Parking is limited, so travelling by bicycle or public transport is recommended. Smoking is prohibited throughout the school grounds, and dogs are not allowed on the sports grounds. Various distances (500 m to 10 km); registration is possible on site or online; some events do not have age-group rankings.

name: Gellershäuser Abendlauf
location: Sportplatz in Gellershausen, Edertal, Hesse, Germany
organizer: Turn und Sportverein Hessen 1848 Frankenberg Eder e.V.
description: The Gellershausen Evening Run takes place at the sports ground in Gellershausen, Edertal, and offers races for children and school students, as well as a 10-kilometer race and a half marathon. The event is part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup and attracts runners of various age groups. The course runs through scenic surroundings and offers a pleasant running atmosphere in June. Information about registration, the course, results, and photos is available.
course_highlights: Half-marathon and 10-kilometer courses starting at Gellershausen Sports Ground
Children’s and school students’ races included
Part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup
additional: Typical June weather: around 23 °C during the day and 13 °C at night, mostly sunny, with an average of 65 mm of precipitation. Children’s and youth races with distances of around 400 m and 1,000 m; the event promotes community and sporting exchange in the region.

name: 12. Heilwald Marathon
location: Heilwald, Bad Lippspringe, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 12th Heilwald Marathon takes place on June 13, 2026, in Bad Lippspringe. The course consists of six large laps of 7.05 km each, for a total of 42.3 km, and runs through the unique Heilwald forest, whose calming low-mountain climate and species-rich woodland offer a special running experience. The event is a privately organized race with self-supported aid. Timing is done by hand, and a photo of the clock must be submitted as proof. Participation is at your own risk, and a voluntary donation toward tree planting is requested.
course_highlights: Six laps of 7.05 km through Bad Lippspringe’s Heilwald forest
Species-rich woodland with a calming low-mountain climate
The course was measured using a measuring wheel and GPS watch
additional: Runners provide their own refreshments, as they pass their cars after each lap. Timing is done with a hand stopwatch; a photo of the clock must be emailed on race day as proof. No showers or changing facilities are available. Participant limit: 18. Minimum age: 18. The organizer accepts no liability. Participation is at your own risk. By registering, participants consent to the creation and use of photos, result lists, and videos. Course: 6 laps of 7.05 km in the Heilwald forest; self-supported; no showers; participation at your own risk; participant limit: 18; registration until 6 p.m. on the day before the race.

name: 13. Himmelswegelauf
description: The 13th Himmelswegelauf on June 13, 2026, takes participants through a unique cultural landscape around Nebra (Unstrut). The race routes connect important archaeological sites such as the Pömmelte Ring Sanctuary, the Goseck solar observatory and the discovery site of the Nebra Sky Disc. The start and finish are at the Arche Nebra visitor center, near the Sky Disc, which is considered the oldest concrete depiction of the cosmos. In addition to the marathon, half marathon and 10 km Sky Disc Run, there are also walking events, cycling tours and hikes to the discovery site. The event is under the patronage of the Minister-President of Saxony-Anhalt and offers an appealing cultural and sporting experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Arche Nebra, near the Nebra Sky Disc
Routes pass the 4,000-year-old Pömmelte Ring Sanctuary
The marathon starts at the 7,000-year-old Goseck solar observatory
additional: Race pack collection and late registration are available on event day, with different times for the marathon, half marathon, Sky Disc Run, walking events and cycling tour. In addition to the running events, the event also offers walking, cycling tours and hikes. The award ceremonies are hosted by Radio SAW presenter Holger Tapper. The event is open to runners, cyclists, walkers and hikers; registration is required. The event is scheduled for June 13, 2026.

name: 14. Glück-Lauf
description: The Glück-Lauf in Salzgitter-Gebhardshagen is a varied running event that appeals to families and experienced runners alike. With distances ranging from 1.2 km for children to a challenging 21.2 km trail half marathon with almost 400 metres of elevation gain, the event has something for everyone. Around 400 participants, including recreational runners, competitive athletes and local club runners, share race day. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and well-organised aid stations along the course.
course_highlights: Trail half marathon of approximately 21.2 km with almost 400 m of elevation gain
1.2 km children’s race, with U8 children taking part
Aid stations and advice to prepare for sunny weather
additional: The event includes a 10.8 km course with a remarkable story of a 64-year-old runner who overtook younger competitors. Participants are encouraged to prepare for the sun with caps, scarves and hydration packs. The event attracts both children and experienced runners and is a local highlight in Gebhardshagen. Distances from 1.2 km to 21.2 km, trail half marathon, family and competitive event, weather in June usually warm and sunny, registration possible online and on site.

name: 15. Fullestrand-Ultramarathon
description: The Fullestrand Ultramarathon takes place on June 13, 2026, in Kassel and offers a challenging 46.5 km course along the Fulda with about 350 metres of elevation gain. The route heads upstream from Kassel, follows the Fuldahöhenweg and returns along the Fuldaradweg, passing through varied landscapes and natural areas. Organized by Laufwerk Kassel under the direction of Sylke Kuhn, the event combines a sporting challenge with the beauty of northern Hesse’s nature and culture.
course_highlights: 46.5 km course along the Fulda with approx. 350 metres of elevation gain
Sections on the Fuldahöhenweg (marked X17) with some elevation gain
Return route on the Fuldaradweg R1 through the Fulda floodplains, Bugaseen and Kassel districts
additional: Meet at 7:58 a.m. at the start. Start and finish are at Auedamm 17 in Kassel, opposite the Pfannkuchenhaus next to the Auebad. Parts of the route follow cycle paths; traffic lights must be used at the Hafenbrücke. The event is organized by Sylke Kuhn, who also oversees other marathon and ultramarathon races in the region. The course includes flat paths and muddy singletrack, is unmarked, has water stations, and has an 8-hour time limit.

name: 18. Edeka Ladage-Lauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld: 3 € Teilnehmer:innen: Kindergarten­kinder laufen eine etwa 600 m und Grundschüler:innen eine 900 m lange Strecke.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld: 4 € Teilnehmer:innen: Jahrgänge 2014 und jünger (U12) | Jahrgänge 2010 bis 2013 (U16)

description: The EDEKA Ladage Run in Wennigsen is a traditional community race with a variety of events for all age groups. The event takes place at the Sophie-Scholl-Gesamtschule sports grounds and offers varied circuits for everyone from kindergarten children to experienced runners. The longer races follow a slightly modified 2.5 km loop, with the start and finish close to the event area, creating a special atmosphere. Alongside competition, the event emphasizes community spirit, supported by a prize drawing and a dedicated team of volunteers.
course_highlights: Varied circuits on the school grounds for children
Slightly modified 2.5 km loop for longer races, with the start and finish near the event area
Atmospheric course through residential streets, dirt paths and an athletics track
additional: On-site late registration is possible until one hour before the respective start, for an additional fee (€5, including a €2 deposit for a rented race bib). Kindergarten children and primary school pupils run an exciting circuit on the school grounds. The longer races use a 2.5 km loop, completed twice (5 km) or four times (10 km). Entry in the charity run includes automatic entry in the prize drawing. Proceeds from the charity run go to the Bastlergemeinschaft der Wennigser Wasserräder e.V. The event is organized by SG Bredenbeck-Holtensen e.V. It takes place on the grounds of the Sophie-Scholl-Gesamtschule, with various race categories and a focus on community and health. Taking part supports the local community and promotes young athletes.

name: 23. Sudenburg-Lauf - Der Lauf mit dem Lächeln
description: The Sudenburg Run is held under the motto “For runners, by runners” and takes place on June 13, 2026, at Heinrich-Germer-Stadion in Magdeburg. The event is driven by enthusiasm for running and for the Sudenburg district. There are various race distances for children, young people and adults, which run through the city and the stadium. The focus is on encouraging as many people as possible to run and to do so with a smile on their faces.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Heinrich-Germer-Stadion, with a final lap of the stadium
A 2.2-kilometer loop, run twice or five times depending on the distance
The course passes through Salzmannstraße, Walmbergsweg, Braunlager Straße, Halberstädter Straße and Lemsdorfer Weg
additional: Race bibs can be collected on 12.06.2026 from 14:30 to 18:00 at the sport39 sports store (Halberstädter Str. 21), or at Heinrich-Germer-Stadion on race day until 9:00. Late entries are possible from June 8, 2026, through race day, but incur a late-entry fee. The award ceremony for the children’s races is at 10:15, and for the longer races at 11:45. The terms of participation include a liability waiver, fair conduct and an obligation to dispose of waste properly. The races count toward the SRL MD and EOC-Cup. Online registration only; participation in June 2026; part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP Series; the aim is to share the joy of running in the city.

name: 5. Biber Backyard Ultra
description: The Biber Backyard Ultra is a unique ultrarunning event in Simmerath/Lammersdorf, taking place on June 13, 2026. Participants run a 6.7-kilometer loop every hour, with elevation gain varying between loops, until only one runner remains. The course follows forest and field paths as well as trails, including a challenging ramp. The event is distinguished by its special ultra-backyard format, in which each loop must be completed within one hour. It offers a friendly, family atmosphere and challenges participants’ endurance and tactics in equal measure.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop with approximately 110 meters of elevation gain during the day
Trail section and numerous forest and field paths
Hourly starts, with one hour to complete each loop
additional: Registration traditionally opens on December 6 at 00:01. The course is divided into a daytime and a nighttime route. Lap times are not recorded; only the number of completed laps is counted. Start announcements are made 3, 2 and 1 minute before each lap. Personal assistance and aids during the lap are not allowed. The event has a friendly, family atmosphere and is sponsored by outdoor manufacturer OMM. The course has daytime and nighttime sections, with 110 meters of elevation gain during the day and 60 meters at night. Refreshments are available in the start/finish area, along with showers, sanitary facilities, accommodation options and community events on site.

name: DUD Ultra
description: The DUD Ultra 70km is a road ultramarathon in Duderstadt, Germany, held on a short loop around Duderstadt’s town walls. The loop is under 5 km long, with 36 m of elevation gain per lap, so runners complete the same course repeatedly throughout the day. The race has a 12-hour time limit, a participant cap, and an entry fee of 100 euros. The compact course lets spectators see the runners multiple times, while a single aid station serves the entire loop. The DUDultra organizer also offers other distances, including 50 km, 100 km, and a 100 km relay.
course_highlights: Loop under 5 km with 36 m of elevation gain per lap
Compact course with one aid station
Spectators can see runners multiple times along the course
additional: The race has a 12-hour time limit and a participant cap. Other event distances include 50 km, 100 km, and a 100 km relay for four runners. June weather is typically around 23 °C, with a minimum of 13 °C, and is mostly sunny. Run on a loop around Duderstadt’s town walls; limited number of participants; multiple ultramarathon distances at the event.

name: Ottermeerlauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld für Einzelläufer 25 Euro bis 09. Juni 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld für Staffeln 50 Euro bis 09. Juni 2026

description: The Ottermeerlauf in Wiesmoor is a traditional race taking place on June 13, 2026. The event offers a varied course and a motivating atmosphere, and is open to individual runners and relay teams. A particular highlight is the 6-hour ultramarathon, which is part of the Nordcup and is open to runners aged 18 and over. Every finisher receives a custom medal shaped like the outline of the Ottermeer, featuring the mascot Otti.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the “Lüttje Haven” cafeteria in Wiesmoor
Varied course with encouraging cheers from spectators
Custom medal shaped like the outline of the Ottermeer, featuring the mascot Otti
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event from 09:00 until one hour before the start. The minimum age is 18 for individual ultramarathon runners and 8 for relay teams. Michis Physiotherapie will offer massages on site in exchange for a donation. Race numbers must be worn visibly on the chest and returned after the race. The number of participants is limited to 400. Participation from age 18, medal with an Ottermeer design, on-site physiotherapy support, supporting program, team and family event.

name: 24h Lauf Halberstadt
price_range: 25 € für den 24h Lauf, andere Laufzeiten variieren
description: The 24-hour run at Friedensstadion Halberstadt takes place on June 12, 2026, at 18:00 and is organized by VfB Germania Halberstadt in cooperation with Freizeit- und Sportzentrum Halberstadt. The aim is to keep runners on the tartan track continuously for the full 24 hours. The event is part of VfB Germania’s club festival, where various sports departments introduce themselves and invite visitors to take part. Alongside the run, traditional activities include pulling a coach on the running track. The event offers a sporting challenge and a social program for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Run continuously for 24 hours on the tartan track at Friedensstadion
Part of VfB Germania’s club festival, featuring a range of sports activities
Traditional coach-pulling on the running track as a special highlight
additional: The run takes place on the tartan track at Friedensstadion. The aim is to keep the track continuously occupied by runners for the full 24 hours. In addition to the run, the club festival offers the opportunity to try various sports, including archery, table tennis, judo, athletics and gymnastics. Various running distances, club festival, Harzer-Lauf-Cup running series, registration by June 4, 2026, results live on site and online

name: Ahrathon Erlebnislauf
location: Weingut Sonnenberg, Bad Neuenahr-Ahrweiler, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany

price_tiers.distance: 21 km Halbmarathon I - Nur schnelle Läufer!!! - Vor KHM

description: The Ahrathon Erlebnislauf on June 13, 2026, in Bad Neuenahr-Ahrweiler offers a varied running experience, from a 500m Bambini run to a 42km marathon. The start and finish are at Weingut Sonnenberg, which also hosts a family festival and a closing festival with live music. The route runs through the picturesque Ahr Valley, with refreshment stations offering wine and gourmet bites as well as water and fruit. The event is known for its special atmosphere, with wine presentations and creative costume runs.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Weingut Sonnenberg in Bad Neuenahr
Refreshment stations with water, fruit, isotonic drinks and wine from renowned wineries
Family festival in the start/finish area and the “Rock & Wein” closing festival from 17:00
additional: Refreshment stations offer water, isotonic drinks, fruit, energy bars and, at selected stations, wine from renowned wineries. Marathon participants pass the refreshment stations twice; half-marathon and 21km participants pass them once. There is a family festival in the start/finish area, followed by a closing festival with live music from 17:00. Age-group winners receive wine gifts, costume runners are judged on creativity, and winners of the shorter races receive prizes in kind. A running event with wine tastings, distances from 5 km to marathon, costume runs, and a route past the wineries of the Ahr Valley.

name: Fischland-Darss-Zingst-Ultramarathon (FDZU)
description: The Fischland-Darss-Zingst Ultramarathon (FDZU) is the longest nature-experience run in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and will take place for the 10th time on June 13, 2026. The course runs through the unique Baltic Sea coastal landscape from Rostock to Stralsund and offers runners a special nature experience along the region’s peninsulas and islands. The event is steeped in tradition and has a distinctive atmosphere created by the combination of nature, challenge and community. Registration opens on July 1, 2025, and closes on May 31, 2026.
course_highlights: Scenic diversity along the Baltic Sea coast from Rostock to Stralsund
A nature experience on the Fischland, Darß and Zingst peninsulas
Course sections around the Saaler Bodden and on the islands of Poel and Usedom
additional: The race starts early in the morning at 04:06 amid the glow of blazing fire bowls. The course has been updated and includes location details for all aid stations. Registration is exclusively through the Tollense Timing GmbH portal. Non-cash prizes are awarded to the fastest runners on the king’s distance. Nature-experience run, course distance over 117 km, relay and beach section, sand passages, elevation profile up to 23 m, registration required

name: Gaißeschennerlauf Kieselbronn
description: The Gaißeschennerlauf is an annual running event organized by Turnverein Kieselbronn in Kieselbronn, Baden-Württemberg. The race has been held regularly since 2003 and is part of a local running series. The event gives runners the opportunity to experience a scenic route, which is presented on the website with a video and external profiles on AllTrails. The name Gaißeschennerlauf gives the event a distinctive local identity.
course_highlights: Two distances: 450 m and 21 km
Route profiles available on AllTrails
Part of a regional running series
additional: Registration is via MY RACE RESULT. June weather is typically mild, with an average temperature of 23 °C and occasional precipitation. Registration via MY RACE RESULT; race at the Heinloch sports grounds and in the surrounding area; takes place in June 2026

name: Harsefelder Lauf- und Musikfestival
organizer: Lauftreff Harsefeld, LSC Harsefeld, Stadtmarketing Harsefeld
description: The 20th Running and Music Festival in Harsefeld takes place on 13 June 2026 and combines sporting challenges with musical entertainment. Runners of all ages can take part in various distances, from children’s and toddler races to short-distance, long-distance and relay races. In the evening, Marktstraße turns into a lively party zone with an open-air disco and live music. The festival is a regular fixture in Harsefeld’s events calendar and, alongside the sporting events, offers a varied children’s programme and food stalls.
course_highlights: Children’s race: approx. 2,000 metres
Short distance: approx. 5,100 metres; long distance: approx. 10,200 metres
Relay: 4 × approx. 2,550 metres
additional: Registration opens on 1 April 2026. Official festival running shirts featuring the logo are available to order. All runners receive an anniversary gift when they collect their race numbers. Schools and kindergartens can earn cheques, which will be honoured on stage. Open-air disco until 11 p.m. with the 2006 Revival Party. Various race distances, children’s programme, music and party, registration opens on 1 April 2026, festival shirts, sponsors: Friedrich- und Margret Tobaben-Stiftung

name: Himmelgeister Brückenlauf
location: Steinkaul, Himmelgeist, Düsseldorf, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Himmelgeister Bridge Run is a traditional half marathon that has been held annually in Düsseldorf-Himmelgeist since 2004. The route follows the Rhine almost to the heart of Düsseldorf and offers a scenic running course. The race starts early in the morning, around 8 a.m., at Steinkaul in Himmelgeist and is known for its family atmosphere and the after-run party in the beer garden at Haus Krevet. The race will be held for the last time in 2026, as the organizing team is stepping down after the anniversary.
course_highlights: Run along the Rhine with views of Düsseldorf
Start at Steinkaul in Himmelgeist
8 refreshment points along the 21.1 km course
additional: Bib pickup on June 12 from 1 p.m. to 7 p.m. and on June 13 from 6:15 a.m. to 7:45 a.m. at the start venue. Timing is by a chest transponder worn behind the bib. Clothes may be left in the beer garden at Haus Krevet at your own risk. After-run party with raffle and awards ceremony from around 10:30 a.m. Separate awards ceremonies for the top women, men, and teams; no age-group awards. Recommended transport: bus route 835 or carpooling. Parking in the Aldi car park is prohibited. Anniversary race, start at Steinkaul in Himmelgeist, final edition in 2026, participation in accordance with DLV regulations, no shower facilities, online results and photos

name: Holzgerlinger Lauf - Waldtrail
price_range: 15.- € bis 18.- € für Erwachsene, kostenlos für Kinder und Jugendliche
description: The Holzgerlinger Lauf - Waldtrail takes place for the 41st time in 2026 and is part of the Schönbuch Cup as the third scoring race. The course covers two laps over a tartan track, asphalt, and forest trails through the beautiful Holzgerlingen forest. The first half is mostly flat, while the second half is undulating, with a final climb accompanied by the sound of drums. Runners pass through the packed stadium three times, where spectators cheer them on with music—at the start, after the first 5 km lap, and at the finish.
course_highlights: Two laps over a tartan track, asphalt, and forest trails
A beautiful, sheltered run through the Holzgerlingen forest
Three passes through the packed stadium with music and cheering spectators
additional: The event offers 5 km and 10 km courses with elevation profiles. On 06.06.2026, there will be a taster run with no registration required. The course is well surfaced and runs mostly through the forest. In 2024, the event was listed among the Württemberg Athletics Association (WLV)’s top 100 running events. The event also includes a taster run for beginners, team and pair competitions, and an after-race party.

name: Kalimandscharolauf 2026
description: The 13th Kalimandscharolauf 2026 takes place on 13 June 2026 in Zielitz and is organized by SV Kali Wolmirstedt e.V., Athletics Department. The event is hosted by K+S Minerals and Agriculture GmbH, Zielitz plant. It is a non-stadium event and offers runners an attractive course in the Magdeburg/Börde region. Registration is open until 6 June 2026.
course_highlights: Run over the landscaped Friedrichshall spoil heap with scenic views
Hilly, challenging course for various disciplines
Varied supporting programme, including walking and Nordic walking
additional: The event includes categories such as Magdeburg, Börde and mountain running, with a registration deadline of 6 June 2026. It is part of a sustainable concept that makes use of former industrial sites.

name: Kehler-Rheinuferlauf
description: The Kehler Rheinuferlauf is a traditional running event celebrating its 10th anniversary in Kehl am Rhein. It offers races for children and young people, a 5 km company run, and 5 km and 10 km main races on measured circuits. The attractive route runs along the Rhine and through the Rhine floodplain, with musical entertainment along the way. Part of the entry fees is donated to the Kehl animal shelter, giving the event a charitable focus.
course_highlights: 5 km route through the Kehler Rheinvorland and across the Passerelle to Strasbourg
10 km route with an additional section on forest trails in the Kehler Rheinwald
Predominantly paved route with musical entertainment along the way
additional: Personalized race bibs for registrations by 31.05.2026. Race bib collection from 16:00 at the KFV clubhouse in the Rheinstadion. Drinks are available at km 3, 6, 8 and at the finish, with still water. Separate changing rooms and showers are available for men and women. Late registration is possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start. Valuables can be stored at the late-registration desk (at your own risk). A finish buffet is available after the race. Companies can set up a stand (3x3m) in front of the grandstand for 200 €, including three race entries. Races on a measured circuit, race bibs for registrations by 31.05.2026, registration available for company runners and children’s races, donations to the Kehl animal shelter

name: Kidsmarathon
description: The Pillenstein KIDSmarathon on June 13, 2026, is an inclusive running event for up to 4,000 children aged 1 to 11. Children can choose their distance freely, with fun and participation taking priority. There is no timing, and every participant is a winner. The event offers a great atmosphere and a varied program, and is designed to be accessible so that children with disabilities can also take part.
course_highlights: Accessible courses of 200 m, 400 m and 800 m
Children aged 1 to 11 can freely choose their running distance
Accompanying adults can run alongside children if needed
additional: There is no timing; every child is a winner. Puma finisher shirt for early registrations, while stocks last. Medical assistance is available if needed.
