Distances: 200 m, 400 m and 800 m; no timing; accessible courses; open to participants aged 1 and up; no late registration; finisher shirt included for early registration.

name: Lauf um den Senftenberger See
description: The 49th Run around Lake Senftenberg takes place on June 13, 2026, and offers runners a choice of distances around scenic Lake Senftenberg. The event is open to all ages and ability levels, from the Bambini run to the challenging 17.7 km lake loop. Races start from 09:00 in front of the Seesporthalle Großkoschen, with a friendly atmosphere, refreshments, and changing and washing facilities. Registration is online via myRacePartner, with late registration available until race day for a small fee.
course_highlights: 17.7 km loop around Lake Senftenberg
Other distances: 10.0 km, 5.4 km, 3.2 km, and a 200 m Bambini run
Start and finish at the Seesporthalle Großkoschen, with good facilities
additional: Late registration is available online from 12.06.2026 18:00 Uhr until 13.06.2026 09:00 Uhr for a late registration fee of €2.00. Parking guidance and refreshments are free until 13:00 on race day. Changing and washing facilities are available in the start and finish area. Participants take part at their own risk; the organizer accepts no liability. Registration is via myRacePartner; free parking until 13:00; changing and washing facilities available; children’s and family races included.

name: Luckenwalder Turmfestlauf
description: The Luckenwalder Turmfest takes place from 12 to 14 June 2026 around the market tower in Luckenwalde. This traditional city festival is open and accessible to all visitors, regardless of their budget. It offers a varied cultural programme and welcomes guests from near and far to celebrate together. The city is committed to an open festival by the people of Luckenwalde for the people of Luckenwalde and welcomes voluntary donations to support the event.
course_highlights: Various race distances, including the 10 km main race and an 800 m sprint
Part of the large Turmfest, with cultural and family-friendly activities
Children’s and youth races, as well as relay races for all age groups
additional: The Turmfest begins at 12:00 each day. The festival closes at 01:00 on Fridays and Saturdays and at 22:00 on Sundays. There is no standard cultural contribution; instead, voluntary donations are welcome and can be made at the tourist information office. The tourist information office is open during its usual opening hours. The event takes place as part of the Luckenwalder Turmfest, celebrated in Luckenwalde from 12 to 14 June 2026, with music, food, rides and family activities.

name: Nordheimlauf
description: The Nordheim Run takes place on June 13, 2026, in Nordheim (Württemberg) and celebrates its 25th anniversary. Five different races are offered, including children’s races, a para race, a schoolchildren’s race, a fun run, and the 10 km main race. The varied course is entirely paved and has around 150 metres of elevation gain in the main race. Times are recorded electronically using transponders, and refreshments are provided along the course and at the finish. The race is part of the 2026 Ensinger-Zabergäu Cup and offers a friendly, sporty atmosphere for all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Varied, entirely paved course
Around 150 metres of elevation gain in the 10 km main race
Refreshment stations with mineral water along the course and at the finish
additional: The start and finish area is at the sports grounds on Lauffener Straße, opposite the outdoor swimming pool. Timing is by a transponder attached to the shoe, which must be returned after the race (rental cost included in the entry fee). Online registration is available until 10.06.2026 at 10 p.m.; late entries are accepted on race day until one hour before the respective start. Nordic walkers’ times are recorded, but no rankings are published. Fruit is provided from the 10 km main race onwards. Team registration is available. Course profiles, parking information, 5 km and 10 km routes, varied paved courses with around 150 metres of elevation gain, team competitions, online registration available

name: OSTSEE Run
description: The OSTSEE Run by ROTEC is a sporting highlight of the OSTSEE Sports Games in Cottbus. The run offers an attractive course for runners and walkers and is part of a varied sports and leisure program featuring numerous other competitions and activities. The event is aimed at sports enthusiasts of all ages and, alongside the sporting competition, offers a colorful program of activities and a large OSTSEE Party with free admission. This combination of sport and celebration makes the OSTSEE Run a special experience in the region.

Running and walking course as part of the SPARKASSEN Half Marathon
Varied program of sports and leisure activities
additional: OSTSEE Party with free admission in the evening from 20:00 in the festival tent. Free OSTSEE shuttle service from the main railway station to the sports park. Varied program of activities including children's races, beach tennis, volleyball, archery, and other sports. Start times from 8:45; registration available. Participation in a taster run requires registration by 12.06.26

name: OSTSEE Sparkassen Halbmarathon
description: The SPARKASSEN Half Marathon takes place on June 13, 2026, in Timmendorfer Strand and Niendorf/Ostsee. The 21-kilometer course starts at 10:00 from the Möbel Höffner grounds. Race materials can be collected from 7:00 at the start and finish area. The race is open to participants aged 18 and over and offers an attractive route along the Baltic Sea coast. There is no on-site registration; participants must register in advance.
course_highlights: 21-kilometer course along the Baltic Sea coast
Start and finish at the Möbel Höffner grounds
Route through Timmendorfer Strand and Niendorf/Ostsee
additional: Race materials available from 7:00 at the start and finish area. No on-site registration. Race materials available from 7:00, no on-site registration, participants must be 18 or over, course distance: 21 km.

name: Panorama-Baumwipfel-Lauf 2026
price_range: 2,00 € für bestimmte Läufe, andere nicht spezifiziert
description: The Panorama Treetop Run 2026 is an appealing running event in the Steigerwald that attracts runners from all over Germany. The varied routes wind through vineyards and the Steigerwald Nature Park, with twisty trails and forest paths. The half-marathon and 12 km routes go over the tower of the Baumwipfelpfad-Steigerwald treetop walkway and return via the Oberschwarzacher Herrenberg. The start and finish are at the Panorama Terrace at the sports grounds / Sebastianihaus Oberschwarzach, and the course offers beautiful new views around every bend.
course_highlights: Routes through vineyards and the Steigerwald Nature Park
Twisty trails and forest paths
Half-marathon and 12 km routes over the tower of the Baumwipfelpfad-Steigerwald treetop walkway
additional: The event includes several race distances, including family and fun runs, with the start and finish at the Panorama Terrace at the sports grounds / Sebastianihaus Oberschwarzach. Registration is online, and the scenic routes take runners along forest paths and through vineyards.

name: ROCKS AND RUN 3. Rielingshäuser Steinbruch-Lauf
location: Rielingshäuser Steinbruch, Marbach am Neckar, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The ROCKS AND RUN 3rd Rielingshäuser Quarry Run takes place on 13 June 2026 in Marbach am Neckar. The event offers races over a distance of 2.5 km for all age groups, including special races for children and young people. It is a great opportunity for families to get active together and enjoy the sporting atmosphere. The event takes place in typical June weather, with pleasant temperatures and mostly sunny days.
course_highlights: 2.5 km course
Races for all age groups, including the Youngster Run and Kids Run
Venue at the Rielingshäuser Quarry near Marbach am Neckar

The event takes place in Marbach am Neckar, with typical weather around 23 °C and occasional rain. It is ideal for families and running enthusiasts looking for a relaxed, sociable running event.

name: Skatstadtmarathon Altenburg
description: The Skatstadtmarathon Altenburg is a challenging running event taking place on June 13, 2026, in Altenburg. Participants can choose from a range of distances, including the marathon, two-person marathon relay, half marathon, 13.3 km run, fitness run, student and children’s races, and walking events. The course winds through the historic city of Altenburg, with varied sections including climbs in the city forest and a stretch along the Großer Teich. Alongside the sporting challenge, the event programme offers a wide range of entertainment, including music, a children’s festival, and a talk by running legend Uta Pippig.
course_highlights: Start on Altenburg’s Market Square, with a view of the Rote Spitzen
A 700 m climb through the city forest to the Bismarck Tower, the highest point on the course
Refreshment stations at 5 km and 7.5 km, with cheering and parties at the stations

The marathon time limit is 6 hours and 30 minutes; Wendegasse closes after 2 hours and 45 minutes for the second lap. Runner refreshments, medical support, cultural programme, professional timing, collectible race numbers, drinks, hot food, showers, event T-shirts (pre-order by 31.03.26), secure luggage storage.

name: Tollenseseelauf
description: The Neubrandenburg Tollensesee Run is a scenic race around Lake Tollensesee that attracts more than 2,000 runners each year. With a variety of distances for all ages, it offers a diverse running festival in a family-friendly atmosphere. The course is challenging, with some elevation gain, which is why the race is also nicknamed “The Toughest in the North.” More than 300 volunteers help make the event an unforgettable experience, with certificates, technical T-shirts, and trophies for the top finishers.
course_highlights: Routes around picturesque Lake Tollensesee
Challenging elevation gain on all courses
Family-friendly running festival with a variety of distances
additional: All participants receive a certificate and a technical T-shirt. Trophies are awarded to the top three overall male and female finishers; age-group winners receive prizes and certificates. A bus transfer for relay teams is available and can be requested during registration. Multiple distances, including a marathon relay and children’s races; registration at tollenseseelauf.de; a well-known event in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania

name: Waaker Bystopen-Attacke

description: The Waaker Bystopen-Attacke is an obstacle race in Lower Saxony around the Waaker Büsteppe in the Göttingen Forest. The event offers distances of 2.5 km (family run), 5 km and 10 km, with more than 30 natural and artificial obstacles. Participants can enter individually or as part of a team; team scoring requires at least 4 runners. In addition to the main race, there is also a Bambini-Attacke for the youngest participants, with no registration required. The event focuses on fun, team spirit and exercise in nature.
course_highlights: More than 30 natural and artificial obstacles
Route around the 387.2-metre-high Waaker Büsteppe
Water and fruit at refreshment stations along the course
additional: Race packs can be collected from 08:00 at the Waake sports ground. Race numbers are attached to the wrist and also written on the upper arms and lower legs; no more race numbers on the abdomen. There are two refreshment stations along the course and one in the start-finish area. Showers and sanitary facilities are available at Waake primary school after the race. Drinks, grilled food, fries, cake and more are available before, during and after the race. Bags can be left free of charge in a supervised truck. The Bambini-Attacke takes place at the same time on the sports ground and requires no registration. Warm-up before every start. Obstacle race, family run, team and club scoring, online registration, optional T-shirt for a fee

name: Waldlauf Reutlingen-Ohmenhausen
description: The 45th Waldlauf in Reutlingen-Ohmenhausen is organised by SV 1923 Ohmenhausen e.V., Recreation and Athletics Department. The races take place on a Saturday evening in early summer and follow routes through the forest in the hilly Alb foothills on well-maintained, partly paved paths. There are several events for different age groups, including a 10 km main race, a 5 km fun run and a 2 km schoolchildren’s race. The event is family-friendly and offers electronic timing and refreshments at the finish.
course_highlights: Routes through the forest in the hilly Alb foothills
Well-maintained paths, partly paved and traffic-free
Water stations at km 3 and 7 (10 km) and at km 3 (5 km)
additional: Late registration is possible until 17:30 on race day for an additional fee of €2.00. The start and finish are at the sports grounds of SV 1923 Ohmenhausen e.V. in Reutlingen-Ohmenhausen, Hornstraße. The course is not suitable for wheelchairs; dogs and jogging strollers are not allowed. All finishers in the 5 km and 10 km races receive a complimentary non-alcoholic Berg Cyriakus. Electronic transponder timing is used; certificates and results are available online. There is a mixed-team classification in the main race (at least 3 runners). Pre-registration until 10.06.2026; late registration is possible on race day; dogs prohibited; jogging strollers not permitted; water and drinks on the course; electronic timing.

name: Autohaus Lutz Nightrun
organizer: SV 1911 Traisa e.V. und Turngemeinde 1879 Traisa
description: The Autohaus Lutz Nightrun is a short running race taking place on June 13, 2026, in Mühltal-Traisa. The race is ideal for runners looking for a short, fast challenge. Please check the details directly with the organizer before registering.

Typical June weather, around 23 °C and mostly sunny
additional: Please check the event details with the organizer before registering. Short distance of 650 m, longer distance of 5.6 km, start times from 18:30, main race at 22:00, including children’s and relay races.

name: Bürgerlauf Visbek
location: Pastors Wisk Visbek Park, Visbek, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 1st Visbek Citizens’ Run takes place on June 13, 2026, in Park Visbek (Pastors Wisk) and offers a varied program for runners of different age groups and ability levels. Bib numbers can be collected on the day of the event from 3:00 p.m., and all races are professionally measured. Proceeds will benefit the Visbek Citizens’ Foundation, making this a sporting event with a social commitment.

name: Drebber-Marathon
location: Schulstraße 1, Jacobidrebber, Drebber, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Drebber Run on June 13, 2026, offers a diverse selection of races for all ages and ability levels. The course follows an officially measured 2.34 km loop through the district of Jacobidrebber, with the start and finish at the sports field. In addition to individual and relay races ranging from a children’s run to a marathon, there is an appealing program of activities for spectators and participants. Emergency services personnel are especially invited to take part in the Blue Light Cup as a relay team and showcase their performance.
course_highlights: Officially measured 2.34 km loop through Jacobidrebber

A range of distances from a 500 m children’s run to a marathon

Parking is available at the sports field, and the route there is signposted. Children have their own race program starting at 14:30, with race number distribution at the clubhouse. The event features refreshments and activities for children in the schoolyard. Certificates with photos will be sent out after the race. Winners are honored in various age groups and team categories. Emergency services personnel can enter relay teams in the Blue Light Cup and receive a code for a free entry fee when they register. The start and finish are in front of the school at Schulstraße 1, Drebber. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and involvement of the local community.

name: Dünenlauf
description: The Dünenlauf Sandhausen takes place on 13 June 2026 at Walter-Reinhard-Stadion and offers flat, varied routes through the forest and over a sand dune. There are timed races for Bambini, 5 km and 10 km. The event is a DLV-approved fun run and takes place in all weather. Refreshments are provided, and the route is closed to traffic.

Bambini races take place in the stadium

The 5 km race starts at 17:00 and the 10 km race at 18:00. Changing rooms are available at the stadium. First aid is provided by the Sandhausen branch of the German Red Cross (DRK). The route is closed to traffic. Non-cash prizes and certificates for the top three finishers in each age group. Flat, varied route through the forest and over a sand dune; refreshment stations along the route; online registration; takes place in all weather; start at Walter-Reinhard-Stadion.

name: 4 Skolwińska Mila
description: The 4th Skolwińska Mile is an annual street race held in Szczecin, attracting both adults and children. The event takes place on June 13, 2026, and continues the tradition of previous editions, offering participants the chance to compete over a short distance. The race is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the local community together. The organizers provide an easy way to get in touch via the entry form, as well as administrative support.
course_highlights: A 1-mile (1,609-meter) course in a scenic recreational area
Online registration and timing by Sport-Time
Prizes for the top finishers and medals for everyone who finishes
additional: The event also includes children's races over a distance of approximately 200 meters. Participants can use the entry form available on the website to contact the organizer and system administrator quickly. Participants can use training plans lasting from 8 to 20 weeks. The event is supported by a local building-supply store, and the participant limit is 60.

name: Coconaut Pomerania Summer Trail
description: Pomerania Summer Trail is a running challenge on the hilly trails of Pomerania, offering three distances: 45 km, 25 km, and 10 km. The event takes place in the picturesque area of Czymanowo, right by Lake Żarnowieckie and the Kaszubskie Oko observation tower, creating a unique trail-running atmosphere. The organizer, the Pomerania Sports Association, together with local sports centers, invites both first-time participants and experienced ultrarunners to take part in this unforgettable event. It’s a great opportunity to take on challenging courses and enjoy the beauty of Kashubian nature.
course_highlights: Hilly Kashubian trails
Courses of 45 km, 25 km, and 10 km
Start and finish by Lake Żarnowieckie and the Kaszubskie Oko observation tower
additional: Online registration usually closes 7 days before the event, but registration on race day may be possible if places are still available. The organizer provides a great race village at the concert square in Czymanowo, by Lake Żarnowieckie and the Kaszubskie Oko observation tower. The event offers different distances, GPX files to download, and requires specific equipment. The race takes place in a beautiful area with access to tourist attractions in Kashubia and Pomerania.

name: IV Bilczańska Dycha
organizer: Zakład Gospodarki Komunalnej i Rekreacji w Morawicy
description: The 3rd Bilczańska Dycha is a 10 km road race held in the recreational area of Bilcza Park in the Municipality of Morawica. The event is aimed at running enthusiasts of all ages, and children’s races and a family festival are also held on race day. The race is open to all and promotes active recreation in the scenic surroundings of the Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship.
course_highlights: The course runs through the recreational area of Bilcza Park
A 10 km road race
Scenic surroundings in the Municipality of Morawica
additional: A family festival and children’s races are also held on race day. The event includes children’s races, a family festival, and recreational activities at Bilcza Park. Registration is available online, and the event promotes active recreation and integration within the local community.

name: 23 Wilcza Dycha
location: Osieczna, Powiat choszczeński, województwo zachodniopomorskie, Poland
description: Borowiacka Dycha is an annual 10 km race organized by the Biegające Śliwice association. The event promotes an active lifestyle and attracts runners from the region, offering a scenic route through the Tuchola Forests. The race takes place in Osieczna and is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich. Participants can expect professional organization and a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km route
Scenic terrain in the Tuchola Forests
The race takes place in Osieczna
additional: The event is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich series, with the chance to win a unique collection as part of the series. Participants can expect competitive racing and attractive prizes.

name: 7 Szamotulska Nocna Piątka
description: Szamotulska Nocna Piątka is an annual, officially certified 5 km race held in Szamotuły. The course runs through the town’s streets, giving participants the opportunity to compete at a professional level with officially recognized results. The event is open to everyone, including children and families, who can take part in accompanying races over shorter distances. The main race starts in the evening, giving the event its distinctive nighttime atmosphere. The organizers look after participants’ comfort by providing refreshments after the race and awards ceremonies for the winners.
course_highlights: Course certified by the Polish Athletics Association
Night race starting at 21:55
Urban course through the streets of Szamotuły
additional: Temporary traffic arrangements will be in place on race day, with parking disruptions and designated detours. Race packs can be collected from 17:00 to 21:30. Refreshments for participants and awards ceremonies for the winners are planned after the race. There are 26 free race packs available for people with disabilities in the family race, accompanied by a caregiver, upon request by email. The event includes road closures and detours, and offers various distances, including 5 km, 255 m, and 555 m. Participants can find news and information on the website and Facebook.

name: 8 Bieg Chwalisza
description: The 8th edition of the Chwalisz Run is an annual charity race taking place on June 13, 2026, in Ściernie. The start and finish are located at Preschool No. 1 – Ściernie branch. The 5 km course runs mainly along forest paths, with very little asphalt, offering both challenges and the joy of running for experienced runners and beginners alike. All entry fees will go towards supporting Antoś Synowiec, a child with a rare genetic disease, highlighting the charitable nature of the event. The organizers also invite participants to join group training sessions every Thursday at 19:00.
course_highlights: 5 km course with very little asphalt
Challenging forest sections
Start and finish at Preschool No. 1 – Ściernie branch
additional: Professional timing accurate to one-hundredth of a second. The event combines sport with charitable support. Group training sessions take place every Thursday at 19:00, starting from the preschool in Ściernie, at 17 Kamienna Street. A family festival accompanies the race. The 5 km course includes forest sections; the event is charitable and includes a family festival and Thursday training sessions at 19:00.

name: Bieg Iskry
description: Bieg Iskry is a unique running event taking place on June 13, 2026, at Mielec Airport. Participants will cover a 6.5 km route along the runway with the lights on and the sun setting, creating a one-of-a-kind aviation atmosphere. The organizers provide professional medals, T-shirts featuring the Iskra aircraft, and prizes including trophies and vouchers for tandem flights. After the race, participants can admire the aircraft and enjoy refreshments and dietary supplements.
course_highlights: A 6.5 km route along the runway at Mielec Airport
A race with the lights on and the sun setting
Start, finish, and awards ceremony in the hangars of the White-and-Red Wings Foundation
additional: Participants will receive running T-shirts featuring the Iskra aircraft, commemorative medals, and trophies and diplomas in the open and age categories. Medical and sanitary facilities will be available. At the end, there will be a draw for a glider flight sponsored by the Polish Aviation Foundation. Event partner DepilConcept salon is providing a voucher for photoepilation treatments for the first woman to cross the finish line. Airport grounds, online registration, medals, T-shirts, prizes, aviation attractions, post-race meals

name: Bieg Recepta na Zdrowie
location: Łódzki Park Arturówek, Łódź, Łódzkie, Poland
description: The eighth national “Recepta na Zdrowie” run will take place on 13 June 2026 in Arturówek, Łódź. This healthy running event promotes physical activity, integration between the running and pharmaceutical communities, and a healthy lifestyle. The race routes follow a 5 km loop in Łagiewnicki Forest, with 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as 5 km Nordic Walking. Shorter races on the same route are planned for children and young people. A family picnic with free health checks and consultations will be held near the start and finish.
course_highlights: The running and Nordic Walking routes follow a 5 km loop in Łagiewnicki Forest
Two 5 km loops for the 10 km distance
Family picnic with blood pressure and blood sugar checks and consultations
additional: The start and finish are by the Arturówek recreational facilities. The race office will be open from 8:00 on race day. The 5 km run and Nordic Walking start together at 10:00, the children’s and youth races begin at 12:00, and the 10 km run starts at 13:30. The course is not certified. Awards and prizes for children and young people will be presented immediately after their races. Registration for children requires an account on zapisy.inessport.pl. The event, supported by organizers from the pharmaceutical industry, places strong emphasis on promoting a healthy lifestyle and preventive healthcare. It takes place in June 2026 in Arturówek, Łódź.

name: Biegi w Rogoźniku
organizer: Gminne Centrum Kultury i Sportu w Bobrownikach
description: The Rogoźnik Runs is an annual running event held in the picturesque village of Rogoźnik. The races offer a variety of courses, including races for children and young people, as well as distances of 8.4 km and 15.5 km. The event is supported by local institutions and sponsors, and participants can expect professional organization and a friendly atmosphere. It is a great opportunity to enjoy the outdoors and compete in sport.
course_highlights: Courses of 8.4 km and 15.5 km
Races for children and young people
Picturesque surroundings of Rogoźnik
additional: The start list is available online. Supported by local institutions and sponsors. Race courses are available as maps on the website. Races for children and young people are held alongside the main races. Various distances and courses; online registration; support from local sponsors and institutions.

name: Leśna ZaDyszka
location: Leśnictwo Szulmierz, gmina Regimin, Mazowieckie, Poland
description: Leśna ZaDyszka is a race held in the picturesque Szulmierz Forest District in the Regimin municipality, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle in forest areas. The course is a 5 km loop along forest tracks and a section of asphalt, showcasing the beauty of the Mazovian countryside. Participants can choose from three events: 5 km, 10 km (two loops), and 5 km Nordic Walking. Children can take part in a 1.5 km run with no classification. The start and finish are on a forest clearing by the Szulmierz-Regimin road, and times are recorded using a professional chip timing system.
course_highlights: A 5 km loop along forest tracks and asphalt
Views of the Mazovian countryside and a fallow deer farm
The course is safeguarded by volunteers
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 on the forest clearing by the Szulmierz-Regimin road. Participants receive a commemorative medal and a restorative meal after the race. They can choose a standard T-shirt at no extra cost or a Premium LAS T-shirt for an additional 20 zł. Times are recorded using chips attached to participants’ shoes. Prizes are awarded for age-group and overall placements, with a prize draw among participants. Courses include forest tracks and asphalt, with various distances and categories, including running, Nordic Walking, and Cross Duathlon. Entry fees depend on the registration date.

name: Memoriał Mariana Szymańskiego
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Radomsku
description: The 13th Radomsko Street Run, the Marian Szymański Memorial, is an annual running event held in Radomsko to commemorate Marian Szymański. The race takes place on the city streets, giving participants the chance to compete in a friendly atmosphere. It is organized by the City of Radomsko and the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Radomsko, with timing provided by Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu. The race is scheduled to start at 17:30, and online registration is open until 10 June 2026.
course_highlights: 10 km street race
Participation in a memorial race commemorating Marian Szymański
Organized by MOSiR Radomsko, with electronic timing
additional: The event is scheduled for 13 June 2026, with a 17:30 start. Online registration is open until 10 June 2026. The race takes place on the streets of Radomsko.

description: Szamotulska Nocna Piątka is an annual road race in Szamotuły, certified by the Polish Athletic Association. The 5 km course runs through the town streets, offering official results and a unique night-race atmosphere. The event is open to everyone, including children and families, who can take part in accompanying races. It attracts considerable interest, and participants can look forward to refreshments and an awards ceremony after the race.
course_highlights: A 5 km course certified by the Polish Athletic Association
A night race starting at 21:55
Route through the streets of Sportowa, Lipowa, Szczęsnego, Kolarska, Wioślarska, Łąkowa, 3 Maja and Staszica
additional: Temporary traffic changes apply on race day, with parking restrictions and designated detours. Race packs are distributed from 17:00 to 21:30. Refreshments and an awards ceremony for the winners are planned after the race. Free race packs are available for people with disabilities taking part in the family race with a guardian. The 5 km race starts at 21:00; the course is marked every 1 km and has a limit of 800 participants. Various categories are available, including family and children’s races, with race packs containing T-shirts and medals. An event schedule and traffic restrictions for the duration of the race are planned.

name: VIII Kwidzyńska zaDyszka
description: The 8th Kwidzyńska zaDyszka is a 10 km road race taking place on June 13, 2026, in Kwidzyn. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for race day with training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is aimed at runners with varying levels of experience who want to stay active and compete on a course of moderate difficulty. The organizers provide expert support and access to a platform for managing race information.
course_highlights: 10 km road course
Scenic surroundings in Kwidzyn
Course of moderate difficulty
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level. Expert support and a platform for managing the race profile and marketing collaboration are provided. Registration runs from April 17 to June 8, 2025; participant limit: 200.

name: XII Wojewódzki Bieg Przełajowy o Puchar ...
location: Zagwiździe, Gmina Murów, Opole Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 12th Voivodeship Badger Cup Cross-Country Run is a running event organized by the Municipality of Murów. It will take place on June 13, 2026, in Zagwiździe, on the grounds of the historic Ironworks complex. The event includes several categories: a 12 km run, a 3.5 km run, children’s races, and Nordic Walking. The race office will be open from 8:00 to 9:30, and timing will be electronic. This sporting event combines competition with a beautiful historic setting, encouraging physical activity and community engagement.
course_highlights: The course runs through the grounds of the historic Ironworks complex
Several distances and categories are available: 12 km, 3.5 km, children’s races, and Nordic Walking
Electronic timing provides accurate results
additional: The race office is open from 8:00 to 9:30. Categories include a 12 km run, a 3.5 km run, children’s races, and Nordic Walking. The organizer is the Municipality of Murów. Timing is electronic. Registration is open from 8:00 to 9:30. Various age categories are available. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle.

name: XIX Bieg Marszałka
description: The 19th Marshal’s Run is an annual road race held in Sulejówek, commemorating the traditions of the pre-war Sulejówek–Belweder marches. The main race, approximately 10 km long, takes place in June and commemorates Józef Piłsudski settling in Sulejówek. The event also includes accompanying races, including the Halina Zielińska Memorial over 3.6 km and races for children. The race has a patriotic and sporting character, with uniformed services and museum staff taking part. The start and finish are at 94 Paderewskiego Street, next to Willa Bzów.
course_highlights: Main race of approximately 10 km on the streets of Sulejówek
Halina Zielińska Memorial over approximately 3.6 km
Traditional start and finish by Willa Bzów, 94 Paderewskiego Street
additional: The main race and the Halina Zielińska Memorial start at 10:20, the Little Kids’ Run at 10:30, and the Older Kids’ Run at 10:40. A flower-laying ceremony at the monument to Marshal Józef Piłsudski takes place at 9:50. Race packages can be officially and safely transferred to another participant. Uniformed services and museum staff also compete in separate categories. Registration and race-package collection take place at the Józef Piłsudski Museum, with registration also available by email. The event features various distances and forms of competition, including races for children and seniors.

name: XV Bieg Szlakiem Króla Zygmunta Starego
description: The 15th Run in the Footsteps of King Sigismund the Old is an annual race held in Kozienice, commemorating a historic route associated with King Sigismund the Old. The event attracts runners from various regions, offering a scenic course and sporting competition. The organizers provide professional support and a welcoming atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: A race course following the historic route of King Sigismund the Old
Scenic landscapes of Kozienice and the surrounding area
A well-marked and prepared running course
additional: Registration for the event is available online; the event attracts nearly 180 runners, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in the region.

name: XV Siemiatycka Wieczorna Dycha
location: Amfiteatr miejski, Grodzieńska 31, Siemiatycze, Podlaskie, Poland
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Siemiatyczach
description: The XV Siemiatycze Evening 10K is a 10 km road race held in Siemiatycze. The start and finish are at the municipal amphitheatre at 31 Grodzieńska Street. The course follows the city’s asphalt streets. In addition to the main 10 km race, there are also 5 km races and a 400 m race for children. The event takes place in the evening, with a start time of 18:00. Participants can use municipal parking near the amphitheatre.
course_highlights: Asphalt course through the streets of Siemiatycze
Start and finish at the municipal amphitheatre, 31 Grodzieńska Street
Additional 5 km races and a 400 m race for children
additional: Participants can park at the municipal car park along Nadrzeczna Street and at the municipal car park behind the Biedronka store. The race office is located at the municipal amphitheatre at 31 Grodzieńska Street. Participants in the M65, M70+ and K60+ categories in the 10 km race, and the M65+ and K60+ categories in the 5 km race, are exempt from the entry fee. Participants can take part free of charge in the M65+, M70+ and K60+ categories. Registration is through the Time2go.pl platform. The race takes place on asphalt, and its evening format makes it an attractive sporting and social event in the region.

Bieg Wolności Podatkowej IFirma Bieg Stacjonarny i Wirtualny
XIX Bieg Zajączkowski
location: Zajączki Drugie, Gmina Krzepice, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
