name: Ultra Nízke Tatry
description: Ultra Nízke Tatry is the first edition of a mountain running event that follows the ridge of the Low Tatras from west to east. The route is 49.7 km long, with 2,650 metres of elevation gain, and follows marked hiking trails from Donovaly to Srdiečko. The event is part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association calendar and also serves as the Milan Styka Memorial, in honour of the prominent runner and mountaineer who tragically died in 2025. The start is scheduled for 13 June 2026 at 7:00 in Donovaly, by the Donovalský pivovar brewery.
course_highlights: 49.7 km route with 2,650 m of elevation gain
Along the Low Tatras ridge from Donovaly to Srdiečko
The route follows red, green and yellow hiking markers, passing M. R. Štefánik Chalet and Kosodrevina
additional: Registration is available online from 20.12.2025 at 0:00, and also at the start venue, Donovalský pivovar, on 13.6.2026 from 16:00 to 21:00 and on race morning from 6:00 to 6:45. The provisional cutoff at Chopok, after 37 km, is 15:00 (8 hours after the start). The organizer reserves the right to change the route depending on the weather and to set time limits. The route passes through mountain terrain. Additional information concerns registration, the memorial nature of the event, possible weather-related route changes, and time limits set according to conditions.

name: Strečnianska mašľa
description: Strečnianska Mašľa is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance hike around Strečno, taking place on 13 June 2026. The event offers two routes: a challenging 50 km route with approximately 2,985 metres of elevation gain and a shorter 25 km route, which is also suitable for runners with dogs. The routes follow marked hiking trails through both parts of the Malá Fatra and part of a national park, with the start and finish at the Radinové football field in Strečno. The organizers provide race packs, prizes for the top finishers, and good conditions for participants.
course_highlights: 50 km route with approximately 2,985 m of elevation gain through the Malá Fatra
Routes follow marked hiking trails and pass through a national park
Start and finish at the Radinové football field in Strečno
additional: Participant limits: 300 for the 50 km route, 300 for the 25 km route, and 50 for the 25 km route with a dog. Race numbers and chips are assigned by the organizers. Mandatory equipment includes a first-aid kit, valid identification, insurance covering Mountain Rescue Service intervention, a charged mobile phone, a personal drinking container, a whistle or bells (recommended for the 50 km route), a map or GPS route, sunglasses, and sunscreen. Overnight stays are possible in the changing rooms or tents at the football field. Accommodation is also available at Pizzeria Alžbetka and SIP ŽSR Strečno. The race offers certified routes; registration opens on 1 March 2026. The event is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League, and the course passes through Malá Fatra National Park.

name: Krosak pod hradom
organizer: Mgr. Ján Podstavský, Vladimír Adam, Ing. Ladislav Ondrik, Vladimír Sikorai, Gabriel Sabo, Štefan Karafa
description: Krosák pod hradom is a running race in Trnava pri Laborci, offering various categories, including the 10 km Big Cross-Country Run, the 5 km Small Cross-Country Run, a Health Run, and Nordic Walking. The course follows farm and forest roads with asphalt surfaces, while the Big Cross-Country Run consists of two 5 km loops. The race is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Running League and is suitable for a wide range of runners, from juniors to veterans. The race starts at the Municipal Office in Trnava pri Laborci. Children’s races start at 9:00, and the main race at 11:00.
course_highlights: The course follows farm and forest roads with asphalt surfaces
The Big Cross-Country Run is 10 km (2 × 5 km loops)
The race takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Trnava pri Laborci
additional: Race check-in begins at 8:00 at the Municipal Office; check-in for children’s categories begins at 7:30. New registrations on race day are possible only while race numbers remain available. On-site payment is €25. The event takes place on 13 June 2026, with starts at 09:00 and 11:00. It includes 10 km, 5 km, and Nordic Walking categories, with an emphasis on charitable causes and community participation.

name: Kysucký maratón
location: Čadca, Čadca, Matičné námestie - pred Domom kultúry Čadca, Slovakia
price_range: 35 EUR do 1. 5. 2026, 40 EUR po 1. 5. 2026, 25 EUR pre účastníkov z okresu Čadca
description: The Kysuce Marathon is the second-oldest marathon in Slovakia and a major sporting and social event in the Kysuce region. The course runs through the picturesque Kysuce valley along the Kysuca River, with a safer and more attractive route along the running and cycling path introduced in 2025. In addition to the marathon, the event includes a half marathon, a marathon relay and a children’s minimarathon. The start and finish are at Matičné Square in Čadca, in front of the House of Culture. Races are held in various age categories, and participants have access to refreshment stations and facilities including changing rooms and wellness services.
course_highlights: The course runs through the picturesque Kysuce valley along the Kysuca River
A safe and attractive route along the running and cycling path (Bystrica Cycling Highway)
The marathon turnaround is at the square by the Slovak Astronomical Clock in Stará Bystrica
additional: The start and finish are at Matičné Square in Čadca, in front of the House of Culture. There are 8 refreshment stations along the course. Refreshments are provided after the race. Participants can use the changing rooms, swimming pool and sauna at the local swimming pool. The marathon time limit is 5 hours for 40 km; runners who exceed this time are not guaranteed a place in the results. Certified course, refreshment stations along the route, changing rooms, swimming pool, sauna, post-race refreshments, online registration until 1.6.2026, no insurance provided by the organizers

name: Beh Hodkovským parkom

price_tiers.distance: Beh pre zdravie 4 km a Nordic walking 4 km

description: The Run through Hodkovce Park is a running event held on the grounds of Hodkovce Manor in Žehra. The course runs mostly along farm and forest roads, with some asphalt sections. The event features an 8 km competitive race for various men’s and women’s age groups, as well as non-competitive 4 km categories for Run for Health and Nordic walking, with no age restrictions. The organizer, DOMOVINA n.o., provides a welcoming atmosphere and quality organization for all participants. Discounted entry is available online, encouraging early registration.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly along farm and forest roads, with an asphalt section
The event takes place on the grounds of Hodkovce Manor in Žehra
Categories for various age groups, plus non-competitive running and Nordic walking options
additional: Entry is €7 for online registration by 12 June 2025, and €9 on site. The course is suitable for various age groups and includes non-competitive running and Nordic walking options. The start and finish are on the grounds of DSS DOMOVINA n.o. in Žehra, in the Hodkovce area. The event includes various categories for all age groups. Registration is open until 12 June 2025; the course includes forest paths, farm roads and asphalt sections.

name: Beh Kalváriou
description: Beh Kalváriou is a charity running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Kalvária in Považská Bystrica. The event offers courses for both adults and children, with forest paths making up the course surface. This fourth edition is an opportunity to experience community, exercise, and joy, with proceeds from the race going to children in need. The organizers emphasize high-quality event management and support for charitable causes.
course_highlights: Forest paths in the surroundings of Kalvária
Courses for adults and children
A scenic, varied course with good weather
additional: Registration is available online only through vysledkovyservis.sk. Registration will not be available at the venue or on race day. After the entry fee is paid, the participant’s name will appear on the list of registered participants and a confirmation will be sent by email. You can make a voluntary contribution during registration to support Hugo and Simonka. The participant limit is 500 adults and 250 children. The event follows the rules of the Slovak Athletics Federation. Registration is online only; the event is charitable; the participant limit is 500 adults and 250 children; starts are scheduled for 10:00 for children and 12:15 for adults.

name: Lemešanská bežecká liga 2. Letné kolo
location: Lemešany, Lúka nad obcou Lemešany, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Lemešany, Športová komisia obce Lemešany, Záhrada pohybu
price_range: dospelí: 10 € online, 15 € na mieste; občania obce: 5 € online, 10 € na mieste; deti a juniorské: 3 €; detské behy zdarma
description: The Lemešany Running League 2nd Summer Round is a running event held in Lemešany, on the meadow above the village. The race is divided into several categories by age and gender, including children’s categories and Nordic walking. The main categories start at 17:00, and the children’s categories start at 17:10. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant summer race atmosphere.
course_highlights: Various categories for all age groups, including children and adults
Online registration with a low entry fee
Children’s races on the meadow are free
additional: Categories: Men A (ages 18–39), Men B (ages 40 and over), Women F (ages 18–39), Women G (ages 40 and over), Girls/Boys 1 (ages 12–14), Girls/Boys 2 (ages 15–17), Children under 12 (accompanied by an adult only), Nordic Walking men/women. Children’s races on the meadow are free. Online registration until 12 June 2026. An additional €2 entry fee is payable for the race bib. Starts at 17:00 and 17:10.

name: Beh na chatu pri Zelenom plese – Memoriál K. Jakeša
location: Tatranský Mlyn pri Zelenom plese, Vysoké Tatry, Prešovský kraj, Slovakia
description: The Run to the Green Lake Hut is a mountain race for sports and nature enthusiasts, suitable for amateur and professional athletes alike. The event has been held regularly since 2005 on the second weekend of June and commemorates Karel Jakeš, a prominent Czechoslovak mountaineer. The course crosses challenging mountain terrain with significant elevation gain, making it a test for all participants. The aim is to bring together different sporting groups and offer them a unique experience in the beautiful surroundings of the High Tatras.
course_highlights: Course distance: 7.7 km
Total elevation gain: 651 m
Total elevation loss: 18 m
additional: The event is held with financial support from the Ministry of Tourism and Sport of the Slovak Republic. The race brings athletes, runners, alpinists, skiers, mountaineers, cyclists and ski mountaineers together as one sporting community. Registration for the 20th edition is closed. The race takes place in June 2026. Registration is available on the official website. The course starts at the Biela voda bus stop and finishes at the Green Lake Hut. It is suitable for runners of all levels who love mountain challenges.

name: Běh zámeckým parkem Kravaře
location: Zámecký park, Kravaře, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run through Kravaře Chateau Park is a traditional running race organized by the Prajzský běžecký klub Kravaře, held in the picturesque chateau park in Kravaře. The race offers an 8.7 km course for adults and shorter courses for children, divided by age category. The surface consists of gravel paths, and the course follows three loops through the park. The event is suitable for recreational runners and families with children, with welcoming facilities and refreshments for all participants.
course_highlights: The course follows three loops through the chateau park
The surface consists of gravel paths
The main course for adults is 8.7 km long
additional: Children’s check-in takes place from 8:30 to 9:10, and children start at 9:15. Children’s categories are divided by age, with course distances ranging from 150 m to 1,800 m. Adults are provided with cake and drinks, while children receive a sweet reward. Facilities include changing rooms and showers at the MFK Kravaře complex. A trail run on gravel paths in the chateau park, registration for adults and children, various age categories, refreshments and prizes.

name: Půlmaraton okolo Prahy 4
location: Žluté lázně, Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Prague 4 Half Marathon is a unique individual running event offering a meditative running experience on the varied terrain of an urban trail. The course is approximately 21 kilometres long and follows the perimeter of the Prague 4 district, giving participants a chance to get to know the area and test their own running fitness. There is no mass start: runners set off individually or in small groups between 9:00 and 10:00, eliminating stress and congestion at the start and on the course. Following a successful debut, the half marathon is being held for the second time and is suitable for anyone who wants to combine athletic effort with an enjoyable experience in nature and the city.
course_highlights: Urban trail with varied terrain
Approximately 21 km loop around Prague 4
Individual start between 9:00 and 10:00, with no mass gathering
additional: The event is run individually, with a flexible start between 9:00 and 10:00. Participants can run alone or in small groups, using a map on their phone or on paper. With no congestion at the start, on the course or at the finish, the event offers a relaxed experience. Individual course, marked route, start between 9:00 and 10:00, event is part of the Trail Running Cup series, run at your own risk, take extra care when crossing roads

name: Přespolní běh areálem zdraví Chábory
location: Chábory u Dobrušky, Chábory, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Chábory Health Centre Cross-Country Run is a traditional race organized by the Chábory Volunteer Fire Brigade, held in the picturesque health centre grounds near Dobruška. The event features a main 10,000-metre race and other categories on a 3,330-metre loop, for men, women, juniors and the general public aged 4 to 90. It is part of the East Bohemia Grand Prix in running and welcomes all generations under the motto “GET FIT!”. Participants can look forward to certificates, prizes and a raffle, while the overall winner of the main race receives a perpetual trophy.
course_highlights: A 3,330 m loop along field and forest paths
Main race: 10,000 m
Categories for everyone aged 4 to 90
additional: Race check-in takes place from 8:00 to 9:30. The 50 Kč entry fee is paid at check-in as a contribution towards administration and refreshments. The results announcement and prize presentation are scheduled for 11:25. Competitors take part at their own risk and must comply with current hygiene measures. The race takes place on 14 June 2026; registration is open until 13 June 2026 at 20:00. In addition to the main 10,000 m race, shorter distances are also available. Certificates, prizes and a trophy for the overall winner are up for grabs.

name: Chaloupecký kros
location: Chaloupky, Komárov, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The Chaloupecký Cross-Country Race is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Chaloupky near Komárov. It offers two main routes of approximately 8 km and 4 km, running on asphalt, forest paths, and meadows. The main race starts at 10:00, giving participants a combination of natural beauty and sporting challenge. The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup and is suitable for the general public. There are no children’s categories.
course_highlights: Surface: asphalt, forest paths, meadows
Route distances: 8 km and 4 km
Start in Chaloupky near Komárov
additional: The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup. Children’s races are not part of this event. The route surface combines asphalt, forest paths, and meadows. Routes: 8 km and 4 km; start at 10:00; no children’s races; different distances for different categories.

name: Běh na Hraničář
location: Lesní divadlo u Úhlavy, Nýrsko, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: The Běh na Hraničář is a traditional and prestigious hill race held in the picturesque surroundings of the forest theatre by the Úhlava River in Nýrsko. The 5 km route, with 380 metres of elevation gain, passes the ruins of Pajrek Castle and finishes at the summit of Hraničář, with a stunning view of Mount Ostrý. The race is part of the Czech Hill Running Cup and has been held again since 2020 after a three-year break. After the race, participants must make their own way back to the start.
course_highlights: Start by the forest theatre on the Úhlava River
380 metres of elevation gain over a 5 km course
Finish at the summit of Hraničář, with a view of Mount Ostrý
additional: The race is part of the Czech Hill Running Cup. After the race, participants must make their own way back to the start. The event includes a 5 km main category and children's races; on-site registration is open from 9:15 to 10:15; the course is mostly trail, with a hilly profile and a climb to the summit of Hraničář.

name: Dobývání Dívčích hradů
description: Conquering Dívčí Hrady is a 2 km uphill race with 135 metres of elevation gain, held in Hlubočepy, Prague 5. The race is part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series and offers runners the challenge of a demanding climb. The course runs through scenic terrain with beautiful views, making the race appealing to fans of mountain running and uphill running. It is suitable for anyone looking to test their endurance and strength on hilly terrain.
course_highlights: 2 km course with 135 m of elevation gain
Demanding uphill race in Hlubočepy, Prague
Part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series
additional: The race is part of the cycling section—a duathlon, with the option to compete in various categories and results recorded for over 78 runners in the past.

name: Kefenröder Dorflauf
description: The 35th Dorflauf in Kefenrod takes place on June 13, 2026, and is organized by Turnverein 1908 Kefenrod e.V. The event gives runners of all ages the opportunity to take part in a long-standing race in the idyllic surroundings of Kefenrod. Registration is via the Oberhessencup website, making it easy to sign up in advance. The race is an established part of club life and promotes community and sporting exchange in the region.
course_highlights: Four laps through Kefenrod with varied elevation
Distances of 1 km and 10 km for different ability levels
Festive awards ceremony with food and a community atmosphere
additional: Registration is via the Oberhessencup website (ohc18). No start times or pricing tiers are listed directly on the website. The race is part of the club life of TV 1908 Kefenrod e.V. It is also part of the local running calendar and, alongside the competition, offers a sociable atmosphere, with coffee, cake, beer, and grilled food at the awards ceremony.

name: Eschathlon - Der Eschborner Halbmarathon
description: The Eschathlon is a popular city race in Eschborn that attracts numerous running enthusiasts every year. The half marathon is the main event, featuring an attractive course around Eschenplatz. Other events include a 10 km race, a 5 km race, a 20 km relay, a FIT Walk, and children’s races. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with entertainment and refreshments, making it ideal for runners of all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Loop course around Eschenplatz in Eschborn
Relay exchange zone at Neugasse 1A
Course with refreshment stations and volunteer posts
additional: The start and finish are at Eschenplatz in Eschborn. The 20 km relay consists of 4 x 5 km laps, with the exchange zone at Neugasse 1A. A race shirt is guaranteed for entries received by 30 April. Late entries are possible up to race day, but without a shirt guarantee. Entertainment and refreshments will be available on site from 09:00 to 14:00. Half marathon on 14 June 2026; children’s races; relay races; registration opens at the end of March; early-bird discounts until 30 April; additional entry places available from 1 May.

name: EVL-HalbMarathon Leverkusen
description: The EVL Half Marathon in Leverkusen is a traditional and challenging half marathon, taking place for the 24th time on June 14, 2026. The 21.1-kilometre course runs through the sports city of Leverkusen and features a special highlight: a passage through the BayArena, home ground of Bayer 04 Leverkusen. The hill-climb competition on Sauerberg presents another challenge. The race is open to runners of all ability levels, from beginners to professional runners, and offers a unique running experience with plenty of atmosphere and a sense of community.
course_highlights: The course runs right through the BayArena
Hill-climb competition on Sauerberg
A varied 21.1-kilometre route through Leverkusen
additional: Start and finish on Bismarckstraße, between the Ostermann-Arena and the BayArena. Runners born in 2010 or earlier are eligible for the half marathon, those born in 2016 or earlier for the 10 km race, and those born in 2018 or earlier for the 5 km race. Race bibs are non-transferable and must be worn clearly visible. There are still places available in the Bambini races. The 2026 event shirt is available. The organiser recommends a good training plan, including recovery and nutrition tips from running coach Andrea von Horn. The event takes place in all weather conditions. The course runs through Leverkusen, including the BayArena; registration for the Bambini races; event shirt and merchandise; podcast with tips and stories.

name: Niederelberter Gickellauf
description: The Niederelbert Gickellauf is a popular running event in Niederelbert, offering various race distances for children and adults. In addition to the children’s races over 800 metres and 2 kilometres, there are also 5- and 10-kilometre races. The event is part of a family festival that creates a sociable atmosphere and highlights the commitment to grassroots sport of SV Blau-Weiss 1908 Niederelbert e.V. The race encourages both sporting ambition and a sense of community in the region.
course_highlights: Children’s races over 800 m and 2 km
5 km and 10 km race distances
Family festival with a variety of highlights
additional: The Gickellauf takes place as part of a family festival that promotes social cohesion across the club’s departments. Races for children and adults are offered, and the event is part of the grassroots sports programme of SV Blau-Weiss 1908 Niederelbert e.V. Various distances; online registration available; no entry fee.

name: Sauerland-Höhenflug-Trailrun
description: The Sauerland-Höhenflug-Trailrun is a popular running event in the Sauerland, taking place on June 14, 2026. The event offers various distances from 0.4 km to a half marathon, running through the varied landscape of the Sauerland-Höhenflug. The trail run is open to runners of all ages and ability levels and is organized by Skiclub Hagen-Wildewiese e.V. in cooperation with Sauerland Tourismus and Naturpark Sauerland-Rothaargebirge. The event is part of the Volksbank-Sauerland-Laufcup and features a special sprint classification over the final 200 meters of the longer distances.
course_highlights: Distances from 0.4 km to a half marathon through the Sauerland
Sprint classification over the final 200 meters for the 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon
Various age groups and classifications, including races for schoolchildren
additional: The trail run includes several age groups and distances, including a Bambini run, races for schoolchildren, and main races. Timing is provided by Time and Voice using RaceResult. The half-marathon cutoff time is 3:15 hours. The event is part of the 2025 Volksbank-Sauerland-Laufcup. On-site late registration is available for an additional fee of €3. Distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon; online registration; nature experience in the Sauerland; annual event in June

name: Barmstedter Stadtlauf
description: The 22nd Barmstedter City Run takes place on 14 June 2026 in Barmstedt. The event features measured, course-record-eligible 5 km and 10 km circuits. In addition to the main races, there are Nordic walking, walking, children’s races and Bambini races. The start and finish are at the Market Square in Barmstedt, and the course runs through the town centre and around Lake Rantzau, over a variety of surfaces including cobblestones, asphalt and firm sandy paths.
course_highlights: Measured, course-record-eligible 5 km and 10 km circuits
Course through Barmstedt town centre and around Lake Rantzau
Varied surfaces: cobblestones, asphalt and firm sandy paths
additional: Timing uses a rental chip worn around the ankle (except in the children’s races); the chip is collected at the finish. Unreturned chips will be charged at 40 euros. Baby joggers and dogs are not permitted for safety reasons. Different age categories and minimum ages apply to the races. The course may vary slightly due to construction work; information will then be posted on the website. Courses are measured; online registration is available; no late entries; refreshments and medals included.

name: Donatus-Lauf
location: Sportgelände SC Fortuna Liblar, Hamburg-Rissen, Hamburg, Germany
description: The Donatuslauf takes place on June 14, 2026, around Lake Donatus at the SC Fortuna Liblar sports grounds in Hamburg-Rissen. The event offers various race distances, from a 400 m Bambini run and 1,200 m children’s races to a half marathon and a 10 km main race. The races are designed for different age groups and offer a family-friendly atmosphere, with additional walking and family races. The course is varied and well marked, with the start and finish area close to Erftstadt railway station. Award ceremonies take place shortly after the races, and certificates can be downloaded online.
course_highlights: A range of distances from 400 m to the half marathon
Start and finish area near Erftstadt railway station, with easy access
Family run and Nordic walking as additional options
additional: Late entries are accepted only until the participant limit is reached and incur a €3 late-entry fee. Award ceremonies take place at the sports grounds immediately after each race. Parking is available only at Erftstadt railway station, just 100 m from the start and finish area. Certificates can be downloaded online as PDFs and printed. Courses around Lake Donatus; online registration; parking at Erftstadt railway station; start and finish area at the SC Fortuna Liblar sports grounds.

name: Eifelmarathon
description: The Eifel Marathon on June 14, 2026, in Waxweiler offers a varied running event featuring a marathon, ultramarathon, trail race, half marathon, 10 km fitness run, hiking marathon, and children’s race. The routes pass through the scenic Eifel region, with varied elevation and well-equipped aid stations. The start and finish are in Waxweiler, with a shuttle service to the half-marathon start in Hamm. The event is part of the new Mini-Cup Deutschland and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with medals for all participants.
course_highlights: Marathon course: 42.195 km with 764 m of elevation gain
Ultramarathon: 51.4 km with 983 m of elevation gain, including a scenic loop through the forest
The half marathon starts in Hamm, with a shuttle service, and follows the reservoir and the Prüm River back to Waxweiler
additional: Race bib pickup on Saturday, June 13, 2026, from 17:00 to 19:00, with a pasta party. On race day (June 14, 2026), race bib pickup is from 07:00 to 09:00. The course closes for all races at 16:00. Every participant receives a medal. Aid stations are staffed from 09:30. Shuttle service for the half marathon from Waxweiler to Hamm. Hiking marathon: approx. 30 km on the Eifel Marathon course. Part of Mini-Cup Deutschland, with prize money for participants who complete three races in Germany. Course approx. 30 km (Waxweiler - Hamm - Waxweiler), start at 08:00, course closes at 16:00, aid stations from 09:30, marked course, medal for all participants.

name: Hahner Kitzenhauslauf
description: The Hahner Kitzenhauslauf is a popular running event in the border region of Germany, Belgium and the Netherlands. The natural, hilly and varied courses in the south of Aachen offer runners a challenging and scenic experience. The event has a long tradition and attracts runners from the region and beyond. It is known for its friendly atmosphere and well-organised races.
course_highlights: Natural running courses in the south of Aachen
Hilly and varied terrain
Scenic routes
additional: Courses for Bambini, schoolchildren, the one-tenth marathon and the half marathon; races counting toward the Regio Aachen Laufcup; refreshments, certificates, photos and live results

name: Integrationslauf des VfB Reichenbach
description: The VfB Reichenbach Integration Run in Reichenbach-Steegen is an annual running event that has been part of the municipality’s event calendar since 2016. The run promotes inclusion and integration through sport by overcoming barriers and enabling people to build connections. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers a shared sporting experience in the region.
course_highlights: Fun run in the municipality of Reichenbach-Steegen
Promotes integration and community through sport
Held since 2016, with a break during the COVID-19 pandemic
additional: The event takes place at the sports grounds in Reichenbach-Steegen and promotes a sense of community through sporting activities for all ages.

name: Kirschlauf
description: The Kirschlauf in Kleinfahner, organised by USV Erfurt, is a long-standing race with a history spanning more than 20 years. The 24th edition takes place on 14 June 2026, taking runners along scenic routes with challenging highland trails. The event offers several distances, including a 14-kilometre main race, a 4.5-kilometre fun run, and races for schoolchildren and younger children. The awards ceremony is traditionally conducted by the Thuringian Cherry Queen, and the race is part of the TLV Running Cup.
course_highlights: 14-kilometre main race featuring a scenic highland trail and views across the northern Thuringian Basin
4.5 km fun run with challenging terrain in the Imtal valley
Finish through a cherry orchard above Kleinfahner, with a magnificent view
additional: Race-pack collection from 8:00 a.m. at the event tent by the mill. Late registration is available online from 2:00 a.m. on 13 June and on race day until 30 minutes before the race, with a €5 late-entry fee. Awards ceremonies take place from approximately 9:45 a.m. for the schoolchildren’s races and from approximately 11:30 a.m. for the other races. Registration until 9 June 2026; late registration is available. The route includes a highland trail and finishes in Kleinfahner. Children’s races and Nordic walking are also offered.

name: Melibokuslauf mit 3. Mountainbike-Gipfelsprint
description: The Melibokus Run is a long-standing running and mountain biking event in Alsbach-Hähnlein, taking place for the 55th time in 2026. It offers several running distances, including a half-marathon trail, 10 km and 5 km running trails, and races for children and teenagers. The Mountain Bike Summit Sprint is also held, featuring a challenging course with 450 m of climbing and 130 m of descent over approximately 13.4 km. The running courses have been evaluated by ITRA and offer varied trails through the countryside around the Melibokus. The event is open to runners and mountain bikers; e-bikes are not allowed.
course_highlights: Half-marathon trail covering 21.2 km
Mountain Bike Summit Sprint with 450 m of climbing and 130 m of descent over approximately 13.4 km
ITRA-evaluated running courses with varied trails
additional: Race-pack collection and late registration from 8:00 a.m. at Sperbergrund, 500 m above Bürgerhaus Sonne. The Mountain Bike Summit Sprint starts at 9:00 a.m., the half-marathon at 9:30 a.m., the 10 km run at 9:45 a.m., and the 5 km run at 10:00 a.m. The children’s races start from 11:00 a.m. Gravel bikes are permitted in the Mountain Bike Summit Sprint; e-bikes are not. Results are processed immediately after the race at the Großsporthalle at Melibokusschule. GPX files of the courses are available. Mountain Bike Summit Sprint distance: approximately 13.4 km. Online registration is available, along with GPX downloads. Public transport stops are in Alsbach-Hähnlein. Age restrictions apply to the competitions.

name: Sohrener Sommerlauf
description: The Sohrener Summer Run is a regional running event in Sohren and part of the Hunsrück Running Series. It is organized by TuS Sohren, a local sports club with a variety of departments, making the event community-focused and non-commercial. Two distances are offered: a short 150-meter run and a 10-kilometer road race. The race typically takes place in pleasant summer weather and gives runners from the region a great opportunity to get active.
course_highlights: Part of the Hunsrück Running Series, which features regional road races
Distances: 150 m and 10 km
Organized by the local sports club TuS Sohren
additional: Typical June weather: approx. 23°C, low of 13°C, mostly sunny with an average of 65 mm of precipitation. Events for children and teenagers; registration required. Start/finish nearby. Typical June weather: around 23°C high, 13°C low, 65 mm of precipitation.

name: Volkslauf Isernhagen
price_range: Adults 12,00 EUR, Kinder und Jugendliche 8,00 EUR, optional T-Shirt 15 EUR
description: The 25th Volkslauf Isernhagen takes place on 14 June 2026 and offers runners of all ages and ability levels a welcoming, traditional running event. Choose from four distances: 1 km, 3.5 km, 5 km and the classic 10 km race, which is measured by the NLV and counts toward the Laufpass. Timing is provided professionally using the runtiming system. All participants can look forward to a clearly marked course, a great atmosphere and a varied supporting programme. The entry fee includes a T-shirt and medal for children and young people; adults can purchase a T-shirt as an optional extra.
course_highlights: Four distances: 1 km, 3.5 km, 5 km and 10 km
The 10 km course is measured by the NLV and counts toward the Laufpass
Professional timing using the runtiming system
additional: Late entries on the event day are not possible. Registration is online via the RUNTIMING portal. All participants receive a refreshment at the finish. The entry fee includes a T-shirt and medal for children and young people; adults can purchase a T-shirt optionally for €15.00. The event takes place whatever the weather. Participation is at your own risk. Trophies and prizes are awarded to the top three finishers in each distance and category, and cash prizes go to the fastest team. Multiple race distances, team competition, online registration via RUNTIMING, no late entries on the event day, medals and T-shirts for participants

name: Drei-Länder-Lauf
description: The Three-Country Run takes place on June 14, 2026, in Arenshausen and connects the regions of Thuringia, Lower Saxony, and Hesse. The event offers several race distances, including 1.2 km, 2 km, 5 km, and 13 km, with a mix of loop courses and out-and-back routes. In addition to the main races, there is a fun run for preschool children with no timing, as well as Nordic walking as a non-competitive event. The run has a long tradition as a symbol of the region growing together after German reunification.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Arenshausen sports field
Loop courses for the 1.2 km, 2 km, and 13 km races
5 km race is an out-and-back route with a lap of the stadium
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the starts, with a late-entry surcharge of 2.00 EUR, except for the children's races. Changing and shower facilities are available in the sports building. Parking is available directly at the Arenshausen sports field. Nordic walking (approx. 8 km) starts at approx. 14:00 with no rankings and no entry fee. The 400 m fun run is for preschool children, with no timing or placings. There is no entry fee for the main race. Online registration is open from 01.05. to 11.06.2026. Parking and changing and shower facilities in the sports building are available.

name: Schackenslebener Hopfenlauf
location: Sportplatz Schackensleben, Schackensleben, Börde, Saxony-Anhalt, Germany
description: The Schackensleben Hopfenlauf is a long-standing running event in Schackensleben, about 25 km west of Magdeburg in the Börde district. All races start and finish at the sports field. Distances include 400 m for children, 1.4 km for young people, and 6.0 km and 10.8 km for adults. The longer routes pass through the village and the surrounding countryside, with the gently rolling profile typical of the Börde region, along roads and paved farm tracks. Refreshments include drinks, coffee, cake, and grilled food. After the finish, there is a raffle with attractive prizes. The Hopfenlauf is part of the Novo Nordisk Landescup and the Elbe-Ohre-Cup.
course_highlights: Routes through the village and nearby area, with the gently rolling profile typical of the Börde region
Roads and paved farm tracks, with several drink stations
Start and finish at the sports field, with good changing and shower facilities
additional: The 0.4 km and 1.4 km races take place on the running track and in the immediate vicinity. After finishing, participants receive drinks and fruit for refreshment. The clubhouse at the sports field offers a generous selection of coffee, cake, lard sandwiches, drinks, and grilled food. A raffle with attractive prizes traditionally takes place alongside the awards ceremony. Multiple distances, online registration, changing rooms, showers, refreshments, and a raffle. Supports the German athletics system through official timekeeping.

name: REWE Women´s Run Hamburg
description: The REWE Women’s Run Hamburg is a road race for beginners and ambitious runners in the Elbe metropolis of Hamburg. The event offers a measured 10 km loop course, starting and finishing at Ballindamm. Alongside the main race, there is also the REWE Girl’s Run, a 1-kilometre race for girls aged 5 to 10. Participants receive a finisher’s medal and can use the showers and changing facilities after the race.
course_highlights: Measured 10 km loop course according to IWB and AIMS
Start and finish at Ballindamm in Hamburg
1 km Girl’s Run for girls aged 5 to 10
additional: Showers and changing facilities are available after the race at Gerhart-Hauptmann-Platz. A bag drop is available for personal belongings. The race number includes a disposable timing chip and must be attached visibly to the running shirt. Photos can be purchased from a photography partner after the race. The event also includes a 1 km Girls’ Run for girls aged 5 to 10, starting at 11:30. Changing facilities, showers and refreshments are available on site.

name: Heidenheimer Sparkassen-Stadtlauf
description: The Heidenheimer Sparkassen City Run on June 14, 2026, offers a range of races for everyone from beginners to half-marathon runners through Heidenheim city center. The half marathon follows two nearly identical laps through the city, passing landmarks such as St. Paul’s Church, the city library, and Brenzpark. The event also includes 10 km and 5 km races, as well as student and Bambini races. All participants receive chip timing via a transponder integrated into their bib number and ample refreshments at the finish.
course_highlights: Half marathon on two nearly identical laps through Heidenheim
The course runs through the city center and Brenzpark, passing the Schlossarkaden
Finish area beside St. Paul’s Church, with strong spectator support
additional: Timing uses a disposable transponder in the bib number. Technical shirts featuring the city run design can be ordered when registering. Baggage drop-off is available from 7 a.m. in the Rathaus underground garage. Medical support is provided by the German Red Cross. Awards ceremonies take place in front of St. Paul’s Church. Photos will be posted online after the race. Event in Heidenheim with various race distances, online and on-site registration, bib number collection, medical support, baggage storage, and race-day refreshments.

name: Herzogstadtlauf Straubing
description: The Herzogstadtlauf in Straubing is a longstanding popular running event taking place on June 13 and 14, 2026, and welcoming runners of all ages. From the children’s run and various distances to the BMW Half Marathon, the event offers a varied program with appealing routes through the historic city and Stadtpark. Alongside the sporting challenge, an extensive program of stage performances and DJ music creates a lively atmosphere. The event promotes community and health and is a highlight of the running calendar in eastern Bavaria.
course_highlights: A loop through Straubing’s historic district, with the start and finish at the Hagen
The route passes the Joseph-von-Fraunhofer-Halle, the ice stadium and the former LAGA site
Varied routes through Stadtpark, the old town and the city centre, passing landmarks such as Ludwigsplatz and Theresienplatz
additional: The children’s runs take place on Saturday, with several start times from 15:30 to 19:00. The main races start on Sunday from 09:00, preceded by a warm-up program. A specially designed technical shirt is offered each year. Registration is available online, and group and company registrations are also accepted. School registration for the children’s runs is possible using a form until 17.04. Stage performances, cheerleaders and DJs provide entertainment throughout the event. Various race distances, technical shirts, medals, refreshments, timing by ZEITGEMAESS, sports physiotherapy support, certificates, prizes, vouchers and a free finisher video.

name: Hohenneuffen-Berglauf mit BW Trail
description: The 37th Hohenneuffen Mountain Race takes place on June 14, 2026, in Linsenhofen, finishing at Hohenneuffen Castle. The main course is 9.3 km long, with approximately 535 m of elevation gain and 180 m of descent. There is also the 24th Students’ Mountain Race, with various distances and elevation gains, open to children from first grade onward. The start is in Balzholz at the town hall, and the finish is at the kindergarten on Jahnstraße. We look forward to welcoming many runners from near and far.
course_highlights: 9.3 km course with approx. +535 / -180 m of elevation change
Start in Balzholz at the town hall; finish at Hohenneuffen Castle
Students’ Mountain Race with distances from 1.56 km to 3.25 km and up to 100 m of elevation gain
additional: Course length approx. 9.3 km, elevation change approx. +535 / -180 m, online registration, children’s and youth races, start in Linsenhofen, finish at Hohenneuffen Castle

name: Metropolmarathon
organizer: Laufteam Fürth 2010 und Team Klinikum Nürnberg
description: The Sparkassen Metropolmarathon 2026 takes place on June 13 and 14 in the cities of Fürth and Nuremberg. The running event connects the two cities with varied routes, numerous races, and a colorful program of activities. With around 9,000 participants and 600 volunteers, the Metropolmarathon offers a weekend full of exercise, fun, and community. Races range from the marathon and half marathon to 10K races and Nordic walking, as well as children’s and youth races.
course_highlights: Start in Fürth, finish at Hauptmarkt in Nuremberg
Varied routes with plenty of refreshment stations
Professional support from the Laufteam Fürth 2010 and Team Klinikum Nürnberg clubs
additional: Pacemakers are available for the half marathon and marathon. Participants can download personalized certificates, and medical care, changing facilities, and showers are provided. A prize draw is offered for participants who also take part in the DATAGROUP Triathlon Nürnberg 2026. Races: marathon, half marathon, 10K, Nordic walking, youth race, KIDSmarathon; start in Fürth, finish in Nuremberg; activities along the course; refreshments, pacemakers, certificates, medical care, changing facilities, and showers

name: Nesselwanger Seenlauf
description: The 1st Nesselwang Lakes Run, presented by Endress+Hauser and organised by Skiklub Nesselwang e. V., is the successor to the former company run and is open to people of all ages. The event promotes exercise and community, offering various courses for children, young people, adults and families, including routes suitable for pushchairs. The start and finish are at the Trendsportzentrum Allgäu. The event welcomes individuals as well as companies, clubs and running groups.
course_highlights: Bambini Run, approx. 0.4 km, for children born 2019–2021
Children’s Run, approx. 1.6 km, for U10, U12 and U14
Lakes Run, approx. 10.7 km, starting and finishing at the Trendsportzentrum Allgäu
additional: Start and finish at the Trendsportzentrum Allgäu. The event includes several races: Bambini Run (0.4 km), Children’s Run (1.6 km), Village Run (5.2 km) and Lakes Run (10.7 km). The run is also suitable for families with pushchairs. Courses for children, families, companies and clubs; registration until 4 June 2026; participation from age 4; various races including the Bambini Run, Children’s Run, Village Run and Lakes Run.

name: NEW-Citylauf
description: The 25th NEW-City Run in Erkelenz on June 14, 2026, is a popular running event that takes runners of all ability levels through the city centre. The event offers a sporting, community-focused atmosphere that appeals to both beginners and ambitious athletes. With a varied course and an electrifying atmosphere, the NEW-City Run is a highlight of the regional events calendar. Taking part is an invitation to enjoy the joy of running together with family and friends.
course_highlights: Course through Erkelenz city centre
Varied running course
Sporting atmosphere and shared experience
additional: The event takes place on Sunday, June 14, 2026. Registration and further information are available at www.new.de/laufserie. The organiser is the City of Erkelenz; contact is available through City Marketing. Run in the city centre, anniversary event, for all ability levels

name: saarBRÜCKENlauf
description: Laufgemeinschaft Saarbrücken warmly invites you to the saarBRÜCKENlauf, a guided run across (almost) all of the state capital Saarbrücken’s bridges. Two distances are offered: a 10 km loop with 7 bridges and a 20 km loop with 17 different bridges. This is not a race but a leisurely run with different pace groups, allowing participants to tackle the challenging route—with ramps, stairs and frequent changes of direction—together. The run starts at 10 a.m. at the Kulturbiergarten opposite the Römerbrücke power plant.
course_highlights: Guided run across (almost) all of Saarbrücken’s bridges over the Saar
Two distances: 10 km with 7 bridges and 20 km with 17 bridges
Challenging route with ramps, stairs and frequent changes of direction
additional: Pace groups are available (60, 70 and 80 minutes for the shorter distance; 2:00, 2:20 and 2:40 hours for the longer distance). No timing and no race numbers. Participation is only for adequately trained runners with no health concerns. This is not a race but a leisurely run. Because of the route, groups should stay together; runners may drop back to a slower group. The guided run has no timing, is suitable for groups and includes refreshments in the finish area at the Kulturbiergarten. The event is suitable only for fit runners.

name: Sparkassenlauf
location: Hessisch Lichtenau, Landkreis Kassel, Hessen, Germany
description: The Gladbeck Sparkassenlauf is a long-standing running event with DLV-certified courses over 1.5 km, 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon. The races run through Wittringer Forest and offer a flat, fast loop course on paved walking paths, asphalt and a tartan track. All participants receive a personalized race bib with their name and a finisher’s medal. The event also hosts the district road-running championships and offers net times and live timing.
course_highlights: Flat, fast loop course through Wittringer Forest on paved walking paths and asphalt
Start and finish at the stadium on Bohmertstraße, with the finish on the tartan track
Two refreshment stations along the course, with additional stations if needed
additional: Personalized race bibs with first names for all participants. Net times and live timing are provided. The course is DLV-certified and eligible for rankings through 2027. Official bike escorts and marshals help ensure the runners move safely through the course. The Fun Walk cutoff time is 10:15. The race is part of the district championships and offers medals, shirts and a festive atmosphere, including live results and personal support.

name: TVE-Sommerlauf 2026
description: The TVE Summer Run is a traditional public race organised by Turnverein 1890 Edingen e.V. in Edingen-Neckarhausen. The event offers races for various age groups, from the youngest participants to seniors, with official timing and certificates. The course has been measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and is eligible for rankings. Runners enjoy a varied route along the Neckar, with the start and finish in the stadium.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Sports and Leisure Centre, including a lap of the running track
The route passes the Fischkinderstube and follows the Neckar towards Wieblingen
Officially measured course eligible for rankings
additional: Late entries are possible until one hour before the start of the respective races, provided the participant limit has not been reached; a late-entry fee of 3 euros applies. Certificates can be downloaded online and printed out. Age-group and overall winner classifications are held, with prizes for places 1–3. Running and Nordic walking event, various distances, registration until 13 June 2026

name: Alfelder Bernd Meyer Staffelmarathon

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld für Freizeit-, Vereins- und Schulteams beträgt 70 € (10 € pro Starter)

description: The Alfeld Bernd Meyer Relay Marathon is a long-standing relay marathon taking place on June 14, 2026, in Alfeld (Leine). The event is open to runners from across the region and is jointly organized by several local running clubs and the City of Alfeld. The course is an approximately 3 km loop, run twice, with the start and finish on the market square. Each team consists of 7 runners, who must be registered by name. Timing is electronic, using single-use transponders. There is also a children’s run of approximately 700 m.
course_highlights: Approximately 3 km loop, to be completed twice
Start and finish on the market square in front of the citizens’ office
Route through the town center and parks, with a varied course
additional: Each relay team consists of 7 people, who must be registered by name and run in the order specified on the day of the event. Bib numbers are personalized and equipped with single-use transponders for electronic timing. Participants may keep their bib numbers as souvenirs. A maximum of 80 teams may take part. The children’s run starts at 10:30 a.m. for girls and 10:45 a.m. for boys, over approximately 700 m. The marathon is known for its community atmosphere, including preparation and training sessions, and is a major event in the regional running calendar.

name: Bad Kohlgruber Schluchtlauf
location: Sport- und Freizeitzentrum am Erle, Bad Kohlgrub, Oberbayern, Germany
description: The Bad Kohlgrub Gorge Run is a scenic race in the foothills of the Alps which, despite its name, is not a mountain run. The course is gently undulating and consists of 20% asphalt and 80% forest paths. The event takes place at the Sports and Leisure Centre at Erle in Bad Kohlgrub and offers free drinks along the way and at the finish. Coffee, cake, food and drinks are available, and all participants receive certificates, with trophies for the class winners.
course_highlights: Gently undulating route through the Alpine foothills
20% asphalt, 80% forest paths
Free drinks at approximately 6 km and at the finish
additional: Race-number collection from 07:45; awards ceremony at approximately 11:00 in the finish area; medical services provided by the Bad Kohlgrub Mountain Rescue Service; if fewer than 6 participants compete in a class, they are ranked in the next lower class; the event takes place in all weather; traffic regulations must be observed. The route passes through the Alpine foothills, along field paths, forest paths and paved sections; it is not a mountain run. Free drinks; prizes for all participants; trophies for the top runners in each class; the event takes place in all weather.

name: Barsbütteler Volkslauf
description: The Barsbüttel Volkslauf is a traditional running event held every June at the sports ground in the Barsbüttel Sports Centre. It offers various distances from 400 m to 10 km, mostly on flat, paved or firm sandy farm tracks. Most of the routes pass through the traffic-free Barsbütteler Feldmark and offer beautiful views, particularly the longer 5 km and 10 km routes. Times are recorded electronically, and all participants receive a certificate afterwards. Food and refreshments are also available for runners and spectators.
course_highlights: The routes are mostly flat and follow paved or firm sandy farm tracks
Routes pass through the traffic-free Barsbütteler Feldmark and offer beautiful views
The 10 km route runs along a small avenue and past the Stapelfelder Moor
additional: Times are recorded electronically, and all participants receive a certificate afterwards. The shortest distance (400 m) takes place entirely on the stadium’s tartan track. The 1 km and 2 km routes partly leave the stadium; the longer routes (5 km and 10 km) offer beautiful views and follow firm sandy tracks and paved farm roads. Food and refreshments are available for runners and spectators. Event on roads, registration online via TrainerDay, refreshments for participants and spectators.

name: BORNE TO RUN (48-Stunden-Lauf)
description: BORNE TO RUN is a 48-hour charity run in Unna that presents an extreme challenge for endurance and willpower. Participants are pushed to their limits over long, demanding hours. This race is for runners ready to take on a genuine test while supporting a good cause.
course_highlights: 48-hour run with distances of 43.2 km and 172.8 km
Venue in Unna, with typical June weather around 23 °C and mostly sunny skies
Charity event focused on endurance and willpower
additional: Please check the event details with the organizer before registering. The run takes place from 12 to 14 June 2026; registration is open until 11 June 2026. Donations go to the German Children’s Hospice Service and NABU.

name: Famberglauf
description: The Famberglauf is a running event held in June in Fambach, organized by SV Schwarz-Weiß Fambach 09 e.V. The program offers four different distances: a 21.1 km half marathon, the 10.9 km Famberglauf, the 5 km Famberg Sprint, and a 1000 m children’s race. The event is open to runners of all ages and ability levels and has more of a friendly club-run feel than that of a large competition.
course_highlights: 21.1 km half marathon
Distances ranging from 1000 m to 21.1 km
Event in Fambach with a friendly club-run atmosphere
additional: The event comprises four races on the same day, including a children’s race. Participant numbers are low, suggesting a friendly club event. June weather is typically sunny, with temperatures around 23 °C. Several running distances are offered, including a half marathon, sprint, and children’s race; the event is part of the Landschaftscup 'Rhön - Thüringer Wald - Werratal'; participant numbers may be limited.

name: h Lauf Reichenau
description: The Reichenau 24-Hour Run is an extraordinary ultra-running event on the island of Reichenau, attracting individual runners, teams of six, and corporate teams. The event runs around the clock, from Saturday at noon to Sunday at noon, challenging participants’ endurance and fitness on a prepared course around Hochwart. The run has established itself as an impressive sporting challenge and attracts both recreational runners and ambitious athletes. The atmosphere is defined by community spirit and sporting ambition, supported by a runners’ camp and a dedicated organizing team.
course_highlights: Loop course around Hochwart on the island of Reichenau
Run continuously for 24 hours, from Saturday at 12 noon to Sunday at 12 noon
Prepared dirt tracks and a scenic course
additional: Participation is open to individuals, teams of six, and corporate teams. A runners’ camp on the “Mofarennen-Acker” provides a place to stay. The event is organized by two running clubs. The top individual runners receive vegetables as prizes. The course runs around Hochwart on unpaved paths. The event is for recreational and professional runners, and the course is closed to traffic.

name: KarlsruheLäuft 100 Jahre Berufsfeuerwehr Karlsruhe
description: In 2026, the Karlsruhe Professional Fire Brigade celebrates its 100th anniversary with a diverse program of events for the whole city. The anniversary includes sporting competitions, historical highlights such as a vintage vehicle gathering and hand-pump competitions, as well as ceremonies and the Schlosslichtspiele. The events offer fascinating insights into the fire brigade’s history and technology and invite everyone to celebrate and remember.
course_highlights: A range of running distances, including children’s races, relay races, 5 km and 10 km
A special anniversary celebration for the Karlsruhe Professional Fire Brigade, with a focus on firefighting
Venue near West Fire Station – Günther Klotz Park
additional: Alongside sporting competitions, the 2026 anniversary year features historical events such as a vintage vehicle gathering with around 120 historic fire engines and the Historic Hand-Pump Fire Engine Competition. There will also be a State Florian Celebration, a children’s play and a variety of insights into fire brigade technology and history. Events will take place at locations including Karlsruhe Palace and the Daxlanden Fire Station. Registration closes on 10 June 2026; the event is part of the anniversary celebrations and is open to runners of all ages.

name: Kirchenkirnberger Wald- und Wiesenlauf
price_range: kostenlos für Kinder- und Jugendläufe, Startgebühren für längere Rennen
description: The 3rd Kirchenkirnberg Forest and Meadow Run takes place on June 14, 2026, in Murrhardt. This is a short running event with two distances, taking runners through forest and meadow landscapes. The race offers a pleasant running atmosphere in typical June weather, with mild temperatures and mostly sunny days. Runners of all ages are warmly invited to take part and enjoy the nature around Murrhardt.
course_highlights: Run through forest and meadow landscapes
Two distances: 450 m and 10.8 km
Typical June weather with mild temperatures and sunshine
additional: Please check the event details with the organiser before registering. A June event with routes through nature, focused on community and health; a regional event.

name: Ludwigsluster Schlossgartenlauf
description: The Ludwigslust Palace Gardens Run takes place on 14 June 2026 in Ludwigslust Palace Park and offers runners of all ages a varied choice of distances. The distances range from 2 km for children to 15 km for experienced runners, with walking routes of 5 and 10 km also available. New to the programme is a Bambini Run for the youngest children, with no registration or results, and an official medal waiting at the finish. This traditional event warmly welcomes beginners and experienced runners alike to enjoy the beautiful parkland.
course_highlights: Routes through the historic Ludwigslust Palace Park
A range of distances from 2 km to 15 km, plus walking routes
Bambini Run for children born in 2021 or later, with a medal
additional: The Bambini Run is free, requires no registration and has no results. It is approximately 500–600 metres long. Adult accompaniment is expressly welcome. Registration for the other races opens on 15 March. Run in Ludwigslust Palace Park; no registration required, no fees, no results, medals for everyone, parking available, drinks and refreshments, changing and shower facilities, 40th anniversary in 2026, route partly outside the park due to park restrictions, post-race party as part of the Linden Festival.

name: Ortslauf Wallertheim
description: The Wallertheim Local Run is a traditional annual running event in Wallertheim and part of the Wingertscup. Various distances are offered, from 900 m for children to 10 km for experienced runners, as well as a 5 km walking route. The event features a family-friendly atmosphere, electronic timing with transponder technology, and convenient online registration. It welcomes runners of all abilities and offers a sporting community experience amid the beautiful Rheinhessen countryside.
course_highlights: Distances from 900 m to 10 km
Electronic timing with transponder technology
Part of the Wingertscup, with the opportunity to collect points
additional: Online registration via br-timing.de with direct debit; the event is the third stage of the Wingertscup; routes for children, beginners, experienced runners, and walkers; team registration available using the provided form. Registration closes on 12 June 2026; late registration is possible until 30 minutes before the start. Changing and shower facilities are available in the multi-purpose hall. Refreshments include a cake buffet. Prizes are awarded to winners, and all participants receive certificates.

name: Isernhagener Volkslauf
description: The 25th Volkslauf Isernhagen takes place on June 14, 2026, and warmly welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels. There are four distances to choose from: 1 km, 3.5 km, 5 km, and the classic 10 km race, which is officially measured by the NLV and counts toward the Laufpass. The event features clearly marked courses, professional timekeeping with the runtiming system, and a lively fun-run atmosphere with more than 400 participants. A T-shirt and medal are included in the entry fee for children and young people; adults can purchase a T-shirt optionally. Late entries on the day of the event are not possible.
course_highlights: Four distances: 1 km, 3.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
10 km course officially measured by the NLV and counts toward the Laufpass
Professional timekeeping with the runtiming system
additional: Registration is online via the RUNTIMING portal until June 11, 2026, at 24:00. Late entries on the day of the event are not possible. All participants receive refreshments at the finish. A T-shirt and medal are included in the entry fee for children and young people; adults can optionally purchase a T-shirt for €15.00. The event takes place in all weather. The start and finish are at the TSV Isernhagen sports grounds, Auf der Heide 32, 30916 Isernhagen H.B. Parking is available nearby. More than 400 participants annually; online registration via RUNTIMING; no late entries on the day of the event.

name: 55. Melibokus Lauf
description: The Melibokus Run is a traditional running event in Alsbach-Hähnlein, taking place for the 55th time on June 14, 2026. The event offers various races, including a half-marathon trail, 10 km and 5 km running trails, and a mountain bike summit sprint. The courses have been evaluated by ITRA and feature varied trails with challenging climbs and beautiful views. Children and young people can take part in dedicated races over 400 m, 800 m, and 1,500 m. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with the start and finish in Sperbergrund.
course_highlights: Half-marathon trail (21.2 km) with challenging trails
Mountain bike summit sprint: 450 m uphill, 130 m downhill over approx. 13.4 km
ITRA-evaluated running courses with GPX files available
additional: Start and late registration from 8:00 a.m. in Sperbergrund, 500 m above Bürgerhaus Sonne. The mountain bike summit sprint starts at 9:00 a.m., the half-marathon at 9:30 a.m., the 10 km at 9:45 a.m., and the 5 km at 10:00 a.m. The children’s races start from 11:00 a.m. at the sports grounds at Hinkelstein. Gravel bikes are permitted in the mountain bike summit sprint; e-bikes are not. Late registration costs an additional €3.00 per race. Results are calculated immediately after the race in the Großsporthalle at Melibokusschule. The event also includes mountain bike summit sprints and trail-running elements; registration is required; detailed course and event information is available.

name: Nocny Maraton Kanału Bydgoskiego od 2007r.
description: The Bydgoszcz Canal Night Marathon is Poland’s oldest continuously held night marathon, taking place since 2007. The race is run in the unique nighttime setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty and along the Bydgoszcz Canal’s distinctive historic hydraulic structures: its 18th-century locks. The canal is the oldest inland waterway in Poland. The event attracts runners from across Poland and abroad, offering generous race packs, original medals and T-shirts, and professional timekeeping. It is growing in prestige and is known for its lively atmosphere, live music, and numerous accompanying attractions.
course_highlights: A night race in the setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty
A route along the historic 18th-century locks of the Bydgoszcz Canal
A unique atmosphere with live music and artistic experiences
additional: There are 6 distances. Participants receive original medals, commemorative T-shirts, and generous race packs. Professional electronic timekeeping and race numbers are provided. Live music adds to the event’s appeal for runners and spectators. The event features 6 distances, electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals and T-shirts, and generous race packs. Participants can expect professional course markings and artistic entertainment during the race.

name: TATRA FEST 2026
location: Zakopane, Tatra County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

description: Tatra Fest is a unique mountain festival held in Zakopane, bringing together a range of outdoor disciplines, including mountain running, climbing, cycling, trekking, and family activities. The event includes challenging races along Tatra trails, such as the 68 km Tatra Fest Bieg and the 22 km Tatra Fest Run, offering participants unforgettable experiences amid the Tatra Mountains’ scenic landscapes. The festival attracts both professionals and amateurs, promoting physical activity, contact with nature, and environmental responsibility. The organizers invite everyone to celebrate life and the mountain spirit together.
course_highlights: Tatra Fest Bieg 68 km: a skyrunning course with 5000 m of elevation gain, running above 2000 m above sea level, with exposed trails and fixed ropes
Tatra Fest Run 22 km: a route through Magura Witowska, Mietlówka, Butorowy Wierch, and Gubałówka, with rocky paths and views of the Tatras
Start and finish in Zakopane’s Municipal Park, with time limits at key points along the course
additional: The 68 km Tatra Fest Bieg has time limits at key points along the course: 7:30 at Kasprowy Wierch (11 km), 10:00 at the PTTK mountain hut at Hala Ornak (24 km), 14:00 and 17:00 at the PTTK mountain hut in Polana Chochołowska (39 and 49 km), and 21:00 at the finish in Municipal Park. The Tatra Fest Run 22 km race package includes transport to the start. The finish in Zakopane’s Municipal Park offers food and drinks. The event includes various distances, including 68 km, 22 km, and 11 km, as well as vertical and family competitions. The races take place on scenic routes in Zakopane, including Municipal Park, Kasprowy Wierch, and Polana Chochołowska.

name: Zawojski Festiwal Biegowy
location: Zawojskie Babiogórskie Park Narodowy, Zawoja, Poland
description: The Zawoja Running Festival is one of the region’s largest sporting events, set amid the picturesque scenery of Babia Góra and the Polica Range. The festival attracts runners from across Poland and abroad, offering a variety of mountain-running distances and a unique atmosphere. The event aims to popularize mountain running and promote the beauty of Babia Góra National Park, combining a sporting adventure with the chance to discover the region’s natural and cultural wealth.
course_highlights: 63 km ultra course with 3,340 m of elevation gain
42.9 km mountain marathon course with 2,060 m of elevation gain
Picturesque views of Babia Góra and the Polica Range
additional: Participant limits for each distance: 63 km – 200 runners, 42.9 km – 200 runners, 21.097 km – 300 runners, 6.2 km – 250 runners. Start times vary by distance: ultra at 5:00, marathon at 10:00, half marathon and 6.2 km run at 15:00. Time limits are 15 hours for the longest distance, 10 hours for the marathon, 3.5 hours for the half marathon, and 1.5 hours for the 6.2 km run. Short races of 100 m to 800 m, adapted to age, are organized for children. Courses range from 6 km to 106 km, with runner limits of 200 to 300; various distances and elevation gains are available, and the event includes mountain running and Nordic walking competitions.

description: The 17th Elbląg Piekarczyk Run is an annual running event held in Elbląg, attracting runners to the 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as the Mini Piekarczyk Run for children. The event is known for its unique atmosphere of sporting excitement and community, and participants receive one-of-a-kind collectible medals. The organizers provide comfortable race-day facilities, including a race office for collecting race packets, a baggage deposit, and sanitary facilities. The race is a great opportunity to spend time actively and compete on the city’s scenic routes.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes along the streets of Elbląg
Mini Piekarczyk Run for children in various age categories
A unique collectible medal that can be combined with medals from other races in the city
additional: Race packets can be collected at Ogrody Shopping Centre (Saturday, 12:00–18:00) and at the Helena MOSiR Ice Rink Hall (Sunday, 7:30–9:30 for the 5 km and 10 km races; 7:30–13:30 for the Mini Run). Participants can use the baggage deposit, changing rooms, and showers at the ice rink hall. The Mini Piekarczyk Run includes several children’s age categories, with distances ranging from 50 m to 600 m. Races start from 12:35 on Sunday. 5 km and 10 km distances, team classification, entry-fee promotions, limited number of places, online registration

name: Bieg Charytatywny
location: Park przy dworcu kolejowym, Oława, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Oławie, Stowarzyszenie Ludzi Aktywnych „Biegnij Oławo”
description: The CZTERY PORY ROKU Charity Run – Stage IV is a sporting event held in Oława, in the park by the railway station. Participants can take part in a run of approximately 5 km or a Nordic Walking event on the same course. The event is charitable and coordinated by the Biegnij Oławo Association of Active People and Oława Municipal Office. The race office is open on race day from 09:30 to 10:30, and the start is scheduled for the same day. The event is supported by local partners, and timing is provided by ZmierzymyCzas.pl.
course_highlights: A course of approximately 5 km for both the run and walk
Start and finish in the park by the railway station in Oława
Participants can choose between running and Nordic Walking
additional: The race office is open on race day from 09:30 to 10:30 near the start. Registration for the run is closed. Race coordinators: Mariusz Jarosławski (698-025-555), Mateusz Bularz (721-162-604). Runs of approximately 5 km; registration closed; events held across the different seasons; charity activities for Michał Proć; accompanying attractions, prize draws, massages, cycling trips, and meals.

name: Dziki Trail
description: Dziki Groń is a challenging mountain course for Pieniny Ultra-Trail®, following hiking and courier-smuggling trails as well as routes across the mountain pastures of the Little Pieniny. The race offers scenic views of the Tatras and the Beskid Mountains, with the start and finish at Dietl Square in Szczawnica. It is intended for experienced mountain runners looking to take on demanding natural terrain. The event is part of the Pieniny Ultra-Trail mountain running festival, which promotes an active lifestyle and the Pieniny region.
course_highlights: Follows hiking and courier-smuggling trails
Views of the Tatras and the Beskid Mountains
Crosses the mountain pastures of the Little Pieniny
additional: The start and finish are at Dietl Square in Szczawnica. The race office and EXPO are located in Upper Park in Szczawnica. There are 5 aid stations on the course, including one at 12 km by the mountain shelter. Mandatory equipment is required in accordance with the regulations. The event promotes an active lifestyle and the Pieniny region. Registration opens in November 2025. Date: June 14, 2026. The course is approximately 64 km long. The event takes place in Szczawnica, and the route includes mountain trails and the pastures of the Little Pieniny.

name: Grodziski Półmaraton Słowaka
location: Grodzisk Wielkopolski, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Hunters Grodziski “Słowaka” Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Grodzisk Wielkopolski since 2007. The race commemorates Juliusz Słowacki, the patron of the local high school, and promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity among residents. The half-marathon course is flat and runs through the town streets over two laps, with numerous refreshment and hydration stations. After the race, participants receive medals and can enjoy a hot meal and drinks. The event also provides an opportunity to promote the town and its local running community.
course_highlights: Flat course through the town streets, with two laps of approximately 10.5 km each
Course marked every 1 km with vertical and horizontal signs
Four nutrition stations and four hydration stations on each lap
additional: The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours. The race office is located at Grodziska Sports Hall, ul. Żwirki i Wigury 2A. Timing is provided by chips attached to race bibs. After the race, the organizer provides a hot meal and drinks. A team classification for sponsor teams is held in the 5 km race. The combined participant limit for the 5 km and 10 km races is 500. Registration and race-pack collection take place in Grodzisk Wielkopolski, ul. Żwirki i Wigury 2A, on 13 June 2026 from 12:00 to 20:00 and on 14 June 2026 from 6:00 to 8:00. Training sessions are held from registration until race day.

The event offers races for children and adults, including a longer 7.2 km course and a shorter 4.8 km course, which run through the town’s parks and surrounding area. The start is at the home for seniors on Radětínská Street, and the event supports the Czech Olympic Foundation. Registration is online, with the option to sign up multiple runners at once. Pelhřimov is also known for its historic landmarks and the Festival of Records and Curiosities, giving the race a unique atmosphere.

Children can choose from shorter distances of 350 m, 550 m and 1,100 m. By taking part, you contribute to the Czech Olympic Foundation, which supports children with limited financial means in participating in sports. The main race starts at 18:00. Registration is online only and closes on 5 June 2026.

description: The Olympic Run in Prague-Satalice is a 5 km running race that follows mainly forest paths in the Satalice Game Reserve, a chestnut avenue, and gravel paths in the forest park. The route is flat and offers runners a pleasant setting with views across the fields and a stretch past the Chapel of St. Anne. There is a warm-up before the start and motivational announcements during the race. After the race, refreshments, showers, changing rooms, and baggage storage are provided, all in a friendly atmosphere. Part of the entry fee is donated to the Czech Olympic Foundation.

The route passes the Chapel of St. Anne and the Satalice Pheasantry Natural Monument
A flat 5 km course with views across the fields and a chestnut avenue

On race day, June 17, sports enthusiasts of all ages can enjoy running and other physical activities. The event is also open to sports clubs and associations, which can organise their own Olympic Day. Registration is available online only on the official website until June 5, with the best entry fee for adults available until the end of March.

The route runs close to the Bečva River
Other physical activities are included, and participants can organise an Olympic Day

The best entry fee for adults is available until the end of March. The main race is 5 km; children’s races range from 200 to 1,100 metres. Online registration is open until June 5, 2026. The start is at 18:00 in the town park by the music pavilion. Proceeds support the Czech Olympic Foundation. The race is suitable for all age groups and families.

name: Olympijský běh - Rychnov nad Kněžnou

The adults’ main race is 5 km long and starts at the Včelné swimming pool complex. Children can take part in races from 200 m to 1,500 m, depending on age category. The event also offers an accompanying programme, the chance to try SPARTAN obstacles, and facilities including baggage storage, toilets and showers. Registration is online, with the option to register multiple runners at once, and the entry fee contributes to the Czech Olympic Foundation.

Race distances include 5 km, 200 m, 400 m, 800 m and 1,500 m, and the event takes place at the Včelné swimming pool complex in Rychnov nad Kněžnou.

Children can take part in races of 350 m and 1.2 km, accompanied by an Olympic-themed programme. The main race starts at 18:00, and part of the entry fee is donated to the Czech Olympic Foundation. The event is suitable for all ages and promotes the joy of movement and a good cause.

Every year, more than 100 companies send several thousand runners, Nordic walkers and walkers to take part, supported by numerous volunteer helpers. The start and finish area is in the Hufeisen car park, nestled in woodland between the villages of Geißlitz, Großenhausen and Lützel. As part of the Main-Kinzig-Challenge, the race is a mainstay of the regional race series and offers runners an appealing course in a natural setting.

name: Krakonosova stovka
description: Krakonošova stovka is a traditional long-distance hike with a history dating back to 1966. The 100 km route crosses the challenging mountain terrain of the Krkonoše Mountains, with over 3,000 metres of elevation gain. It starts and finishes in Vrchlabí and passes notable places such as Špindlerův Mlýn, Sněžka and Pec pod Sněžkou. In addition to the main K100 route, shorter options are available: K50, K25 and the B25 running route. The event is for endurance hikers and runners who want to experience the beauty of the Krkonoše Mountains within a challenging 24-hour time limit.

The route passes through Špindlerův Mlýn, Sněžka and Pec pod Sněžkou
Start and finish in Vrchlabí
additional: UMARA isotonic drinks are available at selected checkpoints. UMARA sports nutrition can be purchased before the start.
