According to the official website, registration for the 2027 edition is expected to open on 1 February 2027. Information on the price, time limit and refreshments available for K100 applies to the 2026 edition.

The start is scheduled for the evening, adding to the unique experience of running in an urban setting. The organizers emphasize competition and community spirit among participants of all ages.

An atmosphere that promotes a healthy lifestyle and community

The race is part of the Běhmetropole series and is suitable for the general public, offering an opportunity for an active evening outdoors.

It is part of the Běžec Vysočiny Cup and is suitable for runners looking for a trail race with a gentle profile. Okolo Rudného is a traditional race that attracts runners from the region and surrounding areas.

The course passes through the beautiful surroundings of Holzheim and offers suitable challenges for all age groups.

Children’s races in two age groups (400 m for children born in 2022 or later, and for those born in 2020 and 2021)

The traditional Laatzener Winzerfest takes place alongside the race, rounding off the evening with culinary and musical highlights.

Bambini run participants receive a small surprise. The event takes place alongside the Laatzener Winzerfest, with musical and culinary entertainment. Routes go through the Leine-Masch and finish at the wine festival; suitable for walkers, teams and children.

name: 40. Braunschweiger Nachtlauf
description: The 40th Braunschweiger Night Run on 19 June 2026 offers a varied programme of sporting events for all age groups, from Bambini races to recreational races. The races run through Braunschweig city centre, starting and finishing on Bohlweg; the Bambini races start at Burgplatz. The event is known for its special atmosphere and the support of the Braunschweigische Sparkassenstiftung, which makes the event possible and helps it develop. The race bib serves as a public transport ticket in Braunschweig on the day of the event. All finishers can download a certificate, and baggage drop-off is open until 23:30.

The start and finish area in Alsterpark offers a special atmosphere with a cheering zone, photo point and a large medal wall, bringing the Hanseatic spirit to life at dusk.

The youngest participants can take part in a children’s run of approximately 400 m in the stadium, making it easy for families to follow all the action.

It is held as part of the Öchslefest in the town of Ochsenhausen on June 19 and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere. The main race is a quarter marathon, run mostly on forest paths with some challenging sections. It starts and finishes with a lap of the track at the Hopfengarten sports grounds. A 5 km race is also offered; it follows the same route as the main race but turns back after 2.5 km. The race is sanctioned by the German Athletics Association (DLV).

name: Heel-Lauf

Alongside the main race, the Schüler-Gipfel-Sprint is a regular part of the programme and offers young runners an exciting challenge.

name: Challenge Gdańsk 2026

Picturesque route in central Gdynia
Nighttime event as part of the Gdynia Grand Prix

Participants can choose between 2.5 km and 5 km, with 60 minutes to complete the race. The entry fee is donated in full to the Polish Association “My Kidneys” (Ogólnopolskie Stowarzyszenie Moje Nerki), and each participant receives a T-shirt featuring the event’s original design. Those unable to attend in person can also take part in the virtual race from 18 to 22 June 2026.
course_highlights: 2.5 km and 5 km distances with electronic timing
60-minute time limit to complete the race
Charity race supporting the Polish Association “My Kidneys” (Ogólnopolskie Stowarzyszenie Moje Nerki)

The entry fee can be a multiple of the minimum amount of 10 zł. No details are provided about fees, the course, or registration.

name: Revírní POHO běh
description: Revírní POHO Run is a traditional running race held in Karviná, with its hub at Masaryk Square. The race offers various distances, including 50 km, a half marathon, 10 km, 6 km, and relays, with routes through the scenic countryside around Karviná Sea and the Olše River. The course is mostly flat with minimal elevation gain and offers beautiful views of nature and the lake, making it an enjoyable experience for runners of all levels. The start and finish are at Masaryk Square, where runners also traditionally loop around the fountain. The race is suitable for experienced runners, families, and amateurs alike.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Masaryk Square in Karviná, with the traditional loop around the fountain
The route passes through Božena Němcová Park and around Karviná (Darkov) Sea, with beautiful views
Mostly flat course with minimal elevation gain, on pleasant paved paths through reclaimed floodplain meadows
additional: Participants can order a POHO50 technical T-shirt for 390 Kč and collect it on race day with their race pack. Relay teams can add or edit members after payment. Runners can use the opened barrier on the road to Karviná Sea for easier access to the course. The 50-kilometre race is also the Czech Republic Championship.

name: Velíšskej přespolňák
location: Veliše, Podblanicko, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: Velíšskej přespolňák is a cross-country race for experienced runners, enthusiasts, and amateurs, held in the picturesque Podblanicko region. The race offers two routes, 10 km and 5.2 km long, running mostly along field and forest paths for an enjoyable experience in nature. It is ideal for anyone who wants to run in a clean environment and test their abilities against other runners. Velíšskej přespolňák is a traditional event that attracts a broad running community.
course_highlights: Routes run mostly along field and forest paths
Picturesque Podblanicko region
Two race distances: 10 km and 5.2 km
additional: Children’s races from 50 to 1000 m, timed with stopwatches; the race is suitable for runners of different levels and offers a friendly atmosphere in nature.

description: Prague Park Race - Divoká Šárka is a running race held on June 20, 2026, amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Divoká Šárka in Prague 6. The race offers a unique atmosphere and breathtaking views, which runners can enjoy on routes of 8 and 14 kilometres. The routes follow paved and unpaved roads, meadows and trails, partly including asphalt roads with limited traffic. The race is suitable for the general public and offers refreshments on the course and at the finish. The start and race-day registration take place at the SK ARITMA grounds in Prague-Vokovice, which are easily accessible by public transport and car.
course_highlights: Routes follow paved and unpaved roads, meadows and trails
Approximate route distances of 8 and 14 km, with every kilometre marked
The course passes through a castle, with two sections featuring stairs and narrow trails
additional: Race-day registration is open from 9:00 to 10:45, and the children's races start from 10:00. There is a refreshment station at approximately the 8 km mark on the longer, 14 km route, with refreshments for everyone at the finish. Race capacity is limited; on-site registration is available if capacity has not been reached. Public transport is recommended to Nádraží Veleslavín stop (700 m from the grounds); parking is available by Džbán Reservoir (300 m). The race takes place in a natural setting, registration is available online, and the event features scenic trail routes of varying lengths and difficulty.

name: Krosový běh Chudenickým Žďárem
location: Sportovní areál Jalovčí, Chudenice, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běh chudenickým Žďárem is a young cross-country race founded in 2016, held amid the picturesque autumn scenery of Žďár Hill above the village of Chudenice. The course is a challenging cross-country run with no paved sections, a gently rolling profile, and an appealing climb up the forest steps to Bolfánek. The start and finish are located in the grounds of the local sports club. The main race is 6.2 km long and offers runners both a challenge and beautiful natural scenery.
course_highlights: No paved sections
Gently rolling profile with a climb up the forest steps to Bolfánek
Start and finish in the grounds of the local sports club
additional: The race is part of Ešus liga, a traditional and prestigious series of off-track runs in the Klatovy District. In previous years, Ešus liga races have offered original prizes such as running caps, bottles of drinks, fairground cakes, and Šumava cheeses. The course is known for being exactly 6.2 km long—as long as you don't get lost. The course is approximately 6.2 km long; the race is open to all age categories, has no paved sections, and includes a climb to Bolfánek. The race takes place in June 2026; the exact date is June 20.

description: Run4Help 2026 is a charity run taking place on June 20, 2026, in Prague’s Letná Gardens nature park. The event offers races for adults over 4 km and 8 km, children’s races in various age categories from birth to 14 years, and a non-competitive 1 km run for people with disabilities. Entry fees are donated to the nonprofit organization No Foot No Stress, and every participant receives a commemorative medal at the finish. The race is suitable for both professional and amateur runners who want to support a good cause.

A charity run supporting the nonprofit organization No Foot No Stress
Categories for children from birth to 14 years, plus a special run for people with disabilities
additional: On-site registration is available without a race pack. Entry is free for people with disabilities and their companions. The official Run4help T-shirt can be ordered until 20.05.2026. The number of participants is limited to 1000. A beautiful medal awaits every runner at the finish. The program includes children’s races, a non-competitive run for people with disabilities, and 4 km and 8 km races. This charity run supports NO FOOT NO STRESS with its proceeds and includes various race distances and an accompanying program.

name: Příborský běh
organizer: město Příbor, Atletický klub Emila Zátopka Kopřivnice
description: The Příbor Run is a traditional race organized by the town of Příbor in cooperation with the local Scout troop and the Emil Zátopek Athletic Club Kopřivnice. The race is for both athletes and recreational runners, who can choose a distance to suit their abilities. It offers a 4.6 km hobby category, a 9.2 km sport category, and relays of four runners (2 men + 2 women), with each runner completing a 2.3 km lap. Children’s races over various distances are also part of the event. The friendly atmosphere supports the region’s broad running community.
course_highlights: Hobby category – 4.6 km (2 laps)
Sport category – 9.2 km (4 laps)
Four-person relays (2 men + 2 women), each runner completes a 2.3 km lap
additional: The race is part of the Lašská Running League. The categories start in sequence: first the sport category, then the hobby category 2 minutes later, followed by the relays after another 2 minutes. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, and offers different distances according to age and ability. It is open to various age categories, including children and relay teams, and takes place in the historic center of Příbor. Details about registration and the exact terrain are not specified.

name: Barvám Neutečeš Praha
location: Park u Čeňku, Sokolský ostrov, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Barvám Neutečeš is a colourful run and a full day of fun for all ages, families and friends. Choose between two routes: 5 km with five colour zones, or 1.5 km with three colour zones and an interactive sports zone. It’s not about speed, but about joy, friendship and unforgettable experiences filled with music, laughter and bursts of colour. The event takes place in Prague at Park u Čeňku and on Sokolský ostrov, and is part of a year-round colourful tour through several cities.
course_highlights: 5 km route with 5 colour zones
1.5 km route with 3 colour zones and an Urban Challenge zone
Colour zones shower runners in colour from head to toe
additional: The all-day event runs from 8:00 to 17:00 in Prague and includes music, themed zones, photo booths, 360° video and an accompanying programme. The run is not timed; children can take part on someone’s shoulders, on scooters or in strollers. The event also includes the charitable Barvám Neutečeš Heroes project for children with disabilities. The festival features a variety of colour zones, music and activities, and is suitable for all age groups. It takes place at Park u Čeňku and on Sokolský ostrov, with a focus on fun and shared community experiences.

name: POHO50 - Revírní pohodová padesátka
description: POHO50 – Revírní Pohodová Padesátka is a traditional running race held in Karviná, Moravian-Silesian Region. The race offers a pleasant atmosphere and the chance to enjoy a run in the region’s beautiful surroundings. Participants can also order an original POHO50 performance T-shirt, which they can pick up on race day. Registration is simple and also allows relay teams to sign up and manage their members after paying the entry fee.
course_highlights: A course of approximately 50 km around Karviná and the Karviná Sea
Shorter distances of 21 km, 10 km, and 6 km are also available
Natural scenery and varied terrain around the Karviná Sea
additional: Participants can order an original POHO50 performance T-shirt for 390 Kč. They can pick it up on race day together with their race number and race pack. The race takes place on June 20, 2026, offers various distances, including an ultramarathon, and is suitable for all ages and running abilities.

description: The Run in the Footsteps of Jan Opletal and Jiří Vaci Memorial is a traditional running event organized by Jan Opletal Grammar School in Litovel. The race commemorates notable figures and the history of the school and town. It takes place in the beautiful Litovel region and is suitable for the general public looking for a sporting experience with a historical touch.
course_highlights: Start at Jan Opletal’s birthplace in Lhota nad Moravou
The race is 8 km or 10 km long, depending on the year
The races include school teams and regional runs

name: Běh okolo Vraní skály
location: Černín u Zdic, Central Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The Run Around Vraní skála is a traditional running race held in Černín near Zdice, offering a challenging course approximately 9 km long. The race combines a steep uphill road section, forest tracks and narrow trails leading to the summit around Vraní skála, followed by a rolling, mostly downhill section with a steep descent to the finish. The race starts in the square in Černín near Zdice, and the main race begins at 10:30. It is part of the Brdský běžecký pohár and is suitable for runners who enjoy a mix of road and trail with significant elevation gain.
course_highlights: Steep uphill road section at the start, up to the 1 km mark
Gentler climb along a forest track and narrow trail to the summit around Vraní skála
Rolling, mostly downhill section followed by a steep road descent to the finish
additional: The entry fee is 200 Kč for on-site registration; a sausage is included. The course runs on both roads and trails. There are no children’s races on the main event date. Results are available in the system and as a PDF. The organizer is Instalatérství Ivan Raboch. The course is 9 km, starts at 10:30, and has no children’s races; registration is on site, and a sausage is included. The race is part of the Brdský běžecký pohár series, which features various distances and categories throughout May and June.

name: Běh na Kozlovský kopec

description: The Kozlovský Kopec Run is a traditional Czech Třebová road hill race, taking place on June 20, 2026. The race starts at 10:00 a.m. on Habrmanova Street in front of the Secondary Vocational School building, and finishes at Max Švabinský Cottage on Kozlovský Kopec. The 5.2 km course, with 230 metres of elevation gain, runs on asphalt and is among the more challenging races in the regional ISCAREX Cup series and the Czech Hill Running Cup. Race facilities are available in the school building, including registration, changing rooms and toilets. Entries can be submitted online in advance at a discounted entry fee or on race day.

The entire course is on asphalt

The start is on Habrmanova Street and the finish is at Max Švabinský Cottage.

The main event features 5 km and 10 km races for men, women and students, timed with chip timing. The event is part of a family sports afternoon and offers a varied programme of accompanying activities in addition to the races. All participants receive a commemorative wooden medal, and there is a raffle for a LIFEFIT.PRO treadmill. The memorial supports health and social projects, especially oncology.

Chip timing

The course crosses mountainous terrain with approximately 903 metres of elevation gain and offers challenging conditions suited to experienced runners. The event takes place every year in June and attracts participants from across the Czech Republic who want to enjoy the beauty of the Krkonoše Mountains and the challenge of a mountain run.

Part of the long-running Krakonošova stovka series

name: Jirkovský crossmarathon a půlmarathon
description: The Jirkov Cross Marathon is a mountain marathon through the Ore Mountains around the town of Jirkov, offering runners a personal approach. The routes pass through the beautiful natural scenery of the Ore Mountains and suit a range of sporting abilities, as well as recreational participants. The start and finish are at 2nd Jirkov Primary School. The event takes place on 20 June 2026.

Routes for running, cycling, scooter riding, and hiking
Scenic views and natural landscapes

name: FarmaRun

Children can take part in a short 300 m run, and there is an exhibition race for the youngest participants, aged up to 4, right on the farm grounds. After the race, participants receive a commemorative medal, a refreshing drink, and light refreshments. There is also an accompanying program for the whole family.

name: Velíšskej přespolňák

The race is open to all age groups and offers a range of distances, from children’s races to the men’s 7,800-metre race. The Lucka Náprstková Memorial commemorates a tragic event and is part of the sporting event. It is organised by the Czech Union of Sport, which encourages the general public to stay active and take part in sport.

Cross-country running on natural terrain in Louny
The Lucka Náprstková Memorial is part of the race

name: Gerolsteiner Stadtlauf

Out-and-back courses for the 500 m and 1,000 m races
Loop courses for the 2,500 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m races

All participants receive medals and certificates, and registration is primarily via the MyRaceResult portal. The race is suitable for both individual and relay participants and offers a family-friendly atmosphere.

2,500 m lap with a notable climb on Mühlberg (approx. 150 m)
10 km main race consisting of four laps of the 2.5 km course
additional: Registration opens on April 25, 2026, via MyRaceResult. On race day, late registration is available from 17:30 until half an hour before the respective start. Certificates can be printed by participants themselves via MyRaceResult. Course description, registration via MyRaceResult, entry fees, transponder timing, refreshments, awards ceremony, showers, age groups, start times, awards, liability disclaimer

Children under 12 have a separate, flat out-and-back course, while the Bambini runners start on shorter loops around the sports field. The event is family-friendly and, in addition to the races, offers a raffle with attractive prizes as well as refreshments for spectators and participants.

name: Abendlauf TSV Blau-Weiß Ippinghausen

name: City Marathon Wiesbaden
description: The City Marathon Wiesbaden takes place on June 20, 2026, and offers a varied race weekend in the Hessian state capital. The weekend traditionally begins with a school class race for children in grades one through ten. The event promises a sporting highlight for runners of all ages and ability levels.

Popular relay competitions
School class race for children in grades 1 through 10

name: Die 49. Nacht von Borgholzhausen
description: The Night of Borgholzhausen is a special running event taking place on June 20, 2026, in the town center of Borgholzhausen. From the Bambini run and Schoolrunning to the atmospheric 10 km night run, there is something for all ages and ability levels. The event is known for its unique atmosphere, with live music, cheerleaders, DJs and torches along the course. Teams, beginners and ambitious runners can enjoy an unforgettable evening filled with community spirit and a passion for running.
course_highlights: Paved roads through the town center of Borgholzhausen
Course-side atmosphere with cheerleaders, live music and DJs
Torch-lit course and garden parties along the route
additional: The event begins with the Bambini run at 18:00 (300 m, untimed, registration through kindergartens). This is followed by two Schoolrunning races: one for primary school pupils (approx. 1.6 km) and one for secondary school pupils (approx. 3 km). The company run (5 km) and the 5 km run are suitable for beginners and teams. The highlight is the 10 km night run, which is filled with a special atmosphere, plenty of spectators and music. Individual entries can be made online until shortly before the final start at 21:30. Various running distances, running course for beginners, atmosphere with music and torches, online registration

name: Dieburger Stadtlauf
description: The Dieburg City Run takes place annually in Dieburg town centre and offers races for various age groups, from Bambinis to the 10 km main race. The route starts in the market square and runs through the old town, making it accessible to all participants. Alongside the sporting competition, the team and school competitions are also a focus, making the run a popular event for the whole family and local community. The event is part of the Lang-Lauf-Cup and is known for its friendly atmosphere and good organisation.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Dieburg market square
Route runs through the historic old town
Loop races with a clearly marked route (from Bambinis to the 10 km main race)
additional: Race number collection from 2 p.m. at the Pater-Delp-Haus near the town hall/market square. Late registration is possible until 4 p.m. on event day, subject to availability. There are no showers or changing rooms near the start and finish. The 4 km race includes school and team competitions. The main race is part of the Lang-Lauf-Cup. Routes in the market square, various race distances, online registration, no showers/changing rooms nearby.

name: Europalauf 2026
location: Hennef, Siegtal, Allner See, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 20th Hennef Europalauf on June 20, 2026, offers a wide range of running events from 1,000 metres to the half marathon (21.1 km). The routes pass through the centre of Hennef, along Allner Lake and through the picturesque Sieg Valley. The event is for the whole family, with beginner-friendly races for children and novice runners as well as challenging courses for ambitious runners. Particular emphasis is placed on inclusion, and special races are offered for people with disabilities. The event is organised by Hennefer Turnverein in cooperation with the City of Hennef and takes place in a friendly, volunteer-run atmosphere.
course_highlights: A variety of routes from 1,000 m to 21.1 km through Hennef, past Allner Lake and through the Sieg Valley
Half marathon with more than 150 metres of elevation gain and five bridge crossings
Scenic routes with views across the Sieg Valley as far as the Siebengebirge
additional: Late entries are possible on race day at the town hall from 8 a.m. until 60 minutes before the respective start, with a late-entry fee of €2 per person per race. The start and finish are at the Historic Hennef Town Hall (Frankfurter Straße 97). Changing rooms and showers are available at Kronos Aktivclub. Timing is provided professionally using disposable chips from runtiming. The award ceremony takes place at 1 p.m. in front of the town hall. There is a team challenge with cash prizes for the top teams in the HIT Panoramalauf. The routes are not suitable for wheelchair users, and coaching from a bicycle results in disqualification. A range of routes is available, including accessible and panoramic options, as well as a challenging half marathon with elevation gain and bridge crossings.

name: Feldbergfestlauf
description: The Feldbergfest Run is a traditional cross-country race around the Großer Feldberg in the Taunus, held as part of the oldest mountain sports festival in the German-speaking world. The approximately 6,300-metre course crosses varied terrain and offers runners a challenging experience in a natural setting. The event attracts numerous participants each year and is an established part of the Feldbergfest.
course_highlights: Cross-country race around the Großer Feldberg
Course approximately 6,300 metres long
Natural, varied running route in the Taunus
additional: The race takes place in typical June weather. The start is on the Großer Feldberg, and the event includes various sporting activities around the Feldberg.

name: Mittsommernachtslauf
price_range: 2 € Nachmeldegebühr (bei Anmeldung bis 18.06.2026, sonst 30 Minuten vor Start)
description: The 46th Midsummer Night Run on June 20, 2026, in Konzen offers a varied running program for all ages and ability levels. The event includes children’s races, fun runs over 4.2 km, 6 km and 10 km, as well as walking routes through the picturesque hedgerow and meadow landscape of the Eifel. The 4.2 km short course is a tenth marathon and part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup; it is particularly suitable for beginners and fit children. Running-Team Konzen looks forward to welcoming many participants to enjoy the run together in a relaxed atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes through the beautiful hedgerow and meadow landscape of the Eifel
Pleasantly flat course for the Eifel region
10 km walking route follows the same course as the running route
additional: The children’s races start at 3 p.m. and are free to enter. Food and drink will be available before, during and after the races. The event is part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup. Terrain in a hedgerow landscape. Online registration available until June 18, 2026; late entries accepted until 30 minutes before the start.

name: Nordholzer Windmühlenlauf
price_range: Kinder/Jugendliche/Wanderer/Walker 4,00 Euro; Erwachsene 8,00 Euro; Halbmarathon 12,00 Euro; Nachmeldung 2,00 Euro

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kinder, Jugendliche, Walker und Wanderer 4,00 Euro

description: The Nordholz Windmill Run is a long-standing running event in Wurster North Sea Coast offering various distances for children, young people and adults. The courses follow measured road routes officially recognised by the German Athletics Association (DLV). There are also hiking and walking options open to all age groups. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, and every participant receives a medal and certificate.
course_highlights: Measured road courses with DLV certification
Distances from the 400 m Bambini run to the half marathon (21.0975 km)
Competition at Willi-Wicke Sports Ground, serving as the start and finish area
additional: Race-pack collection from 14:00 at the clubhouse at Willi-Wicke Sports Ground. Timing is by transponder, loaned with the race pack (20 euro fee if not returned). Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available at the start/finish area. The Bambini run is free, and accompaniment is permitted but not timed. The 5 km race counts as the district championship. Late entries are possible up to 1 hour before the start for an additional fee. Every participant receives a medal and certificate; walkers and hikers receive a certificate of participation. Courses are measured; timing is by transponder; changing rooms, showers and toilets are available; district championship on the 5 km course.

name: Samstagslauf Großenmeer
description: The Samstagslauf Großenmeer is a traditional recreational running event taking place for the 15th time on June 20, 2026. Organized by Großenmeerer Turnverein 1921 e.V., the race offers a sporting opportunity for runners from the region and beyond. The event is open to various distances and welcomes all age groups. Registration is conveniently available through Laufmanager.net, and the organizers look forward to welcoming many participants.
course_highlights: A variety of courses for different ability levels
Run through the scenic region around Großenmeer and Ovelgönne
A traditional race with a friendly atmosphere and strong regional ties
additional: Registration is available through Laufmanager.net. The race is organized by Großenmeerer Turnverein 1921 e.V., which also supports other sports activities in the region. No start times or pricing tiers are explicitly listed on the website. The event is part of the Sportverbund Ovelgönne-Jade. Course routes, online registration, various running distances, regional sports activities

name: Stunden-Lauf Herne
location: Sportpark Eickel, Herne, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld (bis zum 15.06.2026): 65 Euro. (DUV-Mitglieder entrichten ein um 5 Euro niedrigeres Startgeld).

description: The 24-hour run in Herne takes place at Sportpark Eickel, a modern sporting venue with a paved 2 km loop. The challenge is to run as many kilometres as possible within 24 hours, either as an individual or as part of a relay team. Alongside the sporting competition, the event offers entertainment with mini golf and on-site refreshments. Timing is electronic, using a transponder attached to the race bib, and camping is possible right at the venue.
course_highlights: Paved 2 km loop at Sportpark Eickel
Electronic lap counting with a transponder attached to the race bib
Start and finish directly beside the mini golf course
additional: Race packs will be available on the event day from 08:00 to 11:00 at the mini golf course. Timing is electronic using a transponder, which is passed on like a relay baton during team changes. Refreshment stations serving drinks and food are available, and runners may store their own supplies. Camping is possible on site. The course is a paved 2 km loop at Sportpark Eickel. Course: loop around Sportpark Eickel; participate individually or as part of a relay team; fun and refreshments on site

name: Taunus Trailrun
description: The 8th Kreissparkasse Limburg Taunus Trail Run is a nature-focused trail run that takes place predominantly on unpaved field and forest paths and singletracks in the Selters-Eisenbach region. Depending on the weather, the course may include muddy and slippery sections, making the run particularly challenging. The long-distance course is highly regarded by the regional trail-running community. The event offers electronic timing, a pre-race briefing, and an awards ceremony after the finish.
course_highlights: Unpaved field and forest paths and singletracks
Muddy and slippery sections depending on the weather
The long-distance course is highly regarded by the regional trail-running community
additional: The event takes place in all weather conditions. Late registration is possible until 60 minutes before each start, but without a guaranteed place and with a €1 surcharge. Race-number collection, changing rooms, showers, drinks, and refreshments are available on site at Eisenbach Sports Ground. All participants receive a finisher sausage or a meat-free alternative. Timing is provided electronically by RaceR. A DRK vehicle will be stationed in the finish area. The event is officially registered with the Limburg-Weilburg Athletics District and the Hessian Athletics Association. The event takes place on June 27, 2026, with the start and finish in Selters-Eisenbach. It is organized by volunteers and emphasizes runners’ independence through GPS-assisted navigation. Booking accommodation in the region is recommended.

name: Nottulner Stiftslauf - SV DJK GW Nottuln
3. Schluchthof Backyard Ultra
location: Kleinostheim am Main, Landkreis Aschaffenburg, Bayern, Germany
description: The 3rd Schluchthof Backyard Ultra takes place in Kleinostheim on the Main, near Aschaffenburg. This lovingly organized, private Backyard Ultra race emphasizes a family atmosphere and a small field, so everyone runs each lap together. The event offers a distinctive setting in a green corner between the Rhine-Main region and the Spessart, with runners setting off hour after hour until only one runner remains.
course_highlights: Small field so everyone can run each lap together
Distinctive setting in Lower Franconia between the Rhine-Main region and the Spessart
Backyard Ultra format: hour after hour until the last runner remains
additional: This is not a mass-participation event, but a race among like-minded people, with a fluid boundary between participants and spectators. The event is private and not an official competition; the course is slightly shorter than the standard Backyard Ultra distance, and the event emphasizes community and challenge.

name: 41. Volkslauf in Baunatal
description: The 41st Volkslauf in Baunatal is a recreational sports event with the motto “Baunatal rennt” (Baunatal Runs), open to everyone, whether or not they belong to a club. The running routes mostly follow paved paths and pass largely through wooded areas. The 5 km course is an out-and-back route, while the shorter races, from 200 m to 1,000 m, take place in the Parkstadion. The event is part of the Nordhessencup, a popular running series in the region.
course_highlights: Running and walking routes mostly follow paved paths
Routes pass largely through wooded areas
5 km course is an out-and-back route
additional: Registration is online only via Raceresult. The registration deadline is the day before the event, 19.06.2026, at 23:00. Bib numbers can be collected in the area of the upper main stand. The 200 m to 1,000 m races take place in the Parkstadion. The event is a recreational sports event, and registration is online only. June weather is usually sunny with mild temperatures.

name: Hennigsdorfer Feuerwehr- und Bahnenlauf
description: The Hennigsdorf Fire Brigade and Railways Run is a sporting event taking place on 20 June 2026 at the OSZ sports ground in Hennigsdorf. The 6th edition offers a range of races from 400 m to 5 km, including a HandiCap Race, a children’s race, a fun run and Nordic walking. In addition to runners from the volunteer fire brigade, the police and THW will also take part. The Hennigsdorf Fire Brigade’s emergency vehicles, the DLRG and an information stand from EMB Energie Mark Brandenburg will provide entertainment and safety. All finishers receive medals and certificates, and refreshments will be available.
course_highlights: A range of distances from 400 m to 5 km
Participation by the fire brigade, police and THW
Event at the OSZ sports ground with a children’s obstacle course and emergency vehicles
additional: The event is scheduled to run from 8:30 a.m. to around 2:30 p.m., hopefully in sunny weather. There will be a varied programme of activities, including a children’s obstacle course, medical support from the DLRG and information stands. All finishers will receive medals and certificates. Refreshments will be available for participants, volunteers and spectators. The event at the OSZ sports ground features various types of races, participation by the fire brigade and police, a children’s obstacle course, medical support and refreshments.

name: Suderburger Abendlauf
description: The Suderburger Evening Run is a recreational sports event for the whole family, held annually in June in Suderburg since 2022. The routes pass through heathland and the surrounding forests of the Lüneburg Heath on sandy, all-weather forest and farm tracks. Alongside traditional individual races, there is also a 3 x 1.9 km relay. The start and finish are at the sports ground on Tannrähm, and the event is attracting increasing numbers of participants.
course_highlights: Routes through heathland and surrounding forests
Mostly sandy, all-weather forest and farm tracks
A range of distances from 500 m to 20 km, plus a relay
additional: There are seven races ranging from 500 m to 20 km for various age groups. Late entries are accepted on race day until 30 minutes before the start, subject to a €4.00 late-entry fee. Changing and shower facilities are available at the start/finish. Refreshments include drinks at the finish and drink stations on the longer routes. This is not a traditional athletics event, but a recreational sports event for all age groups. Races take place on wooded, hilly paths in the Lüneburg Heath; online registration; changing and shower facilities available; refreshments at the finish; an event that is not weather-dependent.

name: Tiergartenlauf 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Wer sich bis zum 10.6.2026 anmeldet bekommt eine Startnummer mit seinem Vornamen.

description: The Tiergartenlauf Velen is a family-friendly fun run taking place for the 18th time on June 20, 2026. With a total of 11 races, it offers distances for all age groups and fitness levels, from a mini-marathon and children’s races to 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon events, as well as Nordic walking. A special highlight is the family, friends and colleagues relay, in which four people each run 1,400 m in turn. The event takes place at Gesamtschule Velen and offers an extensive supporting programme with refreshments, music and showers. Proceeds will be donated to charitable organisations.
course_highlights: Routes run through the Tiergarten
A range of distances, from the 421.95 m mini-marathon to the half-marathon
Special highlight: 4 × 1,400 m relay
additional: Start and finish at Gesamtschule Velen, An der krummen Mauer 5. Certificates for all participants, with age-group results shown on the certificate; medals for the top three finishers in each category. The mini-marathon is untimed. Extensive supporting programme with refreshment stands, music, refreshments at the finish, drink stations along the route, showers in the sports hall and a valuables deposit. Late registration is possible on the event day up to 30 minutes before the start; payment on the event day is cash only. Routes for all age groups, online registration, certificates available online, address for navigation devices, showers, valuables deposit.

name: Fuffy Twister - From Dusk Till Dawn
description: The Fuffy Twister - From Dusk Till Dawn is a 50 km trail ultra in Langenhagen, Germany. It starts at night and has an 8-hour time limit. The race takes place in June and is characterized by straightforward organization, a low entry fee, an on-site finisher medal, and results and certificates published online. Participation is limited, making it a relatively local and challenging test of endurance. The course runs along the northern edge of Hannover, near Hannover Airport, through Bissendorfer Moor and Kananoher Forst, over varied terrain with a moderate amount of elevation gain.
course_highlights: 50 km trail ultra on asphalt, gravel, forest floor, and trails
Loop course along the northern edge of Hannover, near Hannover Airport
Approximately 130 meters of elevation gain, mostly flat terrain
additional: The race has an 8-hour time limit and starts at night. Participation is limited, with finisher numbers typically in the single digits to high teens. Finisher medals are awarded on site, and results and certificates are available online. June weather is usually sunny, with an average of 23 °C during the day and 13 °C at night. Night start, 130 m of elevation gain, small running group, finisher medal included

name: AlbChallenge 2026 der Jubiläumsrun
description: The Alb Challenge 2026 is a varied obstacle race held as part of the 100th anniversary celebrations of the Bad Herrenalb Ski Club. The course runs across the Schweizerwiese and features various obstacles designed to promote fun, challenge, and team spirit. Participants can enter as individuals or in teams of two or four, and must be at least 16 years old. Alongside the sporting challenge, there is a team competition with an evening at a mountain hut as the prize, as well as an award for the best costume.
course_highlights: Obstacle race on the Schweizerwiese
A variety of obstacles along the course
Team competition with an evening at a mountain hut as the prize
additional: Open to participants aged 16 and over. Register as an individual, a team of two, or a team of four. Team prize: an evening at the Hahnenfalzhütte, including a keg of beer. Costume competition with a prize. Event held as part of the 100th anniversary celebrations of the Bad Herrenalb Ski Club. Obstacle race on the Schweizerwiese, with team and costume prizes, for participants aged 16 and over.

name: Babenberger Volkslauf
location: Kirchweihsamstag, St. Urban, Bamberg, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Babenberger Volkslauf is a family-friendly scenic run that has been held on the Kirchweih Saturday of St. Urban in Bamberg since 1999. The event offers running enthusiasts a great opportunity to meet in a friendly atmosphere and run together for a good cause. The start and finish are at St. Urban Church, and the event supports social projects in the district each year. The organizers look forward to welcoming many participants and to a successful event in June 2026.
course_highlights: Start and finish at St. Urban Church, Babenbergerring 26a, 96049 Bamberg
Family and scenic run on a picturesque route
A tradition since 1999, held on the Kirchweih Saturday of St. Urban
additional: Registration on the event day from 2 p.m. at the race office. The event supports social organizations each year; in 2026, it will support St. Urban Kindergarten. Organized by Bürgerverein Bamberg Süd-West e.V. The run supports St. Urban Kindergarten. Registration from 2:00 p.m.; route details and further information are available on the website.

name: Binner Abendlauf
description: The Binner Evening Run is a traditional running event held as part of the sports festival of Sport- und Jugendbund Binnen e.V. The race offers a sporting challenge in a friendly, family atmosphere in Binnen. It attracts runners of all ages and is a regular fixture on the regional sporting calendar. Alongside the race, the sports festival offers a variety of activities for the whole family.
course_highlights: Running routes through the beautiful surroundings of Binnen
Family atmosphere at the sports festival
Traditional evening run with a long history
additional: The Binner Evening Run takes place as part of the SJB Sports Festival, held on 20 and 21 June 2026. In addition to the race, the event includes other sports and leisure activities. Results from previous races are published on the website. The available pages do not provide explicit information about start times, price tiers, or participant limits. The event is part of the 2026 sports festival, results are published, and it offers a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: FORT FUN Westernlauf
location: Fort Fun Abenteuerland, Bestwig-Wasserfall, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
distance_verbose: Marathon, Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld (inkl. Eintritt in den Freizeitpark): zwischen 12 € und 17 € pro Person

description: The FORT FUN Western Run on June 20, 2026, is a popular running event at the FORT FUN Abenteuerland amusement park in Bestwig-Wasserfall. Families and runners of all ages can choose from a total of 12 different races on the park grounds and in the adjacent forests. The event is especially family-friendly and offers beautiful views, as well as the opportunity to enjoy the amusement park attractions afterward. The event is held in cooperation with TuS Valmetal and is ideal for active children, teenagers, and families.
course_highlights: Run on narrow trails in the amusement park and adjacent forests
Beautiful views along the routes
12 different races for all age groups and ability levels
additional: Accompanying persons receive a discounted admission price of €24.90 per person. Toilets and showers are available on site. The event is especially family-friendly and offers access to the attractions at the FORT FUN Abenteuerland amusement park in addition to the run. Entry fee includes admission to the amusement park, 12 routes, and park attractions

name: Freundschaftslauf LT Rennschnecke Dudweiler
description: The friendship run of the “Rennschnecke” Dudweiler e.V. running club takes place on June 20, 2026, in the Dudweiler city forest around the Gehlenberg. The event offers a recreational sporting activity in a friendly atmosphere and is open to runners of all ability levels. Food and drinks will be provided. The three groups with the highest participation will also receive awards, putting a special emphasis on community.
course_highlights: Run through the training area around the Gehlenberg in the Dudweiler city forest
Refreshment station halfway along the route with water and snacks
Community run with walking and Nordic walking included
additional: The three groups with the highest participation will receive awards. Food and drinks will be provided. The event lasts approximately from 15:00 to 16:00. The best way to get there is via Rentrischer Straße 42, 66125 Saarbrücken; from there, it is another 50 m to the training ground. Run in the Dudweiler city forest, start at 15:00, participation in the run and walk, group awards, food and drinks.

name: GVG Horremer Abendlauf
description: The GVG Horrem Evening Run is a sporting event organized by SCB Horrem and Aktion Horrem and held in accordance with the guidelines of the German Athletics Association (DLV). The event offers races for different age groups and ability levels, including children’s races and a fun run. The course includes a 5 km loop, which is run twice in the 10 km race. The event emphasizes fairness and fun for all participants, from beginners to experienced athletes.
course_highlights: 5 km loop, run twice in the 10 km race
1.5 km children’s race
Event held in accordance with DLV guidelines, with rankings and an awards ceremony
additional: Race packet pickup on the day of the event from 2 p.m. at Friedrich-Ebert-Platz (Horrem market square). Changing and shower facilities at the Horrem sports hall. Free massages for runners provided by the Kerpen-Horrem Physiotherapy Training Institute. Online pre-registration is free and unranked for children’s races. Timing uses a disposable transponder. A requested race number is available with pre-registration for an additional €5. Registration opens on 09.02.2026. Timing uses a disposable transponder. June weather: approx. 23°C and sunny.

name: Hofmann-Flechtkulturlauf-Obermain
description: The Hofmann-Flechtkulturlauf Obermain (FKLO) is a large-scale fun run in Lichtenfels, taking place for the 14th time on 20 June 2026. The event offers a variety of running and Nordic walking routes along the flat “Flechtkultur Trail” and welcomes both recreational and ambitious runners without a strong emphasis on performance. The Lichtenfels Wine Festival takes place alongside the race, making it a sporting and social community event. Highlights include the emergency services championship and team and company managers’ competitions on the 10.4 km course.
course_highlights: Flat course along the Flechtkultur Trail
A variety of running and Nordic walking routes (5.3 km and 10.4 km)
Event in Lichtenfels city centre with a wine festival atmosphere
additional: On-site race bib collection, timing on the courses, competitions for emergency services, company managers and teams, event held alongside the Lichtenfels Wine Festival, good connections via the VGN transport network. Course distances: 5.3 km and 10.4 km; running and Nordic walking, combined with the wine festival and cultural activities.

name: Hüttlinger Muffigellauf
description: The Hüttlingen Muffigelläufe on June 20, 2026, offer a varied running and activity experience for all ages and ability levels. From the Bambini Run for the youngest participants to children’s, school and youth races, as well as more challenging routes such as the 10 km Kocherknie Run and the 7 km Limes Run, there is something for everyone. The Walk around the Limes is also an inviting way to take part at a relaxed pace. The event is organized by the dedicated running group of TSV Hüttlingen and places great importance on fun, community and unforgettable moments.
course_highlights: 780 m Bambini Run for children born in 2019 or later
7 km Limes Run and Walk around the Limes
10 km Kocherknie Run
additional: Race number collection from 11:00 at the race office in the DRK Begegnungsstätte (Muffigelbrunnen), Bachstr. 8, 73460 Hüttlingen. Parking and changing rooms/showers at the Limeshalle, Sulzdorfer Str. 12. Awards ceremonies for the top three finishers in each race on the festival stage from 17:30. Team classification available. Various race distances; on-site registration available; race number collection at the race office; parking at the Limeshalle.

name: km Staffellauf-100 jahre TSV Brokstedt
description: The 100 km relay race celebrating the TSV Brokstedt’s 100th anniversary is a special endurance event held in Brokstedt. Teams of 7 to 15 young people and adults, including at least 2 women, run in pairs for a total of 50 laps to complete the 100 km. Children aged 13 and under can take part in a shorter version of 25 laps and 50 km. The event takes place at the sports field in Brokstedt and offers a sporting challenge for teams who enjoy running together.
course_highlights: 50 laps of 2 km each for the 100 km relay
Teams run in pairs
Separate children’s relay with 25 laps (50 km)
additional: A maximum of 100 teams can take part. Local teams may register from 01.12.2025. To register, email staffellauf@tsvbrokstedt.de with the team leader’s details and the expected number of runners. Withdrawal of the entire team is not possible. The start and finish are at the A-Platz (Am Sportplatz 2b, 24161 Brokstedt). Race over 50 laps (pairs), children’s teams run 25 laps, shared finish, festival with activity area and food trucks, anniversary celebration from 20:00.

name: Never Give Up Hindernislauf
description: The Never Give Up obstacle run 2026 takes place on June 20 in Heinum near Gronau and offers a unique running experience for the whole family. Adults can take on a challenging main race of approx. 12 km with over 30 varied obstacles along idyllic forest and field paths on the edge of the Sieben Berge hills. There is also a 5 km run with more than 25 obstacles for children and adults, as well as a Kidsrun for ages 4 and up on an approx. 2 km course packed with exciting obstacles. Fun, team spirit and crossing the finish line together are the focus, alongside professional timing, medals for all finishers and refreshments in the finish area.
course_highlights: Main race: approx. 12 km with over 30 obstacles
Course follows forest and field paths on the edge of the Sieben Berge hills
5 km run with more than 25 obstacles for children and adults
additional: Professional timing for adults and children; medals and certificates for all finishers; refreshments in the finish area, including drinks, snacks, a cake buffet and street food; obstacles can be tackled solo or as a team; a large number of obstacles are on or around the sports field for a great spectator experience. Obstacle run through forest and fields, registration via RunTiming, family and children’s races, volunteers wanted

name: Referees Run
description: The Referees Run is a 10-kilometer race held annually in Borgholzhausen since 2005 as part of the “Nacht von Borgholzhausen” fun run. The Gelsenkirchen Referees’ Association traditionally fields one of the largest groups in the race. The event promotes camaraderie among referees through sport and offers an athletic challenge in a friendly atmosphere. The race takes place on June 20, 2026, and is coordinated by Stefan Tendyck.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer course
Part of the “Nacht von Borgholzhausen” fun run
Traditionally strong participation by the Gelsenkirchen Referees’ Association
additional: The race is part of the “Nacht von Borgholzhausen” event. Contact Stefan Tendyck for information. No prices or registration options are listed on the website. The Gelsenkirchen Referees’ Association is traditionally strongly represented. The Referees Run regularly attracts numerous referees from Westphalia and promotes camaraderie within the refereeing community.

name: Römerkanal-Volkslauf
description: The Römerkanal Volkslauf takes place on June 20, 2026, in Kreuzweingarten and offers a weekend full of activity and community. The popular race attracts many participants, who are cheered on by enthusiastic spectators along the route. The following day, June 21, village games and a large raffle complement the sporting event, bringing fun, games, and great prizes. The event is organized by TuS Kreuzweingarten and supported by e-regio to promote regional community experiences.
course_highlights: Various race distances, including 4.6 km and 10.4 km
Family and community activities

The course consists of two fast 5-kilometre laps, passing historic aircraft and running through the hangar, offering an unforgettable running experience with urban lifestyle and music.

The organiser provides refreshment stations and post-race recovery meals. Distances range from 10 km to 100 km. The event takes place in forest areas and features cross-country routes, Nordic Walking events, a 12–14-hour time limit, and registration online and on Facebook.

The course includes grass, forest roads, and asphalt; start times are 9:30 and 10:30; registration is available on site; categories are offered for various age groups; course distances range from 60 m to 10 km.

name: Prešov Running Series 2. kolo
description: The second round of the Prešov Running Series, known as Šariš Run, is a running event held on the shores of the ponds in Veľký Šariš, beneath the historic Šariš Castle. This venue is new to the series and has become very popular with runners. The event is full of sporting spirit, community, and love of nature, and also offers a rich programme of activities, including musical performances, health-service stands, a relaxation zone, and activities for children. The friendly, family atmosphere makes the run an unforgettable experience for all participants.

A new venue in the heart of Šariš that has proved very popular with runners
A natural setting with a community feel and a family-friendly atmosphere

The race offers runners a chance to experience the nature and beauty of Zemplín in summer. The event is part of the Zemplínsky extrém series, which brings various running challenges to the region.

Located in the picturesque Michalovce District
Part of the Zemplínsky extrém series, featuring several running events

description: toRunská vrtuľa is a charity running and community day in the beautiful surroundings of the Dubník Reservoir in Stará Turá. The event focuses on exercise and helping others, with all funds raised from entry fees donated to support rehabilitation for Simonka Zigová. Running pairs have 8 hours to complete as many laps around Dubník as possible, in a friendly and supportive atmosphere. The organizers and volunteers run the event without payment, emphasizing its community and charitable spirit.
course_highlights: A lap around the Dubník Reservoir, approximately 2.4 km long
Running pairs have 8 hours to complete as many laps as possible
Pleasant natural surroundings and a community atmosphere
additional: Registration is available as a pair or as a solo runner. Children up to 14.99 years old can register on site for a symbolic entry fee of at least €5, and the first 100 children will receive a race pack. The first 170 registered and paid runners will receive a race pack and a medal. Water and healthy refreshments will be provided during the run. After each lap, runners must report their completed lap at the check-line tent, where a point will be recorded for them. The event ends with the results announcement at around 18:00. The event raises funds to help Simonka Zigová, a young girl. It is organized by the toRun Stará Turá running club and is a charity, community, and fundraising event, with registration available online.

description: Doby vežu is an extreme obstacle race and trail run held in Brezno, Slovakia. Competitors must tackle challenging obstacles and complete a course leading to the top of Slovakia’s second-highest observation tower, which stands 40 metres tall and offers beautiful views. The course runs mainly along forest paths, across meadows and through a stream, with very little asphalt, and includes steep climbs and descents. Alongside the sporting challenge, an entertainment programme for all age groups is also planned. The organiser is M.Š.K Jašterice Brezno o.z., and the race director is Marek Janoštiak.
course_highlights: Forest paths, meadows, a stream and very little asphalt
450 m of elevation gain with challenging obstacles (crawling through mud, a slide, parallel bars, slackline, climbing, cargo net and more)
The top of Slovakia’s second-highest observation tower, standing 40 metres tall
additional: Online registration closes on 13.06.2026 at 23:55 or when the entry limit is reached. After this deadline, on-site registration is possible on race day if the limit has not been reached. Refreshments are available on the course and at the finish (fruit and a drink). Children may compete only with the consent of a legal guardian. Categories are divided by age and course type. The event includes an obstacle race and trail run, registration closes on 13 June 2026, categories are available for children and juniors, and refreshments and an entertainment programme are included.

description: Běhej lesy Týmovka is a unique team relay race held in the heart of the Vysočina region, offering an adventure for teams of 4 to 8 runners. The race consists of three different loops with a total distance of approximately 27.5 km, which each runner must complete over the weekend. The race also takes place at night, with headlamps, adding to its distinctive character and challenge. Alongside the race, there is a packed program of sports activities, cultural events and workshops. The facilities include a comfortable campsite with sanitation and refreshments.
course_highlights: Three loops with a total distance of approximately 27.5 km and elevation gain of 100 to 300 m
Night running with a headlamp as part of the relay race
Forest trails in the heart of the Vysočina region, with loops of varying difficulty
additional: The race bib includes a timing chip and gifts from partners. The team captain must enter the runners’ order in the SportID system by 17 June 2026. On-site registration is not available. Facilities include a campsite with space for tents and motorhomes, showers with hot water, refreshments in the PENNY tent, and a program of sports activities, concerts and workshops. There are no disposable cups at the refreshment stations, so runners must bring their own container (Speedcup). The race includes various team and individual categories, with the option to take part overnight and as part of the Běhej lesy race series, including ultramarathons and charity runs.

name: Velichovská sedmička

The race is open to all age groups, including children, and encourages active leisure in nature. Part of the Primátor Cup series, it is ideal for sports enthusiasts and families looking for an activity to enjoy together. The race takes place on the last Saturday in June, with other shorter routes and children’s categories also available.
course_highlights: Course runs along forest trails and local roads
Suitable for all age groups and families
Part of the Primátor Cup series, with different distances and categories
additional: Suitable for children; held in all weather; sporting event; race in May and June; cancelled in 2020

name: ČEZ RunTour Plzeň
location: Plzeň, centrum města Plzně, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: ČEZ RunTour Plzeň is a family-friendly running race with a joyful, relaxed atmosphere, suitable for both recreational and elite runners. It offers a range of distances, from children’s races to 3, 5 and 10 km, as well as a half marathon. The race takes place in the centre of Plzeň and is part of a series of events held across the Czech Republic. Participants can enjoy not only the race, but also a programme of activities for the whole family and high-quality support from start to finish.
course_highlights: 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km routes in the centre of Plzeň
Children’s races over 500 and 1,000 metres, with a children’s corner and childcare
Aid stations along the course and a race pack for every runner
additional: The race offers pacers, medical support and a dedicated emergency service phone line during the event. Every runner receives a drawstring bag with gifts from partners. Children receive a race pack from Lidl and can enjoy activities in the kids’ zone. There are at least two aid stations on the half-marathon route. The event also offers family activities, charitable support, race packs, facilities with refreshments and showers, and the option to have professional photos taken.

The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, themed categories, and valuable prizes for winners and participants. Picturesque village of Dobratice and surrounding countryside

name: Sunrise Marathon / Halfmaraton
location: Olympia Brno, Modřice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sunrise Marathon and Half Marathon take place on 21 June 2026 at Olympia Brno, Modřice. The race starts early in the morning at 4:46, giving runners the chance to experience the magical atmosphere of sunrise as they run. The course is flat and consists of five equal-length laps, running partly through nature and partly through shaded sections. The organizers provide electronic timekeeping and support at key points along the course. The race is suitable for all runners who want to welcome summer actively and enjoy the unique experience of running at dawn.
course_highlights: Flat course with five equal-length laps
Start and finish at Olympia Shopping Mall Brno, Modřice
Part of the course runs through nature and shaded sections
additional: Electronic chip timing. The course is marked with directional signs, and organizers are stationed at important points. Baggage storage is available until 10:00. The weather at the start is usually pleasant, 14–16 °C; runners are advised to adjust their hydration and clothing accordingly. Early-morning start, bus transport from Brno available, refreshment stations, medical service, and race merchandise available for purchase.

name: Hradecký kros
description: Hradecký kros is a traditional 10 km trail race held in the forests around Biřička in Hradec Králové. The race offers a unique experience on natural terrain with fewer paved sections, making it suitable for the general public and recreational runners. The event is part of the East Bohemia Running Grand Prix and attracts runners of all levels every year. The course consists of two 5 km loops over gently rolling terrain, highlighting both the beauty and the challenge of the race.

Two 5 km loops over gently rolling terrain
Suitable for the general public and recreational runners

The race offers runners a challenging yet appealing course in the beautiful natural surroundings of Beroun in the Central Bohemian Region. It is suitable for fans of mountain running and uphill running who want to test their endurance and strength on a short but intense route. The race is open to the public and welcomes all runners looking to enjoy a sporting challenge in a pleasant atmosphere.
course_highlights: 3.4 km course with 240 m of elevation gain
Challenging uphill run in the natural surroundings of Beroun
Part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series

description: The Gorch-Fock-Lauf in Wilhelmshaven takes place annually in June and offers distances for all age groups, including children’s races, 5 km, 10 km, a half marathon and a marathon. The course runs mostly along the coastline and the inner harbor, starting on Jade-Allee and finishing in Pumpwerk Park. The course is measured by the DLV, ensuring fair competition. In addition to the sporting event, there is also a club and school race with attractive prize money to promote youth sports in the region.

Route along the coastline and the inner harbor
Start on Jade-Allee, finish in Pumpwerk Park

The club and school race offers prize money to the five clubs/schools with the most participants. Changes of registration can be made online via a self-service link; no changes are possible on site. The event also includes a running service, club and school competitions, medals, shirts and prize money. Registration is online, with early-bird discounts available. The race starts on Jade-Allee and finishes in Pumpwerk Park.

The course passes orchards, follows forest and country roads, crosses a closed state road, and returns along a cycle path to the start and finish area at the Kelterei Heil premises. Two distances are offered: 5 kilometers (one lap) and 10 kilometers (two laps). The race is open to everyone, from competitive runners to recreational athletes, and also features a free children’s race for young runners up to 9 years old.

Return along a cycle path to Laubuseschbach

Only the two fastest runners per distance count toward the team result. The course passes orchards, forest and country roads, the closed state road L3063, and a cycle path; finisher shirt optional; team competition available.

name: Draisinenlauf Altenglan
description: The Draisinenlauf Altenglan on 21 June 2026 is a half-marathon event with individual and relay competitions (2-person and 4-person relays). The course follows the Glan-Blies cycle path alongside the draisine railway line. It is officially measured, flat, with only 45 metres of elevation gain, and almost entirely paved. The event takes place in all weather conditions and offers a unique atmosphere in the Kuseler Musikantenland, with dresines passing by. Safety is provided by the DLRG OG Altenglan and the DRK Kreisverband Kusel medical services. Medals are awarded to all finishers in the children’s and youth races, and prize money is awarded to the fastest half-marathon runners.
course_highlights: Officially measured, flat course with only 45 metres of elevation gain
Route along the Glan-Blies cycle path alongside the draisine railway line
Running course is almost entirely paved
additional: Timing is by disposable transponders issued with the race bib. Race bibs must be worn visibly on the chest. There is no walking event. Half-marathon prize money: €150 for 1st place, €100 for 2nd place, €50 for 3rd place. Special prizes for the clubs and schools with the most participants, and for the oldest participants. The event is approved by the DLV (5-year age-group scoring under the DLO). The course is flat, measured and almost entirely paved; relay and individual starts; refreshments every 2.5 km; registration only through BR-Timing; race bibs with transponders; certificates for all finishers; travel by train is possible; refreshments and award ceremonies on site.

name: Globus-Theißen-Lauf

The event offers distances for all age groups, from the Bambini race through 1.5 km, 3 km, and 7 km to 14 km. It is held at the Miners’ Stadium and is part of the Burgenland rankings for adults and the Wiesen-Grundcup for children and young people. Cake, coffee, and hearty food will be available, and there will be entertainment for children during the awards ceremony. The event is a joint project by Globus-Theissen, local clubs, and residents.

Start and finish at the Miners’ Stadium in Theißen
Course routes available as GPS tracks and PDFs

Courses for children, young people, women, men, and seniors; virtual routes are possible; a community event of regional significance

The event promotes a sense of community and enjoyment of nature, with refreshments and prizes for the largest groups.

name: Sachsenlauf Coswig
price_range: 2 € erste Stunde, danach 1,50 € (Parkgebühren im Parkhaus an der Moritzburger Straße)
description: The Sachsenlauf Coswig is a long-standing sporting event held annually in June since 1980. The races follow forest roads, woodland trails and field paths through the Friedewald and into the Moritzburg Hills. A special highlight on the 21.1 km route is running through the Moritzburg State Stud to the castle pond and Pferde-Hügel. In addition to running distances, walking and hiking options cater to different fitness levels and ambitions. The event is part of the Meißner Sparkassencup and the Niederlausitzcup, and also features dedicated races for children and Bambinis, with surprises at the finish.

Paid parking is available in the Moritzburger Straße car park. Travel by public transport (VVO bus routes 400, 401 and 405) is recommended. Children and Bambinis have their own out-and-back races (500 m and 800 m) with small surprises at the finish. Race bibs include a single-use timing transponder. Late registrations are possible on race day until 10:00; payment on site is cash only. Course adjustment due to the state championships, parking in the car park, travel by bus and train recommended, refreshments and awards ceremonies in the finish area, children’s and hiking routes

name: Wallernhäuser Dorflauf
description: The Wallernhausen Village Run is a traditional village race in Nidda-Wallernhausen, Germany, starting at 9:00 a.m. on Sunday morning. The event offers two distances: a short 1.6 km run and a longer 10 km run. This makes it suitable for younger runners and beginners, as well as runners looking for a classic longer distance. The course runs through the village of Wallernhausen and offers a friendly, family atmosphere away from large urban areas. Now in its 18th edition, the run is a popular local sporting event.
course_highlights: Run through the village of Wallernhausen
Two distances: 1.6 km and 10 km
Friendly village-run atmosphere
additional: Typical June weather, with an average temperature of 23 °C and mostly sunny days. The event is suitable for beginners and younger runners. It takes place in June, with typical temperatures around 23 °C and a low probability of precipitation. This is a local event focused on community and the enjoyment of running.

name: Benefizlauf Aachen
location: Waldstadion Aachen, Aachen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Benefizlauf Aachen is a long-standing running event taking place on June 28, 2026, at Waldstadion Aachen. The 24th edition offers various distances for all ages and abilities, from ambitious runners to recreational runners. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, volunteer commitment, and support for non-profit organizations. Participants can look forward to a beautiful course in the stadium and a great atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Aachen’s most beautiful stadium
A variety of distances for young and old, fast and leisurely
A running event with a sunny atmosphere and a great vibe
additional: Registration is via my.race|result. The event is organized by volunteers, and helpers are needed for course marshal posts, refreshment stations, and set-up and dismantling. Training opportunities are available for members, including beginner running groups and regular training sessions in the Aachen Forest. Various distances, registration via the website, charitable event

name: 10K Hamburg - Volkspark
description: The 10K Hamburg Volkspark is an exciting 10-kilometer race on fully closed and secured out-and-back routes in Hamburg. The course runs along paved and asphalt paths, offering an appealing running experience for runners of all abilities. The event is part of the 10K Hamburg series, which takes place at various attractive locations in the Elbe metropolis. Registration is online only, and the event is already sold out.
course_highlights: Fully closed and secured out-and-back routes
Runs along paved and asphalt paths
Attractive course in Hamburg’s Volkspark
additional: A bag drop for personal belongings and change of clothes is available on race day. Travel by public transport is recommended; for example, Stellingen S-Bahn station is about a 20-minute walk from the event site on Max-Schmeling-Straße. Registration is online only. The Cup ranking includes all 10K Hamburg events, with points awarded to the 30 fastest men and women. The race is open to the public, and using public transport is recommended. The event has a set distance of 10 kilometers and medals for all finishers.

name: Barsinghäuser Fuchsbau Spendenlauf
description: The Barsinghausen Fuchsbau Charity Run is a running event in support of the “FUCHSBAU” Association – Bereavement Support for Children and Young People. Since 2010, the association has supported young people coping with the death of someone close to them. The charity run was launched in 2024 to fund Fuchsbau’s important work, as the association has relied entirely on donations since 2023. The event promotes community spirit and social engagement in Barsinghausen and will take place again in 2026.
course_highlights: Run for a good cause in Barsinghausen
A community event with a programme of activities and entertainment
Venue: REWE Sportpark Barsinghausen
additional: The charity run has prominent supporters and includes artistic performances and entertainment, such as a bouncy castle provided by Hoppeburg. Stadtwerke Barsinghausen supplies the drinking water. Jan Haller is the event’s patron for 2026. There is a dm running challenge and a programme of activities. The event takes place at REWE Sportpark. Run for 4 hours, with a variety of activities and refreshments on site; run on a sports facility; sponsors support runners per lap; family festival.

description: The Bestensee Lakes Run is a traditional race held annually in Bestensee since 2002. It offers three different distances—2 km, 7.5 km and 16 km—suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The race starts at the Landkostarena, surrounded by the region’s idyllic lakes and forests. The event is open to all age groups, and children and young people up to 13 years old can take part free of charge.
course_highlights: Three distances: 2 km, 7.5 km and 16 km
Start and finish at the Landkostarena in Bestensee
Route through the region’s scenic lakes and forests
additional: Children and young people up to 13 years old can take part free of charge. Late registration is possible on race day until 08:45, with a late registration fee of 2 euros. Start times are approximately 09:00 for 2 km, 09:30 for 16 km and 09:40 for 7.5 km. The start is at the Landkostarena, Goethestraße 17, 15741 Bestensee. Runners can register online; start and finish at the Landkostarena; routes in Bestensee; registration until 20 June 2024

name: Buchholzer Stadtlauf
location: Buchholz in der Nordheide, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Buchholz City Run is a traditional race with cult status in the Nordheide, taking place on 21 June 2026. The route runs right through the centre of Buchholz and is lined with numerous spectators, creating a special atmosphere and providing motivation. A range of distances offers suitable challenges for all ages and ability levels, from the children’s race to the popular team relay. Running training with certified coaches is also available, and all participants receive special medals and certificates.
course_highlights: Route through the centre of Buchholz
Numerous spectators along the route provide motivation
Two NLV-measured, record-eligible courses (10 km and half marathon)
additional: Race pack collection on 20.06.2026 from 9:00–15:00 and on 21.06.2026 from 7:00 at the town hall. Late entries on 20.06. and 21.06. are cash only. Showers are available at Waldschule. Helmets are compulsory for inline skaters; full protective gear is recommended. Free finisher shirt for children and young people up to age 18; adults pay €5 per shirt. Drinks are provided every 5 km, with tea and water available more frequently. Various distances, running training, children’s races, measured courses, prizes for winners, medals, certificates, free finisher shirt for young people, drinks every 5 km, team competition.

name: edge beyond x Duracher Lauf
description: The Durach Run on June 21, 2026, offers suitable races for runners of all ages and ability levels: 5.5 km, 10 km, Kids Run, and Schülerlauf. The event emphasizes professional organization, safety, and an unforgettable atmosphere. Alongside the sporting competition, there will be a large joint awards ceremony, prize money for new course records, and a raffle. Teams and clubs can also take part in special competitions and receive discounts.
course_highlights: Scenic 5.5 km and 10 km routes through Durach
Large joint awards ceremony from 13:30
Prize money for new course records and a raffle for the grand prize
additional: Team competition for teams of 4, with at least 2 participants in the 5.5 km race. Companies receive a 10% discount for 10 or more registrations (only via company login). The club with the most participants wins 4 crates of their choice (beer, non-alcoholic, or shandy). New start times: 09:30 for the 5.5 km run, 10:45 for the 10 km run. Multiple races (5.5 km, 10 km, Kids Run, Schülerlauf), team and company competitions, new start times; no longer a charity event.

name: Eichberglauf
location: Vereinshaus Am Heller, Glottertal, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
organizer: Kultur- und Heimatverein ‚Rund um den Eichberg‘ e.V.
price_range: 13 € für den Hauptlauf, 7 € für den Winzerlauf, 4 € für Schülerläufe, 3 € für Bambinilauf, Nachmeldung 4 €
