description: The Eichberglauf has been organized for almost 20 years by the Kultur- und Heimatverein „Rund um den Eichberg“ e.V. and offers summer runs for the whole family. The 19th run will take place on June 7, 2026, starting at the club’s storage facility at Am Heller. There are six different courses to choose from, mostly over unpaved terrain and through the Planitzwald. The event is suitable for all age groups, including special courses for children and wheelchair users. Participants receive certificates, and there are prizes for the top runners as well as team trophies.
course_highlights: Six different courses over unpaved terrain and through the Planitzwald
Distances from under 200 m to the half marathon (21 km)
Approximately 3 km paved wheelchair course for wheelchair users, with or without an accompanying person
additional: Late entries are possible on race day for an additional fee (€3 for adults, €1 for children and young people). All participants receive a certificate of participation showing their times, which can be accessed online. Prizes are awarded to the top three finishers in each age group, and team trophies go to the best team of four (5.2 km) and the best children’s team (800 m). First-aid station at the start/finish. A selection of snacks and drinks is available on site at moderate prices. Some sections are unpaved and trail-like. Online registration is open until 18.06.2026; late entries are available on site for a fee. Water stations are available. Results are scored according to BLV rules. Participation is at your own risk.

name: Grafschafter Ahrtal-Lauf
description: The Grafschafter Ahrtal Run is a traditional running event jointly organized by the clubs SV Dernau, SV Hönningen/Ahr and Grafschafter SV. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including 400 m and 1 km children’s races, 5 km and 10 km races, and a 5 km walking competition. The start and finish are at the sports field in Grafschaft-Vettelhoven, and the course follows field paths, some of which are gravel or paved. The event is part of the Ahrtal Team Cup race series and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with changing rooms and showers available on site.
course_highlights: Course along field paths, some of which are gravel or paved
Start and finish at the sports field in Grafschaft-Vettelhoven
A range of distances for children and adults
additional: Late entries are possible on race day until half an hour before the start. Parking is available directly at the sports field. Changing rooms and showers are located in the clubhouse at the sports field. Award ceremonies take place at around 10:45 a.m. for the 5 km and 10 km races, and at around 12:30 p.m. for the age groups in the 10 km race, followed by the children’s races. The courses pass through Grafschafter Forest and the vineyards of the Ahr Valley; online registration is available; parking is available at the sports field; changing rooms and showers are in the clubhouse; proceeds go to local sports clubs.

name: KSC Schlossparklauf
description: The KSC Schlossparklauf takes place for the 28th time on June 21, 2026, and will be held in summer for the first time. New this year is a partner run for companies. The event includes a main race, a youth and schoolchildren’s race, and the partner run, with limited participant numbers. The course is a loop of approximately 3.25 km from the BBBank Wildpark to the palace and back. The main race covers three laps, while young runners complete one lap. The start and finish are at the BBBank Wildpark.
course_highlights: Loop of approximately 3.25 km from the BBBank Wildpark to the palace and back
Main race: 3 laps; youth and schoolchildren’s race: 1 lap
Start at the “Nackter Mann” in front of the south stand; finish in front of the west stand at the BBBank Wildpark
additional: Participant limits: 1,100 in the main race, 300 in the youth and schoolchildren’s race, and 800 in the partner run. Late registration is possible on event day if the participant limit has not been reached. The start and finish are at the BBBank Wildpark. The partner run for companies is new in 2026. Loop of approximately 3.25 km, not officially measured; start at the 'Nackter Mann' in front of the south stand at the BBB Wildpark; finish in the Wildpark; online registration available; various race distances; running shirt available for an additional fee; partner run for companies.

name: Lamspringer Klosterlauf
description: The Lamspringe Monastery Run is an annual running and walking event starting and finishing at Lamspringe Forest Stadium. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including children's races, and is part of the Südniedersachsen Cup. Runners, walkers and hiking enthusiasts are warmly invited to enjoy the varied routes through the countryside around Lamspringe. The event combines sporting ambition with fun and a sense of community in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Lamspringe Forest Stadium
Several running and walking routes at various distances
Children's races and routes from 400 m to 23 km
additional: On-site late registration is available until 1 hour before the start. Distances: 400 m, 1 km, 2 km, 5 km, 15 km, 23 km. The event is part of the Südniedersachsen Cup. Start and finish at Lamspringe Forest Stadium; various distances (1 km, 5 km, 8 km, 13 km, 22.9 km); changing rooms and showers; refreshments available on site; part of the Südniedersachsen Cup.

name: Lauf in die Sonne
description: Lauf in die Sonne takes place on 21 June 2026 in 71397 Nellmersbach and is organised by Hot Socks Leutenbach e.V. There are two race distances, 10 km and 5.8 km, which start together at 08:00. The event offers an extensive breakfast buffet and awards trophies to the top runners. A challenge trophy is also awarded to the best team. Participation is limited to a maximum of 222 starters.
course_highlights: Two distances: 10 km and 5.8 km
Start and finish at the Mehrzweckhalle in Nellmersbach
Large breakfast buffet after the race
additional: Maximum of 222 starters. Race packs available from 07:00. Awards ceremony at 10:30. Trophies for 1st–3rd place in each individual category and a challenge trophy for the best team. Lauf in die Sonne, running event, 10 km & 5.8 km, breakfast included, registration from Easter, max. 222 starters

name: Meilenlauf beim WGV-Leichtathletik-Festival
description: The WGV Athletics Festival on 21 June 2026 in Stuttgart offers a varied programme celebrating athletics. At its heart is the Street Mile, a new running format in the city centre that is open to all running enthusiasts. The festival also features the KLEINformat! Charity Run, where every lap completed supports a good cause, as well as an Elite Mile with top athletes and a Children’s Mile for the youngest participants. The festival brings together elite sport, recreational sport and social commitment in a unique event in the heart of Stuttgart.
course_highlights: A Street Mile covering exactly 1609 metres through Stuttgart city centre
The KLEINformat! Charity Run, with an approx. 800-metre loop passing through Marktplatz, Schillerplatz, Planie, Karlsplatz and Dorotheen Quartier
An Elite Mile featuring top athletes, starting at 12:40 p.m.
additional: The KLEINformat! Charity Run starts at 11:00 a.m. and lasts 75 minutes. The loop is approx. 800 metres long and flat. The Street Mile starts at 12:15 p.m. and is open to all running enthusiasts. The Elite Mile starts at 12:40 p.m., and the Children’s Mile at 1:00 p.m. Participation in the charity run is free; voluntary donations are welcome. The Street Mile is a new format being held in Stuttgart for the first time. Registration is open until 21 June 2026; various race categories are available for children and adults. The event is part of an athletics festival featuring additional sporting activities.

description: The 16th Sababurg Zoo Run takes place on June 21, 2026, in the picturesque Sababurg Zoo and the adjacent Reinhardswald Forest. Runners will be cheered on by enthusiastic spectators and enjoy a unique natural setting on carefully selected courses. The run is a charity event in support of the planned Amphibian World, a new nature learning center that is to be created at the zoo. The Zoo Run is also part of the Reinhardswald Running and Walking Cup and offers courses for various age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: Running courses in Sababurg Zoo and the adjacent Reinhardswald Forest
Beautiful views of the zoo, its animals, and Sababurg Castle
Courses on paved park paths, suitable for beginners and experienced runners
additional: Race bibs with transponders will be issued on race day and must be worn clearly visible at the front. Timing is by transponder. Aid stations with mineral water and bananas are available approximately every 3–4 km. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Bambinis may be accompanied by an adult but may not be carried. Dogs and baby joggers are not permitted on the running courses. Part of the Reinhardswald Running and Walking Cup series. Registration is open from May 1 to June 19, 2026; no registration on race day.

name: Schlossinsellauf Lübben
description: The Schlossinsellauf Lübben is a traditional running event on the idyllic Schlossinsel in the town of Lübben in the Spreewald. It offers courses for children, young people and adults, including Bambini runs, children’s races, 5 km, 10 km, a half marathon and a Run & Bike half marathon. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and varied route, which runs both on the Schlossinsel and through the surrounding Spreewald area. The race is part of the Spreewald Cup and attracts numerous runners every year.
course_highlights: Courses on the idyllic Schlossinsel in Lübben
A range of distances, from the 550 m Bambini run to the half marathon and Run & Bike
Part of the Spreewald Cup, with a varied route
additional: Overall participant limit of 1,000 starters. Registration is binding and cannot be cancelled. Entry fees are collected by direct debit. Group and club registration is available. Age categories are defined for the children’s and youth races. The event is part of the Spreewald Cup. Changing rooms, cloakrooms, showers, medical care, refreshments and entertainment are available on site. Various race distances (Bambini, children’s races, 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, Run & Bike). Registration opens on 01.02.2026. Participant limit: 1,000.

name: Sonnwend-Freundschaftslauf
description: The 3rd Sonnwend Friendship Run in Völklingen offers runners a varied event featuring historic and modern courses. On June 21, 2026, participants can take part in the traditional 10-mile race as well as the 8 km and 10 km races and Nordic walking. The event is supported by experienced runners and takes place near the Hermann-Neuberger-Halle and the swimming pool. Lauftrefffreunde Köllertal look forward to welcoming many participants and enjoying a sporting get-together.
course_highlights: Historic 10-mile course
Additional options: 8 km, 10 km and Nordic walking
Start and finish near the Hermann-Neuberger-Halle / Völklingen swimming pool
additional: Start times: 09:00 for the 10-mile race; 09:30 for the 8 km and 10 km races and Nordic walking. Support from experienced runners. The event is part of a tradition that fosters community spirit and gives runners an opportunity to connect and celebrate the start of summer together.

name: Spessarthelden - Laufen gegen Gewalt
description: The Spessarthelden Run Against Violence is a charity run in Bad Soden-Salmünster, organized by Tuğçe Albayrak e.V. and the city. The event sends a strong message against violence and is supported by former Federal President Christian Wulff as patron. It offers various distances suitable for all age groups and promotes community spirit and social engagement in the region.
course_highlights: Distances: 500 metres, 5 kilometres and 10 kilometres
Charity run promoting social engagement against violence
Event in the Bad Soden-Salmünster region
additional: There is a special school registration for all groups under 18. The event is held as a charity festival with various sponsors and supporters. Start and finish at the Spessart Forum; parking available; arrival by train, bicycle or on foot possible; running event with team scoring and special offers on presentation of the race bib.

name: Töpfermarktlauf Bürgel
description: The Töpfermarktlauf in Bürgel is a long-standing race that has been established as a sporting highlight in the Saale-Holzland district since the 1990s. The event offers a range of distances, including the challenging 12 km main race and the 6 km beginners’ race, which pass through the varied landscape around Bürgel. All participants receive a handmade, pottery-crafted medal as a keepsake. The event is family-friendly, with children’s and schoolchildren’s races, and takes place on Sunday morning to make it possible for as many running enthusiasts as possible to take part.
course_highlights: 12 km main race with a challenging elevation profile for experienced runners
6 km beginners’ race on a varied route around Bürgel
Water stations along the course and refreshments at the finish
additional: Every participant receives a unique, handmade, pottery-crafted medal. Medals go to the first 250 registrants in the 12 km main race and the 6 km beginners’ race, as well as the first 200 children and schoolchildren. The awards ceremony takes place at approximately 11:00 a.m. at the sports field. Overall winners receive pottery-crafted trophies and certificates. There is no parking directly at the sports field, but designated parking areas are nearby. Timing is electronic and provided by GO-timing. The course is clearly marked, and the fire brigade ensures safety at road crossings. A bicycle escort accompanies all courses. Courses for children, beginners, recreational and elite runners; anniversary event; family and community atmosphere

name: Waiblinger Stadtlauf
description: The Waiblingen City Run takes place on June 21, 2026, and offers runners of different age groups and ability levels the opportunity to take part in a range of distances. The event is family-friendly and accompanied by a varied entertainment program at Rathausplatz. The VfL Waiblingen athletics department provides food and refreshments. Participation in the children’s or youth run also supports Tour Ginkgo, which helps seriously ill children and their families.
course_highlights: Children’s run: 2 laps, approx. 1,400 m
10 km and 6 km runs, plus walking: 1 lap, approx. 2 km
Varied entertainment program at Rathausplatz
additional: Registration opens in early 2026. The VfL Waiblingen athletics department provides food and refreshments. Volksbank Stuttgart will donate €1 to Tour Ginkgo in the Rems-Murr district for every successful participation in the children’s or youth run. Online registration is available; the event takes place in June 2026; contact by phone and email.

name: Bieg Lotnej Kompanii Szturmowej
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Wypoczynku w Haczowie oraz Urząd Gminy w Haczowie

price_tiers.distance: Bieg główny 12 km, Piątka Wyżykowskiego 5 km i Nordic Walking 5 km

description: The 8th “Lotna” Run in Haczów is an annual running event commemorating the Lotna Assault Company of Lieutenant Stanisław Maczek and the Haczów Heroes of the Battles for Poland’s Independence in 1918–1921. The events take place on routes of approximately 12 km and 5 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking course, mostly on paved and gravel roads in the Haczów municipality. The run promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity and integration within the local community. Free shorter-distance races for children, tailored to their age, are also planned. The race office and event base are located in the Manor Park by the Municipal Cultural and Recreation Centre in Haczów.
course_highlights: Routes of approximately 12 km and 5 km, mostly on paved and gravel roads
One water refreshment station along the route
Time limits: 2 hours for the 12 km run and 1 hour for the 5 km run and Nordic Walking
additional: The participant limit is 150 for the adult races. Free children’s races are planned over distances from approximately 200 m to 1,000 m, depending on age category. The race office is open from 13:00 to 14:30 for adults and from 11:30 to 12:45 for children. Race packs are distributed at the race office. The entry fee is non-refundable. The event has a limit of 150 participants and water refreshment stations. A detailed schedule includes start and awards ceremony times. The event takes place in Haczów, in the Manor Park and at the LKS stadium.

description: The 9th edition of Gryf Arena Run will take place on June 21, 2026, in Gryfice. The route runs through the city streets, offering participants a great atmosphere, sporting excitement, and positive energy. The event is family-friendly, with children’s races over distances from 100 to 600 metres, tailored to different age groups. Every child taking part in the races will receive a commemorative T-shirt, a medal, and a sweet treat at the finish. It is one of the largest running events in the region, combining sporting competition with fun for the whole family.
course_highlights: The route runs through the streets of Gryfice
Children’s races over distances from 100 to 600 metres, tailored to different age groups
An atmosphere full of sporting excitement and positive energy
additional: The McDonald’s Gryfice children’s races start at 10:00. Every child will receive a commemorative T-shirt, a medal, and a sweet treat at the finish. Online registration is available for the children’s races. The entry fee on race day, payable at the race office, is 50 zł. The event takes place in the city of Gryfice, with a road route and electronic timing. Online registration is available; medals and prizes are planned for the best finishers. The participant limit for the main race is 150.

name: IX Bieg Wolności
location: Samorządowa Instytucja Kultury Kasztelania, Kije, Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 9th Bieg Wolności – Kije 2026 is a special sporting event that brings together a passion for running, community spirit, and the promotion of the beautiful Ponidzie region. The race will take place on June 21, 2026, at 18:00 at the Kasztelania Local Cultural Institution in Kije, where the start and finish will be located. Participants can compete over two distances: 10 km and 5.5 km (“Piątka z plusem”), either running or walking with Nordic walking poles. The event offers a great atmosphere, cash and non-cash prizes, and commemorative medals and race packs for all participants.
course_highlights: Two distances: 10 km and 5.5 km (Piątka z plusem)
The course is open to runners and Nordic walkers
Start and finish at the Kasztelania Local Cultural Institution in Kije
additional: All participants will receive commemorative medals and race packs. The organizers have prepared local and age-group classifications, as well as attractive cash and non-cash prizes. The start and finish are located at the Kasztelania Local Cultural Institution in Kije. The grounds around Kasztelania, online registration, commemorative medals, cash and non-cash prizes.

description: The X STO-nogi Run in Milanówek is a traditional 10 km road race held in the picturesque town of Milanówek. The T-shaped course consists of two 5 km loops along the town’s streets, with turnarounds by a wayside shrine and on Brzozowa Street. The start and finish are at Social General Secondary School No. 5 at 41 Herberta Street. The race is organized by running enthusiasts from the STO-nogi group, who promote running among residents and visitors.
course_highlights: A 10 km T-shaped course consisting of two 5 km loops
A road race through Milanówek, with turnarounds by a wayside shrine and on Brzozowa Street
Start and finish at SLO No. 5, 41 Herberta Street
additional: Start and finish at SLO No. 5 (41 Herberta Street). Road course with two turnarounds. The race is organized by the local STO-nogi running group, which promotes sport among residents. Previous editions have also included races over other distances and night runs. Contact the organizers by phone: Leszek Janasik 666 353 600, Jerzy Stypa 601 825 560. The event includes a 10 km race through the streets of Milanówek, with online registration and training plans available to help participants prepare. Participants can also take part in accompanying night events.

description: The 10th Ostróda St. George’s Half Marathon is the anniversary edition of the event held in Ostróda. The course runs along the promenade by Lake Drwęckie and through the city streets. It consists of two identical loops, covering a total of 21.098 km. The race starts and finishes at the Amphitheatre at 17a Mickiewicza Street, and water stations are located approximately every 4 km. The organizers provide a commemorative medal and a voucher for a post-race meal, with a choice of a race package with or without a T-shirt. The event is charitable, supporting the rehabilitation of a girl named Maja.
course_highlights: The course runs along the promenade by Lake Drwęckie and through the streets of Ostróda
Two identical loops covering a total of 21.098 km
Water stations approximately every 4 km (4 stations per loop)
additional: The participant limit is 400. The start and finish are at the Amphitheatre at 17a Mickiewicza Street. The time limit is 3 hours. The race package includes a personalized bib, a bag for the baggage drop, safety pins, a commemorative medal, and a voucher for a post-race meal. After June 10, registration is available only at the race office (June 20–21), with a basic package priced at 180 PLN. The timing chip is rented and must be returned after the race. The participant limit is 170 out of 400 places. Entry fees include medals, bags, and a meal voucher. Proceeds from the fees support a charity campaign for Maja’s rehabilitation. The course is not certified by PZLA. Water stations are located every 4 km. The time limit is 3 hours.

name: XI Bieg Terenowy Zgierz Malinka
location: MOSiR Zgierz Malinka, Zgierz, Łódzkie, Poland
description: The 11th Zgierz Malinka Trail Run is a trail race held in the wooded grounds of MOSiR Zgierz Malinka. The course features varied terrain, climbs and descents of different lengths and gradients, large sandy patches, and narrow sections through bushes. Its cross-country character attracts runners looking to get away from the asphalt or prepare for mountain races. The event offers three distances: 4, 8, and 12 km, as well as a 4 km Nordic walking event and races for children and young people. Participants receive symbolic medals inspired by raspberries, while the top female and male finishers in each distance receive trophies.
course_highlights: The course runs through the wooded grounds of MOSiR Zgierz Malinka
Varied terrain with climbs, descents, sand, and narrow sections through bushes
A cross-country course, unusual for an urban setting
additional: All runners start at the same time, regardless of distance. Children and young people can take part in races over 150 m (ages 0–6) and 800 m (ages 7–15). The event village at MOSiR Zgierz Malinka offers numerous attractions, including playgrounds, a pump track, beach volleyball courts, mini football and basketball courts, swimming areas, kayak rentals, and a golf driving range. The event includes various race distances, children’s races, medals, electronic timing, and on-site sports attractions.

description: Bieg Świecie Biega Brzegiem Deczna is an annual running event held in the picturesque area of Deczno near Świecie. The main 10 km race takes participants through the Recreation and Leisure Centre grounds, offering an appealing course and sporting competition. The event also includes free races for children, making it a family-friendly and inclusive event. The organizers provide professional timing and race packs with T-shirts for early registrants. The main race is limited to 300 participants, ensuring an intimate atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 10 km course around the Deczno Recreation and Leisure Centre
Picturesque areas along the banks of the Deczna River
Children’s races as an integral part of the event
additional: The main race is limited to 300 participants, and the children’s races to 100 participants. The children’s races are free. The race pack includes a T-shirt for registrations received by May 31. The children’s races start at 10:00, and the main race starts at 11:00. Organizer contact: Bartosz Gładyszew, tel. 669-056-101. The event also includes competitions for children and attractive prizes for the top runners.

name: Grobský Runfest
location: Areál za MŠ a ZŠ Javorová Alej, Chorvátsky Grob, Slovakia
organizer: SBT Spid.com, s.r.o., Susedský Hi o.z., PavúčikSport Team o.z., obec Chorvátsky Grob
description: Grobský Runfest is a two-day sports festival in Chorvátsky Grob, bringing together professional athletes and recreational enthusiasts of all ages. It offers running courses of various distances, children’s runs, cycling races, and a rich cultural and entertainment program, including a food zone and live music. The event supports community spirit and a healthy lifestyle in a pleasant setting, with a range of activities for all visitors.
course_highlights: 5 km WeLive Run on flat asphalt
12 km Run for the Village Cup, 30% asphalt and 70% off-road, mostly flat
Children’s runs and cycling races divided by age group
additional: On-site registration for the 5 km: 16:00–17:45; results announcement at 19:15. On-site registration for the 12 km: Saturday 16:00–18:00, Sunday 10:00–11:15; results announcement Sunday at 13:00. The courses are mainly asphalt and off-road, with a flat profile. The festival also features a floorball tournament, a football cup, a cycling zone, a food zone, and a recovery zone. The program also includes live music and presentations by local organizations. The event includes a range of sports activities, concerts, children’s zones, refreshment stations, a recovery zone, and competitions for all age groups.

name: Tvrďák – Bratislava
description: Tvrďák Bratislava is Slovakia’s largest obstacle race, held at the Divoká Voda complex in Čunovo. Runners tackle more than 20 obstacles on a course of approximately 5 km, and can choose from different formats, including a non-competitive Fitness format or a timed race. After the race, participants can relax by the pool, enjoy refreshments and watch strength competitions. The race is also suitable for children aged 8 to 14 and includes a medal, photos and a race video as souvenirs of the experience.
course_highlights: Approx. 5 km course with more than 20 obstacles
Obstacles adapted for children aged 8 and up
Held at the Divoká Voda complex in Čunovo, with the option to relax by the pool
additional: Participants can take on Tvrďák 5+ km solo or as part of a team (at least 3 people; mixed-gender teams are allowed). Fitness format (non-competitive, no timing, no penalty exercises, obstacles may be skipped) and Timed format (time measured; penalty exercises apply if an obstacle is not completed). After the race, participants can relax by the pool, enjoy refreshments, try water sports and watch strength competitions from 14:00. Entry fees are non-refundable; entry can be transferred to another person or to the following year for a fee. The event also includes a children’s race, team or individual starts, and water activities and entertainment for all age groups after the race.

name: Behu ulicami mesta Veľký Krtíš
price_range: 15 € pre hlavnú trať, 3 € pre juniorov, 15 € pre Nordic Walking, zľavy pre seniorov
description: The Run Through the Streets of Veľký Krtíš is a traditional race organized by the Bežci VK civic association. It offers several categories, including children, hobby runners and Nordic Walking. The race takes place in Veľký Krtíš, with distances ranging from 3,000 m to the 11,000 m main race. The children’s race starts at 09:45, while the main race and Nordic Walking start at 11:00. The event is suitable for the general public and offers discounts for seniors over 60.
course_highlights: 11,000 m main race through the city streets
3,000 m hobby race
6,000 m Nordic Walking route
additional: A 50% discount on the entry fee is available for participants aged 60 and over. On-site registration is possible at least 30 minutes before the main race starts, at the increased entry fee of €17. The route includes city streets and asphalt roads. Online registration is open until 14 June 2025. The event is suitable for all age groups.

name: Moldavský pohár Bodvy
location: Hlavné námestie, Moldava nad Bodvou, Košice, Slovakia
description: The Bodva Moldavian Cup is an international road running, cycling and inline skating event held in Moldava nad Bodvou. The event offers various categories for runners, cyclists and inline skaters, with routes through the surrounding countryside and villages. It is known for its tradition and high-quality organization, with the start and finish at Main Square in Moldava nad Bodvou. It also includes a mass run for health, open to the general public.
course_highlights: The running route follows the road between Moldava nad Bodvou and Jasov and back.
The cycling route passes through several villages, including Budulov, Janík and Turnianska Nová Ves.
The inline skating route is 17.5 km long and is part of the Slovak Inline Cup.
additional: Race registration is open from 7:00 to 8:30. The awards ceremony takes place in front of the Secondary Vocational School of Agricultural Engineering. Cash prizes are awarded to the top three competitors in the men’s and women’s categories; all others receive medals. All competition categories have age limits, and competitors may register only for the category corresponding to their age. The event includes several categories, online registration and sponsor support.

name: Kros Sázava
description: Kros Sázava is a running race in Pikovice, Central Bohemian Region, offering three routes of varying distances and elevation gains. The longest route is 15.5 km with approximately 500 m of elevation gain, the middle route is 10 km with approximately 230 m of elevation gain, and the hobby route is 5 km with 120 m of elevation gain. All courses run exclusively through natural surroundings, promising beautiful and challenging running experiences. The race is suitable for runners of different levels who want to enjoy a cross-country run in a picturesque setting.
course_highlights: Long route: 15.5 km with approximately 500 m of elevation gain
Middle route: 10 km with approximately 230 m of elevation gain
Hobby route: 5 km with 120 m of elevation gain
additional: Routes of 15.5 km, 10 km, and 5 km; scenic trail along the Sázava River and forest paths; scenic and technical sections

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 2
description: The Osterode Stage Marathon is a unique marathon that divides the classic distance of 42.195 km into seven enjoyable after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometres each. The route follows loops through the beautiful countryside around Osterode in the Harz foothills. The event is open to runners, walkers and Nordic walkers, and also offers a Kids’ stage for younger participants. The event is organised by regional clubs and will take place for the 18th time in 2026.
course_highlights: Seven stages of 5 to 7 kilometres each, following loop courses
Countryside in the Harz foothills around Osterode
Additional 750-metre Kids’ stage in Schützenpark
additional: The stages start at 18:45 each day, except for the first stage on 21 June at 10:45 and the final stage on 27 June at 16:00. The awards ceremony takes place on 27 June at 18:00. Runners, walkers and Nordic walkers may participate. Minors need written consent from a parent or guardian. Club membership is not required. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with refreshment stations and social activities at the finish. Registration is mainly by email, and the routes are tailored to the stages scheduled for each day.

name: Sommerlauf Baierbrunn
description: The Baierbrunn Summer Run is a traditional race that has been held annually since 2015, bringing the entire Baierbrunn community together. The event is open to professional and recreational runners of all ages and offers a range of courses through the surrounding forests, with varied terrain. After the races for different age groups and distances, a summer festival for all participants and friends of SC Baierbrunn follows. The course is marked and closed to traffic, with drink stations along the way.
course_highlights: Beautiful course through the surrounding forests
Course with climbs and descents; not suitable for setting personal bests
Drinks provided along the course
additional: Race-number pickup starts at 8:30 a.m. on race day. Late registration is possible on race day until 9:00 a.m. for an additional fee of €5.00. Timing uses Datasport race-number transponders. Showers are available in the changing rooms at the SCB clubhouse, close to the Sports and Civic Centre. Each race is limited to a maximum of 80 participants. The awards ceremony takes place approximately 30 minutes after the last finisher. Baierbrunn S-Bahn station is nearby. A summer festival hosted by SC Baierbrunn follows the event. Races are offered for various age groups, including Bambini, children, youth, recreational runners, the main race, and Nordic walking; registration is recommended; the event is followed by a summer festival.

description: Chuchelský Cross-Country Race is a traditional cross-country running event organized by the SC Radotín athletics club. It takes place on the racecourse in Velká Chuchle. The event offers various categories for all age groups, from young children to adults, including the Prague Cross-Country Championships. The course runs mostly on grass, with some gravel sections, making for an interesting and challenging terrain. Refreshments are available, and the venue is conveniently accessible by public transport and car. Race numbers and timing chips are issued on site on race day.
course_highlights: The course runs on grass, with some gravel sections, at the Velká Chuchle racecourse
The event is part of the Prague Cross-Country Championships
Accessible by bus number 244 and by train to Praha - Velká Chuchle station
additional: Race numbers are issued from 8:55 in the grandstand. Each runner receives a timing chip, which must be returned after finishing. The assembly area is opposite the small bridge over the outer racecourse. Refreshments are available during the races. The venue is entered through the main visitor entrance from the bus turning circle. Runners start in several category-based blocks from 9:30 until approximately 13:30. The event offers various categories and course distances, with registration available online or on site. It takes place at the racecourse, which has facilities including changing rooms, showers and a car park.

name: Sparkassen-Minimarathon
description: The Sparkassen Mini Marathon in Karlsruhe is a special running festival for children and young people, taking place on September 19, 2026, at the Carl-Kaufmann Stadium. Three distances are offered: the Mini Marathon, approximately 4.2 km; the Mini Half Marathon, approximately 2.1 km; and the Bambini Run, approximately 333 m. All races start and finish in the stadium, with the longer distances passing through the beautiful Günther-Klotz-Anlage. The event is inclusive and offers every child a medal and a personalized online certificate. Timing is done using a chip in the race number.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Carl-Kaufmann Stadium in Karlsruhe-Beiertheim
The Mini Marathon and Mini Half Marathon pass through the Günther-Klotz-Anlage
Inclusive event; children with disabilities may be accompanied by a support person
additional: Race number collection on event day from 11:00 until 30 minutes before each start. Changes to registration details can be made online free of charge. The timing chip is included in the race number. Prizes for the three fastest girls and boys in the Mini Marathon and Mini Half Marathon. Results and personalized certificates are available online. Distances: approximately 4.2 km, 2.1 km, and 333 m; registration on event day; inclusion for children with disabilities; start at the Carl-Kaufmann Stadium.

name: V Charytatywny Bieg dla Dzieci Bohaterów Biegaj - Pomagaj
5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (7) – červnový
location: U Kempinku, Praha 4-Braník, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Come and run on a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava in Prague’s Braník district, where personal records are often set! The race is part of the 16th year of VAŠE LIGA’s regular 5 km and 10 km runs, held every month. The course has been measured by a certified measurer, and the 10 km offers a chance to achieve the qualifying standard for the Czech Championships. After the race, you can review your performance and refuel at the restaurant in the Hamr Braník complex. Prizes are awarded to the top runners and loyal participants.
course_highlights: Fast course along the Vltava in Prague’s Braník district
Course measured by a certified measurer
Chance to achieve the qualifying standard for the Czech Championships in the 10 km
additional: Check-in from 18:00 at the blue tent by the cycle path at U Kempinku 2, Prague. 10 km starts at 19:00; 5 km starts at 19:05. After the race, an isotonic drink will be provided, and food and beer are available at the Hamr Braník restaurant. Bag storage is available in the organizers’ tent. Toilets are in the Hamr Braník complex (300 m from the start). You can withdraw until 23.06.2026 19:00 and receive a refund of your entry fee. Recommended parking: P+R by Braník railway station or in the surrounding streets. Course measured by a certified measurer; online or on-site registration; chip timing; refreshments at the venue; parking by Braník railway station; withdrawal possible up to 24 hours before the race.

name: Darmstädter Stadtlauf
description: The Darmstädter Merck City Run is a long-established city race celebrating its 47th edition in 2026. The route runs through downtown Darmstadt and has been adjusted due to construction work to include historic locations such as Marktplatz and Kirchstraße. The race attracts numerous participants every year and offers a lively atmosphere with live music and an enthusiastic team of commentators. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and appealing route through the pedestrian zone.
course_highlights: Route through central historic locations such as Marktplatz and Kirchstraße
Run through the pedestrian zone with a lively atmosphere
Includes Luisenplatz, Ludwigsplatz and Piazza as well-known sections of the course
additional: The event will take place on 24 June 2026, subject to approval. The route has been changed due to construction work, offering an appealing alternative via Ernst-Ludwig-Platz, Marktplatz, Kirchstraße and the Stadtkirche. The event includes seven races with large fields and is run by a dedicated organising team. Route changed due to construction work; race on Tuesday; includes youth and school classes; cultural accompanying events

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 4
location: Schwiegershausen, Osterode am Harz, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The Osterode Stage Marathon is a unique marathon held in seven enjoyable after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometres each around Osterode am Harz. The fourth stage runs through the beautiful Beber nature reserve in Schwiegershausen, with varied paths of gravel, concrete and grass. The start and finish are at Schwiegershausen Sports Hall, and the route offers a great view of the Harz as well as a mix of gentle and steep sections. The race is open to anyone physically able to run about 7 kilometres without stopping, and promotes a sense of community among regional clubs.
course_highlights: Beber nature reserve with varied paths
Great view of the Harz after a steep climb
A mix of gravel, concrete and grass paths
additional: The awards ceremony takes place on Saturday, 27 June 2026 at 18:00, with a raffle of prizes. The 750 m Kids’ Stage is offered on 27 June 2026. The event is jointly organised by seven regional clubs. You can take part without being a club member. Minors need written consent from their parents. Multi-stage marathon event, scenic route through Beber, start and finish in Schwiegershausen

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 4
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the Lower Saxony North Sea coast. Over eight days, participants run, walk or Nordic walk stages of around 10 km on the islands of Borkum, Juist, Norderney, Baltrum, Langeoog, Spiekeroog and Wangerooge. The event attracts running enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad, offering a unique running experience with a maritime atmosphere and a chance to enjoy nature. Due to limited capacity, the race is very popular and sells out quickly.
course_highlights: Stage race across seven East Frisian Islands
Approx. 10 km per stage
Scenery featuring dunes, beaches and the UNESCO World Heritage Wadden Sea
additional: Race numbers are distributed from approximately 1 hour after the special ferry arrives on each island until 30 minutes before the start. Each participant receives a race number with an integrated timing chip. Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available on the islands. Sports-bag storage is provided. There is no waiting list or reserve list; entries are non-transferable and will not be reallocated if cancelled. Stage race across seven islands, approx. 10 km per stage, no waiting list, limited capacity due to ferry and infrastructure constraints, fully booked.

There is also a 25 x 400-meter team race and a Bambini run for children. The event features a varied course on the university campus and is open to all age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer individual race over 5 laps of 2 km on the university campus
25 x 400-meter team race on a 400-meter loop
Bambini run for children aged 2 to 6 over a 400-meter lap
additional: The Bambini run has no entry fee, and every child receives a medal; teams in the team race consist of 2 to 5 runners; a team is classified as female only if all runners are women. Races take place on a 400-meter or 2 km loop on the university campus; various races for children; university championship in the 10 km race

description: The 1st AOK Renningen Company Run takes place on June 24, 2026, in Renningen and offers a great team event for colleagues. The course is approximately 4.6 km long, consisting of two laps of 2.3 km each. The run is part of the BW-Running company run series and emphasizes inclusion, shared experiences, and celebration. After the run, free refreshments will be provided at the finish, followed by an awards ceremony with musical accompaniment.
course_highlights: Course length: approximately 4.6 km, consisting of two laps of 2.3 km each
Group warm-up shortly before the start
Free refreshments at the finish, including Erdinger Alkoholfrei, fruit, vegetables, and water
additional: From 5:00 p.m., a DJ will create an upbeat atmosphere on stage. After the run, there will be an awards ceremony and musical entertainment. Participant changes can be made by email up to one day before the event; on the event day, they are only possible in person and for a fee. The minimum age to participate is 16. A run for everyone, including an inclusive run. Online registration is open until June 15, 2026. Participant limit: 1,200.

name: Herbatka u Tadka, czyli Bieg do Herbacia...
Běh Vídrholcem
description: The Vídrholec Run is a popular running race held in Prague 9-Klánovice. It is part of the local running calendar and attracts runners of all levels who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in a picturesque setting. The event is held under the auspices of the Czech Running Association and the Czech Athletics Federation, and offers not only competition but also the pleasure of exercising outdoors.
course_highlights: A scenic course in the natural surroundings of Prague 9-Klánovice
Organized by the Czech Running Association and the Czech Athletics Federation
Open to runners of all levels
additional: The race is held regularly and offers various distances, including a course of approximately 3.5 km, with results and statistics available on the website.

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 5
location: Dorste, Osterode am Harz, Lower Saxony, Germany
organizer: TG LaPeKa, MTV Osterode, MTV Förste, TSV Schwiegershausen, TSC Dorste, MTV Freiheit, SFC Harz-Weser
description: The 18th Osterode Stage Marathon divides the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km into seven enjoyable after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometres each. The races follow circular routes through the beautiful countryside around Osterode in the Harz foothills. The event starts in Förste on Sunday, 21 June 2026, with a new stage each day through Saturday, 27 June 2026. Walkers and Nordic walkers are also warmly welcome. There is also a 750-metre kids’ stage on 27 June in Schützenpark.
course_highlights: Seven stages of 5 to 7 km each on circular routes
Countryside in the Harz foothills around Osterode
750 m kids’ stage in Schützenpark
additional: Stage start times: Sunday, 21 June 2026 at 10:45, Monday to Friday at 18:45 each day, and Saturday, 27 June 2026 at 16:00. Awards ceremony on Saturday at 18:00, with a prize draw for non-cash prizes. Open to runners, walkers and Nordic walkers. No club membership required. Minors need written parental consent. 7 stages, 5–7 km per stage, medical support, free drinks, commemorative gift, marathon certificate, no club membership required

name: Bremer Firmenlauf zur Spätschicht
description: The Bremen Corporate Run for the Late Shift is a community running event covering approximately 5 km around the Weser weir in Bremen, with team spirit and togetherness at its heart. It is aimed at companies, groups of friends and running communities who want to run or walk together without the pressure to perform. New for 2026, official timekeeping will be available for the first time for anyone who wants to measure their athletic performance. After the run, a lively after-run party with music, food and drinks provides a relaxed end to the evening.
course_highlights: A loop of approximately 5 km through Pauliner Marsch, Werdersee and the marina
Start and finish area behind Paulaner’s im Wehrschloss
At least one refreshment point along the course and refreshments at the finish
additional: Teams must have at least 5 people. Official timekeeping is new for 2026 and optional. Late registration is possible online on the day of the event, but only by direct debit. Race numbers must be worn clearly visible on the chest; race number belts are not allowed. Showers and changing rooms are available on site. The course is a loop, completed once. The route passes through Pauliner Marsch, Werdersee and the marina. Registration is online; participation is open to groups of 5 or more, and includes refreshments along the course and music at the party. The event is open to everyone, regardless of ability level.

name: DAK FIRMENLAUF Nordhessen 2026
description: The DAK Nord Hesse Company Run has been organised by FTSV Heckershausen 1890 e.V. since 2011 and is held under the motto “Running together—for your health. For life.” The event promotes health and the enjoyment of exercise and is open to teams and individual runners. The course is approximately 5.3 km long and runs mainly on unpaved paths, with a short asphalt section. The event takes place on 25 June 2026 at 18:30 and offers refreshing drinks and changing facilities on site.
course_highlights: Course approximately 5.3 km long
Mainly unpaved paths, with approximately 1 km of asphalt
Refreshment stations approximately every 2 km and in the finish area
additional: Team race packs must be collected on the event day from the Sportheim Stahlbergbaude. Changing facilities and showers are in the Rasenallee sports hall next to the event area. Public transport: RegioTram 4, Heckershausen stop, approximately 500 m walk to the sports facility. Parking is available at the Rasenallee Sports Centre or on streets in the Heckershausen district. Road traffic regulations must be observed. Event date: 25.06.2026. Course and registration details are available on the website; results will be published online.

name: Firmenlauf Bremerhaven
description: The 9th Bremerhaven Company Run takes place on Thursday, June 25, 2026, and is open to employees and apprentices from companies, government agencies, and other organizations. Participants run a 6 km loop from the Nordsee-Stadion through Speckenbüttler Park. With a limit of 500 participants, the event offers teams a great opportunity to compete athletically and have fun together. Groups receive a free-entry discount when at least 10 participants are registered by the end of May. The event is well established and very popular in the region.
course_highlights: 6 km loop from the Nordsee-Stadion through Speckenbüttler Park
Run for employees and apprentices from companies and government agencies
Limited parking available; alternative transport is recommended
additional: Participant limit: 500. For every 10 participants registered as a group, one entry-fee discount is available until the end of May. Parking at the Nordsee-Stadion is limited; alternative transport is recommended. Participant limit of 500; parking is limited; registration is open.

name: Excalibur Race MOON Zámek Duchcov
location: Duchcov Castle, Duchcov, Ústí nad Labem Region, Czech Republic
description: Excalibur Race MOON Duchcov Castle is an obstacle race taking place from June 26 to 28, 2026, in the historic setting of Duchcov State Castle and its surroundings. Racers will follow in the footsteps of the legendary Giacomo Casanova and take on a fast course with beautiful views of the Ore Mountains, the Central Bohemian Uplands, and the foothills of the Bílina mine. The race features modern, certified obstacles on professional ALU structures, with an emphasis on safety and quality. A knightly theme adds to the atmosphere, bringing together physical challenge and the values of honor, loyalty, and cooperation. A varied program and facilities, including refreshments and support services, are available for racers and fans.
course_highlights: The course runs up the castle staircase and across nearby meadows, with views of the Ore Mountains and the Central Bohemian Uplands
Modern obstacles on ALU structures, TÜV-certified and regularly inspected
An atmosphere inspired by the legend of Giacomo Casanova and tales of knights
additional: Race pack, electronic timing chip, online results, race photos and videos, fresh fruit and refreshing drinks on the course and at the finish, rescue and event staff, support services for racers and their families at the race center, fan zones and fun activities for children and adults, and the chance to watch the race from attractive vantage points. The race takes place at Duchcov Castle and offers various routes from 6 to 12 km, with obstacles and scenic surroundings. Registration and pricing details are available on the official website.

name: Meine Nacht - Kirche laufend erleben
description: The “Meine Nacht” charity relay race is a community running event in Meine, held in support of charitable causes. The event promotes team spirit and sporting commitment in a special atmosphere. Participants experience a varied course through the municipality that strengthens the sense of community.
course_highlights: Relay format for teams
Course through the municipality of Meine
Charity run with a commitment to social causes
additional: Charity run, registration available via the website, event promotes community and spirituality

name: MidSummerRun 2026

late_fee.price: 3,00 Euro für Jugendliche, 5,00 Euro für Jahrgang 2007 und älter
3,00 Euro für Jugendliche, 5,00 Euro für Jahrgang 2007 und älter

description: The MidSummerRun 2026 takes place on June 19 in Hamburg and is being organised for the fifth time by Lauftreff Alstertal e.V. This sustainable running event offers three races: a children’s run of approx. 970 metres, a 5 km run and a 10 km run along the wild upper reaches of the Alster, one of Hamburg’s most beautiful running areas. The start and finish are on the lawn in front of Torhaus Wellingsbüttel, where a Future Fair featuring sustainability partners and a food truck will also be on hand. The MidSummerRun champions environmental protection and sustainability, and was awarded second place in the Hanse Environmental Prize.
course_highlights: Route along the wild upper reaches of the Alster
Start and finish on the lawn in front of Torhaus Wellingsbüttel
Sustainably organised race focused on environmental protection and the 17 UN Sustainable Development Goals
additional: The entry fee includes free travel to and from the event on the HVV. The participant limit is 200 for the children’s run and 600 across all races combined. Late registration is available from 10 June 2026 and on race day, provided the limit has not been reached. First aid is available on an outpatient basis in the finish area. Picnic blankets made from recycled advertising banners and a food truck will be available for a relaxed gathering after the race. Children’s run approx. 970 m, 5 km, 10 km, sustainable organisation, start and finish on the lawn in front of Torhaus Wellingsbüttel, eco-friendly medals, sustainable refreshments

name: Mittsommernachtslauf Hannover
location: Vereinsheim des HRC Hannover, Weddigenufer 23, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Mittsommernachtslauf Hannover is an urban running event held on the longest day of the year along the idyllic Leine floodplains in Hannover. Various distances are offered: a 7.7 km individual race, a 21.1 km individual race, and a 23.1 km relay with three participants. The event is part of the Hannover Region Running Pass and offers a special atmosphere, with the start and finish at the HRC Hannover clubhouse. Two aid stations along the course provide refreshments, and timing is done using rental chips. Late registration is possible on the day of the event from 17:00.
course_highlights: Route along the idyllic Leine floodplains in Hannover
Two aid stations with water, isotonic drinks and energy gels
Start and finish at the HRC Hannover clubhouse
additional: Late registration is possible on the day of the event from 17:00. Timing is done using rental chips, which are worn on the foot and returned at the finish. Showers and changing rooms are available in limited numbers at the neighboring Angaria clubhouse and at the University Sports Center (100 m walk). Bags can be dropped off before the start at the tent opposite the clubhouse. Travel by light rail to Königsworther Platz, followed by a walk of approx. 500 m; parking is available at the University Sports Center. Distances: 7.7 km, 21.1 km, relay 23.1 km; start and finish at the HRC Hannover clubhouse, Weddigenufer 23; online registration until 25.06.2026, on-site late registration available.

name: Bergdorfmeile
description: The Bergdorfmeile is a traditional race over a historic 8.88889 km course in Karlsruhe-Hohenwettersbach, taking place on Friday, June 26, 2026. With around 140 metres of elevation gain, the course is more challenging than a flat city route, but is designed so recreational runners can also take part comfortably. The race starts at 19:00 on Lindenstraße and finishes at the SV Hohenwettersbach sports ground. Alongside the main race, there is also an approximately 2 km youth race for children and teenagers. Every participant receives a high-quality technical shirt, and timing is based on net time using a chip-equipped race bib.
course_highlights: Historic 8.88889 km course with approximately 140 metres of elevation gain
Start on Lindenstraße; finish at the SV Hohenwettersbach sports ground
Refreshments at kilometre 5 and at the finish
additional: Race-bib collection and technical-shirt distribution take place on June 26, 2026, from 16:30 to 18:30 at the schoolyard, Kirchplatz, right by the start. Late entries are possible on race day, subject to the participant limit. Bag storage is available from 17:00 at the start; bags can be collected at the finish until 21:00. Showers are available at SV Hohenwettersbach. Timing is based on net time using a chip-equipped race bib, which must be worn on the chest. The finish closes at 20:15. Participants who reach the hiking car park at Lambrechtshof (approx. km 3.8) later than 19:34 will be removed from the results. The event is limited to approximately 1,000 participants, with chip timing and an online results list. The course is challenging, with around 140 metres of elevation difference.

name: Burg-Lauf Eppstein
description: The Eppstein Castle Run is a traditional Taunus running classic, held annually since 1986 and attracting up to 500 runners as well as numerous spectators. The varied 7.777 km course passes through the forest and the historic old town, loops twice around the medieval castle, then climbs Schmerzberg to the finish at the TSG Eppstein sports ground. Alongside the sporting competition, the event offers a sociable program featuring a cake stand, a Castle Run glass and refreshments. The run is suitable both for ambitious runners and for running enthusiasts who want to enjoy the special atmosphere and challenge of the “old German mile.”
course_highlights: 7.777 km course adapted to the topography
Route through the forest and old town, and twice around the medieval castle
Climb to the finish on Schmerzberg, back to the TSG Eppstein sports ground
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event from 17:00 until half an hour before the start at the “Am Bienroth” sports ground. Chip timing is used. Prizes and non-cash awards are available for the fastest participants, and medals are awarded to student relay teams. Please note the important travel information due to the partial closure of the B455. Eppstein railway station is easily reached on the S2; the start is about a 15-minute walk from the station. The run takes place on varied terrain adapted to the topography. Registration is available online and on the day of the event. Awards, medals and prizes are presented to the winners.

name: Oberhausener Kleeblatt-Lauf
description: The 1st Oberhausen Kleeblatt Run on June 26, 2026, is a new running event inviting runners of all ages to Niederrhein Stadium. Organised by the Rot-Weiß Oberhausen Endurance Team with support from the Oberhausen City Sports Association, the event aims to bring people from across the city together—from beginners to ambitious athletes. The course runs mostly along a lit, kilometre-marked running track beside the Rhine-Herne Canal, offering an attractive route that can be used year-round. After the run, the City Sports Association’s recreation area invites participants to relax, socialise and enjoy the end of the event together.
course_highlights: 7.8-kilometre loop along the Rhine-Herne Canal
Lit, kilometre-marked running track available year-round
Start at Slinky Springs to Fame, with the route extending to Waghalsbrücke
additional: The event is open to all ability levels and aims to become a fixture in Oberhausen’s sporting calendar. After the run, a programme featuring food and drinks will be held at the City Sports Association’s recreation area to encourage community and socialising. Run on a lit route along the Rhine-Herne Canal; various running distances for all age groups; registration until June 21, 2026.

name: Weezer Sommerabendlauf
description: The Weezer Sommerabendlauf is a popular running event held annually since 2019 in Vittinghoff-Schell-Park in Weeze. After cancellations due to the pandemic in 2020 and 2021, the race is once again attracting large numbers of participants, with over 380 starters in 2025. The event offers various race distances, including children’s and youth races, and starts on June 26, 2026, at 5 p.m. Timing is provided by a chip attached to the race bib, and attractive prizes are awarded to clubs with the most finishers.
course_highlights: Weeze town loop over the new Niers bridge and through the animal park
Approx. 300 m children’s race, with a loop starting from Bahnstraße
Start and finish in Vittinghoff-Schell-Park
additional: Registration closes on June 24, 2026, at midnight. Online registration is via raceresult, with payment by SEPA direct debit. Late entries can be paid for in cash or by card on site. Race bibs with chips must be returned on the day of the event; the €3 chip deposit will be refunded. There are no changing rooms or showers; toilets are available in the Bürgerhaus. Eight tickets to the 1Live San Hejmo Festival will be awarded to the club with the most adult finishers (excluding TSV Weeze). The race takes place in Vittinghoff-Schell-Park. Online registration is available; late entries are accepted on site up to 45 minutes before the start. Start times are between 6:00 p.m. and 7:30 p.m.

name: Osnabrücker Mittsommernachtslauf
location: Sportplatz RW Sutthausen, Osnabrück, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Charity Midsummer Night Run in Osnabrück-Sutthausen takes place on June 26, 2026, from 6:00 p.m. and offers a relaxed running event for all age groups in support of the non-profit organization Zusammen-Bewegen e.V. The route starts at the RW Sutthausen sports field and heads into the Hörner Bruch woodland, where one lap is approximately 3 kilometers long. Distances range from 500 m for the Bambini run to 10 km for adults, with no individual timekeeping. After the run, participants can round off the evening with food and drinks.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the RW Sutthausen sports field
Run through the Hörner Bruch woodland, with approximately 3 km per lap
Refreshment station along the route
additional: Bambini run starts at 7:00 p.m. (500 m); running, walking, Nordic walking, and strolling start at 7:30 p.m. No individual timekeeping; a clock is located in the start/finish area. Showers and changing facilities are available. Due to limited parking, participants are advised to come on foot, by bike, or by carpool. Refreshment station along the route. Relaxed get-together with food and drinks after the run. Woodland route, online registration, no individual timekeeping, refreshment station, showers and changing facilities available.

name: Altstadtfestlauf in Lauf
location: Lauf an der Pegnitz, Nürnberger Land, Bavaria, Germany

description: The Altstadtfest Run in Lauf an der Pegnitz takes place every year on Friday evening, opening the Altstadtfest on the last weekend of June. It is considered the world’s largest class reunion and offers runners a special experience, with a setting found nowhere else, such as the pack of runners on the Lauf Water Bridge. There is a 10 km main race with a turnaround point at Lebenshilfe in Schönberg, as well as a 5 km race, including Nordic walking, with a turnaround point on Ottensooser Straße. The event combines sporting competition with a social gathering and also supports social projects.
course_highlights: 10 km main race with a turnaround point at Lebenshilfe in Schönberg
5 km race and Nordic walking with a turnaround point on Ottensooser Straße
Pack of runners on the Lauf Water Bridge, creating a unique setting
additional: Race pack collection and on-the-day registration are available on race day from 14:00 to 17:00 in the finish area (Nürnberger Tor, Friedensplatz 1, 91207 Lauf). On-the-day registration incurs an additional fee of €3, payable in cash. Entries received by 19.06.2026 will receive a personalised race bib with the runner’s name. €1 of the entry fee is donated to Lebenshilfe im Nürnberger Land. The race takes place every year on the last weekend of June, with start times of 18:00 for the 10 km race and 18:05 for Nordic walking. The course is scenic and promotes community spirit and charitable causes.

name: Bietigheimer Fackellauf
description: The Bietigheim Torch Run is a special running experience held annually in Bietigheim-Bissingen. The 10 km run covers three laps on a flat, paved farm track between Bietigheim and Ingersheim, illuminated by torches. The start and finish are at the Olymp company car park, where a unique atmosphere with music, food and drinks awaits participants. The run starts on 26 June 2026 at 10 p.m. and offers an atmospheric nighttime event for running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: 10 km run over three laps
Flat, paved farm track between Bietigheim and Ingersheim
Course illuminated by torches
additional: Race numbers are issued exclusively at the stand in the start/finish area. Nordic walking poles and other objects are not permitted on the course. Registration is online only. The registration deadline is 26 June 2026 at 12 p.m. Torch-lit course, nighttime event, music, food and drinks in the start/finish area

name: Dr. Ernst van Aaken Gedächtnislauf 2026
location: Dr. Ernst van Aaken Stadion, Schwalmtal, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Dr. Ernst van Aaken Memorial Run takes place at the Dr. Ernst van Aaken Stadium in Schwalmtal and offers a varied race programme on a late June evening. OSC Waldniel organizes ten races with more than 1,000 participants from different age and ability groups, from young people to seniors. The event combines track and road races, including a 5-kilometre road race and the 5,000-metre “Race of the Aces” for stronger runners. Participants can compete individually, as part of a team or in the elite field, welcoming both beginners and experienced athletes. The race honours Ernst van Aaken, founder of OSC and a promoter of the women’s marathon.
course_highlights: A combination of track and road races
A 5-kilometre road race and the 5,000-metre Race of the Aces
A range of age and ability groups up to M75/W75
additional: The event takes place late in the evening in June. Ten races are offered, with more than 1,000 runners taking part. The event honours OSC founder and promoter of the women’s marathon Ernst van Aaken. June weather is typically sunny, with temperatures around 23 °C. Various race distances, team classifications, online registration; check parking information.

name: Lippe-Sommer-Serie 2025 Lauf 3: Sommerlauf um den SchiederSee
description: The SchiederSee Summer Run is part of the 2025 Lippe Summer Series and takes place on June 26, 2026, in Schieder-Schwalenberg. The event offers two distances, 1 km and 8.3 km, and is open to runners of all ability levels. The scenic course runs around SchiederSee, with pleasant summer weather averaging 23 °C and mostly sunny days. Results may be included in official athletics rankings.

Two distances: 1 km and 8.3 km
Pleasant summer weather averaging 23 °C
additional: The event recommends checking the details with the organizer before registering. Results may be included in official athletics rankings. June weather is typically sunny, with temperatures around 23°C, creating ideal conditions for a summer run. The event is part of the annual Lippe Summer Series, known in the region for its friendly atmosphere.

name: Retzbachlauf Gaimersheim

description: The Retzbachlauf in Gaimersheim is a traditional running event taking place on June 26, 2026, in Retzbachpark. The event includes races for various age groups, from Bambini to youth, as well as a Fun Run and a main race. The course is a flat loop, mostly on gravel paths, and counts toward the Sport IN Laufcup standings. Races start in the late afternoon, and results are published shortly after the races. The event is family-friendly and offers a pleasant atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Flat loop course
Mostly on gravel paths
Start and finish in Retzbachpark, Gaimersheim
additional: Race start times are staggered from 17:10 (Bambini U7/U8) to 19:00 (Youth U18/U20, Fun Run, main race). Race packets can be collected from 16:00 at the start/finish area. Travel by bus and train is possible, with stops nearby. Parking is available, but do not park in the car park of the adjacent Edeka store. Results will be published at the venue as soon as possible after the races. The event takes place on public roads. On-site registration is available until 30 minutes before the start. Travel by bus or train is recommended; parking is available at EDEKA, the sports hall, and other locations.

name: Wiesengrundlauf
description: The Wiesengrundlauf in Haselbachtal is a regional running event held every year on Friday evening after the summer solstice. The municipality of Haselbachtal invites runners of all ages to take part in distances ranging from 600 m to 11.6 km. The event is part of the Sachsen Energie Läufer-Cup and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with awards for overall winners and age-group winners. The start and finish are at the Wiesengrund sports ground in Bischheim. The inaugural event in 2025 was a great success, with numerous participants and a varied program.
course_highlights: Distances from 600 m to 11.6 km
Start and finish at the Wiesengrund sports ground in Bischheim
Part of the Sachsen Energie Läufer-Cup
additional: The start and finish are at the Wiesengrund sports ground in Bischheim, Jahnstraße 13. Overnight accommodation for athletes is available at the caravan and motorhome site by prior reservation at 03578/3094117 or by email. Strava segments are available for the long, short, and children’s courses. Distances range from 600 m to 11.6 km. Registration is via Baer-Service. Overnight accommodation is available at the pitches.

name: Filsum Löppt
description: Filsum Löppt is a traditional fun run held annually on the last Friday in June as part of the SV Blau-Weiß Filsum e.V. sports days. The event offers races for all age groups, from children to experienced runners, on varied paved country roads and footpaths around Filsum. The start and finish of all races are at the sports ground, where changing rooms and showers are also available. The course is well marked and secured by numerous marshals, with refreshment stations along the main races. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and good organization, including electronic timing.
course_highlights: Routes on paved country roads and footpaths in scenic Filsum
Kilometre markers and several refreshment stations along the route
Start and finish at the sports ground, with changing rooms and showers
additional: Late registration is available on race day from 17:00 until 30 minutes before the relevant start, with a late-registration fee of €4 ( €1 for the 400 m Kinnerloop). Electronic timing uses transponders on the back of the race bib (except for the 400 m Kinnerloop). Race bibs must be worn clearly visible on the chest. The participant limit for the main races (5.2 km, 5.2 km walking, 10.3 km) is 500 runners/walkers. The start and finish are at the sports ground, with changing rooms and showers available. Children’s races take place on grass and on secured routes. Events: 400m Kinnerloop, 2 km schoolchildren’s race, 5.2 km run & walking, 10.3 km run; participant limit: 500; registration opens 02.04.2026; refreshments available on site.

name: Osterrönfelder Moorlauf

description: The Osterrönfeld Moor Run takes place on June 26, 2026, in Osterrönfeld and offers runners of all ages a varied running experience. The event includes a 1.17-kilometer children’s run, a 5-kilometer fun run, and a 10-kilometer Moor Run. The course starts at the sports field on Aukamp Street and leads through the scenic moorland. Timing is recorded using transponders, and participants receive certificates, medals, and trophies. The event is family-friendly and offers showers and on-site parking.
course_highlights: Start at the sports field on Aukamp Street
Run through the moorland
Three distances: 1.17 km children’s run, 5 km fun run, 10 km Moor Run
additional: Race packets can be collected on event day from 4:00 p.m. at the sports hall at Fehmarnstraße 2. Timing uses transponders worn around the ankle, which must be returned after the run (a €40 fee applies if lost). Showers and parking are available at the sports hall. Entry for the 5 km and 10 km runs includes a voucher for a grilled sausage. Late registration on event day is possible for a €2 fee, subject to bib availability. Terrain: moorland run; registration at the sports hall; transponder timing; certificates and medals; parking behind the sports hall

name: GDYNIA ULTRA WAY
description: Gdynia Ultra Way is a mountain race by the sea, taking place on June 26–27, 2026, in Gdynia and the surrounding Kashubian region. Participants can choose from five distances, ranging from 14 km to 160 km, with varied elevation gain and scenic routes. The start and finish are at different locations, and the organizer provides transport to the start of the longest distance. It is a unique opportunity to take on a challenging course and enjoy the beauty of the coastal landscape.
course_highlights: 160 km distance with +/- 2,502 m of elevation gain, starting in Puck at 10:00
100 km distance with +/- 2,267 m of elevation gain, starting in Gdynia at 21:00
Routes pass through Kashubia and coastal areas, with checkpoints and time limits
additional: For the start of the longest distance (160 km), participants are transported by coach from outside the Gdynia Sports Center – National Rugby Stadium (paid transport). The time limit for the 160 km distance is 31 hours. The course has checkpoints with time limits and drop bags. The event includes both summer and winter editions, with routes passing through different towns in the region and offering unforgettable experiences for runners of all ability levels.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – edycja nocna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań - Night Edition 2026 is a cross-country race held in the picturesque Dendrological Garden of the Poznań University of Life Sciences. The event is part of a race series organized since 2014 by a group of enthusiasts who focus on attractive courses and promoting running. After the race, participants will receive unique medals, different from those awarded at the spring edition, encouraging them to collect them. It is a special opportunity to run in beautiful surroundings and enjoy the atmosphere of a night race.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in the Dendrological Garden of the Poznań University of Life Sciences
Picturesque, attractive courses
Night edition with unique medals
additional: At the finish of the night edition, participants receive medals different from those awarded at the spring edition, encouraging them to collect them. The organizers are a group of running enthusiasts active since 2014, specializing in cross-country races and attractive locations. Scenic trail in the Dendrological Garden of the Poznań University of Life Sciences, scenic routes, scenic location, scheduled for June 26, 2026

name: Australijska Dyszka w Pszczelniku
description: Australijska Dyszka w Pszczelniku is a 10 km race taking place on 26 June 2026 in Siemianowice Śląskie, in Pszczelnik Park. The course consists of four loops, and all runners start together. After each loop, the 20 runners who completed it in the longest time are eliminated and receive a so-called “almost medal” at the finish. The top runners competing for the win complete the final loop. The race is open to participants over the age of 16.
course_highlights: A 10 km course consisting of four loops
Start and finish at the MOSiR “Pszczelnik” venue in Pszczelnik Park
Elimination of the last 20 runners after each loop
additional: All runners start together. After each loop, the last 20 runners are eliminated regardless of gender and receive an “almost medal.” The entry fee can be paid via the DOTPAY system after completing the registration form. Parkland course, online registration, participant limit, fee payable by 5 June 2026

name: Biegaj z Duchami
description: Run with the Ghosts is a unique night trail run taking place on June 26, 2026, in Leśniów. Participants will tackle two courses, 15 km and 9 km long, full of dark corners and surprises that create a one-of-a-kind, thrilling atmosphere. Runners are encouraged to dress up as apparitions, ghosts, and other spooky characters, adding magic and atmosphere to the event. It is not only a competition, but also a test of endurance and courage in the dark, where participants face their own weaknesses and mysterious figures along the course.
course_highlights: A night run by flashlight along the mysterious trails of ExtremeJura
Two courses: 15 km for advanced runners and 9 km, also suitable for Nordic walking
Dark corners and numerous surprises along the course
additional: The race office will be open on June 26, 2026, from 20:00 to 21:30. Participants are encouraged to dress up as apparitions, ghosts, vampires, or other spooky characters to enhance the run’s mystical atmosphere. 9 km and 15 km courses, night start, ghost costumes, Jura terrain, flashlight required, registration online and by phone.

The race takes place in a forest, mainly on paved forest roads, with some asphalt sections. The event includes a free family run for children under 18 and main races of 6, 10 and 21 km. It brings together sport, families and support for a good cause, benefiting RENEDA, a nonprofit organization that helps children with neurological challenges.

The race takes place on paved forest roads and has a charitable purpose. Registration opens on 1.5.2026. The event supports the local community and charitable projects.

name: Mistrovství světa veteránů v dlouhém horském běhu
location: Janské Lázně, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The World Masters Mountain Long Distance Running Championships will take place on 27 June 2026 in the picturesque setting of Janské Lázně in the Hradec Králové Region. This race is intended for masters athletes and offers a challenging long-distance mountain run that will test runners’ endurance and strength in beautiful mountain scenery. The event is part of the prestigious trail-running calendar and attracts runners from around the world. For more information, we recommend following the organization’s official website.
course_highlights: A long-distance mountain run over the mountainous terrain of Janské Lázně

Picturesque views and natural scenery in the Hradec Králové Region

name: ROZKOŠný 1/2 Maraton
location: Česká Skalice, Česká Skalice, Czech Republic
description: The ROZKOŠný 1/2 Marathon is a half marathon held in Česká Skalice, following a new cycle path around the Rozkoš Reservoir. The event offers a main 21.1 km race and a 2 km fun run for children and mothers with strollers. Entertainment, refreshments and the option of camping accommodation create a pleasant atmosphere for participants and spectators alike. The main category starts at 12:30; the first category starts at 10:00.
course_highlights: Half marathon along a new cycle path around the Rozkoš Reservoir
2 km fun run for children and mothers with strollers
Camping accommodation and refreshments available on site
