The fun run is for children and mothers with strollers. Entertainment, refreshments and camping accommodation are available. Terrain: road. Registration: not stated. Other notes: entertainment, refreshments, camping accommodation.

name: Záblatská osmička
description: Záblatská osmička is a running race in Bohumín-Záblatí, offering a welcoming local atmosphere and a friendly pace. The course passes over a variety of surfaces, including paved roads, forest sections, and dirt-and-gravel trails, keeping runners engaged from start to finish. The race is open to everyone who wants to enjoy a run and a great atmosphere. Registration is open until 24 June 2026, and the race starts at 10:00 at the football field in Záblatí.
course_highlights: The course follows paved roads, forest sections, and dirt-and-gravel trails

Refreshments at the 4 km mark and at the finish
additional: Check-in is from 9:00 to 9:45. The awards ceremony and raffle are scheduled for 11:30. Toilets are available at the event, but there is no secure storage for belongings in the start and finish area. The race takes place on 27 June 2026, starts at 10:00, and registration closes on 24 June 2026. Refreshments are provided at the 4 km mark and at the finish. The course is similar to the 2025 route and includes categories for men and women, including local runners from Bohumín.

description: The Běh lužanskými hvozdy is a traditional running race held in the recreational area of the municipality of Lužany near Jičín, specifically at the campsite by Marešák Pond. The 50th anniversary edition will take place on 27 June 2026 and offers various categories and race distances suitable for a wide range of runners, including children. The race is supported by the Hradec Králové Region and organized by the Municipality of Lužany, ELMAT Kůtek s.r.o., and TJ Sokol Lužany. Participants can expect medals, prizes in kind, and cash awards for the top runners in each category.
course_highlights: Routes up to 1,000 m run within the campsite grounds; the shorter courses are almost straight
Longer courses consist of laps of 300, 400, and 500 m
The race takes place in a scenic recreational area by Marešák Pond
additional: Awards for the top runners in each category, traveling trophies, cash prizes for breaking records, free entry for residents of the municipality of Lužany who register by 30 April 2026, and medals and prizes in kind for the top three in each category. The race offers multiple categories, including children’s and recreational runs. Registration is available on the official website. The event takes place at the campsite by Marešák Pond and is supported by regional partners.

name: Žhavé běhy Slováckého léta
location: Uherské Hradiště, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Hot Runs of Slovácké Summer are traditional running races held in the historic centre of Uherské Hradiště. Participants can choose from three distances of 5, 10 and 21 kilometres, which pass through the picturesque countryside along the Morava River, through Kunovský les forest park and past the Nová Ves lakes. The races are suitable for all runners, from beginners to experienced athletes, and offer a unique opportunity to enjoy being active in the beautiful surroundings of Slovácko. The start and finish are at Masaryk Square, giving the race the atmosphere of the historic heart of the town.
course_highlights: The route passes through the historic centre of Uherské Hradiště
Run along the Morava River and its confluence with the Olšava
The route connects with Kunovský les forest park and the Nová Ves lakes
additional: The races start and finish at Masaryk Square in Uherské Hradiště. The routes follow urban and natural paths, including cycle paths. The races are part of the Slovácké Summer sports and cultural festival, which also offers other sporting and cultural activities. The festival is suitable for all age groups, including families with children. The course includes the town centre, the river, parks and cycle paths; registration requirements are not specified.

name: Besenbinder Lauf - Rund um Hainrode
description: The 1st Besenbinder Run – Around Hainrode is a running event in the southern Harz, organized by ASV 1902 Sangerhausen. The event takes place on 27 June 2026 in Hainrode and offers runners of various age groups and ability levels the opportunity to take part in a sporting competition. The course runs around Hainrode and promises varied natural surroundings. The event is open to children, young people, adults and masters.
course_highlights: Run around Hainrode in the southern Harz
Event in a natural setting
Suitable for a range of age groups and ability levels
additional: Registration is open until 24 June 2026; the venue is Hainröder Hauptstraße 60A, Hainrode; no specific terrain details are available.

name: Remmers-Hasetal-Marathon
description: The Remmers-Hasetal-Marathon in Löningen is an established running event in northern Germany, taking place for the 24th time on 27 June 2026. The flat, scenic course is a loop through the Hasetal valley, half of it on the Hasetal cycling and walking trail, and is officially measured by the DLV and eligible for the rankings list. In addition to the marathon, the event offers a half marathon, marathon relay, corporate relay, Nordic walking, walking and student races. The event is known for its great atmosphere, support from spectators and volunteers, and the Marathon Night afterwards, featuring a live band on the market square.
course_highlights: Flat course through the Hasetal valley with scenic surroundings
Loop course with 2 laps for the marathon, half of it on the Hasetal cycling and walking trail
Start and finish at Löningen market square, followed by the Marathon Night party
additional: Start and finish at Löningen market square, with information and sales stands as well as an event stage. The course passes through the Werwer Fuhren forest and varied Geest landscapes. There is a Marathon Night party in the evening with a TOP-40 live band. The Bambini run starts separately from the Gelbrink car park. Refreshments are organised by the St. Vitus Löningen altar servers. The event is certified as a “Three-Star Run.” It also includes the charity initiative “Laufend helfen in Löningen,” a marathon brochure, and is usually held in June.

name: Glückstädter City-Lauf
description: The Glückstadt City Run warmly welcomes runners of all ages to experience the picturesque town of Glückstadt. The event offers various distances from 250 m to 10 km, running through the beautiful town centre and along the harbour. Participation is at your own risk. Age-group rankings are provided, with trophies for the top runners in the 5 km and 10 km races. Race materials can be collected on race day from 9:00 a.m., and late entries are possible until 60 minutes before the respective race.
course_highlights: Courses through the picturesque town centre of Glückstadt
Races along the harbour head and past the Legends Park
A range of distances from 250 m to 10 km for all age groups
additional: Race materials can be collected at the harbour head on race day from 9:00 a.m. Late entries are possible until 60 minutes before the respective race, with a late-entry fee of €5. Changing facilities and tents are available; showers are available at Fortunabad. For safety reasons, headphones may not be worn and animals or jogging strollers may not be brought along during the race. The event offers shower and changing facilities, safety and data protection provisions, as well as medals and trophies for the winners.

name: Idar-Obersteiner Altstadtlauf
organizer: Stadtjugendamt Idar-Oberstein in Verbindung mit Stadtverband sporttreibender Vereine und TV 1848 Oberstein
price_range: 5 euro für Erwachsene, 2,50 euro für Kinder/Jugend, U8 frei
description: The Idar-Oberstein Old Town Run is a traditional running event in the historic old town of Oberstein, held annually on the last Saturday in June. The event features six different races for various age groups, from U8 children to adults, with distances ranging from 370 metres to around 6.5 kilometres. The route runs through the pedestrian zone below the striking Felsenkirche, a city landmark. The start and finish are behind the Tourist Information in Oberstein. Entry fees are deliberately kept low to encourage broad participation.
course_highlights: Route through the pedestrian zone below the Felsenkirche
Start and finish behind the Oberstein Tourist Information
A range of distances from 370 m to 6.5 km for all age groups
additional: Late entries are not possible after the registration deadline. The event features six separate races for different age groups. Typical June weather is around 23 °C and mostly sunny. Running event in the old town; online registration is available; start and finish at the Oberstein Tourist Information.

name: Isselhorster Nacht
description: The Isselhorster Nacht is a traditional running event in Gütersloh-Isselhorst, taking place for the 26th time on June 27, 2026. It offers races for different age groups and ability levels, including a Bambini run, Schoolrunning, a fun run, a corporate run, speed skating and the main race. The event combines sporting commitment with social engagement by supporting the German Stroke Foundation. A special preparation programme, “Fit in 100 Days,” motivates and accompanies participants on their way to the event. The races take place in the centre of Isselhorst, with a lively atmosphere, plenty of spectators and a varied supporting programme.
course_highlights: Various race distances from 500 m to 9,200 m for all age groups
Route through the centre of Isselhorst, with several laps
Popular corporate race featuring team rankings and outlandish costumes
additional: Late entries are possible up to two weeks before the event, subject to a late-entry fee, except for the Bambini and school races. On the day of the event, registration is available on site from 16:00. The event supports the German Stroke Foundation, with the option to donate based on kilometres run. There is an extensive preparation programme, “Fit in 100 Days,” with weekly training sessions and individual support. The races take place in the centre of Isselhorst, with spectators lining the route, and there is a warm-up for children before the first races. A running event with a fundraising campaign against stroke, a varied programme, music and a party.

name: XTrail Breitnau
description: XTrail Breitnau is a versatile running event in the Hochschwarzwald that brings runners and Nordic walkers of all age groups together for a day. Four different events are offered: the popular XT-Run, with half-marathon and 10 km distances; the XT-Walk, with 12 km and 8 km distances; the XT-Challenge, an obstacle sprint for age groups U8 to U20; and the XT-Kids run for the youngest participants. The courses cross varied terrain, with trails, steep climbs and panoramic views, and include an attractive race pack and professional timekeeping. The event is organized by Skizunft Breitnau e.V. and takes place on June 27, 2026.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course with steep climbs and trails through the Ravennaschlucht
Nordic-walking routes on natural paths through Moos, Föhrwald and Hohwartshöhe
Obstacle sprint with a serpentine climb and a varied course through the Kurgarten
additional: Race-number collection on event day from 08:00–11:00 and 12:30–13:45 at the fire station. Race numbers for XT-Kids and XT-Challenge are issued in sets for each club. Participation conditions and equipment requirements must be observed; for example, trail-running shoes with profiled soles for RUN and Nordic-walking poles for WALK. Refreshments are available on the course and at the finish. Participants receive a personal digital certificate; XT-Kids finishers receive a medal. Exclusive trophies and prizes are awarded to overall and age-group winners. Late registration is possible for a fee until June 26 at 18:00, and on event day until one hour before the start. Multiple event types, distances and age groups; online registration; race numbers; refreshments; prizes; possible course changes.

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 1
description: The Osterode Stage Marathon divides the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km into seven enjoyable after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometres each. The first stage starts in Förste on Sunday, 21 June 2026, and leads through the beautiful Söse Valley, with views of Lichtenstein and a route past the famous Lichtenstein Cave. The event is open to runners, walkers and Nordic walkers, and also offers a 750-metre kids’ stage in Schützenpark. The stages take place daily through 27 June 2026 and are organised by regional clubs.
course_highlights: Circular routes of 5 to 7 kilometres per stage
Route with views of Lichtenstein and impressions of the gypsum karst landscape
Passage past the world-famous Lichtenstein Cave
additional: The first stage starts at 10:45 a.m. on Sunday at the sports ground in Förste. The awards ceremony takes place on Saturday, 27 June 2026, at 6:00 p.m., including a prize draw for non-cash prizes. The event is open to runners, walkers and Nordic walkers; club membership is not required. Minors need written consent from their parents. After the first stage, participants can enjoy a meal featuring pasta specialities from MTV Förste. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, supports local sponsors and uses varied routes that encourage participants to discover both the natural surroundings and the local area.

name: 6. Hofer Backyard Ultra
description: The Hofer Backyard Ultra is a unique ultrarunning event taking place on June 27, 2026, in Hof, Bavaria. The race starts at 09:00 and is, by definition, “open end”: it finishes only when one runner remains or everyone has dropped out. The course is a 6.706-kilometer loop with around 80 meters of elevation gain, running along forest and woodland trails as well as asphalt. The event attracts participants from across Germany and beyond, and offers a special challenge for runners who want to discover and push their limits.
course_highlights: 6.706-kilometer loop with around 80 meters of elevation gain
Course runs along forest and woodland trails as well as asphalt
Marked with Hofer Backyard Ultra arrows
additional: Maximum of 100 places. Check-in on June 26, 2026, from 07:30 at Hof Airport. 200 free parking spaces approximately 100 m from the start/finish area. A personal headlamp is required at night (from lap 13). Timekeeping may continue beyond 24 hours because the race is open end. The course includes paved paths, gravel and woodland trails, and the runway at Hof Airport; online registration; accommodation recommendations available; maximum of 100 participants; running continues until the final runner finishes.

name: Fischerhuder Sommerlauf
description: The Fischerhude Summer Run, organised by Sportfreunde Fischerhude e.V., takes place on 27 June 2026 from 18:00. Distances include 1 km for children and 5 km and 10 km for teenagers and adults, run on an officially measured 5 km loop. There is also a 2x5 km relay for friends, families and colleagues. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, free hot and cold drinks in the finish area, and changing and shower facilities after the run. A DJ provides entertainment, and an after-run party with a barbecue, cocktails and drinks follows the races.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km on an officially measured 5 km loop
1 km children’s race
2x5 km relay for teams
additional: The start and finish area is in the car park in front of Brünings Scheune (Landstraße 22). Walkers can register for the 5 km race. Free parking is available at the Fischerhude sports ground. Changing and shower facilities are available in the TSV-Fischerhude-Quelkhorn clubhouse. Races start from 19:45. The event takes place in all weather. The after-run party features a barbecue, cocktails and drinks. Proceeds go to regional projects. The event also includes a barbecue and after-run party, parking at the sports ground, and is scheduled to take place in all weather.

name: Südeichsfeldlauf
description: The Südeichsfeld Run in Diedorf is a traditional running event that takes place in all weather. Various races are offered, including a half marathon of 21.1 km with 445 metres of elevation gain, a long race of 11.3 km, and a short race of 5.9 km. There is a Bambini run and a schoolchildren’s race for children. All finishers receive medals, and the top runners are honoured with trophies and certificates.
course_highlights: Half marathon: 21.1 km with 445 metres of elevation gain
Long race: 11.3 km with 210 metres of elevation gain
Short race: 5.9 km with 111 metres of elevation gain
additional: Late registration is possible on the event day from 8:00 to 8:45. All finishers receive medals. The top three men and women in the main races receive trophies; places 1–5 for men and women receive certificates on site. The Bambini run is untimed, and every participant receives a medal. The start and finish are at the sports ground, Katharinenbergerstraße 2, Diedorf. Course profiles and further information are available on the website. Registration opens on 01.03.2026; late registration is available on the event day.

name: 100km Staffellauf um den Pokal der Uni Tübingen
description: The University of Tübingen 100 km relay race is a long-running university sports event held annually in Tübingen. Teams of students and other participants cover the total distance of 100 kilometres together in relay legs. The course passes through the scenic surroundings of Tübingen and offers both a sporting challenge and a shared experience. Refreshments and an accompanying programme are provided, making the race a special event for runners and spectators.
course_highlights: A total distance of 100 kilometres covered in relay legs
A scenic course around Tübingen
A shared running experience as part of university sports
additional: The race is run as a relay, with refreshments and an accompanying programme available on site. Participation requirements and registration are handled through the University of Tübingen university sports website. Course through Tübingen, time limit of 4h 10min, team and runner registration, start at 13:00, support from physiotherapy students, medical care provided by Lorettoklinik

name: Ansmann Cup 2026
organizer: TSV Assamstadt 1947 e.V. und Laufgemeinschaft Tauberfranken
description: The Ansmann Cup 2026 is a long-standing fun run organized by TSV Assamstadt at Waldstadion Assamstadt. The event offers races for different age and ability groups, from the Bambini race to the 10 km main race. The course was redesigned in 2025 and features less elevation gain, making the event particularly appealing. Alongside the competition, the focus is on enjoying exercise and community.
course_highlights: New course since 2025 with less elevation gain
5 km loop with approximately 50 m of elevation change
Start and finish at Waldstadion Assamstadt
additional: Race number pickup from 13:00 to 16:00 in the festival tent. Water is available along the course; water, tea, and fruit are available at the finish. Showers are available at the sports clubhouse. Awards ceremonies for the Bambini race, the student/youth race, and the other races take place in the festival tent. Timing is provided by racesolution.de. Late registration is possible up to 1 hour before the respective start. The course has featured less elevation gain since 2025. Online registration is open until 23.06.2026; late registration is possible up to 1 hour before the start. Refreshments are available along the course and at the finish, and showers are available at the sports clubhouse.

name: Berglauf 2026
description: The Kyffhäuser Mountain Run is a traditional running event at the Kyffhäuser Monument in Thomm, attracting numerous runners every year. The route climbs uphill and offers a sporting challenge with impressive views. Alongside the main race, there is also the Tower Staircase Run, in which participants climb 306 steps in the monument tower. The event thrives on the commitment of runners, supporters, and volunteer helpers, promising an unforgettable running experience in a unique landscape.
course_highlights: Uphill route at the Kyffhäuser Monument
Tower Staircase Run with 306 steps and 70 m of elevation gain
A range of distances from 2 km to marathon
additional: The Tower Staircase Run starts in groups of 10, with 2 minutes between groups. 60–70 starters are expected. The event takes place in summery temperatures and attracts over 2,400 participants every year. The event offers a unique opportunity to experience the nature of the Kyffhäuser Mountains, with details about registration and participation available on the official website. It is an ideal event for mountain-running enthusiasts and nature lovers.

name: Brauerschwender Basaltlauf
description: The Brauerschwender Basalt Run takes place on 27 June 2026 in Brauerschwend and offers runners of all ages a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings. The courses are gently undulating, well marked and have kilometre markers. Drinks are available along the course, and the organisers provide refreshments at the finish. The event is aimed at both competitive runners and anyone who enjoys being active in a group.
course_highlights: Gently undulating courses
Well-marked routes with kilometre markers
Drinks along the course and refreshments at the finish
additional: Race packs can be collected from 14:00; participants should arrive 30 minutes before their race. Certificates and small gifts are awarded for the Bambini and school races. The first three men and women in the main race receive certificates and prizes; age-group winners receive certificates. The event promotes community and enjoyment of sport, not just competition. Gently undulating course, registration until 26 June, changing rooms and showers available, community spirit and fun.

name: Citylauf Leonberg
description: The City Run Leonberg on June 27, 2026, offers a varied running experience for all age groups and ability levels. The routes pass through Leonberg’s historic old town, the picturesque center of Eltingen, and the modern city center at Neuköllner Platz, with several fan zones featuring live music and enthusiastic spectators. In addition to the main 10 km race, there is a 5 km race, a 1.4 km schoolchildren’s race, and a 0.4 km children’s race. The event is a lively sporting highlight for the whole city, with a fantastic start and finish atmosphere.
course_highlights: Run through Leonberg’s historic old town and the center of Eltingen
Several fan zones with live music along the route
Flat course with moderate climbs and little elevation gain
additional: The start and finish are on Steinstraße, between the sports center/indoor swimming pool and the fairground. Changing and shower facilities are available at the sports center. Timing uses a transponder integrated into the race bib (except for the children’s race, which is untimed). Age categories follow the German Athletics Federation’s rules. The 10 km race is approximately 9.7 km due to the course combination. The children’s race is untimed but includes team scoring. The schoolchildren’s race has age-group rankings and prizes. Race-pack collection begins at 15:00 at the Steinstraße fairground. The event includes various race categories, including relay and schoolchildren’s races. Registration for the 5 km race is open until June 22, 2026; participation in the 10 km race is also available. Special offers are available for groups and families.

name: DJK-Willibaldslauf
location: DJK Eichstätt Parkplatz, Eichstätt, Bavaria, Germany
price_range: Kinder bis 12 Jahre € 5,00, ab 13 Jahre € 20,00, Gruppen ab 5 Personen € 17,00

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Gruppen ab 5 Personen € 17,00 (Bei Gruppenanmeldungen bitte im online-Shop den Gutschein für verbilligten Startplatz hinzufügen!!)

description: The DJK-Willibaldslauf is an inclusive running event in Eichstätt, taking place for the second time on June 27, 2026. All age groups and fitness levels are welcome, from the children’s run and inclusion runs to the main run and Nordic walking. The scenic course follows the Altmühl and leads to the cathedral. The start and finish are at the DJK Eichstätt car park. The event focuses on community and fun, with no timekeeping. All participants receive high-quality running shirts and commemorative medals.
course_highlights: Scenic course along the Altmühl
The course leads to the cathedral and returns via a detour
Start and finish at the DJK Eichstätt car park
additional: Start and finish at the DJK Eichstätt car park; changing facilities directly at the start and finish area; free parking at the Volksfest car park. The programme includes a spiritual reflection and a blessing for athletes at 15:00. Staggered start times: children’s run at 15:30, youth run afterwards, inclusion runs at 16:00, main run at 17:00, and Nordic walking afterwards. No timekeeping; each participant receives a high-quality running shirt and a commemorative medal. On-site late registration is possible from 12:00 to 14:00. Various running categories, including inclusion runs. Online registration available.

name: Fuchsburg Lauf
location: Vohburg, Landkreis Pfaffenhofen an der Ilm, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Fuchsburg Run is organized by TV Vohburg and takes place as part of the Vohburg Fuchsburg Festival on June 27, 2026. The event offers runners of various age groups and ability levels the opportunity to run on attractive routes through the region. The races include a 10 km main race, a 2.3 km schoolchildren’s race, and a 600 m Bambini race. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and the joy of sport, supported by a committed team from TV Vohburg.
course_highlights: 10 km main race through the scenic surroundings of Vohburg
2.3 km schoolchildren’s race for young runners
600 m Bambini race for the youngest participants
additional: The run takes place as part of the Vohburg Fuchsburg Festival. Separate races are held for Bambini, schoolchildren, and adults. The event is supported by a committed team, including course safety and refreshments. There is a participant limit; exact numbers are available on the website. Details about the routes, registration, schedule, and participation conditions are available on the website.

name: Göllnitz-Schmooksberglauf (LC/NLC)
description: The 2nd Göllnitz-Schmooksberg Run (LC/NLC) takes place on June 27, 2026, in Diekhof (Laage) and is hosted by Sportclub Laage. This athletics event is held away from a stadium and invites runners to take part in a sporting competition. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Diekhof and offers an appealing challenge for all participants. Registration is open until June 24, 2026.
course_highlights: Various distances for all age groups (2 km, 5 km, 10.5 km)
Scenic route around Schmooksberg
Part of the Mecklenburg-Vorpommern Running Cup and the Nachwuchslauf
additional: Athletics competition, event held away from a stadium, registration deadline: June 24, 2026, with various age groups and race distances

name: Lubaster Waldlauf
location: Dorfplatz in Lubast, Kemberg, Saxony-Anhalt, Germany
description: The 13th Lubaster Waldlauf takes place on 27 June 2026 in Kemberg and offers runners two distances: 1 km and 6.3 km. The event is ideal for anyone looking to enjoy a short but varied forest run. The race promises pleasant summer weather, with an average temperature of 23 °C and mostly sunny conditions. Participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere and a well-organized event.
course_highlights: Run through the Lubaster Forest
Two distances: 1 km and 6.3 km
Typical June weather with pleasant temperatures
additional: Please check the event details with the organizer before registering. The event is part of the Ranglistenläufe series; June weather is typically warm and sunny, ideal for an outdoor run.

name: Ludwigshafener Stadtlauf
description: The Ludwigshafen City Run offers a varied range of races for all ages and ability levels. From races for toddlers and schoolchildren to youth and beginner races and a fun run for adults, there is something for everyone. The event features a friendly atmosphere, electronic timing, and a functional city-run shirt for all participants. The races take place on varied routes in Ludwigshafen am Rhein and are supported by the City of Ludwigshafen and the Ludwigshafen Sports Association.
course_highlights: A variety of distances, from 2.3 km to the fun run
Electronic timing and a certificate available to download
Free refreshments and a city-run functional shirt for all participants
additional: Bib pickup from 12:00 at the tent on the square by the Werfthalle. Late registration is available until 1 hour before the respective race for an additional fee of 3 euros. Prizes for places 1 to 3 in various age groups and categories. Reusable cups are used for refreshments to reduce environmental impact. Terrain: urban/street, registration via www.br-timing.de, early registration recommended

name: MÜRITZ-LAUF
description: The MÜRITZ-LAUF is a race around Germany’s largest inland lake, the Müritz, and takes place on June 27, 2026, in Waren (Müritz). The course showcases the full diversity of the northern German landscape and has a gently rolling profile, making it ideal for runners who want to enjoy nature while also running fast. The event is organized by ESV Waren e.V., a long-established sports club that, with support from numerous sponsors and volunteers, ensures everything runs smoothly.
course_highlights: Loop around the Müritz, Germany’s largest inland lake
Gently rolling course profile
Diverse northern German landscape
additional: The MÜRITZ-LAUF is organized by ESV Waren e.V., which is also responsible for overall organization, course marshals, medical support, and catering in the finish area. The event is supported by numerous sponsors and receives help from local clubs and volunteer fire brigades. There is a relay race around the Müritz as well as the Röbel–Waren city race. The event offers a scenic setting, different race formats, and online registration. The course is gently undulating, with sections through nature and the national park.

name: Ravensburger Stadtlauf
organizer: Stadt Ravensburg, Sportverband Ravensburg, Wirtschaftsforum Pro Ravensburg
description: The Ravensburg City Run takes place on June 27, 2026, in the historic old town of Ravensburg and offers a unique running experience amid the picturesque city center. The event is being held for the 35th time and welcomes both active runners and spectators to enjoy its special atmosphere. It is organized by the City of Ravensburg, the Ravensburg Sports Association, and Wirtschaftsforum Pro Ravensburg, and hosted by LG Welfen / TSB 1847 Ravensburg e.V. The event promises exciting and entertaining running events in the sports city of Ravensburg.
course_highlights: Run through the historic old town of Ravensburg
A unique running experience in the heart of the city center
An atmosphere with enthusiastic spectators lining the course
additional: Organizers: City of Ravensburg, Ravensburg Sports Association, and Wirtschaftsforum Pro Ravensburg; host: LG Welfen / TSB 1847 Ravensburg e.V.; information available from the City of Ravensburg’s Office for Education, Social Affairs and Sports at Tel: 0751 822443; event hours: 16:00 to 22:00. The run takes place in central Ravensburg, particularly around Marienplatz. Registration is open until June 24, 2026. The event is free for spectators to attend.

name: Schöneicher Eichkaterlauf
location: Schöneiche bei Berlin, Oder-Spree, Brandenburg, Germany
description: The 14th Eichkaterlauf on June 27, 2026, in Schöneiche offers a varied range of races for all ages and ability levels. From short Bambini and children’s races to fun runs and the challenging 12 km premier event, there is something for everyone. The courses pass through the beautiful natural surroundings of Schöneiche and offer a chance to enjoy a sporting event together. The event is family-friendly, and registration is conveniently available online, with on-the-day registration also possible.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 400 m to 12 km
Courses through the natural surroundings of Schöneiche
Family-friendly event with Bambini and children’s races
additional: Online registration closes on June 26, 2026, at 12:00. Late registration is available at the venue on race day. The event takes place at Dorfaue / corner of Stegeweg (near the fairground) in Schöneiche. Various race distances, online registration, family-friendly, courses through natural surroundings

name: Stadtlauf Abensberg 2026
location: Stadion in Abensberg, Abensberg, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Abensberg City Run takes place on June 27, 2026, at the new stadium in Abensberg. The event is a special highlight of TSV Abensberg’s athletics department, which is committed to promoting recreational sport. By taking part in the city run, you support local running and make a statement in favor of a vibrant sports culture. The run is a great opportunity to log miles together toward a new tartan track and modern training equipment.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the new Abensberg Stadium
Run together to help expand the sports facilities
Recreational sports event focused on community and the joy of exercise
additional: Training for youth and adults takes place at the stadium on Mondays from 18:00 to 19:30, and for children aged 6 and over on Fridays from 17:00 to 18:30. There is a running group on Mondays from 19:00 to 19:45. Taking part in the city run supports the development of a new tartan track and modern training equipment. City run on 27.06.2026, running event, support for local running, participation promotes local sports culture

The event offers various races, including a half-marathon relay and individual races for runners born in 2012 or earlier. The course is measured by the DLV and is part of the Volksbank-Cup running series. Drinks and refreshments are available at the finish area, and changing and shower facilities are located directly at the Beverstadion.
course_highlights: Course measured by the DLV
Relay exchange zone at the Beverstadion
Start and finish at the Beverstadion in Ostbevern
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event from 2 p.m. until 30 minutes before the respective race, for an additional fee of €2. All athletes can enjoy running tea, mineral water, non-alcoholic beer and Fassbrause in the finish area. Changing and shower facilities are located directly at the Beverstadion. The relay exchange zone is at the Beverstadion. The event offers a pleasant running atmosphere, with refreshments, changing rooms and showers. Registration and results are available on the official website.

name: Sudecka 100
location: Boguszowo-Gorce, Boguszów-Gorce, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Sudecka 100 is the oldest night ultramarathon in Poland, held in the mountain terrain of Boguszów-Gorce. The course is demanding and full of excitement, giving participants the chance to test themselves over 100 km. In 2026, organizers are introducing a new event—the Sudecki Morning Half Marathon over 21 km—as well as a Night Mountain Marathon over 42 km. The event attracts runners from across the country, offering generous race packs and plenty of attractions, including personalized medals and aid stations along the course.
course_highlights: A demanding course in mountain terrain
A night ultramarathon over 100 km
New: the Sudecki Morning Half Marathon over 21 km
additional: Medal personalization (first name, last name, time) is available during registration. Aid stations along the course and a stand selling sports nutrition and running accessories. Free accommodation from June 27 at 12:00 to June 29 at 12:00. The participant limit for the 21 km and 42 km distances is 200; there is no limit for the 100 km distance. A demanding course in mountain terrain, medal personalization, sports nutrition and accessories available, accommodation from Friday to Sunday, and a course that is marked for most of its length.

name: XIII Dycha Anny Wazówny
location: Brodnica, Brodnica County, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 13th Anna Vasa 10K is a 10 km road race taking place in Brodnica. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness over a middle distance, and the organizers encourage participants to prepare with dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The race is open and welcoming to runners, offering expert support and the chance to take part in a sporting event in the picturesque Kuyavian-Pomeranian region.
course_highlights: A 10 km road course
Picturesque surroundings in Brodnica
Designed for a moderate difficulty level
additional: The organizer offers training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to runners’ VDOT levels, as well as expert support. Educational materials on warming up, foam rolling, and running preparation are also available on the website. The event includes several distances, including the 10 km main race, children’s races, and a 3 km race. Registration is available online, and the event promotes active leisure and discovering the region.

name: Supermaraton Gor Stolowych
location: Karlów, Kłodzko County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Table Mountains Supermarathon is a demanding mountain race held in the scenic Table Mountains near Karłów. The course follows hiking trails and is highly technical, with numerous rocks and turns, as well as significant elevation changes. Participants should expect variable conditions, including possible snow and ice, and are required to carry appropriate equipment. The event is part of the Grand Prix DFBG mountain-running series and attracts fans of ultra running and mountain half-marathons.
course_highlights: The course follows hiking trails in Poland’s Table Mountains
Significant elevation changes and technical challenges, with numerous rocks and turns
Heavy snow and ice are possible; the use of snowshoes is permitted
additional: The time limit for finishing the race is 7 hours. The race office and start are at the Table Mountains National Park Training and Education Centre in Karłów. Participants can use drop bags (maximum 3 kg), which are transported to the finish. The course is marked with the organizer’s tape. The race goes ahead regardless of the weather, with the possibility of shortening the course in difficult conditions. A post-race recovery meal and awards ceremony are planned. The time limits are 11 hours for the ultramarathon and 5 hours for the half-marathon. The course has elevation changes of +2400/-2300 m for the ultramarathon and +1050/-925 m for the half-marathon. The event is part of a regional mountain-running series.

Participants will complete 10 laps of a 4.2195 km loop, mostly along sheltered park paths. The event is amateur in character and dedicated to the memory of Marek Dworski. Individual, team, and relay categories are planned. The race starts at 10:00, at the same time as the Gliwice Park Running Challenge.
course_highlights: 10 laps of a 4.2195 km loop
The course runs mostly along sheltered park paths
The race takes place in Gliwice, surrounded by greenery
additional: The marathon starts at the same time as the Gliwice Park Running Challenge. Planned categories include individual open, women’s, men’s, age-group, team, and relay classifications. The marathon course consists of 10 laps of a 4.2195 km park loop. The Pędziwiatr Gliwice Club has been active since 2011 and organizes amateur running events. The participant limit is 300; online registration is available. The time limit is 6 hours. The course runs through park and woodland areas. Individual and team classifications are offered.

name: Bieg Szlakiem Pluderskich Stawów
description: The Bieg Szlakiem Pluderskich Stawów is a 10-kilometre road race held in Dobrodzień. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course combining paved roads and urban areas. The organizers offer training plans tailored to different ability levels so everyone can prepare optimally for the race. The event is open and welcoming to runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Road race in Dobrodzień
Scenic route combining paved roads and urban areas
additional: The organizer offers training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level, as well as expert support. Organizers can use a platform to manage the race’s listing and collaborate on marketing. No information is available about start waves, participant limits, or entry fees. The event includes races for adults and children, with a participant limit of 200. Training sessions and preparation plans are available on the organizer’s website.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
location: Polana za stadionem Piasta, Gliwice, Śląskie, Poland
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: Gliwicka Parkowa Prowokacja Biegowa is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice in 2026, organized by the amateur running club „Pędziwiatr”. The events aim to promote healthy, active outdoor recreation, with the slogan “Let yourself be provoked into fighting laziness!” The approximately 4.2 km course runs mainly along forest tracks and gravel paths, with a refreshment point at the start/finish. Events take place on Saturdays once a month, starting at 10:00, in the clearing behind Piast Stadium in Gliwice.
course_highlights: A 4,219.5 m course along forest tracks and gravel paths
A refreshment point at the start/finish line, available after each lap
The course is not closed to other members of the public
additional: The event series comprises 12 monthly Saturday starts. The course is not certified and is not closed to other members of the public. The race office opens at 9:00 in the clearing near Piast Stadium. Registration is available online and at the race office. Participants can take part in running and Nordic Walking events, as well as the e-Prowokacja online event. A participant wishing to start in another event must register again and receive a new race number. The event takes place in the clearing behind Piast Stadium, with the start at 10:00; advance registration and an entry fee are required.

name: III Bieg w Sławicach
description: The 3rd Sławice Run is a 10 km road race taking place on 27 June 2026 in Sławice, Masovian Voivodeship. Runners can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is a great opportunity for runners to test their fitness over a middle distance in a friendly atmosphere. The organizers welcome both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: A 10 km road course
Designed for a moderate difficulty level
Training plans ranging from 8 to 20 weeks are available to help runners prepare
additional: Training plans ranging from 8 to 20 weeks are available and tailored to the runner’s VDOT level. Expert support is available during preparation. Runners can use the Runner’s Zone, which offers additional materials and courses. No detailed information is available about entry fees, registration, or the exact course. Follow official sources for updates.

name: X Lubeński Cross
description: The X Lubeński Cross is a mountain cross-country race held in the picturesque area of the Lubenia municipality. The start and finish are at the market square in Lubenia. The main race routes are 13.8 km and 22.3 km long, covering varied terrain: asphalt, paved roads and field paths, as well as 3 or 5 green hills. The race is known for its high level of difficulty and beautiful views, creating a unique sporting celebration. Children’s and youth races are also held at the stadium, divided by age and gender categories.
course_highlights: The routes pass over 3 green hills on the shorter distance and 5 on the longer distance
Varied terrain: asphalt (21–25%), paved roads (32–38%), field roads and paths (41–43%)
Picturesque mountain terrain in the Lubenia municipality
additional: Children’s and youth races take place at the stadium on a marked loop of approximately 200 m, divided by age and gender categories. Children’s race numbers must be collected by 10:30. This year, on-the-day registration for children is unavailable because all starting places have been filled. Registration for children at the stadium opens after 10:30, with a limited number of race packages available. The children’s races begin after the shorter main race starts. Mountain terrain, online and stadium registration, annual event held since 2016, varied routes and distances.

description: The 13th Cichociemni Run is a cross-country race held in Sochaczew, dedicated to the memory of the Polish heroes and soldiers known as the Cichociemni. The course is challenging, with numerous natural and artificial obstacles of varying difficulty that require participants to get wet, jump over obstacles, and crawl beneath them. The race takes place once a year in June and attracts people who want to overcome their weaknesses and aren’t afraid of mud. It’s a unique opportunity to get to know the banks and bed of the Bzura River and feel the wind in your hair during a sporting competition.
course_highlights: Cross-country course with natural and artificial obstacles
Route along the banks and bed of the Bzura River
Challenging features: mud, water, ditches, jumps, and crawling beneath obstacles
additional: Registration is available through the Zmierzymy Czas platform. Entry fees increase as the race date approaches and depend on the date payment is made. A race-specific T-shirt can be ordered during selected periods. Running groups of at least 6 people can receive a discount by contacting the organizers by email in advance. Payment must be made within 30 days of registration. The organizer is UKS Dragon Fight Club Sochaczew. terrain, online registration, obstacles, challenging course

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, promoting a healthy, active lifestyle and bringing together runners from the region and beyond. The races take place on a permanent course that is familiar to participants, and the atmosphere is welcoming to both experienced runners and amateurs. The event attracts large groups of runners, Nordic walkers, and canicross participants, and participation is free. The organizers ensure the event runs smoothly and support the development of the local running community.
course_highlights: A permanent course with more than 100 races held to date
Routes for runners, Nordic walkers, and canicross participants
Participants from many cities in the Upper Silesian metropolitan area and from outside the voivodeship
additional: Registration for the Grand Prix series is available only at the Race Office on race day. Participation in the Grand Prix races is free. Nordic walking and canicross participants also take part. Women make up a high proportion of participants, ranging from over 27% to 34% in individual races. The event fosters a welcoming atmosphere and brings together runners from different clubs and cities. The event is planned for June 27, 2026, with the option to register online. It promotes health, physical activity, and fun in a sporting atmosphere.

The race route follows paved roads through the picturesque Chełmno Landscape Park, passing through Unisław, Stablewice and Gołoty. The race is certified by the Polish Athletic Association and is part of the 2026 Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship Grand Prix in Long-Distance Running. All running and Nordic Walking enthusiasts are invited to take part in this sporting event.

A 10 km distance certified by the Polish Athletic Association
Passes through Unisław, Stablewice and Gołoty

The race counts toward the 2026 edition of the Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship Grand Prix in Long-Distance Running. Nordic Walking is also available as an event, and the route is marked and supported by medical services. The race starts at 10:00, and participants can expect refreshment points along the route.

Scenic views around Międzybrodzie Żywieckie
A challenge for runners of different experience levels

The event is held in the scenic village of Pogórze and attracts runners who enjoy competing on off-road courses. The organizers provide professional RFID timing and comprehensive technical support to ensure the event runs smoothly. All running enthusiasts are welcome to take part in this exceptional sporting event.

Professional RFID timing
Start at 18:00, allowing for a run in pleasant evening conditions

The event is open to different age groups, and the course is likely to run through outdoor areas in Pogórze.

Challenging terrain with beautiful views
additional: A trail race featuring mountain terrain, held in memory of Barnabáš Uvegeš. The race takes place in June 2026.

name: Malofatranská stovka
description: Malá Fatra 100 is a mountain ultramarathon in the Malá Fatra range, offering demanding routes with significant climbs and descents. The race is intended for experienced runners in excellent physical condition and crosses the entire range, including Krivánska Fatra and Lúčanská Fatra. The event is a registered ITRA member and serves as a qualifying race for other prestigious ultratrails. It is organized by Slovak Ultra Trail in cooperation with volunteers and partners.
course_highlights: The route crosses the entire Malá Fatra range (Krivánska Fatra and Lúčanská Fatra)
Significant climbs and descents, including exposed sections
Available routes: MF100 (107 km / 7300 m+), MF50 (56 km / 4400 m+), MF33 (35 km / 2600 m+)
additional: Insurance covering Mountain Rescue Service intervention is part of the mandatory equipment and can be ordered directly during registration. Functional and cotton T-shirts with an original print are available. Discounts on the entry fee may be available based on the ITRA Performance Index. Race check-in and the start take place in Terchová. Trail race through Malá Fatra with significant ascents and descents, exposure, and mountain terrain; registration details not specified.

name: Svätojánsky beh na Domaši
description: The Svätojánsky Run at Domaša is a traditional running race held at the Domaša Dobrá recreation centre. Runners can choose between two courses: a short 5 km route and a long 13 km route, which run mainly along forest roads and trails with varied elevation. The event is suitable for the general public, with categories by age and gender. Organisers provide refreshment stations, changing rooms, toilets and medical services. The atmosphere is friendly and competitive, with valuable prizes for the winners.
course_highlights: The 13 km long course has approximately 356 m of ascent and 314 m of descent
The 5 km short course follows a forest road and has 70 m of elevation gain
Refreshment stations are located at 5 km, 10 km and at the finish of the long course; refreshments are available at the finish of the short course
additional: The children's race is free of charge. The changing room, toilets and baggage storage are at the harbour by the Loď Bohémia. Every runner must wear their race number visibly attached to their chest. Medical services are provided by the organiser. The entry fee will be refunded in full for withdrawals made by 8 June. The race is held in accordance with the rules of athletics competitions and the event regulations. 13 km and 5 km courses, children's race, categories for men and women in various age groups, start from 09:45 to 10:15, car park by Bogárka, Domaša Dobrá recreation centre

name: Beh za zdravie – Záhorská Bystrica

The event is open to all ages and fitness levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and support for disadvantaged people. Run for Health was founded in 2023 and each year supports selected individuals or foundations through physical activity.
course_highlights: Takes place at BYS3T PARK in Záhorská Bystrica
The event combines running with support for the community
Open to all ages and fitness levels

The organizers offer the opportunity to volunteer and help run the event. The event takes place on park paths and streets in Záhorská Bystrica, with the option to participate as a runner, walker, or volunteer. A virtual participation option is also available.

5 km Velvet Nordic Walking event
Race registration and start on Hlavná Street

Pair competitions, “Mother and Daughter” and “Sisters,” are held in the 5 km and 10 km runs. Times are measured using the ChampionChip system by MyLaps. The event includes various categories for different age groups, with timing provided by the ChampionChip system; on-site registration is also available.

description: Čergovský Umirak is a mountain race of approximately 30 km with around 1,000 metres of elevation gain, intended for trained runners. The race takes place at the Drienica recreation centre, with refreshments and additional activities available for families. The course follows a marked hiking trail, and runners must wear their race number visibly attached to their chest. Safety on the course is provided by the Čergov Mountain Rescue Service, and each participant starts at their own risk. After the last runners finish, results are announced and prizes are awarded to the top men and women.
course_highlights: Mountain race of approximately 30 km with around 1,000 m of elevation gain
Marked hiking trail in the Čergov region
Start and finish near Chata Ride pub in Drienica
additional: Mandatory equipment: a charged mobile phone, a water bottle with a minimum capacity of 0.5 l, and a space blanket in case of bad weather. A race briefing takes place at 8:30 at Chata Ride pub, covering the course and navigation. Refreshments are provided. Race numbers are non-transferable and must be visibly attached to the chest. Safety during the race is provided by the Čergov Mountain Rescue Service. The course is marked as a hiking trail; trail shoes are recommended. Organisers can be contacted by phone or email for registration.

name: Hámornický polmaratón
description: The Hámornický Half Marathon is a traditional running race organized by the Spartak Medzev running club as part of the celebrations of Medzev City Days. The event includes the half marathon, the accompanying Hámornícka Desiatka run, and children’s Hámorníček categories, which are part of the children’s running league. The start is symbolically marked by striking a hammer against an anvil, giving the event a unique atmosphere. Runners can look forward to attractive performance T-shirts, medals with a modern design, and refreshments during the race. The course runs through a beautiful, deep valley, surrounded by natural beauty and the historic atmosphere of the town of Medzev.
course_highlights: The route runs through a beautiful, deep valley with natural springs and birdsong
Symbolic start marked by striking a hammer against an anvil
Accompanying races include the Hámornícka Desiatka and the Hámorníček children’s categories
additional: Participants receive attractive performance T-shirts and medals with a modern design. The event is supported by the city of Medzev and the village of Štós, and the organizers welcome support through 2% tax donations. The course also includes the football stadium; registration is available online and on site; categories are available for men, women, and seniors.

name: Beh cez Hornoorešanské vŕšky – Memoriál Františka Hečka
location: Futbalový štadión, Horné Orešany, Trnava, Slovakia
organizer: Bežecký klub Viktoria, Obecný úrad Horné Orešany

The event is open to all age groups, from children aged 1 and up to seniors, with categories for men, women, juniors and local runners. It is organised by Bežecký klub Viktoria together with the Municipal Office in Horné Orešany. The children’s start is at 15:35 and the start for everyone else is at 17:00.
course_highlights: 10,300 m course with 100 m of elevation gain
Course surface: 50% asphalt, 50% trail
The route passes through the Hornoorešanské Hills, with beautiful views
additional: The children’s start is at 15:35, and the start for everyone else is at 17:00. Categories include all age groups, from children aged 1 and up, juniors, men and women in various age groups, as well as a local category for teams of three. The course is approximately 10.3 km long, split equally between asphalt and trail. Registration is available online or on site. Start times are 15:35 and 17:00.

name: Rajec RunTour Bratislava
description: Rajec RunTour Bratislava is a family running festival offering courses for all ages and ability levels. Participants can choose from 3, 5 and 10 km races, as well as children’s runs of 500 and 1,000 metres. The event takes place at two locations and offers a race pack with everything runners need. Alongside the races, there is a varied programme of activities, refreshments along the course and at the finish, medical and pacer services, and facilities with changing areas and baggage storage. The whole day is designed as an experience for runners and their families, with a raffle and the option to have personal details engraved on medals.
course_highlights: 3, 5 and 10 km courses for recreational and elite runners
Children’s runs of 500 and 1,000 metres
Refreshment stations along the course and at the finish, plus medical and pacer services
additional: Runners can follow pacers carrying flags to help them maintain their pace. After the run, they can have their finish time and name engraved on their medal. name: Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina
location: Bachledová dolina, Bachledová dolina, Bachledka Ski & Sun, Slovakia
description: Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina is a trail race in the beautiful surroundings of the High Tatras, offering runners a unique experience of running on soft terrain in the fresh mountain air. The course passes through the Treetop Walk, Monkova Valley and the Spišská Magura ridge, with the start reached by cable car. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series, which combines sporting achievement with support for local families and charitable causes. Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina is a challenge for experienced runners and newcomers alike, offering a chance to enjoy mountain nature and unforgettable views.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Treetop Walk
Views of the High Tatras and the Spišská Magura ridge
Start reached by cable car in Bachledova Valley
additional: The race is listed among UTMB Index Races and has an international points ranking. The course features a Conti Speed Section, where participants can win a tire voucher and a running shirt. Online preregistration and changes to the entry fee are available through a SportID profile or at the race venue. The event includes eco-friendly cups, water stations and various race categories, including children's races, and offers discounts when registering multiple participants.

name: Mistrovství světa veteránů v běhu do vrchu - nahoru
location: Janské Lázně, Trutnov, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The 2026 World Masters Mountain Running Championships in Janské Lázně is a prestigious international mountain running event for masters athletes, attracting runners from more than 30 countries. The races take place on challenging courses with significant elevation gain, testing runners’ endurance and strength. The event is organized by TJ Maratonstav Úpice under the patronage of the towns of Janské Lázně and Úpice. Registration is open until May 24, 2026, and the event offers several course options of varying distances and elevation gains.
course_highlights: Uphill race: 7.79 km with 851 m of elevation gain
Long Distance race: 22.17 km with 1,332 m of elevation gain
Up/Downhill race: 8.95 km with 594 m of elevation gain
additional: Start lists are updated 1–2 times per week. Competitors must be members of the Masters Association of the Czech Athletic Federation; otherwise, they will not be allowed to start. Registration requires agreement to the WMRA rules and anti-doping rules. The organizers are TJ Maratonstav Úpice, WMRA, ČAS, and ČABDV, under the patronage of the towns of Janské Lázně and Úpice. The event takes place in Janské Lázně on June 28, 2026, with masters age categories available. The race focuses on mountain running, with challenging climbs and the beautiful natural scenery of the Krkonoše Mountains.

name: Sloupský lesní běh
location: Sloup v Moravském krasu, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sloup Forest Run is a traditional road race held in the picturesque surroundings of Sloup in the Moravian Karst. The course is 11.5 kilometres long and is characterised by substantial elevation gain, making it a challenging and appealing race for runners. The event has a long history and attracts runners from the wider area, who enjoy the beauty of nature and the sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: 11.5 km course
Substantial elevation gain
Road race in the natural surroundings of the Moravian Karst
additional: The race takes place in June 2026. The event has been held since 2016 and is intended for runners of all levels who want to experience a race in nature with technical challenges.

name: Lochovice - Plešivec
description: Lochovice - Plešivec is a running race in the Brdy Running Cup, taking place on June 28, 2026, in Lochovice. The course is approximately 5.5 km long, with 350 metres of elevation gain. It starts with 2 km on asphalt and continues along forest paths, with a steeper climb around the 3 km mark. The finish is at the summit of Plešivec, which offers a beautiful view. The event also includes children’s races and a family run in support of the Mezi břehy home hospice.
course_highlights: Course length: approx. 5.5 km, with 350 m of elevation gain
2 km on asphalt; the remainder is on forest paths, with a steep climb at the 3 km mark
Finish at the summit of Plešivec, with a beautiful view
additional: Marked bags containing change-of-clothes items will be transported by off-road vehicle to the summit of Plešivec at 10:20. Fabián’s Run — children’s competitions start at 11:10. The family run in support of the Mezi břehy hospice starts at 10:30. The course includes asphalt and forest sections; transport to the summit of Plešivec is provided at 10:20; the event includes children’s races and supports outdoor activities.

name: Půlmaratón okolo Nového Veselí

description: The Half Marathon Around Nové Veselí is a traditional running race organized by AO TJ Sokol Nové Veselí and now being held for the 25th year. The main 21.1 km race follows a turnaround course repeated three times, on paved paths and third-class roads with minimal elevation gain. Shorter races are also available for teenagers, schoolchildren, and preschool children, making the event appealing to runners of a wide range of ages. Refreshments are provided after the race, and the winner of the main race receives a cash prize. The start is traditionally in the square in Nové Veselí.
course_highlights: The main race is 21.1 km and follows a turnaround course repeated three times
The route runs on paved paths and third-class roads with minimal elevation gain
Courses for young people and preschool children use local roads and the town square
additional: Refreshment stations are located at both turnaround points on the main race course. Refreshments are provided for all participants after the race, with additional refreshments available at the handball club buffet. The winner of the main race receives a cash prize of CZK 2,000, plus CZK 1,000 for breaking the course record. On request, each runner can receive a certificate showing their placing and finishing time. The race takes place on 28 June 2026, with the main race starting at 9:45. The event is open to the general public, including young people, veterans, and children.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Potůčky
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beauty of the Ore Mountains. The series includes 6 races at various locations, including Potůčky, where the main race covers 6 to 9 km and the adventure route covers 20 to 30 km. Walking routes and children’s races are also available. The event is suitable for runners of all levels, canicross participants, children, and walkers, and offers a chance to discover the beautiful nature of the Ore Mountains.
course_highlights: Main race: 6–9 km through the natural scenery of the Ore Mountains
Adventure route: 20–30 km, according to the map
Children’s races: 200 m to 1,600 m
additional: The series includes 6 races at various locations in the Ore Mountains. In addition to the main running races, walking routes involving finding checkpoints using a map and children’s races are also available. The event is organized by Živé Sokolovsko z.s. in cooperation with Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s. and the municipalities concerned. Registration is available through the website. The event offers multiple categories and routes suitable for runners and walkers of all levels.

name: Dahlenburger Moorlauf
description: The Dahlenburg Moor Run is a popular community race with manual timekeeping, attracting around 200 participants each year. The event offers races for children, walking, and two main races over 4,600 m and 8,800 m. The course is flat and mostly paved, and the children’s races take place on the tartan track. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and picturesque setting in the Dahlenburg Moor.
course_highlights: Flat, mostly paved course
Children’s races on the tartan track
Run through the picturesque setting of the Dahlenburg Moor
additional: Race number pickup from 08:30 at the DSK sports facility/Dornweg in Dahlenburg. Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start for an additional fee of €3.00. Manual timekeeping. Showers are available at the swimming pool (admission required) or in the clubhouse. Refreshments include drink stations along the course, as well as coffee, cake, and soft drinks at the sports field. Parking is available in front of the swimming pool and the school. Courses, registration, community spirit, various types of running

name: AHRTuS-Lauf mit Ahrtal-TEAM-Cup
description: The AHRTuS Run is a club-organized race day above the Calvary Hill in Ahrweiler, prepared by TuS Ahrweiler volunteers in Quarzkaul. The program starts with races for toddlers, children and teenagers, followed by 5 km and 10 km races and a 6.2 km Nordic walking course. The adult course runs mainly along shaded forest roads and narrow trails, with some elevation gain, including a climb through the Maibach gorge with numerous wooden bridges. The 10 km race is also the final event in the Ahrtal TEAM Cup, where club teams compete for the last points. The event combines a family-friendly atmosphere with sporting competition and offers children medals, a bouncy castle, a play bus and live music at the start and finish.
course_highlights: Shaded forest roads and narrow trails
Climb through the Maibach gorge with numerous wooden bridges
10 km race as the final event in the Ahrtal TEAM Cup
additional: The event features races for toddlers, children and teenagers, a 6.2 km Nordic walking option, finisher medals for children, a bouncy castle, a play bus and live music in the start and finish area. Around 250 runners take part. In addition to the races, the event offers family activities, finisher medals, a bouncy castle, a play bus and live music in the start and finish area.

name: Eschelbronner Schreinerdorflauf
description: The Eschelbronn Carpenter Village Run takes place on June 28, 2026, and offers an approximately 10 km course on paved paths through the Eschelbronn forest and countryside. The course is challenging but suitable for all runners. The start and finish are at the TV Heim, Schlossstraße 23, in Eschelbronn. There is also a walking course with timing after 7.5 km, which can also count towards the sports badge assessment.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km course on paved paths
Course through the Eschelbronn forest and countryside
Challenging course profile, but suitable for everyone
additional: A walking course with timing after 7.5 km is available for the sports badge assessment. Start and finish at the TV Heim (Schlossstraße 23). The course is on paved paths. Start at 9:00 a.m.; registration from 8:00 a.m. Includes a walking category with timing after 7.5 km.

name: Schwalbacher Volkslauf - Sport gegen Armut
location: Schwalbach am Taunus, Hochtaunuskreis, Hessen, Germany
description: The Schwalbach Volkslauf is an inclusive charity run held annually by Turngemeinde 1887 e.V. Schwalbach. It offers various race distances for all age and ability groups, including 10 km, 6 km, a 3 km fun run, a 1 km handicap run and a children’s run. The event celebrates inclusion, bringing together people of different backgrounds and abilities in a welcoming atmosphere. It supports social projects and raises awareness of poverty.
course_highlights: A range of distances from 370 m to 10 km
Inclusive participation for people with and without disabilities
A welcoming atmosphere, supported by the commitment of helpers and volunteers
additional: The event features several distances, including a handicap run and a children’s run, to promote inclusion. It is supported by Lebenshilfe Main-Taunus e.V., which advocates for people with disabilities in the Main-Taunus district. The event includes multiple race distances, including races for children and people with disabilities, is sponsored by GLOBUS Eschborn, and takes place in June in Schwalbach am Taunus.

name: Tippkötter Sommerlauf in Rheine
location: Bentlager Wald, Rheine, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 11th Tippkötter Summer Run in Rheine takes place on June 28, 2026, in Bentlage Forest and offers scenic, nature-filled routes with views of the salt works and Bentlage Monastery. The spectacular finish is in the FC Eintracht Rheine stadium, where all runners cross the finish line at the penalty spot. Music, professional commentary and surprises make this a special running experience for participants of all ages. Alongside the main race, there is also an elementary school run, making the event a family-friendly sports festival.
course_highlights: Scenic routes through Bentlage Forest
Route passing the salt works and Bentlage Monastery
Finish in the FC Eintracht Rheine stadium at the penalty spot
additional: Electronic timing with a transponder race bib. Race packets can be collected in the VIP room at FC Eintracht Rheine. Headphones are prohibited and may result in disqualification. Bambini run participants receive a participation medal. Trophies for the overall winners of the 2 km, 5 km, 5 km walking and 10 km races. Age-group awards with medals only for the 2 km race. Certificates can be printed via Race Result. Ample changing rooms and showers are available. Food and drink available on site, including drinks, fries, bratwurst, steaks and waffles. Parking is available at Rheine Zoo. The 5 km and 10 km routes are officially measured and eligible for rankings. The event takes place in June 2026 and features various race distances, electronic timing, on-site refreshments and parking at Rheine Zoo; there is no parking directly at the event venue.

description: The 19th Muko Charity Run Hannover is an inclusive event taking place on 28 June 2026 at the VfL Eintracht Hannover sports ground. It is open to all ages and ability levels, whether you run, walk or stroll, with or without a disability. The aim is to raise donations for Haus Schutzengel, a guest house for parents and patients from cystic fibrosis families, near Hannover Medical School. Sponsors donate one euro for every lap completed on the 400-metre cinder track. The run promotes community and solidarity in the fight against cystic fibrosis.
course_highlights: Lap on a 400-metre cinder track
Inclusive run for all age groups and ability levels
Event held at the VfL Eintracht Hannover sports ground
additional: The run takes place from 11:00 to 15:00. Each participant can run, walk or stroll as many laps as they like. Sponsors donate one euro per lap or a fixed total amount. A donation receipt is issued for donations of 20 euros or more. Certificates are awarded after the run. An online donation tool will be made available later. Hygiene rules must be observed; disinfectant will be available on site. Run on a 400m cinder track, donations from sponsors, online donation tool, changing rooms and showers available, no dogs allowed, refreshments at the club restaurant, children's activities, under the patronage of Tina Deeken.

description: The hella hamburg half marathon is a major running event in Hamburg, held annually on the last Sunday in June. On an officially measured, flat, paved 21.1 km course, up to 24,000 runners enjoy a unique running party through the Hanseatic city. The route passes around 50 landmarks and is accompanied by numerous event spots with DJ support and live music. The event is known for its great atmosphere and traffic-free course, secured by the police and course marshals.
course_highlights: Officially measured half marathon course eligible for best-time lists (21.0975 km)
Flat, fully paved point-to-point course
Around 50 landmarks and numerous event spots with live music and DJ support
additional: Sunday start from 08:30, course closes at 13:40 (maximum finish time 3:30 h). Runners born in 2010 or earlier are eligible to participate. A withdrawal option can be booked for 10.00 euros until 9 June 2026. Medal engraving (8.00 euros), a technical shirt (35.00 euros) and official socks (20.00 euros) can be ordered online until 9 June 2026. Race-pack collection takes place in the foyer (details are incomplete in the text). The course is flat, paved and traffic-free; registration is online; race-pack collection is at the exhibition grounds; timing uses a transponder; separate classifications for men and women.
