The 10 km main race runs through the idyllic Hofgarten, past the imposing Veste Coburg, to the airfield and back to the TV 1848 Coburg sports grounds. In addition to the main race, there is a 1.6 km children’s and youth race and a 400 m Bambini run for the youngest participants. The event offers a lively atmosphere, with refreshment stations and a fan zone providing runners with extra motivation.

Refreshment station at kilometre 3.5 by the airfield
Fan zone at kilometre 8 for extra motivation

Flat course on city and club grounds.

name: VW - THIEL Rheda-Wiedenbrücker Staffelmarathon
location: Schloss- und Rosengarten, Rheda-Wiedenbrück, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The VW - THIEL Rheda-Wiedenbrück Relay Marathon is a long-established relay marathon taking place on July 5, 2026, in the castle and rose gardens in Rheda-Wiedenbrück. The flat, well-maintained course follows a two-kilometre loop through the historic castle park, to be completed 21 times. The event is organised by LG Burg Wiedenbrück, which has been hosting this relay marathon since 2013 and has built a dedicated running community. The relay marathon offers runners an attractive and varied route through beautiful parkland, with no disruptive road crossings.
course_highlights: Flat, well-maintained 2 km loop through the castle park
Start and finish in the rose garden, with a view of the historic castle
No disruptive road crossings on the course
additional: The relay marathon consists of 21 laps of 2 km each, run in Rheda Castle Park. The course is flat and has no road crossings. Registration is available online. The event is organised by LG Burg Wiedenbrück, which also runs other races. Photos and videos of previous relays are available on the website. Registration is via my.raceresult.com; the race is held as a relay marathon, and results are available on the day of the event.

name: Wilhelmsfelder Kerwelauf
description: The Wilhelmsfelder Kerwelauf takes place for the 24th time on 5 July 2026 and offers runners and walkers various routes through the beautiful countryside around Wilhelmsfeld. The race starts at the Odenwaldhalle, at an elevation of 365 metres, and follows varied paths with climbs and aid stations. Timing is electronic, using a chip attached to the race number. This traditional event is for runners of all ages who want to enjoy the fresh air and scenic attractions of this health resort.
course_highlights: Start at the Odenwaldhalle, at an elevation of 365 m, with changing and shower facilities
Routes with challenging climbs, including to the 500 m-high Prinzensitz and the highest point, Holzapfelbaum (505 m)
Aid stations along the course, for example at 2 km, Prinzensitz and Sitzbuch-Hütte
additional: Timing is provided by a chip attached to the race number. Start and finish are at the Odenwaldhalle, which has changing and shower facilities. Photos and video footage will be taken during the event. There is a 10 km walking route. Registration is online with advance payment, saving time on race day. Routes of 6.4 km, 10 km and a half marathon; online registration; walking options; weather-dependent conditions in July

name: Dorflauf TSV Wiera
description: The 6th Dorflauf TSV Wiera takes place on July 5, 2026, in Schwalmstadt and is officially registered with the German Athletics Association. The event offers races over 600 meters and 10 kilometers. The results are included in the official athletics rankings, making the competition particularly attractive to ambitious runners. The race takes place in typical July weather, with pleasant temperatures and mostly sunny conditions.
course_highlights: Distances: 600 m and 10 km
Officially registered with the German Athletics Association
Results are included in the official rankings
additional: Typical July weather: approx. 25 °C, low of 15 °C, 75 mm average precipitation, mostly sunny. July weather: approx. 25°C, sunny; start location in Schwalmstadt; results are included in the official rankings

name: Eselsburger-Tal-Lauf
description: The 28th Eselsburger Tal-Lauf takes place on 5 July 2026 in Herbrechtingen. This long-standing running event warmly welcomes runners of all ages. The varied routes pass through the picturesque Eselsburger Tal and offer ideal conditions for both competitive athletes and recreational runners. The youngest participants can test themselves in the Bambini and school races, while the half marathon—the premier event—covers two laps through the nature reserve. Alongside the competition, the event puts the shared experience, friendly atmosphere and dedicated volunteers first.
course_highlights: Routes through the picturesque Eselsburger Tal
Half marathon with two laps through the nature reserve
Children’s races for Bambinis (500 m) and schoolchildren (800 m)
additional: Start times: Bambini race at 8:30, school races from 8:50, and the 5.5 km, 10 km and half marathon from 9:15. Race-pack collection on 4 July from 13:00 to 16:00 and on 5 July from 7:00. Electronic timing with a single-use transponder. Changing rooms and showers at the Neue Bibrishalle. Medical support provided by Bergwacht Herbrechtingen. Award ceremony and prize draw with valuable prizes after the races. Distances from 500 m to the half marathon; family-friendly; nature reserve; various race categories.

name: Eßlinger Zeitung Lauf
description: The Eßlinger Zeitung Run, also known as the EZ Run, is a traditional road race in Esslingen am Neckar that has been held annually since 1999. Organized by the Eßlinger Zeitung and TSG Esslingen, it is the largest mass-participation sporting event in the Esslingen district. Since 2003, the main race has covered a 10 km course on a 2.5 km loop through the city center, considered challenging because of its cobbled sections. The event also includes children’s and schoolchildren’s races. The EZ Run is a member of German Road Races.
course_highlights: 10 km main race on a 2.5 km loop through Esslingen city center
Cobbled sections make the course challenging
Children’s and schoolchildren’s races are also part of the program
additional: In 2015, the main race was shortened to 7.5 km because of extreme heat. The course is measured in accordance with DLV guidelines using the Jones Counter. 10 km main race, member of German Road Races, event held since 1999

name: Kraftsolmser Dorflauf
description: The Kraftsolms Village Run is a popular running event in Kraftsolms, attracting runners from the region and beyond. The event offers challenging 5.4 km and 10.4 km courses through the municipality. The run is known for its welcoming atmosphere and sporting challenges, as shown by the course records that have been broken multiple times. The start traditionally takes place at Kraftsolms village square, and participant numbers continue to grow.
course_highlights: Challenging 5.4 km and 10.4 km courses
Start and finish at Kraftsolms village square
Course records on the 5.4 km distance
additional: The run takes place at Kraftsolms village square. The event attracts more than 130 participants, including many from the municipality of Waldsolms and neighboring municipalities. Local clubs and runners are strongly represented. The event is part of an inclusive sports program run by the Sportfreunde Kraftsolms club. The course follows mostly paved paths and field roads, with safety measures provided by the fire brigade. Registration options include online registration, on-site registration, and registration on the day of the event. The event is a well-established community gathering with a sporting character.

The event is organized by BLV Kreis Ansbach and hosted by TSC Neuendettelsau Athletics Department. DLV-approved race with official timing
Event in the Middle Franconia region with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: Registration is open until June 30, 2026. The race takes place in the center of Neuendettelsau. Typical summer weather around 25°C.

Alongside the sporting competition, there is an extensive program featuring refreshments, games and fun for children, and an awards ceremony with prizes for the fastest participants.

Trail course, children's program, supporting program, refreshments, late entries until 60 minutes before the start

With a 10 km main race, a 5 km fun run and relay competitions, the event offers a varied programme for all ages and ability levels. Part of the Raiffeisen Oberland Challenge, it is known for its friendly atmosphere, prizes for children and team classifications. The course includes a motorway bridge and features exciting competitions in a family-friendly atmosphere. The run traditionally takes place at the weekend and continues to attract growing numbers of participants.

Exciting 5 km and 10 km main races

Professional electronic timing

Runners are warmly welcomed by local residents of all ages, creating a friendly, family atmosphere. The mini marathon is part of the Šípsko - Fatranské behy series and is suitable for all running enthusiasts who want to enjoy the beauty of Orava’s nature and the spirit of sport.

description: VUM – Valašský Ultra Marathon is a demanding three-day stage ultramarathon in the heart of Valašsko and the Beskydy Mountains. The race is for runners seeking a challenge and discomfort, with progressively tougher stages that test physical and mental endurance. Each day is longer and more demanding, emphasizing self-sufficiency and the ability to recover. The race is not about speed, but about finishing safely and managing fatigue and decisions along the course. The organizers emphasize respect for nature and provide basic facilities, accommodation, and refreshments.
course_highlights: Three days, three stages with progressively increasing distance and elevation gain
Routes pass through the landscape of Valašsko and the Beskydy Mountains, including hiking trails, cycle paths, and forest roads
Maximum self-sufficiency for runners, with no conventional aid stations
additional: The entry fee includes camping in your own tent at the race venue, with the option of accommodation at a school (limited capacity). Refreshments during the race include coffee, tea, and basic refreshments before each stage, followed by fruit, vegetables, meat products, and sweet snacks after the stage. One liter of water per runner is available on the course at approximately the halfway point of each stage. Electronic timing and online runner tracking are provided. If exhausted, runners can use the organizers’ transport from the course. Every runner who completes at least one stage receives a finisher medal, while the exclusive finisher T-shirt is reserved for those who complete all three stages. The date differs between sources: the supplied date is July 11, 2027, while the event pages list July 9, 2027.

name: VUM Valašský ultramaraton
description: The Valašský Ultra Maraton (VUM) is a challenging three-day stage ultramarathon in the heart of Valašsko and the Beskids. The race is for runners seeking a challenge and discomfort, with progressively tougher stages that test both physical and mental resilience. Each day is longer and more demanding than the previous one, with an emphasis on self-sufficiency and the ability to recover. VUM is not a race for speed, but for endurance and safely completing all stages. The organizers emphasize respect for nature and runner safety.
course_highlights: Three days and three stages, with progressively increasing distance and elevation gain
Routes pass through the landscapes of Valašsko and the Beskids, including hiking trails, cycle paths, and forest roads
Maximum self-sufficiency for runners, without traditional aid stations
additional: The entry fee includes a participant pack with a cotton T-shirt, a race bib with your name or nickname, access to facilities with toilets and showers, accommodation in your own tent or at a school (limited capacity), refreshments before and after the stages, 1 liter of water on the route halfway through each stage, electronic timing, and online runner tracking. Every participant who completes at least one stage receives a finisher medal, while the exclusive finisher T-shirt is awarded only to those who complete all three stages. If you become exhausted, you can use the organizers’ transport from the course. This is not a team race, but you can run as a pair while competing as individuals. The race is self-supported: runners carry their own refreshments, and the course is not routinely marked, so navigating with GPX is mandatory. Approximately one liter of water per runner is available halfway through each stage. The ALL entry package includes access to facilities and the option of accommodation in your own tent or at a school.

Runners can choose from three distances of varying difficulty and elevation gain, earning ITRA points. The course follows scenic trails in the Karkonosze Mountains and includes multiple ascents of Śnieżka, offering challenges for experienced ultrarunners as well as an opportunity for beginners to take part in a mountain race.

The route features beautiful ridge running with views of Poland’s Kłodzko Basin and the Lower Morava Valley, as well as short, demanding descents. The race is for lovers of mountain terrain and is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and the Iscarex Cup. A shorter 5 km race with 440 m of elevation gain is available for younger runners. The main race starts at 9:30, and the junior race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: Mountain trails with 1,050 m of elevation gain over 14 km

Demanding descents and chamois trails

The course includes border paths and chamois trails, with a short stretch of asphalt after the start.

The race was founded by Czech ultrarunner Tomáš Rusek and is playfully called “masochistic” to reflect its difficulty.

V., the Taubertal Trail offers a unique combination of sporting challenge and scenic beauty.

Breathtaking views of nature and the landscape

Distances range from 5 km to 60 km and include trail and hike disciplines, as well as a children’s trail, across varied terrain through fields, meadows, forests and vineyards. name: 6. O-SEE Backyard Ultra
description: The O-SEE Backyard Ultra is a unique elimination race around Lake Olbersdorf near Zittau. This Backyard Ultra-format race tests endurance, mental strength and team spirit, as all runners start together every full hour and complete a 6.7 km loop until only one runner remains. The winner qualifies directly for the German Championships and has the chance to compete at the World Championships in Tennessee. The race is limited to 200 participants and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with genuine team spirit.

Training opportunities at Josef-Bestler-Stadion
additional: Preparatory training evenings at the district stadium on 03.06.2026 and 17.06.2026 from 18:30. Children’s training on Fridays at the four-court sports hall. Championship registration is handled by Mathias Bronner (mbronner@gmx.net). The event also includes training sessions in June 2026 and other local running events. Ask the organizer for registration and detailed information.

name: Alb-Run Heroldstatt

description: The Sparkassen Alb-Run in Heroldstatt is a running event for endurance athletes, taking place on July 11, 2026. The varied course runs through the Swabian Alb UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, with beautiful scenery, short trails and a moderate amount of elevation gain. Choose from two appealing distances: 9 km and 16 km. The event offers professional timing, on-course refreshments, refreshments at the finish, baggage storage, showers and a supporting program for a thoroughly enjoyable running experience.
course_highlights: Run through the Swabian Alb UNESCO Biosphere Reserve
Varied course with short trails and approx. 350 metres of elevation gain
Two distances: 9 km (orange markings) and 16 km (blue markings)
additional: Start and race-pack collection at the Heroldstatt Sports Centre. Race-pack collection on 10 July 2026 from 18:00 to 20:00 and on 11 July 2026 from 11:00 to 12:30. Late entries and changes of registration are possible on site on 11 July 2026 from 11:00 to 12:30, provided the event is not sold out. Timing uses transponders worn around the ankle, which must be returned before leaving the finish area. The course is marked with white-and-red tape and coloured arrows. Baggage storage is available in the finish area. Showers and charging stations are available. Fans are welcome on the course on foot or by bicycle. A trail race featuring scenic highlights, short trails and elevation gain; start on 11 July 2026 at 13:00 at the Heroldstatt Sports Centre, Bannholz 10.

name: Bad Buchauer Stadtlauf mit Federseehalbmarathon
description: The 25th Bad Buchau City Run with the Federsee Half Marathon takes place on July 11, 2026, offering runners a varied experience. The half-marathon course passes through the historic town center of Bad Buchau, the spa gardens, and the largest nature reserve in southwestern Germany around Lake Federsee. The course is mostly flat, with an elevation difference of approximately 35 meters. It runs partly on asphalt, partly on gravel paths, and partly along a roughly 1 km-long wooden boardwalk through an unspoiled protected forest. Several aid stations along the course provide water, isotonic drinks, and fruit.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course around Lake Federsee in the largest nature reserve in southwestern Germany
Start and finish in the historic town center of Bad Buchau, with two short loops through the town and spa gardens
Roughly 1 km-long wooden boardwalk through an unspoiled protected forest
additional: Late registration is possible on race day until 30 minutes before the respective start. Late registration fee: €5 for the half marathon and 10 km race, €3 for the 5 km race. Race packets can be collected from 07:00 at the race office in the foyer of the Kurzentrum Bad Buchau. There are 8 aid stations along the course providing water; isotonic drinks and fruit are also available in Seekirch (km 12) and at the finish. Maps showing parking and walking routes to shower facilities are available. Course maps, online registration, late registration on race day, parking, aid stations, scenic wooden boardwalk

name: Bahnstadtlauf 2026
price_range: 11€ für Erwachsene, 5€ für Kinder und Jugendliche unter 16 Jahren

description: The Bahnstadt Run in Heidelberg is a family-friendly event with various distances for children, teenagers and adults. It takes place as part of the Bahnstadt Festival and offers exciting races as well as live music and refreshments. The routes run through Bahnstadt, although short-notice changes may be made due to construction work. The races include children’s and school races, as well as 5 km and 10 km races with age-group classifications.
course_highlights: Route through Bahnstadt, Heidelberg
Children’s and school races with age-appropriate distances (1.1 km and 2.2 km)
5 km and 10 km races with age-group classifications and an awards ceremony
additional: Registration and race number collection are available from 16:00 to 17:30. Late registration is possible up to 45 minutes before the respective start, subject to availability, for a late entry fee of €4. Awards ceremonies take place after the respective races. Live bands and refreshments are available during the Bahnstadt Festival. Course changes are possible due to construction work; timing by Race Result; several race categories; start times from 17:30.

name: Bergheide-Cross 2026
description: SCB Langendamm invites you to the 4th Bergheide Cross 2026. The course starts on the access road to the clubhouse of the local small-bore rifle club and runs through the “Osterberg” local recreation and nature conservation area. The event offers three distances for different scoring and age categories, as well as walking on the shorter course. There is also a 1,000-metre race for children and young people. The event is sanctioned by the DLV and takes place on 11 July 2026 from 16:00.
course_highlights: Course through the “Osterberg” nature conservation area
Start on the access road to the clubhouse of the local small-bore rifle club
Three distances: 10.4 km, 5.2 km and a 1,000 m race for schoolchildren
additional: The 1,000-metre race is for children and young people aged 6 to 14, and registration is free and available only on site. The 5.2 km race is open to participants aged 14 and over, and the 10.4 km course to participants aged 16 and over. The main race starts at 17:00; the race for schoolchildren starts at 16:00. Walking is offered on the shorter course. Free on-site registration for the race for schoolchildren, a run in the Osterberg nature area, a family-friendly event.

name: Crosslauf Fichtenau
price_range: 13 Euro für den Crosslauf, 10 Euro für den Jedermannslauf, 3 Euro Nachmeldegebühr
description: The Fichtenau cross-country run is a traditional running event taking place on 11 July 2026 as part of the Festival by the Lake. The event offers two varied courses through the beautiful municipality of Fichtenau: a 5.2 km fun run for everyone who enjoys being active, and a challenging 10 km cross-country run for those seeking a sporting challenge. The races take place in the so-called “Magic Triangle” of Crailsheim/Dinkelsbühl/Ellwangen and attract runners of all ages. The organising team looks forward to welcoming many participants and offers convenient registration by SEPA direct debit.
course_highlights: Two varied running courses through the municipality of Fichtenau
5.2 km fun run, ideal for recreational runners
10 km cross-country run offering a sporting challenge
additional: The registration deadline is 30 minutes before each start. Late entries on the day of the event incur an additional fee of 3 euros. Entry fees can be paid conveniently by SEPA direct debit. Course distances: 5.2 km and 10 km; registration until 8 July 2026; start at the Festival by the Lake; sporting challenge; online registration available.

name: Dietfurter 7-Täler-Lauf
location: Sportplatz der 7-Täler-Halle, Dietfurt an der Altmühl, Bavaria, Germany
description: The 33rd 7-Täler-Lauf in Dietfurt an der Altmühl takes place on 11 July 2026. This traditional race is part of the BLSV Läufercup 2026. For the first time, participants can enter the Walking category. Also new is the Team-Fun Run, where teams of at least three people compete for prizes for the fastest team, coolest outfit and Lucky Loser. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with race-number pickup, changing rooms and showers at the 7-Täler-Halle, as well as medals for Bambini runners and awards for the best in each age group.
course_highlights: Run through seven valleys in the picturesque surroundings of Dietfurt
Walking category available for the first time
Team-Fun Run with special prizes for teams
additional: Late entries are possible on 11.07.2026 from 15:30 until one hour before the start at the 7-Täler-Halle; the late-entry fee is €5. Race-number pickup, changing rooms and showers are at the 7-Täler-Halle. Bambini runners receive a medal immediately after finishing. Team results are only available with a group registration. The race starts on 11 July 2026 at 16:00 and takes place at the sports field of the 7-Täler-Halle. No information is provided about prizes or registration.

name: LAUF10
description: LAUF10! is a training project by the Bavarian Athletics Association that gets people who are not keen on exercise ready to run 10 kilometres in ten weeks. The programme is for anyone who wants to go from zero to running 10 kilometres and has already inspired many thousands of participants. An official fan shirt is also available to order. LAUF10! promotes the joy of running and fitness in a supportive community.
course_highlights: 10-kilometre running distance
Ten-week training programme
Official performance shirt available as fan merchandise
additional: The official LAUF10! shirt (an ERIMA performance shirt) can be ordered for 24,90 euros plus shipping. Shipping will take place no earlier than the end of March. LAUF10! is a project of the Bavarian Athletics Association, with extensive partner associations and training programmes. Training starts on 27.04.2026; the final run takes place on 11.07.2026 in Wolnzach and is specially designed for beginners.

name: Sauerborner Laufabend
description: The Sauerborner Running Evening is an established running event in Bad Soden-Neuenhain, taking place on July 11, 2026. The races start and finish at the Sauerborn sports ground and follow a hilly course featuring paved country roads and surfaced forest paths. Two distances are offered, 5 km and 10 km, open to different age groups. The event is family-friendly and offers changing and shower facilities in the nearby sports hall.
course_highlights: Hilly course over paved country roads and surfaced forest paths
Start and finish at the Sauerborn sports ground
Course elevation profile available
additional: Late entries are accepted until 30 minutes before the start with no late-entry fee. Race-pack collection from 4 p.m. at the sports ground. Changing and shower facilities are available at the sports hall at Sauerborn. Parking at the sports ground is limited. Animals, scooters, inline skates, skateboards, bicycles, and Nordic walking poles are not permitted on the course. Participation is at your own risk. The course runs along paved country and forest roads; registration by July 9, 2025; parking is limited; changing rooms and showers are available; follow the safety rules.

name: Sidonia-Escape-Lauf
description: The “Sidonia 1639” Escape Walk is an exciting outdoor team event in Kelberg, ideal for friends, families, and birthday celebrations. Along a route of approximately 4 km through a nearby forest, participants help Sidonia in 1639, during the turmoil of the Thirty Years’ War, by following mysterious clues. The game lasts 2.5 to 3 hours and is suitable for participants aged 9 to 99. At seven puzzle locations, participants solve tricky challenges and experience a fascinating story full of secrets and adventure. The start and finish are at the family swimming pool in Kelberg. The game backpacks are handed out at the town hall.
course_highlights: Approx. 4 km adventure route through the forest
7 puzzle locations with mystical clues
Start and finish at the family swimming pool in Kelberg
additional: The game can be booked for teams of 2 to 8 people. Five puzzle backpacks are available and are handed out at staggered times to preserve the mystical atmosphere. Weather permitting, the event runs from March to October and requires sturdy footwear and suitable outdoor clothing. Hints and solutions are included in the backpack. The game is played at your own risk. Free parking is available at the town hall and swimming pool. The Escape Walk event runs from March to October, depending on the season and weather, and requires sturdy footwear. The running event takes place in July 2026; details about distances and registration are available on the race registration page.

name: Tanzenhaider Weiherlauf
price_range: Spende zugunsten der Kinder- und Jugendarbeit des SCO
description: The Tanzenhaider Weiherlauf is a traditional running event in Oberreichenbach, taking place on 11 July 2026. The course passes through picturesque landscapes featuring ponds, forests and historic paths, offering a varied run close to nature. There are races for participants of all ages, including a main race, youth and children’s races, and Nordic walking. In addition to the sporting challenge, the event offers Franconian specialties and a family-friendly atmosphere, with award ceremonies and on-site medical services.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Oberreichenbach sports clubhouse
The course passes the municipal pond and the picturesque hamlet of Tanzenhaid
Sections include forest paths, historic trade routes and several ponds
additional: Register by 13 June to receive a free T-shirt. Entry fees are charged by direct debit; refunds are available up to 2 weeks before the race. Late entries must be paid in cash and are subject to a late-entry fee. Food includes Franconian specialties and a salad buffet at the sports clubhouse. Medical services are provided by the BRK. Results and certificates are available online. Award ceremonies take place after the respective races. 10 km main race; online registration with direct debit; T-shirt included for registrations received by 13 June; water provided; illuminated race with effects; creative relay and costume awards

name: X-treme Battle Heroldstatt
description: The X-treme Battle Heroldstatt is a challenging obstacle race and trail run on the Swabian Alb that tests strength, endurance and willpower. Participants can choose between an obstacle race with exciting challenges and an adrenaline rush, or a varied cross-country run without obstacles over a 16 km course with around 350 metres of elevation gain. The course runs through the natural landscapes of the Swabian Alb, with beautiful scenery and small trails. A real highlight for endurance athletes and teams ready to battle together.
course_highlights: 16 km course with approx. 350 metres of elevation gain
Varied course with small trails and beautiful scenery
Top-class obstacle race with exciting challenges
additional: Start and race-pack collection at the Heroldstatt Sports Centre. Collection times: Friday 18:00–20:00, Saturday 12:00–14:00. Parking is in the Heroldstatt industrial area; access to the Sports Centre is closed during the event. Drinks and refreshments are provided. There is also a Kids Battle on Sunday, 12.07.2025 at 14:30. Course: 16 km with approx. 350 metres of elevation gain, obstacles, trails and scenery; start at the Heroldstatt Sports Centre; parking in the industrial area; race-pack collection on 10.07.2026 and 11.07.2026

name: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka
description: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka is a 10 km race held in Bukowiec, attracting runners eager to take on a course of moderate difficulty. Every participant who crosses the finish line will receive a commemorative medal. The race office is located in the sports hall in Bukowiec, making event logistics convenient. All running enthusiasts are invited to take part in this event, which combines sporting competition with a local atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 10 km course in Bukowiec
Race office in the sports hall in Bukowiec
A commemorative medal for every participant who finishes the race
additional: The race office is located in the sports hall in Bukowiec. Every runner who crosses the finish line receives a medal. A registration form is available, allowing you to contact the organizer and system administrator quickly. Registration takes place online, the event is local in nature, and results are available electronically.

name: VI Warmiński Bieg Uliczny
location: Reszel, Kętrzyn County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 6th Warmian Street Run in Reszel is an annual sporting event that attracts both recreational and experienced runners. The race takes place on the streets of Reszel, giving it a unique atmosphere and allowing participants to experience the city from a different perspective. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively, compete in sport, and meet fellow running enthusiasts. The organizers welcome everyone, regardless of ability level, highlighting the importance of exercise and positive energy.
course_highlights: The route runs through the streets of Reszel
A unique atmosphere for a city street race
An event for runners of all ability levels
additional: Registration is online at www.superczas.pl. The event is open to runners of all ability levels. No information is available about specific distances, start waves, or participant limits. Online registration at www.superczas.pl; time limits: 50 minutes for 5 km and 1 hour 30 minutes for 10 km; entry fee on the day of the event: 60 PLN; the event includes various distances and additional attractions.

name: X Świerczyniecki Bieg Uliczny
description: The 10th Świerczyniec Street Race for the Village Head’s Cup is an annual running event held in Świerczyniec. The race takes place on the town’s streets, with the start scheduled for 10:00. It is organized by the Świerczyniec Volunteer Fire Brigade, and timing is professionally provided using RFID technology. The race attracts both local runners and sports enthusiasts from nearby areas, offering exciting competition and a chance for the community to come together.
course_highlights: A street race in the picturesque village of Świerczyniec
Professional electronic RFID timing
Start at 10:00 on 11 July 2026
additional: The race is organized by the Świerczyniec Volunteer Fire Brigade. Registration closes on 10 July 2026 at 23:59. Timing is provided electronically using RFID technology. Live results are available at the finish, along with personalized certificates showing race times that can be downloaded from the website. The start is at 10:00, registration closes on 10 July 2026 at 23:59, and the event features two distances: 5 and 10 km.

Nízkotatranská stíhačka
description: The Low Tatras Chase (NTS) is an individual ultra-trail race with a main 98 km course from Telgárt to Donovaly via the main ridge of the Low Tatras, and a half-distance course finishing at Čertovica. The race is a qualifying event for the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc and is ITRA-certified. It is organised by the civic association Time Out - OZ in cooperation with STS HIKING and Slovak Ultratrail. NTS offers a challenging mountain course with beautiful views and challenges for experienced trail runners.
course_highlights: The 98.5 km main course follows the main ridge of the Low Tatras from Telgárt to Donovaly
The 49 km half-distance course finishes at the Čertovica mountain pass
Challenging mountain terrain with beautiful views and checkpoints
additional: Participant check-in takes place on Friday, 10 July 2026, from 18:00 to 22:00 at ZŠ Telgárt, where the briefing will also be held. The race starts on Saturday, 11 July 2026, at 06:00 in Telgárt. The organiser provides baggage transport (drop bags). The participant limit is 200. Qualification requirements must be met to enter the main course. Checkpoints and refreshments are provided during the race. NTS is part of Slovak Ultra Trail and is ITRA-certified. The race is intended for experienced ultramarathon runners, with online registration available subject to meeting the qualification criteria. The event also includes a shorter 49 km course, and takes place on 11 and 12 July 2026.

name: Rozbehni Majerovce
description: Rozbehni Majerovce is a running event held in the village of Majerovce, Vranov nad Topľou District, in front of the Municipal Office. The races offer categories for children and adults, with main races of 5 and 10 km. The children’s races start at 09:15 and the main race at 10:15. Organizer Martin Folenta and the Municipality of Majerovce warmly invite runners of all ages to enjoy a pleasant day of sport.
course_highlights: The races take place in the village of Majerovce, in front of the Municipal Office
The main adult race distances are 5 km and 10 km
Separate categories for children, with their own start
additional: The children’s races start at 09:15, and the main race begins at 10:15. Categories are divided by age and gender, including men and women in different age groups. On-site registration is available for a higher entry fee. The races start at 09:15 and 10:15; the course likely follows local roads, and registration is available online and on-site.

name: Beh Rajeckou dolinou KL Auto
location: Námestie SNP Rajecké Teplice, Rajecké Teplice, Slovakia
description: Beh Rajeckou dolinou KL Auto is a running event in the picturesque setting of the Rajec Valley, offering a mix of paved and dirt roads. The route runs mostly along dirt roads, with approximately 20% paved surfaces, creating an enjoyable and varied running experience. The event is known for its excellent organization and friendly atmosphere, attracting runners of all levels. The start is at SNP Square in Rajecké Teplice. The organizer is Ján Valúch Jr., who is available for information and support.
course_highlights: The route is 20% paved roads and 80% dirt roads
Start at SNP Square in Rajecké Teplice
Picturesque setting of the Rajec Valley
additional: The entry fee is €12 for online registration and €20 on site. The organizer is Ján Valúch Jr., who can be contacted by phone at 0904 255 310 or by email at valuch.jan@gmail.com. The event is part of a sports day in Rajecké Teplice, with a beautiful route and a great atmosphere.

name: Beh malý Caesar
location: Námestie SNP, Rajecké Teplice, Žilina, Slovakia
description: The St. Andrew’s Run and the Little Caesar Children’s Run are traditional events in Rajecké Teplice, bringing a sporting and family-friendly atmosphere to SNP Square. The St. Andrew’s Run is a 4.5 km road race with online registration, while the Little Caesar Children’s Run is for children aged 1 to 9 and is free of charge. The event also includes a competition for the most beautifully decorated children’s stroller, adding to the experience for participants and spectators alike. The event takes place in the afternoon, with check-in and the start on the square.
course_highlights: A 4.5 km road course for the St. Andrew’s Run
Children’s categories for ages 1–3, 4–6, and 7–9
A competition for the most beautifully decorated children’s stroller on the square
additional: Check-in for the St. Andrew’s Run is from 14:30 to 16:30, with the start at 17:00. Check-in for the Little Caesar Children’s Run starts at 14:00 in the lobby of the Municipal Office. Places in the children’s run are limited to 150. The event takes place at SNP Square in Rajecké Teplice. The children’s run is open to all age groups, registration is available online or on site, and the event is suitable for the whole family.

name: S-Race
location: Kolonáda Ferdinandova pramene, Mariánské Lázně, Karlovarský kraj, Czech Republic
description: S-Race is an OCR run in Mariánské Lázně, held in front of the Ferdinand Spring Colonnade. The race offers 6 km, 12 km and 18 km courses, which run mostly along paved forest paths and feature more than 20 obstacles per lap. Races adapted to different age groups are available for children. The start and finish are right by the colonnade, where facilities include changing rooms, toilets, a baggage storage area and refreshments. The race is suitable for a wide range of ages and features staggered starts, with activities for children during the main race.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly along paved forest paths
More than 20 obstacles on the 6 km lap, 40+ on the 12 km course, and 60+ on the 18 km course
Start and finish in front of the Ferdinand Spring Colonnade in Mariánské Lázně
additional: The main race starts at 120-second intervals, with five runners per start. The 18K course starts first, followed by the 12K and 6K courses. Registration and chip collection on race day are open from 8:00 to 9:15 for the main race and from 12:30 to 13:45 for the children’s race. Participants under 18 must have written consent from a legal guardian. Men’s and women’s changing rooms, toilets, baggage storage and refreshments are available. Activities for children are provided during the main race. The terrain includes paved forest paths and obstacles. The race is suitable for the general public, including younger participants born in 2011 or earlier, who need parental consent. The race takes place on 12 July 2026.

name: Koblížkový pasecký běh
location: Paseka u Olomouce, Olomouc District, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: The Koblížkový Pasecký Run is a traditional road race in Paseka near Olomouc, offering an 8.2 km course. The race runs on asphalt, paving stones and park paths, passing through the village, along the cycle path to the sanatorium and through the park of the Specialist Treatment Institute, before returning to the start at the municipal office. The first categories start in the afternoon, creating a pleasant atmosphere for runners and spectators alike. The organiser is Ivan Elischer, who ensures the event runs smoothly and supports the runners.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt, paving stones and park paths
It passes through Paseka and along the cycle path to the sanatorium
It includes the park of the Specialist Treatment Institute
additional: The race starts at the municipal office in Paseka. The course is suitable for running on asphalt, paving stones and park paths. The organiser is Ivan Elischer, who can be contacted for information. The race takes place on 12 July 2026; registration and further information are available on the official website. The event is open to the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.

name: Halda Trail Run
location: Kuřimská Nová Ves, Brno-Country District, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: HALDA TRAIL RUN is an off-road running adventure in Kuřimská Nová Ves, following the picturesque landscape of the Halda stream valley and the Libochovka River. The longest route is approximately 24 km and includes 23 stream crossings that are runnable and pleasantly refreshing in summer. The race offers three route distances (4, 14 and 24 km), which connect to one another and allow runners to change distance during the race. The route runs mostly through forests and meadows, away from the main hiking trails, with panoramic views, two short, steep climbs and varied terrain—something both recreational runners and ambitious trail runners will appreciate.
course_highlights: 23 ankle-deep stream crossings that are runnable and refreshing in summer
Panoramic views and two short, steep climbs with gradients of over 30%
The route runs mostly through forests and meadows, away from the main hiking trails
additional: The time limit for the longest route is 3 hours. The timing checkpoint at the start of the second lap (14.5 km) closes at 12:00; slower runners will be stopped and classified on the middle-distance route. The 4, 14 and 24 km routes connect to one another, and runners can change route distance during the race. The route surface combines challenging terrain (rocks and roots), easy terrain and asphalt. The route will be clearly marked with arrows and flagging tape. Trail, stream crossings, scenery, challenging terrain; registration details are not specified.

description: Běh letním ránem is a trail running race held in Štítná nad Vláří - Popov, offering two routes of approximately 7 and 15 km. The race traverses varied terrain, including asphalt, forest trails and hills, with beautiful views and challenging sections that test runners’ fitness. The start and finish are by the pub in Popov. The race has a friendly, family atmosphere, with an emphasis on participants’ safety and responsibility. It is part of the Běhy Zlín series and is organized by the Martinát family and their friends.
course_highlights: A trail race combining asphalt and forest trails
A challenging climb to the saddle below Hložecká Chapel
Beautiful views of Popov and the surrounding countryside
additional: Online registration is available until 2 business days before the race, and on-site registration is available until 9:30. Timing uses Race Result chip technology. Water and Kofola are available on the course; sweets, fruit and goulash for pre-registered participants are available at the finish. The start and finish are by the pub in Popov. Parking is by the bus stop, as directed by the organizer. Children under 15 must be accompanied by someone over 18; participants aged 15–18 may start with written consent from a parent or legal guardian. The race takes place on 12 July 2026, starts at 10:00, and registration closes 2 days before the race. Chip timing. Suitable for runners aged 15 and over.

name: Běh o Ludgerův meč
description: The Run for Ludger’s Sword is the third edition of a running race organized by Běžecký klub Náchod in cooperation with the municipality of Hořičky. The race is part of the Primátor CUP running series and the Velká cena východních Čech cup. The routes run around Hořičky, offering beautiful views of the Kladské pomezí, across gently rolling terrain with gravel and forest paths and very little asphalt. Courses are available for children, as well as an 8 km main race and a 4 km FIT course. The start and race check-in take place at the grounds by the football pitch in Hořičky.
course_highlights: 8 km main race on gently rolling terrain with gravel and forest paths
4 km FIT course with very little asphalt
Beautiful views of the Kladské pomezí
additional: Race check-in opens at 8:00 at the grounds by the football pitch in Hořičky. Check-in closes 30 minutes before each children’s category starts and at 10:00 for adults. Children’s races start between 9:00 and 9:35, according to age category. The main race and FIT course start at 10:30. The entry fee includes chip timing; homemade cakes, pastries, juice and tea are served at the finish. Parking is available by the football pitch; please follow the organizers’ instructions. Prizes are awarded to the fastest children, with medals and non-cash prizes in the adult categories. Cash prizes go to the first three men and women overall in the main race (600 Kč, 400 Kč, 200 Kč). Terrain: gently rolling, with gravel and forest paths and very little asphalt. Online registration via sportchallange.cz. The race includes medals and prizes and takes place at the grounds by the football pitch in Hořičky.

name: Dodenauer Volkslauf
organizer: Leichtathletik Gemeinschaft Eder (LG Eder) / TSV Dodenau

description: The Dodenau Volkslauf is a recreational running event open to everyone, starting and finishing at the Dodenau multi-purpose hall in Battenberg-Dodenau. The event offers a range of distances from Bambini races to a half marathon, as well as Nordic walking. To be included in the rankings, participants must belong to an athletics club or an LG. Online registration is available until about one week before the race; late registration is possible at the start.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Dodenau multi-purpose hall
Distances for Bambini, short, middle and long races, as well as a half marathon
Nordic walking over 5 km and 10 km
additional: Late registration at the start is possible from 07:45 until 45 minutes before the respective start. To be included in the rankings, participants must provide their club or LG on the registration form. Terrain: Dodenau multi-purpose hall, online registration, various running distances, Nordic walking

name: Monzinger Wingertslauf
description: The Monzinger Wingertslauf on 12 July 2026 offers two attractive running routes of 7.5 km and 15.5 km through the beautiful countryside around Monzingen. The routes run mostly along farm tracks and are undulating, with the longer route including a steep single-track section. Walkers are also welcome on the 7.5 km route, with the emphasis on enjoying the sport. The event is easy to reach by train, and the awards ceremony takes place at the clubhouse by the sports ground.
course_highlights: 7.5 km route with 145 m of elevation gain and a refreshment station at km 4
15.5 km route with 330 m of elevation gain, consisting of two laps, each with a steep single-track section approximately 250 m long
Routes are undulating and consist of 80% farm tracks
additional: Late registration is possible if all 150 places have not been filled, with a €1 late registration fee. The awards ceremony takes place at the clubhouse by the sports ground, approximately 500 m on foot from the start/finish. Parking is available at the sports ground. Wine gifts are awarded to the first three men and women in both races, along with vouchers for a pizza evening for new course records. Monzingen has a railway station, making it easy to travel by train. A ride-sharing service is offered. Refreshments are available at designated kilometres. The event is easy to reach by public transport. Sponsored by Lauf-Abenteuer Marathonreisen.

description: The 41st Pönitz Volkslauf takes place on 12 July 2026 in Pönitz and invites runners, walkers and Nordic walkers to a sporting and social event. The course runs through the scenic Holstein Switzerland, with romantic hedgerows, summer fields and peaceful meadows. Participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere, refreshments, show performances and an awards ceremony at the Pönitz Sports Park. All participants receive a commemorative medal, and attractive prizes are awarded to the winners.
course_highlights: Scenery of Holstein Switzerland, with hedgerows, fields and meadows
Start and finish at Pönitz Sports Park, with a summer atmosphere
Refreshments and show performances at the venue
additional: All participants receive a commemorative medal. The awards ceremony begins at 11:15, with medals for the overall winners (places 1–3) and trophies and certificates for age-group winners and finishers. Members of SVG Pönitz pay half the entry fee. The event offers refreshments, show performances and a friendly atmosphere for athletes, companions and spectators. Runners can choose between the half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and Nordic walking. Starts are from 8:30. A shared experience of community and nature.

name: 27. Gläserner Mönch Lauf
description: The Gläserner Mönch Run is a traditional trail race in the Harz foothills, returning after a seven-year break. The course is known for its undulating profile, with more than 100 metres of elevation gain per lap, and the legendary climb up 222 steps to the “Gläserner Mönch.” Participants can choose from various distances, from the Bambini Run to the 18 km Extreme Run, and experience unspoilt nature among rocks and forest. The event combines a sporting challenge with a love of the local area and takes place around the Landhotel Schäferhof in Halberstadt.
course_highlights: 222 steps to the “Gläserner Mönch”
Undulating profile with more than 100 metres of elevation gain per lap
Unspoilt nature among rocks, forest and cobblestones
additional: Start and finish at the Landhotel Schäferhof in Halberstadt OT Langenstein. Electronic timing with a transponder (€5 deposit). Late registrants do not receive the full race pack. Awards ceremony from approximately 12:15 p.m.; children’s races immediately afterwards. Minimum age and participation requirements apply. Limited places available; various race distances; nature trail with elevation gain.

name: 8. Barigauer Turmlauf
description: The Barigauer Turmlauf is a traditional race in Oberhain near Königsee, taking place on 12 July 2026. The event offers runners an attractive course with scenic sections around the Barigauer Tower. The race is aimed at ambitious runners and running enthusiasts looking for a sporting challenge in a natural setting. It is organized by Laufverein Königsee, which ensures a friendly atmosphere and smooth event.
course_highlights: Scenic course around the Barigauer Tower
Natural running trails in Oberhain (Königsee)
Traditional race with a friendly atmosphere

name: BÄRENFELS SOMMERTRAIL 63-KM mit MARATHON, HALBMARATHON und 11-KM
description: The BÄRENFELS SOMMER-TRAIL on July 12, 2026, offers an unforgettable trail experience in the pristine natural surroundings of Saarland-Hunsrück-Hochwald National Park. The event features four distances from 11 km to 63 km, with challenging elevation gains, on a wild and romantic circular trail route around Bärenfels. Runners and walkers can enjoy the varied landscape of the Nahesteig and look forward to a sporting adventure in a unique natural setting.
course_highlights: Wild and romantic circular trail route along the Nahesteig
Elevation gains from 350 to 1800, depending on the distance
A nature experience in Saarland-Hunsrück-Hochwald National Park
additional: Early start for walkers at 07:00. Cutoff for the 42 km and 63 km distances at 20:00. On-site late registration available for a €5 fee. Registration is online via a form, followed by a bank transfer of the event fee (IBAN provided after registration). Information via WhatsApp at 0151-111-988-00. Trail and nature run in Saarland/Pfalz National Park, online registration, start times at 09:00, early start for walkers at 07:00.

name: Dinkelsbühler Staffellauf
description: The Dinkelsbühl relay race takes place on 12 July 2026 in the historic old town of Dinkelsbühl. Each relay team consists of four runners, each completing a lap of approximately 3 kilometres around the old town. The course passes sights including the Alte Promenade, Wörnitztor, Stadtpark and Musik-Pavillon, accompanied by an inclusive drumming group. Children can take part in the Funtasia Kids-Run, with age-appropriate courses. Alongside the sporting competition, the event offers a varied programme featuring music, a bouncy castle and refreshments.
course_highlights: A lap of approximately 3 km around the historic old town
Passes Wörnitztor and Stadtpark, with the Musik-Pavillon
Children’s courses of 700 m and 1,200 m on laps with good visibility
additional: Start and finish are at the Dreifachturnhalle, Ulmer Weg 6, Dinkelsbühl. Race pack collection and late registration from 08:45. Announcements and DJ music from 09:00. Children’s warm-up before the Kids-Runs. Awards ceremony and raffle after the relay race. The course is marked with arrows and easy for spectators to see. The children’s programme includes a bouncy castle, free ice cream, coffee and cake, and food and drinks. The relay course was changed in 2025 and includes a sharp right-hand turn at its highest point. Course: approximately 3 km lap; registration, awards ceremony, raffle and refreshments; relay baton handover; start at the Dreifachturnhalle, Ulmer Weg 6.

name: int. Rosskopflauf
location: Heuweiler, Freiburg im Breisgau, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The 21st Rosskopflauf on 12 July 2026 in Heuweiler offers varied running routes, from 450 metres for Bambini to the challenging 18.4 km Roßkopflauf with 560 metres of elevation gain. There is also the 10 km Wildtalereck Run, walking routes, and races for schoolchildren and young people. The event is part of the Schwarzwald-Berglauf-Pokal and the Schwarzwald-Laufcup, and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and dedicated care for children and young people.
course_highlights: 18.4 km Roßkopflauf with 560 metres of elevation gain
10 km Wildtalereck Run
Routes from 450 m for Bambini to youth and walking routes
additional: Prizes are awarded to the top three overall finishers in the Rosskopflauf, Wildtalereck Run and Laufcup. Children and young people also receive prizes for places 1–3. Adults forgo prizes in kind in favour of a good cause. Childcare and youth activities, including a sports programme, are available during the summer holidays. The race takes place in July, when the weather is typically warm and sunny. There are various distances, including competitions for children and young people, and accommodation near the start/finish area. Registration is available via the website.

name: Kappelseelauf Rentweinsdorf
description: The Kappelseelauf in Rentweinsdorf is a popular running event held annually since 2008 and has become a regular fixture for recreational runners. The event offers a varied program for all age and ability groups, from Bambini and schoolchildren’s races to Nordic walking and a half marathon. The varied routes pass through idyllic natural surroundings around Lake Kappel, along the Hutseedamm with views of the castle, and through Rentweinsdorf Main Forest and Eichelberg. Refreshments including drinks, fruit, cake and bratwurst are provided along the route and at the finish.
course_highlights: Routes around Lake Kappel and along the Hutseedamm, with views of the Rotenhan family castle
Attractive running routes through Rentweinsdorf Main Forest and Eichelberg
Idyllic natural surroundings with varied and scenic courses
additional: Race number collection and late registration on 11.07.2025 from 18:00 to 20:00 at the sports clubhouse, and on race day from 07:30. The late registration fee on race day is €3. Parking is signposted directly at the sports grounds. Showers and changing rooms are available at the sports grounds. All participants receive a voucher for a drink. Bambini and schoolchildren’s runners receive a medal. Awards ceremonies take place shortly after each race. Races for all age and ability groups; refreshments and drinks at the finish; race number collection on 11.07.2026 and 12.07.2026; parking at the sports grounds; showers and changing rooms available; cancellation possible depending on the weather.

name: Nußlocher Wiesenlauf
description: The Nußloch Wiesenlauf is a traditional running event in Nußloch, held annually at Max-Berk-Stadion and in the surrounding area. The event offers 5.3 km and 10 km races on loop courses over asphalt and forest trails. The 10 km course is measured and officially certified in accordance with DLV regulations, making the race particularly appealing to ambitious runners. The event is well organized and hosted by SG Nußloch Athletics, which also handles online registration and participant support.
course_highlights: 5.3 km and 10 km loop courses
Routes over asphalt and forest trails
10 km course measured and officially certified in accordance with DLV regulations
additional: Online registration is available from 17.05. to 11.07., 22:00 via raceresult.com. The venue is Max-Berk-Stadion, Rudolf-Harbig-Straße 2, 69226 Nußloch. Race distances are 5 km and 10 km; online registration opens on 17.05. Race numbers are available at Marathonshop Wiesloch. Includes course map, results and photos.

name: Ranntallauf
location: Vereinsgelände des TV Nöttingen, Nöttingen, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Ranntallauf takes place on 12 July 2026 at the TV Nöttingen club grounds. The event offers a 5 km course for runners and Nordic walkers. Afterwards, all participants and visitors are invited to enjoy lunch together and a lively family afternoon with grilled food. The event is a great opportunity for sports enthusiasts and families to spend an active and sociable day together.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the TV Nöttingen club grounds
5 km run and 5 km Nordic walking course
Family-friendly programme with lunch and entertainment
additional: Late entries are possible at the venue on the day of the event until 9 a.m. The 5 km run and Nordic walking start at 09:35. After the event, there will be lunch together and a lively afternoon programme for the whole family. Start at the club grounds; advance registration from 15.04. to 09.07.2026; late entries at the venue until 9 a.m. (entry fee + €2).

The routes pass through urban sections, along the Rur, and through green park areas, with the start and finish centrally located at the Market Square. A particular highlight is the First or Burst elimination race on a 500-meter loop. All participants receive an official MIZUNO participant shirt, a finisher medal, and access to refreshments at the finish.
course_highlights: 5 km run: flat, varied route through the city center and along the Rur
10 km run: large city loop with lively downtown sections and scenic stretches
First or Burst: elimination race on a 500 m loop in the city center
additional: The official MIZUNO participant shirt is mandatory and serves as authorization to start. Electronic timing with an online certificate. Finish-line refreshments at Kaiserplatz for all finishers. The children's race is free and includes a Kids Activity Area with various stations. Awards ceremonies take place at the Market Square immediately after the events. City-center routes include the children's race, 5 km, 10 km, and First or Burst; registration includes a T-shirt, goodies, electronic timing, a certificate, and refreshments; the event at the Market Square features awards ceremonies and partner activities.

description: The Steinenberger Waldlauf is a traditional running event set in picturesque woodland near Rudersberg. It offers a range of distances, from a 2 km race for schoolchildren to a half marathon, suitable for competitive runners, families, and beginners alike. The event features challenging, varied courses with some hilly terrain and is designed as a family-friendly summer sporting event. Each participant also supports local clubs and institutions with a donation.
course_highlights: A range of distances from 2 km to a half marathon
Woodland and nature trails with some challenging elevation gain
Family-friendly sporting event with children's races and a team competition
additional: The races start in staggered waves, with the main races at 9:00 a.m., followed by Nordic walking and children's races. A new 5 km fun run with less elevation gain is available for young people aged 16 and over. €1.00 per participant is donated to local clubs and institutions. The 2 km schoolchildren's race is free, but registration is required. The event is designed as a family festival with sporting activities for all age groups. Multiple race distances, charity fundraising, family activities, online registration available.

name: Vierländer-Eck Lauf
location: Sportgelände VfB Bösingen, Bösingen, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Vierländereck Run in Bösingen is a running event featuring a main race, a middle-distance race and a children’s race, taking place on 12 July 2026. The route starts at the VfB Bösingen sports grounds, passes the Vierländereck and runs through the Waldmössingen and Seedorf districts before returning. The course is hilly and alternates between asphalt and gravel paths. Refreshments are available along the route and in the finish area, and participants can shower at the sports club building. The awards ceremony takes place there after the races.
course_highlights: Hilly course with asphalt and gravel paths
Route passes the Vierländereck
Start and finish at the VfB Bösingen sports grounds
additional: Refreshments are available along the route for main-race participants and in the finish area for all races. Every children’s race participant receives a medal. Showers are available at the sports club building. Late entries are accepted up to 30 minutes before the start for an additional fee of €3. Parking is available around the sports grounds. The awards ceremony takes place at the sports club building. Registration is open until 09.07.2026; late entries are accepted up to 30 minutes before the start. Refreshments, showers at the sports club building, awards ceremony at the sports club building and parking are available.

name: Bajoro 26
description: Bajoro 26 is a 10 km race taking place on 12 July 2026 in Starogard Gdański. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for race day with dedicated training plans tailored to different ability levels. The organizers offer expert support and detailed training instructions, making the event appealing to both beginners and more experienced runners. Bajoro 26 is a moderately challenging event on a paved surface, ideal for improving your fitness and competing in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km distance on a paved surface
Moderately challenging course
Scenic surroundings of Starogard Gdański
additional: Training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks are available and tailored to the runner’s VDOT level. The organizer provides expert support and detailed training instructions. Organizers can use a platform to manage the race listing and collaborate on marketing. The event is planned for summer 2026 and is aimed at runners of different age groups and ability levels, with the option to take part in the 10 km race.

name: II Galicyjska 10
description: The 2nd Galician 10K of the Podkarpackie Regional Chamber of Civil Engineers is a sporting event bringing Chamber members and their families together. It will take place on July 12, 2026, in Urzejowice, in the park by the stadium. The event includes a 10 km run, a 7 km Nordic Walking march, and children’s races in various age categories. It’s a great opportunity to spend active family time outdoors, promote a healthy lifestyle, and bring the civil engineering community together. Participants can look forward to a sporty atmosphere and fun at the finish line.
course_highlights: 10 km run
7 km Nordic Walking march
Children’s races in various age categories
additional: The event is open to active Chamber members and their families. In addition to the run and Nordic Walking march, children’s races are held in various age categories. The event promotes integration and a healthy lifestyle. The detailed programme and registration form will be published soon. The start and finish are in the park by the stadium in Urzejowice. name: Malý Štrbský maratón
organizer: Obec Štrba, Obec Liptovská Teplička, Športový klub Štrba
price_range: 20,- € to 25,- € depending on registration date, free for some categories
description: The Malý Štrbský Marathon is a traditional running race held every year on the second Sunday in July in the village of Štrba beneath the Tatras. Runners can choose between two main distances—31 km and 10 km—on an asphalt road between Štrba and Liptovská Teplička. The event is part of the Tatry v pohybe project and attracts runners from several countries. The atmosphere in the square in front of the Cultural Centre is always lively and full of sporting spirit. The organisers are the Municipality of Štrba, the Municipality of Liptovská Teplička and Športový klub Štrba.
course_highlights: 31 km route on a third-class asphalt road from Štrba to Liptovská Teplička and back
Refreshment stations at kilometres 8, 12, 16, 20, 25 and 28
10 km route, introduced in 2021
additional: The total participant limit is 500, with priority given to the 31 km race (limit of 200) and the 10 km race (limit of 300). The race takes place without road closures, so extra caution is required. Medical services are provided by Tatranská horská služba, NsP Poprad and the local Red Cross. Runners take part at their own risk. The organiser provides transport from selected train services from Tatranská Štrba. The event includes 48 km, 10 km and children’s races; it is part of the East Slovak Youth Running League; registration has set deadlines and age categories; Nordic Walking is also part of the event.

description: Dvě kola při zdi is a traditional cross-country race in Prague’s Hvězda Game Reserve, offering courses for men, women, and children. Men run the main 7.8 km course along the reserve’s perimeter walls. Women have a shorter 4 km course, but may also run the men’s course. Two shorter loops are prepared for children. After the race, participants can enjoy a raffle and hearty refreshments.
course_highlights: The course runs along the perimeter walls of Hvězda Game Reserve
The main men’s course is 7.8 km long, with approximately 120 m of total elevation gain
The women’s course is 4 km long, with approximately 60 m of elevation gain; women may also run the men’s course
additional: On-site registration is available from 16:30 to 18:00 (for children, from 16:00 to 16:30). Runners receive an electronic chip for accurate timekeeping. The start and finish are in Hvězda Game Reserve, by the main entrance from Vypich. Hearty refreshments are available, including soft drinks, beer, and bread with English bacon. A raffle with prizes takes place after the race. Portable toilets are available. The race offers refreshments, electronic timekeeping, a raffle with prizes, and various age categories, including children.

name: Halda
description: HALDA TRAIL RUN is an off-road running adventure through the beautiful landscape of the Halda stream valley and the Libochovka River. It offers three connected routes of 4, 14 and 24 kilometres, allowing runners to change distance during the race. The route runs mostly through forests and meadows, away from the main hiking trails, and features 23 stream crossings, two short, steep climbs and panoramic views. The race is suitable for both relaxed runners and ambitious trail runners, and is clearly marked with arrows and ribbons.
course_highlights: 23 ankle-deep stream crossings that are runnable and refreshing in summer
Panoramic views and two short, steep climbs with gradients of over 30%
The route runs mostly through forests and meadows, away from the main hiking trails
additional: The time limit for the longest route is 3 hours. At the start of the second lap (14.5 km), the time checkpoint closes at 12:00; slower runners will be stopped and classified on the middle-distance route. The route combines challenging terrain (rocks and roots), easy terrain and asphalt. Runners may switch to a shorter route during the race. Routes: 4 km, 14 km, 24 km; trail terrain, brooks, scenic views, 3-hour time limit.

name: REWAG-Firmenlauf

description: The REWAG Company Run on 15 July 2026 is one of the largest running events in the Regensburg region, offering a unique opportunity to run, socialise and celebrate with colleagues in a relaxed atmosphere. The event is limited to 3,000 participants and attracts numerous companies and runners. Alongside the sporting experience, the run supports Jumpakids, the Regensburg Centre for Obesity in Children and Adolescents, with a donation. Registration opens on 1 May 2026, with individual and group entries available.
course_highlights: A major company running event with 3,000 places
Run and celebrate together in a relaxed atmosphere
Support for the Jumpakids social project
additional: Registration opens on 1 May 2026 at 9 a.m. Group registration is available and makes team scoring easier. Changes and reservations are possible until 6 July 2026. Transfers after registration closes are only possible on site for a fee of 5 euros. Start at the Stadtwerk.Donau-Arena; registration opens on 1 May 2026; start time is 6 p.m.; participation requires registration and payment; limit of 3,000 runners

name: SUNSET Hamburg 2026
description: Altra Sunset Hamburg takes place on Wednesday, July 15, 2026, at Wilhelmsburger Inselpark. The race features a scenic loop of approximately 5 km on asphalt and paths, which can be run 1 to 3 times, allowing distances of approximately 5 km, 10 km, or 15 km. Participants can choose their preferred number of laps flexibly on race day, with a checkpoint counting the laps. There is also a relay, in which the course is run four times, with teams of 2 to 4 runners. The event is open to anyone who is fit and has no medical concerns; club membership is not required.
course_highlights: Approximately 5 km loop in Wilhelmsburger Inselpark
Asphalt and paths underfoot
Checkpoint on the course to count laps
additional: Race packet distribution starts at 17:30. The finish closes at 21:30; sunset is at 21:41. The race distance can be chosen flexibly on race day. Relay teams consist of 2 to 4 runners; team members do not need to be named in advance. Eligibility by year of birth: 5 km from 2016, 10 km from 2012, 15 km from 2010. The race takes place at Wilhelmsburger Inselpark. Online registration is available. Depending on the number of laps, the course distance is 5 km, 10 km, or 15 km, with a checkpoint to count laps.

name: Lauf um und am Gartower See
location: Nordufer des Gartower Sees, Gartow, Lüchow-Dannenberg, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The run around and along Gartow Lake is a traditional running event held on the lake’s north shore in Gartow. The course offers a natural setting with views of the lake and the surrounding Gartower Tannen, making it ideal for runners of all ages. The event is organized by the SV Gartow sports club, which has supported sporting activities and community in the region since 1946. The start and finish are centrally located in town, creating a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Scenic course along Gartow Lake
Start and finish in the heart of Gartow
Run through the Gartower Tannen and the idyllic Elbe River valley
additional: SV Gartow is a long-established club with more than 600 members, offering a wide range of sports and regularly hosting events that attract participants from beyond the region. The running event is part of a vibrant sports community supported by volunteers. There are no fixed triathlon training times, but participants arrange individual meetups and take part in competitions. The event takes place in a scenic setting that also offers opportunities to relax and enjoy nature. It includes races for children, young people, adults, and seniors, with start times from 19:00. It is a great opportunity to experience nature and take part in sport.

name: Běh o Neplachovský Hrneček
description: The Neplachov Mug Run is a traditional running race held in Neplachov, South Bohemia. Its 14th edition takes place on Friday, July 17, 2026. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and is supported by the South Bohemian Region’s budget. The event offers a sporting experience in the region’s beautiful surroundings and attracts runners from the wider area. The organizers warmly invite all runners to take part in this popular event.
course_highlights: 10 km course with paved and natural-surface sections
Includes various age categories, including children
Part of the South Bohemian Running Cup
additional: The course consists of two 5 km loops. Registration is available through the website, and results are published online. The run is supported by the South Bohemian Region.

name: Kružberský Tesák
location: Kružberský přehradní areál, u přehrady Kružberk, Kružberk, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Kružberský Tesák is a sporting event held at the Kružberk Dam grounds, offering courses and categories for experienced runners, intermediate participants, and complete beginners. The race is suitable for solo runners, walkers, and families with children. The event also includes Pejskiáda, a fun dog show and competitions for dogs of all sizes and breeds. Organizers Kateřina and Lucie, nature lovers and fans of sports with dogs, aim to create a friendly atmosphere and make the event enjoyable for everyone.
course_highlights: Courses suitable for runners of all levels, from beginners to experienced athletes
The area around Kružberk Dam, with beautiful natural scenery and views
Pejskiáda, featuring a dog show and competitions for dogs of all breeds and sizes
additional: Registration opens in May 2026. After submitting the entry form, you will be sent a variable payment reference for paying the entry fee to the organizer’s account. Payment must be made as soon as possible after registration. The event also includes dog competitions and shows, and is suitable for families with children and dog lovers. A two-day event with the option of camping in tents, competitions, and a traveling trophy for the winner.

name: Kölner Zoolauf
description: The Cologne Zoo Run is a unique running event at Cologne Zoo, taking place for the 13th time on July 17, 2026. It offers four different races for all age groups, from Bambini and children’s races to challenging 10 km races. The course runs through the zoo and past numerous animal enclosures, making the run a special experience. Official timing and certificates are included for most races, and the event places great emphasis on safety and family-friendliness.
course_highlights: A 1.62 km loop through Cologne Zoo, with views of numerous animal enclosures
Choose to run between 1 and 6 laps (1.6 km to 10.05 km)
Start and finish in front of the main entrance to Cologne Zoo
additional: Start times: BambiniLauf 18:15, KidsLauf 18:30, TopLauf 19:00, FunLauf 20:15. A requested bib number is available for an additional €3. On-site late registration is possible up to and including event day, with a €5 late-registration fee. Participation with dogs, strollers, walking poles, or music devices is not permitted. Official timing is provided for all races except the BambiniLauf. Certificates can be printed online. Safety and supervision of children in the start and finish areas are organized. Four race types (Bambini, Kids, Top, Fun); online registration; no refunds for non-participation; participation requires a bib number and timing chip; participation with dogs or headphones is not permitted.

name: Schwanberglauf Iphofen-Castell
description: The Schwanberglauf is a traditional 10.4-kilometre race from Iphofen to Castell, taking place for the 42nd time on July 17, 2026. The course combines challenging climbs through vineyards and stretches through woodland with an idyllic finish in Castell Castle Park, accompanied by a wine-festival atmosphere. The event is open to runners and walkers of all ability levels, and its proceeds support social institutions. It is organised by volunteers from TG Kitzingen in collaboration with the SBL team.
course_highlights: Start at the Rödelseer Tor in Iphofen, followed by a steep climb through vineyards
Water stations at kilometres 3 and 6.5, and shortly before kilometre 7
Finish in Castell Castle Park with a wine-festival atmosphere
additional: Race-bib collection from 15:30 at the Karl-Knauf-Halle in Iphofen. Start groups are arranged according to your own 10-kilometre race time. Toilets are available at the Karl-Knauf-Halle. Free bus transfer from the finish in Castell back to the start in Iphofen (departures from 16:50 to 17:45, approximately every 10 minutes). Luggage transport by VW van. Medical services provided by the Bavarian Red Cross. Showers are available in Castell (men at the Meierei, women at the sports club). Every finisher receives a bottle of mineral water from Franken Brunnen. Course: 10.4 km; start in Iphofen, finish in Castell; refreshments along the course; showers in Castell; electronic timing; awards ceremony at the wine festival; online registration; overnight accommodation in Iphofen is recommended.

name: Freiberger Bürgerfestlauf
description: The Freiberger Bürgerfestlauf is one of Germany’s largest Bürgerfest running events and takes place on July 17, 2026, in Freiberg. More than 1,600 runners take part across four different distances, from 600 meters to 10 kilometers. The event has a high finisher rate of over 95% and is followed by a Bürgerfest with live music in the market square. The start and finish are in the center of Freiberg, creating a lively, community atmosphere.
course_highlights: Four distances: 600m Bambini Run, 1km Student Run, 5km Health Run, 10km OptiMove Run
Start and finish at Marktplatz Freiberg a.N.
Timing with a single-use transponder and a cutoff time of 1:20 hours for the 10km distance
additional: Race packet pickup and on-site registration at PRISMA on the market square on July 16 from 17:00 to 19:00 and on July 17 from 15:00. Awards ceremony from approximately 20:00 on the Seebühne. Changing facilities and showers at the Stadthalle and indoor swimming pool. Parking at the Wasen Sports Center (5–10 minutes on foot). Drinks provided during the race and from 18:00 as part of the Bürgerfest by local clubs. Online registration available; open to all age groups, with a festive program featuring music.
