description: Leśna Eko Piątka is a race held in Piekary Śląskie that promotes the city and supports social integration and efforts to prevent addiction among children and young people. The route follows paved and gravel roads through Dioblina Forest, with the start and finish at the MOSiR stadium at 3 Olimpijska Street. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Piekary Śląskie. Participants receive a race pack with a bib, timekeeping, a medal and medical care. The time limit is 45 minutes, and the participant limit is 500.
course_highlights: The route follows paved and gravel roads through Dioblina Forest
Start and finish at the MOSiR stadium at 3 Olimpijska Street
Course checkpoints and a 45-minute time limit
additional: The race office will be open on 17 July 2026 from 16:00 to 18:30 at 3 Olimpijska Street. Changing rooms, baggage storage and toilets are available near the race office. The race pack includes a race bib, electronic timekeeping, a medal, medical care, surprises and access to baggage storage. A T-shirt can be purchased separately for an additional fee of 70 zł until 18.06.2026. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity and integration within the local community. The participant limit is 500, and fees can be paid online or in cash. Race packs include, among other things, T-shirts, making them attractive to participants.

name: Night Run Gdynia
description: Night Run Gdynia is a 5-kilometre night race held on the Baltic Sea coast as part of the IRONMAN Poland triathlon weekends. After dark, as city lights reflect off the asphalt and water, hundreds of runners set off on a spectacular route through the streets of Gdynia. The event has become an important and eagerly anticipated part of the city’s sporting calendar, combining competition with the unique atmosphere of a night run.
course_highlights: A 5 km route along the Baltic Sea coast
A night race with striking city lights reflected on the asphalt and water
An event held as part of the IRONMAN Poland triathlon weekends
additional: The race is held as part of the IRONMAN Poland triathlon weekends in Gdynia, Warsaw and Poznań. It attracts hundreds of runners and is a regular feature of these sporting events. Seaside route, limit of 1,500 participants, entry fees in tiers of 60 zł, 75 zł, 90 zł and 100 zł.

name: Zkus Noční Kuks
location: Kuks, Trutnov District, Hradec Králové Region, Czech Republic
description: Zkus Noční Kuks is a night running race in the picturesque Baroque setting of Kuks. It offers two routes—10 km and 5 km—that pass historic landmarks such as Braun’s Nativity Scene and Kuks Hospital. Running in the dark, lit only by headlamps, offers a unique experience and an atmosphere that runners will remember for a long time. The 10 km route includes the 21st Century Stations of the Cross pilgrimage route, while the shorter 5 km route follows the Elbe at night and the Count’s Avenue, lined with 222 trees.
course_highlights: The 10 km route leads through the magical heart of the Baroque landscape, past Braun’s Nativity Scene and the 21st Century Stations of the Cross
The 5 km route starts at the hospital and runs along the Elbe at night and the Count’s Avenue, lined with 222 trees
A night run illuminated by headlamps, with an unforgettable atmosphere beneath the illuminated façade of Kuks Hospital
additional: The entry fee includes a race bib and chip. Entry can also be purchased as a gift voucher with a unique code. Registration takes place online via myresult.cz; the contractual relationship begins upon payment of the entry fee. The race is organized by TURN ON EVENTS s.r.o. from Hradec Králové. The race offers 5 km and 10 km routes, the option to run with a headlamp, refreshments during and after the race, and dogs are allowed. Registration is available via the website; the entry fee is payable within 14 days of registration.

name: ČEZ RunTour Olomouc
location: Smetanovy sady, Olomouc, Olomouc District, Czech Republic
description: ČEZ RunTour Olomouc is a family-friendly running event offering 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km races for recreational and elite runners, as well as children’s races of 500 and 1,000 metres. The event takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Smetana Gardens and is part of a nationwide series featuring unique courses. The organisers focus on excellent service, safety and fun for the whole family, including a programme of activities and a charitable element. Every participant receives a race pack and can look forward to refreshments and support from the pacer team. ČEZ RunTour is not only a sporting event, but also a full-day experience for all ages.
course_highlights: 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km races, plus children’s races of 500 and 1,000 m
Start and finish in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc
A programme of activities and a charitable element
additional: The event offers 2 x 5 km and 4 x 2.5 km relay races as part of the 10 km race. The pacer team helps runners achieve their target time. There are refreshment stations on the course, including at least two on the half marathon. Children receive a race pack and can enjoy activities in the children’s zone. A dedicated emergency medical service phone line is also available during the race. The event includes various race distances, family activities, charitable support, medals, photos and facilities for runners. The start and finish are in Smetana Gardens, and capacity is approximately 1,700 runners.

description: Noční běh Rusava is an unforgettable night race in the Hostýnské Mountains, offering a 12-hour run on a single loop as well as a 5 km race. The event is suitable for both individuals and relay teams, and participants are not required to run for the full 12 hours. Race facilities include a gymnasium for resting, an all-night buffet, and aid stations. The event takes place in the scenic surroundings of the ski slope and forests around Rusava, offering a unique sporting experience beneath the starry sky.
course_highlights: A night run on the ski slope and through the forests of the Hostýnské Mountains
A single 5 km loop that can be repeated for 12 hours
All-night aid stations and facilities at the local school
additional: Race facilities include a gymnasium at the local school for resting, where participants can bring sleeping bags and sleeping mats. A buffet and aid stations serving drinks, fruit, and food are open throughout the night. Parking is available in designated areas in the village. You do not have to run for the full 12 hours; you can also walk with poles. A belt for attaching the race bib is available for 150 Kč. Terrain: forests and ski slope; registration; relay system; environmental requirements for cups; refreshments throughout the night.

name: 7 pohoří Krušné Hory
description: The Krušné hory 2026 race is a technical trail run that takes you through the beauty of the Krušné Mountains and a former mining landscape listed by UNESCO. The route starts in Abertamy and passes the former Eva mine, Jelení, Švýcarská chata on Plešivec, Merklín, the former settlement of Kaff, Pstruží and the ski area before reaching the finish. It offers three courses of varying lengths and elevation gains, suitable for both experienced runners and beginners. The race takes place in all weather conditions, and participants receive a commemorative medal and refreshments on the course and at the finish.
course_highlights: A scenic route through the Krušné Mountains and UNESCO-listed mining landscape
Main course: 22 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain
Alternative courses: 13 km and 8 km with 510 m and 220 m of elevation gain
additional: The race has a time limit of 4 hours; after this time, a runner is marked DNF. Participants can store small items at the registration tent. Recommended equipment includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Záchranka app. The entry fee includes a professionally marked course, race bib, chip timing, a commemorative medal, and refreshments on the course and at the finish. The event takes place in all weather conditions, and participation is at your own risk. The entry fee includes the course, medal, refreshments, facilities, and recommended equipment, including a windbreaker and a mobile phone with the Záchranka app. The race is organized by a local mountain rescue team.

name: Rokytnice nad Jizerou - Dvoračky
location: Dvorská bouda, Rokytnice nad Jizerou, Krkonoše, Czech Republic
description: The route from Rokytnice nad Jizerou to Dvoračky is a popular hiking trail in the western Krkonoše Mountains. It starts at Horní náměstí in Rokytnice. Marked blue, the trail follows the Huťský stream to the picturesque Huťský Waterfall and continues to the Dvoračky mountain lodge, known for its history and traditional cheese-making. The route offers beautiful natural scenery, especially in autumn, when the surrounding beech forests are ablaze with colour. It is suitable for hikers, ski mountaineers and cross-country skiers, who can enjoy the snowy landscape and refreshments at the Štumpovka restaurant in Dvoračky.
course_highlights: Blue-marked trail following the Huťský stream
Huťský Waterfall, surrounded by beech forests with beautiful autumn colours
Historic Dvoračky mountain lodge, known for traditional cheese-making
additional: Parking is available at the Tesco car park on Dolní náměstí in Rokytnice. Refreshments are available at the Štumpovka restaurant in Dvoračky and the U Vocta pub in Rokytnice. The route is also suitable for winter hiking, ski mountaineering and cross-country skiing. Please respect the groomed ski tracks and do not enter them. The race is part of the local sports calendar, with several distances available, including an uphill race to Dvoračky. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and offers beautiful views and a rewarding sporting experience.

name: OYLER Berglauf
description: The 27th Oyler Berglauf takes place on July 18, 2026, as part of Sports Promotion Week in Marklohe. Organized by Jugendgemeinschaft Oyle, the race offers a sporting challenge on Oyler Berg. The event is part of a varied sports program and is aimed at runners looking to experience a hilly course in a friendly club atmosphere. The exact route and further details can be found on the organizer’s website.
course_highlights: Race on Oyler Berg
Venue: Sportplatz Oyle
Part of Sports Promotion Week 2026
additional: The Oyler Berglauf is part of Sports Promotion Week 2026, which takes place from 18.07.2026 to 26.07.2026 at Sportplatz Oyle. The organizer is Jugendgemeinschaft Oyle von 1953 e.V. No pricing or registration details, start times, or wave information have been published on the website. The event is part of Sports Promotion Week 2026 and takes place at Sportplatz Oyle; no specific registration information is available.

name: 1. Stoppelfeld Ultra

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Stoppelfeld Ultra 2026 is a classic Backyard Ultra race taking place on July 18 and 19, 2026, in Kerpen-Blatzheim. This unique endurance format is not about speed, but about completing a 6.706-kilometre lap within 60 minutes every hour and starting again promptly on the hour. The course runs mainly along field and farm tracks around Blatzheim, starting and finishing at the Blatzheim sports field. The event is limited to 50 participants and promises a family-friendly atmosphere as well as a major mental and physical challenge.
course_highlights: An exact 6.706-kilometre loop
Course along field and farm tracks around Blatzheim
Start and finish area at the Blatzheim sports field
additional: Each new lap starts promptly on the hour. Anyone who does not finish a lap in time or fails to show up for the next start on time is eliminated. Any time remaining in the hour after finishing may be used freely for recovery, refreshments or short breaks. The maximum number of participants is limited to 50 to ensure a family-friendly atmosphere. Registration is online only and is binding only after payment. Participation is at your own risk; good health is required. The course runs along field and farm tracks, with the start and finish area at the sports field. A maximum of 50 participants; the event continues until the 30th lap is reached or a participant is unable to continue.

name: 22. Wiesenlauf
description: The 22nd Wiesenlauf on July 18, 2026, in Klein Meckelsen offers runners the opportunity to compete on officially measured and DLV-approved 5 km and 10 km courses. The event includes district championships over both distances and a regional championship over 5 km, with classifications starting from age group M/W 14. The start and finish are at the Klein Meckelsen sports field, and the event is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners.
course_highlights: 10 km circuit and 5 km course with a turnaround point
Officially measured and DLV-approved running courses
Classifications for the district championships (Rotenburg/W.) and regional championships (Lüneburg)
additional: Late registration is possible until 18:00 on the day of the event, with a €3 late-entry fee in addition to the entry fee. Race numbers can be collected from 18:00 at the announcer’s stand at the sports field. Changing and shower facilities are available at the sports hall on Schulstraße. Parking is available at the sports grounds and at the gymnasium. Awards will be presented to the top three finishers in each race and gender; all participants will receive a medal. Certificates are available online. The event starts at 19:00 and offers a summery running atmosphere. It is a great opportunity for runners of all ages to compete and take part in championships.

name: 4. Fachberg 100
description: The Fachberg 100 is a 100 km road race in Northeim, Germany, starting on July 18, 2026, at 6:00 a.m. The course consists of 15 laps and a short out-and-back section, alternating between asphalt and field paths. Each lap involves about 75 meters of elevation gain, for a total of 1,125 meters. This is a small ultrarunning event with limited participation and no entry fee; runners must bring their own provisions.
course_highlights: 15 laps alternating between asphalt and field paths
About 1,125 m of total elevation gain
6:00 a.m. start
additional: No entry fee; participants must bring their own provisions. A small field, with 21 finishers to date. Typical July weather: around 25 °C during the day and 15 °C at night, usually sunny. The event is a small, close-knit ultramarathon community, with about 21 finishers in previous editions.

name: HAKRO Stadtlauf

description: The Hakro City Run in Schrozberg is a charity running event at which €5 is donated for each participant to support Jugendhilfe Creglingen. The run is open to all age groups and encourages young and old to run together. There are individual competitions by registration class, as well as a team competition for companies, clubs, families and friends. The event aims to run smoothly and asks participants to register in advance by 16 July 2025.
course_highlights: Team competition with five runners covering 2 km each
Individual competitions by registration class
Separate classification for children and young people up to 18 years old
additional: Late entries are accepted up to a maximum of 1 hour before the start, with a €3 late-entry fee. The entry fee must be paid in cash on the event day. Participants in the 400 m run receive certificates. The run is open to all ages and genders. The event includes races for companies, clubs, families and friends, including a relay competition. The course runs through the festival grounds, where additional activities are available. Donations go to Jugendhilfe Creglingen.

description: The Heizomat Altmühlseelauf is a traditional running event held every July around Lake Altmühl in Gunzenhausen. The event includes various races, including a half marathon, a relay, a fun run, a schoolchildren’s race and a Bambini run. The courses are officially measured and run through the scenic surroundings of Lake Altmühl. The event offers both individual and team runners the opportunity to test their endurance and enjoy a day of sport together.
course_highlights: Flat half-marathon course around Lake Altmühl with kilometre markers
Relay race with the half-marathon distance divided flexibly among 2–4 runners
The courses pass Schlungenhof, Muhr am See, Streudorfer Brücke and Seezentrum Wald
additional: Relay race for 2–4 runners, starting together with the half marathon at 18:00. Relay baton with an integrated transponder for timing. Late registration for the Bambini run is possible until 15:45 on race day. Medals for all finishers; certificates and trophies for age-group and overall winners. Company relay teams have their own classification. Race bibs display first names for those who register in advance. Course around Lake Altmühl, officially measured; registration by direct debit; start at 18:00; various race categories for children, young people and adults.

name: Lautersteiner Panorama-Lauf
description: The Lautersteiner Panorama-Lauf on July 18, 2026, offers runners breathtaking views across the Swabian Alb. The varied course winds along forest-edge trails and open stretches around Weißenstein, rewarding the effort with fantastic panoramas. Organized by TV Weißenstein, the event celebrates the joy of sport in nature and a great atmosphere. Runners can choose between a short 4.5 km loop and the challenging 11.5 km main race.
course_highlights: Breathtaking views across the Swabian Alb
Varied trails with forest-edge paths and open stretches
Explore the Alb’s elevation gains through sport
additional: Course distances of 4.5 km and 11.5 km, varied scenery, elevation gains of the Alb, nature experience

name: Maintal Ultratrail / Bayerische Trail Meisterschaften 30km
description: With three scenic routes in the Franconian Wine Country, the Maintal Ultratrail offers an enjoyable trail-running experience. The 30 km route with 720 metres of elevation gain leads through picturesque vineyards, nature reserves and varied woodlands along the Main River. The event is aimed at trail-running enthusiasts of all experience levels who appreciate nature and the shared experience of running. The motto for all participants is: fun and enjoying nature come first—not just athletic performance.
course_highlights: 30 km route with 720 metres of elevation gain through the Main Valley and Franconian Wine Country
Varied landscapes: limestone beech forests, Mediterranean flora, vineyards and meadow valleys
Typical meanders of the Main Valley with picturesque views
additional: The online registration deadline is 30.06.2026. A high-quality technical shirt can be ordered for an additional €20 until 31.05.2026. Please note the BLV late registration surcharge. Food and refreshments for runners and visitors are well catered for in the start and finish area. The route is undulating, with some steep climbs; the cut-off time at aid station 5 is 3 p.m. The event also offers longer distances of 13 km and 64 km, with the start and finish at the SV Veitshöchheim sports ground. On-site registration is available, and the route includes natural trails and elevation gain that make the race challenging and varied.

name: Sparkasse Kraichgau CityCup Bretten
location: TV Platz, Bretten, Karlsruhe, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Sparkasse Kraichgau City Cup Bretten is a popular race that has been held annually since 2004 and attracts many runners from the region. The races take runners through Bretten’s beautiful old town, with its narrow streets and market square lined with half-timbered houses. Various distances are offered, including children’s races, 5 km and 10 km races, and a 4 x 2.5 km relay. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with medals for all children and special prizes for schools and relay teams.
course_highlights: Run through Bretten’s historic old town
Start and finish at TV Platz
Laps around TV Platz and through the old town
additional: Race-number pickup from 15:15 at TV Platz. Medals for all children at the finish. Changing rooms and showers are available. The relay exchange zone is opposite the start/finish, on the sports field. Late registration is possible until 30 minutes before the race starts, with a €2.00 surcharge. Run through the old town, start and finish at TV Platz, registration open, preparation courses as part of the running group

name: Spendenlauf Recke
description: The Spendenlauf Recke on July 18, 2026, is a charity event in aid of Kinderkrebshilfe Münster. Organized by Andreas Egelkamp Heizung, Lüftung, Sanitär GmbH & Co. KG and the company Lewe from Recke, the event offers two distances: 5 kilometers for beginners and those who prefer a relaxed run, and 10 kilometers for experienced runners looking for a greater challenge. The focus is on coming together for a good cause, with the entire entry fee donated. The event combines sporting commitment with social responsibility and invites everyone to take part and show their support.
course_highlights: 5-kilometer route, ideal for beginners and relaxed runners
10-kilometer route for experienced runners seeking a greater challenge
Charity run in aid of Kinderkrebshilfe Münster
additional: The entire entry fee will be donated. The organizers are Andreas Egelkamp Heizung, Lüftung, Sanitär GmbH & Co. KG and the company Lewe from Recke. The event supports Kinderkrebshilfe Münster, which gives hope and improves quality of life for affected children and families. Routes: 5 km and 10 km; online registration only; run in aid of Kinderkrebshilfe Münster

description: The 12th Szczecin Night Port Marathon and the 7th Szczecin Night Port Half Marathon are night road races held in Szczecin, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The marathon course consists of two identical loops, each 42.195 km long, while the half marathon is one 21.097 km loop; both courses are certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA). The race starts at 23:00. Participants can expect original T-shirts and a special classification for people connected with the maritime industry. The event is organized by Ruchowa Akademia Zdrowia, Zachodniopomorska Federacja Sportu, and RAZ Event, with the support of the City of Szczecin and port partners.
course_highlights: The marathon course consists of two identical loops through the streets of Szczecin and is certified by the PZLA
Start and finish at Florian Krygier Municipal Stadium
Course markers every 1 km and refreshment stations along the course and at the finish of each loop
additional: The marathon time limit is 6 hours. A new classification category, “People of the Sea,” is for participants connected with the maritime industry. Start and finish at Florian Krygier Municipal Stadium. The course may be modified slightly due to renovation work near Trasa Zamkowa. Registration opens at 12:00. The course may be subject to minor changes due to construction work. The event includes a “People of the Sea” category for participants connected with the maritime industry.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko
description: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko is a unique trail race taking place on 18 July 2026 in the scenic Elbląg Upland, by the Vistula Lagoon. The course runs along wild trails, with varied elevation and peaceful natural scenery, offering runners a chance to connect with the region’s nature and history. The event is part of a nationwide mountain-running series that promotes physical activity in harmony with nature and welcomes both beginners and experienced ultramarathon runners. Participants can expect professional organization, medical support and a comprehensive race pack.
course_highlights: The wild natural landscapes and scenic hills of the Elbląg Upland
Routes through Elbląg Upland Landscape Park and four forest reserves
Views of the Vistula Lagoon and historic sites, including Old Prussian hillforts and the Imperial Stone
additional: The race pack includes a waterproof race bib with a chip, medical support, course markings, aid stations, drinks and snacks at the finish, a commemorative medal, and a GPS tracker for the 81 km distance. Starts take place in waves from 5:00 (81 km) to 10:30 (14 km), with separate Garmin Junior races for children. The online technical briefing on Facebook will take place on 15.07.2026 at 20:00. The system applies discounts when registering for more than one event in the series. The event also includes junior categories and challenge options, and the routes pass through reserves and hiking trails, offering unique experiences for runners and nature lovers.

name: Nocna zaDyszka 2026
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Piekarach Śląskich
description: Nocna zaDyszka is a 10 km race held as part of the 7th PKO Piekary Śląskie Half Marathon, taking place on 18 July 2026 in Piekary Śląskie. The event attracts many runners, and the entry limit for this distance is 900 participants. The day before, on 17 July, the accompanying Leśna Eko Piątka 5 km race will also take place. The organizers invite runners to take part and say they expect nearly 3,000 runners across all distances in 2026.
course_highlights: Night race over 10 km
Entry limit of 900 participants
Accompanying Leśna Eko Piątka 5 km race, with a limit of 500 participants
additional: Entry limits: 1,500 for the half marathon, 900 for Nocna zaDyszka (10 km), and 500 for Leśna Eko Piątka (5 km). Online registration is available. The accompanying race takes place the day before the main event. The event also includes races for children, the option to register online in advance, and a course time limit of 2 hours and 30 minutes. The race draws strong interest from the local community and is one of the region’s most important sporting events.

name: 2 Chojnicka Piątka
description: 1. Chojnicka Piątka is a road race held in Chojnice on 26 July 2026. The event is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich and attracts runners from various places, offering sporting competition and a great atmosphere. The route runs through the city streets, giving participants attractive views and the chance to test their fitness over 5 km.
course_highlights: Road race in the centre of Chojnice
5 km route
Held as part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich
additional: The event is planned for 18 July 2026, and the route runs through the streets of Chojnice, mainly along Rybacka Street. Registration details have not been provided.

name: Botaniczna Piątka
location: Ogrod Botaniczny UMCS, Lublin, Lublin County, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Lublin is the spring edition of a popular cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque UMCS Botanical Garden in Lublin, combining athletic competition with the beauty of nature. The race aims to promote running and showcase attractive, scenic running routes. The organizers place particular emphasis on the natural features of the locations, making the race a unique experience for participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the UMCS Botanical Garden in Lublin
Picturesque natural surroundings
Organized by experienced running enthusiasts since 2014
additional: 5 km race, course in the Botanical Garden, children's races, Nordic walking, July 2026

name: Puchar Polski Nordic Walking - II etap
XIII Półmaraton i Ćwierćmaraton
location: Chrzypsko Wielkie, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Kordícky Extrém
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT o.z.
description: Kordícky Extrém is a challenging mountain run through the picturesque surroundings of Kordíky in the Banská Bystrica District. The course is intended for runners seeking extreme challenges in nature, with significant elevation gain and technical sections. The event is part of the Marathon Tour series and offers a unique running experience in beautiful mountain scenery. The organizers welcome all runners who want to test their endurance and courage in this extreme terrain.
course_highlights: Mountain setting with significant elevation gain
Technically challenging sections on natural trails
Picturesque views of the surroundings of Kordíky
additional: Multiple categories and registration options, including online and in person. The event is accompanied by a large social gathering with food and entertainment.

name: Mesciské pancaky
location: Futbalové ihrisko, Mestisko, okres Svidník, Slovakia
description: Mesciské Pancaky is a running event in Mestisko, Svidník District, offering 5 km and 10 km courses with no age restrictions for men or women. The course is mostly asphalt, with sections on grass and a dirt road, providing runners with varied terrain. The race starts at the football pitch in Mestisko. Registration is available online or at the event venue.
course_highlights: Surface: 60% asphalt, 20% grass, 20% dirt road
Two categories: 5 km and 10 km, with no age restrictions
Start at the football pitch in Mestisko
additional: The categories are open to men and women regardless of age. The start is at the football pitch in Mestisko. The course combines asphalt, grass and a dirt road. The event is open to all age groups, and registration is available online or at the venue.

name: Behaj lesmi Veľká Fatra
location: Hrabovo, Národný park Veľká Fatra, Slovakia
description: Behaj lesmi Veľká Fatra is a trail race in Veľká Fatra National Park, offering runners unforgettable views of the Low Tatras, forest singletrack trails and special forest roads. The routes pass through the UNESCO-listed site of Vlkolínec and also include a cable car and Sidorovo. The race is part of the international UTMB Index Races, where runners earn points based on their performance and race distance. Three routes of varying distances and elevation gain are available, suitable for runners of different levels.
course_highlights: Unforgettable views of the Low Tatras
Forest singletrack trails and special forest roads
The route passes through the UNESCO-listed site of Vlkolínec
additional: The course includes 150-metre Conti Speed Sections marked with Continental flags. Runners can earn points toward the UTMB Index Races based on their performance and race distance. The routes have different elevation gains: 730 m over 18 km, 405 m over 11 km and 267 m over 5 km. The routes are mostly on soft natural surfaces. The race is part of a series supporting environmental and charitable projects, with details about registration, entry fees and accompanying activities available on the official website.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Fojtovice
location: Fojtovice, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beauty of the Ore Mountains. Across six races in different destinations, you can choose from main races of 6 to 9 km, adventure routes of 20 to 30 km, a walk with checkpoint-finding, and children’s races. The series is suitable for runners, canicross participants, children, and walkers, and offers a varied selection of routes through the picturesque Ore Mountains. The Fojtovice race takes place on 19 July 2026 and offers a main race, an adventure route, a walk, and children’s races.
course_highlights: Main race of 6–9 km through the picturesque Ore Mountains
Adventure route of 20–30 km, following a map
Children’s races from 300 m to 1,600 m
additional: The series includes 6 races in different locations in the Ore Mountains. In addition to running, participants can take part in a walk with checkpoint-finding using a map and in canicross. Children’s races are divided by age and course distance. The organizer is Živé Sokolovsko z.s., in cooperation with Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s. The races include different distances and categories, including walking and children’s races; the series takes place at several locations in the Ore Mountains region.

name: Šachty - Štěpánka
location: Vysoké nad Jizerou-Sklenařice, Vysoké nad Jizerou, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Český Ski klub Vysoké nad Jizerou
description: Běh Šachty - Štěpánka is a traditional race organized by the Czech Ski Club in Vysoké nad Jizerou. The race is part of the Maratonstav Czech Cup in hill running and offers runners a challenging course in beautiful Krkonoše surroundings. The event attracts athletes and hill-running fans, who can enjoy both the challenge and the atmosphere of a mountain race. The organizers welcome all runners who want to test themselves on this traditional course.
course_highlights: A challenging course in the Krkonoše Mountains
A hill run with beautiful views
Part of the Maratonstav Czech Cup
additional: The race is part of a hill-running series with a long-standing tradition and offers challenging terrain suitable for experienced runners and mountain-sports enthusiasts.

name: Aalener Stadtlauf
description: The Aalen City Run takes place on 19 July 2026 at Sparkassenplatz in Aalen and offers a varied running event with several races, including the Bambini Run, Schoolchildren’s Run, AOK Active & Healthy Run, Team Run, and the Youth and Sparkasse Main Run. The event is known for its great atmosphere and sporting challenges. New this year is the Stadt-Land-Fluss Cup ranking, combining races in different landscapes and offering a special challenge. Registration is already open, and all running enthusiasts are warmly invited to take part and enjoy an urban and nature-rich running experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Sparkassenplatz in Aalen
A range of race courses for Bambinis, schoolchildren, young people, and adults
New: Stadt-Land-Fluss Cup ranking, with races in urban, rural, and riverside settings
additional: The event includes several races, including the Bambini Run, Schoolchildren’s Run, AOK Active & Healthy Run, Team Run, and Youth and Sparkasse Main Run. A new cup ranking covers three races in 2026 (Essinger Panoramaläufe, Kocher Cup Unterkochen, Aalen City Run). Individual entry in the Team Run is possible. Invoices/receipts can be issued after the event. Various race distances, the “Stadt-Land-Fluss-Cup” race series, online registration, race-bib collection on event day, parking options in Aalen, limited changing facilities, and valuables storage.

name: Barbarossalauf 2026
location: Erlenbach am Main, Landkreis Miltenberg, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Barbarossalauf 2026 returns to Erlenbach am Main as a city race on July 19. The new course starts centrally at the old fire station and follows a flat, scenic route along the Main before passing through Erlenbach’s old town on the way to the finish. The event offers races for different age groups and distances, from children’s races to the 10 km main race, which consists of two laps. The course is ideal for beginners and ambitious runners aiming for fast times, and showcases Erlenbach at its best.
course_highlights: Flat, scenic route along the Main
Start and finish at the old fire station in the town centre
Circuit through Erlenbach’s old town with good facilities
additional: Race materials will be distributed at the old fire station from 13:30 on race day. Shirts are available while supplies last. Timing is done by scanning race bibs at the finish. Parking is available at the outdoor swimming pool and the train station. 80% of the entry fee will be refunded until 12.07.2026, and 50% thereafter. Transfers to another participant are possible at any time. Several race distances are offered, including a marathon, half marathon, 10 km and shorter races; the event promotes running in the region; registration is possible until race day.

name: Flughafenlauf Barth
description: The Barther Airport Run takes place on July 19, 2026, at Stralsund-Barth Baltic Sea Airport and offers a varied program of seven races for runners and walkers of all ages. From short distances for young runners to the half-marathon distance, there is something for everyone. The event promises a morning full of movement, fun, and exciting races in a unique setting right at the airport. Walkers are also very welcome, and food and refreshments will be available on site.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stralsund-Barth Baltic Sea Airport
Distances from 500 m to the half marathon (21 km)
Water station on the half-marathon course
additional: On-site late registration is possible, with a €2.00 late registration fee for events of 4 km and longer. Bib pickup begins at 7:30 a.m. on race day in the terminal building. Awards are given to places 1–3 in the age-group and overall categories. The “Airpott” café and restaurant offers light snacks and drinks. Participants are asked to return their bib after finishing. Various running and walking distances, family-friendly, at Stralsund-Barth Baltic Sea Airport

name: Heumadener Volkslauf 2026
location: Sportgelände Untere Hasenwedel, Stuttgart-Heumaden, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Heumaden Fun Run has been held annually in Stuttgart-Heumaden since 2009 and offers runners three distances: 5.5 km, 10.3 km and, since 2018, a half marathon of 21 km. The route is a long, relatively flat loop with few hills, passing through the districts of Heumaden, Riedenberg and Kemnat. The start and finish are at the Untere Hasenwedel sports grounds. The event is part of the Family Sports Festival and has a water station on the longer route.
course_highlights: Long, flat loop with few hills
Route through Heumaden, Riedenberg and Kemnat
Start and finish at the Untere Hasenwedel sports grounds
additional: The 10.3 km route is run twice as a loop. There is a water station halfway along the route. The event is part of TSV Heumaden’s Family Sports Festival. It also includes an inclusive walk after the races and is part of the annual Family Sports Festival in Stuttgart-Heumaden.

name: Internationaler Allgäu Volkslauf
description: The International Allgäu Volkslauf in Leutkirch has been held annually on Children’s Festival Sunday since 1970 and has grown into a major sporting event, attracting hundreds of runners from southern Germany and the partner cities. Organized by the Skiläuferzunft of TSG 1847 Leutkirch e.V., the race is supported by numerous volunteers, the Leutkirch German Red Cross, the city administration, and other partners. The race is a traditional sporting fixture in Leutkirch and offers a varied event for runners of all ability levels.
course_highlights: Scenic routes in the Allgäu region
Various categories for children, teenagers, and adults
A friendly, community atmosphere with warm support along the route
additional: The Volkslauf is organized by the Skiläuferzunft of TSG 1847 Leutkirch e.V. and takes place on Children’s Festival Sunday. The event is supported by partner clubs, the Leutkirch German Red Cross, the Red Cross from the partner city of Castiglione, the city administration, and the municipal public works department. It is a traditional event of great regional significance. The event includes various race distances, including a Bambini run and longer distances for older children, and offers a family-friendly sporting community experience.

name: Jakob Scheuring Lauf
description: The 24th Jakob Scheuring Run takes place on 19 July 2026 at Murgstadion Ottenau and includes timed, ranked races over 1.5 km for schoolchildren, 5 km and 10 km. The route leads from the stadium through the picturesque Salzwiesental, mostly through woodland and meadows, and back to the stadium. The event is part of the Sportvereinigung Ottenau sports festival and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, refreshments and an awards ceremony in the festival tent.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Murgstadion Ottenau
Route through the idyllic Salzwiesental, over woodland and meadow terrain
Approx. 140 m elevation difference for the 10 km course and approx. 40 m for the 5 km course
additional: Race number collection at the festival grounds entrance from 07:30 to 08:50. Late registration is possible up to 30 minutes before the start for a €2 fee. Drinks are available in the start/finish area and at the 10 km turnaround point. Certificates and prizes are awarded to the top three in each age group. Special prize of €250 for a course record. Awards ceremony from approx. 12:00 in the festival tent. Changing and shower facilities are available at Murgstadion. Ample parking is available at Murgstadion. Late registration is possible up to 30 minutes before the start; refreshments, changing facilities and parking are available.

name: neuefinanzkultur Laufevent mit Biosphärenlauf und Auinger Alblauf
description: The Neue Finanzkultur running event in Auingen on the Swabian Alb is an annual major race day with various events, including the Biosphärenlauf and the Auinger Alblauf. Alongside the sporting competition, there is also a charity walking event in aid of Clowns im Dienst. The event offers transponder timing, awards for the fastest runners in each age group, and special prizes for the largest group. Children can take part in an untimed Bambini run and receive a medal, certificate, and surprise.
course_highlights: Races on the Swabian Alb, including the Biosphärenlauf and the Auinger Alblauf
Transponder timing provided by time 2finish GbR
Untimed Bambini run with a medal and certificate
additional: Start and finish at the Auingen sports clubhouse, with changing rooms and showers. Race-number distribution from 8:00 Uhr at the Auingen community center. Transponder deposit: 5 €; personal transponders are not permitted. Special prize for the largest group by number of participants (excluding walking). Disclaimer: Participation is at your own risk. Running event held as part of the race day; details about terrain or registration are not provided.

name: run4trees
description: Run4Trees is a running event in Unterhaching taking place on July 19, 2026. The course runs through the idyllic Perlacher Forst, with the start and finish at Festplatz Unterhaching. By taking part, runners show their support for climate protection, as proceeds are donated to Plant for the Planet and TSV Unterhaching’s youth program. The run combines sporting commitment with environmental awareness and community spirit.
course_highlights: Run through the idyllic Perlacher Forst
Start and finish area at Festplatz Unterhaching
Event focused on climate and environmental protection
additional: The proceeds from the run are split equally between Plant for the Planet and TSV Unterhaching’s youth program. The office is closed during the school holidays. The run is known for its sustainability focus and commitment to climate protection. Awards are presented to the overall and youth winners, and registration is open until July 2, 2025.

name: Sommer Rheinauenlauf
description: The Summer Rheinauen Run in Bad Bellingen is a traditional running event organised by TV Rheinweiler. The races wind through the picturesque Rhine meadows and offer varied routes for runners of all ages. The event includes several distances and welcomes both recreational runners and ambitious athletes. Alongside the sporting competition, the sense of community is also a key part of the event.
course_highlights: Run through the idyllic Rhine meadows
Varied route with a chance to enjoy nature
Suitable for all ages and ability levels
additional: Multiple race categories, start and finish in the Kurpark, registration via the website

name: Stundenlauf VfL Dettenhausen
location: VfL Dettenhausen sports ground, Dettenhausen, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The 24-Hour Run in Dettenhausen is a long-standing running event, taking place for the 20th time on July 18, 2026. The event is held at the VfL Dettenhausen sports grounds and gives both individual and team runners the opportunity to test their endurance. Participation is free, and a strong emphasis is placed on community and fitness. The course uses a microchip integrated into the race bib for easy timekeeping, and overnight accommodation is available directly at the sports grounds.
course_highlights: Loop course at the VfL Dettenhausen sports grounds
Microchip timekeeping integrated into the race bib
Overnight accommodation in tents or motorhomes in designated areas
additional: Race bib collection is on Friday evening from 18:00 to 19:00 and on Saturday from 8:00 onwards, on site; teams of 5 to 12 people are allowed, with only one runner on the course at a time; showers and toilets are available on site; donations are welcome, and participation is free. The run takes place at the sports grounds; overnight stays in tents or motorhomes are possible; timekeeping is by microchip; barbecues and open fires are not permitted; dogs are prohibited.

name: Vogelsberger Südbahnlauf
price_range: Bambinilauf kostenlos, Schülerlauf 3 Euro, 5km Lauf 7 Euro, 10km Lauf 12 Euro, Halbmarathon 15 Euro
description: The Vogelsberger Südbahnlauf will be held for the 21st time on 19 July 2026, organised by Lauftreff Unterreichenbach. The event offers runners of all ages and ability levels a varied running experience on well-marked routes along the paved Vogelsberger Südbahn cycle path and surfaced forest and field paths. The races range from a children’s fun run to schoolchildren’s races and 5 km runs, up to the half marathon. The team places great importance on a relaxed and sporting atmosphere, supported by refreshment stations and chip-free timing.
course_highlights: Routes follow the paved Vogelsberger Südbahn cycle path and surfaced forest and field paths
Well-marked routes with kilometre markers and directional signs
Refreshment stations every 2.5 km with mineral water, apple spritzer and damp sponges
additional: Timing is chip-free. The start and finish are at 310 m above sea level, and the highest point of the course is at 460 m above sea level. The races start in staggered intervals between 09:00 and 09:35. Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, with a €2 late-entry fee (except for the schoolchildren’s and children’s fun runs). Refreshment stations every 2.5 km provide mineral water, apple spritzer and damp sponges. Routes follow the cycle path and forest paths. Water stations, changing rooms and showers are available on site, and parking is available.

description: The Lower Silesian Mountain Running Festival is a prestigious trail-running event held in picturesque Lądek-Zdrój. As part of the festival, runners can take on a variety of courses with different distances and elevation gains, from short night runs to mountain ultramarathons. The event attracts mountain-running enthusiasts, offering unforgettable views and technically challenging courses. In 2026, the festival will take place from 16 to 19 July, and participants can look forward to a varied accompanying programme and professional organisation.
course_highlights: 7 Summits Course – approximately 240 km with approximately 7,670 m of elevation gain
Super Trail – 130 km, with its highest point at approximately 1,425 m above sea level
Night Trail – 15 km, ideal for beginners, with beautiful views
additional: Participants can purchase a commemorative technical T-shirt (99 PLN) and running sleeves (60 PLN). DFBG CAMP takes place during the festival (7–10 May 2026). Starts are held at various locations in Lądek-Zdrój and the surrounding area. Bag drop and gear-drop points are available along the courses. The accompanying programme includes an opening ceremony and an awards presentation. The event lasts four days and features various distances; participants can purchase commemorative T-shirts and running sleeves. Registration opens on 17 November, and participants can use various amenities, such as the expo and accommodation.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Lublin edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Lublin – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque UMCS Botanical Garden in Lublin, combining sporting competition with the beauty of nature. The race is part of the Botaniczna Piątka series, known for its scenic courses and friendly atmosphere. We invite all running enthusiasts to take part in this special summer edition.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the UMCS Botanical Garden
Picturesque, scenic green surroundings
Organized with a focus on both natural beauty and sport
additional: The event is planned for July 19, 2026, in Lublin, with options to participate in different distances and age categories.

name: Piątka Królowej Bony
organizer: Gmina Różan, Lekkoatletyczny Klub Sportowy Maków Mazowiecki
price_range: 40 zł – opłata online lub przelew do 17.07.2025, 70 zł – w biurze zawodów

description: Queen Bona’s Five is a 5 km race held at the Municipal Stadium in Różan. The event takes place on July 19, 2026, and is open to people aged 15 and over. Minors must provide written consent from a parent or guardian. The start and finish are located at 3 Szkolna Street. The event is organized by the Municipality of Różan and Maków Mazowiecki Athletics Club, and participants can expect professional support and timekeeping.
course_highlights: 5 km race
Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Różan
Urban route located in Różan
additional: The race office is open from 8:00 to 9:30. Race briefing at the start line is at 9:45. The finish line closes at 11:00, and the winners’ award ceremony takes place at 11:30. Timekeeping uses a modern UHF RFID system, with immediate results and SMS messages sent to runners after the race. Venue: Municipal Stadium in Różan; online registration; distance: 5 km; participant age: 15 and over

name: VII Bieg Górski o Złotą Paproć
description: The 7th Golden Fern Mountain Run is a 10 km mountain race taking place in the picturesque town of Tymbark. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a challenging course with varied terrain. The organizers encourage participants to prepare with dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event attracts runners who enjoy a challenge and connecting with nature.
course_highlights: A 10 km mountain course
Picturesque landscapes of Małopolska
Challenging terrain with uphill sections
additional: The organizer offers training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to a runner’s VDOT level, along with expert support. The website also features a runner zone with tools for tracking progress and following training plans. The event is very popular, and participants can expect sporting competition and beautiful views. The race is open to a wide range of runners, and the organizer provides various categories and attractions.

name: XXII Bieg Szlakiem Partyzantów z Lubatowej
Bančanská desiatka
description: The Bančanská Ten is a traditional running race in the village of Banské, in Vranov nad Topľou District, held in front of the Cultural Centre in Banské. This popular sporting event has a long history and attracts a record number of participants each year. The race is known for its challenging uphill course and beautiful surroundings, and is organized by Športový klub Banské. In addition to the main race, uphill time trials and other accompanying events are held.
course_highlights: Uphill race in the village of Banské – Mláčky
Traditional start in front of the Cultural Centre in Banské
Challenging course profile, with a new course record of 14:35 min
additional: The event is organized by Športový klub Banské, which has a long tradition dating back to 1985. It is held regularly, and in 2025 the 30th edition of the Bančanská 10/5 will take place. The event also includes the JANTEX Banské–Mláčky uphill time trials, which have their own history and categories. The race includes 10 km and a 5 km relay; registration is available online or on site. There is also a varied accompanying programme, including a bouncy castle and performances.

name: YOUNG RUN Nestlé
location: Námestie J. C. Hronského, Prievidza, Prievidza, Slovakia
description: YOUNG RUN Nestlé is a running event in Prievidza offering 21 km, 10 km and 5 km races. Competitors are divided into categories by age and gender, and children’s relay events are also available. The races start at J. C. Hronský Square, with different start times depending on the distance. The event is organised by YOUNG RUN, Nestlé and the City of Prievidza, providing a quality sporting experience for all age groups.
course_highlights: 21 km, 10 km and 5 km courses in the centre of Prievidza
Categories for different age groups, including juniors and veterans
Children’s relay races with circuits of 2 x 5 km and 2 x 2.5 km
additional: Race start times: 8:00 for 21 km, 8:15 for the TRUE circuit and relay, 9:20 for STARTIN, and 9:55 for children. Categories are divided by age and gender, with specific birth years. The organiser provides the contact telephone number +421915574850. The event also includes VIP zones, online timing, support for people with disabilities, and 600 participant medals.

name: Ipelský Beh
location: Lučenec - Kalonda, Hrádza na Ipli, Lučenec, Slovakia
description: Ipelský Beh is a running event held in Lučenec - Kalonda, on the embankment of the Ipeľ River. The course runs mainly on grass and includes a 100-metre section of a disused railway line. The race is open to various age categories for men, women and young people, including Nordic walking. The organizers, the city of Lučenec, the municipality of Kalonda and OZ-Novohrad, warmly invite runners of all levels to take part in this traditional event.
course_highlights: Course surface is mainly grass
A 100-metre section of a disused railway line
Location on the embankment of the Ipeľ River in Lučenec - Kalonda
additional: Online registration is available until 18.7.2025 at the reduced entry fee of €13. On-site entry is €18, subject to availability. Categories are divided by age and gender, including Nordic walking for men and women. The organizer is Marian Duzbaba (tel.: 0907 146 181). The race is held in various categories, including Nordic walking, with online registration available and races on different courses, including a 10 km course and a 6.5 km asphalt course. The event is part of the region’s sports calendar and is suitable for all age groups.

name: Běh za Sliveneckou saní
description: Běh za Sliveneckou saní is an uphill race in Prague 5-Velká Chuchle, covering 2.54 km with 130 meters of elevation gain. The race is part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series and challenges runners with a demanding climb. It is suitable for anyone who wants to test their strength and endurance on hilly terrain.
course_highlights: Course length: 2.54 km
Elevation gain: 130 m
Uphill race in Prague 5-Velká Chuchle

description: The Warsaw Uprising Run is an annual running event held in Warsaw in remembrance of the Heroes of the Warsaw Uprising. The event attracts thousands of participants who take part in the 5 km and 10 km races, creating a unique, solemn atmosphere of patriotism and historical remembrance. The run uses staggered starts and takes place in the evening, further highlighting its distinctive character. The organizers also offer a virtual edition, allowing participants to take part from anywhere in the world.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km courses are certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA)
Staggered evening starts: 5 km at 20:30, 10 km at 21:20
Time limits: 60 minutes for 5 km, 90 minutes for 10 km
additional: Staggered starts are divided into 3 waves, starting approximately every 6 minutes for the 5 km and every 7 minutes for the 10 km. Participants in the 10 km race are ceremonially escorted to the start line at 21:15. Participant limits: 7,500 for the 10 km and 5,000 for the 5 km. Race bibs can be collected at the Race Office at ul. Konwiktorska 6 in Warsaw from July 24–26, 2025. On race day, participants from outside Warsaw can collect their race packs between 16:00 and 18:00. Valid identification documents and a QR code are required to collect a race pack. Minors must present a statement from a parent or legal guardian. The event offers in-person and virtual participation options, with medals, T-shirts, and certificates, and aims to commemorate the Warsaw Uprising.

The course follows the ridge of the Czerwone Wierchy and Starorobociański Wierch, featuring two demanding vertical-style climbs with approximately 1,200 m of elevation gain each, interspersed with difficult Tatra descents. The race is part of a running festival that highlights the sporting character of the Podhale and Orava regions, offering participants and spectators an unforgettable experience. The organizers invite you to take part and cheer along the course.
course_highlights: Course along the ridge of the Czerwone Wierchy and Starorobociański Wierch
Two demanding vertical-style climbs with approximately 1,200 m of elevation gain each
Difficult Tatra descents
additional: Additional transport to the start of Orava 120 and Orava 80 from the parking area at Siwa Polana (for a fee). Orava 120 starts at 19:00 on 24.07.2026; Orava 80 starts at 6:00 on 25.07.2026. Mandatory and recommended equipment is listed on the website. The festival includes several mountain races of varying distances and types. The event features different race categories, a festival atmosphere, information about registration and accompanying attractions, as well as volunteer opportunities.

name: Pogórze Ultra Trail
description: Pogórze Ultra Trail is a mountain race organized by the Pogórze Ultra Trail Association, which brings together a passion for running and exploring the natural beauty of the Strzyżów Foothills. The routes pass through scenic areas with diverse landscapes, including old deciduous forests, coniferous woods, loess ravines, and unique rock formations. Participants have the opportunity to run through historic shelter tunnels in Strzyżów and Stępina, as well as admire the Brzeżanka Range, the Kiczora Massif, Herby, and Mount Chełm. It is the region’s largest running event, attracting trail and ultramarathon enthusiasts every year.

name: Oscheffer TSG-Lauf
description: The 17th Oscheffer TSG Run takes place on July 26, 2026, in Mainaschaff. The event offers various races for different age groups and ability levels, including a schoolchildren’s and youth run, the Sparkassen Run (5 km), the agilimo Run (10 km), a Bambini run, and a relay race. The races are part of a long-standing sporting event organized by TSG Mainaschaff 1973 e.V., welcoming both recreational and competitive runners. Online registration is open, and further information is available in the race announcement.
course_highlights: A range of distances, from the Bambini run to 10 km
Start and finish in Mainaschaff
A traditional sporting event organized by TSG Mainaschaff
additional: The event includes a schoolchildren’s and youth run, the Sparkassen Run (5 km), the agilimo Run (10 km), a Bambini run, and a relay race. Registration is online via the official website. The organizer’s address is Schuberstraße 4, 63814 Mainaschaff. The event includes various categories such as schoolchildren’s and youth races, Bambini races, relay races, and the 5 km and 10 km races. Online registration is available. The courses are officially measured and eligible for best performances.

The 10 km main race starts at 9:30 a.m., followed by the 5 km races and the shorter 1 km and 2 km Spatzenläufe. The focus is on the joy of exercise and health prevention, supported by enthusiastic spectators and a varied program of events as part of SC Rain 1928 e. V.’s sports week. Those who register by June 15, 2026, will receive a popular Volkslauf T-shirt in their race pack. In addition, one euro per participant will be donated to the “Freunde durch Helfen” aid campaign.

name: Südries-Kesseltal Halbmarathon mit Philipp Pflieger
description: The Südries-Kesseltal Half Marathon with Philipp Pflieger takes place on July 26, 2026, in Mönchsdeggingen. The event celebrates the 100th anniversary of TSV Mönchsdeggingen and gives runners the opportunity to take part in a traditional half marathon. The course runs through the scenic Kesseltal area and promises a sporting experience filled with team spirit and a great atmosphere, as in the previous year. The event includes distances of 3 km and 21.1 km and takes place in typical July weather, with pleasant temperatures.
course_highlights: A run through the scenic Kesseltal area
A traditional half marathon celebrating the 100th anniversary of TSV Mönchsdeggingen
A lively event with dedicated volunteers and team spirit
additional: Typical July weather with an average temperature of 25 °C and mostly sunny days. The starting location is Mönchsdeggingen. July weather typically ranges from 15°C to 25°C, with an average of 75mm of precipitation; the starting location is Mönchsdeggingen.

name: Trainingslauf Bottwartal-Marathon
location: Riedstadion, Steinheim an der Murr, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Bottwartal Marathon is a running event in one of the most beautiful landscapes in southern Germany, taking runners past gentle vineyard slopes, picturesque old towns and enthusiastic crowds along the course. The route is a loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal, with varied sections through historic towns such as Steinheim, Murr, Gronau, Beilstein, Oberstenfeld and Großbottwar. The flat finish at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim invites runners to make a strong final push. The marathon is for adults aged 18 and over and is part of a varied running program in the Bottwartal.
course_highlights: Loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal
Passage through historic old towns such as Steinheim, Murr, Beilstein and Großbottwar
Flat finish at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim
additional: Free monthly training runs in different pace groups on the last Sunday of the month in Steinheim. Weekly Sommerloch runs during the summer holidays every Tuesday evening at 19:00. Year-End Run with 10 km, followed by punch and mulled wine at the end of the year. Registration for all runs is through the partner Datasport. Late entries and changes are possible until shortly before the run. The event takes place at the Riedstadion in Steinheim an der Murr. It is an excellent opportunity to prepare for the marathon in July and improve running technique in a motivating community.

description: The Volkswandertag in Bollensen is an annual event held on the last Sunday in July, open to hiking enthusiasts of all ages. A range of family-friendly routes is offered, following forest trails through the beautiful Solling region. The marathon and half-marathon hikes are loop courses starting and finishing at the TSV Bollensen sports clubhouse. All routes are marked and have refreshment stations. The event has a relaxed atmosphere, with food and drinks in the finish area and a strong sense of community.
course_highlights: Forest trails through the Solling region
Loop courses starting and finishing at the TSV Bollensen sports clubhouse
Refreshment stations along the route and at the finish

Refreshments along the routes (3 stations on the marathon and 2 on the half-marathon), plus coffee and cold drinks at the start, one complimentary drink and a food voucher at the finish. Hiking routes of 3, 7, 12 and 42 km; registration by 29.05.2026; participant limit of 400; refreshments and drinks included; special stamp on 27 July 2025 for €3.

name: XRUN - Ucieczka Św. Kingi
location: Krościenko nad Dunajcem, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: St. Kinga’s Escape is a mountain trail race held in Krościenko nad Dunajcem, combining scenic routes in the Sącz Beskids and the Pieniny Mountains. Participants can choose distances from 14 km to 40 km, with different time limits and Sunday morning starts. The 40 km route passes through Przysłop, the Przechyba Mountain Hut, Wielka Przechyba, and Pieniny National Park, finishing on a scenic path along the Dunajec River. The event is organized by the Beskid Foundation and takes place at the amphitheatre in Krościenko nad Dunajcem.
course_highlights: 40 km route with 1,800 m of elevation gain, linking the Sącz Beskids and the Pieniny Mountains
Scenic loop via the Przechyba Mountain Hut and Wielka Przechyba (1,191 m)
Scenic path along the Dunajec River at the finish
additional: The race office and start/finish are at the Centre for Culture and Promotion in Krościenko nad Dunajcem (amphitheatre). Age categories for children’s races range from 3 to 15 years. Time limits: 40 km – 9 h, 26 km – 7 h, 14 km – 5 h. Routes are marked and available on maps on the website. Organizer: Beskid Foundation. The event offers various trail distances, with routes along mountain trails and the option to register online. The start and finish are in Krościenko nad Dunajcem, and the event is part of the XRUN mountain running series.

name: 13 Nadmorski Bieg Uzdrowiskowy
description: The Nadmorski Spa Run is an annual running event held in the picturesque town of Dąbki in the West Pomeranian Voivodeship. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as the attractions of the Dąbki Health Resort and the Municipality of Darłowo. The program includes races for children and young people, a 10 km race, and special accompanying races such as the Spa Sea Mile. Organizers provide a varied program and attractive prizes, and the race route runs through the charming spa area.
course_highlights: 10 km race route through the Dąbki Health Resort area
Spa Sea Mile over a distance of 1,852 m
Children’s and youth races over distances from 150 m to 1,100 m
additional: The event program spans two days: on 25 July, the Spa Sea Mile, with separate races for women and men; and on 26 July, races for children and young people, the ZaRadnych i OdWażnych 1,100 m race, and the main 10 km race. The race office is open from 16:00 to 18:00 on 25 July and from 8:30 on 26 July. The time limit for completing the Sea Mile is 20 minutes. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and the Dąbki Health Resort, with registration opening on 1 April 2026.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
organizer: Zachodniopomorskie Centrum Kultury Obszarów Wiejskich i Edukacji Ekologicznej
description: The summer edition of Botaniczna Piątka is a 5 km race held in the picturesque Przelewice Dendrological Garden. It is a great opportunity to combine physical activity with relaxation amid greenery and nature. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka series and is co-organized by the West Pomeranian Voivodeship. Participants receive a commemorative water lily-shaped medal, and the main race is scheduled to start at 10:00.
course_highlights: A 5 km course in the Przelewice Dendrological Garden
Picturesque scenery surrounded by greenery and nature
A relaxing atmosphere for a summer race
additional: The race takes place as a special summer edition of the Botaniczna Piątka series. Participants receive a commemorative water lily-shaped medal. The event is co-financed from the budget of the West Pomeranian Voivodeship and held under the honorary patronage of the Marshal of the West Pomeranian Voivodeship. Przelewice Gardens also offer a range of attractions and services, including garden tours, a restaurant, conference rooms and guest rooms. Finisher medals; an event connected with culture and education; the opportunity to take part in a summer edition in beautiful gardens.

name: Kresowe Trail #8
description: Kresowe Trail #8 is a 10 km race taking place on July 26, 2026, in Chełm. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic trail course designed for runners of varying experience levels. The organizers encourage participants to use training plans tailored to their individual levels to help them prepare optimally for the race. The event is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl race calendar, a platform that supports runners in their development and in organizing races.
course_highlights: A 10 km trail course
Scenic areas of Chełm in the Lublin Voivodeship
A course suited to runners of varying experience levels
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to runners’ VDOT levels and supported by experts. The platform TreningBiegacza.pl offers the option to manage the race listing and collaborate on marketing. Participants can look forward to attractive trail routes, and the event is part of a series of trail races in the region. More information about dates and locations is available on the series’ homepage.

Participants can choose from a range of distances, from 1 km to a full marathon, making the festival appealing to runners of varying abilities. The course passes through charming scenery, offering both challenges and beautiful views. The event takes place in July, when typical summer weather brings temperatures of around 25°C and sunny skies.

Picturesque areas of Szczawno-Zdrój

The race is part of the Turčianska Running League 2025 and is open to various age categories for men and women. The organizers are BS TATRAN Turany, the town of Turany and LK NÁDEJ Turany. The race offers a challenge for runners who enjoy demanding mountain terrain.

Race in the mountain areas of Turany - Šútovo - Zajacová

name: Zlatý maraton Emila Zátopka
description: The Emil Zátopek Golden Marathon is part of Zátopek’s Golden Week, a series of running races held in Plzeň in honour of Emil Zátopek’s Olympic victories. The main marathon takes place on 27 July and also offers accompanying races, including a half marathon, marathon and half-marathon relays, and a 10.5 km road race. The start is in the afternoon in Štruncovy sady and the surrounding area, with a varied programme and categories for men, women, and young people. The race is known for its tradition, high-quality organisation, and welcoming atmosphere for all runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Plzeň, in Štruncovy sady and the surrounding area
Options to enter the marathon, half marathon, relays, and shorter races
Categories for all age groups, including young people

The race offers several distances, online registration, technical and medical support, and has a capacity of approximately 1,000 participants.

description: The Holger Nothacker Memorial Run is a long-established running event in support of the Schömberg Children’s Hospital. The event offers three distances for different groups of runners: a 3-kilometre course for beginners and school students, a 5.4-kilometre loop for recreational runners, and a challenging 10-kilometre loop with 148 metres of elevation gain for ambitious endurance athletes. The course runs around Schömberg and offers a sporting challenge in the region. Staff from the children’s hospital support the event and provide refreshments and drinks.

10-kilometre loop around Schömberg with 148 metres of elevation gain
additional: The event is supported by staff from the Schömberg Children’s Hospital, who provide refreshments and drinks along the course. It is open to runners of all ages and ability levels, with a particular focus on community and charity.

description: Tempo Makers Osmička is a regular running race in Plzeň, held along the Úslava River. The field is limited to 75 starters, making for a small-scale, relaxed event. The start and finish are at the same location, with parking nearby. After the race, the top finishers are announced and a raffle is held.

The course is certified, and the 10 km race offers the opportunity to achieve the qualifying time for the Czech Championships. After the race, enjoy a relaxed atmosphere, refreshments, and awards for the top runners.

Bag storage is available in the organizers’ tent. A post-race prize draw offers prizes such as free entry to the next race, a massage voucher, and more. The course is suitable for runners of all levels, from beginners to professionals. First-place finishers in the categories receive prizes worth 103,000 Kč. The races are part of a series of running events in Prague.

name: 43. Flora-Westfalica Marathon
description: The Flora-Westfalica Marathon in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a private marathon run held in accordance with the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large laps of 6.10 km each, for a total of 42.7 km, and is marked with arrows or barrier tape depending on the weather. The event emphasizes self-sufficiency, as runners pass their cars after each lap. Marathon times are recorded using a hand stopwatch, and a certificate is sent by email. Participants must be at least 18 years old. There is no entry fee, but a voluntary donation of €5 is requested.

Register by email no later than 6 p.m. on the day before the event, providing first name, last name, year of birth, and club. Participation is at your own risk; a liability waiver applies. Marathon times are recorded using a hand stopwatch; the ultramarathon has external timekeeping, with a photo as proof. Participants who stop the clock for drink breaks will be disqualified. Course: 7 laps of 6.10 km; ultra: 8 laps of 6.25 km; no showers; toilet 150 m away; participants must be at least 18; registration by 6 p.m. on the day before the event.

The event takes place at Bienwaldstadion and attracts ambitious ultrarunners looking to test their endurance and mental strength.

Registration via Race Result; late entries accepted up to one hour before the start.

name: Krkonošská 50

description: Krkonošská 50 is a traditional trail race held in the picturesque setting of Krkonoše National Park, starting in Špindlerův Mlýn. The race offers a challenging 50 km course with 1,784 metres of elevation gain, following marked paths and mountain trails. The field is limited to 300 runners, and the race is divided into several age categories for both men and women. The organizers emphasize environmental responsibility and safety, including a requirement to carry a mobile phone and a ban on littering outside refreshment stations.

Refreshment stations at 13, 18, 27, 33 and 39 km, and at the finish

Runners may switch from the long course to the short course after notifying the checkpoint at Svatý Petr – Hotel Horal. The route is marked with black arrows on a yellow background only at junctions and turns. A mobile phone is mandatory equipment for all runners.
