description: The Berounka running series in Karlštejn is a community trail race held in the beautiful natural surroundings of Autokemp Karlštejn. The route crosses fields, meadows and forests to the Malá Amerika quarry, continues along the red-marked St. James’ Way to Karlštejn Castle, and finishes with a downhill run to the finish line. The race offers a friendly atmosphere, a marked route, refreshments and a place to store belongings. Each participant receives a race number, and the top finishers in each category receive diplomas and medals.
course_highlights: The route crosses fields, meadows and forests to the Malá Amerika quarry
It continues along the red-marked St. James’ Way to Karlštejn Castle
The route finishes with a downhill run towards the finish line
additional: The route is marked with red-and-white ribbons and red arrows on the ground. Refreshments and a place to store belongings are available on site. The top three finishers in each category receive diplomas and medals. The recommended latest arrival time is 17:45. Race number, refreshments, storage for belongings, start by 17:45, marked route, online or on-site registration available.

name: BWM Sommerlochlauf
location: Steinheim an der Murr, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The BWM Sommerlochlauf takes place on August 4, 2026, in Steinheim an der Murr. It is a 10 km race especially suited to runners who love a fast pace. The flat, fast course through Steinheim offers ideal conditions for achieving personal bests. Its friendly organization and lively atmosphere make it a popular weekday event where running enthusiasts can test their fitness together.
course_highlights: Flat and fast 10 km course
Route through Steinheim an der Murr in the Bottwartal
Ideal terrain for ambitious athletes and recreational runners
additional: The race takes place during the cooler evening hours, offering pleasant running conditions during the holiday season. The event is organized by the Bottwartal-Marathon team, which ensures a first-class race experience. 10 km race, evening event, ideal for personal bests, friendly organization, in Steinheim an der Murr

name: Rozdělovský čtvrtmaratón
location: Kladno-Rozdělov, Kladno, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Rozdělov Quarter Marathon is a running race organized by Maratón klub Kladno and held in Kladno-Rozdělov. The club focuses on endurance running and organizing races in the region. The race offers runners of all levels the opportunity to test themselves on a quarter-marathon course in the pleasant surroundings of the Central Bohemian Region. The event is part of the club’s running calendar and supports the running community around Kladno.
course_highlights: A quarter-marathon course in Kladno-Rozdělov
Organized by Maratón klub Kladno, which focuses on endurance running
The race is part of the regional running calendar
additional: The race takes place on a Wednesday or Thursday in the first half of August, starting at 18:00. The route follows forest trails. The event has an intimate atmosphere, and participant numbers are growing.

name: Berglauf zur Schuhbräualm
description: The 41st Berglauf zur Schuhbräualm is a challenging mountain race taking place on 5 August 2026 in Raubling. The course covers 7.5 kilometres with an elevation gain of around 678 metres. The race starts at 19:00 and offers runners a challenging mountain route. The event is aimed at mountain-running enthusiasts looking for a sporting challenge in a natural setting.
course_highlights: 7.5 km course
678 metres of elevation gain
Very challenging mountain terrain
additional: Start and finish are provided for all competitions; exact location details require RUNME Premium. Accommodation is available near the start and finish. The race starts in Großholzhausen, with parking, changing facilities and clothing transport. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a festive atmosphere, with a raffle and commemorative gifts. Early registration is recommended.

name: Krčský lomcovák
description: Krčský lomcovák is a traditional running race held in Krčský les in Prague 4. The race offers a 5 km route starting near the Velký altán, suitable for both men and women, with different start times. The event is part of a sports and fun afternoon in Nové Roztyly Park, where participants and families with children can try various activities such as slacklining, sack races and disc golf. The race is organized by Krčák žije magazine, which covers activities and news in and around Krčský les.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through Krčský les
Start near the Velký altán
Mostly forest terrain with natural features
additional: Men start at 18:30, and women start half an hour earlier. The start is near the Velký altán. The event is part of a sports and fun afternoon in Nové Roztyly Park, with accompanying activities for families with children. The race is open to all age groups, offers various running disciplines and is part of a community sports day in Prague 4.

name: 6. Bärenkopplauf
description: The Bärenkopplauf is a challenging mountain and trail run in the Rhine-Westerwald Nature Park. It follows the premium hiking route “WällerTour Bärenkopp” over approximately 11 km, with around 360 m of ascent and 260 m of descent. The run takes place on the first Friday in August from 18:00, with staggered wave starts. The course is divided into two halves: the first is technically challenging, with trails and steep climbs; the second is predominantly downhill and scenic. A mountain prize is awarded to the fastest man and woman at the Bärenkopp cross. The event is organised by VfL Waldbreitbach and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, refreshments and transponder timing.
course_highlights: 11 km course with +360/-260 m of elevation on the WällerTour Bärenkopp
The first half is a challenging trail and mountain run, with steep climbs and technical sections
The second half is a scenic run on a predominantly downhill course
additional: Staggered wave starts take place between 18:00 and 18:30, with 20 participants per wave. After registration closes, race numbers are assigned based on the submitted 10 km time: the fastest runners start first, and late registrants start in the final wave. There are two water stations at 3.3 km and 7 km. The course is permanently marked and includes steep, sometimes narrow trails with steps and wooden bridges; extra care is advised in wet conditions. Race-number collection and bag drop-off are at the schoolyard of the Realschule plus. Timing uses disposable transponders attached to race numbers. Finish refreshments include water, tea and energy drinks. Parking is available near the start and finish; if you park near the finish, you can jog approximately 1 km to the start as a warm-up. Online registration is open until 3 August 2026; late registration is available until 6 August 2026. No showers are available. The event also includes the Bärchenlauf and other activities.

name: Heimat- und Schützenfestlauf
description: The Zerbst Local Heritage and Marksmen’s Festival Run takes place in the palace gardens of Zerbst/Anhalt and offers flat, varied routes on a 1.5 km loop combining paths and roads, with the start and finish in front of the town hall. The event is open to children, teenagers and adults, with distances ranging from 1.5 km to 9 km. Its friendly, family atmosphere and the opportunity to compete in different age groups and teams make it a popular event as part of the Local Heritage and Marksmen’s Festival.
course_highlights: Flat 1.5 km loop in the Zerbst palace gardens
Start and finish in front of the town hall
Sections on paths and roads
additional: Parking at Gartenstraße 21 (for navigation systems, enter Gartenstraße 26). Changing and shower facilities are available at the gym of the “An der Stadtmauer” primary school (approx. 500 m from the town hall). Certificates for the top three finishers in each age group. Trophy for the running group with the most participants (club, company or school; excluding the event organizers). No refunds for non-participation. Participants must be fit to compete. By registering, participants consent to the storage and publication of competition-related data and images in accordance with the EU GDPR. Race distances: 1.5 km, 3 km, 4.5 km and 9 km; online registration; run in the palace gardens; start times and further details on the official website.

name: Berglauf
description: TuS Ovenhausen 1924 e.V. warmly invites you to the mountain run in Höxter, featuring a challenging course with varied terrain. The event includes a children’s mountain run of approx. 1 km and a main race of approx. 3.2 km with a steady climb and an elevation gain of about 170 metres. The course starts on the sports field and runs over grass, paved paths, meadow trails, and narrow gravel and forest paths to the finish in the forest. This long-standing running event welcomes runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Children’s mountain run of approx. 1 km with 50 m of elevation gain on a narrow gravel/forest path
Main race of approx. 3.2 km with a steady 170 m climb over paved paths and meadow trails
Start and finish on the sports field, with varied surfaces
additional: After the main race, runners return to the sports field by jogging gently or by car. The children’s mountain run starts on the sports field, with approx. 150 m of flat grass followed by paved and forest paths. The event is organised by TuS Ovenhausen 1924 e.V. It takes place in typical August weather, with temperatures around 25°C and occasional rain. Registration is via the official website; details are available in a PDF file.

name: Gifhorner Friedhofslauf
location: Ev.-luth. Friedhof St. Nicolai, Gifhorn, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The Gifhorn Cemetery Run is a special event held at the St. Nicolai Protestant Lutheran Cemetery in Gifhorn. Runners can choose between 4- and 8-kilometre courses. After the run, participants can enjoy a relaxed get-together with a barbecue and drinks beneath the apple trees. Traditionally held in the evening, the event combines physical activity with a laid-back atmosphere in a historic setting.
course_highlights: 4- and 8-kilometre routes around the cemetery grounds
A relaxed get-together with a barbecue and drinks beneath the apple trees
Direct connection to the Gifhorn Old Town Festival
additional: The run supports the Friedhofsmobil, a free transport service for seniors. After the run, participants can go straight to the Gifhorn Old Town Festival. Courses, registration, cemetery tours, refreshments, 2026 dates: 7 and 8 August.

name: Sparkassen-Festungslauf
location: Königstein vor der Festung Königstein, Saxony, Germany
description: The Sparkassen Fortress Run in Königstein is a summer-evening running adventure at one of Europe’s most architecturally and historically significant hilltop fortresses. The challenging 9.4-kilometre main course climbs 470 metres, with the final kilometres running across the fortress plateau and offering magnificent views of Saxon Switzerland and the Elbe. Alongside the main race, there is a 7.7 km course, as well as a mini run and an inclusive run, each 1.2 km long, on the fortress plateau. The event has been established for over 20 years and offers a special atmosphere, with the awards ceremony at sunset in the fortress market square.
course_highlights: Challenging, hilly course with 470 metres of elevation gain
Final 1.2 km on the Königstein Fortress plateau, with views of Saxon Switzerland and the Elbe
Starts in two waves at 18:20 and 18:30 from the Königstein Tourist Information Centre
additional: Race bib collection for the main races (9.4 km and 7.7 km) is at the start area by the Königstein Tourist Information Centre between 16:00 and 18:00. Race bibs for the mini run and inclusive run (1.2 km each) can be collected at the registration desk on the fortress plateau. The inclusive run is not wheelchair-accessible. The awards ceremony takes place in the fortress market square at sunset. Registration opens on 1 December 2025, including for the main races, children’s races and inclusive races. Detailed course information and participant details are available on the website.

name: Měřínský kros
description: Měřín Cross-Country is a traditional cross-country race through the beautiful Vysočina countryside. It features a 13 km main race over Dědkovská hora and a relaxed 8 km course suitable for recreational runners. Children aged 5 to 12 can take part in the Junior Cross obstacle race, with a giant bouncy castle also available. The race is timed using chip timing, and an evening volleyball tournament with refreshments takes place after the run. The start and finish are at the sports field behind the elementary school in Měřín, where parking, a baggage drop, toilets, changing rooms and showers are available.
course_highlights: The 13 km main course runs mostly on dirt and forest roads and trails (about 70%), with the remainder on paved sections in the village
The route crosses Dědkovská hora, with new views thanks to bark beetle damage
A small refreshment station along the route
additional: Junior Cross is a free obstacle race for children aged 5–12, with 700 m and 1,400 m courses. A giant bouncy castle is available after the race. Parking is available at Měřín Elementary School. On-site registration closes 20 minutes before the start. The entry fee includes a sausage and a drink. The race is limited to 100 runners. Participants race at their own risk; no insurance is provided. An evening volleyball tournament with refreshments takes place after the run. The course is mostly on dirt and forest roads, with a marked route; the race is limited to 100 runners. Children’s obstacle races are free, and an evening volleyball tournament takes place after the race.

name: Barvám Neutečeš Pardubice
description: Barvám Neutečeš is a colourful run in Pardubice offering two routes: 5 km and 1.5 km. The event isn’t about speed, but about joy, friendship and fun as participants make their way through colour zones where they are showered with colour. The run is suitable for all ages and is ideal for families, friends and individuals looking for a day full of colour, music and a great atmosphere. The event also includes a music programme and various fun activities.
course_highlights: 5 km route with 5 colour zones
1.5 km route with 3 colour zones and an interactive sports zone
Colour zones, music and fun activities along the route
additional: The event runs from 9:00 to 16:00 in Park Na Špici, Pardubice. The music programme features Pavel Calta and others. The event is charitable, and participants can contribute by purchasing a symbolic heart. There is an opportunity to enter an Instagram prize competition with prizes from partner STANLEY. The event offers BASIC and WOW race packs, and registration is available online and on site. It is suitable for team-building and charitable activities, with rules including paid entry fees and wearing a visible participant T-shirt.

name: Mořice Run
location: Mořice u Olomouce, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Mořice Run is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the picturesque village of Mořice near Olomouc. The race is part of a series of running events focused on fitness and performance running, organized by the club in central Moravia. Liga stovkařů is known for supporting regular running and endurance races, and Mořice Run gives runners of all levels the opportunity to enjoy a quality race atmosphere. The club also provides support and advice to runners who want to get started or improve their training.
course_highlights: An 8 km course on paved roads around the château in Mořice
A 1.5 km children's run as part of the event
A friendly atmosphere and facilities for competitors at the local venue
additional: The race takes place on August 8, 2026, as part of the Grand Prix of Endurance Runners of the Olomouc Region. Start at 9:00. Registration and further details are not specified.

name: Slatinická sedmička
location: Slatinice u Olomouce, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Slatinická sedmička is a 7 km charity run that follows mostly off-road routes around the village of Slatinice near Olomouc. The race is held in memory of Šárka Krčková and offers runners a pleasant route with a natural feel. The event is suitable for all runners who want to combine sport with supporting a good cause.
course_highlights: A 7 km route that is mostly off-road
Around the village of Slatinice near Olomouc
A charity run held in memory of Šárka Krčková
additional: The run is part of charitable activities supporting cancer care, and the event is linked to fundraising and support for local sport.

name: Vnorovská desítka
location: Vnorov, Vnorovy, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: platba přes bankovní účet, ceny nejsou explicitně uvedeny
description: Vnorovská Desítka is a popular 10 km running race held every August in the village of Vnorovy. It is part of the Moravian-Slovak Running Cup and attracts more than 200 runners from various countries, including Czech elites and African runners. The course follows a closed asphalt loop with minimal elevation gain, with both the start and finish by the elementary school. The race has a lively atmosphere thanks to the large crowds and high number of participants; nearly 700 runners take part across all categories.
course_highlights: 4 × 2.5 km course on an asphalt road with minimal elevation gain
Closed loop with traffic excluded
Start and finish by the elementary school in Vnorovy
additional: Online registration is open until 6 August; registration on race day is not possible. The main race is timed using AMB chip technology. Women and men over 70 run a shorter 2 × 2.5 km course. The main race awards ceremony will take place at the Ajax pub grounds in Lidéřovice. Race bibs for runners starting at 17:00 are entered into a running raffle with valuable prizes. 4 × 2.5 km race on a closed loop, online registration until 6 August, start at 17:00, start and finish by the elementary school, spectator atmosphere and raffle

name: Dačického 12
location: GASK Kutná Hora, Kutná Hora, Czech Republic
description: Dačického 12 is a traditional cross-country running race in Kutná Hora, now being held for the 18th time. The race offers 12 km and 6.7 km courses, as well as shorter children’s races. The route runs through the scenic Vrchlice and Bylanka valleys, passing historic landmarks such as St. Barbara’s Church and the Cathedral of the Assumption of Our Lady and St. John the Baptist in Sedlec. The race is suitable for the general public and offers an enjoyable sporting experience in the beautiful surroundings of Kutná Hora.
course_highlights: The route runs through the Vrchlice and Bylanka valleys
The course passes between St. Barbara’s Church and the Cathedral in Sedlec
Refreshment station near the Holy Trinity
additional: Children’s races are divided into categories by year of birth, with course lengths ranging from 300 m to 1,000 m. The start is at the Jesuit College/GASK on Barborská Street. The route includes sections along Pod Hrádkem and Na Podskalí streets, past the Šafrán guesthouse and the Great Pond. After the race, custom badges can be ordered for clubs or events. The event includes a main 12 km course, a 6 km course, children’s races in four categories, online registration, and a start and finish at GASK Kutná Hora. The event also features music and supports the Světluška charity collection.

name: 16. Piesauer Glasmacherlauf
description: The 16th Piesauer Glasmacherlauf takes place on 1 August 2026 in Piesau, Thuringia. The event offers 2 km races for children and a 10 km race for adults, as well as a 10 km Nordic walking competition on forest paths. It is part of the Sparkassen-Cup and the TLV Running and Nordic Walking Cup, and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with changing and shower facilities and refreshments on site. Trophies and awards are presented to the fastest runners and by age group.
course_highlights: 2 km children's race
10 km main race exclusively on forest paths
10 km Nordic walking with poles; running is prohibited
additional: Changing, washing and shower facilities are available. Food, drinks and cake are available for purchase on site. Trophies go to the fastest runners on each course (places 1–3 in each gender category), with awards for the top three in each age group. Team classification for the 10 km race, based on the 2 fastest women or 3 fastest men from a club. Forest paths, team classification, trophies for the fastest on each course, awards, registration until 29.07.2026

name: Frontrun - Janus Queer Games 2026
organizer: Janus Queer Games / SC Janus e.V.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 17 Euro pro Person bei online Anmeldung

description: The Frontrun is an inclusive running event held as part of the Janus Queer Games 2026 in Cologne, welcoming runners of all genders. Events include a 5 km run, a 10 km run, and a 5 km partner run. The start and finish are on the Jahnwiesen beneath a large rainbow. The course is clearly marked and supported by encouraging course marshals. The event values community, diversity, and the joy of sport in an open and supportive environment.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the Jahnwiesen beneath a large rainbow
5 km loop for the shorter runs; 2 loops for the 10 km run
Alphabetically marked course with friendly course marshals
additional: Race bibs can be collected until 11:30 a.m.; group warm-up at 11:45 a.m. Manual timekeeping with +/- 3 seconds’ precision. Free water stations during the run; after the run, fruit and a cake buffet are available for donations benefiting Anyway e.V. There are no age-group rankings; rankings are in the female, male, and all-genders categories. The 5 km partner run is ranked in the All Gender category. Race-day registration is possible if places are available. The course is flat and runs on the Jahnwiesen. Registration is available online and on the event day, with refreshments and rankings in several categories.

name: Güttersbacher Volkslauf 2026
description: The Güttersbach Volkslauf will take place for the 29th time on August 8, 2026, and is an established event on the running calendars of Hesse and the Odenwald. The event is known for excellent organization, a great atmosphere and a smooth-running day. The courses wind through the beautiful countryside around Mossautal and offer a challenge for runners of all ability levels. The start and finish are in the village center at the community hall, where food and drink are also available for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Start and finish area in the village center at the community hall
Challenging courses set in the beautiful Odenwald countryside
Aid stations along the course and free use of the outdoor swimming pool for participants
additional: Late registration is possible on the event day until 30 minutes before the start of the race. The first 200 pre-registered participants receive a T-shirt, as do the first 80 registered schoolchildren. The first-place finisher in each age group (except walking) receives a trophy, a non-cash prize and a certificate. Every finisher receives an exclusive finisher medal. Participants can use the Güttersbach outdoor swimming pool free of charge. Food and drink will be provided for runners and spectators. Participants receive medals, and T-shirts are available for early registrants. Parking is limited and road closures may be in effect. Families receive free admission to the outdoor swimming pool after the race.

name: Monschau-Marathon warm-up
description: The Monschau Marathon is a scenic race through the picturesque Eifel region, attracting runners from all over the world. The course passes through historic old-town areas, green meadows and woodland, as well as challenging climbs that offer a sporting challenge. Its warm, welcoming atmosphere is shaped by dedicated volunteers and an international field of runners. Alongside the classic marathon, ultra distances and relay events are also offered, making this a special running experience.
course_highlights: Start in Konzen, with a gentle downhill section and an ideal warm-up loop
Monschau’s historic old town and natural scenery along the Rur
The legendary climb through the Holderbach Valley, gaining 160 metres
additional: Late entries are possible online and in person through and including 09.08.2026; a late-entry fee applies. There are 12 refreshment stations along the course. Medical services, doctors, a massage team and sports physiotherapists will be on site. Camping is available on the Am Windrad sports field (10 € per day/person; children free). Showers and changing facilities are in the sports hall at Konzen Primary School. Pacemakers for various target times are available. A finisher’s medal is included; a technical shirt can be booked for an additional fee when registering online by 31 July. Several race distances are offered, including the marathon, ultra, relay and walking events. Participant services include refreshments, medals, finisher shirts, massage services and an after-run party. Registration is subject to deadlines, and personalised bibs are available.

name: Oettinger Stadtlauf
description: The Oettingen City Run takes place on August 8, 2026, as part of the “Summer in the City” festival in downtown Oettingen. The event offers races for children, teenagers and adults, with timing for the main race, the youth races and the walking event. The routes lead through the historic city centre and offer a sporting challenge for all age groups. The event is organised by TSV Oettingen, Running, Triathlon and Athletics Department, and is a popular local race with a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Route through the historic city centre of Oettingen
Children’s race: approx. 0.8 km, untimed
Main race and walking event: approx. 7 km, timed
additional: Children’s race is untimed; registration is available through the Oettingen holiday programme; late registration is possible on the event day for an additional fee; medals and drinks for the children’s and youth races; prizes for the first three boys and girls in the youth race; walking event and main race are timed; staggered start times from 16:00. The route is mostly flat, on asphalt and cobblestones; start and finish at the market square; open to all physically fit participants; city championship for Oettingen residents.

name: Residenzfestlauf Kirchheimbolanden
location: Innenstadt von Kirchheimbolanden, Kirchheimbolanden, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Residenzfestlauf Kirchheimbolanden is a traditional race through the town centre of Kirchheimbolanden. The event gives runners the opportunity to take part in a popular local sporting event in a beautiful urban setting. The route runs through the town centre and offers varied urban scenery. The event is organised by LLG Wonnegau, known for its dedicated running community.
course_highlights: Race through the town centre of Kirchheimbolanden
Varied urban running route
Traditional local sporting event
additional: Registration for the LLG Summer Runs 2026 is open. LLG Wonnegau also offers an end-of-year celebration for club members and non-members. The LLG Wonnegau office is located in Monsheim. Routes in the town-centre area; start and finish at the car park; free parking; showers and changing facilities in the school gym.

name: 1. Hannover Backyard Ultra
description: The 1st Hannover Backyard Ultra takes place on August 8, 2026, in the Georgengarten in Hanover. In this unique race format, runners complete a 6.706 km lap every hour until only one person remains. The event offers a special challenge for endurance runners and promotes community and sporting ambition in the Hanover region.
course_highlights: A 6.706 km lap every hour
Start and finish in the Georgengarten, Hanover-Herrenhausen
Run until only one person remains
additional: The race takes place in the Georgengarten in Hanover. Registration is via an external platform, and participation is limited to 70 runners. The event emphasizes community and experience in ultrarunning.

name: Volkslauf um den Mittelpunkt Deutschlands
location: Krebecker Sportplatz, Krebeck, Lower Saxony, Germany
price_range: Erwachsene €8,00, Schüler bis 16 Jahre €3,00, Kinder bis 6 Jahre kostenlos
description: The Volkslauf around the Geographic Center of Germany is a sporting running event on August 8, 2026, in Krebeck, suitable for all ages and for both competitive and recreational runners. The event offers various running and walking distances with changing elevation profiles, some of which are challenging, on paved or asphalt paths. The races start and finish at the Krebeck sports field, and all participants receive fruit and drinks during and after the competition. Medals and prizes are awarded to the top finishers, and there are age-group rankings as well as medical support on site.
course_highlights: Changing elevation profiles, some of which are challenging
Paved or asphalt running and walking routes
Aid stations on the 5.7 km and 10.4 km routes
additional: Late entries and changes to registrations are possible until approximately 30 minutes before the respective start, for a €2.00 processing fee. Showers, toilets, and changing rooms are available in the sports hall. Participation is at your own risk. Photos and video footage will be taken on event day and may be published. Routes on paved or asphalt paths, fruit and drinks provided, showers, toilets, medical support, online registration available, start and finish at the Krebeck sports field

name: Volkslauf um den Auesee
description: The 5th race in the Mühlenkreis Series takes place on 08.08.2026 at ATSV Espelkamp by Lake Aue. The course follows paved and partly asphalted paths around Lake Aue and is almost flat, with no significant elevation changes. The race is part of a popular regional series with a total of nine events. It is organized by ATSV Espelkamp, which provides a well-organized event and a pleasant race atmosphere.
course_highlights: Loop around Lake Aue
Paved and partly asphalted paths
No significant elevation changes
additional: The race is part of the Mühlenkreis Series, which comprises nine races in the region. The series awards ceremony takes place in Espelkamp on 14.11.2026. The race offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with refreshments and medical services on site. Registration is by email, and the course follows asphalt and forest paths. The event is also part of a regional running series.

name: niedamiRUN - Ultramaraton Sudecki
organizer: Stowarzyszenie NIEDAMIRÓW WIOSKA CUDÓW i Foxter Sport
description: NiedamiRUN is a Sudetes ultramarathon taking place on 8 August 2026 in Niedamirów, a picturesque village situated at the crossroads of three cultures. Runners can choose from four distances: 10K, 20K, 50K and 100K, which run through the Karkonosze Mountains, the Lubawka Gate and the Bóbr Valley, offering challenging elevation gains and beautiful views. The routes pass historical and natural attractions of the region, with the start and finish in Niedamirów. It is a unique opportunity to take on a Sudetes ultra surrounded by wild nature and local culture.
course_highlights: Routes run through the Karkonosze Mountains, the Lubawka Gate and the Bóbr Valley
Elevation gain of up to 3,970 m on the 100K distance
Views of Lake Bukówka and historic roadside crucifixes along the 10K route
additional: The participant limit for each distance is 100. Distance changes are possible until 4 August 2026, with an additional fee or no refund of the difference. The routes have aid stations and time limits. The start and finish are at the former WOP Border Guard post and sports field in Niedamirów. Routes can be downloaded to Garmin, Suunto, Polar and other GPS devices. Routes through the Karkonosze Mountains and the Sudetes, time limits from 3 to 18.5 hours, various distances, activities for children and local treats at the finish.

name: 10 Śliwicka Dyszka
description: Śliwicka Dyszka is an annual race organized by the Biegające Śliwice association, promoting an active lifestyle and running. The event takes place in the picturesque area around Śliwice, offering participants an attractive 10 km route. The race attracts both recreational and experienced runners, creating a friendly atmosphere of sporting competition and community spirit.
course_highlights: 10 km route
Picturesque surroundings of Śliwice
Organized by the local Biegające Śliwice association
additional: The event is part of the local running calendar. Details about registration and the route are not readily available on the website, but it is a popular sporting event in the region.

name: 12 eXtremalny Bieg Godzinny
description: The 12th eXtremalny Bieg Godzinny is a unique one-hour race held in Koszalin on a challenging, approximately 1-kilometre loop through forest terrain, with significant elevation changes and varied surfaces, including sandy sections. Participants compete to complete as many laps as possible within one hour, and must start their final lap before the hour is up. The race promotes sport, recreation, volunteering and active tourism. At the finish, runners receive an exceptionally heavy medal and a drink. The event is organised by the “SFX” Association and Rozbiegany Koszalin.
course_highlights: An approximately 1 km loop through challenging, hilly forest terrain
Varied surfaces, including sandy sections
Significant elevation changes and demanding terrain
additional: Electronic chip timing; medical support provided by the PCK Koszalin Rescue Group; each participant receives a race bib with safety pins; a drink at the finish; the race begins with a mass start; participants must complete their final lap if they started it before the one-hour limit; open to people aged 18 and over with a current medical certificate or a signed declaration. Registration opens on 6 June 2025. The event takes place on sandy terrain in Koszalin. Participant limit. Participants can cover 1 km within the hour.

name: Bieg Zbója
description: Bieg Zbója is a mountain race held in the picturesque area of Bielsko-Biała, on trails around the summit of Klimczok. The race takes its name from the legend of the bandit Klimczok, who formed a gang that helped the poor and left traces behind in the form of a mountain hut and a cave. The course is demanding, with significant elevation gain and technical climbs that test runners’ character and endurance. The event attracts runners from all over Poland, offering not only a sporting challenge but also a unique atmosphere and beautiful mountain views.
course_highlights: Mountain course with over 1,530 m of elevation gain over 25 km
Legendary climbs and sections requiring great endurance
The “Hilton” aid station, with a generous buffet along the course
additional: The race package includes a limited-edition running band and a neck gaiter in a color assigned to the distance. An extended package with a T-shirt and race-number belt is available for purchase. At the finish, runners receive a cast medal, a recovery meal, and a certificate of completion showing their time and place. The “Hilton” aid station offers a generous buffet along the course. Mountain race, limited distances, race packages with T-shirts and belts, certificates, medals, meals

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
location: Ogród Botaniczny UAM, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – Summer Edition is a cross-country race held in the picturesque UAM Botanical Garden in Poznań. The event is part of a series of races that have promoted running and the beauty of natural routes in Greater Poland since 2014. It attracts running enthusiasts who appreciate the aesthetics and character of cross-country routes. The alternative location is Lake Rusałka, just 500 metres from the Botanical Garden, offering additional scenic appeal.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the UAM Botanical Garden in Poznań
Picturesque natural surroundings
Alternative location by Lake Rusałka, 500 m from the start
additional: Race packets can be collected by an authorised person. The organiser places particular emphasis on the aesthetic qualities of the routes and the character of cross-country races. Trzymsie.pl is a partner of the autumn series. The alternative race location is Lake Rusałka, 500 metres from the UAM Botanical Garden. The 5 km route runs through parkland; online registration; participant limit: 500; start and finish in the UAM Botanical Garden. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and outdoor activity.

name: I Jura Night Dog Run
location: Klucze, Olkusz County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Jura Night Dog Run 10 km KOBIETA indywidualnie z pełnym pakietem

tiers.label: tier_2

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Jura Night Dog Run 10 km TEAM (co najmniej 1 kobieta lub 1 mężczyzna) z pełnym pakietem

tiers.description: Jura Night Dog Run 21 km KOBIETA półmaraton indywidualnie z pełnym pakietem

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Jura Night Dog Run 21 km MĘŻCZYZNA półmaraton indywidualnie z pełnym pakietem

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Jura Night Dog Run 21 km półmaraton TEAM (co najmniej 1 kobieta lub 1 mężczyzna) z pełnym pakietem

description: The Jura Night Dog Run is a night canicross race taking place on August 8, 2026, in Klucze, Poland. The event offers two main distances: 10 km and a 21 km half marathon, with the option to compete individually or as part of a team. The event is limited to 500 participants, creating an intimate atmosphere and a comfortable racing experience. The race is scheduled to start at 8:00 p.m., highlighting the unique experience of running with a dog at night.
course_highlights: Night canicross race
10 km and 21 km (half marathon) routes
Limited to 500 participants
additional: The number of participants is limited to 500. Competitors can participate individually or as part of a team. Team participation is available, training plans are available, and the event promotes activity with dogs.

name: Złota Dycha
description: The 6th Złota Dycha is a road race held in the heart of Złotoryja, the oldest city in Poland. The event is scheduled for August 8, 2026, combining sporting excitement with the European Gold Panning Championships. The race offers two distances—5 and 10 kilometers—and participants can compete on the city’s picturesque streets. It is organized by the Złotoryja City Office and the Złotoryja Cultural Centre, with support from the local running community.
course_highlights: A road race through the picturesque streets of the oldest city in Poland
Two distances to choose from: 5 and 10 kilometers
An event held alongside the European Gold Panning Championships
additional: The participant limit is 300, split between the 5 km and 10 km distances. Starts are scheduled for Saturday morning at 9:00 and 10:00. The race is part of the European Gold Panning Championships celebrations, and participants will receive special medals and trophies. 10 km and 5 km races, Złotoryja city center, the center closed to traffic on race day, registration at the Złotoryja Cultural Centre, transfer of race packages, training sessions from the time of registration

name: Východniarska

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Poplatok za štart jedného účastníka je 70 EUR

description: Východniarska is a mountain ultra trail and long-distance hike for individuals, following on from the popular Východniarska Stovka. The route runs through the eastern part of the Slovak Ore Mountains, mostly across the Volovské Mountains, and offers a challenging 85 km run with +4200 m of elevation gain. The start is in Kluknava and the finish in Kysak, with a 22-hour time limit. The event is open to the public for participants aged 18 and over, and requires registration and payment of the entry fee.
course_highlights: 85 km route with +4200 m of elevation gain
Crossing the Volovské Mountains in the Slovak Ore Mountains
Checkpoints and aid stations along the route, with time limits
additional: Race-pack collection is on Thursday in Košice from 16:00 to 20:00, and on Friday, 7 August 2026, from 18:00 to 23:00 at Kaštieľ hotela Biela dáma Čierny rytier. Before the start, participants can sleep in the gym at the Primary School in Kluknava; bring your own sleeping mat and sleeping bag. A drop bag can be sent to the aid station at Vyšný Klátov (56 km). Drop bags must be handed in on race morning by 8:30 at the gym of the Primary School in Kluknava. Kluknava is accessible by train and bus; arriving by train in Margecany and taking a bus from there to Kluknava is recommended. The course is 85 km long, with a 22-hour time limit. Mandatory equipment includes a thermal blanket, GPS device and personal cup, among other items. Drop bags can be sent to the 56 km point. The start is in Kluknava and the finish in Kysak. Participants can sleep in the gym, and travel to Kluknava is possible by train or bus.

name: Hámorská dvadsiatka
location: Obecný úrad Remetské Hámre, Remetské Hámre, Slovakia
description: Hámorská dvadsiatka is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Remetské Hámre. Despite the cancellation of the last two editions due to the Covid-19 pandemic, the organizers are looking forward to bringing the event back and welcoming a large turnout of runners. The race takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Vihorlat Mountains, which offer attractive routes for sports enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The route passes through the natural surroundings of the Vihorlat Mountains
Beautiful views and tourist attractions in the area
Organized by the municipality of Remetské Hámre, with a long-standing tradition

name: Rajecký maratón
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajec Marathon is a traditional running race organized by the Rajec Marathon Club, held in the picturesque surroundings of Rajec and the surrounding area. Runners can expect a challenging course with elevation gain and beautiful natural scenery that will test their endurance and fitness. The event has a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere, reflected in its side events and the hospitality at the finish. In addition to the marathon, a half marathon, relay, cross duathlon, and the popular Rajec Borošovec are also held. The Borošovec is a cross-country classic with more than 200 meters of elevation gain.
course_highlights: A course with more than 200 meters of elevation gain
The Rajec Borošovec cross-country classic, 14.1 km long
Natural scenery in Rajec and the surrounding area
additional: The Rajec Borošovec is part of the events that kick off the running season in the Rajec Valley. After the races, participants are served goulash and homemade cakes. The Rajec Borošovec course is dry and fast, with possible obstacles such as fallen trees. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and also attracts younger runners and juniors.

name: Rajecký In-line polmaratón
description: The Rajecký In-line Half Marathon is a competitive inline skating race held in Rajec at SNP Square. The course runs from Rajec to the village of Čičmany and back, with the finish at the marathon turnaround point in Čičmany. Skaters must wear a helmet throughout the race and return their rented timing chips at the finish. The organizer provides refreshments, changing rooms and showers, as well as free transport back to Rajec for inline skaters. The final finish straight is reserved for runners, so participants must follow the organizer’s rules.
course_highlights: The course runs from Rajec to Čičmany and back
The race is held in the right-hand lane
The final finish straight on the square in Rajec is reserved for runners
additional: Skaters must wear a helmet during the race and attach their race number to their right thigh. Rented timing chips must be returned at the finish. Refreshments (sandwiches) are provided at the square in Rajec upon presentation of the race number. Changing rooms and showers are in the gym on Lipová Street. A minibus for transporting personal belongings will be at the start area from 8:00 to 8:30. Inline skaters must take the free bus back from Čičmany to Rajec and must not enter the start and finish area designated for runners, or they risk disqualification. The race is limited to 120 participants; registration depends on the payment date and includes different fees depending on the registration period.

name: Rajecká štafeta
description: The Rajecká Relay is a running event organized by Maratón klub Rajec and held at SNP Square in Rajec. It is a relay race that forms part of the Rajecký Marathon and gives athletes the opportunity to compete in teams. The organizer provides bib numbers, timekeeping, and full support for participants during the race. The event is suitable for runners of different ability levels and promotes community spirit and enthusiasm for sport in the region.
course_highlights: Relay categories for men, women, and mixed teams
Held at SNP Square in Rajec, in the scenic surroundings of Žilina
Registration is subject to a fee, with prices ranging from 90 to 120 euros depending on the registration date
additional: The organizer processes participants’ personal data in accordance with the GDPR and personal data protection legislation. Registration takes place online via the organizer’s website. Participants receive their bib numbers at check-in, and their results are published on the official websites and sports portals. Relay race; registration fees increase closer to the event date; terrain details not specified.

name: Rajecký detský beh
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajecký Children’s Run is a running event organized by Maratón klub Rajec, held at SNP Square in Rajec. It is aimed at children and underage runners, with an emphasis on safety and responsibility: a parent or legal guardian must sign for them to participate. The event is part of a wider running program in Rajec and gives young runners the opportunity to experience the atmosphere of a race in a pleasant urban setting.
course_highlights: The race takes place at SNP Square in Rajec
For children and underage runners
Safety is supported by a parent or legal guardian’s signature
additional: Children and underage participants must bring a signed declaration from a parent or legal guardian. Participation will not be permitted without it.

name: Černovírský kros
location: Černovír u Ústí nad Orlicí, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: Černovír Cross is a traditional running race held in Černovír near Ústí nad Orlicí. Its routes cross hilly terrain and combine paved and unpaved forest and field paths with asphalt. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including children and adults. The start and registration are at the Sokol hall in Černovír, and the main race covers a distance of up to 5 km. The atmosphere is friendly, and the event is popular with both local and visiting runners.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain with a mix of paved and unpaved forest and field paths
Mixed surfaces, including asphalt
A route of up to 5 km, suitable for children and adults
additional: On-site registration from 9:00. Children's race starts at 10:00; main race at 11:30. Entry fee: 100 Kč for adults, 20 Kč for children. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup. The route is up to 5 km and has varied surfaces. The event offers various distances, from 0.08 km to the main 4.85 km race, and is part of a sports series supporting running in the region.

name: Běh na Krušnou horu
description: The Run to Krušná hora is a traditional uphill race held in the village of Hudlice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race starts at the end of Dolejší Street by the forest and follows a wide forest gravel path to the Máminka lookout tower at the summit of Krušná hora. The course is 2.7 km long with 190 metres of elevation gain, offering runners a challenging but beautiful experience in nature. The race is organised by TOBI Sport s.r.o. and is part of the Czech Running Club.
course_highlights: 2.7 km course
Run along a wide forest gravel path
Finish at the Máminka lookout tower on the summit of Krušná hora, with 190 m of elevation gain
additional: The race starts near the village of Hudlice, 9 km from Beroun, at a crossroads by the forest. It is organised by TOBI Sport s.r.o.; the contact person is Pavel Kundrát. The course is certified, and the race is part of the Czech Running Club. The event includes trail running in the forest, registration is available on the KOPEC website, and the race is suitable for runners of different levels.

name: Brunnenlauf
location: Iburg-Stadion, Bad Driburg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Bad Driburg Brunnenlauf is an annual running event organized by TV "Jahn" Bad Driburg e.V., welcoming runners of all ages. The challenging course runs along the Sachsenring, through the spa gardens and the town, and finishes at Iburg Stadium. The event emphasizes fairness and sportsmanship and uses timing with a reusable chip. Registration is online only; late entries are not possible.
course_highlights: Challenging out-and-back course with hills
The course runs along the Sachsenring, through the spa gardens and the town
Finish at Iburg Stadium, Bad Driburg
additional: Timing is provided exclusively with the reusable race result chip, worn on the foot using a chip strap. The chip deposit is 10€ and is refunded when the chip is returned. Late entries are not possible. Participants may be disqualified for violations of fairness and good conduct. Online registration only; no late entries. Participation from age 18; children and school students participate free of charge.

name: Karbener Stadtlauf
price_range: zwischen 2,00€ und 15,00€ je nach Lauf und Jahr
description: The Karben City Run is a traditional running event held every year in Karben at Günter-Reutzel-Weg. The event offers runners of different age groups and ability levels the opportunity to compete on varied courses through the town and surrounding area. An accompanying program provides entertainment and a chance to socialize. The run is a popular event for the whole family and promotes local sporting spirit.
course_highlights: Course through the town of Karben
Finish at Günter-Reutzel-Weg
Varied running courses for different age groups
additional: An accompanying program is part of the event. Registration is via the separate registration page. The event is organized by Karbener Sportverein. Various race disciplines; online registration is open until approximately 60 minutes before the start; late registration is available for a fee.

name: Monschau Marathon
description: The Monschau Marathon takes place from August 7 to 9, 2026, in the picturesque Eifel landscape and offers runners a challenging course with varied terrain. In addition to the classic marathon, the event includes ultra distances (K56 and K70), a Genuss-Marathon, and relay races. The course passes through historic old-town areas, green meadows, and forests, with impressive views, all in a warm, family-friendly atmosphere. The Monschau Marathon is an international running event offering great variety and a strong sense of community among participants, volunteers, and sponsors.
course_highlights: Start in Konzen, with a slight downhill and a fast opening loop
Monschau’s historic old town and nature along the Rur
The legendary Holderbachtal climb, gaining 160 meters in elevation
additional: 12 aid stations along the marathon course. Relay exchange points in Widdau and Kalterherberg. Medical services, doctors, a massage team, and sports physiotherapists on site. Camping is available on the Am Windrad sports field (10 euros per day/person; children free). Showers and changing rooms are available in the Konzen primary school gym. Late registrations are possible online and on site until 09.08.2026, with a late registration fee. Pacemakers for various target times. Finisher medal included; technical shirt available for an additional fee when registering online by July 31. Guided bike tour on Saturday with no entry fee. Multiple race distances, including the marathon, ultras (K56, K70), relay, and walking; event in the Eifel with aid stations, start and exchange zones; focus on community and experiencing nature.

name: Rother Kirchweihlauf
description: The Rother Kirchweihlauf is a traditional running event organized by TSG 08 Roth. The race takes place annually in Roth and offers runners a great opportunity to get active and experience a sense of community. Despite occasional weather-related challenges, the event is held with great dedication. It welcomes runners of all ability levels and is a fixture on the regional running calendar.
course_highlights: A traditional race in Roth with regional significance
An outdoor event with a varied course
Part of the Middle Franconian 10 km Championships (when held)
additional: Certificates can be downloaded online after the race. The event is organized by TSG 08 Roth, which also offers other sports activities and classes. The event takes place on a flat, paved course, with various race categories for all ages and ability levels. Results and photos are available.

name: Stefan-Andres-Freundschaftslauf
organizer: Lauftreff Schweich e.V. / LLG Wustweiler e.V.
description: The Stefan-Andres Friendship Run is a challenging trail run through the vineyards of Schweich on the Moselle, held without a competitive element. The focus is on the joy of running and sharing the experience. Three distances are offered—12, 18 and 26 kilometres—each with several metres of elevation gain and well-marked routes. After the run, participants can get together over soft drinks at the Haus des Sports, which also has changing rooms and showers.
course_highlights: Challenging trail run through the vineyards of Schweich
Three distances: 12 km (approx. 340 m elevation gain), 18 km (approx. 490 m), 26 km (approx. 720 m)
Refreshment stations on all routes, with traditional schnapps at the final station
additional: This is a non-competitive friendship run with no entry fees, held as a charity run in support of the “Region der Lebensretter” emergency responder app project. The start and finish are in Schweich: the start is at Niedeprümer Hof, and the finish is at the Haus des Sports, which has changing rooms and showers. At Schweicher Annaberg, at “Lagenliebe”, each participant is offered a glass of wine. After the run, participants can relax together over soft drinks. The run is usually held in August, when the weather is typically sunny and around 25°C. Refreshment stations offer wine and schnapps tastings, and after the run everyone celebrates together at the Haus des Sports. The event supports the “Region der Lebensretter” app, which alerts nearby first responders.

name: Diekseelauf
description: The Sparkassen Diekseelauf is a traditional fun run around Lake Dieksee in Bad Malente-Gremsmühlen. The event takes place on August 9, 2026, and offers runners an attractive course with modern transponder-based timing. Participants can conveniently view and download their results and certificates online. The race is organized by TSV Malente and is open to runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: Loop course around Lake Dieksee
Timing with transponder and race number
Start and finish at the Dieksee promenade
additional: Timing is provided using a race number with an integrated transponder. The race number must be worn clearly visible at the front. Results and certificates are available online and can be downloaded after the race. Terrain along Lake Dieksee, on-site registration available, start and finish area at the Dieksee promenade, refreshments in the finish area

name: Münzwaldlauf (36. Volkslauf)
description: The Münzwaldlauf is a traditional fun run in Lichtenau, Baden-Württemberg, taking place for the 36th time in 2026. The event offers various distances, from 0.25 km for Bambini runners to the 10 km main race. The routes mainly follow forest and meadow paths and are distinguished by their natural setting, making the run especially appealing to families and nature lovers. Alongside the short children’s races, there are also more challenging sections, such as the 5.2 km trail run. The event is an established local running event with a long history.
course_highlights: Routes along forest and meadow paths
A natural setting, not a typical city-street race
A range of distances from 0.25 km to 10 km
additional: Typical August weather, with an average temperature of 25 °C and mostly sunny days. The event takes place in Lichtenau, with routes around Lichtenau-Ulm. Several distances are available, including 0.25 km, 0.5 km, 5.2 km, 7 km and 10 km. The event takes place on 9 August 2026, with various distances for all age groups. The natural terrain is suitable for both recreational runners and trail enthusiasts.

name: Oberpfalzmeisterschaft Waldlauf 2026
location: Familienbrauerei Jacob, Bodenwöhr, Schwandorf, Bavaria, Germany
description: The 2026 Upper Palatinate Cross-Country Championship takes place on 9 August 2026 at Familienbrauerei Jacob in Bodenwöhr. The event is hosted by the Upper Palatinate district and organized by TV Burglengenfeld. The cross-country race offers runners an attractive course in a natural setting and is part of the Hammerseelauf. The championship is open to various age groups, from youth to masters, and promises exciting races in the Upper Palatinate region.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in a natural setting
Venue: Familienbrauerei Jacob in Bodenwöhr
Part of the Hammerseelauf and featuring a regional championship
additional: Registration closes on 2 August 2026; categories for youth, seniors and masters; venue: Familienbrauerei Jacob in Bodenwöhr.

name: v-office-Europalauf
location: Neustadt in Holstein, Ostholstein, Schleswig-Holstein, Germany
description: The 39th vOffice Europalauf on 09 August 2026 is an international race connecting the Baltic Sea resorts of Neustadt, Pelzerhaken and Rettin along the half-marathon route. The course offers magnificent views across Neustädter Bucht and returns to Neustadt along the beach promenade, parallel to the beach. In addition to the half marathon, there are races over 10 km, 5 km and 2.5 km, as well as a Bambini race. The event is a popular sporting event in the region and is organised by TSV Neustadt.
course_highlights: The half-marathon route connects Neustadt, Pelzerhaken and Rettin
Magnificent views across Neustädter Bucht
The route returns to Neustadt along the beach promenade, parallel to the beach
additional: The start and finish for all races are at Seebrückenvorplatz, Neustadt-Pelzerhaken. Race pack collection begins at 7:00 at Kurzentrum Soziales Genesungswerk (SGW), Dünenweg 1-3, opposite the Tourist Information office. The schedule includes several start times for different distances and disciplines (half marathon, 10 km Windberglauf, 5 km Promenadenlauf, 5 km Nordic walking, 2.5 km Leuchtturmlauf, 900 m Bambini race). Award ceremonies begin at 10:30. The event ends at 13:00. The event features various race distances, including a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and children’s races. The race takes place on 9 August 2026 and offers a beautiful setting and a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Kielce – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the aesthetic qualities of the proposed locations. The organizers aim to promote running and provide participants with a unique sporting and nature experience. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes
The aesthetic qualities of the proposed locations
Organized with passion since 2014
additional: The event takes place on August 9, 2026, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle among residents of Kielce and the surrounding area.

name: Chudy Wawrzyniec
description: Chudy Wawrzyniec is a mountain ultramarathon held in the Żywiec Beskids, offering six distances from 3 km to 100 km. The event takes place on 8–9 August 2026, starting in Rajcza and finishing in Ujsoły. The courses are technically demanding, with significant elevation gain and beautiful views, and the 80 km race is the venue for the Polish Mountain Running Championships over the Ultra Distance. The organizers provide professional race organization and aid stations along the course, as well as the option to transfer a race entry.
course_highlights: Courses with significant elevation gain: 50 km (+2,525 m), 80 km (+3,825 m), 100 km (+5,115 m)
Technically demanding mountain trails with numerous ascents and descents
Start in Rajcza, finish in Ujsoły, with routes passing through Wielka Rycerzowa, Pilsko and other peaks
additional: The time limit for the 50/80/100 km distances is 16 hours. On the 100 km course, runners must reach the checkpoint at Trzy Kopce within a maximum of 11 h 30 min to continue. Aid stations are provided along the courses (3 on the 100 km, 2 on the 80 km, 1 on the 50 km), with no disposable cups. Race entries can be transferred to another participant from 1 April to 31 July. Registration for the event opens on 11 December 2025. The race takes place in the Żywiec Beskids, with several distances available and sections involving mountain climbing. The time limit for finishing is 16 hours.

name: VII Charytatywny Bieg świętego Dominika
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Bieg Świętego Dominika w Ustroniu
description: The St. Dominic’s International Run is a prestigious annual running event held in Gdańsk since 1994 and an integral part of St. Dominic’s Fair. This unique sporting event attracts both recreational and professional runners, offering races over various distances in the picturesque city centre, on a course that loops around Neptune. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and social integration, while creating an unforgettable atmosphere with thousands of spectators cheering and a rich programme of accompanying activities. It is valued by local authorities and sponsors, underscoring its stature and importance in Poland’s running calendar.
course_highlights: A 1,412 m course in central Gdańsk, looping around Neptune
A loop along Długi Targ, Powroźnicza, Kotwiczników and other streets
More than 25,000 spectators cheering along the course at each race
additional: The event includes four races under the slogan “Chase St. Dominic”, including a prologue open to all fair visitors, a race for people with disabilities, and classic women’s and men’s races over 5 km and 10 km. The course is a closed loop, allowing spectators to follow the competition closely. The event is accompanied by a rich programme of attractions, including partner stands, presentations, shows and concerts at St. Dominic’s Fair. A charity race over 10 km and 5 km, with entry fees donated to charitable causes, included in the USTRON GRAND PRIX.

name: XI Bieg Lucka

price_tiers.distance: Bieg rekreacyjny i Nordic Walking 5,2 km

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata startowa za Biegi Dzieci wynosi 10 zł

description: The 11th Bieg Lucka is a memorial race commemorating Lucjan Chorąży, taking place on 9 August 2026 in Skawinki near Lanckorona. The event includes a main race of approximately 14 km, a recreational run and Nordic Walking over approximately 5.2 km, and shorter races for children. The main race route leads up Mount Chełm, and participants can get together for refreshments after the event. The race has a family-friendly, mountain-running character and aims to honor Lucjan, who was passionate about the mountains and running.
course_highlights: The approximately 14 km main race route leads up Mount Chełm
A recreational run and Nordic Walking over approximately 5.2 km
Children’s races on the sports field and meadows near the race office
additional: Race number collection and additional on-site registration take place on race day from 9:00 to 11:00. The children’s races start at 10:30. Capacity: 270 participants for the main race, recreational run and Nordic Walking; children’s races have 80 online places and 30 places available on race day. If there are fewer than 5 participants in an age category, groups may be combined. The children’s race routes are laid out on the sports field and meadows near the race office. Refreshments will be provided for participants after the race. Registration is available online, and the event uses RFID timing. The participant limit is 270. The routes run around Skawinki and Lanckorona, and the event is part of local sporting traditions.

name: Bieg na Wielką Sowę
location: Ludwikowice Kłodzkie, Gmina Nowa Ruda, Poland

name: Beh na Kráľovu studňu
location: Motorest Javorina Lenartov, Lenartov, Bardejov, Slovakia
description: The Run to Kráľova studňa is a traditional uphill race held in the picturesque village of Lenartov, near the historic Kráľova studňa, a meeting place of three kings. The course passes through beautiful natural surroundings and offers a unique mountain-running experience, rich in history and views. The event is part of the local running league and attracts runners from across the region. The organizers create a friendly atmosphere and welcome all participants, regardless of ability.
course_highlights: An uphill race in mountainous terrain around Kráľova studňa
A historic meeting place of the Hungarian and Polish kings
Beautiful views and natural scenery around Lenartov
additional: The race is part of the East Slovak Uphill Running League. The event has a long tradition: the 14th edition was held in 2025 and the 13th in 2024. The atmosphere is friendly, and all runners are welcome, including the oldest participants. Refreshments and a cultural program are provided nearby after the race. The course includes asphalt, forest and mountain sections; registration is available online or on site. The event is part of the 2025 Easterners’ Uphill Running League.

name: Stezka mužů
description: Men’s Trail is a 3 km road race that is part of the SABZO series and will take place on 12 August 2026 in Prague 4. The race is suitable for the general public and offers an opportunity to spend time actively in a friendly atmosphere. Although the main focus is on running, the event is part of a larger sports and social programme in the region. Come and compete, and enjoy a day full of exercise and fun.
course_highlights: 3 km road course
Part of the SABZO series
Friendly atmosphere and suitable for the general public

name: Nettetal-Lauf
distance_verbose: 50 Meilen, Marathon, Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 Meter
description: The Nettetal Run is a traditional road race held annually in mid-August in Ochtendung, Germany. The 2026 event offers a varied selection of distances from 3 km to 10 km, with longer distances also possible in other years. The course is officially measured, allowing results to be recognized in the German rankings. The race is supported by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and is listed in the laufen.de calendar.
course_highlights: Officially measured course
Road race in Ochtendung, Germany
A range of distances: 3 km, 5 km and 10 km
additional: Typical August weather: around 25 °C during the day and 14 °C at night, mostly sunny, with an average of 60 mm of precipitation. The start is in Ochtendung. The race is part of the German athletics calendar, with an official measured course suitable for competitions.

name: 6. Běh pro zdraví
location: Park B. Němcové, Karviná, Czech Republic
description: Běh pro zdraví is a charity series of seven runs held in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná. Each run offers a 3 km route that everyone can complete at their own pace. Proceeds from entry fees go to help people in need, giving the event purpose and added value. Check-in begins at 17:00 and the start is at 17:45 at Lodičky. Everyone is warmly invited to take part and support a good cause.
course_highlights: 3 km route in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park
Cycling path surface
Charity run with proceeds going to help people in need
additional: Check-in begins at 17:00, with the start at 17:45 at Lodičky. A series of seven runs, each covering 3 km. Proceeds from entry fees go to help people in need. Terrain: cycling path; Registration: check-in from 17:00, start at 17:45; Series of seven runs from March to August 2026

name: 15 Diecezjalna Pielgrzymka Biegowa Radom...
description: The 15th Diocesan Running Pilgrimage is a special running event organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association. The race follows a route from Radom to Częstochowa and combines a passion for sport with the spiritual dimension of a pilgrimage. It is not only a competition, but also a shared experience that attracts runners from different backgrounds. The event takes place on August 11–13, 2026, and is an important fixture in the region’s running calendar.
course_highlights: The route runs from Radom to Częstochowa
The event combines running with a pilgrimage of a spiritual nature
Organized by the local “Biegiem Radom!” Association
additional: The race takes place on August 11–13, 2026. Registration is available through the time-sport.pl platform. The event is a running pilgrimage, highlighting its unique spiritual dimension. Participation is limited to 40 pilgrims aged over 18. The entry fee includes meals, insurance, a medal, and a T-shirt, with overnight stays in tents and buildings.

name: 8. Wisent-RUN
location: Wisentgehege Springe, Springe, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Wisent-RUN is a popular race at Wisentgehege Springe, taking place for the eighth time on August 7, 2026. The event offers various race distances, including children’s races and timed competitions, set in a natural environment. With a family-friendly atmosphere and free admission to Wisentgehege from 15:00, the race is a sporting highlight for all ages. The event is organised by VfV Concordia Alvesrode e.V. and is known for its friendly atmosphere and dedicated volunteers.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Köhlerhütte in Wisentgehege Springe
Race routes through the natural surroundings of Wisentgehege
Children’s races with timing and an awards ceremony
additional: Free admission to Wisentgehege from 15:00. The 500 m children’s race “Frischlingsrennen” is untimed and open to children born in 2021 or later. The 1 km children’s race is timed and includes an awards ceremony for children born from 2016 to 2021. Ample parking is available. The event is open to everyone, with free admission for visitors. It offers an opportunity to explore the wildlife at Wisentgehege while getting active.

name: 24. Dammer Stadtlauf
description: The 24th Damme City Run is an evening road race through the center of Damme, organized by OSC Damme in cooperation with the City of Damme. The program includes three starts: a schoolchildren’s race, a general race for all participants, and the main evening race. After a two-year pandemic-related break, the race returns with an expected field of over 500 runners. The event is characterized by an open, local atmosphere, with on-site registration available, as runners fill the streets of the town center.
course_highlights: Evening road race through Damme city center
Three starts: schoolchildren’s race, general race, and main race
The course stays in the city center, with a lively atmosphere
additional: On-site registration is available, encouraging open, local participation. August weather is typically sunny, with temperatures between 14 and 25 °C. The event includes several categories, including children’s races and the main race, on a route through the city, with a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere.

name: 24. Knesebecker Einhornlauf
description: The Knesebecker Unicorn Run is a traditional running event in the Isenhagen region, held annually in August. The event gives runners of various ability levels the opportunity to test themselves on varied courses. Online registration is conveniently available via the RaceResult platform, where all results and certificates can also be accessed. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Wittingen and attracts numerous running enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Nordic walking option
Event held on the school grounds in Knesebeck
additional: Registration is online via RaceResult. Results and certificates are also available via RaceResult. The race takes place on Friday evening. Participant numbers are limited to 100; registration and results are available online; the event is held on the school grounds in Knesebeck.

name: 17. VSB Dresdner Nachtlauf
price_range: early bird price (specific amount not provided)
description: The VSB Dresden Night Run offers a beautifully illuminated course with views of the Dresden skyline. Torches and glow sticks create a special atmosphere. The 11.5 km course follows the Elbe to the Blue Wonder and returns along the Neustadt side of the river, while the 6.2 km course also runs along the Elbe and finishes via the Albert Bridge. Alongside the sporting experience, there are children’s races and a special team ranking for clubs and organizations. The event takes place at Heinz-Steyer-Stadion and is a highlight of the region’s running calendar.
course_highlights: 11.5 km course with views of the romantically illuminated Elbe Castles and the Blue Wonder
6.2 km course along the Elbe, returning via the Albert Bridge
Course illuminated by torches and glow sticks, with views of Dresden’s nighttime skyline
additional: Start times: 18:30 Bambini Run (400 m), 19:00 Children’s Run (1.8 km), 20:00 11.5 km Run, 22:15 6.2 km Run. Pacemakers for target times of 50, 60 and 70 minutes on the 11.5 km course. Team ranking with prize money for the clubs/organizations with the most participants. Cutoff times: 21:40 (11.5 km) and 23:15 (6.2 km). Night run, registration for 2026 open, event in Dresden, various race distances available

name: 35. Speller Sparkassen-Sommernachtslauf
description: The 35th Spelle Sparkassen Summer Night Run is a traditional race in Spelle, organised by SC Spelle-Venhaus. The event offers runners an appealing course in the beautiful surroundings of Wählehof. The race is suitable for all ages and ability levels and takes place in a relaxed atmosphere. Participants can look forward to a well-organised event with a family-friendly feel.
course_highlights: Course through the scenic surroundings of Wählehof
Well-marked routes over various distances
Varied paths combining paved and natural-surface sections
additional: The event takes place in the evening, making it a special summer night run. Results are available online, along with detailed directions. Course maps are available as PDFs, including routes for 5 km, 10 km and walking. The event is part of the EL CUP series, offers numerous categories for all age groups, and is known for its flat course and friendly atmosphere. After the race, participants can enjoy the summer evening with music and refreshments.

name: Reuter Run Boršov nad Vltavou
location: Kemp Poslední štace, Boršov nad Vltavou, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Reuter Run in Boršov nad Vltavou is a 12.5 km running race held on 15 August 2026 from 11:00 at Kemp Poslední štace. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and gives runners the chance to test themselves on an interesting course in the South Bohemian Region. It is organised by Zdeněk Richtr and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including registered Cup members and other runners. The course surface is not specified in detail, but the race is part of a long-running series with clear rules.
course_highlights: 12.5 km course
Start at Kemp Poslední štace, Boršov nad Vltavou
Part of the South Bohemian Running Cup
additional: Registration for the South Bohemian Running Cup requires payment of a membership fee of 250 Kč, valid for the entire Cup season. Registration is available online, with payment made by bank transfer and the runner’s name and year of birth included as the payment reference. For registrations made during the year, points from races are counted retroactively for a maximum of 3 months. The race includes trail and cross-country terrain, with the start and finish at Kemp Poslední štace; on-site registration is available until 10:00. The event also includes an 800 m children’s race.

name: Běžecký mítink Bohuňovice
location: Bohuňovice u Olomouce, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The running meet in Bohuňovice near Olomouc is a cross-country race, offering men a 12.2 km course and women a 6.1 km course. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners’ Grand Prix and attracts runners who enjoy challenging terrain. The meet is suitable for anyone who wants to test their strength in a natural setting with varied surfaces. The event is a traditional gathering for the region’s running community.
course_highlights: Cross-country terrain with varied surfaces
Course distance: 12.2 km for men and 6.1 km for women
Part of the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners’ Grand Prix
additional: The race is part of a series of running events in the region, offers the option to register and borrow running equipment, and attracts runners from a wide area.

name: 7 pohoří Šumava
description: The Trail Run Series 7 Mountains is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you across seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The races feature technical trails, epic views and a unique atmosphere that will test every runner’s strength, willpower and determination. Whether you are an experienced mountain runner or a beginner, 7 Mountains challenges you to conquer every route and become a legend. The Šumava race offers routes crossing the peaks of Špičák and Pacíř, passing glacial lakes and deep forests, with up to 900 m of elevation gain.
course_highlights: The route crosses the peaks of Špičák and Pacíř, with views of the glacial lakes Černé and Čertovo
Mostly natural terrain, with 900 m of elevation gain on the main 23.5 km course
An atmospheric race and technical trails prepared by mountain rescue service members
additional: The race time limit is 4 hours; after that, runners are marked as DNF. Participants can leave small items at the registration tent. Recommended gear includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Záchranka app. The entry fee includes a professionally marked course, race bib, chip timing, commemorative medal, refreshments on the course and at the finish, and use of the facilities at the start and finish area. The races include registration with chip timing, medals, refreshments and the option to take part in different distances in the beautiful surroundings of Šumava.

name: Jablonská osmička
location: Jablonné nad Orlicí, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: Jablonská osmička is a running race in Jablonné nad Orlicí, taking place on August 15, 2026. This fifth edition features an 8 km main race, children’s races, and a fun beer relay for teams of four. After the race, the program continues with a Food Festival and Jabloffest, featuring music and activities for children at the swimming pool grounds. The event is suitable for both competitive athletes and recreational runners, and includes a generous raffle and gift bags for registered participants.
course_highlights: An 8 km road course with gentle elevation changes
