A beer relay featuring a 100 m sprint and beer or non-alcoholic beer
Children’s races divided into three age categories
additional: Main race registration is open from 9:00 to 10:30, children’s races start at 10:15, the 8 km main race at 11:00, and the beer relay at 12:15. A T-shirt and gift bag are available only to those registered by 31.7.2026. The race commentator is biathlete Vlastimil Vávra. After the race, there is a generous raffle and an accompanying program including the Food Festival and Jabloffest. Registration by 31.7.2026; start and finish at the athletics track; T-shirts for registered participants; a generous raffle and gift bags.

name: Křivinský kros
description: Křivinský Kros is a running race held in Křivice, featuring a 7.5 km main course with 275 metres of elevation gain and an 800-metre children’s course. The race runs mostly along forest roads and trails through hilly terrain, making for a challenging and interesting run. Starts are staggered from 9:30 a.m., with children first, then juniors, and finally the main categories. The race is part of the Velká cena východních Čech series and is open to the general public, with a voluntary entry fee. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a short raffle for participants.
course_highlights: Main course: 7.5 km with 275 m of elevation gain
90% of the course runs along forest roads and trails
Hilly terrain on Křivina
additional: You can register on site before the race or in advance by email. The entry fee is voluntary. The start for all categories is about 150 m from the registration area. The course is marked with red-and-white plastic ribbons and white arrows on trees or stakes, or with white spray paint on the ground. The awards ceremony takes place after the race at approximately 11:30, followed by a raffle. Before the race, participants can join a group training session and run the main course. The race features hilly terrain, forest roads and trails, and is part of the Velká cena východních Čech series.

name: Schierker Sommerlauf
description: The Schierker Sommerlauf is a traditional race in the Harz Mountains, taking place for the 24th time on 8 August 2026. The event offers varied distances from 1 km to 16 km, running through the impressive landscape around Schierke. Runners can enjoy breathtaking views, a unique atmosphere and great support in the finish area at the Schierker Feuersteinarena. The race is part of the new Harzer Laufcup 2026 and is open to runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: Run on paved forest roads, with two laps for the 8 km main race
Breathtaking views of the Brocken and the Harz landscape
Start and finish at the Schierker Feuersteinarena, with a great atmosphere
additional: The start and finish are at the Schierker Feuersteinarena, which has changing rooms and showers. The course runs along paved forest roads. There is a refreshment point at the newly built toboggan run. Registration is online, with personalised race numbers for those who register in advance. Use of the showers is included in the entry fee. The event is part of the Harzer Laufcup 2026. Courses on paved forest roads, online registration, personalised race numbers, refreshments included, electronic timing, certificates and trophies for the winners.

name: Brohlbachtal-Lauf mit Halbmarathon und Walking
description: The 15th Brohlbachtal Run in Gamlen offers runners and walkers a varied sporting event on a flat course. The event includes races over 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon (21.0975 km), as well as walking and Nordic walking distances. Children’s and youth races are also offered. The finish is the same for all events; the exact finish address is shown with RUNME Premium.
course_highlights: Flat course
Events for running, walking and Nordic walking
Distances from 5 km to the half marathon
additional: The finish is the same for all events. Children’s and youth races are also part of the event. The exact finish address is only visible with RUNME Premium. The event takes place at the Gamlen community hall and is known for its friendly atmosphere and diverse running events for all age groups.

name: Dülmener Wasserlauf mit 5 km Walking
location: Sportzentrum Nord, Dülmen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 11th Dülmen Water Run with 5 km walking takes place on August 15, 2026, in Dülmen. The event gives runners and walkers the opportunity to participate in 5 km and 10 km races. It takes place at Sportzentrum Nord and promises pleasant conditions in typical August weather, with temperatures around 25 °C and mostly sunny skies. Please note that the exact event details should be verified with the organizer before registering.
course_highlights: Distances: 5 km and 10 km
Venue: Sportzentrum Nord, Dülmen
Typical August weather, around 25 °C and mostly sunny
additional: Please check the event details with the organizer before registering. The event offers a team competition in which four runners start together, and places special emphasis on water and environmental protection. It is family-friendly and open to runners of all abilities.

name: Gederner Stadtlauf
location: Lauterbacher Straße, Gedern, Wetteraukreis, Hesse, Germany
description: The 24th Gedern City Run on August 15, 2026, offers runners of all ages a special running experience through Gedern’s historic old town. With distances of 500 m, 1,500 m, 5 km and 10 km, there is an option for children, teenagers, beginners and ambitious runners alike. The longer distances follow a varied loop course of four 2.5-kilometre laps, combining sporting challenge with history. The route follows historic paths such as the Eisenpfad, Basaltweg, Barbarossaweg and Fürstenweg, with a notable climb to Schlossberg and a section through the castle gardens. The start and finish are on Lauterbacher Straße near Kirchplatz. Changing facilities are available at Gedern gymnasium.
course_highlights: Gedern’s historic old town
Four 2.5 km laps on a varied loop course
Sections along the Eisenpfad, Basaltweg, Barbarossaweg and Fürstenweg, with a climb to Schlossberg
additional: Start and finish on Lauterbacher Straße near Kirchplatz. Changing facilities at Gedern gymnasium (Franseckystraße 32A). The longer distances consist of four 2.5 km laps. The route includes a paved castle courtyard and the castle gardens. The event is organized by the Top-Time timing team. Distances for children, teenagers and adults; start/finish on Lauterbacher Straße; changing facilities at Gedern gymnasium.

name: Hambacher Volkslauf
description: The Hambach People’s Run takes place on 15 August 2026 in Niederzier-Hambach and offers races over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon. There are also 10 km walking and Nordic walking routes. The courses are measured by the DLV, and the event is part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels and looks forward to a large turnout.
course_highlights: Measured courses over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon
10 km walking and Nordic walking routes
Part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup
additional: Registration is now open via the website. Course maps and the race information are available as PDFs. The event is part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup. Courses measured, online registration, part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup

name: 100MeilenBerlin - Der Mauerweglauf
description: The 100MeilenBerlin – Der Mauerweglauf is a historically significant ultramarathon that follows the route of the former Berlin Wall around West Berlin. The approximately 161-kilometre course runs mostly on paved paths, but also includes trail-like and sometimes uneven sections. The start and finish are at Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahnsportpark in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg. The race commemorates the victims of Germany’s division and is held annually, with the direction changing from year to year.
course_highlights: The course follows the former East German border strip around West Berlin
The direction changes annually; in 2026, the race runs counterclockwise
26 aid stations spaced 5 to 9 kilometres apart, including 3 changeover points with drop bag facilities
additional: Start and finish at Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahnsportpark; there is no parking on site, so using public transport is recommended. The race bib serves as a public transport ticket. Time limit: 30 hours for individual runners and 27 hours for 2-person relay teams. Shuttle buses to the start run on the morning of race day. Three changeover points offer drop bag facilities. There are 26 aid stations, with mostly vegan refreshments. Timing uses transponders from race result germany. Soup is served at the finish, and all finishers are invited to the awards ceremony. The race starts at Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahnsportpark in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg at 6:00 a.m. and finishes the following day at 12:00 p.m. The race is known for its historical significance, varied course and support from numerous aid stations. It is a demanding ultramarathon that challenges participants’ physical and mental strength.

name: 2. Backyard Ultra-Marathon Tharandter Wald
description: The 2nd Backyard Ultra Marathon in the Tharandter Wald is organised by SC Freital e.V. and takes place in one of Saxony’s most beautiful forest regions. The course consists of a 6.7 km loop, which runs mainly on forest trails and is run in both clockwise and counterclockwise directions. The start and finish area is at the Jugendfreizeithof Grillenburg. A total of 100 starting places are available, and registration is via RaceResult.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop, mainly on forest trails
The direction changes: counterclockwise at first, clockwise at night, then counterclockwise again during the day
Start and finish area at the Jugendfreizeithof Grillenburg
additional: The first 8 laps are run counterclockwise; from 18:00 (night course), clockwise; and from 6:00 (day course), counterclockwise again. There are 100 starting places in total. Registration is via RaceResult. Maximum 100 participants; registration via RaceResult; accommodation at the Jugendfreizeithof Grillenburg; race format: hourly laps until only one runner remains.

name: Charity Mega Run
description: The Charity Mega Run in Bingen am Rhein is a unique running event with a mission: to get people moving—for themselves, for others and for a good cause. The event offers four distances from 5 km to 52 km along Germany’s most beautiful running route, with magnificent views of the Rhine and vineyards. In addition to the race, there is a pasta party on the eve of the event and a varied program for runners and spectators. The event takes place on 15 August 2026 at the Rhine-Nahe Corner in Bingen and combines sporting ambition with social commitment.
course_highlights: Running route with views of the Rhine and vineyards
Four distances: 5 km, 10 km, 26 km and 52 km
Six to nine refreshment stations, depending on the distance
additional: Race bib collection and late registration are available from 7:30 a.m. on race day or on 14 August at the pasta party. There are six to nine refreshment stations, depending on the distance. Parking nearby is free during the school holidays. The event features an accompanying program and prizes for the top three finishers, as well as trophies for the winners (women and men) of each distance. All participants receive a race bag with goodies. The event includes refreshment stations, a program with music and children’s activities, and a pasta party on 14 August. Registration is available online, with payment options on site including PayPal and card payment. Prizes are awarded to the best runners, and there are sponsors.

name: Altenlotheimer Dorflauf
description: The Altenlotheim Village Run is a great opportunity to get active together. With courses for children and longer distances, there is something for the whole family. The event takes place on 15 August 2026 in Altenlotheim and invites runners of all ages to experience the local running community.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 1 km to 21 km
Family-friendly running event with courses for children
Starts in Altenlotheim amid beautiful surroundings
additional: The weather in August is usually sunny, with an average temperature of 25 °C and 60 mm of precipitation. The event welcomes all age groups and offers a range of distances. In addition to the main races, there are children’s and Bambini races, relay races, and Nordic walking. The event is well organized and offers a great opportunity for community and exercise.

name: Hüttenfelder Volksbankkerwelauf
description: The Hüttenfelder Volksbank Kerwe Run is a long-standing running event with a history spanning more than 30 years. It offers runners of all abilities an appealing opportunity to test their endurance and have fun together. There are three races: a half marathon (21.1 km), a 10 km race, and a 2 km children’s race. The course runs mostly through shady woodland and provides a very flat, pleasant running environment, with historic ammunition bunkers as a special highlight. The start and finish are at the Hüttenfeld allotment gardens, and the award ceremony takes place after the races at the Kerweplatz by the Bürgerhaus.
course_highlights: A very flat course, mostly through woodland
Start and finish at the Hüttenfeld allotment gardens
Historic decommissioned ammunition bunkers along the course
additional: Water and isotonic drink stations in the woodland and at the start/finish. On-site late registration is not possible. Award ceremony at 18:30 at the Kerweplatz by the Bürgerhaus. The 2 km children’s race follows paved farm tracks and the shady edge of the forest. The course passes through woodland and historic bunker complexes, with water and drink stations. Open to participants aged 7 and over. On-site registration from 13:00; start times vary by age group.

name: Josef Kaderhandt-Waldlauf Plus
price_range: Waldlauf (20 km und 20 km Plus): 20€, 7,8 km Lauf: 5€
description: The 42nd Josef Kaderhandt Forest Run in Menden is a long-established running event organized by Marathon-Club Menden e.V. The route follows paved forest paths through the scenic Sauerland and offers a sporting challenge with demanding sections. In addition to the classic 20 km forest run, runners can take part in the 20 km Plus Marathon and extend their distance to an ultramarathon of up to 50 km by completing additional laps. The start is in Waldemei near the Kolping Memorial Stone, and the finish is at Bürgerbad Leitmecke. There is also a 7.8 km fun run for runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: Paved forest paths in the Sauerland
A challenging and scenic route
Variable ultramarathon distance of up to 50 km over multiple laps
additional: The time limit for all events is 6 hours. The start is in Waldemei, Menden, and the finish is at Bürgerbad Leitmecke (new). Parking areas are clearly marked; please do not park in residential areas or on Gisbert-Kranz Straße. The course consists of 3 laps for 20 km, 4 or more laps (up to a maximum of 8) for the 20 km Plus and ultramarathon, and a 7.8 km fun run. Participants can register online; late registration is available in cash on the event day. The route follows paved forest paths, starting in Waldemei and finishing at Bürgerbad Leitmecke. This is the 42nd edition of the event.

name: Kelheimer Volksfestlauf
location: Festgelände Am Pflegerspitz, Kelheim, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Kelheim Volksfest Run is a traditional running event held every August at the festival grounds at Am Pflegerspitz in Kelheim. It offers different distances for various age groups, including 2 km for students, 5 km for young people, and 10 km for adults. The event is a regular fixture in the City of Kelheim’s calendar and is organised by run & bike Kelheim e.V. Race packets are available from 12:00 on the day of the event in the beer tent, and the awards ceremony takes place there after the races.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the festival grounds at Am Pflegerspitz
Distances: 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km depending on age group
Part of the Kelheim District Running Cup
additional: Race packet distribution in the beer tent from 12:00 until 30 minutes before the start. Awards ceremony at approximately 16:30 in the Volksfest beer tent. Timing is provided by Race Result. Online registration is available until 14.08.2026; after that, late registration is only possible on the day of the event. Participation as part of the 2026 District Running Cup; results and registration are available online.

name: Städtedreieckslauf
description: The Städtedreieckslauf is a traditional race through the three towns of Burglengenfeld, Teublitz and Maxhütte-Haidhof. The 16th edition of this event takes place on 15 August 2026, bringing together numerous runners across five competition categories for a good cause. The course is flat and runs along farm tracks and public roads; traffic regulations must be observed. The race is a great opportunity to experience the region through sport and cross the finish line together.
course_highlights: Flat running routes
Farm tracks and public roads
Route through three towns: Burglengenfeld, Teublitz and Maxhütte-Haidhof
additional: The course is flat and runs along farm tracks and public roads. Traffic regulations must be observed. Charity event; registration opens on 1 June; donations go to non-profit clubs; celebrate together after the race at the Bürgerfest.

name: Städtelauf Plauen - Hof
description: The Plauen–Hof City Run is a traditional race in the Saxon-Bavarian border region, celebrating its 35th edition in 2026. The route connects the Vogtland metropolis of Plauen with the Bavarian city of Hof and attracts runners and Nordic walkers from the region and beyond. The race is known for its sporting atmosphere and the cross-border partnership between the cities. Every year, numerous participants take part in ideal running weather and enjoy the scenic route.
course_highlights: A traditional race route in the Saxon-Bavarian border region
Connects Plauen and Hof
A popular route for runners and Nordic walkers
additional: Various distances, Nordic walking available, scenic route, shared finish in Hof

name: WoKiMen
location: Parc de Tarbes, Altenkirchen, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: WoKiMen is a family-friendly day of running in Parc de Tarbes in Altenkirchen, offering a range of running and activity options for children, adults, teams, walkers, Nordic walkers, and even dog owners. Children can run 0.5 km or 2 km, while adults can choose between 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km. The TeamChallenge is a relay with three 1 km legs. Alongside the races, there is a varied program featuring yoga, Zumbathlon, and an adventure course. The day ends with a relaxed Chill & Grill event featuring Nepalese specialties, Italian wood-fired pizza, popcorn, coffee, and cake.
course_highlights: Family-friendly event with races for children and adults
A range of race distances from 0.5 km to a half marathon (21 km)
Additional program featuring yoga, Zumbathlon, and an adventure course in the park
additional: The 5 km course is especially open to walkers, Nordic walkers, and runners with dogs. The TeamChallenge consists of three 1 km relay legs. The event takes place in Parc de Tarbes and offers a family atmosphere, ending with a Chill & Grill. It is open to everyone, with activities for children and adults, team relays, dog runs, and a varied supporting program. It is aimed at families, recreational runners, and community groups.

name: 303 Maraton Antoniego Fili
organizer: Polska Fabryka Wodomomierzy i Ciepłomierzy FILA Sp. z o.o.
description: The 303 Antoni Fili Marathon is a marathon taking place in Sztum, Mazowieckie, Poland, scheduled for August 15, 2026. Participants have access to a professionally prepared training plan tailored to different experience levels to help them prepare optimally for race day. The event is an excellent opportunity for runners looking to take on the marathon distance in picturesque surroundings. The organizers provide expert support and access to a platform for managing race information.
course_highlights: Marathon distance of 42.195 km
Held in the picturesque area of Sztum
Online training plans available
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level and including detailed instructions and expert support. The organizers encourage using the platform to manage the race profile and marketing partnerships, helping increase reach and professionally manage event information. The event also includes other local races, such as the Sztumski Bieg Solidarności. Details about registration and participation are available on the organizer’s website.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that showcase the aesthetic qualities of the locations. The organizers aim to promote running and provide participants with a unique sporting and scenic experience. Join this friendly, dynamic running event.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes
The aesthetic qualities of the locations
Organized with a passion for running since 2014
additional: Registration for the summer editions is available via the entry form. The organizers place particular emphasis on cross-country running and the aesthetics of the routes. Trzymsie.pl is the partner of the autumn Botaniczna Piątka series. Cross-country race; registration for the summer edition via the entry form

name: XII Rozłaziński Bieg po radość z życia
XXXIII Bieg im. Marszałka Józefa Piłsudskiego
Chminianskonovovesský beh
location: Futbalové ihrisko OŠK Chminianska Nová Ves, Chminianska Nová Ves, Prešov, Slovakia
organizer: ThLic. Mgr. Pavol Uličný a obec Chminianska Nova Ves
description: The Chminianska Nová Ves Run is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Chminianska Nová Ves and ThLic. Mgr. Pavol Uličný. The race takes place at the OŠK Chminianska Nová Ves football field in the Prešov District and offers categories for men, women, and youth across different age groups. It is a community sporting event that promotes an active lifestyle and enthusiasm for sport in the region.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the OŠK Chminianska Nová Ves football field
Categories for men, women, and youth, grouped by age
Organized by the municipality of Chminianska Nová Ves and Pavol Uličný
additional: The race takes place on August 15, 2026, with the start at 18:00. Registration is on site. Refreshments and food will be provided after the race.

name: Runica Nevoľné
location: Futbalové ihrisko, Nevoľné, Žiar nad Hronom, Slovakia
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT o.z.
description: Runica Nevoľné is a running event held at the football pitch in Nevoľné, Žiar nad Hronom District. The race offers a unique experience in the heart of Slovakia, where runners can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere and high-quality organization. The course is suitable for runners of different levels, and the event is part of the Marathon Tour running series. The organizers welcome all runners who want to enjoy a sporting experience in a beautiful setting.
course_highlights: The course runs around the football pitch in Nevoľné
Pleasant surroundings in Žiar nad Hronom District
Part of the Marathon Tour running series
additional: Registration is available online and in person. The event takes place at the football pitch in Nevoľné and also includes a mountain trail and a children's run.

name: Štafetový beh 345 km od Tatier k Dunaju Jasná – Bratislava
location: Demänovská dolina, Jasná, Liptovský Mikuláš, Žilina, Slovakia
description: The Tatras to the Danube Relay is the largest relay race in Slovakia, with a course length of 345 km. Teams of 6 or 9 to 12 members start in Jasná in the Low Tatras and run nonstop through day and night, finishing on the Danube embankment in Bratislava. The course is predominantly paved, with approximately 3,990 metres of elevation gain and 4,870 metres of descent. Runners complete 36 stages of varying length and difficulty; in a 12-member team, each runner completes three stages. The race challenges team spirit and endurance amid Slovakia’s beautiful scenery.
course_highlights: Course length: 346 km, with approximately +3,990 m of elevation gain and -4,870 m of descent
95% of the course is paved, on class II and III roads
36 stages, 7 to 12 km long, with varying levels of difficulty
additional: Teams may have 6 or 9 to 12 members. In a 12-member team, each runner completes 3 stages, with 8–10 hours between stages, covering approximately 30 km in total over two days. The organizer provides detailed stage information, including maps, elevation profiles and written descriptions for runners and support vehicles. The team captain registers as a user and represents the entire team. The race runs nonstop, day and night. The course is 345 km, starts in Demänovská Valley, is a nonstop team relay, and takes place in August 2026. Registration is divided by category and deadline, with different fees.

name: Žebrácká pětadvacítka
description: Žebrácká Pětadvacítka is a traditional August road race along the roads and forest trails of the Křivoklátsko region, held every year in Žebrák. It offers several distances, including the main 25 km race, a 10 km run, a 10 km walk and a family run for children. The main race starts at 10:00 by the Primary School in Žebrák, while the senior categories start at 9:00. The race is held as part of the celebrations of the St. Lawrence Pilgrimage and offers a wonderful sporting experience amid the picturesque scenery of the Křivoklátsko region.
course_highlights: Roads and forest trails in the Křivoklátsko region
Two loops around the housing estate in Žebrák at the start of the race
Family run with activities for children on a 1.1 km loop
additional: The family run with Točníček and Žebráček starts on race day at 9:30 in front of the Primary School in Žebrák. The course is 1.1 km long, open to all ages, with a reward for children at the finish. The main 25 km race starts at 10:00, and the senior categories start at 9:00. After the main race starts, a non-competitive 10 km run and a 10 km walk with poles (Nordic walking) also start. Online registration, with the option to order a T-shirt, closes on 20 July 2025. On-site registration is available on race day from 7:30 to 9:15 at the Cultural Club. The race is suitable for all age groups, including children and families, and is open to participants in all weather, with dogs and with wheelchair access.

name: MFB MarathOn LABE
description: MarathOn LABE is a traditional international running festival held in Kolín and Poděbrady, offering a marathon, half marathon, 10 km race, and other running events. The marathon course is an out-and-back route on forest, paved, and asphalt roads, certified by the Czech Athletics Federation (ČAS). The event is suitable for runners of all levels and features a rich program, including children’s races and family entertainment. It is organized by the Kolínská 14 association, which has supported an active and healthy lifestyle in the region since 2011.
course_highlights: Out-and-back marathon course certified by the Czech Athletics Federation (ČAS)
Terrain: forest trails, paved roads, asphalt
Marathon starts on Kmoch Island in Kolín
additional: The marathon starts at 8:00 on Kmoch Island in Kolín. The half marathon and 10 km race start at 9:00 (the half marathon in Poděbrady and the 10 km race in Kolín). Free overnight camping in your own tent is available at the amphitheatre. Bus transport from Kolín to the half-marathon start in Poděbrady is provided by reservation. Check-in and race-bib collection take place on Saturday and on Sunday morning. Parking and changing facilities are available in Kolín. The event takes place on August 16, 2026, features various race categories and a festival atmosphere, and offers online registration.

name: Tyršův běh na Sokol
location: Malá Skála, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Tyrš’s Run to Sokol is a traditional forest race in Malá Skála, offering a challenging 2 km course with 300 metres of elevation gain. The race is intended for nature-running enthusiasts who don’t mind hills and technical terrain full of roots, holes and rocks. Runners start at one-minute intervals, and the race has a long-standing tradition; in 2021, it was held for the 36th time. Everyone interested in this type of race is warmly welcome.
course_highlights: Forest course with technical terrain full of roots, holes and rocks
2 km long with 300 m of elevation gain
Starts at one-minute intervals
additional: The course includes forest and gravel paths, stairs, and only the first 100 metres are asphalt. Registration and further information are available on the event website or Facebook page.

name: Volkslauf Rund um den Beerster See
location: Kurpark am Kanal, Bad Bederkesa, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Volkslauf Rund um den Beerster See is a running event for participants of all ages and abilities, held on the third Sunday in August in Bad Bederkesa. The course passes through a natural setting and offers a motivating challenge for both competitive runners and recreational athletes. The event promotes community and the joy of being active, making it a special experience for both race participants and recreational runners. The start and finish are in Kurpark am Kanal, and timing is by transponder.
course_highlights: Scenic course around Beerster See
Start and finish in Kurpark am Kanal
Free drinks on the opposite side of the lake and at the finish
additional: Race packs are distributed in the Amtsscheune opposite the castle. Showers are available at the Moortherme upon presentation of your race number. Timing is by transponder, which must be returned after the race. The cut-off time for the main races is 1 hour 45 minutes. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Course distances: 7.6 km; hiking, walking and Nordic walking: 1.1 km, 0.5 km and 14.6 km. Race packs are distributed in the Amtsscheune. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Timing is by transponder.

name: HuBuT - 8. Hunsbuckel-Trail
description: The HuBuT - Hunsbuckel Trail is a challenging trail-running event in the Hunsrück with three distances: ShortTrail (12 km), HalfTrail (27 km) and UltraTrail (47 km). The routes pass through varied low mountain landscapes featuring green meadows, deep forests, singletracks, ravines and award-winning hiking trails. A special highlight is crossing the Geierlay suspension bridge, Germany’s most beautiful and highest suspension bridge. The start and finish are in the idyllic village of Laubach, offering participants an unforgettable experience in nature.
course_highlights: Varied low mountain landscape, with elevation profiles ranging from river valleys to ridges
Crossing the 360 m long and 100 m high Geierlay suspension bridge
Running on rugged terrain, singletracks and award-winning hiking trails, and through deep ravines
additional: The start and finish are in Laubach. There are three distances: ShortTrail (12 km), HalfTrail (27 km) and UltraTrail (47 km). The UltraTrail route crosses the Geierlay suspension bridge. The trail features singletracks, forest trails, ravines and historic sights such as the ruins of Balduinseck Castle. There is a Winter Edition with a 6-hour run in February. This trail-running event in Laubach in the Hunsrück offers several distances, including the UltraTrail, HalfTrail and ShortTrail, as well as the Winter Edition 6-hour run; typical weather in August is warm.

name: Ortskernlauf
description: The Roßdorf Town Center Festival is a long-standing tradition, held annually on the third weekend in August, and celebrates its 42nd anniversary in 2026. It brings together Roßdorf’s diverse community and offers a varied program featuring live acts on three stages, a children’s and family area, and numerous clubs and local organizations. The town center is the social hub where visitors from near and far come together to celebrate. The Town Center Run on Sunday is a sporting highlight, starting and finishing in the town center.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the town center of Roßdorf
Warm-up from 11:00 a.m.; the Town Center Run starts from 12:00 p.m. on Sunday
A diverse community and festive atmosphere in the town center
additional: The Town Center Run takes place on Sunday, with a warm-up from 11:00 a.m. and the start from 12:00 p.m. at the Town Center Run start/finish area. The children’s program and children’s band run from 5:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. The festival features live acts on three stages, a kids’ and family area, and numerous local clubs. Sporting run; registration opens in summer 2026 on the website of Skifreunde Roßdorf.

name: SV02 Kerwelauf - Der SV02 lässts LAUFen
description: The 8th SV02 Kerwelauf in Schönau is a lively running event taking place on August 16, 2026. It offers two distances: a 400-meter run and a 10-kilometer run, for runners looking for a short but sporty challenge. The race takes place in typical August weather, with pleasant temperatures and mostly sunny conditions. The course runs through the beautiful surroundings of Schönau and promises an enjoyable running experience.
course_highlights: Distances: 400 m and 10 km
Location: Schönau
Typical August weather, around 25 °C and mostly sunny
additional: Please check the event details with the organizer before registering. The event features a measured course approved by the DLV, live timing, children's races, and a festive atmosphere with refreshments in the festival tent.

name: Waldlauf / 37. Volkslauf
description: The 47th Waldlauf / 37th Volkslauf is a Sunday morning running event in Oberzent-Hetzbach in the Odenwald. The adult program includes hilly courses over 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The 5 km course is also open to walkers and Nordic walkers. Start times are staggered, with the 10 km race starting shortly before the 5 km race, giving the event the character of several local races run under a shared organization. There is also a 750 m race for children and teenagers, and all races finish at the same finish line.
course_highlights: Hilly courses over 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon
Shared finish line for all distances
Separate races for children and teenagers
additional: Start times are staggered, with the 10 km race starting shortly before the 5 km race. The 5 km course is also open to walkers and Nordic walkers. Typical August weather: approximately 25 °C, mostly sunny, with average precipitation of 60 mm. Hilly terrain, several race distances, including walking and Nordic walking options; weather-dependent conditions in August, with temperatures around 25 °C and approximately 60 mm of precipitation.

name: Breitunger Pleßlauf
location: Sporthalle am Riegelsweg, Breitungen/Werra, Thuringia, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Start- incl. Chip­ - Gebühren 6 Km Lauf: 9€

description: The Breitunger Pleßlauf takes place on 23 August 2026 in Breitungen/Werra and offers running distances from 1 km to 30 km, as well as 10.7 km Nordic walking. The event is organised by SV Lauftreff Breitungen e.V. and starts and finishes at the sports hall on Riegelsweg. The varied courses are suitable for both children and experienced runners. Alongside the sporting challenge, the event offers timing with a single-use chip, trophies and non-cash prizes for the fastest participants, and finisher medals for the main distances.
course_highlights: Running distances from 1 km to 30 km
10.7 km Nordic walking
Start and finish at the sports hall on Riegelsweg in Breitungen
additional: Late entries are possible up to 45 minutes before the respective start, with a late-entry fee of €5 for the main distances and Nordic walking. Timing is provided using a single-use chip from GO timing. Race packs can be collected at the sports hall on 22.08.2026 from 12:00 to 15:30 and on race day from 07:00. Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available at the sports hall. Trophies are awarded to the three fastest finishers in the main distances, along with non-cash and cash prizes for the winners. All finishers in the main distances receive a laser-engraved medal. Course profiles, mountain run, online registration, results, photos, videos, dates in 2024–2026

name: Ronneburger Stunden-Paarlauf des Laufprojekt Büdingen
location: Stadion im Jugendzentrum Ronneburg, Ronneburg, Hessen, Germany
description: The Ronneburg Hourly Pair Relay, organised by Laufprojekt Büdingen e.V., is a unique running competition in which teams of two runners take turns completing laps on the 400 m synthetic track at the stadium at the Ronneburg Youth Centre. The event takes place on 16 August 2026 and offers three competitions lasting 15, 30 and 60 minutes. The laps completed are added together and converted into a total distance, with the pair covering the greatest distance winning. The event is open to all gender combinations and promotes team spirit and endurance in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 400 m synthetic track at the stadium at the Ronneburg Youth Centre
Runners switch after each lap
Competitions lasting 15, 30 and 60 minutes
additional: Late registration is possible on site until one hour before the start of the competition. Participants can register individually or as a pair; individual registrants will be matched into pairs by the organiser. Payment is by direct debit upon registration, or in cash at the race-number distribution desk for late registration. The event is expected to end at 15:00. Course lengths of 900 m and 3.6 km, medals, certificates, supporting programme and on-site refreshments.

name: Run´n Roll for Help
description: Run’n Roll for Help is a long-standing city race in Giessen that has delighted runners for more than 28 years. Every year, the city-centre streets become a sporting highlight where, alongside the competition, supporting a good cause is also a priority. With more than 1,200 participants in 2025 and over €19,000 raised for Lebenshilfe and Aidshilfe, the event is an important charity running festival in the region. The event offers a great atmosphere and warmly invites everyone who loves running to join in August 2026.
course_highlights: Course through Giessen city centre
Traditional city race with a large number of participants
Charity race in support of Lebenshilfe and Aidshilfe
additional: Registration for the race opens soon. More than 1,200 runners took part in 2025. The event raises donations for Lebenshilfe and Aidshilfe. Photos and videos from the event are available in the photo gallery on the website. Official hashtags for social media are #MiteinanderMehrBewegen and #RunandRollforHelp. Charity race, registration opening soon, donations for social causes, support for HIV prevention and youth work

name: Wohldenberger Waldlauf
description: The 21st Wohldenberger Forest Run on August 16, 2026, offers runners of all ability levels varied routes through the Wohldenberger Forest. For more than two decades, this event has been one of the most popular in the Hildesheim region, attracting 200 to 300 participants each year. The course follows natural forest trails with changing surfaces and hilly sections, making it a true cross-country running experience. There are suitable distances for beginners, families, walkers, and ambitious runners, from short children’s races to the challenging half marathon.
course_highlights: Natural forest trails with changing surfaces
Hilly sections in the Wohldenberger Forest
A range of routes for all ability levels, from 0 km to 21.1 km
additional: Six starts for everyone: Shorty Run (free, 11:30), Schoolchildren’s Run (1.5 km, 11:15), 4 km walking (09:10), 4 km run (09:00), 10 km run (09:10), half marathon (08:50). Registration is available for individuals or groups. The event takes place at the Waldsportanlage of SV Rot-Weiss Wohldenberg in Holle. Four routes; on-site registration available; forest cross-country run on trails with changing surfaces.

name: Wolfsburg Staffellauf powered by VfL Wob e.V.
price_range: Startgebühren der Kinderstaffeln werden vom Förderkreis Leichtathletik VfL Wolfsburg e.V. übernommen, sonst keine Angaben
description: The Wolfsburg Relay, organized by VfL Wolfsburg e.V., is a special team experience that brings together runners of all ages and backgrounds. On August 16, 2026, the second edition of this relay marathon will take place, where teams from schools, clubs, and businesses can experience sporting team spirit together. The route passes through the green Stadtforst, with the start and finish at the VW-Bad, where music will also create a lively atmosphere. Children’s relay teams are supported by Förderkreis Leichtathletik VfL Wolfsburg e.V., making participation especially appealing.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the VW-Bad
Route through Wolfsburg’s green Stadtforst
Music by DJ Tomoritzland in the start/finish area
additional: Children’s relay teams consist of 5 participants, including at least one female and one male participant. The entry fees for children’s relay teams are covered by Förderkreis Leichtathletik VfL Wolfsburg e.V. Race bibs will be collected after the race and reused for future events. Race packets can be collected on 14.08.2026 from 16:00 to 18:00 at the VfL office, or on event day from 8:00. Dogs are not allowed at the VW-Bad. Medical services will be on site. Participants may use the swimming pools at the VW-Bad free of charge. Relay race, teams from different groups, course maps, impressions, registration via my.race|result

name: Marceliński Bieg Letni 2026
description: Marceliński Summer Run 2026 is a cross-country race organized in Poznań by running enthusiasts from the Biegi.Wlkp. group. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the beauty of the location. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on promoting cross-country running in Wielkopolska, offering participants a unique running experience amid beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes in Poznań
The scenic appeal of the proposed locations
Route available on Garmin Connect
additional: Authorization form for collecting a race pack. The race route is available on Garmin Connect. The event focuses on trail running. Registration details are not provided on the website, but can be found on the event’s Facebook page.

name: XXI Bieg Lesoków
description: The 21st Lesoków Run is an annual race held in Szemud and part of the Kaszuby Biegają series. The event offers two courses, 5 km and 10 km, through the picturesque Kashubian countryside, encouraging people to spend time actively outdoors. It attracts runners of various age groups and ability levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and local running culture.
course_highlights: The courses run through the charming Kashubian countryside
Two distances are available: 5 km and 10 km
The race takes place in the scenic surroundings of Szemud
additional: The event will take place on 16 August 2026, with online registration available from December 2025. The race is part of the regional Kaszuby Biegają series, which promotes physical activity in Kashubia.

name: Jazerný maratón
description: The Jazerný Marathon is a running challenge held in Košice, in the Nad Jazerom neighbourhood, offering distances from 5 to 42 km. The race follows a 2.5 km stretch along the Hornád River embankment, with a high-quality asphalt surface and minimal elevation gain, making it suitable for runners of all levels. The event has a 15-year history and is ideal for anyone looking for a fast and enjoyable run in nature close to the city. The organisers welcome all runners who want to test themselves over different distances.
course_highlights: A 2.5 km loop along the Hornád embankment
High-quality asphalt surface
Minimal elevation gain, ideal for a fast run
additional: Choose a distance from 5 km up to the full marathon distance of 42 km. The course runs along the embankment with minimal elevation gain, allowing for a fast and comfortable run. The event takes place on 16 August 2026. Online registration is available, and the race is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Žvahov - Ivův běh
location: Děvín, Praha 5, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: Žvahov - Ivův běh is a 3.7 km trail race held in the Děvín area of Prague 5. Part of the SABZO series, it gives runners the chance to enjoy a run in natural surroundings, with gentle hills and interesting views. The race is suited to anyone who enjoys short but more challenging off-road courses. Come and enjoy the sporting atmosphere and test yourself against other runners in the beautiful Děvín hills.
course_highlights: A 3.7 km trail course
Natural surroundings in the Děvín hills
Part of the SABZO series
additional: The race starts on the road below the TJ Zlíchov football pitch. It is also suitable for beginners and families with children.

name: BWM Sommerlochlauf
description: The Bottwartal Marathon is a popular running event set in one of the most beautiful landscapes in southern Germany. The course passes through gentle vineyard slopes and idyllic old towns, with an enthusiastic atmosphere along the route. Whether you’re a beginner or an ambitious runner, there’s a personal highlight here for everyone. The dedicated organizing team puts a great deal of heart and precision into creating an unforgettable running experience.
course_highlights: Run through picturesque vineyards and historic old towns
Flat finish on Ludwigsburger Straße in Steinheim
A variety of distances from 5 km to an ultramarathon
additional: Monthly training runs with various pace groups and guides to help you prepare. Summer holiday runs every Tuesday evening during the summer holidays: a 10 km long run, free of charge and with no registration required. The Year-End Run is a traditional event featuring a 10 km run followed by punch and mulled wine. The 5 km run starts at Rosenplatz in Großbottwar, follows a historic route, and has a flat finish. Time limit for the 5 km run: 2 hours. No specific details are available about the terrain, registration, or other notes.

name: ČEZ Lipno Sport Festival
location: Lipno nad Vltavou, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 200-400 Kč (dle věkové kategorie a místa registrace)

price_tiers.distance: Cyklozávod ČEZ Kolem Lipna (60 km a 20 km)

description: The ČEZ Lipno Sport Festival is a traditional sporting event in Lipno nad Vltavou, offering a wide range of races for all ages and sports enthusiasts. The festival includes running events such as the Lipno Half Marathon, the 10 km COOP RUN and a family run, as well as cycling races with 60 km and 20 km gravel and MTB routes. The event also features children’s races and evening runs along the scenic Čertovy proudy cycle path. Participants can enjoy the beautiful Šumava countryside and a varied programme of cultural activities.
course_highlights: Running routes follow the Čertovy proudy cycle path
Cycling races on the quieter side of Lipno, with 60 km and 20 km routes
Children’s off-road cycling races on a cyclocross course in six categories
additional: The 400 m and 800 m children’s runs start at 9:00 and 9:20, respectively, by the lower cable-car station above the Stodola restaurant. The start and finish of the main running races are at the ČEZ Lipno Sport Festival grounds and by the lower cable-car station. Registration for the children’s races is also available on race day. Race packs can be collected in advance from 17 August at the festival’s Active Point. The race office opens at 7:30 on race day. The event includes cycling routes, running courses, a cultural programme, sporting activities and registration, likely via the website. It is suitable for all age groups and offers a varied programme for families and sports enthusiasts.

name: Běh okolo Olympie
location: Olympie, Chrlice, Brno, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné je 150 Kč. Platba startovného probíhá před závodem při registraci závodníků.

description: Běh okolo Olympie is a running race in Brno, taking place on August 20, 2026, in the Chrlice area. The race features a 5.3 km course, with men and women competing together in one category and starting at the same time. A separate race is planned for children, with the course distance announced before the start. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a pleasant atmosphere, refreshments, and on-site baggage storage.
course_highlights: A 5.3 km course in the Chrlice area
Men and women start together
Children’s race with the course distance announced before the start
additional: On-site registration opens at 17:15. The children’s race starts at 17:45, and the main race at 18:00. Water and a baggage-storage tent are available after the race. Recommended transport: bus route 78, Zámecká stop. Parking is limited on a nearby street, or available in the car park by Decathlon. Terrain: urban; registration on-site or online; timing using MYLAPS chip technology; public transport and parking available; refreshments after the race; baggage storage; start and finish near Olympia in Brno.

name: Šárecká 5
location: Divoká Šárka, Praha 6, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: Šárecká 5 is a 5.3 km cross-country race held in the picturesque natural area of Divoká Šárka in Prague 6. This varied race gives runners the chance to enjoy one of Prague’s most beautiful areas on more challenging terrain. It is organized by SABZO Praha under the direction of Michal Procházka and is part of the Czech Athletics Federation’s running activities. The race is suitable for anyone who enjoys trail running and natural scenery.
course_highlights: A 5.3 km course over varied terrain
Cross-country/trail race format
The picturesque natural area of Divoká Šárka in Prague 6
additional: The organizer is SABZO Praha; the contact person is Michal Procházka (tel. 724 845 241). The race is part of the Czech Athletics Federation’s services for runners and running. It takes place in the early evening, with the first category starting at 18:00. The race is held in the beautiful setting of the Divoká Šárka Nature Reserve. Online registration is available, and the course is suitable for runners of all levels.

name: Běh městem Strakonice
location: Letní kino, Strakonice, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
organizer: Město Strakonice, Okresní sdružení Česká unie sportu Strakonice
description: The XXIII Strakonice City Run is a traditional running race held on August 21 at the Summer Cinema in Strakonice. Runners of all ages can test themselves on 3.3 km and 6.6 km routes through the city. Both routes start together at 18:00. All participants have a chance to win prizes in a large raffle, drawn using race numbers. Entries can be submitted by email or on race day.
course_highlights: Two routes through the city: 3.3 km and 6.6 km
Start and finish at the Summer Cinema
All runners start together at 18:00
additional: Entries can be submitted by email until August 20 or on race day, no later than 60 minutes before the start. All race numbers will be entered into a large raffle. The race features an accompanying program with military vehicles and is part of the city's traditional sporting calendar.

name: Abendstraßenlauf
location: Dorfzentrum, Herxheim, Südliche Weinstraße, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Evening Road Race in Herxheim is a long-running event held annually since 1987. In 2026, it will take place with a new concept and a new course in the village center, starting and finishing at the festival grounds behind the festival hall. Races are offered for the whole family, including Bambini, schoolchildren’s, beginner, and 10 km main races. The main race consists of two laps, and the beginner race has been extended to 5 km. The event combines a sporting challenge with a family-friendly supporting program.
course_highlights: New two-lap 10 km course in the village center
Beginner race extended to 5 km
Start and finish at the festival grounds behind the festival hall
additional: Start times: Bambini races from 18:00, schoolchildren’s races from 18:20, and the beginner and 10 km main races from 19:00. Bambini races are not timed; all finishers receive medals. Age-group rankings include certificates and gifts. The three fastest men and women overall in the 10 km race receive gift vouchers. Organizer: TV Herxheim 1892 e.V., Athletics Department. New course, family and children’s races, online registration, event in the village center

name: Bürener Volkslauf - Hochstift-Cup
description: The Bürener Volkslauf is a traditional running event in Büren, taking place on 21 August 2026. The races cover various distances, including Bambini, children’s, schoolchildren’s and corporate races, on paved routes with minimal elevation changes through the scenic Aftetal valley. All participants receive certificates, and the top runners are awarded trophies. The event is part of the Hochstift-Cup and offers a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: 5 km out-and-back course through the scenic Aftetal valley
Fully paved course with minimal elevation changes
800 m schoolchildren’s and children’s races on the 400 m track
additional: Certificates for all participants. Trophies for places 1–3 (men/women/diverse) in the overall standings. The City of Büren’s challenge trophy for first place in the team standings. Special prize for the largest team (corporate runners only). Certificates can be printed via the “race result” software after the event. Race numbers and transponders will be provided. Changing and shower facilities are available. Parking and travel information will be provided. The courses are challenging, with minimal elevation changes. The registration deadline is the day of the event. Registration is via MY RACERESULT.

name: 11. Lichterlauf Tangermünde
location: Kaiserstadt Tangermünde, Elbufer, Bleichenberg, Saxony-Anhalt, Germany
description: The Tangermünde Lichterlauf is an atmospheric race right on the Elbe in the historic imperial town of Tangermünde. On August 21, 2026, runners of all ages and ability levels can take part in several race distances, including a children’s run, a 5 km fun run, a 10 km main race and a team relay. The course runs along the picturesque Elbe promenade and offers a special atmosphere, followed by an after-run party in Tangermünde. The race is a community sporting event that puts fun, exercise and team spirit front and center.
course_highlights: Run along Tangermünde’s Elbe promenade below the castle
Loop course of approximately 1 km, with 5 or 10 laps for the main races
Children’s run of approximately 500 m; parents may accompany children
additional: Timing is provided using a chip that must be returned after the race. Medical support is available along the course. All participants receive a certificate, which is available online. The team relay is awarded a trophy. Race numbers must be worn clearly visible on the chest. Refreshments are provided before, during and after the race. The event takes place at Bleichenberg on the banks of the Elbe and includes various distances, children’s and youth races, and an after-run party. It is part of the regional race calendar and offers a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: 19. Barßeler Hafenfestlauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Fristgerechte Anmeldung bis zwei Tage vor dem Lauf (Mittwoch)

description: The 19th Barßel Harbour Festival Run takes place on 21 August 2026 near Barßel Harbour. The event offers races for different age groups, including Bambini runs, children’s races, a 5-kilometre run, Nordic walking and a 10-kilometre main race. The course runs on paved roads and is suitable for all age groups. The event is organised by Sport- und Turnverein Barßel and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, supporting activities and refreshments.
course_highlights: Start and finish near Barßel Harbour and the swimming and sports centre
Bambini runs of approximately 400 metres on the main road, in two groups with different bib colours
10-kilometre race on a 5 km loop course on paved roads
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day from 15:30 at the Schützenhaus Barßelermoor, and the evening before from 17:00 to 19:00. Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start. Bag drop is in the sports hall; use your race bib for identification. A sweep bicycle accompanies the races, with cut-off times of 19:15 (5 km) and 21:00 (10 km). Parking is available at several locations in Barßel; diversions due to the harbour festival are signposted. Registration is open until 19 August 2026. Late entries are possible for a fee. Parking is available nearby. Race bibs can be collected at the Schützenhaus. The event is hosted by an announcer, and timing is provided by Laufmanager.

name: Buntekuhlauf
description: The Buntekuhlauf in Lübeck-Buntekuh is a traditional race taking place for the 18th time on August 21, 2026. The event offers various races for all ages and ability levels, from short runs on the sports grounds to longer distances on pedestrian paths. The races take place on pedestrian paths closed to traffic and on the sports grounds, creating a safe and pleasant atmosphere for all participants. The SC Buntekuh e.V. organizes the race with the aim of making exercise fun for everyone.
course_highlights: Routes on the sports grounds (750 m and 1.5 km)
Longer distances (5 km, 10 km, 15 km) on pedestrian paths; roads are not closed to traffic
The 5 km route is completed multiple times for the 10 km (2 laps) and 15 km (3 laps) races
additional: Race packets will be distributed on August 20, 2026, from 6 to 8 p.m. and on the event day from 3 p.m. Late registration is possible until August 16, 2026, at 8:00 p.m.; after that, it may be available on the event day but is not guaranteed. Bib numbers are not personalized, but certificates will include the usual details. Changes to registrations are free until a certain time; after that, a fee of 10 euros will be charged. Several race categories are available, including a fun run, walking, and longer distances; online registration is possible. The start and finish are on Koggenweg in Lübeck-Buntekuh.

name: Volkslauf Um die Taakener Ähren
description: The “Um die Taakener Ähren” fun run is a family-friendly and popular running event in Taaken, taking place on 21 August 2026. The event offers various races for all age groups, from the Bambini run through the schoolchildren’s and jogger runs to the competitive 10 km main race and a relay. The course runs through Taaken and its picturesque fields of grain, with fun and community at the heart of the event. All participants receive pastries at the finish, and the winners are awarded traditional winner’s loaves. The village provides refreshments and drink stands, creating a pleasant atmosphere.
course_highlights: The course runs through Taaken and its picturesque fields of grain
Start and finish on the green behind the sports hall
A 10 km relay with an original baton, for teams of 2 to 4 runners
additional: Late entries are possible up to one hour before the start of the respective race for an additional €2. Changing rooms and showers are available in the Taaken sports hall. Parking is located behind the sports hall. Water, fruit and pastries are provided, and there are also snack and drink stands. All runners in the main, relay and jogger races can enter a raffle held after the main race awards ceremony. Various race categories, team relay, children’s and youth races, refreshments on site.

name: Mottenburger Meile
description: The Mottenburger Meile is a traditional cult race on the Elbe in Hamburg, held every year on the Friday after the Hamburg school holidays. The accurately measured out-and-back course is 7.5 km long, equivalent to one Prussian land mile. The race starts and finishes on the banks of the Elbe below Halbmondsweg/Elbchaussee and offers a romantic atmosphere with evening lighting. Alongside the sporting competition, the race supports the Hamburg Donations Parliament and commemorates Jewish victims of the Holocaust with a Stolperstein memorial stone.
course_highlights: Accurately measured 7.5 km out-and-back course (one Prussian land mile)
Start and finish on the banks of the Elbe below Halbmondsweg/Elbchaussee
Romantic lighting for an evening race
additional: Limited to 300 participants. Late registration fee: €1 organizational fee. Relaxed get-together afterwards, weather permitting. The organizer accepts no liability. By registering, participants grant permission for their personal data and photographs to be published. Course: 7.5 km; night race; participant limit: 300; registration probably online; start from 7 p.m.; donations support the Hamburg Donations Parliament.

name: Cestou Grófa Júliusa Andrássyho
description: The Run Along the Route of Count Julius Andrássy takes place in Trebišov near the Municipal Cultural Centre and offers various categories, including running, a summer walk, cycling, Nordic walking, and a virtual race. The start is scheduled for August 21, 2026, at 16:15 for children and 16:25 for the main category. The event is suitable for all ages, including children up to 7 years old and older children up to 13 years old. The organizer is Ing. Michal Majcher, who ensures a pleasant atmosphere and well-organized races.
course_highlights: Start and finish near the Municipal Cultural Centre in Trebišov
Several categories, including running, walking, cycling, and Nordic walking
A virtual race as a new option for participants unable to attend in person
additional: The entry fee is paid on site. Categories include children up to 7 years old, children aged 8–13, the main category, a summer walk, cycling, Nordic walking, and a virtual race, with the option to purchase a medal. The event includes several categories, including children’s and virtual races. Registration is available on site, and the course is located around the cultural centre in Trebišov.

name: Morava Run - proti proudu
location: Pohansko, Břeclav, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné na VI. MORAVA RUN (2026) je stanoveno na 11.000,- Kč / A tým (7-9 členů)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné na VI. MORAVA RUN (2026) je stanoveno na 15.000,- Kč / B tým (10-12 členů)

description: Morava Run – Upstream is a relay running race across Moravia along the course of the Morava River, held in teams of 7 to 12 members. The approximately 280 km route is divided into 30 legs of around 9 km, which teams assign according to their abilities and strategy. The race starts in southern Moravia in the Soutok Protected Landscape Area and follows the river upstream through Slovácko, Haná, the Litovelské Pomoraví Protected Landscape Area and on to the source of the Morava on Králický Sněžník. The event is aimed at amateur runners and emphasizes teamwork and team building, with no pace limit.
course_highlights: The route follows the Morava River upstream from Břeclav to Dolní Morava
30 legs in total, each approximately 9 km long
Passes through the Soutok Protected Landscape Area, Slovácko, Haná, the Litovelské Pomoraví Protected Landscape Area and the Jeseníky Mountains
additional: The race starts in Břeclav by Pohansko Castle and finishes at the Dolní Morava campsite, where participants can also camp overnight. Teams start in waves, and there is no pace limit. Each team plans its logistics and distributes its effort across the 30 legs. The organizer provides an emergency hotline for unexpected events and a WhatsApp group for team leaders. The race is for teams of 7–12 members and includes logistics, support along the route and the option of facilities at the campsite. The event is intended for both athletes and team-building groups, with an emphasis on experiences and cooperation in nature.

name: Brdský půlmaraton
location: Kytín, Kladno District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Brdy Half Marathon is a traditional trail running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Kytín in the Central Bohemian Region. The race offers two routes: a more challenging 21 km course with 430 m of elevation gain and a shorter 9 km course with 158 m of elevation gain, both with refreshment stations. Overall winners and age and gender categories are recognized on the longer course, while the shorter course awards the fastest men and women overall. The race is part of the Trail Running Cup series and is suitable for nature-running enthusiasts, with beautiful views and varied terrain.
course_highlights: 21 km course with 430 m of elevation gain
9 km course with 158 m of elevation gain
Refreshment stations along the course with water and isotonic drinks
additional: The 21 km course has refreshment stations at 3.7 km, 9 km and 17 km, serving water and isotonic drinks. The 9 km course has refreshments at 3.7 km, and water, an isotonic drink and light refreshments are available at the finish. Children's races are free. Age and gender categories are recognized on the 21 km course, and overall winners on the 9 km course. The race offers 21 km and 9 km courses, suitable for trail runners and families with children, with registration available through the official website.

name: Hrabovský 1/2 a 1/4 maraton
description: The Hrabová Half and Quarter Marathon is a traditional running race held in Ostrava-Hrabová, offering half-marathon and quarter-marathon distances. The race is part of the Hrabová Cup and the Moravian-Silesian Running Cup. Participants receive medals, and refreshments, changing rooms, and an accompanying program are available. The start and race-day check-in take place at the TJ Sokol Hrabová sports ground. The route passes through an urban setting with a pleasant atmosphere and is suitable for a wide range of runners.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course: 21.1 km
Quarter-marathon course: 10.5 km
Start and finish at the TJ Sokol Hrabová sports ground
additional: The race bib is returnable and includes a chip. Refreshments are provided along the course and at the finish, along with changing rooms and toilets. An accompanying program is part of the event. Online registration is available, with payment by bank transfer required within 5 days of registration. Race-day check-in and registration take place at the TJ Sokol Hrabová sports ground, Paskovská 209, Ostrava. The event includes not only races, but also children's races, Nordic Walking, a raffle, and other fun activities. The event takes place on August 22, 2026.

name: Jesenický maraton
description: The Jeseníky Marathon is a legendary and challenging mountain marathon in the Czech Republic, held in the Jeseníky Mountains since 2009. The marathon and half-marathon follow the same course each year, but changeable weather and mountain terrain make it feel different every time. Runners follow the ridges of forested mountains, passing springs, primeval forests, stone fields and peat bogs, creating a unique atmosphere and challenge. The Jeseníky Marathon is intended for experienced endurance runners who want to conquer the highest mountain range in Moravia and Silesia.
course_highlights: Ridges of forested mountains with rounded peaks
Springs of fresh water and deep valleys
Centuries-old primeval forests, mountain tundra and stone fields
additional: The race is limited to 700 runners. The time limit for completing the marathon is 6 hours and 30 minutes. Refreshments are available at several stations, with water, isotonic drinks, fruit and energy foods. Hot food and drinks can be purchased at the finish. Runners with a valid registration by 30 June 2026 will receive a T-shirt unless they choose otherwise. The organizer may cancel the race in the event of adverse weather, without compensation for damages. The course is mountainous, with refreshments at two stations, free parking, free bus transport from the start, a time limit and an age limit of 18+.

name: Panevropský půlmaraton
description: The Pan-European Half Marathon is a cross-border running race from Stadlern in Bavaria to Poběžovice. The course runs through the picturesque countryside of the Bavarian-Czech border region, including the former “Iron Curtain” and a low pass in the Bohemian Forest near the source of the Radbuza River. The race is accompanied by a rich cultural programme at both the start and finish, with activities for children. The start is traditionally at 10 a.m., and the finish is in Míru Square in Poběžovice. The organisers warmly invite athletes and spectators to come and support the runners.
course_highlights: Cross-border course from Germany to the Czech Republic
Passes through the former Iron Curtain via the Švarcava border crossing
Undulating course with two climbs to low passes in the Bohemian Forest
additional: Refreshment stations on the course at 6, 9, 12, 15 and 18 km, serving water and isotonic drinks. After the finish: hot food, drinks, fruit, muesli and chocolate. Race-day registration is available at the start in Stadlern for 600 CZK in cash. Bus transport to the start and back after the race. Winners are announced and prizes presented immediately after the race. Every runner receives a commemorative medal and a T-shirt bearing the race emblem. Buses to the start depart from Poběžovice and Domažlice. The race takes place in August 2026. The course is mostly on asphalt and features varied terrain. Part of the Běžec Chodska series.

name: Běh na Svatý Hostýn
location: Bystřice pod Hostýnem, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Svatý Hostýn is a mountain race held in Bystřice pod Hostýnem in the Zlín Region. It is part of the Czech Cup in Mountain Running and offers a challenging 5 km race with 422 metres of elevation gain, with most of the course on asphalt. The race is open to both experienced runners and the general public, attracting running enthusiasts from across the country. It is known for its friendly atmosphere and the beautiful surroundings of Svatý Hostýn.
course_highlights: 5 km course with 422 m of elevation gain
Runs mostly on asphalt, with a challenging climb
Part of the Czech Cup in Mountain Running
additional: Registration is also available on-site. The race uses chip timing and takes place in August 2026.

name: Běh k Božímu hrobu
location: Svatý Hostýn, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run to the Holy Sepulchre is a traditional running event held at Svatý Hostýn in the Zlín Region, part of the wider range of pilgrimages and sporting events at the site. The event features an uphill race finishing at the Holy Sepulchre and is an important part of the regional sporting calendar. Get ready for the atmosphere of this pilgrimage site and enjoy a sporting experience in the beautiful surroundings of Svatý Hostýn.
course_highlights: Uphill race at Svatý Hostýn
Part of the Czech Hill Running Cup
Pilgrimage and sporting atmosphere, with the option to take part during pilgrimages
additional: The event includes a run to Svatý Hostýn and the Holy Sepulchre and is part of the pilgrimage activities. Registration and results are available on the website.

name: Běh na Čupek
description: The Run to Čupek is a newly established running race in Metylovice that has already attracted two hundred runners. The course is scenic and challenging, making for an engaging experience for participants. The race is part of the Slezan Frýdek-Místek Physical Education Association calendar, and its future place in the schedule is being watched with anticipation.
course_highlights: A challenging course in Metylovice
Scenic running surroundings
The race has already attracted two hundred runners
additional: Entry fee: 50 Kč for youth and 150 Kč for adults; the race takes place at the football pitch in Metylovice; changing rooms, showers, toilets, stadium facilities, a restaurant, and parking are available.

name: Vavřinecký běh Moravským krasem
location: Vavřinec, Moravský kras, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Vavřinec Run through the Moravian Karst is a sporting event held in the village of Vavřinec in the South Moravian Region, and is part of the District Running League. The event takes place on August 22, 2026, and offers various running categories suitable for the general public. It is an ideal opportunity for running enthusiasts to discover the beauty of the Moravian Karst and enjoy an outdoor sporting experience.
course_highlights: Held in the picturesque Moravian Karst
Part of the District Running League
Various age categories and race distances
additional: The race is suitable for all age groups, with entry fees of CZK 200 for adults and CZK 50 for children. The event promotes an active lifestyle and exploring the region’s natural beauty.

name: Detmolder Residenzlauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Das Startgeld beträgt 11,00 Euro für Erwachsene und wird per Bankeinzug nach der Anmeldung gezahlt.

description: The Detmold Residenzlauf is a long-standing running event taking place on 15 August 2026 in Detmold. The event offers various races for children, young people and adults, including a Bambini run, school races, a 5 km fitness run and the 10 km main race. The start and finish are on the Market Square in Detmold, providing a central and lively setting. The event is supported by Stadtwerke Detmold and AÜG NETZWERK as title sponsors and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and a range of categories.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the Market Square in Detmold
Various distances from 1.5 km to 10 km
Timing with the Raceresult timing system
additional: Race bib collection on the event day from 15:30 at the Rathaus am Markt in Detmold. Timing is provided by the Raceresult timing system; personal chips are not permitted. Free admission to the Aqualip leisure pool upon presentation of the race bib. Medals for all participating children and young people. Awards ceremony on the Market Square: school races from around 18:30, 10 km race from 20:00. Friedrich-Brakemeier Challenge Trophy for the school with the highest participation rate. Vouchers for schools, teams and groups with the most advance registrations. The race attracts numerous participants from the region and, alongside the main distances, also features children’s races and special competitions. Results and certificates are available online.

name: Exter FlexRun! 2026
location: Sparkassen Sportpark Exter, Vlotho, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Exter FlexRun on 22 August 2026 at Sparkassen Sportpark Exter offers a flexible running format for all ability levels. Participants can choose their distance and run up to four laps of 10.5 km each, covering up to the full marathon distance. There are also relay events, walking and Nordic walking courses, and a children’s run. The event takes place in a scenic setting and offers a great atmosphere, with refreshments and entertainment on site.
course_highlights: Loop courses on paved paths and mostly asphalt roads in and around Vlotho Exter
Refreshment stations at 4.0 km, 8.5 km, and in Sportpark Exter
Showers, changing rooms, and a wide range of refreshments at Sportpark Exter
additional: The start and finish for all events are at Sportpark Exter. Flexible distance choice, with up to 4 laps (10.5 km each). 4 x 10.5 km relay for teams. Walking/Nordic walking: 10.5 km and 21 km. Children’s run: 1.6 km, from age 6. Team and company rankings with awards. Courses are marked and staffed by marshals. Registration is via Race Result; the event offers showers, changing rooms, refreshments, and is family-friendly.

name: Heideköniginnenpokal
description: The Heideköniginnenpokal (HeiPo) in Amelinghausen is a traditional fun run, taking place for the 31st time in 2026 as part of the Heideblütenfest week. The challenging routes pass through scenic landscapes, including along Lopausee. The race attracts many participants and is a mainstay of regional running events.
course_highlights: Scenic stretches
Route along Lopausee
Part of the Heideblütenfest week in Amelinghausen
additional: The Amelinghausen running group meets regularly on Mondays and Wednesdays to run together. There is also a beginners’ course that gradually introduces participants to running. The event is part of a lively running-group community that takes part in many fun runs and marathons across Germany. The race takes place in August, with typical summer weather around 25°C and possible rain. There are also children’s races and other fun runs as part of the festival week.

name: Jahn-Gedenklauf
description: The Jahn Memorial Run in Lanz is a traditional running event organized by SV Jahn Lanz e.V. The event takes place at the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn Stadium and offers various distances, which also count toward the Prignitz Cup. The start time is 10 a.m., and the run is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. The event is supported by Kreissportbund Prignitz e.V. and is a fixture in the regional sports calendar.
course_highlights: Short course: 6.6 km
Long course: 12.5 km
Outside the Prignitz Cup: 3 km
additional: Courses are not suitable for spikes; on-site registration is possible; start at the stadium

name: Michelsmarktlauf
description: The Michelsmarktlauf is a traditional running event in Reichelsheim, held annually in August. The 30th edition of the Michelsmarktlauf takes place on 22 August 2026, featuring a 10 km main race, a 1.4 km school race and a 400 m Bambini race. The event is organised by the athletics department of KSV Reichelsheim and offers runners of all ages a sporting challenge in a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km main race
1.4 km school race
400 m Bambini race
additional: The event offers a variety of distances and is very popular with families, school groups and running enthusiasts from the region. Online registration is available.

name: Münsterland-Sternlauf - Benefizlauf
location: Universitätsklinikum Münster, Münster, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Münsterland Star Run is a charity run in aid of Kinderkrebshilfe Münster e.V. at Münster University Hospital. Five routes lead in a star shape from various towns in the Münsterland region to the shared finish at Leonardo Campus in Münster. The run is designed as a stage event, allowing participants to set their own pace and run one or more stages. 100% of the proceeds are donated to Verein zur Förderung krebskranker Kinder Münster e.V. to support the treatment and care of the children affected.
course_highlights: Five routes lead in a star shape from various towns in the Münsterland region to Münster
Mostly farm tracks, footpaths and cycle paths, as well as traffic-calmed streets
Accompanied by stage leaders and a German Red Cross broom wagon; refreshments at stage points
additional: This is not a race, and participants set their own pace. They can run one or more stages, and can start and finish at any stage point. Participants are responsible for their own return transport. For the first time, donations can be made cashlessly. Donation receipts are issued for donations of €200 or more. The run is accompanied by stage leaders and a German Red Cross broom wagon. Refreshments are offered at stage points in cooperation with Kolping families. The run takes place in Münster and promotes social cohesion through sporting commitment.
