description: The Rammelsberger Steigerlauf is a challenging mountain run in the North Harz, held at the Rammelsberg UNESCO World Heritage Site in Goslar. The event offers various routes with gradients of up to 30%, passing through historic mining scenery and varied forest and mountain sections. Participants can look forward to professional timing and a unique running experience with an alpine character. Routes range from a short run for children to a marathon and trail run with up to 1,110 metres of elevation gain. The event is for runners, walkers and trail runners looking to challenge their fitness and sure-footedness.
course_highlights: Gradients of up to 30% on challenging sections
Start and finish at the Rammelsberg UNESCO World Heritage Site, amid historic mining scenery
Trail sections with an alpine character and up to 620 metres of elevation gain (BergmannTRAIL)
additional: Late registration is possible on 21.08. from 15:00 to 18:00 and on 22.08. from 08:00 on site, with a €3 late registration fee, up to 30 minutes before the start. All participants receive a yellow wristband for free access to the mining site (excluding guided tours). The BergmannTRAIL starts 200 m underground and includes a 250 m tunnel section where helmets are compulsory. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Dogs are not permitted on the site. Routes with up to 1,630 m of elevation gain, challenging sections with gradients of up to 30%, mining scenery, late registration available on site

name: Osnabrücker 6-Stunden-Lauf
organizer: Norbert Dulle, Heinz Hagen, Maik Mittmann, Holger Schulze, Florian Siebelmann, Frank Wilke
price_range: 49 Euro für Einzelstartende, 145 Euro für Staffeln
description: The Osnabrück 6-Hour Run takes place on 22 August 2026 at Rubbenbruchsee in Osnabrück and celebrates its 10th edition. The run is a charity event supporting HelpAge’s “Every Grandma Counts” campaign and is open to all runners who want to cover as many kilometres as possible within six hours. Whether you are an ambitious runner, training for a marathon, or simply interested in running, walking or hiking together in the beautiful landscape around the lake, everyone is welcome. The event offers individual and relay entries and focuses on community and a good cause.
course_highlights: Circuit around Rubbenbruchsee in Osnabrück
Run, walk or hike in beautiful natural surroundings
Six-hour event with a freely chosen distance
additional: Briefing at 09:45, with attendance required for all runners. Relay teams: minimum 3, maximum 6 participants. The legendary “Every Grandma Counts” running shirt can be ordered for 25 euros when registering (sizes S/M/L; other sizes available on request). No refunds for failure to attend. The event supports the charitable organisation HelpAge Deutschland e.V. The route is a 3,130 m paved circuit around Rubbenbruchsee; the run is inclusive; refreshments and race materials are available on site; charity run supporting HelpAge Deutschland.

name: Sieber Berg- und Panoramalauf
location: Sieber, Herzberg am Harz, Niedersachsen, Germany
price_range: 44,00 € für das Original, 34,00 € für die Panorama-Runde, 19,00 € für das Natur-Erlebnis, Kinder 6,00 €; Frühbucherpreise bis 31.03.2026 ab 38,00 €

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Altersklasse: ab 16 Jahren Das Original , 27,5 km 44,00 €

description: The Sieber Mountain and Panorama Run returns on August 22, 2026, after a 14-year break, offering three challenging routes in the Harz with up to 900 meters of elevation gain. The event is handmade and welcoming, and challenges runners of all ability levels. From the family-friendly 4.5 km Nature Experience route and the 12.5 km Panorama Loop to the queen stage of 27.5 km with 900 meters of elevation gain, there is something for everyone. The runs take you through stunning natural scenery with panoramic views and offer an authentic Harz experience. Alongside the sporting challenge, there is a pasta buffet and a community village festival to round off the event.
course_highlights: Nature Experience: 4.5 km with 130 meters of elevation gain, family-friendly and ideal for beginners
Panorama Loop: 12.5 km with 500 meters of elevation gain to Großer Knollen, with impressive views
The Original: 27.5 km with 900 meters of elevation gain via Großer Knollen and Hanskühnenburg, challenging and legendary
additional: Race bib collection on August 21, 2026, from 16:00 to 21:00, and on August 22, 2026, from 07:00 at the Haus des Gastes in Sieber. Pasta buffet on Friday evening (available to book separately for €7.00). Participation in “The Original” and “Panorama Loop” is also possible outside the age categories with written consent from a parent or guardian. Children’s race for ages 6–12 on August 22, 2026, at 11:00. Awards ceremony and village festival afterward on the Großen Wiesen. Three routes: Nature Experience (4.5 km), Panorama Loop (12.5 km), The Original (27.5 km); up to 900 meters of elevation gain; family-friendly; advance booking with pasta buffet; communal carbo-loading; participation outside the age categories possible with parental or guardian consent.

name: THE HUMBLE CLUB Backyard Run IV
description: The Humble Club Backyard Run IV on August 22, 2026, on Oker Island in Braunschweig is a unique running experience that combines an athletic challenge with social commitment. The run supports the “Boxen gegen Parkinson” project and stands for exercise, community, and social responsibility. The event starts at 10:00 a.m., with entry from 8:30 a.m., and provides participants with still water and fresh fruit, as well as an exclusive finisher medal. Participants are asked to bring their own food and drink to ensure they are properly fueled.
course_highlights: Event on Oker Island in Braunschweig
Backyard Ultra format with loop running
Supporting the “Boxen gegen Parkinson” project
additional: Arrival is possible from 8:30 a.m. Basic provisions of still water and fresh fruit are included. An exclusive finisher medal is provided for all participants. Participants should bring their own food and drink. Event held in the Backyard Ultra format, starting at 10:00 a.m.; refreshments available on site; donations for “Boxen gegen Parkinson”; a sense of community in an ultramarathon format.

name: Arnstädter Bach-Ultra
description: The Arnstadt Bach Ultra is a 60-kilometer ultramarathon taking place on August 22, 2026, in Arnstadt. It was created in response to runners’ wish to run the 60 km relay leg as a standalone ultramarathon. The event is organized by SG Motor Arnstadt in cooperation with the Arnstadt city administration and offers a challenging course through the region. The race is an interesting initiative that will hopefully attract strong support and become part of Arnstadt’s diverse running tradition.
course_highlights: 60 km ultramarathon distance
Course runs around Arnstadt
Developed from the relay race into a standalone ultramarathon
additional: Electronic timing is provided by Sportident. Registration is via www.timing.sportident.com. The race is part of Arnstadt’s diverse running calendar, which includes several events throughout the year. Ultramarathon, 60 km, challenging course, in the Arnstadt region

name: Barumer Stick and Stone Run
location: Barumer Waldstadion, Barum, Lower Saxony, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Das Startgeld beträgt 25 € und beinhaltet eine Medaille und die Teilnehmerverpflegung im Zielbereich

description: The Barumer Stick and Stone Run is a challenging obstacle race taking place on August 22, 2026, at Barumer Waldstadion and in the surrounding wooded, hilly landscape of the Lüneburg Heath. The course follows sandy, muddy, and partly overgrown trails, with water obstacles such as ditches and a village pond. The event offers runners a varied challenge in a natural setting and is suitable for individuals and groups. Participants receive a medal and refreshments in the finish area.
course_highlights: Wooded, hilly landscape on the edge of the Lüneburg Heath
Sandy, muddy, and overgrown trails with water obstacles
4 km laps, run 1 to 3 times depending on the distance
additional: Individual start times between 2 and 4 p.m. will be sent to participants by email by August 21, 2026. The start and finish are at Barumer Waldstadion. Groups of 10 or more starters can take advantage of a discount promotion in which every fifth starter runs for free. Race packets are distributed at the race office 30 minutes before each start time. There is a wash area on site, and drinks and snacks are available in the finish area. The race takes place at Barumer Waldstadion and is suitable for all ability levels. Training plans and a family-friendly atmosphere also put the fun of obstacle racing first.

name: Ring of Feier - 2.Hermeskeiler City Lauf
organizer: Kulturbeirat der Stadt Hermeskeil, Hermeskeiler Turnverein
description: The Ring of Feier – 2nd Hermeskeiler City Run takes place on August 22, 2026, in Hermeskeil. It is a short running event with distances of 150 m and 5 km. The race offers a pleasant running atmosphere in typical August weather, with temperatures around 25 °C and mostly sunny days. Participants should check the organizer’s details before registering.
course_highlights: Short distances: 150 m and 5 km
City run in Hermeskeil
Typical summer weather with mostly sunny days
additional: The race takes place on Saturday, August 22, 2026, in Hermeskeil. August weather typically brings temperatures of 25 °C, lows of around 14 °C, and an average of 60 mm of precipitation. The event is designed as a short city run. In addition to the races, the event offers music, refreshments, and team competitions, making it a sociable city festival.

name: IV Festiwal Pustelnika
organizer: Stowarzyszenie na rzecz rozwoju Wysowej-Zdroju „Przekrocz Granice”
description: The 4th Pustelnik Festival is an annual sports and recreation event organized in the picturesque town of Wysowa-Zdrój by the Przekrocz Granice Association. The festival brings together sport, culture, and nature, offering participants the opportunity to take part in runs, marathons, and MTB and E-BIKE competitions. It is a unique opportunity to discover the charms of the Low Beskids, spend time actively, and connect with the local community.
course_highlights: Running and cycling routes in the Low Beskids
Picturesque landscapes and the natural surroundings of Wysowa-Zdrój
A blend of sport, culture, and the region’s history
additional: Participants can take part in running and MTB/E-BIKE competitions. The organizer can be reached by phone from Monday to Saturday, 8:00–22:00, at +48 600 091 196. The competitions take place on mountain trails, with online registration and distances for different ability levels. Participants can choose a marathon, half marathon, or shorter-distance runs.

name: Rusínska 100 a 66
description: Rusínska 100 and 66 is a late-summer ultrarun and long-distance hike starting and finishing in the town of Stropkov. The routes run through the Ondavská Highlands in Zemplín County and continue into Šariš County via the town of Svidník, crossing the region of Rusyn villages and following the border with Poland. The R100 route partly passes through the Eastern Carpathians Protected Landscape Area. The event is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League, is ITRA-certified, and is included in the ITRA National League. It is organised by o.z. Klub bežcov Stropkov, which provides warm hospitality and high-quality organisation.
course_highlights: Routes run through the Ondavská Highlands and the northern part of the Low Beskids
Passage through the Eastern Carpathians Protected Landscape Area
A region with historic religious buildings, lookout towers and cultural monuments
additional: The event takes place on 23–24 August 2025. Rusínska 100 and 66 are part of the 11th edition of the Slovak Ultratrail League. The routes are intended for ultrarunners and long-distance hikers and pass through challenging terrain rich in history and natural beauty. The organisers and volunteers provide warm hospitality and quality support for participants. The routes run mainly along forest and trail paths, with several sections of asphalt; registration is open from 1 May to 20 September 2025; the event highlights the region’s natural beauty and historic landmarks.

name: Hradný gaštanový beh Modrý Kameň
location: Park pred vstupom do Hradu Modrý Kameň, Modrý Kameň, Banskobystrický kraj, Slovakia
organizer: Mesto Modrý Kameň v spolupráci s občianskym združením Bežci VK
price_range: 15 eur pre hlavný 10 km beh, 5 eur pre hobby a Nordic Walking, juniors 7 eur, zľavy pre seniorov nad 60+

price_tiers.distance: Nordic walking a hobby beh 5 km

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Nordic walking a hobby beh 5 km - 15 eur

description: The Modrý Kameň Castle Chestnut Run is a running event held in the park in front of the entrance to Modrý Kameň Castle. The race offers various categories, including a 5 km fun run for children and juniors, a 10 km main race for adults, and 5 km Nordic walking. The course follows asphalt, meadows, forest trails and field roads, providing a varied and enjoyable running experience. The event is organized by the Town of Modrý Kameň in cooperation with the Bežci VK civic association. The children’s start is at 10:00, and the adults’ start is at 11:00.
course_highlights: The course follows asphalt, meadows, forest trails and field roads
The event takes place in the park in front of the entrance to Modrý Kameň Castle
Various categories, including fun runs, junior races and Nordic walking
additional: A 50% discount on the entry fee is available for participants aged 60 and over. On-site registration is available at least 30 minutes before the start of the main race and Nordic walking, with an additional €17 entry fee. The course includes asphalt, meadows, forest trails and field roads; categories are available for children, recreational runners and competitive runners; starts are at 10:00 and 11:00.

name: Čachtický polmaratón

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: elektronicky do 20. augusta 2026 /streda/ štartovné 1-100 pretekár cena 10,- EUR

description: The Čachtice Half Marathon is a traditional half-marathon race taking place on 22 August 2026 in the village of Čachtice. The course runs mainly on asphalt along the streets of Čachtice to Višňové and Hrachovište, with a short section on a forest road. The course is gently undulating, with a maximum elevation gain of up to 90 metres. The start is in the square in Čachtice, and the finish is in the grounds of Čachtice Primary School. Refreshment stations are provided at several points along the course.
course_highlights: Asphalt surface with a short section on a forest road
Gently undulating course with a maximum elevation gain of up to 90 m
Refreshments at 6 km, 10.5 km, 12 km, 15 km and at the finish
additional: The maximum number of half-marathon runners is 250; the relay is limited to 10 teams. The relay is a separate category for teams of 3–4 runners. Race-day registration takes place from 06:30 to 08:30 in the grounds of Čachtice Primary School. Cash prizes are awarded for 1st–3rd place in the categories, and a raffle is held based on race numbers. Online registration is available until 20 August 2025. The maximum number of participants is 250, and the race has several checkpoints with refreshments.

name: Forbaský beh pomoci
location: areál Ščava, Forbasy, okres Stará Ľubovňa, Slovakia
description: The Forbasy Charity Run is a charitable running race held at the Ščava grounds in Forbasy, Stará Ľubovňa District. This event has a voluntary entry fee and supports helping others and solidarity. Runners can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere while contributing to a good cause. The organizer is Valer Kuffa, who is available to provide information and support to participants.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the Ščava grounds in Forbasy
Charity run with a voluntary entry fee
Pleasant atmosphere and support for a good cause
additional: The entry fee is a voluntary contribution; details at https://www.behpomoci.sk/fbp-2025/dobrovo%C4%BEn%C3%BD-pr%C3%ADspevok. Organizer: Valer Kuffa, tel.: +421 949 765 543. Race categories for different age groups; registration via voluntary donation.

name: Lukačovská 5

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 10,-€ na mieste v deň preteku do naplnenia limitu 80 pretekárov

description: Lukačovská 5 is a running race held at the football pitch in Lukačovce, Humenné District. The event features a 5 km main race and children’s races, with categories for men and women, as well as a non-competitive Nordic Walking category. The organizer is the Municipality of Lukačovce, which provides a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality race organization. The children’s races start at 10:00, and the main race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: A 5 km race in the pleasant surroundings of the football pitch in Lukačovce
Categories for men and women, plus a non-competitive Nordic Walking category
Main race limited to 80 participants
additional: The children’s races start at 10:00 and the main race at 11:00. The main race is limited to 80 participants. The organizer is the Municipality of Lukačovce, represented by Ing. Martin Sabol, Mayor. Contacts: Ing. Martin Sabol (Race Director, tel.: 0948 922 600) and Adrián Turik (tel.: 0948 228 212). The event also includes children’s categories. Registration is available online or on site, and the surface is probably flat, suitable for runners of all levels.

name: Harhovská desiatka
price_range: 10 € za hlavnú trať, 5 € za 3,5 km pretek
description: Harhovská desiatka is a running event in Spišský Hrhov, offering a 10 km course and a shorter 3.5 km course for recreational and beginner runners. The race is divided into several age categories for men and women, including a special category for residents of the municipality of Spišský Hrhov. The event is organized by the municipality of Spišský Hrhov, and the start is in front of the Municipal Office. The entry fee is paid at registration and is €10 for the 10 km course and €5 for the 3.5 km course.
course_highlights: 10 km course for advanced runners
3.5 km course for recreational and beginner runners
Start in front of the Municipal Office in Spišský Hrhov
additional: The entry fee is paid at registration on race day. Categories are divided by age and gender, including a category for residents of Spišský Hrhov. The 10 km course is certified by the Slovak Athletic Federation. The race takes place in summer, and registration is available online and on site.

name: Brezovský letný beh
location: Športové ihrisko, Rimavské Brezovo, Bardejov, Slovakia
description: Brezov Health Run is a traditional running race in the village of Brezov, Bardejov District, offering a route along paved roads, dirt roads and forest roads. The race is open to men and women, including youth aged up to 15 and over 15. The organizers have prepared two registration categories with a large and a small package, allowing participants to take part in this sporting event in pleasant surroundings by the Municipal Office in Brezov. The race is suitable for runners of various age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: Course surface: paved road, dirt road, forest road
Start location: by the Municipal Office in Brezov
Categories: men/women, youth aged up to 15 and over 15
additional: The course includes paved, rural and forest roads; the race is open to men, women and youth; registration is subject to a fee

name: Behaj lesmi Čičmany
price_range: €17 - €24 per race, discounts for multiple registrations
description: Behaj lesmi Čičmany is a running race set in the picturesque Slovak folk village of Čičmany. The course winds through the Strážov Mountains, with beautiful scenery, untouched forests, and expansive meadows. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series and is included in the UTMB Index Races, giving it international recognition and ranking. Choose from several distances, including the 20 km long course with 718 m of elevation gain, the 11 km Lesnícka course with 380 m of elevation gain, and a short 5 km course. The race also features a special Conti Speed Section, where the fastest runners can win valuable prizes.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Strážov Mountains, with up to 718 m of elevation gain on the 20 km distance
The race takes place in the authentic Slovak folk village of Čičmany, known for its painted wooden houses
The course includes a 150-metre Conti Speed Section, with prizes for the fastest runners
additional: Participants can transfer their registration and change their entry fee online through their SportID profile. The course features a Conti Speed Section with prizes for the fastest runners. The race is included in the UTMB Index Races, allowing participants to earn points toward the international trail-running rankings. The race is included in the UTMB Index, GPX files are available to download, categories are offered for different age groups, and registration is online.

name: Slopenská desítka
location: Slopné, Luhačovice, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: pro běžce ze Slopného na místě

description: Slopenská Desítka is a traditional cross-country race held in the picturesque village of Slopné near Luhačovice. The race features a challenging course with varied terrain, including paved roads, steep climbs, and descents through forest terrain. The start is located below the church and the finish is at the sports field, where runners are greeted by enthusiastic cheers from spectators. The event is suitable for the general public, including junior categories and family relays. The race is part of the year-round Běhy Zlín competitions and the KRAKONOŠ Czech Mountain Running Cup.
course_highlights: Start on a paved road below the church, with plenty of space for runners
A long 1,500 m climb on paved road and a steep climb through the forest up to the 2.5 km mark
The final three kilometres are entirely downhill, ending with a finishing straight at the sports field
additional: The family relay has three members and is run in three legs. Members must be related, with a minimum age difference of 18 years between two members. Registration closes 5 minutes before the start of the category. The overall winner receives a cash reward for every second under the set time. The main race starts about 100 m from the sports field, on a paved road below the church. The race is part of the local sports calendar and also offers family relays and prizes in various categories.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Stříbrná
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beautiful Ore Mountains. The series comprises 6 races in different locations, including Stříbrná, where the main race covers 6 to 9 km and the experience route covers 20 to 30 km. Children’s races and walking routes with checkpoints to find using a map are also available. The event is suitable for runners of all levels, canicross participants, children, and walkers, and offers a beautiful natural setting in the Ore Mountains.
course_highlights: Main race: 6–9 km through the Ore Mountains
Experience route: 20–30 km, navigated using a map
Children’s races: 200 m to 1,100 m
additional: The series comprises 6 races at different locations in the Ore Mountains. In addition to running routes, walking routes with checkpoints to find using a map and children’s races are available. The organizer is Živé Sokolovsko z.s., in cooperation with Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s. The races include various categories, including dog trekking and walking. Routes are unmarked, with checkpoints along the course; overtaking is prohibited. The series includes multiple locations and races in the Ore Mountains.

name: Běh pro Střížák
location: Střížovický vrch, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: Běh pro Střížák is a traditional race held on Střížovický Hill in Ústí nad Labem, now in its 16th year. The course is a loop run three times, with one significant climb and descent; otherwise, it is gently undulating. The event also includes shorter children’s and youth races, making it accessible to the wider community. The race has an interesting story: the course passes through an area once threatened by a planned development, which was cancelled after residents objected.
course_highlights: The loop is run three times
One challenging climb (220 m, 25 m elevation gain)
Gently undulating terrain with one descent of approximately 20 m over a 400 m section
additional: Shorter children’s (700 m) and youth (2.7 km) races are available. The course passes through an area once threatened by a planned indoor ski slope for year-round downhill skiing, which was cancelled after residents objected. The event includes a raffle and refreshments and is part of the local cross-country cup, with children and young people also welcome to take part.

name: Sengbachtalsperrenlauf
location: Sengbachtalsperre, Leichlingen-Witzhelden, Rheinisch-Bergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany

price_tiers.distance: Stadtwerke Solingen Familienlauf 1,2 km und 3,6 km

description: The Sengbach Reservoir Run is a traditional scenic race around the Sengbach Reservoir near Leichlingen-Witzhelden. The three main distances follow well-maintained forest trails and a paved section along the dam wall, on a loop of about 9.8 km with approximately 200 metres of elevation gain per lap. The course is traffic-free and runs through a protected landscape area. Families can take part in a separate race with shorter distances in the immediate vicinity of the event grounds. The event provides on-course refreshments and showers in nearby Kuhle.
course_highlights: Loop of approx. 9.8 km with 200 metres of elevation gain per lap
Well-maintained forest trails and a paved section along the dam wall
Traffic-free course in a protected landscape area
additional: Race packets will be available from 7:30 a.m. on race day at the registration tent. Showers are available at a school in the neighbouring village of Kuhle and are signposted. Refreshments including bananas, water, isotonic drinks and cola are provided about every 5 km; free tea and bananas are available at the finish. Certificates can be accessed online. The course is traffic-free, with two refreshment stations on the loop. A fundraising campaign for the Leverkusen Children's Hospice will be held. The course follows forest trails, with no roads. Donations to the children's hospice are welcome. Registration is open until race day; a late-entry fee of €5 applies from 11.08.2026.

name: Gladbecker Sparkassenlauf
description: The Gladbeck Sparkassenlauf is a traditional running event welcoming runners of all ages. It offers various distances, from the Bambini Marathon to the half marathon, as well as a team relay. All courses are DLV-certified and eligible for official rankings. Participants receive finisher medals and personalized race bibs bearing their names, making the running experience special. There is also a district championship classification and extensive award ceremonies.
course_highlights: DLV-certified courses: 1.5 km, 5 km, 10 km and half marathon
Personalized race bibs bearing participants’ first names
Live timing and net times for all races
additional: Finisher medals for all participants; personalized race bibs bearing first names; live timing with net times; changing rooms and showers at the stadium; valuables can be left at storage facilities; trophies and certificates for winners and age-group winners; team and club classifications; district championships with certificates and badges; no classification for the Bambini or walking events. Courses at Gladbeck Stadium; online registration; late registration available until 1 hour before the start; medical assistance provided by the German Red Cross; various course distances and categories.

name: FlorSTADT Halbmarathon 2026
description: The FlorSTADT Half Marathon is a popular race in Florstadt, Hesse, taking place for the 11th time on August 23, 2026. In addition to the half marathon, the event offers races over 10 km, 5 km, 1.8 km and 300 m, so the whole family can take part. The course runs through a beautiful forest and is secured, with plenty of aid stations and medical support. The race is part of the Main-Kinzig Challenge and is an excellent preparation for the Frankfurt Marathon. Food and drinks are available, and participants can download a personalized certificate.
course_highlights: Hesse’s most beautiful forest half marathon
Plenty of aid stations along the course
Secured course with medical support
additional: Commentary by Runningvoices, free photo downloads, organic fruit at the finish, warm-up with Smarttraining Ortenberg, playground right by the start/finish area, an event for the whole family, personalized certificate to download, refreshments provided by the Gadde-Crew. The event is part of the Main-Kinzig-Challenge and offers electronic timing, medical support and a photo service. August weather is typically warm, around 25°C.

name: ews Volks- und Spendenlauf
description: The 14th ews Volks- und Spendenlauf runs through Bad Segeberg, past scenic spots such as Kalkberg and the Great Segeberger Lake. Since 2011, the race has been a regular part of the city’s sporting calendar, combining athletic achievement with the enjoyment of exercising together and charitable engagement. The event supports selected projects each year, with donations divided among three projects in 2026. It is a community event that brings together exercise and social commitment.
course_highlights: Through Bad Segeberg
Past Kalkberg
Along the Great Segeberger Lake
additional: Team entries are only possible using a paper form, which must be sent by email to info@volkslauf-bad-segeberg.de by 02 October 2023. Race number collection takes place at the registration desk on 23 August 2026. Registration is online and requires agreement to the liability waiver and data protection terms. The focus is on enjoying exercise and charitable engagement. The race runs through Bad Segeberg and includes walking and Nordic walking. Donations support local projects. Registration is open until June 2026. Team and individual starts are possible.

name: TuS Hiltrup Halbmarathon
location: Stadion am Osttor, Münster, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The TuS Hiltrup Half Marathon is an established running event in Münster, starting and finishing at the Osttor Stadium. The course includes a lap of the stadium, runs along the canal promenade and through the Hiltrup residential area, offering a varied and attractive running environment. In addition to the classic half marathon, there is also a relay race, which is especially appealing to teams. The event is open to runners born in 2008 or earlier (individual race) and 2010 or earlier (relay), and offers a family-friendly atmosphere at a large sports club.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Osttor Stadium
Run along the canal promenade with views of the canal
Course through the Hiltrup residential area, with varied terrain
additional: Individual entries for the half marathon are sold out; only relay places are still available. The course closes at 12:00, after 3 hours of racing. The course is accessible, and detailed information is available for local residents about the route and traffic regulations on race day. Measured course, start at Osttor Stadium, individual and relay races, online registration, start times at 9:00 and 9:05, course closes after 3 hours.

name: H Lauf 2026
description: The 10-hour run in Hanau is a charity event held on the grounds of Paul-Gerhardt-Schule. The event starts at 9:00 a.m. and runs until 7:00 p.m., with participants running for a good cause. The run offers a special opportunity to experience endurance and community while supporting social projects.
course_highlights: Run on the grounds of Paul-Gerhardt-Schule Hanau
10-hour run from 9:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m.
Event for a good cause
additional: The run takes place on the grounds of Paul-Gerhardt-Schule Hanau. A program and flyers are available to download as PDFs. The event is a social initiative that raises donations. The run takes place on the school grounds and lasts 10 hours, making it ideal for anyone who wants to challenge their endurance.

name: Rotherbaum 10K Hamburg - K Rotherbaum
description: The 10K Rotherbaum is an officially measured 10-kilometer race in Hamburg, held in accordance with international competition regulations. The course is a loop registered with the German Athletics Association and AIMS, making finish times eligible for rankings. The event is open to runners of all age groups and offers a cup competition across all 10K Hamburg races, with attractive prizes. Registration is online only, and participants are asked to travel by public transport.
course_highlights: Officially measured 10 km loop course
Start and finish near Hallerstraße U-Bahn station
Finish times eligible for rankings under the IWB and AIMS
additional: A bag drop for personal belongings is available on the event day. The cup competition covers all 10K Hamburg events, with points awarded to the 30 fastest men and women. Official registration confirmation will be sent by email after registration closes. Travel by public transport is recommended, especially to Hallerstraße U-Bahn station. The race is part of the Hamburg 10K Series, which includes various running events in Hamburg. Registration is available online, and various categories are offered.

name: Der Alstertallauf
price_range: Halbmarathon: 40,00 € (Nachmeldungen 45,00 €), 10 km: 30,00 € (35,00 €), 4 km: 20,00 € (25,00 €), Kinder- und Schnupperläufe ab 10,00 €
description: The Alstertallauf is a family-friendly race on the upper Alster hiking trail, considered Hamburg’s most beautiful running route. It welcomes runners of all ages and recreational athletes and offers several distances. The event takes place near the Albert-Schweitzer-Gymnasium in Hamburg and is known for its friendly atmosphere. In 2022, more than 200 runners took part, with distances ranging from 410 m to 10 km.
course_highlights: Race on the upper Alster hiking trail, considered Hamburg’s most beautiful running route
Family-friendly race for all ages and ability levels
Several distances: 410 m, 1,500 m, 4 km and 10 km
additional: The start location is the Albert-Schweitzer-Gymnasium, Wellingsbütteler Landstraße 43, 22337 Hamburg; signs direct participants from U-Klein Borstel. The event includes several distances for different age groups and ability levels. Results and impressions from previous years are available online. The event is organized by Hamburger Turnerbund von 1862 e.V. Race on the Alster hiking trail, registration via www.davengo.com, start/finish at the Albert-Schweitzer-Gymnasium, no parking, public transport recommended, changing rooms and showers available on site.

name: Eschweiler Citylauf 2026
description: The Eschweiler City Run will take place for the third time on August 23, 2026, and is organized by the Marathon-Club Eschweiler, which is organizing a public race in Eschweiler for the 40th time. The start and finish are in Eschweiler city center, on Marienstraße and Grabenstraße. The event offers children’s races and two distances for adults: 5 kilometers and 10 kilometers. The 10-kilometer race also counts as the LVN-Nordrhein Championships. The City Run is part of the newly established Regio Aachen Running Cup and offers runners an attractive route through the city center.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Eschweiler city center (Marienstraße and Grabenstraße)
Distances: 5 km and 10 km, with RAC scoring
Part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup
additional: The start and finish are on Marienstraße in Eschweiler city center. There are children’s races and two distances for adults. The race is part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup. The 10 km race also counts as the LVN-Nordrhein Championships. Various activities, a children’s program, on-site and online late registration, and various race distances.

name: Gettorfer Staffelmarathon
description: The Gettorf Relay Marathon is a team marathon taking place on August 23, 2026, at Sportpark Gettorf. The course is an approximately 4.2 km loop, run ten times. Teams consist of 5 to 10 people, who pass the chipped relay baton in the exchange zone. Alternatively, two people can take part in the Duo Marathon and divide the ten laps between them as they choose. Timing is electronic, using transponders and shoe chips, and split times are recorded for each runner.
course_highlights: Approximately 4.2 km loop at Sportpark Gettorf
Ten laps per team or duo
Electronic timing with a relay-baton transponder and shoe chip
additional: The finish cutoff for both events is 4:45 p.m. Each person may run a maximum of two laps. Team assignments (registrant changes) can be made online until registration closes. Bib numbers are mandatory and provided by the organizer. Online registration is available, with an early-bird discount. Support from local partners such as AOK NordWest, Zippel’s Läuferwelt, Förde Sparkasse, EGE.

name: Bielebohlauf
description: The Bielebohlauf Oppach is a running event in the Lusatian Mountains, offering a range of distances from 400 m to 20 km. The races follow forest, meadow and field paths, as well as minor roads around the Bieleboh. The longer routes are challenging and include steep climbs. Special Bambini and children’s races are available. Refreshments and entertainment are provided at Oppach Stadium, and finishers receive certificates and online clips.
course_highlights: Routes through the landscape of the Lusatian Mountains around the Bieleboh
Forest, meadow and field paths, as well as minor roads
Challenging longer routes with steep climbs
additional: Late registration is available on site for a €5 late registration fee. Dogs are allowed on the walking route; a leash and muzzle are required in the stadium. Trophies and gifts are awarded to route winners in distances of 4.9 km and longer, as well as age-group winners. Age-appropriate gifts are awarded to winners of the 1.5 km route. Results, finisher clips and certificates are available online immediately after the race. Food, drinks and entertainment are provided at the stadium. Routes include climbs; dogs are allowed on the walking route; food and drinks are available.

name: 1. Laufchallenge Mellendorfer TV
description: The 2026 Sparkassen-Laufpass of the Hanover Region features 43 running events, making it the largest series of its kind in Germany. Participants can collect stamps at events across the Hanover Region and discover the area on the run. Each successful participation earns a stamp, and frequent runners can earn attractive rewards in gold, silver or bronze. You can take part directly at the individual races, which take place at many beautiful locations and offer a variety of activities. There is also a Laufpass app with an event calendar and a digital running diary.
course_highlights: A variety of running events at beautiful locations across the Hanover Region
Collect stamps at a total of 43 running events in 2026
Exclusive gold, silver and bronze rewards for frequent runners
additional: The Laufpass is available both as a traditional fold-out booklet and digitally via the Laufpass app. In addition to the event calendar, the app includes a digital running diary. Participation takes place directly at the individual races held throughout the year. Take part in the Laufpass series and collect stamps; available digitally and in traditional format; part of Germany’s largest running series.

name: Die Generalprobe
description: Die Generalprobe is an urban road race in Berlin, serving as the perfect preparation for the BMW BERLIN-MARATHON. On August 23, 2026, runners can test their fitness on a super-flat circuit through the Berlin districts of Steglitz, Wilmersdorf, and Zehlendorf. Events include a quarter marathon, a half marathon, and races for children and teenagers. The event stands out for its lively atmosphere and a personalized medal for every finisher.
course_highlights: Super-flat circuit through the Berlin neighborhoods of Steglitz, Wilmersdorf, and Zehlendorf
Two race distances: quarter marathon (10.5 km) and half marathon (21 km)
The course passes through typical Berlin residential districts with an urban feel
additional: Timing is provided by a MIKA TAG transponder attached to the back of the race bib; it does not need to be returned. The Kids & Youth races start from 08:15, with distances from 200 m to 800 m. Late entries are possible on the day of the event. The start and finish for the main races are on Schlossstraße, Berlin-Steglitz. The participant limit is 4,000. The course passes through the districts of Steglitz, Wilmersdorf, and Zehlendorf; medals for all finishers; results and certificates available to download; age-group winners receive free entry for the following year.

name: RAG Hartfüssler Trail
location: Saarbrücken-Von der Heydt, Saarbrücken, Saarland, Germany
description: The RAG Hartfüssler Trail in Saarbrücken-Von der Heydt commemorates the region’s 250-year mining history and honors the hardworking miners who covered long distances on foot. The event offers four trail distances from 7.5 km to 58 km, with varied routes through nature and historic mining sites. Runners can expect well-marked trails, aid stations serving regional specialties, and a welcoming atmosphere with fair cancellation policies. The event is ideal for trail-running enthusiasts looking to combine an athletic challenge with a cultural experience.
course_highlights: A range of trails from 7.5 km to 58 km
Routes pass through former mining areas and natural landscapes
Aid stations with regional specialties and drinks
additional: Start times: 58 km at 08:00, 30 km at 10:00, 14 km and 7.5 km at 11:00. Briefings take place 15 minutes before each start. Aid stations provide water, isotonic drinks, fruit, snacks, and regional specialties. Cups are not provided; bring your own drinking vessel. Finishers receive a medal, certificate, and personalized bib. Time limits: 6 hours for 30 km and 10 hours for 58 km. Medical support and course marshals are available. Event shirts can be ordered optionally. Good connections by Saarbahn and parking are available. Trail running, challenging terrain, several events around trail and ultrarunning, scenic routes, mining history theme

name: 7. PKO Tarnogórski Półmaraton oraz Tarnogórska Srebrna Dyszka
description: The 7th PKO Tarnogórski Half Marathon and Tarnogórska Srebrna Dyszka are the region’s biggest running celebration, taking place on August 23, 2026. The 21.0975 km half-marathon course runs entirely on paved streets in Tarnowskie Góry, with vehicle traffic partially closed. Refreshment and hydration stations will be available for participants. The time limit for completing the half marathon has been extended to 3 hours, so everyone can cross the finish line with a smile and earn a medal. The Srebrna Dyszka is a run of approximately 10.5 km, complementing the event’s running program.
course_highlights: Course runs entirely on paved streets in Tarnowskie Góry
Refreshment and hydration stations on the half-marathon and Srebrna Dyszka courses
Vehicle traffic partially closed along the course
additional: The time limit for completing the half marathon has been extended to 3 hours. The half marathon is certified by the PZLA, while the Srebrna Dyszka is not certified. The half-marathon course has checkpoints; shortening the course results in disqualification. Paved course, 3-hour time limit, refreshment and hydration stations, limited number of participants.

name: IV BIEG PEŁNEJ MISKI
description: Bieg Pełnej Miski is a charity running event held in Szubin to support animal shelters through the “Pełna Miska” campaign. The race has been held annually since 2023, and the next edition is scheduled for August 23, 2026. The event combines sporting competition with the goal of helping homeless animals, bringing together the local community and running enthusiasts. The organizers encourage people to take part and work together to support animals.
course_highlights: 5 km main race
Children’s races and a dog walk
Virtual race, with participants able to take part from anywhere
additional: The event includes the main race, children’s races, a dog walk, and a virtual race option. Fees vary depending on the package and registration date. Proceeds support animal shelters, and participants can receive commemorative medals by post.

name: Biegi wokół Bursztynowej Góry
description: Runs Around Bursztynowa Góra is an annual running event held in picturesque Bąkowo and is part of the Kaszuby Biegają series. The races attract runners from various age categories, offering appealing courses and the unique atmosphere of Kashubia. It is a great opportunity to spend time outdoors amid beautiful natural surroundings and local culture. The organizers ensure professional event management and a welcoming atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: The course runs around Bursztynowa Góra in Bąkowo
Picturesque landscapes of Kashubia
A course suited to runners in various categories
additional: The event is part of the Kaszuby Biegają series, which includes many races in the Kashubia region. It has a family-friendly, community-building character, with categories for children and young people as well as adults. The organizers provide electronic timing and medals for participants. The event also includes other races and accompanying activities, with opportunities for children and young people to take part. The course most likely passes through rural and natural areas, making for appealing running conditions.

name: XVI Festiwal Biegowy Dziki Weekend
description: The 16th Dziki Weekend Running Festival is an annual sporting event held in Police, West Pomeranian Voivodeship. Organized since 2010 by the DZIK Running Club Association, the festival is one of the region’s best-known running events. It promotes an active lifestyle, cross-country running, and sporting competition for children and young people, while also showcasing the natural attractions of the Wkrzańska Forest. All races start and finish at the sports clearing at 99 Piaskowa Street in Police.
course_highlights: Cross-country routes through the natural landscape of the Wkrzańska Forest
Obstacle races for children and young people (mud, tires, walls, water obstacles, ropes)
Start and finish at the sports clearing at 99 Piaskowa Street in Police
additional: Children’s and youth races take place on 22–23 August 2026. Children’s races on 22.08.2026 start between 10:35 and 11:20, with 5–10 minutes between age-category starts. The obstacle race on 23.08.2026 starts at 10:00, in waves of 10 every 3–5 minutes, divided by sectors and age. The race office is open on 21.08.2026 (14:00–21:30), 22.08.2026 (8:30–11:30), and 23.08.2026 (8:00–11:00). Awards ceremonies take place after the races at 12:30. Children’s race routes are approximately 200 m to 1 km long, while obstacle routes are approximately 600 m to 1 km. The event includes various race categories, online registration, charitable and sporting events, including the Nordic Walking Polish Cup final.

name: Minimaratón
location: Atletický štadión na Štiavničkách, Banská Bystrica, Slovakia
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT OZ, Minimaratón OZ
description: The Minimathon is a unique running event exclusively for families with children, held at the Štiavničky athletics stadium in Banská Bystrica. The event offers various age categories, from the youngest runners to older children, including mothers with strollers. The course is tailored to the age groups, with 400 m and 200 m loops. Alongside the sporting experience, there is an accompanying programme featuring activities for children and opportunities to meet athletes. Every participant receives a commemorative race bib, a medal and refreshments after finishing.
course_highlights: Course for children born in 2011–2020 and mothers with strollers – 400 m loop
Shortened 200 m course for children under 5
SNP Athletics Stadium in Štiavničky – a beautiful track and setting
additional: Online registration is available until 22.8.2026; in person on 21.8.2026 at Europa SC and on 23.8.2026 at the stadium from 8:00. The entry fee is non-refundable and cannot be transferred to the following year. Refreshments and medical services are provided after the finish. There will be no bag storage or changing rooms. At 11:50, a prize draw for valuable prizes will be held for everyone who finishes. Terrain: athletics stadium; online and in-person registration; medals and prizes for participants; 11th anniversary edition; accompanying programme including an aircraft flyover and family activities

name: Beh na boso Tatry
location: Golfový rezort Black Stork, Veľká Lomnica, Slovakia
description: Beh na boso Tatry is a running event in the beautiful surroundings of the Black Stork Golf Resort in Veľká Lomnica. Participants can choose between non-competitive runs for children and adults and a competitive 5 km run. The course follows mown grass and runs over paths and pebbles, giving it a cross-country character. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a pleasant atmosphere in the Tatras. It is organised by OZ Beh na boso Tatry, which ensures the event runs smoothly.
course_highlights: The course follows mown grass
Sections over paths and carpet-covered pebbles
A cross-country course in the surroundings of the Black Stork Golf Resort
additional: The non-competitive runs start at 9:30, and the competitive 5 km run starts at 10:30. Categories are divided by age and gender. The non-competitive runs are 250 m for children up to 12 years old and 1 km for children and adults. The course includes mown grass, paths, pebbles and cross-country terrain. Registration is also available on site. The event supports charitable activities and offers refreshments and activities for children.

name: Běh Smetánkou
description: The Smetánka Run is a 3.5 km off-road race held in Prague 9 and is part of the SABZO series. It offers runners the chance to enjoy a run in a natural setting with varied terrain. It is suitable for anyone looking for a short but dynamic race in a pleasant atmosphere. The race is a traditional part of Prague’s running season and attracts runners from the surrounding area.
course_highlights: 3.5 km off-road course
Part of the SABZO series
Natural setting in Prague 9
additional: The race is intended for runners of all levels; registration and exact details are not explicitly provided.

name: B2Run Hamburg
description: B2Run Hamburg on 25 August 2026 is a corporate run covering around 5.6 km, finishing with a spectacular entry into the Volksparkstadion. The varied route is mostly flat, making it ideal for beginners, walkers and experienced runners. The event promotes team spirit, motivation and a sense of community, and is perfect for companies and individual participants from Hamburg and the surrounding area. Alongside the sporting experience, the race offers a professional supporting programme with an MC and music.
course_highlights: A varied, mostly flat loop of around 5.6 km
Spectacular finish in the Volksparkstadion
Route suitable for beginners, walkers and experienced runners
additional: The event is a large team occasion, with plenty of opportunities for team building and networking. There is a professional supporting programme with an MC and music. Individual participants without a team are very welcome. The route is designed so teams can cross the finish line together. 5 km route, finish in the Volksparkstadion, team event, supporting programme with music, support for the “Menschen für Menschen” foundation

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (9) – srpnový
description: The 5 and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY is a regular running series in Prague-Braník, offering a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava. The races are suitable for runners of all levels, from beginners to professionals, and personal bests are often set here. The course is certified, and the 10 km race offers the opportunity to run a qualifying time for the Czech Championships (MČR). After the race, participants can get together and refuel at a local restaurant. The series is part of its 16th edition and rewards not only the top runners but also loyal participants.
course_highlights: Pleasant, fast course along the Vltava in Prague-Braník
Course measured by a certified course measurer
Opportunity to run a qualifying time for the Czech Championships (MČR) in the 10 km race
additional: Check-in from 18:00; 10 km start at 19:00; 5 km start at 19:05. Post-race refreshments (food, beer, sports drink) at Hamr Braník restaurant. Bag storage is available in the organizers’ tent. Toilets are available in the Hamr Braník complex. You can withdraw up to 24 hours before the start and receive a refund of the entry fee. Public transport is recommended; P+R parking is available at Nádraží Braník. Prizes for the top runners and loyal participants, plus a post-race raffle. Registration includes the option to sign up early, with possible discounts. The races are open to runners of all levels, from beginners to professional competitors.

name: Běh Modřanskou roklí - Memoriál Zdeňka Buriana
location: Modřanská rokle, Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Běh Modřanskou roklí - Zdeněk Burian Memorial is a 4 km race on a gently undulating course in the Modřanská rokle Nature Reserve in Prague 4. The race is part of the SABZO series and features a staggered start, allowing the event to run smoothly. The course is suitable for runners who want to enjoy a run in nature with gentle elevation changes. It is ideal for anyone looking for a short but technically interesting run in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: 4 km course in the Modřanská rokle Nature Reserve
Gently undulating terrain with natural features
Staggered start for a smooth race
additional: The race has a staggered start. It is part of the SABZO series. The course is gently undulating and runs through the Modřanská rokle Nature Reserve in Prague 4. The race is part of the SABZO series, which supports the running community in Prague. Exact registration and entry fee details have not yet been published.

name: Bürostadtlauf 2026
location: Sportanlage Hahnstraße, Frankfurt am Main, Hesse, Germany
organizer: Cargo Human Care und Lufthansa Sportverein ev, Sparte Cargo Bulls

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Bürostadtlauf 2026 in Frankfurt am Main is a sporting event with heart, taking place live on 27 August 2026 at the Hahnstraße sports facility in Niederrad. The 5 km and 10 km races follow a flat, fast and mostly shaded course along the golf course and Goldstein Cemetery. Alongside the sporting competition, supporting a good cause is at the heart of the event: proceeds will support the expansion of the Vocational Training Centre in Nairobi, which gives young people new opportunities. The event combines sport, team spirit and social commitment in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Flat, fast and mostly shaded course
Course along the golf course and Goldstein Cemetery
Asphalt and very good forest paths, with kilometre markers
additional: Race number collection from 16:45; 5 km race starts at 18:15, 10 km race at 19:05; finish closes at 20:20; raffle and awards ceremony from 20:30; age-group rankings from U20 to M/W75 in five-year increments; medical services on the course and at the finish; water stations along the course; race number includes a timing transponder. The event also includes 30 km and 50 km cycling events; registration until 23 August 2026; start times at 18:15 and 19:05; participant limit of 1,100; flat course on asphalt and forest paths.

name: Beskydská sedmička
description: IMOS Beskydská sedmička is an extreme mountain marathon across the entire Beskydy Mountains, running from Třinec to Frenštát pod Radhoštěm. This challenging race, approximately 101 km long with 5,500 m+ of elevation gain, is the Czech Championship in individual mountain marathons and is open to individuals and pairs. The race starts at night at 23:00 from the athletics stadium in Třinec, and the finish gate closes 28 hours later on Sunday morning. The race offers a unique experience of the Beskydy mountain landscape and well-equipped aid stations along the course.
course_highlights: Approximately 101 km with 5,500 m+ of elevation gain across the main Beskydy range
Starts in Třinec at 23:00 and finishes in Frenštát pod Radhoštěm, with a 28-hour time limit
Aid stations along the course in locations including Ostravice, Pustevny, Morávka, and others
additional: Accreditation takes place on Friday, 28 August 2026, from 13:00 to 22:00 at the STARS sports hall in Třinec. Free shuttle transport from Frenštát pod Radhoštěm to the start in Třinec is provided for competitors. Soup and sausages are available at the aid stations, though soup is offered only at designated stations. Competitors can use baggage storage, with bags identified by race number. The athletics stadium stands will be open to supporters and fans, making the start a memorable experience for them too. The race includes aid stations, course changes compared with previous editions, the option to download a GPX file, a 28-hour finish limit, a 23:00 start, and a finish at 3:00 the following day.

name: 7. Ahnepark-Lauf der Laufgemeinschaft Vellmar
description: The 7th Ahnepark Run, organized by Laufgemeinschaft Vellmar, is a late-summer running event in Vellmar. This club race offers two distances, 200 meters and 17.3 kilometers, and is designed primarily as a community run. Registration and results are managed through my.raceresult.com. The race is listed in the laufen.de running calendar and features officially measured courses that are relevant for rankings.
course_highlights: Two distances: 200 m and 17.3 km
Event in Ahnepark in Vellmar
Officially measured courses for rankings
additional: Registration and results are handled through my.raceresult.com. The race takes place in typical August weather, with temperatures around 25 °C and mostly sunny days. It is a local club race without major branding or destination elements. Distances: 200 m, 17.3 km; registration and results through my.raceresult.com; listed in the laufen.de running calendar

name: Lemgoer Hanselauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmeldung am Veranstaltungstag ab 16 Uhr möglich

description: The Lemgo Hanselauf is a traditional running event held annually on the last or second-to-last Friday in August in Lemgo. The event offers 3.3 km, 6.6 km and 10 km courses along the city’s ramparts. Children and Bambinis can also take part over shorter distances, making the Hanselauf a family-friendly event. With around 1,000 participants, the Hanselauf is a sporting highlight in the region that brings together fun and community.
course_highlights: Course along Lemgo’s historic ramparts
Distances of 3.3 km, 6.6 km and 10 km
Children’s and Bambini runs over 1.5 km and 400 m
additional: Bib collection and late registration on the event day from 4 p.m. in the right-hand school wing of Engelbert-Kämpfer-Gymnasium. No timing or placings for the children’s and Bambini runs. Assemble at the start from 4:55 p.m. Participation is free. Run along the ramparts, children’s and Bambini runs, registration at Engelbert-Kämpfer-Gymnasium, late registration available on the event day.

name: Ibbenbürener Aaseelauf 2026
description: The Ibbenbüren Aasee Run is a long-standing running event taking place for the 41st time in 2026. The event offers races for children of kindergarten and primary-school age, as well as a 5 km fun run, a 5 km team run, and a 10 km main race for competitive and recreational runners. The course runs around Lake Aasee, with the start and finish at Stadion Ost in Ibbenbüren. The event is limited to 1,000 participants and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and good on-course support.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stadion Ost, Ibbenbüren
Loop course around Lake Aasee, with three laps in the 10 km main race
Drinks stations along the course and in the finish area
additional: Late registration is available on event day from 15:00 until 1 hour before the start of each race for a fee of €2.50. Changes to entries are also possible on event day for a fee. €1 per registration is donated to a charitable organization. Free parking is available at Stadion Ost. Race bibs can be collected on event day from 15:00. Timing is recorded using transponders on the back of the race bib. Registration is online only, with a limited number of places. Late registration costs €2.50; charitable projects can be supported.

name: Sparkassen-Abendlauf
location: Hohenhorster Wald, Recklinghausen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Sparkassen Evening Run in Recklinghausen is a summer running event organized by Recklinghäuser Leichtathletik Club in cooperation with Sparkasse Vest Recklinghausen. Two distances are offered: 5 km (two laps) and 10 km (four laps) through Hohenhorster Forest. Both courses are officially measured and eligible for inclusion in rankings. The evening run also hosts the district championships over 10 km, for which a valid competition licence in the FLVW district of Recklinghausen is required.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km courses in Hohenhorster Forest
Officially measured courses eligible for inclusion in rankings
10 km district championships held as part of the evening run
additional: The 5 km course consists of two laps, and the 10 km course consists of four laps through Hohenhorster Forest. Participants in the 10 km district championships must tick the corresponding box when registering and hold a valid competition licence. Courses in Hohenhorster Forest, district championships held as part of the event

name: Straßenlauf Rund um den Holtenauer Leuchtturm
5. LSG-Waldauer-Wiesen-Lauf
location: Sportplatz Waldauer Wiesen, Kassel, Hesse, Germany
description: The 5th LSG-Waldauer-Wiesen-Lauf is an evening running event held at the Waldauer Wiesen sports ground in Kassel. The event offers various distances for all age groups, from a 500 m Bambini run to an 18 km run. The shorter children’s races start first, followed by the longer races in the early evening. The courses are well marked and run around the Bugasee and along the Wahlebach, among other places, with refreshment stations and childcare available on site.
course_highlights: 5 km out-and-back course
9.5 km loop around the Bugasee with a Wahlebach section
18 km course consists of two laps of the 9.5 km course
additional: Marked courses, two refreshment stations, catering and childcare are available. Online registration is possible via the event portal. Walking is no longer a separate category, but participants can walk the 5 km or 9.5 km courses. The running courses go around the Bugasee; registration is online via Raceresult. Parking is limited, so travel by public transport is recommended. The event also offers childcare and refreshments on site.

name: Domabergsprint
description: The Doma Mountain Sprint in Calw-Stammheim is a challenging mountain run covering 2.2 kilometres with an elevation gain of 245 metres. The course leads from the Nagold Valley up to a point below the district’s highest elevation and includes three runnable trails and a longer stretch of scree. The run is approved as a charity run and is characterised by steep paths suitable for both younger and older runners. Participants can time themselves and can also complete the run two weeks before the official race day.
course_highlights: 2.2-kilometre course with 245 metres of elevation gain
Three runnable trails
Longer stretch of scree with channels formed by heavy rain
additional: The run is an approved charity run, and participants time themselves. It is possible to complete the run 14 days before the official race day. Self-timing is available, with the option to take part before race day; no specific information is provided about registration or entry fees.

name: Leunaer Saaleanlagenlauf
description: The Leuna Saaleanlagen Run takes place on 21 August 2026 in Leuna and offers various race distances from 1.4 km to 9.6 km. The event is aimed especially at children and school students, creating a family-friendly atmosphere. The race runs through the Saaleanlagen and promises pleasant running weather, with mostly sunny conditions in August. Participants can look forward to a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Runs through the Saaleanlagen in Leuna
Distances from 1.4 km to 9.6 km
Family-friendly event focused on children and school students
additional: Typical August weather: approx. 25 °C, low of 14 °C, average precipitation of 60 mm, mostly sunny. The event takes place in August, with typical temperatures around 25°C. It offers a family-friendly atmosphere with various race categories.

name: Sparkassen-Tauchscher-Stadtlauf
description: The Sparkassen-Tauchscher City Run is a traditional running event organized by Leichtathletik Club Taucha e. V. in the town of Taucha on the Parthe. The 21st edition of this city run will take place on August 28, 2026, and also incorporates the State Championships in the 10 km road race. The event offers runners of all age groups an attractive opportunity to compete in a lively atmosphere. Registration opens in February 2026.
course_highlights: Integrated State Championships in the 10 km road race
City run through Taucha, the town on the Parthe
Traditional running event organized by Leichtathletik Club Taucha e. V.
additional: Registration opens in February 2026; the event also includes special categories and town festival elements.

name: Letni Ultra Świr
description: Letni Ultra Świr is a unique 24-hour ultramarathon on a 15 km loop near Grybów. It is a challenge for runners who want to test the limits of their endurance and enjoy an atmosphere full of sweat, dust and fatigue, but also laughter and madness. The event attracts long-distance running enthusiasts, offering a one-of-a-kind experience and plenty of thrills.
course_highlights: 15 km loop
Race duration: 24 hours
A course full of sweat, dust and fatigue
additional: The race takes place on a 15 km loop and lasts 24 hours. The event is characterized by a lack of limits on common sense and a big dose of excitement. In previous editions, a 17 km Nordic Walking event was also held, but no details about other formats have been provided for Letni Ultra Świr 24h. The start and finish are located at the Winter Sports Centre in Ptaszkowa (information from other editions). The event includes various distances and formats, including ultra, trail and Nordic Walking, with online registration. Start and finish in Ptaszkowa, with an exciting atmosphere and a passion for running.

name: Kácovský běh
location: Náměstí kněžny Toskánské, Kácov, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Kácov Run is a traditional running race held on the last Saturday in August in the picturesque Posázaví region. It offers three main routes—the Devatenáctka, the Desítka and the Kolečko—with varied terrain and elevation that challenge both experienced runners and beginners. The start and finish are in the centre of Kácov, with refreshment stations on the longer routes. The race is timed using chip timing and accompanied by a varied programme, including children’s races and a raffle.
course_highlights: Devatenáctka: 18.8 km with 380 m of elevation gain, a mix of surfaces including forest trails and asphalt
Desítka: 10.4 km with 160 m of elevation gain, similarly varied terrain to the Devatenáctka
Kolečko: 2.9 km with 20 m of elevation gain, suitable for children and beginners
additional: The race uses chip timing, with instructions on how to position the chip correctly. Refreshment stations are available along the course and at the finish for the Devatenáctka and Desítka. A bonus competition for the fastest Kácov man/woman is available to permanent residents of Kácov. Children’s races have a voluntary entry fee and are divided by age. The race includes various categories, the surface combines roads and trails, registration is available online and on site, and the event supports local tourism.

name: Cross Parkmaraton
location: Krásná Lípa, Česká Švýcarsko, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Cross Parkmarathon in Krásná Lípa is a traditional race set in the picturesque surroundings of Bohemian Switzerland National Park. The course runs through hilly terrain, mainly along forest trails, with beautiful views of the Lusatian Mountains. The event offers various disciplines, including a marathon, half marathon, shorter runs, Nordic walking, canicross, and relay races. It is suitable for the general public and running enthusiasts of all ages. In 2019, it received the Bohemian-Saxon Switzerland Regional Product certificate as a certified experience.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain, mainly along forest trails
Picturesque scenery in Bohemian Switzerland National Park
Views of the Lusatian Mountains
additional: Start times: Canicross and marathon at 8:00; all other races at 10:00. Relay teams have four members, each running approximately 5 km. Each team is responsible for transporting its members to the relay handover points. Awards are presented in age and gender categories. The marathon time limit is 15:00. Runners who cannot finish the marathon within the time limit may switch to the half marathon. The entry fee includes a race number. The race is part of Bohemian Switzerland Day and attracts regional and international runners. The event offers aid stations along the course and support from local sponsors and craftspeople.
