description: The Chomutov Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in the picturesque town of Chomutov in the Ústí nad Labem Region. The race offers a fast and attractive course that passes through the historic town centre, around the unique Kamencové Lake and through beautiful natural areas such as Bezruč Valley. The event also includes children’s categories and relay races, making it suitable for a wide range of runners. Participants in the main race can look forward to refreshments along the course and at the finish, as well as a participant medal.
course_highlights: The historic town centre, with its Town Tower and diverse architecture
The world-unique Kamencové Lake and extensive recreational area
Romantic Bezruč Valley and the Chomutovka stream
additional: Registration for adults and the Kamencové Circuit is online from 8:00 to 10:30; children up to 15 years old can register on site from 11:00 to 13:30. The entry fee includes refreshments along the course and at the finish (fruit, water and an isotonic drink) and a participant medal. Free headbands are available with online registration and advance payment; T-shirts can be purchased together with headbands. Children’s races start at 14:00. The organiser reserves the right to change the order of the individual races. Trail course, online and on-site registration, refreshments at the finish and along the course, medals, T-shirts and free headbands with registration.

name: Běhej lesy Jizerská
location: Bedřichov, Jizerské hory, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běhej lesy Jizerská is a trail race held on 29 August 2026 in the picturesque Jizera Mountains in Bedřichov. It offers a range of routes, including short and long distances and an ultramarathon, passing through beautiful natural areas such as Hřebínek, Smědava, Jizerka and Olivetská hora. The race is part of the Běhej lesy series and is included in the UTMB Index Races, providing international ranking points. Runners can also take part in the Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish, which add competitive elements and prizes.
course_highlights: Routes pass through Hřebínek, Smědava, Jizerka and Olivetská hora
Conti Speed Section — a 150-metre speed segment on the Nova 11 km and ČSOB 23 km routes
Generali Investments Finish — a 500 m finish straight with a timed segment and prizes for the fastest men and women
additional: The race is part of the UTMB Index Races, with international ranking points. The Conti Speed Section is a speed segment with a prize worth 5,000 CZK. Generali Investments Finish is a 500 m finish straight with a timed segment and special jerseys for the winners. Online and on-site options are available to transfer registration and change the entry fee. The race includes a charitable component and offers fast, scenic routes in the Jizera Mountains. The start is at the cross-country skiing stadium in Bedřichov.

name: Mizuno Neon Run Praha
description: Mizuno Neon Run Prague is a night running event full of glowing neon lights and colorful zones, offering a unique experience rather than a race focused on speed. The run takes place in Bohnice, and participants receive a starter pack with a neon glow stick and a beautiful Unicorn medal at the finish. The event is held under the auspices of the mayor of Prague 6, and registration proceeds are donated to nonprofit organizations. After the race, there is an after-party with DJ René, adding to the evening’s overall atmosphere.
course_highlights: Night run with neon lights and colorful zones
Start and finish in Prague 8 – Bohnice
Glowing neon experience, with a neon glow stick included in the starter pack
additional: The race is split into start waves for the 5 km run and walk, including the charitable 2 km Fénix Run. After the race, the NEON NIGHT RUN after-party takes place with DJ René. You can purchase the SUPER package for an additional 300 Kč until 20.08.2026. The starter pack includes a neon glow stick. Registration and check-in take place from 17:00 to 20:00; the bag drop is open until 21:45. Neon glow sticks, medals, a festive evening atmosphere, online and on-site registration, and support for FénixRun charitable projects.

name: Proběhni si Zoo Ústí nad Labem
location: Zoo Ústí nad Labem, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: Run through Ústí nad Labem Zoo is a running event held on the grounds of the zoo in Ústí nad Labem. The run offers a unique opportunity to combine physical activity with a visit to the zoo and the chance to admire animals in their natural surroundings. The event is suitable for all age groups and encourages spending free time actively in nature. We look forward to your participation and sharing a memorable experience in the beautiful setting of the zoo.
course_highlights: Run through the zoo grounds with views of the animals
The route passes through varied terrain and natural scenery in the zoo
Combine a sporting challenge with a family visit to the zoo
additional: The zoo is open 365 days a year, and admission is charged at the zoo’s standard rates. Discounts are available for visitors with disabilities. The event is part of the zoo’s events calendar, which may be updated during the year. The event is primarily intended to support animal protection and nature conservation, with an emphasis on environmental education and community involvement.

name: 32. Zeitzer Stadtlauf
description: The Zeitz City Run takes place in Moritzburg Castle Park in Zeitz and is organized by SG Chemie Zeitz. The event begins at 9:15 a.m., with the main races starting at 10:00 a.m. The race office is located in front of the main stage in the city park, and changing and shower facilities are available at the Klinkerhallen on Albrechtstraße. The park entrance is on Stephanstraße. The run is a great opportunity to get active and enjoy the atmosphere in the castle park.
course_highlights: Run through the historic Moritzburg Castle Park in Zeitz
Main races start at 10:00 a.m.
Changing and shower facilities at the nearby Klinkerhallen
additional: The race office is located in front of the main stage in the city park. Changing and shower facilities are available at the Klinkerhallen, Albrechtstraße. The park entrance is on Stephanstraße. The run starts at 10:00 a.m., with changing and shower facilities at the Klinkerhallen. The park entrance is on Stephanstraße. August weather is usually sunny, ideal for an outdoor run.

name: 37. Heideblütenlauf
description: The 37th Heideblütenlauf takes place on Saturday, August 29, 2026, in Schneverdingen. This traditional running event is held as part of the Heideblütenfest. Organized by TV Jahn Schneverdingen, it offers runners of all ages the chance to experience the beautiful heathland. The course passes through the picturesque surroundings, with numerous volunteers and supporters helping ensure that everything runs smoothly. Participants can look forward to a friendly, well-organized event.
course_highlights: Running routes through the heathland around Schneverdingen
Start in front of the town hall on Schulstraße
Event held as part of the Heideblütenfest
additional: The event is supported by numerous local partners and volunteers, including the City of Schneverdingen, the German Red Cross, Johanniter, the Volunteer Fire Brigade, and the Heide Queen. Certificates can be printed for all participants, including Bambini children. Registration is handled by TV Jahn Schneverdingen; further details are available on the website. Online registration opens on 01.04.2026. Start and finish are on Schulstraße in front of the town hall. Results and certificates are available online.

name: 39. Jever-Fun-Lauf
price_range: 4,00 € bis 36,00 € je nach Lauf und Anmeldung
description: The 39th Jever-Fun-Lauf on 29 August 2026 is a traditional running event in Jever that brings together people of all ages and ability levels. The route passes through the town centre and by well-known landmarks, with cheering spectators lining the course. The focus is on the enjoyment of exercise and community, not competition. There are various races for children, young people and adults, including walking, company and team categories, as well as a main race over 10 English miles.
course_highlights: A 2.864 km loop through Jever town centre
The route passes by well-known landmarks
Cheering spectators line the course
additional: The official technical T-shirt can be ordered until 07 June 2026 for 20.00 euros, and thereafter for 25.00 euros (while stocks last). Merchandise such as sports socks, caps and multifunctional scarves is also available and can be collected in Jever on Wednesdays. Late registrations are possible on the event day until one hour before the respective start. The time limit for the main race (10 English miles) is 150 minutes. Several race categories, registration deadlines, start times and further event details are available on the official website. The event takes place on 29 August 2026.

name: Edersee-Lauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1.2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The Edersee Run is part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup and takes place on August 29, 2026, in Vöhl-Herzhausen on Lake Eder. The run is organized by SV 1921 Herzhausen, a club that promotes sport and community for all age groups. The event is very popular and offers runners an appealing opportunity to get active and enjoy the beautiful surroundings of Lake Eder. Pre-registration opens soon, and the club extends its heartfelt thanks to its supporters and sponsors.
course_highlights: A variety of running distances for all age groups
Flat, fast courses on Lake Eder
Family and children's races included
additional: The run is part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup. The event is organized by SV 1921 Herzhausen, which also offers other sports activities and training groups. Race bibs are supported by sponsors. Pre-registration for 2026 opens soon. Various running distances, family-friendly, event held as part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup, start and finish at the Herzhausen barbecue hut.

name: Flörsheimer Lebenslauf
location: Flörsheim am Main, Hochtaunuskreis, Hessen, Germany
description: The 15th Flörsheim Lebenslauf on 29 August 2026 is a traditional race commemorating the town’s deliverance from the plague in 1666. The approximately 10 km course covers two laps, starting along the banks of the Main and passing through Eddersheim, the town park and the old town before finishing at the historic Gallusplatz. The motto “Remember – Run – Give Thanks” reflects the event’s religious and community spirit. Proceeds benefit the support associations of Riedschule and Paul-Maar-Schule. Alongside the main race, there are children’s and youth races with no entry fee.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km in two laps
From the banks of the Main towards Eddersheim, through the town park and old town
Finish at historic Gallusplatz, the heart of Flörsheim
additional: Late entries are accepted at the race-number distribution desk in the Galluszentrum until 30 minutes before the respective race, with no late-entry fee. There is a Bambini race (approximately 800 m) for children born in 2017 or later, with no entry fee, as well as a beginners’ and youth race of approximately 2.6 km for participants born in 2018 or earlier, with no age-group divisions. Children receive certificates and medals. Course: approximately 10 km; several race categories; online registration until 27.08.2026; on-site late entries available.

name: Maare Mosel Lauf
description: The Maare-Mosel-Lauf is a scenic trail race in the Eifel, taking place on 29 August 2026 in Gillenfeld. The course passes mysterious maars, rugged rocks and gently rolling hills, offering runners a unique nature experience with wonderful views. There are three main distances for beginners and experienced runners, as well as age-appropriate children’s races. Alongside the sporting event, participants can enjoy an attractive programme of live music and award ceremonies.
course_highlights: Course passing the deep-blue Pulvermaar
Loop around the Schalkenmehrener Maar with 240 metres of elevation gain
Scenic nature reserves of Mürmes and Sangweiher
additional: Late registration is available on site for an additional fee of €5. Race packs will be mailed to participants who register at least 7 days before the event; otherwise, they can be collected from 15:00 on race day at the school in Gillenfeld. There will be a varied programme of live music and award ceremonies from 19:30. The races take place on the grounds around the Gillenfeld primary and secondary school. Three distances to choose from, including a 5 km route at the Pulvermaar; a scenic race with elevation gain; online registration available.

name: Mindener Volkslauf
description: The Mindener Volkslauf is SV 1860 Minden’s largest running event, with more than 1,000 participants every year. The 50th anniversary run takes place on 29 August 2026, featuring many new highlights along the course and in the stadium. At the same time, the club is celebrating the 10th anniversary of the merger that formed SV Minden, with numerous activities. The event offers a great atmosphere and an after-run party following the company run, inviting everyone to join in the celebrations.
course_highlights: A course featuring new highlights and varied sections
Start and finish in the stadium, with a special atmosphere
After-run party following the company run
additional: The 50th Mindener Volkslauf features an after-run party following the company run. Registration is expected to open in May 2026. In 2025, 1,467 participants crossed the finish line. The event also celebrates the 10th anniversary of the merger that formed SV Minden, with many individual activities through the end of the year. The event takes place in August, with registration opening in May 2026. It is the club’s largest event, with a special focus on community and anniversary celebrations.

name: Monte Sophia XXII und 65. HAG-Lauf
description: The Monte Sophia Mountain Run and the Heinrich-Antons Memorial Run (HAGL) are traditional cross-country races in the Rhenish lignite-mining region near Niederzier. The 25 km Monte Sophia Run, with 380 metres of elevation gain, takes runners across the Sophienhöhe, a former spoil heap with varied trails, distinctive natural and cultural landmarks, and beautiful views. The HAGL offers a shorter 10 km alternative, while the 5.3 km Broisterd Loop is also suitable for beginners. The event also includes children’s races and a 10 km walking route, making it ideal for cross-country runners and marathon trainees.
course_highlights: 25 km route with 380 metres of elevation gain across the Sophienhöhe
Distinctive landmarks including the Stone Compass, Celtic Tree Circle, Golden Meadow and Roman Tower
Varied gradients, from gentle to steep, on firm gravel paths and asphalt
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available in the gymnasium. Aid stations with water, tea, fruit and cola are located along the course and at the finish. Children receive medals and certificates; the top three in each age group receive prizes. Runners entering two races receive a separate bib for each race. Bicycle escorts, jogging strollers, dogs and headphones are prohibited. A challenging cross-country event in the Rhenish lignite-mining region, with a range of race distances, including children’s races and walking.

name: Mußbacher Eselshautlauf
location: Vereinsgelände des TV 1860 Mußbach e.V., Mußbach, Neustadt an der Weinstraße, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The 3rd Mußbacher Eselshautlauf is a community race with four different distances, welcoming participants of all fitness levels. The routes follow farm tracks and pass through the Ordenswald forest, starting and finishing at the TV 1860 Mußbach e.V. club grounds. A special highlight is the after-run party with a DJ, with food provided by a food truck and the club’s catering committee. The event is covered by the German Red Cross and offers restroom facilities as well as a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes along farm tracks and through the Ordenswald forest
Start and finish at the TV 1860 Mußbach e.V. club grounds
After-run party with a DJ and food from a food truck
additional: Race bibs can be collected on the day of the event from 15:30 in the TV 1860 Mußbach e.V. gym. Restroom facilities (toilets and showers) are available at the club grounds. Late registration is possible on race day until 16:30. The city champion of Neustadt an der Weinstraße will be determined in the 10-kilometer race. All finishers receive a medal; the top three finishers in each age group also receive a prize and a certificate. Routes along farm tracks and through the forest, online registration, late registration possible on race day, parking available, DLV-approved, participant limit of 300, medals for all finishers, music and refreshments after the race

name: Panoramalauf rund um die Burg Are
distance_verbose: Ultramarathon, 50 km, 50 km, 35 km, 33 km, 19 km, 16 km
price_range: 10,00 bis 24,00 Euro je nach Strecke und Anmeldedatum
description: The Panoramalauf around Are Castle is a scenic popular race in the middle Ahr Valley, organised by Selbstläufer Altenahr e.V. and approved by the German Athletics Association (DLV). With distances of 19 km, 35 km and 57 km, it offers a varied challenge featuring panoramic paths, single-track trails and some demanding climbs. The start and finish are at Martinshütte above Altenahr, where refreshments are also available. The event takes place annually on the last Saturday in August and welcomes runners from near and far to enjoy the nature and scenery of the Ahr Valley.
course_highlights: Panoramic routes with extended uphill and downhill sections
Uses the Red Wine Hiking Trail, the Ahr Hiking Trail and single-track trails
Routes pass over Schwedenkopf, Saffenburg and Steinerberg (the highest point of the Ahr Mountains)
additional: Course refreshments include water, tea, cola, fruit, biscuits, chocolate, energy bars, sandwiches and potatoes (3 stations for K19, 5 for K35, 7 for K57). Drinking cups are provided; bringing your own cup is recommended to reduce waste. There is no official course supervision at road crossings, so please cross carefully. Time limit for K35 and K57: 10.5 hours. A scenic race with uphill and downhill sections, using hiking trails and single-track trails, with refreshments at several stations. The event encourages environmentally conscious use of drinking cups; there is no official course supervision on roads open to traffic.

name: Bottroper Ultralauf Festival (BUF)
description: The Bottrop Ultrarunning Festival 2026 takes place on August 30 and 31 in Batenbrock Park in Bottrop, offering an unforgettable running experience for ultrarunning fans. Alongside the established 6- and 24-hour races, the Halden Backyard is once again a special highlight. The festival stands out for its great community, compelling challenges and unique festival atmosphere, shaped by hourly restarts and parallel competitions.
course_highlights: 6- and 24-hour races in Batenbrock Park
Halden Backyard as a special highlight
Hourly restarts and parallel competitions
additional: The festival features hourly restarts, a parallel competition and a walking event taking place at the same time, creating a unique festival atmosphere. Running event with 6-hour, 24-hour, relay and Backyard events; in Batenbrock Park; online registration; event in August 2026

name: 8. Stolberger Schloss-Lauf
location: Schloss Stolberg, Stolberg im Harz, Saxony-Anhalt, Germany
description: The Stolberger Schloss-Lauf 2026 is a charity run in the southern Harz region, starting and finishing right at the historic Stolberg Castle. The event offers various races for runners of all abilities, including a half marathon, relay, 10 km, 5 km, walking, and fun runs and children’s races. The varied routes pass through the historic old town, along forest paths and over the hills of the southern Harz, combining a sporting challenge with scenic and cultural highlights. By taking part, every runner supports regional projects in and around Stolberg, giving the event a special charitable character.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stolberg Castle, with its historic setting
Varied routes through the old town, along forest paths and over the hills of the southern Harz
A special finish-line experience at the castle
additional: Alongside the main races, the event includes walking, fun runs, and children’s races. Participation supports regional projects in and around Stolberg. Accommodation is offered by Ritter von Kempski Private Hotels & Resorts directly in and around Stolberg. Some sections of the routes follow unpaved, natural forest paths and carry a corresponding risk of accidents. Multiple distances, children’s races, relay race, support for regional projects, accommodation nearby

name: Elstertal-Lauf
description: The Elstertal Run, organized by 1. SV Gera, is a long-standing running event with a range of distances for runners of all ages. On August 29, 2026, individual races over 10 km and 15 km, as well as relay races for companies and school students, will take place. There are also children’s races and a challenging stair run with about 1,300 steps. The event is part of the Thuringian and Gera Running Cup series and offers a varied route through the region.
course_highlights: 15 km individual race for men, women and youth
Company and school relays over 5 x 3 km, with a flexible number of runners
2,500 m stair run with approx. 1,300 steps
additional: Children’s races as part of the Osterland Cross (600 m, 800 m, 1,000 m / 3 km). Relay teams may have 2 to 5 runners; with 4 runners, one runner covers 6 km. The individual races are part of the Thuringian and Gera Running Cup series. Several race formats, including a stair run; training plans and detailed information available.

name: Karlis Härtetest
description: Karlis Härtetest is a traditional race organized by the Pretzsch running team. Held annually in autumn near Leipzig, it features a challenging cross-country course that tests runners of all ages. The club SG Grün-Weiß 90 Pretzsch e.V. has a long history in running and uses this event to foster community and sporting ambition. The event is known for its special atmosphere and the chance to take on a varied course.
course_highlights: Challenging cross-country course at the canoe center near Leipzig
A variety of challenges for runners of all ages
Traditional event with strong ties to the club
additional: The event is organized by SG Grün-Weiß 90 Pretzsch e.V., which also organizes other running events and challenges. The pages reviewed do not provide explicit details about start times, pricing tiers, or registration procedures. The race takes place on 29 August 2026 and is known for its challenging course and friendly atmosphere. It is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes.

name: Lauf rund um Tiefwarensee
description: The 20th Run around Tiefwarensee in Waren (Müritz) is a traditional running event taking place on 29 August 2026. Organised by Müritzer LSV, the course loops around the picturesque Tiefwarensee and offers runners an attractive and varied setting. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels and is a regular fixture on the regional running calendar.
course_highlights: Loop around Tiefwarensee
Start and finish at the sports field at Tiefwarensee, Güstrower Straße
Scenic route in Waren (Müritz)
additional: Registration address: Peter Hoffmann, Am Pappelgrund 10; Event number: 26V08000010060000; Category: event away from a stadium (6.5.1). Registration closes on 27 August 2026. The event is part of a regional running and nature experience programme highlighting the beauty of Tiefwarensee and the surrounding nature.

name: LimLauf 2026
description: The Limlauf takes place for the 31st time in 2026 in Limbach, Kirkel, and is one of the largest running events in the Saarpfalz district. The event includes a traditional half marathon and a 2 km student race for young runners. The course is officially measured, flat and fast, making it possible to achieve fast times. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with award ceremonies, refreshments and a varied supporting programme.
course_highlights: Officially measured courses with kilometre markers
Flat and fast course
4 laps for the half marathon, 2 laps for the student race
additional: Online pre-registration is closed. Late registration is available on the day of the event from 14:00 to 16:30 in the village hall. Changing rooms and showers are available for women in the village hall and for men in the school gym. Medical assistance is available in the finish area and on course via mobile units. Results are shown live on a large screen in the village hall. Parking is available at several locations, with exits that do not cross the course. Award ceremonies take place in the village hall immediately after the races. Registration on the day of the event is available from 14:00 in the village hall. Prizes are awarded to winners and in team competitions. Parking is available at the school gym, swimming pool, dog shelter, and cemetery/Palatia. Medical assistance is available on site.

name: Panorama - Run - Bad Laasphe
location: Wabachstadion, Bad Laasphe, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Panorama Run in Bad Laasphe is a varied race held as part of the SummerCityGames and organised by TV Laasphe. The course starts at Wabachstadion and follows paved paths and forest trails to its highest point, with a challenging climb and a second half that is mostly downhill and offers a lovely view. There is a 6 km youth/everyone’s race and a 12 km main race, which covers the course twice and is a real challenge. Changing rooms and showers are also available directly at the sports ground.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Wabachstadion Bad Laasphe
Paved paths and forest trails, with a tough climb to the highest point
The second half of the course is mostly downhill and offers a lovely view
additional: Late entries are possible 60 minutes before the start of the competition, subject to a €3 late-entry fee. Race numbers can be collected at the clubhouse on the sports ground. Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports ground. Course description: 6 km and 12 km races, uphill and downhill, on paved paths and forest trails; registration until 28.08.2025; late entry 60 minutes before the start for a fee; start/finish at the Bad Laasphe sports ground; changing rooms/showers available

name: Salzbergener Raffinerielauf
description: The Salzbergen Refinery Run is a popular road race in the beautiful municipality of Salzbergen, taking place on August 29, 2026. Various distances are offered for all age groups, including a children’s fun run, a school mile, a 5 km community race, and a 10 km main race. The event is part of the EL-CUP and, alongside exciting competitions, offers a varied program for runners and spectators. The races start at Oberschule Salzbergen and encourage both individual and team competition.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Oberschule Salzbergen
Distances: 600 m children’s fun run, 1,700 m school mile, 5 km and 10 km community races
Team competition in the main races
additional: Start times: 14:30 first race; 14:45 school mile; 15:15 5 km community race; 16:15 10 km main race; 16:20 5 km walking/Nordic walking (no timing). Team competition for timed races; teams consist of 3 participants. Late registration is possible up to 45 minutes before the respective race, with a €1.00 late registration fee. Race materials are available from approximately 13:15 at the on-site race office. Races with team competition, online registration, supporting program, trophies and medals.

name: Umpfertallauf
description: The 13th Umpfertal Run offers various race distances, including the 10 km main race, a 10 km relay, a 5 km fun run, and races for schoolchildren and toddlers. The flat out-and-back course, with approximately 33 metres of elevation gain, is ideal for less experienced runners. The event starts early on Saturday evening, with the start and finish at the market square, and follows the cycle path to Schweigern. The awards ceremony takes place in the festival tent and rounds off the sporting event.
course_highlights: Flat out-and-back course with approximately 33 metres of elevation gain
Route follows the cycle path to Schweigern
Views of vineyards and Weikersheim Castle
additional: Start and finish at the market square; event takes place early on Saturday evening; awards ceremony in the festival tent; Nordic walking is possible on the 5 km route; various race categories at the fire brigade run in Löffelstelzen; weather in August: approximately 25°C and sunny; start at the market square in Unterschüpf; open to all age groups

name: Wixhäuser Kerblauf
description: The Wixhäuser Kerblauf is a traditional fun run held on the last Saturday in August in Wixhausen near Darmstadt. The event offers races for different age groups and ability levels in a family-friendly atmosphere. The course is mostly paved and flat, running through residential areas and open fields. In addition to individual rankings, there are team rankings for the 4 km and 6 km races. The event is organized by TSG Wixhausen and is popular with runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Flat, paved course with no inclines
The 4 km race consists of two laps; the 6 km race consists of three laps
The course runs approximately one-third through a residential area and two-thirds across open fields
additional: Medals for the top three finishers in each age group in races 1–4; trophies for the overall winners of races 5 and 6. All participants receive a certificate. T-shirts awarded as prizes for races 1–4 for registrations received by 30.07.2026; adults can order a finisher shirt for an additional fee. Team rankings for the 4 km and 6 km races, with at least 3 participants per team. Team names can be submitted up to 30 minutes before the start of the competition. Registration until 30 July 2026; finisher shirts available for an additional fee; team rankings; results at Race Result

name: 4. S-RUN Sparkassenlauf "Rund um das Dünkreuz"
description: The 4th S-RUN Sparkassenlauf “Rund um das Dünkreuz” is a nature-focused popular race in the Eichsfeld, welcoming runners of all ages and fitness levels. The varied courses wind through the breathtaking natural landscape around the Dünkreuz and offer exciting challenges for both experienced runners and beginners. Alongside the sporting competition, community spirit takes centre stage, supported by an attractive programme at the sports ground. The race is part of the Eichsfeld Cup and is organised by SG Birkungen 07.
course_highlights: Nature-focused courses around the Dünkreuz
A variety of events for all ages (400 m to 10 km)
Part of the renowned Eichsfeld Cup
additional: There are 4 courses and 5 events: Bambini-Run (400 m), Youngster-Run (1.5 km), 6-K-Run (6 km run/Nordic walking) and 10-K-Run (10 km run). The event fosters community spirit and offers a programme at the sports ground. Results from previous years are available at my.raceresult.com. Forest trails, fields, elevation gain, Nordic walking, course signage, medical support, transponder timing, community programme

name: UKIEL Susnet Run Olsztyn
location: CRS Ukiel, Olsztyn, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Olsztynie

description: UKIEL Sunset Run Olsztyn 2026 is an evening road race taking place on 29 August 2026. Participants can choose a 5 km or 10 km distance, running through central Olsztyn with picturesque views of the Old Town and CRS Ukiel Beach. The course is certified by PZLA, and the finish is located on the beach, where a finisher zone with music and lighting awaits. It’s a great opportunity to combine sporting competition with the atmosphere of a city event.
course_highlights: The 10 km course runs through the Grunwaldzkie district, Śródmieście and the area around the Old Town, with views of the Town Hall and the High Gate
Start and finish at CRS Ukiel Beach, with music and lighting
Course certified by PZLA, marked every 1 km, with two refreshment zones
additional: Race packs can be collected on 28.08.2026 (16:00–20:00) and 29.08.2026 (9:00–15:00) at the race office at CRS Ukiel. An authorised person may collect a race pack on presentation of an identity document. No race-day registration. The 5 km race starts at 18:00 and the 10 km race at 19:00. There is a one-hour break between starts for rest and recovery in the participants’ zone. A 10% discount is available when registering for both races in a single order. The courses close at 18:45 (5 km) and 20:15 (10 km), respectively. The event includes evening races over 5 km and 10 km, with the option of early registration and discounts available until the end of April 2026, as well as children’s races. The courses are designed with participants’ safety and comfort in mind.

name: 11 Bieg Kurierów Sądeckich
location: Rytro, Nowy Sącz County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

description: The Bieg Kurierów Sądeckich is a historic mountain race held in the Beskid Sądecki Mountains, on a route from Rytro to the PTTK mountain shelter on Przehyba. The route is marked and covers a variety of surfaces: 15% asphalt, 5% gravel roads, and 80% forest trails, offering participants a chance to connect with nature on challenging terrain. The race commemorates couriers from World War II, and the course record is just under an hour. The organizer provides timekeeping, medical support, a commemorative medal, and a hot meal after the race.
course_highlights: Marked route: 15% asphalt, 5% gravel roads, 80% forest trails
Start at Rytro PKP railway station; finish at the PTTK mountain shelter on Przehyba
Historic route associated with World War II couriers of the Home Army (AK)
additional: The race office is open on 30.08.2025 from 08:00 to 09:45. Participants receive a clothing bag for the baggage deposit, which will be transported to the finish. After the race, vouchers for a hot meal and tea are available. Timing is electronic, with manual recording as well. Medical support is provided during the race. A special prize of 500 zł is offered for beating Andrzej Długosz’s course record (00:57:58). The race includes asphalt, gravel, and forest sections, with electronic timing, medals, race bibs, and drinks for participants. Registration is available online, and the event is part of the local sporting tradition.

description: Gliwicka Parkowa Prowokacja Biegowa is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice in 2026. The events take place once a month on Saturdays in the park behind Piast Stadium. The 4,219.5-metre course runs mainly along forest trails and gravel paths, with some asphalt, and there is a refreshment point at the start/finish line. The event aims to promote healthy, active outdoor recreation under the slogan “Let yourself be provoked into fighting laziness!”
course_highlights: A 4,219.5 m course on forest trails, gravel paths and asphalt
A refreshment point with drinks at the start/finish line, available after each lap
The event takes place in a municipal forest in Gliwice, near Piast Stadium
additional: Events are held on Saturdays once a month in 2026. The run starts at 10:00 and Nordic Walking at 10:03. The course is not closed to other members of the public. The race office opens at 9:00 on the clearing near Piast Stadium. Online registration is available throughout the year, as well as at the race office on event day. Wheelchair participation is not permitted due to the terrain. The start and race office are on the clearing behind Piast Stadium. Information about the regulations and archival photos are available on the website.

Participants can choose from three certified race distances: 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The start and finish are in front of GOKiS in Kunice, at 11 Słoneczna Street. The event combines sporting competition with a friendly atmosphere and reggae music, attracting a growing number of participants from across Poland.
course_highlights: Race routes beside picturesque Lake Kunickie
Polish Athletics Association certification for all distances
Start and finish in front of GOKiS in Kunice, 11 Słoneczna Street
additional: A race pack for every participant, a commemorative finisher’s medal, prizes for category winners, timing provided by DataSport, and a post-race meal. It takes place on 29 August 2026 and is an important sporting event in the region.

Activities and fitness challenges for participants

description: NorDan RUN is a race held in picturesque Wolsztyn, with routes along paths in the town park beside Lake Wolsztyn. Participants can choose from several distances, from shorter races for children to challenging 48 km routes with checkpoint and refreshment stations. The start and finish are located at the “Fala Park” venue, providing comfortable event facilities and beautiful views. The race is a great opportunity to spend time outdoors and enjoy the natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Routes follow paths in Wolsztyn town park
Views of Lake Wolsztyn and the UMKS ZRYW kayak marina
Checkpoint and refreshment stations on the 10 km, 24 km and 48 km routes
additional: The start and finish are at the “Fala Park” venue, ul. Poznańska 1, 64-200 Wolsztyn. The event takes place in Wolsztyn, with online registration, an annual edition and a range of distance options.

name: Tatraman

description: Tatraman is a challenging triathlon over the 1/2 Ironman distance, held in the scenic areas of the Polish and Slovak Spiš and the Tatra Mountains. The course runs from Niedzica on Lake Czorsztyn, through mountainous terrain, all the way to the summit of Kasprowy Wierch. The event is aimed mainly at experienced athletes, but amateurs can also test their skills on this extreme course. Tatraman combines sporting competition with beautiful views and Highland hospitality.
course_highlights: 2 km swim in Lake Czorsztyn; wearing a wetsuit is mandatory
90 km bike ride on the mountainous roads of the Polish and Slovak Spiš, with approximately 1,400 m of elevation gain
21.1 km run finishing at Kasprowy Wierch and following mountain trails
additional: The race office is located at Polana Sosny Campground in Niedzica and is open on August 28, 2026, from 16:00 to 21:00. The race starts at the Water Marina in Niedzica-Zamek and finishes at Kasprowy Wierch. The event is non-drafting; road and triathlon bikes are permitted. The time limit for completing the swim is 60 minutes, and the bike leg must be completed by 14:00. Transport is provided for participants and accompanying persons, along with recovery meals and an afterparty. Triathlon, mountain course, ½ Ironman distance, from Niedzica to Kasprowy Wierch

name: VIII Dycha nad Wisłą

Organized as part of the Kociewie Running Grand Prix

This anniversary edition attracts participants of different ages and skill levels. The organizers invite everyone to take part and emphasize the charitable nature of the event.
course_highlights: Cross-country run through the spa town of Iwonicz-Zdrój
Nordic walking march as an integral part of the event
Start and finish at Dietl Square, the town’s central point
additional: The event takes place on August 28–30, 2026, at Dietl Square in Iwonicz-Zdrój. It is organized by the Centre for Culture and Reading in Iwonicz-Zdrój. No information is available about entry fees, start times, or participant limits. The event also includes Nordic walking, training preparations, and online registration. The run is part of local social and cultural initiatives.

description: The Run through the Teplice Rocks is a public cross-country race held every year on the last Sunday in August in Teplice nad Metují. The race has been a tradition since 1994 and is part of the sporting programme of the International Mountaineering Film Festival. The 9 km course follows the Metuje River to the rock city, includes sandy sections and stairs, and returns along the same route. Since 2011, the event has also included a children’s race with age categories. The start and finish are at the TJ Slavoj football field.
course_highlights: 9 km course along the Metuje River and the Teplice rock city
Sandy sections and stairs on the sightseeing route
Start and finish at the TJ Slavoj football field

The children’s race starts in age categories on loop courses. The race office is located in the start and finish area at the football field. The race is part of the Primátor Cup 2026 series. A 9 km cross-country course with sandy sections and stairs; races for different age categories; online registration; the race takes place at the TJ Slavoj football field; part of the Primátor Cup 2026 series.

The 62nd edition takes place on August 30, 2025, and is open to a wide range of participants, from preschoolers to seniors. The race offers a pleasant setting in a historic park and encourages people of all ages to take part in sport. It is organized by T. J. Sokol Lysá nad Labem, which has long supported sport for everyone.

A pleasant setting in a historic garden

Information about the race is available on Sokol’s website in the events section. The race takes place in the castle park, is part of a long-standing tradition, and offers different categories for all age groups.

name: Běh Bezděkovem
location: Bezděkov pod Třemšínem, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běh Bezděkovem is a traditional cross-country race with a course approximately 9 km long, held in the picturesque surroundings of Bezděkov pod Třemšínem. The course runs mainly along forest paths over varied terrain with gentle elevation changes and includes a mix of asphalt and rocky sections. The race starts by the hunting lodge and features a challenging climb with gradients of up to 7%, putting runners’ fitness to the test. After this demanding section comes a final descent and a flat finish, giving runners a chance to show their pace. Children’s races are also part of the event, making it appealing to a wide audience.
course_highlights: 90% forest paths over varied terrain, 10% asphalt
Clockwise loop with gentle descents and climbs
A 360-metre climb with gradients of up to 7% as a test of fitness
additional: Children’s races are part of the event. The start and finish are by the hunting lodge in Bezděkov pod Třemšínem. The course runs mainly along forest paths over varied terrain. Results are available from the organizers in PDF format. The course is approximately 9 km long; children’s races are available, and registration is possible in advance or on the day. The race takes place amid the Brdy countryside, with various categories and course lengths.

name: Kolínská desítka

The race is part of the Kolín Grand Prix and offers runners a pleasant mix of asphalt and natural surroundings. It is suitable for anyone looking for a fast yet scenic run in nature. Come and enjoy the race atmosphere and test yourself against other runners in the beautiful surroundings of Kolín.
course_highlights: A 10 km out-and-back course
A mix of asphalt and well-maintained forest paths
Start and finish at the Mirek Tuček sports stadium in Kolín

The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup and gives runners the chance to test themselves on an attractive course in the beautiful surroundings of the Central Bohemian Region. It is suitable for anyone looking for a quality road race with tradition and the atmosphere of a regional running cup.
course_highlights: 15 km road course
The start alternates each year between Rakovník and Křivoklát
Part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup

This race offers challenging and varied terrain for runners seeking an outdoor challenge in the Pardubice Region.

Route runs along asphalt, field and forest paths
The steepest climb is in the final section of the race

The race is part of the District Running League and is suitable for trail-running enthusiasts looking for natural, technically interesting terrain. The main category traditionally starts at 11:45, making it convenient for a wide range of runners to take part.

Cross-country/trail character
Around Česká Lípa in the Liberec Region

Bib pickup takes place the day before, and the races start from 8:00 a.m. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to enjoy the race in a fairytale setting.

name: Kölner Halbmarathon- Die Generalprobe

Route, start/finish in Cologne, late registration on site, refreshments, race-pack pickup, parking, showers, changing rooms

description: Rund um Ennepetal is an annual mass-participation sporting event held on the last Sunday in August. It combines running, hiking and walking along the 60 km Ennepetal Circular Hiking Trail, divided into five stages. The route passes through varied countryside, with magnificent views of the Bergisches Land, reservoirs and historic places. The event is suitable for all ability levels and offers guided groups for runners and walkers, as well as independent hiking. The stages are scenic and feature cultural highlights and challenging sections. After the event, participants can access their results and certificates online.

Runners and walkers are accompanied in groups by guides familiar with the area; hikers receive GPX data for independent tours. Results and certificates are available online. The event comprises several stages on a challenging route, including bus transfers between start points and refreshments at the changeover points. Participation is open to everyone, with various disciplines and a friendly, family atmosphere.

The event is organized in cooperation with the athletics club SV 1899 Mühlhausen e.V. and attracts around 800 to 1,100 participants each year.

name: 22. Eilenriederennen Hannover

The event has a pleasant atmosphere, with a musical programme in the beer garden, and is part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass series in the Hannover region.

Out-and-back course to the Waldstation and back to the Zoo and Lister Turm
The course is completely flat apart from crossing the Messeschnellweg and is officially measured

Refreshment stations at km 3, 5, 7 and 10 offer water, isotonic drinks and energy gels; watermelon and drinks are available at the finish. Timing is by chip integrated into the race bib. The event venue is Stadtteilzentrum Lister Turm, Walderseestr. 100, Hannover. Travelling by bicycle or public transport is recommended (Stadtbahn lines 3, 7 and 9, Lortzingstraße stop). The course is officially measured, with refreshment stations at km 3, 5, 7, 10 and at the finish; registration is online or on site; race bib collection is at the Lister Turm beer garden; the event takes place in summer.

name: 23. Windmühlenberglauf
location: Bezirkssportanlage am Windmühlenberg, Fallersleben, Wolfsburg, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 23rd Windmühlenberglauf takes place on August 30, 2026, in Fallersleben (Wolfsburg) at the district sports facility on Windmühlenberg. The event is hosted by VfB Fallersleben and gives runners of different age groups and ability levels the opportunity to take part in a traditional race. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Windmühlenberg and promises a varied running experience. Registration is open until August 25, 2026.
course_highlights: Race at the district sports facility on Windmühlenberg
Scenic course in Fallersleben
Traditional race with different age and ability categories
additional: The registration deadline is August 25, 2026; the event offers various race distances and promotes community and sporting exchange.

name: 30. Lauf um den Arendsee
description: The 30th Run around Arendsee (LUDA) takes place on August 30, 2026, at Strandbad Arendsee. This anniversary edition offers runners from the region and beyond a scenic setting in nature. There will also be a small party on the eve of the race, bringing people together to celebrate sport and community. Organized by Kersten Friedrich Events, the event promises professional delivery with strong regional ties.
course_highlights: Event venue at Strandbad Arendsee
Run through the natural landscape of the Altmark region
Anniversary event with a party on the eve of the race
additional: Registration for the race opens on December 1, 2025. The event is part of a day featuring four events in Arendsee on August 30, 2026. A small party will be held at Strandbad on August 29, 2026. Event photos will be provided. The organizing team donates €1 per participant to Special Olympics Sachsen-Anhalt e.V. Registration has been open since December 1, 2025; the event includes several competitions and a party on the preceding day; it is also suitable for marathon training.

name: 45. Königseer Stadtwaldlauf
location: Oberhain bei Königsee, Landkreis Saalfeld-Rudolstadt, Thüringen, Germany
description: The Königseer Stadtwaldlauf is a traditional running event in Oberhain near Königsee, held annually. The event offers runners of various ability levels an attractive route through the municipal forest, with varied terrain. Its friendly atmosphere and scenic surroundings make the run a special experience for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Run through Königsee’s picturesque municipal forest
Varied terrain featuring forest roads and nature trails
Family-friendly event with various distances
additional: Events for children, young people, adults and Masters; registration until 28 August 2026; typical August weather around 25°C. Please check details with the organizer before registering.

name: 6-Stunden-Sparkassenlauf
location: Sportzentrum Seevetal, Seevetal-Fleestedt, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 6-Hour Sparkasse Run in Fleestedt takes place on 30 August 2026 on a 1,200-metre loop at the Seevetal Sports Centre. The course runs mostly over paved surfaces and partly over grass. It is clearly visible from the start/finish area, adding to the excitement for spectators. Alongside the individual event, there are team and relay competitions, with the marathon (42.2 km) receiving its own classification. The run is open to runners born in 2008 or earlier, and for the first time the relay is also open to young people born in 2014 or earlier. Younger participants can take part in a 5,000-metre run and have the opportunity to earn a DLV running badge.
course_highlights: 1,200 m loop at the Seevetal Sports Centre
Course is mostly paved, with some grass
Course is clearly visible to spectators from the start/finish area
additional: The marathon distance requires 35 laps. The team classification adds up all kilometres; the relay includes handovers. Entry is open to those born in 2008 or earlier, and the relay to those born in 2014 or earlier. The 5,000 m youth run is for participants born from 2009 to 2014. Children born from 2015 to 2020 can earn a DLV running badge. The event starts at 10:00 in the morning and lasts six hours, during which participants complete as many laps as possible. Breaks are permitted. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, various running categories and activities for children.

name: Blankeneser Heldenlauf
description: The Blankeneser Heldenlauf on 30 August 2026 offers five varied courses with different distances and profiles, appealing to both beginners and experienced runners. The races pass through the picturesque Blankenese stair district, along the Elbe and through a mix of parks and residential areas. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and unique combination of urban and natural running. At the finish, participants can look forward to a finisher’s medal and a lively awards ceremony.
course_highlights: Courses run along the picturesque Elbe waterfront and through the Blankenese stair district
A variety of profiles, from flat to challenging, with climbs such as Polterberg
Finish at Blankenese weekly market square, with a finisher’s medal
additional: The start is at Strandweg/corner of Mühlenberg, approximately a 15-minute walk from the event site. Bag drop is available at the event site from 8 a.m. The official registration deadline is 19.08.2026; online late registration with an increased entry fee is possible until 29.08.2026. A medal is included in the entry fee for finishers. Results and certificates will be available online. Photos can be purchased after the event through a photo partner. Various course profiles and distances, including medal presentation and awards ceremony; registration, late registration and travel by public transport are possible.

name: Grafschaftslauf
location: Gut Rietberg, Rietberg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Grafschaft Run connects the historic towns of Rietberg, Verl and Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock, offering runners a varied course rich in history and atmosphere. The race starts at Gut Rietberg, passing historic buildings and running through the town centre before continuing along the Ems to the garden show grounds. The route passes through atmospheric locations, with several relay handover points, and finishes in the Holter Forest at Jagdschloss zur Holte, which provides an impressive backdrop for the finish. The race is characterised by varied country trails, enthusiastic spectators and a special blend of sport and regional history.
course_highlights: Start at Gut Rietberg, with the historic ambience of the castle
Atmospheric spectator spots in Westerwiehe and Kaunitz, with relay handovers
Final stretch through the tranquil Holter Forest to Jagdschloss zur Holte
additional: The relay is organised as a three-person team over 28.5 km, with two handover points in Westerwiehe and Kaunitz. The route passes through historic town centres, runs along the Ems and through the garden show park, and finishes at the castle in Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock. A 10 km run and walking events are also available. The event places emphasis on an atmospheric experience, with several spectator points and musical accompaniment. Events: 28 km individual run, relay, 10 km run, walking; registration opens 01.01.2026; Motto: Experience history as you run

name: Altra Sunset Wattenmeer
price_range: 1.100,00 Euro bis 1.500,00 Euro für Teams, je nach Anmeldedatum
description: The Altra Sunset Wattenmeer is a unique team relay race taking place on August 29 and 30, 2026. The route covers approximately 250 kilometers through the impressive natural landscapes along the Elbe and the UNESCO World Heritage Site Wadden Sea National Park. The race starts in Hamburg on St. Pauli Hafenstraße and finishes in St. Peter-Ording, in the Bad district. Teams consist of 5 or 10 runners, each covering several stages, making the race a special shared experience.
course_highlights: Approximately 250 kilometers through the UNESCO World Heritage Site Wadden Sea National Park
Start in Hamburg, finish in St. Peter-Ording, Bad district
A nature experience along the Elbe amid breathtaking landscapes
additional: Teams’ start times are assigned after registration closes, based on their reported average pace. Digital map materials will be provided to teams a few weeks before the event. Teams must arrange their own vehicles (teams of 10 need 2 vans; teams of 5 need 1 van). Runners born in 2010 or earlier are eligible to participate; for Ultra teams, the cutoff is 2008 or earlier. Team categories include gender-based and mixed teams. Registration is handled by a team captain, who manages the team members. The race comprises 30 stages, with running during both day and night and navigation using map materials; it starts in Hamburg and finishes in St. Peter-Ording. Teams from several countries may participate. Conditions include changeable weather and a sporting challenge.

name: CrossFunRun
description: The CrossFunRun on 30 August 2026 in Ahrensburg offers varied courses for all age groups and ability levels. The races take place in Wulfsdorfer Park, with the start and finish at Heidkoppelhof. The event is family-friendly, with special Kids Cross-Run courses and relay competitions. All participants receive medals, certificates and prizes. The event is organised by WEcycle e.V., which ensures a great atmosphere and exciting cross-country running experiences.
course_highlights: Course distances from 500 m to 5 km, depending on age group
Start and finish at Heidkoppelhof, Wulfsdorfer Weg
Family-friendly Cross-Run courses and relay competitions
additional: Late registrations are possible on site from 10:00 for an additional fee of 5 euros. The event offers medals, certificates and prizes. There are Cross-Run relay competitions for teams of 3 or 4. Access is via Bornkampsweg and Wulfsdorfer Weg in 22926 Ahrensburg. On-site registration is possible. Various categories, family-friendly, activities for cyclists and runners, start and finish at Heidkoppelhof Ahrensburg.

name: Koberstädter Waldmarathon
description: The Koberstädter Waldmarathon has been held annually since 1979 on the last Sunday in August in Egelsbach and is organized by the athletics department of SG Egelsbach. The event offers races over 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon (21.1 km) through a scenic, gently hilly woodland landscape. In addition to races for competitive runners, there is also a Bambini run for children in the stadium. Its friendly atmosphere and professional organization make the event popular in the region.
course_highlights: Run through the natural beauty of the Koberstadt, on gently hilly woodland trails
Aid stations approximately every 5 km along the course
Start and finish in the stadium, with a friendly atmosphere
additional: The Bambini run starts at 9:00 a.m. in the stadium and is for children up to nine years old, covering one lap of the track (400 m). Children receive a medal, certificate and gift. Aid stations with drinks and fruit are available approximately every 5 km along the course. The event is part of the Hessian State Championships. A lead bicycle accompanies the fastest runner. Due to increased safety requirements, no marathon is offered. Registration for the Hessian Half Marathon Championships is separate. Distances: Bambini, 5 km, 10 km and half marathon; registration by 22.08.; race number collection on 31.08. from 7:30 a.m.; participation in the Hessian Championships is possible.

name: Straßenlauf TV Rheinau 1893
description: The 38th Mannheim Road Race, organized by TV Rheinau 1893, is a 10 km road race officially approved by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and held under the supervision of the Baden Athletics Association (BLV). The race is part of the engelhorn sports Brooks Laufcup 2025 and follows a course measured in accordance with DLV regulations. The event takes place on 31 August 2025 at 9:30 a.m. in front of the TV Rheinau clubhouse and is open to runners of all age groups, with categories from U18 through the senior classes. Changing rooms and showers are available in the clubhouse, and prizes and course record bonuses are offered to the fastest runners.
course_highlights: 10 km measured road race course in accordance with DLV regulations
Part of the engelhorn sports Brooks Laufcup 2025
Start and finish in front of the TV Rheinau clubhouse, with changing rooms and showers
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the start. Payment is by SEPA direct debit in the week after the race. Certificates are printed via br-timing. Prizes (vouchers) are awarded to the top three in each category. Course record bonuses are offered for men and women. The award ceremony takes place at approximately 11:00 a.m. at the TV sports field/hall. The venue can be reached by tram line 1, Waldseestraße stop. The course is well marked and is located in Rheinau, Mannheim. Registration is online; race numbers are distributed at TV Rheinau. Changing rooms and showers are available in the clubhouse. The venue can also be conveniently reached by line 1 bus, Waldseestraße stop.

name: Stundenlauf des TuS Fleestedt
location: Sportzentrum Seevetal, Seevetal, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 6-Stunden-SPARKASSENLAUF in Fleestedt takes place on August 30, 2026, on a 1,200-meter loop at the Sportzentrum Seevetal. The course is mostly paved, with some grass sections, and is largely visible from the start/finish area, adding to the excitement for spectators. Alongside the individual event, there are team and relay events, and the marathon distance (42.2 km) has its own classification. The race is open to participants born in 2008 or earlier, with special events for teenagers and children.
course_highlights: 1,200 m loop, mostly paved with grass sections
Most of the course is visible from the start/finish area
Marathon distance with 35 laps and its own classification
additional: Participation is open to people born in 2008 or earlier; for the first time, the relay event is also open to teenagers born in 2014 or earlier; 5,000 m race for teenagers born from 2009 to 2014; DLV running badge for children born from 2015 to 2020 during the event; the team classification combines all kilometers completed. Event held on a 1,200 m loop at the Sportzentrum Seevetal, with various events and registration available.

name: Trainingslauf Bottwartal-Marathon
location: Riedstadion, Steinheim an der Murr, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Bottwartal Marathon is a running event in one of the most beautiful landscapes in southern Germany, taking you past gentle vineyard slopes, picturesque old towns and enthusiastic crowds along the course. The route is a loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal, with varied sections through historic towns such as Steinheim, Murr, Gronau, Beilstein, Oberstenfeld and Großbottwar. The flat finish at Riedstadion Steinheim invites you to make a thrilling final push. Whether you’re a beginner or an ambitious runner, you’ll find your own personal running experience here.
course_highlights: Loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal
Pass through historic old towns such as Steinheim, Murr, Beilstein and Großbottwar
Flat finish at Riedstadion Steinheim, with the opportunity for a final push
additional: Free monthly training runs in different pace groups to help you prepare, Summer Holiday Runs during the summer break, and a Year-End Run featuring 10 km and mulled wine. The start and finish area is the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim a.d. Murr. Registration is through the partner Datasport. Late entries are possible at short notice. The training run is intended to help prepare for the marathon and takes place on 30 August 2026. There is also an earlier training event on 28 June 2026 to test the course.

name: Volkswandertag
description: The 40th Volkswandertag of TSV "DE" Immingerode e.V. is a traditional walking event in Tiftlingerode, taking place on August 30, 2026. The event is aimed at walking enthusiasts and offers a wonderful opportunity to enjoy nature and the surrounding area. It is a sociable, sporting activity suitable for all age groups. The event is organized by TSV "DE" Immingerode e.V. and is part of the German Athletics Association’s competition calendar.
course_highlights: Walk at the TSV Immingerode sports ground
Participation in the Volkswandertag in Duderstadt
Enjoy nature in the Eichsfeld region
additional: Walking event, location: TSV Immingerode sports ground, Duderstadt. Registration and contact via the club

name: Wandertag
location: Neuhaus im Solling, Holzminden, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Neuhäuser Hiking Day is an annual hiking event in the Solling-Vogler region around Neuhaus im Solling. Participants can choose from four routes of varying lengths, from 4.7 to 18 km, through varied landscapes of dense forests, green meadows and beautiful viewpoints. The start and finish are at the Haus des Gastes in Neuhaus, where hikers can set off between 8 and 10 a.m. Drinks and light snacks are available at checkpoints for a small fee. An awards ceremony takes place in the afternoon, recognizing, among others, the groups with the most participants and the oldest hikers.
course_highlights: Varied landscapes featuring densely forested areas and lush green meadows
Great viewpoints with beautiful panoramas of the Weser Uplands
Four marked routes ranging from 4.7 to 18 km
additional: The start and finish are at the Haus des Gastes in Neuhaus, Lindenstraße 6. Participants set off between 8 and 10 a.m. Drinks and light snacks are available at checkpoints for a small fee. An awards ceremony takes place in the afternoon, recognizing the groups with the most participants and the oldest hikers. Savory dishes and a selection of sweet cakes will be served. Musical entertainment and a varied range of information and sales stalls round off the event. Routes from 5 to 20 km, refreshments at checkpoints, musical accompaniment, sales stalls, afternoon awards ceremony.

name: Öko-Run
description: The Öko-Run in Wächtersbach is part of the Main-Kinzig-Challenge and takes place on August 30, 2026. The route is paved throughout and traffic-free, following meadows and fields along the Kinzig. Races are offered over 5 km and 10 km, as well as a 1,000 m school race for various age groups. Every finisher receives a running shirt, and the event is part of a race series featuring scored races and attractive prizes.
course_highlights: Paved route throughout, with no road traffic
Route follows meadows and fields along the Kinzig
Start and finish at the Bioenergie Familienbad Wächtersbach
additional: Start times: 5 km race at 09:00, 10 km main race at 09:40, and 1,000 m school race at 10:40. Registration and payment take place on site up to half an hour before each race. No separate registration for the Challenge is required. The event is part of a series of 8 races, with at least 5 participations required to qualify for the rankings. Every finisher receives a running shirt. The event takes place in August, with typical summer weather around 25°C. Registration is on site at the start. Part of the Main-Kinzig-Challenge.

name: 11 Bieg po Oddech
location: Zakopane, Tatra County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Dla dzieci i młodzieży do lat 17 włącznie. Pakiet z koszulką

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Dla dzieci i młodzieży do lat 17 włącznie. Pakiet bez koszulki

tiers.label: tier_4
tiers.description: Pakiet dla chorych na mukowiscydozę. Pakiet z koszulką

description: The 11th Bieg po Oddech is a charity 5 km run through the streets of Zakopane, taking place on 30 August 2026. The event supports people with cystic fibrosis, and every participant receives a T-shirt and a medal. After the run, a family picnic with games and contests is held. The run promotes physical activity as part of rehabilitation and support for people with the condition, as well as social integration.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the picturesque streets of Zakopane
Start and finish in the City Park
The route is marked with vertical signs every 1 km
additional: Electronic timekeeping is provided by S-Time. After the run, there is refreshments and a family picnic with games and contests. The route, start and finish are in the City Park. The route is marked every 1 km. The virtual run of at least 5 km can be completed anywhere from 1 April to 30 September 2026. Participants can take part in the virtual run from April to September 2026, covering at least 5 km, or join the live event in Zakopane on 30 August 2026. Participants can expect race packs and a family charity picnic.

name: Jurajskie Mistrzostwa NA SKRAJU PRZEŁAJU
description: The Jurassic Championships ON THE EDGE OF CROSS-COUNTRY are challenging cross-country races held in picturesque Przewodziszowice near Żarki, in the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland. The routes wind through Jurassic hills, limestone outcrops, dense forests, winding paths, rocky climbs and open spaces with views of the Jurassic Landscape Park. The event offers a variety of distances, from short races for beginners and Nordic walkers to the demanding Trentaraton for experienced runners. It’s a great opportunity to compete and enjoy the beauty of nature.
course_highlights: Jurassic hills and limestone outcrops
Winding paths and rocky climbs
Views of the Jurassic Landscape Park
additional: The race office is open on 30 August 2026 from 8:00 to 10:00. Online registration is available until 24.08.2026; from 24.08.2026, registration is available only on race day at the race office. Children can participate for free. The event also includes Nordic walking over distances of 14 km and 7 km. Distances from 7 km to 30 km, races for children, on-site registration from 8:00, Jurassic terrain, races and walks, a sports and recreational event.

name: 47. Półmaraton Szczecin Bieg na 10 km
location: Plac Jasne Błonia im. Jana Pawła II, Szczecin, Poland
description: The 47th PKO Szczecin Half Marathon is an annual running event taking place on 30 August 2026 in Szczecin. Participants can choose between the half-marathon distance (21.0975 km) and a 10 km race, both following a single-loop route through the city streets. The start and finish are at Jan Paweł II Jasne Błonia Square. The course is certified by PZLA and marked every kilometre, and timing is electronic, using chips in the race bibs. The organisers offer wave starts and high-quality Ventus technical shirts in the extended race packages.
course_highlights: Single-loop route through the streets of Szczecin
Distance-choice point at 9.6 km on the route
PZLA-certified course, marked every kilometre
additional: Participants can choose a basic or extended package, with a Ventus technical shirt included in the extended package. Start and finish at Jan Paweł II Jasne Błonia Square. Participant limit: 6,000. Electronic timing using chips in the race bibs. Wave starts available. Race packages can be shipped by InPost courier, with the option to redirect them to a parcel locker. Distances: half marathon and 10 km race; location: Jasne Błonia, Szczecin; date: 30 August 2026, 09:00–13:00

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznan
location: Jezioro Kierskie, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznań is a prestigious triathlon held by historic Lake Kierskie, the site of Poland’s first triathlon in 1984. Athletes can expect calm, warm waters for the swim; a fast, flat bike course through picturesque villages and the western part of Poznań; and a run towards the city centre, finishing at the Poznań International Fairgrounds, a modern symbol of the city. This unique event combines sporting competition with local culture and modern infrastructure.
course_highlights: Swim in the calm, warm waters of Lake Kierskie, the site of Poland’s first triathlon
A flat, fast bike course through villages and the western part of Poznań
A run towards the city centre, finishing at the Poznań International Fairgrounds
additional: The race starts in a rolling-start format. The start and finish venues are Lake Kierskie and the Poznań International Fairgrounds. IRONKIDS will take place the day before, on August 29, 2026, with a start time of 11:00. Registration for the main race is sold out; notifications are available in case additional places open up. Participants can change their race date free of charge under the Flex90 offer. The event also includes activities such as the Night Run and IRONKIDS, and the participant limit is 1,500. Registration requires a credit card.

name: Kresowe Trail #10
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of small-scale trail races organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in nature. The races take place on scenic routes in eastern Poland, with respect for nature and local communities. The events are intended for both beginners and experienced runners, and aim to build a running community based on passion, competition, and friendship. They are non-commercial and intimate, with a limited number of participants to ensure safety and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: Trail routes through scenic forests and hilly areas of eastern Poland
Respect for nature and local communities
Small-scale events with a limited number of participants
additional: The races are small-scale, with a limited number of participants. The organizer provides electronic timing, medical cover, aid stations along the course and at the finish, and commemorative medals. Participants can earn points toward the overall standings and titles of Finisher and Super Finisher by completing multiple races. The organizer encourages respect for the environment and asks participants not to litter on the routes. The event brings together the trail-running community, promotes outdoor activity, and supports the development of the local running scene. Registration takes place through an online platform, and the event is part of a series held at various locations.

name: Półmaraton Buski
organizer: Buski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Busku-Zdroju

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pierwsza tura zapisów potrwa do 31 maja

description: The Busko Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Busko-Zdrój. In 2026, it will take place on August 30. The race starts at 8:30 a.m. from the Municipal Stadium. The half-marathon route passes notable hotels and sanatoriums, the picturesque Spa Park, and charming promenades, giving the race a unique atmosphere. The time limit for covering the 21.0975 km distance is 3 hours and 30 minutes. The race is open to both experienced runners and amateurs.
course_highlights: The route passes notable hotels and sanatoriums in Busko-Zdrój
The race goes through picturesque Spa Park and charming promenades
A unique atmosphere and scenic surroundings along the route
additional: The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours and 30 minutes. The route is established and popular, and this is the fourth year the race has been held on the same course. The event is organized by the Busko Sports and Recreation Centre and Athletics Busko-Zdrój Sports Club. GPX files of the route are available to download for Suunto and Garmin devices. Registration is open until May 31, 2026. Start time: 8:30 a.m. Time limit: 3 hours and 30 minutes. The route covers urban and park areas.

name: VII Maraton od Zmierzchu do Świtu
Draždiak Run

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 17 € (deti 8 €) - následne, do ukončenia online registrácie (4. september 2025)

description: Draždiak Run is a running event held in Bratislava, in the Veľký Draždiak area of Petržalka. Participants can expect routes along gravel and hiking paths, suitable for different age groups and ability levels. The event includes children’s races, 5 km races for adults, Nordic walking, and a family run with a dog. It is organised by the Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, which provides a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality organisation.
course_highlights: Surface: gravel path and hiking trail
Start location: beach by the Barracuda buffet, Veľký Draždiak, Petržalka
Races for children, adults, Nordic walking, and a family run with a dog
additional: The children’s races start at 10:00. Categories include a children’s race, a 5 km race for men and women in different age categories, 5 km Nordic walking, and a 1.8 km family run with a dog. The entry fee for children is lower than for adults. Online registration is available until 21 August at a discounted price, followed by more expensive online registration until 4 September 2025, and finally on-site registration at the highest price, if capacity has not been reached. Online registration until 21 August 2026; start at 10:00. The route includes gravel, grass, and asphalt sections, with various categories including the family run and Nordic walking.

name: Beh pod Sninským kameňom
location: Rekreačná oblasť Sninske rybníky, Snina, Slovakia
description: The Run Beneath Sninský kameň is a running event in the Sninské rybníky recreational area in Snina, offering races for children and adults. The courses run on asphalt and unpaved roads, with children’s distances ranging from 50 to 600 metres depending on age. The main race starts at 16:30 and is divided into men’s and women’s age groups. The event is organised by BehajmeSpolu o.z. in cooperation with the city of Snina. The entry fee is €15 for online registration and €20 on site.
course_highlights: Surface: asphalt and unpaved roads (10%)
Sninské rybníky recreational area – OMW Snina
Multiple age categories, from children to seniors
additional: The children’s categories are scheduled to start at 15:00, and the main category at 16:30. Categories are divided in detail by age and gender, including juniors and several men’s and women’s age groups. The event includes children’s races from 50 m to 600 m and a 6,000 m main race. The children’s start is also listed as 15:30, and the main race as 16:30.

name: 3 x 1 km
location: Atletický stadion v Novém Jičíně, Kopřivnice, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Atletika Nový Jičín, SVČ Fokus Nový Jičín
description: Atletika Nový Jičín and SVČ Fokus Nový Jičín are organizing a 3 × 1.5 km running race at the athletics stadium in Nový Jičín. The race is part of the Novojičínská běžecká liga and takes place on a varied surface comprising trails, asphalt and tartan. It is intended for adult runners divided into age categories by year of birth. Registration is online, and the race is scheduled to start at 17:00. The event offers an opportunity for sport and competition in the friendly atmosphere of the athletics complex.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the athletics stadium, in the Bocheta complex and on the asphalt surface of the former gardens of Gymnázium Nový Jičín
The course surface includes trails, asphalt and tartan
Race distance: 3 × 1.5 km
additional: Adult registration is online, with the following schedule: 16:00–16:45 registration, 17:00 start, followed by the awards ceremony. Categories are divided by age and gender, from men and women born in 1987 or later to older age groups. The race takes place on 2 September 2026. Registration is online, and the event is open to the general public, including children and adults.

name: Běh Anny-Marie
description: The Anna-Marie Run is a race held in Prague 4, featuring a 6.6 km course over mixed terrain through Milíčov Forest and over an artificial hill. The event is organized by the SABZO Praha association and is part of its running series, attracting runners of all levels. The course includes both forest trails and paved sections, making the race appealing to different types of runners. The race takes place on September 2, 2026, offering a unique opportunity to enjoy nature and a sporting atmosphere in Prague.
course_highlights: 6.6 km course through Milíčov Forest
Mixed terrain including forest trails and paved sections
Organized by the SABZO Praha association
additional: The race is part of the SABZO series and is intended for runners of all levels, with the opportunity to enjoy nature in Prague 4.

name: After Work Run Bad Homburg
location: Bad Homburg v. d. Höhe, Hochtaunuskreis, Hesse, Germany
description: The After Work Run Bad Homburg is an annual running event where running enthusiasts from companies and institutions in Bad Homburg meet after work for a shared race against the clock. The event takes place in summer and has recently attracted around 2,800 participants. It offers a sporting opportunity to leave the desk behind, hit the running route and get active together. All registration information will be published on the official website in due course.
course_highlights: Around the Kronenhof in Bad Homburg
5 km running or walking route
Annual event with a strong community spirit
