additional: The event is aimed primarily at employees of companies and institutions in Bad Homburg. Personal advice is available by appointment only; contacting the relevant department is recommended. The event has a long tradition and will take place for the 12th time in 2026. The event takes place in September, is open to everyone, and registration is available via the website. No specific participation fees are listed.

name: Leśna Piątka Odwrotnie
description: Leśna Piątka Odwrotnie is a cross-country race held in Koszalin on September 3, 2026. The course follows the usual route in the opposite direction, allowing participants to experience it anew. The event is open to runners, Nordic Walking enthusiasts, and mixed pairs. All participants receive medals at the finish, with trophies for the top finishers in various categories. The race is the season finale of Leśne Piątki and part of the Touru Biegów po Okolicy - TurBO, encouraging activity throughout the year.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the forest of the Karnieszewice Forest District
Start and finish at the car park on Słupska Street in Koszalin
The route is run in the opposite direction, offering a chance to experience it anew
additional: Race numbers with chips can be collected at the race office on race day. Participants can compete in the running, Nordic Walking, and mixed-pair categories. The race is part of the Touru Biegów po Okolicy - TurBO, where the kilometres covered count, not pace. After the race, a photo gallery prepared by the A7 FILM team will be available. Participants can register online. The event also features photography attractions and is part of the Touru Biegów po Okolicy (TurBO).

name: 24. Duderstädter Sparkassenlauf
description: The 24th Duderstadt Sparkassenlauf takes place on 28 August 2026 in Duderstadt’s historic pedestrian zone. The event starts at 16:00 with the opening ceremony in front of the town hall, which is also the finish point for all races. Distances include a 600 m Bambini run, 1.25 km school races, and 5 km and 10 km races. Children and young people receive finisher medals; participants in the 5 km and 10 km races receive neckerchiefs, and winners are rewarded with cake. The event is supported by the City of Duderstadt, Sparkasse Duderstadt and other sponsors.
course_highlights: Races through Duderstadt’s historic old town and pedestrian zone
Finish in front of the beautiful town hall
A range of distances from 600 m to 10 km, including races for children and young people
additional: The event opens at 16:00 with remarks by patron and Mayor Thorsten Feike and the board of Sparkasse Duderstadt. The Bambini races have a participant limit of 250, while the school races have limits of 300 to 400 participants. Neckerchiefs are given as finisher gifts for the 5 km and 10 km races. On-the-day registration is not available. The awards ceremony starts at 18:00. Several race distances, registration via the website, medals for children, neckerchiefs for longer races, event in the historic city centre

name: Höinger Heidelauf
location: Ense-Höingen, Kreis Soest, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Höinger Heidelauf is a traditional running event held annually on the first Friday in September in Ense-Höingen. Known as the toughest 10 km race in the Soest district, the event offers distances for different types of runners, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The course runs along mostly paved paths and gravel trails through the Sauerland hills and features challenging terrain. Alongside the sporting challenge, the event puts community and atmosphere at the forefront, making it a special experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Toughest 10 km race in the Soest district
Course along paved paths and gravel trails
Run through the hilly Sauerland landscape
additional: Children’s races start at 16:45, the 5 km and half marathon at 17:30, and the 10 km race at 18:30. The start and finish are at Karl-Kleine-Stadion. The event offers great refreshments and a strong sense of community. Temporary road closures and safety measures should be taken into account. In the past, the event has set participation records despite adverse weather conditions. Running event with children’s races and main races, a challenging course with elevation gain, and online registration available.

name: IHK-Ausbildungslauf move-on
location: Rostrup bei Oldenburg, Ammerland, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The training run “Move On!” is organised by the Oldenburg Chamber of Industry and Commerce (IHK) and takes place on 4 September 2026 around the Zwischenahner Meer. The course is approximately 12 km long and runs from BBS Ammerland in Rostrup via Eyhausen, Zwischenahn, Aschhausen and Dreibergen, returning to Rostrup. The event is aimed at trainers, apprentices, examiners, teachers and other people involved in vocational education and training in the Oldenburg region. In addition to the run, the event offers a programme including race-number collection, team photos, a barbecue evening with music and an awards ceremony. The event takes place in all weather. Parking is available at BBS and Bau-ABC Rostrup.
course_highlights: Approximately 12 km circuit around the Zwischenahner Meer
Start and finish at BBS Ammerland in Rostrup
Route via Eyhausen, Zwischenahn, Aschhausen and Dreibergen
additional: Race numbers and T-shirts can be collected at BBS Rostrup on event day from 14:00 to 15:30. A walking group starts at 15:00. The run starts in four groups from 16:00, at four-minute intervals. After the run, a barbecue with a musical act will take place from 18:00 at Bau-ABC, near the finish. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 18:30. The IHK accepts no liability for accidents or theft. The event takes place in all weather. Valuables cannot be stored. Parking is available at BBS and Bau-ABC. Run on 4 September 2026; registration opens on 1 June 2026; takes place in all weather; parking available at BBS and Bau-ABC Rostrup.

name: Sparkassen Pütt-Tage-Lauf 2026
organizer: Sparkasse Münsterland Ost, SG Rote Erde Beckum, Ski-Club Beckum, TV Beckum, Lions Club Beckum-Ahlen
price_range: online registration, exact fee not specified
description: The Sparkassen Pütt-Tage Run is a road-running event held on Fridays in downtown Beckum as part of the city’s Pütt-Tage festivities. The program includes short children’s races, a youth race, a charity run, and the 10 km main race, which also serves as the FLVW 10 km Road Running Championships. The course covers several laps through the streets around Hühlstraße, where the start and finish are also located. The event is organized by several local clubs and the Lions Club Beckum-Ahlen. Timing uses a RaceResult transponder in the race bib.
course_highlights: City streets around Hühlstraße in Beckum
10 km main race over several laps
Charity run of approximately 4.2 km over about five laps
additional: The program begins with a 400 m Bambini Run, followed by 1 km children’s races (ages 6–9), a 2 km youth race (ages 10–15), and the 10 km main race (ages 16 and up). Timing uses a RaceResult transponder in the race bib, and results are published online. Multiple race types, including children’s, youth, charity, and main races; held as part of the Pütt-Tage festivities; city-street race; timing with a RaceResult transponder.

name: Straberger 1/3 Marathon
description: The Straberger 1/3 Marathon takes place on September 4, 2026, in Dormagen and offers races over 5 kilometers and 14.065 kilometers. The scenic route passes Kloster Knechtsteden and runs through the forest, making it ideal for beginners, experienced runners, and ambitious athletes. The event features samba and a festive atmosphere in the town center and is also suitable as a tune-up run for the Cologne Marathon. Children can take part in junior races and receive free running shirts and medals at the finish.
course_highlights: Scenic route past Kloster Knechtsteden
Run through the forest
Festive atmosphere and samba in Straberg town center
additional: Children up to U8 receive a free running shirt and a medal at the finish. Adults can order a breathable running shirt for 18 euros when registering and collect it with their race number on event day. The junior races take place at Linden-Kirch-Platz in the town center, with different lap lengths depending on age group. Parking is available nearby at Hubertus-Schützensaal and the sports ground. Scenic route, junior races, festive atmosphere, start and finish at Linden-Kirch-Platz, online registration, free for children up to U8, running shirt included

name: 23. Lehrter CityLauf
description: The 23rd Lehrte City Run takes place on September 4, 2026, and is a traditional running event in downtown Lehrte. The races cover distances of 2, 4, and 10 kilometers, including Bambini and school races, as well as a 2-kilometer inclusion run. The company competition over 4 and 10 kilometers will once again be sponsored by the KURTULUS GRUPPE. Music and a varied program of activities featuring LSV departments will create a great atmosphere.
course_highlights: The route runs through downtown Lehrte
Races over 2, 4, and 10 kilometers
Inclusion run as part of the 2-kilometer race
additional: There is a company competition over 4 and 10 kilometers, sponsored by the KURTULUS GRUPPE. Musical accompaniment by Walter Nebel. LSV departments can take part in the program of activities. Help with course support and organization is welcome. Booth spaces are available for companies. In addition to the races, the event offers a varied program of activities, including live music, food stalls, and company competitions. The event is open to everyone; registration is via Raceresult.

name: 6. Fränkischer Backyard Ultra
description: The Fränkischer Backyard Ultra is a unique ultra-running event in the “Backyard Ultra” format, with a 6.7 km loop and approximately 90 metres of elevation gain. A new loop starts every hour, and the last runner to complete a loop within the 60-minute time limit wins. The race takes place in Heuchling and has no fixed finish time, continuing until only one runner remains. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, extensive refreshments, and a special focus on endurance and community.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop with approximately 90 metres of elevation gain
A new loop starts every hour, with a 60-minute time limit
Start and finish at sports club SK Heuchling 1920 e.V.
additional: Each loop completed up to and including the 15th loop requires a €1 donation to the homeless assistance organisation, payable upon withdrawal. Refreshments for runners are included in the entry fee, and bringing reusable cups is recommended. The FamilyTrail is a separate event for families, with a 2.3 km course starting every 30 minutes. Teams consist of 2 to 5 people, and children must be at least 5 years old. The FamilyTrail starts on Saturday at 10:00, with a briefing at 09:45. Personal tents and gazebos may be set up from 10:00. Course: 6.7 km; start and finish at SK Heuchling; 90 metres of elevation gain; GPX and Relive links available; registration at racerun.com; limited to 120 participants; refreshments included; donations for homeless assistance; rules for equipment and the course; starts on 4 September 2026 at 15:00; registration expected to open at the end of November.

name: Nocny Jelczański Bieg Towarzyski 3
description: Nocny Jelczański Bieg Towarzyski 3 is a night race covering 10 km, taking place on September 4, 2026, in Jelcz-Laskowice. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for autumn races. The organizers offer training plans tailored to different experience levels so that everyone can prepare for the race in the best possible way. The event is aimed at runners who enjoy the atmosphere of running at night and sporting competition.
course_highlights: 10 km distance
A night race in the scenic town of Jelcz-Laskowice
A course suited to an intermediate difficulty level
additional: The organizer offers training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level, as well as expert support. The event is promoted on the TreningBiegacza.pl platform, which enables race listing management and marketing collaboration. The event is part of local sports initiatives promoting outdoor activity and bringing the running community together.

name: Z Ľubotína na hrad Plaveč
description: The Run from Ľubotín to Plaveč Castle is a traditional running race that starts in the village of Ľubotín, by the multifunctional building. The race offers categories for men, women, juniors, Nordic walking, and a 4 km hobby run. The main race starts at 17:30, and the children’s categories start at 16:30. The organizers are the municipalities of Ľubotín and Plaveč, welcoming runners of all ages and ability levels. The race is ideal for those who want to run in beautiful surroundings, finishing at Plaveč Castle.
course_highlights: Start in Ľubotín by the multifunctional building
Finish at the historic Plaveč Castle
A route suitable for hobby runners and Nordic walkers
additional: The children’s categories start at 16:30, and the main category starts at 17:30. Categories are divided by age and gender, including Nordic walking and a 4 km hobby run on an asphalt road. Residents of Ľubotín and Plaveč, women over 60, and men over 70 can enter for free. A discounted €20 entry package is available for participants who also take part in the Jastrabské Vŕšky Run 2025. The event includes categories for different age groups, including juniors and Nordic walking, with online and on-site registration and discounts available for early registration. The program also includes a children’s run and races on an asphalt course.

name: SOKOLOVSKÁ 12/24 RUN
location: Koupaliště Michal, Sokolov, Karlovy Vary, Czech Republic
price_range: plné startovné, sleva do 15.6.2026 (-50%), do 31.7.2026 (-20%), na místě +200 Kč
description: Sokolovská 12/24 RUN is an endurance running race lasting 6, 12 or 24 hours, for individuals, pairs and teams of four. The race takes place on an easy, gently rolling loop around the Michal Natural Swimming Pool in Sokolov. It starts on Saturday, 5 September 2026, at 11:15 and offers camping accommodation with full facilities. The race is suitable for a broad range of sports enthusiasts and offers various age and team categories, with teams able to change runners in the transition area by the buffet.
course_highlights: An easy, gently rolling loop around the Michal Natural Swimming Pool
Categories for individuals, pairs and teams of four
Facilities including a buffet and a relay transition area
additional: Registration takes place on 4 September 2026 from 18:00 to 21:00 and on 5 September 2026 from 7:30 to 10:00. The results ceremony takes place on Sunday, 6 September 2026: the 6H and 12H categories at 9:00, and the 24H category at 12:30. The entry fee includes camping accommodation (for personal tents, caravans and shelters) and a commemorative ceramic item or medal. Toilets, showers, electricity and catering are available at the campsite. The race is part of a larger multisport weekend that also includes MTB races and kick scooter events. Registration takes place on 4 September 2026 from 18:00 to 21:00 and on 5 September 2026 from 7:30 to 10:00.

name: Běh kolem Světa
description: Běh kolem Světa is a traditional running event held in Třeboň, following a route around the Svět pond. Since its launch in 2012, the race has gained a loyal following and offers an attractive 11.7 km course that follows the Svět Nature Trail. The event takes place regularly in September and is popular for its natural scenery and varied terrain, including dirt, mud, sand, grass, wooden footbridges, and sections of asphalt. The race is suitable for a wide range of runners, and entry can also be purchased as a Christmas voucher.
course_highlights: The course follows the shores of the Svět pond through beautiful natural scenery
The 11.7 km course is suitable for recreational and competitive runners
Terrain includes dirt, mud, sand, grass, wooden footbridges, and sections of asphalt
additional: 11.7 km course, held in September, electronic chip timing, option to purchase an entry voucher

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - září
location: Průmyslová zóna Příluky, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: The 2-Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all age groups and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt circuit. The event also includes an 800-metre children’s course. Every participant receives a warm cinnamon pancake at the finish as a reward for their effort. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration before the start and timing for all runners.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt circuit of just under two laps (3.2 km)
The children’s course is 800 metres long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 to 127, and children up to age 12; age categories apply throughout the calendar year. The first three finishers in the men’s, women’s and children’s categories receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get to the start are by bike, on foot, by car, on roller skates or by trolleybus no. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). Monthly registration takes place on the first Saturday of the month from 8:15 to 8:55, with the start at 9:00. The event includes an 800 m children’s course. Location: Příluky-Zlín Industrial Zone, starting in front of Madal Bal.

name: Kosiřské žiganec
location: Drahanovice, Olomouc District, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné: 150 Kč za každého účastníka, dětský závod ZDARMA

description: Kosiřské žiganec is a traditional running race held in Drahanovice on Velký Kosíř, and is part of the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners’ Grand Prix. The race offers 10 km and 5 km courses along field and forest paths with mild to moderate elevation gain. Shorter 400- and 1,500-metre races are available for children. The event is open to the general public and, in addition to the sporting experience, offers refreshments and informal entertainment after the race. The start and registration take place at the football pitch, followed by the results announcement and prizes for the top runners in each category.
course_highlights: The 10 km course follows field and forest paths with 180 metres of elevation gain
The 5 km course also follows field and forest paths, with 50 metres of elevation gain
Children’s races over 400 and 1,500 metres; the route will be confirmed on site
additional: Registration for the main race is available only through www.liga100.cz; children’s categories register on site. The 10 km race is limited to 150 participants. Medical services will be present, and all participants compete at their own risk. Refreshments and informal entertainment are provided after the race. Special prizes are awarded to the top runners in each category, as well as to the fastest healthcare workers and local residents. Registration takes place on site; the races are open to all age groups, and race day includes registration, start times and the winners’ announcement.

name: Podhostýnská 10
location: Zámecký park, Bystřice pod Hostýnem, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: Podhostýnská 10ka is a running race held in Bystřice pod Hostýnem, offering 10 km and 5 km courses, as well as children’s races. The event takes place in the castle park and is part of the Běhy Zlín running series. It is suitable for the general public and runners of all ages who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in beautiful surroundings. The organizers emphasize tradition and high-quality race organization.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the castle park grounds in Bystřice pod Hostýnem
Two main distances: 10 km and 5 km
Children’s races are also included
additional: Race check-in takes place in the castle, in the stables area. The race is part of the year-round Běhy Zlín running series, which includes 13 races ranging from 5 km to a half marathon. The organizers emphasize ecology and care for the natural environment. The races take place in the castle park in Bystřice pod Hostýnem. Registration is available online and on site. The course runs mainly on roads and park paths. The event also includes children’s races and medals for participants.

name: Běh Plzeňské teplárenské kolem Boleveckých rybníků
description: The Plzeňská teplárenská Run around the Bolevec Ponds is a traditional running event organized by Pro Sport Activities, offering races for children and adults in the picturesque surroundings of the Bolevec Ponds in Plzeň. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Youth Running Cup and is suitable for the general public, including the youngest runners. Entry is free, and the first 300 people to register will receive a voucher for refreshments. In addition to the races, there is an accompanying program for children and an athlete autograph session.
course_highlights: Courses range from 300 m for the youngest children to 5.5 km with hills for adults
Picturesque surroundings of the Bolevec Ponds, with both flat and hilly sections
Chip timing and results service provided by APACHI s.r.o.
additional: Entry is free for all participants. The first 300 people to register will receive a voucher for refreshments (a sausage with bread and mustard, 0.33 l of beer or a non-alcoholic drink). Chip, race number and safety pins are available to borrow; an original commemorative medal is awarded at the finish. The accompanying program includes face painting, a bouncy castle and an athlete autograph session. Parking is available in car parks around the Bolevec Pond; cars are not permitted to enter the start and finish area without authorization. Courses range from 300 m to 5.5 km; registration through Apachi; race office by Ostende at the Great Pond; parking around the Bolevec Pond; accompanying program including face painting and a bouncy castle.

name: Birell Večerní Běh na 10 km Praha
description: The Birell Prague 10K Evening Run is a traditional night race offering a unique atmosphere on Prague’s illuminated streets. The race starts at dusk, allowing runners to experience the city’s beauty in an unusual light. You can participate individually or as part of a team and enjoy the magical nighttime atmosphere beneath the starry sky. The race is part of the RunCzech running series and attracts thousands of runners every year.
course_highlights: A night run along Prague’s illuminated streets
A dusk start with a magical atmosphere
A 10 km route through central Prague
additional: The race is open to individual runners and teams (women’s, men’s and mixed teams). The RunCzech mobile app provides all information about the race, the accompanying programme and the virtual pack. The 2026 edition will be the race’s 29th, with up to 8,500 runners. The race takes place on 5 September 2026, starting at 19:30. Distance: 10 km. Team option available, refreshments along the route, medical support, online results and certificates.

name: adidas Běh pro ženy 5 km Praha
description: Come and run the adidas 5 km Women’s Run in Prague, the largest race created specifically for women. The 5 km course is suitable even for runners without prior training, with a 50-minute time limit. Enjoy a unique atmosphere and the support of thousands of women at an exclusive race with no men on the course. Sign up with your friends and share the joy of running and solidarity.
course_highlights: 5 km course in central Prague
50-minute time limit, suitable even for beginners
Exclusive race for women only
additional: The race is exclusively for women; there are no men on the course. Race bibs can be collected at the pre-race EXPO, and someone else can be authorised to collect one. The RunCzech mobile app provides information about the race and accompanying programme. The race is suitable for beginners, team participation is available, and registration is online. The event is also available as a virtual option.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - září
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka Park is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running levels, including children up to 12 years old, who run 1.6 km. The race is ideal for those who run for fun, want to improve their personal best, or simply enjoy a pleasant run in beautiful park surroundings. After the finish, every participant receives a warm cinnamon pancake. Everyone’s time is recorded, and the results are published online and count toward the year-round Lívancový Cup.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths through Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (2 miles, 3.2 km); children run 1 lap (1 mile + 70 m)
Beautiful surroundings of Královská obora – Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Bruselská Gate area from 8:15 to 8:45, with the option to register online in advance for faster check-in. Arrival by bicycle, on foot, on roller skates, or by tram is recommended (Výstaviště stop). Parking is available by the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou Street. Tents are available for changing and leaving belongings (unattended), along with a mobile valuables storage facility and portable toilets. Categories are divided by age and gender; every runner’s time is recorded, and results are published online. Road course, 3.2 km, run without bib numbers, registration is voluntary, start at 9:07, registration from 8:15 to 8:45, parking by the bridge to Císařský Island, refreshments at the finish, categories for adults and children, open to all age groups

name: Barokomaraton
description: The Barokomaraton is the 19th edition of a cross-country race held in the picturesque surroundings of the town of Plasy and the Střela River valley. The race is for experienced runners as well as those who run for enjoyment and want to take in the beautiful autumn scenery. Runners can expect routes along forest and field paths, with regular aid stations. The organizers are also preparing a cultural program, entertainment for children, and refreshments, making the Barokomaraton an enjoyable day of sport and relaxation for the whole family.
course_highlights: Forest and field paths in the Střela River valley
Regular aid stations with water, sports drinks, and fruit
Start and finish at the Velká louka venue in Plasy
additional: Race registration takes place at the Velká Louka venue in Plasy on 4 September from 18:00 to 20:30 (until 23:30 for the ultra) and on 5 September from 7:30 to 9:20. The time limit is 6 hours for the marathon and 16 hours for the 100 km ultra. Running with a dog (canicross) is prohibited. Runners are encouraged to bring their own collapsible cup for use at the aid stations; a limited number of cups will be available for purchase on site. Team relay entries are available for teams of three on the 10 km, half-marathon, and marathon routes. Races include various distances, including the 100 km ultra, and are suitable for runners of all levels. The event also offers cultural and accompanying activities, including an expo and entertainment for children.

name: Strážný nahoru a dolů
location: Dolní Dobrouč, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: Strážný Uphill and Downhill is part of the ISCAREX Cup, a traditional series of running races in the Pardubice Region. The race offers a challenging uphill and downhill run in the picturesque surroundings of Dolní Dobrouč. The organisers provide a great sporting atmosphere and facilities for all participants. The event is suitable for experienced runners as well as recreational athletes who want to try running on hilly terrain.
course_highlights: Uphill and downhill run on the terrain of Dolní Dobrouč
Technically interesting course profile with elevation gain
Picturesque natural surroundings in the Pardubice Region
additional: The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup 2025 series. Registration opens at 8:00, and the start is at 10:00. The race takes place outdoors on hilly terrain, with the finish at the summit of Strážný.

name: Lupenická dvanáctka
description: Lupenická dvanáctka is a traditional running race in Lupenice, now being held for the 33rd year. The race features a 12 km course with 98 metres of elevation gain, entirely on asphalt and clearly marked. The start is at the Lupenice sports complex, and the race is part of the East Bohemia Grand Prix. All participants run at their own risk, and runners under 18 must provide parental consent.
course_highlights: 12 km course with 98 m of elevation gain
100% asphalt surface
Marked route in the Lupenice sports complex
additional: Registration takes place on-site from 8:00 to 10:00 for CZK 250. The entry fee includes a race number, refreshments along the course and at the finish, and facilities at the start and finish area. The entry fee is non-refundable if you do not participate. On-site registration is also available. The race starts at 10:30. The event is open to the general public, including families with children.

name: Jenštejnská pětka
location: Jenštejn, Jenštejn, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Jenštejnská pětka is an annual 5 km running race held in the village of Jenštejn since 2014. In addition to the main race, other running categories are also offered, welcoming a wide range of runners. The event is a traditional sporting gathering in the Central Bohemian Region and offers an opportunity to enjoy sport in the picturesque surroundings of Jenštejn.
course_highlights: A 5 km race in the village of Jenštejn
Various running categories for all age groups
An annual tradition since 2014
additional: The race takes place on 5 September 2026. The event is part of the local sports calendar, offers various categories and is popular with both locals and visitors.

name: Zbraslavská Závist
location: Nádraží v Praze-Zbraslavi, Praha-Zbraslav, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Zbraslavská Závist is a trail hill race starting in Prague-Zbraslav near the former mini-zoo and leading to the former Celtic hillfort at the top of Závist. The course is 3.5 km long with 190 metres of elevation gain, offering a challenging and engaging running experience. The race is suitable for athletes ready for a fast start and a demanding climb. It is organised by the KOPEC, z.s. association under the auspices of the Czech Athletics Federation and is part of Prague’s traditional running calendar.
course_highlights: Trail hill race with 190 metres of elevation gain
Start near the former mini-zoo in Prague-Zbraslav
Finish at the former Celtic hillfort at the top of Závist
additional: The race is recommended for athletes in good shape who can handle a demanding climb. The course is initially flat, then climbs all the way to the observation tower. The organiser is KOPEC, z.s., Petr Schovánek. The course is 3.5 km long with 190 m of elevation gain; the start is at the railway station in Prague-Zbraslav. The race offers beautiful views from the top of the Závist hillfort. Registration is available online or on site, and the race is open to all age categories.

name: Felsburglauf
description: The Felsburglauf is a traditional running event held annually since 2013 on the last Sunday in August at the stadium below Felsburg in Felsberg. The event offers races over 400 m, 1,000 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m and attracts runners of all ages from the region. Its family-friendly atmosphere and beautiful setting make it a popular event in the Schwalm-Eder district. As a licensed race in the KSK-Schwalm-Eder-Cup, participants can also earn points toward the overall standings.
course_highlights: Races over 400 m, 1,000 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m
Start and finish at the stadium below historic Felsburg
Family-friendly atmosphere in beautiful surroundings
additional: The race is part of the KSK-Schwalm-Eder-Cup. The youngest participants are often born in 2020 or later, and the oldest runner was born in 1937. The event is organized by TSV Eintracht 1863 Felsberg and partner TSV Jahn Gensungen. Distances: 400 m, 1 km, 5 km, 10 km; terrain: stadium and the area around Felsburg; registration not explicitly mentioned

name: Herbstwaldlauf (Volksbank Sauerland Lauf Cup) inkl. Hobby-Mountainbike-Rennen
location: Finnentrop-Fretter, Finnentrop, Märkischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 62nd Herbstwaldlauf (Volksbank Sauerland Lauf Cup) in Finnentrop-Fretter is a short running event taking place on September 5, 2026. There is also a hobby mountain bike race alongside the run. The event offers runners and mountain bikers an attractive opportunity to experience the autumn scenery of the Sauerland and enjoy an active day.
course_highlights: Short 0.4 km running course
Includes a hobby mountain bike race
Autumn woodland scenery in the Sauerland
additional: The event offers a varied course route, including a trail run, hill run, and mountain biking, with mostly changeable weather in the Sauerland.

name: Volkslauf in St.Vit Laufen und Gutes tun
location: St. Vit, Rheda-Wiedenbrück, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The charity run “Laufen und Gutes tun” takes place on September 5, 2026, in St. Vit, Rheda-Wiedenbrück. The races follow flat loop courses through St. Vit, starting and finishing at the Küsterhaus. The event supports various social causes, including pediatric outpatient palliative care, the Malteser Herzenswunsch ambulance, DKMS, and families in need. Alongside the runs, the event features an inline skating race for the first time, as well as a charity tattoo campaign to encourage participants’ social commitment.
course_highlights: Flat loop courses through St. Vit
Start and finish at the Küsterhaus
9.1 km inline skating race (5 laps), helmets required
additional: Timing is provided by a disposable chip attached to the running shoe. Race bibs and materials can be collected on event day from 13:30 in the registration tent next to the Küsterhaus. Water is available along the course, with tea and fruit at the finish area. Changing facilities are available at the local youth center. Helmets are required for the inline skating race. A charity tattoo campaign and DKMS registration will be available on site. Participation through membership is possible; donations support children’s hospices, DKMS, and families in need. Races are offered over various distances, including a Bambini run and inline skating.

name: Werler Kurpark Crosslauf - Hindernislauf für Groß und Klein
location: Werl Kurpark, Werl, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Werler Kurpark Crosslauf is an obstacle race for all ages, held in the picturesque Kurpark in Werl. The event offers races for different age groups and ability levels, from short courses for children to a challenging 6.4 km course for endurance runners. New in 2026 is the relay cross, which encourages team spirit and fun. The varied course features numerous exciting obstacles that make the race a special experience.
course_highlights: A variety of obstacles, including Climb the Wall, Waterlagoon and Mountainclimber
Distances from 480 metres to 6.4 kilometres
New for 2026: Project S as an additional obstacle
additional: On-site late registration is available up to 60 minutes before the respective start (except for the relay). Race numbers use electronic timing via Racersult. An exclusive Kurparkcross shirt can be pre-ordered only until 30.06.2026. Spikes, barefoot running and costumes are not permitted for safety reasons. Accompaniment on the course is permitted only for the U6 Bambini race. Obstacles, courses for children and adults, family-friendly, team spirit, fun

name: Wiehler AggerEnergie- und Sparkasse Gummersbach Sommerlauf
location: Wiehltalstadion, Wiehl, Oberbergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Wiehl AggerEnergie and Sparkasse Gummersbach Summer Run is a varied running event for all age groups and ability levels. Starting at Wiehltal Stadium, the routes pass through the redesigned parks in the center of Wiehl and offer a scenic setting. Whether you run individually or as part of a team, the Summer Run invites you to get active, enjoy a sense of community, and have fun. The motto “We in Wiehl are sporty!” underscores Wiehl’s vibrant sporting culture.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Wiehltal Stadium
Route through redesigned parks in the city center
Scenic and varied course
additional: The run takes place on Saturday, 05 September 2026. The event is open to individual runners and teams. Contact: Nicole Woberschal (Tel. 02262 99-206). Routes start at Wiehltal Stadium and offer a scenic setting. Registration available.

name: Wildman Harz
description: WILDMAN Harz is a challenging trail-running event around the mountain town of Wildemann in the Harz Mountains. The course features tough climbs, technical downhills, spruce forests and alpine meadows, offering an authentic trail-running experience in the Upper Harz. With distances from 1.5 km to 55 km, there is a suitable challenge for every trail runner. The event also features a varied program, including a pasta party and a barbecue party, making the weekend a special experience.
course_highlights: Tough climbs and technical downhills
Spruce forests and alpine meadows
Singletrack trails over rugged terrain around Wildemann
additional: Late registration is possible online up to 30 minutes before the respective start, with a late-registration fee of EUR 10. Age limits are defined for each course. The program includes a pasta party on Friday and a barbecue party on Saturday. There are race categories, mandatory equipment and aid stations. Registration is through the partner myRacePartner.com. Courses have up to 2,100 metres of elevation gain. Aid stations, timing, environmental and fair-play rules, a program including pasta and barbecue parties, and registration are required.

name: Ederauenlauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km, 0.4 km
description: The Ederauenlauf in Bergheim is a popular running event offering a variety of distances suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels. The course runs through the picturesque Ederauen and provides ideal conditions on a measured course eligible for record lists. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, numerous volunteers, and great spirit. Alongside the sporting competition, the focus is also on sharing the experience and supporting social projects.
course_highlights: Measured course eligible for record lists through the Ederauen
Distances from the 400 m Bambini race to the half marathon (21.1 km)
Start and finish at the central sports complex of TV08 Bergheim
additional: The event offers various distances, from the 400 m Bambini race to the half marathon (21.1 km). The course is dry and sheltered from the wind, with ideal running weather. There is a family-friendly atmosphere with many volunteers and spectators. The event supports social projects such as the Marburg Children's Cancer Aid. The central sports complex of TV08 Bergheim serves as the start and finish venue. Courses are measured and well marked, including for Nordic walking; donations support children's cancer aid; event in September 2026.

name: Fehmarn Marathon
description: The Fehmarn Marathon takes place annually on the island of Fehmarn and offers runners a varied course through the eastern part of the island. The main races follow roads, dike paths and uneven dirt tracks, providing a diverse running experience. The event starts on 5 September 2026 at 9:30 a.m. at the sports field at Inselschule in Fehmarn. In addition to the marathon, there are other races with award ceremonies, and all participants receive an official marathon shirt. Timing is done with a foot chip attached to the running shoe, and the event takes place in all weather conditions.
course_highlights: Loops along roads, dike paths and uneven dirt tracks
Course through the eastern part of Fehmarn
Start and finish at the sports field at Inselschule
additional: Bib pickup is available the day before the event from 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. and on the day of the event from 8:00 a.m. Award ceremonies take place at staggered times after the races. Timing is done with a foot chip, which must be returned after the race; a €15 fee applies if it is lost. The event ends at approximately 3:15 p.m. with the arrival of the bicycle escort marking the end of the course. Parking is recommended, with the start area within walking distance. Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective race. Shirts tend to run small, so larger sizes are recommended. The event takes place in all weather conditions; online registration is available, including running shirts and various categories.

name: 4. Backyard Ultra Munich
description: The Munich Backyard Ultra is a unique running event in Oberschleißheim near Munich, where participants run a 6.7 km loop every hour. What makes it special is that the same course is run each time, and only one person emerges as the winner at the end. The event thrives on a strong community, with runners, volunteers and spectators supporting one another and creating a special atmosphere together. Safety, refreshments and comfort are all taken care of, allowing participants to focus fully on their running experience.
course_highlights: A clearly marked 6.7 km course that is safe to run even at night
A spacious base camp for breaks, refreshments and personal belongings
Easy to reach by car and public transport, with professional support from photographers
additional: Check-in from 6:00 a.m., including setup and race-number collection; group warm-up and motivational huddle before the start; a new start every hour; basic refreshments including water, snacks and hot drinks; on-site medical support; professional organisation; a goodie bag and a DNF portrait and medal as a keepsake. Run through varied terrain. Registration until 04 September 2026. Start on 5 September 2026 at 6:00 a.m.

name: Palatina Backyard Ultra

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Mit der Anmeldung bitte 10,-€ an folgende Bankverbindung überweisen.

description: The Palatina Backyard Ultra is a unique running competition in Erfweiler, where a 6.7 km lap starts every full hour. Participants keep running until only one runner can complete a lap within the hour. The course starts at Belmontplatz and runs along roads, fields and forest trails, with around 100 metres of elevation gain, through varied scenery. A relaxed get-together takes place the day before, and the event is known for its open-ended finish time and friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 6.7 km lap with approximately 100 metres of elevation gain
The course runs along roads, fields and approximately 4 km of forest trails
Start and finish at Belmontplatz in Erfweiler
additional: The start and finish are at Belmontplatz in Erfweiler. Tents, gazebos, motorhomes or caravans can be set up there in limited spaces (first come, first served). A communal tent serves as a refreshment station and for race-number collection, but not as accommodation. Registration is by email only, with the entry fee paid by bank transfer. The race starts every full hour, and each lap must be completed within 60 minutes. Lighting is mandatory between 20:00 and 07:00. Medical services are available on site. The event ends when only one runner can complete a lap within the hour. The race takes place in and around Erfweiler; the start and finish are at Belmontplatz. The course is approximately 6.7 km long and focuses on endurance and enjoyment. September weather is usually mild, around 19°C, with a chance of rain.

name: Intern. Steinhuder-Meer-Lauf
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 46th International Steinhuder Meer Run, hosted by TSV Poggenhagen von 1946 e.V., takes place on September 5, 2026. This traditional public race is scored according to the rules of the German Athletics Association (DLO) and is recognized for all DLV public race badges. Certificates are available for all finishers and can be downloaded online. An awards ceremony is held for the top three finishers in each category. A special prize is also awarded to the largest registered group. Acceptance of the terms of participation and liability limitations is required to take part.
course_highlights: Scored according to DLO rules
Recognized for all DLV public race badges
Awards ceremony on race day, with a special prize for the largest group
additional: Online registrations are acknowledged with a confirmation. The organizational fee is non-refundable if you do not start. Certificates for all finishers are available to download online. The event is part of the TSV Poggenhagen program and, alongside the races, offers the opportunity to earn DLV public race badges. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and the scenic course in the Meer region.

name: Volkslauf Eisbergen 2026
location: Sportplatz Eisbergen, Waterbusch 40, Porta Westfalica, Germany
organizer: TuS Eisbergen TURN- UND SPIELVEREIN 1919 EISBERGEN e. V.
description: The Volkslauf Eisbergen is a long-established running event in Porta Westfalica, offering several distances for children and adults. The course runs around the Eisbergen sports ground and offers varied running options, with a 5.7 km fun run and a 17.7 km long-distance race. Food and refreshments are available for participants, and the event is part of the Mühlenkreisserie. The course can also be viewed on Komoot, allowing runners to prepare in advance.
course_highlights: Loop around the Eisbergen sports ground, with the start and finish at the sports ground
Fun run course: approx. 5.7 km; long-distance course: approx. 17.7 km (two laps with minimal changes)
Children’s races: 400 m Bambini run, 800 m schoolchildren’s run
additional: Bambini run (400 m) for children up to age 6, with no registration or entry fee. Schoolchildren’s run (800 m) for children up to age 12. Online registration is available only until 04.09; after that, late registration is possible on site for an additional fee. Start times have changed: Bambini run 14:00, schoolchildren’s run 14:15, fun run and walking 15:00. Food and refreshments are available. Distances: 5.7 km fun run and walking, approx. 17.7 km long-distance race; start location: Eisbergen sports ground, Waterbusch 40; September weather: around 19°C, cloudy

name: Spargellauf - "Run den Damm"
description: The Spargel Run “Run den Damm” in Lampertheim is a popular fun run with a 35-year tradition, welcoming runners of all ages and ability levels. The event offers 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon distances on a flat, well-marked loop course along the Altrhein embankment, finishing at Adam-Günderoth Stadium. Spectators, music and an after-race party with a live DJ create a lively atmosphere and an unforgettable experience. The 10 km race is also the Bergstraße district championship. The event is family-friendly and warmly welcomes competitive runners, beginners and walkers alike.
course_highlights: Flat, well-marked loop course of approximately 4.6 km along the Altrhein embankment
Finish at Adam-Günderoth Stadium in a lively atmosphere
Refreshment stations along the course and in the finish area
additional: On-site late registration is available until 1 hour before each race for a small late-registration fee. Race numbers can be collected in the foyer of Hans-Pfeiffer-Halle until 30 minutes before the race. Changing rooms, showers and baggage storage are available. Medical support and refreshment stations offering water, apple spritzer and isotonic drinks are provided along the course and in the finish area. After the race, there will be an after-race party with a live DJ, an awards ceremony, food and drinks. All finishers receive a high-quality medal and can print their certificates online. Loop course along the Altrhein embankment, awards ceremonies, live DJ, food and drinks, online registration available.

name: Strassenlauf
description: The Sandhofer Road Race is an attractive 10 km loop through the Sandhofer fields in Mannheim. The course is officially measured by the DLV, flat, paved and mostly asphalt, making it ideal for competitive and recreational runners. In addition to the main race, there is also a 1,200-metre children’s race, giving young people a taste of competition. The event is part of the engelhorn sports Brooks Running Cup 2026 and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with refreshments, changing and shower facilities, and medical services.
course_highlights: Flat, paved and mostly asphalt 10 km loop
Course runs through the Sandhofer fields
Officially measured by the DLV, with signs marking every kilometre
additional: Race-number collection from 17:00 on race day. Changing and shower facilities are available in the SKV Sandhofen tennis hall (women) and gym (men), as well as on the sports grounds. Parking is limited; travel by RNV tram line 3 is recommended. Medical services on site. Refreshments along the course and in the finish area. Timing by br-timing; timing ends after 1:30 hours. Race on 5 September 2026; registration is open. Part of the Running Cup; 10 km course.

name: Volksbank Mitte Kurstadtlauf
description: The VR-Bank Mitte Kurstadtlauf in Heilbad Heiligenstadt is a long-running race taking place for the 27th time on September 5, 2026. The 19-kilometer course crosses the Dün and starts and finishes in the Vitalpark. A tree is planted to reforest local woodlands for every participant, making the race environmentally special too. The event offers a welcoming atmosphere and invites runners of all ability levels.
course_highlights: 19 km race across the Dün
Start and finish in the Vitalpark (Leineaue 1)
Scenic course with sections through the forest
additional: Race bib distribution from 8:30 a.m. in front of the Vitalpark. Late registration is possible for an additional fee of €3. Start and finish in the Vitalpark, race across the Dün, tree-planting campaign for participants

name: 55. Brockenlauf
description: The Brockenlauf is Germany’s oldest mountain race and has been held annually in Ilsenburg in the Harz Mountains since 1927. The main 26.2 km course climbs 890 metres to the Brocken, the highest mountain in northern Germany, and offers a demanding challenge with changeable high-mountain weather at the summit. The course passes through picturesque countryside and historic places, with impressive views along the way. In addition to the main race, there are shorter routes that also offer an experience of nature. The event is open to all runners, whether or not they belong to a club.
course_highlights: 26.2 km with 890 metres of elevation gain to the Brocken
Changeable high-mountain weather at the summit, with temperatures from -15 °C to 15 °C
Start in the medieval town of Ilsenburg; run along the Ilse and through the Harz Forest
additional: Split times are recorded at several points along the 26.2 km course using SPORTident Timing. The course is demanding, with steep sections of up to a 12.5% gradient and concrete slabs at the summit. The event is open to runners and walkers. The organizer reserves the right to change the course if conditions on the Brocken are unreasonable. Registration is already open. Various distances are available, including ultra and running events, as well as a book flea market and exclusive running shirts.

name: Brokser Volkslauf
location: Brokser Volkslauf, Bruchhausen-Vilsen, Lower Saxony, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld per Überweisung vor dem Lauf: Volkslauf 5 km,10 km und 20 km € 6,00

price_tiers.distance: Bambinilauf und Jugendlauf 400 m und 2 km

tiers.description: Startgeld per Überweisung vor dem Lauf: Bambinilauf und Jugendlauf 400 m und 2 km € 2,00

tiers.description: Startgeld per Überweisung vor dem Lauf: Walking und Nordic-Walking 5 km und 10 km € 6,00

description: The Brokser Volkslauf takes place on September 5, 2026, in Bruchhausen-Vilsen and offers running and walking events for all age groups. The event includes distances from 400 m to 20 km, as well as walking and Nordic walking routes. Held in all weather, it offers participants a varied supporting program with a bouncy castle, drinks, cake, and bratwurst. The races start at the school and sports center, and children’s and youth races are rewarded with medals.
course_highlights: Distances from 400 m (Bambini Run) to 20 km (Volkslauf)
Start and finish at the school and sports center in Bruchhausen-Vilsen
The 20 km route consists of two laps of the 10 km route
additional: The start and finish are at the school and sports center in Bruchhausen-Vilsen. Race bib distribution begins at 13:00. Late registration is available on the day of the event. Award ceremonies take place at staggered times after the individual races. Medals are awarded for the children’s and youth races. The supporting program includes a bouncy castle, drinks, cake, and bratwurst. Running, walking, held annually, in all weather.

name: Gremsdorfer Kerwalauf 2026
description: The Gremsdorf Kerwa Run is a traditional running event in Gremsdorf, offering a range of distances for all age groups. The event includes Bambini, children’s, youth, hobby and main races, as well as walking events. The routes pass through the scenic surroundings of Gremsdorf and offer an enjoyable experience for both recreational runners and competitive athletes. The run takes place annually as part of the Kerwa festival and is a popular event for the whole family.
course_highlights: A variety of routes for Bambini, children’s, youth, hobby and main races
Run through the picturesque countryside around Gremsdorf
Part of the traditional Kerwa festival
additional: The event offers races for all age groups, including Bambini, children’s, youth, hobby and main races, as well as walking. Registration is possible until the day of the event, with tiered prices depending on when you register. The scenic route map is available as a PDF on the website. The event is part of the traditional Kerwa festival in Gremsdorf. Categories include children’s races, Nordic walking and hobby races. Held during Kerwa week, the event features a lively atmosphere, medical services, showers at the sports clubhouse and a family-friendly setting.

name: 46. Internationaler Steinhuder-Meer-Lauf
description: The 46th International Steinhuder Meer Run invites running enthusiasts to Poggenhagen on September 5, 2026. The event offers 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon races, all starting together. The scenic course runs around Poggenhagen, past the air base and as far as the bathing island in Steinhude. Children can also take part in races over 450 and 850 metres. All races finish at the TSV Poggenhagen sports park.
course_highlights: The course runs north of Poggenhagen
The 10 km race passes the air base and Großenheidorn
The half-marathon goes as far as the bathing island in Steinhude and back
additional: The children's races over 450 and 850 metres start at 9:30 a.m. All main races start together at 11 a.m. on Dewitz-von-Woyna-Straße in Poggenhagen. The finish is at the TSV Poggenhagen sports park. Races over 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon; children's races; start at 11 a.m. in Poggenhagen; online registration available

name: RAWki na Surowo
location: Bieszczadzki Park Narodowy, Wetlina, Bieszczady, Poland
description: RAWki na Surowo is a mountain trail race held in the magical Bieszczady Mountains, taking runners across the scenic mountain meadows of Mała and Wielka Rawka. The 29 km course with +1550 m of elevation gain runs through Bieszczady National Park, requiring the race to be held without aid stations or course markings. The event is certified by ITRA and UTMB and is part of the MTrail Running Series. The start and finish are in Wetlina, and the race follows a self-supported format that underscores its rugged character.
course_highlights: A 29 km course with +1550 m of elevation gain across the mountain meadows of Mała and Wielka Rawka
A self-supported race with no aid stations or course markings
A route through Bieszczady National Park, with views towards the Polish-Ukrainian and Polish-Slovak borders
additional: The race starts at 08:00 from the ticket office by the green trail to Mała Rawka. The finish and race office are at Wetlina 36, at Arszenik - Jadło & Nalewki. The race office is open on 4 September from 18:00 to 21:00 and on 5 September from 06:30 to 07:30. The time limit for completing the course is 15:30. The start and finish locations are about 1,300 m apart. Participant parking is available in Wetlina, including by the green trail to Jawornik. There are no aid or water stations, so participants must be self-sufficient. The main distance is approximately 28.5 km, with access restricted due to park regulations. The event also includes online registration and electronic timing.

name: 60. Festiwal Chodu
location: Portowy region Gdańska, Gdańsk, Pomorskie, Poland
description: The 60th Walking Festival is a prestigious international sporting event held in the port region of Gdańsk on 5 September 2026. It brings together athletes of various ages and ability levels, with race-walking events over 10 km (women and men, including Open, U20 and U18 categories), 5 km and 3 km for younger participants, as well as the Polish Masters Championships over 5 km. The festival also includes the Polish U23 Championships over 10 km and accompanying events such as the “Walk with the Postman” Prologue and the Polish Post Office Defenders’ Run – Energa Cup. The organiser, LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club, promotes physical activity among people with disabilities, too, with wheelchair races and FrameRunning competitions.
course_highlights: Race walking over 10 km, 5 km and 3 km, with distances suited to different age categories
Polish Masters Championships over 5 km and Polish U23 Championships over 10 km
Accompanying events, including the “Walk with the Postman” Prologue and the Polish Post Office Defenders’ Run
additional: The festival promotes physical activity among people with disabilities through wheelchair races and FrameRunning competitions. It is organised by LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club and supported by the Ministry of Sport and Tourism. Events cover several distances, including 10 km, 5 km and 3 km, and online registration is available. The event promotes sporting activity among people of different ages and people with disabilities, with support from the Ministry of Sport and Tourism.

name: Chojnik Karkonoski Festiwal Biegowy
location: Sobieszów, Jelenia Góra, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

tiers.label: tier_4
tiers.description: 300 zł – w płacone 1 sierpnia – 5 września 2026 r.

description: The Chojnik Karkonoski Running Festival is a mountain running event held in Sobieszów, in the heart of the Karkonosze Mountains. The festival offers a variety of distances, from a family educational run to a demanding 102 km ultramarathon with over 5,000 m of elevation gain. The routes follow scenic, rocky trails in Karkonosze National Park, offering unique views and challenges for runners of varying abilities. The event fosters a sense of community and promotes running as a team sport, as well as nature education.
course_highlights: Routes pass through Karkonosze National Park, with rocky descents and demanding climbs
102 km ultramarathon with over 5,110 m of elevation gain and a 20-hour time limit
Start and finish by Chojnik Castle in Sobieszów, with scenic mountain views
additional: Race starts take place from 2:00 (Ultra Chojnik) to 10:30 (Educational Run). The participant limit for Ultra Chojnik is 100, and for the Chojnik Marathon it is 325. Mandatory equipment for the ultra includes, among other things, a headlamp, a phone with roaming, an NRC emergency blanket, and a course map. Aid stations and drop bags are available along the route. The Educational Run features educational stops and nature-related questions. Mountain terrain, a limit of 325 participants, mandatory equipment required, aid stations along the route, 9-hour time limit.

name: Olkuski Bieg Uliczny
location: Stadion przy ul. 29 Listopada 12c, Olkusz, Poland
description: The Olkusz Street Run VII Silver Ten is an annual running event organized by the Olkuszbiega Association, the Olkusz City and Municipal Office, and the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Olkusz. The main 10 km race consists of two 5 km loops, with chip timing and route markers every kilometre. The course runs along asphalt and partially cobbled streets; the start and finish are at the Market Square in Olkusz. The event promotes an active lifestyle and running as a recreational activity for all age groups.
course_highlights: The 10 km course consists of two 5 km loops
Asphalt and partially cobbled surfaces
Route markers every 1 km and a split time at 5 km
additional: The time limit to finish the race is 90 minutes. There is a refreshment station at approximately 6 km. The participant limit is 300. Verification and race-pack collection take place on 6 and 7 September. Chip timing is used, with the chip attached to the shoe. Participants under 18 must have written parental consent. The participant limit is 300, and the time limit for completing the course is 90 minutes. Online registration is available. The entry fee is non-refundable; it may be transferred until 26.08.2024.

name: Półmaraton Praski
description: The Praski Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Warsaw, attracting both recreational and experienced runners. The half-marathon course passes through the scenic and historic parts of Praga, offering participants exceptional views and atmosphere. The event takes place at night, giving it a unique character and appeal. The organizers provide professional support, timekeeping, and race packs that include an official T-shirt.
course_highlights: The course passes through the historic Praga district of Warsaw
The race takes place in the evening, giving the event a nighttime character
Scenic views and the unique atmosphere of a night half marathon
additional: Official race T-shirt for participants. Electronic timekeeping. The event is held at night, with the start at 20:00. Race packs with a race bib and chip are available. The course is certified and secured. Participants can also take part in the 5 km race, the Praska 5k Run. The event also includes results and details about the course and regulations. The races are open to a wide range of participants, and the event is growing in popularity among runners from Warsaw and the surrounding area.

name: XLVI Usedom Marathon
description: The XLVI International Usedom Marathon is a unique running event that crosses two countries along Europe’s longest seaside promenade. The 42 km course connects Świnoujście in Poland with Wolgast in Germany, passing through historic seaside resorts and scenic woodland. Runners can enjoy varied surfaces and beautiful views of the Baltic Sea, as well as the unique atmosphere of Usedom Island.
course_highlights: The route follows Europe’s longest seaside promenade
Passes through the historic seaside resorts of Ahlbeck, Heringsdorf and Bansin
Varied surfaces: asphalt, cobblestones and forest trails
additional: Transport to the marathon start is provided by the organizer’s buses, with a stop near the race office at 7:15. Boarding is available at various points on Usedom Island. Baggage transport to the stadium in Wolgast is provided. Time limit: runners must pass Kölpinsee (km 21.8) within 2:30 h and Zinnowitz (km 30) within 3:30 h; otherwise, they will be withdrawn from the course. After these time limits, the course will not be supported and no refreshment stations will be available. Start in Świnoujście, finish in Wolgast, bus transfer available, registration until 30 August 2026. The routes include urban, forest and coastal sections.

description: Sports Club Rohals warmly invites you to the 16th edition of the Run Through Novoveská Huta, taking place in Novoveská Huta. Adults can take on a new 12.2 km course to Vojtechova samota and back, the same for women and men. A 5 km course is also available for those who prefer a shorter distance. Children and young runners will compete on shorter courses through the streets of Huta, grouped by age category. After the race, participants can refuel with goulash; children can enjoy a small theatre performance, and adults will be entertained by the band 3násť ciest.
course_highlights: The new adult course goes to Vojtechova samota (Šadroň) and back
The adult course is 12.2 km and is the same for women and men
Short courses for children through the streets of Novoveská Huta, grouped by age category
additional: Registration for school-age participants is from 11:30 to 12:45, and for juniors and adults until 14:45. Participants may start in only one category. Goulash will be provided after the race; children can enjoy a small theatre performance, and adults will be entertained by the band 3násť ciest. Adult categories compete for points in the Spišská Nová Ves District Running League. 12.2 km and 5 km courses, categories for different age groups, registration on the day of the event, activities for children and adults.

name: Marathon Chopok
description: The Chopok Marathon is a challenging mountain race in the beautiful Low Tatras, testing your abilities on a variety of surfaces and terrain. The race takes place on September 5, 2026, starting at 7:00 from Srdiečko and finishing on Chopok at an elevation of 2,004 m above sea level. There are two main courses: the 43 km SkyMarathon Chopok with 2,600 m of elevation gain, and the shorter 21 km Sky Race Jasná Trail with 1,400 m of elevation gain. Relay teams are also available on the long course. The route runs along both the southern and northern sides of Chopok, including the main ridge, and offers beautiful views and varied terrain.
course_highlights: A 43 km course with 2,600 m of elevation gain through the Low Tatras on the southern and northern sides of Chopok
Crossing the main ridge over varied surfaces that make footwear choice important
Finish on Chopok at an elevation of 2,004 m above sea level, with the option of a quick cable-car ride
additional: The long course offers a relay option for teams of four or fewer, with legs of approximately 10–11 km. The race is included in the Slovak Skyrunning Association’s 2026 calendar. The courses are unchanged from previous editions, allowing participants to compare performances. Spectators can watch runners from several points along the course. A trail race with relay-team options; starts at 07:00 and 10:00; part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association’s calendar; the route runs from Srdiečko to Chopok and back.

name: Kokava Trail
location: Kokava nad Rimavicou, Banská Bystrica, Slovakia
description: Kokava Trail is a certified trail race starting and finishing in Kokava nad Rimavicou, with routes through the Veporské vrchy and Stolické vrchy mountain ranges. There are two distances: the main course is 78 km with +3330 m of elevation gain and an 18-hour time limit; the shorter Pasiečky Trail is 23 km with +1200 m of elevation gain and a 7-hour limit. The varied route consists of 45% meadows, 45% forest trails and 10% asphalt. It has no difficult technical sections, but includes several steeper descents and climbs. Runners will find six aid stations along the course. Winners in the Men, Women, Men 50+ and Women 50+ categories receive medals and prizes during the awards ceremony at the cultural centre.
course_highlights: Varied terrain: 45% meadow, 45% forest and 10% asphalt
+3330 m of elevation gain on the 78 km main course
6 aid stations along the course
additional: Mandatory equipment includes a thermal blanket, a headlamp with fresh batteries, a charged mobile phone with an activated SIM card, a GPS device with the race route (a power bank is mandatory when navigating by phone), a reflective vest or bands, at least 1.5 l of fluids, a personal cup or wide-mouth bottle, ID and a clearly visible race number. The first three finishers in the Men, Women, Men 50+ and Women 50+ categories are awarded. The route has no difficult technical sections, but includes several steeper descents and climbs. There are 6 aid stations along the course. Two distances: 78 km and 23 km; mandatory equipment; certified course; mountain terrain; online registration; part of the Slovak Ultra Trail League

name: Prešov Running Series 3. kolo
description: The 3rd round of the Prešov Running Series is part of a series of running events taking place in Prešov during 2026. The event is open to all ages and running abilities, from beginners to professionals. The courses are designed to bring the community together, promote a healthy lifestyle and make running enjoyable. The entry fee includes timing, a medal, refreshments and an accompanying programme. Children who are members of the Prešov Running Team can run for free.
course_highlights: Courses for runners of different abilities, from beginners to professionals
An event on Hlavná Street in Prešov with a community atmosphere
An accompanying programme and refreshments for all participants
additional: The entry fee includes a bib with a chip, timing, a medal, refreshments, an accompanying programme, medical services, race organisation and photographs. On-site registration is possible subject to capacity, but early online registration is recommended. Participants are advised to collect their race bibs the day before at OC Novum. Children who are members of the Prešov Running Team can take part for free after paying the annual membership fee. The series includes three races at different locations in Prešov, with themes from fantasy, history and sport; registration is compulsory; maps, medals and children’s categories are available; a raffle is also part of the event.

name: 6 hodinovka pod Šarišským hradom
description: The 6-hour race beneath Šariš Castle is an endurance running event held in Veľký Šariš, Prešov District. The race is open to both individual runners and relay teams, with categories divided by age and gender. The entry fee is the same for all runners, and the event offers a chance to test your endurance in a six-hour run in the beautiful surroundings beneath the castle. The organizers, Gejza Sabanoš and Ondrej Fedor, ensure the event runs smoothly.
course_highlights: The race takes place around historic Šariš Castle, with beautiful views of the surrounding landscape
The event offers different categories, including relay races
A six-hour endurance challenge for runners of all levels
additional: The race includes various categories and relay options. The course is set around the castle, but details about the terrain are not specified.

name: Ozorovská dvanastka
description: Ozorovská Dvanástka is a running race held in Malé Ozorovce, offering courses for both children and adults. The race is organized by OZ Zorovčan in cooperation with the municipality of Veľké Ozorovce. Runners can compete in the 6 km and 12 km races, with categories based on age and gender. The children’s race starts at 9:00 and the adults’ race at 10:00. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a welcoming atmosphere near the cultural centre.
course_highlights: The course runs through Malé Ozorovce, with parking in front of the cultural centre
Two main distances: 12 km and 6 km, with categories based on age and gender
Children’s race starts at 9:00; adults’ race starts at 10:00
additional: Race categories include children’s categories and age groups for men and women in the 12 km race (Men A up to 39, B 40–49, C 50 and older; Women F up to 39, G 40–49, H) and a 6 km race for men and women. The race takes place on 5 September 2026, with starts at 9:00 and 10:00. The course includes local roads. Registration is available online or on site.

name: Horský kros Gerlach
description: The Gerlach Mountain Cross is a traditional uphill mountain race that starts in the village of Gerlachov and runs through the Velická Valley to the Sliezsky dom mountain hotel. The course is 8,400 metres long with an elevation gain of 879 metres, and runners tackle a rocky trail and sections of asphalt road. The event is suited to runners who enjoy challenging mountain terrain and beautiful views of the High Tatras. The race also includes children’s runs, and participants can purchase an entry option that includes original Gerlach Mountain Cross socks.
course_highlights: 8,400 m course with an elevation gain of 879 m
Rocky trail and sections of asphalt road
Finish in front of the Sliezsky dom mountain hotel
additional: The maximum capacity is 200 runners. The time limit at the Velický Bridge (5.7 km) is 1:30. Refreshments are provided on the course and at the finish, along with transport of belongings to the finish and a post-race meal. The children’s races (100–500 m) are not timed; every child receives a medal and a sweet. Entry with HKG socks is available for €7. The race takes place in mountain terrain. Registration is available at the municipal office, and children’s races are also included.

description: Run for the Tatras is a running event held in the picturesque surroundings of Štrbské Pleso in the High Tatras, below the Tatras Tower observation tower. The races offer a children’s start at 14:00 and an adults’ start at 16:00. The course follows natural terrain along the lakeshore and cross-country ski trails. Categories are divided by age and gender, allowing runners of different age groups to take part. The event is organised by Barbora and Slavomír Ogurčák in cooperation with the civic association Žiť Tatry, who ensure a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality organisation.
course_highlights: Natural terrain along the shore of Štrbské Pleso lake
Štrbské Pleso cross-country ski trails
Picturesque High Tatras setting below Tatras Tower
additional: Children’s start at 14:00; adults’ start at 16:00. Categories by age and gender. Organised by Barbora and Slavomír Ogurčák in cooperation with the civic association Žiť Tatry. The course is on natural terrain, running around the lake and along the cross-country ski trails. The course is on natural terrain, running around the lake and along the ski trails; registration from 15.3.2025 to 4.9.2025; categories for different age groups

name: Veľatský lesný beh
description: Veľaty Forest Run is a traditional running event organized by the civic association OZ Stopa in the village of Veľaty. The race takes place at the FK Veľaty sports field and offers courses of various lengths for men and women aged 15 and over, with children’s races held directly on the football pitch. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, voluntary entry fee in the form of a donation, and refreshments. Volunteers assist runners throughout the day, and results are timed, with winners announced and prizes awarded.
course_highlights: Courses through the forest around Veľaty, measuring 6 km, 11 km, and 16 km
Children’s races on the FK Veľaty football pitch
Changing rooms, showers, and toilets at the starting venue
additional: Online registration is available until 4 September 2024. After that, registration is available at the starting venue until 9:30. The entry fee is voluntary, in the form of a donation to OZ Stopa. Results are announced and prizes awarded after the last runner finishes. Parking is available in designated car parks, with directions provided by the organizers. The race is run according to athletics rules, and participants take part at their own risk. Children run immediately after the main races start. The course includes forest, asphalt, and gravel sections; the races are open to all age groups; registration is available online or on site; refreshments and commemorative items are provided.
