additional: Check-in begins at 17:00, and the start is at Lodičky. A series of seven runs where everyone can run at their own pace. Proceeds from entry fees go to help those in need. Course: cycle path; distance: 3 km; registration from 17:00, race at 17:45; series of seven races during 2026

name: Witzenmann Opavská míle

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Registrace do 25. 8. 2025 budou mít na startovním čísle jméno

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Registrace od 26. 8. do 3. 9. 2025, platba pouze kartou, na startovním čísle nebude jméno

description: Witzenmann Opavská míle is a prestigious one-mile (1609 m) running race that continues the tradition of the Stanislav Mikeska Memorial. The race is open to a wide range of participants, including professionals, amateurs, children, families, corporate and school teams, people with disabilities, and wheelchair users. It takes place in Opava and is supported by its general partner, Witzenmann Opava. The course record is held by Filip Sasínek, with a time of 3:55 minutes set in 2023. The race is held regularly and is one of the most significant running races in the Czech Republic.
course_highlights: A course exactly one mile long (1609 m)
An official middle-distance athletics event
Suitable for all age groups and different types of teams (corporate, family, and school)
additional: Race categories include men and women in various age groups, children’s categories, and corporate, family, and school teams, with rules for team composition and scoring. Team registration allows members to be added using the team name and PIN code. Payment is possible by card or bank transfer. The organiser reserves the right to make changes. The race takes place on 4 September 2025, with payment by card or bank transfer, and is part of the TIPSPORT SPORTUJ S NÁMI 2025 series. Historical results and information about previous editions are available on the official website.

name: Noční běh pro světlušku Liberec

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: The Night Run for Světluška in Liberec is a charity running event taking place on September 10, 2026, at the Vesec sports complex. Participants can choose between a 3 km course (1 lap) and a 6 km course (2 laps), with the run starting at 20:00. The entry fee is CZK 500, half of which supports the Světluška project and half of which goes toward direct assistance for people with severe visual impairments. The event offers an accompanying program, including a concert, and race packs with a headlamp or a sports headband for those who register early.
course_highlights: Night run at the Vesec sports complex
Choice of a 3 km or 6 km course
Start at 20:00, with an accompanying program and concert
additional: Registration desks open at 18:00. Race packs come in two options: with a headlamp or with a sports headband. Holders of TP, ZTP and ZTP/P disability cards, together with a companion, can enter free of charge, but are not entitled to a race pack, which can be purchased on site for CZK 250. Registration is via the GoOut.cz portal. An admission ticket with a unique code is required to enter the venue (printed or on a mobile device). Start at 20:00; registration from 18:00; free registration for holders of ZTP and ZTP/P cards; proceeds from the event support people with visual impairments.

name: Běh Akátkami

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné je 150 Kč. Platba startovného probíhá před závodem při registraci závodníků.

description: Běh Akátkami is a regular running race in Brno-Židenice, offering courses for men, women, and children. Men run 5.2 km (3 laps), women run 3.6 km (2 laps), and children of any age have their own 1.6 km loop. The race takes place in the evening, with registration from 17:15 and the main race starting at 18:00. Refreshments and bag storage are available after the finish. Participants run at their own risk and can use public transport and nearby parking.
course_highlights: A 1.6 km loop in Brno-Židenice
Men run 3 laps (5.2 km); women run 2 laps (3.6 km)
Children's race, with the loop distance set before the start
additional: Registration takes place at the race venue from 17:15. The children's race starts at 17:45, and the men's and women's main race starts together at 18:00. Water and a tent for bag storage are available after the finish. Transport: parking is available in the adjacent streets; trolleybus lines 25, 26, and 27 stop at Pálavské náměstí. The start is scheduled for 18:00. The race provides refreshments, water, and bag storage; on-site registration is also available.

name: Prajzské kilo
description: Prajzské kilo is an ultratrail race through the Hlučín region, recalling the historic borders and stories of a region divided in 1742. The race offers three distances—30, 50 and 100 km—with different time limits and elevation gain. You’ll run through a landscape of old roads, chapels and field tracks, bearing the marks of history and local identity. The race is scored as part of the Czech-Slovak Ultratrail Cup and also offers UTMB Index and ITRA points. It includes a unique medal, a T-shirt, refreshments on the course and at the finish, and childcare for the shorter distances.
course_highlights: 30, 50 and 100 km routes with 270, 350 and 600 m of elevation gain
Run through the Hlučín region, passing historic landmarks and chapels
7 aid stations on the 100 km route, GPS live tracking and online tracking
additional: The entry fee includes a unique metal finisher’s medal, a commemorative magnet, a cotton logo T-shirt, a hot meal at the finish (meat or vegetarian), refreshments on the course, GPS live tracking (100 km), childcare for the 30/50 km distances (registration required), online tracking at checkpoints (30/50 km), timing, and scoring in the Czech-Slovak Ultratrail Cup, with UTMB Index and ITRA points. Course records are waiting for your time; race distances: 30 km, 50 km and 100 km; time limits: 6–24 hours; childcare for 30/50 km; GPS live tracking; scoring for UTMB and ITRA points.

name: Bergisch Gladbacher Stadtlauf
organizer: SV Blau-Weiß Hand e.V., Stadt Bergisch Gladbach
price_range: Hauptlauf: 11-23 Euro, Erlebnislauf: 9-13 Euro, Gruppenrabatte verfügbar
description: The Bergisch Gladbach City Run is a long-standing running event that has taken place annually since 1996. On September 11, 2026, around 1,000 running enthusiasts will start at 6:30 p.m. on Konrad-Adenauer-Platz in the car-free city center. The event includes an untimed fun run and a main race with rankings in various age groups. The event is accompanied by a colorful program of music, food, and drinks, adding to the atmosphere of the city and culture festival.
course_highlights: Run through the car-free city center of Bergisch Gladbach
Start and finish on Konrad-Adenauer-Platz in the city center
Traditional opening event of the city and culture festival
additional: Late registration for both races is available on September 12, 2025, from 4 p.m. The fun run is untimed and has no age-group categories. The main race includes rankings for all age groups, from birth year 2014 onward, in accordance with the 2025 German Athletics Regulations. Certificates for all participants are available online. The awards ceremony is at around 9 p.m. Special awards go to the largest registered group and the youngest and oldest participants. Distances: 3 km and 9 km; online registration; timing with a MikaTag transponder; program includes music and food.

name: Bergneustädter AggerEnergie- und Sparkassen Nachtlauf
location: Bergneustadt, Oberbergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Bergneustädter AggerEnergie- und Sparkassen Nachtlauf is an evening running event in Bergneustadt, Germany, held on a Friday after nightfall. The program offers several running and walking options, including a flat 3.7 km course, a 5.4 km relay, a 5.4 km run, and a 10 km run. All races start and finish at the same locations, making the event family-friendly and easy to follow. Children’s and youth competitions round out the program, making the evening appealing to local clubs, young runners, walkers, relay teams, and adults looking for a short but intensive evening run.
course_highlights: Flat 3.7 km course as a gentler option
Hilly 5.4 km and 10 km courses
Shared start and finish area for all races
additional: The event takes place on Friday evening after nightfall. It is designed to be compact, making it easy for families and supporters to follow. Typical September weather is around 19 °C during the day and 10 °C at night, usually cloudy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. Family-friendly; children’s and youth competitions; September event with typical weather of around 19 °C high, 10 °C low, and 45 mm of precipitation.

name: Int. ENNI Citylauf Xanten
price_range: 40 Euro (5 km und 10 km), 25 Euro (Jahrgang 2010-2013 5 km), plus Pfand
description: The 31st Int. ENNI Citylauf Xanten takes place on September 11, 2026, in Xanten and offers races over 1.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km. The event is an established running event in the city of Xanten and is open to runners of all ability levels. The race takes place in typical September weather, with mild temperatures and mostly cloudy skies. The course runs through the city and offers varied scenery.
course_highlights: Distances: 1.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Course through the city of Xanten
Typical September weather with mild temperatures and cloudy skies
additional: Please check the event details with the organizer before registering. Races in Moers, Sonsbeck, Neukirchen-Vluyn, and Xanten; registration until March 2026; T-shirt included; rankings based on gun times

name: Ipsheimer Weinberglauf
location: Ipsheim, Neustadt an der Aisch-Bad Windsheim, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Ipsheim Vineyard Run is a traditional race held on the second Friday in September in the picturesque Ipsheim vineyards. It offers various events for schoolchildren and recreational runners, as well as the main race over a distance of approx. 5,800 m. The course is well marked and runs through the vineyards, offering a wonderful view of the Aisch Valley. After the race, participants can relax with refreshments and wine at the awards ceremony at the Weinberghaus. The race has become a sporting highlight, with almost 400 participants.
course_highlights: Race routes through the Ipsheim vineyards
Excellent views over the Aisch Valley in the finish area
Routes marked with colored arrows and distance markers
additional: Race number collection from 16:00 on race day in the start area below the Ipsheim vineyards. Race numbers must be worn on the front of the chest. All participants receive a high-quality technical T-shirt as a gift. Showers are available at the Ipsheim festival hall. Toilets are located in the start area and at the Weinberghaus. Free refreshments in the start area, during the main race, and at the finish. Clothing transport from the start to the finish for all races. Shuttle bus from the finish to the showers and the Weinberghaus, with shuttle service to the parking lot every half hour from 20:00. Parking at the start is available in a lit parking lot; parking in the vineyards is prohibited. Awards ceremony after the main race at the Weinberghaus, with wine and refreshments. Terrain in the vineyards, online registration, medals, T-shirts, refreshments, shuttle service, parking in Ipsheim

name: monte mare-Firmenlauf
description: The monte mare company run in Andernach is an attractive corporate race taking place on September 11, 2026. The route is a circuit through Andernach’s scenic Rhine river gardens, giving runners and walkers born in 2010 or earlier the opportunity to compete. In addition to the main race, there is a youth race for the U14 and U16 age groups. The event features a friendly atmosphere and professional timing using disposable transponders.
course_highlights: Circuit through Andernach’s Rhine river gardens
Company run distance: approx. 5.6 km (three laps plus the finishing straight)
Youth race: approx. 2.0 km, finishing at the Rheintor
additional: Start times: 16:30 Rasselstein youth race, 17:00 Raserlauf, 17:40 Hobbylauf, 18:30 Genießerlauf. Timing is provided by disposable transponders attached to the race bib (gun time). Tent and catering bookings are available, including equipment such as beer benches, tables, a power connection and a refrigerator. Food and drink orders can be placed by email until 17.08.2026. The race is a charity event, with part of the entry fees donated to charitable causes, and online registration is available. Tent and catering options, as well as training information, are also available.

name: SportScheck RUN Köln
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: The SportScheck Run Cologne is an atmospheric night run that gives runners the opportunity to experience Cologne after dark. Participants traditionally start on the Rhine Boulevard and run either 5 km or 10 km through the city center, passing historic landmarks such as the City Hall and enjoying an impressive view of Cologne Cathedral illuminated at night. The event is part of Germany’s largest and longest-running city race series and offers an unforgettable atmosphere, with refreshments at the finish and a finisher’s medal.
course_highlights: 5 km loop along the Rhine Boulevard between Hohenzollern Bridge and Deutz Bridge
Run past the historic City Hall, dating from 1330
Breathtaking view of Cologne Cathedral illuminated at night
additional: Children can take part in the 1 km DAK Kids Run. The 5 km course can be run once or twice (for 10 km). Finish-line refreshments and a finisher’s medal are included. Training plans are available to help participants prepare. The course runs between Hohenzollern Bridge and Deutz Bridge, with the start on the Rhine Boulevard. Night run; children’s and family runs included.

name: Lauf der Bildung Aschersleben
description: The Lauf der Bildung in Aschersleben is a family-friendly city run on Friday evening, starting and finishing at Augustapromenade. The route passes through the historic town-wall area and offers distances of 2.3 km, 4.6 km and 9.2 km for children, recreational runners and ambitious runners completing multiple laps. The event is part of the Solvay Cup and attracts both club runners and local families. The atmosphere is small-scale and family-oriented, and the event is well organised by Kreisvolkshochschule Aschersleben.
course_highlights: 2.3 km loop through Aschersleben’s historic town-wall area
Varied surfaces add variety, even on the shortest distance
The longer distances consist of multiple laps of the 2.3 km course
additional: Start and finish at Augustapromenade, next to Kreisvolkshochschule and Kreismusikschule. The event takes place on Friday evening and is family-friendly. Around 260 participants, including club runners competing for Solvay Cup points. A sprint finish decided the women’s 9.2 km race. The event offers several running distances, is part of the Solvay Cup, and attracts club runners, families and running enthusiasts. The route runs along the historic town wall and is known for its varied surfaces.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Radków 2026
location: Radkowskie Lake, Radków, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
distance_verbose: 50 mil, Ultramaraton, Maraton, 24 km, Półmaraton, 10 km
description: Garmin Ultra Race Radków 2026 is a mountain trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of the Stołowe Mountains, near Radków Reservoir. The courses pass through rocky labyrinths, technical trails and beautiful rock formations such as Szczeliniec Wielki and Błędne Skały. The event attracts both beginners and experienced ultramarathon runners, offering a variety of distances and a special atmosphere close to nature. Radków is an ideal place for a sporting adventure and recovery amid nature.
course_highlights: Scenic trails in the Stołowe Mountains with rock formations
Courses passing near Szczeliniec Wielki and Błędne Skały
Radków Reservoir nearby as a place to recover
additional: Award ceremonies take place after each distance. Race packets are distributed at specified times before the start and during the event. Starts take place in waves, with the longest distance starting at 05:00 and shorter distances starting in the following hours. Garmin Junior races are also available for children in various age categories. Participants can visit the EXPO and follow results online and download finisher certificates. Trail running, multiple distances, registration details, scenic mountain terrain, event dates September 11–13, 2026

name: Okolo Kolovrat
description: Běh Okolo Kolovrat is a traditional race that takes you through the beautiful surroundings of Kolovraty, including the neighboring communities of Uhříněves and Lipany, and part of Říčany. It offers 11 km and 21 km routes, with the shorter distance also available as a two-person relay. The courses run mostly along tree-lined country, meadow, and forest paths, offering a wonderful running experience in nature. The race is suitable for all runners looking to improve their time or set a personal course record.
course_highlights: Routes follow the Okolo Kolovrat walking loops, with a short stretch through neighboring communities
Mostly tree-lined country, meadow, and forest roads and paths
The main course crosses beyond Prague’s borders to Říčany, along the 50th parallel
additional: The shorter distance is also available as a two-person relay. The race takes place in all weather conditions. Detailed race information is available in the attached PDF and on the race website: https://ok.nasekolovraty.cz. Trail running, distances of 11 km and 21 km, relay option, beautiful natural scenery, event held in September 2026, support for the local community, and refreshments at the start and finish area.

name: Přeloučská desítka
description: Přelouč Ten is a running race held in Přelouč, offering 10 km and 5 km courses and a 1 km children’s race. The race takes place on asphalt roads, paved surfaces and paths, with minimal elevation gain. The start and finish are on Masaryk Square. The event is suitable for all age groups and promotes running as a social phenomenon. Refreshments and SMS delivery of results are provided after the race.
course_highlights: Course with no significant elevation gain
Surface: 60% asphalt, 40% paved surfaces and paths
Start and finish on Masaryk Square in Přelouč
additional: Refreshment stations on the course and at the finish. An SMS with your finishing time will be sent after the race. On-site registration will not be available. You can purchase a Přelouč 10 technical T-shirt for CZK 490. Trophies and prizes will be awarded to the top three men and women. Races: 5 km, 10 km and a 1 km children’s race. Online registration only. Start and finish on Masaryk Square in Přelouč. The event supports patients with butterfly skin disease (DEBRA ČR).

name: ČEZ RunTour Brno
location: Brněnská přehrada, Brno, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
distance_verbose: Maraton, Půlmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
price_range: 500 Kč - 200 Kč (dle tratě a data registrace)
description: ČEZ RunTour Brno is a family-friendly running event held by the Brno Reservoir, offering courses for all ages, from children to experienced runners. Choose from 500 m, 1 km, 3 km, 5 km, 10 km, and half-marathon (21.1 km) distances. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, excellent facilities, and activities for the whole family. Every participant receives a race pack and contributes to charity. ČEZ RunTour is ideal for recreational and elite runners who want to enjoy running in the beautiful surroundings of the Brno Reservoir.
course_highlights: Courses run around the Brno Reservoir, with unique views
Children’s races over 500 m and 1,000 m, with a kids’ corner and childcare
Aid stations on the half-marathon course and other longer courses
additional: The event provides a race pack, pacer and medical teams, a special emergency-service phone line during the race, refreshments at the finish and on the course, an official gymsack with gifts from partners, a kids’ corner with childcare, and activities for the whole family, including warm-ups and fun in the children’s zone. Multiple courses, a charitable contribution, medal engraving, online and on-site registration, facilities by the Brno Reservoir

name: Běh na Boží horu
location: Ivančice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Boží hora is a traditional race in Ivančice, challenging participants to run up 109 steps to Boží hora. Participants start individually at one-minute intervals, ensuring a smooth race. The event is part of the wide range of activities organized by the Ivančice Leisure-Time Centre, which has a long-standing tradition and support from the town. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a unique sporting experience in an attractive setting.
course_highlights: Run up 109 steps in Ivančice
Individual starts at one-minute intervals
A traditional event with a long history in Ivančice
additional: Participants start individually at one-minute intervals. The race regulations are available to download in the events section of the website. The race is open to all age categories, with the option to download the regulations and register online. The event is held regularly and is part of the local sports calendar.

name: Běh Kovohutěmi
location: TJ Kovohutě stadion, Lhota u Příbramě, Příbram District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: 50,- předem, 100,- na místě, děti a nad 60 let zdarma
description: The Kovohutě Run is a traditional running race held in Lhota u Příbramě since 1967. It offers a 12 km main race as well as races for children and young people. The event takes place at the TJ Kovohutě stadium and is popular with runners of all ages. It attracts many participants every year and is part of the Brdy Running Cup.
course_highlights: 12 km main race
Races for children and young people
Start and finish at the TJ Kovohutě stadium in Lhota u Příbramě
additional: The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup. Registration and provisional start lists are available for the main race, children’s and youth races, and the milers’ race. The races include the 12 km main course and children’s and youth races across various age categories. They take place on a hilly road with asphalt and grass surfaces.

name: Strojařská desítka
description: Strojařská desítka is a traditional road race in Zlín, now being held for the 42nd year. The race offers 10 km and 5 km courses with 153 metres of elevation gain on a certified out-and-back route between Zlín’s Maják, the U Boudy junction, Salaš, and back. The start is always at 10 a.m. by the headquarters of the Road Maintenance Administration on K Majáku Street. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all categories who want to compete in Zlín’s beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: 10 km out-and-back road course with 153 metres of elevation gain
Certified route between Zlín’s Maják, the U Boudy junction, and Salaš
Start and finish by the Road Maintenance Administration on K Majáku Street
additional: The race is part of the Běhy Zlín running series. Junior and children’s categories have specific registration and scoring rules. Results and photo galleries are regularly published online. Bib numbers and other race information are available on the official website. The race is run on a forest road: a hilly, asphalt surface. Registration is available in advance or on the day; results are available online.

name: Běh přátelství Klenčí pod Čerchovem - Waldmünchen
location: Klenčí pod Čerchovem, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run of Friendship Klenčí pod Čerchovem–Waldmünchen is part of the Běžec Chodska running series, which offers a diverse range of races around the Chodsko region. This race takes place in the picturesque setting of Klenčí pod Čerchovem and attracts runners of all ages. The course is suited to nature lovers and trail runners, while the race atmosphere encourages a friendly gathering of the running community. The Běžec Chodska series is known for its tradition and high-quality organization, ensuring an enjoyable experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Run in the picturesque setting of Klenčí pod Čerchovem
Trail course suited to nature lovers
Part of the Běžec Chodska running series, which has a long tradition
additional: The race takes place in September 2026. The course is approximately 15.5 km long and is suitable for runners of all levels. The event combines a celebration of friendship with a sporting competition.

name: Bezdězský půlmaraton
location: Doksy, Liberec District, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Bezděz Half Marathon is a running race held in the picturesque Máchův kraj region around Bezděz Castle. It offers two routes of approximately 13.6 km and 21.2 km, with 200 to 300 metres of elevation gain, running along forest roads, trails and short sections of asphalt. The race is suitable for a wide range of participants and is complemented by children’s races. Refreshments, luggage storage, toilets, and a results ceremony with a raffle are available at the venue. Capacity is limited to 500 participants, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere and quality facilities.
course_highlights: The routes pass through the extensive forests of Máchův kraj and around Bezděz Castle
The course surface includes paved and unpaved roads, trails and short sections of asphalt
Two refreshment stations on the 21 km course, one on the 13 km course
additional: On-site check-in and registration are available from 8:30 to 10:30; race capacity is limited to 500 participants. Luggage storage, changing tents, toilets, refreshments and a raffle are available for runners. The children’s races start at 10:00, and the main 13 km and 21 km races begin at 11:00. The route is marked with streamers, signs and flour, with approximate markers every kilometre. Registration is available via the official website. The race takes place in September 2026, and the course includes natural terrain and forest roads.

name: 7 pohoří Krkonoše
description: The Trail Run Seriál 7 pohoří is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The races feature technical trails, epic views and an atmosphere you won’t find anywhere else. Whether you’re an experienced mountain runner or a beginner, 7 pohoří will test your strength, willpower and determination. Conquer all the mountain ranges and become a trail-running legend.
course_highlights: Technical trails with around 900–1,230 m of elevation gain on the main courses
Epic views of prominent peaks and landscapes, including Ještěd, Bezděz, Kozákov, Trosky, Zvičina and Velká Deštná
Routes follow mountain paths, ancient trails and natural areas in national parks
additional: The time limit for completing the race is 4 hours. After that, runners are marked as DNF. Every participant receives a commemorative finisher’s medal and has access to refreshments on the course and at the finish. Recommended equipment includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Záchranka app. Small items can be stored at the registration tent. The event takes place in all weather conditions, and participation is at your own risk. The course includes mountain trails, technical sections and scenic viewpoints. Registration includes a course map, chip timing, a medal and refreshments.

name: Běh k Mohyle Hanče a Vrbaty
location: Bílý most přes Labe, Špindlerův Mlýn, Krkonoše, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 150 Kč pro přihlášené předem online do 12.9.2025

description: The Run to the Hanč and Vrbata Memorial is a traditional mountain race held in the Krkonoše Mountains. It starts at the White Bridge over the Elbe in Špindlerův Mlýn and finishes at the Hanč and Vrbata Memorial. The 9 km course with 696 m of elevation gain runs mainly on asphalt and trails, offering beautiful views and unforgettable experiences. The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners across different age categories. Refreshments and a raffle are available after the race, and public transport can be used to return from the finish area.
course_highlights: 9 km course with 696 m of elevation gain
65% asphalt, 35% trails
Start at 715 m above sea level, finish at 1,411 m above sea level
additional: The maximum number of entrants is 100. Race-day check-in takes place from 9:30 to 10:30 in Špindlerův Mlýn. There are two aid stations on the course with water and sports drinks. After the race, there is a raffle and refreshments are available at Vrbatova Bouda. Changing rooms and showers are not provided. Light personal belongings can be transported from the start to the finish. Trail race with 696 m of elevation gain, starting at the White Bridge over the Elbe and finishing at the Hanč and Vrbata Memorial. Registration is available online and on site. The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup.

name: Dětmarovická 10

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 350,- Kč (registrace předem, uhrazené do 3 dnů od registrace)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 700,- Kč (cena je za oba dva běžce v případě registrace předem, uhrazené do 3 dnů od registrace)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 200,- Kč (registrace předem, uhrazené do 3 dnů od registrace)

description: Dětmarovická 10 is a traditional running race held in the village of Dětmarovice, featuring a main 10 km race, a 2 x 5 km relay, and children’s races called Cipísek’s Run. The route runs mainly along asphalt roads and forest trails, combining fast sections with gentle challenges and offering scenic corners of the village. The race is intended for both experienced runners and enthusiastic amateurs, with the joy of running and sporting atmosphere more important than performance. Short children’s courses with a cheerful atmosphere and illustrations of Cipísek are also on offer. Registration is online, with the option to sign up on site. Participants receive a race number with a timing chip and gifts from the event’s partners.
course_highlights: The route runs mainly along asphalt roads and forest dirt-and-gravel trails within the cadastral area of Dětmarovice
A combination of fast sections and gentle challenges suitable for experienced and amateur runners
Scenic corners of Dětmarovice with a unique atmosphere
additional: The start and finish are by the Dětmarovice Sports Hall. Participants receive a race number with a timing chip. Refreshment stations are at the 6 km mark and at the finish. Medical services are available at the finish. Transport between relay legs is provided for the 2 x 5 km relay. Children’s races are divided by age into 100 m, 200 m, and 400 m distances. On-site registration is possible, but the same benefits as with online registration are not guaranteed. The race includes electronic registration, chip timing, medical coverage, refreshments, and a raffle. The route includes asphalt, forest, and gravel paths and is suitable for runners of all levels.

name: Volvo Tierparklauf
description: The Volvo Tierparklauf takes place on September 12 and 13, 2026, at Tierpark Berlin. It is especially family-friendly and suitable for beginner runners. The route leads through the zoo, past various animals such as monkeys and flamingos, creating a unique atmosphere. Participants and accompanying persons receive free admission. The event is part of the popular Berlin läuft! series and is known for its animal-themed atmosphere and comprehensive race pack.
course_highlights: Route through Tierpark Berlin with views of monkeys, flamingos and other animals
Free admission to Tierpark Berlin for participants and accompanying persons
Running festival for the whole family at the event venue
additional: Timing is recorded using a transponder attached to the shoe. Participants receive a comprehensive starter pack, with refreshment stations, toilets, an online certificate and free admission to the zoo. Groups of 15 or more receive a 10% discount and can collect their race materials together. Late registration is possible up to one hour before the start. Optional extras such as event shirts, medal engraving and HD finish-line videos can be booked. Free admission, run through Tierpark Berlin, family-friendly, route past animals

name: Freiberger Herbstlauf
location: Platz der Einheit, Freiberg, Saxony, Germany
description: The Freiberg Autumn Run is a traditional race through Freiberg’s municipal forest, starting at Platz der Einheit on September 12, 2026, from 10:00 a.m. The varied program offers races for the whole family, including Bambini and children’s races, Nordic walking, several running distances from 2 km to the half marathon, as well as a corporate relay and the Einfach?Mensch!Lauf. The varied routes pass through the surrounding forests and include some climbs, making the race especially appealing.
course_highlights: Route through Freiberg’s municipal forest
Start and finish at the Platz der Einheit sports facility
Varied routes with some climbs
additional: Events for the whole family, including Bambini and children’s races, Nordic walking, a corporate relay and a unicycle race. Various distances from 400 m to the half marathon. Start and finish at the Platz der Einheit sports facility. Multiple events, including the half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, children’s races, Nordic walking, a unicycle race and team competitions; the venue is the municipal forest and Platz der Einheit.

name: Lauf in den Herbst
description: The Putzbrunn Autumn Run is a DLV-approved public race organized by the sports club’s gymnastics department. It offers running opportunities for all age groups and ability levels, with distances from 1.5 km to 10.7 km. A special feature is the inclusive nature of the race, which welcomes people with different abilities. Alongside sporting competition, the event emphasizes community and the fun of running.
course_highlights: Distances: 1.5 km, 5.3 km, and 10.7 km
Inclusive race with participants from Lebenshilfe and Frame Runner
Age-group rankings and team rankings
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 12:00 at the Putzbrunn triple gymnasium. Late entries are possible on the day of the event until 30 minutes before the respective race. Certificates will be handed out on site and made available as PDFs the following day. Special prizes are awarded to the fastest runners and the oldest participants. Refreshments and changing facilities are available on site. Courses are available for different age groups; registration by email; no advance registration required.

name: Nordhorner Meile
location: Nordhorn, Grafschaft Bentheim, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Nordhorner Meile is the largest running event in the County of Bentheim, with over 2,000 participants. The varied 5 km and 10 km courses run along the Verbindungskanal and through Nordhorn city centre, finishing at the Alte Kirche am Markt. Alongside competitive elite runners and recreational athletes, over 1,500 schoolchildren from the region also take part. The event is known for its lively atmosphere, with more than 3,000 spectators cheering on runners along the course.
course_highlights: Varied 5 km and 10 km courses
Route along the Verbindungskanal and through Nordhorn city centre
Finish at the Alte Kirche am Markt
additional: Online registration is available exclusively via the website. The event also includes school races and is part of the new Grafschafter running series. Over 3,000 spectators create a special atmosphere along the course. The event takes place on 12 September 2026 and offers a lively atmosphere in Nordhorn city centre. It is open to runners of all abilities, from recreational runners to competitive athletes.

name: Schwarzenbacher Ausdauertag 2026
location: Sportzentrum Turnerheim, Schwarzenbach an der Saale, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Schwarzenbach Endurance Day on September 12, 2026, offers a varied program of running and walking events for all age groups. From the Bambini Run and schoolchildren’s race to the Fun Run, 10 km race and half marathon, there is something for every ability level. The start and finish are at the Turnerheim Sports Center in Schwarzenbach an der Saale. Refreshment stations along the course and in the finish area provide water and bananas; at the finish, participants can enjoy a sports buffet with fruit, water and cake. Timing is done using a disposable chip in the race bib, except for the Fun Run and Bambini Run.
course_highlights: A variety of running and walking events for all age groups
Start and finish at the Turnerheim Sports Center
Refreshment stations with water and bananas along the course and in the finish area
additional: Online registration opens on June 1, 2026. Timing is done using a disposable chip in the race bib (except for the Fun Run and Bambini Run). A sports buffet with fruit, water and cake is available at the finish. Registration opens on June 1, 2026; on-site registration is also possible. The event takes place in the Upper Franconia region and offers a mix of running and walking courses as well as a family-friendly supporting program.

name: VL Rund um Weitersburg und 19. Weitersburg Halbmarathon
description: The VL Rund um Weitersburg and the 19th Weitersburg Half Marathon are local running events in Weitersburg, organized by the running team of SV Weitersburg. The event offers both a traditional fun run and the full half-marathon distance of 21.1 kilometers. The club fosters a friendly village-club atmosphere with regular training, summer barbecues, and other running events throughout the year. Beginners and those returning to running are very welcome. The motto is “Just keep running!”
course_highlights: Fun run and half marathon over a distance of 21.1 km
Event in the municipality of Weitersburg with a friendly village-club atmosphere
Regular training at the Weitersburg sports field
additional: The SV Weitersburg running team offers training twice a week at the sports field. The event takes place in typical September weather, around 19 °C with mostly cloudy skies. There is a village-club atmosphere, with a summer barbecue, a Fun Run in September, and a season finale in November. Running event with distances from 200 m to 21 km, including a half marathon; organized by a local club, with regular training and a village-club atmosphere.

name: 10-Teiche-Marathon
description: The 10-Ponds Marathon in Hahnenklee is a scenic marathon held in September as part of the HarzerWanderWochen. The route leads through the Upper Harz and gives runners the opportunity to experience the region’s natural scenery and numerous ponds. The event is part of a ten-day hiking programme featuring a variety of activities and live music. The marathon is a special challenge for runners who appreciate combining athletic achievement with enjoying nature.
course_highlights: Run through the Upper Harz with views of ten ponds
Part of the HarzerWanderWochen, featuring a varied hiking programme
Starts at 10:00 on 12 September 2026
additional: The marathon is part of a ten-day hiking programme featuring guided hikes, evening events with live music, and other activities. A limited-edition marathon T-shirt is available as a special souvenir. Trail and scenic run, various categories, athletically challenging, as part of the HarzerWanderWochen

name: 21. Citylauf
description: The GVG Citylauf Bedburg is a traditional running event taking place on 13 September 2026 in Bedburg’s traffic-free town centre. The event offers various distances for all age groups, from the Bambini run and children’s races to the 10 km main race. The races start and finish in the marketplace in front of the town hall, with routes through the town centre. The Citylauf is ideal for runners of all abilities and promotes physical activity in the community.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the marketplace in front of the town hall
Traffic-free routes through the town centre, featuring turnarounds and loops
10 km main race covering five complete laps through the town centre
additional: Late entries are possible on the event day until one hour before the respective start, with a late-entry fee of €3.00 (the Bambini run is free to enter and has no late-entry fee). Headphones, MP3 players, jogging strollers and dogs are not permitted for safety reasons. The routes are measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV). A 12-week running course is available to help beginners prepare. The event takes place on 12 September 2026 and includes children’s races as well as the main races. Registration is online, and the event is very popular with the local community.

name: 3. Wunstorfer Citylauf
description: The Wunstorf City Run is a running event in the city center of Wunstorf, organized by TuS Wunstorf. The race starts and finishes in front of the town church, which serves as the event hub. There are various distances, from a 400-meter Bambini run and several children’s and youth races to the 10-kilometer main race. The course is a 1,400-meter loop through the city center, run a different number of times or in a modified format depending on age group and distance. The City Run therefore offers suitable races for runners of all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: 1,400-meter loop through the city center
Start and finish in front of the town church
Various distances from 400 m to 10 km
additional: The race takes place on September 12, 2026, in Wunstorf. Typical September weather is around 19 °C during the day and 10 °C at night, with mostly cloudy skies and an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The event is suitable for all age groups, with dedicated races for children and young people. It includes various race distances: 400 m, 900 m, 1,600 m, 4,400 m, and 10,000 m. The course runs through the city center, starting and finishing in front of the town church. The race promotes health and community spirit in Wunstorf.

name: Dabendorfer Herbstlauf
description: The Dabendorf Autumn Run is a traditional running event organised by MSV Zossen 07 e.V. It takes place on 12 September 2026 in Dabendorf and offers courses for runners, walkers and Nordic walkers from 1.3 km to 15 km. The run is part of the Brandenburg Cup and the Energie-Cup Teltow-Fläming and welcomes both experienced runners and beginners. The event starts at 2 p.m. at the Sportforum Dabendorf; the race office opens at 12 p.m. All participants are welcome to choose the course that suits them.
course_highlights: Course distances from 1.3 km to 15 km
Scoring event in the Brandenburg Cup and Energie-Cup Teltow-Fläming
Start and finish at the Sportforum Dabendorf
additional: The race office opens at 12:00 p.m. Runners, walkers and Nordic walkers can participate. Only those wishing to score Cup points need to follow the course requirements. The event also includes walking categories, a new start location at the Sportforum Dabendorf and independent timekeeping. Registration is online via Raceresult.

name: Dagersheimer Waldlauf
location: Waldstadion Dagersheim, Dagersheim, Böblingen, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Dagersheim Forest Run is a traditional cross-country race held in the afternoon at Waldstadion Dagersheim. The event offers races for various age groups, including a Bambini Run, children’s races, a fun run, and a 10 km race that covers two laps through Dagersheim Forest. Race number distribution begins at 13:00, and late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before each race for an additional fee. The event features a scenic forest course and offers runners of all ages an attractive opportunity to run in September.
course_highlights: 10 km race over two laps through Dagersheim Forest
Start and finish at Waldstadion Dagersheim
Various age groups, including Bambini and children’s races
additional: Race number distribution from 13:00 at Waldstadion. On-site late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before each race, with a €3 late entry fee. The 10 km race starts at 15:00, the Bambini Run at 14:00, and the fun run and junior race at 14:50. Forest run, late entries accepted up to 30 minutes before the race, start at Waldstadion Dagersheim, distances: 300 m and 10 km

name: Fichtl-Fun-Run
description: The Fichtl-Fun-Run is an annual running event in Fichtenberg that is aimed particularly at children aged 6 to 11. Training for the run includes playful activities, running games, obstacle courses, and athletic exercises, which take place both outdoors and in the community hall. The event promotes a sense of community and enjoyment of sport in a family-friendly atmosphere. It is organized by Sportkameradschaft Fichtenberg e.V., a long-established club with a wide range of sports.
course_highlights: Playful running games and obstacle courses
Athletic and circuit training in preparation
Event in Fichtenberg focused on children and community
additional: Training for the Fichtl Fun Run takes place on Thursdays from 16:15 to 17:30 in the community hall. It is aimed at children aged 6 to 11. The event places particular emphasis on enjoyment and community. Registration is probably required; the event also includes training sessions for children in September, including obstacle courses and running games.

name: Freisinger Volksfestlauf 2026
description: The Freising Volksfest Run 2026 is organized by LC Freising e.V. and takes place on September 12, 2026, in Freising. The exact route has not yet been finalized; it will either go through the city center or directly around the Volksfest grounds. The run is a popular event that combines tradition with a sporting challenge. Further information will be announced in due course.
course_highlights: Route either through the city center or around the Volksfest grounds
Traditional running event in Freising
Organized by LC Freising e.V.
additional: The exact route will be announced later. Participants can send their opinions about the route to mail@lc-freising.de. Further details will follow.

name: Gassenlauf 2026
description: The Gassenlauf in Großrückerswalde is a sporting highlight in the Ore Mountains and will take place for the 17th time in 2026. The event offers various race distances, including the 10.4 km main race and the 6 km Gassenlauf light, as well as Nordic walking and walking. The course starts at the Großrückerswalde sports grounds and runs to the wind turbines above the Alte Gericht, with a festive atmosphere featuring refreshments, a finish-line video, and an outdoor awards ceremony. The Gassenlauf is part of the Westsachsen Laufcup and a meeting place for sport, community, and a zest for life.
course_highlights: 10.4 km main race finishing at the wind turbines above the Alte Gericht
Gassenlauf light: a shorter 6.0 km option
Electronic timing with net-time scoring by Bear-Service
additional: Race bib pickup on 03.09.2026 from 17:00 to 20:00 and on 04.09.2026 from 14:00 until one hour before the start at the Großrückerswalde sports clubhouse. T-shirts can be reserved online until 23.08.2026 (€8 extra). Refreshments on the course and at the finish. Shuttle service from the finish to the start. Changing rooms and showers available. Participant limit: 500 starters across all disciplines combined. Online registration opens on 01.09.2025; race bib pickup on race day; T-shirt reservations; refreshments on the course and at the finish; shuttle service; showers at the Großrückerswalde sports clubhouse.

name: Gaisenheimer Rhein-Wein-Lauf
description: The Rhein-Wein-Lauf in Geisenheim is a long-established running event that welcomes runners of all ages. It offers various distances, from children’s races to the 10.38 km main race through the scenic Rheingau region. The races feature varied courses with short and long laps, appealing to both recreational and competitive runners. The event emphasizes a family-friendly atmosphere, with separate age-group rankings and prizes such as medals for children and bottles of wine for age-group winners.
course_highlights: Children’s and schoolchildren’s races on short 1,060 m laps
10.38 km main race consisting of three long laps of 3,460 m each
Course through the scenic Rheingau region
additional: Late entries are possible up to one hour before the start of the respective race. All races have separate age-group rankings. Children and young people up to age 14 receive medals for the top three places in each age group; adult age-group winners receive a bottle of wine. The event takes place at the Rheingau Stadium and surrounding area. Races for children, young people and adults; registration until 26.09.2025; late entries possible up to 1 hour before the start; September weather typically around 19°C with 45 mm of precipitation.

name: Horpizlauf Wagrien-Fehmarn
description: The Hospizlauf Wagrien-Fehmarn is an 85 km trail run that starts in Oldenburg in Holstein and takes place in September. This small ultra event is limited to 100 runners and has a 13-hour time limit. The route runs mainly along cycle paths and field roads, with about 60% asphalt, 30% firm sand paths, and the remainder singletrack, as well as around 800 metres of sandy beach. Runners pass the Fehmarnsund Bridge and are supported at aid stations on piers. Each registration also supports the Förderverein Hospiz Wagrien-Fehmarn e.V., which is working to establish a hospice in Oldenburg.
course_highlights: 85 km trail with approximately 60% asphalt and 30% firm sand paths
Passage beneath the Fehmarnsund Bridge
Aid stations on piers near the coast
additional: The race is limited to 100 participants and has a 13-hour time limit. The route includes around 800 metres of sandy beach. Each registration supports the Förderverein Hospiz Wagrien-Fehmarn e.V. The race is limited to 100 runners and takes place in September. It offers a unique combination of experiencing nature and a sporting challenge.

name: KlosterLauf Wiedenbrück
location: Kloster Wiedenbrück, Rheda-Wiedenbrück, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The KlosterLauf in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a special running event taking place for the fourth time on September 12, 2026. The start and finish are at Wiedenbrück Monastery, and the races follow two scenic loop courses through the town. The event is aimed at both competitive runners and anyone who enjoys the camaraderie and fun of running. Community and the joy of running are at the heart of this sporting highlight.
course_highlights: Start and finish at historic Wiedenbrück Monastery
Two scenic loop courses through Wiedenbrück
Distances of 5 km and 10 km
additional: The entry fee includes awards, an awards ceremony, timekeeping, results, certificates, race materials, parking, refreshments, a bag drop, toilets, changing rooms, and medical services. After the race, an after-run party takes place in the monastery garden until 10 p.m. Scenic loop courses, on-site registration available, after-run party in the monastery garden, start and finish at Wiedenbrück Monastery

name: Lauf mit - Isingen 2026
description: Lauf mit! Isingen 2026 is a cross-country running event in the beautiful countryside around Isingen in the Swabian Alb. The event offers various disciplines, including the Crosslauf-Strong at 8.1 km with 200 m of elevation gain, the Crosslauf-Light at 4.8 km with 100 m of elevation gain, and the Molkekär-Kälble-Kidsrun for children. The routes are well marked and take runners through appealing natural scenery. All participants receive chip timing, access to aid stations, and certificates; all Kidsrun participants also receive a medal. The event also promotes team spirit with a team classification called the "euroTECH Team Battle".
course_highlights: Well-marked routes around beautiful Isingen
Crosslauf-Strong: 8.1 km with 200 m of elevation gain
Crosslauf-Light: 4.8 km with 100 m of elevation gain
additional: Late registration is possible on the event day: Kidsrun until 13:00, Crosslauf-Light and Crosslauf-Strong until 14:30. The "euroTECH Team Battle" is a team classification for teams of four, with each team’s combined time counting toward the standings. Aid stations are located at the start/finish and along all disciplines. Timing uses a transponder system integrated into the race bib. Trail and cross-country running, charity run for children with cancer, routes in the Swabian Alb, aid stations along the route

name: Neubrandenburger Staffelmarathon (LC/NLC)
description: The Neubrandenburg Relay Marathon is a long-standing relay event taking place on September 12, 2026, in Neubrandenburg. The event is hosted by SV Turbine Neubrandenburg e.V. and gives runners the opportunity to tackle the marathon distance together as a team. The start is at 9:30 a.m., and the event runs until about 2:30 p.m. The club’s running group organizes the event and looks forward to welcoming many participants.
course_highlights: Relay marathon in Neubrandenburg
Hosted by SV Turbine Neubrandenburg
Various categories for all age groups
additional: The race starts at 9:30 a.m. on September 12, 2026; details about the terrain and registration are available on the website.

name: Rudelsburglauf
description: The Rudelsburglauf is a long-standing running event along the Rudelsburg near Bad Kösen, organised by LG Rudelsburg 1995 Bad Kösen e.V. The race takes place annually and gives runners of all ability levels the opportunity to enjoy the beautiful local region together. The event is a highlight in the club’s calendar, combining a sporting challenge with an experience in nature. Information about the race announcement and registration is published in good time before the event.
course_highlights: Various distances along the historic Rudelsburg
Scenic routes in the Bad Kösen region
A traditional community race with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: Registration and the race announcement for the 2026 Rudelsburglauf will be published on the website from summer 2026. LG Rudelsburg also offers training groups and community runs that enrich club life. The event also offers camping facilities and is open to all age groups. Nordic walkers can also participate.

name: Run of Hope

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Vereinsmitglieder 6,00 Euro, hierfür gibt es einen persönlichen Gutscheincode

description: The Run of Hope is an annual charity event in Kronach that brings together runners of all ages to fight cancer together. The event offers various race distances, including Nordic walking and a fun run, and takes place on the LGS grounds in Kronach. With the event starting at 12:00, participants can enjoy a sporting yet supportive atmosphere made possible by generous sponsors and dedicated volunteers. The run combines athletic effort with social commitment and invites everyone to make a difference with every step.
course_highlights: Run on the LGS grounds in Kronach
4 km Nordic walking course
4 km fun run, with age categories for young people and adults
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event. Start times: 4 km Nordic walking at 12:30; 4 km fun run at 13:30. Children up to 14 years old can take part without an entry fee. Personal voucher codes are available for club members. The event is organized by Gemeinsam gegen Krebs e.V. Start at 12:00; registration until 29.08.2025; late entries are possible on the day of the event.

name: Schledehausener Berglauf
location: Sporthalle Schledehausen, Schledehausen, Bissendorf, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The Schledehausener Berglauf is a 10-hour hill-running event in Schledehausen, part of Bissendorf, Germany. The race starts and finishes at the Schledehausen sports hall. The goal is to climb and descend a short hill as many times as possible, accumulating the most elevation gain within the time limit. The course is 700 metres long and has an elevation gain of 32 metres, with an average gradient of 10%. There are individual, relay and team categories. The event is organised by Omas on Tour as a charity event in support of HelpAge Deutschland e. V.
course_highlights: 700-metre out-and-back course
32 metres of elevation gain with a 10% gradient
Start and finish at the Schledehausen sports hall
additional: The race lasts 10 hours, during which participants can run up and down the hill as often as they like. There is an aid station where participants can take a break or stop running. The German Ultramarathon Association recognises performances of 45 km or more. Run on a 700-metre turnaround course, elevation gain 32 metres, gradient 10%, registration opens on 16.01.2026, participant limit 150, supporting “Every Grandma Counts”

name: Spiegelsbergelauf
price_range: 4 km: 5-10 €, 8 km: 10-15 €, 14 km: 15-19 €, Nachmeldungen am Veranstaltungstag gegen Gebühr
description: The Spiegelsbergelauf on 12 September 2026 in Halberstadt offers varied running routes for all ability levels. The 14 km route passes over the Gläserner Mönch and is a real challenge, with its elevation gain and terrain. The 8 km loop around the Jagdschlösschen combines speed and nature, while the 4 km route through the Spiegelsberge is an inviting introduction to racing. The youngest participants can take part in a 400 m taster run. The event is organised by SwimBikeRun Halberstadt e.V. and takes place at the Sportanlage Friedensstadion.
course_highlights: 14 km run with 277 metres of elevation gain, passing over the Gläserner Mönch
8 km run with 117 metres of elevation gain around the Jagdschlösschen
4 km run through the Spiegelsberge
additional: Late registrations are possible on the event day (12.09.2026) from 08:00 to 08:45 for a fee of €5. Race numbers can be collected on 11.09.2026 from 16:00 to 18:00 and on the event day from 7:30. The event takes place at Sportanlage Friedensstadion, Spiegelsbergenweg 79 / Gebrüder-Rehse-Str. 38820 Halberstadt. Secured course, race-number collection on the day before and on the event day, social runs before the event, detailed course descriptions and age groups

name: SÜDTHÜRINGENTRAIL
description: The SÜDTHÜRINGENTRAIL is a welcoming trail race in the beautiful surroundings of Suhl, celebrating its anniversary edition on September 12, 2026. The route follows partly winding trails away from the main artery of the Thuringian Forest, passing clear streams, dark valleys and glistening mountain ridges. The event offers an unforgettable experience in nature with spectacular views and is part of the SÜHLER BÜCHSEN CUP. All finishers of the longer distances receive ITRA/UTMB® qualifying points.
course_highlights: Partly winding trails away from the main artery of the Thuringian Forest
Passing clear streams, through dark valleys and over glistening mountain ridges
Spectacular views and an experience in nature in the Suhl area
additional: Pasta party on the eve of the race, starter bag, on-course and finish-line refreshments, tracking for position monitoring, emergency medical care by the mountain rescue service, finisher shirt, finisher medal, finisher surprise gift, finisher certificate (online printout), winner’s trophies for the first three women and men in each trail category, age-group rankings, ITRA/UTMB® qualifying points for the Riesentrail and Heldentrail, free parking and showers, maximum participant numbers per distance (Wichteltrail 344, Riesentrail 177, Heldentrail 199), no on-site registration, Wichteltrail start at 10:30 a.m. by patron André Knapp, Mayor of the City of Suhl, optional breakfast from 04:00 a.m. in the start/finish area, award ceremonies from 3:00 p.m. The event offers cultural and scenic highlights, including course profiles, GPX downloads and detailed information about the individual trails.

name: ULTRAMARATHON DM im 100km-Straßenlauf
description: The 38th German 100 km Ultramarathon Championships take place on September 12, 2026, at Stadion Wartenberg in Berlin-Wartenberg. This road race is a demanding long-distance event that requires endurance and mental strength. The event is aimed at experienced ultrarunners and offers an official championship atmosphere under the patronage of the German Athletics Association. Participants can look forward to professional organization and an athletic challenge.
course_highlights: 100 km road race on a flat, fast course
Start and finish at Stadion Wartenberg
Official German Ultramarathon Championships
additional: The race takes place on roads, with Stadion Wartenberg as the start and finish venue. Registration closes on September 5, 2026. Categories include youth, senior and masters. September temperatures are expected to be around 19°C, with approximately 45 mm of precipitation.

name: Unstrutlauf
description: The Unstrutlauf is a versatile running event in Dingelstädt, offering suitable distances for all ability levels, from 2 km to the half marathon (21.1 km). The varied routes run along the Unstrut and feature scenic highlights, paved cycle paths, and short climbs. Drinks, fruit, and bratwurst are provided. All proceeds are donated to charitable projects in the region, giving the event a special social character.
course_highlights: Varied scenery along the Unstrut
Half marathon with two turnaround points and little elevation gain
Relay with four legs, including sections along the Unstrut Cycle Path
additional: Late entries are possible up to one hour before the respective race and cost €3.00. Timing is provided using the BIP chip system. Each participant receives a medal worth €5.00 and a certificate at the awards ceremony. Water, fruit, and bratwurst are included. Toilets, showers, and changing facilities are available in the start area. Relay participants must arrange their own transport to the changeover points. Various race distances from 2 km to 21 km; refreshments including drinks, fruit, and bratwurst; parking at the Schützenplatz and behind the outdoor swimming pool; electronic timing using the BIP chip system.

name: 21. Citylauf
description: The Nordhausen City Run (Old Town Run) takes place on September 12, 2026, in the historic old town of Nordhausen. The race offers various distances, including special races for children and school students, and is part of the North Thuringia Running Cup. The event features a varied route through the city and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Distances: 1 km, 3.3 km, 6.6 km, and 9.9 km
Run through the historic old town of Nordhausen
Part of the North Thuringia Running Cup
additional: Typical September weather: approx. 19 °C, low of 10 °C, mostly cloudy with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The run takes place in Nordhausen’s old town, with support from local sponsors and organizations. The route has not yet been confirmed; the start location is likely to be the Marktpassage.

name: Niedermeiserer Dorflauf
price_range: 6,50 € für Erwachsene, 3,00 € für Schüler, kostenlos für Bambini

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Bambinis (400m-Lauf) kostenlos! Startgeld wird vom Nordhessencup übernommen.

description: The Niedermeiser Village Run is organized by TSV 1864 Niedermeiser e.V. and takes place on 12 September 2026 in Liebenau/Niedermeiser. The races run around Bodenberg, with distances ranging from 400 metres to 18.5 kilometres. Walking and Nordic walking events over various distances are also offered. The start and finish are at the Niedermeiser sports ground, where race materials are also distributed. The event is approved by the Hessian Athletics Association and is held in accordance with the applicable regulations.
course_highlights: Running distances from 400 m to 18.5 km around Bodenberg
Walking and Nordic walking routes of 5 km and 8.5 km
Start and finish at Niedermeiser sports ground, with changing rooms and showers
additional: Start and finish at Niedermeiser sports ground, Bruchweg 60. Race materials are available from 14:30 at the Niedermeiser sports ground/threshing hall. Changing rooms and showers are available at the TSV Niedermeiser clubhouse. The event is approved by the HLV and is held in accordance with the applicable regulations. The event may cause disruption for motorists; please follow signs and instructions from marshals. Results will be published online at www.tsv-niedermeiser.de, www.reinhardswaldcup.de and my.raceresult.com. Distances from 400 m to 18 km, parking at the sports ground, race materials available from 14:30, results online, race part of the Reinhardswald Cup

name: 10. PKO Bieg Charytatywny
description: The 10th PKO Charity Run is a nationwide initiative that combines the excitement of sport with tangible support for an important social cause: the mental health of children and young people. The event will take place across Poland on September 12, 2026, encouraging participants to run together and take action for their communities. Every lap, kilometre and minute on the course matters, highlighting the spirit of community and helping others. This anniversary edition invites runners to take part and show their support.
course_highlights: Multiple locations across Poland, including Gdańsk, Ruda Śląska, Łomża, Krosno and Stalowa Wola
Virtual run option using an app
Charity relay races and runs for children and adults
additional: The event takes place across Poland, combining physical activity with a charitable cause supporting the mental health of children and young people. The PKO Charity Run is an initiative where it is not just the result that matters, but above all, acting together and supporting the community. The event supports the mental health of children and young people, includes relay races and fundraising for therapy, participation in many cities across Poland, and a virtual participation option.

name: Bieg 7 Dolin
location: Piwniczna-Zdrój, Nowy Sącz County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Bieg 7 Dolin is a 100 km mountain ultramarathon held in the scenic Sądecki Beskid Mountains, starting and finishing in Piwniczna-Zdrój. The course follows demanding mountain trails with significant elevation gain, offering participants exceptional views and a chance to connect with nature. The race is part of the Running Festival, which combines sporting competition with promoting the region and an active lifestyle. The time limit is 19 hours, and there are aid stations and drop-bag points along the course. It is a challenge for experienced mountain runners looking to take on demanding but beautiful terrain.
course_highlights: +3,740 m / -3,740 m elevation change over the 100 km course
6 aid stations and 3 drop-bag points along the course
The route follows trails in the Sądecki Beskid Mountains, with views of the mountains and the Poprad Valley
additional: The time limit to finish the race is 19 hours (until 21:00). Intermediate cutoffs: Rytro (36 km) — 7 hours (until 09:00); Krynica (62 km) — 12 hours (until 14:00); Wierchomla (89 km) — 17 hours (until 19:00). Recommended technical gear includes a reusable cup or bottle, a running backpack or belt, an emergency blanket, a headlamp, reflective gear, health insurance, a whistle, hand sanitizer, and a working phone with an ICE number written on the back of the race bib. The event features several distances, including 100 km, 42 km, 61 km, 23 km and 11 km, as well as accompanying attractions such as festivals and an expo. The races take place in early September 2026.

name: 5 Aktywna Piątka
price_range: 100 zł w dniu zawodów, wcześniejsza rejestracja
description: The 5th edition of the “Aktywna Piątka” race will take place on September 12, 2026, in Frydek, in the Miedźna Municipality. It is a fast road race on a route exactly 5 km long, certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA), starting at 11:00. The event will also host the Silesian Voivodeship 5 km Championships, and the participant limit is 600. The accompanying Family Run is for children and teenagers up to 15 years old and features three distances.
course_highlights: Fast 5 km route certified by the PZLA
Asphalt course, marked every 1 km
Water station and cooling mist arches along the route
additional: The participant limit for the main race is 600. The first five women and men in the OPEN classification will be awarded. The race starts at 189C Modowa Street. The accompanying Family Run is for children and teenagers up to 15 years old, with three distances: 800 m for ages 10–15 and shorter distances for younger age groups. The commemorative medal is awarded only to the registered main participant in the Family Run. The limit for paid entries is 400. Running with a dog, wheelchair, or stroller is not permitted.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The Grand Prix Truchtacza in Mysłowice is a series of races organised by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, promoting a healthy, active lifestyle and bringing runners together from different regions. The event is open to everyone, regardless of age or experience, and participants can compete in running, Nordic walking and canicross. The races take place on forest and urban routes, creating a welcoming atmosphere of sporting competition and community. The Grand Prix is a tradition and a passion that has brought runners together for many years.
course_highlights: Forest routes near Bolina
A range of events: running, Nordic walking and canicross
Participants from many cities and sports clubs in the Silesian and Lesser Poland Voivodeships
additional: Registration for the Grand Prix series is available only at the Race Office on race day. Participation in Grand Prix events is free of charge. Both runners and Nordic walking and canicross participants take part. Competitors come from various cities and sports clubs, and women make up more than 27% of participants. The event includes various distances and seasonal races, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in the local community.

location: Miasteczko Krajeńskie, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

location: Sieroszewice, Sieroszewice Municipality, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
