name: Nočný beh mestom Lučenec
location: Synagóga, Adyho 69/7, Lučenec, Banskobystrický kraj, Slovakia
description: The Lučenec City Night Run is a nighttime race along illuminated streets in Lučenec, covering a distance of 4.5 km. The event is open to the general public, including juniors and adults, with categories by age and gender. It is organized by the City of Lučenec and OZ Novohrad and takes place by the Synagogue, with electronic timing and chip technology. The start is scheduled for 19:30. Runners can expect a commemorative medal, a race number, refreshments and an accompanying program.
course_highlights: Illuminated streets of Lučenec at night
Course distance: 4.5 km
Electronic timing with chip technology
additional: Race check-in is on 15.9.2025 from 17:00 to 19:00 by the Synagogue. The race is limited to 350 participants. The entry fee includes a commemorative metal medal, a race number bearing the event logo, a collage of photographs sent by email, medical services, refreshments and a show program. The race takes place with traffic partially restricted and at participants’ own risk. Registration is available online and on-site. The maximum number of participants is 350. Medals, race numbers, photographs, medical care and refreshments are also included.

name: Školáčik detský beh
description: Školáčik Children’s Run is a running event for children in various age categories, held in Lučenec by the synagogue. It is organized by the City of Lučenec and OZ Novohrad. The races are for boys and girls aged 3 to 15 inclusive, including children with disabilities. The entry fee is symbolic and encourages children to take part in sports activities in the pleasant surroundings of the city.
course_highlights: Races for children aged 3 to 15 in various age categories
Running courses adapted to children’s ages and abilities
Held in the centre of Lučenec by the synagogue
additional: The entry fee is €5 for online registration by 12.9.2025, and €7 on site if places are available. Categories are divided by age, from 3 to 15 inclusive, and include children with disabilities. The event is organized by the City of Lučenec and OZ Novohrad. Contact person: Marian Duzbaba, tel: 0907146181. Children in various age categories, online and on-site entry fees, location: Lučenec, synagogue.

name: Beh okolo Lysej
location: Lysá pod Makytou, Púchov District, Slovakia
description: Beh okolo Lysej is a traditional running race in the village of Lysá pod Makytou, with various categories for children, juniors, women and men according to age. The race takes place by the cultural centre and is organised by Bežecký klub Lysá pod Makytou. The children’s start is at 11:00, categories E, women and juniors start at 12:30, and men start at 13:00. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the village of Lysá pod Makytou by the cultural centre
Multiple age categories, from kindergarten children to veterans over 70
Starts are scheduled by category: children, juniors, women and men
additional: The children’s start is at 11:00, categories E, women and juniors start at 12:30, and men start at 13:00. Categories are divided by age, from kindergarten children to veterans over 70. The organiser is Bežecký klub Lysá pod Makytou. The race probably takes place on natural or mountain terrain; registration details are not specified; event date: 12 September 2026

name: Behaj lesmi Topoľčianky
description: Behaj lesmi Topoľčianky is a night trail race in the beautiful wine-growing region of Topoľčianky, taking place on 12 September 2026. Runners can enjoy routes passing by Topoľčianky Castle and Hrušov Castle, with forest trails and an atmosphere under the stars. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series and is included in the international UTMB Index, adding to its prestige. There are two main distances—11 km and 22 km—and the course also features the Conti Speed Section, where runners can win a valuable prize.
course_highlights: Routes pass through a wine-growing region with views of Topoľčianky Castle and Hrušov Castle
Forest trails with soft surfaces, ideal for trail running
A night run under the stars with the marked Conti Speed Section speed segment
additional: The race includes the Conti Speed Section, a 150-metre speed segment where participants can win a tyre voucher and a running shirt. The night-time event offers a unique atmosphere and experience. The routes are 80% soft surface and 100% fresh air. The event is part of the Behaj lesmi series, which includes multiple events across Slovakia and the Czech Republic. The race offers several distances, including a children’s race, with prices from 5 EUR when purchasing 7 or more races. There is also an entertainment programme for children, registration outside Terminovka.sk, and the option to take part in the night run.

name: Marina Liptov RUN
organizer: Olympijský klub Liptova a rezort Marina Liptov
description: Marina Liptov RUN is a sports and recreational event in the beautiful setting of the Marina Liptov resort near Liptovská Mara. This unconventional run combines nature and quality services in harmony with the four elements—fire, water, earth and air. Runners can enjoy a peaceful and inspiring setting, with views of the surrounding countryside and the opportunity to relax at the resort after the run. Marina Liptov is an ideal place for athletes and families looking for an experience in nature.
course_highlights: The route runs through a natural setting near Liptovská Mara
Beautiful views of the surrounding countryside, meadows, mountains and forests
A peaceful, harmonious setting inspired by the four elements of nature
additional: Marina Liptov offers accommodation, wellness facilities, water activities, a boathouse and a marina, which runners can enjoy before or after the race. The resort is open daily from 09:00 to 19:00. Hiking, cycling, skiing and fishing are available nearby. The course is a 9 km trail, subject to possible changes. Registration is available online or on site, and technical and medical support is provided.

name: Lemešanská bežecká liga 3. Jesenné kolo
organizer: Obec Lemešany, Športová komisia obce Lemešany
price_range: 7€ online, 10€ na mieste; zľavy pre obyvateľov obce a deti
description: Lemešany Running League – 3rd Autumn Round is a running competition held in the village of Lemešany in the beautiful surroundings of the Garden of Movement. The race is open to all age groups and ability levels, offering a pleasant atmosphere and the chance to enjoy sport outdoors. It is organized by Záhrada Pohybu, which provides quality facilities for sport and recreation.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the grounds of the Garden of Movement in Lemešany
A course suitable for all ages and ability levels
Pleasant natural surroundings with a pump track and playground
additional: The race is part of the Lemešany Running League, which includes four rounds in 2024, with discounted prices available for those who enter all of them. The event is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners, with registration available online or on site.

name: Beh pre Labky jesenný špeciál
organizer: Únia vzájomnej pomoci ľudí a psov
description: The Run for Paws Autumn Special is a running event in Kavečany, Košice, near Hrešná Cottage, organised by the Union for Mutual Assistance of People and Dogs (UVP). The race is open to various categories, including women, men, children and runners with dogs, including shelter dogs. The course is 5 km long and offers a pleasant autumn atmosphere in nature. Registration is available online at a reduced price and on-site at a higher price. The event supports dog adoption and brings runners and animals together in a friendly setting.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the natural surroundings of Kavečany, near Hrešná Cottage
The option to run with a dog, including a dog adopted from a shelter
Categories for women, men, children under 15 and runners with dogs
additional: Categories include women, men, children under 15 and runners with dogs, including shelter dogs. The entry fee is €10 for online registration by 19.9.2025, and €15 on-site. The event is organised by the Union for Mutual Assistance of People and Dogs (UVP). The start is at Hrešná Cottage in Kavečany, Košice. This outdoor event is suitable for dogs and their owners, with an emphasis on charitable purposes and a community atmosphere.

name: Night run Michalovce
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, TAZS Michalovce, MSKS Michalovce, Fitko Michalovce, R M s.r.o.
description: Night Run Michalovce is a nighttime running race held at Námestie osloboditeľov in Michalovce. The race offers three distances: 10 km, 5 km and 3 km, suitable for different age groups and ability levels. The adult race starts at 19:00, and the children’s races begin at 17:00. The organizers are the City of Michalovce, TAZS Michalovce, MSKS Michalovce, Fitko Michalovce and R M s.r.o. The race is open to the general public and offers a chance to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in the city at night.
course_highlights: A night run in central Michalovce, at Námestie osloboditeľov
Three distances: long 10 km, middle 5 km and short 3 km
Categories for all age groups, including children’s races
additional: You can also pay the entry fee by card on site. The race has age- and gender-based categories, including junior, men’s and women’s categories. The children’s races start at 17:00. The event starts at 19:00 for adults and 17:00 for children. Online registration is available and is subject to fees and deadlines; registration details and deadlines are available on the official website.

name: Beh do Choča

description: The Run to Choč is a unique running event in the heart of Orava that will test your fitness as you race to the summit of Veľký Choč. The route follows marked hiking trails and climbs steadily, offering beautiful views and the natural surroundings of the Choč National Nature Reserve. The event is for anyone who loves running, sport and nature and wants to enjoy a memorable atmosphere, refreshments and prizes. The run is also held in memory of Jožo Čajka, a sportsman and big-hearted friend.
course_highlights: Climb to the summit of Veľký Choč along the green and red hiking trails
Refreshments at the Drapáč meadow and at the summit of Choč
Cut-off time at the Drapáč meadow: 1 hour 15 minutes
additional: The maximum number of starters is 250. Registration is available online until 6 September 2023, or on race morning from 7:30 in Vyšný Kubín. The entry fee includes refreshments on the course, lunch and a commemorative gift. The route is marked with coloured ribbons; taking shortcuts will result in disqualification. The first three finishers in each category receive prizes and cash awards, including bonuses for breaking the course record. The race is part of a mountain-race series. Registration is available online and on site; refreshments and a finisher’s gift are included. The race is organised within Choč National Park and is open to runners of all levels.

name: Okolo Muňáku
location: Munice u Hluboké nad Vltavou, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
price_range: Dospělí: online 300 Kč, na místě 500 Kč; děti: online 100 Kč, na místě 200 Kč; štafety: online 550 Kč, na místě 750 Kč
description: Okolo Muňáku is a family running race in Munice near Hluboká nad Vltavou, offering a relaxed atmosphere and a fast course around Munický Pond. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and is open to all age groups, including children’s races. Each year, it supports the Centrum Bazalka charity, which receives part of the entry fees. After the race, a varied accompanying programme is prepared, including a raffle and prizes for the fastest runners.
course_highlights: 10 km course with 35 metres of elevation gain
Mostly paved cycle paths (60% asphalt, 40% gravel)
The route goes around Munický Pond, Hluboká, the ZOO and Bažantnice
additional: Children’s registration takes place from 9:30 to 10:30, and the main race starts at 13:30. A race bib printed with your name can be ordered until 10 September. Members of #tymdejvid can enter for free. After the race, there is a raffle, and children receive a ZOO ticket and a medal. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup; the course is fast and flat. Starts take place from 9:30 to 15:30, and registration is open until 13 September 2026.

name: Vrchlabský 1/2 Maraton
location: Náměstí T. G. Masaryka, Vrchlabí, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Vrchlabí City Half Marathon is the first edition of a half marathon held in the heart of the Krkonoše Mountains, at T. G. Masaryk Square in Vrchlabí. During the race, participants will enjoy a sporting challenge on paved roads and field and forest paths, as well as a cultural programme and a friendly atmosphere. In addition to the main half marathon, shorter 2 km and 9 km routes are available for children, juniors and families with children, taking them through the town and its side streets. The event brings together running, experiences and community, and is co-financed by the State Environmental Fund of the Czech Republic.
course_highlights: The course follows paved roads and field and forest paths
Start and finish at T. G. Masaryk Square in Vrchlabí
The town’s side streets are part of the shorter routes for children and juniors
additional: The 2 km race starts at 13:00, with age categories 7–9, 10–12 and 13–15. The half marathon (21.1 km) starts at 15:00, with age categories 18–29, 30–39, 40–49 and 50+. Parking is available in the town centre; some car parks charge a fee, while others are free. The larger car park near the monastery is temporarily closed. The car park by the cultural centre is recommended; it is within a 10-minute walk of the square. The course includes paved roads and field and forest paths; registration is available using the contact details on the website.

name: Forestova čtrnáctka
location: Záluží u Třemošné, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Forestova čtrnáctka is a 14 km running race around Záluží near Plzeň, featuring a mix of field, forest and gravel roads with light trail terrain. The race is suitable for the general public, including children and young people, who can take part for free. Runners can look forward to plenty of refreshments, a participant medal and race photos. Check-in begins at 9:00 and the start is scheduled no later than 9:45. The race takes place in all weather. The organizer emphasizes participants’ safety and fitness to compete; everyone takes part at their own risk.
course_highlights: 14 km route along field, forest and gravel roads with light trail terrain
Pink arrows on the ground, supplemented by red-and-white tape, mark the course
Plenty of refreshments at the finish, including drinks, fruit and homemade cake
additional: Check-in begins at 9:00. On-site registration is available until 30 minutes before the start, and the organizer issues race numbers 20 minutes before the start. Runners receive a participant medal and refreshments at the finish. Toilets are provided by Johny servis mobile toilets. The start is in Záluží near Plzeň, which is best reached by tram no. 4. Each participant takes part at their own risk and is not insured by the organizer. Registration takes place 30 minutes before the start; the start is scheduled for 9:00 in the morning. The race is part of a series of trail events in the region and is suitable for the general public.

name: Králický Lískovec
location: Chata Amálka, Králíky, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Startovné dorost a juniorské kategorie 50,- Kč

description: Králický Lískovec is a traditional running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Lískovec Hill and its environs in Králíky, Pardubice Region. The race offers various distances, from short children’s categories to the 8 km main race, which is part of the ISCAREX Cup. The main race starts at 11:30, while the children’s categories start from 10:30. The race is suitable for the general public and offers prizes to winners in individual categories. Entries can be submitted on-site on race day from 8:00 to 9:45.
course_highlights: The 8 km main race takes place on the mountain terrain of Lískovec Hill
Additional distances for children and youth, from 200 m to 5 km
The race is part of the 2026 ISCAREX Cup
additional: On-site entries are open on race day from 8:00 to 9:45. The overall male and female winners of the main race will receive separate prizes. The pre-school category starts during the race. The race starts at the Amálka cottage and focuses on mountain running in nature, with on-site registration available from 8:00 to 9:45. The event is part of a cup series and offers different distances for various age categories and levels of runners.

name: Kokořínský kros
description: Kokořínský Kros is a trail run held in the picturesque Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area, near Prague. The race offers three main routes of 15 km, 10 km and 5 km, winding through romantic ravines and past unique sandstone towers. The start and finish are at the municipal spa complex in Mšeno, where facilities include refreshments and a children's corner. The race is suitable for all runners, from beginners to experienced athletes, and offers a wide range of categories, with the option to change route distance even on race day.
course_highlights: The routes pass through the picturesque landscape of the Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area, with sandstone rocks and ponds
Romantic ravines and unique sandstone towers, which are rare in the Czech Republic
Start and finish at the municipal spa complex in Mšeno, with the option to go swimming
additional: A children's corner for children aged 3 to 10, with art activities and supervision by an experienced teacher. Route distance can be changed during race-day registration. Finish-line refreshments include Corny bars, bananas, water and Ionilyte sports drink. Parking is available in a designated car park approximately 200 m from the race facilities. Dogs are not allowed in the swimming pool complex. Trail courses with registration available, gift vouchers, on-site parking and refreshments, and the option of individual entry fees with a personalized race number.

name: Hostivařská 15°
price_range: 500 Kč online / 700 Kč na místě (15 km), 400 Kč online / 500 Kč na místě (5 km), 200 Kč online / 250 Kč na místě (děti)
description: Hostivařská 15 is a family-friendly trail race in the natural surroundings of Prague’s Hostivař district, offering more than just a test of performance. The race takes place around the reservoir, golf course and meanders of the Botič, mostly on forest trails with very little asphalt. The race is run without timing equipment; the winner is the person who most accurately predicts their finishing time. It has a nature-inspired, brewery-themed atmosphere and is suitable for all ages, including children.
course_highlights: Forest trails with very little asphalt
Around the reservoir, golf course and meanders of the Botič
Family-friendly, nature-inspired atmosphere with brewery facilities
additional: Race pack collection is from 8:00 to 10:30 at the Hostivar 2 brewery, with a bag drop available. Refreshments are provided on the 15 km course and at the finish. Participants who register online receive a commemorative gift. The accompanying programme includes a raffle, a dance show and entertainment for families with children. Parking at the brewery is limited; additional parking is available nearby. Public transport: Praha-Horní Měcholupy, buses 154, 183, 224 and 240, and train. Forest surface; online registration until 11. 9. 2026; start at the Hostivar brewery; refreshments on the course and at the finish; accompanying programme; raffle; family-friendly atmosphere.

name: 4Drun
location: Dubany u Prostějova, Prostějov, Olomoucký kraj, Czech Republic
description: 4Drun is a traditional running race organized by Sportovní klub DDsport, z.s., held in the picturesque surroundings of Dubany near Prostějov. The race features a 10.2 km course through the area around Dubany, neighboring villages, and nearby cycle paths, combining paved and cross-country sections. The program also includes a 2 × 5 km relay, a 4 km family run, and children’s races, making the event suitable for all age groups. A varied program of accompanying activities is planned for race day, and every participant receives a commemorative medal.
course_highlights: The 10.2 km course runs through the area around Dubany, the neighboring villages of Hablov and Bystročice, and a newly built cycle path
A combination of paved and cross-country sections
A 4 km family run, suitable for participation with a stroller
additional: Race packs and bib numbers can be collected at the 4Drun Expo at Sokolovna Dubany on Friday 11.9 from 16:00 to 18:00, Saturday 12.9 from 9:00 to 10:00 and 18:00 to 19:00, and on race day 13.9 from 8:00 to 12:30. On-site registration on race day is not possible. Every participant who finishes the race receives a commemorative medal. Participants are advised to collect their race pack well in advance, ideally one hour before the start. Only runners aged 18 and under may place on the podium in the family run. The accompanying program includes children’s races, the family run, relay races, and a prize draw. Advance online registration is required; the race is part of multiple categories and accompanying events.

name: Internationaler Altenaulauf
description: The International Altenau Run in Borchen is a traditional running event organised by SC Borchen 1926/32, Athletics Department. The race takes place annually and is part of the Hochstift Cup. Alongside the sporting competition, the event also demonstrates social commitment: coffee and cake are offered free of charge, and donations are collected for Aktion Lichtblicke e.V. The event offers runners of different age groups and ability levels an attractive platform.
course_highlights: Part of the Hochstift Cup
A variety of distances for different age groups
Traditional race with a social commitment
additional: Coffee and cake are offered free of charge at the cake stall. Donations are collected for Aktion Lichtblicke e.V. Runners can register for distances online; the event also includes social activities such as coffee and cake and fundraising for Aktion Lichtblicke e.V.

name: 6. DeisterCrossing Springe
description: DeisterCrossing is a nature-focused extreme experience in the wooded Deister hills near Springe. The event offers running and walking routes of 10 km, 21.1 km (half marathon) and 42.2 km (marathon), with challenging climbs, including the Deisterhölle, with 200 metres of elevation gain in one stretch. Participants enjoy a well-marked course with aid stations, places to sit and filled rolls for walkers. The event is all about consideration for others and enjoying nature, with awards for the fastest runners and a finisher’s gift as a souvenir.
course_highlights: Deisterhölle with 200 metres of elevation gain in one stretch
Marathon walk with an additional climb to Bielstein and the Deister ridge
Aid stations with places to sit and filled rolls
additional: Race bib collection from 7:15 a.m. at IGS Springe. Chip timing with a rental chip; return the chip to receive a wheat beer glass as a finisher’s gift. Showers and changing rooms in the IGS Springe sports hall. Parking at IGS, netto and BZE. Travel by S5 to Springe station, then a 10-minute walk to the Nord school centre. Awards ceremonies: 10 km and half marathon at 12:00, marathon at 14:30. Sew-on patches for walkers. Trail event with challenging terrain, refreshments at aid stations, and options for runners and walkers.

name: Braker hkk Lauf
description: The 19th Braker hkk Run takes place on September 13, 2026, in Brake (Unterweser). It is a short running race with distances of 850 meters and 10 kilometers. The race offers a pleasant opportunity to run in typical September weather, with mild temperatures and mostly cloudy skies. Please check the exact event details directly with the organizer.
course_highlights: Distances: 850 m and 10 km
Typical September weather with approx. 19°C and 45 mm of precipitation
Start location in Brake (Unterweser)
additional: The race offers two distances: 850 meters and 10 kilometers. September weather is typically mild and cloudy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The event usually takes place in pleasant temperatures of around 19°C. Participants should check the latest details with the organizer before registering.

name: Brückenlauf Halbmarathon Köln des ASV Köln
description: The ASV Köln Bridge Run Half Marathon is a long-standing 21.1-kilometre race that takes runners through the heart of Cologne, along the Rhine and across six of the city’s most beautiful bridges. The course offers spectacular views of the cathedral and the city, with an uplifting atmosphere and music along the route. Alongside the half marathon, shorter distances are available: the Kölsche Runde (11.11 km) and the Bambini Run (500 m), for beginners and children. The race combines a sporting challenge with Rhineland joie de vivre and is ideal for both ambitious and recreational runners.
course_highlights: 21.1 km along the Rhine with views of Cologne Cathedral
Cross six Cologne bridges, including the Hohenzollern Bridge and Rodenkirchen Bridge
Start and finish at the Chocolate Museum forecourt, with a lively atmosphere
additional: The Bridge Run is measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and is eligible for record lists. The LVN South-East regional championships take place as part of the half marathon. Registration is online, with on-site late registration available on the day of the event. The Kölsche Runde is ideal for beginners and recreational runners; the Bambini Run is for children aged 3–6. The start and finish are both at the Chocolate Museum forecourt. The event features music, commentary and a lively atmosphere along the route. The race starts in the Rheinauhafen and is part of the LVN South-East regional championships. Online registration is available, including a T-shirt for members. Entry fees vary by category.

name: Erzhäuser Heegbachlauf
description: The Erzhäuser Heegbachlauf is a long-standing running event that has been organised by the Kaltduscher in Erzhausen for almost 30 years. Its aim is to offer an affordable yet high-quality running experience for all ages and ability levels. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, careful organisation and iconic item of clothing as a souvenir. Despite modern timing and logistics, it retains its original spirit and strong sense of community.
course_highlights: Distances from 0.5 km to 6.4 km
Family-friendly atmosphere and iconic item of clothing
Charity run and community activities
additional: The event offers an iconic item of clothing (KKK) as a finisher’s souvenir, redesigned each year. The organisers take inspiration from major city marathons while keeping entry fees low. Long-standing sponsors support the event and help ensure it is delivered to a high standard. Iconic item of clothing, medals, modern logistics, online registration

name: Hattinger Hüttenlauf
description: The Hattinger Hüttenlauf is a traditional race in HenrichsPark in Hattingen, offering a range of running and walking distances for all age groups. The course follows paths surfaced with paving stones, water-bound gravel and asphalt, passing the park’s ponds. The start and finish are beneath Blast Furnace 3 at the LWL Industrial Museum Henrichshütte. Alongside the sporting competition, there are categories for Bambini, youth, the fun run and the 10 km Sparkasse Run, as well as awards for the largest groups and the fastest Hattingen runners. The event is family-friendly, and all participants can print their certificates online.
course_highlights: Course in HenrichsPark on paths surfaced with paving stones, water-bound gravel and asphalt
Start and finish beneath Blast Furnace 3 at the LWL Industrial Museum Henrichshütte
Course runs alongside the park’s ponds
additional: Late entries are possible up to one hour before the respective start. All Bambini race participants receive a medal. All participants can print their certificates online. Age-group categories are offered, with awards for the largest groups (schools and clubs) and the fastest Hattingen runners. Various running distances, online registration, supporters from the sports and business sectors.

name: Kiel Lauf
description: The Kiel.Lauf is a long-established running event in Kiel, with various competitions for all age groups. The main event is the half marathon, covering 21.1 kilometers through western Kiel and attracting both recreational runners and elite athletes. The 10.2-kilometer fun run is the event’s largest race by participation and offers a lap through Kiel city center with a great atmosphere. There are also shorter races for schoolchildren and Bambinis, making the event family-friendly.
course_highlights: The half marathon runs across western Kiel
The fun run goes through Kiel city center
A range of distances from approx. 0.7 km to 21.1 km
additional: The half marathon starts at 10:50 a.m. and the fun run at 09:45 a.m. Due to construction work, short-notice course changes may occur and will be announced in good time. The event is very popular, with more than 10,000 runners. There are various races for schoolchildren and Bambinis, making the event family-friendly. The event includes street closures and participant information, and offers technical running shirts for most categories.

name: LAUF FÜR MEHR ZEIT
location: Opernplatz, Frankfurt am Main, Hesse, Germany
description: The LAUF FÜR MEHR ZEIT charity run is a well-established sporting and community event in Frankfurt am Main. Recreational runners, elite athletes and celebrities compete together on a circuit through downtown Frankfurt. Alongside the sporting competition, fundraising and the joy of working together for a good cause are central to the event. The run offers five different distances for all age groups, from the Bambini run to the 10-kilometer run, with the start and finish at Opernplatz.
course_highlights: Circuit through downtown Frankfurt
5-kilometer circuit; the 10-kilometer run covers two laps
Water stations along the course provided by Frankfurter Laufshop
additional: Race numbers with electronic timing. Race-number pickup at Opernplatz on 12.09.2026 from 13:00 to 16:00 and on race day at various times depending on the race. The races take place one after another, each with its own timing, starting signal and finish. Travel by U-Bahn to Alte Oper station or use the Alte Oper car park; parking is limited. Various race distances; registration until 01.09.2026; refreshments along the course; no showers; late registration available.

name: Maiwaldlauf
description: The Maiwaldlauf in Rheinau-Freistett is a traditional community race organized by SV Freistett. The event offers runners and walkers an attractive route through nature around the Friedrich-Stephan-Stadion. The race is part of the Ortenauer Volkslaufserie and is open to recreational athletes of all ages. Its friendly atmosphere and well-organized proceedings make the Maiwaldlauf a popular event in the region.
course_highlights: Routes through the Maiwald forest and surrounding countryside
Start and finish at the Friedrich-Stephan-Stadion
Part of the Ortenauer Volkslaufserie
additional: The Maiwaldlauf includes various distances, including a 10 km run, a 5 km run, and walking. Detailed course maps and information about each route are available on the website. The event is part of the Ortenauer Volkslaufserie. It is organized by the Breitensport department of SV Freistett, with contacts including Alexander Dahlke and Regina Huber. The event takes place in September, when average temperatures are around 19°C, and offers Nordic walking and hiking as well as running events.

name: Nibelungenlauf
description: The Nibelungenlauf in Worms is a long-established running event held annually on the second Sunday in September. The event offers a varied programme of races over different distances, set within a cultural programme on the banks of the Rhine near the Hagen Monument and Kriemhild’s Rose Garden. Since 2004, more than 44,000 participants from many nations have taken part, underscoring the event’s popularity and international character. The race welcomes beginners and professionals alike and creates a special running experience in the Nibelungen city.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the newly developed Rhine promenade, close to the Hagen Monument and Kriemhild’s Rose Garden
Three out-and-back courses with clear course markings: half marathon (blue), 10 km (red) and 5 km (green)
Run through the historic Nibelungen city of Worms, with enthusiastic spectators and a cultural programme
additional: The event begins on Saturday with various activities and concludes on Sunday with the races and awards ceremony at the Hagen Monument. There is a team classification, and participants under 18 must provide consent from a parent or guardian. Event shirts and hoodies can be ordered during registration. The event often sells out before the registration deadline. Online registration is available; the deadline is September 6, 2026. Team registration and event shirts are also available. The start and finish are at the Nibelungenlauf Arena on the Rhine.

name: Othaler Gutshof Lauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The Othaler Gutshoflauf is a young but popular running event starting and finishing at the Youth and School Farm at Gutshof Othal. The event offers distances ranging from 0.5 km to the 21.1 km half marathon, which is known as the Intersport Liebig Half Marathon and passes through several villages. The race gives participants the chance to explore the eastern foothills of the Harz on varied routes. Around 350 runners take part each year, highlighting the event’s growing popularity.
course_highlights: Half marathon route through Sotterhausen, Holdenstedt, Klosterrode and Beyernaumburg
Start and finish area at the Youth and School Farm at Gutshof Othal
Distances ranging from 0.5 km to 21.1 km
additional: Start times: 09:00 half marathon, 09:45 10 km run/walk, 10:00 5 km run/walk, 10:05 0.5 km run, 10:15 1 km run, 10:30 2 km children’s race. Routes for children, recreational runners and competitive runners; start and finish area at the Youth and School Farm in Othal; supported by sponsors such as Intersport Liebig and Autohaus Liebe.

name: Rathaus Center Dessauer CityRUN
description: The 26th Dessauer Rathaus-Center CityRUN is a long-standing race in downtown Dessau that has attracted runners from the region and beyond for many years. The route follows a circuit through the city’s central streets, with the start and finish on Zerbster Straße near the Rathaus-Center. The race offers a sporting challenge in an urban setting and is part of a varied sports programme organised by Anhalt Sport e.V., which has been organising major sporting events in the region for decades.
course_highlights: Circuit through downtown Dessau
Start and finish on Zerbster Straße at the Rathaus-Center
Route along Steinstraße, Askanische Straße and Kavalierstraße
additional: Volksbank children’s race for children up to 9 years old over 1,000 metres, free for all children and schoolchildren from Dessau. The organiser is Anhalt Sport e.V., which has been organising numerous major sporting events in the region for over 20 years. Various distances, including children’s races; company race; on-site registration available; finisher medals

name: Seewooglauf
description: The Seewooglauf in Ramstein-Miesenbach is organized by FV Olympia Ramstein and offers 10 km and 5 km races, as well as a 5 km walking event. The event takes place on September 13, 2026, and is open to runners and walkers of all ability levels. The course passes through the scenic surroundings of Ramstein and offers a sporting challenge in a pleasant atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km race courses
5 km walking course
Venue: Reichswaldsporthalle in Ramstein-Miesenbach
additional: Entry fees from €7, late registration available up to 30 minutes before the start, results online, small surprises for the children’s races

name: Sindiso-Spendenlauf
location: Hof von Walter Jahn, Zeitlarn, Bavaria, Germany
price_range: 20 Euro für Laufshirt, Spenden ab 20 Euro für Teilnahme
description: The Sindiso Charity Run on 13 September 2026 in Zeitlarn is a community event combining running, celebration and fundraising. The event takes place at Walter Jahn’s farm and offers runs for all ages, along with a colourful festival featuring lots of attractions for children. Alongside the sporting experience, the event focuses on supporting the education project in Rabuor, Kenya. Food and drinks will be available, and there will be a range of entertainment, including a children’s train, face painting and vehicle displays.
course_highlights: 10 km run consisting of 2 laps of 5 km each
Attractions for children, including a children’s train and face painting
Vehicle displays by the Neutraubling Water Rescue Service, Laub Volunteer Fire Brigade and BRK Barbing/Neutraubling
additional: The Sindiso running shirt can be purchased for €20 on race day after ordering through the online registration. Runs are available for different age groups and disciplines, including a 400 m toddlers’ farm run, a 1.5 km children’s run, a 5 km run, a 10 km run and 5 km Nordic walking. The event kicks off with a big party from 11:00 a.m. and offers a wide range of food and a colourful programme of activities. 10 km run (2 x 5 km), family activities, children’s programme, vehicle display, donations to the education project in Kenya

name: TSG Altenhain 1900 e.V. - Wuzzelauf Altenhain
description: The Wuzzelauf Altenhain is an annual charity run held since 2008 and organized by TSG Altenhain 1900 e.V. It continues a local tradition in which residents of the Main-Taunus district referred to one another by nicknames, especially “Wuzze” for people from Altenhain. The race combines sporting commitment with regional history and a sense of community. The event takes place on September 13, 2026, and welcomes runners of all ages to take part.
course_highlights: Traditional connection to the region’s nickname culture
Run through the community of Altenhain in the Main-Taunus district
Charity event with local ties
additional: The event takes place annually on the second Sunday in September. Proceeds benefit various charitable causes, including support for people with disabilities in the Rhine-Main region. Registration and further details are available on the official website.

name: Volksbank-Münster-Marathon
description: The Volksbank-Münster-Marathon is a major running event organized by runners for runners, largely by volunteers and with great dedication. With around 12,000 participants, more than 300 artists and bands, and over 100,000 spectators along the course, this autumn marathon offers a unique atmosphere. The course is almost entirely flat and runs through the running- and cycling-friendly city of Münster. A red carpet is rolled out in the finish area on Prinzipalmarkt, making the finish a special experience.
course_highlights: Almost entirely flat course
More than 300 artists and bands along the course
Finish on a red carpet at Prinzipalmarkt
additional: The marathon is part of a major event featuring several races, including the Atruvia Staffelmarathon, Wecker-28 (28 km), Stadtwerke-Kids Marathon, Westfalen AG Charity-Lauf (10 km), and H+B technics-Gesundheitslauf (6 km). There is a combined ranking with the Enschede Marathon. The marathon office is open on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays from 9:00 to 15:00. A marathon guide with general information and FAQs is available. The marathon attracts around 12,000 runners, offers qualification opportunities for other races, and is supported by numerous sponsors. There are also accompanying events such as talks and health seminars.

name: Waldlauf des TuS Calle-Wallen - Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup
description: The 46th TuS Calle-Wallen Forest Run is part of the Volksbank Sauerland Running Cup and takes place on September 13, 2026, in Meschede. The event offers 1 km and 10 km races and is open to runners of all age groups. The race runs through the wooded areas around Meschede and promises a varied course in a natural setting. September weather is typically mild and mostly cloudy, ideal for running events.
course_highlights: Run through the wooded areas around Meschede
1 km and 10 km distances
Natural setting and varied course
additional: Typical September weather is around 19 °C, with lows of about 10 °C and an average of 45 mm of precipitation; skies are mostly cloudy. The event takes place in Meschede, where typical weather is around 19 °C with cloudy skies. It is a great opportunity for the whole family to take part in a traditional race.

name: Wehratallauf
price_range: Hauptlauf 15 €, Nordic Walking 10 €, Schülerlauf kostenlos, Kindertallauf kostenlos

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld 15,- €, davon 1,- € zugunsten der Kinderkrebshilfe und 0,50 € DLV-Verbandsabgabe

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld 10,- €, wird zu 100% an den Förderverein für Krebskranke Kinder gespendet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld 5,- €, davon 1,- € zugunsten der Kinderkrebshilfe und 0,50 € DLV-Verbandsabgabe

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kein Startgeld, nur mit Online-Anmeldung möglich, keine Nachmeldung

description: The Wehratallauf is a long-standing running event held every September in Wehr since 1990. It offers various races for all age groups, including a 10.2 km main race, 8.6 km Nordic walking, a 2.87 km schoolchildren’s race and a 750 m children’s race. The courses run directly past the Frankenmatt Stadium and through the surrounding area. The event has a particular charitable focus, with part of the entry fees donated to the Förderverein für krebskranke Kinder Freiburg e.V.
course_highlights: 10.2 km main race through the area around Frankenmatt Stadium
8.6 km Nordic walking course
2.87 km schoolchildren’s race and 750 m children’s race
additional: Late registration is possible up to 1 hour before the respective start (except for the children’s race) for an additional fee of €5. Electronic timing uses transponders integrated into the bib numbers. Changing and shower facilities are available. There is a team competition and special prizes for clubs with the most participants. Parking is limited, particularly on Industriestraße. The event takes place on 13 September 2026, with online registration, transponder bib numbers, prizes for the fastest runners and course-record prizes. Donations are also collected for children with cancer.

name: Wemdinger Stadtlauf
description: The Wemding City Run invites runners of all ages to explore Wemding’s historic old town and the scenic countryside on the edge of the Ries. A special highlight is the panoramic run to the Maria Brünnlein pilgrimage church, combining sporting challenges with impressive views. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and welcomes both experienced runners and beginners. Timing is handled electronically using transponders in the race bibs, and an awards ceremony takes place on the stage at the market square.
course_highlights: Run through Wemding’s historic old town
Panoramic run to the Maria Brünnlein pilgrimage church, with views across the Ries
Start and finish at the market square in the town centre
additional: Race-pack collection and late entries are available on the event day until 30 minutes before each start at the race office in the Geopark Information Centre at the market square. The children’s run has no timing or results list; all children’s and school races receive medals. Timing for the other races is handled using transponders in the race bibs. Parking is available at Johannisweiher, with access via Wolferstädter Straße. Various race distances, medals, non-cash prizes, group prizes, children’s and school races, group training before the event.

name: wep-Lauf
organizer: WEP Intersport Engels / Ralf Sester / TuS Jahn Hilfarth
description: The wepLAUF in Hückelhoven is a varied sporting event with a family-festival atmosphere, taking place on September 13, 2026. Distances range from a marathon to short races for children, including a Flexi Marathon where participants can decide after each lap whether to continue. The start and finish area is on Breteuilplatz, and alongside the race programme the event features a lively supporting programme with a bouncy castle, stage entertainment and stalls. The event particularly encourages children and young people to take part through a school competition. Surrounding streets are closed during the races, and free parking is available at Hückelhoven Center.
course_highlights: The marathon course is completed four times, and the half-marathon course twice
Flexi Marathon with an individually chosen distance and a certificate for the distance completed
Start and finish area on Breteuilplatz; streets are closed during the races
additional: The marathon traditionally starts as the first event of the day. Free parking is available at Hückelhoven Center. Registration is open until September 10, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. The varied supporting programme includes a bouncy castle, stage entertainment and sponsor stalls. The schools with the most participants receive awards. Registration is open until September 10. The start and finish area is on Breteuilplatz; free parking, changing rooms and showers are available. Support is provided for young runners and company relay teams.

name: 17. Parklauf Tangerhütte
description: The 17th Parklauf Tangerhütte takes place in the idyllic Tangerhütte City Park and is part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP running series in northern Saxony-Anhalt. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including 1.1 km for young runners, 2.9 km for juniors, and 5.4 km and 10.3 km for adults. The routes loop around Spiegelsee and pass sights such as the New Palace and the mausoleum. In the finish area, SV Germania Tangerhütte provides refreshments, including grilled food, drinks, fruit, coffee, and cake.
course_highlights: Loop course in Tangerhütte City Park, with its idyllic Spiegelsee
The junior course passes the New Palace and the mausoleum
Adult courses cover 2 or 4 laps through the autumnal city park
additional: Start and finish are in front of the old sports hall at Jahn-Sportplatz. Grilled food, refreshing drinks, fruit, coffee, and cake are available in the finish area. Distances range from 300 m to 10.3 km; online registration; race part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP series.

name: 21. swb-Marathon Bremen
description: The 21st swb-Marathon Bremen takes place on 13 September 2026 and offers runners a varied running experience through Bremen. The start and finish are on Bremen’s Marktplatz. The course passes well-known landmarks such as Werdersee, Weserwehr, Rhododendron Park, the university, Bürgerpark, Überseestadt and Schlachte, and finishes with a run through Weserstadion. Alongside the marathon, there is also an AOK Half Marathon, a HIRSCH 10 km race and an AOK Children’s Run. The event is for beginners and experienced runners alike and promises an unforgettable day of sport, with a great atmosphere and support from spectators.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Bremen’s Marktplatz
The course passes Werdersee, Weserwehr, Rhododendron Park and the university
Run through Weserstadion before the finish
additional: Start and finish area on Bremen’s Marktplatz. Optional extras can be booked, including a finisher’s shirt, an HD video of the finish and participation in the pasta party. Various distances are available for beginners and experienced runners. The run through Weserstadion is a special highlight. The event features strong spectator support and a lively atmosphere. Online registration is available; start times begin at 11:30. The course runs through Bremen and features highlights such as Werdersee and Weserstadion, with additional options including a pasta party and finisher’s shirts.

name: 43. Internationalen Airport Race
price_range: various, e.g., 28 Euro for shirts, 15 Euro for cotton shirts, 12-40 Euro for race entries
description: The 43rd International Airport Race in Hamburg takes place on September 13, 2026, offering a varied running experience around Hamburg Airport. The 10-mile race traditionally starts at 11:00 a.m. at the LSV sports grounds on Borsteler Chaussee. In addition to the 10-mile main race, there are also 5 km races and the Mini Airport Race. The unique airport setting provides ever-changing views and a special atmosphere.
course_highlights: A varied route around Hamburg Airport
Start and finish at the LSV sports grounds on Borsteler Chaussee
A unique airport setting with ever-changing views
additional: In addition to the 10-mile main race, there is also a 5 km race and a Mini Airport Race of approximately 1.4 km. The event is very popular, with almost 4,000 registered participants. The race is part of the Hamburg Running Cup. Registration is via the official registration page. Routes on roads, footpaths and hiking trails; online registration; race shirts and medals; refreshments and showers on race day

name: Bitburger Stadtlauf
description: The Bitburger City Run takes place on 13 September 2026 in Bitburg and offers an inclusive running event where recreational runners, people with disabilities and competitive athletes can take part together. The event grew out of a desire for a great running event in Bitburg and promotes sporting competition in a friendly atmosphere. The start and finish are at St. Martin School, Kölner Straße 14. The event is part of the CITY SPORT Trier event calendar and warmly invites all running enthusiasts to join in.
course_highlights: Inclusive running event for all ability levels
Start and finish at St. Martin School, Kölner Straße 14
Recreational runners, people with disabilities and competitive athletes competing together
additional: Course in Bitburg, race number collection at St. Martin School, results at chiplauf.de, late entries available on the day of the event for a fee, including group and team classifications

name: Brachter Depotlauf
location: Brachter Depot, 41379 Brüggen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Brachter Depot Run is a guided trail run through the beautiful Brachter Depot, with different pace groups ranging from 5:00 to 7:00 min/km. Various distances are offered, including a half marathon, 14 km, a 5 km beginners’ run, a children’s run (max. 2 km), and walking. The event places an emphasis on experiencing nature and social engagement: participation in the children’s run is free, and a starting donation is collected on the day of the event. Organized by TSF Bracht and Depotrunners Bracht, the runs offer a varied course in a natural setting.
course_highlights: Guided trail run through the Brachter Depot
Different pace groups ranging from 5:00 to 7:00 min/km
Various distances: half marathon, 14 km, 5 km, and children’s run
additional: Participation in the children’s run is free. A starting donation of €10.00 is requested for all other runs; it must be paid in cash at the registration desk on the day of the event. The event is organized by TSF Bracht and Depotrunners Bracht. Refreshments are provided for participants. Runs take place in different pace groups to accommodate all running speeds. Trail run, various distances, refreshments provided, online registration.

name: DeisterCrossing Springe
description: DeisterCrossing is a nature-focused endurance event combining running and walking in the outstanding natural surroundings of the forested Deister mountain range. The event offers 10 km, 21.1 km and 42.2 km courses for runners and walkers. The challenging routes include the Deisterhölle, with 200 metres of elevation gain in one stretch, and offer a unique nature and mountain experience near Hanover. The event has a relaxed atmosphere, with participants looking out for one another. Alongside the sporting challenge, it offers refreshment stations, finisher gifts and an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: The Deisterhölle, with 200 metres of elevation gain in one stretch after 5 km
Marathon walkers tackle an additional 50 metres of elevation gain to the Bielstein
Nature and mountain run in the forested Deister mountain range near Hanover
additional: Race number pickup from 7:15 a.m. at IGS Springe. A rental timing chip is provided and exchanged at the finish for a wheat beer glass with the DC logo. Showers and changing rooms are available in the IGS Springe sports hall. Parking is available at IGS, Netto and BZE. Travel by S5 to Springe station, then a 10-minute walk to the Nord school centre. Refreshment stations with seating and filled rolls; finish buffet. Awards for the first three women and men in the running events at 12:00 (10 km and half marathon) and 14:30 (marathon). Walkers receive patches to sew on. Courses in woodland, refreshment stations, patches for walkers, online certificates, awards ceremonies, parking, showers and changing rooms in the sports hall, travel by train.

name: Dübener Heidelauf
location: Obermühle, Bad Düben, Landkreis Nordsachsen, Sachsen, Germany
description: The Dübener Heidelauf is a traditional forest run held at the picturesque Obermühle in Bad Düben, a spa town in northern Saxony. The event is organised by SV Bad Düben and offers races for children, teenagers and adults. With distances ranging from 500 m to the half marathon (21.1 km), the run appeals to both young runners and experienced distance athletes. It is part of the regional athletics scene in northern Saxony and Leipzig and is known for its family-friendly, club-oriented character.
course_highlights: Forest run through the Dübener Heide
Distances from 500 m to 21.1 km (half marathon)
Venue: Obermühle in Bad Düben
additional: The run takes place in typical September weather, with an average temperature of 19 °C (low of 10 °C) and mostly cloudy skies. The event includes age groups from under 8s through to adults and is a regional club race rather than a major commercial event. Cross-country/forest terrain; races for various age groups; regional club event

name: ebm-papst Marathon
price_range: 12€ für Erwachsene, 8€ für Kinder (Laufshirts, bei Anmeldung mitbestellt)
description: The ebm-papst Marathon in Niedernhall is a traditional running event, taking place for the 29th time on September 12 and 13, 2026. The event offers various disciplines, including the marathon, half marathon, duo marathon, relay marathon, 10 km run, handbike and inline skating events, as well as children’s races and Nordic walking. The course runs through the scenic region and offers a varied experience for runners of all abilities. Alongside the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a varied program featuring a show, childcare and a pasta party. Every finisher receives a medal and can download a free finish-line photo.
course_highlights: A range of disciplines: marathon, half marathon, duo and relay marathons, 10 km, handbike and inline skating
Scenic course in and around Niedernhall
Event program featuring a show, childcare and a runners’ church service
additional: On-site late registration is available on September 12 and 13, 2026, up to one hour before the start. A pasta party is available for a contribution of €8 (payable in cash). A sustainable running shirt can be ordered for an additional €12 (€8 for children). Every finisher receives a medal and a free downloadable finish-line photo. Free bag storage, showers and massage are available on site. Childcare for children aged 3 and up is available from 07:30 to 14:30. Runners’ church service on Sunday at 08:00. A relay partner board on Facebook helps runners find partners for the duo marathon. Various running distances, family event, children’s races, inline skaters, handbikers, event program, sustainable running shirts

name: Eicklinger Volks- und Familielauf
description: The 1st Eicklingen Fun Run and Family Run is aimed at active families who would like to enjoy a lovely day running together. The focus is on having fun and enjoying running, without the pressure of competition. The event offers a friendly atmosphere for all age groups and encourages people to be active together.
course_highlights: 3 km and 6 km running routes
Family-friendly event
Starting point in Eicklingen
additional: Typical September weather: approx. 19 °C, low of 10 °C, average precipitation of 45 mm, mostly cloudy. The event is ideal for families who want to run together and offers a relaxed, community atmosphere. September weather can affect the running experience, but is generally pleasant.

name: Freundschaftslauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 15 km, 10 km, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km
description: The Bisttal-Runners Wadgassen Friendship Run is a running event offering beautiful loop courses through Wadgassen Forest. The route is suitable for both runners and walkers and takes in some well-known and some less frequented single-track trails. The event is aimed at recreational athletes from the region and offers a relaxed atmosphere for all ability levels.
course_highlights: Loop courses through Wadgassen Forest
Suitable for runners and walkers
Some well-known and some less frequented single-track trails
additional: The Bisttal-Runners running group meets every Sunday at 10:30 a.m. at the Wadgassen Newspaper Museum. Participation is free and does not require club membership. There are no fixed performance goals; everyone runs at their own pace, and the route distance is chosen individually. Runs on loop courses through the forest; distances of 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon; internal club events

name: Garbenteicher Volkslauf
description: The Garbenteich Volkslauf, organized by Sportverein 1928 Garbenteich e.V., is a traditional race in Pohlheim known as a good preparatory course for the Frankfurt Marathon. The course has been optimized for safety, so it no longer crosses any federal highways or railway lines. There are seven refreshment stations offering water, cola and tea, and participants can look forward to excellent refreshments after the race. Race numbers can be collected on the event day from 08:00 or the day before at the Garbenteich Sports and Cultural Hall.
course_highlights: Safe course route with no crossings of federal highways or railway lines
Seven refreshment stations offering water, cola and tea
Courses of moderate difficulty with moderate elevation gain
additional: Race numbers and timing transponders can be collected on the event day from 08:00 or the day before between 16:00 and 17:00. Late entries are possible on the event day until the start of the race for an additional fee of EUR 5. Changes to another distance are free of charge up to two days before the race. The course is marked and checked several times before the start. The race takes place on 13 September 2026, starting behind the Garbenteich Sports and Cultural Hall. Club membership is not required, and the event is ideal for marathon preparation.

name: Hahnenfalzhüttenberglauf
description: The Hahnenfalzhüttenberglauf is a challenging mountain race that runs from Sägwasenplatz in Bad Herrenalb to Hahnenfalzhütte. The course covers 6 kilometers with an elevation gain of 519 meters and includes steep ramps and gravel paths. The race is a traditional event organized by Skizunft Bad Herrenalb and offers runners a challenging, scenic route in the heights above the source of the Alb. The event combines a sporting challenge with a sociable hut festival at Hahnenfalzhütte.
course_highlights: 6 km course with 519 meters of elevation gain
Steep ramps and gradients of up to 21%
Route through the Felsenmeer and along gravel paths
additional: The race traditionally takes place in conjunction with the Hahnenfalzhüttenfest. Parts of the course are wet and challenging, with ramps of up to 21% gradient. Hahnenfalzhütte, the race finish, is at an elevation of 876 m. Participants range in age from 14 to 78. The race is known for its elevation gain and steep gradients, and includes a festive event with refreshments at Hahnenfalzhütte.

name: Holzlandlauf
description: The Holzlandlauf is a long-running race in the Holzland region near Hermsdorf, held annually on the second Saturday in September. From 2026, the race will be part of the International Trail Running Association (ITRA), giving the courses international recognition and making runners’ performances visible worldwide. The event offers several distances, including 5 km, 11 km and a half marathon, through the beautiful natural surroundings of the Holzland. It welcomes both ambitious trail runners and recreational runners and offers a special atmosphere in the region.
course_highlights: Forest runs through the Holzland with international ITRA recognition
Routes along the Birkenlinie to Bad Klosterlausnitz
A range of distances: 5 km, 11 km and a half marathon
additional: Registration is handled through Laufservice Jena, with payment by SEPA direct debit. Late registration is available on race day until 9:30 a.m. Starts are staggered, with the first start at 8:30 a.m. at the Werner-Seelenbinder-Sporthalle in Hermsdorf. In 2025, the courses were rerouted onto alternative paths because of logging, resulting in longer distances. Courses: 800 m, 1.6 km, 11 km, half marathon, walking/Nordic walking; refreshment stations; medals and certificates; no participation with dogs except assistance dogs; no political or discriminatory advertising.

description: The Kristall-Lauf Weißwasser is a varied fun run for runners and walkers of all ages. The course crosses mixed terrain, including asphalt, concrete, sandy paths, and forest trails with roots. The event counts toward several regional rankings, including the Dresden District Rankings, the Sachsenenergie Läufer-Cup, and the Niederlausitz-Cup. It also features an official walking ranking by the German Athletics Association. A special feature is the traditional team race, which promotes community and team spirit.
course_highlights: Mixed terrain: asphalt, concrete, sandy paths, and forest trails with roots
Part of regional rankings: Dresden District Rankings, Sachsenenergie Läufer-Cup, and Niederlausitz-Cup
Official walking ranking by the German Athletics Association
additional: Late entries are possible in person on race day, with a late-entry fee of €6 (2025) or €4 (2024). The event includes individual and team rankings. The courses are marked on site on race day, and those markings are binding. The event is open to all age groups, from children to seniors. Terrain: asphalt, concrete, sandy paths, and forest trails with roots; team race with at least three runners; start at Bruno-Bürgel-Oberschule; registration in person or online

name: Miltenberger Landkreis Lauftag
location: Schul- und Sportzentrum, Elsenfeld, Miltenberg, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Miltenberger Landkreis Running Day on September 13, 2026, offers a range of races for different age and ability groups. The routes pass through the Elsenfeld municipal forest and along the former Spessart steam railway line, with scenic and mostly flat sections. All participants receive T-shirts, and the top runners are awarded prizes. The event is ideal for runners looking for a well-organized race in a natural setting.
course_highlights: Half marathon with two-thirds paved road and one-third compacted forest floor
Scenic route through the Elsenfeld municipal forest and along the Spessart steam railway line
Out-and-back routes with little elevation change and a pleasant running profile
additional: Refreshments on the course and at the finish, with drinks provided by Rhön-Sprudel; awards ceremony in front of the Untermainhalle; all participants receive a T-shirt upon returning their race number; special prizes for new course records. Registration has been open since May 1, 2026; a wide range of races; start at the school and sports center in Elsenfeld.

name: Run for life
location: Vorplatz des Bayerischen Nationalmuseums, München, Bayern, Germany
description: Run for Life has been an established charity run benefiting Münchner Aids-Hilfe e.V. since 2001. The 26th edition of this DLV-sanctioned fun run will take place on September 13, 2026. The race starts at 2:00 p.m. in the forecourt of the Bavarian National Museum in Munich and follows a familiar route through the English Garden. The event is held under the patronage of Munich Mayor Dominik Krause and combines sporting commitment with social engagement.
course_highlights: Start in the forecourt of the Bavarian National Museum on Prinzregentenstraße
Run through the English Garden
A familiar and well-established course
additional: Registration for Run for Life 2026 opens on June 15. The participation terms exclude people who promote the technology of L. Ron Hubbard. The event relies on volunteer helpers, who support tasks such as course marshalling, setup and dismantling, and childcare. Payments can also be made on the day of the event, provided the participant limit has not been reached. Charity run, registration opens in mid-June, starts at 2:00 p.m., run through the English Garden

name: runroll City
description: The runroll City event takes place on 13 September 2026 in Bielefeld and offers a fast-paced sporting experience on a flat, 7.2-kilometre course through the heart of the city. The course is ideal for fast times and is suited to both intensive run training and a quick race. Participants can enjoy being active in an urban setting and be part of a dynamic event.
course_highlights: 7.2-kilometre course
Flat course layout for fast times
Urban race through the heart of Bielefeld
additional: The event is known for its inclusive atmosphere and the option to run or skate. It is aimed at everyone who enjoys being active in the city and offers an attractive course in central Bielefeld.

name: Stiftungslauf Salzgitter
description: The Stiftungslauf at Salzgittersee is a traditional running event taking place on 13 September 2026. The event offers various races, including two main races, a relay race, a Shorty run and walking. The start is at 10:30 a.m. at the DLRG building at Salzgittersee in Lebenstedt. Bürgerstiftung Salzgitter warmly invites everyone who enjoys running to join in and have fun exercising together.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the DLRG building at Salzgittersee
Various events: main races, relay race, Shorty run and walking
Route along Salzgittersee in Lebenstedt
additional: The event includes two main races, a relay race, a Shorty run and walking. For questions, the organizer can be reached by phone at 0172/5416779. Event at Salzgittersee featuring main races, a relay race, a Shorty run and walking.

name: Zeuthener Jedermannslauf
price_range: kostenlos bis ca. 14,- € je nach Wettbewerb und Anmeldedatum
description: The Zeuthen Jedermann Run is a popular community race held every September in Zeuthen. It offers various events for all age groups, from Bambini to adults, with distances ranging from 400 m to 10 km. The event is family-friendly and promotes recreational sport in the region. The races start at Zeuthen S-Bahn station and follow a varied route along the Waldpromenade.
course_highlights: Various distances from 400 m to 10 km
Start and finish on Miersdorfer Chaussee at Zeuthen S-Bahn station
Family-friendly community race with classifications for all age groups
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start for an additional fee. Award ceremonies take place shortly after the events. There are age-group classifications and overall placings, with awards. The event runs from 8:00 a.m. to approximately 4:00 p.m. The course includes cobblestones. Registration is open until 10.09.2026; bib number pickup is on 12.09.2026. Medals for all finishers. Facilities and offerings include showers, refreshments, and sales stands.

name: HochRhön-BergTrail
description: The HochRhön Mountain Trail is a challenging trail-running event in the picturesque uplands of the Hochrhön around Hilders. The event offers four trail distances from 7 km to 42 km, with varied routes through forests, singletrack, forest roads and meadows. The races feature some steep climbs and wonderful views, particularly from Auerbergsee and Buchschirm. Alongside the sporting challenge, supporting a good cause is also a focus: part of the entry fees is donated to the Malteser Children’s Hospice and Family Support Service in Fulda. The event is part of the regional Trailrunning Cup Rhön and also offers children’s races.
course_highlights: Varied surfaces: asphalt, forest paths, forest roads, singletrack, hiking trails, meadows, stairs and wooden bridges
Challenging climbs, including a singletrack ascent steeper than 20% on the 7K Trail
Fantastic viewpoints, including views of Scheppenbachtal, Milseburg and Wasserkuppe
additional: Start and finish are at the TSV Hilders sports grounds. Start times: 29K and 42K at 9:30 a.m., 7K and 15K at 10:45 a.m., KidsRun at approximately 9:40 a.m. Race bibs can be collected on race day at the Hilders fire station or beforehand at BECK Orthopädie. Race briefings are mandatory. The 15K course is an ITRA National League race and a UTMB Index Race. There will be an expo at the sports grounds. The event supports a fundraising campaign for the Malteser Children’s Hospice and Family Support Service in Fulda. Medical services are provided by the DRK Mountain Rescue Service and volunteer fire brigades. Distances: 7 km, 15 km, 29 km and 42 km; start and finish at the TSV Hilders sports grounds; online registration opens on 23.12.2025; limit of 550 trail participants; children’s races are free; donations support charitable causes; medical services provided by mountain rescue and volunteers; equipment available at BECK in Hilders.

name: II Złotowska Dziesiątka
description: The 2nd Złotów Ten is a road race taking place on September 13, 2026, in Złotów. Participants complete two laps of 5 km each, for a total distance of 10 km. The event is organized by the Złotów Social Activity Center and aims to promote an active lifestyle and bring the local running community together. All running enthusiasts are welcome to take part.
course_highlights: The course consists of two laps of 5 km each
A road race in the center of Złotów
Organized at the Municipal Stadium and on nearby streets
additional: The race takes place at the Municipal Stadium in Złotów and on nearby streets. The course consists of two 5 km laps. Registration is available through the Domtel-Sport platform. The organizer, the Złotów Social Activity Center, provides contact and support. A 10 km road race with online registration, support from local businesses, an appealing course, and prizes

name: Poznań Track Day 2026
location: Tor Poznań, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Tor Poznań Track Day is a series of exciting motorsport events held at the race track in Poznań. Participants have the opportunity to compete, train, and take part in qualifying rounds held throughout the 2026 season. The event is aimed at motorsport enthusiasts and also offers car rentals and one-to-one instruction with instructors. It is a great opportunity to experience the thrill of motorsport and improve your skills on a professional track.
course_highlights: Race track in Poznań with professional facilities
Opportunity to take part in various rounds and qualifying sessions during the 2026 season
Training sessions and one-to-one instruction with instructors
additional: Cars can be rented for track use, for yourself or as a gift. The entry package includes participation by a team member, the option to co-drive (age >17), full catering, individual lap-time measurement, and the option of instruction with an instructor. Participation payments must include the correct payment reference to confirm entry. Multiple rounds include training sessions, qualifying, and night races, with a focus on sporty driving and the excitement of the track.

name: XI Bieg Nadziei oraz VII Mistrzostwa Wielkopolski Prawników
location: Środa Wielkopolska, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 11th Run of Hope and the 7th Greater Poland Lawyers’ Championships are a charity run organized in Środa Wielkopolska to support the work of the Piotr Hospice. The event combines sporting competition with an important social cause, engaging the local community and the legal profession. It is an established tradition that promotes physical activity and solidarity.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Old Market Square in Środa Wielkopolska
Charity run supporting the hospice
Various distances and activities, including children’s races and Nordic walking
additional: The run is a charity event supporting the Piotr Hospice. Registration opens on March 1, 2026. The website has no details about the course, start times, or fees. The event is scheduled for September 13, 2026, and includes various running and activity options; participation supports the work of the Piotr Hospice.

name: XRUN - Vistula Trail
location: Wisła, Cieszyn County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Vistula Trail is a mountain trail race held in Wisła, offering a range of distances from short routes for children to challenging mountain courses. Runners can enjoy scenic views of the Beskids, starting in the center of Wisła or on the Czech side in Třinec. The routes pass notable locations such as Soszów Wielki, Soszów Mountain Hut and Czantoria, combining an international adventure with the character of the Beskids. This event is for mountain-running enthusiasts who value variety and beautiful natural landscapes.
course_highlights: Start in the heart of Wisła at Skolnity Ski & Bike Park
The route passes Soszów Wielki, Soszów Mountain Hut and Czantoria
Scenic descents along the green trail to the center of Wisła and Kopczyński Park
additional: Time limits: 35 km – 9h, 24 km – 7h, 15 km – 4h. Start times vary: 35 km at 07:00, 24 km at 08:00, 15 km at 09:30. Age categories for children aged 3 to 15 on the short distances. Start and finish in Wisła, with transport to the start of the Classic Trail distance from Třinec. The event offers various distances divided into age categories, organized transport for some routes, marked trails and a children’s category. The start is in a scenic area, with the opportunity to enjoy mountain landscapes.

name: 16 Bieg Częstochowski
description: The 16th Częstochowa Run is a road race taking place on September 13, 2026, in the center of Częstochowa. The 10 km course follows the city’s prominent avenues, including the area around Jasna Góra, giving the race a distinctive prestige. The course is officially certified, attracting runners aiming for a fast pace and personal bests. It is an excellent opportunity for sporting competition in picturesque urban surroundings.
course_highlights: 10 km course through the center of Częstochowa
Route passes near Jasna Góra
Officially certified course suited to fast running
additional: Registration takes place at the Sports Hall of IV High School; the fee is payable in cash. The event also includes training sessions and information from sponsors.

name: Bieg na Skałę
organizer: Centrum Kultury, Sportu i Rekreacji w Skale
price_range: 30 zł do 19.09.2025, 50 zł w dniu zawodów, 120 zł w dniu biegu
description: Bieg na Skałę is a unique sporting event that combines physical activity with the natural beauty of Ojców National Park. The course follows scenic trails and hills, offering participants varied terrain, including forest paths, rocky sections, and steep climbs. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners who want to embrace the spirit of adventure and enjoy the fresh air. After the race, participants can look forward to commemorative medals, prizes, and a range of attractions, including activities for children. The event takes place in a friendly, sporty atmosphere.
course_highlights: A course along scenic trails and hills in Ojców National Park
Varied terrain: forest paths, rocky sections, and steep climbs
Stunning views of the surrounding area
additional: Available distances: Bieg po Pstrąga Ojcowskiego (8 km), with team rankings and a prize for the best resident of the Skała municipality, and Bieg Szlakiem Skał i Dolin (15 km), with a similar ranking. Children’s races are available over 100 m (ages 2–5, no ranking), 800 m (ages 10–11), and 1,300 m (ages 12–15). After the race, activities for younger children include inflatable castles, entertainers, and prize competitions. The course follows scenic trails and hills, with varied terrain ranging from forest paths to rocky sections and steep climbs. The event offers races at various distances, including children’s races, and GPX files are available to download. Race packs can be collected on 19–20.09.2025.

name: Chyża 10
location: Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 12th Chyża Ten is a fast and popular 10 km race organized by the Nowotomyski Chyży Running Club. The event takes place in Nowy Tomyśl and counts toward the Nowotomyski County Grand Prix in running. The race starts at 9:00, and the race office is open from 7:00 to 8:30. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a friendly atmosphere and a well-prepared course.
course_highlights: Fast 10 km course
Race counts toward the Nowotomyski County Grand Prix
Start at 9:00; race office opens at 7:00
additional: The race office is open from 7:00 to 8:30. The winners’ award ceremony takes place at 10:45. The race is co-funded by the Municipality of Nowy Tomyśl and Nowotomyski County. The event also includes 5 km races, and registration opens on June 1, 2025. The race is part of a series of sporting events organized by the club.

description: The Northern Running Festival is a unique running event taking place on 13 September 2026 on the Hel Peninsula, bringing together the tradition of the Northern Marathon and the Marathon Relays under one name. The course passes through the scenic locations of Hel, Jastarnia and Rozewie, along Puck Bay, with sea views and four lighthouses giving the race its unique character. The event offers a range of distances for runners of all ability levels, from the marathon and relays to the half marathon, 10 km and 5 km, as well as a children’s race, the Little Lighthouse Keeper Run. It’s not just a sporting event, but also a journey through the coast’s beautiful spots and a chance to connect with nature.
course_highlights: The course runs along Puck Bay with views of the sea
There are four lighthouses along the course: in Hel, Jastarnia and two in Rozewie
The course passes through some of the most beautiful spots on the Hel Peninsula and the coast
additional: The course is available to download in .GPX, .KML and .TCX formats. Registration is open from 1 January 2026 to 24 August 2026 at 15:00. The Little Lighthouse Keeper Run is for children and young people up to 14 years old. The course is available to download in .GPX, .KML and .TCX formats; coastal and seaside terrain; the event includes various distances and competitions for adults and children.
