description: The 15th Damak Half Marathon in Tarczyn is a family celebration of running, promising a great atmosphere and unforgettable experiences. The half-marathon route passes through scenic areas alongside fields, forests and apple orchards, giving the race a distinctive character. The event attracts runners of all ages and also features races for children and teenagers. The organizers take care of participants by providing attractive race packs and support from sponsors.
course_highlights: The route passes alongside fields, forests and apple orchards
Scenic surroundings create a distinctive race atmosphere
A family-friendly event with races for children and teenagers
additional: Race packs include eco-friendly bags, reflective bands and thermal mugs bearing the Fakro sponsor logo. The race packs also contain Kamis spices. The participant limit for the children’s and youth races is 150. The race office is located at 8 Szarych Szeregów Street in Tarczyn. Urban area, online registration, family event, local sponsors and partners.

name: XXI Radomski Maraton Trzeźwości
location: Jedlnia-Letnisko, Kozienice County, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Radom Sobriety Marathon is an annual running event organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association. The races take place on scenic routes in the Kozienice Forest near Jedlnia-Letnisko, giving participants the opportunity to compete in the marathon, half marathon, and other accompanying races. The marathon promotes a healthy lifestyle and sobriety, while also bringing the local running community together. It is a well-established event that attracts both amateur and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Routes run through the Kozienice Forest
Scenic forest trails and natural surroundings
Available distances: marathon and half marathon
additional: Medals can be personalized for a symbolic fee of 10 zł. The organizer encourages participation in the marathon, half marathon, and other accompanying races. The “Biegiem Radom!” Association also works to bring people together and promote running in the region. The event includes various distances, including the marathon and half marathon, with training plans and support for participants. Registration opens on September 14, 2025.

name: Żyrardów w Biegu
description: Żyrardów w Biegu is an annual running event organized by the Żyrardów Cycling Association, taking place on September 13, 2026, by the Żyrardów Reservoir. Participants can choose between two distances: 10 km and 5 km. Both routes go around the reservoir, with multiple laps and a finish at the reservoir grounds. The race promotes physical activity, community spirit and a welcoming sporting atmosphere, while also helping promote the city of Żyrardów and the Mazovia region. The event is open to adults, and athletes using active wheelchairs may also compete in the 10 km race.
course_highlights: Route around the Żyrardów Reservoir
4 laps for the 10 km distance; 2 laps for the 5 km distance
Start and finish by the Żyrardów Reservoir, 17 Ziołowa Street
additional: Online registration is available until September 10, 2026. After that date, registration is available only at the race office until 9:00 a.m. on race day. Each participant collects a race number with a chip at the race office. Athletes using active wheelchairs may compete in the 10 km race. The event base, start, finish and parking are by the Żyrardów Reservoir, 17 Ziołowa Street. Distances: 10 km and 5 km; online registration; a 100-minute time limit for the main race; wheelchair athletes may participate; the swimming area is open during the event weekend.

The course runs around the historic Spiš Castle and is suitable for various age groups, including children and adults. The organizer, the Town of Spišské Podhradie, provides a welcoming atmosphere and well-organized race. Registration fees can be paid online or on site, while residents of Spišské Podhradie can enter for free.
course_highlights: 15.3 km of paved surface
3.7 km of compacted dirt road and grass
The course runs around Spiš Castle
additional: Race categories include children, men and women in various age groups. The organizer is the Town of Spišské Podhradie. Registration fees can be paid online or on site on race day. The start is in front of the Municipal Office in Spišské Podhradie. The course is 12 km long with 227 metres of elevation gain, 80% paved and 20% grass and forest road. name: Crow Mountain Survival
description: The Crow Mountain Survival obstacle race in Bremen is an exciting adventure returning for its ninth edition on September 6, 2026. Distances range from 1.2 km for children to 15 km for experienced runners, featuring challenging obstacles and spectacular water sections, including a swim across Lake Werdersee. The event offers challenges for beginners and experienced OCR veterans, as well as inclusive races for people with disabilities. The varied course runs through forests, meadows and over different terrain, testing endurance, strength and agility. Special untimed races for children and newcomers make it easier to get started.
course_highlights: Spectacular water crossing through Lake Werdersee
Varied course through forests, meadows and over different terrain
Challenging obstacles involving climbing, balancing, crawling and traversing
additional: Wave starts of 10 people every 60 seconds for the 5 km, 10 km and 15 km races; runners are assigned to waves based on their pace at registration; untimed youth and inclusive races; medals and certificates for all participants; start times vary by distance, e.g. the youth race at 09:30 and the introductory race at 12:00; children under 12 require prior approval to participate in certain distances. The course combines demanding climbs with technical descents, giving participants the chance to experience both the region’s wild nature and its historic sites. The event takes place during the beautiful transition from summer to autumn, adding to the charm of the course and its surroundings.

The course is technically demanding, with significant elevation gain. Other distances and accompanying races are also available as part of the festival. The event features a range of distances, a festival atmosphere, electronic timing, and courses through lakes and mountains, offering an unforgettable experience.

Approximately 800 participants each year
additional: The race is suitable for children and takes place on a grass field in Prague-Běchovice. It is organised by the Mladé Běchovice, z.s. association. The organisers can also be contacted by phone at +420 606481222. The race is intended for children and young people and takes place in September 2026. It attracts approximately 800 participants and promotes sport and a healthy lifestyle among young people.

name: Běh Moravským krasem
location: Sloup v Moravském krasu, Blansko, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run through the Moravian Karst is part of the Blansko District Running League, which has a tradition dating back to 1976. This race gives runners from the Blansko area and beyond the opportunity to test their strength in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Moravian Karst. It is suitable for the general public and is part of a year-round competition that promotes running in the region. The organizers aim to provide quality services and a welcoming atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: The route passes through the picturesque terrain of the Moravian Karst
The race is part of the traditional Blansko District Running League
Natural scenery and quality race facilities
additional: The race takes place on September 19, 2026, in Sloup in the Moravian Karst. It is part of a regional running league with multiple events throughout the year.

name: Litovelská nealkoholická čtrnáctka
description: The Litovel Non-Alcoholic 14K is a traditional running race organised by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the picturesque town of Litovel in the Olomouc Region. The race is part of a running series and offers an opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support for the running community in Central Moravia. The race is suitable for the general public, and its name, which refers to the event’s non-alcoholic nature, adds to its friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: The course runs through the picturesque surroundings of Litovel
Mostly asphalt and paved surfaces, suitable for fast running
Part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Endurance Runners
additional: The race is part of a series of local running events in and around Olomouc, with equipment available for organisers and other races in the region.

name: Podzimní běh Heřmanův Městec
location: Zámecký park, Heřmanův Městec, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Autumn Run in Heřmanův Městec is a traditional running race held in a beautiful château park. It offers two main distances, 5 km and 10 km (two laps), as well as children’s races in the start and finish area. The race is part of the Vládce Mrdic sports league and attracts runners of all ages, who enjoy the pleasant autumn atmosphere and quality facilities.
course_highlights: The course runs through the château park in Heřmanův Městec
Two race distances: 5 km and 10 km (two laps)
Children’s races in the start and finish area
additional: The race is part of the Vládce Mrdic sports league, which includes a series of races and open timed training sessions throughout the year. The race takes place on 19 September 2026. Registration is available on the official website. Exact course profiles are not provided, but the routes run through the countryside around Heřmanův Městec.

name: Hořovický cvoček
price_range: 150 CZK v předprodeji, 200 CZK na místě
description: Hořovický cvoček is a traditional running race held in Hořovice, offering a course approximately 12 km long. The route follows forest paths and paved roads. The race starts on Valdecká Street by the water tower, heading towards Hvozdec. The main race starts at 10:00 and is for adult runners; there are no children’s categories. The entry fee is CZK 150 with pre-registration and CZK 200 on the day. The race is part of the Brdský běžecký pohár and has a long history, with results and statistics available.
course_highlights: Approximately 12 km course combining forest paths and paved roads
Starts in Hořovice, on Valdecká Street by the water tower, heading towards Hvozdec
Traditional race with a history and results dating back to 2014
additional: There are no children’s categories. The start and finish are on Valdecká Street by the water tower, heading towards Hvozdec. Results are available in the system and in PDF format. The race is part of the Brdský běžecký pohár, which includes other races during the season. The course features varied terrain, and registration is available in advance or on the day.

name: Kačina Run
description: Kačina Run is a running race held in the beautiful grounds of Kačina Chateau and its expansive park. It is part of the BĚHEJ ZÁMKY STŘEDNÍ ČECHY series. The race offers courses of up to 800 metres for children and 5 km and 10 km courses for adults, mainly on crushed-stone and forest paths. The event is suitable for everyone who loves exercise and nature, and offers a welcoming atmosphere with refreshments along the course and at the finish. The start and event facilities are located at the rear of Kačina Chateau, where registration and the awards ceremony also take place.
course_highlights: Routes pass around Kačina Chateau and through its expansive park
70% crushed-stone path, 30% forest path
Refreshments along the course and at the finish (bananas, orange, apple, water)
additional: Registration opens at 9:00 for the children’s races and at 12:30 for the adults’ races, at the rear of the Kačina Chateau grounds. Children receive a participation medal as soon as they finish. Parents may run with children in the 2–3 and 4–5 age categories. The race takes place in all weather; participants must observe safety guidelines and fair play rules. A disposable race bib with safety pins must be attached to the chest. Parking is available as shown on the parking map; please do not park on the road shoulders. Course maps and videos are available on the website; the race takes place in Kačina Chateau Park.

name: Leskros Mácháč
location: Doksy, Máchovo jezero, CHKO Kokořínsko, Czech Republic
description: Leskros Mácháč is a new event this season, with beautiful routes ideal for running and canicross in the Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area, near Lake Máchovo. The routes follow soft, sandy ground covered with pine needles, making for a pleasant running experience in a natural setting. The event offers various distances, from children’s races to 21 km, with running, canicross, walking/running and dog-trekking categories. Facilities include refreshment stations for people and dogs, massages, taping and canine physiotherapy advice, helping all participants feel their best.
course_highlights: Soft sandy routes covered with pine needles
Location in the Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area near Lake Máchovo
Refreshment stations for people and dogs at the finish and along the route
additional: Race registration opens at 8:00. Facilities include a bag check, changing room, Leskros kids’ club (10:30–14:00), massages and taping for runners, canine physiotherapy advice, canicross equipment available to borrow by prior arrangement, and parking and toilets near the start. The event includes charity activities, children’s races, equipment rental, refreshments and an accompanying programme in the natural setting of the Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area near Lake Máchovo.

name: Štramberský Jasoň
location: Frýdlant nad Ostravicí, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Spolek Bezva běh pro bezva lidi z. s.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Do 30.4.2026 390 Kč nad 15 let a dospělí

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Do 30.4.2026 300 Kč děti v kočárku (s nárokem na medaili, start. číslo se jménem atd.)

description: Štramberský Jasoň is a traditional hiking and running event taking place on 19 September 2026 in Frýdlant nad Ostravicí and the surrounding area. It offers 22 routes of varying lengths, from 6 km to 67 km, including both race and hiking options. Participants can choose routes passing through Lysá hora, the Palkovické hůrky, Velký Javorník and other scenic locations in the Moravian-Silesian Region. At the finish in Štramberk, all registered participants receive an original medal and can order a printed T-shirt. The event is suitable for the general public, including families with children, and also offers routes suitable for strollers and seniors.
course_highlights: 22 routes from 6 km to 67 km, including both race and hiking options
Routes pass through Lysá hora, the Palkovické hůrky, Velký Javorník and other natural attractions
Finish in Štramberk, with an original medal for all participants
additional: Registration is available online only. A printed cotton T-shirt can be ordered during registration for 390 Kč (children’s T-shirt: 350 Kč). Registration can be transferred to another participant until 11.9.2026 at 20:00 by emailing redakce@bezvabeh.cz or in person at the event. The finish in Štramberk closes at 21:00. The event offers routes of various lengths, online registration, medals for participants, optional T-shirts and detailed route maps available for download.

name: Havlíčkova pětka
location: Havlíčkův Brod, Vysočina Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 200 Kč: zvýhodněné startovné při on-line registraci a zaplacení na účet do 31. května 2026

description: Havlíčkova pětka is a running race of approximately 5.2 km, held mostly on cycle paths and sidewalks along the banks of the Sázava River in Havlíčkův Brod. It is suitable for those who do not have a relay team or find a half marathon too challenging. The race starts in Havlíčkovo Square, and part of the entry fee goes toward supporting sports equipment for young people. The race is part of the Běžec Vysočiny running series and offers refreshments at both the start and finish.
course_highlights: The route follows public cycle paths and sidewalks, much of it along the Sázava River
No significant elevation gain (up to 20 m)
Surface: 95% asphalt paths, 5% trail or paving
additional: Refreshments are available at the start and finish. Race numbers for registrations paid by September 1, 2026, include the runner’s name. The race offers a medal, refreshments on the course and after the race, facilities including a changing room and storage for belongings and bikes, portable toilets, drinking water, music, and professional electronic chip timing with online results. Fifteen percent of each entry fee goes toward supporting secondary schools and youth sports programs in the town. The route includes asphalt paths, trails, and paving; registration is available online or on site. The race supports youth sports activities and offers various additional events as part of the running day.

name: Běh rodným krajem Emila Zátopka

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 400 Kč - platí pro závodníky přihlášené do 17. září 2026 - startovné se hradí na účet

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 800 Kč - platí pro závodníky přihlášené 19. září 2026 (v den závodu) - startovné se hradí při prezentaci

description: The Run Through the Homeland of Emil Zátopek is a traditional race honoring the legacy of the famous Olympic athlete Emil Zátopek. It is held each year on the Saturday closest to his birthday, September 19. The race starts in his hometown of Kopřivnice, by the statue of Emil Zátopek, and finishes at the Wallachian Open Air Museum in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm, after a challenging 22.3 km course with a hilly profile. The race is open to participants aged 15 and over and also offers accompanying runs for children and the public. After the race, a ceremonial awards presentation takes place with distinguished guests in attendance.
course_highlights: A 22.3 km course from Kopřivnice to Rožnov pod Radhoštěm
Asphalt and gravel surfaces on forest sections
375 m elevation gain, with a rolling, hilly profile
additional: There are three refreshment stations and one water station along the course. The race takes place on roads open to traffic. The time limit is 3 hours from the start, with an intermediate cutoff of 1:20 hours to Veřovice. Changing rooms are available at the Cultural Centre in Kopřivnice and at the Wallachian Open Air Museum in Rožnov. Luggage is transported by bus to the finish. The organizer provides bus transport from Rožnov to the start and back after the race. Accommodation is available at Hotel Stadion in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm at the runner’s expense. Runners under 18 require consent from a legal guardian. The event also includes accompanying runs for children and the public. The route includes asphalt and forest paths; registration is required. Team and relay races are available, transport and accommodation are provided, and prizes are awarded.

name: Kocelovice-Hornosín-Kocelovice
description: The Kocelovice–Hornosín–Kocelovice cross-country race is a traditional sporting event organized by the municipality of Kocelovice in the South Bohemian Region. The race takes place on Saturday, September 19, 2026, and participants can expect a route from Kocelovice to Hornosín and back. The event is suitable for running enthusiasts and anyone looking for an active day out in scenic terrain popular with hikers and cyclists. The start and finish are at the former school building in Kocelovice, which also serves as the race headquarters. The event lasts approximately 4 hours.
course_highlights: The route passes through scenic South Bohemian countryside with ideal terrain for hiking and cycling
Start and finish at the former school building in Kocelovice
A cross-country race connecting the villages of Kocelovice and Hornosín
additional: The event lasts approximately 240 minutes (4 hours). The start and finish are at the former school building in Kocelovice. The organizer is the Municipality of Kocelovice. The race is held annually in autumn; the most recent edition was in September 2023, and the next is planned for September 2026. The course is approximately 18 km long, with varying levels of difficulty and terrain.

name: Havlíčkobrodský půlmaraton

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 400 Kč: zvýhodněné startovné při on-line registraci a zaplacení na účet do 15. března 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 1200 Kč: zvýhodněné týmové startovné při online registraci a zaplacení na účet do 18. září 2026 (do 12:00)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 200 Kč: zvýhodněné startovné při on-line registraci a zaplacení na účet do 31. května 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 50 Kč: zvýhodněné startovné při online registraci a zaplacení na účet do 18. září 2026 (do 12:00)

description: The Havlíčkův Brod Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in Havlíčkův Brod, celebrating its 14th edition in 2026. The main half marathon follows public cycle paths and pavements, mostly along the Sázava River, and passes through Havlíčkův Brod Square. Alongside the main race, the event includes children’s races, relays, and the shorter Havlíčkova Pětka, welcoming participants of different ages and ability levels. The race offers quality facilities, refreshments on the course and after the race, professional timing, and a varied accompanying programme.
course_highlights: The course follows public cycle paths and pavements, mostly along the Sázava River
The 5.2 km loop is run four times for the half marathon
Start and finish at Havlíčkův Brod Square, with no significant elevation gain
additional: The entry fee includes a race bib (with the runner’s name for registrations paid by 1 September 2026), a medal, refreshments on the course and after the race, free admission to an amusement park in the Vysočina Region, facilities (changing room, storage for belongings and bicycles, portable toilets, drinking water, and seating), music, event announcing, professional electronic chip timing, online results, medical services, and race organisation. The half-marathon time limit is 3 hours. 15% of each entry fee goes toward supporting secondary schools and sports programmes for children in the city. Results from the children’s races and Havlíčkova Pětka count toward the Běžec Vysočiny running cup. The event is traditionally held in September and offers a varied programme for all age groups and ability levels, including relays and children’s races.

name: Běh pro Hospic Anežky České
location: Červený Kostelec, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Děti: jednotné startovné 100 Kč (online i na místě)

description: The Run for Anežka České Hospice is an open charity race held in Červený Kostelec, with courses for all age groups. The race takes place on 19 September 2026 and includes children’s courses along a forest path, as well as 2, 5 and 10 km courses over undulating mixed terrain, mostly asphalt with some forest and field paths. The event is part of the Primátor CUP running series and supports hospice services. Race bibs are distributed from 8:15, and the main race winners’ awards ceremony takes place at 12:00.
course_highlights: The children’s courses follow a forest path
The 2, 5 and 10 km courses follow undulating mixed terrain, mostly asphalt
Beautiful scenery around the ponds of Červený Kostelec, with views of the Orlické Mountains, the Krkonoše Mountains and Hejšovina
additional: Race bibs are distributed from 8:15; registration closes 30 minutes before the start. A small gift is available for the first 300 registered participants. Parking is available on the grassy meadow by Náchodská Street, about a 10-minute walk from the race venue. The race is part of the Primátor CUP 2026 running series, with fair-play rules and no accompanying dogs, scooters or bicycles. The race takes place on 19 September 2026 in Červený Kostelec and supports hospice services. Registration and further details are available on the website.

name: Jilemnice - Žalý
description: Jilemnice - Žalý is a hill race with a total elevation gain of 569 metres, held in the scenic surroundings of Jilemnice in the Liberec Region. The race is part of the Czech Hill Running Cup and features a challenging 9.5 km course. The start is in Jilemnice’s town square, and the race is suitable for runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain. It is organized by ČKS SKI Jilemnice, z.s., which provides professional organization and support for the runners.
course_highlights: 9.5 km course with 569 m of elevation gain
Hill race in the scenic surroundings of Jilemnice
Start in Jilemnice’s town square
additional: The race is part of the Czech Hill Running Cup. It is organized by ČKS SKI Jilemnice, z.s. Contact person: Roman Koucký, tel. 602 265 857. The race regulations are available to download on the official page. The race takes place on a mountain course; registration details are not specified, results are announced at the finish line, and the event is part of the Czech Hill Running Cup.

name: Soběchlebský Š-krpál
organizer: místní běžečtí nadšenci ve spolupráci s obcí Soběchleby a SDH Soběchleby
price_range: 200 Kč dospělí, 150 Kč kondiční běh, děti zdarma
description: Soběchlebský Š-krpál is a traditional running race held in the area around the village of Soběchleby since 2017. The main course is approximately 11.7 km long with 268 m of elevation gain and runs 90% on unpaved farm and forest roads. Since 2024, the event has also included a 6 km fitness run, suitable for beginner runners and walkers. The start and finish are at the football field in Soběchleby, which has facilities including changing rooms, showers and refreshments. The accompanying program includes children’s races for different age groups.
course_highlights: Main course: 11.7 km with 268 m of elevation gain
The route runs 90% on unpaved farm and forest roads
6 km fitness run with 137 m of elevation gain, suitable for beginners
additional: Registration for the children’s races is always available on site on race day. The main race and fitness run can be entered online or on site until 11:30. Facilities at the football field include changing rooms, showers and toilets. Refreshments are provided after the race (soup, beer/non-alcoholic drinks). Parking is available in the immediate vicinity of the venue. The route runs on farm and forest roads; the start and finish are at the football field; refreshments and showers are available; parking is nearby.

name: Černošický běh
location: Černošice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Černošice Run is a traditional running race held in Černošice, offering courses for different age groups, from the youngest children to adults. The race takes place at the sports field at the end of Husova Street and includes short children’s races, a family relay, and longer courses for adult runners. Starts take place in stages from 14:00 to 15:40, allowing participants in different age groups to take part comfortably. The event is suitable for families and for runners looking for a sporting challenge in a pleasant town setting.
course_highlights: 200 m course for children born in 2018 or later
Family relay: 3 x 900 m
Longer 3 km and 10 km courses for adults and older youth
additional: Registration opens at 13:00 and closes 30 minutes before the start of each category. Starts take place in stages from 14:00 to 15:40. The event is held at the sports field at the end of Husova Street in Černošice. Categories are divided by age and course distance, including a family relay. The course is cross-country in style, running on paved and unpaved paths; competitors take part at their own risk; the event is sponsored by community activities in Černošice.

name: Bessunger Merck-Lauf
description: The Bessunger Merck Run is a traditional neighborhood race in Darmstadt that welcomes runners of all ages. The event offers various distances and features a varied course through the Bessungen district. Advance registration is now open, with the deadline falling on September 13 for organizational reasons. The race fosters community spirit and a love of running in the region.
course_highlights: Distances of 1.1 km and 10 km
Event in Darmstadt
Organized by TGB 1865 Darmstadt e.V.
additional: Advance registration is now open and ends on September 13, 2026. The event is organized by TGB 1865 Darmstadt e.V. Advance registration deadline: September 13, 2026; weather in September is typically mild.

name: Int. Pronsfelder Volks- und Straßenlauf
description: The 38th International Pronsfeld Fun Run and Road Race offers a varied running experience in the heart of the Eifel for all ages and ability levels. From Bambini and children’s races to the fun run and half marathon, there is something for everyone. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, attractive prizes and excellent refreshments in the finish area. The start and finish are at Autohaus Mais-Glandien in Pronsfeld, and the race is a sporting highlight with a tradition and community spirit.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 200 m to the half marathon (21 km)
Start and finish at Autohaus Mais-Glandien, Lünebacher Str. 1 - 3, 54597 Pronsfeld
Part of the 4-Regio-Cup in the 10 km main race
additional: Medals and gifts for Bambini and children/young people. Non-cash prizes, bouquets and vouchers in the main race. Every Nordic walking participant receives a gift. Food and drinks in the finish area. An event with a family-friendly atmosphere and team spirit. The event takes place on 19 September 2026. Online registration is available, with various distances including walking and the half marathon, plus refreshments and a lively atmosphere in the finish area.

name: Mühlenlauf in Laar
location: Laar, Grafschaft Bentheim, Lower Saxony, Germany
organizer: Verein zur Erhaltung der Windmühle Laar/Vechte e.V.
description: The Mühlenlauf in Laar has been organized by SV Grenzland Laarwald since 1986 and takes place annually on the third weekend in September. Runners of all ages can choose between 2 km, 5 km and 10 km courses. The start and finish are both by the historic windmill, which, together with the windmill association, creates a welcoming atmosphere. Drinks and refreshments are provided for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Start and finish by the historic windmill in Laar
Course distances: 2 km, 5 km and 10 km
Run through the scenic surroundings of Laar
additional: The Mühlenlauf is organized in cooperation with the sports club. The windmill and the local heritage house can be rented for celebrations. Drinks and refreshments are available on site for runners and spectators. The Mühlenlauf takes place in September, with drinks and refreshments provided. Advance registration is possible; late registration is available on site. The event takes place in all weather conditions.

name: Nassauer Hospiz-Charity-Run 2026
description: The Nassauer Hospice Charity Run 2026 in Seelbach is a varied running event taking place on September 19, 2026, with distances ranging from 250 meters for children to 10 kilometers for experienced runners. The event combines a sporting challenge with social commitment by supporting the important work of the hospice in Nassau. Participants can enjoy the beautiful natural surroundings of the Taunus and take part in a family-friendly event centered on helping others together.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 250 m to 10 km
Run through the beautiful natural surroundings of the Taunus
A family-friendly event focused on solidarity and support
additional: The run is a charity event supporting the Rhein-Lahn inpatient hospice. Great emphasis is placed on community involvement and donations for the hospice. The event takes place on September 19, 2026, amid the natural scenery of the Taunus, and offers distances for children and adults.

name: Röderhof-Benefiz-Lauf
description: The Röderhof Charity Run takes place on September 19, 2026, in Diekholzen and offers various running and walking distances for all age groups and ability levels. This traditional charity event focuses on the enjoyment of running and coming together to support a good cause. Distances range from 500 meters to 10 kilometers, including special wheelchair races. Start times are staggered to ensure the event runs smoothly.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 500 m to 10 km
Inclusive wheelchair races and walking routes
A run through the scenic surroundings of Diekholzen
additional: Online registration closes on 15.09. at 21:00. Late entries are possible on the event day up to 1 hour before the start, subject to a €2 late-entry fee. Payment by direct debit is possible. The event includes several start times for different distances and categories, including special wheelchair races and walking routes. Various running events, wheelchair races, walking, and the option to donate via PayPal

name: Welterbelauf Zollverein 2026
location: Zollverein, Essen-Stoppenberg, Essen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Welterbelauf Zollverein takes place on September 19, 2026, on the grounds of the Zollverein coking plant in Essen-Stoppenberg. The courses run along the Ring Promenade and past prominent industrial landmarks such as the Doppelbock winding tower, the SANAA building, and the Zollverein spoil tip. Various events are available for all ages and ability levels, including a 10 km run, relays, walking, and Special Olympics categories. The 10 km course is officially measured by the DLV and eligible for rankings. The race combines a sporting challenge with the unique atmosphere of this UNESCO World Heritage Site.
course_highlights: Course along the Ring Promenade and past the Doppelbock winding tower
Passes the SANAA building and the Zollverein spoil tip
10 km course officially measured by the DLV and eligible for rankings
additional: The event offers eight different competitions, including the 10 km Zollverein Run, 3 x 3.3 km Pütt Relay, 5.4 km Kumpel Run and Steiger Walk, 2.7 km Coking Plant Run, 1.2 km Schoolchildren's Race, 600 m Helen Keller Run, and 300 m Bambini Run. Parking on the grounds is free for participants and visitors. The venue is easily accessible by public transport and car. The DLV and IAAF International Competition Rules apply. Registration opens on May 15, 2026; the event includes team relays (Pütt Run) and offers certificates and results online.

name: BraunenBerg-Trail
description: The BraunenBerg-Lauf on September 19, 2026, in Aalen offers varied mountain-running courses for different age and ability groups. A particular highlight is the Rolladen Kaiser-BraunenBerg-Trail, which starts underground at the Besucherbergwerk Tiefer Stollen visitor mine and covers 32 km of trail running with 1,100 metres of elevation gain. For beginners and recreational runners, the technically easy VR Bank-BraunenBerg-Lauf covers 14.6 km with 446 metres of elevation gain. Children’s and youth races round out the programme. Personalized race bibs, chip timing, refreshments and a baggage drop are available in the finish area.
course_highlights: Rolladen Kaiser-BraunenBerg-Trail: 32 km of trail running with 1,100 metres of elevation gain; starts at the Besucherbergwerk Tiefer Stollen visitor mine
VR Bank-BraunenBerg-Lauf: technically easy 14.6 km mountain run with 446 metres of elevation gain
Children’s and youth races with personalized race bibs, timing and refreshments at the finish
additional: A special bus transports runners from Oberalfingen to the start at the Besucherbergwerk Tiefer Stollen, departing at 9:45 a.m. A baggage drop is available in the finish area in Oberalfingen. Personalized race bibs and chip timing are provided for all races. Medals for all finishers. Runners exceeding the time limits are disqualified (32 km: by 3:30 p.m.; the 14.6 km race also has a time limit). Awards ceremony at 3:30 p.m. in Oberalfingen. Multiple races are offered, including the trail race and children’s and youth races; registration includes starter packs with timing chips and medals.

name: 32. Stadtparklauf
description: The Sondershausen City Park Run is a traditional running event held annually in Sondershausen City Park. The event offers various distances from 500 m to 10,000 m and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. The course winds through the picturesque city park, offering a pleasant running atmosphere in a green setting. The run is organized by SV Glückauf Sondershausen e.V. and is very popular in the region.
course_highlights: Run through Sondershausen City Park
A variety of distances from 500 m to 10,000 m
Family-friendly and varied course
additional: Results from previous years are available as PDF files for all distances. The event provides results from previous years online and is held annually, with running, family, and leisure activities.

name: Altstadt-Run 2026
description: Altstadt-Run Treysa 2026 takes place on September 19 in Schwalmstadt and is part of the Schwalm-Eder Running Cup. The event offers runners an attractive opportunity to run through Treysa’s historic old town. Organized by ESV Jahn Treysa, the race is open to all running enthusiasts looking for a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Run through Treysa’s historic old town
Start and finish at Marktplatz 7 in Schwalmstadt
Part of the Schwalm-Eder Running Cup
additional: The event is connected with local community activities and takes place at Marktplatz 7 in Schwalmstadt.

name: Aspacher Volkslauf
description: The Aspach Volkslauf is a long-standing running event organized by the Murrtal Runners Aspach. The start and finish are at Mühlfeldhalle in Großaspach. The courses run through the Fautenhau and back, with minor adjustments to simplify the route. The event offers races for various age groups, including Bambini races, youth races, and a 10 km main race. Coffee, cake, and hot meals are available before, during, and after the race.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Mühlfeldhalle in Großaspach
Route through the Fautenhau, with scenic sections
Single-use transponder in the race bib for timing
additional: On-site registration for the Bambini and youth races is also available from 16:00 at Mühlfeldhalle. Ample parking is available at the start/finish, Großaspach Town Hall, and the community hall. The first three overall finishers in each race receive prizes; the first three finishers in each age group of the main race receive certificates and gifts. All certificates are available to view online. Courses: 200 m, 400 m, 1.5 km, 5 km, 10 km; results online; parking at Mühlfeldhalle, Town Hall, and community hall; refreshments include coffee, cake, and hot meals.

name: Baedleslauf
description: The 22nd Baedleslauf takes place on Saturday afternoon in Stuttgart-Zuffenhausen and offers adult races over 5.3 km and 10 km. There is also a shorter 1.5 km distance, available as both a run and Nordic walking, ideal for runners and walkers. The flat course allows for a steady pace without major climbs. All races finish on the grounds of the SSV Zuffenhausen outdoor swimming pool in district 70435. The programme also includes children’s and youth races, making the Baedleslauf a family-friendly running event.
course_highlights: Flat course for a steady pace
Start and finish on the grounds of the SSV Zuffenhausen outdoor swimming pool
Running and Nordic walking distances available
additional: The event takes place on Saturday afternoon. The programme includes children’s and youth races. The shorter 1.5 km distance is also available as Nordic walking. The event is family-friendly, with different running options and a focus on community sport. It takes place in Stuttgart-Zuffenhausen and is a good opportunity for runners of all experience levels.

name: Belchenberglauf
description: The Belchen Mountain Run is a challenging 11.4 km mountain race with 824 m of elevation gain, running from Schönau im Schwarzwald to the Hotel Belchen. The route is approximately 37% forest road and 63% asphalt, and is marked with white arrows and red signs, making it suitable for year-round training. Around 80% of the race passes through open terrain and past grazing land, offering impressive views of Feldberg, the Little and Great Wiesental valleys, and the Swiss Alps. The event takes place on September 19, 2026, and is part of the Black Forest Mountain Running Cup. Participants can take a free return trip by cable car and bus, and luggage is transported to the Belchen.
course_highlights: 11.4 km route with 824 m of elevation gain
80% of the race passes through open terrain and grazing land
Beautiful views of Feldberg, the Wiesental valleys, and the Swiss Alps
additional: Three drink stations along the route. Start and finish are in Schönau im Schwarzwald. Late registration is possible on race day until 45 minutes before the start. Free return transport by cable car and bus to the start. Luggage transport to the Belchen. Parking is available at Buchenbrandstadion. Race-number collection and the event hall open at 10:30 a.m. The route includes forest roads and asphalt; registration by email is possible. The route is well marked, and transport options are available.

name: Black Forest ULTRA Trail Run
description: The Black Forest ULTRA Trail Run offers five challenging routes in the heart of the Black Forest, taking runners along narrow trails, steep climbs and technically demanding sections through an impressive landscape. The routes feature varied sections with stunning views, challenging elevation gains and a distinctive Black Forest character. Whether you choose the 76 km ultra trail with seven aid stations and drop bag service or the 55 km route across rugged, varied terrain, trail runners can expect an uncompromising adventure. The event is DLV-approved and promises an unforgettable experience for everyone who wants to discover the Black Forest in all its diversity.
course_highlights: Narrow trails with steep climbs and technical sections
Stunning views across the Black Forest
Seven aid stations and drop bag service for the 76 km race
additional: Race bibs can be collected the day before the race from 15:00 to 20:00 and on race day during time slots specific to each distance. Drop bag service for BFUTR 76, including drop-off and return transport. Course changes may be made for organizational or weather-related reasons. DLV-approved trail race. Multiple distances, challenging trails and scenic mountain views. Registration available on the website.

name: BraunenBerg-Lauf
description: The BraunenBerg-Lauf on September 19, 2026, offers varied mountain-running routes on the Ostalb, appealing to both beginners and experienced runners. The event includes several distances, including the technically easy 14.6 km VR Bank-BraunenBerg-Lauf with 446 meters of elevation gain and the challenging 32 km Rolladen Kaiser-BraunenBerg-Trail with 1,100 meters of elevation gain, which starts underground at the Tiefen Stollen visitor mine. Children and young people have their own races with personalized timing, refreshments, and medals. Runners can make use of a bag drop in the finish area and enjoy the friendly atmosphere on the Ostalb.
course_highlights: Rolladen Kaiser-BraunenBerg-Trail: 32 km trail run with 1,100 meters of elevation gain; starts underground at the Tiefen Stollen visitor mine
VR Bank-BraunenBerg-Lauf: technically easy 14.6 km mountain run with 446 meters of elevation gain
Bag drop in the Oberalfingen finish area and refreshments during the races
additional: The Rolladen Kaiser-BraunenBerg-Trail starts underground at the Tiefen Stollen visitor mine. Participants are transported there together by special bus from Oberalfingen at 9:45 a.m. Personalized race bibs with timing chips, GPX data for download, refreshments at the finish, and medals for all finishers. A bag drop is available in the Oberalfingen finish area; no liability is accepted for valuables. Runners who exceed the time limit on the longer routes will be disqualified. The awards ceremony is at 3:30 p.m. in the finish area at Getränke Keller Oberalfingen. Multiple race categories, including trail, main race, and children’s races; routes pass landmarks such as the Braunenberg, mining trail, television tower, and Naturfreundehaus. Registration and further information are available on the official website.

name: Crosslauf Rund um den Wasserturm
description: The cross-country run around the water tower in Oberschöna is a varied event offering distances from 1 km to 10 km. Children and school pupils can take part in special races, and Nordic walkers are also very welcome. The course loops around the distinctive water tower and offers a sporting challenge in a scenic setting.
course_highlights: A varied cross-country run around the water tower
Distances of 1 km, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km
Separate races for children and school pupils
additional: Nordic walkers are also welcome. Typical September weather: approx. 19 °C, mostly cloudy, with about 45 mm of precipitation. The run takes place on 19 September 2026 and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with various competitions and courses for all age groups.

name: Duinger Berglauf
description: The Duinger Berglauf takes place on September 19, 2026, in Duingen, Lower Saxony, and offers races for children and adults. The event starts and finishes at the OBS sports hall and includes short children’s races as well as more challenging 5 km and 10 km hill races with around 110 metres of elevation gain. Organised by Duinger Sport-Club e.V., the race has been an accessible local hill-running event for 19 years. After the race, all participants receive free access to the indoor swimming pool and sauna, with changing rooms, showers and refreshments available on site.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km courses with approximately 110 m of elevation gain
Routes mainly on paved farm and forest paths
Children’s races near the school grounds; adult races start at the sports hall
additional: Late registration is possible up to one hour before the start. Free access to the indoor swimming pool and sauna after the race. Changing rooms, showers, food and drinks are available on site. No club membership required. Various distances, including children’s and adult categories; registration is possible until shortly before the race; post-race amenities include the indoor swimming pool and sauna.

name: Edeka Ladage-Lauf Wennigsen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld: 3 € Teilnehmer:innen: Kindergarten­kinder laufen eine etwa 600 m und Grundschüler:innen eine 900 m lange Strecke.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld: 4 € Teilnehmer:innen: Jahrgänge 2014 und jünger (U12) | Jahrgänge 2010 bis 2013 (U16)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld: 8 € || Jahrgänge 2007 und jünger: 4 € Teilnehmer:innen: Jahrgänge 2015 und älter

description: The EDEKA Ladage Run in Wennigsen offers a varied program for all age groups, with distances ranging from approximately 600 m for kindergarten children to 10 km for adults. The races take place on a varied loop course on the grounds of the Sophie Scholl Comprehensive School, passing through residential areas and along field paths, with a special atmosphere at the start and finish. Alongside the sporting competition, the social aspect is also important: proceeds from the main race are donated to the Bastlergemeinschaft der Wennigser Wasserräder e.V. The event is a popular community race with a family-friendly atmosphere and a long tradition in the region.
course_highlights: Varied loop course on the grounds of the Sophie Scholl Comprehensive School
The route passes through residential areas, along field paths and along Argestorfer Straße
Start and finish close to the event area, with a special atmosphere
additional: Late entries are possible up to one hour before the respective start, subject to an additional fee. The kindergarten and primary school races start at 17:00, and awards ceremonies take place shortly after the races. The 5 km race consists of two laps of the 2.5 km course, while the 10 km race consists of four laps. Entry in the main race automatically includes entry into the prize draw. Proceeds from the main race are donated. Various race distances, children’s and adult categories, donations to local associations.

name: Fichtelgebirgstrailrun
description: The Fichtelgebirgstrailrun is a challenging trail-running competition held on partly unpaved roads and paths in the natural surroundings of the Fichtelgebirge. It requires participants to have good fitness and coordination, as well as respect and personal responsibility toward themselves, fellow runners, and the environment. The route passes through the unique and sensitive natural landscape of the Fichtelgebirge and offers runners an immersive nature experience. The event places great importance on safety, fairness, and environmental protection.
course_highlights: Trail running on unpaved roads and paths in the natural surroundings
Challenging route requiring a high level of fitness and coordination
Nature experience in the sensitive Fichtelgebirge
additional: Participation is limited to healthy, well-trained runners. Strict rules apply, with disqualification for leaving the route, unsporting conduct, or doping. Participants should stop if their health is at risk and provide first aid until the medical team arrives. Trail run in the Fichtelgebirge; online registration; no shower facilities; details on the website.

name: Fit in Lautern Lauf 1. Lauf zu Gunsten des Fördervereins Waschmühle e.V.
description: The Fit in Lautern Run is a charity run benefiting the Förderverein Waschmühle e.V. in Kaiserslautern. The event takes place on September 19, 2026, offering a sporting opportunity to strengthen the community while supporting a good cause. The run takes place in the area around the Waschmühle outdoor swimming pool, a well-known location in Kaiserslautern. The event is open to all running enthusiasts and promotes health and social engagement.
course_highlights: Run around the Waschmühle outdoor swimming pool
Event in Kaiserslautern with a social purpose
First run benefiting the Förderverein Waschmühle e.V.
additional: The event takes place near the Waschmühle outdoor swimming pool. Further details about the courses and registration are not currently available.

name: Freimarktslauf
description: The Freimarktslauf in Garrel is the region’s largest fun run and offers a varied running experience for young and old, beginners and professionals, on its flat circuits. The event includes distances from a 400 m Bambini run to 10 km main races, held on a flat 2.5 km circuit through Garrel. Alongside the sporting competition, community and fun take centre stage, supported by RunClub Garrel, which specifically encourages beginners. With more than 1,300 participants, the race is a popular event filled with unforgettable moments.
course_highlights: Flat 2.5 km circuit through Garrel
All main races use the same circuit, with 1, 2 or 4 laps
A range of distances from 400 m to 10 km for all age groups
additional: The race offers combined scoring for the 5 km and 10 km races. There are special races for children and young people, including a Bambini run, a taster run and a schoolchildren’s run. RunClub Garrel supports beginners and returning runners with group training sessions. The event is a large community gathering with more than 1,300 participants, and numerous photos and results are available online. The race includes various distances and is open to runners of all age groups. Registration is online, and the event is part of the region’s festivities.

name: Int. Bodensee-Marathon
location: Kressbronn am Bodensee, Bodenseekreis, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The International Lake Constance Marathon in Kressbronn am Bodensee is a traditional running event with a history spanning more than 50 years. The course follows a loop through the town centre, along the Argen and on the shores of Lake Constance. Marathon runners complete two half-marathon laps. The event combines a sporting challenge with beautiful scenery in a natural setting. Finishers receive wooden medals, and a high-quality finisher shirt can be ordered as an optional extra. A popular street festival with music, food and a flea market takes place alongside the race.
course_highlights: Loop through Kressbronn, starting on Hauptstraße
Approximately 12 km loop along the Argen on shaded natural walking trails
The marathon consists of two half-marathon laps, finishing in front of the Festhalle
additional: Finishers receive wooden medals. The high-quality finisher shirt (Puma, dark blue) can be ordered during registration for 30€ and collected on site or from the equipment partner. A shuttle service is available from the Strandbad car park to the Festhalle. Late entries are possible on race day (8:30-11:00, Kids Run until 10:00) with a 5 € late-entry fee, except for the Kids Run and the sold-out half marathon. The Kressbronn street festival, featuring live music, food and a flea market, takes place in the town centre on the day of the event. The event offers a great running atmosphere, support from numerous sponsors, a shuttle bus option and the opportunity to donate to the Kressbronn indoor swimming pool.

name: Kapuziner-Kessellauf
description: The Kapuziner Kessellauf is a traditional race through the Kessel and the Kulmbacher Forest, starting at the Weiher Sports Center. Since its revival in 2002, it has been a fixture on the Upper Franconian running calendar. Alongside the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a varied supporting programme featuring music, coffee and cake, a finish-line buffet and a large raffle. The Bambini and schoolchildren’s races, with medals for all participants, are especially family-friendly. The event also encourages community spirit through team rankings and awards for the teams with the most participants.
course_highlights: Race through the Kessel and the Kulmbacher Forest
Start at the Weiher Sports Center
Family-friendly Bambini and schoolchildren’s races, with medals
additional: Late entries are possible until 19.09.2026 at 9 p.m. for a fee of 5 euros. Team rankings apply only to the main race and are separate for men and women. The team with the most participants will receive a non-cash prize. Nordic walking is timed, with no finish ranking. Supporting programme featuring music, coffee and cake, a finish-line buffet, childcare, finisher medals for the schoolchildren’s and Bambini races, and a large raffle. Courses on forest and woodland trails, children’s and schoolchildren’s races, supporting programme with music, coffee and cake, raffle, race-number collection on 19.09.2026, participant limit of 500.

name: Klausdorfer Kranichlauf
description: The Klausdorf Crane Run invites runners of all ages to enjoy a choice of running routes in the beautiful surroundings of Klausdorf. Times are recorded using a chip issued with the race bib. Every participant receives a certificate and a medal, and the top three finishers in each race are honored separately. Refreshments are provided along the route and at the finish, and changing rooms and toilets are available at the Vorpommernhus. The event offers a friendly, family atmosphere and is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational athletes.
course_highlights: Scenic running routes through Klausdorf, Hohendorf, Wendisch-Langendorf, Zarrenzin, Barhöft and Prohn
Start and finish at the Vorpommernhus, close to the beach
Refreshments along the route and at the finish
additional: Late registration is available at the Vorpommernhus on 18.09.2026 from 18:00 to 20:00 and on race day from 07:00 to 09:30. The awards ceremony for the Landknirpselauf takes place immediately after the finish. Ample parking is available around the Vorpommernhus. Registration is possible by email or online. Participation is at your own risk. All participants receive medals and certificates. Refreshments are available at the finish and along the route. Parking is available.

name: Seelauf TSV-Obernzenn
description: The TSV Obernzenn Seelauf is a long-established running event offering various distances for children, teenagers and adults. The routes include a Bambini run, schoolchildren’s races, a middle distance and a long distance of approx. 10.7 km. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, with participant gifts and attractive prizes for the top runners. Registration is online only via my.raceresult.com from 1 May 2026. Start times are staggered to ensure the event runs smoothly.
course_highlights: Long-distance course of approx. 10.7 km with elevation profile
Middle- and long-distance races for teenagers and adults
Children’s races of approx. 400 m for Bambini and schoolchildren
additional: Late entries are possible until one hour before the start for a €3 late-entry fee. Race-pack collection begins at 9:15 am at the clubhouse. All Bambini and schoolchildren receive a T-shirt as a participant gift; the first 60 participants in the middle- and long-distance races receive a technical shirt. Bambini runners receive a gold medal and certificate; participants in the schoolchildren’s races receive trophies, medals and certificates. Results and certificates are available online. The event also includes a children’s race of approx. 400 m and longer distances of around 10.7 km. The event takes place at the TSV Obernzenn sports field and is part of the club’s activities.

name: Sparkassen-Altstadtlauf
description: The Sparkassen-Altstadtlauf in Ottweiler is a traditional race that brings together inclusion, emotion, and outstanding athletic performance. Held annually, the event gives runners of all ages and abilities the opportunity to run through Ottweiler’s historic old town. It promotes community and sporting ambition in a lively atmosphere.
course_highlights: Run through the historic old town of Ottweiler
Inclusive event focused on community
Outstanding athletic performances in an emotional atmosphere
additional: The event promotes a sense of community and physical activity in a historic setting.

name: Volkslauf Rund um den Disibodenberg
location: Disibodenberg, Odernheim am Glan, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Disibodenberglauf is a long-standing fun run around Disibodenberg in Odernheim, taking place for the 38th time in 2026. The scenic course combines flat sections along the Glan with a challenging climb on the Eselspfad, which defines the character of the race. Events include 5 km and 10 km runs, walking on the 5 km course, and children’s and youth races from 200 m. The event has a sporting yet family-friendly focus, with special prizes for records, families, teams, and Walk-&-Talk groups. The awards ceremony and social gathering take place in the sports hall, with coffee, cake, and grilled food.
course_highlights: Scenic course along the Glan
Challenging climb on the Eselspfad
Combination of flat sections and trail passages
additional: Children’s training runs take place on three Tuesdays in September from 18:30 at the sports hall. The entry fee is paid when collecting race materials. Special prizes are awarded for new course records, the most running-loving family, the largest team, and the happiest Walk-&-Talk group. The awards ceremony takes place in the sports hall, where coffee, homemade cake, and grilled food are available at fair prices. A running event with varied terrain, parking, changing rooms, and showers on site; a popular community event in September.

name: Wehringer Wertachlauf mit schwäbischen Meisterschaften
description: The Wehringer Wertachlauf is a local running event in Wehringen, Germany, organized by Laufgemeinschaft Wehringen. The program includes a short 350-meter race and a 10 km race, classified as a short run. The course runs around the village of Wehringen and offers a family-friendly atmosphere. This edition also includes the Swabian Championships.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Aue 6, near the Musikerheim in Wehringen
Two distances: 350 m and 10 km
Course around the village of Wehringen; not a point-to-point route
additional: The event takes place on September 19, 2026. September weather is typically around 19 °C, with a minimum of 10 °C, and mostly cloudy. The event is short and simple, with a focus on its local character. Distances: 350 m and 10 km; includes the Swabian Championships; venue in Wehringen.

name: Wilstermarsch Lauf
description: The Wilstermarschlauf is a traditional running event in Wilster, taking place for the 34th time on September 19, 2026. The event offers various distances for children and adults, including 400 m, 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km, through the scenic Wilstermarsch. Alongside the sporting competition, a varied program featuring games, bouncy cushions, a DJ, a barbecue stand, and refreshments provides entertainment and a welcoming atmosphere for participants and spectators. The race is part of the Steinburg Cup and attracts several hundred runners each year, supported by numerous volunteers.
course_highlights: Runs through the scenic Wilstermarsch
Stadium laps for children, with enthusiastic support from spectators
5 km loop through Nortorf and Wilster, featuring a varied course
additional: The Wilstermarschlauf includes several races for different age groups and distances, including children’s races from 400 m, a 2 km children’s race, 5 km and 10 km races, and 5 km walking. There is an extensive program featuring bouncy cushions, a DJ, a barbecue stand, refreshments, and a photo wall. Around 40 volunteers support the event, which is part of the Steinburg Cup. Prizes and vouchers are raffled among participants, and the 33rd women to finish receive anniversary gifts. Registration is planned for spring 2026. The event is part of the Steinburg Cup and offers a family-friendly day with entertainment for everyone involved.

name: Wutzseelauf
description: The Wutzseelauf in Lindow (Mark) is a family-friendly public race, taking place for the 21st time on September 19, 2026. The varied courses run around Lake Wutzsee through Stechlin-Ruppiner Land Nature Park and offer running opportunities for all age groups, from Bambinis to experienced runners. The event is known for its welcoming atmosphere, professional chip timing and varied supporting program. Participants can look forward to distances from 600 meters to 22 kilometers, including Nordic walking. Award ceremonies take place after the races, and every finisher receives a certificate to download or have printed on site.
course_highlights: Courses around Lake Wutzsee in Stechlin-Ruppiner Land Nature Park
Distances from 600 m to 22 km for all age groups
Varied routes with forest and lakeside sections
additional: Timing is provided by myRacePartner using transponders integrated into the race bibs. Late entries can be made online on race day up to 10 minutes before the respective start, except for the Bambini races, which have no late-entry fee. Award ceremonies take place shortly after the races. Every finisher can download their certificate online or have it printed on site. Course profiles for children, youths and adults, online registration, race bibs with transponders, various distances, routes through the forest and around Lake Wutzsee

name: Arberland Ultratrail
location: Hohenzollern Skistadion, Großer Arbersee, Bayerischer Wald, Bavaria, Germany
description: The ARBERLAND Ultra Trail on 19 September 2026 offers trail running in one of the most beautiful areas of the Bavarian Forest. The course winds through autumn forests with colourful foliage, over peaks with breathtaking distant views, and finishes at the Hohenzollern ski stadium at the Großer Arbersee. The event has established itself as a popular end-of-season race for the trail-running scene, known for its relaxed atmosphere, welcoming volunteers and great trails. It is organised by Woidläufer e. V., whose members can also offer advice on the best trails in ARBERLAND.
course_highlights: Autumn woodland with colourful foliage and soft light
Breathtaking distant views across the Bavarian Forest and Alpine peaks
Varied trails with tough climbs and technically demanding descents
additional: The ARBERLAND Ultra Trail offers distances of 100 km, 66 km, 45 km and 20 km. The event takes place in autumn at the Hohenzollern ski stadium at the Großer Arbersee and is a popular end-of-season race for trail runners. The organisers are a small group of athletes and former athletes (Woidläufer e. V.) who also offer tips on the best trails in ARBERLAND. Distances from 20 km to 100 km; start at the Hohenzollern ski stadium; autumn event; trails in the Bavarian Forest; participation prizes, finisher medals, refreshments and recovery facilities.

name: 17. PKO Bytomski Półmaraton
organizer: Klub MKS MOSM Bytom, Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Bytomiu, Centrum Handlowe Plejada
description: The 17th PKO Bytom Half Marathon is an event promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing together the local community of Bytom and the surrounding area. The race takes place on a certified, fully asphalt 21.097 km course consisting of a single loop. The start and finish are located at G City Plejada Shopping Centre in Bytom. Participants can expect refreshment and water stations, as well as pacemakers. After the race, they can personalize their medal by having their result engraved.
course_highlights: A certified PZLA half-marathon course, one loop and 21.097 km long
100% asphalt surface, with markings every 1 km
Refreshment and water stations along the course; 3-hour time limit
additional: After the race, participants can personalize their medal with their result engraved (cost: 25 zł). Pacemakers wearing balloons and special shirts will be on the course. The half-marathon time limit is 3 hours. After that, runners must stop and travel to the finish in a minibus marked KONIEC PÓŁMARATONU. A group warm-up is scheduled for 9:45. An activity zone is available for children. The event attracts over 1,200 participants each year and offers personalized medals, a 3-hour time limit, and activities for children. Registration is available online and at the race office.

name: PKO Wieczorny Półmaraton Łódź
description: The PKO Łódź Evening Half Marathon is a new, atmospheric running event held in the centre of Łódź. The start and finish are located at the revitalised EC1 combined heat and power plant, which is now a cultural and science centre. The 21.097 km course passes through the city’s best-known landmarks, bringing together its industrial history and modern character. This is a race where it’s not just the result that matters, but also the unique atmosphere and energy of the city.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the revitalised EC1 combined heat and power plant
The course passes through Łódź’s best-known landmarks
An evening road race in the city centre
additional: The participant limit is 5,000. The race pack includes a commemorative drawstring backpack, and everyone who finishes the race receives a medal. An official SMMASH technical shirt is available to purchase. Discounts are available to PKO Bank Polski customers paying online. Registration opened one week before the event. The course includes key locations in Łódź.

name: 44 Strzeliński Rogaining
location: Wzgórza Strzelińskie, Strzelin, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Polskie Towarzystwo Turystyczno-Krajoznawcze Oddział Ziemi Strzelińskiej
description: Strzeliński Rogaining is an orienteering foot rally organized by the Polish Tourist and Sightseeing Society, Strzelin Land Branch, since 1996. Teams of 2–5 plan their own route, aiming to visit as many checkpoints as possible within the allotted time. The checkpoints have different point values, so success calls for both navigation skills and strategy. The event is open to participants of different ages and ability levels, making it an appealing activity for enthusiasts and families alike. It takes place in the scenic Strzelin Hills, offering a chance to enjoy nature and spend time actively outdoors.
course_highlights: The varied checkpoints of the Strzelin Hills
A route of any chosen length, from approximately 5 km to 70 km, planned by each team
Foot navigation using a map and compass
additional: Teams of 2–5 plan their route independently and may change it during the competition. Checkpoints have different point values depending on how difficult they are to find. The competition is open to everyone, regardless of age or gender, and results are divided into age and gender categories. Routes range from 6 to 70 km, with the option to register and plan a route before the start. The event takes place in the Strzelin Hills, among forests and varied terrain.

name: Gontyniec Celtic Trail
location: Gontyniec, Chodzież, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Gontyniec Celtic Trail is a unique reverse-format race, lasting 6 or 12 hours on loops of approximately 10 km through the picturesque Gontyniec Massif. Competitors cover the greatest distance they can, with well-stocked aid stations available after every loop. The course offers changing scenery at different times of day, with beautiful views of the Noteć Valley and unique natural and cultural attractions, such as beehives shaped like ancient gods. It is a unique experience for runners seeking a challenge and unforgettable impressions.
course_highlights: Non-stop race on loops of approximately 10 km
Aid station for competitors after every loop
Views of the Noteć Valley and unique figurative beehives along the course
additional: The race lasts 6 or 12 hours non-stop. The course consists of loops of approximately 10 km. An aid station is available after every loop. Competitors can choose the 6- or 12-hour option. The course runs through the Gontyniec Massif, with scenic views and natural attractions. Trail, mountain and forest paths; participant limit of 150 in each race; preparation period of 8 to 20 weeks.

name: Run in Sopot IV - Opera Leśna
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sopocie

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 5 km - mieszkańcy Sopotu posiadający Kartę Sopocką

description: Run in Sopot Opera Leśna is a 5 km race taking place on September 19, 2026, in Sopot. The start and finish are located in the parking lot by the Forest Opera, and the course runs through the picturesque surroundings.
