description: The PSD Bank Half Marathon in Hamburg is a fast, flat running event through the Wandsbek district, taking runners as far north as Berne U-Bahn station. The route heads back via Rahlstedt and Tonndorf to the start and finish area on Wandsbeker Marktstraße. The race is known for its unique atmosphere, with support from spectators and live bands along the course, and takes place in late summer at dusk.
course_highlights: Fast, flat course through the Wandsbek district
Northernmost point at Berne U-Bahn station
Strong support from spectators and bands along the course
additional: Bag drop on race day from 08:30 to 13:30 at Wandsbeker Wochenmarkt. The start and finish are on Wandsbeker Marktstraße in front of Quarree shopping centre. Race pack collection takes place on 19 and 20 September 2026. Services include medical emergency care, a closed and secured race course, and a finisher’s medal. Results and personalised certificates are available online. The event also includes the Köhlbrandbrückenlauf and offers detailed information about the course, registration, and results.

name: 14. Northeimer Tageslicht Ultra
description: The Northeim Daylight Ultra is a challenging ultramarathon held in Northeim. The route passes through varied terrain and offers a special challenge for experienced ultrarunners. The event has a long tradition, with numerous finishers and records underscoring the race’s high quality and sporting demands. Participants can download the route’s GPX track to prepare optimally.
course_highlights: A long ultramarathon distance of over 100 km
Varied terrain with a daylight-running character
Course records of over 125 km (men) and 104 km (women)
additional: The route’s GPX track can be downloaded. The event has a long history, with finisher numbers and course records. The pages do not provide explicit prices or start times. The event takes place twice a year, in March and September, and has been held multiple times since 2018. The routes are available as GPX files, making preparation easier.

name: 21. Fun-Run
description: The 21st Maisel’s FunRun takes place on 10 May 2026 in Bayreuth and is a fixture on the regional running calendar. The event attracts more than 4,000 running enthusiasts each year, from beginners to ambitious athletes. Various distances are offered for adults, including a half marathon, quarter marathon and 5 km run, as well as several children’s races with no entry fee. The finish takes runners straight onto the festival grounds of Maisel’s Weissbierfest, where they can celebrate with live music and freshly tapped Maisel’s Weisse. The varied, mostly flat course passes some of Bayreuth’s most beautiful spots and creates a fantastic atmosphere.
course_highlights: Varied, mostly flat course through Bayreuth
Finish directly on the festival grounds of Maisel’s Weissbierfest
Atmospheric race with enthusiastic cheers and live music
additional: Race packs are sent by post in advance. An official FunRun shirt from Bayreuth sports brand CEP’s collection can be purchased as an optional extra. There is no entry fee for the children’s races (U12, U10, U8, U6). The FunRun is part of Maisel’s Weissbierfest, which takes place from 7 to 10 May 2026. Distances: half marathon, quarter marathon, 5 km; children’s races (U12, U10, U8, U6); early-bird discount until 6 December 2025; start in Bayreuth; flat, varied course; part of the Weissbierfest.

name: 28. Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf
description: The 28th Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf is a friendly running event organized by the running group of Sportverein Eintracht Hiddestorf. The event offers courses of 1.4 km, 5.2 km, 10.1 km and the Hemmingen Half Marathon (21.3 km). Alongside the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a legendary runners’ breakfast, cake, waffles, grilled food and drinks, as well as a varied program including face painting for children. The event is open to all runners; club membership is not required.
course_highlights: Distances from 1.4 km to 21.3 km (half marathon)
Start and finish at the SVE Hiddestorf sports field
Friendly atmosphere with a runners’ breakfast and food and refreshments
additional: Race numbers and chips will be issued on event day from 7:00 a.m. Timing is by chip; chips must be returned after the race. A free Möhrrchenlauf (500 m) for children up to 6 years old is offered, with no registration or entry fee required. Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports club/tennis club facilities close to the start and finish. Parking is limited, with parking areas no more than 500 m away on foot. Late entries are possible online only, until the registration deadline. The runners’ breakfast is free for all participants and includes cheese, salami, baguette and red wine (for those aged 18 and over). Distances: 1.4 km, 5.2 km, 10.1 km and 21.3 km; online registration; the event takes place at the sports field in Hiddestorf; parking is limited.

name: 8. Altstadtlauf Salzwedel
description: The Altstadtlauf Salzwedel is part of the Elbe-Ohre-Cup and will take place for the eighth time in 2026. The course runs through the historic old town of Salzwedel on a 5 km loop. The longer distances, 10 km and half marathon, are run over multiple laps accordingly. The event is organized by Sportclub Demker ´95 e.V. and offers runners in northern Saxony-Anhalt an attractive racing opportunity.
course_highlights: Loop through the historic old town of Salzwedel
5 km loop as the basis for all distances
Longer distances (10 km, half marathon) run over multiple laps
additional: The event recorded 223 finishers in 2023 and offers running opportunities for all age groups, including Bambini and youth races.

name: Gau-Algesheimer Alagastaluf
location: Sportpark Binger Straße, Gau-Algesheim, Rheinland-Pfalz, Germany
description: The Gau-Algesheim Alagastaluf is a traditional fun run that has been held in Gau-Algesheim since the 1980s. The event follows field paths and roads around Binger Straße and through Gau-Algesheim’s old town. The run offers a sporting challenge in beautiful autumn surroundings and is suitable for runners of all ages. It is organized by SV 1910 Gau-Algesheim e.V. – Athletics Department and takes place annually in autumn.
course_highlights: The route passes through Gau-Algesheim’s old town
The run follows field paths and roads around Binger Straße
A traditional autumn fun run with a long history
additional: The start and finish are at Sportpark Binger Straße. The event is organized by SV 1910 Gau-Algesheim e.V. – Athletics Department. Training sessions are held on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Recaps and galleries of past runs are available on the website. Terrain details are not specified; registration is expected; the event takes place at Sportpark Binger Straße.

name: Insellauf mit HM, 10km, 3x7km Staffel und Kinderläufen
description: The Reichenau Island Run is a traditional running event held annually in September on Reichenau Island. Various distances are offered, including a half marathon, a 10 km run, a 3 x 7 km relay, and children’s and youth races. The routes follow varied and scenic paths around the island. The Island Run attracts numerous runners of all ages and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with a wide range of running options.
course_highlights: Half-marathon and 10 km routes around Reichenau Island
3 x 7 km relay featuring special relay handovers
Children’s and youth races with distances suited to young runners
additional: The Island Run takes place at the Baurenhorn sports field in Reichenau. The schedule includes various races, including children’s and youth races. The event is organized by Sportverein Reichenau 1920 e. V., with Michael Rick listed as the contact person. The event has a long tradition, with over 800 participants the previous year. The relay is 3 x 7 km and features special relay handovers. Distances: half marathon, 10 km, 3 x 7 km relay, youth race (1.6 km), children’s race (0.9 km). Start and finish are at the Baurenhorn sports field. September weather is usually mild and cloudy, around 19°C.

name: Karlsfelder Seelauf
description: The Karlsfeld Lake Run is a long-standing running event held at Lake Karlsfeld. It offers an attractive course in a natural setting and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. The event is organized by TSV Eintracht Karlsfeld and will take place for the 47th time in 2026. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event with a friendly, family atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course around Lake Karlsfeld
Natural and varied running environment
Suitable for runners of all ages
additional: The Lake Run is organized by TSV Eintracht Karlsfeld. The event is part of the athletics department’s competition program. Further details about registration and the race announcement are available on the official website. Courses are suitable for personal-best times and officially measured, with refreshments along the course and at the finish, pacers, results services, and registration at the stadium.

name: Uentroper Geithelauf
description: The 24th Uentroper Geithelauf takes place on September 20, 2026, and takes runners through the green heart of Uentrop. The event is organized by Turn- und Sportverein 46/68 Uentrop e.V. and offers a sporting community in a natural setting. The routes pass through fields and forest paths in the surrounding area and are suitable for a range of fitness levels. The event emphasizes fun, community, and a welcoming atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Routes through the green heart of Uentrop
Scenic paths through fields and forests
Suitable for a range of fitness levels
additional: The running groups are divided so that no one is overwhelmed and everyone can find their own pace. Experienced instructors support participants with technique and preparation. The event encourages flexibility and the enjoyment of running as a group. Run through the green heart of Uentrop. Date: September 20, 2026

name: Baden-Marathon Karlsruhe
description: The Baden-Marathon Karlsruhe on September 20, 2026, offers a varied running experience with a marathon, half marathon, team marathon, health run, inclusion run, and mini marathon for children. The flat, fast course runs through the city center, past Karlsruhe Palace and through Citypark Ost, with an atmospheric finish in the Carl-Kaufmann-Stadion. A special feature is the option to have Marathon Angels accompany runners over the final 4 kilometers, making the race a shared experience. Attractive shorter distances for beginners and families put the fun of running first.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course through Karlsruhe with views of the palace and Citypark Ost
Finish in the Carl-Kaufmann-Stadion with comprehensive runner support
The marathon cutoff at km 20.5 allows runners to switch from the marathon to the half marathon
additional: All registration fees include €3.50 for mailing the race bibs, which are sent exclusively by post. School pupils, apprentices, and students receive a 10% discount. Marathon Angels can accompany runners over the final 4 kilometers of the marathon course. The course has been measured and approved in accordance with DLV guidelines. There is a marathon cutoff at km 20.5, where marathon runners can switch to the half-marathon classification without changing their registration. Course map, measurement in accordance with DLV guidelines, several marathon cutoffs, stadium finish, including art and body-painting events

name: CANOSSA Benefiz Berglauf
location: Burgberg, Bad Harzburg, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The CANOSSA Charity Mountain Run® in Bad Harzburg is a challenging charity run through the Harz National Park, taking place on September 20, 2026. Participants can complete the course running, walking or hiking; it ends at the CANOSSA Column on Burgberg. The event supports inclusive work with children and young people in the Goslar district and combines a sporting challenge with social commitment. After the run, participants can enjoy a festive post-race event with music, refreshments and an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: The course passes through a protected area in the Harz National Park
Highest point at Luisenbank above the Eckertalsperre (12 km course)
Wonderful views of the Brocken and mixed forests from the level hillside path
additional: Race bibs are available from 8:30 a.m. upon submission of a signed liability waiver. Two courses: 12 km run (starts at 10:00 a.m.) for runners aged 16 and over, and 6 km run (starts at 10:30 a.m.) for runners, walkers and hikers aged 10 and over. There are no course signs due to nature conservation requirements; participants can navigate using course marshals and Harz Club information signs. After the run, there will be music and refreshments on Burgberg, followed by an awards ceremony at around 12:00 p.m., with a unique indulgence certificate for all participants. It is possible to take the gondola up in exchange for a donation of at least 30 euros. The cable car’s last descent is at 6:00 p.m. The event is open to runners, walkers and hikers aged 10 and over. There are no course signs, only markers, and the event promotes environmental protection by asking participants not to leave any waste in nature. The event concludes with a program including music and refreshments on Burgberg.

name: CEB-Saarwiesenlauf
description: The CEB-Saarwiesenlauf is a running event in Hilbringen near Merzig, organized by Christliche Erwachsenenbildung in Hilbringen together with Sparkasse Merzig-Wadern and Leichtathletikverein Merzig. Despite difficult weather conditions, almost 500 runners and 16 relay teams took part in a previous edition, reflecting strong community involvement. The race offers several distances and allows both individual and relay participation, making it appealing to runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: Distances: 1.8 km, 5 km and 10 km
Start in Merzig, with varied running speeds
Event with strong local and community participation
additional: The race takes place in typical September weather, with an average temperature of 19 °C (minimum 10 °C) and mostly cloudy skies. The course is easily accessible by car. Competitions for children and young people, relay races, and participation for school students. September weather is usually around 19 °C.

name: Citylauf Leer
description: The Citylauf Leer is a traditional running event taking place on September 20, 2026, in downtown Leer at Denkmalsplatz. The event offers races for various age groups and distances, including Bambino, Teeny, 5 km, and 10 km races. The course follows closed circuits through the town center, with refreshment stations along the course and in the finish area. All participants receive a T-shirt (while supplies last), and attractive prizes and certificates are awarded to the top runners. The event offers individual and team classifications and takes place in all weather conditions.
course_highlights: Closed 2.5 km circuit (green) through the town center for the 5 km and 10 km races
Closed 1.1 km circuit (yellow) for the Bambino and Teeny races
Refreshment stations along the course and in the finish area at Denkmalsplatz
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Denkmalsplatz on event day from 10:00. Late registrations are accepted on event day from 10:00 until 45 minutes before the respective start. Each participant receives a T-shirt in exchange for returning their race bib, while supplies last. The top three finishers in each race receive prizes/vouchers and a certificate/medal. There is a team classification for the 5 km race, with at least 3 runners per team. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Animals are not permitted to participate. Course on a closed circuit through the town center, refreshments along the course, online certificate printing, team classification, race bibs with deposit, no animals permitted.

name: EDITH LÜCKE-Frauenlauf TRIER
description: The EDITH LÜCKE Women’s Run in Trier is a special event, holding its sixth edition on 20 September 2026. The 5-kilometre route is a sightseeing tour through Trier’s Roman history, starting in front of the Imperial Baths and finishing in spectacular style at the Amphitheatre. The run is open to women and girls aged 12 and over, with the focus on enjoying exercise together, regardless of ability. After the run, all participants can celebrate the day with a glass of sparkling wine from a local winery.
course_highlights: 5-kilometre route through the former capital of the Western Roman Empire
Start in front of the Imperial Baths
Finish at the historic Amphitheatre
additional: Race packs will be handed out from 8:00 a.m. in the schoolyard of Friedrich-Wilhelm-Gymnasium. All participants are required to wear the high-quality race T-shirt included in the entry fee. No bib number is needed. The participant bag contains small gifts from the sponsors. The number of participants is limited to 1,000. Open to participants aged 12 and over; includes a race T-shirt and chip timing. Parking is available in Trier. Preparation courses are offered.

name: Eltviller Familienlauf 2026
price_range: kostenfrei bis 12 Euro (je nach Lauf), Jugendliche bis 16 Jahre frei
description: The Eltville Family Run on September 20, 2026, offers a range of distances for all age groups, from Bambini races to a 10 km run. The course runs mostly on paved roads with flat cobblestones and includes a short, gently uphill section. The event is family-friendly and allows both individual and team entries. Race packets can be collected the day before or on race day. Bag storage and toilets are available in the start/finish area. Young people up to 16 years of age can take part in the paid races free of charge, but registration is required.
course_highlights: Run on paved roads with flat cobblestones
Short uphill section (approx. 15 m) over rounded cobblestones
No significant climbs
additional: Race packet pickup and late registration on September 19 from 11:00 to 12:30 in the pedestrian zone at Schwalbacher Straße 2, and on race day from 8:30 at the start/finish area on the Rhine riverbank. Parking at the Rhine riverbank/swimming pool, Kiliansring parking garage (fee applies), and Weinhohle car park (free). Bag storage is available in the start/finish area. Toilets nearby; no showers. Online registration only; payment is required within 5 days. No refunds for DNS. Various race distances (500 m to 10 km); online registration opens in summer 2026. Start/finish area on the Rhine riverbank. Results and certificates available after the race at br-timing.de. Supporting program with food stalls and music.

name: Fürst Carl Seenlandmarathon
description: The Fürst Carl Seenland Marathon takes place on September 19 and 20, 2026, in Pleinfeld on Lake Brombach. The event offers a range of distances, including the marathon, half marathon, relay, fun run, schoolchildren’s run, and Bambini run, on paved and partly asphalted paths. The marathon and half-marathon distances are officially certified by the German Athletics Association (DLV). The event welcomes runners of all ages and offers a varied program with supporting events and refreshments.
course_highlights: Routes on paved, partly asphalted paths
Officially measured and DLV-certified marathon and half-marathon distances
A variety of distances for all ages, from the Bambini run to the marathon relay
additional: Start times and the course closure time are listed in the schedule on the website. On event day, race-pack collection and late registration are available from 07:00 to 11:00. A free training plan with different ability levels is available to download. Bicycle accompaniment is prohibited and will be penalized. The event includes a marathon, half marathon, relay, schoolchildren’s run, and fun run; family activities and opportunities to take part; and scenic routes around Lake Brombach.

name: Grebinlauf
description: The Grebinlauf takes place on Sunday, September 20, 2026, in Grebin and offers varied courses for runners, walkers, children, and relay teams. The event is known for its great atmosphere and a special finish on the Grebin sports field. One highlight is the turnaround point at Grebin Mill, which makes the course unique. Registration is through the Davengo platform.
course_highlights: Varied courses
Special turnaround point at Grebin Mill
Finish on the Grebin sports field
additional: Events: Schmarkrunde / Nordic Walking – 4.5 km; Krümellauf for children – 2.3 km. Registration through Davengo. Events: Schmarkrunde / Nordic Walking (4.5 km), Krümellauf for children (2.3 km). Registration through Davengo.

name: Halbmarathon Altötting
description: The Altötting Half Marathon on September 20, 2026, is one of the fastest nature runs in the world and has been awarded 5 stars by European Athletics. The course is 80% on paved forest paths in the Altötting Forest, and is flat, sheltered from the wind, and has little asphalt. In addition to the half marathon, the event offers a 6 km race and a fun run. Free childcare is available for children aged 5 and over, and numerous bands and music along the course create a lively atmosphere.
course_highlights: 80% of the course is on paved forest paths in the Altötting Forest
Flat, wind-sheltered course with little asphalt; measured and approved by the German Athletics Association (DLV)
Five aid stations along the course and refreshments at the finish
additional: Start and finish at the intersection of Burghauser Str./Traunsteiner Str. Race numbers are non-transferable. Pacemakers are available for 1:30, 1:45, 2:00, 2:15, and 2:30 hours. Changing rooms and showers are available at schools and at the sports field. Free city tour on Saturday, 19.09. at 4 p.m.; advance registration required. Free childcare for children aged 5 and over (advance registration required). Finishers receive a specially designed medal and a personalized certificate online. Free massage in the refreshments area. Forest course, 5 aid stations, childcare, changing rooms, showers, start at 10:00 a.m., course closes at 1:00 p.m.

name: Heidelauf Halle am 20.09.2026
description: The 278th Heidelauf Halle takes place on 20 September 2026 in Halle (Saale) and is organised by SV Halle Triathlon. The event gives runners of different age groups and ability levels the opportunity to take part in a long-established race. The course runs around the Heidebad and offers varied running scenery. Registration is open until race day.
course_highlights: Race around the Heidebad in Halle (Saale)
Various categories for children, youth, adults and masters
Long-established event with over 270 years of history
additional: The registration deadline is race day, 20 September 2026. The organiser is SV Halle Triathlon. The event is classified as a non-stadium event (category 6.5.1). It takes place at Am Heidebad 10 in Halle (Saale). Registration is by email. Various categories are offered for different age groups.

name: Horster Löwenlauf
location: Schloss Horst, Gelsenkirchen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 2nd Horster Löwenlauf takes place on September 20, 2026, around Schloss Horst in Gelsenkirchen. This sporting event offers a lively, welcoming atmosphere for all age groups, with refreshments and entertainment in the castle park. Following the great success of the inaugural event, the race is once again being organized as a sporting highlight for the Horst district. The event takes place on World Children’s Day, which is considered especially fitting.
course_highlights: Race around Schloss Horst and the former racecourse
Event in the castle park with refreshments and entertainment
Community sporting event for all age groups
additional: Regular registration is open until September 11, 2026; late registration is available until September 18, 2026, for an additional fee. A race shirt can be added as an option (design to follow). The event is expected to run until approximately 2:00 p.m. It also includes children’s and Bambini races, with a particular focus on families and community. Online registration is available.

name: Hörnle Berglauf Bad Kohlgrub
description: The Hörnle Mountain Run in Bad Kohlgrub is a traditional annual race that takes runners up the local mountain, Hörnle. The event features a challenging course with impressive views and a sporting challenge for mountain-running enthusiasts. The race takes place in September and attracts participants from both the region and further afield. The Skiclub Bad Kohlgrub organizes the event with great commitment and offers a friendly, family atmosphere.
course_highlights: Mountain run up the local mountain, Hörnle
Challenging climb and varied terrain
Panoramic views over Bad Kohlgrub and the Ammergau Alps
additional: The Hörnle Run traditionally takes place on September 19 at 3:00 p.m., starting at Bad Kohlgrub Town Hall. The event is organized by the Skiclub Bad Kohlgrub. No prices are explicitly listed on the website, but online registration is available via the specified URL. The event is part of a sports program that includes other races such as the Schlucht Run. Held as part of the 2021 German Mountain Running Championships; course details and hygiene plans are available. Descents on the Hörnle cable car are possible until 5:00 p.m.

name: IWB Laurentiuslauf x Landkreislauf
description: The IWB Laurentiuslauf x Landkreislauf takes place annually in Bobingen. This long-standing running event follows unique trails and enchanting paths through the western forests of Augsburg. Alongside the sporting competition, it supports a vocational training project at Bobingen Middle School, giving participation a social purpose. The event also features a career-orientation rally that gives young people exciting insights into regional vocational training opportunities. The race is part of a lively community of dedicated sponsors and volunteers and is always held on the third Sunday in September.
course_highlights: Run on unique trails and enchanting paths through Augsburg’s western forests
Traditional venue in Bobingen, the birthplace of German fun runs since 1963
Career-orientation rally with an interactive experience course held alongside the race
additional: Participation supports the vocational training project at Bobingen Middle School, and all entry-fee proceeds go directly to the project. A career-orientation rally with stamp stations and a raffle for students in Grade 5 and above takes place alongside the race. The rally is hosted by well-known presenters and offers lots of small prizes, as well as a meet and greet with an FCA player for the whole class. Trail terrain, supports regional education projects, offers a variety of running routes and an extensive supporting program

name: Kemmerner Kuckuckslauf

price_tiers.distance: Mit Eigen läufts - Jugend U16, Kinder U14
Mit Eigen läufts - Kinder U12-U8 männlich
Mit Eigen läufts - Kinder U12-U8 weiblich

description: The Kemmern Cuckoo Run is a traditional running event in the center of Kemmern, taking place for the 16th time on September 20, 2026. Various races are offered for all age groups, including Bambini, student and youth races, a 4 km fun and corporate run, and a 10 km main race. The event is known for fair, sporting competition and a friendly atmosphere with plenty of spectators. Food and refreshments for runners are available at the SC Kemmern sports clubhouse.
course_highlights: Fast road races in the center of Kemmern
Start and finish at Wagner Brewery, Hauptstraße 15
Course marshaling by the Kemmern Volunteer Fire Brigade
additional: Race-number pickup begins at 9:30 a.m. at the sports clubhouse, with ample parking available. Late registration is possible on race day until 1 hour before the respective start, for an additional fee of €4.00. Free fruit and drinks are available at the finish. Showers and changing facilities are available at the sports clubhouse. The awards ceremony takes place approximately 1 hour after the finish at the sports clubhouse. Medical support is provided by Malteser Bamberg. Various race distances, children’s and youth races, fun and corporate runs, 10 km main race, online registration and results, course marshaling by the Volunteer Fire Brigade, medical support by Malteser Bamberg

tiers.description: 10 EUR AK weibl. /männl. Jugend U14 (Jg. 2013-2014), U16 (Jg. 2011-2012); Frauen/Männer in jeweils einer Gesamtwertung.

description: The 10 km of Röthenbach is an event sanctioned by the German Athletics Association (DLV), taking place on 20 September 2026 in Röthenbach a.d.Pegnitz. The event offers various race distances for all age groups, including a fast, flat circuit on a DLV-measured course. Timing is provided by a chip integrated into the race bib, and the event is family-friendly, with races for children and young people. Changing rooms, showers and medical services are available on site, and the venue is easily accessible by public transport.
course_highlights: Fast, flat circuit on a DLV-measured course
1 lap of 1.9 km and three laps of 2.7 km
Timing by a chip integrated into the race bib
additional: Late entries are possible on site from 8:00 until 60 minutes before the start, subject to limited availability; the late-entry fee is EUR 4. Changes to entries can be made by email until the registration deadline of 07.09.2026. Race bibs can be collected on site from 8:00 until 30 minutes before the start. Changing rooms and showers are available in the sports hall area. Medical services are provided by the BRK. Röthenbach Steinberg S-Bahn station is a 5-minute walk away. Roads will be closed during the event; access via Renzenhofer Straße is possible. Registration deadline: 12 September 2026; on-site registration is possible; medical services provided by the BRK; road closures in the event area.

name: Lohelauf
description: The Lohelauf in Wentorf bei Hamburg is a traditional race taking place for the 21st time in 2026. The event offers a range of distances for different age groups and ability levels, including races from 1.5 km to 9 km and a 5 km walking route. The race takes place in the beautiful Wentorfer Lohe conservation area and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and team spirit. On event day, a tent village at the dog park serves as the start and finish area, where participants collect their race numbers and enjoy the event.
course_highlights: Routes through the Wentorfer Lohe conservation area
Various laps from 1.5 km to 9 km depending on age group
Start and finish at the dog park, with a tent village
additional: The Lohelauf takes place on 20.09.2026 from 10:00 to 13:00. On event day, a tent village at the dog park serves as the start and finish area. The event is open to all age groups, with age-appropriate routes. Results and certificates are available online after the race. The Lohelauf offers distances of 1.5 km, 3 km, 6 km, 9 km and 5 km walking. Registration is through RaceResult. On-site amenities include refreshments, bicycle parking, and medals and certificates for all participants. The event regularly attracts numerous runners from the region.

name: Memminger Altstadtlauf
description: The Memmingen Old Town Run is a traditional race through the historic old town of Memmingen. The course is a flat, paved circuit approximately 1 km long, winding through the picturesque old town. The event is open to club, professional, and recreational runners and features professional chip timing using a transponder. The start and finish are on the Market Square, where the awards ceremony also takes place. All participants receive a high-quality towel as a souvenir.
course_highlights: Flat, paved circuit through Memmingen’s old town
One lap is approximately 1 km long
Start and finish on the Market Square
additional: Race bib pickup from 12:30 p.m. on the Market Square. Chip timing using a transponder attached to the race bib. The main race is ranked by net time; other events are ranked by gun time. Changing facilities and showers are available at the Bismarck-Elsbethenschule gym, St. Josefs Kirchplatz 3. Parking is available in the Stadthalle and Krautstraße parking garages. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Awards ceremonies are held on the Market Square from approximately 4:00 p.m. (individual runners) and 4:30 p.m. (company teams). Every participant receives a high-quality towel featuring the event logo as a souvenir. The top three finishers in each age group receive prizes; children receive certificates, and main-race podium finishers receive awards. Team competition for public authorities and company teams in the main race (5 participants per team, mixed male/female). Commentary and music by Andreas Schales of Hitradio RT1. Online registration is open until 16 September; late registration is available for an additional fee. High-quality keepsakes and prizes. The event takes place in all weather conditions.

name: Mommelsteinlauf
description: The Mommelsteinlauf in Floh-Seligenthal, district of Hohleborn, is a family-friendly running event organized by SV 1962 Hohleborn. From the Bambini run and youth and beginner courses to the challenging 32 km trail, every runner and Nordic walker can find a suitable distance. The courses are marked and have aid stations from 8 km onward. The event offers timing with race-number transponders and medical support. Participants can enjoy refreshments and a coffee-and-cake buffet at the finish.
course_highlights: Distances from 500 m to 32 km south of the Rennsteig
Aid stations from 8 km onward (Holzplatz Brotterode, Weinberg intersection, Tennelberg hut)
Up to 1,100 m of elevation gain on the 32 km course
additional: Start times: 09:00 32 km Ausdauerpfad, 09:10 500 m Bambinilauf, 09:30 1 km Fuchstrail, 10:00 4 km youth and beginner run, 10:00 8 km Traditionslauf & Nordic Walking, 10:00 16 km Traditionslauf & Nordic Walking. The finish closes for all distances at 13:30. Services: toilets and showers (limited), changing rooms, medical support, certificate printing and online results, coffee-and-cake buffet, snack service. Registration opens on 1 June 2025; parking available on site, refreshments at aid stations, timing by GO-Timing, various distances for all age groups.

name: Sonneberger Spielzeuglauf
description: The 6th Sonneberg Toy Run and 2nd Company Run will take place on September 20, 2026, in Sonneberg. The event offers several race distances, including the main race, beginner race, Nordic walking, schoolchildren’s race, and Bambini race. All races start at the same time and finish together. In addition to individual rankings, there are special company awards for the company with the most participants and the most creative company, as well as an award for the club with the most participants. The Nordic walking event is timed, but there is no awards ceremony. The event is family-friendly and organized by Leichtathletik Sonneberg e. V.
course_highlights: Several race distances: main race, beginner race, Nordic walking, schoolchildren’s race, and Bambini race
Start and finish at Ernst-Moritz-Arndt-Straße 26 a in Sonneberg
All races start together and finish together
additional: Photos will be taken during the event and published on the website and Facebook page. The company run awards recognize the company with the most participants, the most creative company, and the club with the most participants. Nordic walking is timed, but there is no awards ceremony. Several types of races are offered, including children’s and company races, with awards for companies and clubs. Participation is at the participant’s own risk. Photos will be taken.

name: Sparkassen-Küstenmarathon 26

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Sparkassen Coastal Marathon in Otterndorf is a traditional race on the North Sea coast, taking place on September 20, 2026. The event offers various distances, from a Bambini run for kindergarten children to the classic marathon covering 42.195 km. The routes pass through the historic old town, along the Elbe dike and by the water, providing a varied and scenic running experience. In addition to the marathon, there are half-marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, as well as relay and walking events. The event emphasizes community, endurance and a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Route through the historic old town and along the Elbe dike
Marathon over four laps, combining varied city and countryside scenery
Half-marathon and other distances by the water and on paved paths
additional: The Bambini run is limited to 300 children from daycare centers in the Samtgemeinde Land Hadeln and is non-competitive. There are various age groups and classifications for schoolchildren. The event offers free parking, bag storage, and one hour of free use of the Otterndorf saltwater thermal baths (excluding the sauna) upon presentation of a race bib. There is a Cuxland classification with cash prizes for runners from the district of Cuxhaven. Award ceremonies are held in stages by distance and classification at the Historic Town Hall. The event takes place on the Elbe dike and in Otterndorf’s historic old town, with special categories such as handbikers and walkers. It is a family-friendly event with a strong sense of community.

name: Tübinger Erbe-Lauf
price_range: 34 € bis 58 € je nach Lauf und Nachmeldung
description: The Tübinger Erbe-Lauf is a varied running event in Tübingen’s historic old town, taking place on 20 September 2026. The main race covers 10 kilometres, divided into four laps through the old town and the Umbrisch-Provencalischer Markt. Other events include the 5K, Team Challenge, Junior Run and BG Handbike Challenge. The event offers individual timing, an exclusive finisher’s medal and a unique atmosphere in this picturesque city. Breathable organic cotton running socks are included in the entry fee for all participants.
course_highlights: 4 laps through Tübingen’s old town
Course passes through the Umbrisch-Provencalischer Markt
Closed, record-eligible course with timing
additional: Free organic cotton running socks included in the entry fee (order by 28 June 2026; collect at race-pack collection). Free public transport on event day within the Neckar-Alb-Donau Transport Association area. Baggage storage, refreshments during and after the race, free post-race massage, downloadable certificate. Exclusive finisher’s medal. Late entries online are possible until 2 hours before the start, subject to a €5 late-entry fee and availability of places. Race numbers, medals, refreshments, massage and public transport included; registration closes on 6 September 2026.

name: Uplengener RVB Herbstmarktlauf
location: Raiffeisen-Volksbank, Reetstr. 13, Uplengen, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Uplengener RVB Autumn Market Run takes place on September 20, 2026, in Uplengen, Germany. This long-standing race was first held in 2002 and offers races for children and schoolchildren. The start is at the Raiffeisen-Volksbank car park, Reetstr. 13. The event is ideal for runners of all ages who want to enjoy an autumn running atmosphere.
course_highlights: Distances: 1 km, 6.6 km, and 10 km
Start at the Raiffeisen-Volksbank car park, Reetstr. 13
Typical September weather: around 19 °C and mostly cloudy
additional: Please check the event details with the organiser before registering. Typical September weather: around 19 °C, cloudy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation; ideal for an outdoor autumn run.

name: Weddelbrooker Dorflauf
description: The Weddelbrook Village Run is a traditional race through the village of Weddelbrook and the surrounding countryside. It offers various distances from 900 m to 10 km, so runners of all ages and ability levels can take part. The course passes through scenic areas, including around the lake, and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with many volunteers on site. The race is known for its good organisation and the opportunity to compete with other runners or simply enjoy running.
course_highlights: Course through the village, around the lake and through the surrounding countryside
A variety of distances from 900 m to 10 km
Scenic and varied running routes
additional: The race includes several age and distance categories, including a Bambini run for children aged 3–4 and up. Photos from the race can be requested by email by providing your bib number. The event is supported by many volunteers and takes place annually. It offers various distances, including Bambini and junior races, with results by age group. Photos and further information are available on request.

name: Wilscher FUN-RUN
description: The Wilscher FunRun is a longstanding race that has been held annually since 2005 at the Wilsche sports ground in Gifhorn. It is part of the Gifhorn-Wolfsburg Running Cup and offers an appealing 10 km race. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and strong participation, and is a fixture in the regional running scene. The race starts promptly at 10 a.m., and the event is supported by local organisations such as the fire brigades and the German Red Cross (DRK).
course_highlights: 10 km race as part of the Gifhorn-Wolfsburg Running Cup
Start and finish at the Wilsche sports ground
Fire brigade and DRK participation for safety
additional: The FunRun is part of the Gifhorn-Wolfsburg Running Cup, which has a total of 9 races. The event is supported by the Wilsche and Neubokel fire brigades and a DRK emergency response vehicle. A children’s race and the Wilscher Marathon have been offered as part of Gifhorn Running Day since 2015. The registration link for 2026 will be published later. Start at 10 a.m.; registration is via the organiser’s website, and participation is open to all running enthusiasts.

name: Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf
description: The Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf is a family-friendly running event organized by the running group of Sportverein Eintracht Hiddestorf. It offers distances of 1.4 km, 5.2 km, 10.1 km and the Hemmingen Half Marathon (21.3 km). Alongside the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a legendary runners’ breakfast, cake, waffles, grilled food and drinks, as well as a varied supporting program including face painting for children. The event is particularly suitable for runners of all ages and emphasizes a friendly, welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: Distances from 1.4 km to 21.3 km (half marathon)
Start on Ihmer Straße, with different start times for each distance
Family-friendly atmosphere with a runners’ breakfast and food on offer
additional: The 500 m Möhrchenlauf (start: 9:10 a.m.) and 1.4 km Schülerlauf (start: 9:15 a.m.) are free for children up to age 6 and ages 7–12, respectively. The runners’ breakfast after finishing is free for all participants. Food includes a cake buffet, waffle stand and grilled food at reasonable prices. Team scoring is available, and clubs and teams can register together. Various distances, children’s and youth races, walking; registration is required for some races.

name: Trail Marathon Heidelberg
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: The Trail Marathon Heidelberg is one of Germany’s most extraordinary trail-running events and takes place on September 20, 2026. Under the motto “HERRLICH.HÖHER.HÄRTER” (“GLORIOUS.HIGHER.HARDER”), the race offers challenging and varied courses with plenty of trails, steep climbs and impressive views. The event includes three distances: the Base Trail (20 km), the Half Trail (30 km) and the Heart Core Trail (45 km), with more than 2,000 metres of elevation gain. The route passes, among other places, the Thingstätte, the Philosophenweg, the Heiligenberg and the Königstuhl, offering a unique atmosphere for trail runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 45 km Heart Core Trail with approx. 2,019 metres of elevation gain and challenging trail sections
Course sections along the Philosophenweg and through the Thingstätte and Heiligenberg
Michelsbrunnen Nature Park and the Felsenmeer, with an approx. 8 km loop
additional: The Heart Core Trail crosses the Alte Brücke and passes through the Hirschgasse to the Philosophenweg. The course includes 178 steps at the Thingstätte and a challenging section along the Himmelsleiter, with natural steps, rocky ledges and loose stones. The upper station of the Heidelberg funicular, at an elevation of 567 metres, is a notable point shortly before the steep and dangerous descent to the finish at Karlsplatz. The event offers distances of 20 km, 30 km and 45 km, including a 20 km Base Trail, and is known for its scenic beauty and sporting challenge.

name: 12 Bieg "Król Parku"
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mosinie
description: The 12th “King of the Park” Run is an annual running event organized by the Mosina Sports and Recreation Centre. The competition takes place in the scenic surroundings of the town park, offering participants an appealing course and sporting competition. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, promoting an active lifestyle and community engagement. The organizers provide professional event services and a comprehensive race pack.
course_highlights: The course runs through the town park in Mosina
Scenic surroundings with natural greenery
A well-marked and prepared running course
additional: The event is organized by the Mosina Sports and Recreation Centre. Telephone: +48 61 813 29 03. Detailed information and registration will be available soon. The event is part of the Mosina municipality’s calendar of sports and recreational events. It also includes races for children and young people, with medals and accompanying attractions for participants. The races are part of the Mosina Grand Prix series.

name: 49 Półmaraton Lechitów
description: The 49th Lechitów Half Marathon is Poland’s oldest half marathon, held continuously since 1978. The 21.0975 km race route runs from the Small Open-Air Museum in Ostrów Lednicki to the finish at Saint Adalbert’s Square in Gniezno, recalling the historic journey of Otto III. The race attracts thousands of runners every year and is part of the Polish Half Marathon Crown and the Greater Poland Half Marathon Grand Prix. The organizers provide professional race services, timing and course safety, while participants receive a race pack with a medal and a recovery meal.
course_highlights: Start at the Small Open-Air Museum in Ostrów Lednicki; finish at Saint Adalbert’s Square in Gniezno
A 21.0975 km PZLA-certified route, entirely on asphalt
5 refreshment stations along the route, including water and isotonic drink
additional: The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours and 30 minutes. Timing is provided by chips attached to race bibs. The organizer provides coach transport to the start in Ostrów Lednicki. The race pack includes safety pins for attaching the bib, a medal at the finish and a recovery meal. Registration and race-pack collection take place at the sports hall of II LO in Gniezno on 19 September from 15:00 to 20:00 and on 20 September from 7:00 to 9:00. The participant limit is 2,000; minimum age is 18. Travel by coach or own transport.

name: 6 Półmaraton Aleją Dębów Czerwonych
organizer: Gmina Łęka Opatowska, Gmina Wieruszów, Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Turystyki w Wieruszowie, Spółdzielnia Socjalna Green Service
description: The 6th Red Oaks Avenue Half Marathon is a 21.097 km race taking place on 20 September 2026 in Wieruszów. The event is organised by Łęka Opatowska Municipality, Wieruszów Municipality and the Municipal Sports and Tourism Centre in Wieruszów. The race is open and runner-friendly, with a scenic route along Red Oaks Avenue. The race office will be open on the day of the event from 08:00 to 11:30, and timing will be electronic. The event is supported by local partners and sponsors, and participants can expect professional organisation and attractive race conditions.
course_highlights: A 21.097 km half-marathon route
Scenic Red Oaks Avenue
Electronic timing
additional: The race office is open on 20.09.2026 from 08:00 to 11:30. Organisers: Łęka Opatowska Municipality, Wieruszów Municipality, the Municipal Sports and Tourism Centre in Wieruszów, and Green Service Social Cooperative. Partners: Kępno County and Wieruszów County. Main sponsor: HK Furniture Group. Participants must accept the regulations and consent to the processing of their personal data. A route map and authorisation form for collecting a race pack are available. Entry limit: 434 participants. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. Registration details and regulations are available on the website.

name: 7 H2O Półmaraton
location: ul. Międzyrzecka 3, Wrocław, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 7 H2O Half Marathon is a 21.097 km race taking place on 20 September 2026 in Wrocław. The course is flat and paved, with sections of compacted gravel, and follows a single loop, starting and finishing at 3 Międzyrzecka Street. The event promotes running and physical activity among Wrocław residents, offering participants professional organisation and a friendly atmosphere. The race has a 3-hour time limit and provides hydration points and a post-race recovery meal.
course_highlights: Flat, paved course with approximately 3 km of gravel surface
One loop measuring 21.097 m, certified by the PZLA
Three hydration and refreshment points on the course (5, 10 and 15 km)
additional: The race office is open on race day from 7:00 to 8:30 at the start. Race bibs can also be collected on Saturday at the Decathlon Magnolia store from 12:00 to 20:00. A medal and recovery meal are provided at the finish. A baggage deposit and portable toilets are available by the race office. Overall and age-group classifications; 3-hour time limit for the half marathon. Online registration. The race package includes a bib, water, a meal, a medal and a giveaway. Activities for participants and spectators.

name: Bieg Charytatywny
location: Park przy dworcu kolejowym, Oława, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Oławie, Stowarzyszenie Ludzi Aktywnych „Biegnij Oławo”
description: The CZTERY PORY ROKU Charity Run – Stage IV is a sporting event held in Oława, in the park by the railway station. Participants can take part in a run of approximately 5 km or a Nordic Walking event on the same route. The event is charitable and is coordinated by the „Biegnij Oławo” Association of Active People and the Oława Municipal Office. The race office is open on race day from 09:30 to 10:30, and the event is scheduled to start on December 20, 2026. The event is supported by local partners, and timing is provided by ZmierzymyCzas.pl.
course_highlights: A route of approximately 5 km for both the run and the walk
Located in the park by the railway station in Oława
Option to participate in a Nordic Walking event
additional: The race office is open on race day from 09:30 to 10:30 near the start. Race coordinators: Mariusz Jarosławski (698-025-555) and Mateusz Bularz (721-162-604). Registration for the run is closed. The event takes place in the park by the railway station in Oława, with additional attractions and charity collections.

name: Festiwal Górski Maraton Trzech Jezior
description: The Three Lakes Mountain Marathon Festival is a unique running event in the scenic land of the Beskid lakes, featuring four distances: the 3.5 km Czupel Vertical with 600 m of elevation gain, a 43 km marathon, 21 km, and 17 km. The routes pass through the wild mountain terrain of the Little Beskids, offering participants beautiful views, varied terrain, and a connection with the region’s nature and history. The event brings the running community together and promotes an active lifestyle as well as the area’s tourist and cultural attractions. Races take place from September 18–20, 2026, and the main marathon is an ultramarathon with demanding climbs and technical descents.
course_highlights: The main marathon route is approximately 43 km long, with +/- 2,480 m of elevation change
Views of three lakes and the dam in Tresna, as well as Czupel, the highest peak in the Little Beskids
Varied terrain: punishing climbs, fast traverses, technical descents, and scenic meadows
additional: The festival takes place from September 18–20, 2026. Four distances: Czupel Vertical 3.5 km (starts September 18 at 16:30), Three Lakes Marathon 43 km (starts September 19 at 8:00), Rollercoaster 21 km (starts September 19 at 10:00), and Wołoski Shepherds’ Trail 17 km (starts September 20 at 9:30). The race office is open September 18–20, with hours varying by distance. The marathon route finishes at the stadium in Porąbka. Four distances, mountain routes, scenic views, mountain terrain, sports festival

name: II Bieg Farmera
description: The 2nd Farmer’s Run is a 10 km road race taking place in Police. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course, and participants can use training plans tailored to different experience levels. The organizers provide expert support and detailed training instructions to help runners prepare optimally for the race. This sporting event is aimed at runners who value good organization and the opportunity to improve.
course_highlights: 10 km road course
Scenic areas of Police in the West Pomeranian Voivodeship
Tailored training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks
additional: Training plans are available to suit each runner’s level, along with expert support and the option to use a platform for managing the race’s profile and marketing cooperation. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as local community integration. Participants can count on support and attractions along the course.

name: Prószkowski Bieg Uliczny
organizer: Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Prószkowie
description: The Piotr Blachucik Prószków Street Run is one of the region’s most atmospheric running events, taking place on September 20, 2026, in Prószków. The race offers a dynamic course and sporting excitement, with children’s races held before the main event to encourage activity from an early age. It’s a day full of energy, smiles, and friendly competition, ideal both for runners chasing a result and for anyone looking to spend time actively.
course_highlights: Dynamic street course
Children’s races before the main event
An atmosphere full of sporting excitement and friendly competition
additional: Children’s races promoting participation among the youngest runners take place before the main event. The event is organized by the Culture and Sport Centre in Prószków, and its atmosphere is described as full of energy, smiles, and sporting competition. terrain: street, registration: not provided, notes: children’s races, promotes sport and local activity

name: VII Bieg Pocztyliona
location: Cewice, Gmina Cewice, Powiat lęborski, Pomorskie, Poland
description: The 7th Pocztylion Run is a 10 km race taking place on September 20, 2026, in Cewice, Pomeranian Voivodeship. Runners can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is a great opportunity for runners to test their fitness on a scenic course and enjoy friendly competition.
course_highlights: 10 km distance
Road course in Cewice
Scenic surroundings of Pomerania
additional: Training plans from 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level and including instructions and expert support. Date: 2026-09-20; Location: Cewice, Pomeranian Voivodeship; Distance: 10 km

name: Bešeňovský charitatívny beh pre MAPENZI
organizer: Občianske združenie MAPENZI by Generation of love, Obec Bešeňov
description: The Bešeňov Charity Run for MAPENZI is a running event organized by the civic association MAPENZI by Generation of love and the municipality of Bešeňov. The race takes place at the football field in Bešeňov and offers 10 km and 5 km categories, children’s races, and a 2 km recreational run. The children’s races start at 15:00 and the main race at 16:00. The event is charitable and suitable for the general public, including different age groups.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km routes for men and women in different age categories
Children’s races starting at 15:00
2 km recreational run
additional: The children’s races start at 15:00 and the main race starts at 16:00. The organizers provide contact details for four responsible persons, including their phone numbers. The event is charitable and organized in cooperation with the municipality of Bešeňov. It includes a charity run in support of MAPENZI; registration is available online and on site, and the course passes through the football field in Bešeňov.

organizer: Obec Ruskov and Dobrovoľný hasičský zbor Ruskov

description: The Olšavský Cup – Július Kažimír Memorial is a running race held in the village of Ruskov, in the Košice-okolie District. The race offers two main courses, 16.8 km and 9.7 km long, with the start in front of the Municipal Office. Men, women, and children can compete in various age categories. The organizers are the Municipality of Ruskov and the Ruskov Volunteer Fire Brigade, in cooperation with neighboring villages. The race is suitable for a wide range of participants, including seniors and children, who can enter for free.
course_highlights: Two courses: 16.8 km and 9.7 km
Start in front of the Municipal Office in Ruskov
Categories for men, women, and children by age
additional: Children’s categories start at 13:00 and adults at 14:00. Men over 70, women over 60, and children can enter for free. The race takes place on 20 September 2026; registration is available on site; course conditions are not specified.

description: The AOK Haslach im Kinzigtal Company Run is a team event taking place on 22 September 2026 and is part of the BW-Running series. The event promotes exercise, team spirit and shared experiences in everyday working life. The main race is approximately 5 km long, and there is also a 2 km “Run for Everyone”. After the race, participants can enjoy complimentary refreshments at the finish, and special meeting points are available for teams to experience race day together.
course_highlights: Main race: approximately 5 km
Run for Everyone: approximately 2 km
Nordic walking poles are permitted; participants using them should start at the very back
additional: The main race starts at 18:00, while the Run for Everyone starts at 17:30. Registration is via company registration with a team captain. Late registration is possible until the registration deadline; after that, only changes of participant are permitted. Participants must be at least 16 years old. Accompaniment by cyclists, skaters, dogs or fans is not permitted. Nordic walking poles are allowed, and starting at the very back is recommended. Complimentary finish refreshments are available at all BW-Running series venues. Registration details can be changed up to 30 minutes before the start. Minimum age: 16. Registration via company registration; team and individual registrations are possible. Start times: 17:30 and 18:00.

name: 404. Malá cena Monaka
description: The Small Monaco Race is a traditional running race held in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. It has a long history and is part of the KRB Chrudim club’s running calendar. The race offers a sporting atmosphere and an opportunity to test yourself on an interesting course in beautiful surroundings. It is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels.
course_highlights: A traditional running race with a long history
The course runs in the area around Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region
Organized by KRB Chrudim, a club with a rich running tradition
additional: The race includes courses of various distances, including a half marathon and other races; exact route and registration details are not specified.

description: The Night Run for Světluška in Zlín is a charity running event taking place on 24 September 2026 at Míru Square. The start is at 20:00, and participants can choose a route according to their preference, or walk it. Starter packs are available in two options—with a headlamp or a sports headband. Part of the entry fee goes toward helping people with severe visual impairments, underscoring the event’s charitable purpose. An accompanying program is also planned for all participants.
course_highlights: Choose your route on site—run or walk
Start at Míru Square at 20:00
Starter packs with a headlamp or sports headband
additional: Registration desks are open from 18:00. An entry ticket with a unique code (printed or on a mobile device) is required to enter the venue. Holders of TP, ZTP and ZTP/P cards may enter free of charge with an accompanying person; they can purchase a starter pack on site for 250 Kč. The run’s capacity is limited for participants’ safety and comfort. Details of the accompanying program will be announced later. Route selection at the start; accompanying program; capacity limited for safety

description: Běh okolo Campusu is a running race in Brno, held in the Bohunice area. The race features a 5.6 km course, with men and women competing in a single category. The programme also includes a children’s race for children of any age, with the loop distance determined before the start. The event is friendly and open to all runners, offering the chance to discover interesting places in Brno.
course_highlights: A 5.6 km loop in the University Campus area in Bohunice
Start and finish on Netroufalky Street, with public transport access (bus routes 50, 60, 61 and 69, and trolleybus routes 25 and 37)
Friendly atmosphere, a children’s race and refreshments after the finish
additional: Registration takes place at the race venue from 16:15. The children’s race starts at 16:45 and the main race at 17:00. Water and a tent for storing belongings are available after the finish. Runners participate at their own risk. Parking is available on nearby streets. 5.6 km course, pre-race registration, start in Bohunice, refreshments after the race, public transport, facilities at the venue

name: AOK Firmenlauf Balingen

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 801 bis 2.000 Anmeldungen bzw. bis zum Meldeschluss am 14. September 2026 (18:00 Uhr)

description: The AOK Balingen Company Run is a popular team event taking place on 24 September 2026 at the marketplace in Balingen. The course is approximately 5.9 kilometres long and is run over two laps of about 2.9 km each. The event promotes exercise for everyone and inclusion, enabling people with and without disabilities to take part together. After the run, participants can enjoy complimentary refreshments at the finish and a lively awards ceremony with music. It’s a great opportunity to experience team spirit and add some physical activity to the working day.
course_highlights: Course approx. 5.9 km, two laps of approx. 2.9 km each
Start and finish at the marketplace in Balingen
Inclusive run for all participants
additional: From 17:00, a DJ will set the mood on stage. There will be a group warm-up before the start. After the finish, awards ceremonies and musical entertainment will take place. Finish-line refreshments include alcohol-free Erdinger in three varieties, fruit, vegetables and water. Changes to registrations are free of charge until the registration deadline and subject to a fee thereafter. Minimum age: 16. A run for EVERYONE, a team event, inclusive training and refreshments.

name: Eleven Večerní běh
location: Areál pivovaru VOLT, Jablonec nad Nisou, Czech Republic
price_range: 250 Kč pro dospělé, 100 Kč pro mládež
description: ELEVEN Evening Run is a 5 km night race held in the early evening at the VOLT brewery grounds in Jablonec nad Nisou. The course runs around three reservoirs and is suitable for men, women and young people aged 16 and over, as well as children up to 15. The race offers a sporting atmosphere, chip timing and valuable gifts for the first registered participants. The start and finish are at the brewery grounds, where race numbers can also be collected.
course_highlights: The course runs around three reservoirs
A 5 km night race
Start and finish at the VOLT brewery grounds
additional: The first 50 people to register will receive a sports headband in a special race design. The first 200 registered participants will receive a valuable gift from Dr. Oetker. Race numbers can be collected at the start venue from 18:00 to 19:30. Chip timing is provided by Datacontrol.cz. The race takes place around three lakes. Registration is available online and on site, and prizes are prepared for the best finishers and those who register early.

name: Běh Březinou v Polné
location: Fotbalový stadion v Polná, Polná, Jihlava, Czech Republic

description: Běh Březinou in Polná is a traditional running race organized by Běžecký tým Polná and Běžec Vysočiny z.s., held at the football stadium in Polná. The race offers courses for various age categories, from the youngest children to veterans, with the main race covering 9.5 km along field and forest paths through the valley of the Šlapanka River. The race starts at 17:00, and participants can expect a pleasant atmosphere and commemorative prizes for the top finishers in each category. The race has a long tradition, with more than 39 editions since 1992.
course_highlights: The 9.5 km main course follows field and forest paths through the valley of the Šlapanka River
The asphalt section makes up approximately 30% of the course
The loop passes through the village of Věžnice and returns along forest and field paths
additional: Online registration is open until 12:00 on race day. A CZK 1,000 entry-fee season pass can be used. Runners aged 3 and over may take part. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category, subject to the organizer’s means. Refreshments are available at the clubhouse buffet at the stadium. The race takes place on September 25, 2026. The start and event facilities are in Polná near Jihlava. The routes include various distances and terrain, including the 10.75 km main race and shorter categories.

name: ENTEGA Nightrun
location: Radgelände des Darmstädter Velodroms, Darmstadt, Hesse, Germany
description: The ENTEGA Nightrun on September 25, 2026, is a unique running event on the cycling grounds of the Velodrom in Darmstadt. The course is fully illuminated and offers a varied mix of grass, asphalt, gravel, and hard-packed surfaces. With distances of 1.6 km (students’ run), 2.5 km, 5 km, and 7.5 km, there is something for runners of all ages and ability levels. The special atmosphere at dusk and the energetic presence of fellow runners make this an unforgettable experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Illuminated circuit around the cycling track grounds
Varied surfaces: grass, asphalt, gravel, and hard-packed ground
Atmospheric run at dusk with dazzling lights
additional: Race-number collection on the day of the event from 17:30 in the hall. Every participant receives a finisher’s medal. Shoes with spikes are not allowed. Water and regional products from Alnatura will be provided. Medical services will be available on the course and at the finish. Parking is available on the tennis grounds next to the event site. Valuables can be handed in at the hall for a fee of €1. No showers are provided. Course on grass, asphalt, and gravel; shoes with spikes not allowed; parking at the TGB tennis grounds; no showers; medical services available.

name: Nachtlauf über 7 Meilen und 30. Jedermannlauf über 3,1 Meilen (5 km)
description: The Zonser Night Run offers two exciting races: the 7-mile race and the 5 km fun run. The event takes place in Dormagen-Zons and is known for its unique nighttime atmosphere. The course runs through the historic old town, giving runners a special experience. The race is open to all ages and ability levels and is a popular event in the region.
course_highlights: 7 miles (approx. 11.3 km) through the historic old town of Zons
5 km fun run as a shorter option
Night run with a special atmosphere and lighting
additional: No late registration is possible. The event takes place in the historic old town of Zons. There is an accompanying program and an awards ceremony. Parking and travel information are available on the website. The race takes place at night and offers a special atmosphere. Late registration is not possible. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and offers a great opportunity to experience the historic surroundings.

name: Schülerlauf
location: Wymeer, Landkreis Cloppenburg, Lower Saxony, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
