description: The Rüppurr Schools’ Student Race is a traditional annual running competition that brings together students from several schools in Karlsruhe. The event has separate classifications for girls and boys, and all participants receive certificates and medals. Prizes are awarded to the first three finishers. Registration is through the schools, and late registration is available on the day of the event. The race takes place around the TUS Rüppurr club grounds and promotes youth sport in the region.
course_highlights: Each course is marked with a different colour
Separate classifications for girls and boys
Preparation runs before the main event
additional: Late registration is possible on the day of the event from 15:00 to 15:30 in the gymnastics room at the TUS clubhouse. Registration is through the schools. Students under 16 need the signatures of both legal guardians to register late. Courses are marked by colour; there are separate classifications for girls and boys; all participants receive certificates and medals; prizes go to the first three finishers; late registration is available on the day of the event.

name: Beh Tokajskými vinicami
location: Oddychové centrum, Čerhov, Trebišov District, Slovakia
description: The Run Through the Tokaj Vineyards is a traditional running race held in the village of Čerhov in the Trebišov District. The course winds through the picturesque Tokaj vineyards, offering beautiful natural scenery and a pleasant setting for runners of all ages. The event is suitable for both amateur and experienced runners who want to enjoy a day of sport outdoors and discover the unique Tokaj region. It is organized by the municipality of Čerhov, which ensures a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Tokaj vineyards, with beautiful views
Natural surroundings with moderate elevation gain
A combination of paved and forest roads
additional: The event takes place at the Recreation Centre in Čerhov. A course map is available on the municipality’s website. No specific start times or wave assignments are provided. Registration information is available on a separate page. No entry fees or race categories are listed.

name: Mělnický vinařský běh
location: Mělník, Mělník District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Mělník Wine Run is a traditional running race in Mělník, offering 10 km and 21 km courses. The race takes place on a single loop with beautiful views of the castle and vineyards, and the route passes historical and natural landmarks around the town. After the race, participants can enjoy a tasting of local wines, a commemorative glass, a free lunch, and a prize raffle. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own races free of charge. It is organized by the Run the World association, which promotes running as a friendly community activity.
course_highlights: The route passes Mělník Castle and vineyards, with views of the Vltava River
The loop includes crossing the lock and running through Hořín Park
On-course refreshment stations, including a turnaround point near Vrbno
additional: Registration and changes are not possible on race day. Race bibs can only be collected until 9:30. After the race, every participant receives a commemorative glass and can take part in a tasting of local wines. Lunch is free for all runners, including a vegetarian option. A prize raffle will take place after the winners are announced. The race capacity is 500 runners for the 10 km and 21 km courses. Children’s races are free of charge. Entry fees vary depending on the registration date. The event supports charitable causes helping people with cystic fibrosis, and the race is limited to 500 runners.

name: Grymovská pětka
description: Grymovská pětka is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, offering athletes the chance to test their abilities in the pleasant surroundings of the town of Grymov. Liga stovkařů Olomouc is a club specializing in recreational and competitive running that organizes a number of endurance races in the Olomouc Region. The race is part of its running calendar and attracts runners of different ages and ability levels. The club also supports runners with training and race preparation, helping to ensure a high-quality sporting experience.
course_highlights: Road course in a beautiful sports complex by the Bečva River
An opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners
Part of the Grand Prix of Endurance Runners of the Olomouc Region
additional: The race takes place on 26 September 2026. The course is adapted to different ability levels; exact registration information is not provided.

name: Běh Bohutínem
location: Fotbalové hřiště Litavan, Bohutín, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 CZK pro dospělé, 20 CZK pro děti
description: Běh Bohutínem is a traditional running race organized by SK Sporting Bohutín, held at the Litavan football pitch. The race offers an 8 km course for men and a 4 km course for women, with a surface combining asphalt and forest trails. The event also includes children’s races, making it suitable for a wide range of runners. The main race starts at 13:00, and the atmosphere is friendly and sporty.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt and forest trails
Men run 8 km; women run 4 km
Start and finish at the Litavan football pitch
additional: Children’s races are part of the event. The course is GPS-measured at 4.88 km; according to the race details, men run 8 km and women 4 km. Results are regularly published in the system and as a PDF. The organizer offers neoprene chip straps for purchase for 100 Kč. The race starts at the Litavan football pitch at 13:00. The event also includes children’s races and running in a natural setting, with asphalt and forest sections.

name: Běh Zlínského kraje
location: Baťovský areál, Zlín, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Zlín Region Run is part of the celebrations for Zlín Region Day, taking place on 26 September 2026 in Zlín. The event offers not only a sporting experience in the form of a 6 km run, but also a cultural program, regional cuisine, and family activities. The run is open to the general public and is part of a full day of entertainment, crafts, and regional products. The organizer is the Zlín Region, which supports sport and local traditions through the event.
course_highlights: The course follows a closed asphalt loop in the Baťa industrial complex
The day also includes a children’s run and other sporting activities
The program features regional cuisine, crafts, and cultural performances
additional: Regional cuisine, running, sports and cultural program, family activities, regional products

name: Běh Velké skály
description: Běh Velké skály is a traditional running race held in Děčín, offering 11 km and 6.5 km courses through forest and urban terrain. The race is part of the Děčín Running Cup and is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children, who have special races prepared for them. The start is at the ASK Děčín athletics stadium, and the race atmosphere is enhanced by the beautiful natural surroundings and rock formations. The event is now in its 56th edition and is known for its exceptional atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: Forest and urban terrain
11 km and 6.5 km courses
Start and finish at the ASK Děčín athletics stadium
additional: Registration is available online at www.nazavody.cz until midnight on 23. 9. 2026. The entry fee must be paid in advance to receive the lower price; on-site payment is available at a higher price. The race office accepts late registrations up to 30 minutes before the start of each category. The course covers forest and urban terrain. Registration is via www.nazavody.cz. Children’s races and relay races are held, and the main race is part of the Děčín Running Cup.

name: Plzeňský kardioběh
description: The Plzeň Cardiovascular Run is the largest cross-country race in Plzeň, with 5.8 km and 10 km courses. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Youth Running Cup and also serves as the Czech Republic Cross-Country Championship for healthcare professionals. It is organized by Pro Sport Activities, an agency with a long-standing tradition of organizing sporting events in Plzeň and the surrounding area. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a quality sporting experience in the natural surroundings of Plzeň-Roudná.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in Plzeň-Roudná
Two courses: 5.8 km and 10 km
Czech Republic Cross-Country Championship for healthcare professionals
additional: The races include cross-country and asphalt routes. There are children’s races and an accompanying program with activities. Registration is through Apachi, and parking is available at Rychtářka.

name: KEEN Prague Park Race – Konopiště
description: KEEN Prague Park Race - Konopiště is a running race held in the beautiful natural surroundings of Konopiště, offering a unique running experience in the picturesque Central Bohemian Region. The course runs along both paved and unpaved paths and combines natural scenery with historic sites. The race is part of the Prague Park Race series, known for its relaxed atmosphere and high-quality organization. Runners of all levels are welcome to take on a sporting challenge close to nature.
course_highlights: The course runs along paved and unpaved paths in the natural surroundings of Konopiště
A combination of natural scenery and historic sites
A friendly atmosphere and well-organized race
additional: Choose between an 8 km or 14 km course, with the option to change your distance before race day. The longer course has a refreshment station at approximately 8 km, and refreshments are also available at the finish. The race is part of the Prague Park Race series, which includes pre-race group runs. Registration is through irontime.cz; payment must be made within three days of registering. The event includes a children’s race, on-site registration, parking nearby, and a detailed schedule on the website. The event also features test runs and presentations of KEEN running shoes.

name: 7 pohoří Beskydy
location: Ski Areál Severák, Trojanovice, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Trail Run Series 7 Mountain Ranges is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The Beskydy race takes place in the amphitheatre at Horečky in Trojanovice and offers technical trails, epic views and an atmosphere you won’t experience anywhere else. The routes follow forest roads and paths, with climbs up interesting hills and long descents. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and can look forward to refreshments and professional facilities.
course_highlights: Technical trails with 1,230 m of elevation gain on the main 23 km course
Routes follow forest roads and paths, with climbs up interesting hills
Beautiful views and an atmosphere in the amphitheatre at Horečky in Trojanovice
additional: The race time limit is 4 hours; after that, a runner is marked as DNF. Participants can leave small items at the registration booth. Recommended gear includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Záchranka app. The entry fee includes chip timing, refreshments on the course and at the finish, and a commemorative medal. The races take place at Ski Areál Severák in Trojanovice. Registration includes a race bib, chip timing, a medal, refreshments and facilities. The time limit is 4 hours.

name: ŠumpeRUN
description: ŠumpeRUN is a popular urban running race held through the historic centre of Šumperk. The eighth edition will offer races for the general public, including the 10 km main race, a 3.33 km race, relay races for teams of three, and children’s races over various distances. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and community spirit while celebrating the city’s cultural heritage. For 2026, a varied programme of activities is planned, including group warm-ups and music along the course.
course_highlights: The course runs through Šumperk’s historic centre, its urban conservation area, pedestrian zones and parks
The 10 km main race consists of three 3.33 km laps, with approximately 60 m of total elevation gain
Children’s races take place in Sady 1. máje Park, with distances from 100 m to 2 km depending on age
additional: Registration opens on 1 June 2026. Entry to the children’s races is free. Group warm-ups led by professional instructors will take place before the children’s races (10:30) and the adult races (14:00). There will be music along the course from a DJ or live band. The start and finish are at Svobody Square, near Hotel PERK and the Business Academy. Capacity is 350 runners for the main race, 100 runners for the 3 km race, 50 relay teams and 100 children in each age category. The event is aimed at the general public, offers a range of categories and makes results available online. It is part of the local sports calendar and promotes an active lifestyle.

name: K3-run
description: K3 – Krčmaň Run Over Three Peaks is an 11.3 km race with approximately 350 metres of elevation gain. The route passes through beautiful countryside over three peaks, mainly on paved paths and partly on grass, with predominantly firm surfaces. This run offers athletes an enjoyable experience in nature and a challenge in the form of climbs and trail running.
course_highlights: Route length: 11.3 km
Elevation gain: approx. 350 m
The route passes over three peaks, mainly on paved paths
additional: The race runs mainly on paved paths and grass, is suitable for runners of all levels, and offers beautiful views of the surrounding countryside.

name: Neusser Integrationslauf
description: The Neuss Integration Run, organized by DJK RHEINKRAFT Neuss 1914 e.V., takes place on 19 September 2026 at the Ludwig-Wolker-Sportanlage in Neuss. The event celebrates integration in practice, bringing together people of all backgrounds, skin colors and religions, including people with disabilities, to run or walk together. The focus is on community and making a statement for integration, not competition. A colorful program featuring music, children’s activities and food makes the day a celebration for participants and visitors.
course_highlights: An open course for running and walking, with no time pressure
Participants of all ages and backgrounds
A colorful program featuring a bouncy castle, bull riding and music
additional: The run is open to people of all ages, backgrounds, skin colors and religions, including people with disabilities. There are no rankings; the focus is on fun and community. The program offers a range of activities for participants and visitors, including a bouncy castle, bull riding, children’s activities, music and culinary specialties. The event takes place at the Ludwig-Wolker-Sportanlage and is part of SportWoche für Alle 2026, which features inclusive sports activities and taster sessions.

name: Schottener Stauseelauf
description: The Schotten Reservoir Run is organized by TGV Schotten, the largest sports club in the Vogelsberg region. The event gives runners the opportunity to compete on varied courses around the reservoir. The run is part of the club’s extensive sports program, which also includes numerous major running events. Participants and visitors are warmly welcome to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and beautiful scenery.
course_highlights: Running routes around the Schotten Reservoir
Varied terrain in the Vogelsberg region
Organized by an experienced sports club with professional timing
additional: Registration, results and certificates are provided through the club’s own timing service, "TGV SportStar". TGV Schotten is a large sports club with more than 1,300 members and organizes other major events in running and other disciplines in addition to the Reservoir Run. The race is known for its fast, flat course and attracts runners from across the region. Registration is available on the official website, and the event is a popular opportunity for recreational and competitive runners to improve their personal bests.

name: Appelhülsener Landlauf
location: Appelhülsener Landlauf, Nottuln-Appelhülsen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Appelhülsener Landlauf on September 26, 2026, is a family-friendly running event in the beautiful Münsterland, offering distances for all age groups. The officially measured 5 km and 10 km races are eligible for rankings and combine Westphalian charm with rural scenery. Refreshment stations and a varied selection in the finish area ensure participants are well catered for. The event is part of the Westmünsterland Running Series and offers a welcoming atmosphere for runners and walkers.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses, eligible for rankings
Water stations every 2.5 km
Start and finish area with changing and shower facilities at the sports center
additional: Race packets can be collected at the sports center from 13:00 on race day. Timing is provided by Race-Result using a reusable chip attached to the race bib, which is collected at the finish. Changing and shower facilities are available directly in the start/finish area. The first three male and female finishers in the 5 km and 10 km races will receive awards. All participants in the Bambini and schoolchildren’s races will receive a medal. Nordic walking is untimed, with no awards ceremony. Certificates and results are available online; certificate printing is offered at race-bib collection. Parking is available at Marienplatz 15, 48301 Nottuln. The courses are officially measured. Online registration is open until 24.09.2026; late registration is available on site for a fee. Race packets can be collected from 13:00 on race day. Parking is available at Marienplatz 15, Nottuln.

name: Bahnstreckenlauf
location: Zinhaine, Bad Marienberg, Westerwaldkreis, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Wäller Bahnstreckenlauf in Bad Marienberg is a new running event starting in 2025. From 2026, it will also count as a scoring race for the Wäller-Lauf-Cup. The course is an out-and-back route along the cycle path between Langenbach bei Bad-Marienberg and Nistertal. The start and finish are on Zinhainer Weg, above the Rübsamen company, with a nearby parking lot for participants. The event is organized by TuS Bad-Marienberg Leichtathletik and offers runners an attractive course in the region.
course_highlights: Out-and-back route along the cycle path between Langenbach and Nistertal
Start and finish on Zinhainer Weg, above the Rübsamen company
Parking available right by the start and finish
additional: The event is part of the Wäller-Lauf-Cup from 2026. Certificates and individual results are available online. The course is an out-and-back route on a cycle path, suggesting a flat, fast course. The event offers various age categories and distances.

name: Halveraner Herbstlauf
location: Innenstadt von Halver, Märkischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Halver Autumn Run takes place annually on the last weekend in September in Halver town centre. Organised by SSV Halver together with LGHS, the event offers races for toddlers and schoolchildren, as well as a relay for recreational runners. The main event is a 4 x 900-metre relay with two categories (U100 and Ü100). The event has been a fixture on the local running calendar for over 20 years and takes runners right through Halver city centre.
course_highlights: Relay race with 4 x 900-metre laps
The course runs through Halver town centre
Separate races for toddlers, schoolchildren and youth
additional: Late entries are possible online or at the race office up to 45 minutes before the respective race start. A fee of €1.50 (online) or €2 (race office) applies to entries on the day of the event. Toilets, showers and changing facilities are available at Lindenhof School. The roads will be closed for the race from 12:00. All participants receive a medal; the top three in each age group also receive medals and certificates. Relay race, 4 x 900 m, in Halver town centre, age categories U100 / Ü100

name: Hofheimer Volkslauf
description: The Hofheim Volkslauf is a long-standing running event taking place on September 26, 2026, at Sportpark Hofheim in Lampertheim-Hofheim. It is organized by Turnverein 1896 Hofheim im Ried e.V. and offers runners of all ages a friendly, family atmosphere. The event is known for its good organization and the opportunity to enjoy sport and a sense of community.
course_highlights: Various distances (1 km, 5 km, 10 km)
Running, walking, and Nordic walking events
Venue at Sportpark Hofheim with a flat course
additional: Registration is by submitting a form downloaded as a Word document. Esther Heilmann and Verena Salomon are the contacts for questions; their telephone numbers and email addresses are provided. The website has a contact form for further inquiries. The event is open to runners of all ages, including children’s and youth events. Start times are 15:15 and 15:30. Further details, registration, and the race information are available on the website.

name: REHAmed Herkules-Berglauf
description: The REHAmed Herkules Mountain Race is a challenging mountain race through Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe in Kassel, running almost entirely on paved natural paths. The course passes numerous sights, including Löwenburg and Steinhöfer Waterfall, and finishes at the Hercules Monument. The race is open to runners and walkers and offers both individual and three-person relay categories, making it ideal for families, clubs and companies. Changing rooms and showers are available at the nearby Reformschule gym, and a bag transport service to the finish is provided.
course_highlights: The course runs almost entirely on paved natural paths through Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe
Passes well-known sights such as Löwenburg, Steinhöfer Waterfall and the Hercules Monument
Relay race with three legs and handovers at notable points
additional: Bag transport to the finish is available from 10 a.m. in the start area. Participants make their own way back to the start on foot or by bus route 22. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Reformschule gym. Relay results are based on the combined times of the three individual legs; there are no age-group categories for relays. The course runs on paved natural paths and asphalt. Registration is online via RaceResult. The start and finish are in Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe in Kassel. Wooden medals are awarded; T-shirts can be ordered. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Reformschule gym.

name: Rodheimer Volkslauf

late_fee.price: Nachmeldung möglich am Veranstaltungstag bis 30 Minuten vor Start

description: The Rodheim Fun Run is a family-friendly running event and part of the popular Main-Lauf-Cup series. The start and finish are centrally located at the sports center on the main playing field, creating an appealing stadium atmosphere for sports enthusiasts. The event offers a range of competitions, from a children’s race to a half marathon and 10 km race, suitable for children, fitness enthusiasts, and ambitious runners alike. The awards ceremony is lively, and the event attracts a good turnout.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the sports center on the main playing field, with a stadium atmosphere
A variety of distances, from the 0.15 km children’s race to the half marathon and 10 km race
Part of the Main-Lauf-Cup, with scoring races for various age groups
additional: Late entries are possible on the event day until approximately 30 minutes before the respective start. The event includes scoring races in the Main-Lauf-Cup and BBF-Junior Main-Lauf-Cup. The office is open at specific times on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays. Scenic run, family event, inclusive options, various race distances, on-site registration

name: Volksbank-Citylauf Telgte
description: The 19th Volksbank-Citylauf Telgte takes place on September 26, 2026, and offers a varied program for runners of all ages. The routes pass through the historic town center, along the Ems and through the surrounding countryside, vividly reflecting the motto “Town, Country and River.” In addition to the 10,000-meter main race, there are other events, including a 5,000-meter race, walking, children’s and Bambini races, and an untimed fun run. The event is suitable for competitive runners, recreational runners and families, and is organized by TV Friesen Telgte e.V.
course_highlights: 10,000-meter main race through the historic town center, the Ems floodplains and the countryside
5,000-meter race with a water station halfway along the course
Varied routes featuring asphalt, a tartan track, paved paths and natural trails
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, with a €2 late-entry fee (for the Bambini race, charged once per family or group). Changing facilities are available at the old double gymnasium at the school center, close to the start and finish. Medals, trophies and certificates are awarded in various events and age groups. The course is varied, with asphalt, a tartan track, paved paths and natural trails. Photos and video recordings will be taken and published. The start and finish are at the school center sports field; registration is online; changing facilities are at the Old Double Gymnasium; children’s races are not timed.

name: Weezer Staffellauf
description: The Weeze relay race has been held in Weeze in mid-September each year since 1985 and has become a popular relay event, with up to 250 teams taking part. The course follows a scenic 5 km loop along the Niers hiking trail. The event offers various relay categories, including Bambini, school, and regular relays, and attracts runners of all ages. The athletics department of TSV Weeze organizes the event with great dedication and looks forward to welcoming many participants in 2026.
course_highlights: 5 km loop along the Niers hiking trail
Relay event with Bambini, school, and regular relay categories
Held annually in mid-September since 1985
additional: The 40th Weeze relay race will take place on 26 September 2026. The race announcement and registration will follow at the end of July. The event has attracted up to 250 relay teams. The 38th Weeze relay race in 2024 had 32 Bambini teams, 36 school relay teams, and 55 regular relay teams cross the finish line. Participants can register online until the end of July 2026; the event also includes school and community competitions, as well as on-site refreshments.

name: Herbstcross des SSV-MG-Ahlsdorf / 2. Peter Zinke Gedenklauf
MOUNTAINMAN Reit im Winkl
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: MOUNTAINMAN Reit im Winkl is a challenging trail-running event in the Chiemgau Alps, offering five distances from 11 to 73 kilometres. The routes pass through impressive mountain scenery, with highlights including ski jumps, the idyllic Klausenbach Gorge, alpine pastures and Dürrnbachhorn, and breathtaking views as far as the Wilder Kaiser. The event is open to trail runners from beginners to professionals, although the longer routes are suitable only for experienced runners. Special routes are available for hikers, and dogs are also allowed on the shorter routes. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, with an expo, Kids’ Trail, Community Trail and a pasta party on the eve of the race.
course_highlights: Magnificent mountain scenery with views of the Wilder Kaiser
Passage through the idyllic Klausenbach Gorge
Technically challenging trails with up to 3,200 metres of elevation gain
additional: Start and finish at the Festsaal, Tiroler Straße 37, Reit im Winkl. Travel by train is recommended for environmental reasons. Parking is available in town, a 5–10-minute walk away; parking is free for overnight guests staying in Reit im Winkl. Dogs are allowed on the S and M routes. Entries with dogs are sold out; a waiting list is available. Flexi Ticket options, which allow cancellation up to 30 or 2 days before the event, can be purchased for an additional fee. Race packs will be sent by post approximately 4 weeks before the race. The day before the event features an expo, Kids’ Trail, Community Trail with ALTRA, pre-race information and a pasta party. The awards ceremony takes place at 15:00 on race day. The event includes various trail-running and hiking routes, including Kids’ and Dogs’ Trails, with detailed information on registration, route profiles and terrain. The Winter Trail event in March offers distances from 10 to 42 km on snow-covered terrain, with support options.

name: Kreuzhorst Ultra
description: The Kreuzhorst Ultra (KRHU) is a friendly Backyard Ultra in Magdeburg-Kreuzhorst, taking place for the third time on September 26, 2026. The 6.7 km course restarts on the hour, and participants run as many laps as they can or want to. The race is a private invitation-only event focused on community, passion, and the joy of running. The course is mostly on forest and farm tracks, with no significant climbs, and results are recorded for distances of 53 km, 100 km, and 160 km.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop on forest and farm tracks
Starts on the hour; run for as long as you can or want to
Results recorded for distances of 53 km, 100 km, and 160 km
additional: The race is a private invitation-only event with no public registration and a maximum of 70 participants. Water, sports drink, cola, fruit, and cake are available in the start/finish area, and participants are asked to contribute items themselves. No mandatory equipment is required, but a headlamp and phone are recommended. Parking, toilets, and showers are available at the SV Pechau sports ground. The race includes several categories, including 50 km, 100 km, and 100 miles, with the fastest person in each category winning. It is not a public event, but a private invitation event with modified Backyard Ultra rules.

name: VR-Bank Mitte Herbstlauf in Dingelstädt
description: The VR-Bank Mitte Autumn Run in Dingelstädt is a versatile running event taking place on September 26, 2026. The event offers courses for all ability levels, from a children’s run for the youngest participants to a half marathon that passes through the impressive 1,530-meter-long Küllstedt Tunnel. The flat, fast courses are measured to DLV/IAAF standards and are ideal for personal bests. The Autumn Run is part of the Eichsfeld Cup and the TLV Running Cup, and also hosts the Thuringian State Road Running Championships.
course_highlights: Half marathon through the 1,530-meter-long Küllstedt Tunnel
Flat, low-turnaround courses with only 2 to 50 meters of elevation gain
Courses measured to DLV/IAAF standards
additional: Start and finish on the fully paved Kanonenbahn cycle path near Bahnhofsallee in Dingelstädt. Changing rooms, registration and the awards ceremony are in the primary school sports hall. Bib pickup from 8:00 a.m. Age-group awards according to DLV standards. The 1 km race is limited to 50 starters, with a referee-led start lineup. Net timing; placings determined by gun time. The courses are flat and fast, including tunnel sections; registration in the primary school sports hall; start and finish on the Kanonenbahn cycle path; refreshments along the course and at the finish; age-group awards; part of the Eichsfeld Cup and the Thuringian State Championships.

name: Bausch+Ströbel Stadtlauf Ilshofen
description: The Bausch+Ströbel Ilshofen City Run is a traditional running event held annually in Ilshofen. It gives runners of different ages and ability levels the opportunity to compete on a varied course through the town. The course is well marked and passes through attractive parts of the town, making the event interesting for both participants and spectators. The city run is a popular event on the regional running calendar and is organized by TSV Ilshofen.
course_highlights: Varied course through the town of Ilshofen
Well-marked course
Attractive sections for runners and spectators
additional: The event offers GPS-based course measurement. The start and finish are at the Roland-Wurmthaler-Halle, where registration also takes place. The event is held annually and has been established for more than thirty years.

The 10 km course covers two laps through Ötigheim Forest and promises a beautiful autumn running atmosphere.

The 10 km course runs through Ötigheim Forest
Two laps on the 10 km course

description: The Benin Charity Run is a scenic running event in Hirzweiler, taking place for the 19th time on September 26, 2026. The course offers panoramic views across the Ill Valley and runs mostly along paved farm roads. The event supports aid projects in Benin, with the proceeds and entry fees going to AG Benin. In addition to the race, participants can enjoy a generous cake buffet, grilled sausages and drinks at the Dorfwaldhalle Hirzweiler, followed by the awards ceremony.
course_highlights: Panoramic views across the entire Ill Valley
Mostly paved farm road
Start and finish at the Dorfwaldhalle Hirzweiler
additional: On-site late registration is available with no late-registration fee. The event is part of the LLG Illtal Cup, alongside the Illinger City Run and the Friendship Run. There are no age-group categories in the children's races, and races not included in the rankings are not timed. The awards ceremony takes place at the Dorfwaldhalle Hirzweiler. Grilled sausages, a cake buffet and drinks are available. The race usually takes place in October, with refreshments at the Dorfwaldhalle Hirzweiler. Some races have no age-group categories, and no times were recorded at the first events. The event is a community initiative that combines a sporting challenge with social support.

name: Bergzeitlauf Brockenheroes 2026
description: The BROCKENHEROES mountain time trial and mountain race is a challenging individual time trial in the Harz, taking place on September 26, 2026, in Schierke. Participants compete on various courses of up to 24 km with up to 900 meters of elevation gain, including road cycling, mountain biking, unicycling, running, roller skiing, and Nordic walking. The event offers a unique challenge against the clock, the mountain, and yourself, starting on the Brockenstraße and finishing on the Brocken plateau. The atmosphere is defined by sporting ambition and the impressive natural scenery of the Harz.
course_highlights: Main course: 11.2 km with 550 meters of elevation gain on the Brockenstraße
Longer course: 24 km with 900 meters of elevation gain to the Brocken plateau
A range of disciplines: road cycling, mountain biking, unicycling, running, roller skiing, and Nordic walking
additional: Race packs can be collected on Friday from 16:00 to 19:00 and on race day from 8:00. Electronic timing, medical support, drinks, and refreshments at the finish are included. The event offers views from the Brocken plateau across to several distant cities and landmarks. After the race, there is a recovery walk to cheer on the participants starting later. Participants under 15 require parental permission to take part, and parental supervision is required. Mountain individual time trial, running, roller skiing, Nordic walking, e-bikes permitted for road races, various course distances, age categories, online registration

name: Böckstiegellauf
price_range: 18,00 EUR bis 29,00 EUR (je nach Strecke und Anmeldezeitraum)
description: The Böckstiegellauf is a scenic race through the Teutoburg Forest and the Ravensberg Hills, starting at Peter auf’m Berge in Bielefeld and finishing in Werther town centre. Routes of 18 km and 10 km are offered, along with a 2.5 km student race. Part of the course follows the Hermannslauf route and passes the Böckstiegelhaus and the Böckstiegel Museum. The event is very well organised, with a bus shuttle from the finish to the start and an awards ceremony in the centre of Werther.
course_highlights: A route through the Teutoburg Forest and the Ravensberg Hills
The course passes the Böckstiegelhaus and the Böckstiegel Museum
Starts at Peter auf’m Berge and finishes in the centre of Werther
additional: The start is at Peter auf’m Berge and the finish is at Venghauss-Platz in Werther. Buses to the start leave from Werther bus station from 12:00. Late entries are possible at Venghauss-Platz on the event day from 11:00 to 13:00, subject to remaining places. Most of the course is in good condition; the section at the 18/10 km route split at kilometre 3.7 is very gravelly. The routes pass through nature and the town. Registration is already open, with bus transport to the start. There is no parking at the start, and late entries are subject to availability.

name: Cloppenburger Citylauf
organizer: Stadt Cloppenburg, Lauftreff des SV Bethen
description: The Cloppenburg City Run is a popular running event held as part of the Cloppenburg City Festival, which takes place annually on the last weekend of September. The main race starts at the Red School on the Market Square and runs along Eschstraße to Rathausplatz. In addition to the main race, there is a relay competition in which teams of four each complete a course of approximately 1,000 metres four times. The event is organised by the running group of SV Bethen e. V. and supervised by the NLV Cloppenburg district association.
course_highlights: The main race starts at the Red School on the Market Square
The course runs along Eschstraße and finishes at Rathausplatz
The relay features laps of approximately 1,000 metres, completed four times
additional: Relay teams receive a 50% discount on the entry fee if all four runners also take part in the main race. All events except the main race start and finish at Rathausplatz. The event is supported by local sponsors and takes place as part of the Cloppenburg City Festival. Events for various age groups, start times, course distances, registration not yet open

name: Crosslauf Winhöring
description: The cross-country race in Winhöring offers a varied event for different age groups and ability levels on September 26, 2026. The event includes a 7.5 km main race and a 700 m children’s race. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Winhöring and offers runners of all ages a sporting challenge.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through the countryside around Winhöring
7.5 km main race
700 m children’s race
additional: Typical September weather: around 19 °C high, 10 °C low, usually cloudy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The event takes place in September, when the weather is typically cloudy, and registration is available on the website.

name: Drei-Täler-Lauf
location: Mettingen, Tecklenburger Land, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 3-Täler-Lauf, organised by TV Mettingen 1930 e.V., takes place on 26 September 2026 and takes participants along varied routes through the three valleys of Fahlbachtal, Ölmühlental and Köllbachtal in the Tecklenburger Land. The main 14.1 km race features challenging, undulating terrain and impressive views of Querenberg, Schafberg and Schniederberg. There is also an 8.3 km 2-Täler-Lauf and a Nordic walking option for beginners and experienced athletes alike. Children are warmly invited to take part in an 800 m junior race and a 400 m Bambini race, with fun taking priority for the youngest participants. The event is family-friendly and offers one-time-chip timing, as well as showers and changing rooms at Ludgeri-Schule.
course_highlights: Scenic route through Fahlbachtal, Ölmühlental and Köllbachtal
14.1 km main race over undulating terrain, with views of Querenberg, Schafberg and Schniederberg
8.3 km 2-Täler-Lauf and a Nordic walking option for beginners and experienced athletes
additional: Timing is provided by a Runtiming one-time chip, integrated into the race number and included in the entry fee. The finish closes at 16:30; participants finishing after that time will not be recorded. Showers and changing rooms are available in the sports hall at Ludgeri-Schule. The three fastest women and men in the main and 2-Täler-Lauf races, as well as the three fastest boys and girls in the junior race, receive awards. Personal race certificates showing finishing times can be downloaded free of charge from the Runtiming website. Results are linked online at www.tvmettingen.de. Award ceremonies take place after the respective races. The route passes through the valleys of the Tecklenburger Land and has challenging terrain. Children’s races and parking are available; online registration is possible.

name: Durlacher Turmberglauf
description: The Durlach Turmberg Run is a flat, fast 10-kilometer race through the historic old town of Durlach, along the Pfinz to just before Grötzingen and back. The race has become a regular fixture for running enthusiasts from the region and offers an attractive course for ambitious runners. A children’s race also takes place in the Durlach Palace Gardens. The event combines sporting competition with social engagement by collecting donations for charitable causes.
course_highlights: Flat, fast 10-kilometer race through Durlach’s old town
Course along the Pfinz to just before Grötzingen and back
Children’s race in the Durlach Palace Gardens
additional: Annual fundraising as part of the race in support of social projects. Opportunity to join the Africa Runners team and run for a good cause in the team shirt. Race on September 26, 2026, sponsors from the region, fundraising activities for charitable causes, terms and conditions and registration on the official website

name: Emmertinger Herbstfestlauf
description: The Emmerting Autumn Festival Run takes place at the sports ground in Emmerting and is part of the local autumn festival. The event is open to children, adults, club runners, recreational runners and walkers. It offers various distances, including Bambini runs, children’s races, 5 km and 10 km races, and Nordic walking routes. Its welcoming, festive atmosphere makes the run a popular gathering for the local running community.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Emmerting sports ground
Children’s races on short forest loops
5 km and 10 km races, plus Nordic walking on forest paths
additional: The event is part of the local autumn festival, with food and drinks available throughout the day. The youngest children run 600 metres on the sports ground, while older children run 2.5 km on a short forest loop. Nordic walkers complete one or two 5 km laps in the forest. This community event welcomes runners of all ages and abilities. It takes place on 26 September 2026 and offers food and a festive atmosphere in addition to the race programme.

name: Friedrichshaller Runde
description: The Friedrichshaller Runde is a long-standing running event in Bad Friedrichshall, taking place on 26 September 2026. It is part of the 3-Flüsse-Cup and offers runners an appealing route through the region’s scenic landscape. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels and combines a sporting challenge with scenic highlights. It is organised by Stadtmarketing Bad Friedrichshall, which is also known for other tourism services in the region.
course_highlights: Route through the picturesque landscape of Bad Friedrichshall
Part of the 3-Flüsse-Cup, with varied terrain
Combines a nature experience with a sporting challenge
additional: Distances: 400 m, 10 km; registration and results via my.race|result; listed in the laufen.de running calendar.

name: Herbstfestlauf
description: The 30th Niederstetten Autumn Festival Run takes place around the town hall in Niederstetten and offers varied courses for all age groups. The shorter races run through the town centre, while the main race follows the picturesque Vorbach Valley. Participants can look forward to beautiful views of the vineyards and Weikersheim Castle. A range of race categories, from mini races to a relay, means there is something for everyone.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Niederstetten Town Hall
Main race along the Vorbach Valley
Views of the vineyards and Weikersheim Castle
additional: Mini races C and B are untimed. Awards are given for the school and youth races, fun run, relay and main race. The Autumn Festival Run is part of the Laufgemeinschaft Tauberfranken, which organizes several regional running events with scoring for the Tauberfranken Cup. The event includes main, mini, school and youth races, as well as relays, on routes through the beautiful region around Niederstetten. It promotes running in the region and offers attractive prizes for participants.

name: Hohenlockstedter Pellkartoffellauf
description: The Hohenlockstedter Pellkartoffellauf is a long-standing running event held annually since 2002 on the Pohl-Boskamp grounds. With distances of 2.8 km, 5 km and 10 km, the race offers a suitable challenge for both beginners and experienced runners. The event is especially family-friendly, with special Bambini runs for children and a varied supporting programme featuring games, a food area and entertainment. It promotes community spirit and enjoyment of physical activity, and welcomes individual participants, school classes, teams and companies.
course_highlights: Three distances: 2.8 km, 5 km and 10 km
Bambini runs of approximately 500 m for preschool and first-grade children
Refreshments along the 10 km course and fruit in the finish area
additional: Registration is available directly at the event venue from 11:30 a.m. on race day. Late registration for children and teenagers costs €8.00 and is available until 45 minutes before the race starts. Awards ceremonies for places 1–3 overall and in the age categories take place at 2:15 p.m., 4:00 p.m. and 5:00 p.m. On the Friday before the race, the programme celebrating the potato begins with the coronation festivities for the Pellkartoffelkönigin and an after-show party with free admission. Various distances, Bambini runs, supporting programme, awards ceremonies, prize draws, after-show party, registration from 11:30 a.m. on race day

name: Hotfoot Run Warstein

description: The Hotfoot Run Warstein is a spectacular obstacle race on September 26, 2026, with distances ranging from 5 km (Family Edition) to 20 km, making it suitable for all fitness levels and age groups. The course runs across the Montgolfiadengelände, the ski slope and through the quarry, with plenty of muddy obstacles, water slides and foam. The event features an exciting start show, a unique atmosphere and has promoted team spirit and fun since 2007. Whether you’re a fitness enthusiast, a fun-loving group or a family, everyone can enjoy an unforgettable adventure here in NRW.

Participants under 18 must provide consent from a parent or guardian. Terrain includes a ski slope, quarry, water and foam elements; registration with group discounts; various distances and a Family Edition; entertainment with bands and DJs.

description: The Remseck Forest Run is a family-friendly race in the beautiful Hochdorf Forest, taking place for the sixth time in 2026. The SGV Hochdorf organising team is also preparing fresh forest-run shirts and informative flyers to support participants. The race takes place on 26 September 2026 and warmly welcomes everyone who loves sport.

Family-friendly atmosphere

name: König Ludwig Lauf - Sommeredition
description: The König Ludwig Lauf - Summer Edition is Bavaria’s most beautiful panoramic run in the Ammergau Alps. A free shuttle bus takes participants to the start in Ettal, and the event is ideal for trail and landscape running enthusiasts. The friendly atmosphere and well-organized arrangements make the run a special experience.

name: R5K Berlin
description: The R5K Tour Final 2026 is a youth race held as part of the BMW BERLIN-MARATHON, where ambitious runners aged 12 to 22 can measure their 5K times. The event supports young athletes and offers an exciting platform for emerging running talent.

Aid stations and BRITA refill stations along the course to help runners stay hydrated

The R5K is a series of five 5-kilometer races in Germany for young people aged 12 to 22, with an overall ranking, prizes for U20 and U23, and training opportunities.

name: Remsecker Waldlauf
location: Hochdorfer Wald, Remseck am Neckar, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Remseck Forest Run is a family-friendly race through the picturesque Hochdorf Forest in Remseck. The event offers various distances for children, teenagers, and adults, running through varied woodland terrain with muddy, uneven ground and narrow paths. The race combines sporting ambition with a nature experience and a sense of community, and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. The event is organized by Sport- und Gesangverein Hochdorf e.V. and will be held for the sixth time in 2026.
course_highlights: Race routes run through the beautiful Hochdorf Forest
A variety of courses with muddy, uneven ground and small obstacles
Distances from 500 m to 7.5 km for all age groups
additional: Late registration is possible on the day of the event until 60 minutes before the start, subject to availability, for an additional fee of €3. Each participant receives a race bib with an integrated chip. A recycled technical shirt can be ordered as an optional extra (€15 for children, €20 for adults). Team rankings are available for the middle distance. Race bibs can be collected on Friday evening and Saturday morning in the start/finish area. Registration opens in mid-May; routes are being prepared, and training sessions will take place before the event.

name: Schelder Berglauf
description: The Schelder Berglauf is a challenging mountain race in Dillenburg, held annually by ASC Dillenburg. The course runs through varied terrain with steep climbs and offers runners a sporting challenge in a natural setting. The event attracts both competitive and recreational runners and is a fixture on the regional running calendar.
course_highlights: Challenging mountain course with steep climbs
Natural course through woods and hills
Traditional event with regional significance
additional: Runner information, terrain details, registration and further guidance are available on the website.

name: Wald-und Hügellauf
description: The Wald- und Hügellauf in Groß-Umstadt is a traditional race that starts and finishes at Ludwig-Wedel-Stadion on September 26, 2026. Participants can choose between two distances: the classic 13.2 km route and the 21.1 km half-marathon. The race is part of the Langlauf Cup Jugenheim and is sanctioned by the DLV. The course runs through forests and hills, where runners can expect witches in the woods and the “Mountain of Truth.” Refreshments are available along the course. After the race, there is an awards ceremony, and showers and changing rooms are available on site.
course_highlights: Forest and hilly terrain, including the “Mountain of Truth”
Water and fruit stations (1 for 13.2 km, 3 for the half-marathon)
Start and finish at Ludwig-Wedel-Stadion, Groß-Umstadt
additional: Race packs can be collected until 13:30 on race day. Race numbers are available for collection from 12:30 to 13:30. The half-marathon cutoff time is 17:00; participants who finish after that will not be ranked. Showers and changing rooms are available. Participants are asked to bring their own cups to reduce the carbon footprint. Refreshments are provided after the race. On-the-day registration is available at the venue. Terrain: forest and hills; registration: online; refreshments along the course; showers available

name: Nocna Piątka 2026
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Nocna Piątka is a unique 5-kilometre race taking place on 26 September 2026 in Gdańsk, the day before the Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon. The start and finish are on the illuminated track at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, where participants can expect a spectacular show featuring lasers, music and light effects. The route winds through the city and is enlivened by spectator points with music and fire shows, creating a unique nighttime atmosphere. This new version of the well-known race accompanying the half marathon has moved to Saturday evening to offer runners and spectators a special experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the illuminated track at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk
City route with fire shows and spectator points featuring music and a DJ
Spectacular show featuring laser displays and energetic music
additional: The race takes place the day before the half marathon, with the start and finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. It features a nighttime atmosphere with music, laser and fire shows, and spectator points with a DJ. An evening race with laser and pyrotechnic displays, starting at 20:00, on an illuminated route. An event accompanying the Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon. The participant limit is not provided. Attractions and visual production are described as being of the highest standard.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: The 146th Gliwice Park Run Provocation is an annual running event in Gliwice that combines sport, a friendly atmosphere, and time in the city’s green spaces. The race is open to both experienced runners and people who want to spend time actively without the pressure of competition. The race traditionally starts in the clearing behind Piast Stadium, and the race office opens at 9:00, with the start at 10:00. Participation requires advance registration and an entry fee. It’s a great opportunity to end February actively and head into the upcoming spring season with renewed energy.
course_highlights: Start in the clearing behind Piast Stadium (entrance from Leśna Street)
A route through urban green spaces, offering a chance to connect with nature
An event combining sport and a friendly atmosphere without the pressure of competition
additional: The race office is open from 9:00. Advance registration and payment of the entry fee are required to be included in the results. The race takes place on the last day of February, offering a symbolic way to start the new month actively. The event encourages the local community to come together and promotes an active lifestyle among Gliwice residents.

name: Kołobrzeska Odyseja
description: Kołobrzeska Odyseja ’26 is a series of three exceptional races held in Kołobrzeg, bringing together passion, strength and a seaside atmosphere. The event offers races over 5 km, half-marathon, marathon and 10 km distances. The courses are certified by PZLA, and participants can look forward to generous race packs, a finisher area with a hot meal and drinks, and valuable prizes. It’s a perfect opportunity to feel the energy of the seaside and become part of a new running tradition in Kołobrzeg.
course_highlights: Courses certified by PZLA
A flat course along a pedestrian and cycle promenade with an asphalt and cobblestone surface
Seaside atmosphere and views
additional: Start and finish by the Seaside Hotel at ul. Wschodnia 20 in Kołobrzeg. Race office hours: 16.05.2026, 18:00–20:00, and 17.05.2026, 8:00–10:50. Facilities: baggage deposit, changing rooms, showers and toilets. Professional timekeeping and referees. Finisher area with a hot meal, snacks, isotonic drinks and water. Awards ceremony at the Atrium Seaside Park Hotel. Quiz with additional prizes for participants attending the ceremony. Courses certified by PZLA, finisher area, meals, prizes, awards ceremony, accommodation discounts, timekeeping, generous race packs

name: X Cross Doliny Małej Panwi
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Mała Panew Team Zawadzkie Koło Towarzystwa Przyjaciół Lasu "Dolina Małej Panwi"
description: X Cross Doliny Małej Panwi – In Pursuit of the Beaver is a running and Nordic walking event held in the picturesque surroundings of Zawadzkie. The event offers 5.3 km and 10.3 km courses that run through the Mała Panew Valley, giving participants the chance to enjoy nature and active recreation. The event is organized by the Mała Panew Team Zawadzkie Association and the “Dolina Małej Panwi” Circle of the Society of Friends of the Forest.
course_highlights: 5.3 km and 10.3 km courses through the Mała Panew Valley
Picturesque woodland and natural scenery
Option to take part in a 5.3 km Nordic walking event
additional: The race office is open from 10:00 to 11:40 on the day of the event. Electronic timing using passive chips. Online registration and payment available. The organizer provides race bib distribution and technical support for the event. Online registration; event in Zawadzkie, promoting physical activity and contact with nature.

name: XIII Bieg Branicki
description: The 13th Branice Run is a 10 km road race taking place on September 26, 2026, in Branice, Opole Voivodeship. Runners can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is a great opportunity for runners to test their fitness on a scenic course and enjoy a sporting atmosphere. The organizers provide expert support and the option to manage race information through the TreningBiegacza.pl platform.
course_highlights: A 10 km road course
Scenic surroundings in Branice, Opole Voivodeship
Tailored training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks
additional: Training plans tailored to runners’ experience levels and expert support are available. The TreningBiegacza.pl platform offers the option to manage the race listing and collaborate on marketing. The event includes training preparations and is part of local sporting events in Branice.

name: XXI Mikołowski Bieg Uliczny
description: The 21st Henryk Biskupiak Mikołów Street Run is the biggest sporting event in Mikołów and is held annually. The street race attracts runners of different age groups and abilities, promoting physical activity and the spirit of sports competition. Participants can take on a route through the city streets, while the organizers provide professional support and an atmosphere full of sporting excitement. The event is an excellent opportunity to bring the local community together and promote a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: A street race in the center of Mikołów
Option to receive a commemorative T-shirt
Organized by MOSiR Mikołów
additional: The race office is open on race day from 16:00 to 18:45. Commemorative T-shirts can be purchased until 31.08.2025; after that date, it will no longer be possible to buy one. More than 50 people have already registered for the race. The event offers various registration options, and participants can look forward to commemorative T-shirts. The race is part of the local sporting events and promotes physical activity in the community.

name: VIII Bieg Szlakiem Kolejowym
location: Czerwona Woda, Gmina Węgliniec, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Horský beh Pačanským chotárom
location: Pača, Rožňava District, Košice Region, Slovakia
description: The Pačanský Chotár Mountain Run is a running event in the village of Pača, offering two main courses: a more challenging 13.5 km main race with 492 m of elevation gain, and a shorter 6.3 km hobby race with 203 m of elevation gain. The routes combine paved and forest roads, with beautiful views and refreshment stations along the way. Runners start and finish in front of the cultural centre in Pača, and the organizers provide route navigation and markings. The event is suitable for both experienced and recreational runners and offers a sporting atmosphere with refreshments and a raffle.
course_highlights: Main race: 13.5 km with 492 m of elevation gain; 40% paved road and 60% forest road
Hobby race: 6.3 km with 203 m of elevation gain, combining paved and forest roads
Refreshment stations along the route and panoramic views of the Pačanský Chotár
additional: Race-day registration is from 8:30 to 9:45 in front of the cultural centre in Pača. Children’s races are free, with a medal for every participant and prizes for the top three in each category. The race pack includes a chipped race number, a commemorative headband, a medal, nutritional supplements, and entry into the raffle. Refreshments after the finish include goulash, beer, or Kofola. 13.5 km and 6.3 km routes, scenic forest and mountain terrain, online registration, prizes for top finishers, scenic views, mountain trail, mountain race

name: Rybnícka 10-ka a 5-ka
location: Futbalový štadión, Rybník, Rybník, Levice, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Rybník, ZŠ s MŠ Rybník
description: Rybník 10K and 5K is a running event held at the football stadium in the village of Rybník, Levice District. Races are held over two distances—5 km and 10 km—with various age categories for men and women. The children’s race starts at 9:00, and the adults’ race at 11:00. The event is suitable for the general public, including secondary school students and seniors, who receive a discounted entry fee. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and quality facilities for runners.
course_highlights: The course runs around the football stadium in Rybník
Two distances: 5 km and 10 km
Categories for children, women, and men across different age groups
additional: The children’s race starts at 9:00, and the adults’ race at 11:00. The discounted entry fee is €10 for secondary school students aged up to 18 and seniors over 65. The race is open to all age groups, including children, with the option to register online or on site. The event also offers sporting activities at the football stadium.

name: Behaj lesmi Devín
description: Behaj lesmi Devín is a unique trail race near Bratislava, offering a route with views of the confluence of the Danube and Morava rivers and Devínska Kobyla. The routes follow the historic Amber Road and pass through flowering wild garlic avenues, making the run an unforgettable experience. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series and is included in the UTMB Index Races, providing an international points ranking. You can compete on the short 12 km route or the 22 km half marathon; both routes feature a marked Conti Speed Section with a valuable prize.
course_highlights: Route with views of the confluence of the Danube and Morava rivers and Devínska Kobyla
Historic trade route, the Amber Road, and wild garlic avenues
Conti Speed Section—a speed segment marked over 150 metres
additional: The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series. The routes are marked, and refreshment stations are located along the course. The Conti Speed Section competition offers the chance to win a tyre-purchase voucher and a running shirt. The race is included in the UTMB Index Races, allowing participants to earn an international points ranking. The course passes through wooded areas and along the historic Amber Road. Medals, participant gifts, photographs, and medical services are available.

name: S Ankou za život
description: The Run With Anka for Life is a charity event held in Košice by St. Elizabeth’s Cathedral. The entry fee is a voluntary contribution, and all proceeds from the entry fees go to the Oáza – Hope for a New Life facility. The event is organized by the Anka Kolesárová Pastoral Centre in Vysoká nad Uhom. Runners can combine their athletic effort with supporting a good cause.
course_highlights: Charitable event, with proceeds supporting social projects
Running relay in Košice and the surrounding area
An event bringing the community together to support life
additional: The entry fee is a voluntary contribution, and all proceeds go to the Oáza – Hope for a New Life charitable facility. The event supports life and charity; registration is available by making a voluntary contribution.

name: Hutčanská 5 s vierou – beh srdcom i telom
price_range: 10 € online, 15 € na mieste, 0 € pre deti 8-17 rokov a niektoré vekové skupiny
description: The Run with Heart and Soul in Nižná Hutka is an annual running event offering a 5 km course for experienced runners and a fun 500 m route for the youngest participants. Alongside the sporting experience, the programme includes spiritual reflection, refreshments, a panel discussion and musical entertainment. The event creates a welcoming community atmosphere and encourages both competition and the joy of running.
course_highlights: 5 km course for experienced runners
Fun 500 m route for children
Goulash refreshments for runners
additional: Registration is available online and in person, with a higher fee for in-person registration. Race numbers, safety pins and the participant list will be prepared. After the run, there will be an awards ceremony, thanks, a raffle and a concert by the band Kalap. The event includes spiritual activities, refreshments, entertainment and age-based categories, with different entry fees.

name: Běchovice - Praha, MČR v silničním běhu mužů, žen, juniorů a juniorek
description: Běchovice–Prague is a legendary 10 km road race with the longest uninterrupted tradition in Europe, now being held for the 130th time. The race is the official Czech Republic Road Running Championship and features a challenging 10,031-metre course that tests every runner. The atmosphere is exceptional and complemented by modern facilities, including an accompanying programme and commemorative medals. The race is open to a wide range of categories, from juniors to veterans, and also offers a relay race.
course_highlights: The course is 10,031 metres long, 31 metres more than the traditional 10 km
Start in Běchovice, finish at Pražačka in Prague
Official Czech Republic 10 km Road Running Championship with 26 categories
additional: Race numbers are distributed at the hall at Masaryk Railway Station in Prague in the days before the race, and in Běchovice on race day. The race includes a Joma technical T-shirt and a commemorative medal in the entry fee. The relay race starts at the same time as the third wave of the race, at 11:50. Each relay team consists of 4 members, with predetermined legs. The race has a capacity of 3,333 runners. Race photos and a personalised race video are free. The race is part of Prague’s running traditions and celebrations, offers online registration, and starts on Českobrodská Street in Běchovice.

name: Běh metropole Praha 1
location: Praha 1, Centrum Prahy, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: Běh Metropole is a series of public running races held in different districts of Prague. It aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and a sense of belonging to one’s district. The race is open to all age groups, from children to seniors, as well as participants with disabilities, who represent their district. Each start earns points in the competition to find Prague’s most sports-oriented district. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, with original medals and gifts for participants.
course_highlights: Races take place in different districts of Prague, including the city centre
Promotes a healthy lifestyle and community spirit among Prague residents
Categories for all age groups, including participants with disabilities
additional: Each participant represents the district where they have permanent residence and contributes to the districts’ points tally. The project emphasises competition between Prague’s districts to be named the most sports-oriented. Original medals and running magnets for bib numbers are prepared for participants as keepsakes. The races offer different course distances and are part of a series, with medals and updates about the event location; registration is available online and on site.

name: 14. Bahrs-Kartoffellauf
description: The 14th Bahrs Potato Run 2026 in Jembke offers runners a varied program with three distances: the 10 km Bahrs Run, the 5 km Potato Run, and an 800 m children’s run. The event takes place on September 27, 2026, and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, culinary delights, and a colorful program featuring performances by the Jembke Cheerleaders. Race bibs must be returned after the run, and there is no on-site registration. The event is part of the running cup and offers not only sporting challenges but also a chance to socialize over a generous cake buffet and savory dishes.
course_highlights: 10 km course on Komoot
5 km course on Komoot
800 m children’s run
additional: Start times: 10 km Bahrs Run at 10:30, 5 km Potato Run at 12:00, and 800 m children’s run at 13:15. No on-site registration; advance registration only. Race bibs must be returned after the run. Food and drink include potato soup, veggie bowls, potato pancakes with applesauce, burgers, bratwurst, shashlik, and rosemary potatoes. Performances by the Jembke Cheerleaders at approximately 11:45 and 13:00. Award ceremonies take place after the respective races. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, diverse running options for all age groups, and the opportunity to combine the run with a social gathering.

name: 7-MEILEN-TRAIL
description: The 7-Mile Trail in Kaiserslautern offers two challenging courses: a short 4-mile course for running and Nordic walking, and a long 7-mile course for runners only. The routes pass through varied terrain with a high proportion of singletrack and are completely unpaved. The start and finish are opposite the Sommerhaus restaurant on Pfaffenbergstraße. The event is ideal for trail-running enthusiasts looking for a scenic, challenging route.
course_highlights: 4-mile course: approx. 6.4 km with 130 m of elevation gain
7-mile course: approx. 11.3 km with 340 m of elevation gain
Courses are 40–60% singletrack and completely unpaved
additional: Start and finish opposite the Sommerhaus restaurant on Pfaffenbergstraße. Aid stations: 4-mile course, once in the finish area; 7-mile course, twice (after 6 km at the TSG fountain and in the finish area). The long course is for runners only; the short course is also open to Nordic walkers. Trail running, event date: 2026-09-27, location: Kaiserslautern, course distance approx. 11 km, elevation gain approx. 340 m

name: Altkönig-Lauf
price_range: 10 km 16,00 Euro, Halbmarathon 18,00 Euro, Schülerläufe 5,00 Euro, Walking 14,00 Euro
description: The Altkönig Run, organized by MTV Kronberg, is a traditional public race approved by the German Athletics Association (DLV), taking place on September 27, 2026. Events include a half marathon (21.1 km), 10 km races, children’s races, a toddlers’ race, and walking/Nordic walking. The course runs through the scenic Taunus landscape, with around 350 metres of elevation gain in the half marathon. The race is part of the Taunus Running Challenge and offers every finisher a medal, as well as trophies and cash prizes for the top runners. The start and finish are at the MTV sports grounds in Kronberg.
course_highlights: Half marathon with approximately 350 metres of elevation gain
Start and finish at the MTV sports grounds in Kronberg
Part of the Taunus Running Challenge, which has three scoring races
additional: Every finisher receives a medal. The 10 km walking and Nordic walking events start at 9:40 a.m. and are not timed. Children’s races start from 12:00 p.m., with distances of 350 m and 1,000 m. There is a refreshment station on the course. Participants are asked to bring reusable cups or their own mugs to help protect the environment. The awards ceremony is planned for around 1:00 p.m., with finisher trophies for all participants who are present and cash prizes for the top runners. The courses run along forest paths through the Taunus. Elevation gain: 150 m for 10 km and 350 m for the half marathon. Start and finish at the MTV sports grounds in Kronberg. Registration is available online and on race day. Environmentally conscious behaviour is encouraged at the refreshment station.

name: Asse-Volkslauf und Nordic Walking
description: The Asse Run and Nordic Walking event organised by TSV "Vater Jahn" Wittmar is held annually and will take place for the 34th time on 27 September 2026. The event is very popular, with record participation last year. It offers various running and walking routes in the beautiful surroundings of Wittmar and is open to athletes of all ages. Registration opens at the end of June. Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, except for the kindergarten run.
course_highlights: Route distances: 0.3 km and 10.6 km
Nordic walking included
Venue: Wittmar, Germany
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, except for the kindergarten run. Registration opens at the end of June; detailed information is available in the official race announcement. The event includes running and Nordic walking events.

name: Kraichgaulauf
description: The Kraichgaulauf in Sinsheim-Rohrbach is a traditional race on September 27, 2026, offering runners of all ability levels varied routes through the scenic Kraichgau countryside. From the short 5 km course and the popular 10 km race to the challenging half marathon and demanding 42.2 km hill marathon, there is something for everyone. The routes pass through natural surroundings and offer stunning views, including of the landmark Steinsberg Castle. The event is ideal for anyone looking to combine endurance, nature, and sporting ambition.
course_highlights: Hill marathon with varied elevation profiles and stunning views
10 km course featuring paved roads, surfaced farm tracks, and idyllic woodland sections
5 km course with panoramic views of Kraichgaublick and Steinsberg Castle
additional: Race-bib distribution until 30 minutes before the start at Kreuzgrundhalle. Changing rooms and showers at Kreuzgrundhalle and at the sports grounds. Parking available around the hall and in the sports field area. Bag storage in the start/finish area (Rohrbach Primary School). Refreshments including drinks, fruit, and snacks at several stations, depending on the course. Medal for all finishers. Timing with a disposable timing chip integrated into the race bib. Late registration possible until 30 minutes before the start, subject to availability. Limited to 1000 participants. Various distances; registration opens April 15, 2026; focus on nature and experience.

name: Schusterlauf
description: The Schusterlauf Preetz is a long-standing running event with various distances, taking place on September 27, 2026, in Preetz. The challenging 16 km course leads through forests and meadows and along Lake Lanker, and requires good to very good fitness. Alongside the main race, there are shorter distances, including the Bambini Run for children and the Kirchsee and Wehrberg runs. The event is part of the ZIPPEL’S Kiel.Cup, where participants can earn points toward the overall standings.
course_highlights: 16 km course through forests and meadows and along Lake Lanker
Good, firm-footed trails in the Wehrberg and along the shores of Lake Kirchsee
Challenging course with a changeover point at Gut Wahlstorf
additional: Race number collection is available the day before the event (19:00–20:00) and on race day from 08:00 at the Alte Wilhelminenhalle, Schulstraße 2, 24211 Preetz. Participation in the ZIPPEL’S Kiel.Cup, including points scoring, is automatic. Race number changes are not possible. New service: Bags can be dropped off in a truck on the Marktplatz near the finish. GPX files for the 5 km and 16 km courses are available to download. Courses are available as GPX files; online registration; start and finish in Preetz; bag drop-off service and results downloads.

name: Bergkloster-Lauf
description: The Bergklosterlauf, organized by TuS Velmede-Bestwig in cooperation with Bergkloster Bestwig, takes place on September 27, 2026, in the Sauerland. The 6, 10 and 21-kilometer races pass idyllic streams, run along ridges with magnificent views and through smaller settlements before finishing at Bergkloster Bestwig. In addition to the races, there are children’s and youth races, plus a supporting program featuring live music, childcare, free massages and extensive catering. The event is also part of the Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup organized by LAC Veltins Hochsauerland. The start and finish are easy to reach and offer ample parking, as well as affordable accommodation at Bergkloster.
course_highlights: Routes pass idyllic streams
Ridges with magnificent viewpoints
Finish at Bergkloster Bestwig
additional: Free massages are offered after the finish. Childcare is available for “running parents.” The start and finish are just 600 meters apart and are easy to reach by bus, train or car. There are 500 parking spaces nearby, including spaces for motorhomes. Affordable accommodation is available at Bergkloster. The 10-kilometer race is also open to walkers. The children’s and youth races start at 12:00. The 10-kilometer race and the children’s and youth races are scoring events for the Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup. Routes of 6, 10 and 21 km; children’s and youth races; registration via Race Result; parking and accommodation at Bergkloster; route maps on Outdooractive

name: Bickendorfer Büdchenlauf
description: The Bickendorfer Büdchenlauf is an atmospheric race through the Cologne neighborhood of Bickendorf, offering an extensive selection of different running events so there is a suitable distance for everyone. The event delights competitive runners as well as children and recreational runners. The start and finish are on Venloer Straße in Cologne-Bickendorf. In addition to the sporting event, participants and visitors can enjoy a varied program featuring food and drink stalls, exhibitors, and music.
course_highlights: Race through the Cologne neighborhood of Bickendorf
Start and finish on Venloer Straße in Cologne-Bickendorf
Varied program featuring food and drink and music
additional: The event grounds offer a varied program featuring food and drink stalls, exhibitors, and music. The race offers different events for all ages and ability levels. Various distances, including children’s and dog races; registration opens on February 14; a traditional neighborhood race in Cologne-Bickendorf

name: Cochem Zeller Crosslauf Serie
description: The 39th edition of the Cochem Zeller Cross-Country Series takes place on 27 September 2026 in Ulmen, Germany. The event offers two distances, 400 metres and 8 kilometres, on courses that are often suitable for record times. As part of the solidarity system in sport and running culture, Laufen.de members benefit from reduced entry fees. The race is known for its varied cross-country courses in the Eifel region.
course_highlights: Cross-country courses suitable for record times
Distances: 400 m and 8 km
Scenic surroundings in Ulmen, Eifel
additional: Typical September weather: approx. 19 °C, low of 10 °C, 45 mm average precipitation, mostly cloudy. September weather around 19°C, cloudy; several venues in the region; certificates and trophies for winners

name: GVG Citylauf Erftstadt
description: The GVG Citylauf Erftstadt is the region’s largest running event and takes place every September. It offers a special atmosphere for everyone who loves running, from children and recreational runners to elite athletes. The 10 km main race takes runners four times through the medieval old town and Lechenich Castle Park, with numerous spectators lining the route. Shorter races for schoolchildren, families, and companies are also available; they start and finish at the market square in Erftstadt-Lechenich.
course_highlights: 10 km main race with four laps through the medieval old town and the castle park
Loop course starting and finishing at the market square in Erftstadt-Lechenich
Officially measured, fast course with few turns
