description: The Karel Havlíček Borovský Run is a traditional circuit race in Havlíčkův Brod, offering courses for different age groups, from the youngest children to adults. The route passes through Budoucnost Park and by landmarks such as the memorial to the victims of the world wars and the statue of Karel Havlíček Borovský. The race is suitable for all age groups and combines paved and unpaved paths with gentle elevation changes. The start and finish are at the primary school at V Sadech 560, where showers and toilets are also available.
course_highlights: Circuit route with a section through Budoucnost Park
Passes the memorial to the victims of the First and Second World Wars and the statue of Karel Havlíček Borovský
The highest point of the route is at Kalvárie, with its three crosses
additional: The start and finish are at the primary school at V Sadech 560. Showers and toilets are available in the school building. Parking is available at several locations nearby, some paid and some free. Runners aged 3 and over may take part. Participants aged 17 and under can enter for free. The event includes various age groups, with registration available online and on site. Parking is available nearby. Races take place at the Havlíčkův Brod Primary School and around the park.

name: Baran Trail Race
location: Węgierska Górka, Żywiec County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Baran Trail Race is a recurring running event held in picturesque Węgierska Górka. The event offers a range of distances from 10 km to 100 km, following challenging mountain routes with beautiful views and natural terrain. It attracts both recreational and experienced runners, offering unique challenges and a distinctive atmosphere. The organizers ensure the event runs professionally and that participants are safe.
course_highlights: Mountain routes of varying difficulty
Picturesque views of the Beskids
Natural forest and rocky terrain
additional: Start and finish in Węgierska Górka. The routes pass through the Beskids over varied terrain. The event takes place on 2–3 October 2026. Four distances are available: 10 km, 25 km, 60 km and 100 km. Refreshment points along the route and medical support are provided. The event offers different participant categories, as well as an archive of results and event partners.

name: PUMA Třeboňský půl/maraton 10 a 5 km
description: The Puma Třeboň Marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races take runners through the unique natural landscape of the Třeboňsko Protected Landscape Area. The routes are flat with minimal elevation gain and run mostly along paved cycling paths and forest trails, helping runners achieve personal bests in beautiful, peaceful surroundings. The race starts in Třeboň’s Renaissance square and passes through a historic gate into a nature reserve that is a candidate for UNESCO listing. The ideal October timing offers pleasant running weather and a motivating atmosphere, with professional pacers on the course.
course_highlights: Flat routes with minimal elevation gain in the protected natural area of Třeboňsko
Most of the course follows paved cycling paths and quality forest trails
Start in the Renaissance square and pass through a historic gate into a nature reserve that is a candidate for UNESCO listing
additional: Registration allows a refund of the entry fee until 8 September 2026, subject to a 150 Kč administrative fee, or transfer of the entry fee to the following year until 30 September 2026. After the race, participants can also receive a voucher worth 777 Kč toward the purchase of running shoes. The race has a participant limit, and transferring registration to another runner is not possible. The entry fee includes a free 12-month subscription to the Svět běhu magazine. Routes are available to download in .GPX format. The race includes a half marathon, 10 km and 5 km, is supported by regional authorities, and offers gift vouchers for purchase. The event takes place in October 2026.

name: Run Berounka Run
location: Újezd u Svatého Kříže, Plzeň-sever, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 3,300 Kč za tým; 800 Kč pro jednotlivce v kategorii Ultra

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné pro ročník 2026 je 3 300 Kč za tým.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pro jednotlivce v kategorii Ultra je startovné 800 Kč.

description: Run Berounka Run is a relay race for teams and individuals, following the Berounka River from Újezd u Svatého Kříže to Prague-Radotín. The 130 km route is divided into 6 legs, with over 3,100 metres of elevation gain, and runs mostly along forest and field paths. The race starts on 3 October 2026 from 5:00 in several waves; the Ultra category starts on the evening of 2 October. The race is open to teams of 2 to 6 runners and individuals in the Ultra category. Winners are announced in several categories, and refreshments are available at the finish.
course_highlights: 130 km route along the Berounka River, divided into 6 legs
Total elevation gain of 3,182 m, mostly on forest and field paths
Starts in Újezd u Svatého Kříže and finishes in Prague-Radotín, by the Říční Lázně kiosk
additional: Starts take place in waves from 5:00. The Ultra category starts on 2 October at 20:00 and at midnight. Teams have a 4-hour limit to complete each leg. Each team receives a race pack with bib numbers, a GPS chip and gifts from sponsors. Portable toilets are available at the relay points. Refreshments are available at the Říční Lázně kiosk at the finish. The maximum number of teams is 80; teams may have up to 6 runners, and the Ultra category is limited to 55 individuals. The race starts in Újezd u Svatého Kříže and finishes in Prague-Radotín. Registration is open from 1 November 2025 to 20 September 2026. The Ultra category starts on Friday evening. The route runs mostly along forest and field paths, with a total elevation gain of 3,182 m.

name: 24DS (24 Dlouhé Stráně)
location: Kouty nad Desnou, Jeseníky, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné je stanoveno na 900,- Kč / účastník

description: 24DS is a 24-hour endurance challenge in the unique setting of the Hrubý Jeseník mountains, running from Kouty nad Desnou to the upper reservoir of the Dlouhé Stráně pumped-storage power plant. The race offers stunning views of the Jeseníky Mountains and combines daytime and night running with sunrise and sunset. The demanding route has 820 metres of elevation gain and is 90% trail, and is suitable for solo runners and pairs. The Kouty nad Desnou resort offers comfortable facilities, including restaurants, accommodation and parking.
course_highlights: 14.7 km loop with 820 m of elevation gain
90% trail surface
Views from the upper Dlouhé Stráně reservoir at an altitude of 1,354 m above sea level
additional: Registration runs from 1 May 2026 to 30 August 2026, or until capacity is reached. Every participant must have a GPS tracker, which is activated on race day during check-in. The race package includes a cable car voucher for viewing the course. Teammates in pairs may take turns as often as they like. Participants must follow the rules on the course and carry a working mobile phone. The organizer provides maps and marks the route with white spray paint and yellow course markers. At the finish, participants must return their chip and GPS tracker. The race takes place on 3 October 2026, offers accommodation options nearby, and is associated with support for MORAVA FLOW projects.

name: Běh kolem Hejtmanu
location: Chlum u Třeboně, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běh kolem Hejtmanu is a traditional sporting event held in Chlum u Třeboně in the Třeboň region, always on the second Saturday in October. The main event is a 10 km race with a time limit of 1 hour and 20 minutes, running along local roads and pond dams through a picturesque setting. The race is open to the public and takes place amid normal road traffic, with an emphasis on safety and compliance with the rules. Shorter races are arranged for children and young people up to 15 years old, with on-site registration on race day. The event is organized by TJ Jiskra Chlum u Třeboně, z.s.
course_highlights: The main race route crosses the dam of Hejtman Pond and the dam of Staňkovský Pond
The race follows local roads with picturesque views of the Třeboň region
The start and finish are at the TJ Jiskra Chlum u Třeboně stadium
additional: Race-day registration takes place from 8:30 to 10:15 at the TJ Jiskra Chlum u Třeboně stadium, where race numbers and timing chips are issued for the main 10 km race. Competitors participate at their own risk and must comply with road traffic regulations. Competitors under 18 must be accompanied by a legal guardian or provide a declaration from one. The race follows local roads and a cinder track; registration is available on-site or online. The start is at the stadium grounds, and races of varying distances are open to all age groups.

name: ČEZ RunTour Praha
distance_verbose: Maraton, Půlmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: ČEZ RunTour Prague is a family-friendly running race offering courses for recreational runners and elite athletes over 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km, as well as children’s runs of 500 and 1,000 metres. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Ladronka Park and is part of a nationwide series spanning eight unique locations. The organizers focus on excellent service, safety and fun for the whole family, with an accompanying programme and a charitable dimension. Every participant receives a race pack and can support charity by taking part.
course_highlights: 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km courses in Ladronka Park
Children’s runs of 500 and 1,000 metres
Excellent service, including pacers and a medical team
additional: Pacers, a medical team and refreshment stations are available on the course (1 station for the 5 and 10 km races, at least 2 for the half marathon). Every runner receives a gymsack with gifts; children receive a race pack from Lidl. A children’s zone, warm-ups for children and an accompanying programme for families are available. A special emergency medical service phone line is set up for the race. More courses, family activities, charity support, medals, photos, refreshments and facilities for participants.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - říjen
description: The 2-Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of less than two laps of a precisely measured asphalt loop. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and a 9:00 start. Every participant will be rewarded at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake for their effort.
course_highlights: Precisely measured 3.2 km (2-mile) asphalt loop
The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky industrial zone
The children’s course is 800 m long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and over, and children aged 12 and under. Each runner is timed, and the top three finishers in the men’s, women’s, and children’s categories receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get to the start are by bike, on foot, by car, on roller skates, or by trolleybus No. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). A regular monthly race, 3.2 km course, road surface, a run for all age groups, 800 m children’s course, access by bike, car, or trolleybus No. 11.

name: Běh na Čerťák
location: Flemmichova zahrada, Rýmařov, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: zdarma pro děti do 14 let, 150 Kč pro ostatní při online přihlášení, 200 Kč při prezenci na místě

price_tiers.distance: všechny kategorie mimo děti do 14 let

description: Běh na Čerťák is a traditional race organized by AK Běžci z Rýmařova, held in the grounds of Flemmich Garden in Rýmařov. The race offers courses for various age categories, from preschoolers to seniors, with the main route running along forest paths and over the summit of Kamenná hora. The race starts in the SKI Flemmich Garden grounds, and the course includes field tracks, meadows and forest trails with beautiful views. Refreshments are provided after the race, followed by the awards ceremony at the SKI grounds. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for distance runners, and category winners receive prizes.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the SKI Flemmich Garden grounds
Route over the summit of Kamenná hora (799 m above sea level), passing the Čerťák balancing rock
Forest and field paths with beautiful views
additional: Registration takes place at the facilities in the SKI grounds at Flemmich Garden from 9:30 to 10:30. Men’s categories D and E and all women run the shortened course. After the race, refreshments are provided: beer, soft drinks, coffee and tea. The awards ceremony takes place at the SKI grounds after all runners have finished. The course includes forest paths and meadows. Online registration is open until 3.10.2025. The start is in the SKI grounds at Flemmich Garden. The race takes place on 3 October 2026.

name: Benešovská osmička
location: Benešov u Semil, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: Benešovská osmička is a traditional cross-country race in Benešov u Semil, held for more than half a century. The race offers courses for the whole family, from preschool children to veterans, with the main 8,000-meter race running through the picturesque countryside around the village and along the slopes of Benešov Hill. The start and race facilities are at the sports complex in Horní Benešov. Prizes are awarded, and light refreshments are available for all participants and spectators.
course_highlights: The main 8,000 m course runs mostly over meadows and farm and forest tracks of varying quality
Children’s courses follow paved paths within the sports complex
The area around the village and the slopes of Benešov Hill (567 m above sea level)
additional: Registration and check-in take place at the start venue from 12:30, no later than 15 minutes before the start of each category. The race is divided into categories: preschool children (50 and 100 m), youth (400–1,200 m), juniors, women, men, and veterans (2,250 m and 8,000 m courses). The first three finishers in each category receive prizes. Light refreshments are available for participants and spectators. Courses from 50 m to 8 km, a family event, refreshments, prizes.

name: Běh města Příbrami
price_range: dospělí - předem 200 Kč, na místě 300 Kč; štafety - předem 400 Kč, na místě 600 Kč; děti a studenti zdarma; rodinné startovné 200 Kč
description: The Příbram City Run is a traditional running race, held for the 32nd year in the picturesque surroundings of Nový rybník in Příbram. The race offers various categories, including the 10 km main race, relays, and children’s races, welcoming a wide range of runners. The event is suitable for families, students, and individuals looking to enjoy a sporting day in a friendly atmosphere. Start times and check-in are tailored to the different categories to ensure everything runs smoothly and in an orderly manner.
course_highlights: 10 km main race in the natural surroundings of Nový rybník
Categories for children and adults, as well as family and student relays
Traditional race with a history of more than thirty years
additional: Check-in is from 8:00 to 10:30 for children and from 10:30 to 11:00 for adults. The schoolchildren’s category starts at 9:00; the 10 km main race and relays start at 11:30. Family relay teams must be made up of relatives. Student relay teams must consist of students from primary, secondary, or higher education institutions; student status may be checked at check-in. Starts from 8:00; the 10 km main race starts at 11:30; registration is from 8:00 to 10:30. Various categories, including relays and children’s races.

name: Mattoni Liberec Trail Run
location: Liberec, Jizerské hory, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: Mattoni Liberec Trail Run is a race in nature, offering runners the chance to escape the hustle and bustle of the city and enjoy running along forest trails in the Jizera Mountains. It is the final race of the season and leads through the forest, around a reservoir, through a granite quarry, and back. Runners can choose between a shorter 12 km route and a longer 22 km route, allowing them to test their strength amid beautiful natural scenery.
course_highlights: Forest trails in the Jizera Mountains
Running around the reservoir
Passing through a granite quarry
additional: The race takes place on 3 October 2026, with staggered starts from 10:00 to 12:15. Two routes are available: 12 km and 22 km. The event includes an accompanying program and a virtual package. The race is part of the RunCzech running league and is in its ninth year, with approximately 2,000 participants. The terrain includes forest trails. The race offers various categories, registration is possible using a code, and the race map is available in JPG/PNG and GPX formats. The event also includes family races.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - říjen
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka Park is an open race for all ages and running levels. It’s for people who run for fun and want to improve their personal best or simply enjoy a pleasant run in a beautiful park. The course follows Stromovka’s paved paths. Adults run two laps (3.2 km), while children up to 12 years old run one lap (1.6 km). After the race, everyone gets a warm cinnamon pancake as a reward. The race is part of the year-round Lívancový pohár, which encourages regular participation and reflection on performance.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths through Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km); children run 1 lap (1.6 km)
A warm cinnamon pancake for all participants after the race
additional: Registration takes place at the Bruselská brána area from 8:15 to 8:45. Online pre-registration is available for faster check-in. Recommended ways to get there are by bike, on foot, by rollerblades, or by tram (Výstaviště stop). Parking is available by the bridge to Císařský ostrov on Za elektrárnou Street. Changing and bag-drop tents, a mobile valuables storage service, and toilet cabins are available. Categories are divided by age and gender, every participant is timed, and results are published online. Times adjusted using an age coefficient count toward the Lívancový pohár. The course is 3.2 km long and starts in Stromovka Park. Registration is available in advance or on site. The race is suitable for all age groups and running levels.

description: SILESIA Cross 1/2 Marathon is a traditional cross-country running race held in Opava-Kylešovice, with its hub at the U Chovatelů grounds. The race offers 21 km and 13 km courses that pass through scenic locations such as Raduň, Vršovice, Chvalíkovice, Hradec nad Moravicí, Branka and Opava. The course is challenging and partly follows roads open to traffic. Participants must follow fair-play rules and respect nature. Times are recorded electronically without chips, and the awards ceremony takes place at the finish area. The 2026 race has been cancelled, but information about previous editions and courses is available.
course_highlights: The route passes through Raduň, Vršovice, Chvalíkovice, Hradec nad Moravicí, Branka and Opava
The race takes place on roads open to traffic, with electronic timekeeping and no chips
Course changes have been made because of fenced private property; the 21 km course does not go to Raduň Chateau
additional: Race-day registration takes place at the race centre on Friday from 17:00 to 19:00 and on Saturday from 7:30 to 9:00. The start is at the sports field behind the primary school in Raduň, and the finish is at the U Chovatelů grounds in Opava-Kylešovice. The race takes place on roads open to traffic, and participants run at their own risk. Times are recorded electronically without chips. Because there are few entrants in the shorter races, the 750 m, 1,500 m, 3 km and 5 km races start directly at the finish area. The course is marked year-round, with additional temporary markings and course marshals provided for race day. From 1 October 2025, entry fees increase to 350 CZK for 21 km, 250 CZK for 13 km and 150 CZK for the shorter distances. If the entry fee is paid by 26 September, participants can have their name printed on their race number. Registration usually takes place in October. The event offers various distances and is known for its distinctive cross-country terrain. In the past, course changes have been made because of private property.

name: Běh zámeckým parkem
location: Zámecký park ve Vlašimi, Vlašim, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run Through the Chateau Park is a race through the picturesque grounds of Vlašim Chateau Park. The 8.4 km course combines off-road and paved sections, offering runners a varied experience. The race is organized by Atletika Vlašim, z.s., and is included in the official Czech Running calendar. It is suitable for runners looking to enjoy a run in a beautiful park with a historic atmosphere.
course_highlights: The course runs through Vlašim Chateau Park
A combination of off-road and paved sections
Course length: 8.4 km
additional: The race is part of a running series and offers various course lengths, including off-road and paved sections.

name: Z(a)tracené vrchy
description: Z(a)tracené vrchy is an adrenaline-fueled orienteering, beer-drinking running, walking and crawling race for teams, held in the scenic terrain of Bordovice in the Moravian-Silesian Region. Competitors must complete the course carrying a 10-litre keg of beer on their backs, take part in mini-games at checkpoints and drink beer at the checkpoints. The race combines a physical challenge with teamwork and fun, with a route through varied terrain featuring climbs and descents. The winning team receives a travelling trophy and gift packages. The event is for adults over 18 and emphasises participant safety and responsibility.
course_highlights: The course runs through varied terrain with climbs and descents
Complete the course carrying a 10-litre keg of beer on your back
Five checkpoints with mini-games and beer drinking
additional: Mandatory gear includes a charged phone, a tap (bayonet fitting), a pump, a keg harness, a rubbish bag and a headlamp. Recommended gear includes a basic first-aid kit, water and nutritious food. Beer may be consumed only at checkpoints, where it is served from a single competition vessel in portions of max. 0.5 l. Keg collection takes place from 7:30 to 7:35 at the start location. The race is for competitors over 18 who sign a declaration accepting personal responsibility. The use of transport is prohibited, except for trekking poles. The event is part of an ultratrail series, with results from 2024 available, and is aimed at experienced runners seeking a challenge in demanding terrain.

name: Běh Pístovickou riviérou
location: Pístovice, Vyškov, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Pístovická Riviera Run is a traditional cross-country race along forest roads above the Pístovická Riviera recreational area in Pístovice near Vyškov. The race is open to everyone who enjoys healthy exercise, from children to adults, and takes place in all weather conditions. The course is uneven, with possible puddles and mud, and includes running and walking uphill and downhill. The organizers from the Vyškov Ski Club warmly invite runners and spectators to take part and support sport in the region.
course_highlights: Forest roads above the Pístovická Riviera recreational area
Uneven terrain with possible puddles and mud
Cross-country course with uphill and downhill sections
additional: The course is not closed, and participants must follow the organizers’ instructions. The race takes place regardless of the weather; only extreme conditions may result in postponement or cancellation. Runners under 15 must be accompanied by someone over 18. Participants under 18 must have written consent from a legal guardian. The race number must be worn visibly on the chest. Skates, bicycles, trekking poles, and taking shortcuts are prohibited. The race is open to all age groups and offers a varied program, refreshments, and activities for children. The event is supported by the City of Vyškov and Lesy České republiky, s.p.

name: Cibulka - Košířský okruh
description: Cibulka - Košířský okruh is a popular running race held in Prague’s Košíře district, offering a course approximately 4.5 km long. The race is part of a series of local running events and is intended both for recreational runners and for those looking to improve their performance in a natural setting. The course follows forest roads and trails around the Cibulka lookout tower, providing a pleasant and varied setting for running. The event is suitable for all ages and running levels, with an emphasis on the joy of exercising outdoors.
course_highlights: An approximately 4.5 km course featuring forest roads and trails
Natural surroundings near the Cibulka lookout tower in Prague 5
Open to both recreational and competitive runners
additional: The race takes place in Prague 5-Košíře, with the start near the 'U lesíka' stop.

name: Běh za bořetickým burčákem
price_range: 150 Kč / 6 EUR pro hlavní závod, zdarma pro mládežnické kategorie
description: The Run for Bořetice Burčák is a traditional sporting event held in the picturesque wine-growing village of Bořetice, in the heart of the Blue Mountains. The run gives participants the chance to experience the beautiful landscape of vineyards and wine cellars characteristic of this part of South Moravia. The event is organized by the Bořetice Municipal Cultural Commission, SDH Bořetice, and the Republic of Kraví hora, and is part of the village’s rich cultural calendar. The run is scheduled to start in the afternoon on October 3, 2026, at Sólo by the cultural centre.
course_highlights: The route passes through the picturesque wine-growing countryside of Bořetice and Kraví hora
Surroundings of wine cellars and fertile vineyards
Start and finish by the cultural centre in Bořetice
additional: The event is organized by the Bořetice Municipal Cultural Commission, SDH Bořetice, and the Republic of Kraví hora. The start is at Sólo by the cultural centre. Bořetice has a rich cultural and sporting programme, complemented by other events throughout the year. The race takes place on asphalt; registration opens at 13:20. There is a bouncy castle for children, and after the race participants can taste burčák and local specialities.

name: Korschenbroicher Waldlauf
location: Waldstadion Korschenbroich, Korschenbroich, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 21st Korschenbroich Forest Run takes place on October 3, 2026, at the Waldstadion Korschenbroich. The event offers races over distances from 400 to 10,000 meters, as well as walking, and is open to all age groups. It includes a new 2,300-meter race for young people in age groups U14 to U18. Alongside the sporting competition, there will be a cafeteria and a raffle in aid of the youth department. Held on German Unity Day, the race combines sporting commitment with a good cause.
course_highlights: Distances from 400 to 10,000 meters, plus walking
New 2,300-meter race for age groups U14 to U18
Event at the Waldstadion Korschenbroich on German Unity Day
additional: Cafeteria and raffle in aid of the youth department; NEW-Group is the new main sponsor; registration opens in early 2026; the event takes place on German Unity Day. Courses run across the sports field and forest paths; spikes are not allowed. Registration opens in early 2026; sponsored by the NEW-Group.

name: RheinEnergie Kinderlauf Köln
description: The RheinEnergie Children’s Run Cologne takes place on October 3, 2026, at Roncalliplatz by Cologne Cathedral. The event offers several child-friendly races over distances from 500 m to 2,000 m. Most of the course is closed to traffic and secured by course marshals. Before the run, there is a children’s church service at Cologne Cathedral, after which the children start their races together. Children born between 2015 and 2021 are eligible to participate. There is no timing; the focus is on having fun and taking part.
course_highlights: The route passes Cologne Cathedral
Start and finish at Roncalliplatz
Closed course with course marshals
additional: Race bibs can be collected on October 3, 2026, from a tent at Roncalliplatz. On-site registration is also available on race day from 9:00 to 12:15. Depending on the number of participants, the children start in several waves, divided by age group and/or gender. There is no timing, and children should be able to complete the course without parental accompaniment. Several races with different distances; no timing; participation open to children born in 2015 or later; limit of 1,000 children; online registration available; race bibs collected on race day.

name: Rothaarwaldlauf
location: Rothaargebirge, Bad Berleburg-Aue, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Rothaar Forest Run organized by TSV Aue-Wingeshausen is a popular, scenic forest run in the Rothaar Mountains, taking place on 3 October 2026. The event offers a range of distances, including loop courses and point-to-point routes, appealing to both competitive athletes and recreational runners. The races are part of the Rothaar-Laufserie AOK-Cup, which is celebrating its 25th anniversary this year. The course passes through beautiful woodland with moderate climbs. Excellent refreshments and bus transfers to the start points of the longer routes are provided.
course_highlights: A range of distances from 400m to 28km, including loop courses and point-to-point routes
Start and finish at the Aue-Wingeshausen sports ground, with bus transfers to the start points of the longer routes
Scenic forest routes with moderate climbs and good refreshments
additional: Start times vary by distance; for example, the main race starts at 13:30. A bus transfer runs from the Aue-Wingeshausen gymnasium to the start points of the longer routes (15km and 28km). Race packs can be collected at various locations until shortly before the start. Showers and changing facilities are available at the gymnasium. Late entries are possible at the start points until 30 minutes before the start. The event is part of the Rothaar-Laufserie AOK-Cup, which is celebrating its 25th anniversary. Participants can enjoy shuttle bus transport and refreshments including cake, waffles and fries, as well as an established tradition on the running calendar.

name: Saerbecker Kirmeslauf
price_range: Bambinilauf € 1,00; Schülerläufe 1,2 km und 2 km € 3,00; 5 km Jedermannlauf € 8,00; 10 km Hauptlauf € 10,00
description: The Saerbeck Kirmes Run takes place on October 3, 2026, at Sparkassen Stadium Saerbeck. The course is entirely paved and flat, and runs along well-maintained secondary roads, allowing for fast times. The event offers races for various age groups, with transponder timing and results determined by finish order. Children receive medals, and awards are presented for the overall and age-group results. Participants can print their certificates online.
course_highlights: Well-maintained, fully paved course
Flat secondary roads for fast times
Start and finish at Sparkassen Stadium Saerbeck
additional: Timing is recorded using a transponder attached to the back of the race bib. Finish order determines the results. Online certificates are available to all participants. The course is monitored by volunteers, but traffic rules must still be observed. Every child receives a medal in the children's races. Liability for theft is excluded. Participants must confirm that they are in a healthy state of training. Online registration is available; late entries are accepted on the day of the event for a fee; the event is held under official supervision in accordance with DLV/IWR rules.

name: 16. Köhlbrandbrückenlauf
description: The Köhlbrandbrückenlauf is Germany’s largest bridge run and crosses the landmark in the Port of Hamburg. The event offers runners the unique opportunity to cross the impressive Köhlbrand Bridge and experience the harbor atmosphere up close. The race attracts numerous participants each year and is known for its distinctive course and great atmosphere along the route.
course_highlights: Run across the impressive Köhlbrand Bridge in the Port of Hamburg
Unique harbor atmosphere with views of the water and ships
A distinctive route crossing a Hamburg landmark
additional: Registration opens on December 3, 2026, and typically fills up quickly. There is a race-entry exchange for sold-out races. The event offers bag storage with a coupon, and every finisher receives a medal. Optional medal engraving can be booked during registration for €10.00. Public transport is recommended, as parking is limited. The race is known for its special location in the Port of Hamburg; participation is limited, and the event attracts many runners from across Germany. Medal engraving is also available for a fee, and the event takes place annually in October.

name: 26. Bismarck-Gedenklauf
description: The Bismarck Memorial Run is an annual road and trail race in Schönhausen (Elbe), Saxony-Anhalt, held on German Unity Day. Organized by SV Preussen 27 Schönhausen, it is part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP and offers 6.5 km and 13 km races, as well as shorter runs for children and young people. The course starts at the club’s sports center, follows paved roads into the forest and past Kollerberg, and the longer distance is run twice. The event honors Otto von Bismarck, Schönhausen’s most famous son, and concludes with an awards ceremony and refreshments at the sports center.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the sports center of SV Preussen 27 Schönhausen
Course follows paved roads and passes through the forest by Kollerberg
The longer distance (13 km) consists of two laps of the 6.5 km course
additional: Children’s races: 900 m for U8 to U12, and 3 km for older children and young people. Refreshments and an awards ceremony at the sports center after the race. The event is part of the regional ELBE-OHRE-CUP. Distances: 6.5 km, 13 km, and children’s races; held on October 3; included in the ELBE-OHRE-CUP; weather-dependent, with temperatures typically around 14°C in October.

name: 28. Alfelder Leinetal-Lauf
description: The 28th Alfelder Leinetal Run takes place on Saturday, October 3, 2026, in Alfeld, Lower Saxony. Various distances are offered for adults, including 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon, all finishing at Hindenburg Stadium, which serves as the shared finish area throughout the day. The flat, marked courses are ideal for maintaining a steady pace. There are also races for children and teenagers, making for a varied program.
course_highlights: Flat, marked courses
Shared finish area at Hindenburg Stadium
Various distances for adults and children
additional: The 5 km race starts in the morning, the half marathon about 30 minutes later, and the 10 km race starts around midday. Typical October weather is around 14°C, with a low of 6°C and mostly cloudy skies. Courses: 600 m, 5 km, 10 km, half marathon; finish at Hindenburg Stadium; average October weather: 14°C, approximately 40 mm of precipitation.

name: 49. Warburger Oktoberwochen Volkslauf
location: Sportzentrum Diemelaue, Warburg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 49th Warburger Oktoberwochenlauf takes place on October 3, 2026, at the Diemelaue Sports Center in Warburg. The event offers a 5 km corporate competition and is also open to young people and school students. Registration is by SEPA direct debit via RaceResult. Further details about the race announcement will be shared with participants later.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Diemelaue Sports Center
5 km course with a corporate competition
Event on October 3, 2026
additional: The entry fee is collected by SEPA direct debit via RaceResult. A corporate team consists of three people. Further information will be provided later in the race announcement. Corporate competition, online registration only, results on the website and RaceResult, race at the Diemelaue Sports Center

name: 10km Lauf Neuhütten
price_range: 12 Euro für 10 km, 7 Euro für 5,5 km
description: The Neuhütten 10 km Run is a popular race starting and finishing at the Burgfriedenhalle in Wüstenrot-Neuhütten. The course is a gently undulating but fast loop, suitable for both competitive and recreational runners. The event offers age-group rankings up to M/W 80 and a finisher’s medal for young participants. After the race, an awards ceremony is held with prizes and certificates. The run is also part of the Schwäbisch-Fränkischer Wald Running Cup.
course_highlights: Gently undulating, fast loop course
Start and finish at the Burgfriedenhalle, 71543 Wüstenrot-Neuhütten
Age-group rankings up to M/W 80 in accordance with the DLV
additional: Late registration is possible until 30 minutes before the start for an additional fee of 2 euros. Medical services are provided by the Wüstenrot DRK local association. Course marshaling is handled by the Maienfels Volunteer Fire Department. Showers and changing rooms are available in the Burgfriedenhalle Neuhütten. Participants born in 2011 or later receive a finisher’s medal. Results and certificates can be reordered for a fee of 3 euros. Course: loop, gently undulating; registration until 30.09.2026; late registration available; awards ceremony from 12:30; finisher’s medal for participants born in 2011 or later; prizes and certificates; showers/changing rooms at the Burgfriedenhalle

name: Alfelder Leinetal-Lauf
location: Hindenburg-Stadion, Alfeld, Hüllhorst, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Alfelder Leinetal Run takes place on Saturday, October 3, 2026, in Alfeld, Germany. The event offers 5 km, 10 km, and half-marathon races, all finishing at Hindenburg Stadium, which serves as the shared finish area throughout the day. The flat, marked courses are ideal for maintaining a steady pace. There are also races for children and teenagers, making for a varied program.
course_highlights: Flat, marked courses
Shared finish area at Hindenburg Stadium
Races for children, teenagers, and adults
additional: The 5 km race starts in the morning, the half marathon 30 minutes later, and the 10 km race starts around midday. October weather is typically around 14 °C, with lows of around 6 °C; it is mostly cloudy, with average precipitation of 40 mm. The courses are suitable for competitive races, including children’s and teenagers’ races; the event is part of the club program.

name: Burgentrail Unterfränkische Traillaufmeisterschaften
description: The Burgentrail in Ostheim is a challenging trail running event hosting the Lower Franconian Trail Running Championships on October 3, 2026. The course follows varied forest and meadow paths, passing historic castle ruins such as Lichtenburg and Königsburg, and features technically demanding trails with roots and steep descents. The scenic setting, with views across the Grabfeld, makes this a special experience for trail enthusiasts of all ability levels. SC Ostheim/Rhön warmly invites all running enthusiasts to take part in this sporting highlight.
course_highlights: Start at the school sports field, followed by forest and meadow paths
Passage by Lichtenburg castle ruins, with views across the Grabfeld
Technically demanding trails with roots and steep descents to Königsburg
additional: The Burgentrail is part of the Trailrunning Cup Rhön 2026, which consists of three events. Participants who take part in all three races are included in the overall standings. Every finisher receives an online certificate. The course includes technically challenging sections with roots and steep trails that require coordination and concentration. Trailrunning Cup Rhön 2026, courses with elevation gain, registration via the website, GPS data available for download, varied trails through forests and mountains.

name: BÄRENFELS SECHS-STUNDEN TRAIL
description: The BÄRENFELS SIX-HOUR TRAIL on 3 October 2026 offers runners a challenging trail experience in the wild and romantic natural surroundings of Bärenfels in Saarland/Pfalz National Park. The event is part of the diverse trail and sporting events organised by BÄRENFELS TEAM, which has been creating unforgettable running adventures since 2002. The course follows the Nahesteig and promises a chance to enjoy nature alongside a sporting challenge in a unique landscape.
course_highlights: Wild and romantic trail loop along the Nahesteig
Scenery in Saarland/Pfalz National Park
Trail adventure in unspoilt nature
additional: Trail and nature events in the national park, online registration, various distances, Trail-Adventure

name: Crailsheimer Sparkassenlauf (4. Lauf des 4-Jahreszeiten Laufcup 2026)
description: The Crailsheim Sparkassenlauf is a family-friendly sporting event taking place on October 3, 2026, in downtown Crailsheim. It offers a variety of race distances for all ages and fitness levels, including Bambini, student and main races, as well as walking and relay races. The routes follow varied circuits through the heart of the city, with enthusiastic spectators and a lively atmosphere. Sustainability and community are at the heart of the event, allowing participants to enjoy a sporting event with environmental awareness.
course_highlights: A 2.5 km circuit through downtown with several crossings of the Jagst
Four laps of 2.5 km each in the main race (Horaffenlauf)
Various distances for Bambini, students, walking and relay races
additional: Bib pickup from October 1 and on race day until 45 minutes before the race. Net timekeeping using a disposable chip attached to the bib. Wooden finisher’s medal for all participants. Start and finish in front of Crailsheim Town Hall, with refreshments in the start/finish area. Late registration possible until September 29; after that, registration is available for a fee on October 1 and on race day. Free parking at Karlsberghalle at the Volksfestplatz. A variety of routes for all age groups, with a focus on sustainability and community. Registration required.

name: Cross der deutschen Einheit
price_range: 5 € Nachmeldegebühr, Bambini- und Staffellauf ohne Startgeld
description: The Cross of German Unity in Weißensee is a traditional cross-country race organised by the Blau-Weiß 1921 Weißensee e.V. sports club. This race is being held for the 35th time and offers various events for all age groups, including Bambini races, youth races, a 3.5 km race, a 10.5 km race, a half marathon, and walking/Nordic walking. The course loops around the gondola pond, with varied sections including climbs and stairs, and offers a sporting challenge for runners of all ability levels. A jubilee relay race rounds off the programme; it requires no registration and has no entry fee.
course_highlights: Course around the gondola pond, with flat and hilly sections
3.5 km race with two laps, each featuring two climbs (a hill and stairs)
Half marathon consisting of 2 x 10.5 km laps, with a marked start/finish area
additional: On-site registration is possible until 03.10.2025 at 10:00, with a late registration fee of €5 / €2 for children. The Bambini race and jubilee relay race are free and require no registration. Parking is available directly at the gondola pond; signs point to the Chinese Garden car park. Courses range from flat to hilly; on-site registration is available, with parking at the gondola pond.

name: Gemüselauf
description: The Maxdorf Vegetable Run is a traditional running event in Maxdorf that appeals to runners of all ages. The event includes several races, including the main race, the Everyone’s Race and the junior race “Young Vegetables.” The course has been modernized in recent years and offers attractive running conditions and the potential for great times. The race is part of the Engelhorn Sports Trail Cup and Brooks Running Cup and is very popular in the region.
course_highlights: A new course with attractive running conditions
Part of the Engelhorn Sports Trail Cup and Brooks Running Cup
A variety of races for different age and ability groups
additional: The event includes several competitions: the main race, the Everyone’s Race and the junior race. It is part of regional running cups. Start lists and results are available online. The course has been redesigned to enable faster times. Course maps, race information, results, photos and more are available on the website.

name: Gilching Läuft
price_range: Frühbucherpreise bis 31.07.2025, reguläre Preise ab 01.08.2025, Nachmeldung 3 € Gebühr
description: Gilching Läuft will take place again in 2026 on the grounds of TSV Gilching-Argelsried, with the start and finish in the stadium. The routes pass through the adjoining Baderwinkel woodland on paved forest and woodland paths, with little asphalt and mostly flat terrain. The event is open to runners of all ages, with a particular focus on children’s races. Free drinks and fruit are provided, along with snacks and cake for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Routes through the adjoining Baderwinkel woodland
Paved forest and woodland paths with little asphalt
Start and finish in the stadium at TSV Gilching-Argelsried
additional: Late registrations are possible on event day up to 1 hour before the respective start, subject to a late-entry fee. Toilets and changing rooms are available on site. All participants in the children’s races receive medals and certificates; certificates are awarded to the top three finishers in the main races. Participants in the main races can enter a raffle with attractive prizes from local businesses. First aid is provided by the Bavarian Red Cross, and course safety is handled by the Gilching Volunteer Fire Department. Routes follow woodland paths, online registration is open until 30.09.2025, late registration is available on event day, race numbers can be collected 1 hour before the race starts, parking is limited, and refreshments and massage services are available on site.

name: Heckengäu-Volkslauf 2026
description: The Heckengäu People’s Run is an annual running event in Wiernsheim, starting and finishing at the Lindenhalle Wiernsheim. It is firmly established in the local club SFG-Serres’s events calendar; the club also organizes other village festivals and club events. The event is part of Germany’s club road-running system, supported by volunteers, regional sports associations, and official timekeeping. It offers several distances for runners of all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Lindenhalle Wiernsheim
Distances: 400 m, 1.4 km, 5.5 km, and 10 km
Part of the established club road-running system with official timekeeping
additional: The start and finish are at the Lindenhalle Wiernsheim. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with a low of 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. There is currently no published course map or confirmed race distance. The event is supported by a broad club and safety network with official results infrastructure. It takes place in typical October conditions and is a great opportunity for running enthusiasts to experience the community and enjoy the scenic Heckengäu landscape.

name: Herbstlauf TuS Ofen
location: Sportplatz des TuS Ofen, Ofen, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The TuS Ofen Autumn Run is a family-friendly race taking place for the 35th time on 3 October 2026. The event offers distances for all age and ability groups, from 800 m for the youngest runners, to a 3 km schoolchildren’s race, a 5 km walking and fun run, and the 10 km EDEKA-Böse Run for ambitious runners. The start and finish are at the TuS Ofen sports ground. A large cake buffet in the sports hall will provide refreshments, and all participants will receive a gingerbread heart at the finish as a special treat.
course_highlights: Distances from 800 m to 10 km for all age and ability groups
Start and finish at the TuS Ofen sports ground
Refreshments with a large cake buffet in the sports hall
additional: Bag drop in the new gymnastics hall, where race numbers are collected. The event is approved by the DLV and will be held in accordance with the applicable regulations. Event number: 26V09000610860000. Courses for different age groups and fitness levels, online and on-site registration, race number collection in the gymnastics hall, event approved by the DLV.

name: Kirchertlauf
description: The Kirchertlauf in Nürtingen-Rossdorf is a long-standing running event through the Kirchert recreational area. Three races are offered for different ability levels: a 10 km main race, a 5 km Nordic walking/everyone’s race, and a 3 km student race. The courses follow firm, partly asphalted forest paths with gentle hills and are well marked. The event offers refreshments at the start/finish, changing rooms and showers, and on-site medical support.
course_highlights: Firm, partly asphalted forest paths through the Kirchert recreational area
Gently hilly circuits with 46 metres of elevation gain, marked every kilometre
Route through woodland, allotment gardens and the Humpfenbach valley, with a steep climb at the end
additional: Late registration is available on the day of the event from 8:00 to 9:45 a.m. at the information stand at the Waldheim sports grounds. Refreshments and drinks are available at the start/finish. Changing rooms and showers are available and signposted. Medical support from first-aid staff is provided in the start/finish area. After the race, coffee and cake are available for a donation. The courses are available to download as 3D maps and GPX files. The route is on asphalt and gravel, with refreshments, changing rooms, showers, first-aid staff, and coffee and cake for a donation. On-site registration is available; exact details are on the website.

name: Krautsander Insellauf
location: Drochtersen, Elbinsel Krautsand, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Krautsand Island Run is a long-standing running event on the Elbe island of Krautsand near Drochtersen. Organized by SV Dornbusch and TV Wischhafen, the event offers an appealing course in a natural setting. It is open to runners of all ability levels and takes place annually on October 3. The event is organized by the Kehdingen Athletics Association, which ensures everything runs smoothly.
course_highlights: Run on the Elbe island of Krautsand through natural surroundings
An appealing course for runners of all ability levels
A traditional event on German Unity Day
additional: Registration deadline: October 1, 2024; category: off-stadium events; registration, results, photos, accommodation information

name: Neudorfer Fichtelberglauf mit LM Berglauf
description: The Neudorf Fichtelberg Run is a challenging 9.4-kilometre mountain race with 550 metres of elevation gain, held annually in Sehmatal in the Ore Mountains since 1987. It is considered the toughest mountain race in Saxony and attracts both professional and amateur athletes. The race starts at the Neudorf Spindle Factory and finishes on the Fichtelberg summit plateau. The event includes an open state mountain-running championship and offers a free shuttle service for the return journey.
course_highlights: 9.4 km mountain race with 550 metres of elevation gain
Start at the Neudorf Spindle Factory (714 m above sea level); finish on the Fichtelberg plateau (1,214.6 m above sea level)
Route along paved roads and surfaced paths through scenic sections
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 9:00 to 10:30 at the Spindle Factory festival tent. Late entries are accepted only on the event day until 10:30 and are subject to a late-entry fee. Free shuttle bus for the return journey from the Fichtelberg to the start. Baggage transport (maximum one bag/backpack per runner). Changing rooms and showers available on site. Medical services provided by the Oberwiesenthal Mountain Rescue Service. Lunch catering by the German Red Cross (requested). Sports equipment is not permitted, and there is no Nordic walking category. Registration opens in spring 2026. Shuttle service, baggage transport, awards ceremony in the festival tent, parking at the start and train station.

name: Oberbayerische Straßenlaufmeisterschaften 10 km
description: The Schweiger Forest Run is a long-established running event organized by LG Sempt in Anzing, held annually on October 3 since 1983. The 44th edition in 2026 offers fast courses and a family-friendly atmosphere in the heart of the Anzing Forest. The Upper Bavarian 10 km Road Running Championships are held as part of the Forest Run. The event welcomes runners of all ages and is known for its excellent organization and strong running community.
course_highlights: Traditional run through the Anzing Forest
Fast 10 km road-running course
Family-friendly atmosphere and popular race character
additional: Family rate for 4 or more people, with a 25% discount for participants with the same surname. Option to support SYNGAP Elternhilfe through donations. RUNNER'S WORLD special: save €10 when registering with a subscription trial offer. The race takes place on a paved course in Anzing. Registration is via the event website. The event is part of the Upper Bavarian Road Running Championships and attracts runners from across the region.

description: The Ochsenweiherlauf in Emskirchen is a traditional running event hosted by TSV Emskirchen and held annually on October 3. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including a Bambini run, youth/schoolchildren’s run, fun run, walking, and the 10 km main race. The course follows paved forest paths around the Ochsenweiher and is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes. Refreshments are provided, and the times can be used for the German Sports Badge.
course_highlights: Paved forest paths around the Ochsenweiher
Refreshment station passed on every lap
Distances from approx. 400 m to 10 km for different age groups
additional: Late registration is available on the day of the event until 1 hour before the start, subject to a €2 late-registration fee. The event is sanctioned by the Bavarian Athletics Association, and the rules of the German Athletics Regulations apply. Bags can be stored in the changing room; keys and valuables will be held upon presentation of the race number. Times from the main race and the 7.5 km walking/Nordic walking event can be used for the German Sports Badge. October event with refreshments, Park & Ride, online registration; no liability for damage to or loss of valuables.

name: Rodenbacher Lauftag
description: The Rodenbach Running Day is a long-standing race for peace and democracy in Europe, taking place for the seventh time on October 3, 2026. The event offers four competitions for the whole family on a flat, paved, high-speed course measured according to IAAF rules through the oxygen-rich Rodenbach Forest. A special highlight is the lap through the stadium at the end of the 5 km loop, offering exciting views for spectators and runners. The youngest participants can enjoy an appealing stadium cross-country race with obstacles, commentated by an experienced team of announcers. The race is ideal preparation for an autumn marathon and is known for its family atmosphere and professional organization.
course_highlights: Flat, paved, high-speed course through the Rodenbach Forest
Lap through the stadium at the end of the 5 km loop, with a good view for spectators
Appealing stadium cross-country race with obstacles for children
additional: Late entries are possible in person on the day of the event. The course is eligible for record lists and measured according to IAAF rules. Every finisher receives a special certificate, and numerous athletes are honored at award ceremonies right at the event. Courses are measured according to IAAF rules; in-person registration is available on the day of the event, including children’s and youth races as well as a stadium cross-country race for the youngest participants.

name: Stauch Cup
