Duration: 1 hour
Individual and team categories available
additional: A competition for children and young people is also offered. The start and finish are at Hüffertsportplatz; exact location details require RUNME Premium. The event is part of the RUNME race calendar. Participants receive certificates and trophies; registration is online; the event takes place in October, weather permitting.

name: BKK Walking am Baldeneysee mit Mini-Marathon
description: BKK Walking at Lake Baldeney is part of the Westenergie Marathon weekend in Essen and offers a varied program for walkers, Nordic walkers and runners. The main marathon runs twice around Lake Baldeney, with an additional turnaround section, and features a flat profile and fast cycle paths. The marathon has been held annually since 1963, making it Germany’s oldest event of its kind. The event is organized by the athletics department of TUSEM Essen with the support of numerous volunteers. The number of participants is limited to 3,000 to avoid bottlenecks on the course.
course_highlights: Flat course around Lake Baldeney
Two laps, with an additional turnaround section on the first lap
Fast cycle paths and early autumn weather
additional: The number of participants is limited to 3,000 because of bottlenecks on the course. The walking program offers routes of up to 14 km. The event takes place annually on the second Sunday in October. Organized by the athletics department of TUSEM Essen with support from volunteers. Distances: 1.1 km, 7 km, 42.2 km; participant limit of 3,000; October weather around 14°C, cloudy; registration with the organizer recommended.

name: Coesfelder DJK - Citylauf
description: The 32nd Coesfeld City Run takes place on October 10, 2026, in Coesfeld. The event is organized by DJK Eintracht Coesfeld e.V. and gives runners of all ages the opportunity to take part in sport. The city run combines recreational, competitive, health and rehabilitation sports and is an established event in the region. Online registration is available via the official website.

A variety of race distances for all age and ability groups
Attractive prizes, certificates and trophies for top runners and teams
additional: The organizer’s office is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 12:00 and 14:30 to 18:00. The office is closed on December 24 and 31 and on public holidays. The website credits photos to photobello and provides entry lists for the individual races. Road/cross-country run, registration open, various race distances, start and finish in Coesfeld town center, age categories for children, recreational runners, club members and older participants

description: The Damscheider Kuckucks-Trail on October 10, 2026, offers a varied trail-running experience across three distances in the picturesque landscape of the Rhine Heights near Damscheid. The 21 km Extended course runs through Damscheid Forest, over natural meadows and vineyards, and along the Schwede-Bure-Weg to the valley at Oberwesel and back, with around 700 metres of elevation gain. The 9.5 km Best of Trails course offers a classic trail feel with varied terrain and 240 metres of elevation gain. Children can take part in an approximately 1 km Kidsrun around the sports field. The event combines a sporting challenge with enjoyment of nature and a family-friendly atmosphere.

9.5 km Best of Trails with varied terrain and 240 metres of elevation gain

Dogs are not permitted during the competition. Trail running on hiking paths; course distances of 9.5 km and 21 km; children's race planned; registration opens on May 16, 2026; timing by Race Result; personalised bibs with transponders.

name: Lindenseelaufserie
description: The Lindenseelaufserie is a long-standing running event in Rüsselsheim at the Lindensee, held annually. It gives runners of different ages and ability levels the opportunity to run on varied routes around the lake. The series is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and well-organized event. Participants can look forward to a scenic course and a friendly running community.
course_highlights: Running routes around the Lindensee in Rüsselsheim
Varied routes for different age and ability levels
Scenic and well-marked running paths
additional: Races in November and January; no series ranking for the 5 km race; start and finish area moved to a field path; moderate entry fees; awards for top finishers and age groups

name: Wadersloher Volkslauf
description: The Wadersloh Volkslauf is a long-standing running event in Wadersloh, welcoming runners of all ages and ability levels. Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses are available and are eligible for rankings until 2029. There are also shorter races for children and walking routes. The event takes place at the Sportpark on Winkelstraße and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with a start-number deposit and timekeeping.

600 m Bambini run and 1000 m schoolchildren’s race on the synthetic track at the Sportpark
7.5 km walking and Nordic walking route available

The 5 km and 10 km races are officially measured and have DLV approval until 2029. Photos and videos are taken and published as part of the event. Measured courses, online registration, start numbers with chips, sponsors

name: Büdelsdorfer Eiderlauf
description: The Büdelsdorf Eiderlauf is a traditional autumn race in Büdelsdorf, Schleswig-Holstein, organized by SG Athletico Büdelsdorf. It offers classic local road-race distances, including 5 km and 10 km, on flat, manageable courses that are ideal for recreational runners and beginners. The start and finish are often at Eiderstadion, giving the event a friendly, informal atmosphere. The race attracts children, young people, and local club runners, and is a fixture on the regional autumn running calendar.

Start and finish at Eiderstadion
Family-friendly local club race
additional: The race takes place in typical October weather, with daytime temperatures around 14 °C and mostly cloudy skies. Distances range from 1.5 km to 11.1 km, including children's races. After a break during the COVID-19 pandemic, the format was adjusted to incorporate the start and finish in the stadium. name: Geilenkirchener Volkslauf und 34. Halbmarathon
description: The Geilenkirchen Volkslauf and Half Marathon is a long-standing running event in Geilenkirchen-Gillrath, organized by DJK-Gillrath e. V. The event offers a flat 21.1 km half-marathon course as well as several other distances, including a 10 km run, 10 km walking and Nordic walking, a 4 km run, youth races and a Bambini run. The event caters to both recreational and competitive runners and is part of a five-year series ranking as well as the RAC ranking.

description: The Thänhuser Schloss Erbhof Run takes place on October 11, 2026, in Kirchwiehe, directly opposite Schloss Erbhof in Thedinghausen, Lower Saxony. Organized by TSV Thedinghausen, the road race has welcomed children, young people, active adults, and masters since 2016. Distances offered are 10 km, 5 km, and an 800 m children’s run, which takes place in the tree park near the start and finish. The course is a measured, flat 5 km loop that is also suitable for Nordic walking.

The 10 km course completes the loop twice
800 m children’s run in the tree park directly by Schloss Erbhof
additional: The 5 km course is also suitable for Nordic walking. October weather is typically 14 °C, with lows around 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. The children’s run, “Löwenlauf,” is designed specifically for the youngest participants and takes place near the start and finish area. Start and finish in Kirchwiehe opposite Schloss Erbhof; children’s run in the tree park; October weather with temperatures around 14°C low and 6°C high, 40 mm of precipitation, mostly cloudy.

name: Westenergie Marathon
description: The Westenergie Marathon in Essen is a traditional race around the picturesque Baldeneysee. In addition to the classic marathon, the event offers the Westenergie Seerunde, the AllbauTeamStaffel, a mini-marathon for children, and a Walking Day. The course is known for its scenic beauty and proximity to the lakeshore, making the race a special experience for runners of all ages. The event is very well organized and attracts numerous participants every year.
course_highlights: A run around the Baldeneysee with picturesque lakeside scenery
Start and finish at Seaside Beach in Essen
Sections with lake views and through the Heisinger Aue nature conservation area
additional: The start and finish are at Seaside Beach on the Baldeneysee. Late registration on the event day is paperless and uses a QR code. Children can take part in a 1.1 km mini-marathon, with a prize and medals for all participants. Photobello offers race photos. The Walking Day routes include various distances with beautiful lake views and also pass through the Heisinger Aue nature conservation area. The marathon is Germany’s oldest continuously held marathon, with a flat, fast course, several race disciplines, and support for the region. Results and certificates are available online.

name: Roštejnskou oborou
description: The Run through Roštejn Game Preserve is a friendly race for the general public, held in the scenic forests near Růžená in the Vysočina Region. The course follows forest paths and is suitable for all ages from 4 upwards, with distances ranging from 300 metres to 8,900 metres. The event is part of the Běžec Vysočiny Cup and offers a unique opportunity to run in nature and observe local wildlife. It is organised by TJ Růžená, z.s., and is ideal for families and sports enthusiasts who want to combine sport with nature.
course_highlights: Forest terrain with opportunities to observe local wildlife
Distances from 300 m to 8,900 m, suitable for all age groups
Part of the Běžec Vysočiny Cup, ideal for families and sports enthusiasts
additional: The race takes place on 9 October 2026 near Růžená. The main race is 7.3 km long, follows forest paths and is suitable for all age groups from 4 upwards.

name: Pražský Kelt
description: Pražský Kelt is a unique 100 km ultra trail in the heart of Prague, offering runners the chance to discover beautiful natural surroundings and Celtic hillforts, with a total elevation gain of 2,500 metres. The route passes through Prague’s wooded, hilly landscape and includes historic sites such as the Šance, Butovice, Závist and Vyšehrad hillforts, as well as others. It offers beautiful views of the city and surrounding nature. The race starts and finishes at the grounds of Kunratice Elementary School and is for runners who want to experience the atmosphere of an ultramarathon in an unconventional urban setting. The race is limited to 120 participants, ensuring an intimate and friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 100 km course with 2,500 m of elevation gain through Prague’s wooded hills
A route linking three Celtic hillforts and historic sites in Prague
Beautiful views of Prague from Vyšehrad, Branické skály and other places

Parking is available around the school. Mandatory equipment is specified in the race rules (section 3.3). The route for the new edition is emailed to registered participants. Aid stations are provided as part of the race and are highly appreciated by participants. The course is 100 km with 2,500 m of elevation gain; aid stations; the option of a distance race; a diploma and medal; registration until 30.9.2026; capacity of 120 participants.

Winners are recognized in both the children’s categories and the main race, with cash and non-cash prizes.

organizer: Brněnský klub běžeckých a sportovních aktivit z.s.
price_range: early bird ceny do konce roku 2025, přesné ceny nejsou specifikovány
description: Vokolo priglu is a traditional running race around the Brno Reservoir, taking place on 10 October 2026. The race offers a unique sporting experience on a 14.1 km course, approximately one third of a marathon. The course is gently undulating, mostly on asphalt with a section of rocky surface, and offers beautiful views of the Brno Sea, Veveří Castle and autumn forests. The race is open to individuals, pairs in the steamboat relay, teams of four, companies and universities, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: A 14.1 km course around the Brno Reservoir
A gently undulating course with 85% asphalt and 15% rocky surface
Views of the Brno Sea, Veveří Castle and the autumn Podkomorské Forests
additional: The main race starts in waves, timing is chip-based using a chip attached to the race bib, and the time limit is 2.5 hours. Facilities include a sports EXPO, an accompanying program for adults and children, changing rooms, portable toilets, a baggage drop, refreshments, and medical services on the course and in the start and finish area. Gift vouchers are sent electronically as PDF files. The race offers various categories, the option to buy official race merchandise, and an environmentally friendly approach with electronic vouchers.

name: Běh Borským parkem
description: Běh Borským parkem is a traditional autumn sporting event in Plzeň, with a history dating back to 1970. The race is open to both beginner recreational runners and experienced athletes of all ages. It offers excitement at the starting line, the thrill of the race atmosphere, and the joy of crossing the finish line. The organizers provide a welcoming race environment and homemade refreshments for all participants.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Borský Park in Plzeň
A traditional autumn running event with a history dating back to 1970
A friendly atmosphere for recreational and competitive runners of all ages
additional: Registration is available in advance until 10. 10. 2024 at a discounted entry fee on nazavody.cz. On-site registration is available on race day, 12. 10. 2024, from 8:30 to 9:45. The organizers provide homemade refreshments for runners. Race in Borský Park; registration: https://www.nazavody.cz/zavod/565-beh-borskym-parkem; start from 8:30 to 9:45

name: Běhej lesy Lednice
location: Lednice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Běhej lesy Lednice is part of a popular running series offering races in the Czech Republic’s most beautiful natural locations. The Lednice race takes place in the picturesque Lednice-Valtice Cultural Landscape, where runners pass through the château park, around ponds, and by iconic landmarks such as the Temple of the Three Graces and Apollo’s Temple. The courses suit runners of different abilities and include the shorter Nova 14 km and the longer ČSOB 21 km, both with an international UTMB Index. The race also features speed-section competitions and an attractive finish straight, providing extra motivation for participants.
course_highlights: Courses pass through the Lednice-Valtice Cultural Landscape, by landmarks such as the Temple of the Three Graces and Apollo’s Temple
The 150-metre Conti Speed Section, marked with Continental flags
The 500-metre Generali Investments Finish straight, with a timed section
additional: The race features the Conti Speed Section—a 150 m speed section with Continental flags—and the Generali Investments Finish—a 500 m finish straight with a timed section. The fastest man and woman will receive a technical running shirt from Craft. Participants are advised to collect their race numbers at least 90 minutes before the start. The event offers various course distances from 3 to 50 km, is suitable for families and children, and includes a charity run and partnerships with major companies such as Continental and ČSOB.

name: Hradčanské vlnky
location: Hradčany u Olomouce, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Hradčanské vlnky is a traditional cross-country trail race in Hradčany near Olomouc, offering three main distances: 5.6 km, 10.4 km, and a 21.1 km half marathon. The race focuses on off-road running, predominantly on forest and field paths, making it both appealing and challenging. Children’s categories with various distances are also included. Runners are provided with refreshments, chip timing, and extensive facilities, including showers. The atmosphere is friendly, and the race is suitable for a wide range of runners, from children to experienced trail runners.
course_highlights: Main 10.4 km course with approximately 260 m of elevation gain; 5% asphalt, 25% field paths, and 70% forest roads and trails
21.1 km half marathon with approximately 505 m of elevation gain; a combination of asphalt, field paths, and rocky trails, with the second half off-road
Short 5.6 km course with approximately 155 m of elevation gain; a fast, technical blue route
additional: Registration for children’s races opens at 8:30; the main races start at 9:45. The half marathon starts at 11:00 from the recreation area; the main 10.4 km course and the short 5.6 km course start from the town square. The entry fee includes race organization, facilities, showers, food, beer/soft drinks, chip timing, a race bib, on-course refreshments, and refreshments after finishing. Parking is organized by volunteers, with an emphasis on following traffic regulations and being considerate of Hradčany residents. The race offers various categories, including children’s categories, and features an extensive accompanying program and a raffle.

name: Podzimní běh Olympu
description: The Olymp Autumn Run is a traditional running race organized by the Olymp Prague Police Sports Club. It takes place in the scenic surroundings of Stromovka Park in Prague 7. The race offers runners of all levels the chance to enjoy the autumn atmosphere and a sporting challenge in a pleasant city park. The event is open to the general public and promotes team spirit and an active lifestyle. The organizers welcome all participants and provide support during registration and the race.
course_highlights: Run in Stromovka Park, Prague 7
Scenic urban setting with natural views
Traditional autumn running event with a friendly atmosphere
additional: The run takes place in the Stromovka grounds. Online registration is available at results.bezeckenadeje.cz

name: Benešovský půlmaratón a desítka Pojizeřím
location: Podmošně, Benešov u Semil, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Benešov Half Marathon and 10K through the Pojizeří is a traditional running race set in the picturesque village of Benešov u Semil in the Liberec Region. The race offers half-marathon and 10-kilometer courses through the beautiful countryside of the Pojizeří, with varied terrain. It is organized by TJ Benešov u Semil, which provides a friendly atmosphere and light refreshments for runners and spectators. The race is suitable for runners of all abilities and is part of the village’s sporting activities.
course_highlights: The courses wind through the scenic countryside of the Pojizeří, along forest and field paths
The half-marathon course features elevation changes and views of the hills around Benešov
The 10K offers a faster run on a mix of asphalt and forest paths
additional: The race venue is at the sports complex in upper Benešov. Registration and check-in take place at the start venue from 12:30, no later than 15 minutes before the start of each category. Light refreshments are available for runners and spectators. The race is organized by TJ Benešov u Semil z.s., with support from the village of Benešov u Semil. Events include a half marathon, a 10K, and a non-competitive 10 km route. They take place in October 2026, with the start in Podmošno.

name: Běh Bukovem
description: Běh Bukovem is an annual running festival held in the beautiful natural surroundings of Bukov and Plískov as part of the Brdy Running Cup. The race takes place entirely on meadows, forest roads and trails, offering runners an enjoyable experience in nature. The event is suitable for a wide range of age groups, from the youngest children to veterans. It is organised by the municipality of Plískov in cooperation with Farma Ekl and is known for its friendly atmosphere and tradition.
course_highlights: The course runs through the meadows, forest roads and trails around Bukov and Plískov
A range of distances for children and adults, from 100 m to 8,250 m
Start and finish at the playground by the swimming pool in Plískov
additional: Participant registration takes place on the terrace of the pub in Plískov from 9:00 to 10:50. Starts are staggered by category, from 10:05 (youngest children) to 11:21 (women, juniors and veterans). Winners in the children’s categories are announced throughout the event, while winners in the other categories are announced after the race. Participants are asked to follow Covid precautions; disinfectant is available at the start. Runners with no health restrictions take part at their own risk. The race takes place in October. The course is mainly through forest and meadows, with online registration available and different race distances offered during the year.

name: Kašavský kros
price_range: 400 CZK dospělí, 200 CZK junioři, 50 CZK děti
description: Kašavský kros is a traditional off-road running race in the area around Kašava, offering two main routes for runners aged 16 and over, as well as children’s races. The race takes place on Saturday, October 10, 2026, and is known for its established route with hills and a friendly atmosphere. It is organized by the VALACHBAJK TEAM KAŠAVA association in cooperation with the local municipality and school. The children’s races take place after the main races finish and are divided into several age categories, with different course distances.
course_highlights: Main course: 16.6 km with 679 m of elevation gain
Short course: 8 km with 254 m of elevation gain
Children’s races with courses from 100 to 1,300 m
additional: Children can register only in person on race day. Registration opens at 10:30; registration for the long course closes at 11:30; the long course starts at 12:00 and the short course at 12:30. The children’s races start from 14:30. The organizer limits the number of adult participants to 200. After the race, winners are presented with awards and a raffle is held. Terrain: trail. Registration: online and in person. The event includes children’s races and the main adult courses.

name: MUTRAverz - Mikulovský Ultra Trail Run (2)
location: Mikulov, Krušné hory, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Mikulovský Ultra Trail Run, z. s.
description: MUTRAverz is an extreme ultratrail race held in the Ore Mountains, specifically in Mikulov and its surroundings. The race is intended for experienced runners looking for a challenging course in beautiful countryside on waymarked hiking trails. The organizers emphasize safety, fair play, and high-quality event support. The race is suitable for runners over 18 who are physically and mentally prepared for extreme conditions. We look forward to seeing you at the next edition on October 10, 2026.
course_highlights: Extreme ultratrail in the Ore Mountains
Waymarked hiking trails in the Mikulov countryside
Challenging terrain suitable for experienced runners
additional: The race is open only to people over 18. Participants must be physically and mentally fit and are required to follow the race rules and safety measures. The organizer is not responsible for trail conditions or any health complications. Runners consent to audiovisual recording of their performance for the purpose of promoting the race. A trail race with courses of over 50 km and 16 km, suitable for both experienced and recreational runners; the event supports athletic performance in nature.

name: Rybský trhák
description: Rybský trhák is a road race organised by Atletický klub Emila Zátopka Kopřivnice in cooperation with the municipality of Rybí and TJ Sokol Rybí. The race is 7 km long with 135 metres of elevation gain and is open to various age categories for both men and women. The start is at the TJ Sokol Rybí football pitch, where changing rooms and showers are available. Refreshments are provided at the finish, along with prizes for the top runners in each category, including an award for the oldest participant and the best runner from the municipality of Rybí.
course_highlights: 7 km course
135 m elevation gain
Start and finish at the TJ Sokol Rybí football pitch
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available. Refreshments and a tasty treat are provided at the finish. Prizes are awarded to the first three runners in each category, as well as to the oldest participant and the best runner from the municipality of Rybí. The race takes place on 10 October 2026, with the start at 11:00. Registration is at the football pitch in Rybí. Runners can expect refreshments and prizes for category winners.

name: Běh pro Kleofáše
location: Lázeňský park Aurora, Třeboň, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běh pro Kleofáše is a traditional charity run held in the spa park in Třeboň, supporting the local hospice. Participants can choose from several categories, from short children’s races to a 12-kilometre run around Svět Pond. Less experienced runners can enjoy a pleasant four-kilometre route, and there is also a relay for two or four runners. The event offers a varied programme of activities for children and is part of Hospice Week.
course_highlights: A beautiful natural route around Svět Pond
A pleasant four-kilometre route for other runners
A 4 km relay for two or four runners
additional: Registration opens at 9:00, and participants can also sign up on the day of the event. Children’s races are divided by age, with distances of 200 m, 450 m and 1 km. Results are announced in stages after the children’s races and the 4 km and 12 km races. The event is part of Hospice Week. Routes range in length from 200 m to 12 km, with forest paths, asphalt and trails and gentle or flat elevation. Registration is available via an online form or on site. The start is at Lázeňský park Aurora.

name: Malá cena Špindlerova Mlýna
location: Městský úřad ve Špindlerově Mlýně, Špindlerův Mlýn, Krkonoše, Czech Republic
description: The Malá cena Špindlerova Mlýna is a traditional 34th edition of a hill race held as part of the Czech Cup. The race starts at the Municipal Office in Špindlerův Mlýn and offers a challenging 14 km course with 901 metres of elevation gain. It is ideal for hill-running enthusiasts who want to test themselves in the beautiful mountain setting of the Krkonoše.
course_highlights: Course distance: 14 km
Elevation gain: 901 m
Start at the Municipal Office in Špindlerův Mlýn
additional: The race is part of the Czech Cup running series. The organisers call for the protection of the Krkonoše nature. The race offers various categories for men and women. Registration is available at www.jktiming.cz. It is known for its challenging course and the beauty of the surrounding Krkonoše nature.

name: Červený okruh
location: Termit, Doksy, Liberec District, Czech Republic
description: The Červený okruh in Doksy is a traditional race in the Českolipsko District Running League, taking place on October 10, 2026. The race gives runners the chance to test themselves on an interesting course in the natural surroundings of Termit in Doksy. The event is part of a series of regional running races and attracts both the general public and experienced athletes. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and quality facilities for all participants.
course_highlights: Natural terrain at Termit, Doksy
Part of the Českolipsko District Running League
Traditional autumn running race with a history
additional: The race takes place at the Termit complex in Doksy. The course runs through woodland. Registration is available on site or by email. The race is suitable for various age groups.

name: Bašťanská šestka
description: Bašťanská šestka is a traditional running race held in the picturesque setting of the Baška Reservoir in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The race is organized by Tělovýchovná jednota Slezan Frýdek-Místek, z.s., which has long been dedicated to athletics and supporting sporting activities in the region. The event is suitable for the general public and offers an opportunity to enjoy sport in beautiful natural surroundings. Both experienced runners and recreational athletes are welcome to register and take part.
course_highlights: The race takes place on a route around the Baška Reservoir
Picturesque natural surroundings in the Moravian-Silesian Region
A traditional running event organized by the Slezan Frýdek-Místek athletics club
additional: The race is held on a road circuit around the Baška Reservoir, with the start scheduled for 11:00. The event is suitable for all age groups and also offers races for children.

name: Svatováclavský běh - Tyreto RUN
price_range: libovolná cena (dobrovolný příspěvek od 250 Kč do 1000 Kč pro první desítku registrujících)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.price: libovolná částka od 250 Kč do 1000 Kč
tiers.description: Startovné je libovolné v rozmezí 250 až 1000 Kč, výtěžek jde na charitu

description: The Svatováclavský běh Tyreto RUN 2026 is a charity running race taking place on October 10 in Děčín. The race offers courses for men, women, and children, including a family run, and supports people with multiple sclerosis through proceeds from entry fees. Participants can enjoy a sporting experience while supporting a good cause. The first ten people to register will receive a discount on Tyreto tire purchases.
course_highlights: A traditional running race in Děčín
Courses for all age groups: 2.5 km, 5 km, 12 km, and 21 km
A charitable purpose supporting Domov svatého Josefa
additional: The first ten registered participants who pay an entry fee of 250 to 1,000 Kč will receive a voucher for a discount on Tyreto tire purchases equal to the amount of their entry fee. 5 km, 12 km, and 21 km routes; races in Děčín; charity support; music and accompanying program

name: Borský kros
location: Doleček, Machov, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Borský Cross-Country Race is a traditional running race organized by the Borský Club of Skiers Machov in the scenic Doleček cross-country skiing area in the Hradec Králové Region. The course offers a range of difficulty levels, from gentle, sustained climbs suitable for families with children to challenging, hilly and steep profiles for experienced runners. The race is part of the club’s varied sporting activities and takes place in beautiful natural surroundings with quality facilities. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and a quality sporting experience for all participants.
course_highlights: The Doleček cross-country skiing area offers different types of courses, from gentle to very hilly and steep profiles
Scenic natural surroundings near Machov in the Hradec Králové Region
Quality facilities and a long tradition of the organizer, the Borský Club of Skiers Machov
additional: The Doleček cross-country skiing area offers courses suitable for families with children as well as challenging runners. The Machov area also has the Hůrka ski-jumping complex, with certified hills for summer use. The club has new facilities following the renovation of the unit beneath the ski-jumping hills, funded by a grant from the SZIF program. The race takes place in Doleček, near the ski area, with results available online. Registration details are not specified.

name: Podzimní přespolní běh - Memoriál Jiřího Bláhy
location: Koupaliště Nové Město na Moravě, Nové Město na Moravě, Vysočina, Czech Republic
description: The Autumn Cross-Country Run – Jiří Bláha Memorial is a traditional race that has been held since 1986, and this year marks its 39th edition. The race takes place at the swimming pool complex in Nové Město na Moravě, where registration opens at 8:30. The longest course is approximately 6 km for men; women run 2 km, while youth courses range from 300 m to 1,500 m. The race is run on grass, and spikes are suitable. Categories start in sequence so everyone can make it to Sunday lunch, and the results are announced shortly after the last men’s category finishes.
course_highlights: A run on grass at the swimming pool complex
Longest course approximately 6 km for men; 2 km for women
Categories start in sequence with minimal gaps
additional: Registration opens at 8:30 by the swimming pool. Categories start in sequence with the shortest possible gaps so everyone can make it to Sunday lunch. Spikes suitable for grass are used. The races are open to the general public, with the start at 9:30 and registration from 8:30 at the swimming pool. Courses are suitable for all age groups.

name: Lesní běh Říčany XCR
description: Lesní běh Říčany XCR is a popular forest race held in Říčany, with courses suitable for all age groups, from children to veterans. The race takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Central Bohemian Region and offers courses of various lengths, including 11 km and 5.7 km for adults, on challenging forest trails with steep climbs. The event is intended not only for sports enthusiasts but also for families with children, who can enjoy shorter routes adapted to the participants’ ages. The organizer, Bežecký klub Říčany, invites everyone to enjoy an active day outdoors and take part in this traditional event.
course_highlights: Forest terrain with natural trails and steep climbs
Courses available for all age groups, from children to veterans
Adult course distances of 11 km and 5.7 km
additional: The race is part of the Pohár Ladova kraje, offers courses of various lengths, and is suitable for families with children. It is scheduled for October 11, 2026.

name: Běh na Strandu
location: Stránská skála, Brno-Slatině, Brno, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Běh na Strandu is a distinctive uphill running race held at Stránská skála in Brno-Slatina. Competitors start individually at one-minute intervals, allowing them to focus on the 450-metre course with 47 metres of elevation gain. The route follows a rocky and grassy path, and the race is divided into several age categories, from younger pupils to veterans. After finishing, runners must return their bib number. Results are announced after the last competitor finishes. Registration takes place on race day from 9:00 to 10:00, and the race starts at 10:01.
course_highlights: 450 m course with 47 m of elevation gain
Route along a rocky and grassy path
Individual starts at one-minute intervals
additional: Registration takes place on race day from 9:00 to 10:00. The bib number corresponds to the start time (for example, number 1 starts at 10:01). Runners must return their bib number after finishing. Results are announced after the last competitor finishes. The race takes place in October, starts between 9:00 and 10:00, and registration begins at 9:00. The entry fee is 50 Kč. The race is open to the general public, including children and adults.

name: Hrabenovský kros
location: Hrabenov u Šumperka, Šumperk, Czech Republic
description: Hrabenov Cross is a 7.47 km forest cross-country race with 200 metres of elevation gain, held in the picturesque surroundings of Hrabenov near Šumperk. The race is part of the Chlapácký běh series, which offers challenging cross-country courses in the area around Šumperk. It is suitable for runners looking for a challenge on natural terrain with significant elevation gain. The route runs through the forest and offers beautiful natural scenery and technically interesting terrain.
course_highlights: 7.47 km forest course
200 metres of elevation gain
Part of the Chlapácký běh series in and around Šumperk
additional: The race is suitable for runners looking for a challenge on natural terrain with a technically interesting profile. It takes place in October 2026.

name: Slavkovský lesík
location: Fotbalové hřiště TJ Sokol Slavkov, Slavkov u Opavy, Opava, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Slavkovský lesík Cross-Country Run is a traditional race organized by TJ Opava, held in the picturesque woodland near Slavkov u Opavy. The race offers runners the chance to enjoy nature, varied terrain, and a relaxed sporting atmosphere. The start and registration take place by the TJ Sokol Slavkov football field, with the start traditionally at 10:00. The organizers invite all runners to take part and promise an enjoyable sporting experience.
course_highlights: Woodland terrain with varied surfaces
Start and finish by the TJ Sokol Slavkov football field
Traditional autumn date in October
additional: Registration opens at 8:30 by the TJ Sokol Slavkov football field. The race is open to the general public, and the organizers invite everyone to run for fun and enjoy a friendly atmosphere. Registration is through the ORIS system. The course follows woodland paths and is suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike.

name: Rozběháme (i) Klenčí
location: Klenčí pod Čerchovem, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Rozběháme Klenčí is a traditional running race set in the picturesque surroundings of Klenčí pod Čerchovem in the Plzeň Region. The race offers runners of all ages and abilities the chance to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and the region’s beautiful countryside. Results and rankings are carefully tracked, and the race is part of the wider Běžec Chodska series. The organizers welcome all runners and provide high-quality event facilities.
course_highlights: Various course distances, including 5 km and 10 km
Running in the picturesque surroundings of Klenčí pod Čerchovem
Races for different age groups and ability levels
additional: The event is part of the Běžec Chodska 2024 series, includes various distances and terrain, and has a strong community atmosphere.

name: Z Dobřichovic na Šraňk
description: From Dobřichovice to Šraňk is a 3.7 km uphill race with 280 metres of elevation gain, part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series. This run offers a challenging course with a significant climb, ideal for fans of mountain running and outdoor challenges. The race takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Dobřichovice and is suitable for runners who want to test their endurance and strength on hilly terrain. Come and enjoy the race atmosphere and push your limits at this traditional event.
course_highlights: Course distance: 3.7 km
Elevation gain: 280 m
Part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series
additional: The course follows the blue trail uphill to the ridge. The race is low-budget, with no changing rooms and luggage storage only. The entry fee is 20 CZK. The race offers the opportunity to be admired by slower runners and to have your photo taken for the website.

name: Vorlauf zum Harz-Gebirgslauf
description: The warm-up for the Harz Mountain Run is a free test run held one week before the main race. It gives runners the opportunity to check their fitness and get to know the Harz Mountain Run courses. Everyone starts together at 9:30 a.m. in Himmelpforte, Wernigerode, with distances of 2 km, 5 km, 11 km and 22 km. Participants are welcomed at the finish with tea and lard bread. No registration is required, but the courses are not yet marked.
course_highlights: Mass start at 9:30 a.m. in Himmelpforte, Wernigerode
Distances: 2 km, 5 km, 11 km and 22 km
Free entry; no registration required
additional: Participation is free and registration is not required. The courses are not yet marked. Tea and lard bread are served at the finish. Courses not yet marked, free participation, no registration required, including children's and family runs during the main race weekend.

name: Biberacher Herbstwaldlauf 2026
location: Biberach an der Riß, Biberach, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Biberach Autumn Forest Run is a small autumn forest run in Biberach an der Riß, starting at the Burrenwald parking lot. The event is organized by TG Biberach 1847 e.V. and offers runners a choice of 5 km or 10 km. It is a relaxed running event with no advance registration required; registration is available in person on race day. The route runs through the autumnal Burrenwald area and offers a nature-focused running experience. The entry fee is very affordable at 4 euros and includes refreshments at the finish as well as a certificate, which can be collected later or sent by email.
course_highlights: Run through the autumnal Burrenwald area
Start and finish at the Burrenwald parking lot
Nature-focused route with no stadium sections
additional: No advance registration required; registration is available in person on race day. Entry fee: 4 euros, including refreshments at the finish and a certificate. The event has been held since at least 2011, with a cancellation in 2020. A local field of participants includes many returning runners. The run takes place in the Burrenwald; finish-line refreshments are included and a certificate is available. Autumn weather in October. A small, family-friendly event.

name: Herbstcross auf dem Bergfried
price_range: 10,00 € Nachmeldegebühr für Erwachsene/Jugend U18 bis U20
description: The Herbstcross auf dem Bergfried is a short autumn cross-country race held on the grounds of the Bergfried in Saalfeld, Germany. Distances range from 800 m to 4.8 km and are designed for fast off-road running, not long road races. The race takes place outside the stadium and is classified as both a hill race and a cross-country race. The Saalfelder Leichtathletikverein has organized the event for many years, with separate races for children and adults as well as different age groups.
course_highlights: Terrain around the Bergfried in Saalfeld
Distances from 800 m to 4.8 km
Combination of hill running and cross-country running
additional: The race includes categories for youth, open class, masters, and local runners from Saalfeld-Rudolstadt. Around 200 children and young people took part in a previous edition. Typical October weather is around 14 °C during the day and 6 °C at night, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation and mostly cloudy skies. The race takes place outside the stadium and includes children’s and adults’ categories, off-road and hill running. Registration deadline: September 29, 2026.

name: 25. Volkslauf um den Altwarmbüchener See
description: The Volkslauf around Lake Altwarmbüchen is part of the Sparkassen Laufpass of the Hanover Region, one of Germany’s largest running series, with 43 events in 2026. The race gives runners the opportunity to discover the Hanover Region on foot and take part in a varied range of running events. Every participation is rewarded with a stamp in the Laufpass, which is available in both digital and traditional formats. The event is aimed at recreational runners and promotes active movement in the region.
course_highlights: Loop course around Lake Altwarmbüchen
Scenic route in the Hanover Region
Part of a large running series with a wide range of events
additional: Participation is rewarded with a stamp in the Laufpass, also available digitally via the Laufpass app. The app offers an event calendar, a digital running diary and further information. The Volkslauf is part of a series of 43 running events in the Hanover Region. Running event in Altwarmbüchen; on-site registration possible; race on 01.03.2026; part of the Laufpass series; various distances, including 1.6 km, 3.6 km, 7.2 km and 10.8 km.

name: Abt-Degen-Lauf
description: The Abt-Degen Run organized by TV 1884 Zeil is a traditional running event taking place for the 30th time on October 10, 2026. Several distances are offered, including an 11 km main race, junior races over 1600 m and 800 m, and a Bambini race. The event provides a well-organized course with timing, race-number pickup, showers and changing rooms, refreshments, and an awards ceremony. The race is open to runners of all ages and promotes a sense of sporting community in Zeil am Main.
course_highlights: 11 km main race
Junior races over 1600 m and 800 m
Bambini race for the youngest runners
additional: The event offers team scoring, race-number pickup, timing, showers and changing rooms, toilets, an awards ceremony, food and drink, medical support, and a secured course. The course is hilly; races are available for adults, children, and young people; team scoring; family- and team-friendly; results published

name: Brakelsieker Volkslauf "Am Fuße des Mörths"
location: Sportplatz Brakelsiek, Schieder-Schwalenberg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Brakelsieker Volkslauf “Am Fuße des Mörths” is a traditional local running, walking and Nordic walking event in Schieder-Schwalenberg, held on a Saturday afternoon in October. It offers a range of distances for adults and young people, including 5 km, 9 km and 15 km runs, as well as 5 km and 9 km walking and Nordic walking. The start and finish are at the Brakelsiek sports ground, and the course runs around the village sports ground, with a gently rolling, rural profile at the foot of the Mörth. The event is a lovely opportunity to enjoy the autumn scenery in a relaxed atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Brakelsiek sports ground
Loop around the village sports ground; not a point-to-point course
Gently rolling course with a rural profile at the foot of the Mörth
additional: Running, walking and Nordic walking distances are offered for adults and young people. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with a low of 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. The course is not considered a tough mountain route, but has moderate elevation gain. Running and walking events; start and finish at the Brakelsiek sports ground; gently rolling course; rural profile.

name: Herberts Bremserlauf mit dem TSV Zornheim
description: The Herberts Bremserlauf with TSV Zornheim is a local road race in Zornheim, taking place on October 10, 2026. With 2 km and 10 km distances, it offers a club and community race format that differs from stadium events. It is part of the Wingertscup series in the Mainz region and is open to children, school-age runners, youth, adults, masters, and recreational runners. Changing facilities and showers are available at the nearby Hans-Steib-Halle. On-site late registration is possible, but incurs a small surcharge.
course_highlights: Road race in a club and community race format
Part of the Wingertscup series in the Mainz region
Start and meeting point at Herberts Kulturscheune
additional: On-site late registration is possible but incurs a small surcharge. Changing facilities and showers are located at the Hans-Steib-Halle on Zum Neuen Sportplatz. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with lows of 6 °C, mostly cloudy skies, and an average of 40 mm of precipitation. On-site late registration is available, and facilities such as changing rooms and showers are available at the Hans-Steib-Halle.

name: Herbstlauf
description: The 2026 Autumn Run takes place on October 10 at the Waldstadion Schutterwald. The course covers 10 kilometers of flat forest and field paths, measured and marked in accordance with DLV standards. The event is open to runners of all age groups and offers an appealing opportunity to run in natural surroundings. Registration is online via my.raceresult.com, and the organizer is happy to answer questions by email.
course_highlights: 10 km of flat forest and field paths
Course measured in accordance with DLV standards
Every kilometer is marked
additional: Start and finish at the Waldstadion. Register online via my.raceresult.com. Entry fees include €0.50 in federation fees. Online registration, every kilometer is marked, an event with a strong community spirit

name: IKK Südwest Freundschaftslauf
description: The IKK Südwest Friendship Run is a traditional timed-hour run in Marpingen, offering various running distances as well as walking and Nordic walking routes. The event is not a competition; its focus is on community and the enjoyment of running. Routes range from 5.5 km to 11 km, with untimed hiking routes also available. The run is organized by the Saarland Athletics Federation and takes place on 10 October 2026.
course_highlights: Timed-hour run with routes from 7 to 11 km
Walking and Nordic walking routes between 5.5 and 6.5 km
Untimed hiking
additional: The Friendship Run is explicitly not a competition. No times are recorded. The event includes various running and walking distances as well as hiking routes. It is organized by the Saarland Athletics Federation. There is no official timed competition, no prizes, and no competitive rankings; it is ideal for community and the enjoyment of running.

name: Kuppinger Mondfängerlauf
description: The Kuppinger Mondfängerlauf is a special race that runs into the night. Since 2009, it has replaced the well-known Zigeunerberglauf. Illuminated sections of the course create a unique atmosphere. As the sixth and final race in the Schönbuch-Cup series, it traditionally takes place on the second Saturday in October. The event is firmly rooted in the region and appeals to runners who appreciate a special atmosphere while running.
course_highlights: A race that runs into the night
Illuminated sections of the course create a special atmosphere
The final race in the Schönbuch-Cup series
additional: Registration and results are available centrally via the Schönbuch-Cup website. The event takes place on 10 October 2026, with the start and finish at the Kuppingen community hall. A festive running atmosphere for the whole family is on offer.

name: Lichterlauf in Steckenborn
description: The Steckenborn Lichterlauf is a popular race in the Eifel region, known for its unique atmosphere. The course is 10 kilometers long and consists of a 2-kilometer loop run five times. As darkness falls, the course is atmospherically lit with spotlights, lanterns, candles, and torches, making the race a special experience. The organizer, SC Komet Steckenborn e.V., looks forward to welcoming many participants to enjoy this special event.
course_highlights: 10 km course on a 2 km loop run five times
Atmospheric lighting with spotlights, lanterns, candles, and torches after dark
Race with a unique atmosphere in the Eifel region
additional: 10 km night race on a lit course, team competition for young people, registration on the website

name: Loßburger Waldlauf
description: The Loßburg Forest Run is a traditional autumn forest run in Loßburg, Germany, organized by Skiclub Loßburg. The event is being held for the 30th time and offers runners a varied route on roads and forest paths, with no laps on a track. There are several distances, including a 400 m run for children and young people and a challenging 10 km run for adults with a hilly profile. The races start in the evening, with the 10 km run beginning at 19:00.
course_highlights: Forest and road run in October
Hilly profile for the 10 km run
Children’s and youth events over a 400 m distance
additional: The 10 km run starts at 19:00; the shorter run (6.7 km) starts earlier in the evening. The event takes place at the school center in Loßburg. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with mostly cloudy skies and an average of 40 mm of precipitation. Registration is open until October 9, 2026. The event also includes children’s and youth races at various distances, including a 400 m run for the youngest participants.

name: Muswiesenlauf
description: The Muswiesenlauf is a traditional fun run in Hohenlohe, celebrating its 41st edition on October 10, 2026. It is the oldest fun run in the region and offers a range of distances for children, teenagers, and adults. The courses are officially measured and follow varied routes along paved agricultural roads and gravel forest paths. Every participant receives a certificate, and children also receive bumper-car tokens. The event takes place as part of the historic Muswiese festival, which has been held annually since 1434.
course_highlights: Officially measured distances of 500 m, 1 km, 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Varied routes featuring paved roads and gravel forest paths
Run held as part of the traditional Muswiesenfest in Hohenlohe
additional: Late registrations are possible on race day up to 45 minutes before the relevant start. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Forum multipurpose hall, 2 km away; basic changing facilities without showers are available at the start area. The awards ceremony takes place in the Muswiesenhalle at the festival grounds. Parking is available around the festival grounds and the start/finish area; heavy traffic may cause delays. Races over 500 m, 1,000 m, 2,500 m, 5,000 m, and 10,000 m; online registration until one day before the race; late registration available on race day; race bibs distributed at Stadel Hofburk.

name: Parforceheide Crosslauf
location: Sportplatz an der Heinrich-Zille-Straße, Stahnsdorf, Brandenburg, Germany
description: The Parforceheide Cross-Country Run has been organized by RSV Eintracht 1949 in Stahnsdorf since 2008, giving recreational runners from the region the chance to discover the varied landscape of the Parforceheide. The course starts at the sports ground on Heinrich-Zille-Straße and passes the Südwestfriedhof cemetery, winding through woodland and natural terrain with small climbs, sandy sections, and stretches of asphalt and cobblestones. Races are offered over 1 km (Bambini), 3 km (schoolchildren), 5 km, and 10 km for young people and adults. After the race, the organizer provides refreshments, and football matches often take place at the sports ground, making for an enjoyable day of sport for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Course through the Parforceheide, with woodland and natural sections
Varied surfaces: sand, asphalt, and cobblestones
Small climbs add challenge and variety
additional: Races are available for various age groups and distances: Bambini race (1 km), schoolchildren’s race (3 km), and 5 km and 10 km races for young people and adults. Refreshments are provided at the sports ground after the race. The event is part of the Mittelmark Cup and is supported by many volunteers. Football matches are often played on the artificial turf afterward, rounding out the day for families and spectators. Terrain with climbs, sandy sections, asphalt, cobblestones. Registration at www.ziel-zeit.de

name: Pegnitztallauf 2026
description: The Pegnitztal Run is an afternoon event in Vorra, Germany, featuring a flat, single-lap course that does not require repeated laps. The program includes 5 km races for adults and young people, a 10 km race for adults, and 5 km Nordic walking for adults. Children’s and youth races round out the program, making this a local, club-oriented running event. The finish is at the tennis facility in 91247 Vorra, and the start is at 15:00.
course_highlights: Flat, single-lap course with no repeated laps
Finish at the tennis facility in Vorra
A varied program with races for children, young people, and adults
additional: The event takes place in the afternoon, with a 15:00 start. October weather is typically around 14 °C, with lows of 6 °C; it is mostly cloudy, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The event is more of a local club race than a road race exclusively for adults. It is a local club run with a family-friendly atmosphere, welcoming runners of all ages.

name: Ramsthaler Wein-Berg-Lauf
description: The Ramsthal Wine Mountain Run is a traditional running event held annually in Ramsthal. The event offers various competitions for all age groups, from Bambini to schoolchildren, teenagers and adults. The routes pass through Ramsthal’s picturesque vineyards and offer varied scenery. In addition to the running competitions, there is also a walking route that lets participants enjoy the beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Running routes through the picturesque vineyards of Ramsthal
A variety of competitions for Bambini, schoolchildren, teenagers and adults
An 8 km walking route through beautiful scenery
additional: Competitions for various age groups and distances: Bambini, schoolchildren, teenagers and adults (6.4 km and 10.4 km), as well as walking (8 km). Running, Nordic walking, family-friendly activities, picturesque vineyard scenery

name: Solvay Lauf
description: The Solvay Run Bernburg is a 5 km race in Bernburg, Saxony-Anhalt, taking place on October 10, 2026. The start is at Krumbholzallee 8 at 10:00 a.m. The race is part of the Solvay Cup and combines cross-country and road running, so it is not a simple, flat city course. It is aimed mainly at local clubs and usually attracts 100 to 300 runners. The event offers professional timing, online results, certificates, showers, changing rooms, parking, free bag drop and refreshments at the finish.
course_highlights: 5 km course combining cross-country and road running
Start at Krumbholzallee 8 in Bernburg
Local race with a manageable field of 100–300 runners
additional: Registration is available online, in person in advance or on site on race day. Chip timing by race result, online results and start lists, photos and reports, printed and online certificates, showers, changing rooms, parking, free bag drop and refreshments at the finish. Typical October weather: around 14 °C, mostly cloudy with 40 mm of precipitation. This is not a major event, but a local race that typically attracts 100 to 300 participants. In addition to the race, it offers a friendly atmosphere with refreshments, showers and parking.

name: Viersener Herbstwaldlauf Rund um den Bismarckturm
description: The 79th Viersen Autumn Forest Run Around the Bismarck Tower takes place on 10 October 2026 in Viersen. The event offers a 5 km run for adults on a hilly course, with a time limit of one hour. There is also a 7.25 km Walking & Nordic Walking event. The age limits are 14 to 99 for the run and 10 to 99 for walking. This traditional event is aimed at runners and walkers looking for a challenging course through autumn woodland.
course_highlights: Hilly course
Around the Bismarck Tower
One-hour time limit for the 5 km run
additional: There are events for children and young people; further information is available in the organiser’s official race announcement. All events share the same start and finish, but the exact locations are only shown with RUNME Premium. Results are listed by age category, with categories assigned according to year of birth. There are several events with different distances, age categories and start times; young people aged 14 and over may participate. Results will be published on the website.

name: Volkslauf mit Walking um den AWB See
description: The 25th Volkslauf with walking around the AWB Lake is a local running and walking event in Altwarmbüchen, a district of Isernhagen. The event offers short, flat distances around Altwarmbüchener See, with one lap measuring approximately 3.66 km. There are various running and walking routes for adults, as well as races for children and young people, making it a community running experience for the whole region. The start and finish are at Seestraße 23, and the races take place in the afternoon.
course_highlights: Flat route around Altwarmbüchener See
Lap of approximately 3.66 km
Running and Nordic walking options
additional: The races start in the afternoon in the following order: first the 3.6 km run, then the walkers, followed by the 7.2 km run for adults. The event is more of a community running day for the town than a single main race. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with a low of 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. Distances range from 1.6 km to 10.8 km; flat terrain; running and walking events; races for children and young people; date: 10 October 2026.

name: Berliner Morgenpost Great 10K
price_range: 25,00 € bis 70,00 € je nach Strecke und Anmeldedatum
description: The Berliner Morgenpost Great 10K is Berlin’s fastest 10 km race, starting in front of Charlottenburg Palace. The route passes through Berlin Zoo and offers a unique running experience in the capital. In addition to the classic 10-kilometre race, there is also a 2 x 5 km relay and a 4.2 km short course from the zoo to Charlottenburg Palace. The event is suitable for all abilities and age groups, offering a large running festival for the whole family.
course_highlights: Start in front of Charlottenburg Palace
The route passes through Berlin Zoo
Running festival on the forecourt of Charlottenburg Palace
additional: Chip timing with a transponder attached to your shoe, refreshment stations and toilets along the route, pacemakers for the 10 km and short course, online certificate with your personal result, BVG tickets for relay runners, bag transport from the start to the finish, medal engraving and event shirts available as add-ons, HD finish-line video available to purchase, children’s and Bambini races for those born between 2014 and 2021. Distances: 10 km, 4.2 km, children’s and Bambini races, relay events; registration until 20.10.2024; start in front of Berlin Zoo, finish at Charlottenburg Palace; event extras such as medal engraving, photos and videos available.

name: 19. Burger-Rolandlauf
description: The Burger Roland Run is a traditional race that normally takes place in Burg and is jointly organized by Rolandgymnasium Burg and LG Ihleläufer Burg. The course runs through the town along the Ihle, through the forest and past the Bismarck Tower, finishing in the school courtyard. Alongside the competition, participants can enjoy a varied supporting program with music, activities for children and refreshments. In 2026, the event in Burg was canceled because the necessary permit was not granted; a replacement event will instead take place in Tangerhütte Town Park.
course_highlights: The course runs through the town of Burg along the Ihle
A forest section with views of the Bismarck Tower
Finish in the courtyard of Rolandgymnasium
additional: The traditional course in Burg was not approved for 2026. A replacement event will instead take place in Tangerhütte Town Park. Entry fees already paid can be refunded. After the race, there will be a supporting program with music, activities for children and refreshments. Cancellation in 2026, replacement event in Tangerhütte, course through Burg, activities for children, bouncy castle, refreshments

name: Frühstückslauf
description: The breakfast run in Wernigerode is a group run without timing, starting at the market square and climbing to Wernigerode Castle. The route is about 3 kilometres long with 100 metres of elevation gain. The run takes place as a group and is free of charge. A small snack is served afterwards, making the run a sociable event.
course_highlights: Route about 3 km long
About 100 m of elevation gain
Group run uphill to Wernigerode Castle
additional: The run is free of charge, takes place as a group and is not timed. A small snack is served afterwards. Group run, no timing, snack afterwards.

name: H/21 Halbmarathon
description: The H/21 Half Marathon Hannover is a new event on the national running calendar, combining urban flair, modern beats and green stretches. The start and finish are in the heart of Hannover, and the route passes notable hotspots across the state capital. The event takes place in autumn and offers a unique running experience in a lively urban setting. Be there for the prologue as Hannover opens a new chapter in running history.
course_highlights: The route combines urban flair with green stretches
Start and finish in the heart of Hannover
The route passes notable hotspots in the state capital
additional: Check-in takes place on October 10, 2026, and the starting gun goes off on October 11, 2026. The event is an autumn highlight with urban flair and modern music. There are attractive side events, and the route is secured by course marshals. Participation is at your own risk, and DLV and IAAF regulations apply. Course in 2026: the 10 km route is run twice, followed later by the full half-marathon distance; registration is open until race day; a run with a modern atmosphere and music

name: München Marathon
price_range: 15 Euro bis 29,50 Euro (Shirt), variiert je nach Anmeldung
description: The Munich Marathon offers a varied running experience in the Bavarian capital, with a marathon, half marathon, 10 km run and marathon relay. The marathon course passes through the Olympic Park, Leopoldstraße, the English Garden and Munich city centre, and finishes in the Olympic Park. The half-marathon course starts in the English Garden and also finishes in the Olympic Park. The marathon relay lets teams cover the 42.195 km together, with handovers at designated kilometre points. Due to renovation work, the finish is at Hans-Jochen-Vogel-Platz next to the Olympic Hall.
course_highlights: Marathon course featuring sights such as the Olympic Park, Siegestor, the English Garden, Isartor, Marienplatz and Odeonsplatz
Half marathon starts at the Chinese Tower in the English Garden and finishes in the Olympic Park
Marathon relay with four relay points at KM 9.5, 21.3 and 27, followed by a joint finish
additional: The start and finish are at Hans-Jochen-Vogel-Platz next to the Olympic Hall due to renovation work at the Olympic Stadium. Marathon relay teams can run the final metres together and receive their finisher medals as a team. The 10 km course is an out-and-back route from the Olympic Park through Schwabing and back. The half marathon is arranged so that even runners finishing in up to 3 hours can complete the distance comfortably. Registration is open until 27 September 2026. The event also includes activities for children and inclusive running events. The course passes through central Munich neighbourhoods and offers a festive atmosphere for runners and spectators.

name: Bad Hersfelder Lollslauf
description: The Bad Hersfeld Lollslauf is a traditional running event held annually in Bad Hersfeld, welcoming runners of all ages and ability levels. With distances ranging from the Bambini Run to the 10 km individual race, the Lollslauf offers a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings. Alongside the competition, the event emphasizes community and the joy of running. It is a fixture on the running calendar and attracts participants from across Germany.
course_highlights: 500 m Bambini Run around the market square and Germany’s oldest folk festival
A range of courses from 500 m to 10 km, starting and finishing at Linggplatz
Run through the historic old town of Bad Hersfeld
additional: Start times: 1.3 km school race at 09:35, 5 km individual race at 10:00, 5 km team race at 10:10, 5 km Nordic walking at 11:30, 10 km individual race at 11:45, 500 m Bambini Run at 11:15. Certificates available as digital downloads; drinks in the finish area. Teams of 5–7 people can enter the team race. Prizes in kind for the overall winners. Multiple race categories; on-site registration available. Scenic course in Bad Hersfeld.

name: Berglauf
location: Geislingen an der Steige, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The mountain run organized by the Schneelaufverein Geislingen is a long-standing event held annually in Geislingen an der Steige. The route climbs uphill and offers runners a challenging course in a scenic setting. The event attracts both competitive and recreational runners and is known for its friendly atmosphere. Registration is handled through MY RACE RESULT, with the deadline falling shortly before the race.
course_highlights: Uphill route with a challenging elevation profile
Scenic surroundings in Geislingen an der Steige
Start and finish at the SVG ski hut, Dorfstr. 70
additional: Registration and results are handled through MY RACE RESULT. The registration deadline is 12:00 noon on the Saturday before the race. The start and finish are at the SVG ski hut in Geislingen an der Steige (Weiler o. H. district). The event takes place on October 11, 2026; route and elevation profiles are available; registration is through Race Result; the venue is SVG Dorfstr. 70, Geislingen an der Steige.

name: Burscheider Stadtlauf
location: Burscheid, Rheinisch-Bergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Burscheid City Run takes place on October 11, 2026, in the town center of Burscheid and offers an ideal setting for runners of all ability levels. There are several distances: the 10-kilometer main race, a 3-kilometer run, and an 800-meter run that serves as a qualification for the Sports Badge. The event has a friendly, family atmosphere and welcomes both competitive runners and recreational athletes. All finishers receive the traditional Kretzer City Run bread, and the top finishers are awarded special trophies.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer main race through the town center
3-kilometer run for recreational athletes
800-meter youth run as a qualification for the Sports Badge
additional: Late entries are possible at the registration office on race day for an additional fee of €5.00, but late registrants will not receive Kretzer City Run bread. Race packets will be distributed from 10:30 a.m. at the Protestant church. Changing rooms and showers are available at the “Auf dem Schulberg” sports hall. Free drinks are available along the course and at the finish. Age-group rankings follow DLO regulations. First aid is provided by the German Red Cross, Burscheid branch. Bib numbers must be worn on the chest. The event also includes children’s races, race-packet distribution from 10:30 a.m., online results, age-group rankings, medals, and trophies. October weather is usually mild, making participation comfortable.

name: Citylauf Schwabach 2026
description: The RIBE Citylauf Schwabach on 11 October 2026 offers a varied running programme for all age groups and ability levels. Events include a half marathon, relay, main race, fun run, walking and children’s races. The races start and finish at Königsplatz in Schwabach, and participants can expect a well-organised event with a family-friendly atmosphere. The route leads through the city and offers a special running experience in Schwabach, the City of Gold Leaf.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course of approx. 21.1 km
Start and finish at Königsplatz next to the town hall
A variety of race distances for children, young people and adults
additional: Late entries are possible only on race weekend, subject to availability. Places are limited, and on-site late entries are not available for sold-out events. Participants in the main races must be at least 16 years old; the maximum time is 3 hours. Relay legs are approx. 7 km each. The start and finish are at Königsplatz next to the town hall and at Fürstenherberge, respectively. Registration is open until 4 October 2026. A variety of categories are available for different age groups and ability levels. Refreshments are provided at several points along the route.

name: Hotfoot Run Bad Hönningen
price_range: Super Early Bird Preise (spezifische Preise nicht angegeben)
description: The Hotfoot Run Bad Hönningen is an exciting obstacle race on 11 October 2026, with distances of 7 to 26 kilometres to suit all ability levels. The route runs through the picturesque spa town of Bad Hönningen on the Rhine, past vineyards and historic buildings, and features varied terrain with plenty of elevation gain. Alongside the sporting challenge, participants can expect spectacular obstacles, mud, water slides and a unique atmosphere with a spectacular opening show. The race is ideal for individuals, teams and families looking to enjoy fun and adventure together.
course_highlights: Along the legendary Rheinsteig trail, with spectacular views of the Rhine Valley
Narrow, steep sections and plenty of elevation gain
Past Arenfels Castle, two gravel pits and a disused concrete plant
additional: The start and finish are right in the centre of Bad Hönningen, directly on the Rhine. There is a mega opening show featuring bands and DJs before the mass start. Group discounts are available for groups of 6 or more. The Family Edition is for children aged 12 and over, accompanied by an adult, on a 7 km route. There are different start groups (Überflieger, Senkrechtstarter, Dauerbrenner, Spätzünder) for different ability levels. The event includes water and mud obstacles, group discounts when registering, music, costumes and various distances, including a family edition for children aged 12 and over accompanied by an adult.

name: Int. Schwarzwald-Marathon
description: The Black Forest Marathon in Bräunlingen is a long-established race that has been held annually since 1968 and is known as the world’s oldest nature and women’s marathon. The course runs mainly along well-maintained forest trails and offers a varied experience in nature, with a gentle climb up to kilometer 21 followed by a slight descent. In addition to the classic marathon, there is also a marathon relay, half marathon, 10 km races, Nordic walking and other races for different age groups. The event is ideal for runners who want to combine nature with a sporting challenge.
course_highlights: 80% well-maintained forest trails, 20% asphalt
Gentle climb up to approx. km 21, followed by a slight descent
Kilometer markers along the entire course
additional: Late registration is available at the town hall on 10.10.2026 from 12:00-18:00 and on 11.10.2026 from 07:00 until 60 minutes before the start. Bib numbers are color-coded to make the different events easier to distinguish. No transportation is provided by the organizer for the marathon relay. Various race disciplines; on-site registration available; bib numbers are color-coded; the schedule may be changed at short notice.

name: Klosterlauf Aurachtal

price_tiers.distance: Hauptlauf, Hobbylauf, Jugendlauf B, Nordic Walking

description: The Klosterlauf Aurachtal is a running event starting and finishing near the Münchaurach Abbey Church. All routes are marked by kilometre and run mainly on paved paths and gravel tracks. Various events are offered, including a 10 km main race, a fun run, youth races, Nordic walking, and children’s and Bambini races. The event is open to all healthy people with sufficient training; club membership is not required.
course_highlights: Start and finish near the Münchaurach Abbey Church
Routes mainly on paved paths and gravel tracks
Routes marked by kilometre
additional: Late entries are possible up to 1 hour before the respective start for an additional fee of 4,- €. Registration is valid only once payment has been received. Entry fees can be refunded up to 2 weeks before the event date. Prizes are awarded to places 1–3 in each age group (male/female). The event is managed by an external service provider. The main race route is 10 km (2 laps); the fun run, Youth Race B, and Nordic walking are 5 km (1 lap); the children’s race is approximately 1 km (out and back). Routes are mainly on paved paths. Online registration is available; late entries are subject to a fee. Participation is open from age 18 without club membership. Prizes are awarded to the top finishers in the age groups.

name: Kreuzberglauf mit Ufr. Meisterschaften
location: Schönau an der Brend, Rhön-Region, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Kreuzberglauf in Schönau an der Brend is a traditional running event held annually by DJK Olympia Schönau. The event attracts runners of various ages and ability levels and offers a sporting challenge in the scenic Rhön region. The course passes through varied terrain and is part of the Lower Franconian Championships. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event with a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Run through the scenic Rhön region
Part of the Lower Franconian Championships
Varied terrain with diverse sections of the course
additional: The race takes place on 11 October 2026. Further details about registration and participation are available on the website.

name: Laubacher Ramsberglauf
price_range: bis 20. September vergünstigtes Startgeld, danach zzgl. Nachmeldegebühr
description: The Laubach Ramsberg Run is a traditional running event that starts and finishes in the picturesque castle park in Laubach. The event offers various distances for different age and ability groups, including a 10 km main race, a 5 km fun run, and races for schoolchildren and Bambini. The races feature a varied course through the beautiful countryside around Laubach. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere, with refreshments, changing facilities, and an awards ceremony right in the castle park.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Laubach Castle Park
A varied course through the countryside around Laubach
Refreshments and changing facilities at the Sports and Cultural Hall
additional: Registration is via RACERESULT, with a reduced entry fee available until 20 September; a late registration fee applies thereafter. Changing and shower facilities are available at the Sports and Cultural Hall. The awards ceremony takes place right in the castle park. Distances: 10 km main race, 5 km fun run, children’s races over 1500 m and 300 m; registration via Raceresult; start and finish in the castle park; refreshments, changing and shower facilities on site; October weather: approx. 14°C, cloudy

name: Offenbacher Mainuferlauf
description: The Offenbach Main Riverside Run is an open running event held annually along the Main River in Offenbach. Races are offered over 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as a 2 km schoolchildren’s run. The course follows the Main and offers an attractive riverside setting. In 2025, short-notice course changes were made due to construction work. The event is open to all runners; club membership is not required. It has a family-friendly atmosphere and a dedicated organizing team.
course_highlights: Run along the Main with attractive riverside scenery
Distances of 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon
Separate 2 km schoolchildren’s run
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Mathildenschule Offenbach, Arthur-Zitscher-Str. Parking is recommended at the Innenstadt car park on Berliner Straße (about 750 m away; fee of approximately €1 per hour). Due to construction work, Mainstraße is closed, resulting in short-notice course changes. This year’s course is not eligible for record purposes because official measurement was not possible. The half-marathon starts about 350 m from the previous start location. The 5 km and 10 km races start by the Main at the finish arch. The 2 km schoolchildren’s run starts by the Main as usual. Event photos are provided by Team Ingo Kutsche. Course changes due to construction work; course not eligible for record purposes; registration opens on 1.8.2025; weather-dependent conditions; various race distances

name: Porta Volkslauf
organizer: SC Nammen / SC Porta Westfalica Nammen e.V.
description: The 2026 Porta Fun Run is a long-standing running event in Porta Westfalica and has been a fixture on the regional running calendar for more than three decades. The event attracts runners of all ages, from competitive athletes to recreational runners. The route follows roads and field paths around the Nammen sports ground and through the Nammer Unterholz nature reserve, offering varied, flat sections with beautiful panoramic views of Porta. The race is part of the Mühlenkreisserie and takes place at the local sports facility in Nammen. The warm atmosphere and sense of community make it a special day.
course_highlights: Route along roads and field paths around the Nammen sports ground
Sections through the Nammer Unterholz nature reserve
Flat, varied sections with panoramic views of Porta
additional: The race is part of the Mühlenkreisserie (8th race in 2026). Course maps for the short course (5.5 km), medium course (8.8 km) and long course (17 km) are available as PDFs. Registration will open shortly. The event takes place at the sports facility in Nammen (Poggenbeeke). The courses are flat and offer open views of nature. Registration and course maps will be available soon. Drinks, coffee, cake and bratwurst are available in the start/finish area.

name: Salzachbrückenlauf
