description: The Salzach Bridge Run starts and finishes at Burghausen town square, below Burghausen Castle, the longest castle complex in the world. The route follows the Salzach, which forms the border between Germany and Austria, and includes several border crossings. Various distances are offered, including a 505-metre parent-child run, a 3.2 km fun run, a 5.5 km walk and the 8.8 km main race. More than 1,000 participants take part each year, from children and recreational runners to club runners and fast athletes. The run is a charity event organised by nine volunteers, with proceeds supporting local people in need.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Burghausen town square below the castle
The route crosses the Salzach and the German-Austrian border
The 8.8 km route includes four border crossings and sections on gravel paths by the bathing lake
additional: The run takes place annually under the patronage of Bürgerinsel Burghausen. The 8.8 km route includes a second lap and passes a bathing lake and a rowing lake. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with mostly cloudy skies and an average of 40 mm of precipitation. Multiple distances, including a 505 m route; charity event; scenic surroundings around Burghausen; open to children, recreational runners and competitive runners.

name: Sebastian Fredrich Gedenklauf (LM/LC/NLC)
description: The Sebastian Fredrich Memorial Run is a traditional running event in Lubmin, organized by the Triathlon and Running Group of HSG Uni Greifswald. The event offers a sporting challenge in a friendly, well-organized atmosphere, supported by many volunteers. The course passes through scenic areas and is suitable for both ambitious runners and recreational athletes. The event is part of an active running and triathlon community in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.
course_highlights: Running course through scenic areas in Lubmin
Good organization, with many volunteers along the course and in the finish area
Traditional run with high participation and a positive atmosphere
additional: The event is organized by the Triathlon and Running Group of HSG Uni Greifswald. Relay competitions are held over middle and short distances. The event is known for strong participation and positive feedback. A para-athlete was specially honored for an outstanding performance. The event also offers special short-distance races for young participants (U10, U12, U14) and fosters team spirit. October weather is usually mild, with temperatures around 14°C, and the event takes place at the Seebadzentrum near the Baltic Sea.

name: Sparkassen SAARathon
description: The Sparkassen SAARathon 2026 takes place on 11 October in Saarbrücken and offers suitable challenges for runners of all ability levels. The flat, fast courses run along the Saar and offer wonderful views of Saarbrücken city and the varied surrounding area. In addition to the traditional 10 km Westspangenlauf, there is a new World Heritage Marathon, held for the third time, which takes runners as far as the Völklinger Hütte. The running event combines a sporting challenge with scenic beauty and regional culture.
course_highlights: Flat, fast courses along the Saar
Wonderful views of Saarbrücken city and the surrounding area
World Heritage Marathon route to the Völklinger Hütte
additional: The event includes several distances: marathon (with state championships), half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and 1 km schoolchildren’s race. The event is aimed at experienced runners and beginners. The 10 km course, the Westspangenlauf, has a 38-year tradition. The organizers can be reached by phone at 0681-927200, Monday to Friday from 8:30 to 17:00. Courses for all ability levels, online registration, race number collection in Saarbrücken, discounts for groups and people with disabilities, pacemakers available

name: Storkower See Lauf
description: The Storkower See Run is a long-standing running event organised by Triathlonverein Fürstenwalde 1990 e.V. and approved by the Brandenburg Athletics Association. On 11 October 2026, runners of different age groups and ability levels can take part on various distances around Lake Storkow. The event offers a fair competition atmosphere and is open to running enthusiasts of all ages. Online registration opens in January 2026, and participants are included in an official participant list.
course_highlights: Various distances from 1 km to 15.2 km
Running routes around Lake Storkow
Start and finish area with a modern race briefing
additional: Race numbers can be collected on event day from 08:00. There are several competition classes (WK1 to WK6) with different start times. Award ceremonies begin at around 11:00. Registration is only valid once payment has been received. Online registration is available; start times and distances vary. The event is suitable for runners of all ability levels.

name: Styrumer Straßenlauf "Rund um die Neustadtstraße"
location: Neustadtstraße, Mülheim an der Ruhr, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
distance_verbose: 25 km, Halbmarathon, Halbmarathon, 15 km, 10 km, 7.5 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: The Styrum Road Race “Around Neustadtstraße” is a traditional road race in Mülheim an der Ruhr, centered on Neustadtstraße in Styrum. The event offers various distances from 1 km to 100 km, including 5 km, 7.5 km, 10 km, 15 km, 20 km, 25 km, a half marathon and 50 km. The courses are officially measured and listed in the laufen.de race calendar, making participation in the German rankings possible. The race is held in accordance with the rules and safety standards of the German Athletics Association (DLV).
course_highlights: Officially measured road race courses
A range of distances from 1 km to 100 km
Event on Neustadtstraße in Styrum
additional: Typical October weather: approx. 14 °C, low of 6 °C, average precipitation of 40 mm, mostly cloudy. The event also includes shorter distances such as 5 km, 7.5 km, 10 km, 15 km, 20 km and 25 km, as well as special races for children and young people. The course runs along Neustadtstraße and through Sportpark Styrum, in cool October weather averaging 14°C. The event is listed in the official race calendar and meets the standards of the German Athletics Association.

name: Trochtelfinger Nordic Walking Stöckles-Cup

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Für Gruppenanmeldungen von 10 Personen und mehr gilt der ermäßigte Tarif von 11,- €

description: The Trochtelfingen Stöckles Cup is a popular Nordic walking trail event on the Swabian Alb, held annually on the second weekend of October in Trochtelfingen. The event offers two route distances of approximately 9 km and 13 km, leading through the gentle hills of the Sonnenalb and marked with arrows. Participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere, a drinks station along the route, and a raffle with valuable prizes. The event is open to everyone, with or without poles, and encourages people of all ages to enjoy being active.
course_highlights: Two route distances: approximately 9 km short course and 13 km long course
The gentle hills of the Sonnenalb and an extensive network of trails
A drinks station along the route and marked courses
additional: Race pack distribution from 08:30 at Tommis Sportshop. Start window for the 13 km loop until 10:30. The finish closes at 13:00; no timing is available after that. Participants receive chip timing and an online certificate. There are no age-group or category rankings, only a finisher list for women and men. Trophies for the three largest groups. Raffle with high-quality prizes from 13:15. Refreshments include a standing snack bar, coffee, and cake from 10:00, provided by TSV Trochtelfingen. The event starts and finishes at Tommis Sportshop in Trochtelfingen. Children up to age 12 can participate for free. Groups of 10 or more receive a discount. The courses are marked and there is a drinks station. The event is open to all ages and fitness levels.

name: Wendlandmarathon
location: Kolborn bei Lüchow, Lüchow-Dannenberg, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The Wendlandmarathon Kolborn is a traditional road race in Lüchow, Lower Saxony, held since 1993. The event offers a wide range of distances, from the marathon and half marathon to short children’s races, appealing to both distance runners and families. The course is measured to AIMS/IAAF standards and has kilometre markers and refreshment stations. Practical facilities for participants include parking, showers, changing rooms, certificates and finisher medals for children.
course_highlights: Road race with a course measured to AIMS/IAAF standards
Kilometre markers and refreshment stations along the course
A variety of distances from 400 m to the marathon
additional: The marathon and marathon relay start in the morning, followed by the half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races. Registration is available online in advance or in person on race weekend. Timing is handled by the organiser. Refreshments are available at the finish. Certificates are printed and made available online. Course distance up to 42.2 km, refreshments along the course, finisher medals, parking, showers, changing rooms, registration online or in person

name: II Korczyński Półmaraton Górski XI Korczyński Bieg i Nordic Walking "Do Prządek"
description: The 2nd Korczyna Mountain Half Marathon and the 11th Korczyna “Do Prządek” Runs and Nordic Walking event takes place in the scenic areas of Korczyna and Czarnorzeki. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, bringing together experienced runners and Nordic walking enthusiasts. The routes follow mountain trails, offering participants close contact with nature and off-road challenges. Registration is online, and the organizers prioritize a welcoming atmosphere and participant safety.
course_highlights: Mountain routes around Korczyna and Czarnorzeki
Scenic landscapes and natural trails
Routes suited to runners and Nordic walkers
additional: Registration is online via the TIMEKEEPER platform. The event takes place on 10 October 2026 in Czarnorzeki. The regulations are available to download from the organizer’s website. The event includes a half-marathon, a run, and Nordic Walking, with online registration available. The event date is 10 October 2026.

name: 12. PKO Cracovia Półmaraton Królewski
description: The Cracovia Royal Half Marathon is an international half marathon held in Kraków, a city with a thousand-year history and the former seat of Polish kings. The race attracts thousands of participants from around the world, combining a passion for sport with sightseeing at historic sites. The finish inside the impressive TAURON Arena Kraków delivers unforgettable excitement and cheers from the spectators. The event is part of the Royal Running Triad and the Polish Half Marathon Crown, underscoring its prestige and standing among runners.
course_highlights: The course runs through the streets of Kraków, a city with a rich history and royal heritage
The finish is inside Poland’s largest indoor sports and entertainment venue, TAURON Arena Kraków
The race is part of the prestigious Royal Running Triad and the Polish Half Marathon Crown
additional: Race packs are collected at designated locations in accordance with the Run with Class rules. In 2026, the race is part of the Royal Running Triad, where participants can earn a special medal and trophy for completing all three races in the series. The event includes various running categories, including the half marathon and other distances, with registration available online and at the race office. The race takes place in an urban setting, with routes passing through attractive parts of Kraków.

name: Wzgórzowa Trzynastka
location: Chrząszczyce, Opole County, Opole Voivodeship, Poland
description: Wzgórzowa Trzynastka is a 13 km trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of Chrząszczyce. The route follows municipal roads and crosses a military training area between Chrząszczyce, Domecko, Opole-Winów and Górki. The event promotes a healthy, active lifestyle and running as a form of recreation. In addition to the individual race, it also features relay races, a uniformed services category and a family team orienteering challenge. The start and race office are in Chrząszczyce, and the participant limit is 300.
course_highlights: The route runs along municipal roads and through a military training area
Picturesque surroundings of Chrząszczyce, Domecko, Opole-Winów and Górki
Time limit of 120 minutes to complete the 13 km course
additional: Participant limit: 300. The start and race office are at 3 Szkolna Street in Chrząszczyce, open on race day from 10:00 to 13:00. A technical running shirt can be ordered until 28 September and collected with the race pack. Participants in the individual race must be over 16; those under 18 must have written parental consent. Trail race, relays, children's orienteering game, fundraising for the stadium.

name: 30 Bieg Przełajowy o Nóż Komandosa
location: Stadion miejski, Lubliniec, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 30th Commando’s Knife Cross-Country Race is a prestigious running event held under the honorary patronage of the Bishop of the Polish Military, Dr. Wiesław Lechowicz. The race takes place at the Municipal Stadium in Lubliniec and is intended for soldiers and uniformed-service officers, who compete in full field uniform. The event aims to determine the uniformed services’ cross-country champions, promote mass-participation running, and foster integration among uniformed-service communities. The course runs along the street in front of the stadium and finishes on the stadium track. The women’s race starts at 12:00 and the men’s at 12:27.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Lubliniec
The course follows the street in front of the stadium and finishes on the stadium track
Runners compete in full field uniform and special tactical boots
additional: All participants compete in the OPEN category, with no age-group divisions. Full long-sleeved field uniform is required, along with special tactical boots that rise above the ankle and are in military colours. Additional civilian clothing is allowed only if its colours match the uniform. The race judge decides whether it is permitted. Participants must be active-duty or reserve soldiers or uniformed-service officers. Cross-country terrain; online registration; participant limit through 15.09.2026; entry fees from 150 zł to 200 zł; start at 12:00 at the Municipal Stadium in Lubliniec.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The 17th Mysłowice Grand Prix is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, combining a passion for running with an active lifestyle. The event promotes health, inclusion and the joy of movement, welcoming runners of different ages and experience levels. The races take place in the scenic surroundings of Mysłowice, creating a friendly atmosphere and a running community. Participants can compete in running, Nordic walking and canicross events, and participation in the Grand Prix is free.
course_highlights: The routes run through the forest by the Bolina River
A variety of events: running, Nordic walking and canicross
The scenic surroundings of Mysłowice are ideal for recreation and competition
additional: Registration for the Grand Prix series is available only at the Race Office on race day. Participation is free. Competitors come from various cities and clubs, and women make up more than 27% of participants. The organizers provide solid event management and foster a sense of community among runners. The event includes several dates in 2026, bringing the community together and promoting an active lifestyle.

name: Piwna Mila

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata za Piwną Milę wynosi 50 zł

description: The Beer Mile is a unique race over a flexible distance of 1,700 to 2,000 metres and the main event on the third day of the Sun Festival in Wąsowo. Participants start by drinking one beer, and beer refreshment stations are located along the course approximately every 500 metres. This sporting celebration brings together runners, spectators and families, offering a unique atmosphere and a special finisher’s medal.
course_highlights: Flexible distance of 1,700–2,000 m
Beer refreshment stations approximately every 500 m
The race starts with drinking a beer
additional: The race pack includes a race bib with a timing chip and 4 craft beers along the course. The race bib must be worn on the front of the clothing and must not be covered or modified. A T-shirt can be ordered when paying for the race bib in the Runner’s Panel. The race office is open on 14.08.2026 (17:00–19:00), 15.08.2026 (7:00–11:00) and 16.08.2026 (11:00–11:45). Flexible distance of 1,700–2,000 m, beer along the course, online registration from 1 January 2026 to 12 August 2026, T-shirt can be ordered when paying the entry fee.

name: UltraKotlina
location: Szklarska Poręba, Jelenia Góra County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: UltraKotlina is a mountain ultramarathon held in the Jelenia Góra Valley, covering the scenic ranges of the Rudawy Janowickie, Kaczawskie Mountains, Izera Mountains and Karkonosze. The event offers six distances from 15 km to 142 km, as well as a relay, with the finish in Szklarska Poręba. The routes are marked and follow well-known trails as well as quiet, less-traveled paths, allowing both experienced ultrarunners and beginners to enjoy every kilometre. The event is also an opportunity to bring the running community together and promote the region.
course_highlights: The routes pass through four mountain ranges: the Rudawy Janowickie, Kaczawskie Mountains, Izera Mountains and Karkonosze
The route is marked with reflective tape, chalk spray and directional signs
Scenic views and the chance to admire the Jelenia Góra Valley from various vantage points
additional: The race pack can be collected at race headquarters or just before the start. The organizer provides buses to the start from the finish. The route is marked with reflective tape, chalk spray and signs. Race headquarters operates at various locations and times on 9–11 October. Time limits for the individual distances range from 3 to 30 hours. The course is verified at checkpoints, where runners must confirm their race number. Distances include ultramarathons and trail running, with mountain routes and technical checkpoints; the event takes place in October 2026.

name: XIV Biegi Przyjaźni
description: The Friendship Run is one of the events in the Kaszuby Biegają series, the largest running event in northern Poland. The race takes place in the picturesque area around Skrzeszewo, giving participants the chance to enjoy an active day and discover the charms of Kashubia. The series attracts runners of different ages and abilities, promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing the local community together.
course_highlights: The course runs through the picturesque landscapes of Kashubia
The race takes place in a natural, welcoming setting
The event is part of the Kaszuby Biegają series, the largest running event in northern Poland
additional: The event will take place on 11 October 2026, promoting a healthy lifestyle and local community spirit. Participants can expect a medal, prizes, prize draws, and refreshments.

name: Javornícka stovka

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Poplatok za štart jedného účastníka je 79 EUR.

description: Javornícka stovka is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance hike held in the Javorníky region. Runners cross challenging mountain terrain with several checkpoints and time limits. The event is intended for experienced runners seeking a challenge in beautiful natural surroundings. The start and registration are in Čadca, and the finish is in Lysá pod Makytou. The organizers emphasize safety, mandatory equipment, and medical assistance along the entire route.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain in the Javorníky with several checkpoints
Finish in Lysá pod Makytou
A generous 27-hour time limit, with several intermediate cut-off times
additional: Participant registration takes place at the House of Culture in Čadca on Matičné námestie on Friday evening and Saturday morning. The mass start is in Čadca at 07:00. The organizers provide baggage transport and drop bags at checkpoint K4. Medical assistance and safety are provided during the event. Accommodation is available in Čadca; participants can spend the night in the gym of an elementary school, where quiet hours are observed. The course consists of 80% forest roads, 5% asphalt, and 15% meadows. Mandatory equipment includes a headlamp, reflective elements, hydration, and a first-aid kit. Registration closed on 26 September 2025.

description: GARMIN Run through the Súľov Rocks is a traditional running race set in the beautiful surroundings of the Súľov Rocks, offering three courses of varying lengths and difficulty. Runners make their way through scenic countryside, with views of rock formations and ridge trails. Aid stations are also provided along the course. The event is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children, who have separate categories and start times. It is organized by the Slovak Cycling Club CYKLO TOUR Súľov - Hradná, which provides thorough preparation and support for participants.
course_highlights: The course passes through the scenic Súľov Rocks, with views of rock formations and ridge trails
Up to 850 metres of elevation gain on the longest, 17 km course
Three aid stations along the course, plus separate children’s categories with their own starts
additional: The participation limit is 1,200 runners for the main race and 350 children for the children’s race. The children’s race is free of charge. Registration is valid only after the entry fee has been paid. In-person registration and payment are available on the day before the race starts, provided the participation limit has not been reached. Children’s category starts take place between the main race starts. The course includes forest trails and short asphalt sections. Registration is available through the official websites. The event is known for its beautiful scenery and atmosphere.

name: Grand Prix – Cabaj-Čápor
price_range: 10 € online, 15 € na mieste, zadarmo pre deti a niektoré kategórie
description: The Grand Prix Cabaj-Čápor is a traditional cross-country race in beautiful natural surroundings, held in the village of Cabaj-Čápor, starting at Salaš Cabaj. Runners can choose from several distances, including 10 km, 3 km and children’s races of 600 m and 1,000 m. The event is suitable for anyone who wants to enjoy sport in nature, whether to compete or simply for the pleasure of running. Registration is open and participant numbers are limited, so it is advisable to sign up early.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in the natural surroundings of Cabaj-Čápor
10 km and 3 km races, plus children’s races of 600 m and 1,000 m
Start at Salaš Cabaj
additional: Race check-in begins at 9:00. Participant numbers are limited. Participants in the main and hobby races receive a finisher’s award. The event takes place on 10 October 2026. Online registration is available, and the race is suitable for all age groups and ability levels.

description: The Autumn Run of Michalovce Residents is a traditional running race in Michalovce, offering an opportunity for competitors of various age groups. The race takes place at the grounds of the 2nd Primary School at J. Švermu 6 and consists of a 400-metre children’s run and a 3-kilometre main run. The event is suitable for families and runners who want to enjoy the autumn atmosphere and sporting activities in a pleasant setting. The organizers provide refreshments and commemorative items for participants.
course_highlights: 400 m children’s run for children up to 9 years old
3 km main run consisting of 3 laps of 900 m each
Start and finish at the grounds of the 2nd Primary School, J. Švermu 6, Michalovce
additional: Competitors will receive commemorative items, and refreshments will be provided. Competitor check-in is from 08:00 to 09:15. The results announcement and medal awards are at 10:30. The children’s run (500 m) starts at 9:30, and the main run (3 km) at 9:45; on-site registration; categories for adults, children and seniors; the event is part of the autumn sports calendar.

name: Beh Myšľou
location: Archeoskanzene Nižná Myšľa, Nižná Myšľa, Slovakia
description: The Vyšná Myšľa Run is a running event organised by the Vyšná Myšľa Municipal Running Club and the Municipality of Vyšná Myšľa. The race takes place at the football field in Vyšná Myšľa, in Košice-okolie District. The children’s races start at 14:00 and the adults’ races at 16:00. Men and women can compete in various age categories, including a 2 x 3 km relay for pairs. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere for running in the village.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the football field in Vyšná Myšľa
2 x 3 km relay for pairs
Multiple age categories for men and women
additional: Entry fees are waived for Men E, Women I, members of BKO Vyšná Myšľa, residents of Vyšná Myšľa and children. The children’s races start at 14:00 and the adults’ races at 16:00. Race distances range from 350 m to 8 km. Registration is available online or on site, and the event is suitable for all age groups.

name: Beh za zdravie – Kuchajda
description: Run for Health - Kuchajda is a charity running event taking place on October 11, 2026, at Kuchajda in Bratislava. The event combines sport with support for health and the community, aiming to help disadvantaged people and organizations through physical activity. Participants can run, jog at an easy pace, or walk, in a wonderful atmosphere filled with inspiring stories and solidarity. Run for Health is open to all ages and fitness levels, while also supporting charity projects with a real impact.
course_highlights: Running event at Kuchajda in Bratislava
Supporting health and the community through sport
An opportunity to take part regardless of age or fitness level
additional: The event is a charity fundraiser supporting disadvantaged people and organizations. Children, adults, and older people can take part by running, jogging at an easy pace, or walking. The organizers offer the opportunity to volunteer and contribute to the success of the event. The event takes place at Kuchajda in Bratislava and supports health and socially disadvantaged groups. Registration details are not specified.

name: Beh ulicami Krompách
organizer: Mesto Krompachy, Komisia kultúry a športu pri MsZ v Krompachoch

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Štartovné: 5,- € okrem žiakov, dorastencov a pretekárov nad  60 rokov

description: The Run Through the Streets of Krompachy is a traditional running race in the town of Krompachy, offering categories for children, youth, juniors, men and women in various age groups. The race takes place in front of the municipal office building and is organized by the Town of Krompachy and the Culture and Sports Commission of the Municipal Council in Krompachy. The starts are split between the children’s categories and youth at 9:30 and adults at 11:00. The entry fee is a symbolic €5, except for pupils, youth athletes and runners over 60. The race is suitable for the general public and supports sporting life in the region.
course_highlights: The race runs through the streets of Krompachy
Start and finish in front of the municipal office building
Categories for all age groups, from children to seniors
additional: The starts are at 9:30 for the children’s categories and youth, and 11:00 for adults. Categories are divided in detail by age and gender, including several age groups for men and women. The event is organized by the Town of Krompachy and the Culture and Sports Commission of the Municipal Council in Krompachy. The event takes place in October, with various categories and starts from 9:00; registration is possible by contacting the organizer. The course is likely urban and on roads.
